title: 高層建築液壓爬模施工
summary: 液壓自動爬模與滑模不同：每層混凝土澆置後先硬化，再由油壓缸把模板與多層工作平台沿爬升軌道推到上一層，荷載經由預埋錨錐傳入早齡牆體。本課以哈里發塔的 226 組自爬單元與 3 天樓層循環、樂天世界塔的核心筒與巨柱爬模為例，說明循環時程、錨點荷載路徑、油壓機構、模板側壓、平台荷重、爬升停檢點、早齡強度驗收、同步監測、錨孔處理與拆除交接。
summaryEn: Hydraulic automatic climbing forms differ from slipforms: each lift of concrete hardens first, then hydraulic cylinders push the forms and multi-level working platforms along climbing rails to the next storey, with loads passing through cast-in anchor cones into young walls. Using the 226 self-climbing units and three-day floor cycle at Burj Khalifa and the core and megacolumn climbing forms at Lotte World Tower, the course covers cycle time, the anchor load path, hydraulics, form pressure, platform loads, climbing hold points, early-strength acceptance, synchronisation monitoring, anchor-hole treatment and dismantling handover.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 規劃練習：一座 180 層次澆置、每層 3.7 m 的核心筒採用自動爬模。標準循環 72 h，總計 180×3 = 540 天。每個爬升單元垂直荷載 60 kN、偏心 1.2 m，錨點水平力偶 36 kN；錨點拉拔基本強度在 10 MPa 時約 58 kN，因此放行強度訂為 10 MPa。油壓缸缸徑 125 mm、油壓 32 MPa，推力約 393 kN，爬升 3.7 m、速度 0.2 m/min 約 18.5 min。牆模側壓以 R = 2 m/h、20°C 計約 48.7 kPa，繫結 1.2 m 間距時每支約 70 kN。冬季時早齡強度在 20 h 只有約 8.0 MPa，若每層需再等 6.6 h，循環變為約 78.6 h，180 層多出約 180×6.6/24 ≈ 50 天；若改用自充填混凝土，側壓升為約 88.8 kPa，繫結力增為約 128 kN，模板與繫結必須重新設計。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的施工計畫。
workedExample.textEn: Planning exercise: a core cast in 180 lifts of 3.7 m uses automatic climbing forms. The standard cycle is 72 h, so 180×3 = 540 days in total. Each climbing unit carries 60 kN at 1.2 m eccentricity, giving a 36 kN anchor couple; the basic anchor pull-out strength at 10 MPa is about 58 kN, so the release strength is set at 10 MPa. A 125 mm cylinder at 32 MPa gives about 393 kN and climbs 3.7 m at 0.2 m/min in about 18.5 min. Wall-form pressure at R = 2 m/h and 20°C is about 48.7 kPa, about 70 kN per tie at 1.2 m spacing. In winter, early strength at 20 h is only about 8.0 MPa; waiting another 6.6 h each storey stretches the cycle to about 78.6 h and adds about 180×6.6/24 ≈ 50 days over 180 lifts. Switching to self-consolidating concrete raises pressure to about 88.8 kPa and tie force to about 128 kN, so forms and ties must be redesigned. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building's construction plan.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自動爬模的工序與樓層循環」與「荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle" and "Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自動爬模的工序與樓層循環：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樓層循環時程」如何影響高層建築液壓爬模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floor cycle time” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydraulic climbing-form construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 自動爬模把核心筒施工拆成重複的樓層循環：綁紮鋼筋與安裝埋件、合模、澆置、等待混凝土達到可拆模與可承載錨點的強度、拆模後以油壓缸把模板與平台爬升一層、清理並調整模板，再進入下一循環。與滑模相比，它容許每層停下來檢查鋼筋與埋件，牆厚變化與退縮也較容易處理，但速度受限於循環中最慢的工序。哈里發塔以 180 次澆置、每次 3.70 m 高完成核心筒與翼牆，標準循環為每層 3 天。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樓層循環時程」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Automatic climbing breaks core construction into repeated floor cycles: fixing rebar and embeds, closing the forms, pouring, waiting for the concrete to reach the strength needed to strike and to carry the anchors, climbing forms and platforms one storey with hydraulic cylinders after striking, then cleaning and adjusting the forms before the next cycle. Compared with slipforming it allows a stop at every level to inspect rebar and embeds and handles changes in wall thickness and setbacks more easily, but its speed is limited by the slowest activity in the cycle. Burj Khalifa completed its core and wing walls in 180 pours of 3.70 m each on a standard three-day floor cycle. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Floor cycle time” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：循環時間 T = 鋼筋埋件 24 h + 合模 8 h + 澆置 8 h + 等強度 24 h + 拆模爬升清理 8 h = 72 h（3 天）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Cycle time T = rebar and embeds 24 h + closing forms 8 h + pouring 8 h + strength wait 24 h + strike, climb and clean 8 h = 72 h (three days).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樓層循環時程」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Floor cycle time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自動爬模的工序與樓層循環
knowledge.titleEn: Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle

knowledge.textEn: Automatic climbing breaks core construction into repeated floor cycles: fixing rebar and embeds, closing the forms, pouring, waiting for the concrete to reach the strength needed to strike and to carry the anchors, climbing forms and platforms one storey with hydraulic cylinders after striking, then cleaning and adjusting the forms before the next cycle. Compared with slipforming it allows a stop at every level to inspect rebar and embeds and handles changes in wall thickness and setbacks more easily, but its speed is limited by the slowest activity in the cycle.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自動爬模的工序與樓層循環」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle" is correct?
options: 爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。
自動爬模把核心筒施工拆成重複的樓層循環：綁紮鋼筋與安裝埋件、合模、澆置、等待混凝土達到可拆模與可承載錨點的強度、拆模後以油壓缸把模板與平台爬升一層、清理並調整模板，再進入下一循環。
錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。
optionsEn: The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb.

Automatic climbing breaks core construction into repeated floor cycles: fixing rebar and embeds, closing the forms, pouring, waiting for the concrete to reach the strength needed to strike and to carry the anchors, climbing forms and platforms one storey with hydraulic cylinders after striking, then cleaning and adjusting the forms before the next cycle.
If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters.
quiz.explanation: 自動爬模把核心筒施工拆成重複的樓層循環：綁紮鋼筋與安裝埋件、合模、澆置、等待混凝土達到可拆模與可承載錨點的強度、拆模後以油壓缸把模板與平台爬升一層、清理並調整模板，再進入下一循環。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Automatic climbing breaks core construction into repeated floor cycles: fixing rebar and embeds, closing the forms, pouring, waiting for the concrete to reach the strength needed to strike and to carry the anchors, climbing forms and platforms one storey with hydraulic cylinders after striking, then cleaning and adjusting the forms before the next cycle. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 自動爬模的工序與樓層循環：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓層循環時程」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floor cycle time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：循環時間 T = 鋼筋埋件 24 h + 合模 8 h + 澆置 8 h + 等強度 24 h + 拆模爬升清理 8 h = 72 h（3 天）。180 次澆置共 540 天；若以較高的混凝土溫度把等強度時間縮為 16 h，T = 64 h ≈ 2.67 天，總計 480 天，節省約 60 天。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Cycle time T = rebar and embeds 24 h + closing forms 8 h + pouring 8 h + strength wait 24 h + strike, climb and clean 8 h = 72 h (three days). 180 pours take 540 days; cutting the strength wait to 16 h with warmer concrete gives T = 64 h ≈ 2.67 days and 480 days in total, saving about 60 days. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以線性排程或網圖模擬每一樓層循環，找出關鍵工序並記錄實際各工序時間；每週比較計畫與實際循環，若某工序持續超時，檢討人力、塔吊時段或混凝土配比，而不是壓縮等強度時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Simulate each floor cycle with a linear schedule or network, identify the critical activity and record actual durations; compare planned and actual cycles weekly and, if one activity keeps overrunning, review labour, crane time or the mix rather than squeezing the strength wait.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 循環時間 T = 鋼筋埋件 24 h + 合模 8 h + 澆置 8 h + 等強度 24 h + 拆模爬升清理 8 h = 72 h（3 天）。180 次澆置共 540 天；若以較高的混凝土溫度把等強度時間縮為 16 h，T = 64 h ≈ 2.67 天，總計 480 天，節省約 60 天。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Cycle time T = rebar and embeds 24 h + closing forms 8 h + pouring 8 h + strength wait 24 h + strike, climb and clean 8 h = 72 h (three days). 180 pours take 540 days; cutting the strength wait to 16 h with warmer concrete gives T = 64 h ≈ 2.67 days and 480 days in total, saving about 60 days. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「自動爬模的工序與樓層循環」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle", which statement holds?
options: 模板側壓只跟澆置高度有關，與澆置速度和配比無關。
地面風不大，代表高空爬模也可以安全爬升。
循環時間 T = 鋼筋埋件 24 h + 合模 8 h + 澆置 8 h + 等強度 24 h + 拆模爬升清理 8 h = 72 h（3 天）。
optionsEn: Form pressure depends only on lift height, not on pour rate or mix.
Light wind at ground level means the climbing form can safely climb at height.
Cycle time T = rebar and embeds 24 h + closing forms 8 h + pouring 8 h + strength wait 24 h + strike, climb and clean 8 h = 72 h (three days).
quiz.explanation: 循環時間 T = 鋼筋埋件 24 h + 合模 8 h + 澆置 8 h + 等強度 24 h + 拆模爬升清理 8 h = 72 h（3 天）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Cycle time T = rebar and embeds 24 h + closing forms 8 h + pouring 8 h + strength wait 24 h + strike, climb and clean 8 h = 72 h (three days). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自動爬模的工序與樓層循環：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓層循環時程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Floor cycle time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以線性排程或網圖模擬每一樓層循環，找出關鍵工序並記錄實際各工序時間；每週比較計畫與實際循環，若某工序持續超時，檢討人力、塔吊時段或混凝土配比，而不是壓縮等強度時間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Simulate each floor cycle with a linear schedule or network, identify the critical activity and record actual durations; compare planned and actual cycles weekly and, if one activity keeps overrunning, review labour, crane time or the mix rather than squeezing the strength wait. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以樓層循環表管理進度，標示每一工序的人員、塔吊時段與停檢點，並在開工前與爬模廠商確認牆厚變化、退縮與開口的改裝次數；哈里發塔施工中經歷超過 30 次平面配置變更，改裝要提前設計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Manage progress with a floor-cycle chart showing crews, crane slots and hold points for each activity, and agree the number of modifications for wall-thickness changes, setbacks and openings with the climbing-form supplier before starting; Burj Khalifa went through more than 30 layout changes, so modifications must be designed in advance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為追趕進度在混凝土強度不足時就拆模爬升，錨點周圍混凝土局部破壞，平台下沉或傾斜；或在循環中臨時插入未規劃的牆厚變化，模板需現場改裝而打亂後續數層的節奏。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Climbing before the concrete is strong enough to catch up on programme can crush concrete around the anchors and let the platform sink or tilt; inserting an unplanned change in wall thickness mid-cycle forces site modifications to the forms and disrupts the rhythm of several following storeys. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以線性排程或網圖模擬每一樓層循環，找出關鍵工序並記錄實際各工序時間；每週比較計畫與實際循環，若某工序持續超時，檢討人力、塔吊時段或混凝土配比，而不是壓縮等強度時間。
knowledge.textEn: Simulate each floor cycle with a linear schedule or network, identify the critical activity and record actual durations; compare planned and actual cycles weekly and, if one activity keeps overrunning, review labour, crane time or the mix rather than squeezing the strength wait.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以樓層循環表管理進度，標示每一工序的人員、塔吊時段與停檢點，並在開工前與爬模廠商確認牆厚變化、退縮與開口的改裝次數；哈里發塔施工中經歷超過 30 次平面配置變更，改裝要提前設計。
knowledge.textEn: Manage progress with a floor-cycle chart showing crews, crane slots and hold points for each activity, and agree the number of modifications for wall-thickness changes, setbacks and openings with the climbing-form supplier before starting; Burj Khalifa went through more than 30 layout changes, so modifications must be designed in advance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「自動爬模的工序與樓層循環」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle"?
options: 以線性排程或網圖模擬每一樓層循環，找出關鍵工序並記錄實際各工序時間。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要控制面板沒有警報，平台就一定是水平且所有單元都已鎖定。
optionsEn: Simulate each floor cycle with a linear schedule or network, identify the critical activity and record actual durations.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the control panel shows no alarm, the platform must be level and every unit locked.
quiz.explanation: 以線性排程或網圖模擬每一樓層循環，找出關鍵工序並記錄實際各工序時間；每週比較計畫與實際循環，若某工序持續超時，檢討人力、塔吊時段或混凝土配比，而不是壓縮等強度時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Simulate each floor cycle with a linear schedule or network, identify the critical activity and record actual durations; compare planned and actual cycles weekly and, if one activity keeps overrunning, review labour, crane time or the mix rather than squeezing the strength wait. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 自動爬模的工序與樓層循環：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓層循環時程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Floor cycle time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為追趕進度在混凝土強度不足時就拆模爬升，錨點周圍混凝土局部破壞，平台下沉或傾斜；或在循環中臨時插入未規劃的牆厚變化，模板需現場改裝而打亂後續數層的節奏。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Climbing before the concrete is strong enough to catch up on programme can crush concrete around the anchors and let the platform sink or tilt; inserting an unplanned change in wall thickness mid-cycle forces site modifications to the forms and disrupts the rhythm of several following storeys. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：哈里發塔以 180 次澆置、每次 3.70 m 高完成核心筒與翼牆，標準循環為每層 3 天。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Burj Khalifa completed its core and wing walls in 180 pours of 3.70 m each on a standard three-day floor cycle.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為追趕進度在混凝土強度不足時就拆模爬升，錨點周圍混凝土局部破壞，平台下沉或傾斜；或在循環中臨時插入未規劃的牆厚變化，模板需現場改裝而打亂後續數層的節奏。
knowledge.textEn: Climbing before the concrete is strong enough to catch up on programme can crush concrete around the anchors and let the platform sink or tilt; inserting an unplanned change in wall thickness mid-cycle forces site modifications to the forms and disrupts the rhythm of several following storeys.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自動爬模的工序與樓層循環」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
為追趕進度在混凝土強度不足時就拆模爬升，錨點周圍混凝土局部破壞，平台下沉或傾斜；或在循環中臨時插入未規劃的牆厚變化，模板需現場改裝而打亂後續數層的節奏。
錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Climbing before the concrete is strong enough to catch up on programme can crush concrete around the anchors and let the platform sink or tilt.
If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters.
quiz.explanation: 為追趕進度在混凝土強度不足時就拆模爬升，錨點周圍混凝土局部破壞，平台下沉或傾斜；或在循環中臨時插入未規劃的牆厚變化，模板需現場改裝而打亂後續數層的節奏。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Climbing before the concrete is strong enough to catch up on programme can crush concrete around the anchors and let the platform sink or tilt; inserting an unplanned change in wall thickness mid-cycle forces site modifications to the forms and disrupts the rhythm of several following storeys. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「錨錐與爬升靴」如何影響高層建築液壓爬模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Anchor cones and climbing shoes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydraulic climbing-form construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 爬模的全部荷載，包括模板、多層平台、布料機、材料、人員與風力，都經由澆置時預埋的錨錐與螺桿，傳到固定在牆上的爬升靴，再進入剛硬化不久的牆體。平台通常懸挑在牆外，因此錨點同時承受垂直力與由偏心造成的水平拉壓力偶；錨點的承載力取決於混凝土當時的強度、埋置深度、邊距與周邊補強筋。PERI ACS Core 400 型錄要求牆厚至少 30 cm 並在錨點周圍加補強筋，正是為了確保錨固區不會先破壞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「錨錐與爬升靴」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: All loads from the climbing system, including forms, multi-level platforms, placing booms, materials, people and wind, pass through anchor cones and bolts cast into the previous lift, into climbing shoes fixed to the wall and then into wall concrete that has only recently hardened. Platforms usually cantilever outside the wall, so anchors carry both vertical force and a horizontal tension–compression couple from the eccentricity; anchor capacity depends on concrete strength at the time, embedment depth, edge distance and local reinforcement. The PERI ACS Core 400 brochure requires walls at least 30 cm thick with extra reinforcement around the climbing anchors precisely so that the anchorage zone does not fail first. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Anchor cones and climbing shoes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每個爬升單元垂直荷載 V = 60 kN、偏心 e = 1.2 m，彎矩 M = 72 kN·m；上錨點與下支承相距 2.0 m，水平力偶 H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Each climbing unit carries V = 60 kN at e = 1.2 m eccentricity, M = 72 kN·m; with 2.0 m between top anchor and lower bearing, the horizontal couple is H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「錨錐與爬升靴」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Anchor cones and climbing shoes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體
knowledge.titleEn: Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls
knowledge.text: 爬模的全部荷載，包括模板、多層平台、布料機、材料、人員與風力，都經由澆置時預埋的錨錐與螺桿，傳到固定在牆上的爬升靴，再進入剛硬化不久的牆體。平台通常懸挑在牆外，因此錨點同時承受垂直力與由偏心造成的水平拉壓力偶；錨點的承載力取決於混凝土當時的強度、埋置深度、邊距與周邊補強筋。
knowledge.textEn: All loads from the climbing system, including forms, multi-level platforms, placing booms, materials, people and wind, pass through anchor cones and bolts cast into the previous lift, into climbing shoes fixed to the wall and then into wall concrete that has only recently hardened. Platforms usually cantilever outside the wall, so anchors carry both vertical force and a horizontal tension–compression couple from the eccentricity; anchor capacity depends on concrete strength at the time, embedment depth, edge distance and local reinforcement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls" is correct?
options: 錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。
油壓缸頂升力很大，所以平台上多放材料也不會影響爬升安全。
爬模的全部荷載，包括模板、多層平台、布料機、材料、人員與風力，都經由澆置時預埋的錨錐與螺桿，傳到固定在牆上的爬升靴，再進入剛硬化不久的牆體。
optionsEn: If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters.
The cylinders are so powerful that extra material on the platform does not affect climbing safety.

All loads from the climbing system, including forms, multi-level platforms, placing booms, materials, people and wind, pass through anchor cones and bolts cast into the previous lift, into climbing shoes fixed to the wall and then into wall concrete that has only recently hardened.
quiz.explanation: 爬模的全部荷載，包括模板、多層平台、布料機、材料、人員與風力，都經由澆置時預埋的錨錐與螺桿，傳到固定在牆上的爬升靴，再進入剛硬化不久的牆體。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: All loads from the climbing system, including forms, multi-level platforms, placing booms, materials, people and wind, pass through anchor cones and bolts cast into the previous lift, into climbing shoes fixed to the wall and then into wall concrete that has only recently hardened. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨錐與爬升靴」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Anchor cones and climbing shoes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每個爬升單元垂直荷載 V = 60 kN、偏心 e = 1.2 m，彎矩 M = 72 kN·m；上錨點與下支承相距 2.0 m，水平力偶 H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN。單一錨點混凝土錐體拉拔基本強度 N_b = k√f_c·h_ef^1.5（k = 10、h_ef = 150 mm）：f_c = 10 MPa 時約 58 kN，20 MPa 時約 82 kN，強度加倍但承載只增加約 √2 倍。數值為教學假設，實際值以錨具製造商的認證資料為準。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Each climbing unit carries V = 60 kN at e = 1.2 m eccentricity, M = 72 kN·m; with 2.0 m between top anchor and lower bearing, the horizontal couple is H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN. A single anchor's basic concrete-cone pull-out strength N_b = k√f_c·h_ef^1.5 with k = 10 and h_ef = 150 mm is about 58 kN at f_c = 10 MPa and 82 kN at 20 MPa: doubling strength raises capacity only by about √2. Values are teaching assumptions; real values come from the anchor maker's approvals. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：爬模設計計算書要列出每個錨點在澆置、爬升與停放三種狀態下的拉力、剪力與所需混凝土強度，並引用錨具製造商的技術認證；現場在爬升前確認錨錐埋置深度、邊距與補強筋，並抽檢錨點周圍有無裂縫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The climbing-form calculations must list each anchor's tension and shear in the pouring, climbing and parked states with the concrete strength required, citing the anchor manufacturer's technical approval; on site confirm cone embedment, edge distance and local reinforcement before each climb and check the concrete around anchors for cracks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每個爬升單元垂直荷載 V = 60 kN、偏心 e = 1.2 m，彎矩 M = 72 kN·m；上錨點與下支承相距 2.0 m，水平力偶 H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN。單一錨點混凝土錐體拉拔基本強度 N_b = k√f_c·h_ef^1.5（k = 10、h_ef = 150 mm）：f_c = 10 MPa 時約 58 kN，20 MPa 時約 82 kN，強度加倍但承載只增加約 √2 倍。數值為教學假設，實際值以錨具製造商的認證資料為準。
knowledge.textEn: Each climbing unit carries V = 60 kN at e = 1.2 m eccentricity, M = 72 kN·m; with 2.0 m between top anchor and lower bearing, the horizontal couple is H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN. A single anchor's basic concrete-cone pull-out strength N_b = k√f_c·h_ef^1.5 with k = 10 and h_ef = 150 mm is about 58 kN at f_c = 10 MPa and 82 kN at 20 MPa: doubling strength raises capacity only by about √2. Values are teaching assumptions; real values come from the anchor maker's approvals.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls", which statement holds?
options: 每個爬升單元垂直荷載 V = 60 kN、偏心 e = 1.2 m，彎矩 M = 72 kN·m。
爬模平台很大，所以任何位置都可以堆放材料。
核心筒用的是高強度混凝土，所以一天後一定已經足夠讓錨點承載。
optionsEn: Each climbing unit carries V = 60 kN at e = 1.2 m eccentricity, M = 72 kN·m.
Climbing-form platforms are large, so materials can be stacked anywhere on them.
Core walls use high-strength concrete, so after one day the anchors can certainly carry load.
quiz.explanation: 每個爬升單元垂直荷載 V = 60 kN、偏心 e = 1.2 m，彎矩 M = 72 kN·m；上錨點與下支承相距 2.0 m，水平力偶 H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Each climbing unit carries V = 60 kN at e = 1.2 m eccentricity, M = 72 kN·m; with 2.0 m between top anchor and lower bearing, the horizontal couple is H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨錐與爬升靴」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anchor cones and climbing shoes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 爬模設計計算書要列出每個錨點在澆置、爬升與停放三種狀態下的拉力、剪力與所需混凝土強度，並引用錨具製造商的技術認證；現場在爬升前確認錨錐埋置深度、邊距與補強筋，並抽檢錨點周圍有無裂縫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The climbing-form calculations must list each anchor's tension and shear in the pouring, climbing and parked states with the concrete strength required, citing the anchor manufacturer's technical approval; on site confirm cone embedment, edge distance and local reinforcement before each climb and check the concrete around anchors for cracks. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：錨點位置要在核心筒施工圖上與開口、埋件與鋼筋衝突一併檢查，錨錐安裝列為合模前檢查項目；爬升前的混凝土強度需求應以數字寫在每層的爬升許可單上。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check anchor positions against openings, embeds and rebar on the core shop drawings, make cone installation a pre-closing inspection item, and write the required concrete strength as a number on each storey's climbing permit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錨錐被振動棒碰歪或埋得太淺，或錨點落在牆體開口邊緣，混凝土錐體拉拔破壞使爬升靴脫落，平台單點失去支承而傾斜；牆體太薄或錨點區缺補強筋時，錨點周圍出現放射狀裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A cone knocked askew by a vibrator or set too shallow, or an anchor placed at the edge of an opening, can fail by concrete-cone pull-out so a climbing shoe tears off and the platform tilts on a lost support; walls too thin or anchors without local reinforcement show radial cracks around the anchors. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 爬模設計計算書要列出每個錨點在澆置、爬升與停放三種狀態下的拉力、剪力與所需混凝土強度，並引用錨具製造商的技術認證；現場在爬升前確認錨錐埋置深度、邊距與補強筋，並抽檢錨點周圍有無裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: The climbing-form calculations must list each anchor's tension and shear in the pouring, climbing and parked states with the concrete strength required, citing the anchor manufacturer's technical approval; on site confirm cone embedment, edge distance and local reinforcement before each climb and check the concrete around anchors for cracks.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 錨點位置要在核心筒施工圖上與開口、埋件與鋼筋衝突一併檢查，錨錐安裝列為合模前檢查項目；爬升前的混凝土強度需求應以數字寫在每層的爬升許可單上。
knowledge.textEn: Check anchor positions against openings, embeds and rebar on the core shop drawings, make cone installation a pre-closing inspection item, and write the required concrete strength as a number on each storey's climbing permit.

steps.title: 荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨錐與爬升靴」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Anchor cones and climbing shoes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錨錐被振動棒碰歪或埋得太淺，或錨點落在牆體開口邊緣，混凝土錐體拉拔破壞使爬升靴脫落，平台單點失去支承而傾斜；牆體太薄或錨點區缺補強筋時，錨點周圍出現放射狀裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A cone knocked askew by a vibrator or set too shallow, or an anchor placed at the edge of an opening, can fail by concrete-cone pull-out so a climbing shoe tears off and the platform tilts on a lost support; walls too thin or anchors without local reinforcement show radial cracks around the anchors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：PERI ACS Core 400 型錄要求牆厚至少 30 cm 並在錨點周圍加補強筋，正是為了確保錨固區不會先破壞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The PERI ACS Core 400 brochure requires walls at least 30 cm thick with extra reinforcement around the climbing anchors precisely so that the anchorage zone does not fail first.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「液壓爬升機構與行程控制」與「模板側壓、澆置速度與繫結」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control" and "Form pressure, pour rate and ties": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 液壓爬升機構與行程控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「液壓油缸與爬升軌道」如何影響高層建築液壓爬模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic cylinders and climbing rails” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydraulic climbing-form construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 自爬系統以固定在爬升靴上的長行程油壓缸推動爬升軌道或主架，軌道再帶動整個平台與模板上升；爬升到位後，軌道卡在新的爬升靴上，油壓缸再收回準備下一行程。PERI ACS Core 400 的長行程油壓缸每支可提供 40 t 頂升力，行程速度約 20 cm/min，一般 4 m 樓層約 20 分鐘可爬完。Doka 在哈里發塔使用 SKE100 自爬系統，並以液壓方式提升超過 5,000 m² 的大面積牆模。機構必須有防止回落的機械卡爪，以及多缸同步的控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「液壓油缸與爬升軌道」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Self-climbing systems use long-stroke hydraulic cylinders mounted on the climbing shoes to push the climbing rail or main frame, which lifts the whole platform and forms; once in position the rail latches into the new shoe and the cylinder retracts for the next stroke. Each long-stroke cylinder in PERI's ACS Core 400 provides 40 t of lifting force at a stroke speed of about 20 cm per minute, so a typical 4 m storey climbs in about 20 minutes. At Burj Khalifa Doka used the SKE100 self-climbing system and lifted more than 5,000 m² of large-area wall formwork hydraulically. The mechanism needs mechanical pawls that prevent fall-back and control to keep multiple cylinders in step. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Hydraulic cylinders and climbing rails” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：油壓缸推力 F = p·A。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Cylinder force F = p·A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「油壓缸頂升力很大，所以平台上多放材料也不會影響爬升安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The cylinders are so powerful that extra material on the platform does not affect climbing safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「液壓油缸與爬升軌道」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Hydraulic cylinders and climbing rails”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 液壓爬升機構與行程控制
knowledge.titleEn: Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control
knowledge.text: 自爬系統以固定在爬升靴上的長行程油壓缸推動爬升軌道或主架，軌道再帶動整個平台與模板上升；爬升到位後，軌道卡在新的爬升靴上，油壓缸再收回準備下一行程。PERI ACS Core 400 的長行程油壓缸每支可提供 40 t 頂升力，行程速度約 20 cm/min，一般 4 m 樓層約 20 分鐘可爬完。
knowledge.textEn: Self-climbing systems use long-stroke hydraulic cylinders mounted on the climbing shoes to push the climbing rail or main frame, which lifts the whole platform and forms; once in position the rail latches into the new shoe and the cylinder retracts for the next stroke. Each long-stroke cylinder in PERI's ACS Core 400 provides 40 t of lifting force at a stroke speed of about 20 cm per minute, so a typical 4 m storey climbs in about 20 minutes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：油壓缸頂升力很大，所以平台上多放材料也不會影響爬升安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The cylinders are so powerful that extra material on the platform does not affect climbing safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「液壓爬升機構與行程控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control" is correct?
options: 自爬系統以固定在爬升靴上的長行程油壓缸推動爬升軌道或主架，軌道再帶動整個平台與模板上升；爬升到位後，軌道卡在新的爬升靴上，油壓缸再收回準備下一行程。
油壓缸頂升力很大，所以平台上多放材料也不會影響爬升安全。
模板側壓只跟澆置高度有關，與澆置速度和配比無關。
optionsEn: Self-climbing systems use long-stroke hydraulic cylinders mounted on the climbing shoes to push the climbing rail or main frame, which lifts the whole platform and forms.
The cylinders are so powerful that extra material on the platform does not affect climbing safety.
Form pressure depends only on lift height, not on pour rate or mix.
quiz.explanation: 自爬系統以固定在爬升靴上的長行程油壓缸推動爬升軌道或主架，軌道再帶動整個平台與模板上升；爬升到位後，軌道卡在新的爬升靴上，油壓缸再收回準備下一行程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Self-climbing systems use long-stroke hydraulic cylinders mounted on the climbing shoes to push the climbing rail or main frame, which lifts the whole platform and forms; once in position the rail latches into the new shoe and the cylinder retracts for the next stroke. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 液壓爬升機構與行程控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「液壓油缸與爬升軌道」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic cylinders and climbing rails” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：油壓缸推力 F = p·A。缸徑 125 mm 時 A = π×62.5² ≈ 12,270 mm²，油壓 32 MPa 時 F ≈ 393 kN，約 40 t。爬升 4 m、速度 0.2 m/min 需 4/0.2 = 20 min。若平台加上布料機使單元荷重升到 450 kN，需提高油壓或改用較大缸徑。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Cylinder force F = p·A. A 125 mm bore gives A = π×62.5² ≈ 12,270 mm², so at 32 MPa F ≈ 393 kN, about 40 t. Climbing 4 m at 0.2 m/min takes 4/0.2 = 20 min. If a placing boom raises a unit's load to 450 kN, higher pressure or a larger bore is needed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：出廠前對油壓缸做耐壓與負載試驗，現場每次爬升前檢查油壓表、油管、卡爪動作與限位開關；爬升中記錄各缸壓力與行程，若某缸壓力明顯高於其他缸，表示荷重分配不均或有卡阻，應立即停止檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pressure- and load-test cylinders before delivery; before every climb check gauges, hoses, pawl action and limit switches; during the climb record each cylinder's pressure and stroke, and stop to investigate immediately if one cylinder runs markedly higher than the others, which signals uneven load or binding.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 油壓缸推力 F = p·A。缸徑 125 mm 時 A = π×62.5² ≈ 12,270 mm²，油壓 32 MPa 時 F ≈ 393 kN，約 40 t。爬升 4 m、速度 0.2 m/min 需 4/0.2 = 20 min。若平台加上布料機使單元荷重升到 450 kN，需提高油壓或改用較大缸徑。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Cylinder force F = p·A. A 125 mm bore gives A = π×62.5² ≈ 12,270 mm², so at 32 MPa F ≈ 393 kN, about 40 t. Climbing 4 m at 0.2 m/min takes 4/0.2 = 20 min. If a placing boom raises a unit's load to 450 kN, higher pressure or a larger bore is needed. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「液壓爬升機構與行程控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control", which statement holds?
options: 地面風不大，代表高空爬模也可以安全爬升。
油壓缸推力 F = p·A。
只要控制面板沒有警報，平台就一定是水平且所有單元都已鎖定。
optionsEn: Light wind at ground level means the climbing form can safely climb at height.
Cylinder force F = p·A.
If the control panel shows no alarm, the platform must be level and every unit locked.
quiz.explanation: 油壓缸推力 F = p·A。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Cylinder force F = p·A. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 液壓爬升機構與行程控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「液壓油缸與爬升軌道」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic cylinders and climbing rails” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 出廠前對油壓缸做耐壓與負載試驗，現場每次爬升前檢查油壓表、油管、卡爪動作與限位開關；爬升中記錄各缸壓力與行程，若某缸壓力明顯高於其他缸，表示荷重分配不均或有卡阻，應立即停止檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure- and load-test cylinders before delivery; before every climb check gauges, hoses, pawl action and limit switches; during the climb record each cylinder's pressure and stroke, and stop to investigate immediately if one cylinder runs markedly higher than the others, which signals uneven load or binding. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每次爬升前執行固定的檢查表（卡爪、限位、油管、錨點、平台清空），平台上只允許爬升作業人員；油壓系統的維修保養紀錄要隨設備移交，並規定卡爪與油封的更換週期。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Run a fixed checklist before every climb covering pawls, limits, hoses, anchors and a cleared platform, allow only climbing crew on the platform, keep hydraulic maintenance records with the equipment, and set replacement intervals for pawls and seals.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：卡爪磨損或被混凝土殘渣卡住，油壓缸收回時軌道無法鎖定而回落，造成衝擊；多缸不同步時平台扭曲，爬升軌道與爬升靴卡死，甚至使錨點承受遠超設計的偏心力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Worn pawls or pawls jammed with concrete debris fail to lock the rail when the cylinder retracts, so the rail drops back with an impact; unsynchronised cylinders twist the platform, jam the rail in the shoe and may load the anchors with eccentric forces far beyond design. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 出廠前對油壓缸做耐壓與負載試驗，現場每次爬升前檢查油壓表、油管、卡爪動作與限位開關；爬升中記錄各缸壓力與行程，若某缸壓力明顯高於其他缸，表示荷重分配不均或有卡阻，應立即停止檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure- and load-test cylinders before delivery; before every climb check gauges, hoses, pawl action and limit switches; during the climb record each cylinder's pressure and stroke, and stop to investigate immediately if one cylinder runs markedly higher than the others, which signals uneven load or binding.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每次爬升前執行固定的檢查表（卡爪、限位、油管、錨點、平台清空），平台上只允許爬升作業人員；油壓系統的維修保養紀錄要隨設備移交，並規定卡爪與油封的更換週期。
knowledge.textEn: Run a fixed checklist before every climb covering pawls, limits, hoses, anchors and a cleared platform, allow only climbing crew on the platform, keep hydraulic maintenance records with the equipment, and set replacement intervals for pawls and seals.

quiz.question: 要驗證「液壓爬升機構與行程控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
爬模到頂後拆除只是組裝的反向步驟，不需要另做計算。
出廠前對油壓缸做耐壓與負載試驗，現場每次爬升前檢查油壓表、油管、卡爪動作與限位開關。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Dismantling at the top is just assembly in reverse and needs no separate calculation.
Pressure- and load-test cylinders before delivery.
quiz.explanation: 出廠前對油壓缸做耐壓與負載試驗，現場每次爬升前檢查油壓表、油管、卡爪動作與限位開關；爬升中記錄各缸壓力與行程，若某缸壓力明顯高於其他缸，表示荷重分配不均或有卡阻，應立即停止檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure- and load-test cylinders before delivery; before every climb check gauges, hoses, pawl action and limit switches; during the climb record each cylinder's pressure and stroke, and stop to investigate immediately if one cylinder runs markedly higher than the others, which signals uneven load or binding. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 液壓爬升機構與行程控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「液壓油缸與爬升軌道」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic cylinders and climbing rails” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 卡爪磨損或被混凝土殘渣卡住，油壓缸收回時軌道無法鎖定而回落，造成衝擊；多缸不同步時平台扭曲，爬升軌道與爬升靴卡死，甚至使錨點承受遠超設計的偏心力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Worn pawls or pawls jammed with concrete debris fail to lock the rail when the cylinder retracts, so the rail drops back with an impact; unsynchronised cylinders twist the platform, jam the rail in the shoe and may load the anchors with eccentric forces far beyond design. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：機構必須有防止回落的機械卡爪，以及多缸同步的控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The mechanism needs mechanical pawls that prevent fall-back and control to keep multiple cylinders in step.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「油壓缸頂升力很大，所以平台上多放材料也不會影響爬升安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The cylinders are so powerful that extra material on the platform does not affect climbing safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 卡爪磨損或被混凝土殘渣卡住，油壓缸收回時軌道無法鎖定而回落，造成衝擊；多缸不同步時平台扭曲，爬升軌道與爬升靴卡死，甚至使錨點承受遠超設計的偏心力。
knowledge.textEn: Worn pawls or pawls jammed with concrete debris fail to lock the rail when the cylinder retracts, so the rail drops back with an impact; unsynchronised cylinders twist the platform, jam the rail in the shoe and may load the anchors with eccentric forces far beyond design.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「液壓爬升機構與行程控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 卡爪磨損或被混凝土殘渣卡住，油壓缸收回時軌道無法鎖定而回落，造成衝擊；多缸不同步時平台扭曲，爬升軌道與爬升靴卡死，甚至使錨點承受遠超設計的偏心力。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
模板側壓只跟澆置高度有關，與澆置速度和配比無關。
optionsEn: Worn pawls or pawls jammed with concrete debris fail to lock the rail when the cylinder retracts, so the rail drops back with an impact.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Form pressure depends only on lift height, not on pour rate or mix.
quiz.explanation: 卡爪磨損或被混凝土殘渣卡住，油壓缸收回時軌道無法鎖定而回落，造成衝擊；多缸不同步時平台扭曲，爬升軌道與爬升靴卡死，甚至使錨點承受遠超設計的偏心力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Worn pawls or pawls jammed with concrete debris fail to lock the rail when the cylinder retracts, so the rail drops back with an impact; unsynchronised cylinders twist the platform, jam the rail in the shoe and may load the anchors with eccentric forces far beyond design. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 模板側壓、澆置速度與繫結：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Form pressure, pour rate and ties: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「大面積牆模與繫結螺桿」如何影響高層建築液壓爬模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Large-area wall forms and ties” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydraulic climbing-form construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 爬模每次澆置高度常達 3.7 至 4.5 m（哈里發塔 3.70 m、樂天世界塔標準層 4.5 m），新鮮混凝土對模板的側壓取決於澆置速度、混凝土溫度、凝結特性與坍度。一般混凝土在澆置速度不高時，下部混凝土已開始凝結，側壓小於全液壓；但自充填混凝土或使用大量緩凝劑時，側壓接近全液壓，模板與繫結螺桿必須按液壓設計。哈里發塔的牆厚由 200 mm 變化到 1.3 m，牆越厚，單次澆置量越大、澆置時間越長，速度與側壓管理更重要。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「大面積牆模與繫結螺桿」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each climbing lift is often 3.7 to 4.5 m high (3.70 m at Burj Khalifa, 4.5 m in Lotte World Tower's typical storeys), and fresh-concrete pressure on the forms depends on pour rate, concrete temperature, setting behaviour and slump. With ordinary concrete placed at a moderate rate, the lower concrete begins to stiffen and pressure stays below fully hydrostatic; with self-consolidating concrete or heavy retarder dosages pressure approaches hydrostatic and forms and ties must be designed for it. Burj Khalifa's walls varied from 200 mm to 1.3 m thick, and thicker walls mean bigger, longer pours, making rate and pressure control more important. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Large-area wall forms and ties” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 347 牆模側壓 p = C_w·C_c[7.2 + 785R/(T+17.8)] kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 347 wall-form pressure p = C_w·C_c[7.2 + 785R/(T+17.8)] kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模板側壓只跟澆置高度有關，與澆置速度和配比無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Form pressure depends only on lift height, not on pour rate or mix." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「大面積牆模與繫結螺桿」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Large-area wall forms and ties”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模板側壓、澆置速度與繫結
knowledge.titleEn: Form pressure, pour rate and ties
knowledge.text: 爬模每次澆置高度常達 3.7 至 4.5 m（哈里發塔 3.70 m、樂天世界塔標準層 4.5 m），新鮮混凝土對模板的側壓取決於澆置速度、混凝土溫度、凝結特性與坍度。一般混凝土在澆置速度不高時，下部混凝土已開始凝結，側壓小於全液壓；但自充填混凝土或使用大量緩凝劑時，側壓接近全液壓，模板與繫結螺桿必須按液壓設計。
knowledge.textEn: Each climbing lift is often 3.7 to 4.5 m high (3.70 m at Burj Khalifa, 4.5 m in Lotte World Tower's typical storeys), and fresh-concrete pressure on the forms depends on pour rate, concrete temperature, setting behaviour and slump. With ordinary concrete placed at a moderate rate, the lower concrete begins to stiffen and pressure stays below fully hydrostatic; with self-consolidating concrete or heavy retarder dosages pressure approaches hydrostatic and forms and ties must be designed for it.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模板側壓只跟澆置高度有關，與澆置速度和配比無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Form pressure depends only on lift height, not on pour rate or mix. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模板側壓、澆置速度與繫結」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Form pressure, pour rate and ties" is correct?
options: 模板側壓只跟澆置高度有關，與澆置速度和配比無關。
爬模每次澆置高度常達 3.7 至 4.5 m（哈里發塔 3.70 m、樂天世界塔標準層 4.5 m），新鮮混凝土對模板的側壓取決於澆置速度、混凝土溫度、凝結特性與坍度。
爬模平台很大，所以任何位置都可以堆放材料。
optionsEn: Form pressure depends only on lift height, not on pour rate or mix.

Each climbing lift is often 3.7 to 4.5 m high (3.70 m at Burj Khalifa, 4.5 m in Lotte World Tower's typical storeys), and fresh-concrete pressure on the forms depends on pour rate, concrete temperature, setting behaviour and slump.
Climbing-form platforms are large, so materials can be stacked anywhere on them.
quiz.explanation: 爬模每次澆置高度常達 3.7 至 4.5 m（哈里發塔 3.70 m、樂天世界塔標準層 4.5 m），新鮮混凝土對模板的側壓取決於澆置速度、混凝土溫度、凝結特性與坍度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each climbing lift is often 3.7 to 4.5 m high (3.70 m at Burj Khalifa, 4.5 m in Lotte World Tower's typical storeys), and fresh-concrete pressure on the forms depends on pour rate, concrete temperature, setting behaviour and slump. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模板側壓、澆置速度與繫結：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Form pressure, pour rate and ties: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「大面積牆模與繫結螺桿」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Large-area wall forms and ties” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 347 牆模側壓 p = C_w·C_c[7.2 + 785R/(T+17.8)] kPa。R = 2 m/h、T = 20°C、係數取 1 時 p ≈ 7.2 + 41.5 ≈ 48.7 kPa；若改用自充填混凝土須取全液壓 p = 24×3.7 ≈ 88.8 kPa。繫結螺桿間距 1.2 m×1.2 m 時，每支拉力由約 70 kN 增為約 128 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 347 wall-form pressure p = C_w·C_c[7.2 + 785R/(T+17.8)] kPa. With R = 2 m/h, T = 20°C and unit coefficients, p ≈ 7.2 + 41.5 ≈ 48.7 kPa; self-consolidating concrete requires full hydrostatic p = 24×3.7 ≈ 88.8 kPa. With ties at 1.2 m×1.2 m, each tie's force rises from about 70 kN to about 128 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：模板計算書須註明假設的澆置速度、混凝土溫度與配比類型，現場以澆置紀錄驗證實際速度；首次使用自充填或改變緩凝劑時，可在模板上裝設壓力感測器量測實際側壓，並觀察模板變形與繫結螺桿伸長。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The form calculations must state the assumed pour rate, concrete temperature and mix type, and pour records verify the actual rate on site; on first use of self-consolidating concrete or a new retarder dosage, fit pressure sensors to the forms to measure actual pressure and watch form deflection and tie elongation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 347 牆模側壓 p = C_w·C_c[7.2 + 785R/(T+17.8)] kPa。R = 2 m/h、T = 20°C、係數取 1 時 p ≈ 7.2 + 41.5 ≈ 48.7 kPa；若改用自充填混凝土須取全液壓 p = 24×3.7 ≈ 88.8 kPa。繫結螺桿間距 1.2 m×1.2 m 時，每支拉力由約 70 kN 增為約 128 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: ACI 347 wall-form pressure p = C_w·C_c[7.2 + 785R/(T+17.8)] kPa. With R = 2 m/h, T = 20°C and unit coefficients, p ≈ 7.2 + 41.5 ≈ 48.7 kPa; self-consolidating concrete requires full hydrostatic p = 24×3.7 ≈ 88.8 kPa. With ties at 1.2 m×1.2 m, each tie's force rises from about 70 kN to about 128 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模板側壓、澆置速度與繫結」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Form pressure, pour rate and ties", which statement holds?
options: 核心筒用的是高強度混凝土，所以一天後一定已經足夠讓錨點承載。
錨錐孔很小，封不封堵對結構與耐久沒有影響。
ACI 347 牆模側壓 p = C_w·C_c[7.2 + 785R/(T+17.8)] kPa。
optionsEn: Core walls use high-strength concrete, so after one day the anchors can certainly carry load.
Anchor-cone holes are small, so plugging them has no effect on structure or durability.
ACI 347 wall-form pressure p = C_w·C_c[7.2 + 785R/(T+17.8)] kPa.
quiz.explanation: ACI 347 牆模側壓 p = C_w·C_c[7.2 + 785R/(T+17.8)] kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ACI 347 wall-form pressure p = C_w·C_c[7.2 + 785R/(T+17.8)] kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模板側壓、澆置速度與繫結：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Form pressure, pour rate and ties: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「大面積牆模與繫結螺桿」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Large-area wall forms and ties” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 模板計算書須註明假設的澆置速度、混凝土溫度與配比類型，現場以澆置紀錄驗證實際速度；首次使用自充填或改變緩凝劑時，可在模板上裝設壓力感測器量測實際側壓，並觀察模板變形與繫結螺桿伸長。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The form calculations must state the assumed pour rate, concrete temperature and mix type, and pour records verify the actual rate on site; on first use of self-consolidating concrete or a new retarder dosage, fit pressure sensors to the forms to measure actual pressure and watch form deflection and tie elongation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在澆置許可中寫明最大澆置速度與配比類型，並由現場工程師控制車次間隔；配比或緩凝劑變更必須通知模板設計者重新檢核側壓，未經同意不得使用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State the maximum pour rate and mix type on the pour permit and have the site engineer pace truck arrivals; notify the formwork designer of any change in mix or retarder for a pressure recheck, and do not use it without approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：改用流動性更高的混凝土卻沿用一般混凝土的側壓設計，下部模板鼓出、繫結螺桿拉斷，混凝土從模板縫隙爆出；澆置速度在夜間因供料集中而突然加快，也會造成同樣問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Switching to a more fluid concrete while keeping the ordinary-concrete pressure design bulges the lower forms, snaps ties and blows concrete out of the joints; a sudden jump in pour rate at night when trucks bunch up causes the same problem. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 模板計算書須註明假設的澆置速度、混凝土溫度與配比類型，現場以澆置紀錄驗證實際速度；首次使用自充填或改變緩凝劑時，可在模板上裝設壓力感測器量測實際側壓，並觀察模板變形與繫結螺桿伸長。
knowledge.textEn: The form calculations must state the assumed pour rate, concrete temperature and mix type, and pour records verify the actual rate on site; on first use of self-consolidating concrete or a new retarder dosage, fit pressure sensors to the forms to measure actual pressure and watch form deflection and tie elongation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在澆置許可中寫明最大澆置速度與配比類型，並由現場工程師控制車次間隔；配比或緩凝劑變更必須通知模板設計者重新檢核側壓，未經同意不得使用。
knowledge.textEn: State the maximum pour rate and mix type on the pour permit and have the site engineer pace truck arrivals; notify the formwork designer of any change in mix or retarder for a pressure recheck, and do not use it without approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模板側壓、澆置速度與繫結」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Form pressure, pour rate and ties"?
options: 模板計算書須註明假設的澆置速度、混凝土溫度與配比類型，現場以澆置紀錄驗證實際速度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。
optionsEn: The form calculations must state the assumed pour rate, concrete temperature and mix type, and pour records verify the actual rate on site.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb.
quiz.explanation: 模板計算書須註明假設的澆置速度、混凝土溫度與配比類型，現場以澆置紀錄驗證實際速度；首次使用自充填或改變緩凝劑時，可在模板上裝設壓力感測器量測實際側壓，並觀察模板變形與繫結螺桿伸長。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The form calculations must state the assumed pour rate, concrete temperature and mix type, and pour records verify the actual rate on site; on first use of self-consolidating concrete or a new retarder dosage, fit pressure sensors to the forms to measure actual pressure and watch form deflection and tie elongation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模板側壓、澆置速度與繫結：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Form pressure, pour rate and ties: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「大面積牆模與繫結螺桿」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Large-area wall forms and ties” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 改用流動性更高的混凝土卻沿用一般混凝土的側壓設計，下部模板鼓出、繫結螺桿拉斷，混凝土從模板縫隙爆出；澆置速度在夜間因供料集中而突然加快，也會造成同樣問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Switching to a more fluid concrete while keeping the ordinary-concrete pressure design bulges the lower forms, snaps ties and blows concrete out of the joints; a sudden jump in pour rate at night when trucks bunch up causes the same problem. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：哈里發塔的牆厚由 200 mm 變化到 1.3 m，牆越厚，單次澆置量越大、澆置時間越長，速度與側壓管理更重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Burj Khalifa's walls varied from 200 mm to 1.3 m thick, and thicker walls mean bigger, longer pours, making rate and pressure control more important.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模板側壓只跟澆置高度有關，與澆置速度和配比無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Form pressure depends only on lift height, not on pour rate or mix." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 改用流動性更高的混凝土卻沿用一般混凝土的側壓設計，下部模板鼓出、繫結螺桿拉斷，混凝土從模板縫隙爆出；澆置速度在夜間因供料集中而突然加快，也會造成同樣問題。
knowledge.textEn: Switching to a more fluid concrete while keeping the ordinary-concrete pressure design bulges the lower forms, snaps ties and blows concrete out of the joints; a sudden jump in pour rate at night when trucks bunch up causes the same problem.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模板側壓、澆置速度與繫結」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Form pressure, pour rate and ties" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
改用流動性更高的混凝土卻沿用一般混凝土的側壓設計，下部模板鼓出、繫結螺桿拉斷，混凝土從模板縫隙爆出；澆置速度在夜間因供料集中而突然加快，也會造成同樣問題。
爬模平台很大，所以任何位置都可以堆放材料。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Switching to a more fluid concrete while keeping the ordinary-concrete pressure design bulges the lower forms, snaps ties and blows concrete out of the joints.
Climbing-form platforms are large, so materials can be stacked anywhere on them.
quiz.explanation: 改用流動性更高的混凝土卻沿用一般混凝土的側壓設計，下部模板鼓出、繫結螺桿拉斷，混凝土從模板縫隙爆出；澆置速度在夜間因供料集中而突然加快，也會造成同樣問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Switching to a more fluid concrete while keeping the ordinary-concrete pressure design bulges the lower forms, snaps ties and blows concrete out of the joints; a sudden jump in pour rate at night when trucks bunch up causes the same problem. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「多層平台、布料機與塔吊介面」與「爬升作業、風速管制與停檢點」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Multi-level platforms, placing booms and crane interface" and "Climbing operation, wind limits and hold points": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 多層平台、布料機與塔吊介面：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Multi-level platforms, placing booms and crane interface: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「平台佈置與布料機」如何影響高層建築液壓爬模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Platform layout and placing booms” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydraulic climbing-form construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 自爬系統通常有三層以上平台：最上層放置布料機與鋼筋，中間層為模板操作層，下層用於拆除錨錐與修補。樂天世界塔核心筒使用 132 組 SKE100 自爬單元，另以 12 組 SKE100 爬升 3 台混凝土布料機，讓布料機隨模板循環同步上升；8 根巨柱則使用 80 組 SKE50 plus。平台就像一座在百米高空、每幾天移動一次的臨時工廠，它的容許荷重、材料堆放區與塔吊吊料點必須事先規劃，否則最常見的錯誤就是把整捆鋼筋堆在設計荷重很小的走道上。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「平台佈置與布料機」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Self-climbing systems usually have three or more platform levels: the top carries the placing boom and rebar, the middle is the formwork operating level and the lowest is used for removing anchor cones and patching. Lotte World Tower's core used 132 SKE100 self-climbing units, with another 12 SKE100 units climbing three concrete placing booms in step with the formwork cycle, while its eight megacolumns used 80 SKE50 plus units. The platform is like a temporary factory hundreds of metres up that moves every few days; its allowable loads, stockpile zones and crane drop points must be planned beforehand, or the most common error follows: a whole bundle of rebar dumped on a walkway with a small design load. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Platform layout and placing booms” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一捆鋼筋 3,000 kg，重 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 kN，若放在 2.4 m×3.0 m = 7.2 m² 的平台區，平均荷重 29.4/7.2 ≈ 4.1 kPa，超過假設的平台容許 3.0 kPa；改以墊木分散到 10 m²，荷重降為約 2.9 kPa 才符合。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 3,000 kg rebar bundle weighs 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 kN; set on a 2.4 m×3.0 m = 7.2 m² patch it averages 29.4/7.2 ≈ 4.1 kPa, above an assumed platform allowance of 3.0 kPa; spreading it on timbers over 10 m² brings it to about 2.9 kPa, which complies.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「爬模平台很大，所以任何位置都可以堆放材料。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Climbing-form platforms are large, so materials can be stacked anywhere on them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「平台佈置與布料機」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Platform layout and placing booms”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 多層平台、布料機與塔吊介面
knowledge.titleEn: Multi-level platforms, placing booms and crane interface
knowledge.text: 自爬系統通常有三層以上平台：最上層放置布料機與鋼筋，中間層為模板操作層，下層用於拆除錨錐與修補。樂天世界塔核心筒使用 132 組 SKE100 自爬單元，另以 12 組 SKE100 爬升 3 台混凝土布料機，讓布料機隨模板循環同步上升；8 根巨柱則使用 80 組 SKE50 plus。
knowledge.textEn: Self-climbing systems usually have three or more platform levels: the top carries the placing boom and rebar, the middle is the formwork operating level and the lowest is used for removing anchor cones and patching. Lotte World Tower's core used 132 SKE100 self-climbing units, with another 12 SKE100 units climbing three concrete placing booms in step with the formwork cycle, while its eight megacolumns used 80 SKE50 plus units.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：爬模平台很大，所以任何位置都可以堆放材料。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Climbing-form platforms are large, so materials can be stacked anywhere on them. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「多層平台、布料機與塔吊介面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multi-level platforms, placing booms and crane interface" is correct?
options: 爬模平台很大，所以任何位置都可以堆放材料。
地面風不大，代表高空爬模也可以安全爬升。
自爬系統通常有三層以上平台：最上層放置布料機與鋼筋，中間層為模板操作層，下層用於拆除錨錐與修補。
optionsEn: Climbing-form platforms are large, so materials can be stacked anywhere on them.
Light wind at ground level means the climbing form can safely climb at height.

Self-climbing systems usually have three or more platform levels: the top carries the placing boom and rebar, the middle is the formwork operating level and the lowest is used for removing anchor cones and patching.
quiz.explanation: 自爬系統通常有三層以上平台：最上層放置布料機與鋼筋，中間層為模板操作層，下層用於拆除錨錐與修補。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Self-climbing systems usually have three or more platform levels: the top carries the placing boom and rebar, the middle is the formwork operating level and the lowest is used for removing anchor cones and patching. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多層平台、布料機與塔吊介面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multi-level platforms, placing booms and crane interface: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「平台佈置與布料機」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Platform layout and placing booms” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一捆鋼筋 3,000 kg，重 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 kN，若放在 2.4 m×3.0 m = 7.2 m² 的平台區，平均荷重 29.4/7.2 ≈ 4.1 kPa，超過假設的平台容許 3.0 kPa；改以墊木分散到 10 m²，荷重降為約 2.9 kPa 才符合。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 3,000 kg rebar bundle weighs 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 kN; set on a 2.4 m×3.0 m = 7.2 m² patch it averages 29.4/7.2 ≈ 4.1 kPa, above an assumed platform allowance of 3.0 kPa; spreading it on timbers over 10 m² brings it to about 2.9 kPa, which complies. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：平台每一層與每一區的容許荷重要標示在現場並與爬模計算書一致；吊料前由信號手確認卸料區，布料機的基座反力與風荷重要列入爬升單元荷重檢核，並由爬模設計者確認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Post the allowable load for each platform level and zone on site, consistent with the climbing-form calculations; have the signaller confirm the drop zone before each lift, and include placing-boom base reactions and wind in the climbing-unit load check, confirmed by the climbing-form designer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一捆鋼筋 3,000 kg，重 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 kN，若放在 2.4 m×3.0 m = 7.2 m² 的平台區，平均荷重 29.4/7.2 ≈ 4.1 kPa，超過假設的平台容許 3.0 kPa；改以墊木分散到 10 m²，荷重降為約 2.9 kPa 才符合。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 3,000 kg rebar bundle weighs 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 kN; set on a 2.4 m×3.0 m = 7.2 m² patch it averages 29.4/7.2 ≈ 4.1 kPa, above an assumed platform allowance of 3.0 kPa; spreading it on timbers over 10 m² brings it to about 2.9 kPa, which complies. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「多層平台、布料機與塔吊介面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Multi-level platforms, placing booms and crane interface", which statement holds?
options: 一捆鋼筋 3,000 kg，重 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 kN，若放在 2.4 m×3.0 m = 7.2 m² 的平台區，平均荷重 29.4/7.2 ≈ 4.1 kPa，超過假設的平台容許 3.0 kPa。
只要控制面板沒有警報，平台就一定是水平且所有單元都已鎖定。
爬模到頂後拆除只是組裝的反向步驟，不需要另做計算。
optionsEn: A 3,000 kg rebar bundle weighs 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 kN.
If the control panel shows no alarm, the platform must be level and every unit locked.
Dismantling at the top is just assembly in reverse and needs no separate calculation.
quiz.explanation: 一捆鋼筋 3,000 kg，重 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 kN，若放在 2.4 m×3.0 m = 7.2 m² 的平台區，平均荷重 29.4/7.2 ≈ 4.1 kPa，超過假設的平台容許 3.0 kPa；改以墊木分散到 10 m²，荷重降為約 2.9 kPa 才符合。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 3,000 kg rebar bundle weighs 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 kN; set on a 2.4 m×3.0 m = 7.2 m² patch it averages 29.4/7.2 ≈ 4.1 kPa, above an assumed platform allowance of 3.0 kPa; spreading it on timbers over 10 m² brings it to about 2.9 kPa, which complies. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 多層平台、布料機與塔吊介面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multi-level platforms, placing booms and crane interface: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「平台佈置與布料機」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Platform layout and placing booms” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 平台每一層與每一區的容許荷重要標示在現場並與爬模計算書一致；吊料前由信號手確認卸料區，布料機的基座反力與風荷重要列入爬升單元荷重檢核，並由爬模設計者確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Post the allowable load for each platform level and zone on site, consistent with the climbing-form calculations; have the signaller confirm the drop zone before each lift, and include placing-boom base reactions and wind in the climbing-unit load check, confirmed by the climbing-form designer. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以平面圖標示平台各區容許荷重、材料堆放區、布料機基座與人員通道，張貼在每層出入口；布料機的停放姿態與停用風速需寫入作業程序，強風時收臂並鎖定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark allowable loads, stockpile zones, placing-boom bases and walkways on a platform plan posted at every access point; write the boom's parking position and wind limit into the work procedure, retracting and locking it in strong wind.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鋼筋與模板配件長期堆放在同一角落，使該處爬升單元超載，錨點周圍混凝土開裂；布料機在強風中旋轉或伸臂，基座傳來的力矩超過爬升單元容許值，平台局部變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rebar and form accessories piled in one corner for days overload the climbing units there and crack the concrete around their anchors; slewing or extending the placing boom in strong wind sends base moments beyond the climbing unit's allowance and locally deforms the platform. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
