steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 平台每一層與每一區的容許荷重要標示在現場並與爬模計算書一致；吊料前由信號手確認卸料區，布料機的基座反力與風荷重要列入爬升單元荷重檢核，並由爬模設計者確認。
knowledge.textEn: Post the allowable load for each platform level and zone on site, consistent with the climbing-form calculations; have the signaller confirm the drop zone before each lift, and include placing-boom base reactions and wind in the climbing-unit load check, confirmed by the climbing-form designer.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以平面圖標示平台各區容許荷重、材料堆放區、布料機基座與人員通道，張貼在每層出入口；布料機的停放姿態與停用風速需寫入作業程序，強風時收臂並鎖定。
knowledge.textEn: Mark allowable loads, stockpile zones, placing-boom bases and walkways on a platform plan posted at every access point; write the boom's parking position and wind limit into the work procedure, retracting and locking it in strong wind.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多層平台、布料機與塔吊介面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multi-level platforms, placing booms and crane interface"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
平台每一層與每一區的容許荷重要標示在現場並與爬模計算書一致；吊料前由信號手確認卸料區，布料機的基座反力與風荷重要列入爬升單元荷重檢核，並由爬模設計者確認。
錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Post the allowable load for each platform level and zone on site, consistent with the climbing-form calculations.
If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters.
quiz.explanation: 平台每一層與每一區的容許荷重要標示在現場並與爬模計算書一致；吊料前由信號手確認卸料區，布料機的基座反力與風荷重要列入爬升單元荷重檢核，並由爬模設計者確認。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Post the allowable load for each platform level and zone on site, consistent with the climbing-form calculations; have the signaller confirm the drop zone before each lift, and include placing-boom base reactions and wind in the climbing-unit load check, confirmed by the climbing-form designer. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 多層平台、布料機與塔吊介面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multi-level platforms, placing booms and crane interface: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「平台佈置與布料機」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Platform layout and placing booms” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋼筋與模板配件長期堆放在同一角落，使該處爬升單元超載，錨點周圍混凝土開裂；布料機在強風中旋轉或伸臂，基座傳來的力矩超過爬升單元容許值，平台局部變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rebar and form accessories piled in one corner for days overload the climbing units there and crack the concrete around their anchors; slewing or extending the placing boom in strong wind sends base moments beyond the climbing unit's allowance and locally deforms the platform. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平台就像一座在百米高空、每幾天移動一次的臨時工廠，它的容許荷重、材料堆放區與塔吊吊料點必須事先規劃，否則最常見的錯誤就是把整捆鋼筋堆在設計荷重很小的走道上。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The platform is like a temporary factory hundreds of metres up that moves every few days; its allowable loads, stockpile zones and crane drop points must be planned beforehand, or the most common error follows: a whole bundle of rebar dumped on a walkway with a small design load.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「爬模平台很大，所以任何位置都可以堆放材料。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Climbing-form platforms are large, so materials can be stacked anywhere on them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鋼筋與模板配件長期堆放在同一角落，使該處爬升單元超載，錨點周圍混凝土開裂；布料機在強風中旋轉或伸臂，基座傳來的力矩超過爬升單元容許值，平台局部變形。
knowledge.textEn: Rebar and form accessories piled in one corner for days overload the climbing units there and crack the concrete around their anchors; slewing or extending the placing boom in strong wind sends base moments beyond the climbing unit's allowance and locally deforms the platform.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多層平台、布料機與塔吊介面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Multi-level platforms, placing booms and crane interface" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
地面風不大，代表高空爬模也可以安全爬升。
鋼筋與模板配件長期堆放在同一角落，使該處爬升單元超載，錨點周圍混凝土開裂；布料機在強風中旋轉或伸臂，基座傳來的力矩超過爬升單元容許值，平台局部變形。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Light wind at ground level means the climbing form can safely climb at height.
Rebar and form accessories piled in one corner for days overload the climbing units there and crack the concrete around their anchors.
quiz.explanation: 鋼筋與模板配件長期堆放在同一角落，使該處爬升單元超載，錨點周圍混凝土開裂；布料機在強風中旋轉或伸臂，基座傳來的力矩超過爬升單元容許值，平台局部變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rebar and form accessories piled in one corner for days overload the climbing units there and crack the concrete around their anchors; slewing or extending the placing boom in strong wind sends base moments beyond the climbing unit's allowance and locally deforms the platform. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 爬升作業、風速管制與停檢點：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Climbing operation, wind limits and hold points: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「爬升前停檢點」如何影響高層建築液壓爬模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pre-climb hold point” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydraulic climbing-form construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 爬升是爬模循環中風險最集中的步驟：模板脫離牆面、平台只由爬升機構支承、人員在高空移動。因此每次爬升前都需要一個正式停檢點，確認混凝土強度、錨點狀態、平台淨空、無人員在禁區、天候許可。高空風速比地面大得多，爬升許可必須以平台上的風速計為準，而不是地面感受。Doka 指出哈里發塔的爬模系統在停放狀態可承受超過 200 km/h 的風，但爬升作業的容許風速遠低於停放設計值，必須依製造商規定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「爬升前停檢點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Climbing is the riskiest step in the cycle: forms leave the wall, the platform hangs only on the climbing mechanism and people move at height. Every climb therefore needs a formal hold point confirming concrete strength, anchor condition, a cleared platform, nobody in exclusion zones and acceptable weather. Wind at height is much stronger than at ground level, so climbing permits must rely on an anemometer on the platform rather than the feel at ground level. Doka states that the climbing systems at Burj Khalifa withstood winds above 200 km/h when parked, but the allowable wind for climbing is far lower than the parked design value and must follow the manufacturer's rules. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pre-climb hold point” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α、α = 0.16 估計：400 m 高度係數 = 40^0.16 ≈ 1.80，地面 11 m/s 對應平台約 19.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimate with a power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and α = 0.16: at 400 m the factor is 40^0.16 ≈ 1.80, so 11 m/s at ground corresponds to about 19.8 m/s on the platform.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地面風不大，代表高空爬模也可以安全爬升。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Light wind at ground level means the climbing form can safely climb at height." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「爬升前停檢點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pre-climb hold point”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 爬升作業、風速管制與停檢點
knowledge.titleEn: Climbing operation, wind limits and hold points
knowledge.text: 爬升是爬模循環中風險最集中的步驟：模板脫離牆面、平台只由爬升機構支承、人員在高空移動。因此每次爬升前都需要一個正式停檢點，確認混凝土強度、錨點狀態、平台淨空、無人員在禁區、天候許可。
knowledge.textEn: Climbing is the riskiest step in the cycle: forms leave the wall, the platform hangs only on the climbing mechanism and people move at height. Every climb therefore needs a formal hold point confirming concrete strength, anchor condition, a cleared platform, nobody in exclusion zones and acceptable weather.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地面風不大，代表高空爬模也可以安全爬升。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Light wind at ground level means the climbing form can safely climb at height. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「爬升作業、風速管制與停檢點」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Climbing operation, wind limits and hold points" is correct?
options: 爬升是爬模循環中風險最集中的步驟：模板脫離牆面、平台只由爬升機構支承、人員在高空移動。
地面風不大，代表高空爬模也可以安全爬升。
核心筒用的是高強度混凝土，所以一天後一定已經足夠讓錨點承載。
optionsEn: Climbing is the riskiest step in the cycle: forms leave the wall, the platform hangs only on the climbing mechanism and people move at height.
Light wind at ground level means the climbing form can safely climb at height.
Core walls use high-strength concrete, so after one day the anchors can certainly carry load.
quiz.explanation: 爬升是爬模循環中風險最集中的步驟：模板脫離牆面、平台只由爬升機構支承、人員在高空移動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Climbing is the riskiest step in the cycle: forms leave the wall, the platform hangs only on the climbing mechanism and people move at height. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 爬升作業、風速管制與停檢點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Climbing operation, wind limits and hold points: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「爬升前停檢點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pre-climb hold point” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α、α = 0.16 估計：400 m 高度係數 = 40^0.16 ≈ 1.80，地面 11 m/s 對應平台約 19.8 m/s。風壓比較：停放設計 200 km/h（55.6 m/s）q ≈ 1,890 Pa，假設爬升上限 20 m/s 時 q ≈ 245 Pa，相差約 7.7 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate with a power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and α = 0.16: at 400 m the factor is 40^0.16 ≈ 1.80, so 11 m/s at ground corresponds to about 19.8 m/s on the platform. Comparing pressures, a 200 km/h (55.6 m/s) parked design gives q ≈ 1,890 Pa, while an assumed 20 m/s climbing limit gives q ≈ 245 Pa, about 7.7 times less. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：爬升許可單包含：混凝土強度證明、錨點與卡爪檢查、平台清空確認、禁區設置、平台風速讀值與預報，由爬模主管與工地安全主管簽名後才可啟動；爬升後確認所有爬升靴鎖定並記錄完成時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The climbing permit covers proof of concrete strength, anchor and pawl checks, confirmation that the platform is cleared, exclusion zones, the platform anemometer reading and forecast, and is signed by the climbing supervisor and the site safety manager before any climb starts; afterwards confirm that every shoe is locked and record the completion time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α、α = 0.16 估計：400 m 高度係數 = 40^0.16 ≈ 1.80，地面 11 m/s 對應平台約 19.8 m/s。風壓比較：停放設計 200 km/h（55.6 m/s）q ≈ 1,890 Pa，假設爬升上限 20 m/s 時 q ≈ 245 Pa，相差約 7.7 倍。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate with a power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and α = 0.16: at 400 m the factor is 40^0.16 ≈ 1.80, so 11 m/s at ground corresponds to about 19.8 m/s on the platform. Comparing pressures, a 200 km/h (55.6 m/s) parked design gives q ≈ 1,890 Pa, while an assumed 20 m/s climbing limit gives q ≈ 245 Pa, about 7.7 times less. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「爬升作業、風速管制與停檢點」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Climbing operation, wind limits and hold points", which statement holds?
options: 錨錐孔很小，封不封堵對結構與耐久沒有影響。
以冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α、α = 0.16 估計：400 m 高度係數 = 40^0.16 ≈ 1.80，地面 11 m/s 對應平台約 19.8 m/s。
爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。
optionsEn: Anchor-cone holes are small, so plugging them has no effect on structure or durability.
Estimate with a power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and α = 0.16: at 400 m the factor is 40^0.16 ≈ 1.80, so 11 m/s at ground corresponds to about 19.8 m/s on the platform.
The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb.
quiz.explanation: 以冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α、α = 0.16 估計：400 m 高度係數 = 40^0.16 ≈ 1.80，地面 11 m/s 對應平台約 19.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate with a power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and α = 0.16: at 400 m the factor is 40^0.16 ≈ 1.80, so 11 m/s at ground corresponds to about 19.8 m/s on the platform. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 爬升作業、風速管制與停檢點：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Climbing operation, wind limits and hold points: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「爬升前停檢點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pre-climb hold point” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 爬升許可單包含：混凝土強度證明、錨點與卡爪檢查、平台清空確認、禁區設置、平台風速讀值與預報，由爬模主管與工地安全主管簽名後才可啟動；爬升後確認所有爬升靴鎖定並記錄完成時間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The climbing permit covers proof of concrete strength, anchor and pawl checks, confirmation that the platform is cleared, exclusion zones, the platform anemometer reading and forecast, and is signed by the climbing supervisor and the site safety manager before any climb starts; afterwards confirm that every shoe is locked and record the completion time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：爬升屬高風險作業，必須以書面許可制管理並設停檢點：爬模主管、安全主管與現場工程師各自確認其負責項目後才放行，任何人都可在發現異常時要求中止；許可單存檔作為品質紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Climbing is high-risk work managed by written permit with a hold point: the climbing supervisor, safety manager and site engineer each confirm their items before release, anyone may stop the climb on noticing an anomaly, and permits are filed as quality records.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：依地面風況判斷可以爬升，實際平台高度的陣風已超過限值，爬升中平台受風擺動，軌道與爬升靴卡阻；未清空的材料或工具在爬升時掉落，對下方人員造成危險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Judging from ground-level wind that climbing is fine while gusts at platform height already exceed the limit lets the platform swing during the climb and jam rails in their shoes; loose materials or tools left on the platform fall during the climb and endanger people below. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 爬升許可單包含：混凝土強度證明、錨點與卡爪檢查、平台清空確認、禁區設置、平台風速讀值與預報，由爬模主管與工地安全主管簽名後才可啟動；爬升後確認所有爬升靴鎖定並記錄完成時間。
knowledge.textEn: The climbing permit covers proof of concrete strength, anchor and pawl checks, confirmation that the platform is cleared, exclusion zones, the platform anemometer reading and forecast, and is signed by the climbing supervisor and the site safety manager before any climb starts; afterwards confirm that every shoe is locked and record the completion time.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 爬升屬高風險作業，必須以書面許可制管理並設停檢點：爬模主管、安全主管與現場工程師各自確認其負責項目後才放行，任何人都可在發現異常時要求中止；許可單存檔作為品質紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Climbing is high-risk work managed by written permit with a hold point: the climbing supervisor, safety manager and site engineer each confirm their items before release, anyone may stop the climb on noticing an anomaly, and permits are filed as quality records.

quiz.question: 要驗證「爬升作業、風速管制與停檢點」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Climbing operation, wind limits and hold points"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
油壓缸頂升力很大，所以平台上多放材料也不會影響爬升安全。
爬升許可單包含：混凝土強度證明、錨點與卡爪檢查、平台清空確認、禁區設置、平台風速讀值與預報，由爬模主管與工地安全主管簽名後才可啟動。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The cylinders are so powerful that extra material on the platform does not affect climbing safety.

The climbing permit covers proof of concrete strength, anchor and pawl checks, confirmation that the platform is cleared, exclusion zones, the platform anemometer reading and forecast, and is signed by the climbing supervisor and the site safety manager before any climb starts.
quiz.explanation: 爬升許可單包含：混凝土強度證明、錨點與卡爪檢查、平台清空確認、禁區設置、平台風速讀值與預報，由爬模主管與工地安全主管簽名後才可啟動；爬升後確認所有爬升靴鎖定並記錄完成時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The climbing permit covers proof of concrete strength, anchor and pawl checks, confirmation that the platform is cleared, exclusion zones, the platform anemometer reading and forecast, and is signed by the climbing supervisor and the site safety manager before any climb starts; afterwards confirm that every shoe is locked and record the completion time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 爬升作業、風速管制與停檢點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Climbing operation, wind limits and hold points: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「爬升前停檢點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pre-climb hold point” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 依地面風況判斷可以爬升，實際平台高度的陣風已超過限值，爬升中平台受風擺動，軌道與爬升靴卡阻；未清空的材料或工具在爬升時掉落，對下方人員造成危險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Judging from ground-level wind that climbing is fine while gusts at platform height already exceed the limit lets the platform swing during the climb and jam rails in their shoes; loose materials or tools left on the platform fall during the climb and endanger people below. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Doka 指出哈里發塔的爬模系統在停放狀態可承受超過 200 km/h 的風，但爬升作業的容許風速遠低於停放設計值，必須依製造商規定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Doka states that the climbing systems at Burj Khalifa withstood winds above 200 km/h when parked, but the allowable wind for climbing is far lower than the parked design value and must follow the manufacturer's rules.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地面風不大，代表高空爬模也可以安全爬升。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Light wind at ground level means the climbing form can safely climb at height." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 依地面風況判斷可以爬升，實際平台高度的陣風已超過限值，爬升中平台受風擺動，軌道與爬升靴卡阻；未清空的材料或工具在爬升時掉落，對下方人員造成危險。
knowledge.textEn: Judging from ground-level wind that climbing is fine while gusts at platform height already exceed the limit lets the platform swing during the climb and jam rails in their shoes; loose materials or tools left on the platform fall during the climb and endanger people below.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「爬升作業、風速管制與停檢點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Climbing operation, wind limits and hold points" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 依地面風況判斷可以爬升，實際平台高度的陣風已超過限值，爬升中平台受風擺動，軌道與爬升靴卡阻；未清空的材料或工具在爬升時掉落，對下方人員造成危險。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
核心筒用的是高強度混凝土，所以一天後一定已經足夠讓錨點承載。
optionsEn: Judging from ground-level wind that climbing is fine while gusts at platform height already exceed the limit lets the platform swing during the climb and jam rails in their shoes.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Core walls use high-strength concrete, so after one day the anchors can certainly carry load.
quiz.explanation: 依地面風況判斷可以爬升，實際平台高度的陣風已超過限值，爬升中平台受風擺動，軌道與爬升靴卡阻；未清空的材料或工具在爬升時掉落，對下方人員造成危險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Judging from ground-level wind that climbing is fine while gusts at platform height already exceed the limit lets the platform swing during the climb and jam rails in their shoes; loose materials or tools left on the platform fall during the climb and endanger people below. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「早齡強度驗收與爬升放行」與「爬升同步、平台傾斜與荷重監測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Early-age strength acceptance and climbing release" and "Climbing synchronisation, platform tilt and load monitoring": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 早齡強度驗收與爬升放行：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Early-age strength acceptance and climbing release: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「錨點區現場養護試體」如何影響高層建築液壓爬模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Field-cured specimens at anchor level” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydraulic climbing-form construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 爬升放行的核心證據是錨點所在牆體的實際強度。實驗室標準養護試體反映的是配比潛力，而不是高空平台上、夜間低溫中的實際混凝土強度；因此常用與牆體同條件養護的現場試體、溫度感測器推估或錨點區的回彈檢測。核心筒牆常使用高強度混凝土，但高強度不等於早強：大量礦物摻料降低水化熱，也會延後早期強度發展。冬季或高空寒風時，早期強度可能比預期低很多，爬升時程必須跟著調整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「錨點區現場養護試體」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The key evidence for releasing a climb is the actual strength of the wall at the anchors. Standard-cured laboratory specimens show the mix's potential, not the strength of concrete on a platform high up on a cold night, so practice uses field-cured specimens kept with the wall, temperature-based estimates or rebound checks at the anchor zone. Core walls often use high-strength concrete, but high strength is not early strength: large supplementary cementitious contents lower heat and also delay early strength gain. In winter or cold wind at height, early strength can fall far below expectation, and the climbing schedule must adjust accordingly. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Field-cured specimens at anchor level” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設錨點放行強度 10 MPa、驗收規則為三個現場試體平均 ≥ 10 MPa 且單一 ≥ 9.0 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume an anchor release strength of 10 MPa with the rule that three field-cured specimens average at least 10 MPa and none is below 9.0 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「核心筒用的是高強度混凝土，所以一天後一定已經足夠讓錨點承載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Core walls use high-strength concrete, so after one day the anchors can certainly carry load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「錨點區現場養護試體」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Field-cured specimens at anchor level”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 早齡強度驗收與爬升放行
knowledge.titleEn: Early-age strength acceptance and climbing release
knowledge.text: 爬升放行的核心證據是錨點所在牆體的實際強度。實驗室標準養護試體反映的是配比潛力，而不是高空平台上、夜間低溫中的實際混凝土強度；因此常用與牆體同條件養護的現場試體、溫度感測器推估或錨點區的回彈檢測。
knowledge.textEn: The key evidence for releasing a climb is the actual strength of the wall at the anchors. Standard-cured laboratory specimens show the mix's potential, not the strength of concrete on a platform high up on a cold night, so practice uses field-cured specimens kept with the wall, temperature-based estimates or rebound checks at the anchor zone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：核心筒用的是高強度混凝土，所以一天後一定已經足夠讓錨點承載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Core walls use high-strength concrete, so after one day the anchors can certainly carry load. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「早齡強度驗收與爬升放行」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Early-age strength acceptance and climbing release" is correct?
options: 核心筒用的是高強度混凝土，所以一天後一定已經足夠讓錨點承載。
爬升放行的核心證據是錨點所在牆體的實際強度。
只要控制面板沒有警報，平台就一定是水平且所有單元都已鎖定。
optionsEn: Core walls use high-strength concrete, so after one day the anchors can certainly carry load.
The key evidence for releasing a climb is the actual strength of the wall at the anchors.
If the control panel shows no alarm, the platform must be level and every unit locked.
quiz.explanation: 爬升放行的核心證據是錨點所在牆體的實際強度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The key evidence for releasing a climb is the actual strength of the wall at the anchors. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 早齡強度驗收與爬升放行：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Early-age strength acceptance and climbing release: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨點區現場養護試體」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Field-cured specimens at anchor level” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設錨點放行強度 10 MPa、驗收規則為三個現場試體平均 ≥ 10 MPa 且單一 ≥ 9.0 MPa。20 h 時試體 11.2、10.4、9.6 MPa，平均 10.4 MPa，放行；冬季同時段為 8.1、7.6、8.4 MPa，平均約 8.0 MPa，若強度成長約 0.3 MPa/h，需再等 (10 − 8.0)/0.3 ≈ 6.6 h。數值為教學假設，不是任何專案的試驗資料。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume an anchor release strength of 10 MPa with the rule that three field-cured specimens average at least 10 MPa and none is below 9.0 MPa. At 20 h, results of 11.2, 10.4 and 9.6 MPa average 10.4 MPa and the climb is released; in winter the same age gives 8.1, 7.6 and 8.4 MPa, averaging about 8.0 MPa, and at a gain of about 0.3 MPa/h another (10 − 8.0)/0.3 ≈ 6.6 h is needed. Values are teaching assumptions, not test data from any project. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：現場試體與牆體一起放在平台上養護並標示對應樓層；試驗結果在爬升許可單上填寫，並與溫度感測器推估值比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Keep field-cured specimens on the platform beside the wall they represent, labelled by storey; write results on the climbing permit and compare with temperature-based estimates, using the more conservative value when they differ widely and reviewing whether specimen curing truly represents the wall.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 假設錨點放行強度 10 MPa、驗收規則為三個現場試體平均 ≥ 10 MPa 且單一 ≥ 9.0 MPa。20 h 時試體 11.2、10.4、9.6 MPa，平均 10.4 MPa，放行；冬季同時段為 8.1、7.6、8.4 MPa，平均約 8.0 MPa，若強度成長約 0.3 MPa/h，需再等 (10 − 8.0)/0.3 ≈ 6.6 h。數值為教學假設，不是任何專案的試驗資料。
knowledge.textEn: Assume an anchor release strength of 10 MPa with the rule that three field-cured specimens average at least 10 MPa and none is below 9.0 MPa. At 20 h, results of 11.2, 10.4 and 9.6 MPa average 10.4 MPa and the climb is released; in winter the same age gives 8.1, 7.6 and 8.4 MPa, averaging about 8.0 MPa, and at a gain of about 0.3 MPa/h another (10 − 8.0)/0.3 ≈ 6.6 h is needed. Values are teaching assumptions, not test data from any project.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「早齡強度驗收與爬升放行」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Early-age strength acceptance and climbing release", which statement holds?
options: 爬模到頂後拆除只是組裝的反向步驟，不需要另做計算。
錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。
假設錨點放行強度 10 MPa、驗收規則為三個現場試體平均 ≥ 10 MPa 且單一 ≥ 9.0 MPa。
optionsEn: Dismantling at the top is just assembly in reverse and needs no separate calculation.
If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters.
Assume an anchor release strength of 10 MPa with the rule that three field-cured specimens average at least 10 MPa and none is below 9.0 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 假設錨點放行強度 10 MPa、驗收規則為三個現場試體平均 ≥ 10 MPa 且單一 ≥ 9.0 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume an anchor release strength of 10 MPa with the rule that three field-cured specimens average at least 10 MPa and none is below 9.0 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 早齡強度驗收與爬升放行：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Early-age strength acceptance and climbing release: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨點區現場養護試體」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Field-cured specimens at anchor level” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 現場試體與牆體一起放在平台上養護並標示對應樓層；試驗結果在爬升許可單上填寫，並與溫度感測器推估值比對。兩者差異過大時以較保守者為準，並檢討試體養護條件是否真正代表牆體。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Keep field-cured specimens on the platform beside the wall they represent, labelled by storey; write results on the climbing permit and compare with temperature-based estimates, using the more conservative value when they differ widely and reviewing whether specimen curing truly represents the wall. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：品質計畫中規定放行強度、試體數量、養護位置與試驗時間，並把冬季的延長等待寫入循環表；任何不符合時都不得以主管口頭同意代替，須由結構或臨時工程設計者書面處理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set the release strength, number of specimens, curing location and test age in the quality plan and build longer winter waits into the cycle chart; never replace a nonconformance with a supervisor's verbal approval, but have the structural or temporary-works designer resolve it in writing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以標準養護試體或配比設計強度作為放行依據，忽略高空低溫，錨點區混凝土實際強度不足，爬升時錨點周圍開裂；試體放在溫暖的工務所而非平台上，同樣高估實際強度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Releasing climbs on standard-cured results or mix-design strength while ignoring cold at height leaves anchor-zone concrete too weak, and it cracks around the anchors during the climb; storing specimens in a warm site office instead of on the platform overestimates real strength in the same way. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 現場試體與牆體一起放在平台上養護並標示對應樓層；試驗結果在爬升許可單上填寫，並與溫度感測器推估值比對。兩者差異過大時以較保守者為準，並檢討試體養護條件是否真正代表牆體。
knowledge.textEn: Keep field-cured specimens on the platform beside the wall they represent, labelled by storey; write results on the climbing permit and compare with temperature-based estimates, using the more conservative value when they differ widely and reviewing whether specimen curing truly represents the wall.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 品質計畫中規定放行強度、試體數量、養護位置與試驗時間，並把冬季的延長等待寫入循環表；任何不符合時都不得以主管口頭同意代替，須由結構或臨時工程設計者書面處理。
knowledge.textEn: Set the release strength, number of specimens, curing location and test age in the quality plan and build longer winter waits into the cycle chart; never replace a nonconformance with a supervisor's verbal approval, but have the structural or temporary-works designer resolve it in writing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「早齡強度驗收與爬升放行」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Early-age strength acceptance and climbing release"?
options: 現場試體與牆體一起放在平台上養護並標示對應樓層；試驗結果在爬升許可單上填寫，並與溫度感測器推估值比對。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
模板側壓只跟澆置高度有關，與澆置速度和配比無關。
optionsEn: Keep field-cured specimens on the platform beside the wall they represent, labelled by storey.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Form pressure depends only on lift height, not on pour rate or mix.
quiz.explanation: 現場試體與牆體一起放在平台上養護並標示對應樓層；試驗結果在爬升許可單上填寫，並與溫度感測器推估值比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Keep field-cured specimens on the platform beside the wall they represent, labelled by storey; write results on the climbing permit and compare with temperature-based estimates, using the more conservative value when they differ widely and reviewing whether specimen curing truly represents the wall. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 早齡強度驗收與爬升放行：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Early-age strength acceptance and climbing release: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨點區現場養護試體」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Field-cured specimens at anchor level” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以標準養護試體或配比設計強度作為放行依據，忽略高空低溫，錨點區混凝土實際強度不足，爬升時錨點周圍開裂；試體放在溫暖的工務所而非平台上，同樣高估實際強度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Releasing climbs on standard-cured results or mix-design strength while ignoring cold at height leaves anchor-zone concrete too weak, and it cracks around the anchors during the climb; storing specimens in a warm site office instead of on the platform overestimates real strength in the same way. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：冬季或高空寒風時，早期強度可能比預期低很多，爬升時程必須跟著調整。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In winter or cold wind at height, early strength can fall far below expectation, and the climbing schedule must adjust accordingly.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「核心筒用的是高強度混凝土，所以一天後一定已經足夠讓錨點承載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Core walls use high-strength concrete, so after one day the anchors can certainly carry load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以標準養護試體或配比設計強度作為放行依據，忽略高空低溫，錨點區混凝土實際強度不足，爬升時錨點周圍開裂；試體放在溫暖的工務所而非平台上，同樣高估實際強度。
knowledge.textEn: Releasing climbs on standard-cured results or mix-design strength while ignoring cold at height leaves anchor-zone concrete too weak, and it cracks around the anchors during the climb; storing specimens in a warm site office instead of on the platform overestimates real strength in the same way.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「早齡強度驗收與爬升放行」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Early-age strength acceptance and climbing release" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
以標準養護試體或配比設計強度作為放行依據，忽略高空低溫，錨點區混凝土實際強度不足，爬升時錨點周圍開裂；試體放在溫暖的工務所而非平台上，同樣高估實際強度。
只要控制面板沒有警報，平台就一定是水平且所有單元都已鎖定。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Releasing climbs on standard-cured results or mix-design strength while ignoring cold at height leaves anchor-zone concrete too weak, and it cracks around the anchors during the climb.
If the control panel shows no alarm, the platform must be level and every unit locked.
quiz.explanation: 以標準養護試體或配比設計強度作為放行依據，忽略高空低溫，錨點區混凝土實際強度不足，爬升時錨點周圍開裂；試體放在溫暖的工務所而非平台上，同樣高估實際強度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Releasing climbs on standard-cured results or mix-design strength while ignoring cold at height leaves anchor-zone concrete too weak, and it cracks around the anchors during the climb; storing specimens in a warm site office instead of on the platform overestimates real strength in the same way. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 爬升同步、平台傾斜與荷重監測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Climbing synchronisation, platform tilt and load monitoring: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「平台傾斜與油壓監測」如何影響高層建築液壓爬模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Platform tilt and hydraulic monitoring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydraulic climbing-form construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 一個核心筒可能同時有上百組爬升單元，例如哈里發塔共有 226 組自爬單元，整體平台由許多單元以剛接或鉸接連在一起。爬升時若各單元行程不同步，平台會產生傾斜與扭轉，連接處產生附加內力，落後的單元可能被拖著走或承擔額外荷重。現代系統以中央控制同時讀取各缸壓力、行程與平台傾斜，設定警戒值與自動停止值；人員仍需在爬升中目視確認軌道與爬升靴的位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「平台傾斜與油壓監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A core may have over a hundred climbing units working together; Burj Khalifa had 226 self-climbing units in total, with the platforms linked by rigid or pinned connections. If units stroke unevenly during a climb, the platform tilts and twists, the connections pick up extra forces, and a lagging unit may be dragged along or carry extra load. Modern systems read each cylinder's pressure, stroke and platform tilt centrally, with alert and automatic stop values; people still need to watch rails and shoes during the climb. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Platform tilt and hydraulic monitoring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：爬升 4 m、兩單元速度差 0.5% 時，終點高差 = 4,000×0.005 = 20 mm；單元間距 6 m，平台斜率 20/6,000 ≈ 1:300。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Climbing 4 m with a 0.5% speed difference between two units leaves a level difference of 4,000×0.005 = 20 mm; at 6 m unit spacing the platform slope is 20/6,000 ≈ 1:300.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要控制面板沒有警報，平台就一定是水平且所有單元都已鎖定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the control panel shows no alarm, the platform must be level and every unit locked." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「平台傾斜與油壓監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Platform tilt and hydraulic monitoring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 爬升同步、平台傾斜與荷重監測
knowledge.titleEn: Climbing synchronisation, platform tilt and load monitoring
knowledge.text: 一個核心筒可能同時有上百組爬升單元，例如哈里發塔共有 226 組自爬單元，整體平台由許多單元以剛接或鉸接連在一起。爬升時若各單元行程不同步，平台會產生傾斜與扭轉，連接處產生附加內力，落後的單元可能被拖著走或承擔額外荷重。
knowledge.textEn: A core may have over a hundred climbing units working together; Burj Khalifa had 226 self-climbing units in total, with the platforms linked by rigid or pinned connections. If units stroke unevenly during a climb, the platform tilts and twists, the connections pick up extra forces, and a lagging unit may be dragged along or carry extra load.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要控制面板沒有警報，平台就一定是水平且所有單元都已鎖定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the control panel shows no alarm, the platform must be level and every unit locked. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「爬升同步、平台傾斜與荷重監測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Climbing synchronisation, platform tilt and load monitoring" is correct?
options: 只要控制面板沒有警報，平台就一定是水平且所有單元都已鎖定。
錨錐孔很小，封不封堵對結構與耐久沒有影響。
一個核心筒可能同時有上百組爬升單元，例如哈里發塔共有 226 組自爬單元，整體平台由許多單元以剛接或鉸接連在一起。
optionsEn: If the control panel shows no alarm, the platform must be level and every unit locked.
Anchor-cone holes are small, so plugging them has no effect on structure or durability.
A core may have over a hundred climbing units working together.
quiz.explanation: 一個核心筒可能同時有上百組爬升單元，例如哈里發塔共有 226 組自爬單元，整體平台由許多單元以剛接或鉸接連在一起。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A core may have over a hundred climbing units working together; Burj Khalifa had 226 self-climbing units in total, with the platforms linked by rigid or pinned connections. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 爬升同步、平台傾斜與荷重監測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Climbing synchronisation, platform tilt and load monitoring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「平台傾斜與油壓監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Platform tilt and hydraulic monitoring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：爬升 4 m、兩單元速度差 0.5% 時，終點高差 = 4,000×0.005 = 20 mm；單元間距 6 m，平台斜率 20/6,000 ≈ 1:300。若規定高差警戒值 10 mm，同步控制必須在爬升到約 2 m 前修正。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Climbing 4 m with a 0.5% speed difference between two units leaves a level difference of 4,000×0.005 = 20 mm; at 6 m unit spacing the platform slope is 20/6,000 ≈ 1:300. With a 10 mm alert value, synchronisation must correct the difference before about 2 m of travel. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：爬升中以控制系統記錄每缸壓力與行程曲線，並於平台四角設傾斜計；爬升完成後以水準儀抽測平台水平，與控制系統讀值比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log each cylinder's pressure and stroke during the climb and fit inclinometers at platform corners; after the climb spot-check platform level with an optical level against the control readings, and inspect any unit with abnormally high pressure for binding or concentrated platform load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 爬升 4 m、兩單元速度差 0.5% 時，終點高差 = 4,000×0.005 = 20 mm；單元間距 6 m，平台斜率 20/6,000 ≈ 1:300。若規定高差警戒值 10 mm，同步控制必須在爬升到約 2 m 前修正。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Climbing 4 m with a 0.5% speed difference between two units leaves a level difference of 4,000×0.005 = 20 mm; at 6 m unit spacing the platform slope is 20/6,000 ≈ 1:300. With a 10 mm alert value, synchronisation must correct the difference before about 2 m of travel. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「爬升同步、平台傾斜與荷重監測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Climbing synchronisation, platform tilt and load monitoring", which statement holds?
options: 爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。
油壓缸頂升力很大，所以平台上多放材料也不會影響爬升安全。
optionsEn: Climbing 4 m with a 0.5% speed difference between two units leaves a level difference of 4,000×0.005 = 20 mm.
The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb.
The cylinders are so powerful that extra material on the platform does not affect climbing safety.
quiz.explanation: 爬升 4 m、兩單元速度差 0.5% 時，終點高差 = 4,000×0.005 = 20 mm；單元間距 6 m，平台斜率 20/6,000 ≈ 1:300。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Climbing 4 m with a 0.5% speed difference between two units leaves a level difference of 4,000×0.005 = 20 mm; at 6 m unit spacing the platform slope is 20/6,000 ≈ 1:300. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 爬升同步、平台傾斜與荷重監測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Climbing synchronisation, platform tilt and load monitoring: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「平台傾斜與油壓監測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Platform tilt and hydraulic monitoring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 爬升中以控制系統記錄每缸壓力與行程曲線，並於平台四角設傾斜計；爬升完成後以水準儀抽測平台水平，與控制系統讀值比對。壓力異常偏高的單元要檢查是否卡阻或平台荷重集中。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log each cylinder's pressure and stroke during the climb and fit inclinometers at platform corners; after the climb spot-check platform level with an optical level against the control readings, and inspect any unit with abnormally high pressure for binding or concentrated platform load. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：爬升作業至少配置一位專責巡視員沿平台確認爬升靴與軌道狀態，並與控制員以無線電保持聯絡；控制系統的感測器每月校正，紀錄保存於設備檔案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assign at least one patrol person to walk the platform during each climb checking shoes and rails, in radio contact with the operator; calibrate control sensors monthly and keep the records in the equipment file.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：控制系統的行程感測器故障而未發現，單一單元持續落後，平台連接處螺栓剪斷或平台撕開；人員只看控制面板而不巡視，未發現某個爬升靴未完全鎖定，下一次澆置時錨點受力異常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A failed stroke sensor goes unnoticed while one unit keeps lagging, shearing connection bolts or tearing the platform apart; staff who watch only the control panel without walking the platform miss a shoe that has not fully latched, and its anchor is loaded abnormally at the next pour. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 爬升中以控制系統記錄每缸壓力與行程曲線，並於平台四角設傾斜計；爬升完成後以水準儀抽測平台水平，與控制系統讀值比對。壓力異常偏高的單元要檢查是否卡阻或平台荷重集中。
knowledge.textEn: Log each cylinder's pressure and stroke during the climb and fit inclinometers at platform corners; after the climb spot-check platform level with an optical level against the control readings, and inspect any unit with abnormally high pressure for binding or concentrated platform load.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 爬升作業至少配置一位專責巡視員沿平台確認爬升靴與軌道狀態，並與控制員以無線電保持聯絡；控制系統的感測器每月校正，紀錄保存於設備檔案。
knowledge.textEn: Assign at least one patrol person to walk the platform during each climb checking shoes and rails, in radio contact with the operator; calibrate control sensors monthly and keep the records in the equipment file.

quiz.question: 要驗證「爬升同步、平台傾斜與荷重監測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Climbing synchronisation, platform tilt and load monitoring"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
爬升中以控制系統記錄每缸壓力與行程曲線，並於平台四角設傾斜計；爬升完成後以水準儀抽測平台水平，與控制系統讀值比對。
爬模平台很大，所以任何位置都可以堆放材料。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Log each cylinder's pressure and stroke during the climb and fit inclinometers at platform corners.
Climbing-form platforms are large, so materials can be stacked anywhere on them.
quiz.explanation: 爬升中以控制系統記錄每缸壓力與行程曲線，並於平台四角設傾斜計；爬升完成後以水準儀抽測平台水平，與控制系統讀值比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log each cylinder's pressure and stroke during the climb and fit inclinometers at platform corners; after the climb spot-check platform level with an optical level against the control readings, and inspect any unit with abnormally high pressure for binding or concentrated platform load. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 爬升同步、平台傾斜與荷重監測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Climbing synchronisation, platform tilt and load monitoring: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「平台傾斜與油壓監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Platform tilt and hydraulic monitoring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 控制系統的行程感測器故障而未發現，單一單元持續落後，平台連接處螺栓剪斷或平台撕開；人員只看控制面板而不巡視，未發現某個爬升靴未完全鎖定，下一次澆置時錨點受力異常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A failed stroke sensor goes unnoticed while one unit keeps lagging, shearing connection bolts or tearing the platform apart; staff who watch only the control panel without walking the platform miss a shoe that has not fully latched, and its anchor is loaded abnormally at the next pour. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：現代系統以中央控制同時讀取各缸壓力、行程與平台傾斜，設定警戒值與自動停止值；人員仍需在爬升中目視確認軌道與爬升靴的位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Modern systems read each cylinder's pressure, stroke and platform tilt centrally, with alert and automatic stop values; people still need to watch rails and shoes during the climb.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要控制面板沒有警報，平台就一定是水平且所有單元都已鎖定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the control panel shows no alarm, the platform must be level and every unit locked." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 控制系統的行程感測器故障而未發現，單一單元持續落後，平台連接處螺栓剪斷或平台撕開；人員只看控制面板而不巡視，未發現某個爬升靴未完全鎖定，下一次澆置時錨點受力異常。
knowledge.textEn: A failed stroke sensor goes unnoticed while one unit keeps lagging, shearing connection bolts or tearing the platform apart; staff who watch only the control panel without walking the platform miss a shoe that has not fully latched, and its anchor is loaded abnormally at the next pour.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「爬升同步、平台傾斜與荷重監測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Climbing synchronisation, platform tilt and load monitoring" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
錨錐孔很小，封不封堵對結構與耐久沒有影響。
控制系統的行程感測器故障而未發現，單一單元持續落後，平台連接處螺栓剪斷或平台撕開。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Anchor-cone holes are small, so plugging them has no effect on structure or durability.
A failed stroke sensor goes unnoticed while one unit keeps lagging, shearing connection bolts or tearing the platform apart.
quiz.explanation: 控制系統的行程感測器故障而未發現，單一單元持續落後，平台連接處螺栓剪斷或平台撕開；人員只看控制面板而不巡視，未發現某個爬升靴未完全鎖定，下一次澆置時錨點受力異常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A failed stroke sensor goes unnoticed while one unit keeps lagging, shearing connection bolts or tearing the platform apart; staff who watch only the control panel without walking the platform miss a shoe that has not fully latched, and its anchor is loaded abnormally at the next pour. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「錨錐孔封堵、耐久與防火」與「改裝紀錄、頂部拆除與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Plugging cone holes for durability and fire" and "Modification records, top-out dismantling and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 錨錐孔封堵、耐久與防火：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Plugging cone holes for durability and fire: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「錨錐孔與修補」如何影響高層建築液壓爬模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Anchor-cone holes and patching” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydraulic climbing-form construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每次爬升都在牆上留下錨錐孔與螺桿孔，拆除錨錐後必須以專用塞頭或修補砂漿封堵。這些孔洞若未妥善處理，會成為水、氯離子與二氧化碳進入的捷徑，也可能削弱防火時的保護層。高層核心筒多在電梯井與樓梯間，孔洞位置可能在日後難以到達的位置，所以應在下層平台趁平台經過時立即處理。哈里發塔約有 2,500 次爬升步驟，留下的孔洞數量以千計，必須以系統化方式追蹤。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「錨錐孔與修補」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each climb leaves anchor-cone and bolt holes in the wall, which must be plugged with purpose-made plugs or repair mortar after the cones are removed. Poorly treated holes become short paths for water, chlorides and carbon dioxide and can weaken the cover that protects reinforcement in fire. High-rise cores enclose elevator shafts and stairs, where holes may later be hard to reach, so they should be treated from the lowest platform while it passes. Burj Khalifa involved about 2,500 climbing steps, leaving holes in the thousands that had to be tracked systematically. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Anchor-cone holes and patching” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若約 2,500 次爬升步驟每次留下 2 個錨孔，總數約 5,000 個；以 5% 抽查率做附著與密實度檢查，需檢查約 250 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If each of about 2,500 climbing steps leaves two anchor holes, there are about 5,000 holes; a 5% sample for bond and compaction checks means about 250 inspections.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錨錐孔很小，封不封堵對結構與耐久沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Anchor-cone holes are small, so plugging them has no effect on structure or durability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「錨錐孔與修補」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Anchor-cone holes and patching”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錨錐孔封堵、耐久與防火
knowledge.titleEn: Plugging cone holes for durability and fire
knowledge.text: 每次爬升都在牆上留下錨錐孔與螺桿孔，拆除錨錐後必須以專用塞頭或修補砂漿封堵。這些孔洞若未妥善處理，會成為水、氯離子與二氧化碳進入的捷徑，也可能削弱防火時的保護層。
knowledge.textEn: Each climb leaves anchor-cone and bolt holes in the wall, which must be plugged with purpose-made plugs or repair mortar after the cones are removed. Poorly treated holes become short paths for water, chlorides and carbon dioxide and can weaken the cover that protects reinforcement in fire.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：錨錐孔很小，封不封堵對結構與耐久沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Anchor-cone holes are small, so plugging them has no effect on structure or durability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錨錐孔封堵、耐久與防火」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Plugging cone holes for durability and fire" is correct?
options: 每次爬升都在牆上留下錨錐孔與螺桿孔，拆除錨錐後必須以專用塞頭或修補砂漿封堵。
錨錐孔很小，封不封堵對結構與耐久沒有影響。
爬模到頂後拆除只是組裝的反向步驟，不需要另做計算。
optionsEn: Each climb leaves anchor-cone and bolt holes in the wall, which must be plugged with purpose-made plugs or repair mortar after the cones are removed.
Anchor-cone holes are small, so plugging them has no effect on structure or durability.
Dismantling at the top is just assembly in reverse and needs no separate calculation.
quiz.explanation: 每次爬升都在牆上留下錨錐孔與螺桿孔，拆除錨錐後必須以專用塞頭或修補砂漿封堵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each climb leaves anchor-cone and bolt holes in the wall, which must be plugged with purpose-made plugs or repair mortar after the cones are removed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錨錐孔封堵、耐久與防火：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Plugging cone holes for durability and fire: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨錐孔與修補」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Anchor-cone holes and patching” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若約 2,500 次爬升步驟每次留下 2 個錨孔，總數約 5,000 個；以 5% 抽查率做附著與密實度檢查，需檢查約 250 個。若抽查不合格率超過 2%（即 5 個以上），則擴大檢查該批次所有孔洞。數值中的爬升步驟數取自公開資料，其餘為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If each of about 2,500 climbing steps leaves two anchor holes, there are about 5,000 holes; a 5% sample for bond and compaction checks means about 250 inspections. If more than 2% of the sample (five or more) fails, all holes in that batch are inspected. The climbing-step count is from public information; the rest are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在下層平台以檢查表逐孔記錄封堵日期、材料批號與施作者，以敲擊或拉拔試驗抽查附著；電梯井內的孔洞要在電梯導軌安裝前完成檢查並拍照存證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record each hole's plugging date, material batch and installer on a checklist from the lowest platform, sample bond by tapping or pull-off tests, and inspect and photograph holes inside elevator shafts before rails are installed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若約 2,500 次爬升步驟每次留下 2 個錨孔，總數約 5,000 個；以 5% 抽查率做附著與密實度檢查，需檢查約 250 個。若抽查不合格率超過 2%（即 5 個以上），則擴大檢查該批次所有孔洞。數值中的爬升步驟數取自公開資料，其餘為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If each of about 2,500 climbing steps leaves two anchor holes, there are about 5,000 holes; a 5% sample for bond and compaction checks means about 250 inspections. If more than 2% of the sample (five or more) fails, all holes in that batch are inspected. The climbing-step count is from public information; the rest are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「錨錐孔封堵、耐久與防火」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Plugging cone holes for durability and fire", which statement holds?
options: 錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。
若約 2,500 次爬升步驟每次留下 2 個錨孔，總數約 5,000 個；以 5% 抽查率做附著與密實度檢查，需檢查約 250 個。
模板側壓只跟澆置高度有關，與澆置速度和配比無關。
optionsEn: If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters.
If each of about 2,500 climbing steps leaves two anchor holes, there are about 5,000 holes.
Form pressure depends only on lift height, not on pour rate or mix.
quiz.explanation: 若約 2,500 次爬升步驟每次留下 2 個錨孔，總數約 5,000 個；以 5% 抽查率做附著與密實度檢查，需檢查約 250 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If each of about 2,500 climbing steps leaves two anchor holes, there are about 5,000 holes; a 5% sample for bond and compaction checks means about 250 inspections. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 錨錐孔封堵、耐久與防火：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Plugging cone holes for durability and fire: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨錐孔與修補」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anchor-cone holes and patching” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在下層平台以檢查表逐孔記錄封堵日期、材料批號與施作者，以敲擊或拉拔試驗抽查附著；電梯井內的孔洞要在電梯導軌安裝前完成檢查並拍照存證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record each hole's plugging date, material batch and installer on a checklist from the lowest platform, sample bond by tapping or pull-off tests, and inspect and photograph holes inside elevator shafts before rails are installed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：孔洞封堵材料與方法要與防火、防水需求一起在規範中指定，並列為下層平台的固定工序；孔洞封堵完成率應隨樓層循環一起統計，未完成者不得讓平台離開該高程太遠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify plugging materials and methods together with fire and waterproofing requirements, make plugging a fixed task on the lowest platform, track completion with the floor cycle and do not let the platform move far beyond a level with unfinished holes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：封堵塞頭僅以乾縮大的砂漿塞填，日後脫落或出現環狀裂縫，雨水沿孔洞滲入鋼筋區；外牆孔洞未封堵，多年後出現鏽水痕，修補需搭設高空吊籠，費用遠高於當初施作。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Plugs set in high-shrinkage mortar later fall out or ring-crack, letting rain reach the reinforcement; unplugged holes on exterior walls show rust stains years later, and repairs need high-level cradles at far greater cost than doing it right at the time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在下層平台以檢查表逐孔記錄封堵日期、材料批號與施作者，以敲擊或拉拔試驗抽查附著；電梯井內的孔洞要在電梯導軌安裝前完成檢查並拍照存證。
knowledge.textEn: Record each hole's plugging date, material batch and installer on a checklist from the lowest platform, sample bond by tapping or pull-off tests, and inspect and photograph holes inside elevator shafts before rails are installed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 孔洞封堵材料與方法要與防火、防水需求一起在規範中指定，並列為下層平台的固定工序；孔洞封堵完成率應隨樓層循環一起統計，未完成者不得讓平台離開該高程太遠。
knowledge.textEn: Specify plugging materials and methods together with fire and waterproofing requirements, make plugging a fixed task on the lowest platform, track completion with the floor cycle and do not let the platform move far beyond a level with unfinished holes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錨錐孔封堵、耐久與防火」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Plugging cone holes for durability and fire"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
地面風不大，代表高空爬模也可以安全爬升。
在下層平台以檢查表逐孔記錄封堵日期、材料批號與施作者，以敲擊或拉拔試驗抽查附著；電梯井內的孔洞要在電梯導軌安裝前完成檢查並拍照存證。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Light wind at ground level means the climbing form can safely climb at height.

Record each hole's plugging date, material batch and installer on a checklist from the lowest platform, sample bond by tapping or pull-off tests, and inspect and photograph holes inside elevator shafts before rails are installed.
quiz.explanation: 在下層平台以檢查表逐孔記錄封堵日期、材料批號與施作者，以敲擊或拉拔試驗抽查附著；電梯井內的孔洞要在電梯導軌安裝前完成檢查並拍照存證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record each hole's plugging date, material batch and installer on a checklist from the lowest platform, sample bond by tapping or pull-off tests, and inspect and photograph holes inside elevator shafts before rails are installed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 錨錐孔封堵、耐久與防火：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Plugging cone holes for durability and fire: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨錐孔與修補」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Anchor-cone holes and patching” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 封堵塞頭僅以乾縮大的砂漿塞填，日後脫落或出現環狀裂縫，雨水沿孔洞滲入鋼筋區；外牆孔洞未封堵，多年後出現鏽水痕，修補需搭設高空吊籠，費用遠高於當初施作。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Plugs set in high-shrinkage mortar later fall out or ring-crack, letting rain reach the reinforcement; unplugged holes on exterior walls show rust stains years later, and repairs need high-level cradles at far greater cost than doing it right at the time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：哈里發塔約有 2,500 次爬升步驟，留下的孔洞數量以千計，必須以系統化方式追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Burj Khalifa involved about 2,500 climbing steps, leaving holes in the thousands that had to be tracked systematically.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錨錐孔很小，封不封堵對結構與耐久沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Anchor-cone holes are small, so plugging them has no effect on structure or durability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 封堵塞頭僅以乾縮大的砂漿塞填，日後脫落或出現環狀裂縫，雨水沿孔洞滲入鋼筋區；外牆孔洞未封堵，多年後出現鏽水痕，修補需搭設高空吊籠，費用遠高於當初施作。
knowledge.textEn: Plugs set in high-shrinkage mortar later fall out or ring-crack, letting rain reach the reinforcement; unplugged holes on exterior walls show rust stains years later, and repairs need high-level cradles at far greater cost than doing it right at the time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錨錐孔封堵、耐久與防火」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Plugging cone holes for durability and fire" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 封堵塞頭僅以乾縮大的砂漿塞填，日後脫落或出現環狀裂縫，雨水沿孔洞滲入鋼筋區；外牆孔洞未封堵，多年後出現鏽水痕，修補需搭設高空吊籠，費用遠高於當初施作。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
爬模到頂後拆除只是組裝的反向步驟，不需要另做計算。
optionsEn: Plugs set in high-shrinkage mortar later fall out or ring-crack, letting rain reach the reinforcement.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Dismantling at the top is just assembly in reverse and needs no separate calculation.
quiz.explanation: 封堵塞頭僅以乾縮大的砂漿塞填，日後脫落或出現環狀裂縫，雨水沿孔洞滲入鋼筋區；外牆孔洞未封堵，多年後出現鏽水痕，修補需搭設高空吊籠，費用遠高於當初施作。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Plugs set in high-shrinkage mortar later fall out or ring-crack, letting rain reach the reinforcement; unplugged holes on exterior walls show rust stains years later, and repairs need high-level cradles at far greater cost than doing it right at the time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 改裝紀錄、頂部拆除與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Modification records, top-out dismantling and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「頂部拆除與設備紀錄」如何影響高層建築液壓爬模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Top-out dismantling and equipment records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydraulic climbing-form construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 爬模在施工期間會因牆厚變化、退縮、開口與巨柱轉換而多次改裝，每次改裝都改變了平台荷重與錨點配置，因此改裝圖與計算必須和原設計同樣受控。到達頂部後，平台需在高空分段拆除並以塔吊吊下，這時塔吊能力、吊點與拆除順序決定了安全；拆除過程中剩餘平台的穩定性也要計算。交接時，結構業主需要的是牆體品質紀錄（錨孔、修補、強度、垂直度），而設備供應商需要的是設備使用與損耗紀錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「頂部拆除與設備紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During construction a climbing form is modified many times for changes in wall thickness, setbacks, openings and megacolumn transitions, and each modification changes platform loads and anchor layout, so modification drawings and calculations need the same control as the original design. At the top the platforms must be dismantled in sections at height and lowered by crane, where crane capacity, pick points and dismantling sequence decide safety, and the stability of the remaining platform during dismantling must also be calculated. At handover the structural owner needs wall quality records, such as anchor holes, repairs, strength and verticality, while the equipment supplier needs records of use and wear. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Top-out dismantling and equipment records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以哈里發塔的 226 組單元為規模參考，若每組拆成約 5 t 的吊件、塔吊每小時可完成 4 次吊卸，約需 226/4 ≈ 56.5 h 塔吊時間，約 7 個 8 小時工作天；若高空風速每天只允許一半時段作業，就要約 14 天。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taking Burj Khalifa's 226 units as the scale, if each unit is dismantled into lifts of about 5 t and the crane manages four lifts per hour, about 226/4 ≈ 56.5 h of crane time are needed, about seven 8-hour days; if wind at height allows work only half the time, about 14 days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「爬模到頂後拆除只是組裝的反向步驟，不需要另做計算。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dismantling at the top is just assembly in reverse and needs no separate calculation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「頂部拆除與設備紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Top-out dismantling and equipment records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 改裝紀錄、頂部拆除與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Modification records, top-out dismantling and handover
knowledge.text: 爬模在施工期間會因牆厚變化、退縮、開口與巨柱轉換而多次改裝，每次改裝都改變了平台荷重與錨點配置，因此改裝圖與計算必須和原設計同樣受控。到達頂部後，平台需在高空分段拆除並以塔吊吊下，這時塔吊能力、吊點與拆除順序決定了安全；拆除過程中剩餘平台的穩定性也要計算。
knowledge.textEn: During construction a climbing form is modified many times for changes in wall thickness, setbacks, openings and megacolumn transitions, and each modification changes platform loads and anchor layout, so modification drawings and calculations need the same control as the original design. At the top the platforms must be dismantled in sections at height and lowered by crane, where crane capacity, pick points and dismantling sequence decide safety, and the stability of the remaining platform during dismantling must also be calculated.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：爬模到頂後拆除只是組裝的反向步驟，不需要另做計算。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dismantling at the top is just assembly in reverse and needs no separate calculation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「改裝紀錄、頂部拆除與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Modification records, top-out dismantling and handover" is correct?
options: 爬模到頂後拆除只是組裝的反向步驟，不需要另做計算。
爬模在施工期間會因牆厚變化、退縮、開口與巨柱轉換而多次改裝，每次改裝都改變了平台荷重與錨點配置，因此改裝圖與計算必須和原設計同樣受控。
爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。
optionsEn: Dismantling at the top is just assembly in reverse and needs no separate calculation.

During construction a climbing form is modified many times for changes in wall thickness, setbacks, openings and megacolumn transitions, and each modification changes platform loads and anchor layout, so modification drawings and calculations need the same control as the original design.
The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb.
quiz.explanation: 爬模在施工期間會因牆厚變化、退縮、開口與巨柱轉換而多次改裝，每次改裝都改變了平台荷重與錨點配置，因此改裝圖與計算必須和原設計同樣受控。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: During construction a climbing form is modified many times for changes in wall thickness, setbacks, openings and megacolumn transitions, and each modification changes platform loads and anchor layout, so modification drawings and calculations need the same control as the original design. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 改裝紀錄、頂部拆除與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Modification records, top-out dismantling and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂部拆除與設備紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Top-out dismantling and equipment records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以哈里發塔的 226 組單元為規模參考，若每組拆成約 5 t 的吊件、塔吊每小時可完成 4 次吊卸，約需 226/4 ≈ 56.5 h 塔吊時間，約 7 個 8 小時工作天；若高空風速每天只允許一半時段作業，就要約 14 天。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taking Burj Khalifa's 226 units as the scale, if each unit is dismantled into lifts of about 5 t and the crane manages four lifts per hour, about 226/4 ≈ 56.5 h of crane time are needed, about seven 8-hour days; if wind at height allows work only half the time, about 14 days. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次改裝都需有版本控制的圖面與計算，由爬模設計者簽認並在現場張貼生效版本；拆除計畫須包含拆除順序、剩餘平台穩定計算、吊件重量清單與禁區，並設停檢點由臨時工程設計者確認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Every modification needs version-controlled drawings and calculations signed by the climbing-form designer, with the current version posted on site; the dismantling plan must include sequence, stability calculations for the remaining platform, a list of lift weights and exclusion zones, with a hold point confirmed by the temporary-works designer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以哈里發塔的 226 組單元為規模參考，若每組拆成約 5 t 的吊件、塔吊每小時可完成 4 次吊卸，約需 226/4 ≈ 56.5 h 塔吊時間，約 7 個 8 小時工作天；若高空風速每天只允許一半時段作業，就要約 14 天。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Taking Burj Khalifa's 226 units as the scale, if each unit is dismantled into lifts of about 5 t and the crane manages four lifts per hour, about 226/4 ≈ 56.5 h of crane time are needed, about seven 8-hour days; if wind at height allows work only half the time, about 14 days. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.
