Taking Burj Khalifa's 226 units as the scale, if each unit is dismantled into lifts of about 5 t and the crane manages four lifts per hour, about 226/4 ≈ 56.5 h of crane time are needed, about seven 8-hour days.

steps.title: 改裝紀錄、頂部拆除與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Modification records, top-out dismantling and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂部拆除與設備紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Top-out dismantling and equipment records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每次改裝都需有版本控制的圖面與計算，由爬模設計者簽認並在現場張貼生效版本；拆除計畫須包含拆除順序、剩餘平台穩定計算、吊件重量清單與禁區，並設停檢點由臨時工程設計者確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Every modification needs version-controlled drawings and calculations signed by the climbing-form designer, with the current version posted on site; the dismantling plan must include sequence, stability calculations for the remaining platform, a list of lift weights and exclusion zones, with a hold point confirmed by the temporary-works designer. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含每層爬升許可與強度紀錄、錨孔封堵紀錄、改裝版本清單、垂直度量測與修補位置圖；拆除作業列為高風險作業，須由臨時工程設計者、吊裝工程師與安全主管共同核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include each storey's climbing permits and strength records, anchor-hole plugging records, the list of modification versions, verticality surveys and repair maps; dismantling is high-risk work requiring joint approval by the temporary-works designer, lifting engineer and safety manager.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：現場自行改裝平台而未通知設計者，原本的錨點配置無法承受新增懸挑，平台在下一次爬升時變形；拆除時先拆掉提供穩定的斜撐，剩餘平台在風中失穩，構件墜落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Modifying a platform on site without telling the designer leaves the original anchor layout unable to carry a new cantilever, and the platform deforms at the next climb; removing stabilising braces first during dismantling lets the remaining platform become unstable in wind and pieces fall. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「改裝紀錄、頂部拆除與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Modification records, top-out dismantling and handover"?
options: 每次改裝都需有版本控制的圖面與計算，由爬模設計者簽認並在現場張貼生效版本。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
核心筒用的是高強度混凝土，所以一天後一定已經足夠讓錨點承載。
optionsEn: Every modification needs version-controlled drawings and calculations signed by the climbing-form designer, with the current version posted on site.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Core walls use high-strength concrete, so after one day the anchors can certainly carry load.

quiz.explanationEn: Every modification needs version-controlled drawings and calculations signed by the climbing-form designer, with the current version posted on site; the dismantling plan must include sequence, stability calculations for the remaining platform, a list of lift weights and exclusion zones, with a hold point confirmed by the temporary-works designer. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 改裝紀錄、頂部拆除與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Modification records, top-out dismantling and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂部拆除與設備紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Top-out dismantling and equipment records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 現場自行改裝平台而未通知設計者，原本的錨點配置無法承受新增懸挑，平台在下一次爬升時變形；拆除時先拆掉提供穩定的斜撐，剩餘平台在風中失穩，構件墜落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Modifying a platform on site without telling the designer leaves the original anchor layout unable to carry a new cantilever, and the platform deforms at the next climb; removing stabilising braces first during dismantling lets the remaining platform become unstable in wind and pieces fall. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時，結構業主需要的是牆體品質紀錄（錨孔、修補、強度、垂直度），而設備供應商需要的是設備使用與損耗紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At handover the structural owner needs wall quality records, such as anchor holes, repairs, strength and verticality, while the equipment supplier needs records of use and wear.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「爬模到頂後拆除只是組裝的反向步驟，不需要另做計算。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dismantling at the top is just assembly in reverse and needs no separate calculation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「改裝紀錄、頂部拆除與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Modification records, top-out dismantling and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
現場自行改裝平台而未通知設計者，原本的錨點配置無法承受新增懸挑，平台在下一次爬升時變形；拆除時先拆掉提供穩定的斜撐，剩餘平台在風中失穩，構件墜落。
爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Modifying a platform on site without telling the designer leaves the original anchor layout unable to carry a new cantilever, and the platform deforms at the next climb.
The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb.
quiz.explanation: 現場自行改裝平台而未通知設計者，原本的錨點配置無法承受新增懸挑，平台在下一次爬升時變形；拆除時先拆掉提供穩定的斜撐，剩餘平台在風中失穩，構件墜落。 需以量測區分可能原因。

title: 高強度混凝土高程泵送
summary: 超高層核心筒與巨柱的混凝土多以泵送輸送，600 m 的垂直高度本身就產生約 14 MPa 的靜壓，再加上高強度混凝土黏度高造成的管壁摩擦，泵機出口壓力可達 20 至 30 MPa 級。本課以哈里發塔 2008 年 606 m 的垂直泵送紀錄、上海中心大廈約 580 m 的泵送、平安金融中心以 C100 泵送至 555.5 m 等案例，說明壓力組成、潤滑層流變、高壓管與接頭、泵機功率、管線固定、開泵與清管、可泵性試驗、溫度與坍流度監測、磨耗檢測與強度追溯。
summaryEn: Concrete for supertall cores and megacolumns is mostly pumped; a vertical lift of 600 m alone creates about 14 MPa of static head, and wall friction from viscous high-strength mixes pushes pump outlet pressures into the 20 to 30 MPa range. Using Burj Khalifa's 2008 vertical pumping record of 606 m, pumping to about 580 m at Shanghai Tower and C100 concrete pumped to 555.5 m at Ping An Finance Center, the course covers pressure components, lubrication-layer rheology, high-pressure pipes and couplings, pump power, line fixing, start-up and flushing, pumpability testing, temperature and slump-flow monitoring, wear inspection and strength traceability.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 計算練習：以 125 mm 管徑把高強度混凝土泵送到 600 m 高，總管長 700 m、10 個彎管、排量 40 m³/h。靜壓 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa；摩擦梯度由試驗迴路量得 0.0106 MPa/m，700 m 約 7.4 MPa；彎管 1.0 MPa；總泵壓約 22.8 MPa。管內流速 0.0111/0.0123 ≈ 0.91 m/s；水力功率 22.8×10⁶×0.0111 ≈ 253 kW，效率 0.75 時引擎約 338 kW。以 D = 150 mm、容許應力 300 MPa 計，所需壁厚 22.8×150/600 ≈ 5.7 mm，取 10 mm 新管保留磨耗裕度。若為提高強度使界面黏度加倍，摩擦梯度升到 0.0202 MPa/m，總泵壓約 29.5 MPa，功率約 328 kW、引擎約 437 kW，所需壁厚增為約 7.4 mm，磨耗裕度與管件壽命都大幅縮短，可能需要改用接力泵或調整配比。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。
workedExample.textEn: Calculation exercise: high-strength concrete is pumped through a 125 mm line to 600 m, with 700 m of line, ten bends and 40 m³/h output. Static head is 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa; the loop-measured friction gradient of 0.0106 MPa/m gives about 7.4 MPa over 700 m; bends add 1.0 MPa; total pressure is about 22.8 MPa. Line velocity is 0.0111/0.0123 ≈ 0.91 m/s; hydraulic power is 22.8×10⁶×0.0111 ≈ 253 kW, about 338 kW of engine at 0.75 efficiency. With D = 150 mm and 300 MPa allowable stress, the required wall is 22.8×150/600 ≈ 5.7 mm, so 10 mm new pipe keeps a wear allowance. If interface viscosity doubles to gain strength, friction rises to 0.0202 MPa/m and total pressure to about 29.5 MPa, power to about 328 kW and engine to about 437 kW, and the required wall to about 7.4 mm, sharply shortening wear allowance and pipe life, so a relay pump or a mix adjustment may be needed. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高程泵送的壓力組成」與「潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Components of high-rise pumping pressure" and "The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高程泵送的壓力組成：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Components of high-rise pumping pressure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「泵送壓力需求」如何影響高強度混凝土高程泵送的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pump pressure demand” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 泵機必須提供的壓力由三部分組成：把混凝土柱抬高的靜壓、混凝土沿管壁滑動的摩擦損失，以及彎管、錐形管與閥件的局部損失。對超高層而言，靜壓與高度成正比，600 m 時已經非常可觀；摩擦則與管長、流速、管徑與混凝土流變有關，高強度混凝土的低水膠比與高膠結料量使它更黏，摩擦明顯高於一般混凝土。三者相加決定泵機等級、輸送管壁厚與接頭型式，也決定是否需要在中途設接力泵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「泵送壓力需求」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The pressure a pump must deliver has three parts: static head to lift the concrete column, friction loss as concrete slides along the pipe wall, and local losses in bends, reducers and valves. In supertall work static head grows linearly with height and is already very large at 600 m; friction depends on line length, velocity, pipe diameter and rheology, and the low water–binder ratio and high binder content of high-strength concrete make it stickier, with markedly higher friction than ordinary concrete. Their sum sets the pump class, pipe wall thickness and coupling type, and decides whether an intermediate relay pump is needed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pump pressure demand” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵送高度只要乘上混凝土密度就能算出所需泵壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pump pressure can be found simply by multiplying height by concrete density." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「泵送壓力需求」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pump pressure demand”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高程泵送的壓力組成
knowledge.text: 泵機必須提供的壓力由三部分組成：把混凝土柱抬高的靜壓、混凝土沿管壁滑動的摩擦損失，以及彎管、錐形管與閥件的局部損失。對超高層而言，靜壓與高度成正比，600 m 時已經非常可觀；摩擦則與管長、流速、管徑與混凝土流變有關，高強度混凝土的低水膠比與高膠結料量使它更黏，摩擦明顯高於一般混凝土。
knowledge.textEn: The pressure a pump must deliver has three parts: static head to lift the concrete column, friction loss as concrete slides along the pipe wall, and local losses in bends, reducers and valves. In supertall work static head grows linearly with height and is already very large at 600 m; friction depends on line length, velocity, pipe diameter and rheology, and the low water–binder ratio and high binder content of high-strength concrete make it stickier, with markedly higher friction than ordinary concrete.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵送高度只要乘上混凝土密度就能算出所需泵壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pump pressure can be found simply by multiplying height by concrete density. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高程泵送的壓力組成」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Components of high-rise pumping pressure" is correct?
options: 泵送高度只要乘上混凝土密度就能算出所需泵壓。
泵機必須提供的壓力由三部分組成：把混凝土柱抬高的靜壓、混凝土沿管壁滑動的摩擦損失，以及彎管、錐形管與閥件的局部損失。
坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。
optionsEn: Pump pressure can be found simply by multiplying height by concrete density.
The pressure a pump must deliver has three parts: static head to lift the concrete column, friction loss as concrete slides along the pipe wall, and local losses in bends, reducers and valves.
The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump.
quiz.explanation: 泵機必須提供的壓力由三部分組成：把混凝土柱抬高的靜壓、混凝土沿管壁滑動的摩擦損失，以及彎管、錐形管與閥件的局部損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The pressure a pump must deliver has three parts: static head to lift the concrete column, friction loss as concrete slides along the pipe wall, and local losses in bends, reducers and valves. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高程泵送的壓力組成：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Components of high-rise pumping pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泵送壓力需求」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pump pressure demand” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local。ρ = 2,450 kg/m³、h = 600 m 時靜壓 = 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa；摩擦梯度 i = 0.010 MPa/m、管長 L = 700 m 得 7.0 MPa；10 個彎管各 0.1 MPa 得 1.0 MPa；合計約 22.4 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local. With ρ = 2,450 kg/m³ and h = 600 m the static head is 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa; a friction gradient i = 0.010 MPa/m over L = 700 m adds 7.0 MPa; ten bends at 0.1 MPa each add 1.0 MPa; the total is about 22.4 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以泵送計畫書列出最高澆置點的高度、總管長、彎管數與假設摩擦梯度，計算所需泵壓並保留裕度；施工中以泵機壓力紀錄與管線上的壓力感測器比對預測值，並隨樓層升高逐段更新。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List the highest placement level, total line length, number of bends and assumed friction gradient in the pumping plan, compute the required pressure with a margin, and during construction compare pump pressure logs and in-line pressure sensors with predictions, updating them as the building rises.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local。ρ = 2,450 kg/m³、h = 600 m 時靜壓 = 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa；摩擦梯度 i = 0.010 MPa/m、管長 L = 700 m 得 7.0 MPa；10 個彎管各 0.1 MPa 得 1.0 MPa；合計約 22.4 MPa。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local. With ρ = 2,450 kg/m³ and h = 600 m the static head is 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa; a friction gradient i = 0.010 MPa/m over L = 700 m adds 7.0 MPa; ten bends at 0.1 MPa each add 1.0 MPa; the total is about 22.4 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高程泵送的壓力組成」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Components of high-rise pumping pressure", which statement holds?
options: 泵機的最大排量和最大壓力可以同時達到。
泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。
p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local。
optionsEn: A pump can reach its maximum output and its maximum pressure at the same time.
Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time.
p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local.
quiz.explanation: p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高程泵送的壓力組成：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Components of high-rise pumping pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泵送壓力需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pump pressure demand” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以泵送計畫書列出最高澆置點的高度、總管長、彎管數與假設摩擦梯度，計算所需泵壓並保留裕度；施工中以泵機壓力紀錄與管線上的壓力感測器比對預測值，並隨樓層升高逐段更新。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List the highest placement level, total line length, number of bends and assumed friction gradient in the pumping plan, compute the required pressure with a margin, and during construction compare pump pressure logs and in-line pressure sensors with predictions, updating them as the building rises. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：泵送計畫要在每一個關鍵高程（例如每 100 m）重新計算泵壓與裕度，並明訂超過某壓力即需改配比、換管或設接力泵的決策點，由泵送工程師與混凝土供應商共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate pressure and margin at each key level, for example every 100 m, and set decision points at which a mix change, new pipes or a relay pump is triggered above a given pressure, signed jointly by the pumping engineer and the concrete supplier.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以靜壓估算泵壓、低估高強度混凝土的摩擦，樓層升高後泵壓不足，混凝土在管中停滯並堵管；泵壓接近設備上限時，管線接頭與 S 閥磨耗加速，爆管風險升高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Estimating pump pressure from static head alone and underrating friction of high-strength concrete leaves the pump short of pressure as the tower rises, so concrete stalls and blocks the line; running near the equipment limit accelerates wear of couplings and the S-valve and raises the risk of a pipe burst. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以泵送計畫書列出最高澆置點的高度、總管長、彎管數與假設摩擦梯度，計算所需泵壓並保留裕度；施工中以泵機壓力紀錄與管線上的壓力感測器比對預測值，並隨樓層升高逐段更新。
knowledge.textEn: List the highest placement level, total line length, number of bends and assumed friction gradient in the pumping plan, compute the required pressure with a margin, and during construction compare pump pressure logs and in-line pressure sensors with predictions, updating them as the building rises.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高程泵送的壓力組成」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

quiz.explanationEn: List the highest placement level, total line length, number of bends and assumed friction gradient in the pumping plan, compute the required pressure with a margin, and during construction compare pump pressure logs and in-line pressure sensors with predictions, updating them as the building rises. steps.title: 高程泵送的壓力組成：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Components of high-rise pumping pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泵送壓力需求」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pump pressure demand” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以靜壓估算泵壓、低估高強度混凝土的摩擦，樓層升高後泵壓不足，混凝土在管中停滯並堵管；泵壓接近設備上限時，管線接頭與 S 閥磨耗加速，爆管風險升高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Estimating pump pressure from static head alone and underrating friction of high-strength concrete leaves the pump short of pressure as the tower rises, so concrete stalls and blocks the line; running near the equipment limit accelerates wear of couplings and the S-valve and raises the risk of a pipe burst. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：三者相加決定泵機等級、輸送管壁厚與接頭型式，也決定是否需要在中途設接力泵。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Their sum sets the pump class, pipe wall thickness and coupling type, and decides whether an intermediate relay pump is needed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵送高度只要乘上混凝土密度就能算出所需泵壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pump pressure can be found simply by multiplying height by concrete density." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以靜壓估算泵壓、低估高強度混凝土的摩擦，樓層升高後泵壓不足，混凝土在管中停滯並堵管；泵壓接近設備上限時，管線接頭與 S 閥磨耗加速，爆管風險升高。
knowledge.textEn: Estimating pump pressure from static head alone and underrating friction of high-strength concrete leaves the pump short of pressure as the tower rises, so concrete stalls and blocks the line; running near the equipment limit accelerates wear of couplings and the S-valve and raises the risk of a pipe burst.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

quiz.question: 在「高程泵送的壓力組成」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Components of high-rise pumping pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只以靜壓估算泵壓、低估高強度混凝土的摩擦，樓層升高後泵壓不足，混凝土在管中停滯並堵管；泵壓接近設備上限時，管線接頭與 S 閥磨耗加速，爆管風險升高。
坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Estimating pump pressure from static head alone and underrating friction of high-strength concrete leaves the pump short of pressure as the tower rises, so concrete stalls and blocks the line.
The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump.

steps.title: 潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「管壁潤滑層」如何影響高強度混凝土高程泵送的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pipe-wall lubrication layer” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混凝土在管中並不是像水一樣整體流動，而是以塞流方式前進：中間的混凝土幾乎不剪切，只靠管壁附近一層薄薄的漿體或砂漿潤滑層滑動。ACI 304.2R 指出這層邊界潤滑層只有在泵送連續、配比穩定且供料不斷時才能維持。高強度混凝土的漿體黏度高，潤滑層的剪應力也較高，因此同樣流速下摩擦更大；配比中加入適量的細粉料、黏度調整劑或選擇合適的減水劑，可以在不降低強度的情況下改善可泵性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「管壁潤滑層」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete does not flow through a pipe like water; it advances as a plug: the core barely shears and slides on a thin layer of paste or mortar at the wall. ACI 304.2R notes that this boundary lubrication layer survives only while pumping is continuous, the mix is consistent and supply is uninterrupted. High-strength concrete has a viscous paste, so the shear stress in the layer is higher and friction at a given velocity is greater; suitable fines, viscosity-modifying admixtures or a well-chosen superplasticiser can improve pumpability without reducing strength. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pipe-wall lubrication layer” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：管壁剪應力 τ = τ₀ + η_i·v，摩擦梯度 i = 2τ/R。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wall shear stress τ = τ₀ + η_i·v and friction gradient i = 2τ/R.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「管壁潤滑層」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pipe-wall lubrication layer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變
knowledge.titleEn: The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete
knowledge.text: 混凝土在管中並不是像水一樣整體流動，而是以塞流方式前進：中間的混凝土幾乎不剪切，只靠管壁附近一層薄薄的漿體或砂漿潤滑層滑動。ACI 304.2R 指出這層邊界潤滑層只有在泵送連續、配比穩定且供料不斷時才能維持。
knowledge.textEn: Concrete does not flow through a pipe like water; it advances as a plug: the core barely shears and slides on a thin layer of paste or mortar at the wall. ACI 304.2R notes that this boundary lubrication layer survives only while pumping is continuous, the mix is consistent and supply is uninterrupted.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete" is correct?
options: 坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。
輸送管只是管子，任何鋼管只要接得上就能用於超高層泵送。
混凝土在管中並不是像水一樣整體流動，而是以塞流方式前進：中間的混凝土幾乎不剪切，只靠管壁附近一層薄薄的漿體或砂漿潤滑層滑動。
optionsEn: The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump.
A pump line is just pipe, so any steel pipe that fits can be used for supertall pumping.
Concrete does not flow through a pipe like water; it advances as a plug: the core barely shears and slides on a thin layer of paste or mortar at the wall.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土在管中並不是像水一樣整體流動，而是以塞流方式前進：中間的混凝土幾乎不剪切，只靠管壁附近一層薄薄的漿體或砂漿潤滑層滑動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Concrete does not flow through a pipe like water; it advances as a plug: the core barely shears and slides on a thin layer of paste or mortar at the wall. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「管壁潤滑層」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pipe-wall lubrication layer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：管壁剪應力 τ = τ₀ + η_i·v，摩擦梯度 i = 2τ/R。管半徑 R = 0.0625 m、v = 1.0 m/s：一般高強配比 τ₀ = 30 Pa、η_i = 300 Pa·s/m，τ = 330 Pa，i ≈ 0.0106 MPa/m；黏度加倍 η_i = 600 時 τ = 630 Pa，i ≈ 0.0202 MPa/m，700 m 管線的總泵壓由約 22.8 MPa 升到約 29.5 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wall shear stress τ = τ₀ + η_i·v and friction gradient i = 2τ/R. With R = 0.0625 m and v = 1.0 m/s, a typical high-strength mix with τ₀ = 30 Pa and η_i = 300 Pa·s/m gives τ = 330 Pa and i ≈ 0.0106 MPa/m; doubling η_i to 600 gives τ = 630 Pa and i ≈ 0.0202 MPa/m, raising total pressure on a 700 m line from about 22.8 MPa to about 29.5 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以管道流變儀或試驗迴路量測不同配比的界面屈服應力與黏度常數，或以兩支相距已知距離的壓力感測器量測實際摩擦梯度；把結果回填泵壓計算，選出在強度、坍流度與摩擦之間平衡的配比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure interface yield stress and viscous constant for candidate mixes with a tribometer or test loop, or measure actual friction gradient with two pressure sensors a known distance apart; feed the results back into the pressure calculation and choose a mix that balances strength, slump flow and friction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 管壁剪應力 τ = τ₀ + η_i·v，摩擦梯度 i = 2τ/R。管半徑 R = 0.0625 m、v = 1.0 m/s：一般高強配比 τ₀ = 30 Pa、η_i = 300 Pa·s/m，τ = 330 Pa，i ≈ 0.0106 MPa/m；黏度加倍 η_i = 600 時 τ = 630 Pa，i ≈ 0.0202 MPa/m，700 m 管線的總泵壓由約 22.8 MPa 升到約 29.5 MPa。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Wall shear stress τ = τ₀ + η_i·v and friction gradient i = 2τ/R. With R = 0.0625 m and v = 1.0 m/s, a typical high-strength mix with τ₀ = 30 Pa and η_i = 300 Pa·s/m gives τ = 330 Pa and i ≈ 0.0106 MPa/m; doubling η_i to 600 gives τ = 630 Pa and i ≈ 0.0202 MPa/m, raising total pressure on a 700 m line from about 22.8 MPa to about 29.5 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete", which statement holds?
options: 管壁剪應力 τ = τ₀ + η_i·v，摩擦梯度 i = 2τ/R。
垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。
只要在地面試泵一次成功，整棟超高層都可以用同一配比泵送。
optionsEn: Wall shear stress τ = τ₀ + η_i·v and friction gradient i = 2τ/R.
A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required.
One successful trial at ground level means the same mix can be pumped to the top of a supertall.
quiz.explanation: 管壁剪應力 τ = τ₀ + η_i·v，摩擦梯度 i = 2τ/R。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wall shear stress τ = τ₀ + η_i·v and friction gradient i = 2τ/R. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「管壁潤滑層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pipe-wall lubrication layer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以管道流變儀或試驗迴路量測不同配比的界面屈服應力與黏度常數，或以兩支相距已知距離的壓力感測器量測實際摩擦梯度；把結果回填泵壓計算，選出在強度、坍流度與摩擦之間平衡的配比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure interface yield stress and viscous constant for candidate mixes with a tribometer or test loop, or measure actual friction gradient with two pressure sensors a known distance apart; feed the results back into the pressure calculation and choose a mix that balances strength, slump flow and friction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：配比審查除強度與坍流度外，應要求提出可泵性證據（摩擦梯度或試驗迴路結果）與配比調整範圍；高層段若改用更高強度，必須重新做可泵性評估再放行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mix review should require pumpability evidence, such as friction gradient or loop results, and an allowed adjustment range in addition to strength and slump flow; any switch to higher strength in upper zones must be re-evaluated for pumpability before release.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了提高強度而一味降低用水量，混凝土黏度大增，潤滑層變薄，泵壓急升並出現間歇性堵管；配比中粗骨材級配不良時，漿體被擠出而骨材在彎管處形成架橋，造成難以清除的堵塞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cutting water to chase strength sharply raises viscosity, thins the lubrication layer and makes pump pressure spike with intermittent blockages; a poorly graded coarse aggregate lets paste be squeezed out so aggregate bridges at bends and forms blockages that are hard to clear. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以管道流變儀或試驗迴路量測不同配比的界面屈服應力與黏度常數，或以兩支相距已知距離的壓力感測器量測實際摩擦梯度；把結果回填泵壓計算，選出在強度、坍流度與摩擦之間平衡的配比。
knowledge.textEn: Measure interface yield stress and viscous constant for candidate mixes with a tribometer or test loop, or measure actual friction gradient with two pressure sensors a known distance apart; feed the results back into the pressure calculation and choose a mix that balances strength, slump flow and friction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 配比審查除強度與坍流度外，應要求提出可泵性證據（摩擦梯度或試驗迴路結果）與配比調整範圍；高層段若改用更高強度，必須重新做可泵性評估再放行。
knowledge.textEn: Mix review should require pumpability evidence, such as friction gradient or loop results, and an allowed adjustment range in addition to strength and slump flow; any switch to higher strength in upper zones must be re-evaluated for pumpability before release.

quiz.question: 要驗證「潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以管道流變儀或試驗迴路量測不同配比的界面屈服應力與黏度常數，或以兩支相距已知距離的壓力感測器量測實際摩擦梯度。
管線外觀沒有漏漿或變形，就表示管壁厚度足夠。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Measure interface yield stress and viscous constant for candidate mixes with a tribometer or test loop, or measure actual friction gradient with two pressure sensors a known distance apart.
If the line shows no leaks or deformation, the walls must still be thick enough.
quiz.explanation: 以管道流變儀或試驗迴路量測不同配比的界面屈服應力與黏度常數，或以兩支相距已知距離的壓力感測器量測實際摩擦梯度；把結果回填泵壓計算，選出在強度、坍流度與摩擦之間平衡的配比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure interface yield stress and viscous constant for candidate mixes with a tribometer or test loop, or measure actual friction gradient with two pressure sensors a known distance apart; feed the results back into the pressure calculation and choose a mix that balances strength, slump flow and friction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「管壁潤滑層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pipe-wall lubrication layer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了提高強度而一味降低用水量，混凝土黏度大增，潤滑層變薄，泵壓急升並出現間歇性堵管；配比中粗骨材級配不良時，漿體被擠出而骨材在彎管處形成架橋，造成難以清除的堵塞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting water to chase strength sharply raises viscosity, thins the lubrication layer and makes pump pressure spike with intermittent blockages; a poorly graded coarse aggregate lets paste be squeezed out so aggregate bridges at bends and forms blockages that are hard to clear. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高強度混凝土的漿體黏度高，潤滑層的剪應力也較高，因此同樣流速下摩擦更大；配比中加入適量的細粉料、黏度調整劑或選擇合適的減水劑，可以在不降低強度的情況下改善可泵性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: High-strength concrete has a viscous paste, so the shear stress in the layer is higher and friction at a given velocity is greater; suitable fines, viscosity-modifying admixtures or a well-chosen superplasticiser can improve pumpability without reducing strength.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了提高強度而一味降低用水量，混凝土黏度大增，潤滑層變薄，泵壓急升並出現間歇性堵管；配比中粗骨材級配不良時，漿體被擠出而骨材在彎管處形成架橋，造成難以清除的堵塞。
knowledge.textEn: Cutting water to chase strength sharply raises viscosity, thins the lubrication layer and makes pump pressure spike with intermittent blockages; a poorly graded coarse aggregate lets paste be squeezed out so aggregate bridges at bends and forms blockages that are hard to clear.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
輸送管只是管子，任何鋼管只要接得上就能用於超高層泵送。
為了提高強度而一味降低用水量，混凝土黏度大增，潤滑層變薄，泵壓急升並出現間歇性堵管。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A pump line is just pipe, so any steel pipe that fits can be used for supertall pumping.
Cutting water to chase strength sharply raises viscosity, thins the lubrication layer and makes pump pressure spike with intermittent blockages.
quiz.explanation: 為了提高強度而一味降低用水量，混凝土黏度大增，潤滑層變薄，泵壓急升並出現間歇性堵管；配比中粗骨材級配不良時，漿體被擠出而骨材在彎管處形成架橋，造成難以清除的堵塞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cutting water to chase strength sharply raises viscosity, thins the lubrication layer and makes pump pressure spike with intermittent blockages; a poorly graded coarse aggregate lets paste be squeezed out so aggregate bridges at bends and forms blockages that are hard to clear. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「管壁厚度、接頭與磨耗裕度」與「泵機輸出、壓力與功率」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pipe wall thickness, couplings and wear allowance" and "Pump output, pressure and power": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 管壁厚度、接頭與磨耗裕度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pipe wall thickness, couplings and wear allowance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「高壓輸送管與接頭」如何影響高強度混凝土高程泵送的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High-pressure pipes and couplings” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超高層泵送管必須承受 20 MPa 以上的內壓，並在數萬立方公尺混凝土的磨耗下保持強度。常用的是經硬化處理的雙層或厚壁鋼管，以高壓法蘭或螺栓式接頭連接，接頭需同時防漏漿與承受拉脫力。管壁厚度由內壓與容許應力決定，再加上磨耗裕度；彎管外側磨耗最快，常做成加厚或可旋轉的耐磨彎頭。ACI 304.2R 提到早期活塞泵通常配用 150 mm 以上管徑，超高層則常用較小管徑以降低管內混凝土重量與接頭負擔。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「高壓輸送管與接頭」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Supertall pump lines must resist internal pressures above 20 MPa and keep their strength while tens of thousands of cubic metres of concrete wear them away. Hardened double-wall or thick-wall steel pipes are common, joined by high-pressure flanged or bolted couplings that must both seal against grout loss and resist pull-apart forces. Wall thickness is set by internal pressure and allowable stress plus a wear allowance; the outside of bends wears fastest and is often thickened or made as rotatable wear elbows. ACI 304.2R notes that early piston pumps typically used lines of 150 mm or more, whereas supertall lines often use smaller bores to reduce the weight of concrete in the line and the load on couplings. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “High-pressure pipes and couplings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Barlow 公式 t = pD/(2σ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Barlow's formula t = pD/(2σ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「輸送管只是管子，任何鋼管只要接得上就能用於超高層泵送。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A pump line is just pipe, so any steel pipe that fits can be used for supertall pumping." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「高壓輸送管與接頭」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “High-pressure pipes and couplings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 管壁厚度、接頭與磨耗裕度
knowledge.titleEn: Pipe wall thickness, couplings and wear allowance
knowledge.text: 超高層泵送管必須承受 20 MPa 以上的內壓，並在數萬立方公尺混凝土的磨耗下保持強度。常用的是經硬化處理的雙層或厚壁鋼管，以高壓法蘭或螺栓式接頭連接，接頭需同時防漏漿與承受拉脫力。
knowledge.textEn: Supertall pump lines must resist internal pressures above 20 MPa and keep their strength while tens of thousands of cubic metres of concrete wear them away. Hardened double-wall or thick-wall steel pipes are common, joined by high-pressure flanged or bolted couplings that must both seal against grout loss and resist pull-apart forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：輸送管只是管子，任何鋼管只要接得上就能用於超高層泵送。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A pump line is just pipe, so any steel pipe that fits can be used for supertall pumping. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「管壁厚度、接頭與磨耗裕度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pipe wall thickness, couplings and wear allowance" is correct?
options: 超高層泵送管必須承受 20 MPa 以上的內壓，並在數萬立方公尺混凝土的磨耗下保持強度。
輸送管只是管子，任何鋼管只要接得上就能用於超高層泵送。
泵機的最大排量和最大壓力可以同時達到。
optionsEn: Supertall pump lines must resist internal pressures above 20 MPa and keep their strength while tens of thousands of cubic metres of concrete wear them away.
A pump line is just pipe, so any steel pipe that fits can be used for supertall pumping.
A pump can reach its maximum output and its maximum pressure at the same time.
quiz.explanation: 超高層泵送管必須承受 20 MPa 以上的內壓，並在數萬立方公尺混凝土的磨耗下保持強度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Supertall pump lines must resist internal pressures above 20 MPa and keep their strength while tens of thousands of cubic metres of concrete wear them away. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 管壁厚度、接頭與磨耗裕度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pipe wall thickness, couplings and wear allowance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高壓輸送管與接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High-pressure pipes and couplings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Barlow 公式 t = pD/(2σ)。p = 22.4 MPa、D = 150 mm、容許應力 300 MPa 時 t = 22.4×150/600 = 5.6 mm；加上 4.4 mm 磨耗裕度，新管壁厚取 10 mm。若泵壓升到 29.5 MPa，所需厚度增為約 7.4 mm，磨耗裕度只剩 2.6 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Barlow's formula t = pD/(2σ). With p = 22.4 MPa, D = 150 mm and 300 MPa allowable stress, t = 22.4×150/600 = 5.6 mm; adding a 4.4 mm wear allowance gives a 10 mm new wall. If pressure rises to 29.5 MPa, the required thickness grows to about 7.4 mm and only 2.6 mm of wear allowance remains. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：輸送管與接頭須有製造商的耐壓等級證明與材料硬度報告；安裝前逐根以超音波測厚記錄基準厚度並編號，接頭螺栓依規定扭力鎖緊並做標記，第一次加壓時巡查漏漿與滲水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pipes and couplings need the manufacturer's pressure rating and hardness reports; before installation record a baseline ultrasonic thickness for each numbered pipe, tighten coupling bolts to the specified torque and mark them, and walk the line for grout or water leaks at first pressurisation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Barlow 公式 t = pD/(2σ)。p = 22.4 MPa、D = 150 mm、容許應力 300 MPa 時 t = 22.4×150/600 = 5.6 mm；加上 4.4 mm 磨耗裕度，新管壁厚取 10 mm。若泵壓升到 29.5 MPa，所需厚度增為約 7.4 mm，磨耗裕度只剩 2.6 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Barlow's formula t = pD/(2σ). With p = 22.4 MPa, D = 150 mm and 300 MPa allowable stress, t = 22.4×150/600 = 5.6 mm; adding a 4.4 mm wear allowance gives a 10 mm new wall. If pressure rises to 29.5 MPa, the required thickness grows to about 7.4 mm and only 2.6 mm of wear allowance remains. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「管壁厚度、接頭與磨耗裕度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pipe wall thickness, couplings and wear allowance", which statement holds?
options: 泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。
Barlow 公式 t = pD/(2σ)。
混凝土在工地入口檢驗合格，泵送到樓頂後的性質也不會改變。
optionsEn: Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time.
Barlow's formula t = pD/(2σ).
If concrete passes inspection at the site gate, its properties will not change after pumping to the top.
quiz.explanation: Barlow 公式 t = pD/(2σ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Barlow's formula t = pD/(2σ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 管壁厚度、接頭與磨耗裕度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pipe wall thickness, couplings and wear allowance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高壓輸送管與接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High-pressure pipes and couplings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 輸送管與接頭須有製造商的耐壓等級證明與材料硬度報告；安裝前逐根以超音波測厚記錄基準厚度並編號，接頭螺栓依規定扭力鎖緊並做標記，第一次加壓時巡查漏漿與滲水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pipes and couplings need the manufacturer's pressure rating and hardness reports; before installation record a baseline ultrasonic thickness for each numbered pipe, tighten coupling bolts to the specified torque and mark them, and walk the line for grout or water leaks at first pressurisation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以管段編號與位置圖管理所有高壓管與彎頭，規定不同壓力區只能使用相對應等級的管件；接頭與管段的更換與測厚紀錄須能追溯，高壓區設人員禁入區與防護罩。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Manage every high-pressure pipe and elbow by number and location drawing, allow only matching pressure grades in each pressure zone, keep traceable replacement and thickness records, and set exclusion zones and guards around high-pressure sections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：混用不同等級的管段或以一般接頭代替高壓接頭，在高壓段爆裂或拉脫，高速噴出的混凝土與管段碎片可傷及人員；彎管外側磨薄而未更換，在最高壓力時破裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing pipe grades or substituting ordinary couplings for high-pressure ones lets the line burst or pull apart in the high-pressure zone, and concrete and fragments ejected at speed can injure people; bends worn thin on the outside and not replaced rupture at peak pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 輸送管與接頭須有製造商的耐壓等級證明與材料硬度報告；安裝前逐根以超音波測厚記錄基準厚度並編號，接頭螺栓依規定扭力鎖緊並做標記，第一次加壓時巡查漏漿與滲水。
knowledge.textEn: Pipes and couplings need the manufacturer's pressure rating and hardness reports; before installation record a baseline ultrasonic thickness for each numbered pipe, tighten coupling bolts to the specified torque and mark them, and walk the line for grout or water leaks at first pressurisation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以管段編號與位置圖管理所有高壓管與彎頭，規定不同壓力區只能使用相對應等級的管件；接頭與管段的更換與測厚紀錄須能追溯，高壓區設人員禁入區與防護罩。
knowledge.textEn: Manage every high-pressure pipe and elbow by number and location drawing, allow only matching pressure grades in each pressure zone, keep traceable replacement and thickness records, and set exclusion zones and guards around high-pressure sections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「管壁厚度、接頭與磨耗裕度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pipe wall thickness, couplings and wear allowance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要強度試驗平均值合格，就不需要記錄每一車混凝土澆在哪裡。
輸送管與接頭須有製造商的耐壓等級證明與材料硬度報告；安裝前逐根以超音波測厚記錄基準厚度並編號，接頭螺栓依規定扭力鎖緊並做標記，第一次加壓時巡查漏漿與滲水。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If the average strength passes, there is no need to record where each truck was placed.
Pipes and couplings need the manufacturer's pressure rating and hardness reports.
quiz.explanation: 輸送管與接頭須有製造商的耐壓等級證明與材料硬度報告；安裝前逐根以超音波測厚記錄基準厚度並編號，接頭螺栓依規定扭力鎖緊並做標記，第一次加壓時巡查漏漿與滲水。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pipes and couplings need the manufacturer's pressure rating and hardness reports; before installation record a baseline ultrasonic thickness for each numbered pipe, tighten coupling bolts to the specified torque and mark them, and walk the line for grout or water leaks at first pressurisation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 管壁厚度、接頭與磨耗裕度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pipe wall thickness, couplings and wear allowance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高壓輸送管與接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “High-pressure pipes and couplings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 混用不同等級的管段或以一般接頭代替高壓接頭，在高壓段爆裂或拉脫，高速噴出的混凝土與管段碎片可傷及人員；彎管外側磨薄而未更換，在最高壓力時破裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing pipe grades or substituting ordinary couplings for high-pressure ones lets the line burst or pull apart in the high-pressure zone, and concrete and fragments ejected at speed can injure people; bends worn thin on the outside and not replaced rupture at peak pressure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：ACI 304.2R 提到早期活塞泵通常配用 150 mm 以上管徑，超高層則常用較小管徑以降低管內混凝土重量與接頭負擔。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: ACI 304.2R notes that early piston pumps typically used lines of 150 mm or more, whereas supertall lines often use smaller bores to reduce the weight of concrete in the line and the load on couplings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「輸送管只是管子，任何鋼管只要接得上就能用於超高層泵送。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A pump line is just pipe, so any steel pipe that fits can be used for supertall pumping." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 混用不同等級的管段或以一般接頭代替高壓接頭，在高壓段爆裂或拉脫，高速噴出的混凝土與管段碎片可傷及人員；彎管外側磨薄而未更換，在最高壓力時破裂。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing pipe grades or substituting ordinary couplings for high-pressure ones lets the line burst or pull apart in the high-pressure zone, and concrete and fragments ejected at speed can injure people; bends worn thin on the outside and not replaced rupture at peak pressure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「管壁厚度、接頭與磨耗裕度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pipe wall thickness, couplings and wear allowance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 混用不同等級的管段或以一般接頭代替高壓接頭，在高壓段爆裂或拉脫，高速噴出的混凝土與管段碎片可傷及人員；彎管外側磨薄而未更換，在最高壓力時破裂。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
泵機的最大排量和最大壓力可以同時達到。
optionsEn: Mixing pipe grades or substituting ordinary couplings for high-pressure ones lets the line burst or pull apart in the high-pressure zone, and concrete and fragments ejected at speed can injure people.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A pump can reach its maximum output and its maximum pressure at the same time.
quiz.explanation: 混用不同等級的管段或以一般接頭代替高壓接頭，在高壓段爆裂或拉脫，高速噴出的混凝土與管段碎片可傷及人員；彎管外側磨薄而未更換，在最高壓力時破裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing pipe grades or substituting ordinary couplings for high-pressure ones lets the line burst or pull apart in the high-pressure zone, and concrete and fragments ejected at speed can injure people; bends worn thin on the outside and not replaced rupture at peak pressure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 泵機輸出、壓力與功率：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pump output, pressure and power: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「泵機與 S 閥」如何影響高強度混凝土高程泵送的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pump unit and S-valve” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超高壓拖式泵以兩支混凝土缸交替推送，S 閥在兩缸之間切換，把混凝土送入輸送管。泵機能提供的混凝土壓力取決於油壓與主油缸對混凝土缸的面積比，提高混凝土壓力就必須降低排量，因此同一台泵在高壓時輸出較小。哈里發塔的泵送站以兩台 Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D 與一台 BSA 14000 HP-D 組成，泵機的機架、料斗與 S 閥都為預期壓力加強；上海中心大廈則以三一重工 HBT90CH 系列超高壓拖泵泵送核心筒混凝土。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「泵機與 S 閥」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An ultra-high-pressure trailer pump drives two concrete cylinders alternately, with an S-valve switching between them to feed the line. The concrete pressure a pump can deliver depends on hydraulic pressure and the area ratio between the drive cylinders and concrete cylinders, so higher concrete pressure means lower output, and the same pump delivers less at high pressure. Burj Khalifa's pumping station combined two Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D units and one BSA 14000 HP-D, with frames, hoppers and S-valves reinforced for the expected pressures; Shanghai Tower used Sany HBT90CH-series ultra-high-pressure trailer pumps for its core concrete. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pump unit and S-valve” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：水力功率 P = p·Q。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Hydraulic power P = p·Q.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵機的最大排量和最大壓力可以同時達到。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A pump can reach its maximum output and its maximum pressure at the same time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「泵機與 S 閥」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pump unit and S-valve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 泵機輸出、壓力與功率
knowledge.text: 超高壓拖式泵以兩支混凝土缸交替推送，S 閥在兩缸之間切換，把混凝土送入輸送管。泵機能提供的混凝土壓力取決於油壓與主油缸對混凝土缸的面積比，提高混凝土壓力就必須降低排量，因此同一台泵在高壓時輸出較小。
knowledge.textEn: An ultra-high-pressure trailer pump drives two concrete cylinders alternately, with an S-valve switching between them to feed the line. The concrete pressure a pump can deliver depends on hydraulic pressure and the area ratio between the drive cylinders and concrete cylinders, so higher concrete pressure means lower output, and the same pump delivers less at high pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵機的最大排量和最大壓力可以同時達到。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A pump can reach its maximum output and its maximum pressure at the same time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「泵機輸出、壓力與功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pump output, pressure and power" is correct?
options: 泵機的最大排量和最大壓力可以同時達到。
超高壓拖式泵以兩支混凝土缸交替推送，S 閥在兩缸之間切換，把混凝土送入輸送管。
垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。
optionsEn: A pump can reach its maximum output and its maximum pressure at the same time.
An ultra-high-pressure trailer pump drives two concrete cylinders alternately, with an S-valve switching between them to feed the line.
A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required.
quiz.explanation: 超高壓拖式泵以兩支混凝土缸交替推送，S 閥在兩缸之間切換，把混凝土送入輸送管。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An ultra-high-pressure trailer pump drives two concrete cylinders alternately, with an S-valve switching between them to feed the line. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 泵機輸出、壓力與功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pump output, pressure and power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泵機與 S 閥」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pump unit and S-valve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：水力功率 P = p·Q。排量 Q = 40 m³/h = 0.0111 m³/s、泵壓 22.4 MPa 時 P ≈ 249 kW，效率 0.75 時引擎約需 332 kW。管徑 125 mm 時截面 A ≈ 0.0123 m²，流速 v = Q/A ≈ 0.91 m/s，與前述 1.0 m/s 的摩擦假設一致。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Hydraulic power P = p·Q. At Q = 40 m³/h = 0.0111 m³/s and 22.4 MPa, P ≈ 249 kW, about 332 kW of engine power at 0.75 efficiency. In a 125 mm line the area is A ≈ 0.0123 m², so velocity v = Q/A ≈ 0.91 m/s, consistent with the 1.0 m/s friction assumption. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對泵機性能曲線，確認所需壓力與排量組合落在曲線內並有裕度；現場記錄每次泵送的出口壓力、行程頻率與排量，並安排備用泵機與關鍵零件（S 閥、眼鏡板、切割環），以免單機故障中斷澆置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the pump's performance curve to confirm that the required pressure and output lie inside it with a margin; log outlet pressure, stroke rate and output for every pour, and keep a standby pump and critical spares such as S-valves, wear plates and cutting rings so that a single failure does not interrupt a pour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 水力功率 P = p·Q。排量 Q = 40 m³/h = 0.0111 m³/s、泵壓 22.4 MPa 時 P ≈ 249 kW，效率 0.75 時引擎約需 332 kW。管徑 125 mm 時截面 A ≈ 0.0123 m²，流速 v = Q/A ≈ 0.91 m/s，與前述 1.0 m/s 的摩擦假設一致。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Hydraulic power P = p·Q. At Q = 40 m³/h = 0.0111 m³/s and 22.4 MPa, P ≈ 249 kW, about 332 kW of engine power at 0.75 efficiency. In a 125 mm line the area is A ≈ 0.0123 m², so velocity v = Q/A ≈ 0.91 m/s, consistent with the 1.0 m/s friction assumption. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「泵機輸出、壓力與功率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pump output, pressure and power", which statement holds?
options: 只要在地面試泵一次成功，整棟超高層都可以用同一配比泵送。
管線外觀沒有漏漿或變形，就表示管壁厚度足夠。
水力功率 P = p·Q。
optionsEn: One successful trial at ground level means the same mix can be pumped to the top of a supertall.
If the line shows no leaks or deformation, the walls must still be thick enough.
Hydraulic power P = p·Q.
quiz.explanation: 水力功率 P = p·Q。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydraulic power P = p·Q. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 泵機輸出、壓力與功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pump output, pressure and power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泵機與 S 閥」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pump unit and S-valve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對泵機性能曲線，確認所需壓力與排量組合落在曲線內並有裕度；現場記錄每次泵送的出口壓力、行程頻率與排量，並安排備用泵機與關鍵零件（S 閥、眼鏡板、切割環），以免單機故障中斷澆置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the pump's performance curve to confirm that the required pressure and output lie inside it with a margin; log outlet pressure, stroke rate and output for every pour, and keep a standby pump and critical spares such as S-valves, wear plates and cutting rings so that a single failure does not interrupt a pour. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重要澆置（例如巨柱或核心筒的關鍵段）前，泵機須完成保養並備妥備用機，泵送計畫書附上壓力—排量工作點；泵機操作員與樓上布料人員要有直接通訊，並規定停泵與降壓的指令方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before critical pours such as key megacolumn or core lifts, service the pump and have a standby ready, attach the pressure–output operating point to the pumping plan, give the pump operator and the placing crew upstairs direct communication, and define how stop and pressure-relief orders are given.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：泵機長時間在最高壓力下運轉，眼鏡板與切割環磨耗加快，漏漿使有效壓力下降，最終在關鍵澆置途中停機，形成冷縫；只依額定最大排量排程，忽略高壓時排量下降，供料計畫失準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Running a pump at maximum pressure for long periods accelerates wear of the wear plate and cutting ring, leakage cuts effective pressure and the pump finally stops mid-pour, creating a cold joint; scheduling on the rated maximum output while ignoring the drop at high pressure throws the supply plan off. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對泵機性能曲線，確認所需壓力與排量組合落在曲線內並有裕度；現場記錄每次泵送的出口壓力、行程頻率與排量，並安排備用泵機與關鍵零件（S 閥、眼鏡板、切割環），以免單機故障中斷澆置。
knowledge.textEn: Check the pump's performance curve to confirm that the required pressure and output lie inside it with a margin; log outlet pressure, stroke rate and output for every pour, and keep a standby pump and critical spares such as S-valves, wear plates and cutting rings so that a single failure does not interrupt a pour.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重要澆置（例如巨柱或核心筒的關鍵段）前，泵機須完成保養並備妥備用機，泵送計畫書附上壓力—排量工作點；泵機操作員與樓上布料人員要有直接通訊，並規定停泵與降壓的指令方式。
knowledge.textEn: Before critical pours such as key megacolumn or core lifts, service the pump and have a standby ready, attach the pressure–output operating point to the pumping plan, give the pump operator and the placing crew upstairs direct communication, and define how stop and pressure-relief orders are given.

quiz.question: 要驗證「泵機輸出、壓力與功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pump output, pressure and power"?
options: 核對泵機性能曲線，確認所需壓力與排量組合落在曲線內並有裕度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
泵送高度只要乘上混凝土密度就能算出所需泵壓。
optionsEn: Check the pump's performance curve to confirm that the required pressure and output lie inside it with a margin.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Pump pressure can be found simply by multiplying height by concrete density.
quiz.explanation: 核對泵機性能曲線，確認所需壓力與排量組合落在曲線內並有裕度；現場記錄每次泵送的出口壓力、行程頻率與排量，並安排備用泵機與關鍵零件（S 閥、眼鏡板、切割環），以免單機故障中斷澆置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the pump's performance curve to confirm that the required pressure and output lie inside it with a margin; log outlet pressure, stroke rate and output for every pour, and keep a standby pump and critical spares such as S-valves, wear plates and cutting rings so that a single failure does not interrupt a pour. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 泵機輸出、壓力與功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pump output, pressure and power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泵機與 S 閥」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pump unit and S-valve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 泵機長時間在最高壓力下運轉，眼鏡板與切割環磨耗加快，漏漿使有效壓力下降，最終在關鍵澆置途中停機，形成冷縫；只依額定最大排量排程，忽略高壓時排量下降，供料計畫失準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Running a pump at maximum pressure for long periods accelerates wear of the wear plate and cutting ring, leakage cuts effective pressure and the pump finally stops mid-pour, creating a cold joint; scheduling on the rated maximum output while ignoring the drop at high pressure throws the supply plan off. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：哈里發塔的泵送站以兩台 Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D 與一台 BSA 14000 HP-D 組成，泵機的機架、料斗與 S 閥都為預期壓力加強；上海中心大廈則以三一重工 HBT90CH 系列超高壓拖泵泵送核心筒混凝土。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Burj Khalifa's pumping station combined two Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D units and one BSA 14000 HP-D, with frames, hoppers and S-valves reinforced for the expected pressures; Shanghai Tower used Sany HBT90CH-series ultra-high-pressure trailer pumps for its core concrete.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵機的最大排量和最大壓力可以同時達到。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A pump can reach its maximum output and its maximum pressure at the same time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 泵機長時間在最高壓力下運轉，眼鏡板與切割環磨耗加快，漏漿使有效壓力下降，最終在關鍵澆置途中停機，形成冷縫；只依額定最大排量排程，忽略高壓時排量下降，供料計畫失準。
knowledge.textEn: Running a pump at maximum pressure for long periods accelerates wear of the wear plate and cutting ring, leakage cuts effective pressure and the pump finally stops mid-pour, creating a cold joint; scheduling on the rated maximum output while ignoring the drop at high pressure throws the supply plan off.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「泵機輸出、壓力與功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pump output, pressure and power" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
泵機長時間在最高壓力下運轉，眼鏡板與切割環磨耗加快，漏漿使有效壓力下降，最終在關鍵澆置途中停機，形成冷縫。
垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Running a pump at maximum pressure for long periods accelerates wear of the wear plate and cutting ring, leakage cuts effective pressure and the pump finally stops mid-pour, creating a cold joint.
A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required.
quiz.explanation: 泵機長時間在最高壓力下運轉，眼鏡板與切割環磨耗加快，漏漿使有效壓力下降，最終在關鍵澆置途中停機，形成冷縫；只依額定最大排量排程，忽略高壓時排量下降，供料計畫失準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Running a pump at maximum pressure for long periods accelerates wear of the wear plate and cutting ring, leakage cuts effective pressure and the pump finally stops mid-pour, creating a cold joint; scheduling on the rated maximum output while ignoring the drop at high pressure throws the supply plan off. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「管線佈置、固定與止回」與「開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Line layout, fixing and shut-off" and "Priming, continuous supply and water flushing": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 管線佈置、固定與止回：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Line layout, fixing and shut-off: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「管線佈置與固定」如何影響高強度混凝土高程泵送的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Line layout and fixing” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 垂直泵送管沿核心筒內的豎井或牆面設置，每層以管夾固定在結構上，承受管線與管內混凝土的重量以及每一次泵送衝程的脈動。彎管處的內壓會產生很大的推力，底部的水平轉垂直彎頭尤其關鍵，必須以混凝土座或鋼支架錨固。泵機出口與垂直段之間通常保留一段水平管，並在垂直段底部設置截止閥，停泵或更換管件時防止數百公尺混凝土柱回流衝擊泵機。管線也必須避開會隨樓層升高而移動的爬模平台。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「管線佈置與固定」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The vertical line runs up a shaft or along walls of the core, clamped to the structure at every floor to carry the weight of pipe and concrete and the pulsation of each pump stroke. Internal pressure at bends produces large thrust, and the bottom horizontal-to-vertical elbow is especially critical, anchored in a concrete block or steel frame. A horizontal run is usually kept between the pump outlet and the vertical section, with a shut-off valve at the foot of the riser so that, when pumping stops or pipes are changed, hundreds of metres of concrete cannot flow back and hit the pump. The line must also clear climbing-form platforms that move up with the building. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Line layout and fixing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：彎管推力 F = p·A。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Bend thrust F = p·A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「管線佈置與固定」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Line layout and fixing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 管線佈置、固定與止回
knowledge.text: 垂直泵送管沿核心筒內的豎井或牆面設置，每層以管夾固定在結構上，承受管線與管內混凝土的重量以及每一次泵送衝程的脈動。彎管處的內壓會產生很大的推力，底部的水平轉垂直彎頭尤其關鍵，必須以混凝土座或鋼支架錨固。
knowledge.textEn: The vertical line runs up a shaft or along walls of the core, clamped to the structure at every floor to carry the weight of pipe and concrete and the pulsation of each pump stroke. Internal pressure at bends produces large thrust, and the bottom horizontal-to-vertical elbow is especially critical, anchored in a concrete block or steel frame.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「管線佈置、固定與止回」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Line layout, fixing and shut-off" is correct?
options: 垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。
泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。
垂直泵送管沿核心筒內的豎井或牆面設置，每層以管夾固定在結構上，承受管線與管內混凝土的重量以及每一次泵送衝程的脈動。
optionsEn: A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required.
Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time.
The vertical line runs up a shaft or along walls of the core, clamped to the structure at every floor to carry the weight of pipe and concrete and the pulsation of each pump stroke.
quiz.explanation: 垂直泵送管沿核心筒內的豎井或牆面設置，每層以管夾固定在結構上，承受管線與管內混凝土的重量以及每一次泵送衝程的脈動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The vertical line runs up a shaft or along walls of the core, clamped to the structure at every floor to carry the weight of pipe and concrete and the pulsation of each pump stroke. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 管線佈置、固定與止回：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Line layout, fixing and shut-off: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「管線佈置與固定」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Line layout and fixing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：彎管推力 F = p·A。p = 22.4 MPa、A ≈ 0.0123 m² 時單向推力約 275 kN，90° 彎管合力約 √2×275 ≈ 389 kN。每 4 m 樓層的管線重：鋼管約 34.5 kg/m 加混凝土約 30.1 kg/m，共約 64.6 kg/m，每層管夾約承受 2.5 kN 的靜重，另加泵送脈動。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Bend thrust F = p·A. At p = 22.4 MPa and A ≈ 0.0123 m² the thrust is about 275 kN in each direction and the resultant at a 90° bend about √2×275 ≈ 389 kN. Per 4 m storey the line weighs about 34.5 kg/m of steel plus about 30.1 kg/m of concrete, about 64.6 kg/m, so each floor clamp carries about 2.5 kN of static weight plus pumping pulsation. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：管線佈置圖須標示每一個彎管位置、錨座設計反力、管夾間距與截止閥位置，由結構工程師確認錨座與預埋件能承受推力；首次高壓泵送時觀察底部錨座與管夾是否移位，並量測管線振動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The line layout drawing should show every bend, anchor design reactions, clamp spacing and shut-off valve location, with the structural engineer confirming that anchors and embeds can take the thrust; at the first high-pressure pour watch the bottom anchor and clamps for movement and measure line vibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
