steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 彎管推力 F = p·A。p = 22.4 MPa、A ≈ 0.0123 m² 時單向推力約 275 kN，90° 彎管合力約 √2×275 ≈ 389 kN。每 4 m 樓層的管線重：鋼管約 34.5 kg/m 加混凝土約 30.1 kg/m，共約 64.6 kg/m，每層管夾約承受 2.5 kN 的靜重，另加泵送脈動。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Bend thrust F = p·A. At p = 22.4 MPa and A ≈ 0.0123 m² the thrust is about 275 kN in each direction and the resultant at a 90° bend about √2×275 ≈ 389 kN. Per 4 m storey the line weighs about 34.5 kg/m of steel plus about 30.1 kg/m of concrete, about 64.6 kg/m, so each floor clamp carries about 2.5 kN of static weight plus pumping pulsation. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「管線佈置、固定與止回」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Line layout, fixing and shut-off", which statement holds?
options: 彎管推力 F = p·A。
混凝土在工地入口檢驗合格，泵送到樓頂後的性質也不會改變。
只要強度試驗平均值合格，就不需要記錄每一車混凝土澆在哪裡。
optionsEn: Bend thrust F = p·A.
If concrete passes inspection at the site gate, its properties will not change after pumping to the top.
If the average strength passes, there is no need to record where each truck was placed.
quiz.explanation: 彎管推力 F = p·A。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Bend thrust F = p·A. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 管線佈置、固定與止回：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Line layout, fixing and shut-off: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「管線佈置與固定」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Line layout and fixing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 管線佈置圖須標示每一個彎管位置、錨座設計反力、管夾間距與截止閥位置，由結構工程師確認錨座與預埋件能承受推力；首次高壓泵送時觀察底部錨座與管夾是否移位，並量測管線振動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The line layout drawing should show every bend, anchor design reactions, clamp spacing and shut-off valve location, with the structural engineer confirming that anchors and embeds can take the thrust; at the first high-pressure pour watch the bottom anchor and clamps for movement and measure line vibration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：管線錨座、管夾預埋件與通過樓板的開口應在結構施工圖中預先設計，而非現場臨時鑽孔；截止閥、洩壓與清管作業須有書面程序，並列為每次高壓泵送前的檢查項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design line anchors, clamp embeds and slab openings into the structural shop drawings rather than drilling them ad hoc; give shut-off, pressure relief and line clearing written procedures and include them in the checklist before every high-pressure pour.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：底部彎頭錨座不足，泵送脈動使彎頭逐漸移位，接頭被拉開而爆管；垂直段底部沒有截止閥，停泵時混凝土柱回流，S 閥與活塞受衝擊損壞，甚至造成人員傷害。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An inadequate anchor at the bottom elbow lets pumping pulses move it bit by bit until a coupling pulls apart and bursts; without a shut-off valve at the riser foot, the concrete column flows back when pumping stops, damaging the S-valve and pistons and possibly injuring people. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 管線佈置圖須標示每一個彎管位置、錨座設計反力、管夾間距與截止閥位置，由結構工程師確認錨座與預埋件能承受推力；首次高壓泵送時觀察底部錨座與管夾是否移位，並量測管線振動。
knowledge.textEn: The line layout drawing should show every bend, anchor design reactions, clamp spacing and shut-off valve location, with the structural engineer confirming that anchors and embeds can take the thrust; at the first high-pressure pour watch the bottom anchor and clamps for movement and measure line vibration.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 管線錨座、管夾預埋件與通過樓板的開口應在結構施工圖中預先設計，而非現場臨時鑽孔；截止閥、洩壓與清管作業須有書面程序，並列為每次高壓泵送前的檢查項目。
knowledge.textEn: Design line anchors, clamp embeds and slab openings into the structural shop drawings rather than drilling them ad hoc; give shut-off, pressure relief and line clearing written procedures and include them in the checklist before every high-pressure pour.

quiz.question: 要驗證「管線佈置、固定與止回」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Line layout, fixing and shut-off"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
管線佈置圖須標示每一個彎管位置、錨座設計反力、管夾間距與截止閥位置，由結構工程師確認錨座與預埋件能承受推力。
坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

The line layout drawing should show every bend, anchor design reactions, clamp spacing and shut-off valve location, with the structural engineer confirming that anchors and embeds can take the thrust.
The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump.
quiz.explanation: 管線佈置圖須標示每一個彎管位置、錨座設計反力、管夾間距與截止閥位置，由結構工程師確認錨座與預埋件能承受推力；首次高壓泵送時觀察底部錨座與管夾是否移位，並量測管線振動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The line layout drawing should show every bend, anchor design reactions, clamp spacing and shut-off valve location, with the structural engineer confirming that anchors and embeds can take the thrust; at the first high-pressure pour watch the bottom anchor and clamps for movement and measure line vibration. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 管線佈置、固定與止回：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Line layout, fixing and shut-off: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「管線佈置與固定」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Line layout and fixing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 底部彎頭錨座不足，泵送脈動使彎頭逐漸移位，接頭被拉開而爆管；垂直段底部沒有截止閥，停泵時混凝土柱回流，S 閥與活塞受衝擊損壞，甚至造成人員傷害。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An inadequate anchor at the bottom elbow lets pumping pulses move it bit by bit until a coupling pulls apart and bursts; without a shut-off valve at the riser foot, the concrete column flows back when pumping stops, damaging the S-valve and pistons and possibly injuring people. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：管線也必須避開會隨樓層升高而移動的爬模平台。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The line must also clear climbing-form platforms that move up with the building.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 底部彎頭錨座不足，泵送脈動使彎頭逐漸移位，接頭被拉開而爆管；垂直段底部沒有截止閥，停泵時混凝土柱回流，S 閥與活塞受衝擊損壞，甚至造成人員傷害。
knowledge.textEn: An inadequate anchor at the bottom elbow lets pumping pulses move it bit by bit until a coupling pulls apart and bursts; without a shut-off valve at the riser foot, the concrete column flows back when pumping stops, damaging the S-valve and pistons and possibly injuring people.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「管線佈置、固定與止回」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Line layout, fixing and shut-off" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。
底部彎頭錨座不足，泵送脈動使彎頭逐漸移位，接頭被拉開而爆管；垂直段底部沒有截止閥，停泵時混凝土柱回流，S 閥與活塞受衝擊損壞，甚至造成人員傷害。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time.
An inadequate anchor at the bottom elbow lets pumping pulses move it bit by bit until a coupling pulls apart and bursts.
quiz.explanation: 底部彎頭錨座不足，泵送脈動使彎頭逐漸移位，接頭被拉開而爆管；垂直段底部沒有截止閥，停泵時混凝土柱回流，S 閥與活塞受衝擊損壞，甚至造成人員傷害。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An inadequate anchor at the bottom elbow lets pumping pulses move it bit by bit until a coupling pulls apart and bursts; without a shut-off valve at the riser foot, the concrete column flows back when pumping stops, damaging the S-valve and pistons and possibly injuring people. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Priming, continuous supply and water flushing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「開泵與水洗清管」如何影響高強度混凝土高程泵送的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Start-up and water flushing” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每次泵送開始前，管線內壁必須先以砂漿或商用潤管劑完整潤滑，否則第一批混凝土會失去漿體而堵管。泵送中最重要的是連續供料：一旦中斷，潤滑層開始脫水，管內混凝土逐漸變硬，重新啟動時壓力急升。超高層管線很長、容積很大，澆置結束後要把管內數立方公尺的混凝土推出並清潔管線；三一重工在超高層專案中以水洗方式把管內混凝土直接推送至澆置點，減少浪費與高空拆管作業。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「開泵與水洗清管」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before each pour the inside of the line must be fully lubricated with mortar or a commercial primer, or the first concrete loses its paste and blocks the line. During pumping the most important thing is continuous supply: once it stops the lubrication layer starts to dewater, concrete in the line stiffens, and pressure spikes on restart. Supertall lines are long and hold several cubic metres, so at the end of a pour that concrete must be pushed out and the line cleaned; on supertall projects Sany has used water flushing to push the concrete in the line through to the placement point, reducing waste and dismantling of pipes at height. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Start-up and water flushing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：管線容積 V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³，以 40 m³/h 充滿約需 12.9 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Line volume V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³, about 12.9 min to fill at 40 m³/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「開泵與水洗清管」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Start-up and water flushing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管
knowledge.titleEn: Priming, continuous supply and water flushing
knowledge.text: 每次泵送開始前，管線內壁必須先以砂漿或商用潤管劑完整潤滑，否則第一批混凝土會失去漿體而堵管。泵送中最重要的是連續供料：一旦中斷，潤滑層開始脫水，管內混凝土逐漸變硬，重新啟動時壓力急升。
knowledge.textEn: Before each pour the inside of the line must be fully lubricated with mortar or a commercial primer, or the first concrete loses its paste and blocks the line. During pumping the most important thing is continuous supply: once it stops the lubrication layer starts to dewater, concrete in the line stiffens, and pressure spikes on restart.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Priming, continuous supply and water flushing" is correct?
options: 每次泵送開始前，管線內壁必須先以砂漿或商用潤管劑完整潤滑，否則第一批混凝土會失去漿體而堵管。
泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。
只要在地面試泵一次成功，整棟超高層都可以用同一配比泵送。
optionsEn: Before each pour the inside of the line must be fully lubricated with mortar or a commercial primer, or the first concrete loses its paste and blocks the line.
Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time.
One successful trial at ground level means the same mix can be pumped to the top of a supertall.
quiz.explanation: 每次泵送開始前，管線內壁必須先以砂漿或商用潤管劑完整潤滑，否則第一批混凝土會失去漿體而堵管。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before each pour the inside of the line must be fully lubricated with mortar or a commercial primer, or the first concrete loses its paste and blocks the line. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Priming, continuous supply and water flushing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開泵與水洗清管」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Start-up and water flushing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：管線容積 V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³，以 40 m³/h 充滿約需 12.9 min。潤管砂漿以 2 mm 厚覆蓋內壁：π×0.125×700×0.002 ≈ 0.55 m³。供料 40 m³/h 時，9 m³ 預拌車需每 13.5 min 到達一車，車次間隔一旦超過約 30 min 即需啟動低速循環或暫停程序。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Line volume V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³, about 12.9 min to fill at 40 m³/h. Priming mortar 2 mm thick on the wall needs π×0.125×700×0.002 ≈ 0.55 m³. At 40 m³/h a 9 m³ truck must arrive every 13.5 min; if the gap exceeds about 30 min, the slow-recirculation or stop procedure starts. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次泵送記錄潤管材料與數量、首車到達時間、車次間隔、泵壓變化與清管方式；把車次間隔與泵壓尖峰對照，找出供料中斷造成的壓力異常，並與預拌廠檢討派車。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For each pour record priming material and quantity, first truck arrival, truck intervals, pressure changes and the cleaning method; compare truck gaps with pressure spikes to find supply-related anomalies and review dispatching with the ready-mix plant.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 管線容積 V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³，以 40 m³/h 充滿約需 12.9 min。潤管砂漿以 2 mm 厚覆蓋內壁：π×0.125×700×0.002 ≈ 0.55 m³。供料 40 m³/h 時，9 m³ 預拌車需每 13.5 min 到達一車，車次間隔一旦超過約 30 min 即需啟動低速循環或暫停程序。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Line volume V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³, about 12.9 min to fill at 40 m³/h. Priming mortar 2 mm thick on the wall needs π×0.125×700×0.002 ≈ 0.55 m³. At 40 m³/h a 9 m³ truck must arrive every 13.5 min; if the gap exceeds about 30 min, the slow-recirculation or stop procedure starts. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Priming, continuous supply and water flushing", which statement holds?
options: 管線外觀沒有漏漿或變形，就表示管壁厚度足夠。
管線容積 V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³，以 40 m³/h 充滿約需 12.9 min。
泵送高度只要乘上混凝土密度就能算出所需泵壓。
optionsEn: If the line shows no leaks or deformation, the walls must still be thick enough.
Line volume V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³, about 12.9 min to fill at 40 m³/h.
Pump pressure can be found simply by multiplying height by concrete density.
quiz.explanation: 管線容積 V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³，以 40 m³/h 充滿約需 12.9 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Line volume V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³, about 12.9 min to fill at 40 m³/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Priming, continuous supply and water flushing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開泵與水洗清管」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Start-up and water flushing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每次泵送記錄潤管材料與數量、首車到達時間、車次間隔、泵壓變化與清管方式；把車次間隔與泵壓尖峰對照，找出供料中斷造成的壓力異常，並與預拌廠檢討派車。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For each pour record priming material and quantity, first truck arrival, truck intervals, pressure changes and the cleaning method; compare truck gaps with pressure spikes to find supply-related anomalies and review dispatching with the ready-mix plant. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：與預拌廠簽訂的供料計畫應包含最大車次間隔、備援車隊與交通尖峰對策；清管程序要規定水洗或球洗方式、管端出口的防護與廢水處理，並明訂只有指定人員可以打開管線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The supply agreement with the ready-mix plant should include the maximum truck interval, a back-up fleet and rush-hour measures; the cleaning procedure should define water or ball flushing, protection at the discharge end and wash-water disposal, and allow only designated people to open the line.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：潤管砂漿不足或與混凝土配比不相容，第一車混凝土在泵機出口附近堵管；尖峰交通造成車次中斷 40 分鐘，重新啟動時壓力過高而爆管，或只能拆管清除已硬化的混凝土。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Too little or incompatible priming mortar lets the first truck block the line near the pump; a 40-minute gap in deliveries during rush hour means restarting at excessive pressure and bursting a pipe, or dismantling the line to clear hardened concrete. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每次泵送記錄潤管材料與數量、首車到達時間、車次間隔、泵壓變化與清管方式；把車次間隔與泵壓尖峰對照，找出供料中斷造成的壓力異常，並與預拌廠檢討派車。
knowledge.textEn: For each pour record priming material and quantity, first truck arrival, truck intervals, pressure changes and the cleaning method; compare truck gaps with pressure spikes to find supply-related anomalies and review dispatching with the ready-mix plant.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 與預拌廠簽訂的供料計畫應包含最大車次間隔、備援車隊與交通尖峰對策；清管程序要規定水洗或球洗方式、管端出口的防護與廢水處理，並明訂只有指定人員可以打開管線。
knowledge.textEn: The supply agreement with the ready-mix plant should include the maximum truck interval, a back-up fleet and rush-hour measures; the cleaning procedure should define water or ball flushing, protection at the discharge end and wash-water disposal, and allow only designated people to open the line.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Priming, continuous supply and water flushing"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
輸送管只是管子，任何鋼管只要接得上就能用於超高層泵送。
每次泵送記錄潤管材料與數量、首車到達時間、車次間隔、泵壓變化與清管方式；把車次間隔與泵壓尖峰對照，找出供料中斷造成的壓力異常，並與預拌廠檢討派車。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A pump line is just pipe, so any steel pipe that fits can be used for supertall pumping.
For each pour record priming material and quantity, first truck arrival, truck intervals, pressure changes and the cleaning method.
quiz.explanation: 每次泵送記錄潤管材料與數量、首車到達時間、車次間隔、泵壓變化與清管方式；把車次間隔與泵壓尖峰對照，找出供料中斷造成的壓力異常，並與預拌廠檢討派車。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For each pour record priming material and quantity, first truck arrival, truck intervals, pressure changes and the cleaning method; compare truck gaps with pressure spikes to find supply-related anomalies and review dispatching with the ready-mix plant. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Priming, continuous supply and water flushing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開泵與水洗清管」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Start-up and water flushing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 潤管砂漿不足或與混凝土配比不相容，第一車混凝土在泵機出口附近堵管；尖峰交通造成車次中斷 40 分鐘，重新啟動時壓力過高而爆管，或只能拆管清除已硬化的混凝土。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Too little or incompatible priming mortar lets the first truck block the line near the pump; a 40-minute gap in deliveries during rush hour means restarting at excessive pressure and bursting a pipe, or dismantling the line to clear hardened concrete. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：超高層管線很長、容積很大，澆置結束後要把管內數立方公尺的混凝土推出並清潔管線；三一重工在超高層專案中以水洗方式把管內混凝土直接推送至澆置點，減少浪費與高空拆管作業。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Supertall lines are long and hold several cubic metres, so at the end of a pour that concrete must be pushed out and the line cleaned; on supertall projects Sany has used water flushing to push the concrete in the line through to the placement point, reducing waste and dismantling of pipes at height.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 潤管砂漿不足或與混凝土配比不相容，第一車混凝土在泵機出口附近堵管；尖峰交通造成車次中斷 40 分鐘，重新啟動時壓力過高而爆管，或只能拆管清除已硬化的混凝土。
knowledge.textEn: Too little or incompatible priming mortar lets the first truck block the line near the pump; a 40-minute gap in deliveries during rush hour means restarting at excessive pressure and bursting a pipe, or dismantling the line to clear hardened concrete.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Priming, continuous supply and water flushing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 潤管砂漿不足或與混凝土配比不相容，第一車混凝土在泵機出口附近堵管；尖峰交通造成車次中斷 40 分鐘，重新啟動時壓力過高而爆管，或只能拆管清除已硬化的混凝土。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要在地面試泵一次成功，整棟超高層都可以用同一配比泵送。
optionsEn: Too little or incompatible priming mortar lets the first truck block the line near the pump.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
One successful trial at ground level means the same mix can be pumped to the top of a supertall.
quiz.explanation: 潤管砂漿不足或與混凝土配比不相容，第一車混凝土在泵機出口附近堵管；尖峰交通造成車次中斷 40 分鐘，重新啟動時壓力過高而爆管，或只能拆管清除已硬化的混凝土。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Too little or incompatible priming mortar lets the first truck block the line near the pump; a 40-minute gap in deliveries during rush hour means restarting at excessive pressure and bursting a pipe, or dismantling the line to clear hardened concrete. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高」與「泵送監測、坍流度保持與溫度上升」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase" and "Pumping monitoring, slump-flow retention and temperature rise": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「可泵性試驗與試泵」如何影響高強度混凝土高程泵送的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pumpability tests and trial pumping” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超高層泵送無法只靠配比表判斷可行性，必須在開工前做試驗並在施工中逐步驗證。常見作法是在地面鋪設長水平試驗迴路，量測不同配比在設計流速下的摩擦梯度，再換算到實際高程；也可在施工中隨樓層升高逐步提高泵送高度，累積實測數據。哈里發塔的預拌商 Unimix 在 2007 年先達到 452 m，2008 年再以 BSA 14000 SHP-D 創下 606 m 的垂直泵送紀錄，正是逐步驗證的例子。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「可泵性試驗與試泵」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Supertall pumping feasibility cannot be judged from a mix sheet; it needs tests before work starts and step-by-step verification during construction. A common approach lays a long horizontal test loop at ground level to measure the friction gradient of candidate mixes at design velocity and scale it to the real height; another is to raise pumping height step by step as floors rise, building up measured data. At Burj Khalifa the ready-mix supplier Unimix first reached 452 m in 2007, then set a vertical record of 606 m in 2008 with a BSA 14000 SHP-D, an example of stepwise verification. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pumpability tests and trial pumping” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：試驗迴路上兩個壓力感測器相距 100 m，量到壓差 1.06 MPa，摩擦梯度 i = 1.06/100 = 0.0106 MPa/m；換算到 700 m 實際管線摩擦約 7.4 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Two pressure sensors 100 m apart on a test loop read a difference of 1.06 MPa, so i = 1.06/100 = 0.0106 MPa/m, scaling to about 7.4 MPa of friction on a 700 m line.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要在地面試泵一次成功，整棟超高層都可以用同一配比泵送。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One successful trial at ground level means the same mix can be pumped to the top of a supertall." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「可泵性試驗與試泵」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pumpability tests and trial pumping”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高
knowledge.titleEn: Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase
knowledge.text: 超高層泵送無法只靠配比表判斷可行性，必須在開工前做試驗並在施工中逐步驗證。常見作法是在地面鋪設長水平試驗迴路，量測不同配比在設計流速下的摩擦梯度，再換算到實際高程；也可在施工中隨樓層升高逐步提高泵送高度，累積實測數據。
knowledge.textEn: Supertall pumping feasibility cannot be judged from a mix sheet; it needs tests before work starts and step-by-step verification during construction. A common approach lays a long horizontal test loop at ground level to measure the friction gradient of candidate mixes at design velocity and scale it to the real height; another is to raise pumping height step by step as floors rise, building up measured data.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要在地面試泵一次成功，整棟超高層都可以用同一配比泵送。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One successful trial at ground level means the same mix can be pumped to the top of a supertall. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase" is correct?
options: 只要在地面試泵一次成功，整棟超高層都可以用同一配比泵送。
超高層泵送無法只靠配比表判斷可行性，必須在開工前做試驗並在施工中逐步驗證。
混凝土在工地入口檢驗合格，泵送到樓頂後的性質也不會改變。
optionsEn: One successful trial at ground level means the same mix can be pumped to the top of a supertall.
Supertall pumping feasibility cannot be judged from a mix sheet; it needs tests before work starts and step-by-step verification during construction.
If concrete passes inspection at the site gate, its properties will not change after pumping to the top.
quiz.explanation: 超高層泵送無法只靠配比表判斷可行性，必須在開工前做試驗並在施工中逐步驗證。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Supertall pumping feasibility cannot be judged from a mix sheet; it needs tests before work starts and step-by-step verification during construction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可泵性試驗與試泵」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pumpability tests and trial pumping” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：試驗迴路上兩個壓力感測器相距 100 m，量到壓差 1.06 MPa，摩擦梯度 i = 1.06/100 = 0.0106 MPa/m；換算到 700 m 實際管線摩擦約 7.4 MPa。但 300 m 長的水平迴路總壓只有約 3.2 MPa，遠低於實際 22 MPa 級，因此迴路試驗是用來校正摩擦參數，不能直接代表高壓下的設備行為。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Two pressure sensors 100 m apart on a test loop read a difference of 1.06 MPa, so i = 1.06/100 = 0.0106 MPa/m, scaling to about 7.4 MPa of friction on a 700 m line. But a 300 m horizontal loop reaches only about 3.2 MPa in total, far below the real 22 MPa class, so loop tests calibrate friction parameters and do not represent equipment behaviour at high pressure. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫列出配比、流速、溫度、感測器位置與允收準則（例如推算泵壓不超過泵機能力的 80%）；施工中每升高一個區段，比較實測泵壓與預測曲線，偏差持續擴大時暫停加高並檢討配比與管線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The test plan lists mixes, velocities, temperatures, sensor positions and acceptance criteria, for example predicted pressure no more than 80% of pump capacity; as each height zone is reached, compare measured pressure with the predicted curve and pause the climb in height to review mix and line if the deviation keeps growing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 試驗迴路上兩個壓力感測器相距 100 m，量到壓差 1.06 MPa，摩擦梯度 i = 1.06/100 = 0.0106 MPa/m；換算到 700 m 實際管線摩擦約 7.4 MPa。但 300 m 長的水平迴路總壓只有約 3.2 MPa，遠低於實際 22 MPa 級，因此迴路試驗是用來校正摩擦參數，不能直接代表高壓下的設備行為。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Two pressure sensors 100 m apart on a test loop read a difference of 1.06 MPa, so i = 1.06/100 = 0.0106 MPa/m, scaling to about 7.4 MPa of friction on a 700 m line. But a 300 m horizontal loop reaches only about 3.2 MPa in total, far below the real 22 MPa class, so loop tests calibrate friction parameters and do not represent equipment behaviour at high pressure. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase", which statement holds?
options: 只要強度試驗平均值合格，就不需要記錄每一車混凝土澆在哪裡。
坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。
試驗迴路上兩個壓力感測器相距 100 m，量到壓差 1.06 MPa，摩擦梯度 i = 1.06/100 = 0.0106 MPa/m。
optionsEn: If the average strength passes, there is no need to record where each truck was placed.
The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump.
Two pressure sensors 100 m apart on a test loop read a difference of 1.06 MPa, so i = 1.06/100 = 0.0106 MPa/m, scaling to about 7.4 MPa of friction on a 700 m line.
quiz.explanation: 試驗迴路上兩個壓力感測器相距 100 m，量到壓差 1.06 MPa，摩擦梯度 i = 1.06/100 = 0.0106 MPa/m；換算到 700 m 實際管線摩擦約 7.4 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Two pressure sensors 100 m apart on a test loop read a difference of 1.06 MPa, so i = 1.06/100 = 0.0106 MPa/m, scaling to about 7.4 MPa of friction on a 700 m line. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可泵性試驗與試泵」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pumpability tests and trial pumping” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗計畫列出配比、流速、溫度、感測器位置與允收準則（例如推算泵壓不超過泵機能力的 80%）；施工中每升高一個區段，比較實測泵壓與預測曲線，偏差持續擴大時暫停加高並檢討配比與管線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The test plan lists mixes, velocities, temperatures, sensor positions and acceptance criteria, for example predicted pressure no more than 80% of pump capacity; as each height zone is reached, compare measured pressure with the predicted curve and pause the climb in height to review mix and line if the deviation keeps growing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把可泵性試驗、逐步加高的壓力紀錄與配比調整列為泵送計畫的必要章節，並在合約中規定混凝土供應商、泵送承包商與總承包商在堵管與配比調整上的責任分界。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make pumpability tests, stepwise pressure records and mix adjustments mandatory chapters of the pumping plan, and set out in the contracts how responsibility for blockages and mix adjustments is divided among the concrete supplier, pumping subcontractor and main contractor.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只在低樓層試泵合格就假設高樓層也能泵送，接近頂部時泵壓超過設備能力，高強度巨柱混凝土無法送達，只能改用吊斗或降低配比強度，延誤工期並引發設計變更。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming that success on low floors means the top is pumpable lets pressure exceed equipment capacity near the top, so high-strength megacolumn concrete cannot be delivered and the job falls back on skips or a lower-strength mix, delaying the programme and forcing design changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫列出配比、流速、溫度、感測器位置與允收準則（例如推算泵壓不超過泵機能力的 80%）；施工中每升高一個區段，比較實測泵壓與預測曲線，偏差持續擴大時暫停加高並檢討配比與管線。
knowledge.textEn: The test plan lists mixes, velocities, temperatures, sensor positions and acceptance criteria, for example predicted pressure no more than 80% of pump capacity; as each height zone is reached, compare measured pressure with the predicted curve and pause the climb in height to review mix and line if the deviation keeps growing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把可泵性試驗、逐步加高的壓力紀錄與配比調整列為泵送計畫的必要章節，並在合約中規定混凝土供應商、泵送承包商與總承包商在堵管與配比調整上的責任分界。
knowledge.textEn: Make pumpability tests, stepwise pressure records and mix adjustments mandatory chapters of the pumping plan, and set out in the contracts how responsibility for blockages and mix adjustments is divided among the concrete supplier, pumping subcontractor and main contractor.

quiz.question: 要驗證「可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase"?
options: 試驗計畫列出配比、流速、溫度、感測器位置與允收準則（例如推算泵壓不超過泵機能力的 80%）。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
泵機的最大排量和最大壓力可以同時達到。
optionsEn: The test plan lists mixes, velocities, temperatures, sensor positions and acceptance criteria, for example predicted pressure no more than 80% of pump capacity.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A pump can reach its maximum output and its maximum pressure at the same time.
quiz.explanation: 試驗計畫列出配比、流速、溫度、感測器位置與允收準則（例如推算泵壓不超過泵機能力的 80%）；施工中每升高一個區段，比較實測泵壓與預測曲線，偏差持續擴大時暫停加高並檢討配比與管線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The test plan lists mixes, velocities, temperatures, sensor positions and acceptance criteria, for example predicted pressure no more than 80% of pump capacity; as each height zone is reached, compare measured pressure with the predicted curve and pause the climb in height to review mix and line if the deviation keeps growing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可泵性試驗與試泵」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pumpability tests and trial pumping” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只在低樓層試泵合格就假設高樓層也能泵送，接近頂部時泵壓超過設備能力，高強度巨柱混凝土無法送達，只能改用吊斗或降低配比強度，延誤工期並引發設計變更。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming that success on low floors means the top is pumpable lets pressure exceed equipment capacity near the top, so high-strength megacolumn concrete cannot be delivered and the job falls back on skips or a lower-strength mix, delaying the programme and forcing design changes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：哈里發塔的預拌商 Unimix 在 2007 年先達到 452 m，2008 年再以 BSA 14000 SHP-D 創下 606 m 的垂直泵送紀錄，正是逐步驗證的例子。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At Burj Khalifa the ready-mix supplier Unimix first reached 452 m in 2007, then set a vertical record of 606 m in 2008 with a BSA 14000 SHP-D, an example of stepwise verification.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要在地面試泵一次成功，整棟超高層都可以用同一配比泵送。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One successful trial at ground level means the same mix can be pumped to the top of a supertall." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只在低樓層試泵合格就假設高樓層也能泵送，接近頂部時泵壓超過設備能力，高強度巨柱混凝土無法送達，只能改用吊斗或降低配比強度，延誤工期並引發設計變更。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming that success on low floors means the top is pumpable lets pressure exceed equipment capacity near the top, so high-strength megacolumn concrete cannot be delivered and the job falls back on skips or a lower-strength mix, delaying the programme and forcing design changes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只在低樓層試泵合格就假設高樓層也能泵送，接近頂部時泵壓超過設備能力，高強度巨柱混凝土無法送達，只能改用吊斗或降低配比強度，延誤工期並引發設計變更。
混凝土在工地入口檢驗合格，泵送到樓頂後的性質也不會改變。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Assuming that success on low floors means the top is pumpable lets pressure exceed equipment capacity near the top, so high-strength megacolumn concrete cannot be delivered and the job falls back on skips or a lower-strength mix, delaying the programme and forcing design changes.
If concrete passes inspection at the site gate, its properties will not change after pumping to the top.
quiz.explanation: 只在低樓層試泵合格就假設高樓層也能泵送，接近頂部時泵壓超過設備能力，高強度巨柱混凝土無法送達，只能改用吊斗或降低配比強度，延誤工期並引發設計變更。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming that success on low floors means the top is pumpable lets pressure exceed equipment capacity near the top, so high-strength megacolumn concrete cannot be delivered and the job falls back on skips or a lower-strength mix, delaying the programme and forcing design changes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 泵送監測、坍流度保持與溫度上升：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pumping monitoring, slump-flow retention and temperature rise: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「坍流度與溫度監測」如何影響高強度混凝土高程泵送的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slump-flow and temperature monitoring” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超高層混凝土從拌合廠到樓頂需要經過運輸、等候、泵送與布料，總時間可能超過一小時，坍流度會隨時間損失；高溫地區還要面對混凝土溫度過高造成的坍流度快速損失與早凝。泵送本身也會加熱混凝土：克服摩擦的能量大部分轉成熱，使混凝土溫度上升。因此監測不能只在工地入口抽驗，還要在布料機出口取樣，比較泵送前後的坍流度、溫度與含氣量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「坍流度與溫度監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Supertall concrete travels from batch plant to roof through haulage, waiting, pumping and placing, possibly for more than an hour, and slump flow is lost with time; in hot regions high concrete temperature accelerates that loss and early stiffening. Pumping itself also heats the concrete: most of the energy spent overcoming friction becomes heat and raises its temperature. Monitoring therefore cannot rely only on sampling at the site gate; samples must also be taken at the boom outlet to compare slump flow, temperature and air content before and after pumping. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Slump-flow and temperature monitoring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：坍流度損失每 30 min 約 30 mm，運輸 60 min 加管內 15 min 共 75 min，損失約 75 mm；出廠 700 mm 到出口約 625 mm，仍高於要求的 600 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Slump flow drops about 30 mm per 30 min; 60 min of haulage plus 15 min in the line is 75 min and about 75 mm of loss, so 700 mm at the plant becomes about 625 mm at the outlet, still above the 600 mm requirement.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土在工地入口檢驗合格，泵送到樓頂後的性質也不會改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If concrete passes inspection at the site gate, its properties will not change after pumping to the top." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「坍流度與溫度監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Slump-flow and temperature monitoring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 泵送監測、坍流度保持與溫度上升
knowledge.titleEn: Pumping monitoring, slump-flow retention and temperature rise
knowledge.text: 超高層混凝土從拌合廠到樓頂需要經過運輸、等候、泵送與布料，總時間可能超過一小時，坍流度會隨時間損失；高溫地區還要面對混凝土溫度過高造成的坍流度快速損失與早凝。泵送本身也會加熱混凝土：克服摩擦的能量大部分轉成熱，使混凝土溫度上升。
knowledge.textEn: Supertall concrete travels from batch plant to roof through haulage, waiting, pumping and placing, possibly for more than an hour, and slump flow is lost with time; in hot regions high concrete temperature accelerates that loss and early stiffening. Pumping itself also heats the concrete: most of the energy spent overcoming friction becomes heat and raises its temperature.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土在工地入口檢驗合格，泵送到樓頂後的性質也不會改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If concrete passes inspection at the site gate, its properties will not change after pumping to the top. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「泵送監測、坍流度保持與溫度上升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pumping monitoring, slump-flow retention and temperature rise" is correct?
options: 混凝土在工地入口檢驗合格，泵送到樓頂後的性質也不會改變。
管線外觀沒有漏漿或變形，就表示管壁厚度足夠。
超高層混凝土從拌合廠到樓頂需要經過運輸、等候、泵送與布料，總時間可能超過一小時，坍流度會隨時間損失；高溫地區還要面對混凝土溫度過高造成的坍流度快速損失與早凝。
optionsEn: If concrete passes inspection at the site gate, its properties will not change after pumping to the top.
If the line shows no leaks or deformation, the walls must still be thick enough.
Supertall concrete travels from batch plant to roof through haulage, waiting, pumping and placing, possibly for more than an hour, and slump flow is lost with time.
quiz.explanation: 超高層混凝土從拌合廠到樓頂需要經過運輸、等候、泵送與布料，總時間可能超過一小時，坍流度會隨時間損失；高溫地區還要面對混凝土溫度過高造成的坍流度快速損失與早凝。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Supertall concrete travels from batch plant to roof through haulage, waiting, pumping and placing, possibly for more than an hour, and slump flow is lost with time; in hot regions high concrete temperature accelerates that loss and early stiffening. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 泵送監測、坍流度保持與溫度上升：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pumping monitoring, slump-flow retention and temperature rise: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坍流度與溫度監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slump-flow and temperature monitoring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：坍流度損失每 30 min 約 30 mm，運輸 60 min 加管內 15 min 共 75 min，損失約 75 mm；出廠 700 mm 到出口約 625 mm，仍高於要求的 600 mm。摩擦造成的溫升 ΔT = Δp_friction/(ρc) = (7.4+1.0)×10⁶/(2,450×1,000) ≈ 3.4°C；靜壓部分轉為位能而非熱。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Slump flow drops about 30 mm per 30 min; 60 min of haulage plus 15 min in the line is 75 min and about 75 mm of loss, so 700 mm at the plant becomes about 625 mm at the outlet, still above the 600 mm requirement. Friction heating gives ΔT = Δp_friction/(ρc) = (7.4+1.0)×10⁶/(2,450×1,000) ≈ 3.4°C; the static-head part becomes potential energy, not heat. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在拌合廠、工地入口與布料機出口三處取樣，記錄坍流度、溫度、含氣量與時間戳記，並定期在出口製作強度試體；比較三處數據的變化趨勢，作為調整減水劑、緩凝劑或冷卻措施的依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample at the plant, the site gate and the boom outlet, recording slump flow, temperature, air content and time stamps, and periodically cast strength specimens at the outlet; use the trends across the three points to adjust superplasticiser, retarder or cooling measures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 坍流度損失每 30 min 約 30 mm，運輸 60 min 加管內 15 min 共 75 min，損失約 75 mm；出廠 700 mm 到出口約 625 mm，仍高於要求的 600 mm。摩擦造成的溫升 ΔT = Δp_friction/(ρc) = (7.4+1.0)×10⁶/(2,450×1,000) ≈ 3.4°C；靜壓部分轉為位能而非熱。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Slump flow drops about 30 mm per 30 min; 60 min of haulage plus 15 min in the line is 75 min and about 75 mm of loss, so 700 mm at the plant becomes about 625 mm at the outlet, still above the 600 mm requirement. Friction heating gives ΔT = Δp_friction/(ρc) = (7.4+1.0)×10⁶/(2,450×1,000) ≈ 3.4°C; the static-head part becomes potential energy, not heat. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「泵送監測、坍流度保持與溫度上升」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pumping monitoring, slump-flow retention and temperature rise", which statement holds?
options: 坍流度損失每 30 min 約 30 mm，運輸 60 min 加管內 15 min 共 75 min，損失約 75 mm。
泵送高度只要乘上混凝土密度就能算出所需泵壓。
輸送管只是管子，任何鋼管只要接得上就能用於超高層泵送。
optionsEn: Slump flow drops about 30 mm per 30 min.
Pump pressure can be found simply by multiplying height by concrete density.
A pump line is just pipe, so any steel pipe that fits can be used for supertall pumping.
quiz.explanation: 坍流度損失每 30 min 約 30 mm，運輸 60 min 加管內 15 min 共 75 min，損失約 75 mm；出廠 700 mm 到出口約 625 mm，仍高於要求的 600 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Slump flow drops about 30 mm per 30 min; 60 min of haulage plus 15 min in the line is 75 min and about 75 mm of loss, so 700 mm at the plant becomes about 625 mm at the outlet, still above the 600 mm requirement. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 泵送監測、坍流度保持與溫度上升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pumping monitoring, slump-flow retention and temperature rise: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坍流度與溫度監測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slump-flow and temperature monitoring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在拌合廠、工地入口與布料機出口三處取樣，記錄坍流度、溫度、含氣量與時間戳記，並定期在出口製作強度試體；比較三處數據的變化趨勢，作為調整減水劑、緩凝劑或冷卻措施的依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample at the plant, the site gate and the boom outlet, recording slump flow, temperature, air content and time stamps, and periodically cast strength specimens at the outlet; use the trends across the three points to adjust superplasticiser, retarder or cooling measures. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規範中明訂驗收取樣位置為布料機出口，並禁止在現場加水；高溫地區應規定混凝土最高溫度、冷卻措施（冰水、液氮或夜間澆置）與運輸時間上限，並由品管人員在樓頂執行抽驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify the boom outlet as the acceptance sampling point and prohibit adding water on site; in hot climates set a maximum concrete temperature, cooling measures such as chilled water, liquid nitrogen or night pours, and a haul-time limit, with quality staff sampling at the top.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只在工地入口驗收坍流度，忽略泵送後的損失與溫升，樓頂出口混凝土已變得太稠，工人在現場加水改善流動，強度與耐久性下降；高溫季節未調整澆置時段，泵壓與堵管頻率顯著升高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accepting slump flow only at the gate while ignoring loss and heating in the line leaves outlet concrete too stiff, and crews add water at the top to make it flow, reducing strength and durability; failing to shift pours to cooler hours in hot seasons markedly raises pump pressure and blockage frequency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在拌合廠、工地入口與布料機出口三處取樣，記錄坍流度、溫度、含氣量與時間戳記，並定期在出口製作強度試體；比較三處數據的變化趨勢，作為調整減水劑、緩凝劑或冷卻措施的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Sample at the plant, the site gate and the boom outlet, recording slump flow, temperature, air content and time stamps, and periodically cast strength specimens at the outlet; use the trends across the three points to adjust superplasticiser, retarder or cooling measures.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規範中明訂驗收取樣位置為布料機出口，並禁止在現場加水；高溫地區應規定混凝土最高溫度、冷卻措施（冰水、液氮或夜間澆置）與運輸時間上限，並由品管人員在樓頂執行抽驗。
knowledge.textEn: Specify the boom outlet as the acceptance sampling point and prohibit adding water on site; in hot climates set a maximum concrete temperature, cooling measures such as chilled water, liquid nitrogen or night pours, and a haul-time limit, with quality staff sampling at the top.

quiz.question: 要驗證「泵送監測、坍流度保持與溫度上升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pumping monitoring, slump-flow retention and temperature rise"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在拌合廠、工地入口與布料機出口三處取樣，記錄坍流度、溫度、含氣量與時間戳記，並定期在出口製作強度試體。
垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Sample at the plant, the site gate and the boom outlet, recording slump flow, temperature, air content and time stamps, and periodically cast strength specimens at the outlet.
A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required.
quiz.explanation: 在拌合廠、工地入口與布料機出口三處取樣，記錄坍流度、溫度、含氣量與時間戳記，並定期在出口製作強度試體；比較三處數據的變化趨勢，作為調整減水劑、緩凝劑或冷卻措施的依據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample at the plant, the site gate and the boom outlet, recording slump flow, temperature, air content and time stamps, and periodically cast strength specimens at the outlet; use the trends across the three points to adjust superplasticiser, retarder or cooling measures. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 泵送監測、坍流度保持與溫度上升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pumping monitoring, slump-flow retention and temperature rise: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坍流度與溫度監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slump-flow and temperature monitoring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只在工地入口驗收坍流度，忽略泵送後的損失與溫升，樓頂出口混凝土已變得太稠，工人在現場加水改善流動，強度與耐久性下降；高溫季節未調整澆置時段，泵壓與堵管頻率顯著升高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accepting slump flow only at the gate while ignoring loss and heating in the line leaves outlet concrete too stiff, and crews add water at the top to make it flow, reducing strength and durability; failing to shift pours to cooler hours in hot seasons markedly raises pump pressure and blockage frequency. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此監測不能只在工地入口抽驗，還要在布料機出口取樣，比較泵送前後的坍流度、溫度與含氣量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Monitoring therefore cannot rely only on sampling at the site gate; samples must also be taken at the boom outlet to compare slump flow, temperature and air content before and after pumping.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土在工地入口檢驗合格，泵送到樓頂後的性質也不會改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If concrete passes inspection at the site gate, its properties will not change after pumping to the top." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只在工地入口驗收坍流度，忽略泵送後的損失與溫升，樓頂出口混凝土已變得太稠，工人在現場加水改善流動，強度與耐久性下降；高溫季節未調整澆置時段，泵壓與堵管頻率顯著升高。
knowledge.textEn: Accepting slump flow only at the gate while ignoring loss and heating in the line leaves outlet concrete too stiff, and crews add water at the top to make it flow, reducing strength and durability; failing to shift pours to cooler hours in hot seasons markedly raises pump pressure and blockage frequency.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「泵送監測、坍流度保持與溫度上升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pumping monitoring, slump-flow retention and temperature rise" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
管線外觀沒有漏漿或變形，就表示管壁厚度足夠。
只在工地入口驗收坍流度，忽略泵送後的損失與溫升，樓頂出口混凝土已變得太稠，工人在現場加水改善流動，強度與耐久性下降。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
If the line shows no leaks or deformation, the walls must still be thick enough.
Accepting slump flow only at the gate while ignoring loss and heating in the line leaves outlet concrete too stiff, and crews add water at the top to make it flow, reducing strength and durability.
quiz.explanation: 只在工地入口驗收坍流度，忽略泵送後的損失與溫升，樓頂出口混凝土已變得太稠，工人在現場加水改善流動，強度與耐久性下降；高溫季節未調整澆置時段，泵壓與堵管頻率顯著升高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Accepting slump flow only at the gate while ignoring loss and heating in the line leaves outlet concrete too stiff, and crews add water at the top to make it flow, reducing strength and durability; failing to shift pours to cooler hours in hot seasons markedly raises pump pressure and blockage frequency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「磨耗監測、爆管風險與更換時機」與「泵送紀錄、強度追溯與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wear monitoring, burst risk and replacement timing" and "Pumping records, strength traceability and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 磨耗監測、爆管風險與更換時機：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wear monitoring, burst risk and replacement timing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「管壁超音波測厚」如何影響高強度混凝土高程泵送的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ultrasonic pipe-wall thickness” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 高強度混凝土含大量硬質骨材，在高壓下高速通過管線，管壁與彎頭外側持續被磨薄；壁厚一旦降到內壓所需的最小值以下，就可能在最高壓力時爆裂。哈里發塔在 32 個月內泵送約 165,000 m³ 混凝土，這樣的累積量足以讓高磨耗位置的管件經歷數次更換。因此管線管理要以泵送量而不只以時間追蹤磨耗，並以測厚數據決定更換，而不是等到漏漿或破裂。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「管壁超音波測厚」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: High-strength concrete carries plenty of hard aggregate through the line at high pressure, so pipe walls and the outside of elbows are continuously worn thinner; once the wall falls below the minimum needed for internal pressure, it can burst at peak pressure. Burj Khalifa pumped about 165,000 m³ of concrete over 32 months, enough for high-wear components to be replaced several times. Line management must therefore track wear against pumped volume, not just time, and replace parts on thickness data rather than waiting for leaks or ruptures. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ultrasonic pipe-wall thickness” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：新管壁厚 10 mm、最小所需 5.6 mm，磨耗裕度 4.4 mm；若直管磨耗率 0.05 mm/1,000 m³，壽命約 4.4/0.05×1,000 = 88,000 m³；彎頭外側磨耗約為 3 倍，壽命約 29,000 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: New walls are 10 mm with 5.6 mm required, a 4.4 mm wear allowance; at 0.05 mm per 1,000 m³ for straight pipe, life is about 4.4/0.05×1,000 = 88,000 m³, while the outside of an elbow wears about three times faster, giving about 29,000 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管線外觀沒有漏漿或變形，就表示管壁厚度足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the line shows no leaks or deformation, the walls must still be thick enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 磨耗監測、爆管風險與更換時機：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wear monitoring, burst risk and replacement timing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「管壁超音波測厚」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ultrasonic pipe-wall thickness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：新管壁厚 10 mm、最小所需 5.6 mm，磨耗裕度 4.4 mm；若直管磨耗率 0.05 mm/1,000 m³，壽命約 4.4/0.05×1,000 = 88,000 m³；彎頭外側磨耗約為 3 倍，壽命約 29,000 m³。以 165,000 m³ 的總量計，直管至少更換一次，彎頭約需更換 5 次。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: New walls are 10 mm with 5.6 mm required, a 4.4 mm wear allowance; at 0.05 mm per 1,000 m³ for straight pipe, life is about 4.4/0.05×1,000 = 88,000 m³, while the outside of an elbow wears about three times faster, giving about 29,000 m³. Over 165,000 m³, straight pipes need at least one replacement and elbows about five. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以超音波測厚儀在每根管與彎頭的固定測點定期量測，量測頻率依累積泵送量設定（例如每 5,000 m³ 一次），把讀值畫成厚度對泵送量的曲線預測更換時點；接近最小厚度的管件標示並排入更換。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure every pipe and elbow at fixed points with an ultrasonic gauge at intervals set by pumped volume, for example every 5,000 m³, plot thickness against volume to forecast replacement, and tag and schedule replacement for parts approaching the minimum thickness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 磨耗監測、爆管風險與更換時機：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wear monitoring, burst risk and replacement timing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「管壁超音波測厚」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ultrasonic pipe-wall thickness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以超音波測厚儀在每根管與彎頭的固定測點定期量測，量測頻率依累積泵送量設定（例如每 5,000 m³ 一次），把讀值畫成厚度對泵送量的曲線預測更換時點；接近最小厚度的管件標示並排入更換。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure every pipe and elbow at fixed points with an ultrasonic gauge at intervals set by pumped volume, for example every 5,000 m³, plot thickness against volume to forecast replacement, and tag and schedule replacement for parts approaching the minimum thickness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：管線維護計畫應包含測點位置圖、量測頻率、最小厚度、更換程序與備品數量；更換作業須先釋壓並確認截止閥關閉，由指定人員執行並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The line maintenance plan should include measuring-point drawings, frequency, minimum thickness, replacement procedure and spare quantities; replacements must follow pressure relief and confirmed shut-off, carried out and recorded by designated staff.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未建立測厚制度，以外觀判斷管件狀況，彎頭在高壓段突然破裂，混凝土與碎片噴出，泵送中斷並造成冷縫；更換管件時未分辨壓力等級，把低壓管裝到高壓段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a thickness programme and judging pipes by appearance, an elbow in the high-pressure zone suddenly ruptures, spraying concrete and fragments, stopping the pour and leaving a cold joint; replacing parts without checking pressure grade puts low-pressure pipe into a high-pressure zone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

quiz.question: 要驗證「磨耗監測、爆管風險與更換時機」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wear monitoring, burst risk and replacement timing"?

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「管壁超音波測厚」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ultrasonic pipe-wall thickness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未建立測厚制度，以外觀判斷管件狀況，彎頭在高壓段突然破裂，混凝土與碎片噴出，泵送中斷並造成冷縫；更換管件時未分辨壓力等級，把低壓管裝到高壓段。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a thickness programme and judging pipes by appearance, an elbow in the high-pressure zone suddenly ruptures, spraying concrete and fragments, stopping the pour and leaving a cold joint; replacing parts without checking pressure grade puts low-pressure pipe into a high-pressure zone. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此管線管理要以泵送量而不只以時間追蹤磨耗，並以測厚數據決定更換，而不是等到漏漿或破裂。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Line management must therefore track wear against pumped volume, not just time, and replace parts on thickness data rather than waiting for leaks or ruptures.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管線外觀沒有漏漿或變形，就表示管壁厚度足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the line shows no leaks or deformation, the walls must still be thick enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未建立測厚制度，以外觀判斷管件狀況，彎頭在高壓段突然破裂，混凝土與碎片噴出，泵送中斷並造成冷縫；更換管件時未分辨壓力等級，把低壓管裝到高壓段。
