optionsEn: Calibrate sensors at two points in ice water and warm water before installation, fix them to rebar on brackets and photograph their depths.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The colder and faster the cooling water, the fewer thermal cracks in the raft.
quiz.explanation: 感測器在安裝前做冰水與溫水兩點校正，安裝時以支架固定在鋼筋上並拍照記錄深度；澆置後確認每點都有資料，若某點失效，以備援點或鄰近點補足判讀，並在報告中註明。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate sensors at two points in ice water and warm water before installation, fix them to rebar on brackets and photograph their depths; after placement confirm that every point reports, cover any failed point with spare or neighbouring sensors and note it in the report. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溫度監測佈點與資料判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temperature monitoring layout and data interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱電偶陣列」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermocouple array” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 感測器只裝在核心而未裝表面點，無法判斷溫差；或表面點裝得太深，讀到的溫度偏高，低估實際溫差；資料只在每天上班時下載，夜間溫差超限無人知道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Installing sensors only in the core leaves the differential unknown; surface sensors set too deep read high and underestimate the real differential; downloading data only during office hours means night-time exceedances go unnoticed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：資料應自動記錄並即時傳輸，設定警戒值與行動值，讓溫控人員在溫差接近限值前就能增加保溫或調整冷卻，而不是事後才發現超限。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Data should be logged automatically and transmitted live with alert and action thresholds, so that thermal-control staff add insulation or adjust cooling before the differential reaches its limit rather than discovering an exceedance afterwards.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要量到核心的最高溫度，就能判斷筏基是否會開裂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Measuring the peak core temperature alone tells you whether the raft will crack." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 感測器只裝在核心而未裝表面點，無法判斷溫差；或表面點裝得太深，讀到的溫度偏高，低估實際溫差；資料只在每天上班時下載，夜間溫差超限無人知道。
knowledge.textEn: Installing sensors only in the core leaves the differential unknown; surface sensors set too deep read high and underestimate the real differential; downloading data only during office hours means night-time exceedances go unnoticed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度監測佈點與資料判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temperature monitoring layout and data interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
感測器只裝在核心而未裝表面點，無法判斷溫差；或表面點裝得太深，讀到的溫度偏高，低估實際溫差；資料只在每天上班時下載，夜間溫差超限無人知道。
熱分析在澆置前做完就好，澆置後不需要再修正。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Installing sensors only in the core leaves the differential unknown.
Thermal analysis is finished before placement and needs no revision afterwards.
quiz.explanation: 感測器只裝在核心而未裝表面點，無法判斷溫差；或表面點裝得太深，讀到的溫度偏高，低估實際溫差；資料只在每天上班時下載，夜間溫差超限無人知道。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Installing sensors only in the core leaves the differential unknown; surface sensors set too deep read high and underestimate the real differential; downloading data only during office hours means night-time exceedances go unnoticed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 預測與實測比對、模型校正與裂縫指數更新：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Comparing prediction and measurement, model calibration and updated cracking index: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「熱分析模型校正」如何影響巨厚筏基水化熱控制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal model calibration” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 熱分析模型的預測依賴許多假設：配比放熱曲線、澆置溫度、表面散熱係數、保溫效果與地盤溫度。實際澆置後的前兩三天，就應以監測資料校正模型：若核心溫升比預測快或高，代表放熱參數或澆置溫度被低估，後續的最高溫度、溫差與保溫拆除時機都要重新預測。分區或分次澆置的筏基，前一次的實測校正可以直接改善下一次的配比與保溫設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「熱分析模型校正」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thermal model predictions rest on many assumptions: the mix heat curve, placing temperature, surface heat-transfer coefficient, insulation performance and ground temperature. Within the first two or three days after placement the model should be calibrated against monitoring data: if the core heats faster or higher than predicted, the heat parameters or placing temperature were underestimated, and peak temperature, differential and insulation-removal timing must all be re-predicted. For rafts placed in zones or stages, calibration from one pour directly improves the mix and insulation design of the next. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Thermal model calibration” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：預測峰值 66°C、實測 70.5°C，澆置溫度 25°C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Predicted peak 66°C, measured 70.5°C, placing temperature 25°C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「熱分析在澆置前做完就好，澆置後不需要再修正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thermal analysis is finished before placement and needs no revision afterwards." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「熱分析模型校正」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Thermal model calibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預測與實測比對、模型校正與裂縫指數更新
knowledge.titleEn: Comparing prediction and measurement, model calibration and updated cracking index
knowledge.text: 熱分析模型的預測依賴許多假設：配比放熱曲線、澆置溫度、表面散熱係數、保溫效果與地盤溫度。實際澆置後的前兩三天，就應以監測資料校正模型：若核心溫升比預測快或高，代表放熱參數或澆置溫度被低估，後續的最高溫度、溫差與保溫拆除時機都要重新預測。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal model predictions rest on many assumptions: the mix heat curve, placing temperature, surface heat-transfer coefficient, insulation performance and ground temperature. Within the first two or three days after placement the model should be calibrated against monitoring data: if the core heats faster or higher than predicted, the heat parameters or placing temperature were underestimated, and peak temperature, differential and insulation-removal timing must all be re-predicted.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：熱分析在澆置前做完就好，澆置後不需要再修正。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thermal analysis is finished before placement and needs no revision afterwards. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預測與實測比對、模型校正與裂縫指數更新」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Comparing prediction and measurement, model calibration and updated cracking index" is correct?
options: 熱分析在澆置前做完就好，澆置後不需要再修正。
筏基溫度高只會影響早期裂縫，只要當時沒裂就沒有後遺症。
熱分析模型的預測依賴許多假設：配比放熱曲線、澆置溫度、表面散熱係數、保溫效果與地盤溫度。
optionsEn: Thermal analysis is finished before placement and needs no revision afterwards.
High raft temperature only matters for early cracking; if it does not crack at the time there are no consequences.
Thermal model predictions rest on many assumptions: the mix heat curve, placing temperature, surface heat-transfer coefficient, insulation performance and ground temperature.
quiz.explanation: 熱分析模型的預測依賴許多假設：配比放熱曲線、澆置溫度、表面散熱係數、保溫效果與地盤溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal model predictions rest on many assumptions: the mix heat curve, placing temperature, surface heat-transfer coefficient, insulation performance and ground temperature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預測與實測比對、模型校正與裂縫指數更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Comparing prediction and measurement, model calibration and updated cracking index: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱分析模型校正」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal model calibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預測峰值 66°C、實測 70.5°C，澆置溫度 25°C。以溫升比例校正放熱：(70.5 − 25)/(66 − 25) = 45.5/41 ≈ 1.11，即實際放熱約高 11%；以此係數重算後續溫差與降溫曲線，若預測溫差將達 20°C，就必須提前加厚保溫。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Predicted peak 66°C, measured 70.5°C, placing temperature 25°C. Calibrate heat by the rise ratio (70.5 − 25)/(66 − 25) = 45.5/41 ≈ 1.11, so actual heat is about 11% higher; recompute later differentials and cooling curves with this factor, and if the predicted differential reaches 20°C, thicken the insulation in advance. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每天把實測曲線與預測曲線疊圖比較，記錄偏差與修正後的參數；修正後的模型須由溫控負責人與結構工程師確認，並據以更新裂縫指數與保溫拆除條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Overlay measured and predicted curves daily, recording deviations and revised parameters; have the thermal-control lead and the structural engineer confirm the revised model and update the cracking index and insulation-removal criteria from it.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 預測峰值 66°C、實測 70.5°C，澆置溫度 25°C。以溫升比例校正放熱：(70.5 − 25)/(66 − 25) = 45.5/41 ≈ 1.11，即實際放熱約高 11%；以此係數重算後續溫差與降溫曲線，若預測溫差將達 20°C，就必須提前加厚保溫。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predicted peak 66°C, measured 70.5°C, placing temperature 25°C. Calibrate heat by the rise ratio (70.5 − 25)/(66 − 25) = 45.5/41 ≈ 1.11, so actual heat is about 11% higher; recompute later differentials and cooling curves with this factor, and if the predicted differential reaches 20°C, thicken the insulation in advance. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預測與實測比對、模型校正與裂縫指數更新」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Comparing prediction and measurement, model calibration and updated cracking index", which statement holds?
options: 預測峰值 66°C、實測 70.5°C，澆置溫度 25°C。
筏基越厚越堅固，水化熱只是暫時現象，不需要特別控制。
筏基強度要求高，所以水泥用量越多越安全。
optionsEn: Predicted peak 66°C, measured 70.5°C, placing temperature 25°C.
The thicker the raft the stronger it is; hydration heat is temporary and needs no special control.
Rafts need high strength, so the more cement the safer.
quiz.explanation: 預測峰值 66°C、實測 70.5°C，澆置溫度 25°C。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Predicted peak 66°C, measured 70.5°C, placing temperature 25°C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預測與實測比對、模型校正與裂縫指數更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Comparing prediction and measurement, model calibration and updated cracking index: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熱分析模型校正」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal model calibration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每天把實測曲線與預測曲線疊圖比較，記錄偏差與修正後的參數；修正後的模型須由溫控負責人與結構工程師確認，並據以更新裂縫指數與保溫拆除條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Overlay measured and predicted curves daily, recording deviations and revised parameters; have the thermal-control lead and the structural engineer confirm the revised model and update the cracking index and insulation-removal criteria from it. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：溫控計畫應規定模型校正的時點（例如澆置後 24、48、72 h）與觸發條件（例如峰值偏差超過 3°C），校正結果與決策紀錄保存於溫控檔案，作為後續工程的參考。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The thermal-control plan should set calibration times, for example 24, 48 and 72 h after placement, and triggers such as a peak deviation above 3°C, and file calibration results and decisions in the thermal-control record for use on later work.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略早期的預測偏差，仍按原計畫在第七天拆除保溫，結果實際溫差遠大於原預測而開裂；分次澆置時未把第一次的實測回饋到第二次，重複同樣問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring early prediction errors and removing insulation on day seven as originally planned produces much larger real differentials than predicted and cracks the raft; failing to feed the first pour's measurements into the second repeats the same problem. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每天把實測曲線與預測曲線疊圖比較，記錄偏差與修正後的參數；修正後的模型須由溫控負責人與結構工程師確認，並據以更新裂縫指數與保溫拆除條件。
knowledge.textEn: Overlay measured and predicted curves daily, recording deviations and revised parameters; have the thermal-control lead and the structural engineer confirm the revised model and update the cracking index and insulation-removal criteria from it.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 溫控計畫應規定模型校正的時點（例如澆置後 24、48、72 h）與觸發條件（例如峰值偏差超過 3°C），校正結果與決策紀錄保存於溫控檔案，作為後續工程的參考。
knowledge.textEn: The thermal-control plan should set calibration times, for example 24, 48 and 72 h after placement, and triggers such as a peak deviation above 3°C, and file calibration results and decisions in the thermal-control record for use on later work.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預測與實測比對、模型校正與裂縫指數更新」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Comparing prediction and measurement, model calibration and updated cracking index"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
每天把實測曲線與預測曲線疊圖比較，記錄偏差與修正後的參數；修正後的模型須由溫控負責人與結構工程師確認，並據以更新裂縫指數與保溫拆除條件。
只要總方量在預定時間內澆完，筏基內就不會有冷縫。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Overlay measured and predicted curves daily, recording deviations and revised parameters.
If the total volume is placed within the planned time, the raft will have no cold joints.
quiz.explanation: 每天把實測曲線與預測曲線疊圖比較，記錄偏差與修正後的參數；修正後的模型須由溫控負責人與結構工程師確認，並據以更新裂縫指數與保溫拆除條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Overlay measured and predicted curves daily, recording deviations and revised parameters; have the thermal-control lead and the structural engineer confirm the revised model and update the cracking index and insulation-removal criteria from it. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預測與實測比對、模型校正與裂縫指數更新：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Comparing prediction and measurement, model calibration and updated cracking index: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱分析模型校正」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal model calibration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略早期的預測偏差，仍按原計畫在第七天拆除保溫，結果實際溫差遠大於原預測而開裂；分次澆置時未把第一次的實測回饋到第二次，重複同樣問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring early prediction errors and removing insulation on day seven as originally planned produces much larger real differentials than predicted and cracks the raft; failing to feed the first pour's measurements into the second repeats the same problem. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分區或分次澆置的筏基，前一次的實測校正可以直接改善下一次的配比與保溫設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For rafts placed in zones or stages, calibration from one pour directly improves the mix and insulation design of the next.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「熱分析在澆置前做完就好，澆置後不需要再修正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thermal analysis is finished before placement and needs no revision afterwards." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略早期的預測偏差，仍按原計畫在第七天拆除保溫，結果實際溫差遠大於原預測而開裂；分次澆置時未把第一次的實測回饋到第二次，重複同樣問題。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring early prediction errors and removing insulation on day seven as originally planned produces much larger real differentials than predicted and cracks the raft; failing to feed the first pour's measurements into the second repeats the same problem.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預測與實測比對、模型校正與裂縫指數更新」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Comparing prediction and measurement, model calibration and updated cracking index" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
筏基溫度高只會影響早期裂縫，只要當時沒裂就沒有後遺症。
忽略早期的預測偏差，仍按原計畫在第七天拆除保溫，結果實際溫差遠大於原預測而開裂；分次澆置時未把第一次的實測回饋到第二次，重複同樣問題。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
High raft temperature only matters for early cracking; if it does not crack at the time there are no consequences.
Ignoring early prediction errors and removing insulation on day seven as originally planned produces much larger real differentials than predicted and cracks the raft.
quiz.explanation: 忽略早期的預測偏差，仍按原計畫在第七天拆除保溫，結果實際溫差遠大於原預測而開裂；分次澆置時未把第一次的實測回饋到第二次，重複同樣問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring early prediction errors and removing insulation on day seven as originally planned produces much larger real differentials than predicted and cracks the raft; failing to feed the first pour's measurements into the second repeats the same problem. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高溫養護後的耐久風險」與「溫控計畫、裂縫調查與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Durability risks after high-temperature curing" and "Thermal-control plan, crack survey and engineering handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高溫養護後的耐久風險：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Durability risks after high-temperature curing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「高溫與延遲鈣礬石」如何影響巨厚筏基水化熱控制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High temperature and delayed ettringite” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 筏基核心溫度過高，不只造成溫差裂縫，也可能損害混凝土本身。早期溫度若超過約 70°C，水泥水化產物中的鈣礬石可能分解，日後在潮濕環境下延遲再生成（延遲鈣礬石生成，DEF），體積膨脹造成內部裂縫，往往在數年後才出現。這是許多規範把最高溫度定在約 70°C 的主要理由之一；使用適量飛灰或爐石可降低 DEF 風險。筏基長期處於地下水中，正是 DEF 需要的潮濕條件，因此筏基的最高溫度控制比地上構件更重要。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「高溫與延遲鈣礬石」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An excessively hot raft core risks more than differential cracking; it can damage the concrete itself. If early temperature exceeds about 70°C, ettringite in the hydration products may decompose and later re-form in moist conditions (delayed ettringite formation, DEF), expanding and cracking the concrete internally, often only after several years. This is one of the main reasons many specifications cap maximum temperature at about 70°C, and suitable fly ash or slag contents reduce DEF risk. A raft sits in groundwater for its whole life, exactly the moist condition DEF needs, so peak-temperature control matters even more for rafts than for members above ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “High temperature and delayed ettringite” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若某區核心峰值 76°C、峰值後降溫速率 1.5°C/天，超過 70°C 的時間約 (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 天。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If a zone peaks at 76°C in the core and cools at 1.5°C per day afterwards, it stays above 70°C for about (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「筏基溫度高只會影響早期裂縫，只要當時沒裂就沒有後遺症。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High raft temperature only matters for early cracking; if it does not crack at the time there are no consequences." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「高溫與延遲鈣礬石」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “High temperature and delayed ettringite”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高溫養護後的耐久風險
knowledge.text: 筏基核心溫度過高，不只造成溫差裂縫，也可能損害混凝土本身。早期溫度若超過約 70°C，水泥水化產物中的鈣礬石可能分解，日後在潮濕環境下延遲再生成（延遲鈣礬石生成，DEF），體積膨脹造成內部裂縫，往往在數年後才出現。
knowledge.textEn: An excessively hot raft core risks more than differential cracking; it can damage the concrete itself. If early temperature exceeds about 70°C, ettringite in the hydration products may decompose and later re-form in moist conditions (delayed ettringite formation, DEF), expanding and cracking the concrete internally, often only after several years.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：筏基溫度高只會影響早期裂縫，只要當時沒裂就沒有後遺症。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High raft temperature only matters for early cracking; if it does not crack at the time there are no consequences. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高溫養護後的耐久風險」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Durability risks after high-temperature curing" is correct?
options: 筏基核心溫度過高，不只造成溫差裂縫，也可能損害混凝土本身。
筏基溫度高只會影響早期裂縫，只要當時沒裂就沒有後遺症。
筏基被覆蓋後看不到，所以裂縫調查與溫度紀錄沒有保存價值。
optionsEn: An excessively hot raft core risks more than differential cracking; it can damage the concrete itself.
High raft temperature only matters for early cracking; if it does not crack at the time there are no consequences.
Once the raft is covered nobody can see it, so crack surveys and temperature records have no lasting value.
quiz.explanation: 筏基核心溫度過高，不只造成溫差裂縫，也可能損害混凝土本身。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An excessively hot raft core risks more than differential cracking; it can damage the concrete itself. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高溫養護後的耐久風險：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Durability risks after high-temperature curing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高溫與延遲鈣礬石」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High temperature and delayed ettringite” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若某區核心峰值 76°C、峰值後降溫速率 1.5°C/天，超過 70°C 的時間約 (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 天。若改以配比 B 加上 15°C 澆置溫度，預測峰值 15 + 0.9×60.3 ≈ 69.2°C，則不超過 70°C。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If a zone peaks at 76°C in the core and cools at 1.5°C per day afterwards, it stays above 70°C for about (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 days. Using mix B with a 15°C placing temperature, the predicted peak is 15 + 0.9×60.3 ≈ 69.2°C, which does not exceed 70°C. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以監測資料統計每一區超過 70°C 的時間與最高溫度，對超限區域評估配比中的摻料比例與硫酸鹽含量是否足以抑制 DEF；必要時鑽心以顯微分析或膨脹試驗評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: From monitoring data, tabulate for each zone the time above 70°C and the peak, assess whether the supplementary-material content and sulphate level of the mix suppress DEF in zones that exceeded it, and if needed take cores for microscopy or expansion testing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若某區核心峰值 76°C、峰值後降溫速率 1.5°C/天，超過 70°C 的時間約 (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 天。若改以配比 B 加上 15°C 澆置溫度，預測峰值 15 + 0.9×60.3 ≈ 69.2°C，則不超過 70°C。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If a zone peaks at 76°C in the core and cools at 1.5°C per day afterwards, it stays above 70°C for about (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 days. Using mix B with a 15°C placing temperature, the predicted peak is 15 + 0.9×60.3 ≈ 69.2°C, which does not exceed 70°C. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高溫養護後的耐久風險」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Durability risks after high-temperature curing", which statement holds?
options: 只要核心溫度低於 70°C，筏基就不會產生溫度裂縫。
若某區核心峰值 76°C、峰值後降溫速率 1.5°C/天，超過 70°C 的時間約 (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 天。
冷卻水越冷、流量越大，筏基的溫度裂縫就越少。
optionsEn: If the core stays below 70°C, the raft will not crack thermally.
If a zone peaks at 76°C in the core and cools at 1.5°C per day afterwards, it stays above 70°C for about (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 days.
The colder and faster the cooling water, the fewer thermal cracks in the raft.
quiz.explanation: 若某區核心峰值 76°C、峰值後降溫速率 1.5°C/天，超過 70°C 的時間約 (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 天。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If a zone peaks at 76°C in the core and cools at 1.5°C per day afterwards, it stays above 70°C for about (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 days. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高溫養護後的耐久風險：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Durability risks after high-temperature curing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高溫與延遲鈣礬石」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High temperature and delayed ettringite” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以監測資料統計每一區超過 70°C 的時間與最高溫度，對超限區域評估配比中的摻料比例與硫酸鹽含量是否足以抑制 DEF；必要時鑽心以顯微分析或膨脹試驗評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: From monitoring data, tabulate for each zone the time above 70°C and the peak, assess whether the supplementary-material content and sulphate level of the mix suppress DEF in zones that exceeded it, and if needed take cores for microscopy or expansion testing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：最高溫度超限應列為不符合事項，由結構工程師與材料專家評估耐久風險與是否需要長期監測；溫控紀錄必須保留，作為建築使用期間若出現異常裂縫時的調查依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Treat any peak-temperature exceedance as a nonconformance assessed by the structural engineer and a materials specialist for durability risk and the need for long-term monitoring; keep the thermal records as evidence for any investigation if unusual cracking appears during the building's life.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：核心溫度短暫超過 80°C 但當時未見裂縫，工程照常驗收；數年後筏基在地下水作用下出現不規則網狀裂縫與膨脹，修復極為困難，因為筏基上方已是整棟建築。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A core briefly exceeds 80°C with no cracks visible at the time and the work is accepted; years later, in groundwater, the raft develops irregular map cracking and expansion that is extremely hard to repair because the whole building sits on top. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以監測資料統計每一區超過 70°C 的時間與最高溫度，對超限區域評估配比中的摻料比例與硫酸鹽含量是否足以抑制 DEF；必要時鑽心以顯微分析或膨脹試驗評估。
knowledge.textEn: From monitoring data, tabulate for each zone the time above 70°C and the peak, assess whether the supplementary-material content and sulphate level of the mix suppress DEF in zones that exceeded it, and if needed take cores for microscopy or expansion testing.

knowledge.text: 最高溫度超限應列為不符合事項，由結構工程師與材料專家評估耐久風險與是否需要長期監測；溫控紀錄必須保留，作為建築使用期間若出現異常裂縫時的調查依據。

quiz.question: 要驗證「高溫養護後的耐久風險」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Durability risks after high-temperature curing"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
保溫只是為了冬天防凍，夏天澆置的筏基不需要保溫。
以監測資料統計每一區超過 70°C 的時間與最高溫度，對超限區域評估配比中的摻料比例與硫酸鹽含量是否足以抑制 DEF；必要時鑽心以顯微分析或膨脹試驗評估。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Insulation is only for winter frost protection; rafts poured in summer do not need it.

From monitoring data, tabulate for each zone the time above 70°C and the peak, assess whether the supplementary-material content and sulphate level of the mix suppress DEF in zones that exceeded it, and if needed take cores for microscopy or expansion testing.
quiz.explanation: 以監測資料統計每一區超過 70°C 的時間與最高溫度，對超限區域評估配比中的摻料比例與硫酸鹽含量是否足以抑制 DEF；必要時鑽心以顯微分析或膨脹試驗評估。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: From monitoring data, tabulate for each zone the time above 70°C and the peak, assess whether the supplementary-material content and sulphate level of the mix suppress DEF in zones that exceeded it, and if needed take cores for microscopy or expansion testing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高溫養護後的耐久風險：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Durability risks after high-temperature curing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高溫與延遲鈣礬石」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “High temperature and delayed ettringite” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 核心溫度短暫超過 80°C 但當時未見裂縫，工程照常驗收；數年後筏基在地下水作用下出現不規則網狀裂縫與膨脹，修復極為困難，因為筏基上方已是整棟建築。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A core briefly exceeds 80°C with no cracks visible at the time and the work is accepted; years later, in groundwater, the raft develops irregular map cracking and expansion that is extremely hard to repair because the whole building sits on top. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：筏基長期處於地下水中，正是 DEF 需要的潮濕條件，因此筏基的最高溫度控制比地上構件更重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A raft sits in groundwater for its whole life, exactly the moist condition DEF needs, so peak-temperature control matters even more for rafts than for members above ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「筏基溫度高只會影響早期裂縫，只要當時沒裂就沒有後遺症。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High raft temperature only matters for early cracking; if it does not crack at the time there are no consequences." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 核心溫度短暫超過 80°C 但當時未見裂縫，工程照常驗收；數年後筏基在地下水作用下出現不規則網狀裂縫與膨脹，修復極為困難，因為筏基上方已是整棟建築。
knowledge.textEn: A core briefly exceeds 80°C with no cracks visible at the time and the work is accepted; years later, in groundwater, the raft develops irregular map cracking and expansion that is extremely hard to repair because the whole building sits on top.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高溫養護後的耐久風險」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Durability risks after high-temperature curing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 核心溫度短暫超過 80°C 但當時未見裂縫，工程照常驗收；數年後筏基在地下水作用下出現不規則網狀裂縫與膨脹，修復極為困難，因為筏基上方已是整棟建築。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
筏基被覆蓋後看不到，所以裂縫調查與溫度紀錄沒有保存價值。
optionsEn: A core briefly exceeds 80°C with no cracks visible at the time and the work is accepted.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once the raft is covered nobody can see it, so crack surveys and temperature records have no lasting value.
quiz.explanation: 核心溫度短暫超過 80°C 但當時未見裂縫，工程照常驗收；數年後筏基在地下水作用下出現不規則網狀裂縫與膨脹，修復極為困難，因為筏基上方已是整棟建築。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A core briefly exceeds 80°C with no cracks visible at the time and the work is accepted; years later, in groundwater, the raft develops irregular map cracking and expansion that is extremely hard to repair because the whole building sits on top. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 溫控計畫、裂縫調查與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal-control plan, crack survey and engineering handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「溫控計畫與竣工紀錄」如何影響巨厚筏基水化熱控制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal-control plan and as-built records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 巨厚筏基完成後會被上部結構完全覆蓋，日後幾乎無法檢查；因此在被覆蓋前完成裂縫調查、修補與紀錄是交接的最後機會。調查應繪製裂縫分布圖，記錄寬度、長度與是否貫穿，判定是否需要注入環氧樹脂或其他修補。交接資料包括溫控計畫、配比與放熱試驗、澆置紀錄（時間、方量、各層覆蓋時間）、溫度監測原始資料、模型校正紀錄、不符合事項處理與裂縫修補紀錄，讓業主與未來的結構工程師理解筏基的實際狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「溫控計畫與竣工紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once complete, a massive raft is entirely covered by the superstructure and can hardly be inspected again, so finishing the crack survey, repairs and records before it is covered is the last chance at handover. The survey should map cracks, recording width, length and whether they pass through, and decide whether epoxy injection or another repair is needed. Handover records include the thermal-control plan, mix and heat tests, placement logs with times, volumes and layer cover times, raw temperature data, model calibration records, nonconformance actions and crack repair records, so that the owner and future structural engineers understand the raft's real condition. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Thermal-control plan and as-built records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：裂縫寬 0.3 mm、深 300 mm、長 50 m 時，注入體積 V = 0.0003×0.3×50 = 0.0045 m³ = 4.5 L；考慮損耗與管路，實際備料約 1.5 倍，約 6.8 L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A crack 0.3 mm wide, 300 mm deep and 50 m long needs V = 0.0003×0.3×50 = 0.0045 m³ = 4.5 L of injection; allowing 1.5 times for losses and lines, about 6.8 L should be prepared.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「筏基被覆蓋後看不到，所以裂縫調查與溫度紀錄沒有保存價值。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the raft is covered nobody can see it, so crack surveys and temperature records have no lasting value." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「溫控計畫與竣工紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Thermal-control plan and as-built records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫控計畫、裂縫調查與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Thermal-control plan, crack survey and engineering handover
knowledge.text: 巨厚筏基完成後會被上部結構完全覆蓋，日後幾乎無法檢查；因此在被覆蓋前完成裂縫調查、修補與紀錄是交接的最後機會。調查應繪製裂縫分布圖，記錄寬度、長度與是否貫穿，判定是否需要注入環氧樹脂或其他修補。
knowledge.textEn: Once complete, a massive raft is entirely covered by the superstructure and can hardly be inspected again, so finishing the crack survey, repairs and records before it is covered is the last chance at handover. The survey should map cracks, recording width, length and whether they pass through, and decide whether epoxy injection or another repair is needed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：筏基被覆蓋後看不到，所以裂縫調查與溫度紀錄沒有保存價值。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the raft is covered nobody can see it, so crack surveys and temperature records have no lasting value. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫控計畫、裂縫調查與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal-control plan, crack survey and engineering handover" is correct?
options: 筏基被覆蓋後看不到，所以裂縫調查與溫度紀錄沒有保存價值。
巨厚筏基完成後會被上部結構完全覆蓋，日後幾乎無法檢查；因此在被覆蓋前完成裂縫調查、修補與紀錄是交接的最後機會。
筏基越厚越堅固，水化熱只是暫時現象，不需要特別控制。
optionsEn: Once the raft is covered nobody can see it, so crack surveys and temperature records have no lasting value.

Once complete, a massive raft is entirely covered by the superstructure and can hardly be inspected again, so finishing the crack survey, repairs and records before it is covered is the last chance at handover.
The thicker the raft the stronger it is; hydration heat is temporary and needs no special control.
quiz.explanation: 巨厚筏基完成後會被上部結構完全覆蓋，日後幾乎無法檢查；因此在被覆蓋前完成裂縫調查、修補與紀錄是交接的最後機會。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once complete, a massive raft is entirely covered by the superstructure and can hardly be inspected again, so finishing the crack survey, repairs and records before it is covered is the last chance at handover. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溫控計畫、裂縫調查與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal-control plan, crack survey and engineering handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「溫控計畫與竣工紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal-control plan and as-built records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：裂縫寬 0.3 mm、深 300 mm、長 50 m 時，注入體積 V = 0.0003×0.3×50 = 0.0045 m³ = 4.5 L；考慮損耗與管路，實際備料約 1.5 倍，約 6.8 L。若允收寬度訂為 0.2 mm，則所有大於此值的裂縫都需納入修補清單。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A crack 0.3 mm wide, 300 mm deep and 50 m long needs V = 0.0003×0.3×50 = 0.0045 m³ = 4.5 L of injection; allowing 1.5 times for losses and lines, about 6.8 L should be prepared. If the acceptance width is 0.2 mm, every crack wider than that goes on the repair list. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在筏基被覆蓋前，以裂縫寬度計與照片完成全面調查，必要時以超音波或鑽心判斷深度；修補後以壓水試驗或鑽心確認填充，所有紀錄與溫度資料一併交給業主並保存於建築檔案。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Complete a full survey with crack-width gauges and photographs before the raft is covered, using ultrasonics or cores to judge depth where needed; after repair confirm filling with water-pressure tests or cores, and hand all records and temperature data to the owner for the building file.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 裂縫寬 0.3 mm、深 300 mm、長 50 m 時，注入體積 V = 0.0003×0.3×50 = 0.0045 m³ = 4.5 L；考慮損耗與管路，實際備料約 1.5 倍，約 6.8 L。若允收寬度訂為 0.2 mm，則所有大於此值的裂縫都需納入修補清單。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A crack 0.3 mm wide, 300 mm deep and 50 m long needs V = 0.0003×0.3×50 = 0.0045 m³ = 4.5 L of injection; allowing 1.5 times for losses and lines, about 6.8 L should be prepared. If the acceptance width is 0.2 mm, every crack wider than that goes on the repair list. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溫控計畫、裂縫調查與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal-control plan, crack survey and engineering handover", which statement holds?
options: 筏基強度要求高，所以水泥用量越多越安全。
只要總方量在預定時間內澆完，筏基內就不會有冷縫。
optionsEn: Rafts need high strength, so the more cement the safer.
If the total volume is placed within the planned time, the raft will have no cold joints.
A crack 0.3 mm wide, 300 mm deep and 50 m long needs V = 0.0003×0.3×50 = 0.0045 m³ = 4.5 L of injection.
quiz.explanation: 裂縫寬 0.3 mm、深 300 mm、長 50 m 時，注入體積 V = 0.0003×0.3×50 = 0.0045 m³ = 4.5 L；考慮損耗與管路，實際備料約 1.5 倍，約 6.8 L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A crack 0.3 mm wide, 300 mm deep and 50 m long needs V = 0.0003×0.3×50 = 0.0045 m³ = 4.5 L of injection; allowing 1.5 times for losses and lines, about 6.8 L should be prepared. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 溫控計畫、裂縫調查與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal-control plan, crack survey and engineering handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溫控計畫與竣工紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal-control plan and as-built records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在筏基被覆蓋前，以裂縫寬度計與照片完成全面調查，必要時以超音波或鑽心判斷深度；修補後以壓水試驗或鑽心確認填充，所有紀錄與溫度資料一併交給業主並保存於建築檔案。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Complete a full survey with crack-width gauges and photographs before the raft is covered, using ultrasonics or cores to judge depth where needed; after repair confirm filling with water-pressure tests or cores, and hand all records and temperature data to the owner for the building file. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把裂縫調查與修補完成列為上部結構開工前的停檢點，由監造與結構工程師簽認；交接文件包含溫控與裂縫的完整紀錄，並在建築維護手冊中註明地下室滲水或異常裂縫時應先查閱這些資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make completion of the crack survey and repairs a hold point before superstructure work, signed by the resident engineer and structural engineer; include complete thermal and crack records in the handover and note in the building maintenance manual that they should be consulted first if basement leaks or unusual cracks appear.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：急於進行上部結構施工，筏基表面裂縫未調查就被防水層與樓板覆蓋，日後地下室滲水時無法判斷來源；溫度監測原始資料未保存，多年後出現疑似 DEF 裂縫時無法回溯當年的最高溫度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rushing into the superstructure lets raft surface cracks be covered by waterproofing and slabs without a survey, so later basement leaks cannot be traced; without retained raw temperature data, suspected DEF cracking years later cannot be checked against the original peak temperatures. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫控計畫、裂縫調查與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 溫控計畫、裂縫調查與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal-control plan, crack survey and engineering handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「溫控計畫與竣工紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal-control plan and as-built records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 急於進行上部結構施工，筏基表面裂縫未調查就被防水層與樓板覆蓋，日後地下室滲水時無法判斷來源；溫度監測原始資料未保存，多年後出現疑似 DEF 裂縫時無法回溯當年的最高溫度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rushing into the superstructure lets raft surface cracks be covered by waterproofing and slabs without a survey, so later basement leaks cannot be traced; without retained raw temperature data, suspected DEF cracking years later cannot be checked against the original peak temperatures. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接資料包括溫控計畫、配比與放熱試驗、澆置紀錄（時間、方量、各層覆蓋時間）、溫度監測原始資料、模型校正紀錄、不符合事項處理與裂縫修補紀錄，讓業主與未來的結構工程師理解筏基的實際狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover records include the thermal-control plan, mix and heat tests, placement logs with times, volumes and layer cover times, raw temperature data, model calibration records, nonconformance actions and crack repair records, so that the owner and future structural engineers understand the raft's real condition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「筏基被覆蓋後看不到，所以裂縫調查與溫度紀錄沒有保存價值。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the raft is covered nobody can see it, so crack surveys and temperature records have no lasting value." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫控計畫、裂縫調查與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal-control plan, crack survey and engineering handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
急於進行上部結構施工，筏基表面裂縫未調查就被防水層與樓板覆蓋，日後地下室滲水時無法判斷來源。
筏基越厚越堅固，水化熱只是暫時現象，不需要特別控制。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Rushing into the superstructure lets raft surface cracks be covered by waterproofing and slabs without a survey, so later basement leaks cannot be traced.
The thicker the raft the stronger it is; hydration heat is temporary and needs no special control.

title: 鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗
titleEn: Welding inspection of major steel joints
summary: 從巨型梁柱接頭與箱型柱續接的傳力出發，說明 1994 年 Northridge 地震焊接接頭脆斷的教訓、厚板層狀撕裂與氫致冷裂、焊接程序與銲工資格、焊接順序與收縮、品管與品保停留點、超音波檢測幾何、尺寸目視檢查、缺陷修補與焊道紀錄，並以 Alexander L. Kielland 平台、I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋與舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段為實例。
summaryEn: Starting from force transfer in mega beam–column joints and box-column splices, explain the lessons of brittle weld fractures in the 1994 Northridge earthquake, lamellar tearing and hydrogen cold cracking in thick plate, welding procedures and welder qualification, weld sequence and shrinkage, quality-control and quality-assurance hold points, ultrasonic testing geometry, dimensional visual inspection, defect repair and weld records, with the Alexander L. Kielland platform, the I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge and the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge East Span as examples.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：超高層巨型箱型柱 800×800 mm、板厚 60 mm，以全滲透焊做現場續接。(1) 受力：柱在風載下承受拉力 15 MN，斷面積 4×(800 − 60)×60 = 177,600 mm²，平均拉應力 15×10⁶/177,600 ≈ 84.5 MPa。(2) 材料：CE ≈ 0.44、板厚 60 mm，教學假設採最低預熱 110°C、層間溫度上限 230°C；以 30 V、300 A、300 mm/min 施焊，熱輸入 1.8 kJ/mm，須落在 WPS 範圍內。(3) 收縮：A_w = 1,300 mm²，每個續接約 4.5 mm，20 個續接約 90 mm，於柱段長度中預留。(4) 檢驗：70° 斜角探頭在 60 mm 板第一跨聲程約 175 mm；400 道焊縫抽驗 40 道、拒收 3 道，拒收率 7.5% 超過 5%，全面補驗其餘 360 道。(5) 若改變一個輸入：抽驗只拒收 1 道（2.5%），可維持 10% 抽驗，但拒收焊縫仍要追溯銲工並修補後複檢。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a supertall mega box column 800×800 mm with 60 mm plates is spliced on site with CJP welds. (1) Demand: the column carries 15 MN of wind tension over an area of 4×(800 − 60)×60 = 177,600 mm², a mean tensile stress of 15×10⁶/177,600 ≈ 84.5 MPa. (2) Material: with CE ≈ 0.44 and 60 mm plate, the teaching assumption is a minimum preheat of 110°C and a maximum interpass temperature of 230°C; welding at 30 V, 300 A and 300 mm/min gives a heat input of 1.8 kJ/mm, which must lie within the WPS range. (3) Shrinkage: with A_w = 1,300 mm², each splice shrinks about 4.5 mm and 20 splices about 90 mm, allowed for in segment lengths. (4) Inspection: a 70° angle probe needs a first-leg sound path of about 175 mm in 60 mm plate; sampling 40 of 400 welds finds 3 rejects, a 7.5% rate above 5%, so the remaining 360 are all tested. (5) Changing one input: with only 1 reject (2.5%) the 10% sampling can continue, but the rejected weld is still traced to its welder, repaired and re-tested. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類」與「Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Force transfer and weld classification in major joints" and "Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Force transfer and weld classification in major joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」如何影響鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam-flange CJP groove weld” governs force, deformation or durability in “Welding inspection of major steel joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 巨型梁柱接頭、桁架節點與箱型柱續接中，彎矩大多以翼板拉壓力偶傳遞，受拉翼板的全滲透開槽焊必須發揮與母材相同的強度；腹板與加勁板的填角焊則主要承受剪力。焊縫的重要性不只取決於尺寸，而取決於失效後果：位於耐震系統塑性區、承受反覆拉力或疲勞的焊縫，會被歸為需求關鍵焊縫，適用更嚴格的韌性、檢驗與紀錄要求。檢驗計畫因此要先把每一道焊縫分類，而不是一律同樣對待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In mega beam–column joints, truss nodes and box-column splices, moment travels mostly as a tension–compression couple in the flanges, and the complete-joint-penetration (CJP) groove weld on the tension flange must develop the full strength of the base metal, while fillet welds on webs and stiffeners mainly carry shear. A weld's importance depends less on its size than on the consequence of its failure: welds in the yielding zones of seismic systems or under repeated tension or fatigue are classed as demand-critical, with stricter toughness, inspection and record requirements. An inspection plan therefore starts by classifying every weld rather than treating all alike. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Beam-flange CJP groove weld” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：翼板力 F = M/(d − t_f)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Flange force F = M/(d − t_f).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「焊縫外觀平整光滑，就代表內部品質良好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A smooth, even weld surface means the weld is sound inside." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Beam-flange CJP groove weld”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：焊縫外觀平整光滑，就代表內部品質良好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A smooth, even weld surface means the weld is sound inside. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Force transfer and weld classification in major joints" is correct?
options: 焊縫外觀平整光滑，就代表內部品質良好。
巨型梁柱接頭、桁架節點與箱型柱續接中，彎矩大多以翼板拉壓力偶傳遞，受拉翼板的全滲透開槽焊必須發揮與母材相同的強度；腹板與加勁板的填角焊則主要承受剪力。
留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。
optionsEn: A smooth, even weld surface means the weld is sound inside.

In mega beam–column joints, truss nodes and box-column splices, moment travels mostly as a tension–compression couple in the flanges, and the complete-joint-penetration (CJP) groove weld on the tension flange must develop the full strength of the base metal, while fillet welds on webs and stiffeners mainly carry shear.
Leaving the weld backing bar in place adds strength, so it never needs removing.
quiz.explanation: 巨型梁柱接頭、桁架節點與箱型柱續接中，彎矩大多以翼板拉壓力偶傳遞，受拉翼板的全滲透開槽焊必須發揮與母材相同的強度；腹板與加勁板的填角焊則主要承受剪力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In mega beam–column joints, truss nodes and box-column splices, moment travels mostly as a tension–compression couple in the flanges, and the complete-joint-penetration (CJP) groove weld on the tension flange must develop the full strength of the base metal, while fillet welds on webs and stiffeners mainly carry shear. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Force transfer and weld classification in major joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam-flange CJP groove weld” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：翼板力 F = M/(d − t_f)。M = 2,000 kN·m、梁深 d = 0.9 m、翼板厚 t_f = 0.03 m：F = 2,000/0.87 ≈ 2,299 kN；翼板 300×30 mm，面積 9,000 mm²，平均應力 σ = 2,299,000/9,000 ≈ 255 MPa，已接近 Q345 或 A572 Gr. 50 鋼材降伏強度的四分之三，焊縫任何缺陷都直接位於高應力區。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Flange force F = M/(d − t_f). With M = 2,000 kN·m, beam depth d = 0.9 m and flange thickness t_f = 0.03 m, F = 2,000/0.87 ≈ 2,299 kN; a 300×30 mm flange of 9,000 mm² carries σ = 2,299,000/9,000 ≈ 255 MPa, about three quarters of the yield strength of a 345 MPa steel, so any weld flaw sits in a highly stressed zone. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在設計圖與施工圖上以符號標出每一道焊縫的類型（全滲透、部分滲透、填角）、受力方向、是否為需求關鍵焊縫與對應的非破壞檢測等級，製成焊縫清冊；檢驗人員以清冊核對現場，確保沒有焊縫被遺漏或降級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark on design and shop drawings the type of every weld (CJP, partial-penetration, fillet), its stress direction, whether it is demand-critical and its required NDT level, compiled into a weld register; inspectors check the site against the register so no weld is missed or downgraded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 翼板力 F = M/(d − t_f)。M = 2,000 kN·m、梁深 d = 0.9 m、翼板厚 t_f = 0.03 m：F = 2,000/0.87 ≈ 2,299 kN；翼板 300×30 mm，面積 9,000 mm²，平均應力 σ = 2,299,000/9,000 ≈ 255 MPa，已接近 Q345 或 A572 Gr. 50 鋼材降伏強度的四分之三，焊縫任何缺陷都直接位於高應力區。數值為教學假設。

With M = 2,000 kN·m, beam depth d = 0.9 m and flange thickness t_f = 0.03 m, F = 2,000/0.87 ≈ 2,299 kN; a 300×30 mm flange of 9,000 mm² carries σ = 2,299,000/9,000 ≈ 255 MPa, about three quarters of the yield strength of a 345 MPa steel, so any weld flaw sits in a highly stressed zone. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Force transfer and weld classification in major joints", which statement holds?
options: 銲工經驗豐富就可以不按焊接程序施焊。
只要完工後的超音波抽驗合格，焊接過程的檢查就可以省略。
翼板力 F = M/(d − t_f)。
optionsEn: An experienced welder does not need to follow the welding procedure.
If post-weld ultrasonic sampling passes, in-process inspection can be skipped.
Flange force F = M/(d − t_f).
quiz.explanation: 翼板力 F = M/(d − t_f)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Flange force F = M/(d − t_f). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Force transfer and weld classification in major joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Beam-flange CJP groove weld” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在設計圖與施工圖上以符號標出每一道焊縫的類型（全滲透、部分滲透、填角）、受力方向、是否為需求關鍵焊縫與對應的非破壞檢測等級，製成焊縫清冊；檢驗人員以清冊核對現場，確保沒有焊縫被遺漏或降級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark on design and shop drawings the type of every weld (CJP, partial-penetration, fillet), its stress direction, whether it is demand-critical and its required NDT level, compiled into a weld register; inspectors check the site against the register so no weld is missed or downgraded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構設計者必須在圖說中明確指定需求關鍵焊縫與各焊縫的檢驗等級，不能留給製造廠判斷；焊縫清冊列為施工圖審查的必要文件，未經結構工程師核定不得開始製造。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural designer must specify demand-critical welds and the inspection level of every weld on the drawings rather than leave it to the fabricator; the weld register is a required submittal in shop-drawing review, and fabrication may not start before the structural engineer approves it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若施工圖把受拉翼板全滲透焊誤標為一般焊縫，只做目視檢查，內部未熔合或夾渣就會留在接頭中，在地震或強風的大拉力下由缺陷處脆性斷裂，裂縫可能貫穿翼板並延伸到柱翼板。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If shop drawings mislabel a tension-flange CJP weld as an ordinary weld inspected only visually, internal lack of fusion or slag stays in the joint and, under large seismic or wind tension, starts a brittle fracture that can run through the flange into the column flange. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構設計者必須在圖說中明確指定需求關鍵焊縫與各焊縫的檢驗等級，不能留給製造廠判斷；焊縫清冊列為施工圖審查的必要文件，未經結構工程師核定不得開始製造。

quiz.question: 要驗證「巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Force transfer and weld classification in major joints"?
options: 在設計圖與施工圖上以符號標出每一道焊縫的類型（全滲透、部分滲透、填角）、受力方向、是否為需求關鍵焊縫與對應的非破壞檢測等級，製成焊縫清冊。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Mark on design and shop drawings the type of every weld (CJP, partial-penetration, fillet), its stress direction, whether it is demand-critical and its required NDT level, compiled into a weld register.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Welds on non-load-bearing attachments do not matter and need no inspection.

quiz.explanationEn: Mark on design and shop drawings the type of every weld (CJP, partial-penetration, fillet), its stress direction, whether it is demand-critical and its required NDT level, compiled into a weld register; inspectors check the site against the register so no weld is missed or downgraded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Force transfer and weld classification in major joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Beam-flange CJP groove weld” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若施工圖把受拉翼板全滲透焊誤標為一般焊縫，只做目視檢查，內部未熔合或夾渣就會留在接頭中，在地震或強風的大拉力下由缺陷處脆性斷裂，裂縫可能貫穿翼板並延伸到柱翼板。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If shop drawings mislabel a tension-flange CJP weld as an ordinary weld inspected only visually, internal lack of fusion or slag stays in the joint and, under large seismic or wind tension, starts a brittle fracture that can run through the flange into the column flange. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢驗計畫因此要先把每一道焊縫分類，而不是一律同樣對待。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An inspection plan therefore starts by classifying every weld rather than treating all alike.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「焊縫外觀平整光滑，就代表內部品質良好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A smooth, even weld surface means the weld is sound inside." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若施工圖把受拉翼板全滲透焊誤標為一般焊縫，只做目視檢查，內部未熔合或夾渣就會留在接頭中，在地震或強風的大拉力下由缺陷處脆性斷裂，裂縫可能貫穿翼板並延伸到柱翼板。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Force transfer and weld classification in major joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

若施工圖把受拉翼板全滲透焊誤標為一般焊縫，只做目視檢查，內部未熔合或夾渣就會留在接頭中，在地震或強風的大拉力下由缺陷處脆性斷裂，裂縫可能貫穿翼板並延伸到柱翼板。
留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

steps.title: Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「背墊板與焊接扇形孔」如何影響鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backing bars and weld access holes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Welding inspection of major steel joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 1994 年 1 月 17 日規模 6.7 的 Northridge 地震後，工程師在多棟鋼造抗彎矩構架建築中發現梁柱焊接接頭脆性斷裂，SEAOC、ATC 與 CUREE 同年組成 SAC 聯合團隊，在 FEMA 與加州緊急服務辦公室資助下研究至 2000 年。常見問題包括：留在原處的背墊板與未熔合根部形成類似裂縫的缺口，焊材韌性不足，焊接扇形孔幾何造成應力集中，以及檢驗難以看到下翼板根部。之後的規範要求需求關鍵焊縫使用有韌性保證的焊材、移除背墊板並清根補焊或加填角焊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「背墊板與焊接扇形孔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After the magnitude 6.7 Northridge earthquake of 17 January 1994, engineers found brittle fractures in welded beam–column joints of many steel moment-frame buildings; SEAOC, ATC and CUREE formed the SAC Joint Venture that year and, funded by FEMA and the California Office of Emergency Services, studied the problem until 2000. Common issues included backing bars left in place with unfused roots acting as crack-like notches, weld metal of low toughness, stress concentrations at weld access holes, and inspection that could hardly see the root of the bottom flange. Later codes required demand-critical welds with toughness-rated filler metal, backing removal with back-gouging and reweld, or a reinforcing fillet. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Backing bars and weld access holes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：根部缺口近似邊緣裂縫，K = 1.12σ√(πa)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Treat the root notch as an edge crack, K = 1.12σ√(πa).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Leaving the weld backing bar in place adds strength, so it never needs removing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「背墊板與焊接扇形孔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Backing bars and weld access holes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
