knowledge.titleEn: Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake
knowledge.text: 1994 年 1 月 17 日規模 6.7 的 Northridge 地震後，工程師在多棟鋼造抗彎矩構架建築中發現梁柱焊接接頭脆性斷裂，SEAOC、ATC 與 CUREE 同年組成 SAC 聯合團隊，在 FEMA 與加州緊急服務辦公室資助下研究至 2000 年。常見問題包括：留在原處的背墊板與未熔合根部形成類似裂縫的缺口，焊材韌性不足，焊接扇形孔幾何造成應力集中，以及檢驗難以看到下翼板根部。
knowledge.textEn: After the magnitude 6.7 Northridge earthquake of 17 January 1994, engineers found brittle fractures in welded beam–column joints of many steel moment-frame buildings; SEAOC, ATC and CUREE formed the SAC Joint Venture that year and, funded by FEMA and the California Office of Emergency Services, studied the problem until 2000. Common issues included backing bars left in place with unfused roots acting as crack-like notches, weld metal of low toughness, stress concentrations at weld access holes, and inspection that could hardly see the root of the bottom flange.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Leaving the weld backing bar in place adds strength, so it never needs removing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake" is correct?
options: 留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。
鋼板越厚越安全，所以厚板接頭不需要特別的焊接控制。
1994 年 1 月 17 日規模 6.7 的 Northridge 地震後，工程師在多棟鋼造抗彎矩構架建築中發現梁柱焊接接頭脆性斷裂，SEAOC、ATC 與 CUREE 同年組成 SAC 聯合團隊，在 FEMA 與加州緊急服務辦公室資助下研究至 2000 年。
optionsEn: Leaving the weld backing bar in place adds strength, so it never needs removing.
Thicker plate is always safer, so thick-plate joints need no special welding control.
After the magnitude 6.7 Northridge earthquake of 17 January 1994, engineers found brittle fractures in welded beam–column joints of many steel moment-frame buildings.
quiz.explanation: 1994 年 1 月 17 日規模 6.7 的 Northridge 地震後，工程師在多棟鋼造抗彎矩構架建築中發現梁柱焊接接頭脆性斷裂，SEAOC、ATC 與 CUREE 同年組成 SAC 聯合團隊，在 FEMA 與加州緊急服務辦公室資助下研究至 2000 年。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After the magnitude 6.7 Northridge earthquake of 17 January 1994, engineers found brittle fractures in welded beam–column joints of many steel moment-frame buildings; SEAOC, ATC and CUREE formed the SAC Joint Venture that year and, funded by FEMA and the California Office of Emergency Services, studied the problem until 2000. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背墊板與焊接扇形孔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backing bars and weld access holes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：根部缺口近似邊緣裂縫，K = 1.12σ√(πa)。翼板應力 σ = 300 MPa：未熔合深 a = 1 mm 時 K ≈ 1.12×300×√(π×0.001) ≈ 18.8 MPa√m；a = 5 mm 時 K ≈ 42.1 MPa√m，已接近低韌性焊材在低溫下的斷裂韌性量級。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Treat the root notch as an edge crack, K = 1.12σ√(πa). With flange stress σ = 300 MPa, an unfused depth of a = 1 mm gives K ≈ 1.12×300×√(π×0.001) ≈ 18.8 MPa√m, while a = 5 mm gives K ≈ 42.1 MPa√m, approaching the fracture toughness of low-toughness weld metal at low temperature. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：需求關鍵焊縫的焊材須有規定溫度下的 Charpy 衝擊韌性證明，背墊板移除後以清根、磁粉檢測確認根部無缺陷再補焊；完成後以超音波檢測全長，特別注意下翼板根部與扇形孔周圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Demand-critical welds need filler metal certified for Charpy impact toughness at specified temperatures; after removing the backing bar, back-gouge, confirm a sound root by magnetic particle testing and reweld, then ultrasonically test the full length with special attention to the bottom-flange root and around the access hole.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 根部缺口近似邊緣裂縫，K = 1.12σ√(πa)。翼板應力 σ = 300 MPa：未熔合深 a = 1 mm 時 K ≈ 1.12×300×√(π×0.001) ≈ 18.8 MPa√m；a = 5 mm 時 K ≈ 42.1 MPa√m，已接近低韌性焊材在低溫下的斷裂韌性量級。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Treat the root notch as an edge crack, K = 1.12σ√(πa). With flange stress σ = 300 MPa, an unfused depth of a = 1 mm gives K ≈ 1.12×300×√(π×0.001) ≈ 18.8 MPa√m, while a = 5 mm gives K ≈ 42.1 MPa√m, approaching the fracture toughness of low-toughness weld metal at low temperature. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake", which statement holds?
options: 根部缺口近似邊緣裂縫，K = 1.12σ√(πa)。
焊接順序只影響外觀與變形，不會影響接頭強度。
射線檢測一定比超音波更適合檢驗所有厚板焊縫。
optionsEn: Treat the root notch as an edge crack, K = 1.12σ√(πa).
Weld sequence affects only appearance and distortion, never joint strength.
Radiography is always better than ultrasonics for every thick-plate weld.
quiz.explanation: 根部缺口近似邊緣裂縫，K = 1.12σ√(πa)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Treat the root notch as an edge crack, K = 1.12σ√(πa). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「背墊板與焊接扇形孔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backing bars and weld access holes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 需求關鍵焊縫的焊材須有規定溫度下的 Charpy 衝擊韌性證明，背墊板移除後以清根、磁粉檢測確認根部無缺陷再補焊；完成後以超音波檢測全長，特別注意下翼板根部與扇形孔周圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Demand-critical welds need filler metal certified for Charpy impact toughness at specified temperatures; after removing the backing bar, back-gouge, confirm a sound root by magnetic particle testing and reweld, then ultrasonically test the full length with special attention to the bottom-flange root and around the access hole. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：耐震抗彎矩接頭的細部（扇形孔形狀、背墊板處理、補強填角焊）要採用經試驗驗證的接頭型式，任何現場變更都須經結構工程師核准；地震後的檢查計畫要預先指定拆除被覆的抽查接頭位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Seismic moment-connection details (access-hole shape, backing treatment, reinforcing fillets) must follow test-qualified connection types, and any field change needs the structural engineer's approval; post-earthquake inspection plans should name in advance which joints will have fireproofing removed for checks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：Northridge 後檢查發現，許多斷裂接頭從外觀幾乎看不出異常，必須拆除防火被覆與裝修才看得到裂縫；這說明地震後的鋼構檢查若只做目視巡查，會嚴重低估損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Post-Northridge inspections found that many fractured joints looked almost normal from outside and cracks appeared only after fireproofing and finishes were removed, showing that post-earthquake steel inspections relying on walk-through visual checks badly underestimate damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 需求關鍵焊縫的焊材須有規定溫度下的 Charpy 衝擊韌性證明，背墊板移除後以清根、磁粉檢測確認根部無缺陷再補焊；完成後以超音波檢測全長，特別注意下翼板根部與扇形孔周圍。
knowledge.textEn: Demand-critical welds need filler metal certified for Charpy impact toughness at specified temperatures; after removing the backing bar, back-gouge, confirm a sound root by magnetic particle testing and reweld, then ultrasonically test the full length with special attention to the bottom-flange root and around the access hole.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 耐震抗彎矩接頭的細部（扇形孔形狀、背墊板處理、補強填角焊）要採用經試驗驗證的接頭型式，任何現場變更都須經結構工程師核准；地震後的檢查計畫要預先指定拆除被覆的抽查接頭位置。
knowledge.textEn: Seismic moment-connection details (access-hole shape, backing treatment, reinforcing fillets) must follow test-qualified connection types, and any field change needs the structural engineer's approval; post-earthquake inspection plans should name in advance which joints will have fireproofing removed for checks.

quiz.question: 要驗證「Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
需求關鍵焊縫的焊材須有規定溫度下的 Charpy 衝擊韌性證明，背墊板移除後以清根、磁粉檢測確認根部無缺陷再補焊。
修補焊縫只是把缺陷補起來，品質要求可以比原焊縫寬鬆。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Demand-critical welds need filler metal certified for Charpy impact toughness at specified temperatures.
A repair weld just fills a defect, so it can be held to a looser standard than the original.
quiz.explanation: 需求關鍵焊縫的焊材須有規定溫度下的 Charpy 衝擊韌性證明，背墊板移除後以清根、磁粉檢測確認根部無缺陷再補焊；完成後以超音波檢測全長，特別注意下翼板根部與扇形孔周圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Demand-critical welds need filler metal certified for Charpy impact toughness at specified temperatures; after removing the backing bar, back-gouge, confirm a sound root by magnetic particle testing and reweld, then ultrasonically test the full length with special attention to the bottom-flange root and around the access hole. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背墊板與焊接扇形孔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backing bars and weld access holes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: Northridge 後檢查發現，許多斷裂接頭從外觀幾乎看不出異常，必須拆除防火被覆與裝修才看得到裂縫；這說明地震後的鋼構檢查若只做目視巡查，會嚴重低估損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Post-Northridge inspections found that many fractured joints looked almost normal from outside and cracks appeared only after fireproofing and finishes were removed, showing that post-earthquake steel inspections relying on walk-through visual checks badly underestimate damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：之後的規範要求需求關鍵焊縫使用有韌性保證的焊材、移除背墊板並清根補焊或加填角焊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Later codes required demand-critical welds with toughness-rated filler metal, backing removal with back-gouging and reweld, or a reinforcing fillet.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Leaving the weld backing bar in place adds strength, so it never needs removing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: Northridge 後檢查發現，許多斷裂接頭從外觀幾乎看不出異常，必須拆除防火被覆與裝修才看得到裂縫；這說明地震後的鋼構檢查若只做目視巡查，會嚴重低估損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Post-Northridge inspections found that many fractured joints looked almost normal from outside and cracks appeared only after fireproofing and finishes were removed, showing that post-earthquake steel inspections relying on walk-through visual checks badly underestimate damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼板越厚越安全，所以厚板接頭不需要特別的焊接控制。
Northridge 後檢查發現，許多斷裂接頭從外觀幾乎看不出異常，必須拆除防火被覆與裝修才看得到裂縫；這說明地震後的鋼構檢查若只做目視巡查，會嚴重低估損傷。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Thicker plate is always safer, so thick-plate joints need no special welding control.

Post-Northridge inspections found that many fractured joints looked almost normal from outside and cracks appeared only after fireproofing and finishes were removed, showing that post-earthquake steel inspections relying on walk-through visual checks badly underestimate damage.
quiz.explanation: Northridge 後檢查發現，許多斷裂接頭從外觀幾乎看不出異常，必須拆除防火被覆與裝修才看得到裂縫；這說明地震後的鋼構檢查若只做目視巡查，會嚴重低估損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Post-Northridge inspections found that many fractured joints looked almost normal from outside and cracks appeared only after fireproofing and finishes were removed, showing that post-earthquake steel inspections relying on walk-through visual checks badly underestimate damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「厚板層狀撕裂與氫致冷裂」與「焊接程序與銲工資格」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lamellar tearing and hydrogen cracking in thick plate" and "Welding procedures and welder qualification": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 厚板層狀撕裂與氫致冷裂：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lamellar tearing and hydrogen cracking in thick plate: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「厚板 Z 向性能與預熱」如何影響鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Through-thickness properties and preheat” governs force, deformation or durability in “Welding inspection of major steel joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 巨型接頭常用 50 mm 以上的厚板，焊縫收縮會在板厚方向拉扯母材；若鋼板內有平行於表面的非金屬夾雜，就可能沿夾雜層狀撕裂。另一種危險是氫致冷裂：焊材或潮濕帶入的氫、硬化的熱影響區與高拘束應力同時存在時，裂縫可能在焊後數小時至數天才出現。對策是選用 Z 向性能保證的鋼板、使用低氫焊材並保持乾燥、依碳當量與板厚預熱並控制層間溫度。Alexander L. Kielland 平台事故調查也在相關板件中發現層狀撕裂與冷裂。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「厚板 Z 向性能與預熱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Major joints often use plates thicker than 50 mm, and weld shrinkage pulls the base metal through its thickness; non-metallic inclusions lying parallel to the surface can then cause lamellar tearing. Another danger is hydrogen cold cracking: when hydrogen from consumables or moisture, a hardened heat-affected zone and high restraint stress coincide, cracks may appear hours to days after welding. Remedies are plates with guaranteed through-thickness properties, dry low-hydrogen consumables, preheat chosen by carbon equivalent and thickness, and controlled interpass temperature. The Alexander L. Kielland investigation also found lamellar tearing and cold cracks in the plates involved. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Through-thickness properties and preheat” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：碳當量 CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15。

knowledge.title: 厚板層狀撕裂與氫致冷裂
knowledge.titleEn: Lamellar tearing and hydrogen cracking in thick plate
knowledge.text: 巨型接頭常用 50 mm 以上的厚板，焊縫收縮會在板厚方向拉扯母材；若鋼板內有平行於表面的非金屬夾雜，就可能沿夾雜層狀撕裂。另一種危險是氫致冷裂：焊材或潮濕帶入的氫、硬化的熱影響區與高拘束應力同時存在時，裂縫可能在焊後數小時至數天才出現。
knowledge.textEn: Major joints often use plates thicker than 50 mm, and weld shrinkage pulls the base metal through its thickness; non-metallic inclusions lying parallel to the surface can then cause lamellar tearing. Another danger is hydrogen cold cracking: when hydrogen from consumables or moisture, a hardened heat-affected zone and high restraint stress coincide, cracks may appear hours to days after welding.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼板越厚越安全，所以厚板接頭不需要特別的焊接控制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker plate is always safer, so thick-plate joints need no special welding control. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

鋼板越厚越安全，所以厚板接頭不需要特別的焊接控制。
銲工經驗豐富就可以不按焊接程序施焊。
optionsEn: Major joints often use plates thicker than 50 mm, and weld shrinkage pulls the base metal through its thickness.
Thicker plate is always safer, so thick-plate joints need no special welding control.

quiz.explanationEn: Major joints often use plates thicker than 50 mm, and weld shrinkage pulls the base metal through its thickness; non-metallic inclusions lying parallel to the surface can then cause lamellar tearing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 厚板層狀撕裂與氫致冷裂：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lamellar tearing and hydrogen cracking in thick plate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「厚板 Z 向性能與預熱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Through-thickness properties and preheat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：碳當量 CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15。C 0.16、Mn 1.45、Cr 0.05、Mo 0.02、V 0.05、Ni 0.10、Cu 0.15（%）：CE = 0.16 + 0.242 + 0.024 + 0.017 ≈ 0.44。熱輸入 HI = 60·V·I/(1,000·v)，30 V、300 A、行進速度 300 mm/min：HI = 1.8 kJ/mm；碳當量偏高且板厚大時，需提高預熱並把熱輸入控制在焊接程序範圍內。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Carbon equivalent CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15. With C 0.16, Mn 1.45, Cr 0.05, Mo 0.02, V 0.05, Ni 0.10 and Cu 0.15 (%), CE = 0.16 + 0.242 + 0.024 + 0.017 ≈ 0.44. Heat input HI = 60·V·I/(1,000·v); at 30 V, 300 A and 300 mm/min travel, HI = 1.8 kJ/mm; a high carbon equivalent in thick plate calls for higher preheat, with heat input held inside the procedure range. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對鋼板出廠證明的化學成分、Z 向斷面收縮率與超音波探傷結果，焊前以超音波掃描接頭附近母材找出分層；焊接時以接觸式溫度計或測溫筆在距焊道規定距離處確認預熱與層間溫度，並記錄電流、電壓與行進速度以計算熱輸入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check mill certificates for chemistry, through-thickness reduction of area and ultrasonic plate testing, and scan the base metal near the joint ultrasonically before welding to find laminations; during welding, confirm preheat and interpass temperature with a contact thermometer or temperature crayon at the specified distance from the joint, and log current, voltage and travel speed to compute heat input.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 厚板層狀撕裂與氫致冷裂：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「厚板 Z 向性能與預熱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Through-thickness properties and preheat” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對鋼板出廠證明的化學成分、Z 向斷面收縮率與超音波探傷結果，焊前以超音波掃描接頭附近母材找出分層；焊接時以接觸式溫度計或測溫筆在距焊道規定距離處確認預熱與層間溫度，並記錄電流、電壓與行進速度以計算熱輸入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check mill certificates for chemistry, through-thickness reduction of area and ultrasonic plate testing, and scan the base metal near the joint ultrasonically before welding to find laminations; during welding, confirm preheat and interpass temperature with a contact thermometer or temperature crayon at the specified distance from the joint, and log current, voltage and travel speed to compute heat input. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：厚板接頭的焊接程序要明訂最低預熱、最高層間溫度、熱輸入範圍與焊材烘乾保管要求；對淬火回火等高強度鋼，最終目視與非破壞檢測應在焊後規定的等待時間（例如 48 小時）後進行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Thick-plate procedures must state minimum preheat, maximum interpass temperature, heat-input range and consumable drying and storage; for quenched-and-tempered high-strength steels, final visual inspection and NDT should follow a specified waiting time after welding, such as 48 hours.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在冬季未預熱就焊接厚板，或焊條暴露在潮濕空氣中過久，焊後隔天才在熱影響區出現細微裂縫；若在完工當下就做完非破壞檢測並放行，這些延遲裂縫會被包覆在防火被覆或混凝土內。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Welding thick plate in winter without preheat, or with electrodes left too long in damp air, lets fine cracks appear in the heat-affected zone a day later; if NDT is done immediately and the joint released, these delayed cracks are sealed inside fireproofing or concrete. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objective: 說明「焊接程序規範與程序評定紀錄」如何影響鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “WPS and PQR” governs force, deformation or durability in “Welding inspection of major steel joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 焊接程序規範（WPS）規定製程、焊材、接頭形狀、焊接位置、預熱與熱輸入等變數；它必須是規範預審合格的程序，或以程序評定紀錄（PQR）的試板經拉伸、彎曲與衝擊試驗證明可行。改變重要變數（例如焊材類別、熱輸入範圍或預熱）就需要重新評定。銲工則須以同等或更困難的位置與接頭考試合格，並維持資格有效。檢驗員的第一項工作是確認每一道焊縫都有對應的有效程序，且由合格銲工施焊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「焊接程序規範與程序評定紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A welding procedure specification (WPS) fixes the process, consumable, joint geometry, position, preheat and heat input; it must be prequalified by the code or proven by a procedure qualification record (PQR) whose test plates pass tension, bend and impact tests. Changing an essential variable, such as consumable class, heat-input range or preheat, requires requalification. Welders must pass tests in the same or more difficult positions and joints and keep their qualifications current. The inspector's first task is to confirm that every weld has a valid procedure and is made by a qualified welder. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “WPS and PQR” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：PQR 焊道金屬在 −29°C 要求平均 ≥ 27 J（20 ft·lbf），單一試片不得低於要求值的 2/3 = 18 J。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A PQR weld metal requiring an average of at least 27 J (20 ft·lbf) at −29°C, with no single specimen below two thirds of it, 18 J, gives 34, 29 and 19 J: average (34 + 29 + 19)/3 ≈ 27.3 J ≥ 27 J and minimum 19 J ≥ 18 J, a pass; a minimum of 17 J fails even with a passing average.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「銲工經驗豐富就可以不按焊接程序施焊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An experienced welder does not need to follow the welding procedure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「焊接程序規範與程序評定紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “WPS and PQR”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 焊接程序與銲工資格
knowledge.text: 焊接程序規範（WPS）規定製程、焊材、接頭形狀、焊接位置、預熱與熱輸入等變數；它必須是規範預審合格的程序，或以程序評定紀錄（PQR）的試板經拉伸、彎曲與衝擊試驗證明可行。改變重要變數（例如焊材類別、熱輸入範圍或預熱）就需要重新評定。
knowledge.textEn: A welding procedure specification (WPS) fixes the process, consumable, joint geometry, position, preheat and heat input; it must be prequalified by the code or proven by a procedure qualification record (PQR) whose test plates pass tension, bend and impact tests. Changing an essential variable, such as consumable class, heat-input range or preheat, requires requalification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：銲工經驗豐富就可以不按焊接程序施焊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An experienced welder does not need to follow the welding procedure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「焊接程序與銲工資格」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Welding procedures and welder qualification" is correct?
options: 銲工經驗豐富就可以不按焊接程序施焊。
焊接程序規範（WPS）規定製程、焊材、接頭形狀、焊接位置、預熱與熱輸入等變數。
焊接順序只影響外觀與變形，不會影響接頭強度。
optionsEn: An experienced welder does not need to follow the welding procedure.
A welding procedure specification (WPS) fixes the process, consumable, joint geometry, position, preheat and heat input.
Weld sequence affects only appearance and distortion, never joint strength.
quiz.explanation: 焊接程序規範（WPS）規定製程、焊材、接頭形狀、焊接位置、預熱與熱輸入等變數；它必須是規範預審合格的程序，或以程序評定紀錄（PQR）的試板經拉伸、彎曲與衝擊試驗證明可行。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A welding procedure specification (WPS) fixes the process, consumable, joint geometry, position, preheat and heat input; it must be prequalified by the code or proven by a procedure qualification record (PQR) whose test plates pass tension, bend and impact tests. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 焊接程序與銲工資格：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Welding procedures and welder qualification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「焊接程序規範與程序評定紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “WPS and PQR” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：PQR 焊道金屬在 −29°C 要求平均 ≥ 27 J（20 ft·lbf），單一試片不得低於要求值的 2/3 = 18 J。三支試片 34、29、19 J：平均 (34 + 29 + 19)/3 ≈ 27.3 J ≥ 27 J，最低 19 J ≥ 18 J，合格；若最低為 17 J，即使平均合格仍判不合格。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A PQR weld metal requiring an average of at least 27 J (20 ft·lbf) at −29°C, with no single specimen below two thirds of it, 18 J, gives 34, 29 and 19 J: average (34 + 29 + 19)/3 ≈ 27.3 J ≥ 27 J and minimum 19 J ≥ 18 J, a pass; a minimum of 17 J fails even with a passing average. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：開工前審查每份 WPS 與其 PQR 試驗報告，核對焊材型號、板厚範圍與位置是否涵蓋實際接頭；現場抽查銲工資格證與識別號碼，並比對焊道上的銲工標記與每日焊接紀錄，確認是同一人。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before work starts, review each WPS against its PQR test reports and confirm that consumable, thickness range and positions cover the actual joints; on site, spot-check welder certificates and ID numbers and compare weld stamps with daily welding logs to confirm the same person made the weld.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: PQR 焊道金屬在 −29°C 要求平均 ≥ 27 J（20 ft·lbf），單一試片不得低於要求值的 2/3 = 18 J。三支試片 34、29、19 J：平均 (34 + 29 + 19)/3 ≈ 27.3 J ≥ 27 J，最低 19 J ≥ 18 J，合格；若最低為 17 J，即使平均合格仍判不合格。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A PQR weld metal requiring an average of at least 27 J (20 ft·lbf) at −29°C, with no single specimen below two thirds of it, 18 J, gives 34, 29 and 19 J: average (34 + 29 + 19)/3 ≈ 27.3 J ≥ 27 J and minimum 19 J ≥ 18 J, a pass; a minimum of 17 J fails even with a passing average. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「焊接程序與銲工資格」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Welding procedures and welder qualification", which statement holds?
options: 射線檢測一定比超音波更適合檢驗所有厚板焊縫。
修補焊縫只是把缺陷補起來，品質要求可以比原焊縫寬鬆。
PQR 焊道金屬在 −29°C 要求平均 ≥ 27 J（20 ft·lbf），單一試片不得低於要求值的 2/3 = 18 J。
optionsEn: Radiography is always better than ultrasonics for every thick-plate weld.
A repair weld just fills a defect, so it can be held to a looser standard than the original.

A PQR weld metal requiring an average of at least 27 J (20 ft·lbf) at −29°C, with no single specimen below two thirds of it, 18 J, gives 34, 29 and 19 J: average (34 + 29 + 19)/3 ≈ 27.3 J ≥ 27 J and minimum 19 J ≥ 18 J, a pass.
quiz.explanation: PQR 焊道金屬在 −29°C 要求平均 ≥ 27 J（20 ft·lbf），單一試片不得低於要求值的 2/3 = 18 J。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A PQR weld metal requiring an average of at least 27 J (20 ft·lbf) at −29°C, with no single specimen below two thirds of it, 18 J, gives 34, 29 and 19 J: average (34 + 29 + 19)/3 ≈ 27.3 J ≥ 27 J and minimum 19 J ≥ 18 J, a pass; a minimum of 17 J fails even with a passing average. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 焊接程序與銲工資格：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Welding procedures and welder qualification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「焊接程序規範與程序評定紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “WPS and PQR” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 開工前審查每份 WPS 與其 PQR 試驗報告，核對焊材型號、板厚範圍與位置是否涵蓋實際接頭；現場抽查銲工資格證與識別號碼，並比對焊道上的銲工標記與每日焊接紀錄，確認是同一人。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before work starts, review each WPS against its PQR test reports and confirm that consumable, thickness range and positions cover the actual joints; on site, spot-check welder certificates and ID numbers and compare weld stamps with daily welding logs to confirm the same person made the weld. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每個焊接工作站張貼適用的 WPS 摘要，檢驗員每班至少抽測一次電流、電壓與行進速度；程序任何變更都須重新提送審查，未經核准的變更所做的焊縫一律列為不符合項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Post the applicable WPS summary at every welding station and have the inspector check current, voltage and travel speed at least once per shift; any procedure change must be resubmitted for review, and welds made under an unapproved change are recorded as nonconformances.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了趕工改用較粗焊線或提高電流，熱輸入超出程序範圍，熱影響區韌性下降；若沒有人發現程序已被改變，試驗合格的 PQR 就不再代表實際焊縫的性能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Switching to a larger wire or higher current to save time pushes heat input outside the procedure range and lowers HAZ toughness; if nobody notices the change, the passed PQR no longer represents the actual welds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 開工前審查每份 WPS 與其 PQR 試驗報告，核對焊材型號、板厚範圍與位置是否涵蓋實際接頭；現場抽查銲工資格證與識別號碼，並比對焊道上的銲工標記與每日焊接紀錄，確認是同一人。
knowledge.textEn: Before work starts, review each WPS against its PQR test reports and confirm that consumable, thickness range and positions cover the actual joints; on site, spot-check welder certificates and ID numbers and compare weld stamps with daily welding logs to confirm the same person made the weld.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每個焊接工作站張貼適用的 WPS 摘要，檢驗員每班至少抽測一次電流、電壓與行進速度；程序任何變更都須重新提送審查，未經核准的變更所做的焊縫一律列為不符合項目。
knowledge.textEn: Post the applicable WPS summary at every welding station and have the inspector check current, voltage and travel speed at least once per shift; any procedure change must be resubmitted for review, and welds made under an unapproved change are recorded as nonconformances.

quiz.question: 要驗證「焊接程序與銲工資格」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Welding procedures and welder qualification"?
options: 開工前審查每份 WPS 與其 PQR 試驗報告，核對焊材型號、板厚範圍與位置是否涵蓋實際接頭。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
焊縫外觀平整光滑，就代表內部品質良好。
optionsEn: Before work starts, review each WPS against its PQR test reports and confirm that consumable, thickness range and positions cover the actual joints.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A smooth, even weld surface means the weld is sound inside.
quiz.explanation: 開工前審查每份 WPS 與其 PQR 試驗報告，核對焊材型號、板厚範圍與位置是否涵蓋實際接頭；現場抽查銲工資格證與識別號碼，並比對焊道上的銲工標記與每日焊接紀錄，確認是同一人。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before work starts, review each WPS against its PQR test reports and confirm that consumable, thickness range and positions cover the actual joints; on site, spot-check welder certificates and ID numbers and compare weld stamps with daily welding logs to confirm the same person made the weld. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 焊接程序與銲工資格：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Welding procedures and welder qualification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「焊接程序規範與程序評定紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “WPS and PQR” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了趕工改用較粗焊線或提高電流，熱輸入超出程序範圍，熱影響區韌性下降；若沒有人發現程序已被改變，試驗合格的 PQR 就不再代表實際焊縫的性能。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Switching to a larger wire or higher current to save time pushes heat input outside the procedure range and lowers HAZ toughness; if nobody notices the change, the passed PQR no longer represents the actual welds. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢驗員的第一項工作是確認每一道焊縫都有對應的有效程序，且由合格銲工施焊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The inspector's first task is to confirm that every weld has a valid procedure and is made by a qualified welder.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「銲工經驗豐富就可以不按焊接程序施焊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An experienced welder does not need to follow the welding procedure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了趕工改用較粗焊線或提高電流，熱輸入超出程序範圍，熱影響區韌性下降；若沒有人發現程序已被改變，試驗合格的 PQR 就不再代表實際焊縫的性能。
knowledge.textEn: Switching to a larger wire or higher current to save time pushes heat input outside the procedure range and lowers HAZ toughness; if nobody notices the change, the passed PQR no longer represents the actual welds.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「焊接程序與銲工資格」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Welding procedures and welder qualification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
為了趕工改用較粗焊線或提高電流，熱輸入超出程序範圍，熱影響區韌性下降；若沒有人發現程序已被改變，試驗合格的 PQR 就不再代表實際焊縫的性能。
焊接順序只影響外觀與變形，不會影響接頭強度。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Switching to a larger wire or higher current to save time pushes heat input outside the procedure range and lowers HAZ toughness.
Weld sequence affects only appearance and distortion, never joint strength.
quiz.explanation: 為了趕工改用較粗焊線或提高電流，熱輸入超出程序範圍，熱影響區韌性下降；若沒有人發現程序已被改變，試驗合格的 PQR 就不再代表實際焊縫的性能。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Switching to a larger wire or higher current to save time pushes heat input outside the procedure range and lowers HAZ toughness; if nobody notices the change, the passed PQR no longer represents the actual welds. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「焊接順序、收縮與殘餘應力」與「品管、品保與檢驗停留點」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Weld sequence, shrinkage and residual stress" and "Quality control, quality assurance and hold points": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 焊接順序、收縮與殘餘應力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Weld sequence, shrinkage and residual stress: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「對稱分段焊接順序」如何影響鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Balanced weld sequence” governs force, deformation or durability in “Welding inspection of major steel joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大型全滲透焊冷卻時沿焊道橫向收縮數公釐，若接頭被周圍構件拘束，收縮變成殘餘拉應力，可能造成裂縫或使構件位置偏移。超高層箱型柱的現場續接，每一個接頭的收縮累積起來會影響樓層標高與垂直度；桁架節點多方向焊接時，焊接順序則決定變形方向。因此要以對稱、分段、由拘束大處往拘束小處的順序施焊，並在製造長度中預留收縮補償。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「對稱分段焊接順序」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large CJP welds shrink several millimetres transversely as they cool; if surrounding members restrain the joint, the shrinkage turns into residual tensile stress that can crack the weld or pull members out of position. In supertall box-column field splices the shrinkage of every joint accumulates into floor-level and plumbness errors, and in truss nodes welded from several directions the sequence decides which way the joint distorts. Welds are therefore made symmetrically, in segments, from the most restrained toward the least restrained area, with shrinkage allowances built into fabricated lengths. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Balanced weld sequence” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：對接焊橫向收縮經驗式 S ≈ 0.2·A_w/t + 0.05·d。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An empirical transverse shrinkage for butt welds is S ≈ 0.2·A_w/t + 0.05·d.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「焊接順序只影響外觀與變形，不會影響接頭強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Weld sequence affects only appearance and distortion, never joint strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「對稱分段焊接順序」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Balanced weld sequence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 焊接順序、收縮與殘餘應力
knowledge.titleEn: Weld sequence, shrinkage and residual stress
knowledge.text: 大型全滲透焊冷卻時沿焊道橫向收縮數公釐，若接頭被周圍構件拘束，收縮變成殘餘拉應力，可能造成裂縫或使構件位置偏移。超高層箱型柱的現場續接，每一個接頭的收縮累積起來會影響樓層標高與垂直度；桁架節點多方向焊接時，焊接順序則決定變形方向。
knowledge.textEn: Large CJP welds shrink several millimetres transversely as they cool; if surrounding members restrain the joint, the shrinkage turns into residual tensile stress that can crack the weld or pull members out of position. In supertall box-column field splices the shrinkage of every joint accumulates into floor-level and plumbness errors, and in truss nodes welded from several directions the sequence decides which way the joint distorts.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：焊接順序只影響外觀與變形，不會影響接頭強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Weld sequence affects only appearance and distortion, never joint strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「焊接順序、收縮與殘餘應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Weld sequence, shrinkage and residual stress" is correct?
options: 焊接順序只影響外觀與變形，不會影響接頭強度。
只要完工後的超音波抽驗合格，焊接過程的檢查就可以省略。
大型全滲透焊冷卻時沿焊道橫向收縮數公釐，若接頭被周圍構件拘束，收縮變成殘餘拉應力，可能造成裂縫或使構件位置偏移。
optionsEn: Weld sequence affects only appearance and distortion, never joint strength.
If post-weld ultrasonic sampling passes, in-process inspection can be skipped.
Large CJP welds shrink several millimetres transversely as they cool.
quiz.explanation: 大型全滲透焊冷卻時沿焊道橫向收縮數公釐，若接頭被周圍構件拘束，收縮變成殘餘拉應力，可能造成裂縫或使構件位置偏移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Large CJP welds shrink several millimetres transversely as they cool; if surrounding members restrain the joint, the shrinkage turns into residual tensile stress that can crack the weld or pull members out of position. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 焊接順序、收縮與殘餘應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weld sequence, shrinkage and residual stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「對稱分段焊接順序」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Balanced weld sequence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：對接焊橫向收縮經驗式 S ≈ 0.2·A_w/t + 0.05·d。焊道斷面積 A_w = 1,300 mm²、板厚 t = 60 mm、根部間隙 d = 3 mm：S ≈ 0.2×1,300/60 + 0.05×3 ≈ 4.3 + 0.15 ≈ 4.5 mm。若柱高方向有 20 個續接，累積約 20×4.5 ≈ 90 mm，必須在柱段長度中預留。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An empirical transverse shrinkage for butt welds is S ≈ 0.2·A_w/t + 0.05·d. With weld area A_w = 1,300 mm², plate thickness t = 60 mm and root opening d = 3 mm, S ≈ 0.2×1,300/60 + 0.05×3 ≈ 4.3 + 0.15 ≈ 4.5 mm. Twenty splices up a column add about 20×4.5 ≈ 90 mm, which must be allowed for in segment lengths. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以首件或代表性接頭量測焊前焊後的間隙、長度與垂直度，比較實際收縮與預估值並修正後續補償量；箱型柱續接完成後量測柱頂標高與傾斜，與施工測量控制網比對，偏差超過允許值時停止上層施工並檢討。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure gap, length and plumb before and after welding on a first or representative joint, compare actual shrinkage with the estimate and correct later allowances; after each box-column splice, survey column-top level and tilt against the construction control network, stopping upper work for review if deviations exceed tolerances.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 對接焊橫向收縮經驗式 S ≈ 0.2·A_w/t + 0.05·d。焊道斷面積 A_w = 1,300 mm²、板厚 t = 60 mm、根部間隙 d = 3 mm：S ≈ 0.2×1,300/60 + 0.05×3 ≈ 4.3 + 0.15 ≈ 4.5 mm。若柱高方向有 20 個續接，累積約 20×4.5 ≈ 90 mm，必須在柱段長度中預留。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: An empirical transverse shrinkage for butt welds is S ≈ 0.2·A_w/t + 0.05·d. With weld area A_w = 1,300 mm², plate thickness t = 60 mm and root opening d = 3 mm, S ≈ 0.2×1,300/60 + 0.05×3 ≈ 4.3 + 0.15 ≈ 4.5 mm. Twenty splices up a column add about 20×4.5 ≈ 90 mm, which must be allowed for in segment lengths. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「焊接順序、收縮與殘餘應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Weld sequence, shrinkage and residual stress", which statement holds?
options: 對接焊橫向收縮經驗式 S ≈ 0.2·A_w/t + 0.05·d。
非受力的附屬焊縫品質不重要，不需要檢查。
焊縫檢驗合格後，焊接紀錄就沒有保存價值。
optionsEn: An empirical transverse shrinkage for butt welds is S ≈ 0.2·A_w/t + 0.05·d.
Welds on non-load-bearing attachments do not matter and need no inspection.
Once welds pass inspection, the welding records have no further value.
quiz.explanation: 對接焊橫向收縮經驗式 S ≈ 0.2·A_w/t + 0.05·d。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An empirical transverse shrinkage for butt welds is S ≈ 0.2·A_w/t + 0.05·d. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 焊接順序、收縮與殘餘應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Weld sequence, shrinkage and residual stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「對稱分段焊接順序」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Balanced weld sequence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以首件或代表性接頭量測焊前焊後的間隙、長度與垂直度，比較實際收縮與預估值並修正後續補償量；箱型柱續接完成後量測柱頂標高與傾斜，與施工測量控制網比對，偏差超過允許值時停止上層施工並檢討。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure gap, length and plumb before and after welding on a first or representative joint, compare actual shrinkage with the estimate and correct later allowances; after each box-column splice, survey column-top level and tilt against the construction control network, stopping upper work for review if deviations exceed tolerances. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製造廠應提交焊接順序計畫，標示每一道焊縫的施焊順序、分段長度與銲工配置（例如對邊兩人同時施焊），並由結構工程師審查；現場不得因方便而改變順序，變更須重新核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The fabricator should submit a weld-sequence plan showing the order, segment lengths and welder arrangement for every weld (for example two welders working opposite faces at once), reviewed by the structural engineer; the sequence may not be changed on site for convenience without re-approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若四面箱型柱同時由一側焊完再焊另一側，柱段會向先焊的一側傾斜；拘束很高的節點一次焊滿而不分段，冷卻時在焊根或熱影響區產生橫向裂縫，往往要到超音波檢測才發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Welding one face of a four-sided box column completely before the opposite face tilts the segment toward the first side; filling a highly restrained node in one go without segmenting can crack the root or heat-affected zone transversely on cooling, often found only by ultrasonic testing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以首件或代表性接頭量測焊前焊後的間隙、長度與垂直度，比較實際收縮與預估值並修正後續補償量；箱型柱續接完成後量測柱頂標高與傾斜，與施工測量控制網比對，偏差超過允許值時停止上層施工並檢討。
knowledge.textEn: Measure gap, length and plumb before and after welding on a first or representative joint, compare actual shrinkage with the estimate and correct later allowances; after each box-column splice, survey column-top level and tilt against the construction control network, stopping upper work for review if deviations exceed tolerances.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 製造廠應提交焊接順序計畫，標示每一道焊縫的施焊順序、分段長度與銲工配置（例如對邊兩人同時施焊），並由結構工程師審查；現場不得因方便而改變順序，變更須重新核准。
knowledge.textEn: The fabricator should submit a weld-sequence plan showing the order, segment lengths and welder arrangement for every weld (for example two welders working opposite faces at once), reviewed by the structural engineer; the sequence may not be changed on site for convenience without re-approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「焊接順序、收縮與殘餘應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Weld sequence, shrinkage and residual stress"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以首件或代表性接頭量測焊前焊後的間隙、長度與垂直度，比較實際收縮與預估值並修正後續補償量。
留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure gap, length and plumb before and after welding on a first or representative joint, compare actual shrinkage with the estimate and correct later allowances.
Leaving the weld backing bar in place adds strength, so it never needs removing.
quiz.explanation: 以首件或代表性接頭量測焊前焊後的間隙、長度與垂直度，比較實際收縮與預估值並修正後續補償量；箱型柱續接完成後量測柱頂標高與傾斜，與施工測量控制網比對，偏差超過允許值時停止上層施工並檢討。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure gap, length and plumb before and after welding on a first or representative joint, compare actual shrinkage with the estimate and correct later allowances; after each box-column splice, survey column-top level and tilt against the construction control network, stopping upper work for review if deviations exceed tolerances. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 焊接順序、收縮與殘餘應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Weld sequence, shrinkage and residual stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「對稱分段焊接順序」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Balanced weld sequence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若四面箱型柱同時由一側焊完再焊另一側，柱段會向先焊的一側傾斜；拘束很高的節點一次焊滿而不分段，冷卻時在焊根或熱影響區產生橫向裂縫，往往要到超音波檢測才發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Welding one face of a four-sided box column completely before the opposite face tilts the segment toward the first side; filling a highly restrained node in one go without segmenting can crack the root or heat-affected zone transversely on cooling, often found only by ultrasonic testing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此要以對稱、分段、由拘束大處往拘束小處的順序施焊，並在製造長度中預留收縮補償。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Welds are therefore made symmetrically, in segments, from the most restrained toward the least restrained area, with shrinkage allowances built into fabricated lengths.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「焊接順序只影響外觀與變形，不會影響接頭強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Weld sequence affects only appearance and distortion, never joint strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若四面箱型柱同時由一側焊完再焊另一側，柱段會向先焊的一側傾斜；拘束很高的節點一次焊滿而不分段，冷卻時在焊根或熱影響區產生橫向裂縫，往往要到超音波檢測才發現。
knowledge.textEn: Welding one face of a four-sided box column completely before the opposite face tilts the segment toward the first side; filling a highly restrained node in one go without segmenting can crack the root or heat-affected zone transversely on cooling, often found only by ultrasonic testing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「焊接順序、收縮與殘餘應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Weld sequence, shrinkage and residual stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要完工後的超音波抽驗合格，焊接過程的檢查就可以省略。
若四面箱型柱同時由一側焊完再焊另一側，柱段會向先焊的一側傾斜；拘束很高的節點一次焊滿而不分段，冷卻時在焊根或熱影響區產生橫向裂縫，往往要到超音波檢測才發現。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If post-weld ultrasonic sampling passes, in-process inspection can be skipped.
Welding one face of a four-sided box column completely before the opposite face tilts the segment toward the first side.
quiz.explanation: 若四面箱型柱同時由一側焊完再焊另一側，柱段會向先焊的一側傾斜；拘束很高的節點一次焊滿而不分段，冷卻時在焊根或熱影響區產生橫向裂縫，往往要到超音波檢測才發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Welding one face of a four-sided box column completely before the opposite face tilts the segment toward the first side; filling a highly restrained node in one go without segmenting can crack the root or heat-affected zone transversely on cooling, often found only by ultrasonic testing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 品管、品保與檢驗停留點：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Quality control, quality assurance and hold points: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「焊前、焊中與焊後檢查點」如何影響鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Before, during and after-weld checks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Welding inspection of major steel joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 焊接品質主要在焊接過程中決定，完工後的非破壞檢測只能抽查結果。製造廠的品管人員負責焊前組立間隙、坡口角度、清潔與預熱，焊中逐層檢查與清根，焊後外觀與尺寸；業主委託的品保人員則獨立觀察與抽驗。2005 年舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段工程的焊接品質遭前銲工與檢驗員指控後，FHWA 委託民間檢驗單位切取鋼塊做實驗室分析，報告三塊試件的焊道符合或超過規範，這種獨立驗證正是品保的角色。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「焊前、焊中與焊後檢查點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Weld quality is decided mainly during welding; NDT after completion only samples the result. The fabricator's quality-control staff check fit-up gap, bevel angle, cleanliness and preheat before welding, each pass and back-gouging during welding, and appearance and size afterwards, while the owner's quality-assurance staff observe and sample independently. In 2005, after former welders and inspectors alleged poor welding on the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge East Span project, FHWA had private inspectors cut sections for laboratory analysis and reported that welds from three pieces met or exceeded specifications, an example of exactly this kind of independent assurance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Before, during and after-weld checks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：某批 400 道全滲透焊，抽驗 10% 即 40 道超音波，發現 3 道拒收：拒收率 3/40 = 7.5%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In a lot of 400 CJP welds, a 10% sample of 40 is ultrasonically tested and 3 are rejected: a reject rate of 3/40 = 7.5%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要完工後的超音波抽驗合格，焊接過程的檢查就可以省略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If post-weld ultrasonic sampling passes, in-process inspection can be skipped." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「焊前、焊中與焊後檢查點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Before, during and after-weld checks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 品管、品保與檢驗停留點
knowledge.titleEn: Quality control, quality assurance and hold points
knowledge.text: 焊接品質主要在焊接過程中決定，完工後的非破壞檢測只能抽查結果。製造廠的品管人員負責焊前組立間隙、坡口角度、清潔與預熱，焊中逐層檢查與清根，焊後外觀與尺寸；業主委託的品保人員則獨立觀察與抽驗。
knowledge.textEn: Weld quality is decided mainly during welding; NDT after completion only samples the result. The fabricator's quality-control staff check fit-up gap, bevel angle, cleanliness and preheat before welding, each pass and back-gouging during welding, and appearance and size afterwards, while the owner's quality-assurance staff observe and sample independently.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要完工後的超音波抽驗合格，焊接過程的檢查就可以省略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If post-weld ultrasonic sampling passes, in-process inspection can be skipped. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「品管、品保與檢驗停留點」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Quality control, quality assurance and hold points" is correct?
options: 焊接品質主要在焊接過程中決定，完工後的非破壞檢測只能抽查結果。
只要完工後的超音波抽驗合格，焊接過程的檢查就可以省略。
射線檢測一定比超音波更適合檢驗所有厚板焊縫。
optionsEn: Weld quality is decided mainly during welding; NDT after completion only samples the result.
If post-weld ultrasonic sampling passes, in-process inspection can be skipped.
Radiography is always better than ultrasonics for every thick-plate weld.
quiz.explanation: 焊接品質主要在焊接過程中決定，完工後的非破壞檢測只能抽查結果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Weld quality is decided mainly during welding; NDT after completion only samples the result. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 品管、品保與檢驗停留點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Quality control, quality assurance and hold points: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「焊前、焊中與焊後檢查點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Before, during and after-weld checks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某批 400 道全滲透焊，抽驗 10% 即 40 道超音波，發現 3 道拒收：拒收率 3/40 = 7.5%。若規格規定拒收率超過 5% 時改為 100% 檢測，其餘 360 道須全部補驗；若只有 1 道拒收（2.5%），可維持抽驗比例。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In a lot of 400 CJP welds, a 10% sample of 40 is ultrasonically tested and 3 are rejected: a reject rate of 3/40 = 7.5%. If the specification switches to 100% testing above 5%, the remaining 360 welds must all be tested; with only 1 rejection (2.5%) the sampling rate could stay. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以檢驗計畫表列出每類焊縫的觀察項目（組立、預熱、清根、外觀）與頻率，並設置停留點：例如清根後須經檢驗員確認才能繼續、全部檢驗合格前不得塗裝或包覆；每個停留點以簽名與時間記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Tabulate in the inspection plan the observation items (fit-up, preheat, back-gouge, appearance) and frequency for each weld class, and set hold points such as inspector release after back-gouging before welding continues, and no painting or encasement before all tests pass; record each hold point with signature and time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 某批 400 道全滲透焊，抽驗 10% 即 40 道超音波，發現 3 道拒收：拒收率 3/40 = 7.5%。若規格規定拒收率超過 5% 時改為 100% 檢測，其餘 360 道須全部補驗；若只有 1 道拒收（2.5%），可維持抽驗比例。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: In a lot of 400 CJP welds, a 10% sample of 40 is ultrasonically tested and 3 are rejected: a reject rate of 3/40 = 7.5%. If the specification switches to 100% testing above 5%, the remaining 360 welds must all be tested; with only 1 rejection (2.5%) the sampling rate could stay. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「品管、品保與檢驗停留點」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Quality control, quality assurance and hold points", which statement holds?
options: 修補焊縫只是把缺陷補起來，品質要求可以比原焊縫寬鬆。
某批 400 道全滲透焊，抽驗 10% 即 40 道超音波，發現 3 道拒收：拒收率 3/40 = 7.5%。
焊縫外觀平整光滑，就代表內部品質良好。
optionsEn: A repair weld just fills a defect, so it can be held to a looser standard than the original.
In a lot of 400 CJP welds, a 10% sample of 40 is ultrasonically tested and 3 are rejected: a reject rate of 3/40 = 7.5%.
A smooth, even weld surface means the weld is sound inside.
quiz.explanation: 某批 400 道全滲透焊，抽驗 10% 即 40 道超音波，發現 3 道拒收：拒收率 3/40 = 7.5%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: In a lot of 400 CJP welds, a 10% sample of 40 is ultrasonically tested and 3 are rejected: a reject rate of 3/40 = 7.5%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 品管、品保與檢驗停留點：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Quality control, quality assurance and hold points: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「焊前、焊中與焊後檢查點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Before, during and after-weld checks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以檢驗計畫表列出每類焊縫的觀察項目（組立、預熱、清根、外觀）與頻率，並設置停留點：例如清根後須經檢驗員確認才能繼續、全部檢驗合格前不得塗裝或包覆；每個停留點以簽名與時間記錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Tabulate in the inspection plan the observation items (fit-up, preheat, back-gouge, appearance) and frequency for each weld class, and set hold points such as inspector release after back-gouging before welding continues, and no painting or encasement before all tests pass; record each hold point with signature and time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：品保檢驗員應由業主直接委託並獨立於製造廠，擁有停工權；檢驗計畫明訂抽驗比例與拒收率升級規則，所有拒收焊縫都追溯到銲工與班次，作為擴大檢驗的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Quality-assurance inspectors should be hired directly by the owner, independent of the fabricator and empowered to stop work; the inspection plan fixes sampling rates and escalation rules on reject rates, and every rejected weld is traced to its welder and shift as the basis for expanded testing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若品管與品保由同一單位擔任，或品保人員只看報告不到現場，焊工趕工時省略清根或預熱也不會被發現；之後即使超音波抽驗合格，也只代表被抽到的焊縫，而非整批品質。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If one party performs both quality control and quality assurance, or assurance staff read reports without visiting the shop, a hurried welder skipping back-gouging or preheat goes unnoticed; a passing ultrasonic sample then represents only the welds sampled, not the lot. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以檢驗計畫表列出每類焊縫的觀察項目（組立、預熱、清根、外觀）與頻率，並設置停留點：例如清根後須經檢驗員確認才能繼續、全部檢驗合格前不得塗裝或包覆；每個停留點以簽名與時間記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Tabulate in the inspection plan the observation items (fit-up, preheat, back-gouge, appearance) and frequency for each weld class, and set hold points such as inspector release after back-gouging before welding continues, and no painting or encasement before all tests pass; record each hold point with signature and time.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 品保檢驗員應由業主直接委託並獨立於製造廠，擁有停工權；檢驗計畫明訂抽驗比例與拒收率升級規則，所有拒收焊縫都追溯到銲工與班次，作為擴大檢驗的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Quality-assurance inspectors should be hired directly by the owner, independent of the fabricator and empowered to stop work; the inspection plan fixes sampling rates and escalation rules on reject rates, and every rejected weld is traced to its welder and shift as the basis for expanded testing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「品管、品保與檢驗停留點」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Quality control, quality assurance and hold points"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
鋼板越厚越安全，所以厚板接頭不需要特別的焊接控制。
以檢驗計畫表列出每類焊縫的觀察項目（組立、預熱、清根、外觀）與頻率，並設置停留點：例如清根後須經檢驗員確認才能繼續、全部檢驗合格前不得塗裝或包覆。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Thicker plate is always safer, so thick-plate joints need no special welding control.

Tabulate in the inspection plan the observation items (fit-up, preheat, back-gouge, appearance) and frequency for each weld class, and set hold points such as inspector release after back-gouging before welding continues, and no painting or encasement before all tests pass.
quiz.explanation: 以檢驗計畫表列出每類焊縫的觀察項目（組立、預熱、清根、外觀）與頻率，並設置停留點：例如清根後須經檢驗員確認才能繼續、全部檢驗合格前不得塗裝或包覆；每個停留點以簽名與時間記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Tabulate in the inspection plan the observation items (fit-up, preheat, back-gouge, appearance) and frequency for each weld class, and set hold points such as inspector release after back-gouging before welding continues, and no painting or encasement before all tests pass; record each hold point with signature and time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 品管、品保與檢驗停留點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Quality control, quality assurance and hold points: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「焊前、焊中與焊後檢查點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Before, during and after-weld checks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若品管與品保由同一單位擔任，或品保人員只看報告不到現場，焊工趕工時省略清根或預熱也不會被發現；之後即使超音波抽驗合格，也只代表被抽到的焊縫，而非整批品質。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If one party performs both quality control and quality assurance, or assurance staff read reports without visiting the shop, a hurried welder skipping back-gouging or preheat goes unnoticed; a passing ultrasonic sample then represents only the welds sampled, not the lot. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：2005 年舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段工程的焊接品質遭前銲工與檢驗員指控後，FHWA 委託民間檢驗單位切取鋼塊做實驗室分析，報告三塊試件的焊道符合或超過規範，這種獨立驗證正是品保的角色。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In 2005, after former welders and inspectors alleged poor welding on the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge East Span project, FHWA had private inspectors cut sections for laboratory analysis and reported that welds from three pieces met or exceeded specifications, an example of exactly this kind of independent assurance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要完工後的超音波抽驗合格，焊接過程的檢查就可以省略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If post-weld ultrasonic sampling passes, in-process inspection can be skipped." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若品管與品保由同一單位擔任，或品保人員只看報告不到現場，焊工趕工時省略清根或預熱也不會被發現；之後即使超音波抽驗合格，也只代表被抽到的焊縫，而非整批品質。
knowledge.textEn: If one party performs both quality control and quality assurance, or assurance staff read reports without visiting the shop, a hurried welder skipping back-gouging or preheat goes unnoticed; a passing ultrasonic sample then represents only the welds sampled, not the lot.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「品管、品保與檢驗停留點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Quality control, quality assurance and hold points" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若品管與品保由同一單位擔任，或品保人員只看報告不到現場，焊工趕工時省略清根或預熱也不會被發現；之後即使超音波抽驗合格，也只代表被抽到的焊縫，而非整批品質。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
射線檢測一定比超音波更適合檢驗所有厚板焊縫。
optionsEn: If one party performs both quality control and quality assurance, or assurance staff read reports without visiting the shop, a hurried welder skipping back-gouging or preheat goes unnoticed.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Radiography is always better than ultrasonics for every thick-plate weld.
quiz.explanation: 若品管與品保由同一單位擔任，或品保人員只看報告不到現場，焊工趕工時省略清根或預熱也不會被發現；之後即使超音波抽驗合格，也只代表被抽到的焊縫，而非整批品質。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If one party performs both quality control and quality assurance, or assurance staff read reports without visiting the shop, a hurried welder skipping back-gouging or preheat goes unnoticed; a passing ultrasonic sample then represents only the welds sampled, not the lot. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「超音波與相位陣列檢測」與「目視與尺寸檢查」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ultrasonic and phased-array testing" and "Visual and dimensional inspection": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 超音波與相位陣列檢測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Ultrasonic and phased-array testing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「超音波斜角探頭掃描」如何影響鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Angle-beam ultrasonic scanning” governs force, deformation or durability in “Welding inspection of major steel joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 厚板全滲透焊與 T 型接頭的內部缺陷主要靠超音波檢測：斜角探頭把聲波以固定折射角送入鋼板，遇到未熔合、夾渣或裂縫就反射回來，由聲程與角度換算缺陷深度與位置，再以參考靈敏度判定是否拒收。相位陣列超音波（PAUT）以多個晶片電子控制聲束角度，一次掃描就得到斷面影像，並可留下可重新檢視的數位紀錄。焊前也要掃描母材找出可能導致層狀撕裂的分層。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「超音波斜角探頭掃描」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Internal flaws in thick-plate CJP welds and T-joints are found mainly by ultrasonic testing: an angle-beam probe sends sound into the plate at a fixed refracted angle, lack of fusion, slag or cracks reflect it back, and sound path and angle locate the flaw's depth and position, judged against reference sensitivity for rejection. Phased-array ultrasonics (PAUT) steer the beam electronically with many elements, producing a cross-sectional image in one scan and a digital record that can be reviewed later. Base metal near the joint is also scanned before welding to find laminations that could lead to lamellar tearing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Angle-beam ultrasonic scanning” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：斜角探頭 θ = 70°，聲程 S = 60 mm 時缺陷深度 d = S·cosθ = 60×0.342 ≈ 20.5 mm，表面距離 = S·sinθ ≈ 56.4 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For an angle-beam probe at θ = 70° and a sound path S = 60 mm, flaw depth d = S·cosθ = 60×0.342 ≈ 20.5 mm and surface distance S·sinθ ≈ 56.4 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「射線檢測一定比超音波更適合檢驗所有厚板焊縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Radiography is always better than ultrasonics for every thick-plate weld." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「超音波斜角探頭掃描」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Angle-beam ultrasonic scanning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 超音波與相位陣列檢測
knowledge.text: 厚板全滲透焊與 T 型接頭的內部缺陷主要靠超音波檢測：斜角探頭把聲波以固定折射角送入鋼板，遇到未熔合、夾渣或裂縫就反射回來，由聲程與角度換算缺陷深度與位置，再以參考靈敏度判定是否拒收。相位陣列超音波（PAUT）以多個晶片電子控制聲束角度，一次掃描就得到斷面影像，並可留下可重新檢視的數位紀錄。

Phased-array ultrasonics (PAUT) steer the beam electronically with many elements, producing a cross-sectional image in one scan and a digital record that can be reviewed later.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：射線檢測一定比超音波更適合檢驗所有厚板焊縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Radiography is always better than ultrasonics for every thick-plate weld. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「超音波與相位陣列檢測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ultrasonic and phased-array testing" is correct?
options: 射線檢測一定比超音波更適合檢驗所有厚板焊縫。
厚板全滲透焊與 T 型接頭的內部缺陷主要靠超音波檢測：斜角探頭把聲波以固定折射角送入鋼板，遇到未熔合、夾渣或裂縫就反射回來，由聲程與角度換算缺陷深度與位置，再以參考靈敏度判定是否拒收。
非受力的附屬焊縫品質不重要，不需要檢查。
optionsEn: Radiography is always better than ultrasonics for every thick-plate weld.

Internal flaws in thick-plate CJP welds and T-joints are found mainly by ultrasonic testing: an angle-beam probe sends sound into the plate at a fixed refracted angle, lack of fusion, slag or cracks reflect it back, and sound path and angle locate the flaw's depth and position, judged against reference sensitivity for rejection.
Welds on non-load-bearing attachments do not matter and need no inspection.
