quiz.explanationEn: Internal flaws in thick-plate CJP welds and T-joints are found mainly by ultrasonic testing: an angle-beam probe sends sound into the plate at a fixed refracted angle, lack of fusion, slag or cracks reflect it back, and sound path and angle locate the flaw's depth and position, judged against reference sensitivity for rejection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 超音波與相位陣列檢測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ultrasonic and phased-array testing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超音波斜角探頭掃描」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Angle-beam ultrasonic scanning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：斜角探頭 θ = 70°，聲程 S = 60 mm 時缺陷深度 d = S·cosθ = 60×0.342 ≈ 20.5 mm，表面距離 = S·sinθ ≈ 56.4 mm。60 mm 厚板第一跨（聲波到底面）的聲程 = t/cosθ = 60/0.342 ≈ 175 mm，掃描範圍須依此規劃。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For an angle-beam probe at θ = 70° and a sound path S = 60 mm, flaw depth d = S·cosθ = 60×0.342 ≈ 20.5 mm and surface distance S·sinθ ≈ 56.4 mm. In a 60 mm plate the first leg to the back wall needs a sound path of t/cosθ = 60/0.342 ≈ 175 mm, which sets the scan range. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢測前以標準規塊校正時基、折射角與參考靈敏度，並以含人工缺陷的對比試塊確認能偵測規定尺寸；掃描須從兩側、多個角度涵蓋整個焊道與熱影響區，記錄每個指示的位置、長度與評級，並由具資格的檢測員簽署。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before testing, calibrate time base, refracted angle and reference sensitivity on standard blocks and confirm on a mock-up with artificial flaws that the required size can be detected; scan from both sides and at several angles to cover the whole weld and heat-affected zone, record position, length and rating of every indication and have a qualified technician sign.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 斜角探頭 θ = 70°，聲程 S = 60 mm 時缺陷深度 d = S·cosθ = 60×0.342 ≈ 20.5 mm，表面距離 = S·sinθ ≈ 56.4 mm。60 mm 厚板第一跨（聲波到底面）的聲程 = t/cosθ = 60/0.342 ≈ 175 mm，掃描範圍須依此規劃。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For an angle-beam probe at θ = 70° and a sound path S = 60 mm, flaw depth d = S·cosθ = 60×0.342 ≈ 20.5 mm and surface distance S·sinθ ≈ 56.4 mm. In a 60 mm plate the first leg to the back wall needs a sound path of t/cosθ = 60/0.342 ≈ 175 mm, which sets the scan range. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「超音波與相位陣列檢測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ultrasonic and phased-array testing", which statement holds?
options: 焊縫檢驗合格後，焊接紀錄就沒有保存價值。
留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。
斜角探頭 θ = 70°，聲程 S = 60 mm 時缺陷深度 d = S·cosθ = 60×0.342 ≈ 20.5 mm，表面距離 = S·sinθ ≈ 56.4 mm。
optionsEn: Once welds pass inspection, the welding records have no further value.
Leaving the weld backing bar in place adds strength, so it never needs removing.
For an angle-beam probe at θ = 70° and a sound path S = 60 mm, flaw depth d = S·cosθ = 60×0.342 ≈ 20.5 mm and surface distance S·sinθ ≈ 56.4 mm.
quiz.explanation: 斜角探頭 θ = 70°，聲程 S = 60 mm 時缺陷深度 d = S·cosθ = 60×0.342 ≈ 20.5 mm，表面距離 = S·sinθ ≈ 56.4 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For an angle-beam probe at θ = 70° and a sound path S = 60 mm, flaw depth d = S·cosθ = 60×0.342 ≈ 20.5 mm and surface distance S·sinθ ≈ 56.4 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超音波與相位陣列檢測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ultrasonic and phased-array testing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「超音波斜角探頭掃描」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Angle-beam ultrasonic scanning” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢測前以標準規塊校正時基、折射角與參考靈敏度，並以含人工缺陷的對比試塊確認能偵測規定尺寸；掃描須從兩側、多個角度涵蓋整個焊道與熱影響區，記錄每個指示的位置、長度與評級，並由具資格的檢測員簽署。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before testing, calibrate time base, refracted angle and reference sensitivity on standard blocks and confirm on a mock-up with artificial flaws that the required size can be detected; scan from both sides and at several angles to cover the whole weld and heat-affected zone, record position, length and rating of every indication and have a qualified technician sign. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢測程序書要指定探頭角度、掃描路徑、校正試塊與允收標準，相位陣列檢測的原始資料檔須保存並交給業主；檢測員資格（例如 ASNT 或 ISO 9712 二級以上）與檢測時間須記錄在報告中。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The procedure must specify probe angles, scan paths, calibration blocks and acceptance criteria, and raw PAUT data files must be kept and delivered to the owner; technician qualification (for example ASNT or ISO 9712 Level II or higher) and test timing go into the report.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只從一側以單一角度掃描，平行於聲束的平面型未熔合可能完全不反射而被漏判；耦合劑不足或表面有焊濺物，也會使靈敏度下降，讓應拒收的缺陷看起來可以接受。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Scanning from one side at a single angle can miss a planar lack-of-fusion flaw lying parallel to the beam, which returns no echo; poor couplant or weld spatter on the surface lowers sensitivity so that a rejectable flaw looks acceptable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Before testing, calibrate time base, refracted angle and reference sensitivity on standard blocks and confirm on a mock-up with artificial flaws that the required size can be detected; scan from both sides and at several angles to cover the whole weld and heat-affected zone, record position, length and rating of every indication and have a qualified technician sign.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 檢測程序書要指定探頭角度、掃描路徑、校正試塊與允收標準，相位陣列檢測的原始資料檔須保存並交給業主；檢測員資格（例如 ASNT 或 ISO 9712 二級以上）與檢測時間須記錄在報告中。
knowledge.textEn: The procedure must specify probe angles, scan paths, calibration blocks and acceptance criteria, and raw PAUT data files must be kept and delivered to the owner; technician qualification (for example ASNT or ISO 9712 Level II or higher) and test timing go into the report.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超音波與相位陣列檢測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ultrasonic and phased-array testing"?
options: 檢測前以標準規塊校正時基、折射角與參考靈敏度，並以含人工缺陷的對比試塊確認能偵測規定尺寸。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
銲工經驗豐富就可以不按焊接程序施焊。
optionsEn: Before testing, calibrate time base, refracted angle and reference sensitivity on standard blocks and confirm on a mock-up with artificial flaws that the required size can be detected.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An experienced welder does not need to follow the welding procedure.
quiz.explanation: 檢測前以標準規塊校正時基、折射角與參考靈敏度，並以含人工缺陷的對比試塊確認能偵測規定尺寸；掃描須從兩側、多個角度涵蓋整個焊道與熱影響區，記錄每個指示的位置、長度與評級，並由具資格的檢測員簽署。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before testing, calibrate time base, refracted angle and reference sensitivity on standard blocks and confirm on a mock-up with artificial flaws that the required size can be detected; scan from both sides and at several angles to cover the whole weld and heat-affected zone, record position, length and rating of every indication and have a qualified technician sign. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 超音波與相位陣列檢測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ultrasonic and phased-array testing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「超音波斜角探頭掃描」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Angle-beam ultrasonic scanning” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只從一側以單一角度掃描，平行於聲束的平面型未熔合可能完全不反射而被漏判；耦合劑不足或表面有焊濺物，也會使靈敏度下降，讓應拒收的缺陷看起來可以接受。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Scanning from one side at a single angle can miss a planar lack-of-fusion flaw lying parallel to the beam, which returns no echo; poor couplant or weld spatter on the surface lowers sensitivity so that a rejectable flaw looks acceptable. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：焊前也要掃描母材找出可能導致層狀撕裂的分層。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Base metal near the joint is also scanned before welding to find laminations that could lead to lamellar tearing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「射線檢測一定比超音波更適合檢驗所有厚板焊縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Radiography is always better than ultrasonics for every thick-plate weld." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只從一側以單一角度掃描，平行於聲束的平面型未熔合可能完全不反射而被漏判；耦合劑不足或表面有焊濺物，也會使靈敏度下降，讓應拒收的缺陷看起來可以接受。
knowledge.textEn: Scanning from one side at a single angle can miss a planar lack-of-fusion flaw lying parallel to the beam, which returns no echo; poor couplant or weld spatter on the surface lowers sensitivity so that a rejectable flaw looks acceptable.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超音波與相位陣列檢測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ultrasonic and phased-array testing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只從一側以單一角度掃描，平行於聲束的平面型未熔合可能完全不反射而被漏判；耦合劑不足或表面有焊濺物，也會使靈敏度下降，讓應拒收的缺陷看起來可以接受。
非受力的附屬焊縫品質不重要，不需要檢查。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Scanning from one side at a single angle can miss a planar lack-of-fusion flaw lying parallel to the beam, which returns no echo.
Welds on non-load-bearing attachments do not matter and need no inspection.
quiz.explanation: 若只從一側以單一角度掃描，平行於聲束的平面型未熔合可能完全不反射而被漏判；耦合劑不足或表面有焊濺物，也會使靈敏度下降，讓應拒收的缺陷看起來可以接受。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scanning from one side at a single angle can miss a planar lack-of-fusion flaw lying parallel to the beam, which returns no echo; poor couplant or weld spatter on the surface lowers sensitivity so that a rejectable flaw looks acceptable. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 目視與尺寸檢查：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Visual and dimensional inspection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「填角焊腳長量規」如何影響鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fillet-weld size gauge” governs force, deformation or durability in “Welding inspection of major steel joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 目視檢查是最基本也最常被輕視的焊接檢驗：焊腳尺寸、喉厚、餘高、咬邊、焊瘤、表面氣孔與弧坑裂縫，都可以用量規、放大鏡與良好照明找出來。巨型接頭中大量的填角焊承受剪力，尺寸不足會直接降低強度；咬邊與焊瘤則在焊趾形成缺口，降低疲勞強度。Kielland 平台的 6 mm 填角焊因焊道輪廓不良而降低疲勞強度，說明非主要受力的附屬焊縫也必須被檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「填角焊腳長量規」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Visual inspection is the most basic and most often underrated weld check: leg size, throat, reinforcement, undercut, overlap, surface porosity and crater cracks can all be found with gauges, a magnifier and good lighting. Major joints contain many fillet welds carrying shear, and undersize directly reduces strength; undercut and overlap notch the weld toe and cut fatigue strength. On the Kielland platform a 6 mm fillet weld with a poor profile had reduced fatigue strength, showing that welds on non-load-bearing attachments must be inspected too. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fillet-weld size gauge” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：填角焊有效喉厚 a = 0.707·s，每 mm 強度 φR = 0.75×0.6×F_EXX×a。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Fillet-weld effective throat a = 0.707·s and strength per mm φR = 0.75×0.6×F_EXX×a.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「非受力的附屬焊縫品質不重要，不需要檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Welds on non-load-bearing attachments do not matter and need no inspection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「填角焊腳長量規」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fillet-weld size gauge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 目視與尺寸檢查
knowledge.text: 目視檢查是最基本也最常被輕視的焊接檢驗：焊腳尺寸、喉厚、餘高、咬邊、焊瘤、表面氣孔與弧坑裂縫，都可以用量規、放大鏡與良好照明找出來。巨型接頭中大量的填角焊承受剪力，尺寸不足會直接降低強度；咬邊與焊瘤則在焊趾形成缺口，降低疲勞強度。
knowledge.textEn: Visual inspection is the most basic and most often underrated weld check: leg size, throat, reinforcement, undercut, overlap, surface porosity and crater cracks can all be found with gauges, a magnifier and good lighting. Major joints contain many fillet welds carrying shear, and undersize directly reduces strength; undercut and overlap notch the weld toe and cut fatigue strength.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：非受力的附屬焊縫品質不重要，不需要檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Welds on non-load-bearing attachments do not matter and need no inspection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「目視與尺寸檢查」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Visual and dimensional inspection" is correct?
options: 非受力的附屬焊縫品質不重要，不需要檢查。
修補焊縫只是把缺陷補起來，品質要求可以比原焊縫寬鬆。
目視檢查是最基本也最常被輕視的焊接檢驗：焊腳尺寸、喉厚、餘高、咬邊、焊瘤、表面氣孔與弧坑裂縫，都可以用量規、放大鏡與良好照明找出來。
optionsEn: Welds on non-load-bearing attachments do not matter and need no inspection.
A repair weld just fills a defect, so it can be held to a looser standard than the original.

Visual inspection is the most basic and most often underrated weld check: leg size, throat, reinforcement, undercut, overlap, surface porosity and crater cracks can all be found with gauges, a magnifier and good lighting.
quiz.explanation: 目視檢查是最基本也最常被輕視的焊接檢驗：焊腳尺寸、喉厚、餘高、咬邊、焊瘤、表面氣孔與弧坑裂縫，都可以用量規、放大鏡與良好照明找出來。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Visual inspection is the most basic and most often underrated weld check: leg size, throat, reinforcement, undercut, overlap, surface porosity and crater cracks can all be found with gauges, a magnifier and good lighting. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 目視與尺寸檢查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Visual and dimensional inspection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「填角焊腳長量規」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fillet-weld size gauge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：填角焊有效喉厚 a = 0.707·s，每 mm 強度 φR = 0.75×0.6×F_EXX×a。F_EXX = 490 MPa：s = 12 mm 時 a = 8.48 mm，φR ≈ 0.75×0.6×490×8.48 ≈ 1,871 N/mm；若實際只有 10 mm，a = 7.07 mm，φR ≈ 1,559 N/mm，強度少約 17%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fillet-weld effective throat a = 0.707·s and strength per mm φR = 0.75×0.6×F_EXX×a. With F_EXX = 490 MPa, a 12 mm weld has a = 8.48 mm and φR ≈ 0.75×0.6×490×8.48 ≈ 1,871 N/mm; an actual 10 mm weld has a = 7.07 mm and φR ≈ 1,559 N/mm, about 17% weaker. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以焊腳量規沿焊道等間距量測尺寸，記錄不足處的長度與位置，並依規範允許的局部不足長度判定；咬邊深度以深度規量測，焊趾輪廓不良處以磁粉檢查是否有裂縫；淬火回火鋼的最終目視檢查應在焊後規定等待時間後進行。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure leg size with a fillet gauge at regular intervals along the weld, recording the length and location of any undersize and judging it against the local undersize length the code allows; measure undercut depth with a depth gauge and check poor toe profiles for cracks by magnetic particle testing; final visual inspection of quenched-and-tempered steel should follow the specified waiting time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 填角焊有效喉厚 a = 0.707·s，每 mm 強度 φR = 0.75×0.6×F_EXX×a。F_EXX = 490 MPa：s = 12 mm 時 a = 8.48 mm，φR ≈ 0.75×0.6×490×8.48 ≈ 1,871 N/mm；若實際只有 10 mm，a = 7.07 mm，φR ≈ 1,559 N/mm，強度少約 17%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Fillet-weld effective throat a = 0.707·s and strength per mm φR = 0.75×0.6×F_EXX×a. With F_EXX = 490 MPa, a 12 mm weld has a = 8.48 mm and φR ≈ 0.75×0.6×490×8.48 ≈ 1,871 N/mm; an actual 10 mm weld has a = 7.07 mm and φR ≈ 1,559 N/mm, about 17% weaker. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「目視與尺寸檢查」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Visual and dimensional inspection", which statement holds?
options: 填角焊有效喉厚 a = 0.707·s，每 mm 強度 φR = 0.75×0.6×F_EXX×a。
焊縫外觀平整光滑，就代表內部品質良好。
鋼板越厚越安全，所以厚板接頭不需要特別的焊接控制。
optionsEn: Fillet-weld effective throat a = 0.707·s and strength per mm φR = 0.75×0.6×F_EXX×a.
A smooth, even weld surface means the weld is sound inside.
Thicker plate is always safer, so thick-plate joints need no special welding control.
quiz.explanation: 填角焊有效喉厚 a = 0.707·s，每 mm 強度 φR = 0.75×0.6×F_EXX×a。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Fillet-weld effective throat a = 0.707·s and strength per mm φR = 0.75×0.6×F_EXX×a. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 目視與尺寸檢查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Visual and dimensional inspection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「填角焊腳長量規」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fillet-weld size gauge” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以焊腳量規沿焊道等間距量測尺寸，記錄不足處的長度與位置，並依規範允許的局部不足長度判定；咬邊深度以深度規量測，焊趾輪廓不良處以磁粉檢查是否有裂縫；淬火回火鋼的最終目視檢查應在焊後規定等待時間後進行。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure leg size with a fillet gauge at regular intervals along the weld, recording the length and location of any undersize and judging it against the local undersize length the code allows; measure undercut depth with a depth gauge and check poor toe profiles for cracks by magnetic particle testing; final visual inspection of quenched-and-tempered steel should follow the specified waiting time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：焊縫清冊要納入所有附屬件的焊縫，特別是焊在受拉或疲勞構件上的吊耳、托架與感測器底座；臨時吊耳拆除後要磨平並以磁粉檢查，紀錄位置供日後檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The weld register must include every attachment weld, especially lugs, brackets and sensor mounts welded to tension or fatigue members; temporary lifting lugs must be ground flush after removal and checked by magnetic particle testing, with their locations recorded for future inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：附屬板件的填角焊常被視為「不重要」而不檢查，但它在受拉主構件上形成疲勞細節；Kielland 平台的斜撐裂縫被認為可追溯到 1976 年施工時的不良焊接，1980 年 3 月 27 日平台傾覆，212 人中 123 人罹難。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fillet welds on attachments are often dismissed as unimportant and left uninspected, yet they create fatigue details on main tension members; the crack in the Kielland platform's brace was traced to poor welding probably dating from construction in 1976, and on 27 March 1980 the platform capsized, killing 123 of the 212 people aboard. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以焊腳量規沿焊道等間距量測尺寸，記錄不足處的長度與位置，並依規範允許的局部不足長度判定；咬邊深度以深度規量測，焊趾輪廓不良處以磁粉檢查是否有裂縫；淬火回火鋼的最終目視檢查應在焊後規定等待時間後進行。
knowledge.textEn: Measure leg size with a fillet gauge at regular intervals along the weld, recording the length and location of any undersize and judging it against the local undersize length the code allows; measure undercut depth with a depth gauge and check poor toe profiles for cracks by magnetic particle testing; final visual inspection of quenched-and-tempered steel should follow the specified waiting time.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 焊縫清冊要納入所有附屬件的焊縫，特別是焊在受拉或疲勞構件上的吊耳、托架與感測器底座；臨時吊耳拆除後要磨平並以磁粉檢查，紀錄位置供日後檢查。
knowledge.textEn: The weld register must include every attachment weld, especially lugs, brackets and sensor mounts welded to tension or fatigue members; temporary lifting lugs must be ground flush after removal and checked by magnetic particle testing, with their locations recorded for future inspection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「目視與尺寸檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Visual and dimensional inspection"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以焊腳量規沿焊道等間距量測尺寸，記錄不足處的長度與位置，並依規範允許的局部不足長度判定。
焊接順序只影響外觀與變形，不會影響接頭強度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Measure leg size with a fillet gauge at regular intervals along the weld, recording the length and location of any undersize and judging it against the local undersize length the code allows.
Weld sequence affects only appearance and distortion, never joint strength.
quiz.explanation: 以焊腳量規沿焊道等間距量測尺寸，記錄不足處的長度與位置，並依規範允許的局部不足長度判定；咬邊深度以深度規量測，焊趾輪廓不良處以磁粉檢查是否有裂縫；淬火回火鋼的最終目視檢查應在焊後規定等待時間後進行。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure leg size with a fillet gauge at regular intervals along the weld, recording the length and location of any undersize and judging it against the local undersize length the code allows; measure undercut depth with a depth gauge and check poor toe profiles for cracks by magnetic particle testing; final visual inspection of quenched-and-tempered steel should follow the specified waiting time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 目視與尺寸檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Visual and dimensional inspection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「填角焊腳長量規」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fillet-weld size gauge” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 附屬板件的填角焊常被視為「不重要」而不檢查，但它在受拉主構件上形成疲勞細節；Kielland 平台的斜撐裂縫被認為可追溯到 1976 年施工時的不良焊接，1980 年 3 月 27 日平台傾覆，212 人中 123 人罹難。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fillet welds on attachments are often dismissed as unimportant and left uninspected, yet they create fatigue details on main tension members; the crack in the Kielland platform's brace was traced to poor welding probably dating from construction in 1976, and on 27 March 1980 the platform capsized, killing 123 of the 212 people aboard. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Kielland 平台的 6 mm 填角焊因焊道輪廓不良而降低疲勞強度，說明非主要受力的附屬焊縫也必須被檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: On the Kielland platform a 6 mm fillet weld with a poor profile had reduced fatigue strength, showing that welds on non-load-bearing attachments must be inspected too.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「非受力的附屬焊縫品質不重要，不需要檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Welds on non-load-bearing attachments do not matter and need no inspection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 附屬板件的填角焊常被視為「不重要」而不檢查，但它在受拉主構件上形成疲勞細節；Kielland 平台的斜撐裂縫被認為可追溯到 1976 年施工時的不良焊接，1980 年 3 月 27 日平台傾覆，212 人中 123 人罹難。
knowledge.textEn: Fillet welds on attachments are often dismissed as unimportant and left uninspected, yet they create fatigue details on main tension members; the crack in the Kielland platform's brace was traced to poor welding probably dating from construction in 1976, and on 27 March 1980 the platform capsized, killing 123 of the 212 people aboard.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「目視與尺寸檢查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Visual and dimensional inspection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
修補焊縫只是把缺陷補起來，品質要求可以比原焊縫寬鬆。
附屬板件的填角焊常被視為「不重要」而不檢查，但它在受拉主構件上形成疲勞細節。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A repair weld just fills a defect, so it can be held to a looser standard than the original.
Fillet welds on attachments are often dismissed as unimportant and left uninspected, yet they create fatigue details on main tension members.
quiz.explanation: 附屬板件的填角焊常被視為「不重要」而不檢查，但它在受拉主構件上形成疲勞細節；Kielland 平台的斜撐裂縫被認為可追溯到 1976 年施工時的不良焊接，1980 年 3 月 27 日平台傾覆，212 人中 123 人罹難。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fillet welds on attachments are often dismissed as unimportant and left uninspected, yet they create fatigue details on main tension members; the crack in the Kielland platform's brace was traced to poor welding probably dating from construction in 1976, and on 27 March 1980 the platform capsized, killing 123 of the 212 people aboard. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「缺陷修補與重新檢驗」與「焊接紀錄、可追溯性與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Defect repair and re-inspection" and "Weld records, traceability and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 缺陷修補與重新檢驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Defect repair and re-inspection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「刨除修補與複檢」如何影響鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gouge-out repair and re-test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Welding inspection of major steel joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 被拒收的焊縫要以碳弧刨或研磨把缺陷完全挖除，並以磁粉或滲透檢測確認挖除乾淨，再依核准的修補程序重新預熱與施焊，最後以原檢測方法重新檢驗。修補比原焊接更困難：挖槽窄深、拘束更高，同一位置反覆修補會讓熱影響區反覆受熱而劣化。I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋 2021 年斷裂的調查即指向製造時兩處寬大的焊接修補所引發的氫致裂紋，說明修補焊縫必須與原焊縫一樣受到嚴格控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「刨除修補與複檢」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A rejected weld is excavated by air-carbon-arc gouging or grinding until the flaw is fully removed, confirmed clean by magnetic particle or penetrant testing, then preheated and rewelded to an approved repair procedure and re-tested by the original method. Repairs are harder than original welds: the excavation is narrow and deep, restraint is higher, and repeated repairs at one spot reheat and degrade the heat-affected zone. The investigation of the 2021 I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge fracture pointed to hydrogen cracks from two wide weld repairs made during fabrication, showing that repair welds need the same strict control as the originals. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Gouge-out repair and re-test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：缺陷長 60 mm，兩端各外延 50 mm 挖除，挖槽長 L = 60 + 2×50 = 160 mm；預熱範圍取各方向至少 max(75 mm, t) 且 t = 60 mm，預熱區長度約 160 + 2×75 = 310 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 60 mm long flaw excavated 50 mm beyond each end, the gouge is L = 60 + 2×50 = 160 mm long; with preheat extending at least max(75 mm, t) in every direction and t = 60 mm, the preheated zone is about 160 + 2×75 = 310 mm long.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「修補焊縫只是把缺陷補起來，品質要求可以比原焊縫寬鬆。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A repair weld just fills a defect, so it can be held to a looser standard than the original." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「刨除修補與複檢」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Gouge-out repair and re-test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 缺陷修補與重新檢驗
knowledge.text: 被拒收的焊縫要以碳弧刨或研磨把缺陷完全挖除，並以磁粉或滲透檢測確認挖除乾淨，再依核准的修補程序重新預熱與施焊，最後以原檢測方法重新檢驗。修補比原焊接更困難：挖槽窄深、拘束更高，同一位置反覆修補會讓熱影響區反覆受熱而劣化。
knowledge.textEn: A rejected weld is excavated by air-carbon-arc gouging or grinding until the flaw is fully removed, confirmed clean by magnetic particle or penetrant testing, then preheated and rewelded to an approved repair procedure and re-tested by the original method. Repairs are harder than original welds: the excavation is narrow and deep, restraint is higher, and repeated repairs at one spot reheat and degrade the heat-affected zone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：修補焊縫只是把缺陷補起來，品質要求可以比原焊縫寬鬆。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A repair weld just fills a defect, so it can be held to a looser standard than the original. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「缺陷修補與重新檢驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Defect repair and re-inspection" is correct?
options: 被拒收的焊縫要以碳弧刨或研磨把缺陷完全挖除，並以磁粉或滲透檢測確認挖除乾淨，再依核准的修補程序重新預熱與施焊，最後以原檢測方法重新檢驗。
修補焊縫只是把缺陷補起來，品質要求可以比原焊縫寬鬆。
焊縫檢驗合格後，焊接紀錄就沒有保存價值。
optionsEn: A rejected weld is excavated by air-carbon-arc gouging or grinding until the flaw is fully removed, confirmed clean by magnetic particle or penetrant testing, then preheated and rewelded to an approved repair procedure and re-tested by the original method.
A repair weld just fills a defect, so it can be held to a looser standard than the original.
Once welds pass inspection, the welding records have no further value.
quiz.explanation: 被拒收的焊縫要以碳弧刨或研磨把缺陷完全挖除，並以磁粉或滲透檢測確認挖除乾淨，再依核准的修補程序重新預熱與施焊，最後以原檢測方法重新檢驗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A rejected weld is excavated by air-carbon-arc gouging or grinding until the flaw is fully removed, confirmed clean by magnetic particle or penetrant testing, then preheated and rewelded to an approved repair procedure and re-tested by the original method. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 缺陷修補與重新檢驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Defect repair and re-inspection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「刨除修補與複檢」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gouge-out repair and re-test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：缺陷長 60 mm，兩端各外延 50 mm 挖除，挖槽長 L = 60 + 2×50 = 160 mm；預熱範圍取各方向至少 max(75 mm, t) 且 t = 60 mm，預熱區長度約 160 + 2×75 = 310 mm。若同一接頭抽驗 40 道中有 3 道需修補，修補率 7.5%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 60 mm long flaw excavated 50 mm beyond each end, the gouge is L = 60 + 2×50 = 160 mm long; with preheat extending at least max(75 mm, t) in every direction and t = 60 mm, the preheated zone is about 160 + 2×75 = 310 mm long. If 3 of 40 sampled welds in a joint need repair, the repair rate is 7.5%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一處修補都要有修補單：缺陷位置與類型、挖除深度、清除確認方法、修補程序、銲工、預熱紀錄與複檢結果；同一位置第二次以上的修補須經結構工程師核准，並考慮以硬度或韌性試驗確認熱影響區未劣化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Every repair needs a repair record: flaw location and type, excavation depth, method of confirming removal, repair procedure, welder, preheat record and re-test result; a second or further repair at one location should require the structural engineer's approval, with hardness or toughness checks considered to confirm the heat-affected zone has not degraded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 缺陷長 60 mm，兩端各外延 50 mm 挖除，挖槽長 L = 60 + 2×50 = 160 mm；預熱範圍取各方向至少 max(75 mm, t) 且 t = 60 mm，預熱區長度約 160 + 2×75 = 310 mm。若同一接頭抽驗 40 道中有 3 道需修補，修補率 7.5%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 60 mm long flaw excavated 50 mm beyond each end, the gouge is L = 60 + 2×50 = 160 mm long; with preheat extending at least max(75 mm, t) in every direction and t = 60 mm, the preheated zone is about 160 + 2×75 = 310 mm long. If 3 of 40 sampled welds in a joint need repair, the repair rate is 7.5%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「缺陷修補與重新檢驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Defect repair and re-inspection", which statement holds?
options: 留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。
缺陷長 60 mm，兩端各外延 50 mm 挖除，挖槽長 L = 60 + 2×50 = 160 mm。
銲工經驗豐富就可以不按焊接程序施焊。
optionsEn: Leaving the weld backing bar in place adds strength, so it never needs removing.
For a 60 mm long flaw excavated 50 mm beyond each end, the gouge is L = 60 + 2×50 = 160 mm long.
An experienced welder does not need to follow the welding procedure.
quiz.explanation: 缺陷長 60 mm，兩端各外延 50 mm 挖除，挖槽長 L = 60 + 2×50 = 160 mm；預熱範圍取各方向至少 max(75 mm, t) 且 t = 60 mm，預熱區長度約 160 + 2×75 = 310 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 60 mm long flaw excavated 50 mm beyond each end, the gouge is L = 60 + 2×50 = 160 mm long; with preheat extending at least max(75 mm, t) in every direction and t = 60 mm, the preheated zone is about 160 + 2×75 = 310 mm long. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 缺陷修補與重新檢驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Defect repair and re-inspection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「刨除修補與複檢」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gouge-out repair and re-test” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每一處修補都要有修補單：缺陷位置與類型、挖除深度、清除確認方法、修補程序、銲工、預熱紀錄與複檢結果；同一位置第二次以上的修補須經結構工程師核准，並考慮以硬度或韌性試驗確認熱影響區未劣化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Every repair needs a repair record: flaw location and type, excavation depth, method of confirming removal, repair procedure, welder, preheat record and re-test result; a second or further repair at one location should require the structural engineer's approval, with hardness or toughness checks considered to confirm the heat-affected zone has not degraded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：修補程序要與原焊接程序一樣事先送審，修補後的非破壞檢測不得低於原檢測等級；修補紀錄與位置必須永久保存並標在竣工焊道圖上，作為日後營運檢查的重點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Repair procedures must be submitted for approval in advance like the original WPS, post-repair NDT must be at least as stringent as the original test, and repair records and locations must be kept permanently and marked on the as-built weld map as priority points for in-service inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：修補時未完全挖除裂縫末端，或為了快速完成而省略預熱，新焊道下方留下氫致裂紋；這類裂縫可能多年後才在使用應力下成長並造成斷裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Leaving the tip of a crack unexcavated, or skipping preheat to finish quickly, leaves hydrogen cracks beneath the new weld that may grow under service stress and fracture years later. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每一處修補都要有修補單：缺陷位置與類型、挖除深度、清除確認方法、修補程序、銲工、預熱紀錄與複檢結果；同一位置第二次以上的修補須經結構工程師核准，並考慮以硬度或韌性試驗確認熱影響區未劣化。
knowledge.textEn: Every repair needs a repair record: flaw location and type, excavation depth, method of confirming removal, repair procedure, welder, preheat record and re-test result; a second or further repair at one location should require the structural engineer's approval, with hardness or toughness checks considered to confirm the heat-affected zone has not degraded.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 修補程序要與原焊接程序一樣事先送審，修補後的非破壞檢測不得低於原檢測等級；修補紀錄與位置必須永久保存並標在竣工焊道圖上，作為日後營運檢查的重點。
knowledge.textEn: Repair procedures must be submitted for approval in advance like the original WPS, post-repair NDT must be at least as stringent as the original test, and repair records and locations must be kept permanently and marked on the as-built weld map as priority points for in-service inspection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「缺陷修補與重新檢驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Defect repair and re-inspection"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要完工後的超音波抽驗合格，焊接過程的檢查就可以省略。
每一處修補都要有修補單：缺陷位置與類型、挖除深度、清除確認方法、修補程序、銲工、預熱紀錄與複檢結果。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If post-weld ultrasonic sampling passes, in-process inspection can be skipped.
Every repair needs a repair record: flaw location and type, excavation depth, method of confirming removal, repair procedure, welder, preheat record and re-test result.
quiz.explanation: 每一處修補都要有修補單：缺陷位置與類型、挖除深度、清除確認方法、修補程序、銲工、預熱紀錄與複檢結果；同一位置第二次以上的修補須經結構工程師核准，並考慮以硬度或韌性試驗確認熱影響區未劣化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Every repair needs a repair record: flaw location and type, excavation depth, method of confirming removal, repair procedure, welder, preheat record and re-test result; a second or further repair at one location should require the structural engineer's approval, with hardness or toughness checks considered to confirm the heat-affected zone has not degraded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 缺陷修補與重新檢驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Defect repair and re-inspection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「刨除修補與複檢」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gouge-out repair and re-test” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 修補時未完全挖除裂縫末端，或為了快速完成而省略預熱，新焊道下方留下氫致裂紋；這類裂縫可能多年後才在使用應力下成長並造成斷裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Leaving the tip of a crack unexcavated, or skipping preheat to finish quickly, leaves hydrogen cracks beneath the new weld that may grow under service stress and fracture years later. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋 2021 年斷裂的調查即指向製造時兩處寬大的焊接修補所引發的氫致裂紋，說明修補焊縫必須與原焊縫一樣受到嚴格控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The investigation of the 2021 I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge fracture pointed to hydrogen cracks from two wide weld repairs made during fabrication, showing that repair welds need the same strict control as the originals.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「修補焊縫只是把缺陷補起來，品質要求可以比原焊縫寬鬆。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A repair weld just fills a defect, so it can be held to a looser standard than the original." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 修補時未完全挖除裂縫末端，或為了快速完成而省略預熱，新焊道下方留下氫致裂紋；這類裂縫可能多年後才在使用應力下成長並造成斷裂。
knowledge.textEn: Leaving the tip of a crack unexcavated, or skipping preheat to finish quickly, leaves hydrogen cracks beneath the new weld that may grow under service stress and fracture years later.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「缺陷修補與重新檢驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Defect repair and re-inspection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 修補時未完全挖除裂縫末端，或為了快速完成而省略預熱，新焊道下方留下氫致裂紋；這類裂縫可能多年後才在使用應力下成長並造成斷裂。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
焊縫檢驗合格後，焊接紀錄就沒有保存價值。
optionsEn: Leaving the tip of a crack unexcavated, or skipping preheat to finish quickly, leaves hydrogen cracks beneath the new weld that may grow under service stress and fracture years later.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once welds pass inspection, the welding records have no further value.
quiz.explanation: 修補時未完全挖除裂縫末端，或為了快速完成而省略預熱，新焊道下方留下氫致裂紋；這類裂縫可能多年後才在使用應力下成長並造成斷裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Leaving the tip of a crack unexcavated, or skipping preheat to finish quickly, leaves hydrogen cracks beneath the new weld that may grow under service stress and fracture years later. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 焊接紀錄、可追溯性與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Weld records, traceability and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「焊道地圖與檢驗報告」如何影響鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weld map and inspection reports” governs force, deformation or durability in “Welding inspection of major steel joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每一道重要焊縫都應能追溯到鋼板爐號、焊接程序、銲工、施焊日期、預熱紀錄、非破壞檢測報告與修補履歷。這些紀錄在施工期間用來找出系統性問題，例如某位銲工或某個班次的拒收率偏高；在營運期間則讓檢查人員知道哪些接頭曾經修補、哪些附屬件焊在受拉構件上。Kielland 平台與 I-40 橋的事故都顯示，製造時的焊接缺陷可能在多年後才顯現，因此交接文件要讓下一代工程師找得到這些細節。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「焊道地圖與檢驗報告」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every important weld should trace back to plate heat number, welding procedure, welder, date, preheat record, NDT reports and repair history. During construction these records expose systematic problems, such as one welder or shift with a high reject rate; in service they tell inspectors which joints were repaired and which attachments are welded to tension members. The Kielland platform and the I-40 bridge both show that fabrication weld defects can surface years later, so handover documents must let the next generation of engineers find these details. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Weld map and inspection reports” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以紀錄比較銲工表現：銲工 A 焊 80 道、拒收 2 道，拒收率 2/80 = 2.5%；銲工 B 焊 60 道、拒收 6 道，拒收率 6/60 = 10%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Records compare welders: welder A made 80 welds with 2 rejected, a 2/80 = 2.5% rate; welder B made 60 with 6 rejected, a 6/60 = 10% rate.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「焊縫檢驗合格後，焊接紀錄就沒有保存價值。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once welds pass inspection, the welding records have no further value." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「焊道地圖與檢驗報告」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Weld map and inspection reports”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 焊接紀錄、可追溯性與交接
knowledge.text: 每一道重要焊縫都應能追溯到鋼板爐號、焊接程序、銲工、施焊日期、預熱紀錄、非破壞檢測報告與修補履歷。這些紀錄在施工期間用來找出系統性問題，例如某位銲工或某個班次的拒收率偏高；在營運期間則讓檢查人員知道哪些接頭曾經修補、哪些附屬件焊在受拉構件上。
knowledge.textEn: Every important weld should trace back to plate heat number, welding procedure, welder, date, preheat record, NDT reports and repair history. During construction these records expose systematic problems, such as one welder or shift with a high reject rate; in service they tell inspectors which joints were repaired and which attachments are welded to tension members.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：焊縫檢驗合格後，焊接紀錄就沒有保存價值。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once welds pass inspection, the welding records have no further value. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「焊接紀錄、可追溯性與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Weld records, traceability and handover" is correct?
options: 焊縫檢驗合格後，焊接紀錄就沒有保存價值。
每一道重要焊縫都應能追溯到鋼板爐號、焊接程序、銲工、施焊日期、預熱紀錄、非破壞檢測報告與修補履歷。
焊縫外觀平整光滑，就代表內部品質良好。
optionsEn: Once welds pass inspection, the welding records have no further value.
Every important weld should trace back to plate heat number, welding procedure, welder, date, preheat record, NDT reports and repair history.
A smooth, even weld surface means the weld is sound inside.
quiz.explanation: 每一道重要焊縫都應能追溯到鋼板爐號、焊接程序、銲工、施焊日期、預熱紀錄、非破壞檢測報告與修補履歷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every important weld should trace back to plate heat number, welding procedure, welder, date, preheat record, NDT reports and repair history. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 焊接紀錄、可追溯性與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weld records, traceability and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「焊道地圖與檢驗報告」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weld map and inspection reports” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以紀錄比較銲工表現：銲工 A 焊 80 道、拒收 2 道，拒收率 2/80 = 2.5%；銲工 B 焊 60 道、拒收 6 道，拒收率 6/60 = 10%。B 的拒收率為 A 的 4 倍，應暫停其需求關鍵焊縫作業、重新訓練與考試，並把其已完成焊縫的超音波抽驗提高到 100%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Records compare welders: welder A made 80 welds with 2 rejected, a 2/80 = 2.5% rate; welder B made 60 with 6 rejected, a 6/60 = 10% rate. B's rate is four times A's, so B should be stood down from demand-critical welds, retrained and retested, and B's completed welds raised to 100% ultrasonic testing. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前隨機抽取數道焊縫，從現場焊道標記追溯到銲工、程序、檢測報告與修補單，確認紀錄鏈完整；並檢查竣工焊道圖是否標示所有修補位置、臨時附件移除處與需求關鍵焊縫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, pick several welds at random and trace each from its site mark to welder, procedure, test reports and repair records to confirm an unbroken chain; check that the as-built weld map shows every repair, every removed temporary attachment and every demand-critical weld.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以紀錄比較銲工表現：銲工 A 焊 80 道、拒收 2 道，拒收率 2/80 = 2.5%；銲工 B 焊 60 道、拒收 6 道，拒收率 6/60 = 10%。B 的拒收率為 A 的 4 倍，應暫停其需求關鍵焊縫作業、重新訓練與考試，並把其已完成焊縫的超音波抽驗提高到 100%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Records compare welders: welder A made 80 welds with 2 rejected, a 2/80 = 2.5% rate; welder B made 60 with 6 rejected, a 6/60 = 10% rate. B's rate is four times A's, so B should be stood down from demand-critical welds, retrained and retested, and B's completed welds raised to 100% ultrasonic testing. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「焊接紀錄、可追溯性與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Weld records, traceability and handover", which statement holds?
options: 鋼板越厚越安全，所以厚板接頭不需要特別的焊接控制。
焊接順序只影響外觀與變形，不會影響接頭強度。
以紀錄比較銲工表現：銲工 A 焊 80 道、拒收 2 道，拒收率 2/80 = 2.5%；銲工 B 焊 60 道、拒收 6 道，拒收率 6/60 = 10%。
optionsEn: Thicker plate is always safer, so thick-plate joints need no special welding control.
Weld sequence affects only appearance and distortion, never joint strength.
Records compare welders: welder A made 80 welds with 2 rejected, a 2/80 = 2.5% rate; welder B made 60 with 6 rejected, a 6/60 = 10% rate.
quiz.explanation: 以紀錄比較銲工表現：銲工 A 焊 80 道、拒收 2 道，拒收率 2/80 = 2.5%；銲工 B 焊 60 道、拒收 6 道，拒收率 6/60 = 10%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Records compare welders: welder A made 80 welds with 2 rejected, a 2/80 = 2.5% rate; welder B made 60 with 6 rejected, a 6/60 = 10% rate. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 焊接紀錄、可追溯性與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Weld records, traceability and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「焊道地圖與檢驗報告」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weld map and inspection reports” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前隨機抽取數道焊縫，從現場焊道標記追溯到銲工、程序、檢測報告與修補單，確認紀錄鏈完整；並檢查竣工焊道圖是否標示所有修補位置、臨時附件移除處與需求關鍵焊縫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, pick several welds at random and trace each from its site mark to welder, procedure, test reports and repair records to confirm an unbroken chain; check that the as-built weld map shows every repair, every removed temporary attachment and every demand-critical weld. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約應規定焊接紀錄以數位格式交付業主，包含焊道地圖、銲工與程序對照、檢測原始資料與修補履歷；業主的維護手冊要指定需定期檢查的焊縫清單，並由結構工程師依修補與疲勞風險排定優先順序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The contract should require weld records delivered digitally to the owner, including weld maps, welder and procedure cross-references, raw NDT data and repair history; the owner's maintenance manual should list welds for periodic inspection, prioritised by the structural engineer according to repair history and fatigue risk.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若焊接紀錄只以紙本存放在製造廠，工程結束後隨公司搬遷或結束營業而遺失，業主在數十年後發現裂縫時，無法判斷是單一缺陷還是同批焊縫的共同問題，只能全面檢驗。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If weld records stay on paper at the fabricator and are lost when it moves or closes, an owner who finds a crack decades later cannot tell whether it is an isolated flaw or common to a whole batch, and must inspect everything. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前隨機抽取數道焊縫，從現場焊道標記追溯到銲工、程序、檢測報告與修補單，確認紀錄鏈完整；並檢查竣工焊道圖是否標示所有修補位置、臨時附件移除處與需求關鍵焊縫。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover, pick several welds at random and trace each from its site mark to welder, procedure, test reports and repair records to confirm an unbroken chain; check that the as-built weld map shows every repair, every removed temporary attachment and every demand-critical weld.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合約應規定焊接紀錄以數位格式交付業主，包含焊道地圖、銲工與程序對照、檢測原始資料與修補履歷；業主的維護手冊要指定需定期檢查的焊縫清單，並由結構工程師依修補與疲勞風險排定優先順序。
knowledge.textEn: The contract should require weld records delivered digitally to the owner, including weld maps, welder and procedure cross-references, raw NDT data and repair history; the owner's maintenance manual should list welds for periodic inspection, prioritised by the structural engineer according to repair history and fatigue risk.

quiz.question: 要驗證「焊接紀錄、可追溯性與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Weld records, traceability and handover"?
options: 交接前隨機抽取數道焊縫，從現場焊道標記追溯到銲工、程序、檢測報告與修補單，確認紀錄鏈完整；並檢查竣工焊道圖是否標示所有修補位置、臨時附件移除處與需求關鍵焊縫。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
射線檢測一定比超音波更適合檢驗所有厚板焊縫。
optionsEn: Before handover, pick several welds at random and trace each from its site mark to welder, procedure, test reports and repair records to confirm an unbroken chain.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Radiography is always better than ultrasonics for every thick-plate weld.
quiz.explanation: 交接前隨機抽取數道焊縫，從現場焊道標記追溯到銲工、程序、檢測報告與修補單，確認紀錄鏈完整；並檢查竣工焊道圖是否標示所有修補位置、臨時附件移除處與需求關鍵焊縫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover, pick several welds at random and trace each from its site mark to welder, procedure, test reports and repair records to confirm an unbroken chain; check that the as-built weld map shows every repair, every removed temporary attachment and every demand-critical weld. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 焊接紀錄、可追溯性與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Weld records, traceability and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「焊道地圖與檢驗報告」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Weld map and inspection reports” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若焊接紀錄只以紙本存放在製造廠，工程結束後隨公司搬遷或結束營業而遺失，業主在數十年後發現裂縫時，無法判斷是單一缺陷還是同批焊縫的共同問題，只能全面檢驗。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If weld records stay on paper at the fabricator and are lost when it moves or closes, an owner who finds a crack decades later cannot tell whether it is an isolated flaw or common to a whole batch, and must inspect everything. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Kielland 平台與 I-40 橋的事故都顯示，製造時的焊接缺陷可能在多年後才顯現，因此交接文件要讓下一代工程師找得到這些細節。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Kielland platform and the I-40 bridge both show that fabrication weld defects can surface years later, so handover documents must let the next generation of engineers find these details.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「焊縫檢驗合格後，焊接紀錄就沒有保存價值。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once welds pass inspection, the welding records have no further value." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

title: 高強度螺栓預拉力施工
summary: 從摩擦型接頭的傳力與預拉力對疲勞的作用出發，說明螺栓等級與氫脆、接觸面處理與孔型、密貼與鎖緊順序、轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與直接張力指示墊圈、安裝前驗證與施工後稽核、長期鬆弛與紀錄交接，並以 RCSC 規範 2025 年版撤除校正扳手法、舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋 2013 年錨桿斷裂、1979 年 Kemper Arena 屋頂吊架螺栓失效與雪梨港灣大橋六百萬支鉚釘為對照。
summaryEn: Starting from force transfer in slip-critical joints and the role of pretension in fatigue, explain bolt grades and hydrogen embrittlement, faying surfaces and hole types, snugging and tightening sequence, turn-of-nut, twist-off bolts and direct tension indicators, pre-installation verification and post-installation audits, long-term relaxation and record handover, contrasted with the withdrawal of the calibrated wrench method in the 2025 RCSC Specification, the 2013 anchor-rod fractures on the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge, the 1979 Kemper Arena hanger-bolt failure and the six million rivets of Sydney Harbour Bridge.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某鋼構支撐續接需傳遞使用剪力 900 kN，採 7/8 in A325 螺栓、雙剪面、標準孔。(1) 最低預拉 T_b = 0.70×120 ksi×0.462 in² ≈ 39 kips ≈ 173 kN。(2) 接觸面採噴砂 Class B（μ = 0.50）：每支 2×0.50×1.13×173 ≈ 195 kN，需 900/195 ≈ 4.6 支，為對稱配置取 6 支。(3) 螺栓長 4.5 in（約 114 mm），L/d ≈ 5.1，依轉角表介於 4d 與 8d 之間，密貼後轉 1/2 圈。(4) 安裝前驗證要求每組 ≥ 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN，三組 186、190、185 kN 均合格後才能開工。(5) 若改變一個輸入：接觸面誤塗面漆而只能以 Class A（μ = 0.30）計，每支只剩約 117 kN，需 900/117 ≈ 7.7 支，原本 6 支的接頭抗滑力約只有需求的 78%，須清除塗層或增加螺栓。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際結構。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a steel brace splice must carry 900 kN of service shear using 7/8 in A325 bolts in double shear with standard holes. (1) Minimum pretension T_b = 0.70×120 ksi×0.462 in² ≈ 39 kips ≈ 173 kN. (2) With blast-cleaned Class B faying surfaces (μ = 0.50), each bolt gives 2×0.50×1.13×173 ≈ 195 kN, needing 900/195 ≈ 4.6 bolts, so 6 are used for a symmetric layout. (3) The bolt length is 4.5 in (about 114 mm), L/d ≈ 5.1, between 4d and 8d in the turn-of-nut table, so the nut is turned 1/2 turn after snugging. (4) Pre-installation verification requires each assembly to reach at least 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN; three assemblies at 186, 190 and 185 kN pass before work starts. (5) Changing one input: if the faying surfaces were painted by mistake and only Class A (μ = 0.30) can be counted, each bolt gives about 117 kN, needing 900/117 ≈ 7.7 bolts, so the six-bolt joint has only about 78% of the required slip resistance and the coating must be removed or bolts added. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real structure.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「摩擦型接頭的傳力機制」與「預拉力與疲勞、反覆載重」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Force transfer in slip-critical joints" and "Pretension, fatigue and repeated load": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 摩擦型接頭的傳力機制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Force transfer in slip-critical joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「接觸面夾緊力與滑動係數」如何影響高強度螺栓預拉力施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Clamp force and slip coefficient” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 高強度螺栓接頭有兩種傳力方式：承壓型接頭讓板件滑動到螺栓桿與孔壁接觸，以螺栓剪力與孔壁承壓傳力；摩擦型接頭則靠螺栓預拉力把板件夾緊，以接觸面的摩擦力傳遞剪力，在使用載重下板件不滑動。需要摩擦型接頭的情況包括反覆或反向載重、疲勞敏感構件、超大孔或槽孔，以及滑動會造成幾何改變的支撐與續接。摩擦型接頭的強度因此直接取決於夾緊力與接觸面滑動係數，而不是螺栓本身的剪力強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「接觸面夾緊力與滑動係數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: High-strength bolted joints transfer force in two ways: in a bearing joint the plies slip until the shank bears on the hole, carrying force by bolt shear and bearing; in a slip-critical joint the bolt pretension clamps the plies so friction at the faying surfaces carries the shear without slip under service loads. Slip-critical joints are needed for reversing or repeated loads, fatigue-sensitive members, oversized or slotted holes, and bracing or splices where slip would change geometry. Their capacity therefore depends directly on clamp force and the faying-surface slip coefficient, not on the shear strength of the bolt itself. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Clamp force and slip coefficient” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：滑動強度 R = μ·D_u·T_b·n_s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Slip resistance R = μ·D_u·T_b·n_s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「摩擦型接頭的強度主要來自螺栓的剪力強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A slip-critical joint gets its strength mainly from the bolts' shear strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「接觸面夾緊力與滑動係數」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Clamp force and slip coefficient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 摩擦型接頭的傳力機制
knowledge.text: 高強度螺栓接頭有兩種傳力方式：承壓型接頭讓板件滑動到螺栓桿與孔壁接觸，以螺栓剪力與孔壁承壓傳力；摩擦型接頭則靠螺栓預拉力把板件夾緊，以接觸面的摩擦力傳遞剪力，在使用載重下板件不滑動。需要摩擦型接頭的情況包括反覆或反向載重、疲勞敏感構件、超大孔或槽孔，以及滑動會造成幾何改變的支撐與續接。
knowledge.textEn: High-strength bolted joints transfer force in two ways: in a bearing joint the plies slip until the shank bears on the hole, carrying force by bolt shear and bearing; in a slip-critical joint the bolt pretension clamps the plies so friction at the faying surfaces carries the shear without slip under service loads. Slip-critical joints are needed for reversing or repeated loads, fatigue-sensitive members, oversized or slotted holes, and bracing or splices where slip would change geometry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：摩擦型接頭的強度主要來自螺栓的剪力強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A slip-critical joint gets its strength mainly from the bolts' shear strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「摩擦型接頭的傳力機制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Force transfer in slip-critical joints" is correct?
options: 摩擦型接頭的強度主要來自螺栓的剪力強度。
高強度螺栓接頭有兩種傳力方式：承壓型接頭讓板件滑動到螺栓桿與孔壁接觸，以螺栓剪力與孔壁承壓傳力。
外加拉力會全部直接加到預拉螺栓上，所以預拉沒有好處。
optionsEn: A slip-critical joint gets its strength mainly from the bolts' shear strength.
High-strength bolted joints transfer force in two ways: in a bearing joint the plies slip until the shank bears on the hole, carrying force by bolt shear and bearing.
Any applied tension adds directly to a pretensioned bolt, so pretension gives no benefit.
quiz.explanation: 高強度螺栓接頭有兩種傳力方式：承壓型接頭讓板件滑動到螺栓桿與孔壁接觸，以螺栓剪力與孔壁承壓傳力；摩擦型接頭則靠螺栓預拉力把板件夾緊，以接觸面的摩擦力傳遞剪力，在使用載重下板件不滑動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: High-strength bolted joints transfer force in two ways: in a bearing joint the plies slip until the shank bears on the hole, carrying force by bolt shear and bearing; in a slip-critical joint the bolt pretension clamps the plies so friction at the faying surfaces carries the shear without slip under service loads. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 摩擦型接頭的傳力機制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Force transfer in slip-critical joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接觸面夾緊力與滑動係數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Clamp force and slip coefficient” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：滑動強度 R = μ·D_u·T_b·n_s。7/8 in A325 螺栓 T_b = 173 kN、D_u = 1.13：Class A（μ = 0.30）每支單面 0.30×1.13×173 ≈ 58.6 kN，雙剪面約 117 kN；Class B（μ = 0.50）雙剪面約 195 kN，同樣的螺栓多出約 67% 的抗滑力。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Slip resistance R = μ·D_u·T_b·n_s. For a 7/8 in A325 bolt with T_b = 173 kN and D_u = 1.13, a Class A surface (μ = 0.30) gives 0.30×1.13×173 ≈ 58.6 kN per bolt per plane, about 117 kN with two planes; a Class B surface (μ = 0.50) gives about 195 kN with two planes, about 67% more for the same bolt. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工圖須逐一標示接頭類型（密貼、預拉或摩擦型）、接觸面等級與孔型，檢驗員以此核對現場；摩擦型接頭的接觸面在組立前檢查是否有油漆、油污、鏽皮或毛邊，並與經滑動試驗認可的塗層規格比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Shop drawings must label each joint as snug-tight, pretensioned or slip-critical with its faying-surface class and hole type, which inspectors check on site; before fit-up, slip-critical faying surfaces are inspected for paint, oil, loose scale or burrs and compared with the coating qualified by slip testing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 滑動強度 R = μ·D_u·T_b·n_s。7/8 in A325 螺栓 T_b = 173 kN、D_u = 1.13：Class A（μ = 0.30）每支單面 0.30×1.13×173 ≈ 58.6 kN，雙剪面約 117 kN；Class B（μ = 0.50）雙剪面約 195 kN，同樣的螺栓多出約 67% 的抗滑力。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Slip resistance R = μ·D_u·T_b·n_s. For a 7/8 in A325 bolt with T_b = 173 kN and D_u = 1.13, a Class A surface (μ = 0.30) gives 0.30×1.13×173 ≈ 58.6 kN per bolt per plane, about 117 kN with two planes; a Class B surface (μ = 0.50) gives about 195 kN with two planes, about 67% more for the same bolt. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「摩擦型接頭的傳力機制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Force transfer in slip-critical joints", which statement holds?
options: 接觸面多塗一層油漆可以保護鋼材，對摩擦型接頭沒有影響。
只要用扭力扳手鎖到規定扭力，就能精確得到設計預拉力。
滑動強度 R = μ·D_u·T_b·n_s。
optionsEn: An extra coat of paint on faying surfaces protects the steel and has no effect on a slip-critical joint.
Tightening to a specified torque with a torque wrench gives the design pretension precisely.
Slip resistance R = μ·D_u·T_b·n_s.
quiz.explanation: 滑動強度 R = μ·D_u·T_b·n_s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Slip resistance R = μ·D_u·T_b·n_s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 摩擦型接頭的傳力機制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Force transfer in slip-critical joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接觸面夾緊力與滑動係數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Clamp force and slip coefficient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 施工圖須逐一標示接頭類型（密貼、預拉或摩擦型）、接觸面等級與孔型，檢驗員以此核對現場；摩擦型接頭的接觸面在組立前檢查是否有油漆、油污、鏽皮或毛邊，並與經滑動試驗認可的塗層規格比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 摩擦型接頭的傳力機制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Force transfer in slip-critical joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接觸面夾緊力與滑動係數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Clamp force and slip coefficient” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若摩擦型接頭的接觸面被誤塗面漆，或預拉力不足，接頭在使用載重下滑動，支撐構架因螺栓孔間隙而鬆動，反覆載重下孔壁磨損、螺栓承受未設計的反覆剪力，最終產生疲勞裂縫或連接鬆脫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If a slip-critical faying surface is painted by mistake or pretension is short, the joint slips under service load, bracing loosens through the hole clearances, and repeated loading wears the holes and subjects bolts to unintended cyclic shear, ending in fatigue cracks or a loose connection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：摩擦型接頭的強度因此直接取決於夾緊力與接觸面滑動係數，而不是螺栓本身的剪力強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Their capacity therefore depends directly on clamp force and the faying-surface slip coefficient, not on the shear strength of the bolt itself.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「摩擦型接頭的強度主要來自螺栓的剪力強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A slip-critical joint gets its strength mainly from the bolts' shear strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「摩擦型接頭的傳力機制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Force transfer in slip-critical joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

steps.title: 預拉力與疲勞、反覆載重：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pretension, fatigue and repeated load: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「受拉接頭的螺栓負擔比」如何影響高強度螺栓預拉力施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bolt load share in tension joints” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 受拉接頭中的預拉力讓螺栓與被夾板件形成預壓的彈簧系統：外加拉力大部分只是減少板件間的壓力，螺栓本身只多承受一小部分，因此應力變化小、疲勞壽命長；但一旦外力超過分離載重，板件張開，螺栓承受全部外力並可能出現撬力。1979 年 6 月 4 日 Kansas City 的 Kemper Arena 在約 70 mph 強風與大雨中，屋頂吊架螺栓的強度被低估、積水又增加載重，一支螺栓失效後引發連鎖破壞，約 200×215 ft 的屋頂倒塌。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「受拉接頭的螺栓負擔比」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pretension turns a tension joint into a preloaded spring system of bolt and clamped plies: most of an applied tension only reduces the contact pressure between plies, and the bolt picks up only a small share, so its stress range stays small and fatigue life long; once the load exceeds the separation load, the plies open, the bolt takes the whole load and prying can appear. At Kemper Arena in Kansas City on 4 June 1979, in winds of about 70 mph and heavy rain, the strength of the roof hanger bolts had been underestimated and ponding added load; one bolt gave way, starting a cascade that dropped a roof area of about 200×215 ft. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bolt load share in tension joints” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：螺栓負擔比 C = k_b/(k_b + k_m)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Bolt load share C = k_b/(k_b + k_m).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外加拉力會全部直接加到預拉螺栓上，所以預拉沒有好處。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any applied tension adds directly to a pretensioned bolt, so pretension gives no benefit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「受拉接頭的螺栓負擔比」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bolt load share in tension joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 受拉接頭中的預拉力讓螺栓與被夾板件形成預壓的彈簧系統：外加拉力大部分只是減少板件間的壓力，螺栓本身只多承受一小部分，因此應力變化小、疲勞壽命長；但一旦外力超過分離載重，板件張開，螺栓承受全部外力並可能出現撬力。1979 年 6 月 4 日 Kansas City 的 Kemper Arena 在約 70 mph 強風與大雨中，屋頂吊架螺栓的強度被低估、積水又增加載重，一支螺栓失效後引發連鎖破壞，約 200×215 ft 的屋頂倒塌。
