knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外加拉力會全部直接加到預拉螺栓上，所以預拉沒有好處。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any applied tension adds directly to a pretensioned bolt, so pretension gives no benefit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預拉力與疲勞、反覆載重」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pretension, fatigue and repeated load" is correct?
options: 外加拉力會全部直接加到預拉螺栓上，所以預拉沒有好處。
螺栓強度越高越好，選用最高等級一定最安全。
受拉接頭中的預拉力讓螺栓與被夾板件形成預壓的彈簧系統：外加拉力大部分只是減少板件間的壓力，螺栓本身只多承受一小部分，因此應力變化小、疲勞壽命長。
optionsEn: Any applied tension adds directly to a pretensioned bolt, so pretension gives no benefit.
The stronger the bolt the better, so the highest grade is always safest.

Pretension turns a tension joint into a preloaded spring system of bolt and clamped plies: most of an applied tension only reduces the contact pressure between plies, and the bolt picks up only a small share, so its stress range stays small and fatigue life long.
quiz.explanation: 受拉接頭中的預拉力讓螺栓與被夾板件形成預壓的彈簧系統：外加拉力大部分只是減少板件間的壓力，螺栓本身只多承受一小部分，因此應力變化小、疲勞壽命長；但一旦外力超過分離載重，板件張開，螺栓承受全部外力並可能出現撬力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pretension turns a tension joint into a preloaded spring system of bolt and clamped plies: most of an applied tension only reduces the contact pressure between plies, and the bolt picks up only a small share, so its stress range stays small and fatigue life long; once the load exceeds the separation load, the plies open, the bolt takes the whole load and prying can appear. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預拉力與疲勞、反覆載重：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pretension, fatigue and repeated load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「受拉接頭的螺栓負擔比」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bolt load share in tension joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：螺栓負擔比 C = k_b/(k_b + k_m)。k_m = 4k_b 時 C = 0.2：外力反覆 100 kN 時螺栓只承受 0.2×100 = 20 kN 的變化。初始預拉 T_i = 173 kN，分離載重 P_sep = T_i/(1 − C) = 173/0.8 ≈ 216 kN；超過後螺栓承受全部外力變化。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Bolt load share C = k_b/(k_b + k_m). With k_m = 4k_b, C = 0.2, so a 100 kN cyclic load changes bolt force by only 0.2×100 = 20 kN. With initial pretension T_i = 173 kN the separation load is P_sep = T_i/(1 − C) = 173/0.8 ≈ 216 kN; beyond it the bolt carries the full load change. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：受拉或疲勞接頭的設計要檢查最大外力是否低於分離載重並計算撬力，螺栓應力範圍與疲勞類別比較；現場則確認板件平整、厚度與設計相符，因為板件剛度不足或接觸不良會讓負擔比上升。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Design of tension or fatigue joints should confirm that the peak load stays below separation, compute prying forces and compare the bolt stress range with its fatigue category; on site, confirm that plies are flat and as thick as designed, because flexible or poorly seated plies raise the bolt's load share.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 螺栓負擔比 C = k_b/(k_b + k_m)。k_m = 4k_b 時 C = 0.2：外力反覆 100 kN 時螺栓只承受 0.2×100 = 20 kN 的變化。初始預拉 T_i = 173 kN，分離載重 P_sep = T_i/(1 − C) = 173/0.8 ≈ 216 kN；超過後螺栓承受全部外力變化。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Bolt load share C = k_b/(k_b + k_m). With k_m = 4k_b, C = 0.2, so a 100 kN cyclic load changes bolt force by only 0.2×100 = 20 kN. With initial pretension T_i = 173 kN the separation load is P_sep = T_i/(1 − C) = 173/0.8 ≈ 216 kN; beyond it the bolt carries the full load change. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預拉力與疲勞、反覆載重」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pretension, fatigue and repeated load", which statement holds?
options: 螺栓負擔比 C = k_b/(k_b + k_m)。
每支螺栓只要鎖一次到規定值，整個接頭就一定達到預拉力。
出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。
optionsEn: Bolt load share C = k_b/(k_b + k_m).
Tightening each bolt once to the specified value guarantees the whole joint is pretensioned.
Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site.
quiz.explanation: 螺栓負擔比 C = k_b/(k_b + k_m)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Bolt load share C = k_b/(k_b + k_m). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預拉力與疲勞、反覆載重：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pretension, fatigue and repeated load: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「受拉接頭的螺栓負擔比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bolt load share in tension joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 受拉或疲勞接頭的設計要檢查最大外力是否低於分離載重並計算撬力，螺栓應力範圍與疲勞類別比較；現場則確認板件平整、厚度與設計相符，因為板件剛度不足或接觸不良會讓負擔比上升。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Design of tension or fatigue joints should confirm that the peak load stays below separation, compute prying forces and compare the bolt stress range with its fatigue category; on site, confirm that plies are flat and as thick as designed, because flexible or poorly seated plies raise the bolt's load share. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊掛屋頂、懸吊樓板或設備吊架等受拉關鍵接頭，應以冗餘設計使單一螺栓失效不致連鎖倒塌，並指定為預拉接頭且列入定期檢查清單；設計者須在計算書中寫明分離載重與撬力檢核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Tension-critical joints such as hung roofs, suspended floors or equipment hangers should be redundant so one bolt failure cannot cascade, specified as pretensioned and placed on the periodic inspection list; the designer must record the separation-load and prying checks in the calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若吊架或受拉接頭的螺栓只鎖到密貼而未預拉，每一次風振或載重變化都由螺栓全部承受，螺紋根部很快出現疲勞裂縫；一支螺栓斷裂後，其餘螺栓分擔增加，可能在同一事件中連鎖斷裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If hanger or tension-joint bolts are only snug-tight and not pretensioned, the bolt takes every wind cycle or load change in full and fatigue cracks soon start at the thread root; when one bolt breaks, the others take more load and can fail in a cascade during the same event. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 受拉或疲勞接頭的設計要檢查最大外力是否低於分離載重並計算撬力，螺栓應力範圍與疲勞類別比較；現場則確認板件平整、厚度與設計相符，因為板件剛度不足或接觸不良會讓負擔比上升。
knowledge.textEn: Design of tension or fatigue joints should confirm that the peak load stays below separation, compute prying forces and compare the bolt stress range with its fatigue category; on site, confirm that plies are flat and as thick as designed, because flexible or poorly seated plies raise the bolt's load share.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吊掛屋頂、懸吊樓板或設備吊架等受拉關鍵接頭，應以冗餘設計使單一螺栓失效不致連鎖倒塌，並指定為預拉接頭且列入定期檢查清單；設計者須在計算書中寫明分離載重與撬力檢核。
knowledge.textEn: Tension-critical joints such as hung roofs, suspended floors or equipment hangers should be redundant so one bolt failure cannot cascade, specified as pretensioned and placed on the periodic inspection list; the designer must record the separation-load and prying checks in the calculations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預拉力與疲勞、反覆載重」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pretension, fatigue and repeated load"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
受拉或疲勞接頭的設計要檢查最大外力是否低於分離載重並計算撬力，螺栓應力範圍與疲勞類別比較。
鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Design of tension or fatigue joints should confirm that the peak load stays below separation, compute prying forces and compare the bolt stress range with its fatigue category.
A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening.
quiz.explanation: 受拉或疲勞接頭的設計要檢查最大外力是否低於分離載重並計算撬力，螺栓應力範圍與疲勞類別比較；現場則確認板件平整、厚度與設計相符，因為板件剛度不足或接觸不良會讓負擔比上升。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Design of tension or fatigue joints should confirm that the peak load stays below separation, compute prying forces and compare the bolt stress range with its fatigue category; on site, confirm that plies are flat and as thick as designed, because flexible or poorly seated plies raise the bolt's load share. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預拉力與疲勞、反覆載重：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pretension, fatigue and repeated load: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「受拉接頭的螺栓負擔比」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bolt load share in tension joints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若吊架或受拉接頭的螺栓只鎖到密貼而未預拉，每一次風振或載重變化都由螺栓全部承受，螺紋根部很快出現疲勞裂縫；一支螺栓斷裂後，其餘螺栓分擔增加，可能在同一事件中連鎖斷裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If hanger or tension-joint bolts are only snug-tight and not pretensioned, the bolt takes every wind cycle or load change in full and fatigue cracks soon start at the thread root; when one bolt breaks, the others take more load and can fail in a cascade during the same event. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：1979 年 6 月 4 日 Kansas City 的 Kemper Arena 在約 70 mph 強風與大雨中，屋頂吊架螺栓的強度被低估、積水又增加載重，一支螺栓失效後引發連鎖破壞，約 200×215 ft 的屋頂倒塌。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At Kemper Arena in Kansas City on 4 June 1979, in winds of about 70 mph and heavy rain, the strength of the roof hanger bolts had been underestimated and ponding added load; one bolt gave way, starting a cascade that dropped a roof area of about 200×215 ft.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外加拉力會全部直接加到預拉螺栓上，所以預拉沒有好處。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any applied tension adds directly to a pretensioned bolt, so pretension gives no benefit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若吊架或受拉接頭的螺栓只鎖到密貼而未預拉，每一次風振或載重變化都由螺栓全部承受，螺紋根部很快出現疲勞裂縫；一支螺栓斷裂後，其餘螺栓分擔增加，可能在同一事件中連鎖斷裂。
knowledge.textEn: If hanger or tension-joint bolts are only snug-tight and not pretensioned, the bolt takes every wind cycle or load change in full and fatigue cracks soon start at the thread root; when one bolt breaks, the others take more load and can fail in a cascade during the same event.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預拉力與疲勞、反覆載重」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pretension, fatigue and repeated load" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
螺栓強度越高越好，選用最高等級一定最安全。
若吊架或受拉接頭的螺栓只鎖到密貼而未預拉，每一次風振或載重變化都由螺栓全部承受，螺紋根部很快出現疲勞裂縫。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The stronger the bolt the better, so the highest grade is always safest.
If hanger or tension-joint bolts are only snug-tight and not pretensioned, the bolt takes every wind cycle or load change in full and fatigue cracks soon start at the thread root.
quiz.explanation: 若吊架或受拉接頭的螺栓只鎖到密貼而未預拉，每一次風振或載重變化都由螺栓全部承受，螺紋根部很快出現疲勞裂縫；一支螺栓斷裂後，其餘螺栓分擔增加，可能在同一事件中連鎖斷裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If hanger or tension-joint bolts are only snug-tight and not pretensioned, the bolt takes every wind cycle or load change in full and fatigue cracks soon start at the thread root; when one bolt breaks, the others take more load and can fail in a cascade during the same event. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「螺栓等級、材料與氫脆」與「接觸面處理與孔型」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bolt grades, materials and hydrogen embrittlement" and "Faying-surface preparation and hole types": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 螺栓等級、材料與氫脆：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bolt grades, materials and hydrogen embrittlement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「螺栓等級與鍍鋅限制」如何影響高強度螺栓預拉力施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bolt grades and galvanizing limits” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 結構用高強度螺栓依 ASTM F3125 分為 A325（最低抗拉 120 ksi，約 830 MPa）與 A490（150 ksi，約 1,040 MPa）等級，以及對應的扭剪型螺栓；螺帽與墊圈須搭配相容等級。強度越高的鋼對氫脆越敏感：酸洗、電鍍或熱浸鍍鋅帶入的氫，加上持續高拉應力，可能在鎖緊後數天內造成延遲斷裂，因此 A490 等級不得熱浸鍍鋅。2013 年舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段 288 支直徑 3 in 的錨桿中，最先受拉的 96 支在兩週內有 32 支斷裂，起初即被歸因於氫脆。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「螺栓等級與鍍鋅限制」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Structural high-strength bolts under ASTM F3125 include Grade A325 (minimum tensile 120 ksi, about 830 MPa) and A490 (150 ksi, about 1,040 MPa) with matching twist-off versions, and nuts and washers must be of compatible grades. Higher-strength steel is more sensitive to hydrogen embrittlement: hydrogen from pickling, electroplating or hot-dip galvanizing, combined with sustained high tension, can cause delayed fracture within days of tightening, which is why Grade A490 must not be hot-dip galvanized. In 2013, of the 288 three-inch anchor rods on the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge East Span, 32 of the first 96 to be tensioned broke within two weeks, a failure initially attributed to hydrogen embrittlement. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bolt grades and galvanizing limits” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：最低預拉力 T_b = 0.70·F_u·A_s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Minimum pretension T_b = 0.70·F_u·A_s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「螺栓強度越高越好，選用最高等級一定最安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The stronger the bolt the better, so the highest grade is always safest." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「螺栓等級與鍍鋅限制」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bolt grades and galvanizing limits”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 螺栓等級、材料與氫脆
knowledge.titleEn: Bolt grades, materials and hydrogen embrittlement
knowledge.text: 結構用高強度螺栓依 ASTM F3125 分為 A325（最低抗拉 120 ksi，約 830 MPa）與 A490（150 ksi，約 1,040 MPa）等級，以及對應的扭剪型螺栓；螺帽與墊圈須搭配相容等級。強度越高的鋼對氫脆越敏感：酸洗、電鍍或熱浸鍍鋅帶入的氫，加上持續高拉應力，可能在鎖緊後數天內造成延遲斷裂，因此 A490 等級不得熱浸鍍鋅。
knowledge.textEn: Structural high-strength bolts under ASTM F3125 include Grade A325 (minimum tensile 120 ksi, about 830 MPa) and A490 (150 ksi, about 1,040 MPa) with matching twist-off versions, and nuts and washers must be of compatible grades. Higher-strength steel is more sensitive to hydrogen embrittlement: hydrogen from pickling, electroplating or hot-dip galvanizing, combined with sustained high tension, can cause delayed fracture within days of tightening, which is why Grade A490 must not be hot-dip galvanized.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：螺栓強度越高越好，選用最高等級一定最安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The stronger the bolt the better, so the highest grade is always safest. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「螺栓等級、材料與氫脆」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bolt grades, materials and hydrogen embrittlement" is correct?
options: 結構用高強度螺栓依 ASTM F3125 分為 A325（最低抗拉 120 ksi，約 830 MPa）與 A490（150 ksi，約 1,040 MPa）等級，以及對應的扭剪型螺栓。
螺栓強度越高越好，選用最高等級一定最安全。
接觸面多塗一層油漆可以保護鋼材，對摩擦型接頭沒有影響。
optionsEn: Structural high-strength bolts under ASTM F3125 include Grade A325 (minimum tensile 120 ksi, about 830 MPa) and A490 (150 ksi, about 1,040 MPa) with matching twist-off versions, and nuts and washers must be of compatible grades.
The stronger the bolt the better, so the highest grade is always safest.
An extra coat of paint on faying surfaces protects the steel and has no effect on a slip-critical joint.
quiz.explanation: 結構用高強度螺栓依 ASTM F3125 分為 A325（最低抗拉 120 ksi，約 830 MPa）與 A490（150 ksi，約 1,040 MPa）等級，以及對應的扭剪型螺栓；螺帽與墊圈須搭配相容等級。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Structural high-strength bolts under ASTM F3125 include Grade A325 (minimum tensile 120 ksi, about 830 MPa) and A490 (150 ksi, about 1,040 MPa) with matching twist-off versions, and nuts and washers must be of compatible grades. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 螺栓等級、材料與氫脆：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bolt grades, materials and hydrogen embrittlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螺栓等級與鍍鋅限制」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bolt grades and galvanizing limits” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：最低預拉力 T_b = 0.70·F_u·A_s。7/8 in 螺栓應力面積 A_s = 0.462 in²：A325 為 0.70×120×0.462 ≈ 38.8 kips，取 39 kips（約 173 kN）；A490 為 0.70×150×0.462 ≈ 48.5 kips，取 49 kips（約 218 kN）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Minimum pretension T_b = 0.70·F_u·A_s. For a 7/8 in bolt with stress area A_s = 0.462 in², A325 gives 0.70×120×0.462 ≈ 38.8 kips, tabulated as 39 kips (about 173 kN), and A490 gives 0.70×150×0.462 ≈ 48.5 kips, tabulated as 49 kips (about 218 kN). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：進場時核對螺栓、螺帽與墊圈的製造批號、等級標記與出廠試驗報告，確認組件來自同一批並具相容性；鍍鋅或塗覆組件須確認螺帽潤滑與適用等級，並抽樣做硬度或拉伸試驗；高強度錨桿另須檢查氫脆相關的製程與試驗紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At delivery, check lot numbers, grade markings and mill test reports of bolts, nuts and washers, confirming that assemblies are from matched lots and compatible; for galvanized or coated assemblies confirm nut lubrication and permitted grade and sample for hardness or tensile tests; for high-strength anchor rods also check process and test records related to hydrogen embrittlement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 最低預拉力 T_b = 0.70·F_u·A_s。7/8 in 螺栓應力面積 A_s = 0.462 in²：A325 為 0.70×120×0.462 ≈ 38.8 kips，取 39 kips（約 173 kN）；A490 為 0.70×150×0.462 ≈ 48.5 kips，取 49 kips（約 218 kN）。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Minimum pretension T_b = 0.70·F_u·A_s. For a 7/8 in bolt with stress area A_s = 0.462 in², A325 gives 0.70×120×0.462 ≈ 38.8 kips, tabulated as 39 kips (about 173 kN), and A490 gives 0.70×150×0.462 ≈ 48.5 kips, tabulated as 49 kips (about 218 kN). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「螺栓等級、材料與氫脆」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bolt grades, materials and hydrogen embrittlement", which statement holds?
options: 只要用扭力扳手鎖到規定扭力，就能精確得到設計預拉力。
最低預拉力 T_b = 0.70·F_u·A_s。

Minimum pretension T_b = 0.70·F_u·A_s.

steps.title: 螺栓等級、材料與氫脆：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bolt grades, materials and hydrogen embrittlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「螺栓等級與鍍鋅限制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bolt grades and galvanizing limits” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 進場時核對螺栓、螺帽與墊圈的製造批號、等級標記與出廠試驗報告，確認組件來自同一批並具相容性；鍍鋅或塗覆組件須確認螺帽潤滑與適用等級，並抽樣做硬度或拉伸試驗；高強度錨桿另須檢查氫脆相關的製程與試驗紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At delivery, check lot numbers, grade markings and mill test reports of bolts, nuts and washers, confirming that assemblies are from matched lots and compatible; for galvanized or coated assemblies confirm nut lubrication and permitted grade and sample for hardness or tensile tests; for high-strength anchor rods also check process and test records related to hydrogen embrittlement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要寫明螺栓、螺帽與墊圈的標準與等級、表面處理限制（例如 A490 禁止熱浸鍍鋅）與批號追溯要求；現場不同批次與等級的螺栓須分區存放並保持潤滑與乾燥，未標示的螺栓不得使用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification must name standards and grades for bolts, nuts and washers, coating limits (for example no hot-dip galvanizing of A490) and lot traceability; on site, different lots and grades are stored separately, kept lubricated and dry, and unmarked bolts are never used.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把 A490 螺栓送去熱浸鍍鋅，或在高硬度螺栓上使用電鍍後未除氫，鎖緊後數天在螺紋根部或頭下圓角突然斷裂，斷口平整且無明顯塑性變形；海灣大橋錨桿最後以加裝鞍座的方式補強，2013 年 12 月 19 日正式啟用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Hot-dip galvanizing A490 bolts, or electroplating hard bolts without hydrogen relief, leads to sudden fractures at the thread root or under-head fillet days after tightening, with flat faces and little plastic deformation; the Bay Bridge rods were ultimately bypassed by added saddle assemblies, placed in service on 19 December 2013. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

quiz.question: 要驗證「螺栓等級、材料與氫脆」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。

Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept.
At delivery, check lot numbers, grade markings and mill test reports of bolts, nuts and washers, confirming that assemblies are from matched lots and compatible.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 螺栓等級、材料與氫脆：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bolt grades, materials and hydrogen embrittlement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「螺栓等級與鍍鋅限制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bolt grades and galvanizing limits” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把 A490 螺栓送去熱浸鍍鋅，或在高硬度螺栓上使用電鍍後未除氫，鎖緊後數天在螺紋根部或頭下圓角突然斷裂，斷口平整且無明顯塑性變形；海灣大橋錨桿最後以加裝鞍座的方式補強，2013 年 12 月 19 日正式啟用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Hot-dip galvanizing A490 bolts, or electroplating hard bolts without hydrogen relief, leads to sudden fractures at the thread root or under-head fillet days after tightening, with flat faces and little plastic deformation; the Bay Bridge rods were ultimately bypassed by added saddle assemblies, placed in service on 19 December 2013. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：2013 年舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段 288 支直徑 3 in 的錨桿中，最先受拉的 96 支在兩週內有 32 支斷裂，起初即被歸因於氫脆。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In 2013, of the 288 three-inch anchor rods on the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge East Span, 32 of the first 96 to be tensioned broke within two weeks, a failure initially attributed to hydrogen embrittlement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「螺栓強度越高越好，選用最高等級一定最安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The stronger the bolt the better, so the highest grade is always safest." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把 A490 螺栓送去熱浸鍍鋅，或在高硬度螺栓上使用電鍍後未除氫，鎖緊後數天在螺紋根部或頭下圓角突然斷裂，斷口平整且無明顯塑性變形；海灣大橋錨桿最後以加裝鞍座的方式補強，2013 年 12 月 19 日正式啟用。
knowledge.textEn: Hot-dip galvanizing A490 bolts, or electroplating hard bolts without hydrogen relief, leads to sudden fractures at the thread root or under-head fillet days after tightening, with flat faces and little plastic deformation; the Bay Bridge rods were ultimately bypassed by added saddle assemblies, placed in service on 19 December 2013.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「螺栓等級、材料與氫脆」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bolt grades, materials and hydrogen embrittlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把 A490 螺栓送去熱浸鍍鋅，或在高硬度螺栓上使用電鍍後未除氫，鎖緊後數天在螺紋根部或頭下圓角突然斷裂，斷口平整且無明顯塑性變形。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
接觸面多塗一層油漆可以保護鋼材，對摩擦型接頭沒有影響。
optionsEn: Hot-dip galvanizing A490 bolts, or electroplating hard bolts without hydrogen relief, leads to sudden fractures at the thread root or under-head fillet days after tightening, with flat faces and little plastic deformation.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
An extra coat of paint on faying surfaces protects the steel and has no effect on a slip-critical joint.
quiz.explanation: 把 A490 螺栓送去熱浸鍍鋅，或在高硬度螺栓上使用電鍍後未除氫，鎖緊後數天在螺紋根部或頭下圓角突然斷裂，斷口平整且無明顯塑性變形；海灣大橋錨桿最後以加裝鞍座的方式補強，2013 年 12 月 19 日正式啟用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Hot-dip galvanizing A490 bolts, or electroplating hard bolts without hydrogen relief, leads to sudden fractures at the thread root or under-head fillet days after tightening, with flat faces and little plastic deformation; the Bay Bridge rods were ultimately bypassed by added saddle assemblies, placed in service on 19 December 2013. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 接觸面處理與孔型：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Faying-surface preparation and hole types: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「接觸面噴砂與孔型」如何影響高強度螺栓預拉力施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Blasted faying surfaces and hole types” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 摩擦型接頭的滑動係數取決於接觸面：RCSC 規範把清潔的軋鋼皮面歸為 Class A，平均滑動係數至少 0.30，噴砂清理面歸為 Class B，設計值為 0.50，且設計不得採用大於 0.50 的值；塗裝接觸面必須依附錄的滑動試驗取得等級，鍍鋅接觸面在設計上視為 Class A。孔型也影響抗滑：超大孔與槽孔讓夾緊區域減少、對位誤差增大，須折減強度。接觸面範圍內的油漆噴濺、油污與毛邊都會顯著降低摩擦。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「接觸面噴砂與孔型」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The slip coefficient of a slip-critical joint depends on the faying surface: the RCSC Specification treats clean mill scale as Class A with a mean slip coefficient of at least 0.30 and blast-cleaned steel as Class B with a design value of 0.50, and no design value above 0.50 may be used; coated faying surfaces must earn their class by slip testing per the appendix, and galvanized faying surfaces count as Class A for design. Hole type also matters: oversized and slotted holes reduce the clamped area and allow misalignment, so strength is reduced. Paint overspray, oil and burrs within the faying area cut friction markedly. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Blasted faying surfaces and hole types” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：某支撐續接需傳遞使用剪力 900 kN，7/8 in A325 雙剪面。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A brace splice must carry 900 kN of service shear with 7/8 in A325 bolts in double shear.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接觸面多塗一層油漆可以保護鋼材，對摩擦型接頭沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An extra coat of paint on faying surfaces protects the steel and has no effect on a slip-critical joint." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「接觸面噴砂與孔型」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Blasted faying surfaces and hole types”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接觸面處理與孔型
knowledge.text: 摩擦型接頭的滑動係數取決於接觸面：RCSC 規範把清潔的軋鋼皮面歸為 Class A，平均滑動係數至少 0.30，噴砂清理面歸為 Class B，設計值為 0.50，且設計不得採用大於 0.50 的值；塗裝接觸面必須依附錄的滑動試驗取得等級，鍍鋅接觸面在設計上視為 Class A。孔型也影響抗滑：超大孔與槽孔讓夾緊區域減少、對位誤差增大，須折減強度。

Hole type also matters: oversized and slotted holes reduce the clamped area and allow misalignment, so strength is reduced.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接觸面多塗一層油漆可以保護鋼材，對摩擦型接頭沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An extra coat of paint on faying surfaces protects the steel and has no effect on a slip-critical joint. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接觸面處理與孔型」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Faying-surface preparation and hole types" is correct?
options: 接觸面多塗一層油漆可以保護鋼材，對摩擦型接頭沒有影響。
摩擦型接頭的滑動係數取決於接觸面：RCSC 規範把清潔的軋鋼皮面歸為 Class A，平均滑動係數至少 0.30，噴砂清理面歸為 Class B，設計值為 0.50，且設計不得採用大於 0.50 的值。
每支螺栓只要鎖一次到規定值，整個接頭就一定達到預拉力。

The slip coefficient of a slip-critical joint depends on the faying surface: the RCSC Specification treats clean mill scale as Class A with a mean slip coefficient of at least 0.30 and blast-cleaned steel as Class B with a design value of 0.50, and no design value above 0.50 may be used.
Tightening each bolt once to the specified value guarantees the whole joint is pretensioned.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接觸面處理與孔型：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Faying-surface preparation and hole types: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接觸面噴砂與孔型」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Blasted faying surfaces and hole types” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某支撐續接需傳遞使用剪力 900 kN，7/8 in A325 雙剪面。Class A 每支約 117 kN，需 900/117 ≈ 7.7，取 8 支；Class B 每支約 195 kN，需 900/195 ≈ 4.6，取 5 支；若改用超大孔、強度乘 0.85，Class B 每支約 166 kN，需 5.4，取 6 支。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A brace splice must carry 900 kN of service shear with 7/8 in A325 bolts in double shear. Class A gives about 117 kN per bolt, needing 900/117 ≈ 7.7, so 8 bolts; Class B gives about 195 kN, needing 900/195 ≈ 4.6, so 5 bolts; with oversized holes and a 0.85 factor, Class B gives about 166 kN, needing 5.4, so 6 bolts. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：組立前目視檢查接觸面清潔度與遮蔽範圍，噴砂面以表面粗糙度比對片或量規確認；塗裝接觸面核對塗層型號、膜厚與其滑動試驗報告是否相符，膜厚超過試驗值的部分不得視為同等級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before fit-up, inspect faying surfaces visually for cleanliness and masking extent and check blasted surfaces against a roughness comparator or gauge; for coated faying surfaces, confirm that coating product and film thickness match its slip-test report, since thicker films than tested do not earn the same class.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接觸面處理與孔型」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Faying-surface preparation and hole types", which statement holds?
options: 出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。
鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。
某支撐續接需傳遞使用剪力 900 kN，7/8 in A325 雙剪面。
optionsEn: Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site.
A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening.
A brace splice must carry 900 kN of service shear with 7/8 in A325 bolts in double shear.
quiz.explanation: 某支撐續接需傳遞使用剪力 900 kN，7/8 in A325 雙剪面。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A brace splice must carry 900 kN of service shear with 7/8 in A325 bolts in double shear. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接觸面處理與孔型：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Faying-surface preparation and hole types: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接觸面噴砂與孔型」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Blasted faying surfaces and hole types” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 組立前目視檢查接觸面清潔度與遮蔽範圍，噴砂面以表面粗糙度比對片或量規確認；塗裝接觸面核對塗層型號、膜厚與其滑動試驗報告是否相符，膜厚超過試驗值的部分不得視為同等級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before fit-up, inspect faying surfaces visually for cleanliness and masking extent and check blasted surfaces against a roughness comparator or gauge; for coated faying surfaces, confirm that coating product and film thickness match its slip-test report, since thicker films than tested do not earn the same class. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接觸面在製造廠就以遮蔽膠帶標示並在施工圖註明「接觸面勿塗」，現場組立前由檢驗員簽認接觸面狀態；運輸與吊裝時以覆蓋保護接觸面，受污染者須重新清理至規定等級。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mask faying areas at the shop and mark the shop drawings with a do-not-paint note, and have the inspector sign off faying-surface condition before field fit-up; protect faying areas with covers during shipping and erection, and re-clean any contaminated area to the specified class.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：塗裝工人為了外觀一致，把接觸面一併噴上面漆，或運輸時接觸面沾到油污，Class B 設計的接頭實際只有更低的摩擦，在設計風力或地震下滑動，支撐系統變形增大並使相鄰構件承受額外力量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A painter coating faying areas for a uniform look, or oil picked up in transport, leaves a joint designed for Class B with much lower friction, so it slips under design wind or seismic load, bracing deformations grow and adjacent members pick up extra force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 接觸面在製造廠就以遮蔽膠帶標示並在施工圖註明「接觸面勿塗」，現場組立前由檢驗員簽認接觸面狀態；運輸與吊裝時以覆蓋保護接觸面，受污染者須重新清理至規定等級。

quiz.question: 要驗證「接觸面處理與孔型」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Faying-surface preparation and hole types"?
options: 組立前目視檢查接觸面清潔度與遮蔽範圍，噴砂面以表面粗糙度比對片或量規確認。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
摩擦型接頭的強度主要來自螺栓的剪力強度。
optionsEn: Before fit-up, inspect faying surfaces visually for cleanliness and masking extent and check blasted surfaces against a roughness comparator or gauge.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A slip-critical joint gets its strength mainly from the bolts' shear strength.
quiz.explanation: 組立前目視檢查接觸面清潔度與遮蔽範圍，噴砂面以表面粗糙度比對片或量規確認；塗裝接觸面核對塗層型號、膜厚與其滑動試驗報告是否相符，膜厚超過試驗值的部分不得視為同等級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before fit-up, inspect faying surfaces visually for cleanliness and masking extent and check blasted surfaces against a roughness comparator or gauge; for coated faying surfaces, confirm that coating product and film thickness match its slip-test report, since thicker films than tested do not earn the same class. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接觸面處理與孔型：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Faying-surface preparation and hole types: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接觸面噴砂與孔型」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Blasted faying surfaces and hole types” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 塗裝工人為了外觀一致，把接觸面一併噴上面漆，或運輸時接觸面沾到油污，Class B 設計的接頭實際只有更低的摩擦，在設計風力或地震下滑動，支撐系統變形增大並使相鄰構件承受額外力量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A painter coating faying areas for a uniform look, or oil picked up in transport, leaves a joint designed for Class B with much lower friction, so it slips under design wind or seismic load, bracing deformations grow and adjacent members pick up extra force. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接觸面範圍內的油漆噴濺、油污與毛邊都會顯著降低摩擦。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Paint overspray, oil and burrs within the faying area cut friction markedly.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接觸面多塗一層油漆可以保護鋼材，對摩擦型接頭沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An extra coat of paint on faying surfaces protects the steel and has no effect on a slip-critical joint." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 塗裝工人為了外觀一致，把接觸面一併噴上面漆，或運輸時接觸面沾到油污，Class B 設計的接頭實際只有更低的摩擦，在設計風力或地震下滑動，支撐系統變形增大並使相鄰構件承受額外力量。
knowledge.textEn: A painter coating faying areas for a uniform look, or oil picked up in transport, leaves a joint designed for Class B with much lower friction, so it slips under design wind or seismic load, bracing deformations grow and adjacent members pick up extra force.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接觸面處理與孔型」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Faying-surface preparation and hole types" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
塗裝工人為了外觀一致，把接觸面一併噴上面漆，或運輸時接觸面沾到油污，Class B 設計的接頭實際只有更低的摩擦，在設計風力或地震下滑動，支撐系統變形增大並使相鄰構件承受額外力量。
每支螺栓只要鎖一次到規定值，整個接頭就一定達到預拉力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

A painter coating faying areas for a uniform look, or oil picked up in transport, leaves a joint designed for Class B with much lower friction, so it slips under design wind or seismic load, bracing deformations grow and adjacent members pick up extra force.
Tightening each bolt once to the specified value guarantees the whole joint is pretensioned.
