quiz.explanationEn: A painter coating faying areas for a uniform look, or oil picked up in transport, leaves a joint designed for Class B with much lower friction, so it slips under design wind or seismic load, bracing deformations grow and adjacent members pick up extra force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「密貼與系統化鎖緊順序」與「轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與張力指示墊圈」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Snugging and systematic tightening sequence" and "Turn-of-nut, twist-off bolts and DTIs": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 密貼與系統化鎖緊順序：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Snugging and systematic tightening sequence: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「密貼狀態與鎖緊順序」如何影響高強度螺栓預拉力施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Snug-tight state and tightening sequence” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預拉之前，接頭必須先達到密貼：所有板件緊密接觸，通常由鐵工以一般扳手全力鎖緊或衝擊扳手數次衝擊達成。鎖緊要從接頭最剛硬的部分（通常是中央）往自由邊系統化推進，因為後鎖的螺栓會把板件進一步拉近，使先鎖的螺栓夾緊力下降。板件較厚、層數較多或板面不平時，往往需要多輪鎖緊，才能讓每一支螺栓在最後都達到最低預拉力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「密貼狀態與鎖緊順序」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before pretensioning, a joint must be snug: all plies in firm contact, usually achieved by an ironworker's full effort on an ordinary spanner or a few impacts of an impact wrench. Tightening must progress systematically from the most rigid part of the joint, usually the centre, toward the free edges, because later bolts pull the plies closer and reduce the clamp on bolts tightened earlier. Thick plates, many plies or uneven surfaces often require several passes before every bolt finally reaches minimum pretension. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Snug-tight state and tightening sequence” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若每鎖緊一支相鄰螺栓會使先鎖螺栓損失約 5% 夾緊力，第一輪鎖到 173 kN 的螺栓在其後三支相鄰螺栓鎖緊後剩 173×0.95³ ≈ 148 kN，只有 86%，低於最低預拉力，須再鎖第二輪。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If tightening each neighbouring bolt costs an earlier bolt about 5% of its clamp, a bolt brought to 173 kN in the first pass keeps only 173×0.95³ ≈ 148 kN after three neighbours are tightened, 86% and below minimum pretension, so a second pass is needed.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每支螺栓只要鎖一次到規定值，整個接頭就一定達到預拉力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tightening each bolt once to the specified value guarantees the whole joint is pretensioned." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「密貼狀態與鎖緊順序」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Snug-tight state and tightening sequence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 密貼與系統化鎖緊順序
knowledge.text: 預拉之前，接頭必須先達到密貼：所有板件緊密接觸，通常由鐵工以一般扳手全力鎖緊或衝擊扳手數次衝擊達成。鎖緊要從接頭最剛硬的部分（通常是中央）往自由邊系統化推進，因為後鎖的螺栓會把板件進一步拉近，使先鎖的螺栓夾緊力下降。
knowledge.textEn: Before pretensioning, a joint must be snug: all plies in firm contact, usually achieved by an ironworker's full effort on an ordinary spanner or a few impacts of an impact wrench. Tightening must progress systematically from the most rigid part of the joint, usually the centre, toward the free edges, because later bolts pull the plies closer and reduce the clamp on bolts tightened earlier.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每支螺栓只要鎖一次到規定值，整個接頭就一定達到預拉力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tightening each bolt once to the specified value guarantees the whole joint is pretensioned. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密貼與系統化鎖緊順序」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Snugging and systematic tightening sequence" is correct?
options: 每支螺栓只要鎖一次到規定值，整個接頭就一定達到預拉力。
只要用扭力扳手鎖到規定扭力，就能精確得到設計預拉力。
預拉之前，接頭必須先達到密貼：所有板件緊密接觸，通常由鐵工以一般扳手全力鎖緊或衝擊扳手數次衝擊達成。
optionsEn: Tightening each bolt once to the specified value guarantees the whole joint is pretensioned.
Tightening to a specified torque with a torque wrench gives the design pretension precisely.
Before pretensioning, a joint must be snug: all plies in firm contact, usually achieved by an ironworker's full effort on an ordinary spanner or a few impacts of an impact wrench.
quiz.explanation: 預拉之前，接頭必須先達到密貼：所有板件緊密接觸，通常由鐵工以一般扳手全力鎖緊或衝擊扳手數次衝擊達成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before pretensioning, a joint must be snug: all plies in firm contact, usually achieved by an ironworker's full effort on an ordinary spanner or a few impacts of an impact wrench. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 密貼與系統化鎖緊順序：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Snugging and systematic tightening sequence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「密貼狀態與鎖緊順序」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Snug-tight state and tightening sequence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若每鎖緊一支相鄰螺栓會使先鎖螺栓損失約 5% 夾緊力，第一輪鎖到 173 kN 的螺栓在其後三支相鄰螺栓鎖緊後剩 173×0.95³ ≈ 148 kN，只有 86%，低於最低預拉力，須再鎖第二輪。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If tightening each neighbouring bolt costs an earlier bolt about 5% of its clamp, a bolt brought to 173 kN in the first pass keeps only 173×0.95³ ≈ 148 kN after three neighbours are tightened, 86% and below minimum pretension, so a second pass is needed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：密貼後檢查板件間是否仍有可見縫隙，大型接頭可用塞尺抽查；鎖緊順序寫入安裝程序並由檢驗員抽查觀察，若發現由邊緣往中央鎖或一次鎖完單支，要求重新密貼並依序重做。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After snugging, check for visible gaps between plies, using a feeler gauge on large joints; write the tightening sequence into the installation procedure and have inspectors observe it, requiring re-snugging and a proper sequence if bolts are tightened from the edges inward or one at a time to full tension.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若每鎖緊一支相鄰螺栓會使先鎖螺栓損失約 5% 夾緊力，第一輪鎖到 173 kN 的螺栓在其後三支相鄰螺栓鎖緊後剩 173×0.95³ ≈ 148 kN，只有 86%，低於最低預拉力，須再鎖第二輪。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If tightening each neighbouring bolt costs an earlier bolt about 5% of its clamp, a bolt brought to 173 kN in the first pass keeps only 173×0.95³ ≈ 148 kN after three neighbours are tightened, 86% and below minimum pretension, so a second pass is needed. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「密貼與系統化鎖緊順序」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Snugging and systematic tightening sequence", which statement holds?
options: 若每鎖緊一支相鄰螺栓會使先鎖螺栓損失約 5% 夾緊力，第一輪鎖到 173 kN 的螺栓在其後三支相鄰螺栓鎖緊後剩 173×0.95³ ≈ 148 kN，只有 86%，低於最低預拉力，須再鎖第二輪。
完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。
螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。
optionsEn: If tightening each neighbouring bolt costs an earlier bolt about 5% of its clamp, a bolt brought to 173 kN in the first pass keeps only 173×0.95³ ≈ 148 kN after three neighbours are tightened, 86% and below minimum pretension, so a second pass is needed.
A torque-wrench spot check after completion tells the pretension of each bolt accurately.
Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept.
quiz.explanation: 若每鎖緊一支相鄰螺栓會使先鎖螺栓損失約 5% 夾緊力，第一輪鎖到 173 kN 的螺栓在其後三支相鄰螺栓鎖緊後剩 173×0.95³ ≈ 148 kN，只有 86%，低於最低預拉力，須再鎖第二輪。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If tightening each neighbouring bolt costs an earlier bolt about 5% of its clamp, a bolt brought to 173 kN in the first pass keeps only 173×0.95³ ≈ 148 kN after three neighbours are tightened, 86% and below minimum pretension, so a second pass is needed. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 密貼與系統化鎖緊順序：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Snugging and systematic tightening sequence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「密貼狀態與鎖緊順序」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Snug-tight state and tightening sequence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 密貼後檢查板件間是否仍有可見縫隙，大型接頭可用塞尺抽查；鎖緊順序寫入安裝程序並由檢驗員抽查觀察，若發現由邊緣往中央鎖或一次鎖完單支，要求重新密貼並依序重做。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After snugging, check for visible gaps between plies, using a feeler gauge on large joints; write the tightening sequence into the installation procedure and have inspectors observe it, requiring re-snugging and a proper sequence if bolts are tightened from the edges inward or one at a time to full tension. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：安裝程序應規定密貼與預拉為兩個分開的階段，並把接頭密貼後的檢查列為停留點；厚板或多層板接頭的鎖緊輪數與順序應在首件安裝時以張力量測確認，再推廣到其餘接頭。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The installation procedure should treat snugging and pretensioning as separate stages with a hold point after snugging; for thick or multi-ply joints, confirm the number of passes and sequence on the first joint by tension measurement before applying it to the rest.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：厚板接頭未先全面密貼就直接逐支鎖到最終預拉，先鎖的螺栓在後續鎖緊中被放鬆，接頭中央夾緊力不足；若是轉角法，鬆動後的螺栓已經轉過規定角度，標記看似合格，實際預拉力卻不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Taking bolts in a thick-plate joint one by one to final pretension without first snugging the whole joint loosens the early bolts as later ones are tightened, leaving the joint centre under-clamped; with turn-of-nut, those relaxed bolts have already turned the required angle, so their marks look right while their pretension is short. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 密貼後檢查板件間是否仍有可見縫隙，大型接頭可用塞尺抽查；鎖緊順序寫入安裝程序並由檢驗員抽查觀察，若發現由邊緣往中央鎖或一次鎖完單支，要求重新密貼並依序重做。
knowledge.textEn: After snugging, check for visible gaps between plies, using a feeler gauge on large joints; write the tightening sequence into the installation procedure and have inspectors observe it, requiring re-snugging and a proper sequence if bolts are tightened from the edges inward or one at a time to full tension.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 安裝程序應規定密貼與預拉為兩個分開的階段，並把接頭密貼後的檢查列為停留點；厚板或多層板接頭的鎖緊輪數與順序應在首件安裝時以張力量測確認，再推廣到其餘接頭。
knowledge.textEn: The installation procedure should treat snugging and pretensioning as separate stages with a hold point after snugging; for thick or multi-ply joints, confirm the number of passes and sequence on the first joint by tension measurement before applying it to the rest.

quiz.question: 要驗證「密貼與系統化鎖緊順序」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Snugging and systematic tightening sequence"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
密貼後檢查板件間是否仍有可見縫隙，大型接頭可用塞尺抽查；鎖緊順序寫入安裝程序並由檢驗員抽查觀察，若發現由邊緣往中央鎖或一次鎖完單支，要求重新密貼並依序重做。
外加拉力會全部直接加到預拉螺栓上，所以預拉沒有好處。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
After snugging, check for visible gaps between plies, using a feeler gauge on large joints.
Any applied tension adds directly to a pretensioned bolt, so pretension gives no benefit.
quiz.explanation: 密貼後檢查板件間是否仍有可見縫隙，大型接頭可用塞尺抽查；鎖緊順序寫入安裝程序並由檢驗員抽查觀察，若發現由邊緣往中央鎖或一次鎖完單支，要求重新密貼並依序重做。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After snugging, check for visible gaps between plies, using a feeler gauge on large joints; write the tightening sequence into the installation procedure and have inspectors observe it, requiring re-snugging and a proper sequence if bolts are tightened from the edges inward or one at a time to full tension. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 密貼與系統化鎖緊順序：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Snugging and systematic tightening sequence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密貼狀態與鎖緊順序」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Snug-tight state and tightening sequence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 厚板接頭未先全面密貼就直接逐支鎖到最終預拉，先鎖的螺栓在後續鎖緊中被放鬆，接頭中央夾緊力不足；若是轉角法，鬆動後的螺栓已經轉過規定角度，標記看似合格，實際預拉力卻不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Taking bolts in a thick-plate joint one by one to final pretension without first snugging the whole joint loosens the early bolts as later ones are tightened, leaving the joint centre under-clamped; with turn-of-nut, those relaxed bolts have already turned the required angle, so their marks look right while their pretension is short. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：板件較厚、層數較多或板面不平時，往往需要多輪鎖緊，才能讓每一支螺栓在最後都達到最低預拉力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Thick plates, many plies or uneven surfaces often require several passes before every bolt finally reaches minimum pretension.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每支螺栓只要鎖一次到規定值，整個接頭就一定達到預拉力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tightening each bolt once to the specified value guarantees the whole joint is pretensioned." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 厚板接頭未先全面密貼就直接逐支鎖到最終預拉，先鎖的螺栓在後續鎖緊中被放鬆，接頭中央夾緊力不足；若是轉角法，鬆動後的螺栓已經轉過規定角度，標記看似合格，實際預拉力卻不足。
knowledge.textEn: Taking bolts in a thick-plate joint one by one to final pretension without first snugging the whole joint loosens the early bolts as later ones are tightened, leaving the joint centre under-clamped; with turn-of-nut, those relaxed bolts have already turned the required angle, so their marks look right while their pretension is short.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「密貼與系統化鎖緊順序」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Snugging and systematic tightening sequence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要用扭力扳手鎖到規定扭力，就能精確得到設計預拉力。
厚板接頭未先全面密貼就直接逐支鎖到最終預拉，先鎖的螺栓在後續鎖緊中被放鬆，接頭中央夾緊力不足。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Tightening to a specified torque with a torque wrench gives the design pretension precisely.
Taking bolts in a thick-plate joint one by one to final pretension without first snugging the whole joint loosens the early bolts as later ones are tightened, leaving the joint centre under-clamped.
quiz.explanation: 厚板接頭未先全面密貼就直接逐支鎖到最終預拉，先鎖的螺栓在後續鎖緊中被放鬆，接頭中央夾緊力不足；若是轉角法，鬆動後的螺栓已經轉過規定角度，標記看似合格，實際預拉力卻不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Taking bolts in a thick-plate joint one by one to final pretension without first snugging the whole joint loosens the early bolts as later ones are tightened, leaving the joint centre under-clamped; with turn-of-nut, those relaxed bolts have already turned the required angle, so their marks look right while their pretension is short. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與張力指示墊圈：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Turn-of-nut, twist-off bolts and DTIs: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「螺帽轉角標記與張力指示墊圈」如何影響高強度螺栓預拉力施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Turn-of-nut marks and DTI washers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預拉方法的核心是用可檢查的量取代不可靠的扭力：轉角法在密貼後把螺帽相對螺栓轉過規定角度，以應變控制使螺栓進入非彈性範圍，預拉力穩定；扭剪型螺栓在尾端花鍵被扳手扭斷時達到張力；直接張力指示墊圈的凸點被壓扁到規定間隙，以塞尺判定；另有合併法。RCSC 2025 年版規範撤除了校正扳手法，因為扭力與張力的關係受潤滑、螺紋狀態與溫度影響很大。轉角量依螺栓長度與直徑比而定，例如長度不超過 4 倍直徑時為 1/3 圈。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「螺帽轉角標記與張力指示墊圈」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pretensioning methods replace unreliable torque with checkable quantities: turn-of-nut rotates the nut a specified angle relative to the bolt after snugging, using strain control to push the bolt into the inelastic range for consistent pretension; twist-off tension-control bolts reach tension when the spline end shears off; direct tension indicators have protrusions that flatten to a specified gap judged with a feeler gauge; and a combined method also exists. The 2025 RCSC Specification withdrew the calibrated wrench method, because the torque–tension relation varies greatly with lubrication, thread condition and temperature. Turn-of-nut rotation depends on bolt length relative to diameter, for example 1/3 turn when the length is no more than four diameters. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Turn-of-nut marks and DTI washers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：7/8 in 螺栓每英吋 9 牙，螺距 25.4/9 ≈ 2.82 mm，1/3 圈螺帽前進約 0.94 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 7/8 in bolt has 9 threads per inch, a pitch of 25.4/9 ≈ 2.82 mm, so 1/3 turn advances the nut about 0.94 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要用扭力扳手鎖到規定扭力，就能精確得到設計預拉力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tightening to a specified torque with a torque wrench gives the design pretension precisely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「螺帽轉角標記與張力指示墊圈」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Turn-of-nut marks and DTI washers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與張力指示墊圈
knowledge.text: 預拉方法的核心是用可檢查的量取代不可靠的扭力：轉角法在密貼後把螺帽相對螺栓轉過規定角度，以應變控制使螺栓進入非彈性範圍，預拉力穩定；扭剪型螺栓在尾端花鍵被扳手扭斷時達到張力；直接張力指示墊圈的凸點被壓扁到規定間隙，以塞尺判定；另有合併法。RCSC 2025 年版規範撤除了校正扳手法，因為扭力與張力的關係受潤滑、螺紋狀態與溫度影響很大。
knowledge.textEn: Pretensioning methods replace unreliable torque with checkable quantities: turn-of-nut rotates the nut a specified angle relative to the bolt after snugging, using strain control to push the bolt into the inelastic range for consistent pretension; twist-off tension-control bolts reach tension when the spline end shears off; direct tension indicators have protrusions that flatten to a specified gap judged with a feeler gauge; and a combined method also exists. The 2025 RCSC Specification withdrew the calibrated wrench method, because the torque–tension relation varies greatly with lubrication, thread condition and temperature.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要用扭力扳手鎖到規定扭力，就能精確得到設計預拉力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tightening to a specified torque with a torque wrench gives the design pretension precisely. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與張力指示墊圈」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Turn-of-nut, twist-off bolts and DTIs" is correct?
options: 預拉方法的核心是用可檢查的量取代不可靠的扭力：轉角法在密貼後把螺帽相對螺栓轉過規定角度，以應變控制使螺栓進入非彈性範圍，預拉力穩定。
只要用扭力扳手鎖到規定扭力，就能精確得到設計預拉力。
出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。
optionsEn: Pretensioning methods replace unreliable torque with checkable quantities: turn-of-nut rotates the nut a specified angle relative to the bolt after snugging, using strain control to push the bolt into the inelastic range for consistent pretension.
Tightening to a specified torque with a torque wrench gives the design pretension precisely.
Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site.
quiz.explanation: 預拉方法的核心是用可檢查的量取代不可靠的扭力：轉角法在密貼後把螺帽相對螺栓轉過規定角度，以應變控制使螺栓進入非彈性範圍，預拉力穩定；扭剪型螺栓在尾端花鍵被扳手扭斷時達到張力；直接張力指示墊圈的凸點被壓扁到規定間隙，以塞尺判定；另有合併法。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pretensioning methods replace unreliable torque with checkable quantities: turn-of-nut rotates the nut a specified angle relative to the bolt after snugging, using strain control to push the bolt into the inelastic range for consistent pretension; twist-off tension-control bolts reach tension when the spline end shears off; direct tension indicators have protrusions that flatten to a specified gap judged with a feeler gauge; and a combined method also exists. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與張力指示墊圈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Turn-of-nut, twist-off bolts and DTIs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螺帽轉角標記與張力指示墊圈」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Turn-of-nut marks and DTI washers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：7/8 in 螺栓每英吋 9 牙，螺距 25.4/9 ≈ 2.82 mm，1/3 圈螺帽前進約 0.94 mm。達到 173 kN 時螺栓應力 173,000/298 ≈ 581 MPa、應變約 0.0029，70 mm 有效長度只需伸長約 0.20 mm；轉角提供的位移約為 4.6 倍，因此螺栓進入非彈性範圍，預拉力穩定超過最低值。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 7/8 in bolt has 9 threads per inch, a pitch of 25.4/9 ≈ 2.82 mm, so 1/3 turn advances the nut about 0.94 mm. At 173 kN the bolt stress is 173,000/298 ≈ 581 MPa, a strain of about 0.0029, needing only about 0.20 mm of stretch over a 70 mm effective length; the rotation supplies about 4.6 times that, so the bolt goes inelastic and pretension reliably exceeds the minimum. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：轉角法在密貼後於螺帽、螺栓端與鋼板上畫連續標記，完成後檢查標記錯開的角度；扭剪型螺栓檢查尾端是否扭斷，但須先確認螺栓在扭斷前已密貼；張力指示墊圈以塞尺檢查間隙拒入的數量，並注意墊圈方向與位置是否依規定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For turn-of-nut, draw continuous match marks on nut, bolt end and steel after snugging and check their offset angle afterwards; for twist-off bolts, check that the spline has sheared, having confirmed the joint was snug before shearing; for direct tension indicators, count feeler-gauge refusals and confirm washer orientation and position as specified.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 7/8 in 螺栓每英吋 9 牙，螺距 25.4/9 ≈ 2.82 mm，1/3 圈螺帽前進約 0.94 mm。達到 173 kN 時螺栓應力 173,000/298 ≈ 581 MPa、應變約 0.0029，70 mm 有效長度只需伸長約 0.20 mm；轉角提供的位移約為 4.6 倍，因此螺栓進入非彈性範圍，預拉力穩定超過最低值。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 7/8 in bolt has 9 threads per inch, a pitch of 25.4/9 ≈ 2.82 mm, so 1/3 turn advances the nut about 0.94 mm. At 173 kN the bolt stress is 173,000/298 ≈ 581 MPa, a strain of about 0.0029, needing only about 0.20 mm of stretch over a 70 mm effective length; the rotation supplies about 4.6 times that, so the bolt goes inelastic and pretension reliably exceeds the minimum. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與張力指示墊圈」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Turn-of-nut, twist-off bolts and DTIs", which statement holds?
options: 鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。
7/8 in 螺栓每英吋 9 牙，螺距 25.4/9 ≈ 2.82 mm，1/3 圈螺帽前進約 0.94 mm。
摩擦型接頭的強度主要來自螺栓的剪力強度。
optionsEn: A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening.
A 7/8 in bolt has 9 threads per inch, a pitch of 25.4/9 ≈ 2.82 mm, so 1/3 turn advances the nut about 0.94 mm.
A slip-critical joint gets its strength mainly from the bolts' shear strength.
quiz.explanation: 7/8 in 螺栓每英吋 9 牙，螺距 25.4/9 ≈ 2.82 mm，1/3 圈螺帽前進約 0.94 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 7/8 in bolt has 9 threads per inch, a pitch of 25.4/9 ≈ 2.82 mm, so 1/3 turn advances the nut about 0.94 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與張力指示墊圈：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Turn-of-nut, twist-off bolts and DTIs: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「螺帽轉角標記與張力指示墊圈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Turn-of-nut marks and DTI washers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 轉角法在密貼後於螺帽、螺栓端與鋼板上畫連續標記，完成後檢查標記錯開的角度；扭剪型螺栓檢查尾端是否扭斷，但須先確認螺栓在扭斷前已密貼；張力指示墊圈以塞尺檢查間隙拒入的數量，並注意墊圈方向與位置是否依規定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For turn-of-nut, draw continuous match marks on nut, bolt end and steel after snugging and check their offset angle afterwards; for twist-off bolts, check that the spline has sheared, having confirmed the joint was snug before shearing; for direct tension indicators, count feeler-gauge refusals and confirm washer orientation and position as specified. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每一種預拉方法都要寫成書面安裝程序，包含密貼、標記、鎖緊順序與判定方式，並在開工前以安裝前驗證確認；預拉作業屬鐵工專業工作，人員須受訓並由檢驗員核准，本課只說明檢核邏輯，不構成作業許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write every pretensioning method as a procedure covering snugging, marking, sequence and acceptance, proven by pre-installation verification before work; pretensioning is skilled ironwork requiring trained crews approved by the inspector, and this course explains the checking logic only, not a work permit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：扭剪型螺栓若在接頭尚未密貼時就一次扭斷尾端，扭力大多消耗在拉近板件，螺栓張力不足卻有合格外觀；張力指示墊圈裝反方向或放在轉動側，凸點被磨平而非壓扁，判讀失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If twist-off bolts are sheared in one go before the joint is snug, much of the torque goes into drawing the plies together, leaving low tension behind a passing appearance; a direct tension indicator fitted the wrong way round or under the turned element has its protrusions ground rather than compressed, falsifying the reading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 轉角法在密貼後於螺帽、螺栓端與鋼板上畫連續標記，完成後檢查標記錯開的角度；扭剪型螺栓檢查尾端是否扭斷，但須先確認螺栓在扭斷前已密貼；張力指示墊圈以塞尺檢查間隙拒入的數量，並注意墊圈方向與位置是否依規定。
knowledge.textEn: For turn-of-nut, draw continuous match marks on nut, bolt end and steel after snugging and check their offset angle afterwards; for twist-off bolts, check that the spline has sheared, having confirmed the joint was snug before shearing; for direct tension indicators, count feeler-gauge refusals and confirm washer orientation and position as specified.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每一種預拉方法都要寫成書面安裝程序，包含密貼、標記、鎖緊順序與判定方式，並在開工前以安裝前驗證確認；預拉作業屬鐵工專業工作，人員須受訓並由檢驗員核准，本課只說明檢核邏輯，不構成作業許可。
knowledge.textEn: Write every pretensioning method as a procedure covering snugging, marking, sequence and acceptance, proven by pre-installation verification before work; pretensioning is skilled ironwork requiring trained crews approved by the inspector, and this course explains the checking logic only, not a work permit.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與張力指示墊圈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Turn-of-nut, twist-off bolts and DTIs"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
螺栓強度越高越好，選用最高等級一定最安全。
轉角法在密貼後於螺帽、螺栓端與鋼板上畫連續標記，完成後檢查標記錯開的角度。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The stronger the bolt the better, so the highest grade is always safest.
For turn-of-nut, draw continuous match marks on nut, bolt end and steel after snugging and check their offset angle afterwards.
quiz.explanation: 轉角法在密貼後於螺帽、螺栓端與鋼板上畫連續標記，完成後檢查標記錯開的角度；扭剪型螺栓檢查尾端是否扭斷，但須先確認螺栓在扭斷前已密貼；張力指示墊圈以塞尺檢查間隙拒入的數量，並注意墊圈方向與位置是否依規定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For turn-of-nut, draw continuous match marks on nut, bolt end and steel after snugging and check their offset angle afterwards; for twist-off bolts, check that the spline has sheared, having confirmed the joint was snug before shearing; for direct tension indicators, count feeler-gauge refusals and confirm washer orientation and position as specified. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與張力指示墊圈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Turn-of-nut, twist-off bolts and DTIs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「螺帽轉角標記與張力指示墊圈」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Turn-of-nut marks and DTI washers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 扭剪型螺栓若在接頭尚未密貼時就一次扭斷尾端，扭力大多消耗在拉近板件，螺栓張力不足卻有合格外觀；張力指示墊圈裝反方向或放在轉動側，凸點被磨平而非壓扁，判讀失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If twist-off bolts are sheared in one go before the joint is snug, much of the torque goes into drawing the plies together, leaving low tension behind a passing appearance; a direct tension indicator fitted the wrong way round or under the turned element has its protrusions ground rather than compressed, falsifying the reading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：轉角量依螺栓長度與直徑比而定，例如長度不超過 4 倍直徑時為 1/3 圈。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Turn-of-nut rotation depends on bolt length relative to diameter, for example 1/3 turn when the length is no more than four diameters.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要用扭力扳手鎖到規定扭力，就能精確得到設計預拉力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tightening to a specified torque with a torque wrench gives the design pretension precisely." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 扭剪型螺栓若在接頭尚未密貼時就一次扭斷尾端，扭力大多消耗在拉近板件，螺栓張力不足卻有合格外觀；張力指示墊圈裝反方向或放在轉動側，凸點被磨平而非壓扁，判讀失真。
knowledge.textEn: If twist-off bolts are sheared in one go before the joint is snug, much of the torque goes into drawing the plies together, leaving low tension behind a passing appearance; a direct tension indicator fitted the wrong way round or under the turned element has its protrusions ground rather than compressed, falsifying the reading.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與張力指示墊圈」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Turn-of-nut, twist-off bolts and DTIs" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 扭剪型螺栓若在接頭尚未密貼時就一次扭斷尾端，扭力大多消耗在拉近板件，螺栓張力不足卻有合格外觀；張力指示墊圈裝反方向或放在轉動側，凸點被磨平而非壓扁，判讀失真。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。
optionsEn: If twist-off bolts are sheared in one go before the joint is snug, much of the torque goes into drawing the plies together, leaving low tension behind a passing appearance.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site.
quiz.explanation: 扭剪型螺栓若在接頭尚未密貼時就一次扭斷尾端，扭力大多消耗在拉近板件，螺栓張力不足卻有合格外觀；張力指示墊圈裝反方向或放在轉動側，凸點被磨平而非壓扁，判讀失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If twist-off bolts are sheared in one go before the joint is snug, much of the torque goes into drawing the plies together, leaving low tension behind a passing appearance; a direct tension indicator fitted the wrong way round or under the turned element has its protrusions ground rather than compressed, falsifying the reading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「安裝前驗證試驗」與「施工後檢驗與爭議稽核」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pre-installation verification testing" and "Post-installation inspection and arbitration": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 安裝前驗證試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pre-installation verification testing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「螺栓張力校正器」如何影響高強度螺栓預拉力施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bolt tension calibrator” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 任何預拉方法在現場使用前，都要以同批的螺栓、螺帽與墊圈組件，在液壓式螺栓張力校正器中照實際程序鎖緊，量測得到的張力，確認方法、工具與組件組合能達到規定的最低預拉力並留有餘裕（一般要求至少 1.05 倍）。這項試驗能抓出潤滑不足、批次不符、工具設定錯誤或螺栓太短無法裝入校正器等問題；RCSC 2025 年版另新增了驗證不合格時的處理程序。驗證要在每一批、每一種直徑與長度組合開工時進行。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「螺栓張力校正器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before any pretensioning method is used in the field, assemblies of bolts, nuts and washers from the same lots are tightened by the actual procedure in a hydraulic bolt tension calibrator and the tension measured, confirming that method, tools and assemblies reach the specified minimum pretension with margin, typically at least 1.05 times. The test catches poor lubrication, mismatched lots, wrong tool settings, or bolts too short to fit the calibrator; the 2025 RCSC edition also adds procedures for nonconforming verification tests. Verification is done at the start of work for every lot and every diameter and length combination. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bolt tension calibrator” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：7/8 in A325 最低預拉 173 kN，驗證要求 ≥ 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 7/8 in A325 bolt the minimum pretension is 173 kN and verification requires at least 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「螺栓張力校正器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bolt tension calibrator”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安裝前驗證試驗
knowledge.text: 任何預拉方法在現場使用前，都要以同批的螺栓、螺帽與墊圈組件，在液壓式螺栓張力校正器中照實際程序鎖緊，量測得到的張力，確認方法、工具與組件組合能達到規定的最低預拉力並留有餘裕（一般要求至少 1.05 倍）。這項試驗能抓出潤滑不足、批次不符、工具設定錯誤或螺栓太短無法裝入校正器等問題；RCSC 2025 年版另新增了驗證不合格時的處理程序。
knowledge.textEn: Before any pretensioning method is used in the field, assemblies of bolts, nuts and washers from the same lots are tightened by the actual procedure in a hydraulic bolt tension calibrator and the tension measured, confirming that method, tools and assemblies reach the specified minimum pretension with margin, typically at least 1.05 times. The test catches poor lubrication, mismatched lots, wrong tool settings, or bolts too short to fit the calibrator; the 2025 RCSC edition also adds procedures for nonconforming verification tests.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝前驗證試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pre-installation verification testing" is correct?
options: 出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。
任何預拉方法在現場使用前，都要以同批的螺栓、螺帽與墊圈組件，在液壓式螺栓張力校正器中照實際程序鎖緊，量測得到的張力，確認方法、工具與組件組合能達到規定的最低預拉力並留有餘裕（一般要求至少 1.05 倍）。
完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。
optionsEn: Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site.

Before any pretensioning method is used in the field, assemblies of bolts, nuts and washers from the same lots are tightened by the actual procedure in a hydraulic bolt tension calibrator and the tension measured, confirming that method, tools and assemblies reach the specified minimum pretension with margin, typically at least 1.05 times.
A torque-wrench spot check after completion tells the pretension of each bolt accurately.
quiz.explanation: 任何預拉方法在現場使用前，都要以同批的螺栓、螺帽與墊圈組件，在液壓式螺栓張力校正器中照實際程序鎖緊，量測得到的張力，確認方法、工具與組件組合能達到規定的最低預拉力並留有餘裕（一般要求至少 1.05 倍）。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before any pretensioning method is used in the field, assemblies of bolts, nuts and washers from the same lots are tightened by the actual procedure in a hydraulic bolt tension calibrator and the tension measured, confirming that method, tools and assemblies reach the specified minimum pretension with margin, typically at least 1.05 times. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安裝前驗證試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pre-installation verification testing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螺栓張力校正器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bolt tension calibrator” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：7/8 in A325 最低預拉 173 kN，驗證要求 ≥ 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN。三組試驗得 186、190、179 kN：平均 185 kN，但 179 kN < 181.7 kN，此組合判不合格，須查明潤滑或程序後重做，不能以平均值放行。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 7/8 in A325 bolt the minimum pretension is 173 kN and verification requires at least 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN. Three assemblies give 186, 190 and 179 kN: the average is 185 kN, but 179 kN < 181.7 kN, so the combination fails and lubrication or procedure must be investigated and the test repeated; the average cannot release it. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：張力校正器須在有效期限內校正，試驗由檢驗員在場觀察並記錄批號、直徑、長度、方法、工具設定與每組張力；轉角法驗證同時記錄達到最低張力所需的轉角，扭剪型與指示墊圈則記錄扭斷或間隙判定時的實際張力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The calibrator must be within its calibration period, and the inspector witnesses and records lot numbers, diameter, length, method, tool settings and each tension; for turn-of-nut also record the rotation needed to reach minimum tension, and for twist-off bolts and indicators record the actual tension at shear-off or gap acceptance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 7/8 in A325 最低預拉 173 kN，驗證要求 ≥ 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN。三組試驗得 186、190、179 kN：平均 185 kN，但 179 kN < 181.7 kN，此組合判不合格，須查明潤滑或程序後重做，不能以平均值放行。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 7/8 in A325 bolt the minimum pretension is 173 kN and verification requires at least 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN. Three assemblies give 186, 190 and 179 kN: the average is 185 kN, but 179 kN < 181.7 kN, so the combination fails and lubrication or procedure must be investigated and the test repeated; the average cannot release it. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安裝前驗證試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pre-installation verification testing", which statement holds?
options: 螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。
外加拉力會全部直接加到預拉螺栓上，所以預拉沒有好處。
optionsEn: Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept.
Any applied tension adds directly to a pretensioned bolt, so pretension gives no benefit.
For a 7/8 in A325 bolt the minimum pretension is 173 kN and verification requires at least 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN.
quiz.explanation: 7/8 in A325 最低預拉 173 kN，驗證要求 ≥ 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 7/8 in A325 bolt the minimum pretension is 173 kN and verification requires at least 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安裝前驗證試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pre-installation verification testing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「螺栓張力校正器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bolt tension calibrator” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 張力校正器須在有效期限內校正，試驗由檢驗員在場觀察並記錄批號、直徑、長度、方法、工具設定與每組張力；轉角法驗證同時記錄達到最低張力所需的轉角，扭剪型與指示墊圈則記錄扭斷或間隙判定時的實際張力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The calibrator must be within its calibration period, and the inspector witnesses and records lot numbers, diameter, length, method, tool settings and each tension; for turn-of-nut also record the rotation needed to reach minimum tension, and for twist-off bolts and indicators record the actual tension at shear-off or gap acceptance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把安裝前驗證列為每一批螺栓開工前的停留點，未完成驗證的批次不得發放到工作面；太短而無法放入校正器的螺栓，應依規範採用替代的直接張力量測方法，不能直接免驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make pre-installation verification a hold point before each lot is used, with unverified lots not issued to the work face; bolts too short for the calibrator must be verified by an alternative direct-tension method allowed by the specification, never simply exempted.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若省略安裝前驗證，某批扭剪型螺栓因螺帽潤滑不足，在尾端扭斷時張力只有規定值的七到八成，整座建築數千支螺栓都不足，直到事後抽查才發現，補救需要逐支更換。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping verification can let a lot of twist-off bolts with dry nuts shear at only seventy to eighty percent of required tension, leaving thousands of bolts across a building short until an after-the-fact audit finds them, with bolt-by-bolt replacement as the remedy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 張力校正器須在有效期限內校正，試驗由檢驗員在場觀察並記錄批號、直徑、長度、方法、工具設定與每組張力；轉角法驗證同時記錄達到最低張力所需的轉角，扭剪型與指示墊圈則記錄扭斷或間隙判定時的實際張力。
knowledge.textEn: The calibrator must be within its calibration period, and the inspector witnesses and records lot numbers, diameter, length, method, tool settings and each tension; for turn-of-nut also record the rotation needed to reach minimum tension, and for twist-off bolts and indicators record the actual tension at shear-off or gap acceptance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把安裝前驗證列為每一批螺栓開工前的停留點，未完成驗證的批次不得發放到工作面；太短而無法放入校正器的螺栓，應依規範採用替代的直接張力量測方法，不能直接免驗。
knowledge.textEn: Make pre-installation verification a hold point before each lot is used, with unverified lots not issued to the work face; bolts too short for the calibrator must be verified by an alternative direct-tension method allowed by the specification, never simply exempted.

quiz.question: 要驗證「安裝前驗證試驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pre-installation verification testing"?
options: 張力校正器須在有效期限內校正，試驗由檢驗員在場觀察並記錄批號、直徑、長度、方法、工具設定與每組張力。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
接觸面多塗一層油漆可以保護鋼材，對摩擦型接頭沒有影響。
optionsEn: The calibrator must be within its calibration period, and the inspector witnesses and records lot numbers, diameter, length, method, tool settings and each tension.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An extra coat of paint on faying surfaces protects the steel and has no effect on a slip-critical joint.
quiz.explanation: 張力校正器須在有效期限內校正，試驗由檢驗員在場觀察並記錄批號、直徑、長度、方法、工具設定與每組張力；轉角法驗證同時記錄達到最低張力所需的轉角，扭剪型與指示墊圈則記錄扭斷或間隙判定時的實際張力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 安裝前驗證試驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pre-installation verification testing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「螺栓張力校正器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bolt tension calibrator” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若省略安裝前驗證，某批扭剪型螺栓因螺帽潤滑不足，在尾端扭斷時張力只有規定值的七到八成，整座建築數千支螺栓都不足，直到事後抽查才發現，補救需要逐支更換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping verification can let a lot of twist-off bolts with dry nuts shear at only seventy to eighty percent of required tension, leaving thousands of bolts across a building short until an after-the-fact audit finds them, with bolt-by-bolt replacement as the remedy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗證要在每一批、每一種直徑與長度組合開工時進行。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Verification is done at the start of work for every lot and every diameter and length combination.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若省略安裝前驗證，某批扭剪型螺栓因螺帽潤滑不足，在尾端扭斷時張力只有規定值的七到八成，整座建築數千支螺栓都不足，直到事後抽查才發現，補救需要逐支更換。
knowledge.textEn: Skipping verification can let a lot of twist-off bolts with dry nuts shear at only seventy to eighty percent of required tension, leaving thousands of bolts across a building short until an after-the-fact audit finds them, with bolt-by-bolt replacement as the remedy.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安裝前驗證試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pre-installation verification testing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若省略安裝前驗證，某批扭剪型螺栓因螺帽潤滑不足，在尾端扭斷時張力只有規定值的七到八成，整座建築數千支螺栓都不足，直到事後抽查才發現，補救需要逐支更換。
完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Skipping verification can let a lot of twist-off bolts with dry nuts shear at only seventy to eighty percent of required tension, leaving thousands of bolts across a building short until an after-the-fact audit finds them, with bolt-by-bolt replacement as the remedy.
A torque-wrench spot check after completion tells the pretension of each bolt accurately.
quiz.explanation: 若省略安裝前驗證，某批扭剪型螺栓因螺帽潤滑不足，在尾端扭斷時張力只有規定值的七到八成，整座建築數千支螺栓都不足，直到事後抽查才發現，補救需要逐支更換。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Skipping verification can let a lot of twist-off bolts with dry nuts shear at only seventy to eighty percent of required tension, leaving thousands of bolts across a building short until an after-the-fact audit finds them, with bolt-by-bolt replacement as the remedy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工後檢驗與爭議稽核：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-installation inspection and arbitration: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「稽查扭力與標記檢查」如何影響高強度螺栓預拉力施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arbitration torque and mark checks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預拉螺栓完成後無法直接看出張力，因此檢驗重點在於觀察過程：檢驗員觀察安裝前驗證，並定期觀察鐵工是否依程序密貼、標記與鎖緊，最後檢查轉角標記、扭斷尾端或指示墊圈間隙。若對已安裝螺栓有疑問，可用稽查扭力法：先以同批組件在校正器中求出達到規定張力所需的扭力，再以校正過的扭力扳手檢查現場螺栓是否在該扭力下不再轉動；RCSC 2025 年版新增稽查用扭力扳手的校正要求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「稽查扭力與標記檢查」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Because pretension cannot be seen once a bolt is installed, inspection focuses on observing the process: the inspector witnesses pre-installation verification, periodically watches crews snug, mark and tighten by procedure, and finally checks match marks, sheared splines or indicator gaps. Where installed bolts are in dispute, arbitration torque is used: the torque needed to reach specified tension is found for same-lot assemblies in the calibrator, then a calibrated torque wrench checks whether field bolts resist turning at that torque; the 2025 RCSC edition adds calibration requirements for the arbitration torque wrench. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Arbitration torque and mark checks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：扭力—張力近似 T = K·D·F。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Torque–tension is approximated by T = K·D·F.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A torque-wrench spot check after completion tells the pretension of each bolt accurately." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「稽查扭力與標記檢查」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Arbitration torque and mark checks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工後檢驗與爭議稽核
knowledge.text: 預拉螺栓完成後無法直接看出張力，因此檢驗重點在於觀察過程：檢驗員觀察安裝前驗證，並定期觀察鐵工是否依程序密貼、標記與鎖緊，最後檢查轉角標記、扭斷尾端或指示墊圈間隙。若對已安裝螺栓有疑問，可用稽查扭力法：先以同批組件在校正器中求出達到規定張力所需的扭力，再以校正過的扭力扳手檢查現場螺栓是否在該扭力下不再轉動；RCSC 2025 年版新增稽查用扭力扳手的校正要求。
knowledge.textEn: Because pretension cannot be seen once a bolt is installed, inspection focuses on observing the process: the inspector witnesses pre-installation verification, periodically watches crews snug, mark and tighten by procedure, and finally checks match marks, sheared splines or indicator gaps. Where installed bolts are in dispute, arbitration torque is used: the torque needed to reach specified tension is found for same-lot assemblies in the calibrator, then a calibrated torque wrench checks whether field bolts resist turning at that torque; the 2025 RCSC edition adds calibration requirements for the arbitration torque wrench.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A torque-wrench spot check after completion tells the pretension of each bolt accurately. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工後檢驗與爭議稽核」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-installation inspection and arbitration" is correct?
options: 完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。
鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。
預拉螺栓完成後無法直接看出張力，因此檢驗重點在於觀察過程：檢驗員觀察安裝前驗證，並定期觀察鐵工是否依程序密貼、標記與鎖緊，最後檢查轉角標記、扭斷尾端或指示墊圈間隙。
optionsEn: A torque-wrench spot check after completion tells the pretension of each bolt accurately.
A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening.

Because pretension cannot be seen once a bolt is installed, inspection focuses on observing the process: the inspector witnesses pre-installation verification, periodically watches crews snug, mark and tighten by procedure, and finally checks match marks, sheared splines or indicator gaps.
quiz.explanation: 預拉螺栓完成後無法直接看出張力，因此檢驗重點在於觀察過程：檢驗員觀察安裝前驗證，並定期觀察鐵工是否依程序密貼、標記與鎖緊，最後檢查轉角標記、扭斷尾端或指示墊圈間隙。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Because pretension cannot be seen once a bolt is installed, inspection focuses on observing the process: the inspector witnesses pre-installation verification, periodically watches crews snug, mark and tighten by procedure, and finally checks match marks, sheared splines or indicator gaps. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工後檢驗與爭議稽核：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-installation inspection and arbitration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「稽查扭力與標記檢查」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arbitration torque and mark checks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：扭力—張力近似 T = K·D·F。以同批組件校正得 K = 0.20、D = 22.2 mm、目標 F = 182 kN：稽查扭力 T = 0.20×0.0222×182,000 ≈ 808 N·m。若潤滑改變使 K 落在 0.12 至 0.30，同樣扭力對應的張力差約 2.5 倍，這說明扭力只適合作為同批比較，而不能用來安裝。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Torque–tension is approximated by T = K·D·F. Calibrating same-lot assemblies gives K = 0.20, with D = 22.2 mm and target F = 182 kN, so the arbitration torque is T = 0.20×0.0222×182,000 ≈ 808 N·m. If lubrication shifts K anywhere from 0.12 to 0.30, the same torque implies tensions differing by a factor of 2.5, which is why torque suits same-lot comparison only, not installation. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：稽核時依規範抽取每個接頭一定數量的螺栓，以稽查扭力檢查螺帽是否轉動，若有不合格則擴大抽查到整個接頭並重新鎖緊；所有檢查結果記錄接頭編號、日期、扳手編號與校正紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For arbitration, sample the specified number of bolts in each joint and check whether nuts turn at the arbitration torque; if any fail, extend to the whole joint and retighten, and record joint number, date, wrench number and calibration record for every check.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 扭力—張力近似 T = K·D·F。以同批組件校正得 K = 0.20、D = 22.2 mm、目標 F = 182 kN：稽查扭力 T = 0.20×0.0222×182,000 ≈ 808 N·m。若潤滑改變使 K 落在 0.12 至 0.30，同樣扭力對應的張力差約 2.5 倍，這說明扭力只適合作為同批比較，而不能用來安裝。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Torque–tension is approximated by T = K·D·F. Calibrating same-lot assemblies gives K = 0.20, with D = 22.2 mm and target F = 182 kN, so the arbitration torque is T = 0.20×0.0222×182,000 ≈ 808 N·m. If lubrication shifts K anywhere from 0.12 to 0.30, the same torque implies tensions differing by a factor of 2.5, which is why torque suits same-lot comparison only, not installation. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工後檢驗與爭議稽核」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-installation inspection and arbitration", which statement holds?
options: 扭力—張力近似 T = K·D·F。
摩擦型接頭的強度主要來自螺栓的剪力強度。
螺栓強度越高越好，選用最高等級一定最安全。
optionsEn: Torque–tension is approximated by T = K·D·F.
A slip-critical joint gets its strength mainly from the bolts' shear strength.
The stronger the bolt the better, so the highest grade is always safest.
quiz.explanation: 扭力—張力近似 T = K·D·F。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Torque–tension is approximated by T = K·D·F. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工後檢驗與爭議稽核：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-installation inspection and arbitration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「稽查扭力與標記檢查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arbitration torque and mark checks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 稽核時依規範抽取每個接頭一定數量的螺栓，以稽查扭力檢查螺帽是否轉動，若有不合格則擴大抽查到整個接頭並重新鎖緊；所有檢查結果記錄接頭編號、日期、扳手編號與校正紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For arbitration, sample the specified number of bolts in each joint and check whether nuts turn at the arbitration torque; if any fail, extend to the whole joint and retighten, and record joint number, date, wrench number and calibration record for every check. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢驗計畫要把觀察安裝前驗證與施工中鎖緊列為主要檢驗手段，完工後的稽查扭力只用於爭議處理；稽查扭力扳手須有校正紀錄，判定規則與擴大抽查方式須事先在合約中約定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The inspection plan should make witnessing verification and in-process tightening the primary means, reserving post-installation arbitration torque for disputes; the arbitration wrench must have calibration records, and acceptance and escalation rules must be agreed in the contract beforehand.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若檢驗員只在完工後抽查扭力而沒有觀察安裝過程，且稽查扭力未以同批組件校正，量到的結果可能把合格的轉角法螺栓判為不合格，或把未預拉的螺栓判為合格，引發不必要的爭議或留下隱患。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If inspectors only spot-check torque after completion without observing installation, and the arbitration torque was not calibrated on same-lot assemblies, they may reject good turn-of-nut bolts or accept bolts never pretensioned, creating needless disputes or hidden risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 稽核時依規範抽取每個接頭一定數量的螺栓，以稽查扭力檢查螺帽是否轉動，若有不合格則擴大抽查到整個接頭並重新鎖緊；所有檢查結果記錄接頭編號、日期、扳手編號與校正紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: For arbitration, sample the specified number of bolts in each joint and check whether nuts turn at the arbitration torque; if any fail, extend to the whole joint and retighten, and record joint number, date, wrench number and calibration record for every check.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 檢驗計畫要把觀察安裝前驗證與施工中鎖緊列為主要檢驗手段，完工後的稽查扭力只用於爭議處理；稽查扭力扳手須有校正紀錄，判定規則與擴大抽查方式須事先在合約中約定。
knowledge.textEn: The inspection plan should make witnessing verification and in-process tightening the primary means, reserving post-installation arbitration torque for disputes; the arbitration wrench must have calibration records, and acceptance and escalation rules must be agreed in the contract beforehand.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工後檢驗與爭議稽核」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-installation inspection and arbitration"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
稽核時依規範抽取每個接頭一定數量的螺栓，以稽查扭力檢查螺帽是否轉動，若有不合格則擴大抽查到整個接頭並重新鎖緊。
每支螺栓只要鎖一次到規定值，整個接頭就一定達到預拉力。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
For arbitration, sample the specified number of bolts in each joint and check whether nuts turn at the arbitration torque.
Tightening each bolt once to the specified value guarantees the whole joint is pretensioned.
quiz.explanation: 稽核時依規範抽取每個接頭一定數量的螺栓，以稽查扭力檢查螺帽是否轉動，若有不合格則擴大抽查到整個接頭並重新鎖緊；所有檢查結果記錄接頭編號、日期、扳手編號與校正紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For arbitration, sample the specified number of bolts in each joint and check whether nuts turn at the arbitration torque; if any fail, extend to the whole joint and retighten, and record joint number, date, wrench number and calibration record for every check. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工後檢驗與爭議稽核：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-installation inspection and arbitration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「稽查扭力與標記檢查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Arbitration torque and mark checks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若檢驗員只在完工後抽查扭力而沒有觀察安裝過程，且稽查扭力未以同批組件校正，量到的結果可能把合格的轉角法螺栓判為不合格，或把未預拉的螺栓判為合格，引發不必要的爭議或留下隱患。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If inspectors only spot-check torque after completion without observing installation, and the arbitration torque was not calibrated on same-lot assemblies, they may reject good turn-of-nut bolts or accept bolts never pretensioned, creating needless disputes or hidden risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若對已安裝螺栓有疑問，可用稽查扭力法：先以同批組件在校正器中求出達到規定張力所需的扭力，再以校正過的扭力扳手檢查現場螺栓是否在該扭力下不再轉動；RCSC 2025 年版新增稽查用扭力扳手的校正要求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Where installed bolts are in dispute, arbitration torque is used: the torque needed to reach specified tension is found for same-lot assemblies in the calibrator, then a calibrated torque wrench checks whether field bolts resist turning at that torque; the 2025 RCSC edition adds calibration requirements for the arbitration torque wrench.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A torque-wrench spot check after completion tells the pretension of each bolt accurately." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若檢驗員只在完工後抽查扭力而沒有觀察安裝過程，且稽查扭力未以同批組件校正，量到的結果可能把合格的轉角法螺栓判為不合格，或把未預拉的螺栓判為合格，引發不必要的爭議或留下隱患。
knowledge.textEn: If inspectors only spot-check torque after completion without observing installation, and the arbitration torque was not calibrated on same-lot assemblies, they may reject good turn-of-nut bolts or accept bolts never pretensioned, creating needless disputes or hidden risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工後檢驗與爭議稽核」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-installation inspection and arbitration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。
若檢驗員只在完工後抽查扭力而沒有觀察安裝過程，且稽查扭力未以同批組件校正，量到的結果可能把合格的轉角法螺栓判為不合格，或把未預拉的螺栓判為合格，引發不必要的爭議或留下隱患。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening.

If inspectors only spot-check torque after completion without observing installation, and the arbitration torque was not calibrated on same-lot assemblies, they may reject good turn-of-nut bolts or accept bolts never pretensioned, creating needless disputes or hidden risk.

quiz.explanationEn: If inspectors only spot-check torque after completion without observing installation, and the arbitration torque was not calibrated on same-lot assemblies, they may reject good turn-of-nut bolts or accept bolts never pretensioned, creating needless disputes or hidden risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊」與「螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening" and "Bolting records, traceability and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預拉力鬆弛與腐蝕」如何影響高強度螺栓預拉力施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pretension relaxation and corrosion” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預拉力在使用期間會因為幾個原因下降：螺紋與承壓面的局部嵌入、接觸面厚塗層的潛變、鍍鋅層的蠕變、腐蝕減少有效截面，以及反覆振動造成的鬆動。由於螺栓的軸向勁度很高，被夾區域只要縮短百分之幾毫米，夾緊力就明顯下降。高強度螺栓還可能因環境氫或腐蝕反應而延遲斷裂。維護時常見的問題是是否可以重新鎖緊：A490 與鍍鋅的 A325 螺栓不得重複使用，鬆動的螺栓通常應更換而非直接回鎖。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預拉力鬆弛與腐蝕」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pretension declines in service for several reasons: local embedment at threads and bearing faces, creep of thick coatings on faying surfaces, creep of galvanized layers, corrosion reducing the effective section, and loosening under repeated vibration. Because a bolt is axially very stiff, the clamped zone need only shorten by hundredths of a millimetre for clamp force to drop noticeably. High-strength bolts may also suffer delayed fracture from environmental hydrogen or corrosion reactions. A common maintenance question is whether bolts may be retightened: A490 and galvanized A325 bolts must not be reused, and loose bolts are usually replaced rather than simply retightened. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pretension relaxation and corrosion” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：螺栓軸向勁度 k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm（N/mm 換算）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Bolt axial stiffness k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預拉力鬆弛與腐蝕」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pretension relaxation and corrosion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊
knowledge.text: 預拉力在使用期間會因為幾個原因下降：螺紋與承壓面的局部嵌入、接觸面厚塗層的潛變、鍍鋅層的蠕變、腐蝕減少有效截面，以及反覆振動造成的鬆動。由於螺栓的軸向勁度很高，被夾區域只要縮短百分之幾毫米，夾緊力就明顯下降。
knowledge.textEn: Pretension declines in service for several reasons: local embedment at threads and bearing faces, creep of thick coatings on faying surfaces, creep of galvanized layers, corrosion reducing the effective section, and loosening under repeated vibration. Because a bolt is axially very stiff, the clamped zone need only shorten by hundredths of a millimetre for clamp force to drop noticeably.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening" is correct?
options: 預拉力在使用期間會因為幾個原因下降：螺紋與承壓面的局部嵌入、接觸面厚塗層的潛變、鍍鋅層的蠕變、腐蝕減少有效截面，以及反覆振動造成的鬆動。
鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。
螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。
optionsEn: Pretension declines in service for several reasons: local embedment at threads and bearing faces, creep of thick coatings on faying surfaces, creep of galvanized layers, corrosion reducing the effective section, and loosening under repeated vibration.
A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening.
Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept.
quiz.explanation: 預拉力在使用期間會因為幾個原因下降：螺紋與承壓面的局部嵌入、接觸面厚塗層的潛變、鍍鋅層的蠕變、腐蝕減少有效截面，以及反覆振動造成的鬆動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pretension declines in service for several reasons: local embedment at threads and bearing faces, creep of thick coatings on faying surfaces, creep of galvanized layers, corrosion reducing the effective section, and loosening under repeated vibration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預拉力鬆弛與腐蝕」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pretension relaxation and corrosion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：螺栓軸向勁度 k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm（N/mm 換算）。若接觸面塗層潛變使夾緊長度縮短 0.02 mm，預拉力損失 ΔT = k_b·δ ≈ 851×0.02 ≈ 17 kN，約為 173 kN 的 10%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Bolt axial stiffness k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm. If faying-coating creep shortens the clamped length by 0.02 mm, pretension falls by ΔT = k_b·δ ≈ 851×0.02 ≈ 17 kN, about 10% of 173 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期檢查時以目視與敲擊找出鬆動、缺失或腐蝕的螺栓，關鍵接頭可抽樣以超音波螺栓伸長量測或稽查扭力確認夾緊力；接觸面塗層的潛變特性應在塗層滑動試驗中一併評估，選用通過潛變試驗的產品。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At periodic inspections, find loose, missing or corroded bolts visually and by tapping, and on critical joints sample clamp force by ultrasonic bolt-elongation measurement or arbitration torque; assess creep of faying coatings as part of the coating slip test and select products that pass the creep test.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 螺栓軸向勁度 k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm（N/mm 換算）。若接觸面塗層潛變使夾緊長度縮短 0.02 mm，預拉力損失 ΔT = k_b·δ ≈ 851×0.02 ≈ 17 kN，約為 173 kN 的 10%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Bolt axial stiffness k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm. If faying-coating creep shortens the clamped length by 0.02 mm, pretension falls by ΔT = k_b·δ ≈ 851×0.02 ≈ 17 kN, about 10% of 173 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening", which statement holds?
options: 外加拉力會全部直接加到預拉螺栓上，所以預拉沒有好處。
螺栓軸向勁度 k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm（N/mm 換算）。
接觸面多塗一層油漆可以保護鋼材，對摩擦型接頭沒有影響。
optionsEn: Any applied tension adds directly to a pretensioned bolt, so pretension gives no benefit.
Bolt axial stiffness k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm.
An extra coat of paint on faying surfaces protects the steel and has no effect on a slip-critical joint.
quiz.explanation: 螺栓軸向勁度 k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm（N/mm 換算）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Bolt axial stiffness k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預拉力鬆弛與腐蝕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pretension relaxation and corrosion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期檢查時以目視與敲擊找出鬆動、缺失或腐蝕的螺栓，關鍵接頭可抽樣以超音波螺栓伸長量測或稽查扭力確認夾緊力；接觸面塗層的潛變特性應在塗層滑動試驗中一併評估，選用通過潛變試驗的產品。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At periodic inspections, find loose, missing or corroded bolts visually and by tapping, and on critical joints sample clamp force by ultrasonic bolt-elongation measurement or arbitration torque; assess creep of faying coatings as part of the coating slip test and select products that pass the creep test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊應規定鬆動、缺失或腐蝕螺栓的處理：同時更換螺栓、螺帽與墊圈，依原規格重新驗證與預拉，並確認接觸面狀態；一次更換一支，避免整個接頭同時失去夾緊，必要時由結構工程師指定更換順序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual should set rules for loose, missing or corroded bolts: replace bolt, nut and washer together, re-verify and pretension to the original specification and check the faying surface; replace one bolt at a time so the joint never loses all its clamp, with the structural engineer setting the sequence where needed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在接觸面使用未經滑動與潛變試驗的厚塗層，接頭完工時預拉力合格，數年後夾緊力流失，摩擦型接頭在強風或地震時滑動；海邊環境的螺栓頭與螺紋腐蝕，也可能在檢查前就失去大部分截面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using a thick faying coating never tested for slip and creep leaves pretension correct at completion but lost within a few years, so the slip-critical joint slips in a storm or earthquake; in a marine setting, corrosion of bolt heads and threads can remove most of the section before anyone inspects it. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
