steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期檢查時以目視與敲擊找出鬆動、缺失或腐蝕的螺栓，關鍵接頭可抽樣以超音波螺栓伸長量測或稽查扭力確認夾緊力；接觸面塗層的潛變特性應在塗層滑動試驗中一併評估，選用通過潛變試驗的產品。
knowledge.textEn: At periodic inspections, find loose, missing or corroded bolts visually and by tapping, and on critical joints sample clamp force by ultrasonic bolt-elongation measurement or arbitration torque; assess creep of faying coatings as part of the coating slip test and select products that pass the creep test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護手冊應規定鬆動、缺失或腐蝕螺栓的處理：同時更換螺栓、螺帽與墊圈，依原規格重新驗證與預拉，並確認接觸面狀態；一次更換一支，避免整個接頭同時失去夾緊，必要時由結構工程師指定更換順序。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance manual should set rules for loose, missing or corroded bolts: replace bolt, nut and washer together, re-verify and pretension to the original specification and check the faying surface; replace one bolt at a time so the joint never loses all its clamp, with the structural engineer setting the sequence where needed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要用扭力扳手鎖到規定扭力，就能精確得到設計預拉力。
定期檢查時以目視與敲擊找出鬆動、缺失或腐蝕的螺栓，關鍵接頭可抽樣以超音波螺栓伸長量測或稽查扭力確認夾緊力。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Tightening to a specified torque with a torque wrench gives the design pretension precisely.
At periodic inspections, find loose, missing or corroded bolts visually and by tapping, and on critical joints sample clamp force by ultrasonic bolt-elongation measurement or arbitration torque.
quiz.explanation: 定期檢查時以目視與敲擊找出鬆動、缺失或腐蝕的螺栓，關鍵接頭可抽樣以超音波螺栓伸長量測或稽查扭力確認夾緊力；接觸面塗層的潛變特性應在塗層滑動試驗中一併評估，選用通過潛變試驗的產品。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At periodic inspections, find loose, missing or corroded bolts visually and by tapping, and on critical joints sample clamp force by ultrasonic bolt-elongation measurement or arbitration torque; assess creep of faying coatings as part of the coating slip test and select products that pass the creep test. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預拉力鬆弛與腐蝕」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pretension relaxation and corrosion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在接觸面使用未經滑動與潛變試驗的厚塗層，接頭完工時預拉力合格，數年後夾緊力流失，摩擦型接頭在強風或地震時滑動；海邊環境的螺栓頭與螺紋腐蝕，也可能在檢查前就失去大部分截面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a thick faying coating never tested for slip and creep leaves pretension correct at completion but lost within a few years, so the slip-critical joint slips in a storm or earthquake; in a marine setting, corrosion of bolt heads and threads can remove most of the section before anyone inspects it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：維護時常見的問題是是否可以重新鎖緊：A490 與鍍鋅的 A325 螺栓不得重複使用，鬆動的螺栓通常應更換而非直接回鎖。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A common maintenance question is whether bolts may be retightened: A490 and galvanized A325 bolts must not be reused, and loose bolts are usually replaced rather than simply retightened.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在接觸面使用未經滑動與潛變試驗的厚塗層，接頭完工時預拉力合格，數年後夾緊力流失，摩擦型接頭在強風或地震時滑動；海邊環境的螺栓頭與螺紋腐蝕，也可能在檢查前就失去大部分截面。
knowledge.textEn: Using a thick faying coating never tested for slip and creep leaves pretension correct at completion but lost within a few years, so the slip-critical joint slips in a storm or earthquake; in a marine setting, corrosion of bolt heads and threads can remove most of the section before anyone inspects it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在接觸面使用未經滑動與潛變試驗的厚塗層，接頭完工時預拉力合格，數年後夾緊力流失，摩擦型接頭在強風或地震時滑動。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。
optionsEn: Using a thick faying coating never tested for slip and creep leaves pretension correct at completion but lost within a few years, so the slip-critical joint slips in a storm or earthquake.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept.
quiz.explanation: 在接觸面使用未經滑動與潛變試驗的厚塗層，接頭完工時預拉力合格，數年後夾緊力流失，摩擦型接頭在強風或地震時滑動；海邊環境的螺栓頭與螺紋腐蝕，也可能在檢查前就失去大部分截面。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a thick faying coating never tested for slip and creep leaves pretension correct at completion but lost within a few years, so the slip-critical joint slips in a storm or earthquake; in a marine setting, corrosion of bolt heads and threads can remove most of the section before anyone inspects it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bolting records, traceability and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「批號、驗證紀錄與螺栓圖」如何影響高強度螺栓預拉力施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lots, verification records and bolt map” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鉚接時代的接頭一旦完成就幾乎無法調整，雪梨港灣大橋以約六百萬支手工鉚釘接合，最大的一支重 3.5 kg、長 39.5 cm；高強度螺栓接頭則可以檢查、更換與重新預拉，但前提是紀錄完整。交接文件要讓維護人員知道：哪些接頭是摩擦型或預拉型、使用哪個等級與批號、採用何種預拉方法、安裝前驗證與稽核結果、曾經有哪些不符合項目與更換。沒有這些紀錄，任何一支斷裂螺栓都無法判斷是單一事件還是整批問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「批號、驗證紀錄與螺栓圖」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Riveted joints were practically unadjustable once made, and Sydney Harbour Bridge is held together by about six million hand-driven rivets, the largest weighing 3.5 kg and 39.5 cm long; high-strength bolted joints can be inspected, replaced and re-pretensioned, but only if the records are complete. Handover documents must tell maintainers which joints are slip-critical or pretensioned, which grade and lot was used, which pretensioning method, the verification and audit results, and any nonconformances and replacements. Without these records, nobody can tell whether a broken bolt is an isolated event or a lot-wide problem. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lots, verification records and bolt map” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若隨機有 0.5% 螺栓預拉不足，一個 8 支螺栓的接頭至少有一支不足的機率 = 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%；全結構 1,500 個接頭約有 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 個接頭含不足螺栓。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If 0.5% of bolts are randomly under-tensioned, the chance that an 8-bolt joint has at least one is 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%; across 1,500 joints, about 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 joints contain a deficient bolt.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「批號、驗證紀錄與螺栓圖」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lots, verification records and bolt map”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接
knowledge.text: 鉚接時代的接頭一旦完成就幾乎無法調整，雪梨港灣大橋以約六百萬支手工鉚釘接合，最大的一支重 3.5 kg、長 39.5 cm；高強度螺栓接頭則可以檢查、更換與重新預拉，但前提是紀錄完整。交接文件要讓維護人員知道：哪些接頭是摩擦型或預拉型、使用哪個等級與批號、採用何種預拉方法、安裝前驗證與稽核結果、曾經有哪些不符合項目與更換。
knowledge.textEn: Riveted joints were practically unadjustable once made, and Sydney Harbour Bridge is held together by about six million hand-driven rivets, the largest weighing 3.5 kg and 39.5 cm long; high-strength bolted joints can be inspected, replaced and re-pretensioned, but only if the records are complete. Handover documents must tell maintainers which joints are slip-critical or pretensioned, which grade and lot was used, which pretensioning method, the verification and audit results, and any nonconformances and replacements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bolting records, traceability and handover" is correct?
options: 螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。
鉚接時代的接頭一旦完成就幾乎無法調整，雪梨港灣大橋以約六百萬支手工鉚釘接合，最大的一支重 3.5 kg、長 39.5 cm。
摩擦型接頭的強度主要來自螺栓的剪力強度。
optionsEn: Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept.
Riveted joints were practically unadjustable once made, and Sydney Harbour Bridge is held together by about six million hand-driven rivets, the largest weighing 3.5 kg and 39.5 cm long.
A slip-critical joint gets its strength mainly from the bolts' shear strength.
quiz.explanation: 鉚接時代的接頭一旦完成就幾乎無法調整，雪梨港灣大橋以約六百萬支手工鉚釘接合，最大的一支重 3.5 kg、長 39.5 cm；高強度螺栓接頭則可以檢查、更換與重新預拉，但前提是紀錄完整。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Riveted joints were practically unadjustable once made, and Sydney Harbour Bridge is held together by about six million hand-driven rivets, the largest weighing 3.5 kg and 39.5 cm long; high-strength bolted joints can be inspected, replaced and re-pretensioned, but only if the records are complete. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bolting records, traceability and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「批號、驗證紀錄與螺栓圖」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lots, verification records and bolt map” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若隨機有 0.5% 螺栓預拉不足，一個 8 支螺栓的接頭至少有一支不足的機率 = 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%；全結構 1,500 個接頭約有 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 個接頭含不足螺栓。這說明稽核抽樣應以接頭為單位，並以批號紀錄追查集中問題。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If 0.5% of bolts are randomly under-tensioned, the chance that an 8-bolt joint has at least one is 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%; across 1,500 joints, about 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 joints contain a deficient bolt. Audit samples should therefore be drawn by joint, with lot records used to trace clustered problems. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前抽查數個接頭，從現場螺栓的等級標記追溯到進料批號、出廠證明、安裝前驗證紀錄與檢驗報告，確認紀錄鏈完整；並確認螺栓配置圖標示所有摩擦型接頭、接觸面等級與曾經更換的位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, sample several joints and trace bolt grade markings back to delivery lots, mill certificates, verification records and inspection reports to confirm an unbroken chain; confirm that the bolt layout drawing marks every slip-critical joint, its faying-surface class and every replaced location.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若隨機有 0.5% 螺栓預拉不足，一個 8 支螺栓的接頭至少有一支不足的機率 = 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%；全結構 1,500 個接頭約有 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 個接頭含不足螺栓。這說明稽核抽樣應以接頭為單位，並以批號紀錄追查集中問題。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If 0.5% of bolts are randomly under-tensioned, the chance that an 8-bolt joint has at least one is 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%; across 1,500 joints, about 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 joints contain a deficient bolt. Audit samples should therefore be drawn by joint, with lot records used to trace clustered problems. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bolting records, traceability and handover", which statement holds?
options: 螺栓強度越高越好，選用最高等級一定最安全。
每支螺栓只要鎖一次到規定值，整個接頭就一定達到預拉力。
若隨機有 0.5% 螺栓預拉不足，一個 8 支螺栓的接頭至少有一支不足的機率 = 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%。
optionsEn: The stronger the bolt the better, so the highest grade is always safest.
Tightening each bolt once to the specified value guarantees the whole joint is pretensioned.
If 0.5% of bolts are randomly under-tensioned, the chance that an 8-bolt joint has at least one is 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%.
quiz.explanation: 若隨機有 0.5% 螺栓預拉不足，一個 8 支螺栓的接頭至少有一支不足的機率 = 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%；全結構 1,500 個接頭約有 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 個接頭含不足螺栓。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If 0.5% of bolts are randomly under-tensioned, the chance that an 8-bolt joint has at least one is 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%; across 1,500 joints, about 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 joints contain a deficient bolt. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bolting records, traceability and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「批號、驗證紀錄與螺栓圖」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lots, verification records and bolt map” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前抽查數個接頭，從現場螺栓的等級標記追溯到進料批號、出廠證明、安裝前驗證紀錄與檢驗報告，確認紀錄鏈完整；並確認螺栓配置圖標示所有摩擦型接頭、接觸面等級與曾經更換的位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, sample several joints and trace bolt grade markings back to delivery lots, mill certificates, verification records and inspection reports to confirm an unbroken chain; confirm that the bolt layout drawing marks every slip-critical joint, its faying-surface class and every replaced location. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約應要求以數位格式交付螺栓批號與使用位置對照、安裝前驗證與稽核紀錄、不符合項目處理與螺栓配置圖；業主的維護手冊要列出關鍵受拉與摩擦型接頭的檢查週期，並指定由誰判定是否需要更換。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The contract should require digital delivery of lot-to-location records, verification and audit records, nonconformance dispositions and the bolt layout drawing; the owner's maintenance manual should list inspection intervals for critical tension and slip-critical joints and name who decides on replacement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交接時只留下「螺栓已依規範施工」的結論，多年後在某接頭發現延遲斷裂的螺栓，業主無法知道同批螺栓還用在哪裡，只能全面檢查或大量更換，成本與停用時間都大幅增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If handover leaves only a statement that bolting met the specification, an owner who finds a delayed-fracture bolt years later cannot know where else that lot was used and must inspect or replace across the structure, at much greater cost and downtime. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前抽查數個接頭，從現場螺栓的等級標記追溯到進料批號、出廠證明、安裝前驗證紀錄與檢驗報告，確認紀錄鏈完整；並確認螺栓配置圖標示所有摩擦型接頭、接觸面等級與曾經更換的位置。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover, sample several joints and trace bolt grade markings back to delivery lots, mill certificates, verification records and inspection reports to confirm an unbroken chain; confirm that the bolt layout drawing marks every slip-critical joint, its faying-surface class and every replaced location.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合約應要求以數位格式交付螺栓批號與使用位置對照、安裝前驗證與稽核紀錄、不符合項目處理與螺栓配置圖；業主的維護手冊要列出關鍵受拉與摩擦型接頭的檢查週期，並指定由誰判定是否需要更換。
knowledge.textEn: The contract should require digital delivery of lot-to-location records, verification and audit records, nonconformance dispositions and the bolt layout drawing; the owner's maintenance manual should list inspection intervals for critical tension and slip-critical joints and name who decides on replacement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bolting records, traceability and handover"?
options: 交接前抽查數個接頭，從現場螺栓的等級標記追溯到進料批號、出廠證明、安裝前驗證紀錄與檢驗報告，確認紀錄鏈完整。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。
optionsEn: Before handover, sample several joints and trace bolt grade markings back to delivery lots, mill certificates, verification records and inspection reports to confirm an unbroken chain.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site.
quiz.explanation: 交接前抽查數個接頭，從現場螺栓的等級標記追溯到進料批號、出廠證明、安裝前驗證紀錄與檢驗報告，確認紀錄鏈完整；並確認螺栓配置圖標示所有摩擦型接頭、接觸面等級與曾經更換的位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover, sample several joints and trace bolt grade markings back to delivery lots, mill certificates, verification records and inspection reports to confirm an unbroken chain; confirm that the bolt layout drawing marks every slip-critical joint, its faying-surface class and every replaced location. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bolting records, traceability and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「批號、驗證紀錄與螺栓圖」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lots, verification records and bolt map” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交接時只留下「螺栓已依規範施工」的結論，多年後在某接頭發現延遲斷裂的螺栓，業主無法知道同批螺栓還用在哪裡，只能全面檢查或大量更換，成本與停用時間都大幅增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If handover leaves only a statement that bolting met the specification, an owner who finds a delayed-fracture bolt years later cannot know where else that lot was used and must inspect or replace across the structure, at much greater cost and downtime. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沒有這些紀錄，任何一支斷裂螺栓都無法判斷是單一事件還是整批問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without these records, nobody can tell whether a broken bolt is an isolated event or a lot-wide problem.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若交接時只留下「螺栓已依規範施工」的結論，多年後在某接頭發現延遲斷裂的螺栓，業主無法知道同批螺栓還用在哪裡，只能全面檢查或大量更換，成本與停用時間都大幅增加。
knowledge.textEn: If handover leaves only a statement that bolting met the specification, an owner who finds a delayed-fracture bolt years later cannot know where else that lot was used and must inspect or replace across the structure, at much greater cost and downtime.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bolting records, traceability and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若交接時只留下「螺栓已依規範施工」的結論，多年後在某接頭發現延遲斷裂的螺栓，業主無法知道同批螺栓還用在哪裡，只能全面檢查或大量更換，成本與停用時間都大幅增加。
摩擦型接頭的強度主要來自螺栓的剪力強度。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

If handover leaves only a statement that bolting met the specification, an owner who finds a delayed-fracture bolt years later cannot know where else that lot was used and must inspect or replace across the structure, at much greater cost and downtime.
A slip-critical joint gets its strength mainly from the bolts' shear strength.
quiz.explanation: 若交接時只留下「螺栓已依規範施工」的結論，多年後在某接頭發現延遲斷裂的螺栓，業主無法知道同批螺栓還用在哪裡，只能全面檢查或大量更換，成本與停用時間都大幅增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If handover leaves only a statement that bolting met the specification, an owner who finds a delayed-fracture bolt years later cannot know where else that lot was used and must inspect or replace across the structure, at much greater cost and downtime. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 組合樓板剪力釘焊接
titleEn: Stud welding for composite floor systems
summary: 從組合梁介面的水平剪力流與部分組合出發，說明頭釘強度與壓型鋼板肋的折減、穿板焊接的電流與環境條件、首件 30° 彎曲試驗與外觀檢查、推出試驗求取剪力釘強度，以及火災溫度效應與改修時的紀錄需求，並以 NIST 對世界貿易中心七號樓組合樓板的調查、雙子塔以桁架「指節」取得組合作用的樓板，以及英國鋼結構協會對穿板焊接的說明為依據。
summaryEn: Starting from horizontal shear flow and partial composite action at the beam–slab interface, explain headed-stud strength and its reduction in deck ribs, current and site conditions for through-deck welding, first-stud 30° bend tests and visual checks, push-out tests for stud resistance, and fire and thermal effects and record-keeping for alterations, drawing on NIST's investigation of the composite floors of 7 World Trade Center, the Twin Towers' floors made composite by truss knuckles, and steel-industry guidance on through-deck welding.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
subcategoryTitleEn: Concrete and steel construction technology

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：12 m 簡支組合梁 W460×60（A_s = 7,590 mm²、F_y = 345 MPa），梁距 3 m，76 mm 高的壓型鋼板橫向鋪設、肋距 300 mm，樓板總厚 140 mm、f′c = 28 MPa，使用 19 mm 頭釘（F_u = 450 MPa）。(1) 完全組合所需剪力 C = min(7,590×345, 0.85×28×3,000×64) ≈ min(2,619, 4,570) = 2,619 kN。(2) 每肋 1 支、弱位置：Q_n = 0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN，半跨 20 個肋 ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN，組合比 58%；I_eff ≈ 255 + √0.58×(700 − 255) ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴，約為完全組合的 85%。(3) 焊後長度 125 mm，高出肋頂 49 mm，保護層 15 mm，皆滿足要求。(4) 若改變一個輸入：剪力釘全部焊在強位置（R_p = 0.75），每支約 95.7 kN，ΣQ_n ≈ 1,914 kN，組合比提高到約 73%，不必增加剪力釘數量就提高勁度與強度。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 12 m simply supported composite beam W460×60 (A_s = 7,590 mm², F_y = 345 MPa) at 3 m spacing carries a slab 140 mm thick on transverse 76 mm deck with ribs at 300 mm and f′c = 28 MPa, using 19 mm headed studs (F_u = 450 MPa). (1) Full composite shear C = min(7,590×345, 0.85×28×3,000×64) ≈ min(2,619, 4,570) = 2,619 kN. (2) One weak-position stud per rib: Q_n = 0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN, and 20 ribs per half span give ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN, a 58% ratio; I_eff ≈ 255 + √0.58×(700 − 255) ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴, about 85% of full composite. (3) The welded stud of 125 mm projects 49 mm above the rib with 15 mm of cover, both acceptable. (4) Changing one input: welding every stud in the strong position (R_p = 0.75) gives about 95.7 kN each, ΣQ_n ≈ 1,914 kN and a ratio of about 73%, raising stiffness and strength without adding studs. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「組合梁的水平剪力流」與「部分組合、勁度與使用性」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Horizontal shear flow in composite beams" and "Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 組合梁的水平剪力流：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Horizontal shear flow in composite beams: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam–slab interface shear” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼梁上的混凝土樓板若只是放在梁上，兩者各自彎曲，接觸面會相對滑動；焊在上翼板的剪力釘阻止滑動，讓樓板成為受壓翼緣、鋼梁成為受拉部分，斷面像一根更深的梁，強度與勁度都大幅提高。剪力釘要傳遞的是從零彎矩點到最大彎矩點之間的水平剪力總和，等於混凝土受壓合力與鋼梁受拉合力中較小者。剪力釘數量不足時，梁只能部分組合，強度與勁度介於純鋼梁與完全組合之間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A concrete slab merely resting on a steel beam bends separately and slips along the interface; studs welded to the top flange prevent this slip so the slab becomes a compression flange and the steel a tension zone, behaving like a much deeper beam with far greater strength and stiffness. The studs must carry the total horizontal shear between the points of zero and maximum moment, equal to the smaller of the concrete compression force and the steel tension force. With too few studs, the beam is only partially composite, with strength and stiffness between those of the bare steel and full composite action. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Beam–slab interface shear” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Beam–slab interface shear”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 組合梁的水平剪力流
knowledge.titleEn: Horizontal shear flow in composite beams
knowledge.text: 鋼梁上的混凝土樓板若只是放在梁上，兩者各自彎曲，接觸面會相對滑動；焊在上翼板的剪力釘阻止滑動，讓樓板成為受壓翼緣、鋼梁成為受拉部分，斷面像一根更深的梁，強度與勁度都大幅提高。剪力釘要傳遞的是從零彎矩點到最大彎矩點之間的水平剪力總和，等於混凝土受壓合力與鋼梁受拉合力中較小者。
knowledge.textEn: A concrete slab merely resting on a steel beam bends separately and slips along the interface; studs welded to the top flange prevent this slip so the slab becomes a compression flange and the steel a tension zone, behaving like a much deeper beam with far greater strength and stiffness. The studs must carry the total horizontal shear between the points of zero and maximum moment, equal to the smaller of the concrete compression force and the steel tension force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「組合梁的水平剪力流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Horizontal shear flow in composite beams" is correct?
options: 混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。
鋼梁上的混凝土樓板若只是放在梁上，兩者各自彎曲，接觸面會相對滑動。
部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。
optionsEn: A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it.
A concrete slab merely resting on a steel beam bends separately and slips along the interface.
Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration.
quiz.explanation: 鋼梁上的混凝土樓板若只是放在梁上，兩者各自彎曲，接觸面會相對滑動；焊在上翼板的剪力釘阻止滑動，讓樓板成為受壓翼緣、鋼梁成為受拉部分，斷面像一根更深的梁，強度與勁度都大幅提高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A concrete slab merely resting on a steel beam bends separately and slips along the interface; studs welded to the top flange prevent this slip so the slab becomes a compression flange and the steel a tension zone, behaving like a much deeper beam with far greater strength and stiffness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 組合梁的水平剪力流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Horizontal shear flow in composite beams: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam–slab interface shear” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c)。W460×60 鋼梁 A_s = 7,590 mm²、F_y = 345 MPa：A_s·F_y ≈ 2,619 kN；樓板有效寬 3,000 mm、肋上混凝土厚 64 mm、f′c = 28 MPa：0.85×28×3,000×64 ≈ 4,570 kN，取 C = 2,619 kN，即半跨內剪力釘須傳遞約 2,619 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c). For a W460×60 beam with A_s = 7,590 mm² and F_y = 345 MPa, A_s·F_y ≈ 2,619 kN; a slab of 3,000 mm effective width with 64 mm of concrete above the ribs and f′c = 28 MPa gives 0.85×28×3,000×64 ≈ 4,570 kN, so C = 2,619 kN, the force the studs in each half span must transfer. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計審查時核對每根組合梁的剪力釘數量、間距與分布是否滿足半跨剪力總和，並檢查集中載重或開口附近的剪力釘是否足夠；施工圖須以每根梁的剪力釘數量標示，現場以清點方式核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In design review, check that each composite beam's stud count, spacing and distribution satisfy the half-span shear total and that studs are sufficient near concentrated loads and openings; shop drawings must give the stud count for each beam, checked on site by counting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c)。W460×60 鋼梁 A_s = 7,590 mm²、F_y = 345 MPa：A_s·F_y ≈ 2,619 kN；樓板有效寬 3,000 mm、肋上混凝土厚 64 mm、f′c = 28 MPa：0.85×28×3,000×64 ≈ 4,570 kN，取 C = 2,619 kN，即半跨內剪力釘須傳遞約 2,619 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c). For a W460×60 beam with A_s = 7,590 mm² and F_y = 345 MPa, A_s·F_y ≈ 2,619 kN; a slab of 3,000 mm effective width with 64 mm of concrete above the ribs and f′c = 28 MPa gives 0.85×28×3,000×64 ≈ 4,570 kN, so C = 2,619 kN, the force the studs in each half span must transfer. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「組合梁的水平剪力流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Horizontal shear flow in composite beams", which statement holds?
options: 只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。
被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。
C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c)。
optionsEn: If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam.
A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded.
C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c).
quiz.explanation: C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 組合梁的水平剪力流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Horizontal shear flow in composite beams: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Beam–slab interface shear” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計審查時核對每根組合梁的剪力釘數量、間距與分布是否滿足半跨剪力總和，並檢查集中載重或開口附近的剪力釘是否足夠；施工圖須以每根梁的剪力釘數量標示，現場以清點方式核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In design review, check that each composite beam's stud count, spacing and distribution satisfy the half-span shear total and that studs are sufficient near concentrated loads and openings; shop drawings must give the stud count for each beam, checked on site by counting. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構圖應在每根組合梁旁標示剪力釘數量與排列（單排、雙排、每肋支數），並註明是否為完全或部分組合；施工中若肋位與設計不符，須由結構工程師重新核算，而不是由現場自行減少。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Structural drawings should note stud number and arrangement (single or double row, studs per rib) beside each composite beam and say whether it is fully or partially composite; if rib positions differ from design, the structural engineer re-checks, rather than the site reducing studs on its own.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若施工時因壓型鋼板肋位不合或趕工而少焊剪力釘，梁在使用載重下仍看似正常，但撓度與振動比設計大，極限狀態下介面滑動使強度不足；事後補焊需要打除樓板，代價極高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If studs are omitted because rib positions do not match or work is rushed, the beam looks normal in service but deflects and vibrates more than designed, and at ultimate load interface slip leaves it short of strength; adding studs afterwards means breaking out the slab at great cost. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計審查時核對每根組合梁的剪力釘數量、間距與分布是否滿足半跨剪力總和，並檢查集中載重或開口附近的剪力釘是否足夠；施工圖須以每根梁的剪力釘數量標示，現場以清點方式核對。
knowledge.textEn: In design review, check that each composite beam's stud count, spacing and distribution satisfy the half-span shear total and that studs are sufficient near concentrated loads and openings; shop drawings must give the stud count for each beam, checked on site by counting.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構圖應在每根組合梁旁標示剪力釘數量與排列（單排、雙排、每肋支數），並註明是否為完全或部分組合；施工中若肋位與設計不符，須由結構工程師重新核算，而不是由現場自行減少。
knowledge.textEn: Structural drawings should note stud number and arrangement (single or double row, studs per rib) beside each composite beam and say whether it is fully or partially composite; if rib positions differ from design, the structural engineer re-checks, rather than the site reducing studs on its own.

quiz.question: 要驗證「組合梁的水平剪力流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Horizontal shear flow in composite beams"?
options: 設計審查時核對每根組合梁的剪力釘數量、間距與分布是否滿足半跨剪力總和，並檢查集中載重或開口附近的剪力釘是否足夠。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。
optionsEn: In design review, check that each composite beam's stud count, spacing and distribution satisfy the half-span shear total and that studs are sufficient near concentrated loads and openings.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape.
quiz.explanation: 設計審查時核對每根組合梁的剪力釘數量、間距與分布是否滿足半跨剪力總和，並檢查集中載重或開口附近的剪力釘是否足夠；施工圖須以每根梁的剪力釘數量標示，現場以清點方式核對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In design review, check that each composite beam's stud count, spacing and distribution satisfy the half-span shear total and that studs are sufficient near concentrated loads and openings; shop drawings must give the stud count for each beam, checked on site by counting. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 組合梁的水平剪力流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Horizontal shear flow in composite beams: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Beam–slab interface shear” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若施工時因壓型鋼板肋位不合或趕工而少焊剪力釘，梁在使用載重下仍看似正常，但撓度與振動比設計大，極限狀態下介面滑動使強度不足；事後補焊需要打除樓板，代價極高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If studs are omitted because rib positions do not match or work is rushed, the beam looks normal in service but deflects and vibrates more than designed, and at ultimate load interface slip leaves it short of strength; adding studs afterwards means breaking out the slab at great cost. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：剪力釘數量不足時，梁只能部分組合，強度與勁度介於純鋼梁與完全組合之間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With too few studs, the beam is only partially composite, with strength and stiffness between those of the bare steel and full composite action.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若施工時因壓型鋼板肋位不合或趕工而少焊剪力釘，梁在使用載重下仍看似正常，但撓度與振動比設計大，極限狀態下介面滑動使強度不足；事後補焊需要打除樓板，代價極高。
knowledge.textEn: If studs are omitted because rib positions do not match or work is rushed, the beam looks normal in service but deflects and vibrates more than designed, and at ultimate load interface slip leaves it short of strength; adding studs afterwards means breaking out the slab at great cost.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「組合梁的水平剪力流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Horizontal shear flow in composite beams" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若施工時因壓型鋼板肋位不合或趕工而少焊剪力釘，梁在使用載重下仍看似正常，但撓度與振動比設計大，極限狀態下介面滑動使強度不足；事後補焊需要打除樓板，代價極高。
部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

If studs are omitted because rib positions do not match or work is rushed, the beam looks normal in service but deflects and vibrates more than designed, and at ultimate load interface slip leaves it short of strength.
Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration.
quiz.explanation: 若施工時因壓型鋼板肋位不合或趕工而少焊剪力釘，梁在使用載重下仍看似正常，但撓度與振動比設計大，極限狀態下介面滑動使強度不足；事後補焊需要打除樓板，代價極高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If studs are omitted because rib positions do not match or work is rushed, the beam looks normal in service but deflects and vibrates more than designed, and at ultimate load interface slip leaves it short of strength; adding studs afterwards means breaking out the slab at great cost. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 部分組合、勁度與使用性：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「組合比與有效慣性矩」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Composite ratio and effective inertia” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 實務上很多組合梁刻意設計成部分組合，因為壓型鋼板肋距限制了可焊剪力釘的位置，而強度往往不需要完全組合。部分組合時，介面有少量滑動，有效慣性矩低於完全組合的換算斷面，撓度與樓板振動因此變大。組合比（實際剪力釘總強度除以完全組合所需值）同時控制強度與勁度，太低時剪力釘會在變形能力用盡前斷裂，因此規範通常設定最低組合比。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「組合比與有效慣性矩」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In practice many composite beams are deliberately partially composite, because deck rib spacing limits where studs can go and strength often does not need full composite action. With partial composite action the interface slips slightly and the effective moment of inertia falls below that of the fully composite transformed section, so deflection and floor vibration increase. The composite ratio, total stud strength divided by that required for full action, governs both strength and stiffness; too low a ratio lets studs fracture before their deformation capacity is used, so codes usually set a minimum ratio. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Composite ratio and effective inertia” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：部分組合有效慣性矩 I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For partial composite action I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「組合比與有效慣性矩」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Composite ratio and effective inertia”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 部分組合、勁度與使用性
knowledge.titleEn: Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability
knowledge.text: 實務上很多組合梁刻意設計成部分組合，因為壓型鋼板肋距限制了可焊剪力釘的位置，而強度往往不需要完全組合。部分組合時，介面有少量滑動，有效慣性矩低於完全組合的換算斷面，撓度與樓板振動因此變大。
knowledge.textEn: In practice many composite beams are deliberately partially composite, because deck rib spacing limits where studs can go and strength often does not need full composite action. With partial composite action the interface slips slightly and the effective moment of inertia falls below that of the fully composite transformed section, so deflection and floor vibration increase.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「部分組合、勁度與使用性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability" is correct?
options: 部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。
剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。
實務上很多組合梁刻意設計成部分組合，因為壓型鋼板肋距限制了可焊剪力釘的位置，而強度往往不需要完全組合。
optionsEn: Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration.
Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength.
In practice many composite beams are deliberately partially composite, because deck rib spacing limits where studs can go and strength often does not need full composite action.
quiz.explanation: 實務上很多組合梁刻意設計成部分組合，因為壓型鋼板肋距限制了可焊剪力釘的位置，而強度往往不需要完全組合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In practice many composite beams are deliberately partially composite, because deck rib spacing limits where studs can go and strength often does not need full composite action. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 部分組合、勁度與使用性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「組合比與有效慣性矩」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Composite ratio and effective inertia” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：部分組合有效慣性矩 I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s)。I_s = 255×10⁶ mm⁴、I_tr = 700×10⁶ mm⁴，半跨 20 支剪力釘每支 76.5 kN：ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN，組合比 1,531/2,619 ≈ 0.58，√0.58 ≈ 0.76，I_eff ≈ 255 + 0.76×445 ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴，約為完全組合的 85%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For partial composite action I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s). With I_s = 255×10⁶ mm⁴, I_tr = 700×10⁶ mm⁴ and 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN, a composite ratio of 1,531/2,619 ≈ 0.58; √0.58 ≈ 0.76, so I_eff ≈ 255 + 0.76×445 ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴, about 85% of full composite. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有效慣性矩計算施工後的長期撓度與樓板自振頻率，與使用性標準比較；完工後可抽樣量測樓板頻率或以已知載重量測撓度，若明顯低於預期勁度，追查是否有剪力釘缺漏或焊接不良。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use the effective inertia to compute long-term deflection and floor natural frequency against serviceability criteria; after completion, sample floor frequencies or measure deflection under a known load, and if stiffness is clearly below expectation, trace whether studs are missing or poorly welded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 部分組合有效慣性矩 I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s)。I_s = 255×10⁶ mm⁴、I_tr = 700×10⁶ mm⁴，半跨 20 支剪力釘每支 76.5 kN：ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN，組合比 1,531/2,619 ≈ 0.58，√0.58 ≈ 0.76，I_eff ≈ 255 + 0.76×445 ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴，約為完全組合的 85%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For partial composite action I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s). With I_s = 255×10⁶ mm⁴, I_tr = 700×10⁶ mm⁴ and 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN, a composite ratio of 1,531/2,619 ≈ 0.58; √0.58 ≈ 0.76, so I_eff ≈ 255 + 0.76×445 ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴, about 85% of full composite. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「部分組合、勁度與使用性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability", which statement holds?
options: 部分組合有效慣性矩 I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s)。
剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。
剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。
optionsEn: For partial composite action I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s).
Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day.
If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting.
quiz.explanation: 部分組合有效慣性矩 I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For partial composite action I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 部分組合、勁度與使用性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「組合比與有效慣性矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Composite ratio and effective inertia” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有效慣性矩計算施工後的長期撓度與樓板自振頻率，與使用性標準比較；完工後可抽樣量測樓板頻率或以已知載重量測撓度，若明顯低於預期勁度，追查是否有剪力釘缺漏或焊接不良。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use the effective inertia to compute long-term deflection and floor natural frequency against serviceability criteria; after completion, sample floor frequencies or measure deflection under a known load, and if stiffness is clearly below expectation, trace whether studs are missing or poorly welded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計說明應寫明每類組合梁採用的組合比及其使用性檢核結果；當樓板用途改變（例如由辦公改為實驗室或健身房）時，須以原組合比重新檢核振動與撓度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should state the composite ratio adopted for each beam type and its serviceability results; when floor use changes, for example from office to laboratory or gym, recheck vibration and deflection with the original composite ratio.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了節省剪力釘而把組合比壓得很低，梁強度檢核勉強通過，但樓板在人員走動下振動明顯，辦公室使用者抱怨；剪力釘在反覆滑動下也可能先達到變形極限而斷裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Pushing the composite ratio very low to save studs lets the strength check pass narrowly, but the floor vibrates noticeably under footfall and office users complain; under repeated slip the studs may also reach their deformation limit and fracture first. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以有效慣性矩計算施工後的長期撓度與樓板自振頻率，與使用性標準比較；完工後可抽樣量測樓板頻率或以已知載重量測撓度，若明顯低於預期勁度，追查是否有剪力釘缺漏或焊接不良。
knowledge.textEn: Use the effective inertia to compute long-term deflection and floor natural frequency against serviceability criteria; after completion, sample floor frequencies or measure deflection under a known load, and if stiffness is clearly below expectation, trace whether studs are missing or poorly welded.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計說明應寫明每類組合梁採用的組合比及其使用性檢核結果；當樓板用途改變（例如由辦公改為實驗室或健身房）時，須以原組合比重新檢核振動與撓度。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis should state the composite ratio adopted for each beam type and its serviceability results; when floor use changes, for example from office to laboratory or gym, recheck vibration and deflection with the original composite ratio.

quiz.question: 要驗證「部分組合、勁度與使用性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以有效慣性矩計算施工後的長期撓度與樓板自振頻率，與使用性標準比較。
組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Use the effective inertia to compute long-term deflection and floor natural frequency against serviceability criteria.
The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire.
quiz.explanation: 以有效慣性矩計算施工後的長期撓度與樓板自振頻率，與使用性標準比較；完工後可抽樣量測樓板頻率或以已知載重量測撓度，若明顯低於預期勁度，追查是否有剪力釘缺漏或焊接不良。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use the effective inertia to compute long-term deflection and floor natural frequency against serviceability criteria; after completion, sample floor frequencies or measure deflection under a known load, and if stiffness is clearly below expectation, trace whether studs are missing or poorly welded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 部分組合、勁度與使用性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「組合比與有效慣性矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Composite ratio and effective inertia” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了節省剪力釘而把組合比壓得很低，梁強度檢核勉強通過，但樓板在人員走動下振動明顯，辦公室使用者抱怨；剪力釘在反覆滑動下也可能先達到變形極限而斷裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Pushing the composite ratio very low to save studs lets the strength check pass narrowly, but the floor vibrates noticeably under footfall and office users complain; under repeated slip the studs may also reach their deformation limit and fracture first. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：組合比（實際剪力釘總強度除以完全組合所需值）同時控制強度與勁度，太低時剪力釘會在變形能力用盡前斷裂，因此規範通常設定最低組合比。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The composite ratio, total stud strength divided by that required for full action, governs both strength and stiffness; too low a ratio lets studs fracture before their deformation capacity is used, so codes usually set a minimum ratio.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了節省剪力釘而把組合比壓得很低，梁強度檢核勉強通過，但樓板在人員走動下振動明顯，辦公室使用者抱怨；剪力釘在反覆滑動下也可能先達到變形極限而斷裂。
knowledge.textEn: Pushing the composite ratio very low to save studs lets the strength check pass narrowly, but the floor vibrates noticeably under footfall and office users complain; under repeated slip the studs may also reach their deformation limit and fracture first.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「部分組合、勁度與使用性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。
為了節省剪力釘而把組合比壓得很低，梁強度檢核勉強通過，但樓板在人員走動下振動明顯，辦公室使用者抱怨；剪力釘在反覆滑動下也可能先達到變形極限而斷裂。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength.
Pushing the composite ratio very low to save studs lets the strength check pass narrowly, but the floor vibrates noticeably under footfall and office users complain.
quiz.explanation: 為了節省剪力釘而把組合比壓得很低，梁強度檢核勉強通過，但樓板在人員走動下振動明顯，辦公室使用者抱怨；剪力釘在反覆滑動下也可能先達到變形極限而斷裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pushing the composite ratio very low to save studs lets the strength check pass narrowly, but the floor vibrates noticeably under footfall and office users complain; under repeated slip the studs may also reach their deformation limit and fracture first. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度」與「壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stud size, material and resistance" and "Profiled decking and through-deck welding details": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stud size, material and resistance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「19 mm 頭釘」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “19 mm headed stud” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 建築組合樓板最常用的是直徑 19 mm 的頭釘，釘頭讓混凝土能抵抗拔出，釘身則以剪力與彎曲把介面力傳入混凝土。單支剪力釘的強度由兩個機制中較小者決定：周圍混凝土被壓碎或劈裂，或釘身鋼材剪斷；放在壓型鋼板肋內時，肋的寬度、高度與剪力釘在肋中的位置還會進一步折減強度，例如剪力釘位於受力方向的不利側（弱位置）時強度明顯較低。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「19 mm 頭釘」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The most common connector in building composite floors is the 19 mm headed stud: the head anchors it against pull-out while the shank carries interface force into the concrete by shear and bending. A single stud's resistance is the lesser of two mechanisms, crushing or splitting of the surrounding concrete or shearing of the steel shank; inside a deck rib, the rib's width and height and the stud's position within it reduce strength further, notably when the stud sits on the unfavourable side of the rib relative to the load, the weak position. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “19 mm headed stud” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「19 mm 頭釘」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “19 mm headed stud”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度
knowledge.text: 建築組合樓板最常用的是直徑 19 mm 的頭釘，釘頭讓混凝土能抵抗拔出，釘身則以剪力與彎曲把介面力傳入混凝土。單支剪力釘的強度由兩個機制中較小者決定：周圍混凝土被壓碎或劈裂，或釘身鋼材剪斷；放在壓型鋼板肋內時，肋的寬度、高度與剪力釘在肋中的位置還會進一步折減強度，例如剪力釘位於受力方向的不利側（弱位置）時強度明顯較低。
knowledge.textEn: The most common connector in building composite floors is the 19 mm headed stud: the head anchors it against pull-out while the shank carries interface force into the concrete by shear and bending. A single stud's resistance is the lesser of two mechanisms, crushing or splitting of the surrounding concrete or shearing of the steel shank; inside a deck rib, the rib's width and height and the stud's position within it reduce strength further, notably when the stud sits on the unfavourable side of the rib relative to the load, the weak position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stud size, material and resistance" is correct?
options: 建築組合樓板最常用的是直徑 19 mm 的頭釘，釘頭讓混凝土能抵抗拔出，釘身則以剪力與彎曲把介面力傳入混凝土。
剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。
只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。
optionsEn: The most common connector in building composite floors is the 19 mm headed stud: the head anchors it against pull-out while the shank carries interface force into the concrete by shear and bending.
Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength.
If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam.
quiz.explanation: 建築組合樓板最常用的是直徑 19 mm 的頭釘，釘頭讓混凝土能抵抗拔出，釘身則以剪力與彎曲把介面力傳入混凝土。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The most common connector in building composite floors is the 19 mm headed stud: the head anchors it against pull-out while the shank carries interface force into the concrete by shear and bending. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stud size, material and resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「19 mm 頭釘」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “19 mm headed stud” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u。19 mm 頭釘 A_sc ≈ 283.5 mm²，f′c = 28 MPa、E_c ≈ 24,870 MPa：混凝土控制值 ≈ 118 kN；F_u = 450 MPa，肋內單支弱位置 R_g = 1.0、R_p = 0.6：0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN 控制；強位置 R_p = 0.75 時約 95.7 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u. For a 19 mm stud, A_sc ≈ 283.5 mm²; with f′c = 28 MPa and E_c ≈ 24,870 MPa the concrete limit is about 118 kN; with F_u = 450 MPa, one stud per rib in the weak position (R_g = 1.0, R_p = 0.6) governs at 0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN, rising to about 95.7 kN in the strong position (R_p = 0.75). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：進場時核對剪力釘的材料證明（抗拉強度、伸長率）、尺寸與釘頭形狀，以及配套陶瓷護圈的型號；設計時確認所用的肋折減係數與實際壓型鋼板的肋寬、肋高與剪力釘位置一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At delivery, check stud material certificates (tensile strength, elongation), dimensions and head shape, and the matching ceramic ferrule type; in design, confirm that the rib reduction factors used match the actual deck rib width, height and stud position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u。19 mm 頭釘 A_sc ≈ 283.5 mm²，f′c = 28 MPa、E_c ≈ 24,870 MPa：混凝土控制值 ≈ 118 kN；F_u = 450 MPa，肋內單支弱位置 R_g = 1.0、R_p = 0.6：0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN 控制；強位置 R_p = 0.75 時約 95.7 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u. For a 19 mm stud, A_sc ≈ 283.5 mm²; with f′c = 28 MPa and E_c ≈ 24,870 MPa the concrete limit is about 118 kN; with F_u = 450 MPa, one stud per rib in the weak position (R_g = 1.0, R_p = 0.6) governs at 0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN, rising to about 95.7 kN in the strong position (R_p = 0.75). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stud size, material and resistance", which statement holds?
options: 被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。
Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u。
剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。
optionsEn: A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded.
Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u.
Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape.
quiz.explanation: Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stud size, material and resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「19 mm 頭釘」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “19 mm headed stud” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 進場時核對剪力釘的材料證明（抗拉強度、伸長率）、尺寸與釘頭形狀，以及配套陶瓷護圈的型號；設計時確認所用的肋折減係數與實際壓型鋼板的肋寬、肋高與剪力釘位置一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At delivery, check stud material certificates (tensile strength, elongation), dimensions and head shape, and the matching ceramic ferrule type; in design, confirm that the rib reduction factors used match the actual deck rib width, height and stud position. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工圖應指定剪力釘在肋中的位置（例如一律焊在強位置），並在壓型鋼板配置圖上標示；若壓型鋼板中間有加勁肋使剪力釘無法置中，須由設計者指定偏移方向。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Shop drawings should fix the stud position in the rib, for example always the strong position, and show it on the deck layout; where a stiffener in the rib prevents central placement, the designer must specify the direction of offset.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若設計以平板條件計算剪力釘強度，卻使用肋高較大的壓型鋼板並把剪力釘焊在弱位置，實際強度可能只有計算值的六成多，組合梁的極限強度與延性都不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing stud strength for a solid slab, then using a deep-rib deck with studs welded in the weak position, can leave actual strength at little more than sixty percent of the calculated value, short of both ultimate strength and ductility. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 進場時核對剪力釘的材料證明（抗拉強度、伸長率）、尺寸與釘頭形狀，以及配套陶瓷護圈的型號；設計時確認所用的肋折減係數與實際壓型鋼板的肋寬、肋高與剪力釘位置一致。
knowledge.textEn: At delivery, check stud material certificates (tensile strength, elongation), dimensions and head shape, and the matching ceramic ferrule type; in design, confirm that the rib reduction factors used match the actual deck rib width, height and stud position.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工圖應指定剪力釘在肋中的位置（例如一律焊在強位置），並在壓型鋼板配置圖上標示；若壓型鋼板中間有加勁肋使剪力釘無法置中，須由設計者指定偏移方向。
knowledge.textEn: Shop drawings should fix the stud position in the rib, for example always the strong position, and show it on the deck layout; where a stiffener in the rib prevents central placement, the designer must specify the direction of offset.

quiz.question: 要驗證「剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stud size, material and resistance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。
進場時核對剪力釘的材料證明（抗拉強度、伸長率）、尺寸與釘頭形狀，以及配套陶瓷護圈的型號；設計時確認所用的肋折減係數與實際壓型鋼板的肋寬、肋高與剪力釘位置一致。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them.
At delivery, check stud material certificates (tensile strength, elongation), dimensions and head shape, and the matching ceramic ferrule type.
quiz.explanation: 進場時核對剪力釘的材料證明（抗拉強度、伸長率）、尺寸與釘頭形狀，以及配套陶瓷護圈的型號；設計時確認所用的肋折減係數與實際壓型鋼板的肋寬、肋高與剪力釘位置一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At delivery, check stud material certificates (tensile strength, elongation), dimensions and head shape, and the matching ceramic ferrule type; in design, confirm that the rib reduction factors used match the actual deck rib width, height and stud position. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stud size, material and resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「19 mm 頭釘」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “19 mm headed stud” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若設計以平板條件計算剪力釘強度，卻使用肋高較大的壓型鋼板並把剪力釘焊在弱位置，實際強度可能只有計算值的六成多，組合梁的極限強度與延性都不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing stud strength for a solid slab, then using a deep-rib deck with studs welded in the weak position, can leave actual strength at little more than sixty percent of the calculated value, short of both ultimate strength and ductility. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單支剪力釘的強度由兩個機制中較小者決定：周圍混凝土被壓碎或劈裂，或釘身鋼材剪斷；放在壓型鋼板肋內時，肋的寬度、高度與剪力釘在肋中的位置還會進一步折減強度，例如剪力釘位於受力方向的不利側（弱位置）時強度明顯較低。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A single stud's resistance is the lesser of two mechanisms, crushing or splitting of the surrounding concrete or shearing of the steel shank; inside a deck rib, the rib's width and height and the stud's position within it reduce strength further, notably when the stud sits on the unfavourable side of the rib relative to the load, the weak position.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若設計以平板條件計算剪力釘強度，卻使用肋高較大的壓型鋼板並把剪力釘焊在弱位置，實際強度可能只有計算值的六成多，組合梁的極限強度與延性都不足。
knowledge.textEn: Designing stud strength for a solid slab, then using a deep-rib deck with studs welded in the weak position, can leave actual strength at little more than sixty percent of the calculated value, short of both ultimate strength and ductility.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stud size, material and resistance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若設計以平板條件計算剪力釘強度，卻使用肋高較大的壓型鋼板並把剪力釘焊在弱位置，實際強度可能只有計算值的六成多，組合梁的極限強度與延性都不足。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。
optionsEn: Designing stud strength for a solid slab, then using a deep-rib deck with studs welded in the weak position, can leave actual strength at little more than sixty percent of the calculated value, short of both ultimate strength and ductility.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam.
quiz.explanation: 若設計以平板條件計算剪力釘強度，卻使用肋高較大的壓型鋼板並把剪力釘焊在弱位置，實際強度可能只有計算值的六成多，組合梁的極限強度與延性都不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing stud strength for a solid slab, then using a deep-rib deck with studs welded in the weak position, can leave actual strength at little more than sixty percent of the calculated value, short of both ultimate strength and ductility. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Profiled decking and through-deck welding details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼承板肋與穿板焊接」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck ribs and through-deck welding” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 英國鋼結構業界的說明指出，穿板焊接是把剪力釘固定在鋼梁上翼板的常規做法：壓型鋼板夾在剪力釘底部與翼板之間，一次焊接把三者熔合。約 1 mm 厚的鍍鋅鋼承板不影響焊接品質，但鋼承板必須緊貼翼板、保持乾燥，翼板頂面不得有影響焊接的厚塗層。橫向鋪設的鋼承板每個肋內通常最多兩支剪力釘，因此肋距直接決定可配置的剪力釘數量；兩支並排時每支強度又會再折減。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼承板肋與穿板焊接」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steel-industry guidance in the UK describes through-deck welding as the normal way to fix studs to a beam's top flange: the decking is sandwiched between the stud base and the flange and one weld fuses all three. Galvanized decking about 1 mm thick does not affect weld quality, but the deck must sit tight on the flange and be dry, and the flange top must be free of thick coatings that impair welding. With transverse decking, usually no more than two studs go in one trough, so rib spacing directly sets how many studs can be placed, and two studs side by side are each reduced further. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck ribs and through-deck welding” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：12 m 梁、肋距 300 mm，半跨約 20 個肋。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 12 m beam with ribs at 300 mm has about 20 ribs per half span.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼承板肋與穿板焊接」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck ribs and through-deck welding”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部
knowledge.titleEn: Profiled decking and through-deck welding details
knowledge.text: 英國鋼結構業界的說明指出，穿板焊接是把剪力釘固定在鋼梁上翼板的常規做法：壓型鋼板夾在剪力釘底部與翼板之間，一次焊接把三者熔合。約 1 mm 厚的鍍鋅鋼承板不影響焊接品質，但鋼承板必須緊貼翼板、保持乾燥，翼板頂面不得有影響焊接的厚塗層。
knowledge.textEn: Steel-industry guidance in the UK describes through-deck welding as the normal way to fix studs to a beam's top flange: the decking is sandwiched between the stud base and the flange and one weld fuses all three. Galvanized decking about 1 mm thick does not affect weld quality, but the deck must sit tight on the flange and be dry, and the flange top must be free of thick coatings that impair welding.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Profiled decking and through-deck welding details" is correct?
options: 只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。
英國鋼結構業界的說明指出，穿板焊接是把剪力釘固定在鋼梁上翼板的常規做法：壓型鋼板夾在剪力釘底部與翼板之間，一次焊接把三者熔合。
剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。
optionsEn: If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam.

Steel-industry guidance in the UK describes through-deck welding as the normal way to fix studs to a beam's top flange: the decking is sandwiched between the stud base and the flange and one weld fuses all three.
Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day.
quiz.explanation: 英國鋼結構業界的說明指出，穿板焊接是把剪力釘固定在鋼梁上翼板的常規做法：壓型鋼板夾在剪力釘底部與翼板之間，一次焊接把三者熔合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Steel-industry guidance in the UK describes through-deck welding as the normal way to fix studs to a beam's top flange: the decking is sandwiched between the stud base and the flange and one weld fuses all three. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Profiled decking and through-deck welding details: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼承板肋與穿板焊接」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
