steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck ribs and through-deck welding” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：12 m 梁、肋距 300 mm，半跨約 20 個肋。每肋 1 支弱位置 76.5 kN：ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN，組合比 58%；每肋 2 支時 R_g = 0.85，每支 0.85×0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 65.1 kN，40 支 ≈ 2,603 kN，組合比約 99%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 12 m beam with ribs at 300 mm has about 20 ribs per half span. One weak-position stud per rib at 76.5 kN gives ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN, a 58% ratio; two per rib with R_g = 0.85 gives 0.85×0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 65.1 kN each, 40 studs ≈ 2,603 kN, a ratio of about 99%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：焊接前檢查鋼承板是否已依圖固定、與翼板間無縫隙、接頭搭接位置是否避開剪力釘位置，並確認肋內無積水與雜物；翼板頂面若有底漆，須確認是否為允許穿板焊接的類型或已清除。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before welding, check that the deck is fixed as drawn, tight to the flange with no gap, with laps placed clear of stud positions, and that ribs are free of water and debris; if the flange top is primed, confirm the primer is permitted for through-deck welding or has been removed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 12 m 梁、肋距 300 mm，半跨約 20 個肋。每肋 1 支弱位置 76.5 kN：ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN，組合比 58%；每肋 2 支時 R_g = 0.85，每支 0.85×0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 65.1 kN，40 支 ≈ 2,603 kN，組合比約 99%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 12 m beam with ribs at 300 mm has about 20 ribs per half span. One weak-position stud per rib at 76.5 kN gives ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN, a 58% ratio; two per rib with R_g = 0.85 gives 0.85×0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 65.1 kN each, 40 studs ≈ 2,603 kN, a ratio of about 99%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Profiled decking and through-deck welding details", which statement holds?
options: 剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。
組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。
12 m 梁、肋距 300 mm，半跨約 20 個肋。
optionsEn: If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting.
The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire.
A 12 m beam with ribs at 300 mm has about 20 ribs per half span.
quiz.explanation: 12 m 梁、肋距 300 mm，半跨約 20 個肋。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 12 m beam with ribs at 300 mm has about 20 ribs per half span. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Profiled decking and through-deck welding details: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼承板肋與穿板焊接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck ribs and through-deck welding” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 焊接前檢查鋼承板是否已依圖固定、與翼板間無縫隙、接頭搭接位置是否避開剪力釘位置，並確認肋內無積水與雜物；翼板頂面若有底漆，須確認是否為允許穿板焊接的類型或已清除。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before welding, check that the deck is fixed as drawn, tight to the flange with no gap, with laps placed clear of stud positions, and that ribs are free of water and debris; if the flange top is primed, confirm the primer is permitted for through-deck welding or has been removed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鋼承板配置圖應與剪力釘配置圖一起審查，確認肋位、搭接與剪力釘位置相容；鋼承板鋪設完成並經檢查後才可開始焊接剪力釘，雨後須清除肋內積水並讓板面乾燥。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Review the deck layout together with the stud layout to confirm that rib positions, laps and stud locations are compatible; welding may start only after the deck is laid and inspected, and after rain, water must be cleared from the ribs and the surface allowed to dry.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鋼承板與翼板之間有空隙或兩層鋼承板搭接處焊接，熔池無法同時熔合鋼承板與翼板，剪力釘看似牢固，實際只焊在鋼承板上；樓板澆置後這些剪力釘幾乎不傳力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A gap between deck and flange, or welding through a double-thickness lap, stops the weld pool fusing deck and flange together; the stud looks firm but is welded only to the deck and carries almost no force once the slab is cast. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 焊接前檢查鋼承板是否已依圖固定、與翼板間無縫隙、接頭搭接位置是否避開剪力釘位置，並確認肋內無積水與雜物；翼板頂面若有底漆，須確認是否為允許穿板焊接的類型或已清除。
knowledge.textEn: Before welding, check that the deck is fixed as drawn, tight to the flange with no gap, with laps placed clear of stud positions, and that ribs are free of water and debris; if the flange top is primed, confirm the primer is permitted for through-deck welding or has been removed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 鋼承板配置圖應與剪力釘配置圖一起審查，確認肋位、搭接與剪力釘位置相容；鋼承板鋪設完成並經檢查後才可開始焊接剪力釘，雨後須清除肋內積水並讓板面乾燥。
knowledge.textEn: Review the deck layout together with the stud layout to confirm that rib positions, laps and stud locations are compatible; welding may start only after the deck is laid and inspected, and after rain, water must be cleared from the ribs and the surface allowed to dry.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Profiled decking and through-deck welding details"?
options: 焊接前檢查鋼承板是否已依圖固定、與翼板間無縫隙、接頭搭接位置是否避開剪力釘位置，並確認肋內無積水與雜物。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。
optionsEn: Before welding, check that the deck is fixed as drawn, tight to the flange with no gap, with laps placed clear of stud positions, and that ribs are free of water and debris.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it.
quiz.explanation: 焊接前檢查鋼承板是否已依圖固定、與翼板間無縫隙、接頭搭接位置是否避開剪力釘位置，並確認肋內無積水與雜物；翼板頂面若有底漆，須確認是否為允許穿板焊接的類型或已清除。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before welding, check that the deck is fixed as drawn, tight to the flange with no gap, with laps placed clear of stud positions, and that ribs are free of water and debris; if the flange top is primed, confirm the primer is permitted for through-deck welding or has been removed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Profiled decking and through-deck welding details: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼承板肋與穿板焊接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deck ribs and through-deck welding” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋼承板與翼板之間有空隙或兩層鋼承板搭接處焊接，熔池無法同時熔合鋼承板與翼板，剪力釘看似牢固，實際只焊在鋼承板上；樓板澆置後這些剪力釘幾乎不傳力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A gap between deck and flange, or welding through a double-thickness lap, stops the weld pool fusing deck and flange together; the stud looks firm but is welded only to the deck and carries almost no force once the slab is cast. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：橫向鋪設的鋼承板每個肋內通常最多兩支剪力釘，因此肋距直接決定可配置的剪力釘數量；兩支並排時每支強度又會再折減。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With transverse decking, usually no more than two studs go in one trough, so rib spacing directly sets how many studs can be placed, and two studs side by side are each reduced further.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鋼承板與翼板之間有空隙或兩層鋼承板搭接處焊接，熔池無法同時熔合鋼承板與翼板，剪力釘看似牢固，實際只焊在鋼承板上；樓板澆置後這些剪力釘幾乎不傳力。
knowledge.textEn: A gap between deck and flange, or welding through a double-thickness lap, stops the weld pool fusing deck and flange together; the stud looks firm but is welded only to the deck and carries almost no force once the slab is cast.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Profiled decking and through-deck welding details" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
鋼承板與翼板之間有空隙或兩層鋼承板搭接處焊接，熔池無法同時熔合鋼承板與翼板，剪力釘看似牢固，實際只焊在鋼承板上；樓板澆置後這些剪力釘幾乎不傳力。
剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A gap between deck and flange, or welding through a double-thickness lap, stops the weld pool fusing deck and flange together.
Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day.
quiz.explanation: 鋼承板與翼板之間有空隙或兩層鋼承板搭接處焊接，熔池無法同時熔合鋼承板與翼板，剪力釘看似牢固，實際只焊在鋼承板上；樓板澆置後這些剪力釘幾乎不傳力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A gap between deck and flange, or welding through a double-thickness lap, stops the weld pool fusing deck and flange together; the stud looks firm but is welded only to the deck and carries almost no force once the slab is cast. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件」與「首件試驗與尺寸檢核」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drawn-arc stud welding conditions" and "First-stud testing and dimensional checks": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Drawn-arc stud welding conditions: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「焊槍設定與陶瓷護圈」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gun settings and ceramic ferrules” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接由焊槍提起剪力釘引弧，在設定時間內熔化釘端與母材，再把剪力釘壓入熔池；釘端的鋁球協助脫氧，陶瓷護圈集中熱量、保護熔池並使焊瘤成形，焊後敲除。焊接品質取決於電流、時間、提升與壓入量的組合，而這些設定又受剪力釘直徑、是否穿板、焊接電纜長度與接地位置影響。現場常見問題是電源容量不足、電纜過長或接地不良，使實際電流低於設定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「焊槍設定與陶瓷護圈」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In drawn-arc stud welding the gun lifts the stud to strike an arc, melts the stud end and base metal for a set time, then plunges the stud into the pool; an aluminium flux ball on the stud end deoxidises the weld, and a ceramic ferrule concentrates heat, shields the pool and shapes the flash before being knocked off. Quality depends on the combination of current, time, lift and plunge, which in turn depend on stud diameter, whether welding through deck, cable length and ground position. Common site problems are undersized power supplies, overlong cables and poor grounds that leave actual current below the setting. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Gun settings and ceramic ferrules” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：焊接電纜壓降 ΔV = I·R。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Cable voltage drop ΔV = I·R.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「焊槍設定與陶瓷護圈」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Gun settings and ceramic ferrules”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件
knowledge.text: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接由焊槍提起剪力釘引弧，在設定時間內熔化釘端與母材，再把剪力釘壓入熔池；釘端的鋁球協助脫氧，陶瓷護圈集中熱量、保護熔池並使焊瘤成形，焊後敲除。焊接品質取決於電流、時間、提升與壓入量的組合，而這些設定又受剪力釘直徑、是否穿板、焊接電纜長度與接地位置影響。
knowledge.textEn: In drawn-arc stud welding the gun lifts the stud to strike an arc, melts the stud end and base metal for a set time, then plunges the stud into the pool; an aluminium flux ball on the stud end deoxidises the weld, and a ceramic ferrule concentrates heat, shields the pool and shapes the flash before being knocked off. Quality depends on the combination of current, time, lift and plunge, which in turn depend on stud diameter, whether welding through deck, cable length and ground position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drawn-arc stud welding conditions" is correct?
options: 剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。
被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。
拉弧式剪力釘焊接由焊槍提起剪力釘引弧，在設定時間內熔化釘端與母材，再把剪力釘壓入熔池；釘端的鋁球協助脫氧，陶瓷護圈集中熱量、保護熔池並使焊瘤成形，焊後敲除。
optionsEn: Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day.
A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded.
In drawn-arc stud welding the gun lifts the stud to strike an arc, melts the stud end and base metal for a set time, then plunges the stud into the pool.
quiz.explanation: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接由焊槍提起剪力釘引弧，在設定時間內熔化釘端與母材，再把剪力釘壓入熔池；釘端的鋁球協助脫氧，陶瓷護圈集中熱量、保護熔池並使焊瘤成形，焊後敲除。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In drawn-arc stud welding the gun lifts the stud to strike an arc, melts the stud end and base metal for a set time, then plunges the stud into the pool; an aluminium flux ball on the stud end deoxidises the weld, and a ceramic ferrule concentrates heat, shields the pool and shapes the flash before being knocked off. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drawn-arc stud welding conditions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「焊槍設定與陶瓷護圈」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gun settings and ceramic ferrules” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：焊接電纜壓降 ΔV = I·R。銅纜截面 107 mm²，每米電阻 1.72×10⁻⁸/107×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.61×10⁻⁴ Ω；正負線合計 60 m，R ≈ 0.0096 Ω。若焊接電流 1,500 A，ΔV = 1,500×0.0096 ≈ 14.5 V，相對於數十伏的電弧電壓並不小，必須依電纜長度調整設定。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Cable voltage drop ΔV = I·R. A 107 mm² copper cable has about 1.72×10⁻⁸/107×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.61×10⁻⁴ Ω per metre; with 60 m of lead and return, R ≈ 0.0096 Ω. At a welding current of 1,500 A, ΔV = 1,500×0.0096 ≈ 14.5 V, not small compared with an arc voltage of a few tens of volts, so settings must be adjusted for cable length. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個班次開工前以首件試焊確認設定，記錄電流、時間、電纜長度與接地位置；作業中若更換電纜、移動電源或改變剪力釘批次，須重新試焊；雨天或板面潮濕時停止焊接。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm settings with first-stud trial welds at the start of each shift and record current, time, cable length and ground position; re-test after changing cables, moving the power source or changing stud lots, and stop welding in rain or on wet deck.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 焊接電纜壓降 ΔV = I·R。銅纜截面 107 mm²，每米電阻 1.72×10⁻⁸/107×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.61×10⁻⁴ Ω；正負線合計 60 m，R ≈ 0.0096 Ω。若焊接電流 1,500 A，ΔV = 1,500×0.0096 ≈ 14.5 V，相對於數十伏的電弧電壓並不小，必須依電纜長度調整設定。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Cable voltage drop ΔV = I·R. A 107 mm² copper cable has about 1.72×10⁻⁸/107×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.61×10⁻⁴ Ω per metre; with 60 m of lead and return, R ≈ 0.0096 Ω. At a welding current of 1,500 A, ΔV = 1,500×0.0096 ≈ 14.5 V, not small compared with an arc voltage of a few tens of volts, so settings must be adjusted for cable length. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drawn-arc stud welding conditions", which statement holds?
options: 焊接電纜壓降 ΔV = I·R。
剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。
剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。
optionsEn: Cable voltage drop ΔV = I·R.
Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape.
Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them.
quiz.explanation: 焊接電纜壓降 ΔV = I·R。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Cable voltage drop ΔV = I·R. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drawn-arc stud welding conditions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「焊槍設定與陶瓷護圈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gun settings and ceramic ferrules” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個班次開工前以首件試焊確認設定，記錄電流、時間、電纜長度與接地位置；作業中若更換電纜、移動電源或改變剪力釘批次，須重新試焊；雨天或板面潮濕時停止焊接。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm settings with first-stud trial welds at the start of each shift and record current, time, cable length and ground position; re-test after changing cables, moving the power source or changing stud lots, and stop welding in rain or on wet deck. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：剪力釘焊接人員須經訓練與資格認定，焊接程序寫明各直徑在穿板與直接焊接時的設定範圍、電源容量與最大電纜長度；接地夾須直接夾在鋼梁上並靠近焊接區。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Stud welders must be trained and qualified, and the procedure must state setting ranges for each diameter when welding through deck or direct, power-source capacity and maximum cable length; the ground clamp must be fixed directly to the steel beam close to the welding area.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：電源與多支焊槍共用造成電流不足，焊瘤不完整、釘端未完全熔合，剪力釘在敲擊或彎曲時從根部脫落；接地夾夾在遠端鋼承板上，電流經由鋼承板搭接處流通，產生電弧偏吹與不穩定焊接。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A power source shared among several guns leaves current too low, giving incomplete flash and unfused stud bases that break off when tapped or bent; a ground clamp on distant decking routes current through deck laps, causing arc blow and erratic welds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個班次開工前以首件試焊確認設定，記錄電流、時間、電纜長度與接地位置；作業中若更換電纜、移動電源或改變剪力釘批次，須重新試焊；雨天或板面潮濕時停止焊接。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm settings with first-stud trial welds at the start of each shift and record current, time, cable length and ground position; re-test after changing cables, moving the power source or changing stud lots, and stop welding in rain or on wet deck.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 剪力釘焊接人員須經訓練與資格認定，焊接程序寫明各直徑在穿板與直接焊接時的設定範圍、電源容量與最大電纜長度；接地夾須直接夾在鋼梁上並靠近焊接區。
knowledge.textEn: Stud welders must be trained and qualified, and the procedure must state setting ranges for each diameter when welding through deck or direct, power-source capacity and maximum cable length; the ground clamp must be fixed directly to the steel beam close to the welding area.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drawn-arc stud welding conditions"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
每個班次開工前以首件試焊確認設定，記錄電流、時間、電纜長度與接地位置；作業中若更換電纜、移動電源或改變剪力釘批次，須重新試焊；雨天或板面潮濕時停止焊接。
部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Confirm settings with first-stud trial welds at the start of each shift and record current, time, cable length and ground position.
Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration.
quiz.explanation: 每個班次開工前以首件試焊確認設定，記錄電流、時間、電纜長度與接地位置；作業中若更換電纜、移動電源或改變剪力釘批次，須重新試焊；雨天或板面潮濕時停止焊接。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm settings with first-stud trial welds at the start of each shift and record current, time, cable length and ground position; re-test after changing cables, moving the power source or changing stud lots, and stop welding in rain or on wet deck. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drawn-arc stud welding conditions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「焊槍設定與陶瓷護圈」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gun settings and ceramic ferrules” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 電源與多支焊槍共用造成電流不足，焊瘤不完整、釘端未完全熔合，剪力釘在敲擊或彎曲時從根部脫落；接地夾夾在遠端鋼承板上，電流經由鋼承板搭接處流通，產生電弧偏吹與不穩定焊接。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A power source shared among several guns leaves current too low, giving incomplete flash and unfused stud bases that break off when tapped or bent; a ground clamp on distant decking routes current through deck laps, causing arc blow and erratic welds. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：現場常見問題是電源容量不足、電纜過長或接地不良，使實際電流低於設定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Common site problems are undersized power supplies, overlong cables and poor grounds that leave actual current below the setting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 電源與多支焊槍共用造成電流不足，焊瘤不完整、釘端未完全熔合，剪力釘在敲擊或彎曲時從根部脫落；接地夾夾在遠端鋼承板上，電流經由鋼承板搭接處流通，產生電弧偏吹與不穩定焊接。
knowledge.textEn: A power source shared among several guns leaves current too low, giving incomplete flash and unfused stud bases that break off when tapped or bent; a ground clamp on distant decking routes current through deck laps, causing arc blow and erratic welds.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drawn-arc stud welding conditions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。
電源與多支焊槍共用造成電流不足，焊瘤不完整、釘端未完全熔合，剪力釘在敲擊或彎曲時從根部脫落。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded.
A power source shared among several guns leaves current too low, giving incomplete flash and unfused stud bases that break off when tapped or bent.
quiz.explanation: 電源與多支焊槍共用造成電流不足，焊瘤不完整、釘端未完全熔合，剪力釘在敲擊或彎曲時從根部脫落；接地夾夾在遠端鋼承板上，電流經由鋼承板搭接處流通，產生電弧偏吹與不穩定焊接。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A power source shared among several guns leaves current too low, giving incomplete flash and unfused stud bases that break off when tapped or bent; a ground clamp on distant decking routes current through deck laps, causing arc blow and erratic welds. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 首件試驗與尺寸檢核：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: First-stud testing and dimensional checks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「30° 彎曲試驗」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “30° bend test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每個生產時段開始或設定改變時，先在代表性的構件上焊兩支剪力釘，目視確認 360° 完整焊瘤，再用鐵鎚把剪力釘敲彎約 30°，焊道與熱影響區不得斷裂；通過後才開始量產。焊後長度也要檢查：拉弧焊接會消耗數公釐長度，焊後剪力釘必須高出鋼承板頂足夠距離，頂端又要保留足夠的混凝土保護層，兩者都影響剪力釘的錨定與耐久。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「30° 彎曲試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At the start of each production period or after a settings change, two studs are welded on a representative member, checked visually for a full 360° flash, then hammered over to about 30°; neither weld nor heat-affected zone may fracture, and only then does production begin. After-weld length is checked too: the drawn-arc process consumes a few millimetres, and the welded stud must still project far enough above the deck while leaving enough concrete cover over its head, both affecting anchorage and durability. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “30° bend test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：焊前長 130 mm、焊接消耗約 5 mm，焊後 125 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A stud 130 mm long before welding loses about 5 mm, leaving 125 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「30° 彎曲試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “30° bend test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 首件試驗與尺寸檢核
knowledge.text: 每個生產時段開始或設定改變時，先在代表性的構件上焊兩支剪力釘，目視確認 360° 完整焊瘤，再用鐵鎚把剪力釘敲彎約 30°，焊道與熱影響區不得斷裂；通過後才開始量產。焊後長度也要檢查：拉弧焊接會消耗數公釐長度，焊後剪力釘必須高出鋼承板頂足夠距離，頂端又要保留足夠的混凝土保護層，兩者都影響剪力釘的錨定與耐久。
knowledge.textEn: At the start of each production period or after a settings change, two studs are welded on a representative member, checked visually for a full 360° flash, then hammered over to about 30°; neither weld nor heat-affected zone may fracture, and only then does production begin. After-weld length is checked too: the drawn-arc process consumes a few millimetres, and the welded stud must still project far enough above the deck while leaving enough concrete cover over its head, both affecting anchorage and durability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「首件試驗與尺寸檢核」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "First-stud testing and dimensional checks" is correct?
options: 每個生產時段開始或設定改變時，先在代表性的構件上焊兩支剪力釘，目視確認 360° 完整焊瘤，再用鐵鎚把剪力釘敲彎約 30°，焊道與熱影響區不得斷裂。
被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。
剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。
optionsEn: At the start of each production period or after a settings change, two studs are welded on a representative member, checked visually for a full 360° flash, then hammered over to about 30°.
A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded.
If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting.
quiz.explanation: 每個生產時段開始或設定改變時，先在代表性的構件上焊兩支剪力釘，目視確認 360° 完整焊瘤，再用鐵鎚把剪力釘敲彎約 30°，焊道與熱影響區不得斷裂；通過後才開始量產。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At the start of each production period or after a settings change, two studs are welded on a representative member, checked visually for a full 360° flash, then hammered over to about 30°; neither weld nor heat-affected zone may fracture, and only then does production begin. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 首件試驗與尺寸檢核：定量估算
steps.titleEn: First-stud testing and dimensional checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「30° 彎曲試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “30° bend test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：焊前長 130 mm、焊接消耗約 5 mm，焊後 125 mm。鋼承板肋高 76 mm：高出肋頂 125 − 76 = 49 mm（≥ 38 mm）；樓板總厚 140 mm：釘頂保護層 140 − 125 = 15 mm（≥ 13 mm）。30° 彎曲時 125 mm 剪力釘頂端位移約 125×sin30° ≈ 62.5 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A stud 130 mm long before welding loses about 5 mm, leaving 125 mm. With a 76 mm deck rib it projects 125 − 76 = 49 mm above the rib (≥ 38 mm), and in a 140 mm slab it leaves 140 − 125 = 15 mm of cover over the head (≥ 13 mm). Bending a 125 mm stud by 30° moves its tip about 125×sin30° ≈ 62.5 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：首件試驗由檢驗員見證並記錄日期、構件、設定、剪力釘批次與結果；失敗時調整設定並重做兩支，直到合格；量產中抽量焊後長度，若長度變化異常（過長代表熔化不足、過短代表過度熔化），立即停焊檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspectors witness first-stud tests and record date, member, settings, stud lot and result; on failure, adjust and repeat with two more studs until they pass; during production, spot-measure after-weld length and stop to investigate abnormal changes, since too long suggests insufficient melting and too short excessive melting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 焊前長 130 mm、焊接消耗約 5 mm，焊後 125 mm。鋼承板肋高 76 mm：高出肋頂 125 − 76 = 49 mm（≥ 38 mm）；樓板總厚 140 mm：釘頂保護層 140 − 125 = 15 mm（≥ 13 mm）。30° 彎曲時 125 mm 剪力釘頂端位移約 125×sin30° ≈ 62.5 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A stud 130 mm long before welding loses about 5 mm, leaving 125 mm. With a 76 mm deck rib it projects 125 − 76 = 49 mm above the rib (≥ 38 mm), and in a 140 mm slab it leaves 140 − 125 = 15 mm of cover over the head (≥ 13 mm). Bending a 125 mm stud by 30° moves its tip about 125×sin30° ≈ 62.5 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「首件試驗與尺寸檢核」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "First-stud testing and dimensional checks", which statement holds?
options: 組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。
焊前長 130 mm、焊接消耗約 5 mm，焊後 125 mm。
混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。
optionsEn: The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire.
A stud 130 mm long before welding loses about 5 mm, leaving 125 mm.
A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it.
quiz.explanation: 焊前長 130 mm、焊接消耗約 5 mm，焊後 125 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A stud 130 mm long before welding loses about 5 mm, leaving 125 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 首件試驗與尺寸檢核：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: First-stud testing and dimensional checks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「30° 彎曲試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “30° bend test” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 首件試驗由檢驗員見證並記錄日期、構件、設定、剪力釘批次與結果；失敗時調整設定並重做兩支，直到合格；量產中抽量焊後長度，若長度變化異常（過長代表熔化不足、過短代表過度熔化），立即停焊檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspectors witness first-stud tests and record date, member, settings, stud lot and result; on failure, adjust and repeat with two more studs until they pass; during production, spot-measure after-weld length and stop to investigate abnormal changes, since too long suggests insufficient melting and too short excessive melting. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把首件彎曲試驗列為每個班次與每次設定變更後的停留點，結果寫入剪力釘焊接日誌；通過試驗而彎曲的剪力釘若不妨礙鋼筋與保護層，一般可保留，具體做法依規範與工程師指示。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make the first-stud bend test a hold point for every shift and every settings change and log the results; studs bent in a passing test can usually remain if they do not obstruct reinforcement or cover, following the code and the engineer's instructions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略首件試驗直接量產，當天設定其實偏低，整區數百支剪力釘焊瘤不完整；若混凝土已澆置，只能以鑽心或打除樓板抽查，補救工程遠比一次試驗昂貴。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping first-stud tests and going straight to production with a low setting leaves hundreds of studs across an area with incomplete flash; once concrete is placed, checking requires coring or breaking out the slab, far costlier than one test. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 首件試驗由檢驗員見證並記錄日期、構件、設定、剪力釘批次與結果；失敗時調整設定並重做兩支，直到合格；量產中抽量焊後長度，若長度變化異常（過長代表熔化不足、過短代表過度熔化），立即停焊檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Inspectors witness first-stud tests and record date, member, settings, stud lot and result; on failure, adjust and repeat with two more studs until they pass; during production, spot-measure after-weld length and stop to investigate abnormal changes, since too long suggests insufficient melting and too short excessive melting.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把首件彎曲試驗列為每個班次與每次設定變更後的停留點，結果寫入剪力釘焊接日誌；通過試驗而彎曲的剪力釘若不妨礙鋼筋與保護層，一般可保留，具體做法依規範與工程師指示。
knowledge.textEn: Make the first-stud bend test a hold point for every shift and every settings change and log the results; studs bent in a passing test can usually remain if they do not obstruct reinforcement or cover, following the code and the engineer's instructions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「首件試驗與尺寸檢核」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "First-stud testing and dimensional checks"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。
首件試驗由檢驗員見證並記錄日期、構件、設定、剪力釘批次與結果。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength.
Inspectors witness first-stud tests and record date, member, settings, stud lot and result.
quiz.explanation: 首件試驗由檢驗員見證並記錄日期、構件、設定、剪力釘批次與結果；失敗時調整設定並重做兩支，直到合格；量產中抽量焊後長度，若長度變化異常（過長代表熔化不足、過短代表過度熔化），立即停焊檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspectors witness first-stud tests and record date, member, settings, stud lot and result; on failure, adjust and repeat with two more studs until they pass; during production, spot-measure after-weld length and stop to investigate abnormal changes, since too long suggests insufficient melting and too short excessive melting. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 首件試驗與尺寸檢核：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: First-stud testing and dimensional checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「30° 彎曲試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “30° bend test” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略首件試驗直接量產，當天設定其實偏低，整區數百支剪力釘焊瘤不完整；若混凝土已澆置，只能以鑽心或打除樓板抽查，補救工程遠比一次試驗昂貴。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping first-stud tests and going straight to production with a low setting leaves hundreds of studs across an area with incomplete flash; once concrete is placed, checking requires coring or breaking out the slab, far costlier than one test. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：焊後長度也要檢查：拉弧焊接會消耗數公釐長度，焊後剪力釘必須高出鋼承板頂足夠距離，頂端又要保留足夠的混凝土保護層，兩者都影響剪力釘的錨定與耐久。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: After-weld length is checked too: the drawn-arc process consumes a few millimetres, and the welded stud must still project far enough above the deck while leaving enough concrete cover over its head, both affecting anchorage and durability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略首件試驗直接量產，當天設定其實偏低，整區數百支剪力釘焊瘤不完整；若混凝土已澆置，只能以鑽心或打除樓板抽查，補救工程遠比一次試驗昂貴。
knowledge.textEn: Skipping first-stud tests and going straight to production with a low setting leaves hundreds of studs across an area with incomplete flash; once concrete is placed, checking requires coring or breaking out the slab, far costlier than one test.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「首件試驗與尺寸檢核」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "First-stud testing and dimensional checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 省略首件試驗直接量產，當天設定其實偏低，整區數百支剪力釘焊瘤不完整；若混凝土已澆置，只能以鑽心或打除樓板抽查，補救工程遠比一次試驗昂貴。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。
optionsEn: Skipping first-stud tests and going straight to production with a low setting leaves hundreds of studs across an area with incomplete flash.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting.
quiz.explanation: 省略首件試驗直接量產，當天設定其實偏低，整區數百支剪力釘焊瘤不完整；若混凝土已澆置，只能以鑽心或打除樓板抽查，補救工程遠比一次試驗昂貴。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Skipping first-stud tests and going straight to production with a low setting leaves hundreds of studs across an area with incomplete flash; once concrete is placed, checking requires coring or breaking out the slab, far costlier than one test. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查」與「推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Visual, ring and replacement checks" and "Push-out tests and stud resistance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Visual, ring and replacement checks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「360° 焊瘤與敲擊聲」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “360° flash and hammer ring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 量產中的剪力釘檢查以全數目視為主：焊瘤應完整環繞釘根，沒有缺口、裂紋或過度飛濺；剪力釘應垂直、長度一致。焊瘤不完整或可疑的剪力釘可以鐵鎚敲擊聽聲，或敲彎約 15° 檢查根部，不合格者須在旁邊補焊新剪力釘或依程序以填角焊修補。由於混凝土澆置後無法再檢查，檢驗必須在澆置前完成並放行，這是整個組合樓板最關鍵的停留點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「360° 焊瘤與敲擊聲」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Production studs are checked mainly by 100% visual inspection: the flash should fully encircle the base with no gaps, cracks or excessive spatter, and studs should be upright and of consistent length. Studs with incomplete or doubtful flash can be ring-tested with a hammer or bent about 15° to check the base, and rejects are replaced by a new stud alongside or repaired by fillet welding per the procedure. Because nothing can be checked once concrete is placed, inspection must be completed and released before casting, the single most critical hold point for a composite floor. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “360° flash and hammer ring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若某區不良率為 10%，隨機敲彎 5 支都沒抽到不良的機率 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%；一根梁 40 支剪力釘、不良率 2% 時，至少有一支不良的機率 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If an area has a 10% defect rate, the chance that 5 randomly bent studs include no defect is 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%; for a beam with 40 studs and a 2% defect rate, the chance that at least one is defective is 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「360° 焊瘤與敲擊聲」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “360° flash and hammer ring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查
knowledge.text: 量產中的剪力釘檢查以全數目視為主：焊瘤應完整環繞釘根，沒有缺口、裂紋或過度飛濺；剪力釘應垂直、長度一致。焊瘤不完整或可疑的剪力釘可以鐵鎚敲擊聽聲，或敲彎約 15° 檢查根部，不合格者須在旁邊補焊新剪力釘或依程序以填角焊修補。
knowledge.textEn: Production studs are checked mainly by 100% visual inspection: the flash should fully encircle the base with no gaps, cracks or excessive spatter, and studs should be upright and of consistent length. Studs with incomplete or doubtful flash can be ring-tested with a hammer or bent about 15° to check the base, and rejects are replaced by a new stud alongside or repaired by fillet welding per the procedure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Visual, ring and replacement checks" is correct?
options: 剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。
量產中的剪力釘檢查以全數目視為主：焊瘤應完整環繞釘根，沒有缺口、裂紋或過度飛濺；剪力釘應垂直、長度一致。
剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。
optionsEn: If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting.

Production studs are checked mainly by 100% visual inspection: the flash should fully encircle the base with no gaps, cracks or excessive spatter, and studs should be upright and of consistent length.
Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape.
quiz.explanation: 量產中的剪力釘檢查以全數目視為主：焊瘤應完整環繞釘根，沒有缺口、裂紋或過度飛濺；剪力釘應垂直、長度一致。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Production studs are checked mainly by 100% visual inspection: the flash should fully encircle the base with no gaps, cracks or excessive spatter, and studs should be upright and of consistent length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Visual, ring and replacement checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「360° 焊瘤與敲擊聲」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “360° flash and hammer ring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若某區不良率為 10%，隨機敲彎 5 支都沒抽到不良的機率 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%；一根梁 40 支剪力釘、不良率 2% 時，至少有一支不良的機率 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%。抽樣無法代替全數目視，彎曲只用於可疑剪力釘。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If an area has a 10% defect rate, the chance that 5 randomly bent studs include no defect is 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%; for a beam with 40 studs and a 2% defect rate, the chance that at least one is defective is 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%. Sampling cannot replace 100% visual inspection, and bending is reserved for doubtful studs. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以樓層與梁編號分區檢查，每根梁清點剪力釘數量並與施工圖比對，檢查焊瘤、垂直度與長度，可疑者敲擊或彎曲；不合格與補焊位置以油漆標記並記錄，全部完成後由檢驗員簽發澆置放行單。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect by floor and beam number, count studs on every beam against the shop drawing, check flash, plumbness and length, and ring or bend doubtful studs; mark and record rejects and replacements in paint, and have the inspector issue a casting release once all are complete.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若某區不良率為 10%，隨機敲彎 5 支都沒抽到不良的機率 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%；一根梁 40 支剪力釘、不良率 2% 時，至少有一支不良的機率 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%。抽樣無法代替全數目視，彎曲只用於可疑剪力釘。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If an area has a 10% defect rate, the chance that 5 randomly bent studs include no defect is 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%; for a beam with 40 studs and a 2% defect rate, the chance that at least one is defective is 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%. Sampling cannot replace 100% visual inspection, and bending is reserved for doubtful studs. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Visual, ring and replacement checks", which statement holds?
options: 剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。
部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。
若某區不良率為 10%，隨機敲彎 5 支都沒抽到不良的機率 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%。
optionsEn: Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them.
Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration.
If an area has a 10% defect rate, the chance that 5 randomly bent studs include no defect is 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%.
quiz.explanation: 若某區不良率為 10%，隨機敲彎 5 支都沒抽到不良的機率 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%；一根梁 40 支剪力釘、不良率 2% 時，至少有一支不良的機率 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If an area has a 10% defect rate, the chance that 5 randomly bent studs include no defect is 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%; for a beam with 40 studs and a 2% defect rate, the chance that at least one is defective is 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Visual, ring and replacement checks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「360° 焊瘤與敲擊聲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “360° flash and hammer ring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以樓層與梁編號分區檢查，每根梁清點剪力釘數量並與施工圖比對，檢查焊瘤、垂直度與長度，可疑者敲擊或彎曲；不合格與補焊位置以油漆標記並記錄，全部完成後由檢驗員簽發澆置放行單。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect by floor and beam number, count studs on every beam against the shop drawing, check flash, plumbness and length, and ring or bend doubtful studs; mark and record rejects and replacements in paint, and have the inspector issue a casting release once all are complete. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：澆置前的剪力釘檢查放行單應列為混凝土澆置許可的必要文件，由結構監造簽認；補焊剪力釘須使用相同程序並重新檢查，放行單上註明補焊數量與位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make the stud inspection release a required document for the concrete pour permit, signed by the structural inspector; replacement studs use the same procedure and are re-inspected, with their number and locations noted on the release.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若澆置時程壓縮而未完成剪力釘檢查，混凝土車到場就直接澆置，缺漏或不良的剪力釘從此無法發現；之後即使樓板裂縫或撓度異常，也很難判斷是否源自剪力釘。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the casting schedule is squeezed and stud inspection is incomplete when the trucks arrive, missing or defective studs are buried for good; later slab cracking or excess deflection can then hardly be traced to the studs. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以樓層與梁編號分區檢查，每根梁清點剪力釘數量並與施工圖比對，檢查焊瘤、垂直度與長度，可疑者敲擊或彎曲；不合格與補焊位置以油漆標記並記錄，全部完成後由檢驗員簽發澆置放行單。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect by floor and beam number, count studs on every beam against the shop drawing, check flash, plumbness and length, and ring or bend doubtful studs; mark and record rejects and replacements in paint, and have the inspector issue a casting release once all are complete.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 澆置前的剪力釘檢查放行單應列為混凝土澆置許可的必要文件，由結構監造簽認；補焊剪力釘須使用相同程序並重新檢查，放行單上註明補焊數量與位置。
knowledge.textEn: Make the stud inspection release a required document for the concrete pour permit, signed by the structural inspector; replacement studs use the same procedure and are re-inspected, with their number and locations noted on the release.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Visual, ring and replacement checks"?
options: 以樓層與梁編號分區檢查，每根梁清點剪力釘數量並與施工圖比對，檢查焊瘤、垂直度與長度，可疑者敲擊或彎曲。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。
optionsEn: Inspect by floor and beam number, count studs on every beam against the shop drawing, check flash, plumbness and length, and ring or bend doubtful studs.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam.
quiz.explanation: 以樓層與梁編號分區檢查，每根梁清點剪力釘數量並與施工圖比對，檢查焊瘤、垂直度與長度，可疑者敲擊或彎曲；不合格與補焊位置以油漆標記並記錄，全部完成後由檢驗員簽發澆置放行單。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect by floor and beam number, count studs on every beam against the shop drawing, check flash, plumbness and length, and ring or bend doubtful studs; mark and record rejects and replacements in paint, and have the inspector issue a casting release once all are complete. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Visual, ring and replacement checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「360° 焊瘤與敲擊聲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “360° flash and hammer ring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若澆置時程壓縮而未完成剪力釘檢查，混凝土車到場就直接澆置，缺漏或不良的剪力釘從此無法發現；之後即使樓板裂縫或撓度異常，也很難判斷是否源自剪力釘。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the casting schedule is squeezed and stud inspection is incomplete when the trucks arrive, missing or defective studs are buried for good; later slab cracking or excess deflection can then hardly be traced to the studs. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：由於混凝土澆置後無法再檢查，檢驗必須在澆置前完成並放行，這是整個組合樓板最關鍵的停留點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because nothing can be checked once concrete is placed, inspection must be completed and released before casting, the single most critical hold point for a composite floor.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若澆置時程壓縮而未完成剪力釘檢查，混凝土車到場就直接澆置，缺漏或不良的剪力釘從此無法發現；之後即使樓板裂縫或撓度異常，也很難判斷是否源自剪力釘。
knowledge.textEn: If the casting schedule is squeezed and stud inspection is incomplete when the trucks arrive, missing or defective studs are buried for good; later slab cracking or excess deflection can then hardly be traced to the studs.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Visual, ring and replacement checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若澆置時程壓縮而未完成剪力釘檢查，混凝土車到場就直接澆置，缺漏或不良的剪力釘從此無法發現；之後即使樓板裂縫或撓度異常，也很難判斷是否源自剪力釘。
剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If the casting schedule is squeezed and stud inspection is incomplete when the trucks arrive, missing or defective studs are buried for good.
Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape.
quiz.explanation: 若澆置時程壓縮而未完成剪力釘檢查，混凝土車到場就直接澆置，缺漏或不良的剪力釘從此無法發現；之後即使樓板裂縫或撓度異常，也很難判斷是否源自剪力釘。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the casting schedule is squeezed and stud inspection is incomplete when the trucks arrive, missing or defective studs are buried for good; later slab cracking or excess deflection can then hardly be traced to the studs. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Push-out tests and stud resistance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「推出試驗試體」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Push-out test specimen” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力釘在特定壓型鋼板、混凝土與焊接條件下的強度與滑移能力，可用推出試驗直接量測：把焊有剪力釘的短鋼梁夾在兩塊混凝土板之間，從上方推壓鋼梁，記錄載重與滑移，直到剪力釘或混凝土破壞。歐洲規範 EN 1994-1-1 以特徵滑移能力至少 6 mm 作為延性剪力釘的條件，並提供由試驗結果求取設計強度的方法。新型壓型鋼板、特殊剪力釘或非標準焊接條件，都應以推出試驗確認。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「推出試驗試體」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The strength and slip capacity of studs with a particular deck, concrete and welding condition can be measured directly by push-out tests: a short steel section with studs is sandwiched between two concrete slabs and pushed down while load and slip are recorded until the studs or concrete fail. EN 1994-1-1 treats studs as ductile when their characteristic slip capacity is at least 6 mm and gives a procedure for deriving design resistance from tests. New deck profiles, special connectors or non-standard welding conditions should be confirmed by push-out testing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Push-out test specimen” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：三組推出試驗每支剪力釘破壞載重 92、88、95 kN，平均約 91.7 kN，各值偏差都在 10% 以內；特徵強度取最小值的 0.9 倍：P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN，設計強度 P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Three push-out tests give failure loads per stud of 92, 88 and 95 kN, a mean of about 91.7 kN with every result within 10%; the characteristic resistance is 0.9 times the minimum, P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN, and the design resistance P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「推出試驗試體」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Push-out test specimen”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證
knowledge.text: 剪力釘在特定壓型鋼板、混凝土與焊接條件下的強度與滑移能力，可用推出試驗直接量測：把焊有剪力釘的短鋼梁夾在兩塊混凝土板之間，從上方推壓鋼梁，記錄載重與滑移，直到剪力釘或混凝土破壞。歐洲規範 EN 1994-1-1 以特徵滑移能力至少 6 mm 作為延性剪力釘的條件，並提供由試驗結果求取設計強度的方法。
knowledge.textEn: The strength and slip capacity of studs with a particular deck, concrete and welding condition can be measured directly by push-out tests: a short steel section with studs is sandwiched between two concrete slabs and pushed down while load and slip are recorded until the studs or concrete fail. EN 1994-1-1 treats studs as ductile when their characteristic slip capacity is at least 6 mm and gives a procedure for deriving design resistance from tests.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Push-out tests and stud resistance" is correct?
options: 剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。
組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。
剪力釘在特定壓型鋼板、混凝土與焊接條件下的強度與滑移能力，可用推出試驗直接量測：把焊有剪力釘的短鋼梁夾在兩塊混凝土板之間，從上方推壓鋼梁，記錄載重與滑移，直到剪力釘或混凝土破壞。
optionsEn: Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape.
The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire.

The strength and slip capacity of studs with a particular deck, concrete and welding condition can be measured directly by push-out tests: a short steel section with studs is sandwiched between two concrete slabs and pushed down while load and slip are recorded until the studs or concrete fail.
quiz.explanation: 剪力釘在特定壓型鋼板、混凝土與焊接條件下的強度與滑移能力，可用推出試驗直接量測：把焊有剪力釘的短鋼梁夾在兩塊混凝土板之間，從上方推壓鋼梁，記錄載重與滑移，直到剪力釘或混凝土破壞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The strength and slip capacity of studs with a particular deck, concrete and welding condition can be measured directly by push-out tests: a short steel section with studs is sandwiched between two concrete slabs and pushed down while load and slip are recorded until the studs or concrete fail. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Push-out tests and stud resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「推出試驗試體」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Push-out test specimen” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：三組推出試驗每支剪力釘破壞載重 92、88、95 kN，平均約 91.7 kN，各值偏差都在 10% 以內；特徵強度取最小值的 0.9 倍：P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN，設計強度 P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Three push-out tests give failure loads per stud of 92, 88 and 95 kN, a mean of about 91.7 kN with every result within 10%; the characteristic resistance is 0.9 times the minimum, P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN, and the design resistance P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試體須使用與實際工程相同的壓型鋼板、剪力釘批次、焊接設定與混凝土配比，並在試驗當天量測混凝土強度；記錄完整的載重—滑移曲線，確認破壞模式（剪力釘剪斷、混凝土劈裂或拔出）與滑移能力是否滿足延性條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Specimens must use the same deck, stud lot, welding settings and concrete mix as the project, with concrete strength measured on test day; record the full load–slip curve and confirm the failure mode (stud shear, concrete splitting or pull-out) and whether slip capacity meets the ductility condition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 三組推出試驗每支剪力釘破壞載重 92、88、95 kN，平均約 91.7 kN，各值偏差都在 10% 以內；特徵強度取最小值的 0.9 倍：P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN，設計強度 P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Three push-out tests give failure loads per stud of 92, 88 and 95 kN, a mean of about 91.7 kN with every result within 10%; the characteristic resistance is 0.9 times the minimum, P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN, and the design resistance P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Push-out tests and stud resistance", which statement holds?
options: 三組推出試驗每支剪力釘破壞載重 92、88、95 kN，平均約 91.7 kN，各值偏差都在 10% 以內。
混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。
剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。
optionsEn: Three push-out tests give failure loads per stud of 92, 88 and 95 kN, a mean of about 91.7 kN with every result within 10%.
A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it.
Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength.
quiz.explanation: 三組推出試驗每支剪力釘破壞載重 92、88、95 kN，平均約 91.7 kN，各值偏差都在 10% 以內；特徵強度取最小值的 0.9 倍：P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN，設計強度 P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Three push-out tests give failure loads per stud of 92, 88 and 95 kN, a mean of about 91.7 kN with every result within 10%; the characteristic resistance is 0.9 times the minimum, P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN, and the design resistance P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Push-out tests and stud resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「推出試驗試體」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Push-out test specimen” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試體須使用與實際工程相同的壓型鋼板、剪力釘批次、焊接設定與混凝土配比，並在試驗當天量測混凝土強度；記錄完整的載重—滑移曲線，確認破壞模式（剪力釘剪斷、混凝土劈裂或拔出）與滑移能力是否滿足延性條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Specimens must use the same deck, stud lot, welding settings and concrete mix as the project, with concrete strength measured on test day; record the full load–slip curve and confirm the failure mode (stud shear, concrete splitting or pull-out) and whether slip capacity meets the ductility condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採用新型壓型鋼板或非標準剪力釘配置時，設計者應要求供應商提供依規範進行的推出試驗報告，並在設計說明中註明採用的強度與延性依據；報告須涵蓋實際使用的剪力釘位置與數量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When a new deck profile or non-standard stud layout is used, the designer should require the supplier's code-compliant push-out test reports and state the adopted resistance and ductility basis in the design notes; the reports must cover the actual stud positions and numbers used.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以標準平板的試驗結果套用到肋高較大、肋寬較窄的新型鋼承板，實際破壞可能由混凝土肋劈裂控制，強度與滑移能力都低於假設，部分組合梁的塑性設計前提隨之失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying solid-slab test results to a new deep, narrow-rib deck can miss that failure is governed by rib splitting, with strength and slip capacity both below assumption, invalidating the plastic design premise of partially composite beams. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試體須使用與實際工程相同的壓型鋼板、剪力釘批次、焊接設定與混凝土配比，並在試驗當天量測混凝土強度；記錄完整的載重—滑移曲線，確認破壞模式（剪力釘剪斷、混凝土劈裂或拔出）與滑移能力是否滿足延性條件。
knowledge.textEn: Specimens must use the same deck, stud lot, welding settings and concrete mix as the project, with concrete strength measured on test day; record the full load–slip curve and confirm the failure mode (stud shear, concrete splitting or pull-out) and whether slip capacity meets the ductility condition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 採用新型壓型鋼板或非標準剪力釘配置時，設計者應要求供應商提供依規範進行的推出試驗報告，並在設計說明中註明採用的強度與延性依據；報告須涵蓋實際使用的剪力釘位置與數量。
knowledge.textEn: When a new deck profile or non-standard stud layout is used, the designer should require the supplier's code-compliant push-out test reports and state the adopted resistance and ductility basis in the design notes; the reports must cover the actual stud positions and numbers used.

quiz.question: 要驗證「推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Push-out tests and stud resistance"?

剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Specimens must use the same deck, stud lot, welding settings and concrete mix as the project, with concrete strength measured on test day.
Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Push-out tests and stud resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「推出試驗試體」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Push-out test specimen” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以標準平板的試驗結果套用到肋高較大、肋寬較窄的新型鋼承板，實際破壞可能由混凝土肋劈裂控制，強度與滑移能力都低於假設，部分組合梁的塑性設計前提隨之失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying solid-slab test results to a new deep, narrow-rib deck can miss that failure is governed by rib splitting, with strength and slip capacity both below assumption, invalidating the plastic design premise of partially composite beams. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：新型壓型鋼板、特殊剪力釘或非標準焊接條件，都應以推出試驗確認。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: New deck profiles, special connectors or non-standard welding conditions should be confirmed by push-out testing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以標準平板的試驗結果套用到肋高較大、肋寬較窄的新型鋼承板，實際破壞可能由混凝土肋劈裂控制，強度與滑移能力都低於假設，部分組合梁的塑性設計前提隨之失效。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Push-out tests and stud resistance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。
若以標準平板的試驗結果套用到肋高較大、肋寬較窄的新型鋼承板，實際破壞可能由混凝土肋劈裂控制，強度與滑移能力都低於假設，部分組合梁的塑性設計前提隨之失效。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire.

Applying solid-slab test results to a new deep, narrow-rib deck can miss that failure is governed by rib splitting, with strength and slip capacity both below assumption, invalidating the plastic design premise of partially composite beams.
