quiz.explanationEn: Applying solid-slab test results to a new deep, narrow-rib deck can miss that failure is governed by rib splitting, with strength and slip capacity both below assumption, invalidating the plastic design premise of partially composite beams. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板」與「剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Composite floors under fire and thermal effects" and "Stud records, alterations and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Composite floors under fire and thermal effects: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樓板熱膨脹與梁端接頭」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floor thermal expansion and beam-end connections” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力釘讓鋼梁與樓板連成一體，這在常溫下是優點，在火災中卻會帶來另一種力：受熱的組合梁膨脹時被周圍結構束制，產生很大的軸向推力，推向梁端接頭與相鄰大梁。NIST 對世界貿易中心七號樓的調查指出，樓板梁以剪力釘與混凝土組合，長跨樓板梁在遠低於一般設計考慮的溫度下熱膨脹，推動一根關鍵大梁離開其在 79 號柱的支承座，引發樓板連續破壞與柱挫屈；NIST 建議設計時檢討組合樓板與未考慮熱效應之接頭的熱膨脹影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樓板熱膨脹與梁端接頭」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Studs make the steel beam and slab act as one, an advantage at normal temperature that brings a different force in fire: a heated composite beam expands against surrounding restraint and develops large axial thrust on its end connections and adjacent girders. NIST's investigation of 7 World Trade Center found that floor beams, made composite with the slab by shear studs, expanded on long spans at temperatures far below those normally considered in design and pushed a key girder off its seat at Column 79, starting progressive floor failures and column buckling; NIST recommended evaluating thermal expansion in buildings with composite floor systems and connections not designed for thermal effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Floor thermal expansion and beam-end connections” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樓板熱膨脹與梁端接頭」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Floor thermal expansion and beam-end connections”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板
knowledge.titleEn: Composite floors under fire and thermal effects
knowledge.text: 剪力釘讓鋼梁與樓板連成一體，這在常溫下是優點，在火災中卻會帶來另一種力：受熱的組合梁膨脹時被周圍結構束制，產生很大的軸向推力，推向梁端接頭與相鄰大梁。NIST 對世界貿易中心七號樓的調查指出，樓板梁以剪力釘與混凝土組合，長跨樓板梁在遠低於一般設計考慮的溫度下熱膨脹，推動一根關鍵大梁離開其在 79 號柱的支承座，引發樓板連續破壞與柱挫屈；NIST 建議設計時檢討組合樓板與未考慮熱效應之接頭的熱膨脹影響。
knowledge.textEn: Studs make the steel beam and slab act as one, an advantage at normal temperature that brings a different force in fire: a heated composite beam expands against surrounding restraint and develops large axial thrust on its end connections and adjacent girders. NIST's investigation of 7 World Trade Center found that floor beams, made composite with the slab by shear studs, expanded on long spans at temperatures far below those normally considered in design and pushed a key girder off its seat at Column 79, starting progressive floor failures and column buckling; NIST recommended evaluating thermal expansion in buildings with composite floor systems and connections not designed for thermal effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Composite floors under fire and thermal effects" is correct?
options: 剪力釘讓鋼梁與樓板連成一體，這在常溫下是優點，在火災中卻會帶來另一種力：受熱的組合梁膨脹時被周圍結構束制，產生很大的軸向推力，推向梁端接頭與相鄰大梁。
組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。
剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。
optionsEn: Studs make the steel beam and slab act as one, an advantage at normal temperature that brings a different force in fire: a heated composite beam expands against surrounding restraint and develops large axial thrust on its end connections and adjacent girders.
The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire.
Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them.
quiz.explanation: 剪力釘讓鋼梁與樓板連成一體，這在常溫下是優點，在火災中卻會帶來另一種力：受熱的組合梁膨脹時被周圍結構束制，產生很大的軸向推力，推向梁端接頭與相鄰大梁。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Studs make the steel beam and slab act as one, an advantage at normal temperature that brings a different force in fire: a heated composite beam expands against surrounding restraint and develops large axial thrust on its end connections and adjacent girders. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Composite floors under fire and thermal effects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板熱膨脹與梁端接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floor thermal expansion and beam-end connections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。15 m 長的樓板梁、α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、升溫 400°C：ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×15,000×400 = 72 mm。若梁端支承只有約 100 mm 的餘裕，在完全無束制下升溫約 100/(12×10⁻⁶×15,000) ≈ 556°C 即可推離。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. A 15 m floor beam with α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C heated by 400°C grows ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×15,000×400 = 72 mm. If its end bearing has only about 100 mm of margin, an unrestrained rise of about 100/(12×10⁻⁶×15,000) ≈ 556°C pushes it off. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：性能式防火設計時，以考慮熱膨脹與束制的分析檢查長跨組合梁的端部接頭、支承座寬度與相鄰大梁的側向力；施工時核對防火被覆範圍是否涵蓋接頭與剪力釘附近的翼板，避免局部高溫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In performance-based fire design, analyse long-span composite beams with thermal expansion and restraint to check end connections, seat widths and lateral forces on adjacent girders; during construction, confirm that fireproofing covers connections and flanges near the studs to avoid local hot spots.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。15 m 長的樓板梁、α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、升溫 400°C：ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×15,000×400 = 72 mm。若梁端支承只有約 100 mm 的餘裕，在完全無束制下升溫約 100/(12×10⁻⁶×15,000) ≈ 556°C 即可推離。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. A 15 m floor beam with α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C heated by 400°C grows ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×15,000×400 = 72 mm. If its end bearing has only about 100 mm of margin, an unrestrained rise of about 100/(12×10⁻⁶×15,000) ≈ 556°C pushes it off. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Composite floors under fire and thermal effects", which statement holds?
options: 部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。
熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。
optionsEn: Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration.
Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam.
quiz.explanation: 熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Composite floors under fire and thermal effects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓板熱膨脹與梁端接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Floor thermal expansion and beam-end connections” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 性能式防火設計時，以考慮熱膨脹與束制的分析檢查長跨組合梁的端部接頭、支承座寬度與相鄰大梁的側向力；施工時核對防火被覆範圍是否涵蓋接頭與剪力釘附近的翼板，避免局部高溫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In performance-based fire design, analyse long-span composite beams with thermal expansion and restraint to check end connections, seat widths and lateral forces on adjacent girders; during construction, confirm that fireproofing covers connections and flanges near the studs to avoid local hot spots. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：長跨組合樓板的防火與接頭設計應由結構與防火工程師共同檢討熱膨脹路徑，並在圖說中標示需特別防護或容許位移的接頭；這類變更須經主管機關審查，本課只說明原理，不代替防火設計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Structural and fire engineers should jointly review thermal-expansion paths in long-span composite floors and mark on the drawings the connections needing special protection or movement allowance; such changes require authority review, and this course explains principles only, not fire design.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若接頭只依重力剪力設計，未考慮熱膨脹產生的軸向力與位移，火災時樓板梁推動大梁或剪斷接頭螺栓，樓板失去支承後層層掉落，最後連帶柱的側向支撐失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Composite floors under fire and thermal effects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓板熱膨脹與梁端接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Floor thermal expansion and beam-end connections” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若接頭只依重力剪力設計，未考慮熱膨脹產生的軸向力與位移，火災時樓板梁推動大梁或剪斷接頭螺栓，樓板失去支承後層層掉落，最後連帶柱的側向支撐失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If connections are designed only for gravity shear, without thermal axial force and movement, fire-heated floor beams push girders or shear connection bolts, unsupported floors fall one onto another, and columns lose their lateral bracing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：NIST 對世界貿易中心七號樓的調查指出，樓板梁以剪力釘與混凝土組合，長跨樓板梁在遠低於一般設計考慮的溫度下熱膨脹，推動一根關鍵大梁離開其在 79 號柱的支承座，引發樓板連續破壞與柱挫屈；NIST 建議設計時檢討組合樓板與未考慮熱效應之接頭的熱膨脹影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: NIST's investigation of 7 World Trade Center found that floor beams, made composite with the slab by shear studs, expanded on long spans at temperatures far below those normally considered in design and pushed a key girder off its seat at Column 79, starting progressive floor failures and column buckling; NIST recommended evaluating thermal expansion in buildings with composite floor systems and connections not designed for thermal effects.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若接頭只依重力剪力設計，未考慮熱膨脹產生的軸向力與位移，火災時樓板梁推動大梁或剪斷接頭螺栓，樓板失去支承後層層掉落，最後連帶柱的側向支撐失效。
knowledge.textEn: If connections are designed only for gravity shear, without thermal axial force and movement, fire-heated floor beams push girders or shear connection bolts, unsupported floors fall one onto another, and columns lose their lateral bracing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Composite floors under fire and thermal effects" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若接頭只依重力剪力設計，未考慮熱膨脹產生的軸向力與位移，火災時樓板梁推動大梁或剪斷接頭螺栓，樓板失去支承後層層掉落，最後連帶柱的側向支撐失效。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。
optionsEn: If connections are designed only for gravity shear, without thermal axial force and movement, fire-heated floor beams push girders or shear connection bolts, unsupported floors fall one onto another, and columns lose their lateral bracing.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them.
quiz.explanation: 若接頭只依重力剪力設計，未考慮熱膨脹產生的軸向力與位移，火災時樓板梁推動大梁或剪斷接頭螺栓，樓板失去支承後層層掉落，最後連帶柱的側向支撐失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If connections are designed only for gravity shear, without thermal axial force and movement, fire-heated floor beams push girders or shear connection bolts, unsupported floors fall one onto another, and columns lose their lateral bracing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stud records, alterations and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「剪力釘配置圖與檢查紀錄」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stud layout and inspection records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 樓板完成後剪力釘全部埋在混凝土中，日後改修時工程師只能依賴紀錄判斷樓板與梁的組合程度。不同年代的組合樓板做法也不同：NIST 描述世界貿易中心雙子塔的樓板以輕型鋼桁架支承 4 in 厚的輕質混凝土，桁架腹桿頂端彎折的「指節」伸出上弦約 3 in 埋入樓板而產生組合作用，而不是焊接剪力釘。改修時若在梁旁開大洞、切除樓板或增加重載設備，都可能減少有效的剪力連接，必須依原始紀錄重新檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「剪力釘配置圖與檢查紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once the slab is cast, every stud is buried, and engineers altering the floor later can judge composite action only from records. Composite floors also differ by era: NIST describes the Twin Towers' floors as 4 in of lightweight concrete on light steel trusses whose bent web tops, the knuckles, projected about 3 in above the top chord into the slab to create composite action, rather than welded studs. Cutting large openings beside beams, removing slab or adding heavy equipment during alterations can reduce effective shear connection, so the original records must be used to recheck it. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stud layout and inspection records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原設計半跨 20 支剪力釘、每支 76.5 kN，組合比 58%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The original design has 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, a 58% ratio.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「剪力釘配置圖與檢查紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stud layout and inspection records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接
knowledge.text: 樓板完成後剪力釘全部埋在混凝土中，日後改修時工程師只能依賴紀錄判斷樓板與梁的組合程度。不同年代的組合樓板做法也不同：NIST 描述世界貿易中心雙子塔的樓板以輕型鋼桁架支承 4 in 厚的輕質混凝土，桁架腹桿頂端彎折的「指節」伸出上弦約 3 in 埋入樓板而產生組合作用，而不是焊接剪力釘。
knowledge.textEn: Once the slab is cast, every stud is buried, and engineers altering the floor later can judge composite action only from records. Composite floors also differ by era: NIST describes the Twin Towers' floors as 4 in of lightweight concrete on light steel trusses whose bent web tops, the knuckles, projected about 3 in above the top chord into the slab to create composite action, rather than welded studs.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stud records, alterations and handover" is correct?
options: 剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。
樓板完成後剪力釘全部埋在混凝土中，日後改修時工程師只能依賴紀錄判斷樓板與梁的組合程度。
混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。
optionsEn: Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them.
Once the slab is cast, every stud is buried, and engineers altering the floor later can judge composite action only from records.
A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it.
quiz.explanation: 樓板完成後剪力釘全部埋在混凝土中，日後改修時工程師只能依賴紀錄判斷樓板與梁的組合程度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once the slab is cast, every stud is buried, and engineers altering the floor later can judge composite action only from records. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stud records, alterations and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剪力釘配置圖與檢查紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stud layout and inspection records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原設計半跨 20 支剪力釘、每支 76.5 kN，組合比 58%。改修時沿梁開 1.2 m 寬的洞，切除 4 個肋內的剪力釘：剩 16 支，ΣQ_n = 16×76.5 ≈ 1,224 kN，組合比降為 1,224/2,619 ≈ 47%，須確認仍高於設計者設定的最低組合比並重新檢核強度與撓度。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The original design has 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, a 58% ratio. An alteration cutting a 1.2 m opening along the beam removes the studs in 4 ribs, leaving 16: ΣQ_n = 16×76.5 ≈ 1,224 kN and the ratio falls to 1,224/2,619 ≈ 47%, which must be confirmed above the designer's minimum ratio, with strength and deflection rechecked. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前核對竣工剪力釘配置圖與焊接日誌、首件試驗紀錄、澆置放行單是否一一對應；改修設計前，以紀錄確認原組合比，必要時以鑽心或局部打除樓板抽查剪力釘實際位置與狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, check that the as-built stud layout matches the welding logs, first-stud test records and casting releases one for one; before designing an alteration, confirm the original composite ratio from the records and, if needed, core or locally break out the slab to verify actual stud positions and condition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原設計半跨 20 支剪力釘、每支 76.5 kN，組合比 58%。改修時沿梁開 1.2 m 寬的洞，切除 4 個肋內的剪力釘：剩 16 支，ΣQ_n = 16×76.5 ≈ 1,224 kN，組合比降為 1,224/2,619 ≈ 47%，須確認仍高於設計者設定的最低組合比並重新檢核強度與撓度。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The original design has 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, a 58% ratio. An alteration cutting a 1.2 m opening along the beam removes the studs in 4 ribs, leaving 16: ΣQ_n = 16×76.5 ≈ 1,224 kN and the ratio falls to 1,224/2,619 ≈ 47%, which must be confirmed above the designer's minimum ratio, with strength and deflection rechecked. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stud records, alterations and handover", which statement holds?
options: 剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。
剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。
原設計半跨 20 支剪力釘、每支 76.5 kN，組合比 58%。
optionsEn: Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength.
Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day.
The original design has 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, a 58% ratio.
quiz.explanation: 原設計半跨 20 支剪力釘、每支 76.5 kN，組合比 58%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The original design has 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, a 58% ratio. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stud records, alterations and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剪力釘配置圖與檢查紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stud layout and inspection records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前核對竣工剪力釘配置圖與焊接日誌、首件試驗紀錄、澆置放行單是否一一對應；改修設計前，以紀錄確認原組合比，必要時以鑽心或局部打除樓板抽查剪力釘實際位置與狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, check that the as-built stud layout matches the welding logs, first-stud test records and casting releases one for one; before designing an alteration, confirm the original composite ratio from the records and, if needed, core or locally break out the slab to verify actual stud positions and condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含每根組合梁的剪力釘數量與位置、壓型鋼板型號、組合比、首件試驗與放行紀錄；建物管理規則要求樓板開孔或重型設備進駐前須經結構工程師核准，並更新紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include each composite beam's stud count and positions, deck type, composite ratio, first-stud test and release records; building management rules should require the structural engineer's approval, and a records update, before any slab opening or heavy equipment installation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若竣工圖沒有剪力釘資料，改修設計者只能假設梁為非組合，導致不必要的補強；反之若誤以為所有梁都完全組合，在梁旁開洞或加設備後，可能使樓板撓度與振動明顯增加，甚至超過強度餘裕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without stud data in the as-builts, an alteration designer must assume non-composite beams and strengthen needlessly; conversely, wrongly assuming full composite action everywhere can let openings or new equipment beside beams markedly increase deflection and vibration, or even exceed the strength margin. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前核對竣工剪力釘配置圖與焊接日誌、首件試驗紀錄、澆置放行單是否一一對應；改修設計前，以紀錄確認原組合比，必要時以鑽心或局部打除樓板抽查剪力釘實際位置與狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover, check that the as-built stud layout matches the welding logs, first-stud test records and casting releases one for one; before designing an alteration, confirm the original composite ratio from the records and, if needed, core or locally break out the slab to verify actual stud positions and condition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含每根組合梁的剪力釘數量與位置、壓型鋼板型號、組合比、首件試驗與放行紀錄；建物管理規則要求樓板開孔或重型設備進駐前須經結構工程師核准，並更新紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include each composite beam's stud count and positions, deck type, composite ratio, first-stud test and release records; building management rules should require the structural engineer's approval, and a records update, before any slab opening or heavy equipment installation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stud records, alterations and handover"?
options: 交接前核對竣工剪力釘配置圖與焊接日誌、首件試驗紀錄、澆置放行單是否一一對應；改修設計前，以紀錄確認原組合比，必要時以鑽心或局部打除樓板抽查剪力釘實際位置與狀態。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。
optionsEn: Before handover, check that the as-built stud layout matches the welding logs, first-stud test records and casting releases one for one.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting.
quiz.explanation: 交接前核對竣工剪力釘配置圖與焊接日誌、首件試驗紀錄、澆置放行單是否一一對應；改修設計前，以紀錄確認原組合比，必要時以鑽心或局部打除樓板抽查剪力釘實際位置與狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover, check that the as-built stud layout matches the welding logs, first-stud test records and casting releases one for one; before designing an alteration, confirm the original composite ratio from the records and, if needed, core or locally break out the slab to verify actual stud positions and condition. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stud records, alterations and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剪力釘配置圖與檢查紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stud layout and inspection records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若竣工圖沒有剪力釘資料，改修設計者只能假設梁為非組合，導致不必要的補強；反之若誤以為所有梁都完全組合，在梁旁開洞或加設備後，可能使樓板撓度與振動明顯增加，甚至超過強度餘裕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without stud data in the as-builts, an alteration designer must assume non-composite beams and strengthen needlessly; conversely, wrongly assuming full composite action everywhere can let openings or new equipment beside beams markedly increase deflection and vibration, or even exceed the strength margin. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：改修時若在梁旁開大洞、切除樓板或增加重載設備，都可能減少有效的剪力連接，必須依原始紀錄重新檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cutting large openings beside beams, removing slab or adding heavy equipment during alterations can reduce effective shear connection, so the original records must be used to recheck it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若竣工圖沒有剪力釘資料，改修設計者只能假設梁為非組合，導致不必要的補強；反之若誤以為所有梁都完全組合，在梁旁開洞或加設備後，可能使樓板撓度與振動明顯增加，甚至超過強度餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: Without stud data in the as-builts, an alteration designer must assume non-composite beams and strengthen needlessly; conversely, wrongly assuming full composite action everywhere can let openings or new equipment beside beams markedly increase deflection and vibration, or even exceed the strength margin.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stud records, alterations and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若竣工圖沒有剪力釘資料，改修設計者只能假設梁為非組合，導致不必要的補強。
混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without stud data in the as-builts, an alteration designer must assume non-composite beams and strengthen needlessly.
A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it.
quiz.explanation: 若竣工圖沒有剪力釘資料，改修設計者只能假設梁為非組合，導致不必要的補強；反之若誤以為所有梁都完全組合，在梁旁開洞或加設備後，可能使樓板撓度與振動明顯增加，甚至超過強度餘裕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without stud data in the as-builts, an alteration designer must assume non-composite beams and strengthen needlessly; conversely, wrongly assuming full composite action everywhere can let openings or new equipment beside beams markedly increase deflection and vibration, or even exceed the strength margin. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工
summary: 剪力牆是高層與中高層建築最主要的側力抵抗構件，其耐震表現取決於牆端邊界構材的圍束、縱筋續接位置、施工縫處理與混凝土在密集鋼筋中的密實度。本課以哈里發塔的扶壁式核心牆、亞特蘭大電梯試驗塔的滑模核心牆，以及 2011 年基督城 CTV 大樓倒塌後皇家調查委員會的檢討為背景，說明側力分配、邊界構材需求、圍束配筋、續接、鋼筋間距與骨材、澆置振搗、強度驗收、澆置前查驗、震後損傷判讀與開孔變更管控。
summaryEn: Shear walls are the main lateral-force-resisting members of mid- and high-rise buildings, and their seismic performance depends on confinement of boundary elements, the location of longitudinal splices, treatment of construction joints and the compaction of concrete within dense reinforcement. Against the background of Burj Khalifa's buttressed core walls, the slipformed core walls of the Atlanta elevator test tower and the Royal Commission's review after the 2011 collapse of the CTV Building in Christchurch, the course covers lateral force sharing, boundary-element demand, confinement detailing, splices, bar spacing and aggregate size, placing and vibration, strength acceptance, pre-pour inspection, post-earthquake damage interpretation and control of later openings.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
subcategoryTitleEn: Concrete and steel construction technology

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計檢核練習：一道長 l_w = 8 m、厚 400 mm 的剪力牆，f′_c = 42 MPa、f_y = 420 MPa，設計位移比 δ_u/h_w = 0.01，分析得中性軸深度 c = 1,100 mm。邊界構材門檻 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm，c 超過門檻，需特殊邊界構材，延伸長度 max(1,100 − 800, 550) = 550 mm，取 600 mm。圍束：邊界 400×600 mm、核心 320×520 mm，A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442，0.3×0.442×42/420 ≈ 0.0133 控制，s = 100 mm 時 A_sh ≥ 425 mm²，用 4 肢 D13（507 mm²）。剪力強度 V_n = 3.2×10⁶×(0.17×6.48 + 0.0025×420) ≈ 6,886 kN，φV_n = 0.75×6,886 ≈ 5,164 kN。縱筋 D25 的 B 類搭接約 1,240 mm，若全部在同一斷面搭接，邊界淨間距由約 92 mm 降到約 27 mm，故改為錯開或使用續接器。若設計位移比提高到 0.015，門檻降為 8,000/(600×0.0225) ≈ 593 mm，邊界構材需求更明確，延伸長度仍為 550 mm 但塑性鉸區的應變更高。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design check exercise: a shear wall with l_w = 8 m and 400 mm thickness has f′_c = 42 MPa, f_y = 420 MPa, a design drift ratio δ_u/h_w = 0.01 and an analysed neutral-axis depth c = 1,100 mm. The boundary threshold is 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm, which c exceeds, so a special boundary element is needed, extending max(1,100 − 800, 550) = 550 mm, taken as 600 mm. Confinement: with a 400×600 mm boundary and 320×520 mm core, A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442 and 0.3×0.442×42/420 ≈ 0.0133 governs, so at s = 100 mm A_sh ≥ 425 mm², provided by four legs of D13 (507 mm²). Shear strength is V_n = 3.2×10⁶×(0.17×6.48 + 0.0025×420) ≈ 6,886 kN and φV_n = 0.75×6,886 ≈ 5,164 kN. A Class B lap for D25 is about 1,240 mm; lapping all bars at one section would cut boundary clear spacing from about 92 mm to about 27 mm, so laps are staggered or couplers used. If the design drift ratio rises to 0.015, the threshold falls to 8,000/(600×0.0225) ≈ 593 mm, the boundary-element demand becomes clearer, and although the extent remains 550 mm the hinge-zone strains are higher. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑」與「撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path" and "Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「牆體側力分配」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral force share between walls” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 樓板像一片水平深梁，把每層的風力或地震慣性力收集起來，再依各牆的相對勁度分配給剪力牆；剪力牆以懸臂方式把剪力與彎矩傳到基礎。牆的勁度與長度三次方成正比，所以長牆分擔絕大多數側力，短牆幾乎只是跟著變形。哈里發塔由三翼各自的高性能混凝土核心牆與中央六角形核心互相扶壁，使整體抗扭勁度很高；這種「牆接牆」的佈置讓側力能在三翼之間互相分擔。施工時任何改變牆長、開口位置或樓板與牆連接的變更，都會改變這條傳力路徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「牆體側力分配」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Floors act as horizontal deep beams that collect each storey's wind or seismic inertia force and distribute it to the shear walls in proportion to their stiffness; the walls then carry shear and moment as cantilevers to the foundation. Wall stiffness varies with the cube of length, so long walls take most of the lateral force while short walls largely follow along. At Burj Khalifa each of the three wings has its own high-performance concrete core walls, and these buttress one another through a central hexagonal core, giving very high torsional stiffness; this wall-to-wall arrangement lets lateral force be shared among the wings. During construction, any change to wall length, opening position or the floor-to-wall connection alters this load path. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lateral force share between walls” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩道等厚懸臂牆、長度 8 m 與 4 m，以撓曲控制時勁度比 ∝ L³ = 512 : 64，長牆分擔 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% 的側力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For two cantilever walls of equal thickness and lengths of 8 m and 4 m, flexure-governed stiffness scales as L³ = 512 : 64, so the long wall takes 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% of the lateral force.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「建築裡每一道牆都平均分擔地震力，所以多加幾道短牆就能有效提高抗震能力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every wall in a building shares seismic force equally, so adding a few short walls effectively raises seismic capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「牆體側力分配」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lateral force share between walls”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑
knowledge.titleEn: Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path
knowledge.text: 樓板像一片水平深梁，把每層的風力或地震慣性力收集起來，再依各牆的相對勁度分配給剪力牆；剪力牆以懸臂方式把剪力與彎矩傳到基礎。牆的勁度與長度三次方成正比，所以長牆分擔絕大多數側力，短牆幾乎只是跟著變形。
knowledge.textEn: Floors act as horizontal deep beams that collect each storey's wind or seismic inertia force and distribute it to the shear walls in proportion to their stiffness; the walls then carry shear and moment as cantilevers to the foundation. Wall stiffness varies with the cube of length, so long walls take most of the lateral force while short walls largely follow along.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：建築裡每一道牆都平均分擔地震力，所以多加幾道短牆就能有效提高抗震能力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every wall in a building shares seismic force equally, so adding a few short walls effectively raises seismic capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path" is correct?
options: 建築裡每一道牆都平均分擔地震力，所以多加幾道短牆就能有效提高抗震能力。
樓板像一片水平深梁，把每層的風力或地震慣性力收集起來，再依各牆的相對勁度分配給剪力牆；剪力牆以懸臂方式把剪力與彎矩傳到基礎。
剪力牆主要承受剪力，所以只要水平筋足夠，牆端不需要特別圍束。
optionsEn: Every wall in a building shares seismic force equally, so adding a few short walls effectively raises seismic capacity.
Floors act as horizontal deep beams that collect each storey's wind or seismic inertia force and distribute it to the shear walls in proportion to their stiffness.
Shear walls mainly carry shear, so with enough horizontal bars their ends need no special confinement.
quiz.explanation: 樓板像一片水平深梁，把每層的風力或地震慣性力收集起來，再依各牆的相對勁度分配給剪力牆；剪力牆以懸臂方式把剪力與彎矩傳到基礎。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Floors act as horizontal deep beams that collect each storey's wind or seismic inertia force and distribute it to the shear walls in proportion to their stiffness; the walls then carry shear and moment as cantilevers to the foundation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「牆體側力分配」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral force share between walls” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩道等厚懸臂牆、長度 8 m 與 4 m，以撓曲控制時勁度比 ∝ L³ = 512 : 64，長牆分擔 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% 的側力。若施工中把長牆中段改為 1.2 m 寬的門洞，牆被分成兩段，勁度與分擔比例都大幅改變，需重新分析。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For two cantilever walls of equal thickness and lengths of 8 m and 4 m, flexure-governed stiffness scales as L³ = 512 : 64, so the long wall takes 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% of the lateral force. If a 1.2 m door is cut into the middle of the long wall during construction, the wall is split in two and both stiffness and share change greatly, requiring re-analysis. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以結構分析模型輸出各牆的剪力與彎矩分擔，與手算勁度比例核對量級；施工圖審查時逐一比對牆長、開口與樓板連接是否與分析模型一致，差異需由結構設計者確認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Output each wall's share of shear and moment from the structural model and check the order of magnitude against hand stiffness ratios; at shop-drawing review compare wall lengths, openings and floor connections with the analysis model one by one, with any difference confirmed by the structural designer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩道等厚懸臂牆、長度 8 m 與 4 m，以撓曲控制時勁度比 ∝ L³ = 512 : 64，長牆分擔 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% 的側力。若施工中把長牆中段改為 1.2 m 寬的門洞，牆被分成兩段，勁度與分擔比例都大幅改變，需重新分析。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For two cantilever walls of equal thickness and lengths of 8 m and 4 m, flexure-governed stiffness scales as L³ = 512 : 64, so the long wall takes 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% of the lateral force. If a 1.2 m door is cut into the middle of the long wall during construction, the wall is split in two and both stiffness and share change greatly, requiring re-analysis. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path", which statement holds?
options: 搭接長度只要符合一般構件的要求，用在剪力牆塑性鉸區也一樣安全。
剪力牆用高坍度混凝土就不需要振搗。
兩道等厚懸臂牆、長度 8 m 與 4 m，以撓曲控制時勁度比 ∝ L³ = 512 : 64，長牆分擔 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% 的側力。
optionsEn: A lap length adequate for ordinary members is equally safe in a shear wall's plastic-hinge zone.
Shear walls cast with high-slump concrete do not need vibrating.
For two cantilever walls of equal thickness and lengths of 8 m and 4 m, flexure-governed stiffness scales as L³ = 512 : 64, so the long wall takes 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% of the lateral force.
quiz.explanation: 兩道等厚懸臂牆、長度 8 m 與 4 m，以撓曲控制時勁度比 ∝ L³ = 512 : 64，長牆分擔 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% 的側力。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For two cantilever walls of equal thickness and lengths of 8 m and 4 m, flexure-governed stiffness scales as L³ = 512 : 64, so the long wall takes 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% of the lateral force. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「牆體側力分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lateral force share between walls” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以結構分析模型輸出各牆的剪力與彎矩分擔，與手算勁度比例核對量級；施工圖審查時逐一比對牆長、開口與樓板連接是否與分析模型一致，差異需由結構設計者確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Output each wall's share of shear and moment from the structural model and check the order of magnitude against hand stiffness ratios; at shop-drawing review compare wall lengths, openings and floor connections with the analysis model one by one, with any difference confirmed by the structural designer. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工圖必須明示樓板與剪力牆之間的集力構件、拉桿與錨定長度，並列為澆置前查驗項目；任何牆體開口或牆長變更，須經結構設計者重新分析並書面同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Shop drawings must show collectors, drag bars and anchorage lengths between floors and shear walls and include them in pre-pour inspection; any change in wall openings or length needs re-analysis and written approval by the structural designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：樓板與牆之間的連接（集力構件、拉桿）不足時，地震中樓板無法把慣性力交給剪力牆，牆體雖然完好，樓板卻從牆上脫開；皇家調查委員會對基督城 CTV 大樓的報告即專章檢討其結構系統與樓板拉桿補強。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the connections between floors and walls, collectors and drag bars, are inadequate, floors cannot deliver inertia forces to the shear walls in an earthquake, and floors may separate from walls that remain intact; the Royal Commission's report on Christchurch's CTV Building devotes sections to its structural system and the drag-bar retrofit. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以結構分析模型輸出各牆的剪力與彎矩分擔，與手算勁度比例核對量級；施工圖審查時逐一比對牆長、開口與樓板連接是否與分析模型一致，差異需由結構設計者確認。
knowledge.textEn: Output each wall's share of shear and moment from the structural model and check the order of magnitude against hand stiffness ratios; at shop-drawing review compare wall lengths, openings and floor connections with the analysis model one by one, with any difference confirmed by the structural designer.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工圖必須明示樓板與剪力牆之間的集力構件、拉桿與錨定長度，並列為澆置前查驗項目；任何牆體開口或牆長變更，須經結構設計者重新分析並書面同意。
knowledge.textEn: Shop drawings must show collectors, drag bars and anchorage lengths between floors and shear walls and include them in pre-pour inspection; any change in wall openings or length needs re-analysis and written approval by the structural designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path"?
options: 以結構分析模型輸出各牆的剪力與彎矩分擔，與手算勁度比例核對量級；施工圖審查時逐一比對牆長、開口與樓板連接是否與分析模型一致，差異需由結構設計者確認。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
鋼筋綁好後只要數量對，保護層多一點少一點無所謂。
optionsEn: Output each wall's share of shear and moment from the structural model and check the order of magnitude against hand stiffness ratios.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once the bars are tied, a little more or less cover makes no difference as long as the bar count is right.
quiz.explanation: 以結構分析模型輸出各牆的剪力與彎矩分擔，與手算勁度比例核對量級；施工圖審查時逐一比對牆長、開口與樓板連接是否與分析模型一致，差異需由結構設計者確認。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Output each wall's share of shear and moment from the structural model and check the order of magnitude against hand stiffness ratios; at shop-drawing review compare wall lengths, openings and floor connections with the analysis model one by one, with any difference confirmed by the structural designer. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「牆體側力分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lateral force share between walls” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樓板與牆之間的連接（集力構件、拉桿）不足時，地震中樓板無法把慣性力交給剪力牆，牆體雖然完好，樓板卻從牆上脫開；皇家調查委員會對基督城 CTV 大樓的報告即專章檢討其結構系統與樓板拉桿補強。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the connections between floors and walls, collectors and drag bars, are inadequate, floors cannot deliver inertia forces to the shear walls in an earthquake, and floors may separate from walls that remain intact; the Royal Commission's report on Christchurch's CTV Building devotes sections to its structural system and the drag-bar retrofit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工時任何改變牆長、開口位置或樓板與牆連接的變更，都會改變這條傳力路徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During construction, any change to wall length, opening position or the floor-to-wall connection alters this load path.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「建築裡每一道牆都平均分擔地震力，所以多加幾道短牆就能有效提高抗震能力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every wall in a building shares seismic force equally, so adding a few short walls effectively raises seismic capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 樓板與牆之間的連接（集力構件、拉桿）不足時，地震中樓板無法把慣性力交給剪力牆，牆體雖然完好，樓板卻從牆上脫開；皇家調查委員會對基督城 CTV 大樓的報告即專章檢討其結構系統與樓板拉桿補強。
knowledge.textEn: If the connections between floors and walls, collectors and drag bars, are inadequate, floors cannot deliver inertia forces to the shear walls in an earthquake, and floors may separate from walls that remain intact; the Royal Commission's report on Christchurch's CTV Building devotes sections to its structural system and the drag-bar retrofit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
樓板與牆之間的連接（集力構件、拉桿）不足時，地震中樓板無法把慣性力交給剪力牆，牆體雖然完好，樓板卻從牆上脫開。
剪力牆主要承受剪力，所以只要水平筋足夠，牆端不需要特別圍束。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

If the connections between floors and walls, collectors and drag bars, are inadequate, floors cannot deliver inertia forces to the shear walls in an earthquake, and floors may separate from walls that remain intact.
Shear walls mainly carry shear, so with enough horizontal bars their ends need no special confinement.
quiz.explanation: 樓板與牆之間的連接（集力構件、拉桿）不足時，地震中樓板無法把慣性力交給剪力牆，牆體雖然完好，樓板卻從牆上脫開；皇家調查委員會對基督城 CTV 大樓的報告即專章檢討其結構系統與樓板拉桿補強。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the connections between floors and walls, collectors and drag bars, are inadequate, floors cannot deliver inertia forces to the shear walls in an earthquake, and floors may separate from walls that remain intact; the Royal Commission's report on Christchurch's CTV Building devotes sections to its structural system and the drag-bar retrofit. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「邊界構材範圍」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Boundary-element extent” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力牆在地震中以牆底塑性鉸的撓曲變形消散能量，牆端受壓區的混凝土應變最高。若受壓區深度大、側向變位大，牆端混凝土會壓碎、縱筋挫屈，因此規範要求在需要時設置特殊邊界構材，以密集箍筋圍束牆端。ACI 318-19 以位移為基礎判斷是否需要邊界構材：中性軸深度 c 超過某個與牆長及設計位移相關的門檻時就需設置，並規定其水平延伸範圍。軸壓越高，c 越大，邊界構材越長，這也是為什麼高層下部牆體的端部鋼筋最密。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「邊界構材範圍」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In an earthquake a shear wall dissipates energy through flexural deformation at a plastic hinge near its base, and the compression zone at the wall end sees the highest concrete strain. With a deep compression zone and large drift, the wall-end concrete crushes and longitudinal bars buckle, so codes require special boundary elements, wall ends confined by closely spaced hoops, where needed. ACI 318-19 uses a displacement-based check: a boundary element is needed when the neutral-axis depth c exceeds a threshold related to wall length and design displacement, and its horizontal extent is specified. Higher axial load increases c and lengthens the boundary element, which is why wall ends in the lower storeys of tall buildings carry the densest steel. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Boundary-element extent” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 318-19 門檻 c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 318-19 threshold c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力牆主要承受剪力，所以只要水平筋足夠，牆端不需要特別圍束。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shear walls mainly carry shear, so with enough horizontal bars their ends need no special confinement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「邊界構材範圍」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Boundary-element extent”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求
knowledge.titleEn: Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand
knowledge.text: 剪力牆在地震中以牆底塑性鉸的撓曲變形消散能量，牆端受壓區的混凝土應變最高。若受壓區深度大、側向變位大，牆端混凝土會壓碎、縱筋挫屈，因此規範要求在需要時設置特殊邊界構材，以密集箍筋圍束牆端。
knowledge.textEn: In an earthquake a shear wall dissipates energy through flexural deformation at a plastic hinge near its base, and the compression zone at the wall end sees the highest concrete strain. With a deep compression zone and large drift, the wall-end concrete crushes and longitudinal bars buckle, so codes require special boundary elements, wall ends confined by closely spaced hoops, where needed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力牆主要承受剪力，所以只要水平筋足夠，牆端不需要特別圍束。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Shear walls mainly carry shear, so with enough horizontal bars their ends need no special confinement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand" is correct?
options: 剪力牆主要承受剪力，所以只要水平筋足夠，牆端不需要特別圍束。
只要箍筋總量符合計算，彎鉤是 90° 還是 135° 並不重要。
剪力牆在地震中以牆底塑性鉸的撓曲變形消散能量，牆端受壓區的混凝土應變最高。
optionsEn: Shear walls mainly carry shear, so with enough horizontal bars their ends need no special confinement.
As long as the total hoop steel meets the calculation, whether hooks are 90° or 135° does not matter.
In an earthquake a shear wall dissipates energy through flexural deformation at a plastic hinge near its base, and the compression zone at the wall end sees the highest concrete strain.
quiz.explanation: 剪力牆在地震中以牆底塑性鉸的撓曲變形消散能量，牆端受壓區的混凝土應變最高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In an earthquake a shear wall dissipates energy through flexural deformation at a plastic hinge near its base, and the compression zone at the wall end sees the highest concrete strain. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「邊界構材範圍」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Boundary-element extent” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 318-19 門檻 c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)]。l_w = 8 m、δ_u/h_w = 0.01 時門檻 = 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm；若分析得 c = 1,100 mm，需要特殊邊界構材，其延伸長度取 max(c − 0.1l_w, c/2) = max(300, 550) = 550 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 318-19 threshold c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)]. With l_w = 8 m and δ_u/h_w = 0.01 the threshold is 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm; if analysis gives c = 1,100 mm a special boundary element is needed, extending max(c − 0.1l_w, c/2) = max(300, 550) = 550 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以斷面分析（應變相容）在設計軸力與彎矩下求中性軸深度，與規範門檻比較；施工圖審查時確認每一道牆的邊界構材長度、高度範圍與箍筋配置都與計算書一致，並在模板放樣時標出邊界構材範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Find the neutral-axis depth from strain-compatibility section analysis under design axial load and moment and compare with the code threshold; at shop-drawing review confirm that every wall's boundary-element length, height range and hoop layout match the calculations, and mark boundary-element zones during formwork setting-out.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 318-19 門檻 c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)]。l_w = 8 m、δ_u/h_w = 0.01 時門檻 = 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm；若分析得 c = 1,100 mm，需要特殊邊界構材，其延伸長度取 max(c − 0.1l_w, c/2) = max(300, 550) = 550 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: ACI 318-19 threshold c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)]. With l_w = 8 m and δ_u/h_w = 0.01 the threshold is 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm; if analysis gives c = 1,100 mm a special boundary element is needed, extending max(c − 0.1l_w, c/2) = max(300, 550) = 550 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand", which statement holds?
options: 鋼筋放得越多越密，剪力牆就越安全。
混凝土強度平均值合格，就代表每一道剪力牆都合格。
optionsEn: ACI 318-19 threshold c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)].
The more and the denser the reinforcement, the safer the shear wall.
If the average concrete strength passes, every shear wall passes.
quiz.explanation: ACI 318-19 門檻 c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ACI 318-19 threshold c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「邊界構材範圍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Boundary-element extent” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以斷面分析（應變相容）在設計軸力與彎矩下求中性軸深度，與規範門檻比較；施工圖審查時確認每一道牆的邊界構材長度、高度範圍與箍筋配置都與計算書一致，並在模板放樣時標出邊界構材範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Find the neutral-axis depth from strain-compatibility section analysis under design axial load and moment and compare with the code threshold; at shop-drawing review confirm that every wall's boundary-element length, height range and hoop layout match the calculations, and mark boundary-element zones during formwork setting-out. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工圖應以獨立的牆端詳圖標示邊界構材範圍、箍筋與繫筋間距及延伸高度，現場以噴漆在模板與鋼筋上標記範圍；邊界構材查驗列為停檢點，由監造逐道簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Shop drawings should give separate wall-end details showing boundary-element extent, hoop and crosstie spacing and height, with the zones spray-marked on forms and steel on site; boundary-element inspection is a hold point signed wall by wall by the resident engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：邊界構材長度不足或只在牆底一層設置，地震中牆端混凝土壓碎、縱筋外挫，牆體失去軸向承載而突然下陷；牆太薄時，即使有箍筋，牆端也可能側向挫屈。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Boundary elements that are too short or provided only at the lowest storey let the wall-end concrete crush and bars buckle outward in an earthquake, so the wall loses axial capacity and drops suddenly; walls that are too thin may buckle laterally at their ends even with hoops. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以斷面分析（應變相容）在設計軸力與彎矩下求中性軸深度，與規範門檻比較；施工圖審查時確認每一道牆的邊界構材長度、高度範圍與箍筋配置都與計算書一致，並在模板放樣時標出邊界構材範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Find the neutral-axis depth from strain-compatibility section analysis under design axial load and moment and compare with the code threshold; at shop-drawing review confirm that every wall's boundary-element length, height range and hoop layout match the calculations, and mark boundary-element zones during formwork setting-out.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工圖應以獨立的牆端詳圖標示邊界構材範圍、箍筋與繫筋間距及延伸高度，現場以噴漆在模板與鋼筋上標記範圍；邊界構材查驗列為停檢點，由監造逐道簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Shop drawings should give separate wall-end details showing boundary-element extent, hoop and crosstie spacing and height, with the zones spray-marked on forms and steel on site; boundary-element inspection is a hold point signed wall by wall by the resident engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以斷面分析（應變相容）在設計軸力與彎矩下求中性軸深度，與規範門檻比較。
震後剪力牆裂縫只要灌注環氧樹脂，就能恢復原來的耐震能力。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Find the neutral-axis depth from strain-compatibility section analysis under design axial load and moment and compare with the code threshold.
Injecting epoxy into post-earthquake shear-wall cracks restores the original seismic capacity.
quiz.explanation: 以斷面分析（應變相容）在設計軸力與彎矩下求中性軸深度，與規範門檻比較；施工圖審查時確認每一道牆的邊界構材長度、高度範圍與箍筋配置都與計算書一致，並在模板放樣時標出邊界構材範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Find the neutral-axis depth from strain-compatibility section analysis under design axial load and moment and compare with the code threshold; at shop-drawing review confirm that every wall's boundary-element length, height range and hoop layout match the calculations, and mark boundary-element zones during formwork setting-out. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「邊界構材範圍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Boundary-element extent” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 邊界構材長度不足或只在牆底一層設置，地震中牆端混凝土壓碎、縱筋外挫，牆體失去軸向承載而突然下陷；牆太薄時，即使有箍筋，牆端也可能側向挫屈。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Boundary elements that are too short or provided only at the lowest storey let the wall-end concrete crush and bars buckle outward in an earthquake, so the wall loses axial capacity and drops suddenly; walls that are too thin may buckle laterally at their ends even with hoops. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：軸壓越高，c 越大，邊界構材越長，這也是為什麼高層下部牆體的端部鋼筋最密。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Higher axial load increases c and lengthens the boundary element, which is why wall ends in the lower storeys of tall buildings carry the densest steel.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力牆主要承受剪力，所以只要水平筋足夠，牆端不需要特別圍束。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Shear walls mainly carry shear, so with enough horizontal bars their ends need no special confinement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 邊界構材長度不足或只在牆底一層設置，地震中牆端混凝土壓碎、縱筋外挫，牆體失去軸向承載而突然下陷；牆太薄時，即使有箍筋，牆端也可能側向挫屈。
knowledge.textEn: Boundary elements that are too short or provided only at the lowest storey let the wall-end concrete crush and bars buckle outward in an earthquake, so the wall loses axial capacity and drops suddenly; walls that are too thin may buckle laterally at their ends even with hoops.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要箍筋總量符合計算，彎鉤是 90° 還是 135° 並不重要。
邊界構材長度不足或只在牆底一層設置，地震中牆端混凝土壓碎、縱筋外挫，牆體失去軸向承載而突然下陷；牆太薄時，即使有箍筋，牆端也可能側向挫屈。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
As long as the total hoop steel meets the calculation, whether hooks are 90° or 135° does not matter.

Boundary elements that are too short or provided only at the lowest storey let the wall-end concrete crush and bars buckle outward in an earthquake, so the wall loses axial capacity and drops suddenly.
quiz.explanation: 邊界構材長度不足或只在牆底一層設置，地震中牆端混凝土壓碎、縱筋外挫，牆體失去軸向承載而突然下陷；牆太薄時，即使有箍筋，牆端也可能側向挫屈。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Boundary elements that are too short or provided only at the lowest storey let the wall-end concrete crush and bars buckle outward in an earthquake, so the wall loses axial capacity and drops suddenly; walls that are too thin may buckle laterally at their ends even with hoops. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤」與「縱筋搭接、續接器與塑性鉸區」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks" and "Lap splices, mechanical couplers and the plastic-hinge zone": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「端部箍筋與繫筋」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Boundary hoops and crossties” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 圍束的作用是讓被箍住的核心混凝土在高壓應變下仍能承載，並防止縱筋挫屈。圍束效果取決於箍筋面積、間距、形狀與彎鉤：箍筋需以 135° 彎鉤錨入核心，繫筋要勾住縱筋，並且間距要夠小，使每一根或每隔一根縱筋都受到側向支撐。現場最常見的問題不是鋼筋量不足，而是彎鉤角度不對、繫筋未勾住縱筋，或為了方便澆置而把箍筋間距放寬。這些錯誤在圖面上看不出來，只有在現場查驗才能發現。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「端部箍筋與繫筋」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Confinement lets the confined core carry load at high compressive strain and stops longitudinal bars from buckling. Its effectiveness depends on hoop area, spacing, shape and hooks: hoops must anchor into the core with 135° hooks, crossties must engage longitudinal bars, and spacing must be close enough that every bar or every other bar is laterally supported. The commonest site problems are not too little steel but wrong hook angles, crossties that miss the bars, or hoop spacing opened up to ease concreting. These errors are invisible on drawings and are found only by site inspection. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Boundary hoops and crossties” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 318 特殊邊界構材 A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 318 special boundary elements require A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要箍筋總量符合計算，彎鉤是 90° 還是 135° 並不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the total hoop steel meets the calculation, whether hooks are 90° or 135° does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「端部箍筋與繫筋」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Boundary hoops and crossties”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤
knowledge.titleEn: Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks
knowledge.text: 圍束的作用是讓被箍住的核心混凝土在高壓應變下仍能承載，並防止縱筋挫屈。圍束效果取決於箍筋面積、間距、形狀與彎鉤：箍筋需以 135° 彎鉤錨入核心，繫筋要勾住縱筋，並且間距要夠小，使每一根或每隔一根縱筋都受到側向支撐。
knowledge.textEn: Confinement lets the confined core carry load at high compressive strain and stops longitudinal bars from buckling. Its effectiveness depends on hoop area, spacing, shape and hooks: hoops must anchor into the core with 135° hooks, crossties must engage longitudinal bars, and spacing must be close enough that every bar or every other bar is laterally supported.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要箍筋總量符合計算，彎鉤是 90° 還是 135° 並不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the total hoop steel meets the calculation, whether hooks are 90° or 135° does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks" is correct?
options: 圍束的作用是讓被箍住的核心混凝土在高壓應變下仍能承載，並防止縱筋挫屈。
只要箍筋總量符合計算，彎鉤是 90° 還是 135° 並不重要。
搭接長度只要符合一般構件的要求，用在剪力牆塑性鉸區也一樣安全。
optionsEn: Confinement lets the confined core carry load at high compressive strain and stops longitudinal bars from buckling.
As long as the total hoop steel meets the calculation, whether hooks are 90° or 135° does not matter.
A lap length adequate for ordinary members is equally safe in a shear wall's plastic-hinge zone.
quiz.explanation: 圍束的作用是讓被箍住的核心混凝土在高壓應變下仍能承載，並防止縱筋挫屈。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Confinement lets the confined core carry load at high compressive strain and stops longitudinal bars from buckling. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「端部箍筋與繫筋」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Boundary hoops and crossties” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 318 特殊邊界構材 A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt]。f′_c = 42 MPa、f_yt = 420 MPa，邊界 400×600 mm、核心 320×520 mm，A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442，前式 ≈ 0.0133 控制；s = 100 mm、b_c = 320 mm 時 A_sh ≥ 0.0133×100×320 ≈ 425 mm²，4 肢 D13 提供 507 mm²。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 318 special boundary elements require A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt]. With f′_c = 42 MPa, f_yt = 420 MPa, a 400×600 mm boundary and a 320×520 mm core, A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442 and the first term ≈ 0.0133 governs; for s = 100 mm and b_c = 320 mm, A_sh ≥ 0.0133×100×320 ≈ 425 mm², met by four legs of D13 giving 507 mm². Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：現場查驗以捲尺量測箍筋間距（取連續 5 個間距平均並記錄最大值）、檢查彎鉤角度與延伸長度、確認繫筋勾住縱筋；查驗結果拍照並標註牆編號與樓層，與施工圖逐項核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On site measure hoop spacing with a tape, averaging five consecutive spaces and recording the maximum, check hook angles and extensions and confirm that crossties engage the bars; photograph the results labelled by wall number and storey and check them item by item against the shop drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 318 特殊邊界構材 A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt]。f′_c = 42 MPa、f_yt = 420 MPa，邊界 400×600 mm、核心 320×520 mm，A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442，前式 ≈ 0.0133 控制；s = 100 mm、b_c = 320 mm 時 A_sh ≥ 0.0133×100×320 ≈ 425 mm²，4 肢 D13 提供 507 mm²。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: ACI 318 special boundary elements require A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt]. With f′_c = 42 MPa, f_yt = 420 MPa, a 400×600 mm boundary and a 320×520 mm core, A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442 and the first term ≈ 0.0133 governs; for s = 100 mm and b_c = 320 mm, A_sh ≥ 0.0133×100×320 ≈ 425 mm², met by four legs of D13 giving 507 mm². Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks", which statement holds?
options: 剪力牆用高坍度混凝土就不需要振搗。
ACI 318 特殊邊界構材 A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt]。
鋼筋綁好後只要數量對，保護層多一點少一點無所謂。
optionsEn: Shear walls cast with high-slump concrete do not need vibrating.
ACI 318 special boundary elements require A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt].
Once the bars are tied, a little more or less cover makes no difference as long as the bar count is right.
quiz.explanation: ACI 318 特殊邊界構材 A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ACI 318 special boundary elements require A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「端部箍筋與繫筋」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Boundary hoops and crossties” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 現場查驗以捲尺量測箍筋間距（取連續 5 個間距平均並記錄最大值）、檢查彎鉤角度與延伸長度、確認繫筋勾住縱筋；查驗結果拍照並標註牆編號與樓層，與施工圖逐項核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On site measure hoop spacing with a tape, averaging five consecutive spaces and recording the maximum, check hook angles and extensions and confirm that crossties engage the bars; photograph the results labelled by wall number and storey and check them item by item against the shop drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鋼筋加工圖要明示所有邊界構材箍筋與繫筋的彎鉤角度與延伸長度，加工廠出貨前抽檢；現場不得以「方便施工」為由調整箍筋間距或彎鉤，任何調整都須設計者書面同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Bar-bending schedules must state hook angles and extensions for every boundary hoop and crosstie, with sampling at the fabrication shop before delivery; site crews may not change hoop spacing or hooks for convenience, and any change needs the designer's written approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：箍筋以 90° 彎鉤收尾，地震中保護層剝落後彎鉤張開，箍筋失去圍束，牆端混凝土壓碎、縱筋挫屈；繫筋只勾住箍筋而未勾住縱筋，縱筋在反覆載重下向外鼓出。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
