steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「保護層與鋼筋查驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cover and rebar inspection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 合模前由鋼筋承包商自主檢查，再由監造依檢查表查驗並拍照，每一道牆有獨立紀錄；合模後以手持式保護層測定儀從模板開口或拆模後抽測保護層，結果與查驗紀錄比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before closing forms the rebar contractor self-inspects and the resident engineer then inspects against the checklist with photographs, keeping a separate record for every wall; after closing or stripping, sample cover with a handheld covermeter and compare with the inspection record. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：澆置前查驗設為停檢點：未經監造簽認的牆體不得通知預拌車；檢查表由設計者審定，並把剪力牆特有的項目（邊界構材、135° 彎鉤、拉桿、續接器）列為必檢項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make pre-pour inspection a hold point: no ready-mix truck is called for a wall without the resident engineer's signature; have the designer approve the checklist and make shear-wall-specific items, boundary elements, 135° hooks, drag bars and couplers, mandatory.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：查驗流於形式只看主筋數量，未注意樓板拉桿漏放、開口周邊補強筋缺少或墊塊被踩壞，合模後才發現已無法補救；保護層不足的牆面數年後出現鏽水與剝落，修補成本遠高於當初調整墊塊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A token inspection that counts only main bars misses missing drag bars, absent opening reinforcement or crushed spacers, which cannot be fixed once forms are closed; walls with too little cover show rust stains and spalling years later, at repair costs far above re-setting spacers at the time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 合模前由鋼筋承包商自主檢查，再由監造依檢查表查驗並拍照，每一道牆有獨立紀錄；合模後以手持式保護層測定儀從模板開口或拆模後抽測保護層，結果與查驗紀錄比對。
knowledge.textEn: Before closing forms the rebar contractor self-inspects and the resident engineer then inspects against the checklist with photographs, keeping a separate record for every wall; after closing or stripping, sample cover with a handheld covermeter and compare with the inspection record.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 澆置前查驗設為停檢點：未經監造簽認的牆體不得通知預拌車；檢查表由設計者審定，並把剪力牆特有的項目（邊界構材、135° 彎鉤、拉桿、續接器）列為必檢項目。
knowledge.textEn: Make pre-pour inspection a hold point: no ready-mix truck is called for a wall without the resident engineer's signature; have the designer approve the checklist and make shear-wall-specific items, boundary elements, 135° hooks, drag bars and couplers, mandatory.

quiz.question: 要驗證「澆置前查驗與保護層量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pre-pour inspection and cover measurement"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
合模前由鋼筋承包商自主檢查，再由監造依檢查表查驗並拍照，每一道牆有獨立紀錄；合模後以手持式保護層測定儀從模板開口或拆模後抽測保護層，結果與查驗紀錄比對。
鋼筋放得越多越密，剪力牆就越安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Before closing forms the rebar contractor self-inspects and the resident engineer then inspects against the checklist with photographs, keeping a separate record for every wall.
The more and the denser the reinforcement, the safer the shear wall.
quiz.explanation: 合模前由鋼筋承包商自主檢查，再由監造依檢查表查驗並拍照，每一道牆有獨立紀錄；合模後以手持式保護層測定儀從模板開口或拆模後抽測保護層，結果與查驗紀錄比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before closing forms the rebar contractor self-inspects and the resident engineer then inspects against the checklist with photographs, keeping a separate record for every wall; after closing or stripping, sample cover with a handheld covermeter and compare with the inspection record. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 澆置前查驗與保護層量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pre-pour inspection and cover measurement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「保護層與鋼筋查驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cover and rebar inspection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 查驗流於形式只看主筋數量，未注意樓板拉桿漏放、開口周邊補強筋缺少或墊塊被踩壞，合模後才發現已無法補救；保護層不足的牆面數年後出現鏽水與剝落，修補成本遠高於當初調整墊塊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A token inspection that counts only main bars misses missing drag bars, absent opening reinforcement or crushed spacers, which cannot be fixed once forms are closed; walls with too little cover show rust stains and spalling years later, at repair costs far above re-setting spacers at the time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：查驗應以檢查表逐項進行，並保留照片與簽名紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inspection should follow the checklist item by item with photographs and signatures kept on record.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼筋綁好後只要數量對，保護層多一點少一點無所謂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the bars are tied, a little more or less cover makes no difference as long as the bar count is right." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 查驗流於形式只看主筋數量，未注意樓板拉桿漏放、開口周邊補強筋缺少或墊塊被踩壞，合模後才發現已無法補救；保護層不足的牆面數年後出現鏽水與剝落，修補成本遠高於當初調整墊塊。
knowledge.textEn: A token inspection that counts only main bars misses missing drag bars, absent opening reinforcement or crushed spacers, which cannot be fixed once forms are closed; walls with too little cover show rust stains and spalling years later, at repair costs far above re-setting spacers at the time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「澆置前查驗與保護層量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pre-pour inspection and cover measurement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
震後剪力牆裂縫只要灌注環氧樹脂，就能恢復原來的耐震能力。
查驗流於形式只看主筋數量，未注意樓板拉桿漏放、開口周邊補強筋缺少或墊塊被踩壞，合模後才發現已無法補救。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Injecting epoxy into post-earthquake shear-wall cracks restores the original seismic capacity.
A token inspection that counts only main bars misses missing drag bars, absent opening reinforcement or crushed spacers, which cannot be fixed once forms are closed.
quiz.explanation: 查驗流於形式只看主筋數量，未注意樓板拉桿漏放、開口周邊補強筋缺少或墊塊被踩壞，合模後才發現已無法補救；保護層不足的牆面數年後出現鏽水與剝落，修補成本遠高於當初調整墊塊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A token inspection that counts only main bars misses missing drag bars, absent opening reinforcement or crushed spacers, which cannot be fixed once forms are closed; walls with too little cover show rust stains and spalling years later, at repair costs far above re-setting spacers at the time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「震後損傷判讀、修復與補強」與「開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening" and "Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 震後損傷判讀、修復與補強：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「震後裂縫與鋼筋應變」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-earthquake cracks and bar strain” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 地震後剪力牆的損傷可從裂縫型態判讀：水平裂縫集中在牆底表示撓曲作用，斜裂縫表示剪力作用，牆端保護層剝落、縱筋外露或挫屈表示邊界構材已達高應變，牆端壓碎則是嚴重損傷。殘留裂縫寬度可以粗略推估鋼筋是否已降伏：若裂縫在地震後仍明顯張開，表示鋼筋可能已產生塑性變形。修復策略從環氧樹脂灌注、局部置換混凝土，到以鋼板、纖維複合材料或增設牆體補強，需依損傷程度與殘餘能力決定，而不是只看外觀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「震後裂縫與鋼筋應變」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After an earthquake, shear-wall damage can be read from crack patterns: horizontal cracks concentrated at the base indicate flexure, diagonal cracks indicate shear, spalled cover with exposed or buckled bars at wall ends shows the boundary element reached high strain, and crushing at the wall end is severe damage. Residual crack width gives a rough indication of whether bars have yielded: cracks that stay clearly open after shaking suggest plastic deformation in the steel. Repair ranges from epoxy injection and local concrete replacement to strengthening with steel plates, fibre composites or added walls, chosen by damage level and residual capacity rather than appearance alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-earthquake cracks and bar strain” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以裂縫間距估算鋼筋平均應變 ε ≈ w/s_cr。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Average bar strain can be estimated from crack spacing as ε ≈ w/s_cr.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「震後剪力牆裂縫只要灌注環氧樹脂，就能恢復原來的耐震能力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Injecting epoxy into post-earthquake shear-wall cracks restores the original seismic capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「震後裂縫與鋼筋應變」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Post-earthquake cracks and bar strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 震後損傷判讀、修復與補強
knowledge.titleEn: Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening
knowledge.text: 地震後剪力牆的損傷可從裂縫型態判讀：水平裂縫集中在牆底表示撓曲作用，斜裂縫表示剪力作用，牆端保護層剝落、縱筋外露或挫屈表示邊界構材已達高應變，牆端壓碎則是嚴重損傷。殘留裂縫寬度可以粗略推估鋼筋是否已降伏：若裂縫在地震後仍明顯張開，表示鋼筋可能已產生塑性變形。
knowledge.textEn: After an earthquake, shear-wall damage can be read from crack patterns: horizontal cracks concentrated at the base indicate flexure, diagonal cracks indicate shear, spalled cover with exposed or buckled bars at wall ends shows the boundary element reached high strain, and crushing at the wall end is severe damage. Residual crack width gives a rough indication of whether bars have yielded: cracks that stay clearly open after shaking suggest plastic deformation in the steel.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：震後剪力牆裂縫只要灌注環氧樹脂，就能恢復原來的耐震能力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Injecting epoxy into post-earthquake shear-wall cracks restores the original seismic capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「震後損傷判讀、修復與補強」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening" is correct?
options: 地震後剪力牆的損傷可從裂縫型態判讀：水平裂縫集中在牆底表示撓曲作用，斜裂縫表示剪力作用，牆端保護層剝落、縱筋外露或挫屈表示邊界構材已達高應變，牆端壓碎則是嚴重損傷。
震後剪力牆裂縫只要灌注環氧樹脂，就能恢復原來的耐震能力。
剪力牆上鑽幾個管線孔不會影響結構安全，不需要結構工程師評估。
optionsEn: After an earthquake, shear-wall damage can be read from crack patterns: horizontal cracks concentrated at the base indicate flexure, diagonal cracks indicate shear, spalled cover with exposed or buckled bars at wall ends shows the boundary element reached high strain, and crushing at the wall end is severe damage.
Injecting epoxy into post-earthquake shear-wall cracks restores the original seismic capacity.
Drilling a few services holes in a shear wall does not affect structural safety and needs no structural engineer's assessment.
quiz.explanation: 地震後剪力牆的損傷可從裂縫型態判讀：水平裂縫集中在牆底表示撓曲作用，斜裂縫表示剪力作用，牆端保護層剝落、縱筋外露或挫屈表示邊界構材已達高應變，牆端壓碎則是嚴重損傷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After an earthquake, shear-wall damage can be read from crack patterns: horizontal cracks concentrated at the base indicate flexure, diagonal cracks indicate shear, spalled cover with exposed or buckled bars at wall ends shows the boundary element reached high strain, and crushing at the wall end is severe damage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 震後損傷判讀、修復與補強：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「震後裂縫與鋼筋應變」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-earthquake cracks and bar strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以裂縫間距估算鋼筋平均應變 ε ≈ w/s_cr。殘留裂縫寬 0.6 mm、間距 200 mm 時 ε ≈ 0.6/200 = 0.003，大於 f_y = 420 MPa 鋼筋的降伏應變 420/200,000 = 0.0021，表示鋼筋很可能已降伏，需要工程評估而非只做表面修補。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Average bar strain can be estimated from crack spacing as ε ≈ w/s_cr. A residual crack of 0.6 mm at 200 mm spacing gives ε ≈ 0.6/200 = 0.003, above the yield strain of 420/200,000 = 0.0021 for f_y = 420 MPa, so the bars have probably yielded and an engineering assessment, not just surface repair, is needed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：震後以裂縫寬度計與裂縫圖記錄每道牆的裂縫位置、方向與寬度，必要時打開保護層檢查鋼筋是否挫屈或斷裂，並以結構分析評估殘餘能力；修復後以灌注紀錄、鑽心或超音波確認灌注效果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After an earthquake record crack location, direction and width for each wall with crack gauges and crack maps, open the cover where needed to check for buckled or fractured bars, and assess residual capacity by structural analysis; after repair confirm injection quality from injection records, cores or ultrasonics.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以裂縫間距估算鋼筋平均應變 ε ≈ w/s_cr。殘留裂縫寬 0.6 mm、間距 200 mm 時 ε ≈ 0.6/200 = 0.003，大於 f_y = 420 MPa 鋼筋的降伏應變 420/200,000 = 0.0021，表示鋼筋很可能已降伏，需要工程評估而非只做表面修補。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Average bar strain can be estimated from crack spacing as ε ≈ w/s_cr. A residual crack of 0.6 mm at 200 mm spacing gives ε ≈ 0.6/200 = 0.003, above the yield strain of 420/200,000 = 0.0021 for f_y = 420 MPa, so the bars have probably yielded and an engineering assessment, not just surface repair, is needed. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「震後損傷判讀、修復與補強」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening", which statement holds?
options: 剪力牆主要承受剪力，所以只要水平筋足夠，牆端不需要特別圍束。
以裂縫間距估算鋼筋平均應變 ε ≈ w/s_cr。
搭接長度只要符合一般構件的要求，用在剪力牆塑性鉸區也一樣安全。
optionsEn: Shear walls mainly carry shear, so with enough horizontal bars their ends need no special confinement.
Average bar strain can be estimated from crack spacing as ε ≈ w/s_cr.
A lap length adequate for ordinary members is equally safe in a shear wall's plastic-hinge zone.
quiz.explanation: 以裂縫間距估算鋼筋平均應變 ε ≈ w/s_cr。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Average bar strain can be estimated from crack spacing as ε ≈ w/s_cr. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 震後損傷判讀、修復與補強：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「震後裂縫與鋼筋應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-earthquake cracks and bar strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 震後以裂縫寬度計與裂縫圖記錄每道牆的裂縫位置、方向與寬度，必要時打開保護層檢查鋼筋是否挫屈或斷裂，並以結構分析評估殘餘能力；修復後以灌注紀錄、鑽心或超音波確認灌注效果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After an earthquake record crack location, direction and width for each wall with crack gauges and crack maps, open the cover where needed to check for buckled or fractured bars, and assess residual capacity by structural analysis; after repair confirm injection quality from injection records, cores or ultrasonics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：震後評估應由結構技師依損傷分級程序進行，記錄每道牆的損傷照片與量測值，並與原設計及竣工資料比對；修復或補強設計須經結構審查，施工中設停檢點確認鋼筋狀況。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Post-earthquake assessment should be done by a structural engineer following a damage-classification procedure, recording photos and measurements for every wall and comparing them with the original design and as-built records; repair or strengthening designs need structural review, with hold points during work to confirm reinforcement condition.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以環氧樹脂灌注把裂縫填滿就宣告修復，卻未檢查已挫屈或疲勞的縱筋，下一次地震時牆端在原位置迅速破壞；修補時鑿除混凝土過深，切斷或損傷原有箍筋，反而降低圍束。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Declaring a wall repaired after merely filling cracks with epoxy, without checking for buckled or fatigued longitudinal bars, lets the wall end fail quickly at the same spot in the next earthquake; breaking out too deep during repair cuts or damages existing hoops and reduces confinement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 震後以裂縫寬度計與裂縫圖記錄每道牆的裂縫位置、方向與寬度，必要時打開保護層檢查鋼筋是否挫屈或斷裂，並以結構分析評估殘餘能力；修復後以灌注紀錄、鑽心或超音波確認灌注效果。
knowledge.textEn: After an earthquake record crack location, direction and width for each wall with crack gauges and crack maps, open the cover where needed to check for buckled or fractured bars, and assess residual capacity by structural analysis; after repair confirm injection quality from injection records, cores or ultrasonics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 震後評估應由結構技師依損傷分級程序進行，記錄每道牆的損傷照片與量測值，並與原設計及竣工資料比對；修復或補強設計須經結構審查，施工中設停檢點確認鋼筋狀況。
knowledge.textEn: Post-earthquake assessment should be done by a structural engineer following a damage-classification procedure, recording photos and measurements for every wall and comparing them with the original design and as-built records; repair or strengthening designs need structural review, with hold points during work to confirm reinforcement condition.

quiz.question: 要驗證「震後損傷判讀、修復與補強」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
剪力牆用高坍度混凝土就不需要振搗。
震後以裂縫寬度計與裂縫圖記錄每道牆的裂縫位置、方向與寬度，必要時打開保護層檢查鋼筋是否挫屈或斷裂，並以結構分析評估殘餘能力。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Shear walls cast with high-slump concrete do not need vibrating.

After an earthquake record crack location, direction and width for each wall with crack gauges and crack maps, open the cover where needed to check for buckled or fractured bars, and assess residual capacity by structural analysis.
quiz.explanation: 震後以裂縫寬度計與裂縫圖記錄每道牆的裂縫位置、方向與寬度，必要時打開保護層檢查鋼筋是否挫屈或斷裂，並以結構分析評估殘餘能力；修復後以灌注紀錄、鑽心或超音波確認灌注效果。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After an earthquake record crack location, direction and width for each wall with crack gauges and crack maps, open the cover where needed to check for buckled or fractured bars, and assess residual capacity by structural analysis; after repair confirm injection quality from injection records, cores or ultrasonics. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 震後損傷判讀、修復與補強：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「震後裂縫與鋼筋應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-earthquake cracks and bar strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以環氧樹脂灌注把裂縫填滿就宣告修復，卻未檢查已挫屈或疲勞的縱筋，下一次地震時牆端在原位置迅速破壞；修補時鑿除混凝土過深，切斷或損傷原有箍筋，反而降低圍束。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Declaring a wall repaired after merely filling cracks with epoxy, without checking for buckled or fatigued longitudinal bars, lets the wall end fail quickly at the same spot in the next earthquake; breaking out too deep during repair cuts or damages existing hoops and reduces confinement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：修復策略從環氧樹脂灌注、局部置換混凝土，到以鋼板、纖維複合材料或增設牆體補強，需依損傷程度與殘餘能力決定，而不是只看外觀。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Repair ranges from epoxy injection and local concrete replacement to strengthening with steel plates, fibre composites or added walls, chosen by damage level and residual capacity rather than appearance alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「震後剪力牆裂縫只要灌注環氧樹脂，就能恢復原來的耐震能力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Injecting epoxy into post-earthquake shear-wall cracks restores the original seismic capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以環氧樹脂灌注把裂縫填滿就宣告修復，卻未檢查已挫屈或疲勞的縱筋，下一次地震時牆端在原位置迅速破壞；修補時鑿除混凝土過深，切斷或損傷原有箍筋，反而降低圍束。
knowledge.textEn: Declaring a wall repaired after merely filling cracks with epoxy, without checking for buckled or fatigued longitudinal bars, lets the wall end fail quickly at the same spot in the next earthquake; breaking out too deep during repair cuts or damages existing hoops and reduces confinement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「震後損傷判讀、修復與補強」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只以環氧樹脂灌注把裂縫填滿就宣告修復，卻未檢查已挫屈或疲勞的縱筋，下一次地震時牆端在原位置迅速破壞；修補時鑿除混凝土過深，切斷或損傷原有箍筋，反而降低圍束。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
剪力牆上鑽幾個管線孔不會影響結構安全，不需要結構工程師評估。
optionsEn: Declaring a wall repaired after merely filling cracks with epoxy, without checking for buckled or fatigued longitudinal bars, lets the wall end fail quickly at the same spot in the next earthquake.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Drilling a few services holes in a shear wall does not affect structural safety and needs no structural engineer's assessment.
quiz.explanation: 只以環氧樹脂灌注把裂縫填滿就宣告修復，卻未檢查已挫屈或疲勞的縱筋，下一次地震時牆端在原位置迅速破壞；修補時鑿除混凝土過深，切斷或損傷原有箍筋，反而降低圍束。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Declaring a wall repaired after merely filling cracks with epoxy, without checking for buckled or fatigued longitudinal bars, lets the wall end fail quickly at the same spot in the next earthquake; breaking out too deep during repair cuts or damages existing hoops and reduces confinement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「開孔變更與竣工圖」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Later openings and as-built drawings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力牆在使用期間最常遭遇的破壞來源不是地震，而是後來的開孔：機電管線、門洞、窗口或裝修改造。在剪力牆上鑽孔或切割，會減少剪力斷面、切斷縱筋或水平筋，甚至把一道長牆變成兩道短牆，改變整棟建築的側力分配。因此交接文件必須清楚標示哪些牆是剪力牆、邊界構材與塑性鉸區的位置，以及哪些範圍禁止開孔；任何開孔都要經結構工程師評估。施工期間的開孔變更也應同樣受控。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「開孔變更與竣工圖」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The commonest threat to shear walls in service is not earthquakes but later openings: services penetrations, doors, windows or fit-out changes. Drilling or cutting a shear wall reduces shear area, cuts vertical or horizontal bars and may turn one long wall into two short ones, changing the lateral force distribution of the whole building. Handover documents must therefore clearly identify which walls are shear walls, where boundary elements and plastic-hinge zones are, and which areas must not be penetrated, with every opening assessed by a structural engineer. Opening changes during construction need the same control. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Later openings and as-built drawings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 318 牆剪力強度 V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 318 wall shear strength V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力牆上鑽幾個管線孔不會影響結構安全，不需要結構工程師評估。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Drilling a few services holes in a shear wall does not affect structural safety and needs no structural engineer's assessment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「開孔變更與竣工圖」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Later openings and as-built drawings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover
knowledge.text: 剪力牆在使用期間最常遭遇的破壞來源不是地震，而是後來的開孔：機電管線、門洞、窗口或裝修改造。在剪力牆上鑽孔或切割，會減少剪力斷面、切斷縱筋或水平筋，甚至把一道長牆變成兩道短牆，改變整棟建築的側力分配。
knowledge.textEn: The commonest threat to shear walls in service is not earthquakes but later openings: services penetrations, doors, windows or fit-out changes. Drilling or cutting a shear wall reduces shear area, cuts vertical or horizontal bars and may turn one long wall into two short ones, changing the lateral force distribution of the whole building.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力牆上鑽幾個管線孔不會影響結構安全，不需要結構工程師評估。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Drilling a few services holes in a shear wall does not affect structural safety and needs no structural engineer's assessment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover" is correct?
options: 剪力牆上鑽幾個管線孔不會影響結構安全，不需要結構工程師評估。
剪力牆在使用期間最常遭遇的破壞來源不是地震，而是後來的開孔：機電管線、門洞、窗口或裝修改造。
建築裡每一道牆都平均分擔地震力，所以多加幾道短牆就能有效提高抗震能力。
optionsEn: Drilling a few services holes in a shear wall does not affect structural safety and needs no structural engineer's assessment.
The commonest threat to shear walls in service is not earthquakes but later openings: services penetrations, doors, windows or fit-out changes.
Every wall in a building shares seismic force equally, so adding a few short walls effectively raises seismic capacity.
quiz.explanation: 剪力牆在使用期間最常遭遇的破壞來源不是地震，而是後來的開孔：機電管線、門洞、窗口或裝修改造。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The commonest threat to shear walls in service is not earthquakes but later openings: services penetrations, doors, windows or fit-out changes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開孔變更與竣工圖」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Later openings and as-built drawings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 318 牆剪力強度 V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y)。牆長 8 m、厚 0.4 m，A_cv = 3.2×10⁶ mm²；α_c = 0.17、√42 ≈ 6.48、ρ_t = 0.0025、f_y = 420 MPa，單位應力 ≈ 1.10 + 1.05 = 2.15 MPa，V_n ≈ 6,886 kN。事後切出 1.2 m 寬開口時有效長度剩 6.8 m，V_n 降為約 5,853 kN（減少 15%），尚未計入被切斷鋼筋與開口角隅應力集中。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 318 wall shear strength V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y). For an 8 m long, 0.4 m thick wall, A_cv = 3.2×10⁶ mm²; with α_c = 0.17, √42 ≈ 6.48, ρ_t = 0.0025 and f_y = 420 MPa, the unit stress is about 1.10 + 1.05 = 2.15 MPa and V_n ≈ 6,886 kN. Cutting a 1.2 m opening later leaves 6.8 m effective and V_n drops to about 5,853 kN, 15% less, before counting severed bars and stress concentrations at the corners. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：任何開孔申請須附開孔位置、尺寸與鋼筋掃描結果，由結構工程師以原設計模型評估並指定補強；施工時以鋼筋掃描避開主筋，完成後量測實際位置並更新竣工圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Every opening request should include location, size and a rebar scan, assessed by a structural engineer against the original design model with specified strengthening; during work use rebar scanning to avoid main bars, and survey the actual opening afterwards to update the as-built drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 318 牆剪力強度 V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y)。牆長 8 m、厚 0.4 m，A_cv = 3.2×10⁶ mm²；α_c = 0.17、√42 ≈ 6.48、ρ_t = 0.0025、f_y = 420 MPa，單位應力 ≈ 1.10 + 1.05 = 2.15 MPa，V_n ≈ 6,886 kN。事後切出 1.2 m 寬開口時有效長度剩 6.8 m，V_n 降為約 5,853 kN（減少 15%），尚未計入被切斷鋼筋與開口角隅應力集中。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: ACI 318 wall shear strength V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y). For an 8 m long, 0.4 m thick wall, A_cv = 3.2×10⁶ mm²; with α_c = 0.17, √42 ≈ 6.48, ρ_t = 0.0025 and f_y = 420 MPa, the unit stress is about 1.10 + 1.05 = 2.15 MPa and V_n ≈ 6,886 kN. Cutting a 1.2 m opening later leaves 6.8 m effective and V_n drops to about 5,853 kN, 15% less, before counting severed bars and stress concentrations at the corners. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover", which statement holds?
options: 只要箍筋總量符合計算，彎鉤是 90° 還是 135° 並不重要。
鋼筋放得越多越密，剪力牆就越安全。
ACI 318 牆剪力強度 V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y)。
optionsEn: As long as the total hoop steel meets the calculation, whether hooks are 90° or 135° does not matter.
The more and the denser the reinforcement, the safer the shear wall.
ACI 318 wall shear strength V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y).
quiz.explanation: ACI 318 牆剪力強度 V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ACI 318 wall shear strength V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開孔變更與竣工圖」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Later openings and as-built drawings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 任何開孔申請須附開孔位置、尺寸與鋼筋掃描結果，由結構工程師以原設計模型評估並指定補強；施工時以鋼筋掃描避開主筋，完成後量測實際位置並更新竣工圖。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Every opening request should include location, size and a rebar scan, assessed by a structural engineer against the original design model with specified strengthening; during work use rebar scanning to avoid main bars, and survey the actual opening afterwards to update the as-built drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時提供以顏色標示剪力牆、邊界構材與禁止開孔區的平面圖，並將其納入建築物使用維護手冊；管理單位應建立開孔申請與審查程序，所有開孔都要記錄在竣工圖的更新版本中。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover provide colour-coded plans showing shear walls, boundary elements and no-penetration zones and include them in the building's operation and maintenance manual; the owner should run an opening application and review procedure, recording every opening in updated as-built drawings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：裝修工程未查閱竣工圖就在一樓剪力牆切出大門洞，正好切掉邊界構材，牆的撓曲與剪力能力都大幅下降，平時看不出異狀，直到地震才暴露；機電管線密集鑽孔使牆體形成一排弱點，地震中沿孔洞連線開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A fit-out contractor who never checked the as-built drawings cuts a large doorway through a ground-floor shear wall, removing a boundary element, so the wall loses much of its flexural and shear capacity with no visible sign until an earthquake; dense services holes drilled in a line create a row of weak points along which the wall cracks in an earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 任何開孔申請須附開孔位置、尺寸與鋼筋掃描結果，由結構工程師以原設計模型評估並指定補強；施工時以鋼筋掃描避開主筋，完成後量測實際位置並更新竣工圖。
knowledge.textEn: Every opening request should include location, size and a rebar scan, assessed by a structural engineer against the original design model with specified strengthening; during work use rebar scanning to avoid main bars, and survey the actual opening afterwards to update the as-built drawings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時提供以顏色標示剪力牆、邊界構材與禁止開孔區的平面圖，並將其納入建築物使用維護手冊；管理單位應建立開孔申請與審查程序，所有開孔都要記錄在竣工圖的更新版本中。
knowledge.textEn: At handover provide colour-coded plans showing shear walls, boundary elements and no-penetration zones and include them in the building's operation and maintenance manual; the owner should run an opening application and review procedure, recording every opening in updated as-built drawings.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover"?
options: 任何開孔申請須附開孔位置、尺寸與鋼筋掃描結果，由結構工程師以原設計模型評估並指定補強；施工時以鋼筋掃描避開主筋，完成後量測實際位置並更新竣工圖。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
混凝土強度平均值合格，就代表每一道剪力牆都合格。
optionsEn: Every opening request should include location, size and a rebar scan, assessed by a structural engineer against the original design model with specified strengthening.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If the average concrete strength passes, every shear wall passes.
quiz.explanation: 任何開孔申請須附開孔位置、尺寸與鋼筋掃描結果，由結構工程師以原設計模型評估並指定補強；施工時以鋼筋掃描避開主筋，完成後量測實際位置並更新竣工圖。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Every opening request should include location, size and a rebar scan, assessed by a structural engineer against the original design model with specified strengthening; during work use rebar scanning to avoid main bars, and survey the actual opening afterwards to update the as-built drawings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開孔變更與竣工圖」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Later openings and as-built drawings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 裝修工程未查閱竣工圖就在一樓剪力牆切出大門洞，正好切掉邊界構材，牆的撓曲與剪力能力都大幅下降，平時看不出異狀，直到地震才暴露；機電管線密集鑽孔使牆體形成一排弱點，地震中沿孔洞連線開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A fit-out contractor who never checked the as-built drawings cuts a large doorway through a ground-floor shear wall, removing a boundary element, so the wall loses much of its flexural and shear capacity with no visible sign until an earthquake; dense services holes drilled in a line create a row of weak points along which the wall cracks in an earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工期間的開孔變更也應同樣受控。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Opening changes during construction need the same control.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力牆上鑽幾個管線孔不會影響結構安全，不需要結構工程師評估。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Drilling a few services holes in a shear wall does not affect structural safety and needs no structural engineer's assessment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 裝修工程未查閱竣工圖就在一樓剪力牆切出大門洞，正好切掉邊界構材，牆的撓曲與剪力能力都大幅下降，平時看不出異狀，直到地震才暴露；機電管線密集鑽孔使牆體形成一排弱點，地震中沿孔洞連線開裂。
knowledge.textEn: A fit-out contractor who never checked the as-built drawings cuts a large doorway through a ground-floor shear wall, removing a boundary element, so the wall loses much of its flexural and shear capacity with no visible sign until an earthquake; dense services holes drilled in a line create a row of weak points along which the wall cracks in an earthquake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
裝修工程未查閱竣工圖就在一樓剪力牆切出大門洞，正好切掉邊界構材，牆的撓曲與剪力能力都大幅下降，平時看不出異狀，直到地震才暴露。
建築裡每一道牆都平均分擔地震力，所以多加幾道短牆就能有效提高抗震能力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

A fit-out contractor who never checked the as-built drawings cuts a large doorway through a ground-floor shear wall, removing a boundary element, so the wall loses much of its flexural and shear capacity with no visible sign until an earthquake.
Every wall in a building shares seismic force equally, so adding a few short walls effectively raises seismic capacity.
quiz.explanation: 裝修工程未查閱竣工圖就在一樓剪力牆切出大門洞，正好切掉邊界構材，牆的撓曲與剪力能力都大幅下降，平時看不出異狀，直到地震才暴露；機電管線密集鑽孔使牆體形成一排弱點，地震中沿孔洞連線開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A fit-out contractor who never checked the as-built drawings cuts a large doorway through a ground-floor shear wall, removing a boundary element, so the wall loses much of its flexural and shear capacity with no visible sign until an earthquake; dense services holes drilled in a line create a row of weak points along which the wall cracks in an earthquake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 清水混凝土模板與澆置
summary: 清水混凝土的表面就是建築完成面，不能事後粉刷遮蓋，因此模板分割、繫桿孔排列、面板材料、脫模劑、配比與骨材一致性、澆置速度與振搗、樣板牆與驗收距離都必須在施工前定案。本課以安藤忠雄的光之教會與路易斯．康的沙克研究所為例，並以 ACI 347.3R 的成形面等級 CSC1 至 CSC4 與 ACI 301 第 6 節建築混凝土為框架，說明清水混凝土從設計意圖到長期維護的工程判斷。
summaryEn: In exposed architectural concrete the surface is the finished building face and cannot be covered later, so panel layout, tie-hole pattern, facing material, release agent, mix and aggregate consistency, placing rate and vibration, mock-ups and viewing distance must all be settled before casting. Using Tadao Ando's Church of the Light and Louis Kahn's Salk Institute, framed by the ACI 347.3R formed-surface categories CSC1 to CSC4 and ACI 301 Section 6 Architectural Concrete, the course explains engineering judgement from design intent to long-term maintenance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 施工規劃練習：一道清水牆長 12 m、高 5.46 m、厚 0.3 m，要求 CSC4 級。模板以 0.91×1.82 m 面板分割，12/0.91 ≈ 13.2 片不是整數，改用 13 片、每片 12/13 ≈ 0.923 m 的訂製寬度，高度 3 片，共 39 片，每片 6 個繫桿孔共 234 個。面板 21 mm 合板，設計側壓 50 kPa，背楞間距 250 mm 時撓度 ≈ 0.47 mm（約 L/531），滿足 L/400。牆體體積 12×5.46×0.3 ≈ 19.7 m³，上升速度限制 1.5 m/h 時供料 5.4 m³/h，約 3.6 h 完成。驗收距離訂為 6 m，可分辨約 1.75 mm 的缺陷。若現場改以 15 m³/h 供料，上升速度變為約 4.17 m/h，整面牆約 1.3 h 澆完，側壓接近液壓 24×5.46 ≈ 131 kPa，為設計值的約 2.6 倍，面板撓度增為約 1.23 mm，超過 L/400 的 0.625 mm，牆面會出現可見波浪與漏漿痕。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
workedExample.textEn: Planning exercise: an exposed wall 12 m long, 5.46 m high and 0.3 m thick is specified to CSC4. With 0.91×1.82 m panels, 12/0.91 ≈ 13.2 is not a whole number, so 13 custom panels of 12/13 ≈ 0.923 m are used, three high, 39 panels in all with 6 tie holes each, 234 tie holes. With 21 mm plywood, a design pressure of 50 kPa and studs at 250 mm, deflection is about 0.47 mm (about L/531), meeting L/400. The wall holds 12×5.46×0.3 ≈ 19.7 m³; limiting the rate of rise to 1.5 m/h means 5.4 m³/h of supply and about 3.6 h to complete. Viewing distance is set at 6 m, where about 1.75 mm defects can be resolved. If the site switches to 15 m³/h, the rate of rise becomes about 4.17 m/h and the wall fills in about 1.3 h, pressure approaches hydrostatic 24×5.46 ≈ 131 kPa, about 2.6 times the design value, and facing deflection grows to about 1.23 mm, beyond the 0.625 mm L/400 limit, so visible waves and leak marks appear. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「清水混凝土的性能目標與等級」與「模板分割、拼縫與繫桿孔排列」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Performance targets and surface categories" and "Panel layout, joints and tie-hole pattern": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 清水混凝土的性能目標與等級：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Performance targets and surface categories: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「成形面等級」如何影響清水混凝土模板與澆置的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Formed-surface category” governs force, deformation or durability in “Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 清水混凝土的第一個工程問題是「要多好」。ACI 347.3R 把成形混凝土表面分為 CSC1 到 CSC4 四級：CSC1 用於地下室牆等不重視外觀的位置，CSC3 可用於一般商業建築外牆，CSC4 則用於紀念性或地標建築；每一級對模板面材、表面孔洞比例與顏色均勻度的要求不同。ACI 301 第 6 節建築混凝土只有在契約文件指定時才適用，所以設計者必須在圖說中明確寫出哪些面是清水面、要求哪一級，否則承包商只會按一般結構混凝土施作。等級越高，模板、配比、人力與樣板成本都越高。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「成形面等級」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The first engineering question for exposed concrete is how good it must be. ACI 347.3R divides formed concrete surfaces into four categories, CSC1 to CSC4: CSC1 for places such as basement walls where appearance matters little, CSC3 for ordinary commercial exteriors and CSC4 for monumental or landmark structures, each with different requirements for form facing, surface void ratio and colour uniformity. ACI 301 Section 6 Architectural Concrete applies only when the contract documents designate it, so the designer must state explicitly which faces are exposed and to what category, or the contractor will simply build ordinary structural concrete. Higher categories cost more in formwork, mix control, labour and mock-ups. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Formed-surface category” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：表面孔洞比例 = 孔洞總面積/檢查面積。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Surface void ratio = total void area/inspected area.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「清水混凝土就是不粉刷的普通混凝土，不需要特別的規格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Exposed concrete is just ordinary concrete left unpainted and needs no special specification." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「成形面等級」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Formed-surface category”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 清水混凝土的性能目標與等級
knowledge.text: 清水混凝土的第一個工程問題是「要多好」。ACI 347.3R 把成形混凝土表面分為 CSC1 到 CSC4 四級：CSC1 用於地下室牆等不重視外觀的位置，CSC3 可用於一般商業建築外牆，CSC4 則用於紀念性或地標建築；每一級對模板面材、表面孔洞比例與顏色均勻度的要求不同。
knowledge.textEn: The first engineering question for exposed concrete is how good it must be. ACI 347.3R divides formed concrete surfaces into four categories, CSC1 to CSC4: CSC1 for places such as basement walls where appearance matters little, CSC3 for ordinary commercial exteriors and CSC4 for monumental or landmark structures, each with different requirements for form facing, surface void ratio and colour uniformity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：清水混凝土就是不粉刷的普通混凝土，不需要特別的規格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Exposed concrete is just ordinary concrete left unpainted and needs no special specification. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「清水混凝土的性能目標與等級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Performance targets and surface categories" is correct?
options: 清水混凝土就是不粉刷的普通混凝土，不需要特別的規格。
清水混凝土的第一個工程問題是「要多好」。
模板拼縫與繫桿孔只是施工痕跡，交給工地自行安排即可。
optionsEn: Exposed concrete is just ordinary concrete left unpainted and needs no special specification.
The first engineering question for exposed concrete is how good it must be.
Form joints and tie holes are just construction marks that the site can arrange as it likes.
quiz.explanation: 清水混凝土的第一個工程問題是「要多好」。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The first engineering question for exposed concrete is how good it must be. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 清水混凝土的性能目標與等級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Performance targets and surface categories: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「成形面等級」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Formed-surface category” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：表面孔洞比例 = 孔洞總面積/檢查面積。在 0.5 m×0.5 m = 250,000 mm² 的檢查框內量到孔洞總面積 400 mm²，比例 = 400/250,000 = 0.16%；若規格要求 ≤ 0.3%（教學假設值）則合格，若同一框內有一個直徑 25 mm 的大孔（約 491 mm²）就會超出。數值為教學假設，實際限值依規範表格與契約。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Surface void ratio = total void area/inspected area. In a 0.5 m×0.5 m frame of 250,000 mm², a measured void area of 400 mm² gives 400/250,000 = 0.16%; against an assumed limit of 0.3% it passes, but a single 25 mm diameter bughole of about 491 mm² in the same frame would exceed it. Values are teaching assumptions; actual limits come from the code tables and the contract. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在設計圖說中以立面圖標示每一個清水面的等級與觀看條件，並在施工前由業主、建築師與承包商共同確認；驗收時以固定尺寸的檢查框隨機抽取位置，量測孔洞比例並與規定值及樣板牆比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark each exposed face's category and viewing conditions on elevations in the design documents and confirm them jointly with owner, architect and contractor before work starts; at acceptance place a fixed-size inspection frame at random locations, measure the void ratio and compare it with the specified value and the mock-up.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 表面孔洞比例 = 孔洞總面積/檢查面積。在 0.5 m×0.5 m = 250,000 mm² 的檢查框內量到孔洞總面積 400 mm²，比例 = 400/250,000 = 0.16%；若規格要求 ≤ 0.3%（教學假設值）則合格，若同一框內有一個直徑 25 mm 的大孔（約 491 mm²）就會超出。數值為教學假設，實際限值依規範表格與契約。
knowledge.textEn: Surface void ratio = total void area/inspected area. In a 0.5 m×0.5 m frame of 250,000 mm², a measured void area of 400 mm² gives 400/250,000 = 0.16%; against an assumed limit of 0.3% it passes, but a single 25 mm diameter bughole of about 491 mm² in the same frame would exceed it. Values are teaching assumptions; actual limits come from the code tables and the contract.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「清水混凝土的性能目標與等級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Performance targets and surface categories", which statement holds?
options: 只要強度等級相同，不同預拌廠的混凝土在外觀上沒有差別。
清水混凝土澆得越快越連續，表面就越均勻。
表面孔洞比例 = 孔洞總面積/檢查面積。
optionsEn: If the strength grade is the same, concrete from different plants looks the same.
The faster and more continuously exposed concrete is placed, the more uniform the surface.
Surface void ratio = total void area/inspected area.
quiz.explanation: 表面孔洞比例 = 孔洞總面積/檢查面積。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface void ratio = total void area/inspected area. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 清水混凝土的性能目標與等級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Performance targets and surface categories: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「成形面等級」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Formed-surface category” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在設計圖說中以立面圖標示每一個清水面的等級與觀看條件，並在施工前由業主、建築師與承包商共同確認；驗收時以固定尺寸的檢查框隨機抽取位置，量測孔洞比例並與規定值及樣板牆比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark each exposed face's category and viewing conditions on elevations in the design documents and confirm them jointly with owner, architect and contractor before work starts; at acceptance place a fixed-size inspection frame at random locations, measure the void ratio and compare it with the specified value and the mock-up. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在契約中引用 ACI 301 第 6 節或對應規範，逐面指定 ACI 347.3R 等級、孔洞比例、色差與平整度要求，以及樣板牆與觀看距離；這些要求要在投標前提供，讓承包商能正確估價。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Cite ACI 301 Section 6 or an equivalent in the contract, specify ACI 347.3R category, void ratio, colour and flatness face by face, along with the mock-up and viewing distance, and issue these before tender so contractors can price correctly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：圖說只寫「清水混凝土」而未指定等級與驗收方法，完工後業主以地標級標準要求、承包商以一般結構標準施作，雙方對孔洞與色差爭執不下，最後只能大面積修補或塗裝，失去清水的意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Drawings that say only exposed concrete without a category or acceptance method lead the owner to expect landmark quality while the contractor builds to ordinary structural standards, and the two sides argue over voids and colour until extensive patching or painting defeats the purpose of exposed concrete. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 清水混凝土的性能目標與等級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Performance targets and surface categories: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「成形面等級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Formed-surface category” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 圖說只寫「清水混凝土」而未指定等級與驗收方法，完工後業主以地標級標準要求、承包商以一般結構標準施作，雙方對孔洞與色差爭執不下，最後只能大面積修補或塗裝，失去清水的意義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Drawings that say only exposed concrete without a category or acceptance method lead the owner to expect landmark quality while the contractor builds to ordinary structural standards, and the two sides argue over voids and colour until extensive patching or painting defeats the purpose of exposed concrete. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：等級越高，模板、配比、人力與樣板成本都越高。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Higher categories cost more in formwork, mix control, labour and mock-ups.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「清水混凝土就是不粉刷的普通混凝土，不需要特別的規格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Exposed concrete is just ordinary concrete left unpainted and needs no special specification." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「清水混凝土的性能目標與等級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Performance targets and surface categories" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
圖說只寫「清水混凝土」而未指定等級與驗收方法，完工後業主以地標級標準要求、承包商以一般結構標準施作，雙方對孔洞與色差爭執不下，最後只能大面積修補或塗裝，失去清水的意義。
模板拼縫與繫桿孔只是施工痕跡，交給工地自行安排即可。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Form joints and tie holes are just construction marks that the site can arrange as it likes.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 模板分割、拼縫與繫桿孔排列：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Panel layout, joints and tie-hole pattern: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「模板分割與繫桿孔」如何影響清水混凝土模板與澆置的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Panel layout and tie holes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 在清水混凝土中，模板拼縫與繫桿孔不是缺陷，而是建築語彙：它們的位置、間距與對齊方式會永久留在表面上。安藤忠雄的作品常以約 910×1,820 mm 的模板與規則排列的繫桿孔構成立面節奏，路易斯．康在沙克研究所也讓模板接縫與繫桿孔成為表面的秩序。因此模板分割必須在建築設計階段與牆長、開口、樓層高度與轉角一起決定，並把繫桿孔放在面板上對稱的位置；若牆長不是面板寬度的整數倍，就會出現難看的窄條板。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「模板分割與繫桿孔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In exposed concrete, form joints and tie holes are not defects but architectural vocabulary: their position, spacing and alignment stay on the surface permanently. Tadao Ando's work often uses forms of about 910×1,820 mm with regularly spaced tie holes to give elevations their rhythm, and Louis Kahn at the Salk Institute likewise let form joints and tie holes order the surface. Panel layout must therefore be settled at architectural design stage together with wall lengths, openings, storey heights and corners, with tie holes placed symmetrically on each panel; if a wall length is not a whole multiple of the panel width, an awkward narrow filler panel appears. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Panel layout and tie holes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：牆長 17.5 m、面板寬 0.91 m 時需要 17.5/0.91 ≈ 19.2 片，不是整數。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 17.5 m wall with 0.91 m panels needs 17.5/0.91 ≈ 19.2 panels, not a whole number.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模板拼縫與繫桿孔只是施工痕跡，交給工地自行安排即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Form joints and tie holes are just construction marks that the site can arrange as it likes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「模板分割與繫桿孔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Panel layout and tie holes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模板分割、拼縫與繫桿孔排列
knowledge.titleEn: Panel layout, joints and tie-hole pattern
knowledge.text: 在清水混凝土中，模板拼縫與繫桿孔不是缺陷，而是建築語彙：它們的位置、間距與對齊方式會永久留在表面上。安藤忠雄的作品常以約 910×1,820 mm 的模板與規則排列的繫桿孔構成立面節奏，路易斯．康在沙克研究所也讓模板接縫與繫桿孔成為表面的秩序。
knowledge.textEn: In exposed concrete, form joints and tie holes are not defects but architectural vocabulary: their position, spacing and alignment stay on the surface permanently. Tadao Ando's work often uses forms of about 910×1,820 mm with regularly spaced tie holes to give elevations their rhythm, and Louis Kahn at the Salk Institute likewise let form joints and tie holes order the surface.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模板拼縫與繫桿孔只是施工痕跡，交給工地自行安排即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Form joints and tie holes are just construction marks that the site can arrange as it likes. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模板分割、拼縫與繫桿孔排列」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Panel layout, joints and tie-hole pattern" is correct?
options: 模板拼縫與繫桿孔只是施工痕跡，交給工地自行安排即可。
脫模劑塗得越多越好，可以保證拆模後表面光滑。
在清水混凝土中，模板拼縫與繫桿孔不是缺陷，而是建築語彙：它們的位置、間距與對齊方式會永久留在表面上。
optionsEn: Form joints and tie holes are just construction marks that the site can arrange as it likes.
The more release agent the better; it guarantees a smooth surface after stripping.
In exposed concrete, form joints and tie holes are not defects but architectural vocabulary: their position, spacing and alignment stay on the surface permanently.
quiz.explanation: 在清水混凝土中，模板拼縫與繫桿孔不是缺陷，而是建築語彙：它們的位置、間距與對齊方式會永久留在表面上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In exposed concrete, form joints and tie holes are not defects but architectural vocabulary: their position, spacing and alignment stay on the surface permanently. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模板分割、拼縫與繫桿孔排列：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Panel layout, joints and tie-hole pattern: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模板分割與繫桿孔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Panel layout and tie holes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：牆長 17.5 m、面板寬 0.91 m 時需要 17.5/0.91 ≈ 19.2 片，不是整數。可選擇：改用 19 片、每片約 17.5/19 ≈ 0.921 m 的訂製寬度，或把牆長調為 19×0.91 = 17.29 m 或 20×0.91 = 18.2 m。牆高 3 片×1.82 m = 5.46 m，每片 6 個繫桿孔，19×3 = 57 片共 342 個繫桿孔。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 17.5 m wall with 0.91 m panels needs 17.5/0.91 ≈ 19.2 panels, not a whole number. Options: 19 custom panels of about 17.5/19 ≈ 0.921 m, or adjusting the wall to 19×0.91 = 17.29 m or 20×0.91 = 18.2 m. Three panels of 1.82 m make 5.46 m of height; with 6 tie holes per panel, 19×3 = 57 panels carry 342 tie holes. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以立面展開圖繪出每一道牆的面板分割、拼縫、繫桿孔與施工縫位置，並與開口、轉角、樓板邊緣對齊檢查；模板加工前由建築師簽認展開圖，現場組模後以捲尺與雷射抽查拼縫與繫桿孔位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw developed elevations of every wall showing panel layout, joints, tie holes and construction joints, checking alignment with openings, corners and slab edges; have the architect sign the developed elevations before forms are made, and spot-check joint and tie-hole positions on site with tape and laser after assembly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: A 17.5 m wall with 0.91 m panels needs 17.5/0.91 ≈ 19.2 panels, not a whole number. Options: 19 custom panels of about 17.5/19 ≈ 0.921 m, or adjusting the wall to 19×0.91 = 17.29 m or 20×0.91 = 18.2 m. Three panels of 1.82 m make 5.46 m of height; with 6 tie holes per panel, 19×3 = 57 panels carry 342 tie holes. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模板分割、拼縫與繫桿孔排列」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Panel layout, joints and tie-hole pattern", which statement holds?
options: 清水模板只要表面光滑就好，背楞間距照一般結構模板即可。
樣板牆只是給業主看的展示品，正式施工時不需要再參照。
optionsEn: A 17.5 m wall with 0.91 m panels needs 17.5/0.91 ≈ 19.2 panels, not a whole number.
Exposed-concrete forms only need a smooth facing; stud spacing can follow ordinary structural forms.
The mock-up is just a showpiece for the owner and need not be referred to during construction.
quiz.explanation: 牆長 17.5 m、面板寬 0.91 m 時需要 17.5/0.91 ≈ 19.2 片，不是整數。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 17.5 m wall with 0.91 m panels needs 17.5/0.91 ≈ 19.2 panels, not a whole number. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.titleEn: Panel layout, joints and tie-hole pattern: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模板分割與繫桿孔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Panel layout and tie holes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以立面展開圖繪出每一道牆的面板分割、拼縫、繫桿孔與施工縫位置，並與開口、轉角、樓板邊緣對齊檢查；模板加工前由建築師簽認展開圖，現場組模後以捲尺與雷射抽查拼縫與繫桿孔位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw developed elevations of every wall showing panel layout, joints, tie holes and construction joints, checking alignment with openings, corners and slab edges; have the architect sign the developed elevations before forms are made, and spot-check joint and tie-hole positions on site with tape and laser after assembly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把模板分割展開圖列為建築設計圖的一部分，施工縫、繫桿孔與拼縫的位置與構造詳圖（例如倒角、凹槽、繫桿錐形套）都要在開工前定案；任何現場調整須經建築師書面同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make the developed formwork elevations part of the architectural drawings, and settle construction joints, tie holes and joint details such as chamfers, reveals and tie cones before work starts; any site adjustment needs the architect's written approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：模板分割在現場臨時決定，牆端出現 200 mm 的窄條板，繫桿孔在轉角兩側無法對齊，施工縫位置與拼縫錯開形成雜亂的水平線，整面清水牆的秩序被破壞且無法修正。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Deciding the layout on site leaves a 200 mm filler strip at the wall end, tie holes that cannot line up on either side of a corner, and construction joints offset from panel joints that form messy horizontal lines, destroying the order of the whole exposed wall beyond correction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模板分割、拼縫與繫桿孔排列」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Panel layout, joints and tie-hole pattern"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以立面展開圖繪出每一道牆的面板分割、拼縫、繫桿孔與施工縫位置，並與開口、轉角、樓板邊緣對齊檢查。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Draw developed elevations of every wall showing panel layout, joints, tie holes and construction joints, checking alignment with openings, corners and slab edges.
Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan.
