Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模板分割、拼縫與繫桿孔排列：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Panel layout, joints and tie-hole pattern: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模板分割與繫桿孔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Panel layout and tie holes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模板分割在現場臨時決定，牆端出現 200 mm 的窄條板，繫桿孔在轉角兩側無法對齊，施工縫位置與拼縫錯開形成雜亂的水平線，整面清水牆的秩序被破壞且無法修正。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Deciding the layout on site leaves a 200 mm filler strip at the wall end, tie holes that cannot line up on either side of a corner, and construction joints offset from panel joints that form messy horizontal lines, destroying the order of the whole exposed wall beyond correction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此模板分割必須在建築設計階段與牆長、開口、樓層高度與轉角一起決定，並把繫桿孔放在面板上對稱的位置；若牆長不是面板寬度的整數倍，就會出現難看的窄條板。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Panel layout must therefore be settled at architectural design stage together with wall lengths, openings, storey heights and corners, with tie holes placed symmetrically on each panel; if a wall length is not a whole multiple of the panel width, an awkward narrow filler panel appears.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模板拼縫與繫桿孔只是施工痕跡，交給工地自行安排即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Form joints and tie holes are just construction marks that the site can arrange as it likes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 模板分割在現場臨時決定，牆端出現 200 mm 的窄條板，繫桿孔在轉角兩側無法對齊，施工縫位置與拼縫錯開形成雜亂的水平線，整面清水牆的秩序被破壞且無法修正。
knowledge.textEn: Deciding the layout on site leaves a 200 mm filler strip at the wall end, tie holes that cannot line up on either side of a corner, and construction joints offset from panel joints that form messy horizontal lines, destroying the order of the whole exposed wall beyond correction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模板分割、拼縫與繫桿孔排列」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Panel layout, joints and tie-hole pattern" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
脫模劑塗得越多越好，可以保證拆模後表面光滑。
模板分割在現場臨時決定，牆端出現 200 mm 的窄條板，繫桿孔在轉角兩側無法對齊，施工縫位置與拼縫錯開形成雜亂的水平線，整面清水牆的秩序被破壞且無法修正。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The more release agent the better; it guarantees a smooth surface after stripping.

Deciding the layout on site leaves a 200 mm filler strip at the wall end, tie holes that cannot line up on either side of a corner, and construction joints offset from panel joints that form messy horizontal lines, destroying the order of the whole exposed wall beyond correction.
quiz.explanation: 模板分割在現場臨時決定，牆端出現 200 mm 的窄條板，繫桿孔在轉角兩側無法對齊，施工縫位置與拼縫錯開形成雜亂的水平線，整面清水牆的秩序被破壞且無法修正。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Deciding the layout on site leaves a 200 mm filler strip at the wall end, tie holes that cannot line up on either side of a corner, and construction joints offset from panel joints that form messy horizontal lines, destroying the order of the whole exposed wall beyond correction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「模板面材、脫模劑與表面顏色」與「配比、單一材料來源與色差控制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Form facing, release agent and surface colour" and "Mix design, single-source materials and colour control": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 模板面材、脫模劑與表面顏色：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Form facing, release agent and surface colour: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「面板材料與脫模劑」如何影響清水混凝土模板與澆置的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Facing material and release agent” governs force, deformation or durability in “Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混凝土表面會忠實複製模板面材的質感與吸水性：覆膜合板得到光滑均勻的表面，未處理木板留下木紋，吸水性不同的面板會讓表層水灰比不同而產生色差。ACI 347.3R 把模板面材特性列為成形面等級的三大分類之一。脫模劑塗太多會流淌並在表面留下深色斑痕或孔洞，塗太少則混凝土黏模；不同廠牌或批次的脫模劑也可能造成顏色差異。面材重複使用時表面磨損、吸水性改變，也會逐次改變混凝土顏色，所以高等級清水面要限制面材使用次數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「面板材料與脫模劑」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete faithfully reproduces the texture and absorbency of the form facing: film-faced plywood gives a smooth, even surface, untreated boards leave wood grain, and facings of different absorbency change the surface water–cement ratio and cause colour differences. ACI 347.3R lists form-facing characteristics as one of its three surface-finish categories. Too much release agent runs and leaves dark stains or bugholes, too little lets concrete stick; different brands or batches of release agent can also change colour. Reused facings wear and change absorbency, gradually altering colour from use to use, so higher categories limit how many times a facing may be used. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Facing material and release agent” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：脫模劑用量若為 1 L/40 m²，1,000 m² 模板需 25 L，現場應以量杯或噴霧量控制而非目測。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 1 L of release agent per 40 m², 1,000 m² of form needs 25 L, controlled by measured spray rather than by eye.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「脫模劑塗得越多越好，可以保證拆模後表面光滑。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more release agent the better; it guarantees a smooth surface after stripping." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「面板材料與脫模劑」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Facing material and release agent”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模板面材、脫模劑與表面顏色
knowledge.titleEn: Form facing, release agent and surface colour
knowledge.text: 混凝土表面會忠實複製模板面材的質感與吸水性：覆膜合板得到光滑均勻的表面，未處理木板留下木紋，吸水性不同的面板會讓表層水灰比不同而產生色差。ACI 347.3R 把模板面材特性列為成形面等級的三大分類之一。
knowledge.textEn: Concrete faithfully reproduces the texture and absorbency of the form facing: film-faced plywood gives a smooth, even surface, untreated boards leave wood grain, and facings of different absorbency change the surface water–cement ratio and cause colour differences. ACI 347.3R lists form-facing characteristics as one of its three surface-finish categories.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：脫模劑塗得越多越好，可以保證拆模後表面光滑。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The more release agent the better; it guarantees a smooth surface after stripping. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模板面材、脫模劑與表面顏色」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Form facing, release agent and surface colour" is correct?
options: 混凝土表面會忠實複製模板面材的質感與吸水性：覆膜合板得到光滑均勻的表面，未處理木板留下木紋，吸水性不同的面板會讓表層水灰比不同而產生色差。
脫模劑塗得越多越好，可以保證拆模後表面光滑。
只要強度等級相同，不同預拌廠的混凝土在外觀上沒有差別。
optionsEn: Concrete faithfully reproduces the texture and absorbency of the form facing: film-faced plywood gives a smooth, even surface, untreated boards leave wood grain, and facings of different absorbency change the surface water–cement ratio and cause colour differences.
The more release agent the better; it guarantees a smooth surface after stripping.
If the strength grade is the same, concrete from different plants looks the same.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土表面會忠實複製模板面材的質感與吸水性：覆膜合板得到光滑均勻的表面，未處理木板留下木紋，吸水性不同的面板會讓表層水灰比不同而產生色差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Concrete faithfully reproduces the texture and absorbency of the form facing: film-faced plywood gives a smooth, even surface, untreated boards leave wood grain, and facings of different absorbency change the surface water–cement ratio and cause colour differences. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模板面材、脫模劑與表面顏色：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Form facing, release agent and surface colour: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「面板材料與脫模劑」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Facing material and release agent” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：脫模劑用量若為 1 L/40 m²，1,000 m² 模板需 25 L，現場應以量杯或噴霧量控制而非目測。面材使用次數：清水牆總面積 2,400 m²、一套模板 400 m² 需翻用 2,400/400 = 6 次；若規格限定面材最多使用 4 次，需準備 6/4 = 1.5 套，即約 600 m² 面材。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 1 L of release agent per 40 m², 1,000 m² of form needs 25 L, controlled by measured spray rather than by eye. Facing reuse: 2,400 m² of exposed wall with a 400 m² form set means 2,400/400 = 6 uses; if the specification allows a facing to be used at most 4 times, 6/4 = 1.5 sets, about 600 m² of facing, are needed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在樣板牆上試驗選定的面材與脫模劑組合，記錄用量與施作方式；施工中每次組模前檢查面材的損傷、修補與使用次數標記，並抽查脫模劑塗佈是否均勻，有流淌的面板須擦拭後才可合模。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trial the chosen facing and release agent on the mock-up, recording dosage and application; before every assembly inspect facings for damage, repairs and use-count marks, spot-check that release agent is even, and wipe any panel with runs before closing the form.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 脫模劑用量若為 1 L/40 m²，1,000 m² 模板需 25 L，現場應以量杯或噴霧量控制而非目測。面材使用次數：清水牆總面積 2,400 m²、一套模板 400 m² 需翻用 2,400/400 = 6 次；若規格限定面材最多使用 4 次，需準備 6/4 = 1.5 套，即約 600 m² 面材。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: At 1 L of release agent per 40 m², 1,000 m² of form needs 25 L, controlled by measured spray rather than by eye. Facing reuse: 2,400 m² of exposed wall with a 400 m² form set means 2,400/400 = 6 uses; if the specification allows a facing to be used at most 4 times, 6/4 = 1.5 sets, about 600 m² of facing, are needed. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模板面材、脫模劑與表面顏色」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Form facing, release agent and surface colour", which statement holds?
options: 清水混凝土澆得越快越連續，表面就越均勻。
脫模劑用量若為 1 L/40 m²，1,000 m² 模板需 25 L，現場應以量杯或噴霧量控制而非目測。
清水混凝土的外觀好壞只能靠主觀感覺判斷，無法量測。
optionsEn: The faster and more continuously exposed concrete is placed, the more uniform the surface.
At 1 L of release agent per 40 m², 1,000 m² of form needs 25 L, controlled by measured spray rather than by eye.
The appearance of exposed concrete can only be judged subjectively and cannot be measured.
quiz.explanation: 脫模劑用量若為 1 L/40 m²，1,000 m² 模板需 25 L，現場應以量杯或噴霧量控制而非目測。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At 1 L of release agent per 40 m², 1,000 m² of form needs 25 L, controlled by measured spray rather than by eye. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模板面材、脫模劑與表面顏色：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Form facing, release agent and surface colour: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「面板材料與脫模劑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Facing material and release agent” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在樣板牆上試驗選定的面材與脫模劑組合，記錄用量與施作方式；施工中每次組模前檢查面材的損傷、修補與使用次數標記，並抽查脫模劑塗佈是否均勻，有流淌的面板須擦拭後才可合模。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trial the chosen facing and release agent on the mock-up, recording dosage and application; before every assembly inspect facings for damage, repairs and use-count marks, spot-check that release agent is even, and wipe any panel with runs before closing the form. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格中指定面材種類、使用次數上限與修補方式，以及脫模劑廠牌、用量與施作方法；同一可見面應使用同一批面材與同一批脫模劑，並在面板背面標記使用次數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify facing type, maximum uses and repair method, and release-agent brand, dosage and application in the specification; use one batch of facing and one batch of release agent for each visible face, and mark use counts on the back of each panel.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一面牆混用新舊面材，新面板吸水多，牆面出現與面板分割相同的明暗格子；脫模劑過量在下方積聚，牆腳一帶出現深色斑塊與密集小孔，無法以清洗去除。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing new and used facings on one wall makes the more absorbent new panels show as a chequerboard of light and dark matching the panel layout; excess release agent pooling at the bottom leaves dark patches and dense small voids at the wall base that cannot be washed off. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在樣板牆上試驗選定的面材與脫模劑組合，記錄用量與施作方式；施工中每次組模前檢查面材的損傷、修補與使用次數標記，並抽查脫模劑塗佈是否均勻，有流淌的面板須擦拭後才可合模。
knowledge.textEn: Trial the chosen facing and release agent on the mock-up, recording dosage and application; before every assembly inspect facings for damage, repairs and use-count marks, spot-check that release agent is even, and wipe any panel with runs before closing the form.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格中指定面材種類、使用次數上限與修補方式，以及脫模劑廠牌、用量與施作方法；同一可見面應使用同一批面材與同一批脫模劑，並在面板背面標記使用次數。
knowledge.textEn: Specify facing type, maximum uses and repair method, and release-agent brand, dosage and application in the specification; use one batch of facing and one batch of release agent for each visible face, and mark use counts on the back of each panel.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模板面材、脫模劑與表面顏色」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Form facing, release agent and surface colour"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。
在樣板牆上試驗選定的面材與脫模劑組合，記錄用量與施作方式。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing.
Trial the chosen facing and release agent on the mock-up, recording dosage and application.
quiz.explanation: 在樣板牆上試驗選定的面材與脫模劑組合，記錄用量與施作方式；施工中每次組模前檢查面材的損傷、修補與使用次數標記，並抽查脫模劑塗佈是否均勻，有流淌的面板須擦拭後才可合模。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trial the chosen facing and release agent on the mock-up, recording dosage and application; before every assembly inspect facings for damage, repairs and use-count marks, spot-check that release agent is even, and wipe any panel with runs before closing the form. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模板面材、脫模劑與表面顏色：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Form facing, release agent and surface colour: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「面板材料與脫模劑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Facing material and release agent” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一面牆混用新舊面材，新面板吸水多，牆面出現與面板分割相同的明暗格子；脫模劑過量在下方積聚，牆腳一帶出現深色斑塊與密集小孔，無法以清洗去除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing new and used facings on one wall makes the more absorbent new panels show as a chequerboard of light and dark matching the panel layout; excess release agent pooling at the bottom leaves dark patches and dense small voids at the wall base that cannot be washed off. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：面材重複使用時表面磨損、吸水性改變，也會逐次改變混凝土顏色，所以高等級清水面要限制面材使用次數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reused facings wear and change absorbency, gradually altering colour from use to use, so higher categories limit how many times a facing may be used.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「脫模劑塗得越多越好，可以保證拆模後表面光滑。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more release agent the better; it guarantees a smooth surface after stripping." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一面牆混用新舊面材，新面板吸水多，牆面出現與面板分割相同的明暗格子；脫模劑過量在下方積聚，牆腳一帶出現深色斑塊與密集小孔，無法以清洗去除。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing new and used facings on one wall makes the more absorbent new panels show as a chequerboard of light and dark matching the panel layout; excess release agent pooling at the bottom leaves dark patches and dense small voids at the wall base that cannot be washed off.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模板面材、脫模劑與表面顏色」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Form facing, release agent and surface colour" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 同一面牆混用新舊面材，新面板吸水多，牆面出現與面板分割相同的明暗格子；脫模劑過量在下方積聚，牆腳一帶出現深色斑塊與密集小孔，無法以清洗去除。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要強度等級相同，不同預拌廠的混凝土在外觀上沒有差別。
optionsEn: Mixing new and used facings on one wall makes the more absorbent new panels show as a chequerboard of light and dark matching the panel layout.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If the strength grade is the same, concrete from different plants looks the same.
quiz.explanation: 同一面牆混用新舊面材，新面板吸水多，牆面出現與面板分割相同的明暗格子；脫模劑過量在下方積聚，牆腳一帶出現深色斑塊與密集小孔，無法以清洗去除。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing new and used facings on one wall makes the more absorbent new panels show as a chequerboard of light and dark matching the panel layout; excess release agent pooling at the bottom leaves dark patches and dense small voids at the wall base that cannot be washed off. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 配比、單一材料來源與色差控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Mix design, single-source materials and colour control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「配比與材料一致性」如何影響清水混凝土模板與澆置的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mix and material consistency” governs force, deformation or durability in “Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 清水混凝土的顏色由水泥、礦物摻料、細骨材的顏色與表層水灰比共同決定，所以整個工程應使用同一水泥廠、同一摻料來源與同一砂石來源，避免批次變化。沙克研究所的混凝土採用含火山灰的配比，產生偏暖的色調，康並在地下室以不同顏色的試驗牆比較配比；這說明配比本身就是外觀設計的一部分。最常被忽視的變數是骨材含水率：砂的含水率變動會改變實際用水量，表層水灰比升高時顏色變淺且孔洞增加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「配比與材料一致性」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The colour of exposed concrete comes from the cement, supplementary materials, fine aggregate and surface water–cement ratio together, so the whole job should use one cement plant, one supplementary-material source and one aggregate source to avoid batch variation. The Salk Institute used a mix containing volcanic ash that gives a warm tone, and Kahn compared mixes in differently coloured trial walls in the basement, showing that the mix itself is part of the visual design. The most overlooked variable is aggregate moisture: changes in sand moisture alter the actual water content, and a higher surface water–cement ratio lightens colour and increases voids. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mix and material consistency” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：細骨材 800 kg/m³、含水率比假設高 1%，等於多加 8 L 水；水泥 350 kg/m³ 時水灰比由 0.45 變為 0.45 + 8/350 ≈ 0.473，增加約 0.023，足以在相鄰兩車之間造成可見色差。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 800 kg/m³ of fine aggregate, moisture 1% above the assumed value adds 8 L of water; with 350 kg/m³ of cement the water–cement ratio rises from 0.45 to 0.45 + 8/350 ≈ 0.473, about 0.023 more, enough to cause a visible colour difference between adjacent truckloads.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要強度等級相同，不同預拌廠的混凝土在外觀上沒有差別。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the strength grade is the same, concrete from different plants looks the same." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「配比與材料一致性」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Mix and material consistency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 配比、單一材料來源與色差控制
knowledge.titleEn: Mix design, single-source materials and colour control
knowledge.text: 清水混凝土的顏色由水泥、礦物摻料、細骨材的顏色與表層水灰比共同決定，所以整個工程應使用同一水泥廠、同一摻料來源與同一砂石來源，避免批次變化。沙克研究所的混凝土採用含火山灰的配比，產生偏暖的色調，康並在地下室以不同顏色的試驗牆比較配比；這說明配比本身就是外觀設計的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: The colour of exposed concrete comes from the cement, supplementary materials, fine aggregate and surface water–cement ratio together, so the whole job should use one cement plant, one supplementary-material source and one aggregate source to avoid batch variation. The Salk Institute used a mix containing volcanic ash that gives a warm tone, and Kahn compared mixes in differently coloured trial walls in the basement, showing that the mix itself is part of the visual design.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要強度等級相同，不同預拌廠的混凝土在外觀上沒有差別。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the strength grade is the same, concrete from different plants looks the same. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「配比、單一材料來源與色差控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mix design, single-source materials and colour control" is correct?
options: 只要強度等級相同，不同預拌廠的混凝土在外觀上沒有差別。
清水混凝土的顏色由水泥、礦物摻料、細骨材的顏色與表層水灰比共同決定，所以整個工程應使用同一水泥廠、同一摻料來源與同一砂石來源，避免批次變化。
清水模板只要表面光滑就好，背楞間距照一般結構模板即可。
optionsEn: If the strength grade is the same, concrete from different plants looks the same.

The colour of exposed concrete comes from the cement, supplementary materials, fine aggregate and surface water–cement ratio together, so the whole job should use one cement plant, one supplementary-material source and one aggregate source to avoid batch variation.
Exposed-concrete forms only need a smooth facing; stud spacing can follow ordinary structural forms.
quiz.explanation: 清水混凝土的顏色由水泥、礦物摻料、細骨材的顏色與表層水灰比共同決定，所以整個工程應使用同一水泥廠、同一摻料來源與同一砂石來源，避免批次變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The colour of exposed concrete comes from the cement, supplementary materials, fine aggregate and surface water–cement ratio together, so the whole job should use one cement plant, one supplementary-material source and one aggregate source to avoid batch variation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 配比、單一材料來源與色差控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mix design, single-source materials and colour control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「配比與材料一致性」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mix and material consistency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：細骨材 800 kg/m³、含水率比假設高 1%，等於多加 8 L 水；水泥 350 kg/m³ 時水灰比由 0.45 變為 0.45 + 8/350 ≈ 0.473，增加約 0.023，足以在相鄰兩車之間造成可見色差。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 800 kg/m³ of fine aggregate, moisture 1% above the assumed value adds 8 L of water; with 350 kg/m³ of cement the water–cement ratio rises from 0.45 to 0.45 + 8/350 ≈ 0.473, about 0.023 more, enough to cause a visible colour difference between adjacent truckloads. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：預拌廠以含水率感測器或每班烘乾試驗即時修正用水量，並記錄每車的配比、含水率與出廠時間；工地每車檢查坍度或坍流度與溫度，與樣板牆使用的配比紀錄比對，偏離範圍的車次退回。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The batch plant corrects water in real time with moisture probes or oven-dry tests each shift and records mix, moisture and dispatch time for every truck; on site check slump or slump flow and temperature for every truck against the mock-up mix record and reject trucks outside the range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 細骨材 800 kg/m³、含水率比假設高 1%，等於多加 8 L 水；水泥 350 kg/m³ 時水灰比由 0.45 變為 0.45 + 8/350 ≈ 0.473，增加約 0.023，足以在相鄰兩車之間造成可見色差。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 800 kg/m³ of fine aggregate, moisture 1% above the assumed value adds 8 L of water; with 350 kg/m³ of cement the water–cement ratio rises from 0.45 to 0.45 + 8/350 ≈ 0.473, about 0.023 more, enough to cause a visible colour difference between adjacent truckloads. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「配比、單一材料來源與色差控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mix design, single-source materials and colour control", which statement holds?
options: 樣板牆只是給業主看的展示品，正式施工時不需要再參照。
清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。
細骨材 800 kg/m³、含水率比假設高 1%，等於多加 8 L 水。
optionsEn: The mock-up is just a showpiece for the owner and need not be referred to during construction.
Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan.
With 800 kg/m³ of fine aggregate, moisture 1% above the assumed value adds 8 L of water.
quiz.explanation: 細骨材 800 kg/m³、含水率比假設高 1%，等於多加 8 L 水；水泥 350 kg/m³ 時水灰比由 0.45 變為 0.45 + 8/350 ≈ 0.473，增加約 0.023，足以在相鄰兩車之間造成可見色差。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 800 kg/m³ of fine aggregate, moisture 1% above the assumed value adds 8 L of water; with 350 kg/m³ of cement the water–cement ratio rises from 0.45 to 0.45 + 8/350 ≈ 0.473, about 0.023 more, enough to cause a visible colour difference between adjacent truckloads. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 配比、單一材料來源與色差控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mix design, single-source materials and colour control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「配比與材料一致性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mix and material consistency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 預拌廠以含水率感測器或每班烘乾試驗即時修正用水量，並記錄每車的配比、含水率與出廠時間；工地每車檢查坍度或坍流度與溫度，與樣板牆使用的配比紀錄比對，偏離範圍的車次退回。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The batch plant corrects water in real time with moisture probes or oven-dry tests each shift and records mix, moisture and dispatch time for every truck; on site check slump or slump flow and temperature for every truck against the mock-up mix record and reject trucks outside the range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：清水混凝土的配比、水泥與骨材來源應在樣板牆核定後鎖定，供應契約中規定材料庫存與不可替換條款；任何變更都要重做樣板並經建築師同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lock the mix, cement and aggregate sources once the mock-up is approved, require stockpiles and no-substitution clauses in the supply contract, and redo the mock-up with the architect's approval for any change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：工程中途水泥廠更換或砂石來源改變，新舊混凝土交界出現明顯色帶；夏季砂料含水率波動而預拌廠未修正，同一面牆上下層顏色不同，修補無法消除。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Changing cement plant or aggregate source mid-job leaves a clear colour band where old and new concrete meet; summer swings in sand moisture not corrected at the plant give upper and lower lifts of one wall different colours that no repair can remove. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 預拌廠以含水率感測器或每班烘乾試驗即時修正用水量，並記錄每車的配比、含水率與出廠時間；工地每車檢查坍度或坍流度與溫度，與樣板牆使用的配比紀錄比對，偏離範圍的車次退回。
knowledge.textEn: The batch plant corrects water in real time with moisture probes or oven-dry tests each shift and records mix, moisture and dispatch time for every truck; on site check slump or slump flow and temperature for every truck against the mock-up mix record and reject trucks outside the range.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 清水混凝土的配比、水泥與骨材來源應在樣板牆核定後鎖定，供應契約中規定材料庫存與不可替換條款；任何變更都要重做樣板並經建築師同意。
knowledge.textEn: Lock the mix, cement and aggregate sources once the mock-up is approved, require stockpiles and no-substitution clauses in the supply contract, and redo the mock-up with the architect's approval for any change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「配比、單一材料來源與色差控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mix design, single-source materials and colour control"?
options: 預拌廠以含水率感測器或每班烘乾試驗即時修正用水量，並記錄每車的配比、含水率與出廠時間。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
清水混凝土就是不粉刷的普通混凝土，不需要特別的規格。
optionsEn: The batch plant corrects water in real time with moisture probes or oven-dry tests each shift and records mix, moisture and dispatch time for every truck.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Exposed concrete is just ordinary concrete left unpainted and needs no special specification.
quiz.explanation: 預拌廠以含水率感測器或每班烘乾試驗即時修正用水量，並記錄每車的配比、含水率與出廠時間；工地每車檢查坍度或坍流度與溫度，與樣板牆使用的配比紀錄比對，偏離範圍的車次退回。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The batch plant corrects water in real time with moisture probes or oven-dry tests each shift and records mix, moisture and dispatch time for every truck; on site check slump or slump flow and temperature for every truck against the mock-up mix record and reject trucks outside the range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 配比、單一材料來源與色差控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mix design, single-source materials and colour control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「配比與材料一致性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mix and material consistency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 工程中途水泥廠更換或砂石來源改變，新舊混凝土交界出現明顯色帶；夏季砂料含水率波動而預拌廠未修正，同一面牆上下層顏色不同，修補無法消除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Changing cement plant or aggregate source mid-job leaves a clear colour band where old and new concrete meet; summer swings in sand moisture not corrected at the plant give upper and lower lifts of one wall different colours that no repair can remove. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：最常被忽視的變數是骨材含水率：砂的含水率變動會改變實際用水量，表層水灰比升高時顏色變淺且孔洞增加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The most overlooked variable is aggregate moisture: changes in sand moisture alter the actual water content, and a higher surface water–cement ratio lightens colour and increases voids.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要強度等級相同，不同預拌廠的混凝土在外觀上沒有差別。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the strength grade is the same, concrete from different plants looks the same." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 工程中途水泥廠更換或砂石來源改變，新舊混凝土交界出現明顯色帶；夏季砂料含水率波動而預拌廠未修正，同一面牆上下層顏色不同，修補無法消除。
knowledge.textEn: Changing cement plant or aggregate source mid-job leaves a clear colour band where old and new concrete meet; summer swings in sand moisture not corrected at the plant give upper and lower lifts of one wall different colours that no repair can remove.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「配比、單一材料來源與色差控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mix design, single-source materials and colour control" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
工程中途水泥廠更換或砂石來源改變，新舊混凝土交界出現明顯色帶；夏季砂料含水率波動而預拌廠未修正，同一面牆上下層顏色不同，修補無法消除。
清水模板只要表面光滑就好，背楞間距照一般結構模板即可。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Changing cement plant or aggregate source mid-job leaves a clear colour band where old and new concrete meet.
Exposed-concrete forms only need a smooth facing; stud spacing can follow ordinary structural forms.
quiz.explanation: 工程中途水泥廠更換或砂石來源改變，新舊混凝土交界出現明顯色帶；夏季砂料含水率波動而預拌廠未修正，同一面牆上下層顏色不同，修補無法消除。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing cement plant or aggregate source mid-job leaves a clear colour band where old and new concrete meet; summer swings in sand moisture not corrected at the plant give upper and lower lifts of one wall different colours that no repair can remove. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「模板勁度、拼縫密封與漏漿痕」與「澆置上升速度、分層與振搗」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Form stiffness, joint sealing and grout-loss marks" and "Rate of rise, layering and vibration": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 模板勁度、拼縫密封與漏漿痕：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Form stiffness, joint sealing and grout-loss marks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「模板勁度與拼縫止漏」如何影響清水混凝土模板與澆置的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Form stiffness and joint sealing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 清水面要平整、拼縫要乾淨，模板必須夠剛且密封良好。新鮮混凝土的側壓使面板在支撐間撓曲，撓曲量若超過肉眼在斜光下可辨識的程度，牆面就會出現波浪；拼縫若有縫隙，水泥漿在壓力下從縫隙流失，留下砂紋、深色漏漿痕或粗糙的蜂窩帶。因此清水模板常比結構模板有更密的背楞、更厚的面板，拼縫以密封條或膠帶處理，牆角與施工縫以倒角或凹槽把無法避免的接縫變成刻意的線條。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「模板勁度與拼縫止漏」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a flat face and clean joints, forms must be stiff and well sealed. Fresh-concrete pressure bends facings between supports, and if deflection exceeds what the eye detects in raking light the wall shows waves; any gap at a joint lets paste escape under pressure, leaving sand streaks, dark grout-loss lines or rough honeycomb bands. Exposed-concrete forms therefore often have closer studs and thicker facings than structural forms, joints sealed with gaskets or tape, and chamfers or reveals at corners and construction joints that turn unavoidable joints into deliberate lines. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Form stiffness and joint sealing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：21 mm 合板、E = 7,000 MPa，每 mm 寬 I = 21³/12 ≈ 772 mm⁴；側壓 50 kPa（0.05 N/mm²）、背楞間距 300 mm 時 δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 0.98 mm ≈ L/307。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For 21 mm plywood with E = 7,000 MPa, I per mm width = 21³/12 ≈ 772 mm⁴; at 50 kPa (0.05 N/mm²) with studs at 300 mm, δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 0.98 mm ≈ L/307.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「清水模板只要表面光滑就好，背楞間距照一般結構模板即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Exposed-concrete forms only need a smooth facing; stud spacing can follow ordinary structural forms." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「模板勁度與拼縫止漏」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Form stiffness and joint sealing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模板勁度、拼縫密封與漏漿痕
knowledge.titleEn: Form stiffness, joint sealing and grout-loss marks
knowledge.text: 清水面要平整、拼縫要乾淨，模板必須夠剛且密封良好。新鮮混凝土的側壓使面板在支撐間撓曲，撓曲量若超過肉眼在斜光下可辨識的程度，牆面就會出現波浪；拼縫若有縫隙，水泥漿在壓力下從縫隙流失，留下砂紋、深色漏漿痕或粗糙的蜂窩帶。
knowledge.textEn: For a flat face and clean joints, forms must be stiff and well sealed. Fresh-concrete pressure bends facings between supports, and if deflection exceeds what the eye detects in raking light the wall shows waves; any gap at a joint lets paste escape under pressure, leaving sand streaks, dark grout-loss lines or rough honeycomb bands.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：清水模板只要表面光滑就好，背楞間距照一般結構模板即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Exposed-concrete forms only need a smooth facing; stud spacing can follow ordinary structural forms. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模板勁度、拼縫密封與漏漿痕」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Form stiffness, joint sealing and grout-loss marks" is correct?
options: 清水模板只要表面光滑就好，背楞間距照一般結構模板即可。
清水混凝土澆得越快越連續，表面就越均勻。
清水面要平整、拼縫要乾淨，模板必須夠剛且密封良好。
optionsEn: Exposed-concrete forms only need a smooth facing; stud spacing can follow ordinary structural forms.
The faster and more continuously exposed concrete is placed, the more uniform the surface.
For a flat face and clean joints, forms must be stiff and well sealed.
quiz.explanation: 清水面要平整、拼縫要乾淨，模板必須夠剛且密封良好。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For a flat face and clean joints, forms must be stiff and well sealed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模板勁度、拼縫密封與漏漿痕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Form stiffness, joint sealing and grout-loss marks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模板勁度與拼縫止漏」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Form stiffness and joint sealing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：21 mm 合板、E = 7,000 MPa，每 mm 寬 I = 21³/12 ≈ 772 mm⁴；側壓 50 kPa（0.05 N/mm²）、背楞間距 300 mm 時 δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 0.98 mm ≈ L/307。若要求 L/400，背楞間距須 ≤ 約 281 mm；取 250 mm 時 δ ≈ 0.47 mm（約 L/531）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For 21 mm plywood with E = 7,000 MPa, I per mm width = 21³/12 ≈ 772 mm⁴; at 50 kPa (0.05 N/mm²) with studs at 300 mm, δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 0.98 mm ≈ L/307. Meeting L/400 needs stud spacing ≤ about 281 mm; at 250 mm δ ≈ 0.47 mm, about L/531. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：模板計算書須列出設計側壓、面板與背楞的撓度限值；組模後以直尺與燈光斜照檢查面板平整，拼縫以塞尺確認間隙並檢查密封材；澆置中派人在模板外側巡視漏漿，發現時立即處理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The formwork calculations must state design pressure and deflection limits for facings and studs; after assembly check flatness with a straightedge and raking light, gauge joint gaps with feelers and inspect seals; during placing have someone patrol the outside of the forms for paste leaks and deal with them at once.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 21 mm 合板、E = 7,000 MPa，每 mm 寬 I = 21³/12 ≈ 772 mm⁴；側壓 50 kPa（0.05 N/mm²）、背楞間距 300 mm 時 δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 0.98 mm ≈ L/307。若要求 L/400，背楞間距須 ≤ 約 281 mm；取 250 mm 時 δ ≈ 0.47 mm（約 L/531）。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For 21 mm plywood with E = 7,000 MPa, I per mm width = 21³/12 ≈ 772 mm⁴; at 50 kPa (0.05 N/mm²) with studs at 300 mm, δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 0.98 mm ≈ L/307. Meeting L/400 needs stud spacing ≤ about 281 mm; at 250 mm δ ≈ 0.47 mm, about L/531. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模板勁度、拼縫密封與漏漿痕」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Form stiffness, joint sealing and grout-loss marks", which statement holds?
options: 21 mm 合板、E = 7,000 MPa，每 mm 寬 I = 21³/12 ≈ 772 mm⁴。
清水混凝土的外觀好壞只能靠主觀感覺判斷，無法量測。
清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。
optionsEn: For 21 mm plywood with E = 7,000 MPa, I per mm width = 21³/12 ≈ 772 mm⁴; at 50 kPa (0.05 N/mm²) with studs at 300 mm, δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 0.98 mm ≈ L/307.
The appearance of exposed concrete can only be judged subjectively and cannot be measured.
Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing.
quiz.explanation: 21 mm 合板、E = 7,000 MPa，每 mm 寬 I = 21³/12 ≈ 772 mm⁴；側壓 50 kPa（0.05 N/mm²）、背楞間距 300 mm 時 δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 0.98 mm ≈ L/307。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For 21 mm plywood with E = 7,000 MPa, I per mm width = 21³/12 ≈ 772 mm⁴; at 50 kPa (0.05 N/mm²) with studs at 300 mm, δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 0.98 mm ≈ L/307. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模板勁度、拼縫密封與漏漿痕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Form stiffness, joint sealing and grout-loss marks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模板勁度與拼縫止漏」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Form stiffness and joint sealing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 模板計算書須列出設計側壓、面板與背楞的撓度限值；組模後以直尺與燈光斜照檢查面板平整，拼縫以塞尺確認間隙並檢查密封材；澆置中派人在模板外側巡視漏漿，發現時立即處理。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The formwork calculations must state design pressure and deflection limits for facings and studs; after assembly check flatness with a straightedge and raking light, gauge joint gaps with feelers and inspect seals; during placing have someone patrol the outside of the forms for paste leaks and deal with them at once. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：清水模板的撓度限值、拼縫密封方式與倒角凹槽詳圖要寫入模板設計規範，並由模板設計者出具計算書；第一次使用的模板系統必須先在樣板牆上驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write deflection limits, joint-sealing methods and chamfer and reveal details for exposed-concrete forms into the formwork specification, with calculations from the formwork designer, and prove any formwork system on the mock-up before first use.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為節省材料放寬背楞間距，拆模後在斜光下牆面出現規則的波浪；拼縫未密封，每一道拼縫兩側都有砂紋與深色漏漿線，牆腳因壓力最大而出現連續蜂窩帶。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Widening stud spacing to save material leaves regular waves visible in raking light after stripping; unsealed joints leave sand streaks and dark leak lines along every joint, and the wall base, where pressure is greatest, shows a continuous honeycomb band. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 模板計算書須列出設計側壓、面板與背楞的撓度限值；組模後以直尺與燈光斜照檢查面板平整，拼縫以塞尺確認間隙並檢查密封材；澆置中派人在模板外側巡視漏漿，發現時立即處理。
knowledge.textEn: The formwork calculations must state design pressure and deflection limits for facings and studs; after assembly check flatness with a straightedge and raking light, gauge joint gaps with feelers and inspect seals; during placing have someone patrol the outside of the forms for paste leaks and deal with them at once.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 清水模板的撓度限值、拼縫密封方式與倒角凹槽詳圖要寫入模板設計規範，並由模板設計者出具計算書；第一次使用的模板系統必須先在樣板牆上驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Write deflection limits, joint-sealing methods and chamfer and reveal details for exposed-concrete forms into the formwork specification, with calculations from the formwork designer, and prove any formwork system on the mock-up before first use.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模板勁度、拼縫密封與漏漿痕」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Form stiffness, joint sealing and grout-loss marks"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。

optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
The formwork calculations must state design pressure and deflection limits for facings and studs.
Form joints and tie holes are just construction marks that the site can arrange as it likes.
