quiz.explanationEn: The formwork calculations must state design pressure and deflection limits for facings and studs; after assembly check flatness with a straightedge and raking light, gauge joint gaps with feelers and inspect seals; during placing have someone patrol the outside of the forms for paste leaks and deal with them at once. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模板勁度、拼縫密封與漏漿痕：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Form stiffness, joint sealing and grout-loss marks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模板勁度與拼縫止漏」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Form stiffness and joint sealing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為節省材料放寬背楞間距，拆模後在斜光下牆面出現規則的波浪；拼縫未密封，每一道拼縫兩側都有砂紋與深色漏漿線，牆腳因壓力最大而出現連續蜂窩帶。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Widening stud spacing to save material leaves regular waves visible in raking light after stripping; unsealed joints leave sand streaks and dark leak lines along every joint, and the wall base, where pressure is greatest, shows a continuous honeycomb band. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此清水模板常比結構模板有更密的背楞、更厚的面板，拼縫以密封條或膠帶處理，牆角與施工縫以倒角或凹槽把無法避免的接縫變成刻意的線條。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Exposed-concrete forms therefore often have closer studs and thicker facings than structural forms, joints sealed with gaskets or tape, and chamfers or reveals at corners and construction joints that turn unavoidable joints into deliberate lines.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「清水模板只要表面光滑就好，背楞間距照一般結構模板即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Exposed-concrete forms only need a smooth facing; stud spacing can follow ordinary structural forms." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為節省材料放寬背楞間距，拆模後在斜光下牆面出現規則的波浪；拼縫未密封，每一道拼縫兩側都有砂紋與深色漏漿線，牆腳因壓力最大而出現連續蜂窩帶。
knowledge.textEn: Widening stud spacing to save material leaves regular waves visible in raking light after stripping; unsealed joints leave sand streaks and dark leak lines along every joint, and the wall base, where pressure is greatest, shows a continuous honeycomb band.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模板勁度、拼縫密封與漏漿痕」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Form stiffness, joint sealing and grout-loss marks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
清水混凝土澆得越快越連續，表面就越均勻。
為節省材料放寬背楞間距，拆模後在斜光下牆面出現規則的波浪；拼縫未密封，每一道拼縫兩側都有砂紋與深色漏漿線，牆腳因壓力最大而出現連續蜂窩帶。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The faster and more continuously exposed concrete is placed, the more uniform the surface.
Widening stud spacing to save material leaves regular waves visible in raking light after stripping.
quiz.explanation: 為節省材料放寬背楞間距，拆模後在斜光下牆面出現規則的波浪；拼縫未密封，每一道拼縫兩側都有砂紋與深色漏漿線，牆腳因壓力最大而出現連續蜂窩帶。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Widening stud spacing to save material leaves regular waves visible in raking light after stripping; unsealed joints leave sand streaks and dark leak lines along every joint, and the wall base, where pressure is greatest, shows a continuous honeycomb band. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 澆置上升速度、分層與振搗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rate of rise, layering and vibration: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「澆置速度與振搗控制」如何影響清水混凝土模板與澆置的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Placing rate and vibration control” governs force, deformation or durability in “Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 清水牆的澆置要控制「上升速度」，也就是單位時間內混凝土在模板中升高的高度；它同時決定模板側壓、分層結合與表面氣泡。上升太快時側壓接近液壓，模板撓曲與漏漿增加，下層混凝土也來不及排出氣泡；太慢則兩層之間可能形成顏色不同的層線。振搗要讓氣泡沿模板面上升排出，但過度振搗會使漿體上浮、骨材下沉，造成上下顏色不同；振動棒碰觸模板面會在表面留下磨痕。ACI 347.3R 把表面孔洞比例作為成形面等級的分類依據之一，振搗正是控制孔洞的關鍵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「澆置速度與振搗控制」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Placing exposed walls means controlling the rate of rise, how fast concrete climbs in the form, which governs form pressure, bonding between layers and surface bubbles. Too fast and pressure approaches hydrostatic, form deflection and leaks increase and lower layers cannot release air; too slow and colour lines may form between layers. Vibration must drive bubbles up and out along the form face, but over-vibration floats paste up and sinks aggregate, giving different colours top and bottom, and a vibrator touching the facing scuffs the surface. ACI 347.3R uses surface void ratio as one of its classification criteria, and vibration is the key to controlling voids. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Placing rate and vibration control” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：牆長 12 m、厚 0.3 m，預拌車以 15 m³/h 供料時上升速度 = 15/(12×0.3) ≈ 4.17 m/h，遠高於模板設計所假設的 1.5 m/h；要維持 1.5 m/h，供料應限制為 1.5×12×0.3 = 5.4 m³/h，5.46 m 高的牆需約 3.6 h 完成。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a wall 12 m long and 0.3 m thick, supplying 15 m³/h gives a rate of rise of 15/(12×0.3) ≈ 4.17 m/h, far above the 1.5 m/h assumed in the formwork design; holding 1.5 m/h limits supply to 1.5×12×0.3 = 5.4 m³/h, and a 5.46 m wall takes about 3.6 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「清水混凝土澆得越快越連續，表面就越均勻。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The faster and more continuously exposed concrete is placed, the more uniform the surface." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「澆置速度與振搗控制」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Placing rate and vibration control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 澆置上升速度、分層與振搗
knowledge.titleEn: Rate of rise, layering and vibration
knowledge.text: 清水牆的澆置要控制「上升速度」，也就是單位時間內混凝土在模板中升高的高度；它同時決定模板側壓、分層結合與表面氣泡。上升太快時側壓接近液壓，模板撓曲與漏漿增加，下層混凝土也來不及排出氣泡；太慢則兩層之間可能形成顏色不同的層線。
knowledge.textEn: Placing exposed walls means controlling the rate of rise, how fast concrete climbs in the form, which governs form pressure, bonding between layers and surface bubbles. Too fast and pressure approaches hydrostatic, form deflection and leaks increase and lower layers cannot release air; too slow and colour lines may form between layers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：清水混凝土澆得越快越連續，表面就越均勻。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The faster and more continuously exposed concrete is placed, the more uniform the surface. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「澆置上升速度、分層與振搗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rate of rise, layering and vibration" is correct?
options: 清水牆的澆置要控制「上升速度」，也就是單位時間內混凝土在模板中升高的高度；它同時決定模板側壓、分層結合與表面氣泡。
清水混凝土澆得越快越連續，表面就越均勻。
樣板牆只是給業主看的展示品，正式施工時不需要再參照。
optionsEn: Placing exposed walls means controlling the rate of rise, how fast concrete climbs in the form, which governs form pressure, bonding between layers and surface bubbles.
The faster and more continuously exposed concrete is placed, the more uniform the surface.
The mock-up is just a showpiece for the owner and need not be referred to during construction.
quiz.explanation: 清水牆的澆置要控制「上升速度」，也就是單位時間內混凝土在模板中升高的高度；它同時決定模板側壓、分層結合與表面氣泡。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Placing exposed walls means controlling the rate of rise, how fast concrete climbs in the form, which governs form pressure, bonding between layers and surface bubbles. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 澆置上升速度、分層與振搗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rate of rise, layering and vibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「澆置速度與振搗控制」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Placing rate and vibration control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：牆長 12 m、厚 0.3 m，預拌車以 15 m³/h 供料時上升速度 = 15/(12×0.3) ≈ 4.17 m/h，遠高於模板設計所假設的 1.5 m/h；要維持 1.5 m/h，供料應限制為 1.5×12×0.3 = 5.4 m³/h，5.46 m 高的牆需約 3.6 h 完成。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a wall 12 m long and 0.3 m thick, supplying 15 m³/h gives a rate of rise of 15/(12×0.3) ≈ 4.17 m/h, far above the 1.5 m/h assumed in the formwork design; holding 1.5 m/h limits supply to 1.5×12×0.3 = 5.4 m³/h, and a 5.46 m wall takes about 3.6 h. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：澆置計畫列出每道牆的上升速度上限、分層厚度、澆置點與振動棒插入間距，現場以時間與液面高度紀錄核對上升速度；樣板牆上試驗振搗時間與插入方式，並以相同人員與設備施作正式牆體。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The placing plan lists maximum rate of rise, layer thickness, pour points and vibrator spacing for each wall, and the site checks rate of rise from time and level records; trial vibration time and technique on the mock-up and use the same crew and equipment for the real walls.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 牆長 12 m、厚 0.3 m，預拌車以 15 m³/h 供料時上升速度 = 15/(12×0.3) ≈ 4.17 m/h，遠高於模板設計所假設的 1.5 m/h；要維持 1.5 m/h，供料應限制為 1.5×12×0.3 = 5.4 m³/h，5.46 m 高的牆需約 3.6 h 完成。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a wall 12 m long and 0.3 m thick, supplying 15 m³/h gives a rate of rise of 15/(12×0.3) ≈ 4.17 m/h, far above the 1.5 m/h assumed in the formwork design; holding 1.5 m/h limits supply to 1.5×12×0.3 = 5.4 m³/h, and a 5.46 m wall takes about 3.6 h. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「澆置上升速度、分層與振搗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rate of rise, layering and vibration", which statement holds?
options: 清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。
牆長 12 m、厚 0.3 m，預拌車以 15 m³/h 供料時上升速度 = 15/(12×0.3) ≈ 4.17 m/h，遠高於模板設計所假設的 1.5 m/h。
清水混凝土就是不粉刷的普通混凝土，不需要特別的規格。
optionsEn: Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan.
For a wall 12 m long and 0.3 m thick, supplying 15 m³/h gives a rate of rise of 15/(12×0.3) ≈ 4.17 m/h, far above the 1.5 m/h assumed in the formwork design.
Exposed concrete is just ordinary concrete left unpainted and needs no special specification.
quiz.explanation: 牆長 12 m、厚 0.3 m，預拌車以 15 m³/h 供料時上升速度 = 15/(12×0.3) ≈ 4.17 m/h，遠高於模板設計所假設的 1.5 m/h；要維持 1.5 m/h，供料應限制為 1.5×12×0.3 = 5.4 m³/h，5.46 m 高的牆需約 3.6 h 完成。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a wall 12 m long and 0.3 m thick, supplying 15 m³/h gives a rate of rise of 15/(12×0.3) ≈ 4.17 m/h, far above the 1.5 m/h assumed in the formwork design; holding 1.5 m/h limits supply to 1.5×12×0.3 = 5.4 m³/h, and a 5.46 m wall takes about 3.6 h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 澆置上升速度、分層與振搗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rate of rise, layering and vibration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「澆置速度與振搗控制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Placing rate and vibration control” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 澆置計畫列出每道牆的上升速度上限、分層厚度、澆置點與振動棒插入間距，現場以時間與液面高度紀錄核對上升速度；樣板牆上試驗振搗時間與插入方式，並以相同人員與設備施作正式牆體。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The placing plan lists maximum rate of rise, layer thickness, pour points and vibrator spacing for each wall, and the site checks rate of rise from time and level records; trial vibration time and technique on the mock-up and use the same crew and equipment for the real walls. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：清水牆澆置由經過樣板訓練的固定班組執行，並安排專人控制供料節奏與記錄上升速度；澆置前在交底會議說明振動棒操作規則（垂直插入、不碰模板、規定停留時間）。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Have exposed walls placed by a fixed crew trained on the mock-up, with a person assigned to pace supply and log the rate of rise; brief the vibrator rules at the pre-pour meeting: insert vertically, never touch the facing, hold for the specified time.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為趕在下班前完成而加快供料，上升速度倍增，模板鼓脹、拼縫漏漿，牆面下半部出現大量氣泡孔；振動棒在模板面附近反覆拖動，表面留下弧形磨痕與砂紋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Speeding up supply to finish before the end of shift doubles the rate of rise, bulging the forms and leaking at joints, and leaves many bugholes on the lower half of the wall; dragging the vibrator back and forth near the facing leaves arc-shaped scuff marks and sand streaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 澆置計畫列出每道牆的上升速度上限、分層厚度、澆置點與振動棒插入間距，現場以時間與液面高度紀錄核對上升速度；樣板牆上試驗振搗時間與插入方式，並以相同人員與設備施作正式牆體。
knowledge.textEn: The placing plan lists maximum rate of rise, layer thickness, pour points and vibrator spacing for each wall, and the site checks rate of rise from time and level records; trial vibration time and technique on the mock-up and use the same crew and equipment for the real walls.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 清水牆澆置由經過樣板訓練的固定班組執行，並安排專人控制供料節奏與記錄上升速度；澆置前在交底會議說明振動棒操作規則（垂直插入、不碰模板、規定停留時間）。
knowledge.textEn: Have exposed walls placed by a fixed crew trained on the mock-up, with a person assigned to pace supply and log the rate of rise; brief the vibrator rules at the pre-pour meeting: insert vertically, never touch the facing, hold for the specified time.

quiz.question: 要驗證「澆置上升速度、分層與振搗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rate of rise, layering and vibration"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
脫模劑塗得越多越好，可以保證拆模後表面光滑。
澆置計畫列出每道牆的上升速度上限、分層厚度、澆置點與振動棒插入間距，現場以時間與液面高度紀錄核對上升速度。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The more release agent the better; it guarantees a smooth surface after stripping.
The placing plan lists maximum rate of rise, layer thickness, pour points and vibrator spacing for each wall, and the site checks rate of rise from time and level records.
quiz.explanation: 澆置計畫列出每道牆的上升速度上限、分層厚度、澆置點與振動棒插入間距，現場以時間與液面高度紀錄核對上升速度；樣板牆上試驗振搗時間與插入方式，並以相同人員與設備施作正式牆體。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The placing plan lists maximum rate of rise, layer thickness, pour points and vibrator spacing for each wall, and the site checks rate of rise from time and level records; trial vibration time and technique on the mock-up and use the same crew and equipment for the real walls. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 澆置上升速度、分層與振搗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rate of rise, layering and vibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「澆置速度與振搗控制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Placing rate and vibration control” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為趕在下班前完成而加快供料，上升速度倍增，模板鼓脹、拼縫漏漿，牆面下半部出現大量氣泡孔；振動棒在模板面附近反覆拖動，表面留下弧形磨痕與砂紋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Speeding up supply to finish before the end of shift doubles the rate of rise, bulging the forms and leaking at joints, and leaves many bugholes on the lower half of the wall; dragging the vibrator back and forth near the facing leaves arc-shaped scuff marks and sand streaks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：ACI 347.3R 把表面孔洞比例作為成形面等級的分類依據之一，振搗正是控制孔洞的關鍵。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: ACI 347.3R uses surface void ratio as one of its classification criteria, and vibration is the key to controlling voids.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「清水混凝土澆得越快越連續，表面就越均勻。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The faster and more continuously exposed concrete is placed, the more uniform the surface." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為趕在下班前完成而加快供料，上升速度倍增，模板鼓脹、拼縫漏漿，牆面下半部出現大量氣泡孔；振動棒在模板面附近反覆拖動，表面留下弧形磨痕與砂紋。
knowledge.textEn: Speeding up supply to finish before the end of shift doubles the rate of rise, bulging the forms and leaking at joints, and leaves many bugholes on the lower half of the wall; dragging the vibrator back and forth near the facing leaves arc-shaped scuff marks and sand streaks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「澆置上升速度、分層與振搗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rate of rise, layering and vibration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 為趕在下班前完成而加快供料，上升速度倍增，模板鼓脹、拼縫漏漿，牆面下半部出現大量氣泡孔；振動棒在模板面附近反覆拖動，表面留下弧形磨痕與砂紋。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
樣板牆只是給業主看的展示品，正式施工時不需要再參照。
optionsEn: Speeding up supply to finish before the end of shift doubles the rate of rise, bulging the forms and leaking at joints, and leaves many bugholes on the lower half of the wall.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The mock-up is just a showpiece for the owner and need not be referred to during construction.
quiz.explanation: 為趕在下班前完成而加快供料，上升速度倍增，模板鼓脹、拼縫漏漿，牆面下半部出現大量氣泡孔；振動棒在模板面附近反覆拖動，表面留下弧形磨痕與砂紋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Speeding up supply to finish before the end of shift doubles the rate of rise, bulging the forms and leaking at joints, and leaves many bugholes on the lower half of the wall; dragging the vibrator back and forth near the facing leaves arc-shaped scuff marks and sand streaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「樣板牆、比對基準與驗收距離」與「色差、平整度與孔洞的量化檢測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mock-up, reference standard and viewing distance" and "Quantifying colour, flatness and voids": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 樣板牆、比對基準與驗收距離：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Mock-up, reference standard and viewing distance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樣板牆與觀看距離」如何影響清水混凝土模板與澆置的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mock-up and viewing distance” governs force, deformation or durability in “Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 清水混凝土的驗收離不開樣板牆。ACI 347.3R 把樣板定義為依契約文件製作的構件樣本，用來建立預期的表面完成度；它同時驗證模板、配比、脫模劑、澆置與振搗的組合，並成為整個工程的比對基準。樣板牆應包含真實的拼縫、繫桿孔、轉角、施工縫與開口邊緣，並在與正式工程相同的季節與條件下製作。驗收時還必須規定觀看距離與光線條件：同一面牆在 1 m 與 10 m 外看，可接受的缺陷完全不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樣板牆與觀看距離」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance of exposed concrete depends on the mock-up. ACI 347.3R defines a mock-up as a sample of a building component made as specified in the contract documents to establish the expected surface finish; it proves the combination of forms, mix, release agent, placing and vibration and becomes the reference for the whole job. A mock-up should include real panel joints, tie holes, a corner, a construction joint and an opening edge, and be cast in the same season and conditions as the work. Acceptance must also state viewing distance and light: the same wall seen from 1 m and from 10 m tolerates entirely different defects. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mock-up and viewing distance” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：人眼解析度約 1 角分，觀看距離 d 時可分辨尺寸 ≈ d·tan(1/60°)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Human visual resolution is about one arc-minute, so the resolvable size at distance d is about d·tan(1/60°).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樣板牆只是給業主看的展示品，正式施工時不需要再參照。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The mock-up is just a showpiece for the owner and need not be referred to during construction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樣板牆與觀看距離」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Mock-up and viewing distance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 樣板牆、比對基準與驗收距離
knowledge.titleEn: Mock-up, reference standard and viewing distance
knowledge.text: 清水混凝土的驗收離不開樣板牆。ACI 347.3R 把樣板定義為依契約文件製作的構件樣本，用來建立預期的表面完成度；它同時驗證模板、配比、脫模劑、澆置與振搗的組合，並成為整個工程的比對基準。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance of exposed concrete depends on the mock-up. ACI 347.3R defines a mock-up as a sample of a building component made as specified in the contract documents to establish the expected surface finish; it proves the combination of forms, mix, release agent, placing and vibration and becomes the reference for the whole job.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：樣板牆只是給業主看的展示品，正式施工時不需要再參照。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The mock-up is just a showpiece for the owner and need not be referred to during construction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「樣板牆、比對基準與驗收距離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mock-up, reference standard and viewing distance" is correct?
options: 樣板牆只是給業主看的展示品，正式施工時不需要再參照。
清水混凝土的驗收離不開樣板牆。
清水混凝土的外觀好壞只能靠主觀感覺判斷，無法量測。
optionsEn: The mock-up is just a showpiece for the owner and need not be referred to during construction.
Acceptance of exposed concrete depends on the mock-up.
The appearance of exposed concrete can only be judged subjectively and cannot be measured.
quiz.explanation: 清水混凝土的驗收離不開樣板牆。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance of exposed concrete depends on the mock-up. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 樣板牆、比對基準與驗收距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mock-up, reference standard and viewing distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樣板牆與觀看距離」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mock-up and viewing distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：人眼解析度約 1 角分，觀看距離 d 時可分辨尺寸 ≈ d·tan(1/60°)。d = 6 m 時約 6,000×0.000291 ≈ 1.75 mm，表示 1 mm 以下的小氣孔在 6 m 外幾乎看不見；若改為 1 m 近看，可分辨約 0.29 mm，驗收結果會完全不同。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Human visual resolution is about one arc-minute, so the resolvable size at distance d is about d·tan(1/60°). At d = 6 m that is about 6,000×0.000291 ≈ 1.75 mm, so bugholes under 1 mm are almost invisible from 6 m; from 1 m about 0.29 mm can be resolved and the acceptance outcome changes completely. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：樣板牆完成後由業主、建築師、結構工程師與承包商在規定距離與自然光下共同檢視並書面核定，拍照存檔；正式工程驗收時在相同距離與光線下與樣板牆並列比較，爭議部分以檢查框量測孔洞比例與色差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Once the mock-up is complete, owner, architect, structural engineer and contractor inspect it together at the specified distance in daylight, approve it in writing and photograph it; at acceptance compare the work side by side with the mock-up at the same distance and light, settling disputes with void-ratio and colour measurements in an inspection frame.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 人眼解析度約 1 角分，觀看距離 d 時可分辨尺寸 ≈ d·tan(1/60°)。d = 6 m 時約 6,000×0.000291 ≈ 1.75 mm，表示 1 mm 以下的小氣孔在 6 m 外幾乎看不見；若改為 1 m 近看，可分辨約 0.29 mm，驗收結果會完全不同。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Human visual resolution is about one arc-minute, so the resolvable size at distance d is about d·tan(1/60°). At d = 6 m that is about 6,000×0.000291 ≈ 1.75 mm, so bugholes under 1 mm are almost invisible from 6 m; from 1 m about 0.29 mm can be resolved and the acceptance outcome changes completely. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「樣板牆、比對基準與驗收距離」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mock-up, reference standard and viewing distance", which statement holds?
options: 清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。
模板拼縫與繫桿孔只是施工痕跡，交給工地自行安排即可。
人眼解析度約 1 角分，觀看距離 d 時可分辨尺寸 ≈ d·tan(1/60°)。
optionsEn: Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing.
Form joints and tie holes are just construction marks that the site can arrange as it likes.
Human visual resolution is about one arc-minute, so the resolvable size at distance d is about d·tan(1/60°).
quiz.explanation: 人眼解析度約 1 角分，觀看距離 d 時可分辨尺寸 ≈ d·tan(1/60°)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Human visual resolution is about one arc-minute, so the resolvable size at distance d is about d·tan(1/60°). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 樣板牆、比對基準與驗收距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mock-up, reference standard and viewing distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樣板牆與觀看距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mock-up and viewing distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 樣板牆完成後由業主、建築師、結構工程師與承包商在規定距離與自然光下共同檢視並書面核定，拍照存檔；正式工程驗收時在相同距離與光線下與樣板牆並列比較，爭議部分以檢查框量測孔洞比例與色差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Once the mock-up is complete, owner, architect, structural engineer and contractor inspect it together at the specified distance in daylight, approve it in writing and photograph it; at acceptance compare the work side by side with the mock-up at the same distance and light, settling disputes with void-ratio and colour measurements in an inspection frame. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：樣板牆要在正式澆置前完成並核定，列為開工停檢點，且在工程期間保留在現場作為比對基準；契約中寫明驗收距離、光線條件、檢查框方法與可接受的修補範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Complete and approve the mock-up before production casting as a hold point, keep it on site throughout the job as the reference, and write viewing distance, lighting, inspection-frame method and acceptable repair scope into the contract.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：樣板牆只做一片光滑小面，沒有拼縫、繫桿孔或施工縫，正式工程出現的問題在樣板上從未被驗證；未約定觀看距離，業主以手電筒貼近檢查每一個小孔，導致無止境的修補要求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A mock-up that is only a small smooth panel without joints, tie holes or construction joints never tests the problems that appear on the real work; with no agreed viewing distance, the owner inspects every pinhole with a torch at close range and repair demands never end. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 樣板牆、比對基準與驗收距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mock-up, reference standard and viewing distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樣板牆與觀看距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mock-up and viewing distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樣板牆只做一片光滑小面，沒有拼縫、繫桿孔或施工縫，正式工程出現的問題在樣板上從未被驗證；未約定觀看距離，業主以手電筒貼近檢查每一個小孔，導致無止境的修補要求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A mock-up that is only a small smooth panel without joints, tie holes or construction joints never tests the problems that appear on the real work; with no agreed viewing distance, the owner inspects every pinhole with a torch at close range and repair demands never end. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收時還必須規定觀看距離與光線條件：同一面牆在 1 m 與 10 m 外看，可接受的缺陷完全不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance must also state viewing distance and light: the same wall seen from 1 m and from 10 m tolerates entirely different defects.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樣板牆只是給業主看的展示品，正式施工時不需要再參照。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The mock-up is just a showpiece for the owner and need not be referred to during construction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「樣板牆、比對基準與驗收距離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mock-up, reference standard and viewing distance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
樣板牆只做一片光滑小面，沒有拼縫、繫桿孔或施工縫，正式工程出現的問題在樣板上從未被驗證；未約定觀看距離，業主以手電筒貼近檢查每一個小孔，導致無止境的修補要求。
清水混凝土的外觀好壞只能靠主觀感覺判斷，無法量測。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A mock-up that is only a small smooth panel without joints, tie holes or construction joints never tests the problems that appear on the real work.
The appearance of exposed concrete can only be judged subjectively and cannot be measured.
quiz.explanation: 樣板牆只做一片光滑小面，沒有拼縫、繫桿孔或施工縫，正式工程出現的問題在樣板上從未被驗證；未約定觀看距離，業主以手電筒貼近檢查每一個小孔，導致無止境的修補要求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A mock-up that is only a small smooth panel without joints, tie holes or construction joints never tests the problems that appear on the real work; with no agreed viewing distance, the owner inspects every pinhole with a torch at close range and repair demands never end. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 色差、平整度與孔洞的量化檢測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Quantifying colour, flatness and voids: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「表面亮度與色差量測」如何影響清水混凝土模板與澆置的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Surface lightness and colour measurement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 清水混凝土的驗收若只靠主觀印象，很容易產生爭議，因此應盡量把外觀指標量化：以色差儀或標準灰卡量測表面明度與色差，以直尺或數位平整度儀量測平整度，以檢查框與影像分析量測孔洞比例。量測要在混凝土乾燥程度相近時進行，因為潮濕表面顏色較深；同一面牆的量測點應涵蓋不同澆置批次與樓層，才能看出系統性的變化。這些數據也能回饋到施工，例如發現下層顏色偏深時檢討振搗與漿體上浮。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「表面亮度與色差量測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance by subjective impression alone invites disputes, so appearance criteria should be quantified where possible: measure surface lightness and colour difference with a colorimeter or standard grey cards, flatness with a straightedge or digital flatness gauge, and void ratio with an inspection frame and image analysis. Measure when the concrete is similarly dry, because damp surfaces look darker, and spread points on each wall across different batches and storeys to reveal systematic changes. The data also feed back into construction; for example, a darker lower zone prompts a review of vibration and paste flotation. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Surface lightness and colour measurement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 L*（明度）比較：樣板牆平均 L* = 65.0，某面牆平均 62.0，ΔL* = 3.0，超過假設容許值 ±2.0，需檢討原因；若同一面牆內最高與最低區塊相差 ΔL* = 1.2，則屬可接受的自然變化。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Compare lightness L*: the mock-up averages L* = 65.0 and a wall averages 62.0, ΔL* = 3.0, beyond an assumed tolerance of ±2.0, so the cause must be investigated; a spread of ΔL* = 1.2 between the lightest and darkest zones within one wall counts as acceptable natural variation.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「清水混凝土的外觀好壞只能靠主觀感覺判斷，無法量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The appearance of exposed concrete can only be judged subjectively and cannot be measured." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「表面亮度與色差量測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Surface lightness and colour measurement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 色差、平整度與孔洞的量化檢測
knowledge.text: 清水混凝土的驗收若只靠主觀印象，很容易產生爭議，因此應盡量把外觀指標量化：以色差儀或標準灰卡量測表面明度與色差，以直尺或數位平整度儀量測平整度，以檢查框與影像分析量測孔洞比例。量測要在混凝土乾燥程度相近時進行，因為潮濕表面顏色較深；同一面牆的量測點應涵蓋不同澆置批次與樓層，才能看出系統性的變化。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance by subjective impression alone invites disputes, so appearance criteria should be quantified where possible: measure surface lightness and colour difference with a colorimeter or standard grey cards, flatness with a straightedge or digital flatness gauge, and void ratio with an inspection frame and image analysis. Measure when the concrete is similarly dry, because damp surfaces look darker, and spread points on each wall across different batches and storeys to reveal systematic changes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：清水混凝土的外觀好壞只能靠主觀感覺判斷，無法量測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The appearance of exposed concrete can only be judged subjectively and cannot be measured. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「色差、平整度與孔洞的量化檢測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Quantifying colour, flatness and voids" is correct?
options: 清水混凝土的外觀好壞只能靠主觀感覺判斷，無法量測。
清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。
清水混凝土的驗收若只靠主觀印象，很容易產生爭議，因此應盡量把外觀指標量化：以色差儀或標準灰卡量測表面明度與色差，以直尺或數位平整度儀量測平整度，以檢查框與影像分析量測孔洞比例。
optionsEn: The appearance of exposed concrete can only be judged subjectively and cannot be measured.
Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan.

Acceptance by subjective impression alone invites disputes, so appearance criteria should be quantified where possible: measure surface lightness and colour difference with a colorimeter or standard grey cards, flatness with a straightedge or digital flatness gauge, and void ratio with an inspection frame and image analysis.
quiz.explanation: 清水混凝土的驗收若只靠主觀印象，很容易產生爭議，因此應盡量把外觀指標量化：以色差儀或標準灰卡量測表面明度與色差，以直尺或數位平整度儀量測平整度，以檢查框與影像分析量測孔洞比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance by subjective impression alone invites disputes, so appearance criteria should be quantified where possible: measure surface lightness and colour difference with a colorimeter or standard grey cards, flatness with a straightedge or digital flatness gauge, and void ratio with an inspection frame and image analysis. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 色差、平整度與孔洞的量化檢測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Quantifying colour, flatness and voids: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「表面亮度與色差量測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Surface lightness and colour measurement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 L*（明度）比較：樣板牆平均 L* = 65.0，某面牆平均 62.0，ΔL* = 3.0，超過假設容許值 ±2.0，需檢討原因；若同一面牆內最高與最低區塊相差 ΔL* = 1.2，則屬可接受的自然變化。平整度：3 m 直尺下最大間隙 3 mm，相當於 1/1,000。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Compare lightness L*: the mock-up averages L* = 65.0 and a wall averages 62.0, ΔL* = 3.0, beyond an assumed tolerance of ±2.0, so the cause must be investigated; a spread of ΔL* = 1.2 between the lightest and darkest zones within one wall counts as acceptable natural variation. Flatness: a maximum gap of 3 mm under a 3 m straightedge is 1/1,000. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測計畫規定儀器、校正方式、量測時機（例如拆模後 28 天、表面乾燥）、點位密度與紀錄格式；同一儀器與操作者量測樣板牆與正式牆體，結果以面板編號與澆置批次整理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The measurement plan specifies instruments, calibration, timing (for example 28 days after stripping with a dry surface), point density and record format; measure mock-up and production walls with the same instrument and operator and organise results by panel number and pour batch.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 L*（明度）比較：樣板牆平均 L* = 65.0，某面牆平均 62.0，ΔL* = 3.0，超過假設容許值 ±2.0，需檢討原因；若同一面牆內最高與最低區塊相差 ΔL* = 1.2，則屬可接受的自然變化。平整度：3 m 直尺下最大間隙 3 mm，相當於 1/1,000。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Compare lightness L*: the mock-up averages L* = 65.0 and a wall averages 62.0, ΔL* = 3.0, beyond an assumed tolerance of ±2.0, so the cause must be investigated; a spread of ΔL* = 1.2 between the lightest and darkest zones within one wall counts as acceptable natural variation. Flatness: a maximum gap of 3 mm under a 3 m straightedge is 1/1,000. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「色差、平整度與孔洞的量化檢測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Quantifying colour, flatness and voids", which statement holds?
options: 以 L*（明度）比較：樣板牆平均 L* = 65.0，某面牆平均 62.0，ΔL* = 3.0，超過假設容許值 ±2.0，需檢討原因。
清水混凝土就是不粉刷的普通混凝土，不需要特別的規格。
脫模劑塗得越多越好，可以保證拆模後表面光滑。
optionsEn: Compare lightness L*: the mock-up averages L* = 65.0 and a wall averages 62.0, ΔL* = 3.0, beyond an assumed tolerance of ±2.0, so the cause must be investigated.
Exposed concrete is just ordinary concrete left unpainted and needs no special specification.
The more release agent the better; it guarantees a smooth surface after stripping.
quiz.explanation: 以 L*（明度）比較：樣板牆平均 L* = 65.0，某面牆平均 62.0，ΔL* = 3.0，超過假設容許值 ±2.0，需檢討原因；若同一面牆內最高與最低區塊相差 ΔL* = 1.2，則屬可接受的自然變化。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare lightness L*: the mock-up averages L* = 65.0 and a wall averages 62.0, ΔL* = 3.0, beyond an assumed tolerance of ±2.0, so the cause must be investigated; a spread of ΔL* = 1.2 between the lightest and darkest zones within one wall counts as acceptable natural variation. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 色差、平整度與孔洞的量化檢測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Quantifying colour, flatness and voids: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「表面亮度與色差量測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Surface lightness and colour measurement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測計畫規定儀器、校正方式、量測時機（例如拆模後 28 天、表面乾燥）、點位密度與紀錄格式；同一儀器與操作者量測樣板牆與正式牆體，結果以面板編號與澆置批次整理。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The measurement plan specifies instruments, calibration, timing (for example 28 days after stripping with a dry surface), point density and record format; measure mock-up and production walls with the same instrument and operator and organise results by panel number and pour batch. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在契約中明訂外觀量測方法、時機與允收值，並約定量測不合格時的處理順序：先比對樣板、再評估是否為可接受的自然變化、最後才決定修補；修補方法本身也要先在樣板牆上試做。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify appearance measurement methods, timing and acceptance values in the contract and agree the sequence for failures: compare with the mock-up, assess whether it is acceptable natural variation, and only then decide on repair, with any repair method trialled first on the mock-up.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：拆模後第二天就在潮濕表面量色差，數據與日後乾燥後完全不同，據此要求的修補反而造成新的色斑；量測點只選在明顯缺陷處，無法代表整面牆，引發不必要的整面處理。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Measuring colour on a damp surface the day after stripping gives data unlike the dry surface later, and repairs ordered on that basis create new blotches; choosing points only at obvious defects does not represent the wall and triggers unnecessary whole-face treatment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測計畫規定儀器、校正方式、量測時機（例如拆模後 28 天、表面乾燥）、點位密度與紀錄格式；同一儀器與操作者量測樣板牆與正式牆體，結果以面板編號與澆置批次整理。
knowledge.textEn: The measurement plan specifies instruments, calibration, timing (for example 28 days after stripping with a dry surface), point density and record format; measure mock-up and production walls with the same instrument and operator and organise results by panel number and pour batch.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在契約中明訂外觀量測方法、時機與允收值，並約定量測不合格時的處理順序：先比對樣板、再評估是否為可接受的自然變化、最後才決定修補；修補方法本身也要先在樣板牆上試做。
knowledge.textEn: Specify appearance measurement methods, timing and acceptance values in the contract and agree the sequence for failures: compare with the mock-up, assess whether it is acceptable natural variation, and only then decide on repair, with any repair method trialled first on the mock-up.

quiz.question: 要驗證「色差、平整度與孔洞的量化檢測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Quantifying colour, flatness and voids"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
量測計畫規定儀器、校正方式、量測時機（例如拆模後 28 天、表面乾燥）、點位密度與紀錄格式；同一儀器與操作者量測樣板牆與正式牆體，結果以面板編號與澆置批次整理。
清水模板只要表面光滑就好，背楞間距照一般結構模板即可。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
The measurement plan specifies instruments, calibration, timing (for example 28 days after stripping with a dry surface), point density and record format.
Exposed-concrete forms only need a smooth facing; stud spacing can follow ordinary structural forms.
quiz.explanation: 量測計畫規定儀器、校正方式、量測時機（例如拆模後 28 天、表面乾燥）、點位密度與紀錄格式；同一儀器與操作者量測樣板牆與正式牆體，結果以面板編號與澆置批次整理。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The measurement plan specifies instruments, calibration, timing (for example 28 days after stripping with a dry surface), point density and record format; measure mock-up and production walls with the same instrument and operator and organise results by panel number and pour batch. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 色差、平整度與孔洞的量化檢測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Quantifying colour, flatness and voids: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「表面亮度與色差量測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Surface lightness and colour measurement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 拆模後第二天就在潮濕表面量色差，數據與日後乾燥後完全不同，據此要求的修補反而造成新的色斑；量測點只選在明顯缺陷處，無法代表整面牆，引發不必要的整面處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring colour on a damp surface the day after stripping gives data unlike the dry surface later, and repairs ordered on that basis create new blotches; choosing points only at obvious defects does not represent the wall and triggers unnecessary whole-face treatment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些數據也能回饋到施工，例如發現下層顏色偏深時檢討振搗與漿體上浮。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The data also feed back into construction; for example, a darker lower zone prompts a review of vibration and paste flotation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「清水混凝土的外觀好壞只能靠主觀感覺判斷，無法量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The appearance of exposed concrete can only be judged subjectively and cannot be measured." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 拆模後第二天就在潮濕表面量色差，數據與日後乾燥後完全不同，據此要求的修補反而造成新的色斑；量測點只選在明顯缺陷處，無法代表整面牆，引發不必要的整面處理。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring colour on a damp surface the day after stripping gives data unlike the dry surface later, and repairs ordered on that basis create new blotches; choosing points only at obvious defects does not represent the wall and triggers unnecessary whole-face treatment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「色差、平整度與孔洞的量化檢測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Quantifying colour, flatness and voids" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。
拆模後第二天就在潮濕表面量色差，數據與日後乾燥後完全不同，據此要求的修補反而造成新的色斑；量測點只選在明顯缺陷處，無法代表整面牆，引發不必要的整面處理。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan.
Measuring colour on a damp surface the day after stripping gives data unlike the dry surface later, and repairs ordered on that basis create new blotches.
quiz.explanation: 拆模後第二天就在潮濕表面量色差，數據與日後乾燥後完全不同，據此要求的修補反而造成新的色斑；量測點只選在明顯缺陷處，無法代表整面牆，引發不必要的整面處理。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring colour on a damp surface the day after stripping gives data unlike the dry surface later, and repairs ordered on that basis create new blotches; choosing points only at obvious defects does not represent the wall and triggers unnecessary whole-face treatment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「表面保護、污染與修補」與「清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Surface protection, soiling and repair" and "Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 表面保護、污染與修補：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Surface protection, soiling and repair: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「撥水保護與修補」如何影響清水混凝土模板與澆置的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water-repellent protection and repair” governs force, deformation or durability in “Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 清水混凝土沒有塗裝保護，表面毛細孔會吸水，雨水帶著灰塵與微生物進入表層，形成流痕與黑斑；吸水也會加速凍融、碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕。常見作法是在完工後施作滲透型撥水劑（如矽烷或矽氧烷），降低表面吸水但不改變外觀與透氣性。修補是清水混凝土最難的工作：修補砂漿必須與周圍顏色、質感一致，而且新舊材料的顏色會隨時間以不同速度變化，所以修補配方要在樣板牆上試驗並放置一段時間觀察。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「撥水保護與修補」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Exposed concrete has no paint, so surface capillaries absorb water and rain carries dust and micro-organisms into the surface layer, forming streaks and dark patches; absorption also accelerates freeze–thaw, carbonation and bar corrosion. A common measure is a penetrating water repellent such as silane or siloxane after completion, reducing absorption without changing appearance or breathability. Repair is the hardest job in exposed concrete: repair mortar must match the surrounding colour and texture, and new and old materials change colour at different rates over time, so repair recipes are trialled on the mock-up and left to weather before use. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Water-repellent protection and repair” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：毛細吸水量 W = w·√t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Capillary uptake W = w·√t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「撥水保護與修補」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Water-repellent protection and repair”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 表面保護、污染與修補
knowledge.text: 清水混凝土沒有塗裝保護，表面毛細孔會吸水，雨水帶著灰塵與微生物進入表層，形成流痕與黑斑；吸水也會加速凍融、碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕。常見作法是在完工後施作滲透型撥水劑（如矽烷或矽氧烷），降低表面吸水但不改變外觀與透氣性。
knowledge.textEn: Exposed concrete has no paint, so surface capillaries absorb water and rain carries dust and micro-organisms into the surface layer, forming streaks and dark patches; absorption also accelerates freeze–thaw, carbonation and bar corrosion. A common measure is a penetrating water repellent such as silane or siloxane after completion, reducing absorption without changing appearance or breathability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「表面保護、污染與修補」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Surface protection, soiling and repair" is correct?
options: 清水混凝土沒有塗裝保護，表面毛細孔會吸水，雨水帶著灰塵與微生物進入表層，形成流痕與黑斑；吸水也會加速凍融、碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕。
清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。
清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。
optionsEn: Exposed concrete has no paint, so surface capillaries absorb water and rain carries dust and micro-organisms into the surface layer, forming streaks and dark patches.
Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan.
Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing.
quiz.explanation: 清水混凝土沒有塗裝保護，表面毛細孔會吸水，雨水帶著灰塵與微生物進入表層，形成流痕與黑斑；吸水也會加速凍融、碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Exposed concrete has no paint, so surface capillaries absorb water and rain carries dust and micro-organisms into the surface layer, forming streaks and dark patches; absorption also accelerates freeze–thaw, carbonation and bar corrosion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 表面保護、污染與修補：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Surface protection, soiling and repair: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「撥水保護與修補」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water-repellent protection and repair” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：毛細吸水量 W = w·√t。未處理表面 w = 1.0 kg/m²·h^0.5，4 h 降雨吸水 W = 1.0×√4 = 2.0 kg/m²；以撥水劑降到 w = 0.1 時 W = 0.2 kg/m²，吸水減少 90%，表面污染與凍融風險隨之降低。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Capillary uptake W = w·√t. For an untreated surface with w = 1.0 kg/m²·h^0.5, four hours of rain absorb W = 1.0×√4 = 2.0 kg/m²; a water repellent that cuts w to 0.1 gives W = 0.2 kg/m², a 90% reduction with correspondingly less soiling and freeze–thaw risk. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：撥水劑施作前在樣板牆上試驗外觀是否改變，施作後以卡斯頓管（Karsten tube）或吸水試驗比較處理前後的吸水量；修補配方在樣板牆上試做並至少觀察數週至數月的顏色變化，再核定使用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before applying a repellent, trial it on the mock-up for any change in appearance, and afterwards compare water uptake before and after with Karsten tubes or absorption tests; trial repair recipes on the mock-up and watch colour change for at least several weeks to months before approval.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 毛細吸水量 W = w·√t。未處理表面 w = 1.0 kg/m²·h^0.5，4 h 降雨吸水 W = 1.0×√4 = 2.0 kg/m²；以撥水劑降到 w = 0.1 時 W = 0.2 kg/m²，吸水減少 90%，表面污染與凍融風險隨之降低。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Capillary uptake W = w·√t. For an untreated surface with w = 1.0 kg/m²·h^0.5, four hours of rain absorb W = 1.0×√4 = 2.0 kg/m²; a water repellent that cuts w to 0.1 gives W = 0.2 kg/m², a 90% reduction with correspondingly less soiling and freeze–thaw risk. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「表面保護、污染與修補」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Surface protection, soiling and repair", which statement holds?
options: 模板拼縫與繫桿孔只是施工痕跡，交給工地自行安排即可。
毛細吸水量 W = w·√t。
只要強度等級相同，不同預拌廠的混凝土在外觀上沒有差別。
optionsEn: Form joints and tie holes are just construction marks that the site can arrange as it likes.
Capillary uptake W = w·√t.
If the strength grade is the same, concrete from different plants looks the same.
quiz.explanation: 毛細吸水量 W = w·√t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Capillary uptake W = w·√t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 表面保護、污染與修補：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surface protection, soiling and repair: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「撥水保護與修補」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water-repellent protection and repair” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 撥水劑施作前在樣板牆上試驗外觀是否改變，施作後以卡斯頓管（Karsten tube）或吸水試驗比較處理前後的吸水量；修補配方在樣板牆上試做並至少觀察數週至數月的顏色變化，再核定使用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before applying a repellent, trial it on the mock-up for any change in appearance, and afterwards compare water uptake before and after with Karsten tubes or absorption tests; trial repair recipes on the mock-up and watch colour change for at least several weeks to months before approval. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：完工前應決定是否施作撥水劑、產品類型與重塗週期，並在樣板牆上核定；修補程序須規定誰可修補、修補範圍上限、配方與試做，並保存修補位置紀錄供日後維護比對。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Decide before completion whether to apply a repellent, which type and how often to recoat, approved on the mock-up; the repair procedure should state who may repair, the maximum repair extent, recipes and trials, and keep a record of repair locations for later maintenance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用成膜型塗料代替滲透型撥水劑，表面變亮且逐年黃化、剝落，清水質感消失；修補砂漿當下顏色相近，一年後明顯偏白或偏深，整面牆布滿補丁。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using a film-forming coating instead of a penetrating repellent makes the surface glossy, yellows and peels over the years and destroys the exposed-concrete texture; repair mortar that matches on the day turns noticeably lighter or darker a year later, leaving the wall covered in patches. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 撥水劑施作前在樣板牆上試驗外觀是否改變，施作後以卡斯頓管（Karsten tube）或吸水試驗比較處理前後的吸水量；修補配方在樣板牆上試做並至少觀察數週至數月的顏色變化，再核定使用。
knowledge.textEn: Before applying a repellent, trial it on the mock-up for any change in appearance, and afterwards compare water uptake before and after with Karsten tubes or absorption tests; trial repair recipes on the mock-up and watch colour change for at least several weeks to months before approval.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 完工前應決定是否施作撥水劑、產品類型與重塗週期，並在樣板牆上核定；修補程序須規定誰可修補、修補範圍上限、配方與試做，並保存修補位置紀錄供日後維護比對。
knowledge.textEn: Decide before completion whether to apply a repellent, which type and how often to recoat, approved on the mock-up; the repair procedure should state who may repair, the maximum repair extent, recipes and trials, and keep a record of repair locations for later maintenance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「表面保護、污染與修補」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Surface protection, soiling and repair"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
清水混凝土澆得越快越連續，表面就越均勻。
撥水劑施作前在樣板牆上試驗外觀是否改變，施作後以卡斯頓管（Karsten tube）或吸水試驗比較處理前後的吸水量。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The faster and more continuously exposed concrete is placed, the more uniform the surface.
Before applying a repellent, trial it on the mock-up for any change in appearance, and afterwards compare water uptake before and after with Karsten tubes or absorption tests.
quiz.explanation: 撥水劑施作前在樣板牆上試驗外觀是否改變，施作後以卡斯頓管（Karsten tube）或吸水試驗比較處理前後的吸水量；修補配方在樣板牆上試做並至少觀察數週至數月的顏色變化，再核定使用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before applying a repellent, trial it on the mock-up for any change in appearance, and afterwards compare water uptake before and after with Karsten tubes or absorption tests; trial repair recipes on the mock-up and watch colour change for at least several weeks to months before approval. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 表面保護、污染與修補：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surface protection, soiling and repair: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「撥水保護與修補」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water-repellent protection and repair” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用成膜型塗料代替滲透型撥水劑，表面變亮且逐年黃化、剝落，清水質感消失；修補砂漿當下顏色相近，一年後明顯偏白或偏深，整面牆布滿補丁。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a film-forming coating instead of a penetrating repellent makes the surface glossy, yellows and peels over the years and destroys the exposed-concrete texture; repair mortar that matches on the day turns noticeably lighter or darker a year later, leaving the wall covered in patches. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：修補是清水混凝土最難的工作：修補砂漿必須與周圍顏色、質感一致，而且新舊材料的顏色會隨時間以不同速度變化，所以修補配方要在樣板牆上試驗並放置一段時間觀察。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Repair is the hardest job in exposed concrete: repair mortar must match the surrounding colour and texture, and new and old materials change colour at different rates over time, so repair recipes are trialled on the mock-up and left to weather before use.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 使用成膜型塗料代替滲透型撥水劑，表面變亮且逐年黃化、剝落，清水質感消失；修補砂漿當下顏色相近，一年後明顯偏白或偏深，整面牆布滿補丁。
knowledge.textEn: Using a film-forming coating instead of a penetrating repellent makes the surface glossy, yellows and peels over the years and destroys the exposed-concrete texture; repair mortar that matches on the day turns noticeably lighter or darker a year later, leaving the wall covered in patches.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「表面保護、污染與修補」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surface protection, soiling and repair" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 使用成膜型塗料代替滲透型撥水劑，表面變亮且逐年黃化、剝落，清水質感消失；修補砂漿當下顏色相近，一年後明顯偏白或偏深，整面牆布滿補丁。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。
optionsEn: Using a film-forming coating instead of a penetrating repellent makes the surface glossy, yellows and peels over the years and destroys the exposed-concrete texture.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing.
quiz.explanation: 使用成膜型塗料代替滲透型撥水劑，表面變亮且逐年黃化、剝落，清水質感消失；修補砂漿當下顏色相近，一年後明顯偏白或偏深，整面牆布滿補丁。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a film-forming coating instead of a penetrating repellent makes the surface glossy, yellows and peels over the years and destroys the exposed-concrete texture; repair mortar that matches on the day turns noticeably lighter or darker a year later, leaving the wall covered in patches. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「維護手冊與修補樣本」如何影響清水混凝土模板與澆置的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Maintenance manual and repair samples” governs force, deformation or durability in “Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 清水混凝土的外觀會隨時間演變：表面碳化使顏色略變，雨水流路形成污痕，綠藻在背陽面生長，繫桿孔塞頭可能鬆脫。沙克研究所於 1991 年被指定為歷史地標，其混凝土與柚木的保存工作顯示，清水建築的維護需要了解原始材料與工法。交接時應移交原配比、面材與脫模劑資料、撥水劑產品與施作紀錄、修補配方與樣本、樣板牆照片與量測基準，並規定可接受的清潔方法；高壓水柱或酸洗會改變表面質感，必須先試驗。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「維護手冊與修補樣本」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Exposed concrete changes with time: surface carbonation shifts colour slightly, rain paths form streaks, algae grow on shaded faces and tie-hole plugs may loosen. The Salk Institute, designated a historic landmark in 1991, shows through its concrete and teak conservation work that maintaining exposed buildings requires knowing the original materials and methods. Handover should deliver the original mix, facing and release-agent data, water-repellent product and application records, repair recipes and samples, mock-up photographs and measurement baselines, and specify acceptable cleaning methods; high-pressure water or acid washing changes surface texture and must be trialled first. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Maintenance manual and repair samples” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：撥水劑用量 0.3 L/m²，清水面 2,400 m² 每次約 2,400×0.3 = 720 L；若每 12 年重塗一次，50 年內約 4 次，共約 2,880 L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 0.3 L/m², 2,400 m² of exposed surface needs about 2,400×0.3 = 720 L per application; recoating every 12 years means about 4 applications and 2,880 L over 50 years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「維護手冊與修補樣本」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Maintenance manual and repair samples”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理
knowledge.titleEn: Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance
knowledge.text: 清水混凝土的外觀會隨時間演變：表面碳化使顏色略變，雨水流路形成污痕，綠藻在背陽面生長，繫桿孔塞頭可能鬆脫。沙克研究所於 1991 年被指定為歷史地標，其混凝土與柚木的保存工作顯示，清水建築的維護需要了解原始材料與工法。
knowledge.textEn: Exposed concrete changes with time: surface carbonation shifts colour slightly, rain paths form streaks, algae grow on shaded faces and tie-hole plugs may loosen. The Salk Institute, designated a historic landmark in 1991, shows through its concrete and teak conservation work that maintaining exposed buildings requires knowing the original materials and methods.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance" is correct?
options: 清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。
清水混凝土的外觀會隨時間演變：表面碳化使顏色略變，雨水流路形成污痕，綠藻在背陽面生長，繫桿孔塞頭可能鬆脫。
清水混凝土就是不粉刷的普通混凝土，不需要特別的規格。
optionsEn: Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing.
Exposed concrete changes with time: surface carbonation shifts colour slightly, rain paths form streaks, algae grow on shaded faces and tie-hole plugs may loosen.
Exposed concrete is just ordinary concrete left unpainted and needs no special specification.
quiz.explanation: 清水混凝土的外觀會隨時間演變：表面碳化使顏色略變，雨水流路形成污痕，綠藻在背陽面生長，繫桿孔塞頭可能鬆脫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Exposed concrete changes with time: surface carbonation shifts colour slightly, rain paths form streaks, algae grow on shaded faces and tie-hole plugs may loosen. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「維護手冊與修補樣本」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Maintenance manual and repair samples” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：撥水劑用量 0.3 L/m²，清水面 2,400 m² 每次約 2,400×0.3 = 720 L；若每 12 年重塗一次，50 年內約 4 次，共約 2,880 L。把用量、施作日期與吸水試驗結果列入維護資料庫，可判斷實際重塗時機是否需要提前。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 0.3 L/m², 2,400 m² of exposed surface needs about 2,400×0.3 = 720 L per application; recoating every 12 years means about 4 applications and 2,880 L over 50 years. Recording quantities, dates and absorption-test results in a maintenance database shows whether recoating should come sooner. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：維護計畫規定定期目視檢查（污痕、藻類、裂縫、塞頭）、吸水試驗與色差量測，並與交接時的基準照片與數據比較；任何清潔或修補在不顯眼位置先試做，經建築師或維護顧問核可後才施作。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The maintenance plan sets periodic visual inspections for streaks, algae, cracks and plugs, absorption tests and colour measurements, compared with handover baseline photographs and data; trial any cleaning or repair in an inconspicuous spot and proceed only with approval from the architect or a conservation adviser.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
