knowledge.text: 撥水劑用量 0.3 L/m²，清水面 2,400 m² 每次約 2,400×0.3 = 720 L；若每 12 年重塗一次，50 年內約 4 次，共約 2,880 L。把用量、施作日期與吸水試驗結果列入維護資料庫，可判斷實際重塗時機是否需要提前。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: At 0.3 L/m², 2,400 m² of exposed surface needs about 2,400×0.3 = 720 L per application; recoating every 12 years means about 4 applications and 2,880 L over 50 years. Recording quantities, dates and absorption-test results in a maintenance database shows whether recoating should come sooner. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance", which statement holds?
options: 脫模劑塗得越多越好，可以保證拆模後表面光滑。
清水模板只要表面光滑就好，背楞間距照一般結構模板即可。
撥水劑用量 0.3 L/m²，清水面 2,400 m² 每次約 2,400×0.3 = 720 L。
optionsEn: The more release agent the better; it guarantees a smooth surface after stripping.
Exposed-concrete forms only need a smooth facing; stud spacing can follow ordinary structural forms.
At 0.3 L/m², 2,400 m² of exposed surface needs about 2,400×0.3 = 720 L per application.
quiz.explanation: 撥水劑用量 0.3 L/m²，清水面 2,400 m² 每次約 2,400×0.3 = 720 L；若每 12 年重塗一次，50 年內約 4 次，共約 2,880 L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At 0.3 L/m², 2,400 m² of exposed surface needs about 2,400×0.3 = 720 L per application; recoating every 12 years means about 4 applications and 2,880 L over 50 years. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「維護手冊與修補樣本」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Maintenance manual and repair samples” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 維護計畫規定定期目視檢查（污痕、藻類、裂縫、塞頭）、吸水試驗與色差量測，並與交接時的基準照片與數據比較；任何清潔或修補在不顯眼位置先試做，經建築師或維護顧問核可後才施作。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The maintenance plan sets periodic visual inspections for streaks, algae, cracks and plugs, absorption tests and colour measurements, compared with handover baseline photographs and data; trial any cleaning or repair in an inconspicuous spot and proceed only with approval from the architect or a conservation adviser. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含清水面位置圖、材料與配比資料、撥水劑與修補紀錄、修補樣本與樣板牆照片、允許與禁止的清潔方法；重大清潔或修補應由熟悉清水混凝土的顧問評估並先試做。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include a map of exposed faces, material and mix data, repellent and repair records, repair samples and mock-up photographs, and permitted and prohibited cleaning methods; major cleaning or repair should be assessed by a consultant experienced in exposed concrete and trialled first.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：管理單位為去除污痕以高壓水柱或強酸清洗，表面漿體被沖蝕，骨材外露，與未清洗區形成永久差異；缺少原始配比與修補樣本，後來的修補只能憑感覺調色，越補越明顯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An owner who removes streaks with high-pressure water or strong acid erodes the surface paste and exposes aggregate, leaving a permanent difference from unwashed areas; without the original mix and repair samples, later repairs are colour-matched by guesswork and become ever more obvious. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 維護計畫規定定期目視檢查（污痕、藻類、裂縫、塞頭）、吸水試驗與色差量測，並與交接時的基準照片與數據比較；任何清潔或修補在不顯眼位置先試做，經建築師或維護顧問核可後才施作。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance plan sets periodic visual inspections for streaks, algae, cracks and plugs, absorption tests and colour measurements, compared with handover baseline photographs and data; trial any cleaning or repair in an inconspicuous spot and proceed only with approval from the architect or a conservation adviser.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含清水面位置圖、材料與配比資料、撥水劑與修補紀錄、修補樣本與樣板牆照片、允許與禁止的清潔方法；重大清潔或修補應由熟悉清水混凝土的顧問評估並先試做。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include a map of exposed faces, material and mix data, repellent and repair records, repair samples and mock-up photographs, and permitted and prohibited cleaning methods; major cleaning or repair should be assessed by a consultant experienced in exposed concrete and trialled first.

quiz.question: 要驗證「清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance"?
options: 維護計畫規定定期目視檢查（污痕、藻類、裂縫、塞頭）、吸水試驗與色差量測，並與交接時的基準照片與數據比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
樣板牆只是給業主看的展示品，正式施工時不需要再參照。
optionsEn: The maintenance plan sets periodic visual inspections for streaks, algae, cracks and plugs, absorption tests and colour measurements, compared with handover baseline photographs and data.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The mock-up is just a showpiece for the owner and need not be referred to during construction.
quiz.explanation: 維護計畫規定定期目視檢查（污痕、藻類、裂縫、塞頭）、吸水試驗與色差量測，並與交接時的基準照片與數據比較；任何清潔或修補在不顯眼位置先試做，經建築師或維護顧問核可後才施作。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The maintenance plan sets periodic visual inspections for streaks, algae, cracks and plugs, absorption tests and colour measurements, compared with handover baseline photographs and data; trial any cleaning or repair in an inconspicuous spot and proceed only with approval from the architect or a conservation adviser. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「維護手冊與修補樣本」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Maintenance manual and repair samples” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 管理單位為去除污痕以高壓水柱或強酸清洗，表面漿體被沖蝕，骨材外露，與未清洗區形成永久差異；缺少原始配比與修補樣本，後來的修補只能憑感覺調色，越補越明顯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An owner who removes streaks with high-pressure water or strong acid erodes the surface paste and exposes aggregate, leaving a permanent difference from unwashed areas; without the original mix and repair samples, later repairs are colour-matched by guesswork and become ever more obvious. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時應移交原配比、面材與脫模劑資料、撥水劑產品與施作紀錄、修補配方與樣本、樣板牆照片與量測基準，並規定可接受的清潔方法；高壓水柱或酸洗會改變表面質感，必須先試驗。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover should deliver the original mix, facing and release-agent data, water-repellent product and application records, repair recipes and samples, mock-up photographs and measurement baselines, and specify acceptable cleaning methods; high-pressure water or acid washing changes surface texture and must be trialled first.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 管理單位為去除污痕以高壓水柱或強酸清洗，表面漿體被沖蝕，骨材外露，與未清洗區形成永久差異；缺少原始配比與修補樣本，後來的修補只能憑感覺調色，越補越明顯。
knowledge.textEn: An owner who removes streaks with high-pressure water or strong acid erodes the surface paste and exposes aggregate, leaving a permanent difference from unwashed areas; without the original mix and repair samples, later repairs are colour-matched by guesswork and become ever more obvious.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
管理單位為去除污痕以高壓水柱或強酸清洗，表面漿體被沖蝕，骨材外露，與未清洗區形成永久差異；缺少原始配比與修補樣本，後來的修補只能憑感覺調色，越補越明顯。
清水混凝土就是不粉刷的普通混凝土，不需要特別的規格。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An owner who removes streaks with high-pressure water or strong acid erodes the surface paste and exposes aggregate, leaving a permanent difference from unwashed areas.
Exposed concrete is just ordinary concrete left unpainted and needs no special specification.
quiz.explanation: 管理單位為去除污痕以高壓水柱或強酸清洗，表面漿體被沖蝕，骨材外露，與未清洗區形成永久差異；缺少原始配比與修補樣本，後來的修補只能憑感覺調色，越補越明顯。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An owner who removes streaks with high-pressure water or strong acid erodes the surface paste and exposes aggregate, leaving a permanent difference from unwashed areas; without the original mix and repair samples, later repairs are colour-matched by guesswork and become ever more obvious. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 大型鋼構防蝕塗裝
titleEn: Protective coating of large steel structures
summary: 從大氣腐蝕環境與 ISO 12944 腐蝕性分級出發，說明鋅底漆、中塗與面漆的防蝕機制、噴砂清潔度與錨紋、露點與施工環境、構件細部與邊緣膜厚、濕膜與乾膜厚度驗收、附著力檢測、劣化分級與維護策略，並以舊金山金門大橋的持續修補、蘇格蘭福斯鐵橋首次全面重塗與艾菲爾鐵塔每約七年一次的重塗為實例。
summaryEn: Starting from atmospheric corrosivity and the ISO 12944 categories, explain how zinc primers, intermediate coats and topcoats protect steel, then cover blast-cleaning grade and surface profile, dew point and site conditions, detailing and edge film build, wet- and dry-film thickness acceptance, adhesion testing, degradation rating and maintenance strategy, using the continuous touch-up of San Francisco's Golden Gate Bridge, the first full repaint of Scotland's Forth Bridge and the roughly seven-yearly repainting of the Eiffel Tower.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
subcategoryTitleEn: Concrete and steel construction technology

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某海邊鋼桁架橋塗裝面積 50,000 m²，評估為 C5 環境（教學假設第一年碳鋼損失 100 μm）。(1) 不塗裝時 25 年每面損失約 100×25^0.523 ≈ 538 μm。(2) 系統：無機鋅底漆 75 μm（固含量 60%）、環氧中塗 150 μm（80%）、聚氨酯面漆 60 μm（65%），總乾膜 285 μm。(3) 理論用量：50,000×75/(0.6×1,000) = 6,250 L、50,000×150/(0.8×1,000) = 9,375 L、50,000×60/(0.65×1,000) ≈ 4,615 L，合計約 20,240 L；損耗取 30%，採購約 20,240/0.7 ≈ 28,900 L，約 0.58 L/m²。(4) 施工時氣溫 20°C、濕度 85%，露點約 17.4°C，鋼面須 ≥ 20.4°C。(5) 驗收：最低個別讀數 0.8×285 = 228 μm。(6) 若改變一個輸入：飛濺區改列 CX 而加一道 150 μm 環氧中塗，該層理論用量再增加 9,375 L（含損耗約 13,400 L），總乾膜 435 μm。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際工程。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a coastal steel truss bridge has 50,000 m² to coat in a C5 environment (teaching assumption: first-year steel loss 100 μm). (1) Uncoated, each face would lose about 100×25^0.523 ≈ 538 μm in 25 years. (2) System: inorganic zinc primer 75 μm (60% volume solids), epoxy intermediate 150 μm (80%) and polyurethane topcoat 60 μm (65%), 285 μm dry in total. (3) Theoretical volumes: 50,000×75/(0.6×1,000) = 6,250 L, 50,000×150/(0.8×1,000) = 9,375 L and 50,000×60/(0.65×1,000) ≈ 4,615 L, about 20,240 L in total; with 30% loss, about 20,240/0.7 ≈ 28,900 L is bought, about 0.58 L/m². (4) At 20°C and 85% humidity the dew point is about 17.4°C, so the steel must be at least 20.4°C. (5) Acceptance: the minimum single reading is 0.8×285 = 228 μm. (6) Changing one input: classifying splash zones as CX and adding a 150 μm epoxy coat there adds 9,375 L theoretical for that coat (about 13,400 L with losses) and raises total dry film to 435 μm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級」與「多層塗裝系統的防蝕機制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories" and "How multi-coat systems protect steel": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別」如何影響大型鋼構防蝕塗裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ISO 12944 corrosivity category” governs force, deformation or durability in “Protective coating of large steel structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼材在大氣中腐蝕需要水膜與氧，速率主要取決於表面潮濕時間、氯鹽沉積與硫化物；海邊的霧與鹽風會讓腐蝕速率比內陸高出數倍。ISO 12944 依碳鋼第一年腐蝕損失把環境分成 C1 至 C5 與 CX 等類別，作為選擇塗裝系統與耐久等級的依據。同一座結構內也有微環境差異：遮蔽的下翼板、積水的接頭與縫隙、浪花飛濺區，往往比外露迎風面腐蝕更快。金門大橋的維護人員就描述他們要對抗風、海氣與霧造成的鋼材腐蝕。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steel corrodes in air when a moisture film and oxygen are present, at a rate governed mainly by time of wetness, chloride deposition and sulfur compounds; coastal fog and salt-laden wind can multiply the rate several times over inland values. ISO 12944 groups environments into categories C1 to C5 and CX by the first-year corrosion loss of carbon steel, the basis for choosing coating systems and durability ranges. A single structure also has microclimates: sheltered bottom flanges, water-trapping joints and crevices, and splash zones often corrode faster than exposed windward faces. Golden Gate Bridge maintenance crews describe battling wind, sea air and fog that corrode the steel. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “ISO 12944 corrosivity category” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：大氣腐蝕長期損失 d(t) = r·t^b。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Long-term atmospheric loss d(t) = r·t^b.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一座橋的所有部位都處在相同的腐蝕環境中。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every part of a bridge sits in the same corrosive environment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “ISO 12944 corrosivity category”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級
knowledge.text: 鋼材在大氣中腐蝕需要水膜與氧，速率主要取決於表面潮濕時間、氯鹽沉積與硫化物；海邊的霧與鹽風會讓腐蝕速率比內陸高出數倍。ISO 12944 依碳鋼第一年腐蝕損失把環境分成 C1 至 C5 與 CX 等類別，作為選擇塗裝系統與耐久等級的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Steel corrodes in air when a moisture film and oxygen are present, at a rate governed mainly by time of wetness, chloride deposition and sulfur compounds; coastal fog and salt-laden wind can multiply the rate several times over inland values. ISO 12944 groups environments into categories C1 to C5 and CX by the first-year corrosion loss of carbon steel, the basis for choosing coating systems and durability ranges.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一座橋的所有部位都處在相同的腐蝕環境中。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every part of a bridge sits in the same corrosive environment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories" is correct?
options: 同一座橋的所有部位都處在相同的腐蝕環境中。
鋼材在大氣中腐蝕需要水膜與氧，速率主要取決於表面潮濕時間、氯鹽沉積與硫化物；海邊的霧與鹽風會讓腐蝕速率比內陸高出數倍。
塗裝主要是為了顏色與外觀，防蝕效果與塗層層次無關。
optionsEn: Every part of a bridge sits in the same corrosive environment.
Steel corrodes in air when a moisture film and oxygen are present, at a rate governed mainly by time of wetness, chloride deposition and sulfur compounds.
Coatings are mainly for colour and looks, and the number of layers does not matter for protection.
quiz.explanation: 鋼材在大氣中腐蝕需要水膜與氧，速率主要取決於表面潮濕時間、氯鹽沉積與硫化物；海邊的霧與鹽風會讓腐蝕速率比內陸高出數倍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Steel corrodes in air when a moisture film and oxygen are present, at a rate governed mainly by time of wetness, chloride deposition and sulfur compounds; coastal fog and salt-laden wind can multiply the rate several times over inland values. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “ISO 12944 corrosivity category” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：大氣腐蝕長期損失 d(t) = r·t^b。取 C4 環境第一年損失 r = 60 μm、碳鋼指數 b = 0.523：25 年 d = 60×25^0.523 ≈ 60×5.38 ≈ 323 μm，每面約 0.32 mm；若誤用線性外推 60×25 = 1,500 μm，會高估約 4.6 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Long-term atmospheric loss d(t) = r·t^b. With a C4 first-year loss r = 60 μm and a carbon-steel exponent b = 0.523, 25 years gives d = 60×25^0.523 ≈ 60×5.38 ≈ 323 μm, about 0.32 mm per face; extrapolating linearly as 60×25 = 1,500 μm would overstate it about 4.6 times. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以現場暴露試片（碳鋼與鋅試片）量測一年腐蝕損失，或依鄰近海岸距離、氯鹽沉積與濕度資料評估腐蝕性類別；同時在結構上標出遮蔽、積水與飛濺等高風險區，分區指定塗裝系統。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure one-year corrosion loss on site with exposed steel and zinc coupons, or assess the corrosivity category from distance to the coast, chloride deposition and humidity data; mark sheltered, water-trapping and splash zones on the structure as high-risk areas and assign coating systems by zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 大氣腐蝕長期損失 d(t) = r·t^b。取 C4 環境第一年損失 r = 60 μm、碳鋼指數 b = 0.523：25 年 d = 60×25^0.523 ≈ 60×5.38 ≈ 323 μm，每面約 0.32 mm；若誤用線性外推 60×25 = 1,500 μm，會高估約 4.6 倍。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Long-term atmospheric loss d(t) = r·t^b. With a C4 first-year loss r = 60 μm and a carbon-steel exponent b = 0.523, 25 years gives d = 60×25^0.523 ≈ 60×5.38 ≈ 323 μm, about 0.32 mm per face; extrapolating linearly as 60×25 = 1,500 μm would overstate it about 4.6 times. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories", which statement holds?
options: 塗裝問題只能靠塗料品質解決，與結構細部無關。
塗膜越厚越好，超過規定厚度只會更耐久。
大氣腐蝕長期損失 d(t) = r·t^b。
optionsEn: Coating problems are solved only by better paint, not by structural detailing.
The thicker the film the better; exceeding the specified thickness only adds durability.
Long-term atmospheric loss d(t) = r·t^b.
quiz.explanation: 大氣腐蝕長期損失 d(t) = r·t^b。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-term atmospheric loss d(t) = r·t^b. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “ISO 12944 corrosivity category” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以現場暴露試片（碳鋼與鋅試片）量測一年腐蝕損失，或依鄰近海岸距離、氯鹽沉積與濕度資料評估腐蝕性類別；同時在結構上標出遮蔽、積水與飛濺等高風險區，分區指定塗裝系統。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure one-year corrosion loss on site with exposed steel and zinc coupons, or assess the corrosivity category from distance to the coast, chloride deposition and humidity data; mark sheltered, water-trapping and splash zones on the structure as high-risk areas and assign coating systems by zone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：塗裝規格書應以腐蝕性分區圖指定每一區的系統、總膜厚與耐久等級，並把高風險區列為加強塗裝（例如加一道中塗或條塗）；分區圖由結構與塗裝工程師共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The coating specification should use a corrosivity zoning drawing to assign system, total film thickness and durability range to each zone, with high-risk zones upgraded, for example by an extra intermediate or stripe coat; structural and coating engineers sign the zoning drawing together.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若整座海邊橋梁以單一較低的腐蝕性類別設計塗裝，迎風外露面表現尚可，但下翼板、支承附近與排水不良的節點在數年內就出現大面積生鏽與層狀剝落，修補需要搭設困難的懸吊架。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing a whole coastal bridge's coating for one lower corrosivity category leaves exposed windward faces fine, but bottom flanges, areas near bearings and poorly drained nodes rust widely and delaminate within a few years, and repair needs difficult suspended access. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以現場暴露試片（碳鋼與鋅試片）量測一年腐蝕損失，或依鄰近海岸距離、氯鹽沉積與濕度資料評估腐蝕性類別；同時在結構上標出遮蔽、積水與飛濺等高風險區，分區指定塗裝系統。
knowledge.textEn: Measure one-year corrosion loss on site with exposed steel and zinc coupons, or assess the corrosivity category from distance to the coast, chloride deposition and humidity data; mark sheltered, water-trapping and splash zones on the structure as high-risk areas and assign coating systems by zone.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 塗裝規格書應以腐蝕性分區圖指定每一區的系統、總膜厚與耐久等級，並把高風險區列為加強塗裝（例如加一道中塗或條塗）；分區圖由結構與塗裝工程師共同簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The coating specification should use a corrosivity zoning drawing to assign system, total film thickness and durability range to each zone, with high-risk zones upgraded, for example by an extra intermediate or stripe coat; structural and coating engineers sign the zoning drawing together.

quiz.question: 要驗證「腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories"?
options: 以現場暴露試片（碳鋼與鋅試片）量測一年腐蝕損失，或依鄰近海岸距離、氯鹽沉積與濕度資料評估腐蝕性類別。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
塗層表面還有顏色，就表示防蝕功能仍然完好。
optionsEn: Measure one-year corrosion loss on site with exposed steel and zinc coupons, or assess the corrosivity category from distance to the coast, chloride deposition and humidity data.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the coating still shows colour, its protection is intact.
quiz.explanation: 以現場暴露試片（碳鋼與鋅試片）量測一年腐蝕損失，或依鄰近海岸距離、氯鹽沉積與濕度資料評估腐蝕性類別；同時在結構上標出遮蔽、積水與飛濺等高風險區，分區指定塗裝系統。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure one-year corrosion loss on site with exposed steel and zinc coupons, or assess the corrosivity category from distance to the coast, chloride deposition and humidity data; mark sheltered, water-trapping and splash zones on the structure as high-risk areas and assign coating systems by zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “ISO 12944 corrosivity category” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若整座海邊橋梁以單一較低的腐蝕性類別設計塗裝，迎風外露面表現尚可，但下翼板、支承附近與排水不良的節點在數年內就出現大面積生鏽與層狀剝落，修補需要搭設困難的懸吊架。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing a whole coastal bridge's coating for one lower corrosivity category leaves exposed windward faces fine, but bottom flanges, areas near bearings and poorly drained nodes rust widely and delaminate within a few years, and repair needs difficult suspended access. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：金門大橋的維護人員就描述他們要對抗風、海氣與霧造成的鋼材腐蝕。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Golden Gate Bridge maintenance crews describe battling wind, sea air and fog that corrode the steel.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一座橋的所有部位都處在相同的腐蝕環境中。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every part of a bridge sits in the same corrosive environment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若整座海邊橋梁以單一較低的腐蝕性類別設計塗裝，迎風外露面表現尚可，但下翼板、支承附近與排水不良的節點在數年內就出現大面積生鏽與層狀剝落，修補需要搭設困難的懸吊架。
knowledge.textEn: Designing a whole coastal bridge's coating for one lower corrosivity category leaves exposed windward faces fine, but bottom flanges, areas near bearings and poorly drained nodes rust widely and delaminate within a few years, and repair needs difficult suspended access.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若整座海邊橋梁以單一較低的腐蝕性類別設計塗裝，迎風外露面表現尚可，但下翼板、支承附近與排水不良的節點在數年內就出現大面積生鏽與層狀剝落，修補需要搭設困難的懸吊架。

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 多層塗裝系統的防蝕機制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: How multi-coat systems protect steel: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋅底漆、中塗與面漆」如何影響大型鋼構防蝕塗裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Zinc primer, intermediate and topcoat” governs force, deformation or durability in “Protective coating of large steel structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大型鋼構常用三層系統：富鋅底漆以鋅粉的犧牲陽極作用保護鋼材，即使塗膜有小傷口，鋅也會先腐蝕；中塗（常為環氧）提供膜厚與阻隔，延長水氣與離子滲透到鋼面的路徑；面漆（聚氨酯、壓克力等）抵抗紫外線並保持顏色。金門大橋在移除原有含鉛塗料後改用無機鋅矽酸鹽底漆加面漆；艾菲爾鐵塔每次重塗也採防鏽底漆、防鏽加強層與面漆三層；福斯鐵橋首次全面重塗則使用源自北海石油工業的三層系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋅底漆、中塗與面漆」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large steel structures commonly use a three-coat system: a zinc-rich primer protects steel sacrificially, with zinc corroding first even at small breaks in the film; an intermediate coat, often epoxy, adds thickness and barrier, lengthening the path for moisture and ions to reach the steel; and a topcoat such as polyurethane or acrylic resists ultraviolet light and holds colour. After removing its original lead-based paint, the Golden Gate Bridge moved to an inorganic zinc silicate primer with a topcoat; each Eiffel Tower campaign applies an anti-rust primer, an anti-rust reinforcement coat and a finish coat; and the Forth Bridge's first full repaint used a three-coat system derived from the North Sea oil industry. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Zinc primer, intermediate and topcoat” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：理論塗佈率 = 固含量體積比×1,000/乾膜厚（m²/L）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Theoretical spreading rate = volume solids×1,000/dry film thickness (m²/L).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塗裝主要是為了顏色與外觀，防蝕效果與塗層層次無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Coatings are mainly for colour and looks, and the number of layers does not matter for protection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋅底漆、中塗與面漆」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 多層塗裝系統的防蝕機制
knowledge.text: 大型鋼構常用三層系統：富鋅底漆以鋅粉的犧牲陽極作用保護鋼材，即使塗膜有小傷口，鋅也會先腐蝕；中塗（常為環氧）提供膜厚與阻隔，延長水氣與離子滲透到鋼面的路徑；面漆（聚氨酯、壓克力等）抵抗紫外線並保持顏色。金門大橋在移除原有含鉛塗料後改用無機鋅矽酸鹽底漆加面漆；艾菲爾鐵塔每次重塗也採防鏽底漆、防鏽加強層與面漆三層；福斯鐵橋首次全面重塗則使用源自北海石油工業的三層系統。
knowledge.textEn: Large steel structures commonly use a three-coat system: a zinc-rich primer protects steel sacrificially, with zinc corroding first even at small breaks in the film; an intermediate coat, often epoxy, adds thickness and barrier, lengthening the path for moisture and ions to reach the steel; and a topcoat such as polyurethane or acrylic resists ultraviolet light and holds colour. After removing its original lead-based paint, the Golden Gate Bridge moved to an inorganic zinc silicate primer with a topcoat; each Eiffel Tower campaign applies an anti-rust primer, an anti-rust reinforcement coat and a finish coat; and the Forth Bridge's first full repaint used a three-coat system derived from the North Sea oil industry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：塗裝主要是為了顏色與外觀，防蝕效果與塗層層次無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Coatings are mainly for colour and looks, and the number of layers does not matter for protection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: Coatings are mainly for colour and looks, and the number of layers does not matter for protection.
If the surface looks like bright white metal, it is ready to coat.
Large steel structures commonly use a three-coat system: a zinc-rich primer protects steel sacrificially, with zinc corroding first even at small breaks in the film.
quiz.explanation: 大型鋼構常用三層系統：富鋅底漆以鋅粉的犧牲陽極作用保護鋼材，即使塗膜有小傷口，鋅也會先腐蝕；中塗（常為環氧）提供膜厚與阻隔，延長水氣與離子滲透到鋼面的路徑；面漆（聚氨酯、壓克力等）抵抗紫外線並保持顏色。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Large steel structures commonly use a three-coat system: a zinc-rich primer protects steel sacrificially, with zinc corroding first even at small breaks in the film; an intermediate coat, often epoxy, adds thickness and barrier, lengthening the path for moisture and ions to reach the steel; and a topcoat such as polyurethane or acrylic resists ultraviolet light and holds colour. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多層塗裝系統的防蝕機制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: How multi-coat systems protect steel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋅底漆、中塗與面漆」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Zinc primer, intermediate and topcoat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：理論塗佈率 = 固含量體積比×1,000/乾膜厚（m²/L）。中塗固含量 80%、乾膜 150 μm：0.8×1,000/150 ≈ 5.33 m²/L，對應濕膜 150/0.8 = 187.5 μm；桁架構件噴塗損耗取 40%，實際約 5.33×0.6 ≈ 3.2 m²/L。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Theoretical spreading rate = volume solids×1,000/dry film thickness (m²/L). An intermediate coat with 80% volume solids at 150 μm dry gives 0.8×1,000/150 ≈ 5.33 m²/L, requiring a wet film of 150/0.8 = 187.5 μm; with 40% spray loss on lattice members, the practical rate is about 5.33×0.6 ≈ 3.2 m²/L. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對每一層產品的技術資料（固含量、建議膜厚、覆塗間隔、相容性）與規格書系統是否一致，並要求同一供應商提供整套系統的相容性證明；系統若需達到高耐久等級，應有實驗室加速試驗或實績證明。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check each product's data sheet (volume solids, recommended thickness, recoat window, compatibility) against the specified system and require the supplier to certify compatibility of the whole system; where a high durability range is claimed, require laboratory accelerated test results or a service record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 理論塗佈率 = 固含量體積比×1,000/乾膜厚（m²/L）。中塗固含量 80%、乾膜 150 μm：0.8×1,000/150 ≈ 5.33 m²/L，對應濕膜 150/0.8 = 187.5 μm；桁架構件噴塗損耗取 40%，實際約 5.33×0.6 ≈ 3.2 m²/L。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Theoretical spreading rate = volume solids×1,000/dry film thickness (m²/L). An intermediate coat with 80% volume solids at 150 μm dry gives 0.8×1,000/150 ≈ 5.33 m²/L, requiring a wet film of 150/0.8 = 187.5 μm; with 40% spray loss on lattice members, the practical rate is about 5.33×0.6 ≈ 3.2 m²/L. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「多層塗裝系統的防蝕機制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "How multi-coat systems protect steel", which statement holds?
options: 理論塗佈率 = 固含量體積比×1,000/乾膜厚（m²/L）。
只要天氣晴朗，任何時間都可以進行下一層塗裝。
只要膜厚量測合格，就可以確認塗裝品質良好。
optionsEn: Theoretical spreading rate = volume solids×1,000/dry film thickness (m²/L).
In fine weather, the next coat can be applied at any time.
If film thickness passes, coating quality is confirmed.
quiz.explanation: 理論塗佈率 = 固含量體積比×1,000/乾膜厚（m²/L）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Theoretical spreading rate = volume solids×1,000/dry film thickness (m²/L). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 多層塗裝系統的防蝕機制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: How multi-coat systems protect steel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋅底漆、中塗與面漆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Zinc primer, intermediate and topcoat” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對每一層產品的技術資料（固含量、建議膜厚、覆塗間隔、相容性）與規格書系統是否一致，並要求同一供應商提供整套系統的相容性證明；系統若需達到高耐久等級，應有實驗室加速試驗或實績證明。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check each product's data sheet (volume solids, recommended thickness, recoat window, compatibility) against the specified system and require the supplier to certify compatibility of the whole system; where a high durability range is claimed, require laboratory accelerated test results or a service record. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：塗裝系統應以整套方式指定與採購，不允許承包商任意混用不同廠牌的單一層；任何替代產品都須提出相容性與性能證明，並經業主的塗裝顧問核准後才可使用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify and procure the coating as a complete system and do not let contractors mix single coats from different makers; any substitute product needs evidence of compatibility and performance and approval by the owner's coating consultant before use.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在富鋅底漆上直接塗上不相容的面漆，或把無機鋅矽酸鹽塗得過厚而產生龜裂，整個系統會從底漆層剝離；更換面漆品牌卻沒有確認相容性，也可能造成層間附著不良與起泡。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying an incompatible topcoat directly over zinc-rich primer, or building inorganic zinc silicate too thick so it mud-cracks, lets the whole system delaminate at the primer; switching topcoat brands without checking compatibility can also cause poor intercoat adhesion and blistering. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對每一層產品的技術資料（固含量、建議膜厚、覆塗間隔、相容性）與規格書系統是否一致，並要求同一供應商提供整套系統的相容性證明；系統若需達到高耐久等級，應有實驗室加速試驗或實績證明。
knowledge.textEn: Check each product's data sheet (volume solids, recommended thickness, recoat window, compatibility) against the specified system and require the supplier to certify compatibility of the whole system; where a high durability range is claimed, require laboratory accelerated test results or a service record.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 塗裝系統應以整套方式指定與採購，不允許承包商任意混用不同廠牌的單一層；任何替代產品都須提出相容性與性能證明，並經業主的塗裝顧問核准後才可使用。
knowledge.textEn: Specify and procure the coating as a complete system and do not let contractors mix single coats from different makers; any substitute product needs evidence of compatibility and performance and approval by the owner's coating consultant before use.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多層塗裝系統的防蝕機制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "How multi-coat systems protect steel"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對每一層產品的技術資料（固含量、建議膜厚、覆塗間隔、相容性）與規格書系統是否一致，並要求同一供應商提供整套系統的相容性證明。
大型鋼橋必須定期從一端塗到另一端，永不停止。

Check each product's data sheet (volume solids, recommended thickness, recoat window, compatibility) against the specified system and require the supplier to certify compatibility of the whole system.
A large steel bridge must be painted continuously from one end to the other, forever.

quiz.explanationEn: Check each product's data sheet (volume solids, recommended thickness, recoat window, compatibility) against the specified system and require the supplier to certify compatibility of the whole system; where a high durability range is claimed, require laboratory accelerated test results or a service record. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 多層塗裝系統的防蝕機制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: How multi-coat systems protect steel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋅底漆、中塗與面漆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Zinc primer, intermediate and topcoat” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在富鋅底漆上直接塗上不相容的面漆，或把無機鋅矽酸鹽塗得過厚而產生龜裂，整個系統會從底漆層剝離；更換面漆品牌卻沒有確認相容性，也可能造成層間附著不良與起泡。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying an incompatible topcoat directly over zinc-rich primer, or building inorganic zinc silicate too thick so it mud-cracks, lets the whole system delaminate at the primer; switching topcoat brands without checking compatibility can also cause poor intercoat adhesion and blistering. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：金門大橋在移除原有含鉛塗料後改用無機鋅矽酸鹽底漆加面漆；艾菲爾鐵塔每次重塗也採防鏽底漆、防鏽加強層與面漆三層；福斯鐵橋首次全面重塗則使用源自北海石油工業的三層系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: After removing its original lead-based paint, the Golden Gate Bridge moved to an inorganic zinc silicate primer with a topcoat; each Eiffel Tower campaign applies an anti-rust primer, an anti-rust reinforcement coat and a finish coat; and the Forth Bridge's first full repaint used a three-coat system derived from the North Sea oil industry.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塗裝主要是為了顏色與外觀，防蝕效果與塗層層次無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Coatings are mainly for colour and looks, and the number of layers does not matter for protection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若在富鋅底漆上直接塗上不相容的面漆，或把無機鋅矽酸鹽塗得過厚而產生龜裂，整個系統會從底漆層剝離；更換面漆品牌卻沒有確認相容性，也可能造成層間附著不良與起泡。
knowledge.textEn: Applying an incompatible topcoat directly over zinc-rich primer, or building inorganic zinc silicate too thick so it mud-cracks, lets the whole system delaminate at the primer; switching topcoat brands without checking compatibility can also cause poor intercoat adhesion and blistering.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多層塗裝系統的防蝕機制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "How multi-coat systems protect steel" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要表面看起來是亮白的金屬，就可以直接塗裝。
若在富鋅底漆上直接塗上不相容的面漆，或把無機鋅矽酸鹽塗得過厚而產生龜裂，整個系統會從底漆層剝離；更換面漆品牌卻沒有確認相容性，也可能造成層間附著不良與起泡。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
If the surface looks like bright white metal, it is ready to coat.
Applying an incompatible topcoat directly over zinc-rich primer, or building inorganic zinc silicate too thick so it mud-cracks, lets the whole system delaminate at the primer.

quiz.explanationEn: Applying an incompatible topcoat directly over zinc-rich primer, or building inorganic zinc silicate too thick so it mud-cracks, lets the whole system delaminate at the primer; switching topcoat brands without checking compatibility can also cause poor intercoat adhesion and blistering. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「表面處理、清潔度與露點」與「構件細部與可塗裝性」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Surface preparation, cleanliness and dew point" and "Detailing for coatability": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 表面處理、清潔度與露點：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Surface preparation, cleanliness and dew point: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「Sa 2½ 噴砂與錨紋」如何影響大型鋼構防蝕塗裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sa 2½ blast and anchor profile” governs force, deformation or durability in “Protective coating of large steel structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 塗裝壽命很大部分在塗第一層之前就已決定：噴砂必須除去軋鋼皮、鏽與舊塗層，達到 ISO 8501-1 規定的清潔等級（例如 Sa 2½），並形成適當深度的錨紋讓底漆咬合；表面殘留的可溶性鹽類會在塗膜下吸水起泡，因此海邊結構還要檢測氯鹽。施工時鋼面溫度必須高於露點至少 3°C，否則表面凝結的薄水膜會使新噴砂面立即返鏽，並降低附著力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「Sa 2½ 噴砂與錨紋」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Much of a coating's life is settled before the first coat: blasting must remove mill scale, rust and old coatings to the cleanliness grade of ISO 8501-1, for example Sa 2½, and create an anchor profile deep enough for the primer to key into; soluble salts left on the surface draw water under the film and cause blisters, so coastal structures are also tested for chloride. During work the steel temperature must be at least 3°C above the dew point, or a thin condensed film will flash-rust freshly blasted steel and reduce adhesion. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sa 2½ blast and anchor profile” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Magnus dew point: γ = ln(RH) + 17.62T/(243.12 + T) and T_d = 243.12γ/(17.62 − γ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要表面看起來是亮白的金屬，就可以直接塗裝。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the surface looks like bright white metal, it is ready to coat." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「Sa 2½ 噴砂與錨紋」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sa 2½ blast and anchor profile”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Surface preparation, cleanliness and dew point
knowledge.text: 塗裝壽命很大部分在塗第一層之前就已決定：噴砂必須除去軋鋼皮、鏽與舊塗層，達到 ISO 8501-1 規定的清潔等級（例如 Sa 2½），並形成適當深度的錨紋讓底漆咬合；表面殘留的可溶性鹽類會在塗膜下吸水起泡，因此海邊結構還要檢測氯鹽。施工時鋼面溫度必須高於露點至少 3°C，否則表面凝結的薄水膜會使新噴砂面立即返鏽，並降低附著力。

During work the steel temperature must be at least 3°C above the dew point, or a thin condensed film will flash-rust freshly blasted steel and reduce adhesion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要表面看起來是亮白的金屬，就可以直接塗裝。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the surface looks like bright white metal, it is ready to coat. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「表面處理、清潔度與露點」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Surface preparation, cleanliness and dew point" is correct?
options: 塗裝壽命很大部分在塗第一層之前就已決定：噴砂必須除去軋鋼皮、鏽與舊塗層，達到 ISO 8501-1 規定的清潔等級（例如 Sa 2½），並形成適當深度的錨紋讓底漆咬合。
只要表面看起來是亮白的金屬，就可以直接塗裝。
塗裝問題只能靠塗料品質解決，與結構細部無關。
optionsEn: Much of a coating's life is settled before the first coat: blasting must remove mill scale, rust and old coatings to the cleanliness grade of ISO 8501-1, for example Sa 2½, and create an anchor profile deep enough for the primer to key into.
If the surface looks like bright white metal, it is ready to coat.
Coating problems are solved only by better paint, not by structural detailing.
quiz.explanation: 塗裝壽命很大部分在塗第一層之前就已決定：噴砂必須除去軋鋼皮、鏽與舊塗層，達到 ISO 8501-1 規定的清潔等級（例如 Sa 2½），並形成適當深度的錨紋讓底漆咬合；表面殘留的可溶性鹽類會在塗膜下吸水起泡，因此海邊結構還要檢測氯鹽。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Much of a coating's life is settled before the first coat: blasting must remove mill scale, rust and old coatings to the cleanliness grade of ISO 8501-1, for example Sa 2½, and create an anchor profile deep enough for the primer to key into; soluble salts left on the surface draw water under the film and cause blisters, so coastal structures are also tested for chloride. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 表面處理、清潔度與露點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Surface preparation, cleanliness and dew point: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Sa 2½ 噴砂與錨紋」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sa 2½ blast and anchor profile” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Magnus 露點：γ = ln(RH) + 17.62T/(243.12 + T)，T_d = 243.12γ/(17.62 − γ)。氣溫 20°C、相對濕度 85%：γ = ln0.85 + 17.62×20/263.12 ≈ −0.163 + 1.339 = 1.177，T_d ≈ 243.12×1.177/16.443 ≈ 17.4°C；鋼面須 ≥ 20.4°C，若量到 19°C 就不得施工。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Magnus dew point: γ = ln(RH) + 17.62T/(243.12 + T) and T_d = 243.12γ/(17.62 − γ). At 20°C air and 85% relative humidity, γ = ln0.85 + 17.62×20/263.12 ≈ −0.163 + 1.339 = 1.177, so T_d ≈ 243.12×1.177/16.443 ≈ 17.4°C; the steel must be at least 20.4°C, so a reading of 19°C means no coating. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：噴砂後以 ISO 8501-1 標準照片比對清潔度、以複製膠帶或比對規量測錨紋深度、以膠帶測試灰塵量，並以表面鹽分檢測確認氯鹽低於規格值；每次塗裝前與施工中定時記錄氣溫、濕度、鋼面溫度與露點，不合格時停止施工。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After blasting, compare cleanliness with ISO 8501-1 reference photographs, measure profile with replica tape or a comparator, check dust by tape test and confirm chloride below the specified limit by surface salt testing; before and during each coat, log air temperature, humidity, steel temperature and dew point at set intervals, stopping work when out of limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Magnus dew point: γ = ln(RH) + 17.62T/(243.12 + T) and T_d = 243.12γ/(17.62 − γ). At 20°C air and 85% relative humidity, γ = ln0.85 + 17.62×20/263.12 ≈ −0.163 + 1.339 = 1.177, so T_d ≈ 243.12×1.177/16.443 ≈ 17.4°C; the steel must be at least 20.4°C, so a reading of 19°C means no coating. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「表面處理、清潔度與露點」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Surface preparation, cleanliness and dew point", which statement holds?
options: 塗膜越厚越好，超過規定厚度只會更耐久。
塗層表面還有顏色，就表示防蝕功能仍然完好。
optionsEn: The thicker the film the better; exceeding the specified thickness only adds durability.
Magnus dew point: γ = ln(RH) + 17.62T/(243.12 + T) and T_d = 243.12γ/(17.62 − γ).
If the coating still shows colour, its protection is intact.
quiz.explanation: Magnus 露點：γ = ln(RH) + 17.62T/(243.12 + T)，T_d = 243.12γ/(17.62 − γ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Magnus dew point: γ = ln(RH) + 17.62T/(243.12 + T) and T_d = 243.12γ/(17.62 − γ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 表面處理、清潔度與露點：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surface preparation, cleanliness and dew point: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「Sa 2½ 噴砂與錨紋」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sa 2½ blast and anchor profile” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 噴砂後以 ISO 8501-1 標準照片比對清潔度、以複製膠帶或比對規量測錨紋深度、以膠帶測試灰塵量，並以表面鹽分檢測確認氯鹽低於規格值；每次塗裝前與施工中定時記錄氣溫、濕度、鋼面溫度與露點，不合格時停止施工。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After blasting, compare cleanliness with ISO 8501-1 reference photographs, measure profile with replica tape or a comparator, check dust by tape test and confirm chloride below the specified limit by surface salt testing; before and during each coat, log air temperature, humidity, steel temperature and dew point at set intervals, stopping work when out of limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把表面處理完成後的檢查列為塗底漆前的停留點，由檢驗員簽認清潔度、錨紋、鹽分與環境紀錄；噴砂面須在規定時間內塗上底漆，超過時間或出現返鏽就必須重新處理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make post-preparation inspection a hold point before priming, with the inspector signing for cleanliness, profile, salts and environmental records; blasted steel must be primed within the specified time, and any surface that exceeds it or flash-rusts must be re-prepared.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：清晨在接近露點的鋼面上噴砂並立刻塗底漆，看似完成，數月後塗膜下出現點狀返鏽與起泡；海邊結構若只看清潔度照片而不測鹽分，殘留氯鹽會讓新塗膜在一兩年內大面積起泡。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Blasting and priming early in the morning on steel near the dew point looks finished, but spot rust and blisters appear under the film within months; on coastal structures, judging only by cleanliness photographs without salt testing lets residual chloride blister large areas of new coating within a year or two. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 噴砂後以 ISO 8501-1 標準照片比對清潔度、以複製膠帶或比對規量測錨紋深度、以膠帶測試灰塵量，並以表面鹽分檢測確認氯鹽低於規格值；每次塗裝前與施工中定時記錄氣溫、濕度、鋼面溫度與露點，不合格時停止施工。
knowledge.textEn: After blasting, compare cleanliness with ISO 8501-1 reference photographs, measure profile with replica tape or a comparator, check dust by tape test and confirm chloride below the specified limit by surface salt testing; before and during each coat, log air temperature, humidity, steel temperature and dew point at set intervals, stopping work when out of limits.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把表面處理完成後的檢查列為塗底漆前的停留點，由檢驗員簽認清潔度、錨紋、鹽分與環境紀錄；噴砂面須在規定時間內塗上底漆，超過時間或出現返鏽就必須重新處理。
knowledge.textEn: Make post-preparation inspection a hold point before priming, with the inspector signing for cleanliness, profile, salts and environmental records; blasted steel must be primed within the specified time, and any surface that exceeds it or flash-rusts must be re-prepared.

quiz.question: 要驗證「表面處理、清潔度與露點」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Surface preparation, cleanliness and dew point"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
塗裝完成後，只要保存顏色編號就足以進行日後維護。
噴砂後以 ISO 8501-1 標準照片比對清潔度、以複製膠帶或比對規量測錨紋深度、以膠帶測試灰塵量，並以表面鹽分檢測確認氯鹽低於規格值。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
After coating, keeping the colour code is enough for future maintenance.

After blasting, compare cleanliness with ISO 8501-1 reference photographs, measure profile with replica tape or a comparator, check dust by tape test and confirm chloride below the specified limit by surface salt testing.
quiz.explanation: 噴砂後以 ISO 8501-1 標準照片比對清潔度、以複製膠帶或比對規量測錨紋深度、以膠帶測試灰塵量，並以表面鹽分檢測確認氯鹽低於規格值；每次塗裝前與施工中定時記錄氣溫、濕度、鋼面溫度與露點，不合格時停止施工。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After blasting, compare cleanliness with ISO 8501-1 reference photographs, measure profile with replica tape or a comparator, check dust by tape test and confirm chloride below the specified limit by surface salt testing; before and during each coat, log air temperature, humidity, steel temperature and dew point at set intervals, stopping work when out of limits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 表面處理、清潔度與露點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surface preparation, cleanliness and dew point: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Sa 2½ 噴砂與錨紋」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sa 2½ blast and anchor profile” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 清晨在接近露點的鋼面上噴砂並立刻塗底漆，看似完成，數月後塗膜下出現點狀返鏽與起泡；海邊結構若只看清潔度照片而不測鹽分，殘留氯鹽會讓新塗膜在一兩年內大面積起泡。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blasting and priming early in the morning on steel near the dew point looks finished, but spot rust and blisters appear under the film within months; on coastal structures, judging only by cleanliness photographs without salt testing lets residual chloride blister large areas of new coating within a year or two. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工時鋼面溫度必須高於露點至少 3°C，否則表面凝結的薄水膜會使新噴砂面立即返鏽，並降低附著力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During work the steel temperature must be at least 3°C above the dew point, or a thin condensed film will flash-rust freshly blasted steel and reduce adhesion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要表面看起來是亮白的金屬，就可以直接塗裝。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the surface looks like bright white metal, it is ready to coat." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 清晨在接近露點的鋼面上噴砂並立刻塗底漆，看似完成，數月後塗膜下出現點狀返鏽與起泡；海邊結構若只看清潔度照片而不測鹽分，殘留氯鹽會讓新塗膜在一兩年內大面積起泡。
knowledge.textEn: Blasting and priming early in the morning on steel near the dew point looks finished, but spot rust and blisters appear under the film within months; on coastal structures, judging only by cleanliness photographs without salt testing lets residual chloride blister large areas of new coating within a year or two.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「表面處理、清潔度與露點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surface preparation, cleanliness and dew point" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 清晨在接近露點的鋼面上噴砂並立刻塗底漆，看似完成，數月後塗膜下出現點狀返鏽與起泡；海邊結構若只看清潔度照片而不測鹽分，殘留氯鹽會讓新塗膜在一兩年內大面積起泡。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
塗裝問題只能靠塗料品質解決，與結構細部無關。
optionsEn: Blasting and priming early in the morning on steel near the dew point looks finished, but spot rust and blisters appear under the film within months.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Coating problems are solved only by better paint, not by structural detailing.
quiz.explanation: 清晨在接近露點的鋼面上噴砂並立刻塗底漆，看似完成，數月後塗膜下出現點狀返鏽與起泡；海邊結構若只看清潔度照片而不測鹽分，殘留氯鹽會讓新塗膜在一兩年內大面積起泡。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Blasting and priming early in the morning on steel near the dew point looks finished, but spot rust and blisters appear under the film within months; on coastal structures, judging only by cleanliness photographs without salt testing lets residual chloride blister large areas of new coating within a year or two. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 構件細部與可塗裝性：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Detailing for coatability: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「銳邊、隙縫與排水孔」如何影響大型鋼構防蝕塗裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sharp edges, crevices and drain holes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Protective coating of large steel structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 塗料在銳邊因表面張力而縮離，邊緣膜厚常只有平面的一半甚至更少，所以生鏽多從邊緣、螺栓頭與焊道開始。良好的防蝕細部包括：把銳邊磨圓、避免無法塗裝的窄縫與背對背角鋼、在可能積水處設排水孔、讓箱形構件完全密封或可進入維護，並預留塗裝工具與人員的作業空間。金門大橋的鐵工必須拆下板件，才能讓塗裝工進入柱與弦桿內部作業；該橋自 1970 年起也以高強度螺栓逐步取代鉚釘。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「銳邊、隙縫與排水孔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Paint pulls back from sharp edges by surface tension, so edge film is often half or less of the flat-surface thickness, which is why rust usually starts at edges, bolt heads and welds. Good anti-corrosion detailing rounds sharp edges, avoids uncoatable narrow gaps and back-to-back angles, adds drain holes where water could collect, makes box members either fully sealed or accessible, and leaves working space for tools and painters. On the Golden Gate Bridge, ironworkers must remove plates so painters can reach the interiors of columns and chords, and since 1970 rivets have progressively been replaced with high-strength bolts. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sharp edges, crevices and drain holes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：系統總乾膜 285 μm，銳邊若只保留約 40%，邊緣膜厚約 285×0.4 = 114 μm；先以刷塗條塗增加約 100 μm，邊緣達 214 μm；若改把邊緣磨圓、保留率提高到約 70%，即使不條塗也有約 200 μm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a total dry film of 285 μm, a sharp edge retaining only about 40% gets about 285×0.4 = 114 μm; a brushed stripe coat adding about 100 μm brings it to 214 μm, while rounding the edge to raise retention to about 70% gives about 200 μm even without a stripe coat.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塗裝問題只能靠塗料品質解決，與結構細部無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Coating problems are solved only by better paint, not by structural detailing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「銳邊、隙縫與排水孔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sharp edges, crevices and drain holes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Good anti-corrosion detailing rounds sharp edges, avoids uncoatable narrow gaps and back-to-back angles, adds drain holes where water could collect, makes box members either fully sealed or accessible, and leaves working space for tools and painters.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：塗裝問題只能靠塗料品質解決，與結構細部無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Coating problems are solved only by better paint, not by structural detailing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「構件細部與可塗裝性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Detailing for coatability" is correct?
options: 塗裝問題只能靠塗料品質解決，與結構細部無關。
塗料在銳邊因表面張力而縮離，邊緣膜厚常只有平面的一半甚至更少，所以生鏽多從邊緣、螺栓頭與焊道開始。
只要天氣晴朗，任何時間都可以進行下一層塗裝。
optionsEn: Coating problems are solved only by better paint, not by structural detailing.
Paint pulls back from sharp edges by surface tension, so edge film is often half or less of the flat-surface thickness, which is why rust usually starts at edges, bolt heads and welds.
In fine weather, the next coat can be applied at any time.
quiz.explanation: 塗料在銳邊因表面張力而縮離，邊緣膜厚常只有平面的一半甚至更少，所以生鏽多從邊緣、螺栓頭與焊道開始。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Paint pulls back from sharp edges by surface tension, so edge film is often half or less of the flat-surface thickness, which is why rust usually starts at edges, bolt heads and welds. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 構件細部與可塗裝性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Detailing for coatability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「銳邊、隙縫與排水孔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sharp edges, crevices and drain holes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：系統總乾膜 285 μm，銳邊若只保留約 40%，邊緣膜厚約 285×0.4 = 114 μm；先以刷塗條塗增加約 100 μm，邊緣達 214 μm；若改把邊緣磨圓、保留率提高到約 70%，即使不條塗也有約 200 μm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a total dry film of 285 μm, a sharp edge retaining only about 40% gets about 285×0.4 = 114 μm; a brushed stripe coat adding about 100 μm brings it to 214 μm, while rounding the edge to raise retention to about 70% gives about 200 μm even without a stripe coat. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製造時檢查邊緣是否依規格磨圓、焊道與焊濺物是否處理到規定等級；塗裝後在邊緣、螺栓與焊道附近加測膜厚，並確認條塗已在每一層之間完成；設計審查時檢查是否有積水、無法塗裝或無法檢查的細部。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During fabrication, check that edges are rounded and welds and spatter dressed to the specified grade; after coating, take extra thickness readings at edges, bolts and welds and confirm stripe coats were applied between layers; in design review, look for details that trap water or cannot be coated or inspected.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 系統總乾膜 285 μm，銳邊若只保留約 40%，邊緣膜厚約 285×0.4 = 114 μm；先以刷塗條塗增加約 100 μm，邊緣達 214 μm；若改把邊緣磨圓、保留率提高到約 70%，即使不條塗也有約 200 μm。數值為教學假設。

Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「構件細部與可塗裝性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Detailing for coatability", which statement holds?
options: 只要膜厚量測合格，就可以確認塗裝品質良好。
大型鋼橋必須定期從一端塗到另一端，永不停止。
系統總乾膜 285 μm，銳邊若只保留約 40%，邊緣膜厚約 285×0.4 = 114 μm。
optionsEn: If film thickness passes, coating quality is confirmed.
A large steel bridge must be painted continuously from one end to the other, forever.
With a total dry film of 285 μm, a sharp edge retaining only about 40% gets about 285×0.4 = 114 μm.
quiz.explanation: 系統總乾膜 285 μm，銳邊若只保留約 40%，邊緣膜厚約 285×0.4 = 114 μm；先以刷塗條塗增加約 100 μm，邊緣達 214 μm；若改把邊緣磨圓、保留率提高到約 70%，即使不條塗也有約 200 μm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a total dry film of 285 μm, a sharp edge retaining only about 40% gets about 285×0.4 = 114 μm; a brushed stripe coat adding about 100 μm brings it to 214 μm, while rounding the edge to raise retention to about 70% gives about 200 μm even without a stripe coat. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 構件細部與可塗裝性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Detailing for coatability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「銳邊、隙縫與排水孔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sharp edges, crevices and drain holes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 製造時檢查邊緣是否依規格磨圓、焊道與焊濺物是否處理到規定等級；塗裝後在邊緣、螺栓與焊道附近加測膜厚，並確認條塗已在每一層之間完成；設計審查時檢查是否有積水、無法塗裝或無法檢查的細部。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During fabrication, check that edges are rounded and welds and spatter dressed to the specified grade; after coating, take extra thickness readings at edges, bolts and welds and confirm stripe coats were applied between layers; in design review, look for details that trap water or cannot be coated or inspected. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構設計階段就要邀請塗裝顧問審查細部，把可塗裝性與可檢查性列入設計審查清單；箱形構件須明確標示為密封（並檢查焊縫氣密）或可進入（並設置人孔與照明），不可介於兩者之間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Invite the coating consultant to review details at the structural design stage and add coatability and inspectability to the design review checklist; box members must be clearly designated either sealed, with airtight welds checked, or accessible, with manholes and lighting, never something in between.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：背對背角鋼或密貼板件之間的窄縫無法塗裝，水氣滲入後鏽蝕膨脹，把板件撐開並拉斷鉚釘或螺栓；未設排水孔的箱形構件內部長年積水，外觀完好但內部截面已嚴重減少。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Narrow gaps between back-to-back angles or contacting plates cannot be coated; moisture enters, rust swells and pries the plates apart, breaking rivets or bolts; box members without drain holes hold water for years, looking sound outside while their interior section is badly reduced. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 製造時檢查邊緣是否依規格磨圓、焊道與焊濺物是否處理到規定等級；塗裝後在邊緣、螺栓與焊道附近加測膜厚，並確認條塗已在每一層之間完成；設計審查時檢查是否有積水、無法塗裝或無法檢查的細部。

knowledge.text: 結構設計階段就要邀請塗裝顧問審查細部，把可塗裝性與可檢查性列入設計審查清單；箱形構件須明確標示為密封（並檢查焊縫氣密）或可進入（並設置人孔與照明），不可介於兩者之間。

quiz.question: 要驗證「構件細部與可塗裝性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Detailing for coatability"?
options: 製造時檢查邊緣是否依規格磨圓、焊道與焊濺物是否處理到規定等級。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
同一座橋的所有部位都處在相同的腐蝕環境中。
optionsEn: During fabrication, check that edges are rounded and welds and spatter dressed to the specified grade.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Every part of a bridge sits in the same corrosive environment.
quiz.explanation: 製造時檢查邊緣是否依規格磨圓、焊道與焊濺物是否處理到規定等級；塗裝後在邊緣、螺栓與焊道附近加測膜厚，並確認條塗已在每一層之間完成；設計審查時檢查是否有積水、無法塗裝或無法檢查的細部。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During fabrication, check that edges are rounded and welds and spatter dressed to the specified grade; after coating, take extra thickness readings at edges, bolts and welds and confirm stripe coats were applied between layers; in design review, look for details that trap water or cannot be coated or inspected. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 構件細部與可塗裝性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Detailing for coatability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「銳邊、隙縫與排水孔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sharp edges, crevices and drain holes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 背對背角鋼或密貼板件之間的窄縫無法塗裝，水氣滲入後鏽蝕膨脹，把板件撐開並拉斷鉚釘或螺栓；未設排水孔的箱形構件內部長年積水，外觀完好但內部截面已嚴重減少。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Narrow gaps between back-to-back angles or contacting plates cannot be coated; moisture enters, rust swells and pries the plates apart, breaking rivets or bolts; box members without drain holes hold water for years, looking sound outside while their interior section is badly reduced. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：金門大橋的鐵工必須拆下板件，才能讓塗裝工進入柱與弦桿內部作業；該橋自 1970 年起也以高強度螺栓逐步取代鉚釘。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: On the Golden Gate Bridge, ironworkers must remove plates so painters can reach the interiors of columns and chords, and since 1970 rivets have progressively been replaced with high-strength bolts.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塗裝問題只能靠塗料品質解決，與結構細部無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Coating problems are solved only by better paint, not by structural detailing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 背對背角鋼或密貼板件之間的窄縫無法塗裝，水氣滲入後鏽蝕膨脹，把板件撐開並拉斷鉚釘或螺栓；未設排水孔的箱形構件內部長年積水，外觀完好但內部截面已嚴重減少。
