knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「構件細部與可塗裝性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Detailing for coatability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
背對背角鋼或密貼板件之間的窄縫無法塗裝，水氣滲入後鏽蝕膨脹，把板件撐開並拉斷鉚釘或螺栓；未設排水孔的箱形構件內部長年積水，外觀完好但內部截面已嚴重減少。
只要天氣晴朗，任何時間都可以進行下一層塗裝。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Narrow gaps between back-to-back angles or contacting plates cannot be coated.
In fine weather, the next coat can be applied at any time.
quiz.explanation: 背對背角鋼或密貼板件之間的窄縫無法塗裝，水氣滲入後鏽蝕膨脹，把板件撐開並拉斷鉚釘或螺栓；未設排水孔的箱形構件內部長年積水，外觀完好但內部截面已嚴重減少。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Narrow gaps between back-to-back angles or contacting plates cannot be coated; moisture enters, rust swells and pries the plates apart, breaking rivets or bolts; box members without drain holes hold water for years, looking sound outside while their interior section is badly reduced. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「現場施工環境與工序控制」與「濕膜與乾膜厚度控制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Site environment and sequence control" and "Wet- and dry-film thickness control": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 現場施工環境與工序控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Site environment and sequence control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「圍封、除濕與覆塗間隔」如何影響大型鋼構防蝕塗裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Containment, dehumidification and recoat windows” governs force, deformation or durability in “Protective coating of large steel structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大型既有結構的維護塗裝是在高空、風雨與交通中進行：需要搭設包覆式施工架或吊籃，以圍封收集噴砂粉塵與舊塗層碎屑，必要時以除濕機控制施工環境；每一層須在最短與最長覆塗間隔內完成下一層，否則附著不良。艾菲爾鐵塔一次重塗需 18 個月到三年以上，約 50 名塗裝工使用總長約 55 km 的安全索，並以防護網收集漆片；福斯鐵橋 2002 年起的首次全面重塗覆蓋約 255,000 m²、用漆約 240,000 L。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「圍封、除濕與覆塗間隔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Maintenance painting of large existing structures happens at height, in wind, rain and traffic: encapsulated scaffolds or cradles are needed to contain blast dust and old coating debris, with dehumidifiers controlling the environment where needed, and each coat must be overcoated within its minimum and maximum recoat window or adhesion suffers. An Eiffel Tower campaign takes 18 months to over three years, with about 50 painters using about 55 km of safety lines and nets catching paint flakes; the Forth Bridge's first full repaint from 2002 covered about 255,000 m² with about 240,000 L of paint. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Containment, dehumidification and recoat windows” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以福斯鐵橋公開數字粗估單位用量 240,000/255,000 ≈ 0.94 L/m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A rough unit consumption from the Forth Bridge's published figures is 240,000/255,000 ≈ 0.94 L/m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要天氣晴朗，任何時間都可以進行下一層塗裝。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "In fine weather, the next coat can be applied at any time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「圍封、除濕與覆塗間隔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Containment, dehumidification and recoat windows”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 現場施工環境與工序控制
knowledge.text: 大型既有結構的維護塗裝是在高空、風雨與交通中進行：需要搭設包覆式施工架或吊籃，以圍封收集噴砂粉塵與舊塗層碎屑，必要時以除濕機控制施工環境；每一層須在最短與最長覆塗間隔內完成下一層，否則附著不良。艾菲爾鐵塔一次重塗需 18 個月到三年以上，約 50 名塗裝工使用總長約 55 km 的安全索，並以防護網收集漆片；福斯鐵橋 2002 年起的首次全面重塗覆蓋約 255,000 m²、用漆約 240,000 L。
knowledge.textEn: Maintenance painting of large existing structures happens at height, in wind, rain and traffic: encapsulated scaffolds or cradles are needed to contain blast dust and old coating debris, with dehumidifiers controlling the environment where needed, and each coat must be overcoated within its minimum and maximum recoat window or adhesion suffers. An Eiffel Tower campaign takes 18 months to over three years, with about 50 painters using about 55 km of safety lines and nets catching paint flakes; the Forth Bridge's first full repaint from 2002 covered about 255,000 m² with about 240,000 L of paint.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要天氣晴朗，任何時間都可以進行下一層塗裝。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: In fine weather, the next coat can be applied at any time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「現場施工環境與工序控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Site environment and sequence control" is correct?
options: 只要天氣晴朗，任何時間都可以進行下一層塗裝。
塗膜越厚越好，超過規定厚度只會更耐久。
大型既有結構的維護塗裝是在高空、風雨與交通中進行：需要搭設包覆式施工架或吊籃，以圍封收集噴砂粉塵與舊塗層碎屑，必要時以除濕機控制施工環境。
optionsEn: In fine weather, the next coat can be applied at any time.
The thicker the film the better; exceeding the specified thickness only adds durability.

Maintenance painting of large existing structures happens at height, in wind, rain and traffic: encapsulated scaffolds or cradles are needed to contain blast dust and old coating debris, with dehumidifiers controlling the environment where needed, and each coat must be overcoated within its minimum and maximum recoat window or adhesion suffers.
quiz.explanation: 大型既有結構的維護塗裝是在高空、風雨與交通中進行：需要搭設包覆式施工架或吊籃，以圍封收集噴砂粉塵與舊塗層碎屑，必要時以除濕機控制施工環境；每一層須在最短與最長覆塗間隔內完成下一層，否則附著不良。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Maintenance painting of large existing structures happens at height, in wind, rain and traffic: encapsulated scaffolds or cradles are needed to contain blast dust and old coating debris, with dehumidifiers controlling the environment where needed, and each coat must be overcoated within its minimum and maximum recoat window or adhesion suffers. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現場施工環境與工序控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Site environment and sequence control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「圍封、除濕與覆塗間隔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Containment, dehumidification and recoat windows” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以福斯鐵橋公開數字粗估單位用量 240,000/255,000 ≈ 0.94 L/m²。若假設三層總乾膜 450 μm、平均固含量 75%，理論用量 0.45/0.75 = 0.60 L/m²，推得包含損耗的比例約 1 − 0.60/0.94 ≈ 36%。膜厚與固含量為教學假設，不代表該工程的實際系統。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A rough unit consumption from the Forth Bridge's published figures is 240,000/255,000 ≈ 0.94 L/m². Assuming a three-coat total of 450 μm dry at 75% average volume solids, the theoretical use is 0.45/0.75 = 0.60 L/m², implying losses of about 1 − 0.60/0.94 ≈ 36%. Film thickness and solids are teaching assumptions, not that project's actual system. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每日記錄各區的塗裝層次、產品批號、施工時間與環境數據，並比對覆塗間隔；以材料消耗量與塗裝面積計算實際單位用量，若明顯低於理論值，表示膜厚可能不足，應立即加測乾膜厚。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log daily the coat, product batch, application time and environmental data for each zone and check recoat windows; compute actual unit consumption from material used and area coated, and if it falls well below the theoretical value, suspect thin film and take extra thickness readings at once.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以福斯鐵橋公開數字粗估單位用量 240,000/255,000 ≈ 0.94 L/m²。若假設三層總乾膜 450 μm、平均固含量 75%，理論用量 0.45/0.75 = 0.60 L/m²，推得包含損耗的比例約 1 − 0.60/0.94 ≈ 36%。膜厚與固含量為教學假設，不代表該工程的實際系統。
knowledge.textEn: A rough unit consumption from the Forth Bridge's published figures is 240,000/255,000 ≈ 0.94 L/m². Assuming a three-coat total of 450 μm dry at 75% average volume solids, the theoretical use is 0.45/0.75 = 0.60 L/m², implying losses of about 1 − 0.60/0.94 ≈ 36%. Film thickness and solids are teaching assumptions, not that project's actual system.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場施工環境與工序控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Site environment and sequence control", which statement holds?
options: 以福斯鐵橋公開數字粗估單位用量 240,000/255,000 ≈ 0.94 L/m²。
塗層表面還有顏色，就表示防蝕功能仍然完好。
塗裝完成後，只要保存顏色編號就足以進行日後維護。
optionsEn: A rough unit consumption from the Forth Bridge's published figures is 240,000/255,000 ≈ 0.94 L/m².
If the coating still shows colour, its protection is intact.
After coating, keeping the colour code is enough for future maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 以福斯鐵橋公開數字粗估單位用量 240,000/255,000 ≈ 0.94 L/m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A rough unit consumption from the Forth Bridge's published figures is 240,000/255,000 ≈ 0.94 L/m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 現場施工環境與工序控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Site environment and sequence control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「圍封、除濕與覆塗間隔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Containment, dehumidification and recoat windows” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每日記錄各區的塗裝層次、產品批號、施工時間與環境數據，並比對覆塗間隔；以材料消耗量與塗裝面積計算實際單位用量，若明顯低於理論值，表示膜厚可能不足，應立即加測乾膜厚。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log daily the coat, product batch, application time and environmental data for each zone and check recoat windows; compute actual unit consumption from material used and area coated, and if it falls well below the theoretical value, suspect thin film and take extra thickness readings at once. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫須包含圍封與廢棄物處理、環境監測、每一層的覆塗間隔與天候停工條件，並由業主核准；高空與圍封施工涉及墜落與粉塵風險，作業許可須依職業安全規定辦理，本課只說明品質控制邏輯。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The work plan must cover containment and waste handling, environmental monitoring, recoat windows for each coat and weather stop criteria, approved by the owner; work at height and inside containment carries fall and dust hazards and needs permits under occupational-safety rules, and this course explains quality-control logic only.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：圍封不完整讓含鉛舊漆碎屑落入河道或人行道，工程被環保單位勒令停工；超過最長覆塗間隔才塗面漆，層間附著不良，數年後面漆大片剝落，必須再次全面處理。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Incomplete containment lets lead-bearing debris fall into the river or onto walkways and environmental authorities halt the work; topcoating after the maximum recoat window leaves poor intercoat adhesion, so large sheets of topcoat peel within a few years and everything must be redone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每日記錄各區的塗裝層次、產品批號、施工時間與環境數據，並比對覆塗間隔；以材料消耗量與塗裝面積計算實際單位用量，若明顯低於理論值，表示膜厚可能不足，應立即加測乾膜厚。
knowledge.textEn: Log daily the coat, product batch, application time and environmental data for each zone and check recoat windows; compute actual unit consumption from material used and area coated, and if it falls well below the theoretical value, suspect thin film and take extra thickness readings at once.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫須包含圍封與廢棄物處理、環境監測、每一層的覆塗間隔與天候停工條件，並由業主核准；高空與圍封施工涉及墜落與粉塵風險，作業許可須依職業安全規定辦理，本課只說明品質控制邏輯。
knowledge.textEn: The work plan must cover containment and waste handling, environmental monitoring, recoat windows for each coat and weather stop criteria, approved by the owner; work at height and inside containment carries fall and dust hazards and needs permits under occupational-safety rules, and this course explains quality-control logic only.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場施工環境與工序控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Site environment and sequence control"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
每日記錄各區的塗裝層次、產品批號、施工時間與環境數據，並比對覆塗間隔。
塗裝主要是為了顏色與外觀，防蝕效果與塗層層次無關。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Log daily the coat, product batch, application time and environmental data for each zone and check recoat windows.
Coatings are mainly for colour and looks, and the number of layers does not matter for protection.
quiz.explanation: 每日記錄各區的塗裝層次、產品批號、施工時間與環境數據，並比對覆塗間隔；以材料消耗量與塗裝面積計算實際單位用量，若明顯低於理論值，表示膜厚可能不足，應立即加測乾膜厚。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log daily the coat, product batch, application time and environmental data for each zone and check recoat windows; compute actual unit consumption from material used and area coated, and if it falls well below the theoretical value, suspect thin film and take extra thickness readings at once. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現場施工環境與工序控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Site environment and sequence control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「圍封、除濕與覆塗間隔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Containment, dehumidification and recoat windows” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 圍封不完整讓含鉛舊漆碎屑落入河道或人行道，工程被環保單位勒令停工；超過最長覆塗間隔才塗面漆，層間附著不良，數年後面漆大片剝落，必須再次全面處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Incomplete containment lets lead-bearing debris fall into the river or onto walkways and environmental authorities halt the work; topcoating after the maximum recoat window leaves poor intercoat adhesion, so large sheets of topcoat peel within a few years and everything must be redone. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：艾菲爾鐵塔一次重塗需 18 個月到三年以上，約 50 名塗裝工使用總長約 55 km 的安全索，並以防護網收集漆片；福斯鐵橋 2002 年起的首次全面重塗覆蓋約 255,000 m²、用漆約 240,000 L。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An Eiffel Tower campaign takes 18 months to over three years, with about 50 painters using about 55 km of safety lines and nets catching paint flakes; the Forth Bridge's first full repaint from 2002 covered about 255,000 m² with about 240,000 L of paint.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要天氣晴朗，任何時間都可以進行下一層塗裝。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "In fine weather, the next coat can be applied at any time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 濕膜與乾膜厚度控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wet- and dry-film thickness control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「濕膜梳與乾膜測厚儀」如何影響大型鋼構防蝕塗裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wet-film comb and dry-film gauge” governs force, deformation or durability in “Protective coating of large steel structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 膜厚是塗裝規格中最直接可量測的品質指標：太薄則阻隔不足、提早生鏽，太厚則可能龜裂、殘留溶劑或附著不良。施工中以濕膜梳即時檢查，由固含量換算乾膜；乾燥後以磁性或渦電流測厚儀量測乾膜厚，在粗糙的噴砂面上要依 ISO 19840 扣除粗糙度修正值。驗收常採「80-20 規則」：平均值不低於標稱膜厚、低於標稱值的讀數不超過 20%，且沒有任何讀數低於標稱值的 80%，同時不得超過產品允許的最大膜厚。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「濕膜梳與乾膜測厚儀」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Film thickness is the most directly measurable quality indicator in a coating specification: too thin gives poor barrier and early rust, too thick can crack, trap solvent or adhere poorly. During application a wet-film comb gives immediate checks, converted to dry film by volume solids; after drying, magnetic or eddy-current gauges measure dry film, with a roughness correction deducted on blasted surfaces per ISO 19840. Acceptance commonly uses the 80-20 rule: the mean is at least the nominal thickness, no more than 20% of readings fall below nominal, no reading is below 80% of nominal, and the product's maximum thickness is not exceeded. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wet-film comb and dry-film gauge” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：標稱乾膜 285 μm，最低個別值 0.8×285 = 228 μm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a nominal dry film of 285 μm the minimum single reading is 0.8×285 = 228 μm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塗膜越厚越好，超過規定厚度只會更耐久。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The thicker the film the better; exceeding the specified thickness only adds durability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「濕膜梳與乾膜測厚儀」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wet-film comb and dry-film gauge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

During application a wet-film comb gives immediate checks, converted to dry film by volume solids; after drying, magnetic or eddy-current gauges measure dry film, with a roughness correction deducted on blasted surfaces per ISO 19840.

knowledge.text: 誤解：塗膜越厚越好，超過規定厚度只會更耐久。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.explanationEn: Film thickness is the most directly measurable quality indicator in a coating specification: too thin gives poor barrier and early rust, too thick can crack, trap solvent or adhere poorly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 濕膜與乾膜厚度控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wet- and dry-film thickness control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濕膜梳與乾膜測厚儀」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wet-film comb and dry-film gauge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：標稱乾膜 285 μm，最低個別值 0.8×285 = 228 μm。某區 20 個讀數中有 3 個介於 240 與 280 μm（15%，≤ 20%），但另有 1 個為 220 μm < 228 μm，該區判不合格，須找出低膜厚範圍補塗；粗糙度中等時每個讀數先扣約 25 μm 修正值。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a nominal dry film of 285 μm the minimum single reading is 0.8×285 = 228 μm. If 3 of 20 readings in an area lie between 240 and 280 μm (15%, within 20%) but one reads 220 μm < 228 μm, the area fails and the thin zone must be found and recoated; on a medium profile, about 25 μm is first deducted from each reading as the roughness correction. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：測厚儀每天以標準片在相同粗糙度的試板上校正，量測點依 ISO 19840 的抽樣數量分布於平面、邊緣與接頭；結果以位置圖記錄，低於標準的區域以標記圈出補塗後重新量測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate gauges daily with standard shims on a test panel of the same roughness, distribute readings per the ISO 19840 sampling plan over flats, edges and joints, map the results by location, and circle, recoat and re-measure any area below standard.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 標稱乾膜 285 μm，最低個別值 0.8×285 = 228 μm。某區 20 個讀數中有 3 個介於 240 與 280 μm（15%，≤ 20%），但另有 1 個為 220 μm < 228 μm，該區判不合格，須找出低膜厚範圍補塗；粗糙度中等時每個讀數先扣約 25 μm 修正值。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a nominal dry film of 285 μm the minimum single reading is 0.8×285 = 228 μm. If 3 of 20 readings in an area lie between 240 and 280 μm (15%, within 20%) but one reads 220 μm < 228 μm, the area fails and the thin zone must be found and recoated; on a medium profile, about 25 μm is first deducted from each reading as the roughness correction. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「濕膜與乾膜厚度控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 大型鋼橋必須定期從一端塗到另一端，永不停止。
標稱乾膜 285 μm，最低個別值 0.8×285 = 228 μm。

For a nominal dry film of 285 μm the minimum single reading is 0.8×285 = 228 μm.
Every part of a bridge sits in the same corrosive environment.

steps.title: 濕膜與乾膜厚度控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wet- and dry-film thickness control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濕膜梳與乾膜測厚儀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wet-film comb and dry-film gauge” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 測厚儀每天以標準片在相同粗糙度的試板上校正，量測點依 ISO 19840 的抽樣數量分布於平面、邊緣與接頭；結果以位置圖記錄，低於標準的區域以標記圈出補塗後重新量測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate gauges daily with standard shims on a test panel of the same roughness, distribute readings per the ISO 19840 sampling plan over flats, edges and joints, map the results by location, and circle, recoat and re-measure any area below standard. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要同時規定最小與最大膜厚、量測方法與抽樣數量，並要求每一層都量測與記錄，而不是只量最後總膜厚；膜厚紀錄是付款與保固的依據，須由獨立檢驗員簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification must set both minimum and maximum thickness, the measuring method and sampling, and require each coat, not just the final total, to be measured and recorded; thickness records support payment and warranty and must be signed by an independent inspector.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了趕工一次厚噴無機鋅底漆，局部膜厚超過上限而龜裂，面漆覆蓋後看不出來，幾年後龜裂處先起泡剝落；反之只在平面量膜厚，邊緣與螺栓處偏薄卻未被發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Spraying inorganic zinc primer thick in one pass to save time pushes local thickness past its limit so it cracks, hidden once topcoated until those areas blister and flake years later; conversely, measuring only flat areas misses thin film at edges and bolts. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「濕膜與乾膜厚度控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wet- and dry-film thickness control"?

knowledge.textEn: Spraying inorganic zinc primer thick in one pass to save time pushes local thickness past its limit so it cracks, hidden once topcoated until those areas blister and flake years later; conversely, measuring only flat areas misses thin film at edges and bolts.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「濕膜與乾膜厚度控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wet- and dry-film thickness control" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 為了趕工一次厚噴無機鋅底漆，局部膜厚超過上限而龜裂，面漆覆蓋後看不出來，幾年後龜裂處先起泡剝落；反之只在平面量膜厚，邊緣與螺栓處偏薄卻未被發現。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要膜厚量測合格，就可以確認塗裝品質良好。
optionsEn: Spraying inorganic zinc primer thick in one pass to save time pushes local thickness past its limit so it cracks, hidden once topcoated until those areas blister and flake years later.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If film thickness passes, coating quality is confirmed.
quiz.explanation: 為了趕工一次厚噴無機鋅底漆，局部膜厚超過上限而龜裂，面漆覆蓋後看不出來，幾年後龜裂處先起泡剝落；反之只在平面量膜厚，邊緣與螺栓處偏薄卻未被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Spraying inorganic zinc primer thick in one pass to save time pushes local thickness past its limit so it cracks, hidden once topcoated until those areas blister and flake years later; conversely, measuring only flat areas misses thin film at edges and bolts. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「附著力與塗膜缺陷檢測」與「狀態評估與劣化分級」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Adhesion and film-defect testing" and "Condition surveys and degradation rating": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 附著力與塗膜缺陷檢測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Adhesion and film-defect testing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「拉拔附著力試驗」如何影響大型鋼構防蝕塗裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pull-off adhesion test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Protective coating of large steel structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 膜厚合格不代表塗層黏得住。附著力常以 ISO 4624 拉拔試驗量測：把金屬拉拔頭黏在塗膜上，切開周圍塗膜，以拉拔器施力直到破壞，記錄破壞強度與破壞位置（底材與底漆之間、層間或塗層內聚破壞）。破壞位置往往比數值更有意義：若破壞在底漆與鋼面之間，代表表面處理有問題；若在層間，則可能是覆塗間隔或污染。塗膜還要以目視與針孔檢測找出流掛、乾噴、針孔與漏塗。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「拉拔附著力試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Correct thickness does not prove the coating sticks. Adhesion is commonly measured by the ISO 4624 pull-off test: a metal dolly is glued to the film, the coating around it scored, and a tester pulls until failure, recording the stress and where it failed, between steel and primer, between coats or cohesively within a coat. The failure location often matters more than the value: failure at the primer–steel interface points to surface preparation, failure between coats to recoat timing or contamination. The film is also checked visually and with holiday detectors for runs, dry spray, pinholes and misses. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pull-off adhesion test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：拉拔強度 σ = F/A。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Pull-off stress σ = F/A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要膜厚量測合格，就可以確認塗裝品質良好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If film thickness passes, coating quality is confirmed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「拉拔附著力試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pull-off adhesion test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 附著力與塗膜缺陷檢測
knowledge.text: 膜厚合格不代表塗層黏得住。附著力常以 ISO 4624 拉拔試驗量測：把金屬拉拔頭黏在塗膜上，切開周圍塗膜，以拉拔器施力直到破壞，記錄破壞強度與破壞位置（底材與底漆之間、層間或塗層內聚破壞）。
knowledge.textEn: Correct thickness does not prove the coating sticks. Adhesion is commonly measured by the ISO 4624 pull-off test: a metal dolly is glued to the film, the coating around it scored, and a tester pulls until failure, recording the stress and where it failed, between steel and primer, between coats or cohesively within a coat.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要膜厚量測合格，就可以確認塗裝品質良好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If film thickness passes, coating quality is confirmed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「附著力與塗膜缺陷檢測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Adhesion and film-defect testing" is correct?
options: 只要膜厚量測合格，就可以確認塗裝品質良好。
膜厚合格不代表塗層黏得住。
塗層表面還有顏色，就表示防蝕功能仍然完好。
optionsEn: If film thickness passes, coating quality is confirmed.
Correct thickness does not prove the coating sticks.
If the coating still shows colour, its protection is intact.
quiz.explanation: 膜厚合格不代表塗層黏得住。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Correct thickness does not prove the coating sticks. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 附著力與塗膜缺陷檢測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Adhesion and film-defect testing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拉拔附著力試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pull-off adhesion test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：拉拔強度 σ = F/A。拉拔頭直徑 20 mm，A = π×10² ≈ 314 mm²，破壞力 F = 2.2 kN：σ = 2,200/314 ≈ 7.0 MPa。若規格要求 ≥ 5 MPa，數值合格；但若破壞面 60% 在底漆與鋼面之間，仍應檢討表面處理。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Pull-off stress σ = F/A. A 20 mm dolly has A = π×10² ≈ 314 mm², and a failure force of F = 2.2 kN gives σ = 2,200/314 ≈ 7.0 MPa. Against a specified 5 MPa this passes, yet if 60% of the fracture lies between primer and steel, surface preparation should still be reviewed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：拉拔試驗在代表性試板或結構上的指定位置進行，記錄黏著劑種類、養護時間、拉拔速率、破壞強度與各破壞模式的百分比；試驗點完成後須依程序修補。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run pull-off tests on representative panels or designated locations on the structure, recording adhesive, cure time, pull rate, failure stress and the percentage of each failure mode, and repair test spots by procedure; for holiday detection choose low-voltage wet sponge or high-voltage spark by film thickness, at the specified voltage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 拉拔強度 σ = F/A。拉拔頭直徑 20 mm，A = π×10² ≈ 314 mm²，破壞力 F = 2.2 kN：σ = 2,200/314 ≈ 7.0 MPa。若規格要求 ≥ 5 MPa，數值合格；但若破壞面 60% 在底漆與鋼面之間，仍應檢討表面處理。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Pull-off stress σ = F/A. A 20 mm dolly has A = π×10² ≈ 314 mm², and a failure force of F = 2.2 kN gives σ = 2,200/314 ≈ 7.0 MPa. Against a specified 5 MPa this passes, yet if 60% of the fracture lies between primer and steel, surface preparation should still be reviewed. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「附著力與塗膜缺陷檢測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Adhesion and film-defect testing", which statement holds?
options: 塗裝完成後，只要保存顏色編號就足以進行日後維護。
塗裝主要是為了顏色與外觀，防蝕效果與塗層層次無關。
拉拔強度 σ = F/A。
optionsEn: After coating, keeping the colour code is enough for future maintenance.
Coatings are mainly for colour and looks, and the number of layers does not matter for protection.
Pull-off stress σ = F/A.
quiz.explanation: 拉拔強度 σ = F/A。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Pull-off stress σ = F/A. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 附著力與塗膜缺陷檢測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Adhesion and film-defect testing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拉拔附著力試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pull-off adhesion test” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 拉拔試驗在代表性試板或結構上的指定位置進行，記錄黏著劑種類、養護時間、拉拔速率、破壞強度與各破壞模式的百分比；試驗點完成後須依程序修補。針孔檢測則依塗層厚度選擇低壓濕海綿或高壓火花檢測，電壓依規格設定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run pull-off tests on representative panels or designated locations on the structure, recording adhesive, cure time, pull rate, failure stress and the percentage of each failure mode, and repair test spots by procedure; for holiday detection choose low-voltage wet sponge or high-voltage spark by film thickness, at the specified voltage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在大面積施工前先做一塊現場樣板，依完整程序施工並做附著力與膜厚驗收，作為之後所有區域的品質基準；檢驗結果與樣板位置記錄在交接文件中，保固爭議時可以回溯。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before large-scale work, make a site reference area applied by the full procedure and accepted for adhesion and thickness as the quality benchmark for all later areas; record the results and location in the handover documents so warranty disputes can be traced.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：附著力試驗只在工廠試板上做一次，現場在潮濕或有灰塵的狀態下塗裝，實際附著力遠低於試板，塗層在第一個冬季就成片剝落；高壓針孔檢測電壓過高，反而擊穿合格塗膜造成新缺陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing adhesion once on shop panels while site coats go on damp or dusty steel leaves actual adhesion far below the panels, and the coating peels in sheets the first winter; setting high-voltage holiday detection too high punctures sound film and creates new defects. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 拉拔試驗在代表性試板或結構上的指定位置進行，記錄黏著劑種類、養護時間、拉拔速率、破壞強度與各破壞模式的百分比；試驗點完成後須依程序修補。針孔檢測則依塗層厚度選擇低壓濕海綿或高壓火花檢測，電壓依規格設定。
knowledge.textEn: Run pull-off tests on representative panels or designated locations on the structure, recording adhesive, cure time, pull rate, failure stress and the percentage of each failure mode, and repair test spots by procedure; for holiday detection choose low-voltage wet sponge or high-voltage spark by film thickness, at the specified voltage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在大面積施工前先做一塊現場樣板，依完整程序施工並做附著力與膜厚驗收，作為之後所有區域的品質基準；檢驗結果與樣板位置記錄在交接文件中，保固爭議時可以回溯。
knowledge.textEn: Before large-scale work, make a site reference area applied by the full procedure and accepted for adhesion and thickness as the quality benchmark for all later areas; record the results and location in the handover documents so warranty disputes can be traced.

quiz.question: 要驗證「附著力與塗膜缺陷檢測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Adhesion and film-defect testing"?
options: 拉拔試驗在代表性試板或結構上的指定位置進行，記錄黏著劑種類、養護時間、拉拔速率、破壞強度與各破壞模式的百分比；試驗點完成後須依程序修補。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
塗裝問題只能靠塗料品質解決，與結構細部無關。
optionsEn: Run pull-off tests on representative panels or designated locations on the structure, recording adhesive, cure time, pull rate, failure stress and the percentage of each failure mode, and repair test spots by procedure.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Coating problems are solved only by better paint, not by structural detailing.
quiz.explanation: 拉拔試驗在代表性試板或結構上的指定位置進行，記錄黏著劑種類、養護時間、拉拔速率、破壞強度與各破壞模式的百分比；試驗點完成後須依程序修補。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run pull-off tests on representative panels or designated locations on the structure, recording adhesive, cure time, pull rate, failure stress and the percentage of each failure mode, and repair test spots by procedure; for holiday detection choose low-voltage wet sponge or high-voltage spark by film thickness, at the specified voltage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 附著力與塗膜缺陷檢測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Adhesion and film-defect testing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拉拔附著力試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pull-off adhesion test” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 附著力試驗只在工廠試板上做一次，現場在潮濕或有灰塵的狀態下塗裝，實際附著力遠低於試板，塗層在第一個冬季就成片剝落；高壓針孔檢測電壓過高，反而擊穿合格塗膜造成新缺陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing adhesion once on shop panels while site coats go on damp or dusty steel leaves actual adhesion far below the panels, and the coating peels in sheets the first winter; setting high-voltage holiday detection too high punctures sound film and creates new defects. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：塗膜還要以目視與針孔檢測找出流掛、乾噴、針孔與漏塗。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The film is also checked visually and with holiday detectors for runs, dry spray, pinholes and misses.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要膜厚量測合格，就可以確認塗裝品質良好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If film thickness passes, coating quality is confirmed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 附著力試驗只在工廠試板上做一次，現場在潮濕或有灰塵的狀態下塗裝，實際附著力遠低於試板，塗層在第一個冬季就成片剝落；高壓針孔檢測電壓過高，反而擊穿合格塗膜造成新缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Testing adhesion once on shop panels while site coats go on damp or dusty steel leaves actual adhesion far below the panels, and the coating peels in sheets the first winter; setting high-voltage holiday detection too high punctures sound film and creates new defects.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「附著力與塗膜缺陷檢測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Adhesion and film-defect testing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
附著力試驗只在工廠試板上做一次，現場在潮濕或有灰塵的狀態下塗裝，實際附著力遠低於試板，塗層在第一個冬季就成片剝落。
塗層表面還有顏色，就表示防蝕功能仍然完好。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Testing adhesion once on shop panels while site coats go on damp or dusty steel leaves actual adhesion far below the panels, and the coating peels in sheets the first winter.
If the coating still shows colour, its protection is intact.
quiz.explanation: 附著力試驗只在工廠試板上做一次，現場在潮濕或有灰塵的狀態下塗裝，實際附著力遠低於試板，塗層在第一個冬季就成片剝落；高壓針孔檢測電壓過高，反而擊穿合格塗膜造成新缺陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing adhesion once on shop panels while site coats go on damp or dusty steel leaves actual adhesion far below the panels, and the coating peels in sheets the first winter; setting high-voltage holiday detection too high punctures sound film and creates new defects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 狀態評估與劣化分級：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Condition surveys and degradation rating: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「ISO 4628 生鏽等級」如何影響大型鋼構防蝕塗裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ISO 4628 rust grade” governs force, deformation or durability in “Protective coating of large steel structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 維護決策要以量化的狀態評估為基礎：ISO 4628 以標準圖比對生鏽、起泡、龜裂、剝落與粉化程度，例如生鏽等級 Ri 1 至 Ri 5 對應約 0.05% 至 40% 至 50% 的生鏽面積。金門大橋的塗裝工作依檢查結果決定在哪裡腐蝕正在擴大；艾菲爾鐵塔每次重塗也從找出並暴露最嚴重的腐蝕區開始，並估計兩次重塗之間約有 15 t 塗料被侵蝕。把評估結果畫在構件分區圖上，就能看出劣化是隨機分布還是集中於特定細部。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「ISO 4628 生鏽等級」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Maintenance decisions should rest on quantified condition surveys: ISO 4628 compares rusting, blistering, cracking, flaking and chalking with reference images, rust grades Ri 1 to Ri 5 corresponding to about 0.05% up to 40 to 50% rusted area. Golden Gate Bridge painting is planned from inspections that show where corrosion is advancing, and each Eiffel Tower campaign begins by finding and exposing the worst corrosion, with about 15 t of paint estimated to erode between campaigns. Mapping survey results onto member zones shows whether deterioration is random or concentrated at particular details. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “ISO 4628 rust grade” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：艾菲爾鐵塔每次約用 60 t 塗料、兩次之間約 15 t 被侵蝕，即約 25%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Each Eiffel Tower campaign uses about 60 t of paint, and about 15 t erodes between campaigns, about 25%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塗層表面還有顏色，就表示防蝕功能仍然完好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the coating still shows colour, its protection is intact." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「ISO 4628 生鏽等級」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “ISO 4628 rust grade”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 狀態評估與劣化分級
knowledge.text: 維護決策要以量化的狀態評估為基礎：ISO 4628 以標準圖比對生鏽、起泡、龜裂、剝落與粉化程度，例如生鏽等級 Ri 1 至 Ri 5 對應約 0.05% 至 40% 至 50% 的生鏽面積。金門大橋的塗裝工作依檢查結果決定在哪裡腐蝕正在擴大；艾菲爾鐵塔每次重塗也從找出並暴露最嚴重的腐蝕區開始，並估計兩次重塗之間約有 15 t 塗料被侵蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Maintenance decisions should rest on quantified condition surveys: ISO 4628 compares rusting, blistering, cracking, flaking and chalking with reference images, rust grades Ri 1 to Ri 5 corresponding to about 0.05% up to 40 to 50% rusted area. Golden Gate Bridge painting is planned from inspections that show where corrosion is advancing, and each Eiffel Tower campaign begins by finding and exposing the worst corrosion, with about 15 t of paint estimated to erode between campaigns.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：塗層表面還有顏色，就表示防蝕功能仍然完好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the coating still shows colour, its protection is intact. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「狀態評估與劣化分級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Condition surveys and degradation rating" is correct?
options: 塗層表面還有顏色，就表示防蝕功能仍然完好。
大型鋼橋必須定期從一端塗到另一端，永不停止。
維護決策要以量化的狀態評估為基礎：ISO 4628 以標準圖比對生鏽、起泡、龜裂、剝落與粉化程度，例如生鏽等級 Ri 1 至 Ri 5 對應約 0.05% 至 40% 至 50% 的生鏽面積。
optionsEn: If the coating still shows colour, its protection is intact.
A large steel bridge must be painted continuously from one end to the other, forever.

Maintenance decisions should rest on quantified condition surveys: ISO 4628 compares rusting, blistering, cracking, flaking and chalking with reference images, rust grades Ri 1 to Ri 5 corresponding to about 0.05% up to 40 to 50% rusted area.
quiz.explanation: 維護決策要以量化的狀態評估為基礎：ISO 4628 以標準圖比對生鏽、起泡、龜裂、剝落與粉化程度，例如生鏽等級 Ri 1 至 Ri 5 對應約 0.05% 至 40% 至 50% 的生鏽面積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Maintenance decisions should rest on quantified condition surveys: ISO 4628 compares rusting, blistering, cracking, flaking and chalking with reference images, rust grades Ri 1 to Ri 5 corresponding to about 0.05% up to 40 to 50% rusted area. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 狀態評估與劣化分級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Condition surveys and degradation rating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「ISO 4628 生鏽等級」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “ISO 4628 rust grade” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：艾菲爾鐵塔每次約用 60 t 塗料、兩次之間約 15 t 被侵蝕，即約 25%。換算面積 250,000 m²：15,000 kg/250,000 m² = 60 g/m²；若乾膜密度取 1,500 kg/m³，約等於 40 μm 厚，以約 7 年計平均每年侵蝕約 5.7 μm。密度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Each Eiffel Tower campaign uses about 60 t of paint, and about 15 t erodes between campaigns, about 25%. Over 250,000 m², 15,000 kg/250,000 m² = 60 g/m²; taking a dry-film density of 1,500 kg/m³, that is about 40 μm, or about 5.7 μm a year over roughly 7 years. The density is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：訂定固定的檢查分區與照片位置，每次調查以相同光線與距離拍照，並以 ISO 4628 標準圖評級；抽樣量測剩餘膜厚與附著力，與原始施工紀錄比較，找出劣化最快的區域與原因。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fix inspection zones and photo positions, photograph each survey with the same lighting and distance, and rate against ISO 4628 reference images; sample remaining film thickness and adhesion and compare with the original construction records to find where and why deterioration is fastest.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 艾菲爾鐵塔每次約用 60 t 塗料、兩次之間約 15 t 被侵蝕，即約 25%。換算面積 250,000 m²：15,000 kg/250,000 m² = 60 g/m²；若乾膜密度取 1,500 kg/m³，約等於 40 μm 厚，以約 7 年計平均每年侵蝕約 5.7 μm。密度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Each Eiffel Tower campaign uses about 60 t of paint, and about 15 t erodes between campaigns, about 25%. Over 250,000 m², 15,000 kg/250,000 m² = 60 g/m²; taking a dry-film density of 1,500 kg/m³, that is about 40 μm, or about 5.7 μm a year over roughly 7 years. The density is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「狀態評估與劣化分級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Condition surveys and degradation rating", which statement holds?
options: 艾菲爾鐵塔每次約用 60 t 塗料、兩次之間約 15 t 被侵蝕，即約 25%。
同一座橋的所有部位都處在相同的腐蝕環境中。
只要表面看起來是亮白的金屬，就可以直接塗裝。
optionsEn: Each Eiffel Tower campaign uses about 60 t of paint, and about 15 t erodes between campaigns, about 25%.
Every part of a bridge sits in the same corrosive environment.
If the surface looks like bright white metal, it is ready to coat.
quiz.explanation: 艾菲爾鐵塔每次約用 60 t 塗料、兩次之間約 15 t 被侵蝕，即約 25%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Each Eiffel Tower campaign uses about 60 t of paint, and about 15 t erodes between campaigns, about 25%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 狀態評估與劣化分級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Condition surveys and degradation rating: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「ISO 4628 生鏽等級」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “ISO 4628 rust grade” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 訂定固定的檢查分區與照片位置，每次調查以相同光線與距離拍照，並以 ISO 4628 標準圖評級；抽樣量測剩餘膜厚與附著力，與原始施工紀錄比較，找出劣化最快的區域與原因。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fix inspection zones and photo positions, photograph each survey with the same lighting and distance, and rate against ISO 4628 reference images; sample remaining film thickness and adhesion and compare with the original construction records to find where and why deterioration is fastest. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主應建立以構件分區為單位的塗裝狀態資料庫，固定週期更新評級，並以評級觸發維護行動（例如某區達到 Ri 2 時安排局部修補）；評級人員須受過標準圖比對訓練，以減少主觀差異。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner should keep a coating-condition database by member zone, update ratings on a fixed cycle and let ratings trigger action, for example spot repair when a zone reaches Ri 2; raters must be trained on the reference images to reduce subjective scatter.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以「看起來還好」作為判斷，等到大面積生鏽才處理，鏽層已滲入塗膜下方，局部修補不再可行，只能全面去除重塗，成本與交通管制時間都大幅增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Judging only by whether it still looks fine and acting once rust is widespread lets corrosion creep beneath the film, so spot repair is no longer viable and full removal and repainting become necessary at much greater cost and closure time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 訂定固定的檢查分區與照片位置，每次調查以相同光線與距離拍照，並以 ISO 4628 標準圖評級；抽樣量測剩餘膜厚與附著力，與原始施工紀錄比較，找出劣化最快的區域與原因。
knowledge.textEn: Fix inspection zones and photo positions, photograph each survey with the same lighting and distance, and rate against ISO 4628 reference images; sample remaining film thickness and adhesion and compare with the original construction records to find where and why deterioration is fastest.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 業主應建立以構件分區為單位的塗裝狀態資料庫，固定週期更新評級，並以評級觸發維護行動（例如某區達到 Ri 2 時安排局部修補）；評級人員須受過標準圖比對訓練，以減少主觀差異。
knowledge.textEn: The owner should keep a coating-condition database by member zone, update ratings on a fixed cycle and let ratings trigger action, for example spot repair when a zone reaches Ri 2; raters must be trained on the reference images to reduce subjective scatter.

quiz.question: 要驗證「狀態評估與劣化分級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Condition surveys and degradation rating"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
訂定固定的檢查分區與照片位置，每次調查以相同光線與距離拍照，並以 ISO 4628 標準圖評級。
只要天氣晴朗，任何時間都可以進行下一層塗裝。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Fix inspection zones and photo positions, photograph each survey with the same lighting and distance, and rate against ISO 4628 reference images.
In fine weather, the next coat can be applied at any time.
quiz.explanation: 訂定固定的檢查分區與照片位置，每次調查以相同光線與距離拍照，並以 ISO 4628 標準圖評級；抽樣量測剩餘膜厚與附著力，與原始施工紀錄比較，找出劣化最快的區域與原因。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fix inspection zones and photo positions, photograph each survey with the same lighting and distance, and rate against ISO 4628 reference images; sample remaining film thickness and adhesion and compare with the original construction records to find where and why deterioration is fastest. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 狀態評估與劣化分級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Condition surveys and degradation rating: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「ISO 4628 生鏽等級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “ISO 4628 rust grade” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以「看起來還好」作為判斷，等到大面積生鏽才處理，鏽層已滲入塗膜下方，局部修補不再可行，只能全面去除重塗，成本與交通管制時間都大幅增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Judging only by whether it still looks fine and acting once rust is widespread lets corrosion creep beneath the film, so spot repair is no longer viable and full removal and repainting become necessary at much greater cost and closure time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把評估結果畫在構件分區圖上，就能看出劣化是隨機分布還是集中於特定細部。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mapping survey results onto member zones shows whether deterioration is random or concentrated at particular details.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塗層表面還有顏色，就表示防蝕功能仍然完好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the coating still shows colour, its protection is intact." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以「看起來還好」作為判斷，等到大面積生鏽才處理，鏽層已滲入塗膜下方，局部修補不再可行，只能全面去除重塗，成本與交通管制時間都大幅增加。
knowledge.textEn: Judging only by whether it still looks fine and acting once rust is widespread lets corrosion creep beneath the film, so spot repair is no longer viable and full removal and repainting become necessary at much greater cost and closure time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「狀態評估與劣化分級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Condition surveys and degradation rating" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
大型鋼橋必須定期從一端塗到另一端，永不停止。
若只以「看起來還好」作為判斷，等到大面積生鏽才處理，鏽層已滲入塗膜下方，局部修補不再可行，只能全面去除重塗，成本與交通管制時間都大幅增加。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A large steel bridge must be painted continuously from one end to the other, forever.

Judging only by whether it still looks fine and acting once rust is widespread lets corrosion creep beneath the film, so spot repair is no longer viable and full removal and repainting become necessary at much greater cost and closure time.
quiz.explanation: 若只以「看起來還好」作為判斷，等到大面積生鏽才處理，鏽層已滲入塗膜下方，局部修補不再可行，只能全面去除重塗，成本與交通管制時間都大幅增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Judging only by whether it still looks fine and acting once rust is widespread lets corrosion creep beneath the film, so spot repair is no longer viable and full removal and repainting become necessary at much greater cost and closure time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「局部修補、覆塗或全面重塗」與「塗裝紀錄、環保要求與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spot repair, overcoating or full repainting" and "Coating records, environmental rules and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 局部修補、覆塗或全面重塗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Spot repair, overcoating or full repainting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「維護塗裝決策點」如何影響大型鋼構防蝕塗裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Maintenance-painting decision point” governs force, deformation or durability in “Protective coating of large steel structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 維護策略有三種：局部修補只處理生鏽點，成本低但須及早進行；覆塗是在附著良好的舊塗層上加塗，延長壽命；全面重塗則把舊塗層全部去除，成本最高但可重建完整系統。金門大橋採持續修補，官方強調重塗不是每七年一次、也不是每年從頭塗到尾；它在 1965 年起移除含鉛塗料並改用鋅矽酸鹽系統，至 1995 年完成。福斯鐵橋在 1890 年通車後直到 2002 年才開始第一次全面重塗；艾菲爾鐵塔 2019 年起的第 20 次重塗首次包含局部除漆。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「維護塗裝決策點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: There are three maintenance strategies: spot repair treats only rusted spots, cheaply, but must be done early; overcoating adds coats over well-adhered old paint to extend its life; full repainting removes all old coating at the highest cost but rebuilds a complete system. The Golden Gate Bridge relies on continuous touch-up, and its owner stresses that it is neither repainted every seven years nor painted end to end each year; from 1965 it removed its lead-based paint for a zinc silicate system, a program completed in 1995. The Forth Bridge, opened in 1890, began its first full repaint only in 2002, and the Eiffel Tower's 20th campaign from 2019 included stripping parts of the structure for the first time. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Maintenance-painting decision point” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：某區第 10 年達 Ri 2（約 0.5% 生鏽面積），若生鏽面積每 3 年加倍：0.5%×2⁴ = 8%，約在 10 + 4×3 = 22 年達 Ri 4。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A zone reaches Ri 2 (about 0.5% rusted area) in year 10; if rusted area doubles every 3 years, 0.5%×2⁴ = 8% is reached at about 10 + 4×3 = 22 years, Ri 4.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「大型鋼橋必須定期從一端塗到另一端，永不停止。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A large steel bridge must be painted continuously from one end to the other, forever." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「維護塗裝決策點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Maintenance-painting decision point”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 局部修補、覆塗或全面重塗
knowledge.titleEn: Spot repair, overcoating or full repainting
knowledge.text: 維護策略有三種：局部修補只處理生鏽點，成本低但須及早進行；覆塗是在附著良好的舊塗層上加塗，延長壽命；全面重塗則把舊塗層全部去除，成本最高但可重建完整系統。金門大橋採持續修補，官方強調重塗不是每七年一次、也不是每年從頭塗到尾；它在 1965 年起移除含鉛塗料並改用鋅矽酸鹽系統，至 1995 年完成。
knowledge.textEn: There are three maintenance strategies: spot repair treats only rusted spots, cheaply, but must be done early; overcoating adds coats over well-adhered old paint to extend its life; full repainting removes all old coating at the highest cost but rebuilds a complete system. The Golden Gate Bridge relies on continuous touch-up, and its owner stresses that it is neither repainted every seven years nor painted end to end each year; from 1965 it removed its lead-based paint for a zinc silicate system, a program completed in 1995.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：大型鋼橋必須定期從一端塗到另一端，永不停止。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A large steel bridge must be painted continuously from one end to the other, forever. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「局部修補、覆塗或全面重塗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spot repair, overcoating or full repainting" is correct?
options: 維護策略有三種：局部修補只處理生鏽點，成本低但須及早進行；覆塗是在附著良好的舊塗層上加塗，延長壽命；全面重塗則把舊塗層全部去除，成本最高但可重建完整系統。
大型鋼橋必須定期從一端塗到另一端，永不停止。
塗裝完成後，只要保存顏色編號就足以進行日後維護。
optionsEn: There are three maintenance strategies: spot repair treats only rusted spots, cheaply, but must be done early.
A large steel bridge must be painted continuously from one end to the other, forever.
After coating, keeping the colour code is enough for future maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 維護策略有三種：局部修補只處理生鏽點，成本低但須及早進行；覆塗是在附著良好的舊塗層上加塗，延長壽命；全面重塗則把舊塗層全部去除，成本最高但可重建完整系統。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: There are three maintenance strategies: spot repair treats only rusted spots, cheaply, but must be done early; overcoating adds coats over well-adhered old paint to extend its life; full repainting removes all old coating at the highest cost but rebuilds a complete system. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 局部修補、覆塗或全面重塗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spot repair, overcoating or full repainting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「維護塗裝決策點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Maintenance-painting decision point” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某區第 10 年達 Ri 2（約 0.5% 生鏽面積），若生鏽面積每 3 年加倍：0.5%×2⁴ = 8%，約在 10 + 4×3 = 22 年達 Ri 4。局部修補的經濟窗口約在第 10 至 13 年（Ri 2 至 Ri 3）；錯過後只能以覆塗或全面重塗處理。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A zone reaches Ri 2 (about 0.5% rusted area) in year 10; if rusted area doubles every 3 years, 0.5%×2⁴ = 8% is reached at about 10 + 4×3 = 22 years, Ri 4. The economic window for spot repair is roughly years 10 to 13 (Ri 2 to Ri 3); after that only overcoating or full repainting remain. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：選擇覆塗前，先在舊塗層上做附著力與相容性試驗區，確認舊系統可承受新塗層的收縮應力；選擇全面重塗前，檢測舊塗層是否含鉛或其他有害物質，以決定圍封與廢棄物處理等級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before overcoating, run adhesion and compatibility trial patches on the old coating to confirm it can carry the shrinkage stress of new coats; before full repainting, test old coatings for lead or other hazardous substances to set containment and waste-handling levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 某區第 10 年達 Ri 2（約 0.5% 生鏽面積），若生鏽面積每 3 年加倍：0.5%×2⁴ = 8%，約在 10 + 4×3 = 22 年達 Ri 4。局部修補的經濟窗口約在第 10 至 13 年（Ri 2 至 Ri 3）；錯過後只能以覆塗或全面重塗處理。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A zone reaches Ri 2 (about 0.5% rusted area) in year 10; if rusted area doubles every 3 years, 0.5%×2⁴ = 8% is reached at about 10 + 4×3 = 22 years, Ri 4. The economic window for spot repair is roughly years 10 to 13 (Ri 2 to Ri 3); after that only overcoating or full repainting remain. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「局部修補、覆塗或全面重塗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spot repair, overcoating or full repainting", which statement holds?
options: 塗裝主要是為了顏色與外觀，防蝕效果與塗層層次無關。
某區第 10 年達 Ri 2（約 0.5% 生鏽面積），若生鏽面積每 3 年加倍：0.5%×2⁴ = 8%，約在 10 + 4×3 = 22 年達 Ri 4。
塗裝問題只能靠塗料品質解決，與結構細部無關。
optionsEn: Coatings are mainly for colour and looks, and the number of layers does not matter for protection.
A zone reaches Ri 2 (about 0.5% rusted area) in year 10; if rusted area doubles every 3 years, 0.5%×2⁴ = 8% is reached at about 10 + 4×3 = 22 years, Ri 4.
Coating problems are solved only by better paint, not by structural detailing.
quiz.explanation: 某區第 10 年達 Ri 2（約 0.5% 生鏽面積），若生鏽面積每 3 年加倍：0.5%×2⁴ = 8%，約在 10 + 4×3 = 22 年達 Ri 4。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A zone reaches Ri 2 (about 0.5% rusted area) in year 10; if rusted area doubles every 3 years, 0.5%×2⁴ = 8% is reached at about 10 + 4×3 = 22 years, Ri 4. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 局部修補、覆塗或全面重塗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spot repair, overcoating or full repainting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「維護塗裝決策點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Maintenance-painting decision point” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 選擇覆塗前，先在舊塗層上做附著力與相容性試驗區，確認舊系統可承受新塗層的收縮應力；選擇全面重塗前，檢測舊塗層是否含鉛或其他有害物質，以決定圍封與廢棄物處理等級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before overcoating, run adhesion and compatibility trial patches on the old coating to confirm it can carry the shrinkage stress of new coats; before full repainting, test old coatings for lead or other hazardous substances to set containment and waste-handling levels. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護計畫應以狀態評級、附著力與有害物質檢測為依據，逐區選擇修補、覆塗或全面重塗，並由業主的結構與塗裝工程師共同核定；重大重塗工程須評估施工架載重與交通影響，並取得相關主管機關核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance plan should choose spot repair, overcoat or full repaint zone by zone from condition ratings, adhesion and hazardous-material tests, approved jointly by the owner's structural and coating engineers; major repainting must assess scaffold loads and traffic impact and obtain the relevant authority approvals.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在附著力已不足的舊塗層上直接覆塗，新塗層的收縮把舊塗層一起拉起，整片剝落；錯過局部修補時機，原本只需處理數百平方公尺的生鏽點，演變成全面重塗。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overcoating old paint that has already lost adhesion lets the new coat's shrinkage lift both layers off together in sheets; missing the spot-repair window turns a few hundred square metres of rust spots into a full repaint. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 選擇覆塗前，先在舊塗層上做附著力與相容性試驗區，確認舊系統可承受新塗層的收縮應力；選擇全面重塗前，檢測舊塗層是否含鉛或其他有害物質，以決定圍封與廢棄物處理等級。
knowledge.textEn: Before overcoating, run adhesion and compatibility trial patches on the old coating to confirm it can carry the shrinkage stress of new coats; before full repainting, test old coatings for lead or other hazardous substances to set containment and waste-handling levels.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護計畫應以狀態評級、附著力與有害物質檢測為依據，逐區選擇修補、覆塗或全面重塗，並由業主的結構與塗裝工程師共同核定；重大重塗工程須評估施工架載重與交通影響，並取得相關主管機關核准。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance plan should choose spot repair, overcoat or full repaint zone by zone from condition ratings, adhesion and hazardous-material tests, approved jointly by the owner's structural and coating engineers; major repainting must assess scaffold loads and traffic impact and obtain the relevant authority approvals.

quiz.question: 要驗證「局部修補、覆塗或全面重塗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Spot repair, overcoating or full repainting"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
塗膜越厚越好，超過規定厚度只會更耐久。
選擇覆塗前，先在舊塗層上做附著力與相容性試驗區，確認舊系統可承受新塗層的收縮應力；選擇全面重塗前，檢測舊塗層是否含鉛或其他有害物質，以決定圍封與廢棄物處理等級。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The thicker the film the better; exceeding the specified thickness only adds durability.
Before overcoating, run adhesion and compatibility trial patches on the old coating to confirm it can carry the shrinkage stress of new coats.
quiz.explanation: 選擇覆塗前，先在舊塗層上做附著力與相容性試驗區，確認舊系統可承受新塗層的收縮應力；選擇全面重塗前，檢測舊塗層是否含鉛或其他有害物質，以決定圍封與廢棄物處理等級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before overcoating, run adhesion and compatibility trial patches on the old coating to confirm it can carry the shrinkage stress of new coats; before full repainting, test old coatings for lead or other hazardous substances to set containment and waste-handling levels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 局部修補、覆塗或全面重塗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spot repair, overcoating or full repainting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「維護塗裝決策點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Maintenance-painting decision point” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在附著力已不足的舊塗層上直接覆塗，新塗層的收縮把舊塗層一起拉起，整片剝落；錯過局部修補時機，原本只需處理數百平方公尺的生鏽點，演變成全面重塗。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Overcoating old paint that has already lost adhesion lets the new coat's shrinkage lift both layers off together in sheets; missing the spot-repair window turns a few hundred square metres of rust spots into a full repaint. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：福斯鐵橋在 1890 年通車後直到 2002 年才開始第一次全面重塗；艾菲爾鐵塔 2019 年起的第 20 次重塗首次包含局部除漆。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Forth Bridge, opened in 1890, began its first full repaint only in 2002, and the Eiffel Tower's 20th campaign from 2019 included stripping parts of the structure for the first time.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「大型鋼橋必須定期從一端塗到另一端，永不停止。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A large steel bridge must be painted continuously from one end to the other, forever." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在附著力已不足的舊塗層上直接覆塗，新塗層的收縮把舊塗層一起拉起，整片剝落；錯過局部修補時機，原本只需處理數百平方公尺的生鏽點，演變成全面重塗。

steps.title: 塗裝紀錄、環保要求與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Coating records, environmental rules and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塗裝履歷與色彩規格」如何影響大型鋼構防蝕塗裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coating history and colour specification” governs force, deformation or durability in “Protective coating of large steel structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大型鋼構的塗裝會經歷數十年與多個世代的產品與法規：金門大橋的原始塗料是約含 68% 紅丹膏的亞麻仁油含鉛漆，後來為了符合揮發性有機物空氣品質規定，在 1990 年把面漆由乙烯系改為壓克力乳膠；其國際橘的色彩規格也被精確記錄，由 Sherwin-Williams 供應塗料。交接文件要記錄每一區的系統、產品與批號、表面處理等級、膜厚圖、附著力試驗、環境紀錄與修補履歷，讓下一次維護知道底下是什麼。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塗裝履歷與色彩規格」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Coatings on large steel structures span decades and several generations of products and regulations: the Golden Gate Bridge's original paint was a lead-based linseed-oil paint of about 68% red lead paste, and in 1990 its topcoat changed from vinyl to acrylic emulsion to meet air-quality rules on volatile organic compounds; its International Orange is precisely specified, with paint supplied by Sherwin-Williams. Handover documents must record, zone by zone, the system, products and batches, preparation grade, thickness maps, adhesion tests, environmental logs and repair history, so the next maintenance team knows what lies beneath. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Coating history and colour specification” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：揮發性有機物排放 = 塗料量 × VOC 含量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: VOC emissions = paint volume × VOC content.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塗裝完成後，只要保存顏色編號就足以進行日後維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "After coating, keeping the colour code is enough for future maintenance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 塗裝紀錄、環保要求與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Coating records, environmental rules and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塗裝履歷與色彩規格」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Coating history and colour specification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：揮發性有機物排放 = 塗料量 × VOC 含量。100,000 L 塗料、VOC 300 g/L：100,000×300 = 30,000,000 g = 30 t；改用 100 g/L 的低 VOC 產品則為 10 t，減少三分之二，但須確認新產品的施工窗口與膜厚性能。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: VOC emissions = paint volume × VOC content. 100,000 L of paint at 300 g/L releases 100,000×300 = 30,000,000 g = 30 t; switching to a 100 g/L low-VOC product gives 10 t, two thirds less, provided its application window and film performance are confirmed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前抽查數個分區，從現場標示追溯到產品批號、膜厚圖、附著力與環境紀錄，確認紀錄完整；檢查舊塗層有害物質調查報告與廢棄物處理文件是否歸檔，並確認色彩規格與產品編號已寫入維護手冊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, sample several zones and trace site labels back to product batches, thickness maps, adhesion and environmental records to confirm completeness; check that hazardous-material surveys of old coatings and waste-disposal documents are filed, and that colour specifications and product codes are written into the maintenance manual.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 揮發性有機物排放 = 塗料量 × VOC 含量。100,000 L 塗料、VOC 300 g/L：100,000×300 = 30,000,000 g = 30 t；改用 100 g/L 的低 VOC 產品則為 10 t，減少三分之二，但須確認新產品的施工窗口與膜厚性能。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: VOC emissions = paint volume × VOC content. 100,000 L of paint at 300 g/L releases 100,000×300 = 30,000,000 g = 30 t; switching to a 100 g/L low-VOC product gives 10 t, two thirds less, provided its application window and film performance are confirmed. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 塗裝紀錄、環保要求與交接：試驗與驗證
