steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塗裝履歷與色彩規格」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Coating history and colour specification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前抽查數個分區，從現場標示追溯到產品批號、膜厚圖、附著力與環境紀錄，確認紀錄完整；檢查舊塗層有害物質調查報告與廢棄物處理文件是否歸檔，並確認色彩規格與產品編號已寫入維護手冊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, sample several zones and trace site labels back to product batches, thickness maps, adhesion and environmental records to confirm completeness; check that hazardous-material surveys of old coatings and waste-disposal documents are filed, and that colour specifications and product codes are written into the maintenance manual. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主應維持專職或長期合約的塗裝維護團隊與塗裝履歷資料庫，金門大橋即有 28 名塗裝工、13 名鐵工等常設人員；所有新產品、法規變更與修補都更新到資料庫，並由塗裝主管定期審查維護計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner should keep a dedicated or long-term coating maintenance team and a coating-history database, as the Golden Gate Bridge does with a standing crew including 28 painters and 13 ironworkers; every new product, regulatory change and repair is added to the database, and the chief painter reviews the maintenance plan periodically.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若沒有紀錄舊塗層是否含鉛，後續維護時以一般噴砂方式處理，工人與周邊環境暴露在含鉛粉塵中，工程被迫停工並增加清理成本；不知道原系統成分而選錯修補漆，也會造成相容性問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without records of whether old coatings contain lead, later maintenance may blast them conventionally, exposing workers and surroundings to lead dust, forcing a stop and adding clean-up cost; not knowing the original system can also lead to an incompatible repair paint. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover documents must record, zone by zone, the system, products and batches, preparation grade, thickness maps, adhesion tests, environmental logs and repair history, so the next maintenance team knows what lies beneath.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塗裝完成後，只要保存顏色編號就足以進行日後維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "After coating, keeping the colour code is enough for future maintenance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若沒有紀錄舊塗層是否含鉛，後續維護時以一般噴砂方式處理，工人與周邊環境暴露在含鉛粉塵中，工程被迫停工並增加清理成本；不知道原系統成分而選錯修補漆，也會造成相容性問題。
knowledge.textEn: Without records of whether old coatings contain lead, later maintenance may blast them conventionally, exposing workers and surroundings to lead dust, forcing a stop and adding clean-up cost; not knowing the original system can also lead to an incompatible repair paint.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「塗裝紀錄、環保要求與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Coating records, environmental rules and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若沒有紀錄舊塗層是否含鉛，後續維護時以一般噴砂方式處理，工人與周邊環境暴露在含鉛粉塵中，工程被迫停工並增加清理成本。
同一座橋的所有部位都處在相同的腐蝕環境中。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without records of whether old coatings contain lead, later maintenance may blast them conventionally, exposing workers and surroundings to lead dust, forcing a stop and adding clean-up cost.
Every part of a bridge sits in the same corrosive environment.
quiz.explanation: 若沒有紀錄舊塗層是否含鉛，後續維護時以一般噴砂方式處理，工人與周邊環境暴露在含鉛粉塵中，工程被迫停工並增加清理成本；不知道原系統成分而選錯修補漆，也會造成相容性問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without records of whether old coatings contain lead, later maintenance may blast them conventionally, exposing workers and surroundings to lead dust, forcing a stop and adding clean-up cost; not knowing the original system can also lead to an incompatible repair paint. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 結構抗連鎖倒塌設計
summary: 從 Ronan Point、世界貿易中心 7 號大樓與 Champlain Towers South 的教訓出發，建立異常荷載的風險觀念與拆柱後的荷載重分配，學習拉結力法、板柱穿孔剪力與完整性鋼筋、懸鏈作用與接頭轉角，再談施工符合性、子結構試驗與能量法、既有建築腐蝕評估、火災熱膨脹觸發的倒塌，以及使用期間的荷載變更管理與交接。
summaryEn: Starting from the lessons of Ronan Point, World Trade Center 7 and Champlain Towers South, build the risk view of abnormal loads and the load redistribution after column loss, learn the tie-force method, slab–column punching shear and integrity reinforcement, catenary action and connection rotation, then cover construction conformance, subassembly tests and the energy method, corrosion assessment of existing buildings, fire-triggered collapse through thermal expansion, and load-change management and handover in service.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某鋼筋混凝土構架柱距 8 m，D = 6.0 kPa、L = 3.0 kPa。樓面荷載 w_F = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa。拉結力法：F_i = 3·w_F·L₁ = 3×8.7×8 ≈ 209 kN/m，取 f_y = 420 MPa、φ = 0.75，需 A_s ≈ 663 mm²/m。替代路徑：拆除一根內柱後，8 m 受載寬度的梁線荷載 w = 69.6 kN/m，跨度由 8 m 變 16 m，固端彎矩由約 371 kN·m 增為約 1,485 kN·m，乘動力放大 2.0 後約 2,970 kN·m，為原值 8 倍，一般梁斷面無法以抗彎承受。改用懸鏈作用：轉角 0.20 rad 時下垂 δ ≈ 1.62 m，拉力 T ≈ 69.6×16²/(8×1.62) ≈ 1,373 kN，小於 8 m 寬拉結筋總強度約 1,670 kN，但接頭必須在 0.20 rad 下仍能傳遞拉力，外柱也要承受同量級的內拉力。若跨度 L₁ 改為 10 m（受載寬度仍為 8 m），F_i 增為約 261 kN/m，拆柱後跨度 20 m，懸鏈拉力在相同轉角下約增為 1.25 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a reinforced-concrete frame on an 8 m grid carries D = 6.0 kPa and L = 3.0 kPa, so w_F = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa. Tie-force method: F_i = 3·w_F·L₁ = 3×8.7×8 ≈ 209 kN/m, needing A_s ≈ 663 mm²/m with f_y = 420 MPa and φ = 0.75. Alternate path: after removing an interior column, the beam line load over an 8 m tributary width is w = 69.6 kN/m and the span grows from 8 to 16 m, so the fixed-end moment rises from about 371 to about 1,485 kN·m and, with a dynamic amplification of 2.0, to about 2,970 kN·m, eight times the original and beyond what an ordinary beam section can resist in bending. Relying on catenary action instead: at 0.20 rad the sag is δ ≈ 1.62 m and the tension T ≈ 69.6×16²/(8×1.62) ≈ 1,373 kN, below the roughly 1,670 kN strength of ties across 8 m, provided the connections still carry tension at 0.20 rad and the perimeter columns resist an inward pull of the same order. If L₁ becomes 10 m with the tributary width kept at 8 m, F_i rises to about 261 kN/m, the post-loss span becomes 20 m and catenary tension at the same rotation grows by about 1.25 times. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「異常荷載與不成比例倒塌」與「拆柱後的荷載重分配與動力放大」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Abnormal loads and disproportionate collapse" and "Load redistribution and dynamic amplification after column loss": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 異常荷載與不成比例倒塌：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Abnormal loads and disproportionate collapse: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「局部破壞範圍」如何影響結構抗連鎖倒塌設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Extent of local damage” governs force, deformation or durability in “Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 連鎖倒塌（不成比例倒塌）是指一個局部破壞，例如一根柱或一片承重牆因爆炸、撞擊、火災或施工錯誤失效，沿著荷載路徑擴散，最後造成與起因不成比例的大範圍倒塌。1968 年倫敦 22 層預鑄大板住宅 Ronan Point 在 18 樓角落發生瓦斯爆炸，吹出一片承重牆，上方樓層失去支承後連續塌落，促成英國建築法規加入不成比例倒塌條文。設計目標不是讓結構在任何事件中毫髮無傷，而是把損壞限制在可接受範圍，例如 Eurocode 以樓層面積 15% 或 100 m² 取小者為限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「局部破壞範圍」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Progressive or disproportionate collapse occurs when local damage, such as a column or load-bearing wall lost to explosion, impact, fire or construction error, spreads along the load path until the collapse is out of proportion to its cause. In 1968 a gas explosion in a corner flat on the 18th floor of Ronan Point, a 22-storey precast large-panel block in London, blew out a load-bearing wall, and the floors above, having lost support, fell in sequence; the event led UK building regulations to adopt disproportionate-collapse provisions. The design goal is not to survive every event unscathed but to confine damage to an acceptable extent, for example the Eurocode limit of 15% of the floor area or 100 m², whichever is smaller. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Extent of local damage” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以常見的風險分解 P(C) = P(H)·P(D|H)·P(C|D)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A common risk decomposition is P(C) = P(H)·P(D|H)·P(C|D).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要結構符合耐震規範，就一定不會發生連鎖倒塌。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A structure that satisfies the seismic code can never suffer progressive collapse." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「局部破壞範圍」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Extent of local damage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 異常荷載與不成比例倒塌
knowledge.text: 連鎖倒塌（不成比例倒塌）是指一個局部破壞，例如一根柱或一片承重牆因爆炸、撞擊、火災或施工錯誤失效，沿著荷載路徑擴散，最後造成與起因不成比例的大範圍倒塌。1968 年倫敦 22 層預鑄大板住宅 Ronan Point 在 18 樓角落發生瓦斯爆炸，吹出一片承重牆，上方樓層失去支承後連續塌落，促成英國建築法規加入不成比例倒塌條文。
knowledge.textEn: Progressive or disproportionate collapse occurs when local damage, such as a column or load-bearing wall lost to explosion, impact, fire or construction error, spreads along the load path until the collapse is out of proportion to its cause. In 1968 a gas explosion in a corner flat on the 18th floor of Ronan Point, a 22-storey precast large-panel block in London, blew out a load-bearing wall, and the floors above, having lost support, fell in sequence; the event led UK building regulations to adopt disproportionate-collapse provisions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要結構符合耐震規範，就一定不會發生連鎖倒塌。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A structure that satisfies the seismic code can never suffer progressive collapse. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「異常荷載與不成比例倒塌」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Abnormal loads and disproportionate collapse" is correct?
options: 只要結構符合耐震規範，就一定不會發生連鎖倒塌。
連鎖倒塌（不成比例倒塌）是指一個局部破壞，例如一根柱或一片承重牆因爆炸、撞擊、火災或施工錯誤失效，沿著荷載路徑擴散，最後造成與起因不成比例的大範圍倒塌。
柱失效時，上方荷載會慢慢轉移，用靜力分析就足夠。
optionsEn: A structure that satisfies the seismic code can never suffer progressive collapse.

Progressive or disproportionate collapse occurs when local damage, such as a column or load-bearing wall lost to explosion, impact, fire or construction error, spreads along the load path until the collapse is out of proportion to its cause.
When a column fails, the load above transfers slowly, so static analysis is enough.
quiz.explanation: 連鎖倒塌（不成比例倒塌）是指一個局部破壞，例如一根柱或一片承重牆因爆炸、撞擊、火災或施工錯誤失效，沿著荷載路徑擴散，最後造成與起因不成比例的大範圍倒塌。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Progressive or disproportionate collapse occurs when local damage, such as a column or load-bearing wall lost to explosion, impact, fire or construction error, spreads along the load path until the collapse is out of proportion to its cause. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 異常荷載與不成比例倒塌：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Abnormal loads and disproportionate collapse: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「局部破壞範圍」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Extent of local damage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以常見的風險分解 P(C) = P(H)·P(D|H)·P(C|D)。取異常事件年發生率 P(H) = 1×10⁻⁴、事件造成局部破壞的機率 P(D|H) = 0.5、局部破壞後倒塌的機率 P(C|D) = 0.2，P(C) = 1×10⁻⁵/年；以替代路徑設計把 P(C|D) 降到 0.01，P(C) = 5×10⁻⁷/年，降低 20 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A common risk decomposition is P(C) = P(H)·P(D|H)·P(C|D). With an annual abnormal-event rate P(H) = 1×10⁻⁴, a probability of local damage P(D|H) = 0.5 and a probability of collapse given local damage P(C|D) = 0.2, P(C) = 1×10⁻⁵ per year; designing alternate paths that cut P(C|D) to 0.01 gives P(C) = 5×10⁻⁷ per year, 20 times lower. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計初期與業主確認建築的風險類別或後果等級，例如 UFC 4-023-03 的 RC I 至 RC IV，據以決定採用拉結力、替代路徑或局部強化的組合；審查時核對每個假設事件與可接受的局部破壞範圍是否寫入設計基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Early in design, agree the building's risk or consequence class with the owner, for example RC I to RC IV in UFC 4-023-03, and use it to choose the combination of tie forces, alternate paths and enhanced local resistance; at review, check that every postulated event and the acceptable extent of local damage are written into the design basis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以常見的風險分解 P(C) = P(H)·P(D|H)·P(C|D)。取異常事件年發生率 P(H) = 1×10⁻⁴、事件造成局部破壞的機率 P(D|H) = 0.5、局部破壞後倒塌的機率 P(C|D) = 0.2，P(C) = 1×10⁻⁵/年；以替代路徑設計把 P(C|D) 降到 0.01，P(C) = 5×10⁻⁷/年，降低 20 倍。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A common risk decomposition is P(C) = P(H)·P(D|H)·P(C|D). With an annual abnormal-event rate P(H) = 1×10⁻⁴, a probability of local damage P(D|H) = 0.5 and a probability of collapse given local damage P(C|D) = 0.2, P(C) = 1×10⁻⁵ per year; designing alternate paths that cut P(C|D) to 0.01 gives P(C) = 5×10⁻⁷ per year, 20 times lower. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「異常荷載與不成比例倒塌」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Abnormal loads and disproportionate collapse", which statement holds?
options: 無梁版的穿孔剪力破壞前，一定會有很大的撓度可以預警。
鋼筋數量與圖面相同，就代表結構的抗倒塌能力與設計相同。
以常見的風險分解 P(C) = P(H)·P(D|H)·P(C|D)。
optionsEn: Punching shear in a flat plate is always preceded by large, warning deflections.
If the number of bars matches the drawings, collapse resistance matches the design.
A common risk decomposition is P(C) = P(H)·P(D|H)·P(C|D).
quiz.explanation: 以常見的風險分解 P(C) = P(H)·P(D|H)·P(C|D)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A common risk decomposition is P(C) = P(H)·P(D|H)·P(C|D). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 異常荷載與不成比例倒塌：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Abnormal loads and disproportionate collapse: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「局部破壞範圍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Extent of local damage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計初期與業主確認建築的風險類別或後果等級，例如 UFC 4-023-03 的 RC I 至 RC IV，據以決定採用拉結力、替代路徑或局部強化的組合；審查時核對每個假設事件與可接受的局部破壞範圍是否寫入設計基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Early in design, agree the building's risk or consequence class with the owner, for example RC I to RC IV in UFC 4-023-03, and use it to choose the combination of tie forces, alternate paths and enhanced local resistance; at review, check that every postulated event and the acceptable extent of local damage are written into the design basis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 異常荷載與不成比例倒塌：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Abnormal loads and disproportionate collapse: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部破壞範圍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Extent of local damage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只依一般重力與地震規範設計，構件接合只滿足正常傳力方向，一旦承重牆或柱失效，樓板無法改以懸吊或懸臂方式傳力，上方樓層逐層塌落；Ronan Point 的調查即指出樓板與牆板接合未考慮荷載方向改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing only to ordinary gravity and seismic rules leaves connections able to transfer load in the normal direction only; once a wall or column is lost, floors cannot switch to hanging or cantilever action and the storeys above collapse one by one, and the Ronan Point inquiry found that slab-to-wall joints had not considered such load reversal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計目標不是讓結構在任何事件中毫髮無傷，而是把損壞限制在可接受範圍，例如 Eurocode 以樓層面積 15% 或 100 m² 取小者為限。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The design goal is not to survive every event unscathed but to confine damage to an acceptable extent, for example the Eurocode limit of 15% of the floor area or 100 m², whichever is smaller.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要結構符合耐震規範，就一定不會發生連鎖倒塌。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A structure that satisfies the seismic code can never suffer progressive collapse." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只依一般重力與地震規範設計，構件接合只滿足正常傳力方向，一旦承重牆或柱失效，樓板無法改以懸吊或懸臂方式傳力，上方樓層逐層塌落；Ronan Point 的調查即指出樓板與牆板接合未考慮荷載方向改變。
knowledge.textEn: Designing only to ordinary gravity and seismic rules leaves connections able to transfer load in the normal direction only; once a wall or column is lost, floors cannot switch to hanging or cantilever action and the storeys above collapse one by one, and the Ronan Point inquiry found that slab-to-wall joints had not considered such load reversal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「異常荷載與不成比例倒塌」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Abnormal loads and disproportionate collapse" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只依一般重力與地震規範設計，構件接合只滿足正常傳力方向，一旦承重牆或柱失效，樓板無法改以懸吊或懸臂方式傳力，上方樓層逐層塌落。
柱失效時，上方荷載會慢慢轉移，用靜力分析就足夠。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Designing only to ordinary gravity and seismic rules leaves connections able to transfer load in the normal direction only.
When a column fails, the load above transfers slowly, so static analysis is enough.
quiz.explanation: 若只依一般重力與地震規範設計，構件接合只滿足正常傳力方向，一旦承重牆或柱失效，樓板無法改以懸吊或懸臂方式傳力，上方樓層逐層塌落；Ronan Point 的調查即指出樓板與牆板接合未考慮荷載方向改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing only to ordinary gravity and seismic rules leaves connections able to transfer load in the normal direction only; once a wall or column is lost, floors cannot switch to hanging or cantilever action and the storeys above collapse one by one, and the Ronan Point inquiry found that slab-to-wall joints had not considered such load reversal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 拆柱後的荷載重分配與動力放大：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load redistribution and dynamic amplification after column loss: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「移除柱上方雙跨梁」如何影響結構抗連鎖倒塌設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Double-span beam over a removed column” governs force, deformation or durability in “Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 替代路徑法假設某一根柱突然消失，檢查上方結構能否把荷載繞到相鄰柱。原本兩跨各自受力的梁變成跨度加倍的單跨梁，支承處負彎矩與跨中正彎矩都大幅增加，原本柱頂的負彎矩區甚至反轉為正彎矩，因此下層鋼筋必須連續。柱是瞬間失效而非緩慢卸載，結構會往下衝過靜力平衡位置；對線彈性系統而言，突然施加的荷載使最大變形約為靜態的兩倍，所以線性靜力分析常需乘上荷載放大係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「移除柱上方雙跨梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The alternate-path method assumes a column suddenly disappears and checks whether the structure above can route its load to adjacent columns. Two beams that worked as separate spans become one beam of double span, so hogging moments at supports and sagging moments at midspan rise sharply, and the former hogging zone over the lost column reverses into sagging, which is why bottom reinforcement must be continuous. Because the column fails instantly rather than unloading slowly, the structure overshoots its static equilibrium; for a linear elastic system a suddenly applied load produces about twice the static deformation, so linear static analysis usually applies a load increase factor. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Double-span beam over a removed column” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：樓面荷載 w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa，8 m 受載寬度的線荷載 w = 69.6 kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Floor load w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa, so an 8 m tributary width gives w = 69.6 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「柱失效時，上方荷載會慢慢轉移，用靜力分析就足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "When a column fails, the load above transfers slowly, so static analysis is enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「移除柱上方雙跨梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Double-span beam over a removed column”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拆柱後的荷載重分配與動力放大
knowledge.titleEn: Load redistribution and dynamic amplification after column loss
knowledge.text: 替代路徑法假設某一根柱突然消失，檢查上方結構能否把荷載繞到相鄰柱。原本兩跨各自受力的梁變成跨度加倍的單跨梁，支承處負彎矩與跨中正彎矩都大幅增加，原本柱頂的負彎矩區甚至反轉為正彎矩，因此下層鋼筋必須連續。
knowledge.textEn: The alternate-path method assumes a column suddenly disappears and checks whether the structure above can route its load to adjacent columns. Two beams that worked as separate spans become one beam of double span, so hogging moments at supports and sagging moments at midspan rise sharply, and the former hogging zone over the lost column reverses into sagging, which is why bottom reinforcement must be continuous.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：柱失效時，上方荷載會慢慢轉移，用靜力分析就足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: When a column fails, the load above transfers slowly, so static analysis is enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拆柱後的荷載重分配與動力放大」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load redistribution and dynamic amplification after column loss" is correct?
options: 柱失效時，上方荷載會慢慢轉移，用靜力分析就足夠。
拉結筋只要總面積足夠，在哪裡斷開都沒有關係。
替代路徑法假設某一根柱突然消失，檢查上方結構能否把荷載繞到相鄰柱。
optionsEn: When a column fails, the load above transfers slowly, so static analysis is enough.
As long as the total tie area is sufficient, it does not matter where the bars are interrupted.
The alternate-path method assumes a column suddenly disappears and checks whether the structure above can route its load to adjacent columns.
quiz.explanation: 替代路徑法假設某一根柱突然消失，檢查上方結構能否把荷載繞到相鄰柱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The alternate-path method assumes a column suddenly disappears and checks whether the structure above can route its load to adjacent columns. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拆柱後的荷載重分配與動力放大：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load redistribution and dynamic amplification after column loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「移除柱上方雙跨梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Double-span beam over a removed column” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：樓面荷載 w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa，8 m 受載寬度的線荷載 w = 69.6 kN/m。原跨 8 m 兩端固接時 M = wL²/12 ≈ 371 kN·m；拆柱後跨度 16 m，M ≈ 69.6×16²/12 ≈ 1,485 kN·m，再乘突加荷載的動力放大 2.0，約 2,970 kN·m，為原值的 8 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Floor load w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa, so an 8 m tributary width gives w = 69.6 kN/m. For the original 8 m span with fixed ends, M = wL²/12 ≈ 371 kN·m; after column loss the span is 16 m and M ≈ 69.6×16²/12 ≈ 1,485 kN·m, and with a dynamic amplification of 2.0 for sudden loading about 2,970 kN·m, eight times the original. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以線性靜力、非線性靜力或非線性動力程序之一進行拆柱分析，檢查構件與接頭的強度或轉角是否在允收值內；同一模型至少檢查角柱、長向與短向外柱中央及內柱等多個位置，並比較不同程序的結果是否合理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Carry out column-removal analysis by a linear static, nonlinear static or nonlinear dynamic procedure and check that member and connection strengths or rotations are within acceptance limits; examine several locations in the same model, at least a corner column, columns near the middle of the long and short sides and an interior column, and compare results between procedures for reasonableness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 樓面荷載 w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa，8 m 受載寬度的線荷載 w = 69.6 kN/m。原跨 8 m 兩端固接時 M = wL²/12 ≈ 371 kN·m；拆柱後跨度 16 m，M ≈ 69.6×16²/12 ≈ 1,485 kN·m，再乘突加荷載的動力放大 2.0，約 2,970 kN·m，為原值的 8 倍。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Floor load w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa, so an 8 m tributary width gives w = 69.6 kN/m. For the original 8 m span with fixed ends, M = wL²/12 ≈ 371 kN·m; after column loss the span is 16 m and M ≈ 69.6×16²/12 ≈ 1,485 kN·m, and with a dynamic amplification of 2.0 for sudden loading about 2,970 kN·m, eight times the original. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拆柱後的荷載重分配與動力放大」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load redistribution and dynamic amplification after column loss", which statement holds?
options: 只要梁的抗彎強度足夠，拆柱後就不需要考慮懸鏈作用。
靜力推覆試驗得到的最大力，就等於突然拆柱時結構能承受的荷載。
optionsEn: Floor load w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa, so an 8 m tributary width gives w = 69.6 kN/m.
If the beam has enough bending strength, catenary action need not be considered after column loss.
The peak force from a static push-down test equals the load the structure can carry after sudden column loss.
quiz.explanation: 樓面荷載 w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa，8 m 受載寬度的線荷載 w = 69.6 kN/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Floor load w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa, so an 8 m tributary width gives w = 69.6 kN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拆柱後的荷載重分配與動力放大：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load redistribution and dynamic amplification after column loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「移除柱上方雙跨梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Double-span beam over a removed column” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以線性靜力、非線性靜力或非線性動力程序之一進行拆柱分析，檢查構件與接頭的強度或轉角是否在允收值內；同一模型至少檢查角柱、長向與短向外柱中央及內柱等多個位置，並比較不同程序的結果是否合理。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Carry out column-removal analysis by a linear static, nonlinear static or nonlinear dynamic procedure and check that member and connection strengths or rotations are within acceptance limits; examine several locations in the same model, at least a corner column, columns near the middle of the long and short sides and an interior column, and compare results between procedures for reasonableness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：梁與樓板的下層鋼筋應以搭接或續接器穿越柱線連續，並在圖說標示為拆柱情境必要的連續筋，避免施工時被當作一般鋼筋而在柱頂截斷。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Bottom bars in beams and slabs should run continuously through column lines with laps or couplers, and drawings should flag them as continuity bars required for column-loss scenarios so that site crews do not treat them as ordinary bars and stop them at the column.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只做靜力分析而未計入突然失效的動力效應，需求會被低估約一倍，梁柱接頭在真實事件中先斷裂；若下層鋼筋在柱頂截斷不連續，雙跨梁在原柱位置無法承受反轉的正彎矩，局部破壞直接擴散。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Static analysis without the dynamic effect of sudden loss underestimates demand by about half, so beam–column connections fracture first in a real event; if bottom bars stop short at the column, the double-span beam cannot resist the reversed sagging moment at the lost column and local damage spreads directly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以線性靜力、非線性靜力或非線性動力程序之一進行拆柱分析，檢查構件與接頭的強度或轉角是否在允收值內；同一模型至少檢查角柱、長向與短向外柱中央及內柱等多個位置，並比較不同程序的結果是否合理。
knowledge.textEn: Carry out column-removal analysis by a linear static, nonlinear static or nonlinear dynamic procedure and check that member and connection strengths or rotations are within acceptance limits; examine several locations in the same model, at least a corner column, columns near the middle of the long and short sides and an interior column, and compare results between procedures for reasonableness.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 梁與樓板的下層鋼筋應以搭接或續接器穿越柱線連續，並在圖說標示為拆柱情境必要的連續筋，避免施工時被當作一般鋼筋而在柱頂截斷。
knowledge.textEn: Bottom bars in beams and slabs should run continuously through column lines with laps or couplers, and drawings should flag them as continuity bars required for column-loss scenarios so that site crews do not treat them as ordinary bars and stop them at the column.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拆柱後的荷載重分配與動力放大」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load redistribution and dynamic amplification after column loss"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以線性靜力、非線性靜力或非線性動力程序之一進行拆柱分析，檢查構件與接頭的強度或轉角是否在允收值內。
防火被覆只要滿足耐火時效，就不需要考慮熱膨脹對接頭的影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Carry out column-removal analysis by a linear static, nonlinear static or nonlinear dynamic procedure and check that member and connection strengths or rotations are within acceptance limits.
If fireproofing meets its fire-resistance rating, thermal expansion effects on connections can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 以線性靜力、非線性靜力或非線性動力程序之一進行拆柱分析，檢查構件與接頭的強度或轉角是否在允收值內；同一模型至少檢查角柱、長向與短向外柱中央及內柱等多個位置，並比較不同程序的結果是否合理。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Carry out column-removal analysis by a linear static, nonlinear static or nonlinear dynamic procedure and check that member and connection strengths or rotations are within acceptance limits; examine several locations in the same model, at least a corner column, columns near the middle of the long and short sides and an interior column, and compare results between procedures for reasonableness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拆柱後的荷載重分配與動力放大：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load redistribution and dynamic amplification after column loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「移除柱上方雙跨梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Double-span beam over a removed column” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只做靜力分析而未計入突然失效的動力效應，需求會被低估約一倍，梁柱接頭在真實事件中先斷裂；若下層鋼筋在柱頂截斷不連續，雙跨梁在原柱位置無法承受反轉的正彎矩，局部破壞直接擴散。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Static analysis without the dynamic effect of sudden loss underestimates demand by about half, so beam–column connections fracture first in a real event; if bottom bars stop short at the column, the double-span beam cannot resist the reversed sagging moment at the lost column and local damage spreads directly. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：柱是瞬間失效而非緩慢卸載，結構會往下衝過靜力平衡位置；對線彈性系統而言，突然施加的荷載使最大變形約為靜態的兩倍，所以線性靜力分析常需乘上荷載放大係數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the column fails instantly rather than unloading slowly, the structure overshoots its static equilibrium; for a linear elastic system a suddenly applied load produces about twice the static deformation, so linear static analysis usually applies a load increase factor.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「柱失效時，上方荷載會慢慢轉移，用靜力分析就足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "When a column fails, the load above transfers slowly, so static analysis is enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只做靜力分析而未計入突然失效的動力效應，需求會被低估約一倍，梁柱接頭在真實事件中先斷裂；若下層鋼筋在柱頂截斷不連續，雙跨梁在原柱位置無法承受反轉的正彎矩，局部破壞直接擴散。
knowledge.textEn: Static analysis without the dynamic effect of sudden loss underestimates demand by about half, so beam–column connections fracture first in a real event; if bottom bars stop short at the column, the double-span beam cannot resist the reversed sagging moment at the lost column and local damage spreads directly.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拆柱後的荷載重分配與動力放大」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load redistribution and dynamic amplification after column loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
拉結筋只要總面積足夠，在哪裡斷開都沒有關係。
若只做靜力分析而未計入突然失效的動力效應，需求會被低估約一倍，梁柱接頭在真實事件中先斷裂。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
As long as the total tie area is sufficient, it does not matter where the bars are interrupted.
Static analysis without the dynamic effect of sudden loss underestimates demand by about half, so beam–column connections fracture first in a real event.
quiz.explanation: 若只做靜力分析而未計入突然失效的動力效應，需求會被低估約一倍，梁柱接頭在真實事件中先斷裂；若下層鋼筋在柱頂截斷不連續，雙跨梁在原柱位置無法承受反轉的正彎矩，局部破壞直接擴散。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Static analysis without the dynamic effect of sudden loss underestimates demand by about half, so beam–column connections fracture first in a real event; if bottom bars stop short at the column, the double-span beam cannot resist the reversed sagging moment at the lost column and local damage spreads directly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「拉結力法與結構連續性」與「穿孔剪力與結構完整性鋼筋」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tie-force method and structural continuity" and "Punching shear and structural-integrity reinforcement": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拉結力法與結構連續性：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Tie-force method and structural continuity: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「內部與周邊拉結筋」如何影響結構抗連鎖倒塌設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Internal and peripheral ties” governs force, deformation or durability in “Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 拉結力法是一種間接設計：不必模擬特定事件，而是要求樓板與梁在縱向、橫向、周邊與垂直方向都有足夠的連續受拉鋼筋，使局部失去支承時，樓板能像薄膜或懸鏈一樣把荷載拉回相鄰構件。UFC 4-023-03 以樓面荷載 w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L 與跨度決定內部拉結力，並要求承受拉結力的構件能承受 0.20 rad 的轉角。拉結筋的價值在於連續與錨定：一根在柱邊斷開的鋼筋，帳面面積再大也無效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「內部與周邊拉結筋」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The tie-force method is an indirect design approach: instead of modelling specific events, it requires enough continuous tension reinforcement in floors and beams in the longitudinal, transverse, peripheral and vertical directions that, when local support is lost, the floor can pull the load back to adjacent members as a membrane or catenary. UFC 4-023-03 sets internal tie forces from the floor load w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L and the span, and requires members carrying ties to sustain a rotation of 0.20 rad. The value of a tie lies in continuity and anchorage: a bar cut at the column face is useless however large its area on paper. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Internal and peripheral ties” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：UFC 4-023-03 內部拉結力 F_i = 3·w_F·L₁。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: UFC 4-023-03 gives the internal tie force F_i = 3·w_F·L₁.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拉結筋只要總面積足夠，在哪裡斷開都沒有關係。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the total tie area is sufficient, it does not matter where the bars are interrupted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「內部與周邊拉結筋」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Internal and peripheral ties”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拉結力法與結構連續性
knowledge.text: 拉結力法是一種間接設計：不必模擬特定事件，而是要求樓板與梁在縱向、橫向、周邊與垂直方向都有足夠的連續受拉鋼筋，使局部失去支承時，樓板能像薄膜或懸鏈一樣把荷載拉回相鄰構件。UFC 4-023-03 以樓面荷載 w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L 與跨度決定內部拉結力，並要求承受拉結力的構件能承受 0.20 rad 的轉角。
knowledge.textEn: The tie-force method is an indirect design approach: instead of modelling specific events, it requires enough continuous tension reinforcement in floors and beams in the longitudinal, transverse, peripheral and vertical directions that, when local support is lost, the floor can pull the load back to adjacent members as a membrane or catenary. UFC 4-023-03 sets internal tie forces from the floor load w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L and the span, and requires members carrying ties to sustain a rotation of 0.20 rad.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拉結筋只要總面積足夠，在哪裡斷開都沒有關係。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the total tie area is sufficient, it does not matter where the bars are interrupted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拉結力法與結構連續性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tie-force method and structural continuity" is correct?
options: 拉結力法是一種間接設計：不必模擬特定事件，而是要求樓板與梁在縱向、橫向、周邊與垂直方向都有足夠的連續受拉鋼筋，使局部失去支承時，樓板能像薄膜或懸鏈一樣把荷載拉回相鄰構件。
拉結筋只要總面積足夠，在哪裡斷開都沒有關係。
無梁版的穿孔剪力破壞前，一定會有很大的撓度可以預警。
optionsEn: The tie-force method is an indirect design approach: instead of modelling specific events, it requires enough continuous tension reinforcement in floors and beams in the longitudinal, transverse, peripheral and vertical directions that, when local support is lost, the floor can pull the load back to adjacent members as a membrane or catenary.
As long as the total tie area is sufficient, it does not matter where the bars are interrupted.
Punching shear in a flat plate is always preceded by large, warning deflections.
quiz.explanation: 拉結力法是一種間接設計：不必模擬特定事件，而是要求樓板與梁在縱向、橫向、周邊與垂直方向都有足夠的連續受拉鋼筋，使局部失去支承時，樓板能像薄膜或懸鏈一樣把荷載拉回相鄰構件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The tie-force method is an indirect design approach: instead of modelling specific events, it requires enough continuous tension reinforcement in floors and beams in the longitudinal, transverse, peripheral and vertical directions that, when local support is lost, the floor can pull the load back to adjacent members as a membrane or catenary. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拉結力法與結構連續性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tie-force method and structural continuity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「內部與周邊拉結筋」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Internal and peripheral ties” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：UFC 4-023-03 內部拉結力 F_i = 3·w_F·L₁。w_F = 8.7 kN/m²、L₁ = 8 m 時 F_i = 3×8.7×8 ≈ 209 kN/m；取 f_y = 420 MPa 與強度折減 φ = 0.75（教學假設），所需鋼筋 A_s = 209,000/(0.75×420) ≈ 663 mm²/m，約為每公尺 3 支 D19（3×287 = 861 mm²）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: UFC 4-023-03 gives the internal tie force F_i = 3·w_F·L₁. With w_F = 8.7 kN/m² and L₁ = 8 m, F_i = 3×8.7×8 ≈ 209 kN/m; with f_y = 420 MPa and a strength reduction φ = 0.75 (teaching assumptions), the required steel is A_s = 209,000/(0.75×420) ≈ 663 mm²/m, about three D19 bars per metre (3×287 = 861 mm²). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製作拉結筋路徑圖，逐一檢查每條拉結線從一端錨定到另一端的連續性、搭接長度、續接器等級與在柱或牆內的錨定；施工前由監造比對鋼筋施工圖，澆置前設停止點檢查並拍照存證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw a tie-path plan and check each tie line for continuity from anchorage to anchorage, lap lengths, coupler grade and anchorage in columns or walls; before construction the site supervisor compares it with the rebar shop drawings, and a hold-point inspection with photographs precedes each pour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: UFC 4-023-03 內部拉結力 F_i = 3·w_F·L₁。w_F = 8.7 kN/m²、L₁ = 8 m 時 F_i = 3×8.7×8 ≈ 209 kN/m；取 f_y = 420 MPa 與強度折減 φ = 0.75（教學假設），所需鋼筋 A_s = 209,000/(0.75×420) ≈ 663 mm²/m，約為每公尺 3 支 D19（3×287 = 861 mm²）。
knowledge.textEn: UFC 4-023-03 gives the internal tie force F_i = 3·w_F·L₁. With w_F = 8.7 kN/m² and L₁ = 8 m, F_i = 3×8.7×8 ≈ 209 kN/m; with f_y = 420 MPa and a strength reduction φ = 0.75 (teaching assumptions), the required steel is A_s = 209,000/(0.75×420) ≈ 663 mm²/m, about three D19 bars per metre (3×287 = 861 mm²).

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拉結力法與結構連續性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tie-force method and structural continuity", which statement holds?
options: 鋼筋數量與圖面相同，就代表結構的抗倒塌能力與設計相同。
UFC 4-023-03 內部拉結力 F_i = 3·w_F·L₁。
混凝土表面裂縫與剝落只是外觀問題，與結構倒塌風險無關。
optionsEn: If the number of bars matches the drawings, collapse resistance matches the design.
UFC 4-023-03 gives the internal tie force F_i = 3·w_F·L₁.
Surface cracks and spalls in concrete are cosmetic and unrelated to collapse risk.
quiz.explanation: UFC 4-023-03 內部拉結力 F_i = 3·w_F·L₁。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: UFC 4-023-03 gives the internal tie force F_i = 3·w_F·L₁. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拉結力法與結構連續性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tie-force method and structural continuity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「內部與周邊拉結筋」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Internal and peripheral ties” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 製作拉結筋路徑圖，逐一檢查每條拉結線從一端錨定到另一端的連續性、搭接長度、續接器等級與在柱或牆內的錨定；施工前由監造比對鋼筋施工圖，澆置前設停止點檢查並拍照存證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a tie-path plan and check each tie line for continuity from anchorage to anchorage, lap lengths, coupler grade and anchorage in columns or walls; before construction the site supervisor compares it with the rebar shop drawings, and a hold-point inspection with photographs precedes each pour. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：拉結筋的搭接與續接位置應避開預期的高轉角區，並採能發展鋼筋全強度的續接器；設計變更若移動開口或伸縮縫，須重新檢查拉結路徑並經結構技師核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Locate tie laps and couplers away from expected high-rotation zones and use couplers that develop the full bar strength; any design change that moves openings or movement joints requires the tie paths to be rechecked and approved by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：預鑄或疊合樓板若只靠支承長度擱置而無拉結筋，下方支承失效時板件會直接滑落；拉結筋若在伸縮縫或後澆帶處未續接，計算上連續的拉結線在現場其實是斷開的。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Precast or composite planks that merely sit on their bearings without ties drop straight off when the support below fails; ties left unspliced at movement joints or pour strips are continuous on paper but broken on site. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 製作拉結筋路徑圖，逐一檢查每條拉結線從一端錨定到另一端的連續性、搭接長度、續接器等級與在柱或牆內的錨定；施工前由監造比對鋼筋施工圖，澆置前設停止點檢查並拍照存證。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a tie-path plan and check each tie line for continuity from anchorage to anchorage, lap lengths, coupler grade and anchorage in columns or walls; before construction the site supervisor compares it with the rebar shop drawings, and a hold-point inspection with photographs precedes each pour.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 拉結筋的搭接與續接位置應避開預期的高轉角區，並採能發展鋼筋全強度的續接器；設計變更若移動開口或伸縮縫，須重新檢查拉結路徑並經結構技師核可。
knowledge.textEn: Locate tie laps and couplers away from expected high-rotation zones and use couplers that develop the full bar strength; any design change that moves openings or movement joints requires the tie paths to be rechecked and approved by the structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拉結力法與結構連續性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tie-force method and structural continuity"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
建築完工驗收後，結構安全不會因使用期間的小改裝而改變。
製作拉結筋路徑圖，逐一檢查每條拉結線從一端錨定到另一端的連續性、搭接長度、續接器等級與在柱或牆內的錨定。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once a building passes completion inspection, small renovations in service cannot change its structural safety.
Draw a tie-path plan and check each tie line for continuity from anchorage to anchorage, lap lengths, coupler grade and anchorage in columns or walls.
quiz.explanation: 製作拉結筋路徑圖，逐一檢查每條拉結線從一端錨定到另一端的連續性、搭接長度、續接器等級與在柱或牆內的錨定；施工前由監造比對鋼筋施工圖，澆置前設停止點檢查並拍照存證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw a tie-path plan and check each tie line for continuity from anchorage to anchorage, lap lengths, coupler grade and anchorage in columns or walls; before construction the site supervisor compares it with the rebar shop drawings, and a hold-point inspection with photographs precedes each pour. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拉結力法與結構連續性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tie-force method and structural continuity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「內部與周邊拉結筋」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Internal and peripheral ties” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 預鑄或疊合樓板若只靠支承長度擱置而無拉結筋，下方支承失效時板件會直接滑落；拉結筋若在伸縮縫或後澆帶處未續接，計算上連續的拉結線在現場其實是斷開的。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Precast or composite planks that merely sit on their bearings without ties drop straight off when the support below fails; ties left unspliced at movement joints or pour strips are continuous on paper but broken on site. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：拉結筋的價值在於連續與錨定：一根在柱邊斷開的鋼筋，帳面面積再大也無效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The value of a tie lies in continuity and anchorage: a bar cut at the column face is useless however large its area on paper.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「拉結筋只要總面積足夠，在哪裡斷開都沒有關係。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the total tie area is sufficient, it does not matter where the bars are interrupted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 預鑄或疊合樓板若只靠支承長度擱置而無拉結筋，下方支承失效時板件會直接滑落；拉結筋若在伸縮縫或後澆帶處未續接，計算上連續的拉結線在現場其實是斷開的。
knowledge.textEn: Precast or composite planks that merely sit on their bearings without ties drop straight off when the support below fails; ties left unspliced at movement joints or pour strips are continuous on paper but broken on site.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拉結力法與結構連續性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tie-force method and structural continuity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 預鑄或疊合樓板若只靠支承長度擱置而無拉結筋，下方支承失效時板件會直接滑落；拉結筋若在伸縮縫或後澆帶處未續接，計算上連續的拉結線在現場其實是斷開的。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
無梁版的穿孔剪力破壞前，一定會有很大的撓度可以預警。
optionsEn: Precast or composite planks that merely sit on their bearings without ties drop straight off when the support below fails.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Punching shear in a flat plate is always preceded by large, warning deflections.
quiz.explanation: 預鑄或疊合樓板若只靠支承長度擱置而無拉結筋，下方支承失效時板件會直接滑落；拉結筋若在伸縮縫或後澆帶處未續接，計算上連續的拉結線在現場其實是斷開的。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Precast or composite planks that merely sit on their bearings without ties drop straight off when the support below fails; ties left unspliced at movement joints or pour strips are continuous on paper but broken on site. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 穿孔剪力與結構完整性鋼筋：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Punching shear and structural-integrity reinforcement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「板柱接頭」如何影響結構抗連鎖倒塌設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slab–column connection” governs force, deformation or durability in “Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 無梁版的柱頭是連鎖倒塌的弱點：穿孔剪力破壞屬脆性，一旦柱頭周圍的混凝土錐體被剪斷，板失去支承，荷載轉給相鄰柱頭，若它們也接近極限，破壞就沿樓板擴散。NIST 於 2026 年發布的 Champlain Towers South 技術結論指出，崩塌始於 2021 年 6 月初泳池平台下兩處停車場柱的穿孔剪力破壞，荷載重分配給無法承受的相鄰接頭，而原始設計與施工的偏差使安全餘裕從一開始就太小。穿過柱核心的連續下層完整性鋼筋，能在穿孔後把板懸吊在柱上，防止破壞擴散。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「板柱接頭」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Flat-plate column heads are a weak point for progressive collapse: punching shear is brittle, and once the concrete cone around a column is sheared through, the slab loses support and its load passes to neighbouring column heads, which, if also near their limit, spread the failure across the floor. Technical findings released by NIST in 2026 on Champlain Towers South state that the collapse began in early June 2021 with punching shear failures at two garage columns under the pool deck, that load redistributed to adjacent connections unable to carry it, and that deviations in the original design and construction left margins too narrow from the start. Continuous bottom integrity bars passing through the column core can hang the slab on the column after punching and stop the spread. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Slab–column connection” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：穿孔剪力 V_c = 0.33√f'c·b₀·d。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Punching capacity V_c = 0.33√f'c·b₀·d.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「無梁版的穿孔剪力破壞前，一定會有很大的撓度可以預警。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Punching shear in a flat plate is always preceded by large, warning deflections." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「板柱接頭」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Slab–column connection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 穿孔剪力與結構完整性鋼筋
knowledge.text: 無梁版的柱頭是連鎖倒塌的弱點：穿孔剪力破壞屬脆性，一旦柱頭周圍的混凝土錐體被剪斷，板失去支承，荷載轉給相鄰柱頭，若它們也接近極限，破壞就沿樓板擴散。NIST 於 2026 年發布的 Champlain Towers South 技術結論指出，崩塌始於 2021 年 6 月初泳池平台下兩處停車場柱的穿孔剪力破壞，荷載重分配給無法承受的相鄰接頭，而原始設計與施工的偏差使安全餘裕從一開始就太小。
knowledge.textEn: Flat-plate column heads are a weak point for progressive collapse: punching shear is brittle, and once the concrete cone around a column is sheared through, the slab loses support and its load passes to neighbouring column heads, which, if also near their limit, spread the failure across the floor. Technical findings released by NIST in 2026 on Champlain Towers South state that the collapse began in early June 2021 with punching shear failures at two garage columns under the pool deck, that load redistributed to adjacent connections unable to carry it, and that deviations in the original design and construction left margins too narrow from the start.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：無梁版的穿孔剪力破壞前，一定會有很大的撓度可以預警。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Punching shear in a flat plate is always preceded by large, warning deflections. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「穿孔剪力與結構完整性鋼筋」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Punching shear and structural-integrity reinforcement" is correct?
options: 無梁版的穿孔剪力破壞前，一定會有很大的撓度可以預警。
無梁版的柱頭是連鎖倒塌的弱點：穿孔剪力破壞屬脆性，一旦柱頭周圍的混凝土錐體被剪斷，板失去支承，荷載轉給相鄰柱頭，若它們也接近極限，破壞就沿樓板擴散。
只要梁的抗彎強度足夠，拆柱後就不需要考慮懸鏈作用。
optionsEn: Punching shear in a flat plate is always preceded by large, warning deflections.

Flat-plate column heads are a weak point for progressive collapse: punching shear is brittle, and once the concrete cone around a column is sheared through, the slab loses support and its load passes to neighbouring column heads, which, if also near their limit, spread the failure across the floor.
If the beam has enough bending strength, catenary action need not be considered after column loss.
quiz.explanation: 無梁版的柱頭是連鎖倒塌的弱點：穿孔剪力破壞屬脆性，一旦柱頭周圍的混凝土錐體被剪斷，板失去支承，荷載轉給相鄰柱頭，若它們也接近極限，破壞就沿樓板擴散。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Flat-plate column heads are a weak point for progressive collapse: punching shear is brittle, and once the concrete cone around a column is sheared through, the slab loses support and its load passes to neighbouring column heads, which, if also near their limit, spread the failure across the floor. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 穿孔剪力與結構完整性鋼筋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Punching shear and structural-integrity reinforcement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「板柱接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slab–column connection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：穿孔剪力 V_c = 0.33√f'c·b₀·d。f'c = 28 MPa、方柱 500 mm、有效深度 d = 200 mm：b₀ = 4×(500+200) = 2,800 mm，V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,800×200 ≈ 978 kN，φV_c = 0.75×978 ≈ 733 kN。柱距 7.5 m 的受載面積 56.25 m²、因數化荷載 1.2×7.0 + 1.6×2.5 = 12.4 kPa，V_u ≈ 698 kN，需求比約 0.95。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Punching capacity V_c = 0.33√f'c·b₀·d. With f'c = 28 MPa, a 500 mm square column and effective depth d = 200 mm: b₀ = 4×(500+200) = 2,800 mm, V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,800×200 ≈ 978 kN and φV_c = 0.75×978 ≈ 733 kN. A 7.5 m grid gives a tributary area of 56.25 m² and a factored load of 1.2×7.0 + 1.6×2.5 = 12.4 kPa, so V_u ≈ 698 kN and the demand ratio is about 0.95. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計時檢查每個柱頭的穿孔需求比，並確認穿過柱核心的連續下層筋足以在穿孔後懸吊樓板；既有建築以透地雷達確認鋼筋位置、鑽心取樣確認強度，並檢查柱頭周圍的放射狀或環狀裂縫與板面下陷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In design, check the punching demand ratio at every column head and confirm that continuous bottom bars through the column core can hang the slab after punching; in existing buildings, locate bars with ground-penetrating radar, confirm strength with cores and look for radial or circumferential cracks and slab sagging around column heads.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Punching capacity V_c = 0.33√f'c·b₀·d. With f'c = 28 MPa, a 500 mm square column and effective depth d = 200 mm: b₀ = 4×(500+200) = 2,800 mm, V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,800×200 ≈ 978 kN and φV_c = 0.75×978 ≈ 733 kN. A 7.5 m grid gives a tributary area of 56.25 m² and a factored load of 1.2×7.0 + 1.6×2.5 = 12.4 kPa, so V_u ≈ 698 kN and the demand ratio is about 0.95. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「穿孔剪力與結構完整性鋼筋」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Punching shear and structural-integrity reinforcement", which statement holds?
options: 靜力推覆試驗得到的最大力，就等於突然拆柱時結構能承受的荷載。
防火被覆只要滿足耐火時效，就不需要考慮熱膨脹對接頭的影響。
穿孔剪力 V_c = 0.33√f'c·b₀·d。
optionsEn: The peak force from a static push-down test equals the load the structure can carry after sudden column loss.
If fireproofing meets its fire-resistance rating, thermal expansion effects on connections can be ignored.
Punching capacity V_c = 0.33√f'c·b₀·d.
quiz.explanation: 穿孔剪力 V_c = 0.33√f'c·b₀·d。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Punching capacity V_c = 0.33√f'c·b₀·d. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 穿孔剪力與結構完整性鋼筋：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Punching shear and structural-integrity reinforcement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「板柱接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slab–column connection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計時檢查每個柱頭的穿孔需求比，並確認穿過柱核心的連續下層筋足以在穿孔後懸吊樓板；既有建築以透地雷達確認鋼筋位置、鑽心取樣確認強度，並檢查柱頭周圍的放射狀或環狀裂縫與板面下陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In design, check the punching demand ratio at every column head and confirm that continuous bottom bars through the column core can hang the slab after punching; in existing buildings, locate bars with ground-penetrating radar, confirm strength with cores and look for radial or circumferential cracks and slab sagging around column heads. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：柱頭區不得任意開孔或埋管，泳池、植栽與廣場鋪面等重荷載區要在圖說標示允許附加荷載；需求比偏高的柱頭應加設柱頭版、剪力鋼筋或剪力栓釘，並由結構技師簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Forbid unplanned openings and embedded pipes near column heads, mark the allowable added load on drawings for heavy zones such as pools, planters and plaza paving, and give column heads with high demand ratios drop panels, shear reinforcement or shear studs signed off by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：柱頭穿孔前常先在板面出現環繞柱的裂縫與下陷，之後突然破壞；若沒有穿過柱的連續下層筋，板會整片滑落並把衝擊荷載加到下一層，形成樓層疊落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Punching is often preceded by cracks circling the column on the slab surface and local sagging, then fails suddenly; without continuous bottom bars through the column, the slab drops as a whole and adds impact load to the floor below, producing a pancake collapse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計時檢查每個柱頭的穿孔需求比，並確認穿過柱核心的連續下層筋足以在穿孔後懸吊樓板；既有建築以透地雷達確認鋼筋位置、鑽心取樣確認強度，並檢查柱頭周圍的放射狀或環狀裂縫與板面下陷。
knowledge.textEn: In design, check the punching demand ratio at every column head and confirm that continuous bottom bars through the column core can hang the slab after punching; in existing buildings, locate bars with ground-penetrating radar, confirm strength with cores and look for radial or circumferential cracks and slab sagging around column heads.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 柱頭區不得任意開孔或埋管，泳池、植栽與廣場鋪面等重荷載區要在圖說標示允許附加荷載；需求比偏高的柱頭應加設柱頭版、剪力鋼筋或剪力栓釘，並由結構技師簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Forbid unplanned openings and embedded pipes near column heads, mark the allowable added load on drawings for heavy zones such as pools, planters and plaza paving, and give column heads with high demand ratios drop panels, shear reinforcement or shear studs signed off by the structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「穿孔剪力與結構完整性鋼筋」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Punching shear and structural-integrity reinforcement"?
options: 設計時檢查每個柱頭的穿孔需求比，並確認穿過柱核心的連續下層筋足以在穿孔後懸吊樓板。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要結構符合耐震規範，就一定不會發生連鎖倒塌。
optionsEn: In design, check the punching demand ratio at every column head and confirm that continuous bottom bars through the column core can hang the slab after punching.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A structure that satisfies the seismic code can never suffer progressive collapse.
quiz.explanation: 設計時檢查每個柱頭的穿孔需求比，並確認穿過柱核心的連續下層筋足以在穿孔後懸吊樓板；既有建築以透地雷達確認鋼筋位置、鑽心取樣確認強度，並檢查柱頭周圍的放射狀或環狀裂縫與板面下陷。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In design, check the punching demand ratio at every column head and confirm that continuous bottom bars through the column core can hang the slab after punching; in existing buildings, locate bars with ground-penetrating radar, confirm strength with cores and look for radial or circumferential cracks and slab sagging around column heads. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 穿孔剪力與結構完整性鋼筋：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Punching shear and structural-integrity reinforcement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「板柱接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slab–column connection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 柱頭穿孔前常先在板面出現環繞柱的裂縫與下陷，之後突然破壞；若沒有穿過柱的連續下層筋，板會整片滑落並把衝擊荷載加到下一層，形成樓層疊落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Punching is often preceded by cracks circling the column on the slab surface and local sagging, then fails suddenly; without continuous bottom bars through the column, the slab drops as a whole and adds impact load to the floor below, producing a pancake collapse. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：穿過柱核心的連續下層完整性鋼筋，能在穿孔後把板懸吊在柱上，防止破壞擴散。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Continuous bottom integrity bars passing through the column core can hang the slab on the column after punching and stop the spread.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「無梁版的穿孔剪力破壞前，一定會有很大的撓度可以預警。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Punching shear in a flat plate is always preceded by large, warning deflections." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 柱頭穿孔前常先在板面出現環繞柱的裂縫與下陷，之後突然破壞；若沒有穿過柱的連續下層筋，板會整片滑落並把衝擊荷載加到下一層，形成樓層疊落。
knowledge.textEn: Punching is often preceded by cracks circling the column on the slab surface and local sagging, then fails suddenly; without continuous bottom bars through the column, the slab drops as a whole and adds impact load to the floor below, producing a pancake collapse.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「穿孔剪力與結構完整性鋼筋」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Punching shear and structural-integrity reinforcement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
柱頭穿孔前常先在板面出現環繞柱的裂縫與下陷，之後突然破壞；若沒有穿過柱的連續下層筋，板會整片滑落並把衝擊荷載加到下一層，形成樓層疊落。
只要梁的抗彎強度足夠，拆柱後就不需要考慮懸鏈作用。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Punching is often preceded by cracks circling the column on the slab surface and local sagging, then fails suddenly.
If the beam has enough bending strength, catenary action need not be considered after column loss.
quiz.explanation: 柱頭穿孔前常先在板面出現環繞柱的裂縫與下陷，之後突然破壞；若沒有穿過柱的連續下層筋，板會整片滑落並把衝擊荷載加到下一層，形成樓層疊落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Punching is often preceded by cracks circling the column on the slab surface and local sagging, then fails suddenly; without continuous bottom bars through the column, the slab drops as a whole and adds impact load to the floor below, producing a pancake collapse. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「大變形懸鏈作用與接頭轉角」與「施工符合性與安全餘裕」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Large-deformation catenary action and connection rotation" and "Construction conformance and safety margin": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 大變形懸鏈作用與接頭轉角：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Large-deformation catenary action and connection rotation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「懸鏈線拉力」如何影響結構抗連鎖倒塌設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catenary tension” governs force, deformation or durability in “Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 當梁或樓板在拆柱後下垂到抗彎強度不足以承受荷載時，構件會轉為受拉的懸鏈線，以軸向拉力把荷載掛到相鄰柱上。這需要三個條件：接頭能承受大轉角而不斷裂、構件與接頭能傳遞軸向拉力、相鄰柱與外圍構件能承受向內拉的水平力。梁柱接頭若只設計成傳遞剪力的簡單接頭，螺栓或剪力板常在轉角增加時先撕裂，懸鏈作用根本建立不起來。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「懸鏈線拉力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When a beam or slab sags after column loss until its flexural strength can no longer carry the load, it turns into a tension catenary that hangs the load from adjacent columns by axial force. This requires three things: connections that sustain large rotations without fracturing, members and connections that transfer axial tension, and adjacent columns and perimeter members that resist the inward horizontal pull. Simple shear connections often tear at their bolts or shear tabs as rotation grows, so catenary action never develops. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Catenary tension” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：懸鏈線拉力 T ≈ wL²/(8δ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Catenary tension T ≈ wL²/(8δ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要梁的抗彎強度足夠，拆柱後就不需要考慮懸鏈作用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the beam has enough bending strength, catenary action need not be considered after column loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「懸鏈線拉力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Catenary tension”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 大變形懸鏈作用與接頭轉角
knowledge.titleEn: Large-deformation catenary action and connection rotation
knowledge.text: 當梁或樓板在拆柱後下垂到抗彎強度不足以承受荷載時，構件會轉為受拉的懸鏈線，以軸向拉力把荷載掛到相鄰柱上。這需要三個條件：接頭能承受大轉角而不斷裂、構件與接頭能傳遞軸向拉力、相鄰柱與外圍構件能承受向內拉的水平力。
knowledge.textEn: When a beam or slab sags after column loss until its flexural strength can no longer carry the load, it turns into a tension catenary that hangs the load from adjacent columns by axial force. This requires three things: connections that sustain large rotations without fracturing, members and connections that transfer axial tension, and adjacent columns and perimeter members that resist the inward horizontal pull.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要梁的抗彎強度足夠，拆柱後就不需要考慮懸鏈作用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the beam has enough bending strength, catenary action need not be considered after column loss. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「大變形懸鏈作用與接頭轉角」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Large-deformation catenary action and connection rotation" is correct?
options: 只要梁的抗彎強度足夠，拆柱後就不需要考慮懸鏈作用。
鋼筋數量與圖面相同，就代表結構的抗倒塌能力與設計相同。
當梁或樓板在拆柱後下垂到抗彎強度不足以承受荷載時，構件會轉為受拉的懸鏈線，以軸向拉力把荷載掛到相鄰柱上。
optionsEn: If the beam has enough bending strength, catenary action need not be considered after column loss.
If the number of bars matches the drawings, collapse resistance matches the design.
When a beam or slab sags after column loss until its flexural strength can no longer carry the load, it turns into a tension catenary that hangs the load from adjacent columns by axial force.
quiz.explanation: 當梁或樓板在拆柱後下垂到抗彎強度不足以承受荷載時，構件會轉為受拉的懸鏈線，以軸向拉力把荷載掛到相鄰柱上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When a beam or slab sags after column loss until its flexural strength can no longer carry the load, it turns into a tension catenary that hangs the load from adjacent columns by axial force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 大變形懸鏈作用與接頭轉角：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Large-deformation catenary action and connection rotation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「懸鏈線拉力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Catenary tension” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：懸鏈線拉力 T ≈ wL²/(8δ)。w = 69.6 kN/m、拆柱後跨度 L = 16 m，轉角 0.20 rad 時中點下垂 δ = 8×tan0.20 ≈ 1.62 m，T ≈ 69.6×16²/(8×1.62) ≈ 1,373 kN；8 m 寬的內部拉結筋總強度約 209×8 ≈ 1,670 kN，足以承受，但外柱須能抵抗同量級的內拉力。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Catenary tension T ≈ wL²/(8δ). With w = 69.6 kN/m and a post-loss span L = 16 m, a rotation of 0.20 rad gives a midspan sag δ = 8×tan0.20 ≈ 1.62 m and T ≈ 69.6×16²/(8×1.62) ≈ 1,373 kN; internal ties across an 8 m width provide about 209×8 ≈ 1,670 kN, which suffices, but the perimeter columns must resist an inward pull of the same order. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以非線性靜力或動力分析追蹤接頭轉角與軸力的發展，並與接頭試驗得到的轉角能力比較；外柱與周邊梁另以水平內拉力檢核，必要時加設周邊拉結或水平桁架。
