steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track connection rotation and axial force with nonlinear static or dynamic analysis and compare them with rotation capacities from connection tests; check perimeter columns and edge beams separately for the inward horizontal pull, adding peripheral ties or horizontal trusses where needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 懸鏈線拉力 T ≈ wL²/(8δ)。w = 69.6 kN/m、拆柱後跨度 L = 16 m，轉角 0.20 rad 時中點下垂 δ = 8×tan0.20 ≈ 1.62 m，T ≈ 69.6×16²/(8×1.62) ≈ 1,373 kN；8 m 寬的內部拉結筋總強度約 209×8 ≈ 1,670 kN，足以承受，但外柱須能抵抗同量級的內拉力。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Catenary tension T ≈ wL²/(8δ). With w = 69.6 kN/m and a post-loss span L = 16 m, a rotation of 0.20 rad gives a midspan sag δ = 8×tan0.20 ≈ 1.62 m and T ≈ 69.6×16²/(8×1.62) ≈ 1,373 kN; internal ties across an 8 m width provide about 209×8 ≈ 1,670 kN, which suffices, but the perimeter columns must resist an inward pull of the same order. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「大變形懸鏈作用與接頭轉角」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Large-deformation catenary action and connection rotation", which statement holds?
options: 懸鏈線拉力 T ≈ wL²/(8δ)。
混凝土表面裂縫與剝落只是外觀問題，與結構倒塌風險無關。
建築完工驗收後，結構安全不會因使用期間的小改裝而改變。
optionsEn: Catenary tension T ≈ wL²/(8δ).
Surface cracks and spalls in concrete are cosmetic and unrelated to collapse risk.
Once a building passes completion inspection, small renovations in service cannot change its structural safety.
quiz.explanation: 懸鏈線拉力 T ≈ wL²/(8δ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Catenary tension T ≈ wL²/(8δ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 大變形懸鏈作用與接頭轉角：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Large-deformation catenary action and connection rotation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「懸鏈線拉力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Catenary tension” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以非線性靜力或動力分析追蹤接頭轉角與軸力的發展，並與接頭試驗得到的轉角能力比較；外柱與周邊梁另以水平內拉力檢核，必要時加設周邊拉結或水平桁架。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track connection rotation and axial force with nonlinear static or dynamic analysis and compare them with rotation capacities from connection tests; check perimeter columns and edge beams separately for the inward horizontal pull, adding peripheral ties or horizontal trusses where needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：需要替代路徑的鋼構接頭，應採用經試驗驗證、能在大轉角下傳遞拉力的型式，並在圖說註明不得任意以其他接頭替代；替代方案須提出同等轉角與拉力能力的試驗或分析證明。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Steel connections relied on for alternate paths should be tested types able to carry tension at large rotations, and drawings should forbid substitution; any alternative must be backed by tests or analysis showing equal rotation and tension capacity.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭轉角能力不足時，懸鏈線在形成前就斷裂，失去最後一道防線；外柱若未檢核內拉力，懸鏈作用會把外柱拉向內側並引起挫屈，使破壞擴大到相鄰跨。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With too little rotation capacity, connections fracture before the catenary forms and the last line of defence is lost; perimeter columns not checked for the inward pull are dragged inwards and buckle, spreading the failure into adjacent bays. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以非線性靜力或動力分析追蹤接頭轉角與軸力的發展，並與接頭試驗得到的轉角能力比較；外柱與周邊梁另以水平內拉力檢核，必要時加設周邊拉結或水平桁架。
knowledge.textEn: Track connection rotation and axial force with nonlinear static or dynamic analysis and compare them with rotation capacities from connection tests; check perimeter columns and edge beams separately for the inward horizontal pull, adding peripheral ties or horizontal trusses where needed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 需要替代路徑的鋼構接頭，應採用經試驗驗證、能在大轉角下傳遞拉力的型式，並在圖說註明不得任意以其他接頭替代；替代方案須提出同等轉角與拉力能力的試驗或分析證明。
knowledge.textEn: Steel connections relied on for alternate paths should be tested types able to carry tension at large rotations, and drawings should forbid substitution; any alternative must be backed by tests or analysis showing equal rotation and tension capacity.

quiz.question: 要驗證「大變形懸鏈作用與接頭轉角」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Large-deformation catenary action and connection rotation"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以非線性靜力或動力分析追蹤接頭轉角與軸力的發展，並與接頭試驗得到的轉角能力比較；外柱與周邊梁另以水平內拉力檢核，必要時加設周邊拉結或水平桁架。
柱失效時，上方荷載會慢慢轉移，用靜力分析就足夠。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Track connection rotation and axial force with nonlinear static or dynamic analysis and compare them with rotation capacities from connection tests.
When a column fails, the load above transfers slowly, so static analysis is enough.
quiz.explanation: 以非線性靜力或動力分析追蹤接頭轉角與軸力的發展，並與接頭試驗得到的轉角能力比較；外柱與周邊梁另以水平內拉力檢核，必要時加設周邊拉結或水平桁架。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track connection rotation and axial force with nonlinear static or dynamic analysis and compare them with rotation capacities from connection tests; check perimeter columns and edge beams separately for the inward horizontal pull, adding peripheral ties or horizontal trusses where needed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 大變形懸鏈作用與接頭轉角：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Large-deformation catenary action and connection rotation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「懸鏈線拉力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Catenary tension” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接頭轉角能力不足時，懸鏈線在形成前就斷裂，失去最後一道防線；外柱若未檢核內拉力，懸鏈作用會把外柱拉向內側並引起挫屈，使破壞擴大到相鄰跨。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: With too little rotation capacity, connections fracture before the catenary forms and the last line of defence is lost; perimeter columns not checked for the inward pull are dragged inwards and buckle, spreading the failure into adjacent bays. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：梁柱接頭若只設計成傳遞剪力的簡單接頭，螺栓或剪力板常在轉角增加時先撕裂，懸鏈作用根本建立不起來。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Simple shear connections often tear at their bolts or shear tabs as rotation grows, so catenary action never develops.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要梁的抗彎強度足夠，拆柱後就不需要考慮懸鏈作用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the beam has enough bending strength, catenary action need not be considered after column loss." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接頭轉角能力不足時，懸鏈線在形成前就斷裂，失去最後一道防線；外柱若未檢核內拉力，懸鏈作用會把外柱拉向內側並引起挫屈，使破壞擴大到相鄰跨。
knowledge.textEn: With too little rotation capacity, connections fracture before the catenary forms and the last line of defence is lost; perimeter columns not checked for the inward pull are dragged inwards and buckle, spreading the failure into adjacent bays.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「大變形懸鏈作用與接頭轉角」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Large-deformation catenary action and connection rotation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
鋼筋數量與圖面相同，就代表結構的抗倒塌能力與設計相同。
接頭轉角能力不足時，懸鏈線在形成前就斷裂，失去最後一道防線；外柱若未檢核內拉力，懸鏈作用會把外柱拉向內側並引起挫屈，使破壞擴大到相鄰跨。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If the number of bars matches the drawings, collapse resistance matches the design.
With too little rotation capacity, connections fracture before the catenary forms and the last line of defence is lost.
quiz.explanation: 接頭轉角能力不足時，懸鏈線在形成前就斷裂，失去最後一道防線；外柱若未檢核內拉力，懸鏈作用會把外柱拉向內側並引起挫屈，使破壞擴大到相鄰跨。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With too little rotation capacity, connections fracture before the catenary forms and the last line of defence is lost; perimeter columns not checked for the inward pull are dragged inwards and buckle, spreading the failure into adjacent bays. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工符合性與安全餘裕：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction conformance and safety margin: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼筋放樣與保護層」如何影響結構抗連鎖倒塌設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rebar placement and cover” governs force, deformation or durability in “Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 抗連鎖倒塌設計常仰賴少數關鍵鋼筋與接頭，施工偏差對它們的影響遠大於一般構件。上層筋被踩低使有效深度變小、拉結筋搭接長度不足、續接器未鎖緊、預鑄接頭灌漿不實，都會讓計算上的替代路徑在現場不存在。NIST 對 Champlain Towers South 的結論同時提到施工與設計圖說不符、使用期間增加的荷載以及長期腐蝕，共同壓縮了本來就不足的餘裕；因此施工階段的停止點檢查，本身就是抗連鎖倒塌設計的一部分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼筋放樣與保護層」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Progressive-collapse resistance often rests on a few key bars and connections, and construction deviations affect them far more than ordinary members. Top bars trodden down to a smaller effective depth, short tie laps, couplers not tightened and poorly grouted precast joints all mean the calculated alternate path does not exist on site. NIST's findings on Champlain Towers South cite construction that deviated from the drawings, loads added in service and long-term corrosion as jointly eroding margins that were already too small; hold-point inspection during construction is therefore part of progressive-collapse design itself. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rebar placement and cover” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若柱頭上層筋被踩低 25 mm，有效深度由 200 降為 175 mm：b₀ = 4×(500+175) = 2,700 mm，V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,700×175 ≈ 825 kN，φV_c ≈ 619 kN，比原本 733 kN 低約 16%；同樣 V_u = 698 kN 時，需求比由 0.95 升為約 1.13。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If top bars at a column head are pushed down 25 mm, effective depth drops from 200 to 175 mm: b₀ = 4×(500+175) = 2,700 mm, V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,700×175 ≈ 825 kN and φV_c ≈ 619 kN, about 16% below the original 733 kN; with the same V_u = 698 kN the demand ratio rises from 0.95 to about 1.13.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼筋數量與圖面相同，就代表結構的抗倒塌能力與設計相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the number of bars matches the drawings, collapse resistance matches the design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼筋放樣與保護層」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rebar placement and cover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工符合性與安全餘裕
knowledge.text: 抗連鎖倒塌設計常仰賴少數關鍵鋼筋與接頭，施工偏差對它們的影響遠大於一般構件。上層筋被踩低使有效深度變小、拉結筋搭接長度不足、續接器未鎖緊、預鑄接頭灌漿不實，都會讓計算上的替代路徑在現場不存在。
knowledge.textEn: Progressive-collapse resistance often rests on a few key bars and connections, and construction deviations affect them far more than ordinary members. Top bars trodden down to a smaller effective depth, short tie laps, couplers not tightened and poorly grouted precast joints all mean the calculated alternate path does not exist on site.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼筋數量與圖面相同，就代表結構的抗倒塌能力與設計相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the number of bars matches the drawings, collapse resistance matches the design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工符合性與安全餘裕」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Construction conformance and safety margin" is correct?
options: 抗連鎖倒塌設計常仰賴少數關鍵鋼筋與接頭，施工偏差對它們的影響遠大於一般構件。
鋼筋數量與圖面相同，就代表結構的抗倒塌能力與設計相同。
靜力推覆試驗得到的最大力，就等於突然拆柱時結構能承受的荷載。
optionsEn: Progressive-collapse resistance often rests on a few key bars and connections, and construction deviations affect them far more than ordinary members.
If the number of bars matches the drawings, collapse resistance matches the design.
The peak force from a static push-down test equals the load the structure can carry after sudden column loss.
quiz.explanation: 抗連鎖倒塌設計常仰賴少數關鍵鋼筋與接頭，施工偏差對它們的影響遠大於一般構件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Progressive-collapse resistance often rests on a few key bars and connections, and construction deviations affect them far more than ordinary members. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工符合性與安全餘裕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction conformance and safety margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼筋放樣與保護層」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rebar placement and cover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若柱頭上層筋被踩低 25 mm，有效深度由 200 降為 175 mm：b₀ = 4×(500+175) = 2,700 mm，V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,700×175 ≈ 825 kN，φV_c ≈ 619 kN，比原本 733 kN 低約 16%；同樣 V_u = 698 kN 時，需求比由 0.95 升為約 1.13。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If top bars at a column head are pushed down 25 mm, effective depth drops from 200 to 175 mm: b₀ = 4×(500+175) = 2,700 mm, V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,700×175 ≈ 825 kN and φV_c ≈ 619 kN, about 16% below the original 733 kN; with the same V_u = 698 kN the demand ratio rises from 0.95 to about 1.13. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：澆置前以鋼筋檢查表逐一檢查柱頭上層筋高度、支撐馬凳間距、拉結筋搭接長度與續接器扭力或標記，量測保護層並拍照；澆置後以鋼筋掃描儀抽查，偏差超過允許值時由設計者評估是否補強。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before each pour, use a rebar checklist to verify top-bar height at column heads, chair spacing, tie lap lengths and coupler torque or witness marks, and measure and photograph cover; after the pour, spot-check with a cover meter, and have the designer assess strengthening wherever deviations exceed tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若柱頭上層筋被踩低 25 mm，有效深度由 200 降為 175 mm：b₀ = 4×(500+175) = 2,700 mm，V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,700×175 ≈ 825 kN，φV_c ≈ 619 kN，比原本 733 kN 低約 16%；同樣 V_u = 698 kN 時，需求比由 0.95 升為約 1.13。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If top bars at a column head are pushed down 25 mm, effective depth drops from 200 to 175 mm: b₀ = 4×(500+175) = 2,700 mm, V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,700×175 ≈ 825 kN and φV_c ≈ 619 kN, about 16% below the original 733 kN; with the same V_u = 698 kN the demand ratio rises from 0.95 to about 1.13. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工符合性與安全餘裕」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Construction conformance and safety margin", which statement holds?
options: 防火被覆只要滿足耐火時效，就不需要考慮熱膨脹對接頭的影響。
只要結構符合耐震規範，就一定不會發生連鎖倒塌。
optionsEn: If fireproofing meets its fire-resistance rating, thermal expansion effects on connections can be ignored.

If top bars at a column head are pushed down 25 mm, effective depth drops from 200 to 175 mm: b₀ = 4×(500+175) = 2,700 mm, V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,700×175 ≈ 825 kN and φV_c ≈ 619 kN, about 16% below the original 733 kN.
A structure that satisfies the seismic code can never suffer progressive collapse.
quiz.explanation: 若柱頭上層筋被踩低 25 mm，有效深度由 200 降為 175 mm：b₀ = 4×(500+175) = 2,700 mm，V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,700×175 ≈ 825 kN，φV_c ≈ 619 kN，比原本 733 kN 低約 16%；同樣 V_u = 698 kN 時，需求比由 0.95 升為約 1.13。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If top bars at a column head are pushed down 25 mm, effective depth drops from 200 to 175 mm: b₀ = 4×(500+175) = 2,700 mm, V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,700×175 ≈ 825 kN and φV_c ≈ 619 kN, about 16% below the original 733 kN; with the same V_u = 698 kN the demand ratio rises from 0.95 to about 1.13. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工符合性與安全餘裕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Construction conformance and safety margin: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼筋放樣與保護層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rebar placement and cover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 澆置前以鋼筋檢查表逐一檢查柱頭上層筋高度、支撐馬凳間距、拉結筋搭接長度與續接器扭力或標記，量測保護層並拍照；澆置後以鋼筋掃描儀抽查，偏差超過允許值時由設計者評估是否補強。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before each pour, use a rebar checklist to verify top-bar height at column heads, chair spacing, tie lap lengths and coupler torque or witness marks, and measure and photograph cover; after the pour, spot-check with a cover meter, and have the designer assess strengthening wherever deviations exceed tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工規範應把柱頭上層筋高度、拉結筋連續性與關鍵接頭列為停止點，由監造與結構技師簽認後才能澆置；竣工圖須記錄所有偏差與處置方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should make top-bar height at column heads, tie continuity and key connections hold points that the site supervisor and structural engineer sign before concreting, and as-built drawings must record every deviation and its resolution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若停止點檢查只看鋼筋數量而不量高度與搭接，現場可能出現數量對、位置錯的情況，結構在正常使用下沒有徵兆，安全餘裕卻已被吃掉，直到加載或劣化疊加時突然破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If hold-point checks count bars but do not measure height or laps, the site can have the right number of bars in the wrong place; the structure shows nothing in normal use while its margin is gone, until added load or deterioration triggers sudden failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 澆置前以鋼筋檢查表逐一檢查柱頭上層筋高度、支撐馬凳間距、拉結筋搭接長度與續接器扭力或標記，量測保護層並拍照；澆置後以鋼筋掃描儀抽查，偏差超過允許值時由設計者評估是否補強。
knowledge.textEn: Before each pour, use a rebar checklist to verify top-bar height at column heads, chair spacing, tie lap lengths and coupler torque or witness marks, and measure and photograph cover; after the pour, spot-check with a cover meter, and have the designer assess strengthening wherever deviations exceed tolerance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工規範應把柱頭上層筋高度、拉結筋連續性與關鍵接頭列為停止點，由監造與結構技師簽認後才能澆置；竣工圖須記錄所有偏差與處置方式。
knowledge.textEn: The specification should make top-bar height at column heads, tie continuity and key connections hold points that the site supervisor and structural engineer sign before concreting, and as-built drawings must record every deviation and its resolution.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工符合性與安全餘裕」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Construction conformance and safety margin"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
拉結筋只要總面積足夠，在哪裡斷開都沒有關係。
澆置前以鋼筋檢查表逐一檢查柱頭上層筋高度、支撐馬凳間距、拉結筋搭接長度與續接器扭力或標記，量測保護層並拍照。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
As long as the total tie area is sufficient, it does not matter where the bars are interrupted.
Before each pour, use a rebar checklist to verify top-bar height at column heads, chair spacing, tie lap lengths and coupler torque or witness marks, and measure and photograph cover.
quiz.explanation: 澆置前以鋼筋檢查表逐一檢查柱頭上層筋高度、支撐馬凳間距、拉結筋搭接長度與續接器扭力或標記，量測保護層並拍照；澆置後以鋼筋掃描儀抽查，偏差超過允許值時由設計者評估是否補強。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before each pour, use a rebar checklist to verify top-bar height at column heads, chair spacing, tie lap lengths and coupler torque or witness marks, and measure and photograph cover; after the pour, spot-check with a cover meter, and have the designer assess strengthening wherever deviations exceed tolerance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工符合性與安全餘裕：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction conformance and safety margin: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼筋放樣與保護層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rebar placement and cover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若停止點檢查只看鋼筋數量而不量高度與搭接，現場可能出現數量對、位置錯的情況，結構在正常使用下沒有徵兆，安全餘裕卻已被吃掉，直到加載或劣化疊加時突然破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If hold-point checks count bars but do not measure height or laps, the site can have the right number of bars in the wrong place; the structure shows nothing in normal use while its margin is gone, until added load or deterioration triggers sudden failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：NIST 對 Champlain Towers South 的結論同時提到施工與設計圖說不符、使用期間增加的荷載以及長期腐蝕，共同壓縮了本來就不足的餘裕；因此施工階段的停止點檢查，本身就是抗連鎖倒塌設計的一部分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: NIST's findings on Champlain Towers South cite construction that deviated from the drawings, loads added in service and long-term corrosion as jointly eroding margins that were already too small; hold-point inspection during construction is therefore part of progressive-collapse design itself.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼筋數量與圖面相同，就代表結構的抗倒塌能力與設計相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the number of bars matches the drawings, collapse resistance matches the design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若停止點檢查只看鋼筋數量而不量高度與搭接，現場可能出現數量對、位置錯的情況，結構在正常使用下沒有徵兆，安全餘裕卻已被吃掉，直到加載或劣化疊加時突然破壞。
knowledge.textEn: If hold-point checks count bars but do not measure height or laps, the site can have the right number of bars in the wrong place; the structure shows nothing in normal use while its margin is gone, until added load or deterioration triggers sudden failure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工符合性與安全餘裕」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Construction conformance and safety margin" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若停止點檢查只看鋼筋數量而不量高度與搭接，現場可能出現數量對、位置錯的情況，結構在正常使用下沒有徵兆，安全餘裕卻已被吃掉，直到加載或劣化疊加時突然破壞。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
靜力推覆試驗得到的最大力，就等於突然拆柱時結構能承受的荷載。
optionsEn: If hold-point checks count bars but do not measure height or laps, the site can have the right number of bars in the wrong place.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The peak force from a static push-down test equals the load the structure can carry after sudden column loss.
quiz.explanation: 若停止點檢查只看鋼筋數量而不量高度與搭接，現場可能出現數量對、位置錯的情況，結構在正常使用下沒有徵兆，安全餘裕卻已被吃掉，直到加載或劣化疊加時突然破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If hold-point checks count bars but do not measure height or laps, the site can have the right number of bars in the wrong place; the structure shows nothing in normal use while its margin is gone, until added load or deterioration triggers sudden failure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「子結構試驗與能量法動力容量」與「既有建築評估與腐蝕對餘裕的影響」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity" and "Existing-building assessment and corrosion of margins": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 子結構試驗與能量法動力容量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「子結構拆柱試驗」如何影響結構抗連鎖倒塌設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Subassembly column-removal test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 接頭在大轉角下的拉力與轉角能力很難只靠計算，需要以實尺度梁柱子結構試驗驗證：把中間柱向下推，記錄力—位移曲線、接頭轉角、梁軸力與破壞模式。靜力推覆曲線可用能量法換算為突然拆柱時的動力容量：結構到某位移時吸收的應變能，必須等於重力荷載在該位移所做的功，因此動力容量低於靜力最大值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「子結構拆柱試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The tension and rotation capacity of connections at large rotations is hard to establish by calculation alone and is verified by full-scale beam–column subassembly tests: the middle column is pushed down while the force–displacement curve, connection rotations, beam axial forces and failure mode are recorded. The static push-down curve converts to a dynamic capacity for sudden column loss by the energy method: the strain energy absorbed up to a displacement must equal the work done by gravity load over that displacement, so dynamic capacity is lower than the static peak. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Subassembly column-removal test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡化雙線性推覆曲線：0.1 m 時 600 kN，0.6 m 時因懸鏈作用升到 900 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A simplified bilinear push-down curve reaches 600 kN at 0.1 m and, through catenary action, 900 kN at 0.6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「靜力推覆試驗得到的最大力，就等於突然拆柱時結構能承受的荷載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The peak force from a static push-down test equals the load the structure can carry after sudden column loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「子結構拆柱試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Subassembly column-removal test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 子結構試驗與能量法動力容量
knowledge.titleEn: Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity
knowledge.text: 接頭在大轉角下的拉力與轉角能力很難只靠計算，需要以實尺度梁柱子結構試驗驗證：把中間柱向下推，記錄力—位移曲線、接頭轉角、梁軸力與破壞模式。靜力推覆曲線可用能量法換算為突然拆柱時的動力容量：結構到某位移時吸收的應變能，必須等於重力荷載在該位移所做的功，因此動力容量低於靜力最大值。
knowledge.textEn: The tension and rotation capacity of connections at large rotations is hard to establish by calculation alone and is verified by full-scale beam–column subassembly tests: the middle column is pushed down while the force–displacement curve, connection rotations, beam axial forces and failure mode are recorded. The static push-down curve converts to a dynamic capacity for sudden column loss by the energy method: the strain energy absorbed up to a displacement must equal the work done by gravity load over that displacement, so dynamic capacity is lower than the static peak.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：靜力推覆試驗得到的最大力，就等於突然拆柱時結構能承受的荷載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The peak force from a static push-down test equals the load the structure can carry after sudden column loss. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「子結構試驗與能量法動力容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity" is correct?
options: 靜力推覆試驗得到的最大力，就等於突然拆柱時結構能承受的荷載。
接頭在大轉角下的拉力與轉角能力很難只靠計算，需要以實尺度梁柱子結構試驗驗證：把中間柱向下推，記錄力—位移曲線、接頭轉角、梁軸力與破壞模式。
混凝土表面裂縫與剝落只是外觀問題，與結構倒塌風險無關。
optionsEn: The peak force from a static push-down test equals the load the structure can carry after sudden column loss.

The tension and rotation capacity of connections at large rotations is hard to establish by calculation alone and is verified by full-scale beam–column subassembly tests: the middle column is pushed down while the force–displacement curve, connection rotations, beam axial forces and failure mode are recorded.
Surface cracks and spalls in concrete are cosmetic and unrelated to collapse risk.
quiz.explanation: 接頭在大轉角下的拉力與轉角能力很難只靠計算，需要以實尺度梁柱子結構試驗驗證：把中間柱向下推，記錄力—位移曲線、接頭轉角、梁軸力與破壞模式。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The tension and rotation capacity of connections at large rotations is hard to establish by calculation alone and is verified by full-scale beam–column subassembly tests: the middle column is pushed down while the force–displacement curve, connection rotations, beam axial forces and failure mode are recorded. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 子結構試驗與能量法動力容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「子結構拆柱試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Subassembly column-removal test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡化雙線性推覆曲線：0.1 m 時 600 kN，0.6 m 時因懸鏈作用升到 900 kN。到 0.6 m 的吸收能量 E = ½×600×0.1 + (600+900)/2×0.5 = 30 + 375 = 405 kJ，動力容量 P_d = E/u = 405/0.6 = 675 kN，只有靜力最大值的 75%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A simplified bilinear push-down curve reaches 600 kN at 0.1 m and, through catenary action, 900 kN at 0.6 m. Energy absorbed to 0.6 m is E = ½×600×0.1 + (600+900)/2×0.5 = 30 + 375 = 405 kJ, so the dynamic capacity is P_d = E/u = 405/0.6 = 675 kN, only 75% of the static peak. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫要包含試體尺寸、加載方式、量測點（柱頂位移、接頭轉角、梁軸力應變）、停止條件與破壞判定；結果與有限元素模型比較，用來校核分析中的接頭模型與允收轉角。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The test plan should specify specimen size, loading method, instrumentation (column-top displacement, connection rotation, beam axial strain), stop criteria and failure definition; compare the results with finite-element models to calibrate the connection models and acceptance rotations used in analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 簡化雙線性推覆曲線：0.1 m 時 600 kN，0.6 m 時因懸鏈作用升到 900 kN。到 0.6 m 的吸收能量 E = ½×600×0.1 + (600+900)/2×0.5 = 30 + 375 = 405 kJ，動力容量 P_d = E/u = 405/0.6 = 675 kN，只有靜力最大值的 75%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A simplified bilinear push-down curve reaches 600 kN at 0.1 m and, through catenary action, 900 kN at 0.6 m. Energy absorbed to 0.6 m is E = ½×600×0.1 + (600+900)/2×0.5 = 30 + 375 = 405 kJ, so the dynamic capacity is P_d = E/u = 405/0.6 = 675 kN, only 75% of the static peak. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「子結構試驗與能量法動力容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity", which statement holds?
options: 建築完工驗收後，結構安全不會因使用期間的小改裝而改變。
柱失效時，上方荷載會慢慢轉移，用靜力分析就足夠。
簡化雙線性推覆曲線：0.1 m 時 600 kN，0.6 m 時因懸鏈作用升到 900 kN。
optionsEn: Once a building passes completion inspection, small renovations in service cannot change its structural safety.
When a column fails, the load above transfers slowly, so static analysis is enough.
A simplified bilinear push-down curve reaches 600 kN at 0.1 m and, through catenary action, 900 kN at 0.6 m.
quiz.explanation: 簡化雙線性推覆曲線：0.1 m 時 600 kN，0.6 m 時因懸鏈作用升到 900 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A simplified bilinear push-down curve reaches 600 kN at 0.1 m and, through catenary action, 900 kN at 0.6 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 子結構試驗與能量法動力容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「子結構拆柱試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Subassembly column-removal test” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗計畫要包含試體尺寸、加載方式、量測點（柱頂位移、接頭轉角、梁軸力應變）、停止條件與破壞判定；結果與有限元素模型比較，用來校核分析中的接頭模型與允收轉角。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The test plan should specify specimen size, loading method, instrumentation (column-top displacement, connection rotation, beam axial strain), stop criteria and failure definition; compare the results with finite-element models to calibrate the connection models and acceptance rotations used in analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計採用的接頭轉角能力必須有試驗或公認文獻依據並在計算書中引用；新型接頭應先完成子結構試驗並經審查核可，才可用在需要替代路徑的位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Connection rotation capacities used in design must rest on tests or recognised literature cited in the calculations; a new connection type should complete subassembly tests and pass review before being used where alternate paths depend on it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若直接以靜力推覆的最大力判定合格，會高估約三分之一的實際動力容量；試驗若未正確模擬邊界的水平約束，懸鏈作用被高估或低估，都會讓設計失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accepting the static push-down peak directly overstates the real dynamic capacity by about a third; tests that misrepresent horizontal restraint at the boundaries overstate or understate catenary action and distort the design either way. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫要包含試體尺寸、加載方式、量測點（柱頂位移、接頭轉角、梁軸力應變）、停止條件與破壞判定；結果與有限元素模型比較，用來校核分析中的接頭模型與允收轉角。
knowledge.textEn: The test plan should specify specimen size, loading method, instrumentation (column-top displacement, connection rotation, beam axial strain), stop criteria and failure definition; compare the results with finite-element models to calibrate the connection models and acceptance rotations used in analysis.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計採用的接頭轉角能力必須有試驗或公認文獻依據並在計算書中引用；新型接頭應先完成子結構試驗並經審查核可，才可用在需要替代路徑的位置。
knowledge.textEn: Connection rotation capacities used in design must rest on tests or recognised literature cited in the calculations; a new connection type should complete subassembly tests and pass review before being used where alternate paths depend on it.

quiz.question: 要驗證「子結構試驗與能量法動力容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity"?
options: 試驗計畫要包含試體尺寸、加載方式、量測點（柱頂位移、接頭轉角、梁軸力應變）、停止條件與破壞判定；結果與有限元素模型比較，用來校核分析中的接頭模型與允收轉角。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
無梁版的穿孔剪力破壞前，一定會有很大的撓度可以預警。
optionsEn: The test plan should specify specimen size, loading method, instrumentation (column-top displacement, connection rotation, beam axial strain), stop criteria and failure definition.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Punching shear in a flat plate is always preceded by large, warning deflections.
quiz.explanation: 試驗計畫要包含試體尺寸、加載方式、量測點（柱頂位移、接頭轉角、梁軸力應變）、停止條件與破壞判定；結果與有限元素模型比較，用來校核分析中的接頭模型與允收轉角。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The test plan should specify specimen size, loading method, instrumentation (column-top displacement, connection rotation, beam axial strain), stop criteria and failure definition; compare the results with finite-element models to calibrate the connection models and acceptance rotations used in analysis. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 子結構試驗與能量法動力容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「子結構拆柱試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Subassembly column-removal test” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若直接以靜力推覆的最大力判定合格，會高估約三分之一的實際動力容量；試驗若未正確模擬邊界的水平約束，懸鏈作用被高估或低估，都會讓設計失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accepting the static push-down peak directly overstates the real dynamic capacity by about a third; tests that misrepresent horizontal restraint at the boundaries overstate or understate catenary action and distort the design either way. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：靜力推覆曲線可用能量法換算為突然拆柱時的動力容量：結構到某位移時吸收的應變能，必須等於重力荷載在該位移所做的功，因此動力容量低於靜力最大值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The static push-down curve converts to a dynamic capacity for sudden column loss by the energy method: the strain energy absorbed up to a displacement must equal the work done by gravity load over that displacement, so dynamic capacity is lower than the static peak.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「靜力推覆試驗得到的最大力，就等於突然拆柱時結構能承受的荷載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The peak force from a static push-down test equals the load the structure can carry after sudden column loss." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若直接以靜力推覆的最大力判定合格，會高估約三分之一的實際動力容量；試驗若未正確模擬邊界的水平約束，懸鏈作用被高估或低估，都會讓設計失真。
knowledge.textEn: Accepting the static push-down peak directly overstates the real dynamic capacity by about a third; tests that misrepresent horizontal restraint at the boundaries overstate or understate catenary action and distort the design either way.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「子結構試驗與能量法動力容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若直接以靜力推覆的最大力判定合格，會高估約三分之一的實際動力容量；試驗若未正確模擬邊界的水平約束，懸鏈作用被高估或低估，都會讓設計失真。
混凝土表面裂縫與剝落只是外觀問題，與結構倒塌風險無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Accepting the static push-down peak directly overstates the real dynamic capacity by about a third.
Surface cracks and spalls in concrete are cosmetic and unrelated to collapse risk.
quiz.explanation: 若直接以靜力推覆的最大力判定合格，會高估約三分之一的實際動力容量；試驗若未正確模擬邊界的水平約束，懸鏈作用被高估或低估，都會讓設計失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Accepting the static push-down peak directly overstates the real dynamic capacity by about a third; tests that misrepresent horizontal restraint at the boundaries overstate or understate catenary action and distort the design either way. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 既有建築評估與腐蝕對餘裕的影響：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Existing-building assessment and corrosion of margins: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「既有建築劣化調查」如何影響結構抗連鎖倒塌設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Condition survey of existing building” governs force, deformation or durability in “Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 既有建築的抗倒塌能力會隨時間下降：防水失效使鋼筋腐蝕、混凝土剝落，附加設備與鋪面增加荷載，改裝則移除牆或開孔。Champlain Towers South 約 40 年使用期間的增加荷載與長期腐蝕，都被 NIST 列為壓縮安全餘裕的因素。評估要結合文件回顧、現場調查、非破壞檢測與取樣試驗，找出需求比已接近 1 的柱頭或接頭，再以替代路徑分析決定補強優先順序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「既有建築劣化調查」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Collapse resistance of existing buildings declines over time: failed waterproofing corrodes reinforcement and spalls concrete, added equipment and paving raise loads, and renovations remove walls or cut openings. NIST lists both the loads added and the long-term corrosion over the roughly 40-year life of Champlain Towers South as factors that eroded its margins. Assessment combines document review, site survey, non-destructive testing and sampling to find column heads or connections whose demand ratio is approaching 1, then uses alternate-path analysis to rank strengthening priorities. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Condition survey of existing building” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：直徑 20 mm 鋼筋若每側腐蝕深度 1.5 mm，剩餘直徑 17 mm，面積比 (17/20)² = 0.7225，斷面損失約 28%；若這支鋼筋是穿過柱核心的完整性鋼筋，穿孔後的懸吊能力也同比例下降。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 20 mm bar corroded 1.5 mm on each side retains a 17 mm diameter, an area ratio of (17/20)² = 0.7225 or a loss of about 28%; if it is an integrity bar through the column core, the hanging capacity after punching falls in the same proportion.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土表面裂縫與剝落只是外觀問題，與結構倒塌風險無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Surface cracks and spalls in concrete are cosmetic and unrelated to collapse risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「既有建築劣化調查」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Condition survey of existing building”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 既有建築評估與腐蝕對餘裕的影響
knowledge.titleEn: Existing-building assessment and corrosion of margins
knowledge.text: 既有建築的抗倒塌能力會隨時間下降：防水失效使鋼筋腐蝕、混凝土剝落，附加設備與鋪面增加荷載，改裝則移除牆或開孔。Champlain Towers South 約 40 年使用期間的增加荷載與長期腐蝕，都被 NIST 列為壓縮安全餘裕的因素。
knowledge.textEn: Collapse resistance of existing buildings declines over time: failed waterproofing corrodes reinforcement and spalls concrete, added equipment and paving raise loads, and renovations remove walls or cut openings. NIST lists both the loads added and the long-term corrosion over the roughly 40-year life of Champlain Towers South as factors that eroded its margins.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土表面裂縫與剝落只是外觀問題，與結構倒塌風險無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Surface cracks and spalls in concrete are cosmetic and unrelated to collapse risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「既有建築評估與腐蝕對餘裕的影響」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Existing-building assessment and corrosion of margins" is correct?
options: 混凝土表面裂縫與剝落只是外觀問題，與結構倒塌風險無關。
防火被覆只要滿足耐火時效，就不需要考慮熱膨脹對接頭的影響。
既有建築的抗倒塌能力會隨時間下降：防水失效使鋼筋腐蝕、混凝土剝落，附加設備與鋪面增加荷載，改裝則移除牆或開孔。
optionsEn: Surface cracks and spalls in concrete are cosmetic and unrelated to collapse risk.
If fireproofing meets its fire-resistance rating, thermal expansion effects on connections can be ignored.

Collapse resistance of existing buildings declines over time: failed waterproofing corrodes reinforcement and spalls concrete, added equipment and paving raise loads, and renovations remove walls or cut openings.
quiz.explanation: 既有建築的抗倒塌能力會隨時間下降：防水失效使鋼筋腐蝕、混凝土剝落，附加設備與鋪面增加荷載，改裝則移除牆或開孔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Collapse resistance of existing buildings declines over time: failed waterproofing corrodes reinforcement and spalls concrete, added equipment and paving raise loads, and renovations remove walls or cut openings. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 既有建築評估與腐蝕對餘裕的影響：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Existing-building assessment and corrosion of margins: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「既有建築劣化調查」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Condition survey of existing building” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：直徑 20 mm 鋼筋若每側腐蝕深度 1.5 mm，剩餘直徑 17 mm，面積比 (17/20)² = 0.7225，斷面損失約 28%；若這支鋼筋是穿過柱核心的完整性鋼筋，穿孔後的懸吊能力也同比例下降。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 20 mm bar corroded 1.5 mm on each side retains a 17 mm diameter, an area ratio of (17/20)² = 0.7225 or a loss of about 28%; if it is an integrity bar through the column core, the hanging capacity after punching falls in the same proportion. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依調查計畫以目視、敲擊、半電池電位、氯離子含量與鋼筋掃描找出腐蝕區，鑽心取樣測強度與碳化深度，必要時鑿開確認鋼筋斷面；結果回饋到結構模型，重新計算關鍵接頭的需求比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Following a survey plan, locate corrosion with visual inspection, hammer sounding, half-cell potential, chloride content and cover scanning, take cores for strength and carbonation depth, and break out concrete where needed to measure bar sections; feed the results back into the structural model and recompute demand ratios at key connections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 直徑 20 mm 鋼筋若每側腐蝕深度 1.5 mm，剩餘直徑 17 mm，面積比 (17/20)² = 0.7225，斷面損失約 28%；若這支鋼筋是穿過柱核心的完整性鋼筋，穿孔後的懸吊能力也同比例下降。數值為教學假設。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「既有建築評估與腐蝕對餘裕的影響」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Existing-building assessment and corrosion of margins", which statement holds?
options: 直徑 20 mm 鋼筋若每側腐蝕深度 1.5 mm，剩餘直徑 17 mm，面積比 (17/20)² = 0.7225，斷面損失約 28%。
只要結構符合耐震規範，就一定不會發生連鎖倒塌。
拉結筋只要總面積足夠，在哪裡斷開都沒有關係。
optionsEn: A 20 mm bar corroded 1.5 mm on each side retains a 17 mm diameter, an area ratio of (17/20)² = 0.7225 or a loss of about 28%.
A structure that satisfies the seismic code can never suffer progressive collapse.
As long as the total tie area is sufficient, it does not matter where the bars are interrupted.
quiz.explanation: 直徑 20 mm 鋼筋若每側腐蝕深度 1.5 mm，剩餘直徑 17 mm，面積比 (17/20)² = 0.7225，斷面損失約 28%；若這支鋼筋是穿過柱核心的完整性鋼筋，穿孔後的懸吊能力也同比例下降。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 20 mm bar corroded 1.5 mm on each side retains a 17 mm diameter, an area ratio of (17/20)² = 0.7225 or a loss of about 28%; if it is an integrity bar through the column core, the hanging capacity after punching falls in the same proportion. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 既有建築評估與腐蝕對餘裕的影響：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Existing-building assessment and corrosion of margins: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「既有建築劣化調查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Condition survey of existing building” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依調查計畫以目視、敲擊、半電池電位、氯離子含量與鋼筋掃描找出腐蝕區，鑽心取樣測強度與碳化深度，必要時鑿開確認鋼筋斷面；結果回饋到結構模型，重新計算關鍵接頭的需求比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Following a survey plan, locate corrosion with visual inspection, hammer sounding, half-cell potential, chloride content and cover scanning, take cores for strength and carbonation depth, and break out concrete where needed to measure bar sections; feed the results back into the structural model and recompute demand ratios at key connections. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主應建立定期結構檢查制度，例如每 10 年由結構技師全面評估，報告須列出優先處理的關鍵構件與期限；發現柱頭裂縫、板面下陷或大面積剝落時，應立即限制使用並通報主管機關。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Owners should set up periodic structural inspections, for example a full assessment by a structural engineer every 10 years, with reports listing priority members and deadlines; cracks at column heads, slab sagging or extensive spalling call for immediate use restrictions and notification of the authority.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把剝落與滲水視為一般維修而不評估結構影響，腐蝕會持續吃掉關鍵鋼筋的斷面；修復時只補表面砂漿而不處理氯離子污染與防水，腐蝕會在修補邊緣加速，即所謂環狀陽極效應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating spalls and leaks as routine maintenance without structural assessment lets corrosion keep consuming key bar sections; patching surface mortar without dealing with chloride contamination and waterproofing accelerates corrosion at the patch edges, the so-called ring-anode effect. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依調查計畫以目視、敲擊、半電池電位、氯離子含量與鋼筋掃描找出腐蝕區，鑽心取樣測強度與碳化深度，必要時鑿開確認鋼筋斷面；結果回饋到結構模型，重新計算關鍵接頭的需求比。
knowledge.textEn: Following a survey plan, locate corrosion with visual inspection, hammer sounding, half-cell potential, chloride content and cover scanning, take cores for strength and carbonation depth, and break out concrete where needed to measure bar sections; feed the results back into the structural model and recompute demand ratios at key connections.
