knowledge.text: 業主應建立定期結構檢查制度，例如每 10 年由結構技師全面評估，報告須列出優先處理的關鍵構件與期限；發現柱頭裂縫、板面下陷或大面積剝落時，應立即限制使用並通報主管機關。
knowledge.textEn: Owners should set up periodic structural inspections, for example a full assessment by a structural engineer every 10 years, with reports listing priority members and deadlines; cracks at column heads, slab sagging or extensive spalling call for immediate use restrictions and notification of the authority.

quiz.question: 要驗證「既有建築評估與腐蝕對餘裕的影響」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Existing-building assessment and corrosion of margins"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
依調查計畫以目視、敲擊、半電池電位、氯離子含量與鋼筋掃描找出腐蝕區，鑽心取樣測強度與碳化深度，必要時鑿開確認鋼筋斷面。
只要梁的抗彎強度足夠，拆柱後就不需要考慮懸鏈作用。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Following a survey plan, locate corrosion with visual inspection, hammer sounding, half-cell potential, chloride content and cover scanning, take cores for strength and carbonation depth, and break out concrete where needed to measure bar sections.
If the beam has enough bending strength, catenary action need not be considered after column loss.
quiz.explanation: 依調查計畫以目視、敲擊、半電池電位、氯離子含量與鋼筋掃描找出腐蝕區，鑽心取樣測強度與碳化深度，必要時鑿開確認鋼筋斷面；結果回饋到結構模型，重新計算關鍵接頭的需求比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Following a survey plan, locate corrosion with visual inspection, hammer sounding, half-cell potential, chloride content and cover scanning, take cores for strength and carbonation depth, and break out concrete where needed to measure bar sections; feed the results back into the structural model and recompute demand ratios at key connections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 既有建築評估與腐蝕對餘裕的影響：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Existing-building assessment and corrosion of margins: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「既有建築劣化調查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Condition survey of existing building” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把剝落與滲水視為一般維修而不評估結構影響，腐蝕會持續吃掉關鍵鋼筋的斷面；修復時只補表面砂漿而不處理氯離子污染與防水，腐蝕會在修補邊緣加速，即所謂環狀陽極效應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating spalls and leaks as routine maintenance without structural assessment lets corrosion keep consuming key bar sections; patching surface mortar without dealing with chloride contamination and waterproofing accelerates corrosion at the patch edges, the so-called ring-anode effect. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：評估要結合文件回顧、現場調查、非破壞檢測與取樣試驗，找出需求比已接近 1 的柱頭或接頭，再以替代路徑分析決定補強優先順序。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assessment combines document review, site survey, non-destructive testing and sampling to find column heads or connections whose demand ratio is approaching 1, then uses alternate-path analysis to rank strengthening priorities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土表面裂縫與剝落只是外觀問題，與結構倒塌風險無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Surface cracks and spalls in concrete are cosmetic and unrelated to collapse risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把剝落與滲水視為一般維修而不評估結構影響，腐蝕會持續吃掉關鍵鋼筋的斷面；修復時只補表面砂漿而不處理氯離子污染與防水，腐蝕會在修補邊緣加速，即所謂環狀陽極效應。
knowledge.textEn: Treating spalls and leaks as routine maintenance without structural assessment lets corrosion keep consuming key bar sections; patching surface mortar without dealing with chloride contamination and waterproofing accelerates corrosion at the patch edges, the so-called ring-anode effect.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「既有建築評估與腐蝕對餘裕的影響」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Existing-building assessment and corrosion of margins" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
防火被覆只要滿足耐火時效，就不需要考慮熱膨脹對接頭的影響。
若把剝落與滲水視為一般維修而不評估結構影響，腐蝕會持續吃掉關鍵鋼筋的斷面；修復時只補表面砂漿而不處理氯離子污染與防水，腐蝕會在修補邊緣加速，即所謂環狀陽極效應。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
If fireproofing meets its fire-resistance rating, thermal expansion effects on connections can be ignored.
Treating spalls and leaks as routine maintenance without structural assessment lets corrosion keep consuming key bar sections.
quiz.explanation: 若把剝落與滲水視為一般維修而不評估結構影響，腐蝕會持續吃掉關鍵鋼筋的斷面；修復時只補表面砂漿而不處理氯離子污染與防水，腐蝕會在修補邊緣加速，即所謂環狀陽極效應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating spalls and leaks as routine maintenance without structural assessment lets corrosion keep consuming key bar sections; patching surface mortar without dealing with chloride contamination and waterproofing accelerates corrosion at the patch edges, the so-called ring-anode effect. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「火災引起的連鎖倒塌」與「使用期間變更管理與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fire-induced progressive collapse" and "Change management in service and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 火災引起的連鎖倒塌：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire-induced progressive collapse: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「受熱樓板梁與柱座」如何影響結構抗連鎖倒塌設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Heated floor beams and column seat” governs force, deformation or durability in “Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 火災是常被低估的觸發事件。NIST 對世界貿易中心 7 號大樓的調查指出，這棟 47 層建築因灑水系統水源中斷，下層樓層火災失控約七小時，樓板梁受熱膨脹使第 13 層一根大梁脫離與 79 號柱的接合，樓板逐層塌落使 79 號柱失去側向支撐而挫屈，最後演變成整棟倒塌；NIST 稱這是第一棟主要因不受控火災而倒塌的高樓。教訓是熱膨脹會在長跨樓板與接頭中產生常溫設計沒有考慮的推力與位移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「受熱樓板梁與柱座」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fire is an underrated trigger. NIST's investigation of World Trade Center 7 found that in this 47-storey building, with the sprinkler water supply lost, fires on lower floors burned uncontrolled for about seven hours; thermal expansion of floor beams caused a girder on floor 13 to lose its connection to Column 79, cascading floor failures left Column 79 without lateral support until it buckled, and the whole building collapsed, which NIST calls the first known tall building brought down primarily by uncontrolled fire. The lesson is that thermal expansion produces thrusts and displacements in long-span floors and connections that ambient-temperature design never considered. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Heated floor beams and column seat” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防火被覆只要滿足耐火時效，就不需要考慮熱膨脹對接頭的影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If fireproofing meets its fire-resistance rating, thermal expansion effects on connections can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「受熱樓板梁與柱座」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Heated floor beams and column seat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 火災引起的連鎖倒塌
knowledge.text: 火災是常被低估的觸發事件。NIST 對世界貿易中心 7 號大樓的調查指出，這棟 47 層建築因灑水系統水源中斷，下層樓層火災失控約七小時，樓板梁受熱膨脹使第 13 層一根大梁脫離與 79 號柱的接合，樓板逐層塌落使 79 號柱失去側向支撐而挫屈，最後演變成整棟倒塌；NIST 稱這是第一棟主要因不受控火災而倒塌的高樓。
knowledge.textEn: Fire is an underrated trigger. NIST's investigation of World Trade Center 7 found that in this 47-storey building, with the sprinkler water supply lost, fires on lower floors burned uncontrolled for about seven hours; thermal expansion of floor beams caused a girder on floor 13 to lose its connection to Column 79, cascading floor failures left Column 79 without lateral support until it buckled, and the whole building collapsed, which NIST calls the first known tall building brought down primarily by uncontrolled fire.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：防火被覆只要滿足耐火時效，就不需要考慮熱膨脹對接頭的影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If fireproofing meets its fire-resistance rating, thermal expansion effects on connections can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「火災引起的連鎖倒塌」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire-induced progressive collapse" is correct?
options: 火災是常被低估的觸發事件。
防火被覆只要滿足耐火時效，就不需要考慮熱膨脹對接頭的影響。
建築完工驗收後，結構安全不會因使用期間的小改裝而改變。
optionsEn: Fire is an underrated trigger.
If fireproofing meets its fire-resistance rating, thermal expansion effects on connections can be ignored.
Once a building passes completion inspection, small renovations in service cannot change its structural safety.
quiz.explanation: 火災是常被低估的觸發事件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fire is an underrated trigger. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 火災引起的連鎖倒塌：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire-induced progressive collapse: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「受熱樓板梁與柱座」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Heated floor beams and column seat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。鋼梁 L = 15 m、α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、平均升溫 ΔT = 400°C 時，ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×15,000×400 = 72 mm；若梁端擱置在 150 mm 寬的柱座上而只有部分被螺栓約束，72 mm 的位移已接近擱置長度的一半。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For a 15 m steel beam with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ per °C and an average temperature rise of 400°C, ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×15,000×400 = 72 mm; if the beam end sits on a 150 mm seat with only partial bolt restraint, 72 mm approaches half the seating length. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以結構火災分析（熱傳加結構非線性）檢查長跨樓板在設計火災下的膨脹推力、接頭位移與柱的有效長度，並確認防火被覆與灑水系統的可靠度假設；既有建築則定期檢查防火被覆完整性與灑水水源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use structural fire analysis, heat transfer plus nonlinear structural response, to check expansion thrust, connection displacement and column effective length in long-span floors under the design fire, and confirm the reliability assumed for fire protection and sprinklers; in existing buildings, inspect fireproofing integrity and sprinkler water supply periodically.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。鋼梁 L = 15 m、α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、平均升溫 ΔT = 400°C 時，ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×15,000×400 = 72 mm；若梁端擱置在 150 mm 寬的柱座上而只有部分被螺栓約束，72 mm 的位移已接近擱置長度的一半。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For a 15 m steel beam with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ per °C and an average temperature rise of 400°C, ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×15,000×400 = 72 mm; if the beam end sits on a 150 mm seat with only partial bolt restraint, 72 mm approaches half the seating length. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「火災引起的連鎖倒塌」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire-induced progressive collapse", which statement holds?
options: 柱失效時，上方荷載會慢慢轉移，用靜力分析就足夠。
熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
無梁版的穿孔剪力破壞前，一定會有很大的撓度可以預警。
optionsEn: When a column fails, the load above transfers slowly, so static analysis is enough.
Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
Punching shear in a flat plate is always preceded by large, warning deflections.
quiz.explanation: 熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 火災引起的連鎖倒塌：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire-induced progressive collapse: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「受熱樓板梁與柱座」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Heated floor beams and column seat” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以結構火災分析（熱傳加結構非線性）檢查長跨樓板在設計火災下的膨脹推力、接頭位移與柱的有效長度，並確認防火被覆與灑水系統的可靠度假設；既有建築則定期檢查防火被覆完整性與灑水水源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use structural fire analysis, heat transfer plus nonlinear structural response, to check expansion thrust, connection displacement and column effective length in long-span floors under the design fire, and confirm the reliability assumed for fire protection and sprinklers; in existing buildings, inspect fireproofing integrity and sprinkler water supply periodically. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：長跨樓板與關鍵柱的接頭應以結構火災分析檢核熱膨脹與冷卻收縮，柱座擱置長度與螺栓約束要保留餘裕；灑水水源與消防泵的可靠度須納入維護計畫，任何停水都要有補償措施。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Connections of long-span floors and key columns should be checked by structural fire analysis for expansion and cooling contraction, with margin in seat length and bolt restraint; sprinkler supply and fire-pump reliability belong in the maintenance plan, and any shutdown needs compensating measures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：灑水系統失效而防火被覆又有缺損時，長跨樓板梁膨脹推動大梁，接頭剪斷或大梁脫離柱座，樓板塌落後柱的無支撐長度變成數層，承載力驟降，局部火災演變成整體倒塌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: When sprinklers fail and fireproofing is damaged, expanding long-span floor beams push girders until connections shear or girders walk off their seats; once floors fall, columns become unbraced over several storeys, their capacity collapses and a local fire becomes total collapse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以結構火災分析（熱傳加結構非線性）檢查長跨樓板在設計火災下的膨脹推力、接頭位移與柱的有效長度，並確認防火被覆與灑水系統的可靠度假設；既有建築則定期檢查防火被覆完整性與灑水水源。
knowledge.textEn: Use structural fire analysis, heat transfer plus nonlinear structural response, to check expansion thrust, connection displacement and column effective length in long-span floors under the design fire, and confirm the reliability assumed for fire protection and sprinklers; in existing buildings, inspect fireproofing integrity and sprinkler water supply periodically.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 長跨樓板與關鍵柱的接頭應以結構火災分析檢核熱膨脹與冷卻收縮，柱座擱置長度與螺栓約束要保留餘裕；灑水水源與消防泵的可靠度須納入維護計畫，任何停水都要有補償措施。
knowledge.textEn: Connections of long-span floors and key columns should be checked by structural fire analysis for expansion and cooling contraction, with margin in seat length and bolt restraint; sprinkler supply and fire-pump reliability belong in the maintenance plan, and any shutdown needs compensating measures.

quiz.question: 要驗證「火災引起的連鎖倒塌」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fire-induced progressive collapse"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
鋼筋數量與圖面相同，就代表結構的抗倒塌能力與設計相同。
以結構火災分析（熱傳加結構非線性）檢查長跨樓板在設計火災下的膨脹推力、接頭位移與柱的有效長度，並確認防火被覆與灑水系統的可靠度假設。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If the number of bars matches the drawings, collapse resistance matches the design.

Use structural fire analysis, heat transfer plus nonlinear structural response, to check expansion thrust, connection displacement and column effective length in long-span floors under the design fire, and confirm the reliability assumed for fire protection and sprinklers.
quiz.explanation: 以結構火災分析（熱傳加結構非線性）檢查長跨樓板在設計火災下的膨脹推力、接頭位移與柱的有效長度，並確認防火被覆與灑水系統的可靠度假設；既有建築則定期檢查防火被覆完整性與灑水水源。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use structural fire analysis, heat transfer plus nonlinear structural response, to check expansion thrust, connection displacement and column effective length in long-span floors under the design fire, and confirm the reliability assumed for fire protection and sprinklers; in existing buildings, inspect fireproofing integrity and sprinkler water supply periodically. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 火災引起的連鎖倒塌：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire-induced progressive collapse: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「受熱樓板梁與柱座」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Heated floor beams and column seat” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 灑水系統失效而防火被覆又有缺損時，長跨樓板梁膨脹推動大梁，接頭剪斷或大梁脫離柱座，樓板塌落後柱的無支撐長度變成數層，承載力驟降，局部火災演變成整體倒塌。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: When sprinklers fail and fireproofing is damaged, expanding long-span floor beams push girders until connections shear or girders walk off their seats; once floors fall, columns become unbraced over several storeys, their capacity collapses and a local fire becomes total collapse. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：教訓是熱膨脹會在長跨樓板與接頭中產生常溫設計沒有考慮的推力與位移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The lesson is that thermal expansion produces thrusts and displacements in long-span floors and connections that ambient-temperature design never considered.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「防火被覆只要滿足耐火時效，就不需要考慮熱膨脹對接頭的影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If fireproofing meets its fire-resistance rating, thermal expansion effects on connections can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 灑水系統失效而防火被覆又有缺損時，長跨樓板梁膨脹推動大梁，接頭剪斷或大梁脫離柱座，樓板塌落後柱的無支撐長度變成數層，承載力驟降，局部火災演變成整體倒塌。
knowledge.textEn: When sprinklers fail and fireproofing is damaged, expanding long-span floor beams push girders until connections shear or girders walk off their seats; once floors fall, columns become unbraced over several storeys, their capacity collapses and a local fire becomes total collapse.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「火災引起的連鎖倒塌」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire-induced progressive collapse" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 灑水系統失效而防火被覆又有缺損時，長跨樓板梁膨脹推動大梁，接頭剪斷或大梁脫離柱座，樓板塌落後柱的無支撐長度變成數層，承載力驟降，局部火災演變成整體倒塌。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
建築完工驗收後，結構安全不會因使用期間的小改裝而改變。
optionsEn: When sprinklers fail and fireproofing is damaged, expanding long-span floor beams push girders until connections shear or girders walk off their seats.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once a building passes completion inspection, small renovations in service cannot change its structural safety.
quiz.explanation: 灑水系統失效而防火被覆又有缺損時，長跨樓板梁膨脹推動大梁，接頭剪斷或大梁脫離柱座，樓板塌落後柱的無支撐長度變成數層，承載力驟降，局部火災演變成整體倒塌。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When sprinklers fail and fireproofing is damaged, expanding long-span floor beams push girders until connections shear or girders walk off their seats; once floors fall, columns become unbraced over several storeys, their capacity collapses and a local fire becomes total collapse. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 使用期間變更管理與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Change management in service and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「荷載變更紀錄」如何影響結構抗連鎖倒塌設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Load-change register” governs force, deformation or durability in “Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 抗連鎖倒塌能力在交接後最容易被不知情地削弱：增設屋頂設備、廣場鋪面與植栽、拆除隔間牆、在樓板開孔或切斷拉結筋，每一項單看都不大，累積起來卻可能讓關鍵接頭的需求比超過 1。NIST 指出 Champlain Towers South 使用期間包括泳池平台改變在內的增加荷載，進一步壓縮了餘裕。因此交接文件必須清楚標示哪些構件是替代路徑的關鍵、哪些區域的附加荷載有上限，讓管理單位在改裝前知道必須找結構技師。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「荷載變更紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Collapse resistance is most easily weakened unknowingly after handover: added roof equipment, plaza paving and planters, removed partitions, slab openings or cut ties each look minor, yet together they can push a key connection's demand ratio above 1. NIST notes that loads added during the life of Champlain Towers South, including pool deck modifications, further reduced its margins. Handover documents must therefore show clearly which members are critical to alternate paths and which areas have added-load limits, so that managers know to call a structural engineer before renovating. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Load-change register” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：在 56.25 m² 的柱頭受載面積上增加 100 mm 鋪面（22 kN/m³ × 0.10 m = 2.2 kPa），因數化增量 1.2×2.2×56.25 ≈ 149 kN，V_u 由約 698 kN 增為約 846 kN，相對 φV_c = 733 kN 的需求比由 0.95 升為約 1.15。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Adding 100 mm of paving (22 kN/m³ × 0.10 m = 2.2 kPa) over a 56.25 m² column tributary area adds a factored 1.2×2.2×56.25 ≈ 149 kN, raising V_u from about 698 kN to about 846 kN and the demand ratio against φV_c = 733 kN from 0.95 to about 1.15.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「建築完工驗收後，結構安全不會因使用期間的小改裝而改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a building passes completion inspection, small renovations in service cannot change its structural safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「荷載變更紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Load-change register”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 使用期間變更管理與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Change management in service and handover
knowledge.text: 抗連鎖倒塌能力在交接後最容易被不知情地削弱：增設屋頂設備、廣場鋪面與植栽、拆除隔間牆、在樓板開孔或切斷拉結筋，每一項單看都不大，累積起來卻可能讓關鍵接頭的需求比超過 1。NIST 指出 Champlain Towers South 使用期間包括泳池平台改變在內的增加荷載，進一步壓縮了餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: Collapse resistance is most easily weakened unknowingly after handover: added roof equipment, plaza paving and planters, removed partitions, slab openings or cut ties each look minor, yet together they can push a key connection's demand ratio above 1. NIST notes that loads added during the life of Champlain Towers South, including pool deck modifications, further reduced its margins.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：建築完工驗收後，結構安全不會因使用期間的小改裝而改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a building passes completion inspection, small renovations in service cannot change its structural safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「使用期間變更管理與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Change management in service and handover" is correct?
options: 建築完工驗收後，結構安全不會因使用期間的小改裝而改變。
抗連鎖倒塌能力在交接後最容易被不知情地削弱：增設屋頂設備、廣場鋪面與植栽、拆除隔間牆、在樓板開孔或切斷拉結筋，每一項單看都不大，累積起來卻可能讓關鍵接頭的需求比超過 1。
只要結構符合耐震規範，就一定不會發生連鎖倒塌。
optionsEn: Once a building passes completion inspection, small renovations in service cannot change its structural safety.

Collapse resistance is most easily weakened unknowingly after handover: added roof equipment, plaza paving and planters, removed partitions, slab openings or cut ties each look minor, yet together they can push a key connection's demand ratio above 1.
A structure that satisfies the seismic code can never suffer progressive collapse.
quiz.explanation: 抗連鎖倒塌能力在交接後最容易被不知情地削弱：增設屋頂設備、廣場鋪面與植栽、拆除隔間牆、在樓板開孔或切斷拉結筋，每一項單看都不大，累積起來卻可能讓關鍵接頭的需求比超過 1。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Collapse resistance is most easily weakened unknowingly after handover: added roof equipment, plaza paving and planters, removed partitions, slab openings or cut ties each look minor, yet together they can push a key connection's demand ratio above 1. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 使用期間變更管理與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Change management in service and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「荷載變更紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Load-change register” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：在 56.25 m² 的柱頭受載面積上增加 100 mm 鋪面（22 kN/m³ × 0.10 m = 2.2 kPa），因數化增量 1.2×2.2×56.25 ≈ 149 kN，V_u 由約 698 kN 增為約 846 kN，相對 φV_c = 733 kN 的需求比由 0.95 升為約 1.15。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Adding 100 mm of paving (22 kN/m³ × 0.10 m = 2.2 kPa) over a 56.25 m² column tributary area adds a factored 1.2×2.2×56.25 ≈ 149 kN, raising V_u from about 698 kN to about 846 kN and the demand ratio against φV_c = 733 kN from 0.95 to about 1.15. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：管理單位建立荷載與改裝登錄簿，任何新增設備、鋪面、開孔或拆牆都先由結構技師對照原設計荷載與關鍵構件圖評估；定期檢查時把登錄簿與現場比對，發現未登錄的變更即追溯評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Building managers keep a register of loads and alterations, and every new piece of equipment, paving, opening or wall removal is first assessed by a structural engineer against the design loads and the critical-member plan; periodic inspections compare the register with the site and trigger retrospective assessment of any unrecorded change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Adding 100 mm of paving (22 kN/m³ × 0.10 m = 2.2 kPa) over a 56.25 m² column tributary area adds a factored 1.2×2.2×56.25 ≈ 149 kN, raising V_u from about 698 kN to about 846 kN and the demand ratio against φV_c = 733 kN from 0.95 to about 1.15. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「使用期間變更管理與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Change management in service and handover", which statement holds?
options: 拉結筋只要總面積足夠，在哪裡斷開都沒有關係。
只要梁的抗彎強度足夠，拆柱後就不需要考慮懸鏈作用。
在 56.25 m² 的柱頭受載面積上增加 100 mm 鋪面（22 kN/m³ × 0.10 m = 2.2 kPa），因數化增量 1.2×2.2×56.25 ≈ 149 kN，V_u 由約 698 kN 增為約 846 kN，相對 φV_c = 733 kN 的需求比由 0.95 升為約 1.15。
optionsEn: As long as the total tie area is sufficient, it does not matter where the bars are interrupted.
If the beam has enough bending strength, catenary action need not be considered after column loss.

Adding 100 mm of paving (22 kN/m³ × 0.10 m = 2.2 kPa) over a 56.25 m² column tributary area adds a factored 1.2×2.2×56.25 ≈ 149 kN, raising V_u from about 698 kN to about 846 kN and the demand ratio against φV_c = 733 kN from 0.95 to about 1.15.
quiz.explanation: 在 56.25 m² 的柱頭受載面積上增加 100 mm 鋪面（22 kN/m³ × 0.10 m = 2.2 kPa），因數化增量 1.2×2.2×56.25 ≈ 149 kN，V_u 由約 698 kN 增為約 846 kN，相對 φV_c = 733 kN 的需求比由 0.95 升為約 1.15。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 使用期間變更管理與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Change management in service and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「荷載變更紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Load-change register” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 管理單位建立荷載與改裝登錄簿，任何新增設備、鋪面、開孔或拆牆都先由結構技師對照原設計荷載與關鍵構件圖評估；定期檢查時把登錄簿與現場比對，發現未登錄的變更即追溯評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Building managers keep a register of loads and alterations, and every new piece of equipment, paving, opening or wall removal is first assessed by a structural engineer against the design loads and the critical-member plan; periodic inspections compare the register with the site and trigger retrospective assessment of any unrecorded change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含抗連鎖倒塌設計基準、關鍵構件與拉結筋位置圖、各區允許附加荷載、檢查週期，以及改裝前須經結構技師核可的規定，並隨產權移轉一併交付。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include the progressive-collapse design basis, plans of critical members and ties, allowable added loads by area, inspection intervals and the rule that alterations need prior approval by a structural engineer, all passed on with any change of ownership.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交接文件只有一般竣工圖而沒有關鍵構件與荷載上限資訊，數十年後的改裝者無從得知某條梁是替代路徑或某柱頭已接近極限，逐次小改變累積成大風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If handover provides only ordinary as-built drawings without critical members and load limits, renovators decades later cannot know that a beam forms an alternate path or a column head is near its limit, and small changes accumulate into a large risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 管理單位建立荷載與改裝登錄簿，任何新增設備、鋪面、開孔或拆牆都先由結構技師對照原設計荷載與關鍵構件圖評估；定期檢查時把登錄簿與現場比對，發現未登錄的變更即追溯評估。
knowledge.textEn: Building managers keep a register of loads and alterations, and every new piece of equipment, paving, opening or wall removal is first assessed by a structural engineer against the design loads and the critical-member plan; periodic inspections compare the register with the site and trigger retrospective assessment of any unrecorded change.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含抗連鎖倒塌設計基準、關鍵構件與拉結筋位置圖、各區允許附加荷載、檢查週期，以及改裝前須經結構技師核可的規定，並隨產權移轉一併交付。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include the progressive-collapse design basis, plans of critical members and ties, allowable added loads by area, inspection intervals and the rule that alterations need prior approval by a structural engineer, all passed on with any change of ownership.

quiz.question: 要驗證「使用期間變更管理與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Change management in service and handover"?
options: 管理單位建立荷載與改裝登錄簿，任何新增設備、鋪面、開孔或拆牆都先由結構技師對照原設計荷載與關鍵構件圖評估。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
靜力推覆試驗得到的最大力，就等於突然拆柱時結構能承受的荷載。
optionsEn: Building managers keep a register of loads and alterations, and every new piece of equipment, paving, opening or wall removal is first assessed by a structural engineer against the design loads and the critical-member plan.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The peak force from a static push-down test equals the load the structure can carry after sudden column loss.
quiz.explanation: 管理單位建立荷載與改裝登錄簿，任何新增設備、鋪面、開孔或拆牆都先由結構技師對照原設計荷載與關鍵構件圖評估；定期檢查時把登錄簿與現場比對，發現未登錄的變更即追溯評估。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Building managers keep a register of loads and alterations, and every new piece of equipment, paving, opening or wall removal is first assessed by a structural engineer against the design loads and the critical-member plan; periodic inspections compare the register with the site and trigger retrospective assessment of any unrecorded change. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 使用期間變更管理與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Change management in service and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「荷載變更紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Load-change register” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交接文件只有一般竣工圖而沒有關鍵構件與荷載上限資訊，數十年後的改裝者無從得知某條梁是替代路徑或某柱頭已接近極限，逐次小改變累積成大風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If handover provides only ordinary as-built drawings without critical members and load limits, renovators decades later cannot know that a beam forms an alternate path or a column head is near its limit, and small changes accumulate into a large risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此交接文件必須清楚標示哪些構件是替代路徑的關鍵、哪些區域的附加荷載有上限，讓管理單位在改裝前知道必須找結構技師。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover documents must therefore show clearly which members are critical to alternate paths and which areas have added-load limits, so that managers know to call a structural engineer before renovating.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「建築完工驗收後，結構安全不會因使用期間的小改裝而改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a building passes completion inspection, small renovations in service cannot change its structural safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若交接文件只有一般竣工圖而沒有關鍵構件與荷載上限資訊，數十年後的改裝者無從得知某條梁是替代路徑或某柱頭已接近極限，逐次小改變累積成大風險。
knowledge.textEn: If handover provides only ordinary as-built drawings without critical members and load limits, renovators decades later cannot know that a beam forms an alternate path or a column head is near its limit, and small changes accumulate into a large risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「使用期間變更管理與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Change management in service and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若交接文件只有一般竣工圖而沒有關鍵構件與荷載上限資訊，數十年後的改裝者無從得知某條梁是替代路徑或某柱頭已接近極限，逐次小改變累積成大風險。
只要結構符合耐震規範，就一定不會發生連鎖倒塌。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

If handover provides only ordinary as-built drawings without critical members and load limits, renovators decades later cannot know that a beam forms an alternate path or a column head is near its limit, and small changes accumulate into a large risk.
A structure that satisfies the seismic code can never suffer progressive collapse.
quiz.explanation: 若交接文件只有一般竣工圖而沒有關鍵構件與荷載上限資訊，數十年後的改裝者無從得知某條梁是替代路徑或某柱頭已接近極限，逐次小改變累積成大風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If handover provides only ordinary as-built drawings without critical members and load limits, renovators decades later cannot know that a beam forms an alternate path or a column head is near its limit, and small changes accumulate into a large risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 既有建築基礎隔震改造
summary: 從鹽湖城市郡大樓、舊金山市政府與猶他州議會大廈的隔震改造出發，計算隔震後的週期、位移與扭轉放大，設計鉛心橡膠支承與後拉預力托換梁，再處理切柱頂升的荷載轉移、施工期間的地震風險、原型與出廠試驗、強震監測，最後談性質變化的上下限分析、隔震縫維護與交接。
summaryEn: Starting from the isolation retrofits of the Salt Lake City and County Building, San Francisco City Hall and the Utah State Capitol, compute isolated period, displacement and torsional amplification, design lead-rubber bearings and post-tensioned transfer girders, then handle load transfer by cutting and jacking, earthquake risk during construction, prototype and production tests and strong-motion monitoring, and finally upper- and lower-bound property analysis, moat maintenance and handover.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 建築耐震、預鑄與防火
subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某歷史建築重 W = 216,000 kN，以 54 個鉛心橡膠支承隔震。單一支承：鉛心 150 mm、降伏應力 10 MPa，Q_d ≈ 177 kN；直徑 900 mm、橡膠總厚 200 mm、G = 0.4 MPa，K_d ≈ 1,237 kN/m。設計位移 D = 0.40 m 時 F ≈ 672 kN，K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m，β_eff ≈ 16%。系統 K ≈ 90,650 kN/m，T = 2π√(W/(g·K)) ≈ 3.1 s；以 S_D1 = 0.7、B = 1.35，D = g·S_D1·T/(4π²·B) ≈ 9.81×0.7×3.1/(39.48×1.35) ≈ 0.40 m，與假設一致；基底剪力係數約 0.17，約為固定基底的六分之一。平面 60 m × 30 m、偏心 3 m 時角落總位移約 0.50 m，隔震縫取 0.55 m 以上。若採用上限性質（Q_d×1.3、K_d×1.1），單一支承力增為約 774 kN，上部結構設計力增加約 15%；若隔震縫被縮減到 0.30 m，撞擊動能約 3.2 MJ。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a historic building weighing W = 216,000 kN is isolated on 54 lead-rubber bearings. For one bearing, a 150 mm lead core with 10 MPa yield stress gives Q_d ≈ 177 kN, and a 900 mm diameter with 200 mm total rubber and G = 0.4 MPa gives K_d ≈ 1,237 kN/m. At the design displacement D = 0.40 m, F ≈ 672 kN, K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m and β_eff ≈ 16%. The system K ≈ 90,650 kN/m gives T = 2π√(W/(g·K)) ≈ 3.1 s; with S_D1 = 0.7 and B = 1.35, D = g·S_D1·T/(4π²·B) ≈ 9.81×0.7×3.1/(39.48×1.35) ≈ 0.40 m, consistent with the assumption, and the base-shear coefficient is about 0.17, roughly one sixth of the fixed-base value. For a 60 m × 30 m plan with 3 m eccentricity the corner displacement is about 0.50 m, so the moat should be at least 0.55 m. Upper-bound properties (Q_d×1.3, K_d×1.1) raise the bearing force to about 774 kN, about 15% more superstructure force; a moat reduced to 0.30 m means an impact energy of about 3.2 MJ. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「週期延長與隔震改造的動機」與「隔震面位置、扭轉放大與隔震縫」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Period lengthening and why to isolate an existing building" and "Isolation-plane location, torsional amplification and the moat": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 週期延長與隔震改造的動機：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Period lengthening and why to isolate an existing building: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「隔震層週期」如何影響既有建築基礎隔震改造的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Isolated period” governs force, deformation or durability in “Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 許多既有建築，尤其是無筋磚造或石造的歷史建築，強度與韌性都不足，以傳統方式加剪力牆或斜撐，會大量破壞內部裝飾與空間。基礎隔震改從需求端下手：在建築下方插入水平柔軟的隔震層，把系統週期由約 0.5 s 延長到 2 至 3 s 以上，地震加速度大幅降低，上部結構幾乎以剛體平移，變形集中在隔震層。代價是隔震層要容納數十公分的位移，並需處理建築周邊的隔震縫與穿越管線。Forell/Elsesser 指出，鹽湖城市郡大樓是全球第一個以基礎隔震改造的既有建築。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「隔震層週期」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Many existing buildings, especially unreinforced masonry or stone landmarks, lack strength and ductility, and conventional strengthening with shear walls or braces would destroy much of their interior fabric. Base isolation attacks demand instead: a laterally flexible isolation layer inserted beneath the building lengthens the period from about 0.5 s to 2 to 3 s or more, sharply reducing earthquake acceleration so that the superstructure moves almost as a rigid body while deformation concentrates in the isolation layer. The price is that the layer must accommodate tens of centimetres of displacement, with a moat around the building and flexible utility crossings. Forell/Elsesser describes the Salt Lake City and County Building as the world's first base-isolation retrofit of an existing building. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Isolated period” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：T = 2π√(W/(g·K_eff))。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: T = 2π√(W/(g·K_eff)).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔震改造會讓建築在地震中完全不動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Base isolation makes a building stay completely still in an earthquake." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「隔震層週期」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Isolated period”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 週期延長與隔震改造的動機
knowledge.titleEn: Period lengthening and why to isolate an existing building
knowledge.text: 許多既有建築，尤其是無筋磚造或石造的歷史建築，強度與韌性都不足，以傳統方式加剪力牆或斜撐，會大量破壞內部裝飾與空間。基礎隔震改從需求端下手：在建築下方插入水平柔軟的隔震層，把系統週期由約 0.5 s 延長到 2 至 3 s 以上，地震加速度大幅降低，上部結構幾乎以剛體平移，變形集中在隔震層。
knowledge.textEn: Many existing buildings, especially unreinforced masonry or stone landmarks, lack strength and ductility, and conventional strengthening with shear walls or braces would destroy much of their interior fabric. Base isolation attacks demand instead: a laterally flexible isolation layer inserted beneath the building lengthens the period from about 0.5 s to 2 to 3 s or more, sharply reducing earthquake acceleration so that the superstructure moves almost as a rigid body while deformation concentrates in the isolation layer.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隔震改造會讓建築在地震中完全不動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Base isolation makes a building stay completely still in an earthquake. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「週期延長與隔震改造的動機」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Period lengthening and why to isolate an existing building" is correct?
options: 隔震改造會讓建築在地震中完全不動。
許多既有建築，尤其是無筋磚造或石造的歷史建築，強度與韌性都不足，以傳統方式加剪力牆或斜撐，會大量破壞內部裝飾與空間。
隔震縫寬度只要等於設計位移即可，不必考慮扭轉。
optionsEn: Base isolation makes a building stay completely still in an earthquake.

Many existing buildings, especially unreinforced masonry or stone landmarks, lack strength and ductility, and conventional strengthening with shear walls or braces would destroy much of their interior fabric.
The moat width only needs to equal the design displacement, without considering torsion.
quiz.explanation: 許多既有建築，尤其是無筋磚造或石造的歷史建築，強度與韌性都不足，以傳統方式加剪力牆或斜撐，會大量破壞內部裝飾與空間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Many existing buildings, especially unreinforced masonry or stone landmarks, lack strength and ductility, and conventional strengthening with shear walls or braces would destroy much of their interior fabric. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 週期延長與隔震改造的動機：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Period lengthening and why to isolate an existing building: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隔震層週期」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Isolated period” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：T = 2π√(W/(g·K_eff))。W = 216,000 kN、54 個隔震器各 K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m（K ≈ 90,650 kN/m），T = 2π√(216,000/(9.81×90,650)) ≈ 3.1 s。以 S_D1 = 0.7、阻尼修正 B = 1.35，基底剪力係數 S_D1/(T·B) = 0.7/(3.1×1.35) ≈ 0.17，而固定基底 0.5 s 時約為 1.0，約降為六分之一。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: T = 2π√(W/(g·K_eff)). With W = 216,000 kN and 54 isolators of K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m each (K ≈ 90,650 kN/m), T = 2π√(216,000/(9.81×90,650)) ≈ 3.1 s. With S_D1 = 0.7 and damping coefficient B = 1.35, the base-shear coefficient is S_D1/(T·B) = 0.7/(3.1×1.35) ≈ 0.17, against about 1.0 for the fixed base at 0.5 s, roughly one sixth. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以既有建築調查得到的材料強度與重量建立模型，比較固定基底與隔震兩種方案的樓層加速度、層間變位與上部結構需求強度比；同時評估場址是否為軟弱土層或近斷層，因為長週期地動會削弱隔震效益，必要時做場址反應分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build a model from surveyed material strengths and weights, compare floor accelerations, drifts and superstructure demand-to-capacity ratios for fixed-base and isolated schemes, and check whether the site is soft soil or near-fault, since long-period ground motion erodes the benefit, performing site-response analysis where needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: T = 2π√(W/(g·K_eff)). With W = 216,000 kN and 54 isolators of K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m each (K ≈ 90,650 kN/m), T = 2π√(216,000/(9.81×90,650)) ≈ 3.1 s. With S_D1 = 0.7 and damping coefficient B = 1.35, the base-shear coefficient is S_D1/(T·B) = 0.7/(3.1×1.35) ≈ 0.17, against about 1.0 for the fixed base at 0.5 s, roughly one sixth. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「週期延長與隔震改造的動機」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Period lengthening and why to isolate an existing building", which statement holds?
options: 新澆托換梁只要與舊柱接觸，就能自動把柱荷載傳過去。
施工期間只有幾年，不需要考慮地震。
T = 2π√(W/(g·K_eff))。
optionsEn: A newly cast transfer beam that touches the old column will automatically pick up its load.
Construction lasts only a few years, so earthquakes need not be considered.
T = 2π√(W/(g·K_eff)).
quiz.explanation: T = 2π√(W/(g·K_eff))。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: T = 2π√(W/(g·K_eff)). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 週期延長與隔震改造的動機：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Period lengthening and why to isolate an existing building: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隔震層週期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Isolated period” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以既有建築調查得到的材料強度與重量建立模型，比較固定基底與隔震兩種方案的樓層加速度、層間變位與上部結構需求強度比；同時評估場址是否為軟弱土層或近斷層，因為長週期地動會削弱隔震效益，必要時做場址反應分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a model from surveyed material strengths and weights, compare floor accelerations, drifts and superstructure demand-to-capacity ratios for fixed-base and isolated schemes, and check whether the site is soft soil or near-fault, since long-period ground motion erodes the benefit, performing site-response analysis where needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：可行性研究階段就要比較隔震與傳統補強在文化資產衝擊、停用期間、造價與性能目標上的差異，並把性能目標（例如震後立即使用）寫進設計基準由業主確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At feasibility stage compare isolation with conventional strengthening for heritage impact, closure time, cost and performance, and write the performance objective, for example immediate occupancy after the earthquake, into the design basis for the owner to confirm.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在軟弱土層上隔震而未做場址分析，地動的長週期能量正好落在隔震週期附近，位移遠超過預期，撞擊隔震縫邊牆；若上部結構過於柔軟或有軟弱層，變形不會只集中在隔震層，仍可能損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Isolating on soft soil without site analysis can put long-period ground-motion energy right at the isolated period, so displacement far exceeds expectations and the building strikes the moat wall; a flexible superstructure or soft storey keeps deformation from concentrating in the isolation layer and still allows damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以既有建築調查得到的材料強度與重量建立模型，比較固定基底與隔震兩種方案的樓層加速度、層間變位與上部結構需求強度比；同時評估場址是否為軟弱土層或近斷層，因為長週期地動會削弱隔震效益，必要時做場址反應分析。
knowledge.textEn: Build a model from surveyed material strengths and weights, compare floor accelerations, drifts and superstructure demand-to-capacity ratios for fixed-base and isolated schemes, and check whether the site is soft soil or near-fault, since long-period ground motion erodes the benefit, performing site-response analysis where needed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 可行性研究階段就要比較隔震與傳統補強在文化資產衝擊、停用期間、造價與性能目標上的差異，並把性能目標（例如震後立即使用）寫進設計基準由業主確認。
knowledge.textEn: At feasibility stage compare isolation with conventional strengthening for heritage impact, closure time, cost and performance, and write the performance objective, for example immediate occupancy after the earthquake, into the design basis for the owner to confirm.

quiz.question: 要驗證「週期延長與隔震改造的動機」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Period lengthening and why to isolate an existing building"?
options: 以既有建築調查得到的材料強度與重量建立模型，比較固定基底與隔震兩種方案的樓層加速度、層間變位與上部結構需求強度比。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
小地震時隔震建築的加速度折減應該和設計地震一樣大。
optionsEn: Build a model from surveyed material strengths and weights, compare floor accelerations, drifts and superstructure demand-to-capacity ratios for fixed-base and isolated schemes, and check whether the site is soft soil or near-fault, since long-period ground motion erodes the benefit, performing site-response analysis where needed.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
In a small earthquake an isolated building should show the same acceleration reduction as in the design earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 以既有建築調查得到的材料強度與重量建立模型，比較固定基底與隔震兩種方案的樓層加速度、層間變位與上部結構需求強度比；同時評估場址是否為軟弱土層或近斷層，因為長週期地動會削弱隔震效益，必要時做場址反應分析。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build a model from surveyed material strengths and weights, compare floor accelerations, drifts and superstructure demand-to-capacity ratios for fixed-base and isolated schemes, and check whether the site is soft soil or near-fault, since long-period ground motion erodes the benefit, performing site-response analysis where needed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 週期延長與隔震改造的動機：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Period lengthening and why to isolate an existing building: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隔震層週期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Isolated period” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在軟弱土層上隔震而未做場址分析，地動的長週期能量正好落在隔震週期附近，位移遠超過預期，撞擊隔震縫邊牆；若上部結構過於柔軟或有軟弱層，變形不會只集中在隔震層，仍可能損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Isolating on soft soil without site analysis can put long-period ground-motion energy right at the isolated period, so displacement far exceeds expectations and the building strikes the moat wall; a flexible superstructure or soft storey keeps deformation from concentrating in the isolation layer and still allows damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Forell/Elsesser 指出，鹽湖城市郡大樓是全球第一個以基礎隔震改造的既有建築。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Forell/Elsesser describes the Salt Lake City and County Building as the world's first base-isolation retrofit of an existing building.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隔震改造會讓建築在地震中完全不動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Base isolation makes a building stay completely still in an earthquake." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若在軟弱土層上隔震而未做場址分析，地動的長週期能量正好落在隔震週期附近，位移遠超過預期，撞擊隔震縫邊牆；若上部結構過於柔軟或有軟弱層，變形不會只集中在隔震層，仍可能損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Isolating on soft soil without site analysis can put long-period ground-motion energy right at the isolated period, so displacement far exceeds expectations and the building strikes the moat wall; a flexible superstructure or soft storey keeps deformation from concentrating in the isolation layer and still allows damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「週期延長與隔震改造的動機」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 隔震面位置、扭轉放大與隔震縫：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Isolation-plane location, torsional amplification and the moat: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「隔震縫與隔震面」如何影響既有建築基礎隔震改造的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Moat and isolation plane” governs force, deformation or durability in “Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 改造時隔震面的位置決定了工程難度：放在地下室底部要開挖並托換基礎，放在地下室柱頂則地下室仍隨地盤運動。隔震面正上方必須有一層剛性樓板或格梁，把各柱連成整體，讓所有隔震器同步變形。建築的質心與隔震層勁度中心若不重合，扭轉會使角落隔震器的位移大於中心，所以隔震縫寬度要按最大總位移而非平均位移設計，並保留所有穿越管線與通道的可動接頭。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「隔震縫與隔震面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The location of the isolation plane governs the difficulty of a retrofit: at the base of the basement it requires excavation and underpinning, while at basement column tops the basement still moves with the ground. A stiff diaphragm or grid of beams is needed directly above the isolators to tie the columns together so that all isolators deform together. If the centre of mass does not coincide with the centre of isolator stiffness, torsion makes corner isolators move more than central ones, so the moat must be sized for the total maximum displacement rather than the average, with movable joints for every utility and access crossing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Moat and isolation plane” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 ASCE 7-10 型式的扭轉放大 D_TM = D_M·[1 + y·12e/(b² + d²)]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Using the ASCE 7-10 form of torsional amplification, D_TM = D_M·[1 + y·12e/(b² + d²)].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔震縫寬度只要等於設計位移即可，不必考慮扭轉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The moat width only needs to equal the design displacement, without considering torsion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「隔震縫與隔震面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 隔震面位置、扭轉放大與隔震縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Isolation-plane location, torsional amplification and the moat: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隔震縫與隔震面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Moat and isolation plane” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 ASCE 7-10 型式的扭轉放大 D_TM = D_M·[1 + y·12e/(b² + d²)]。平面 60 m × 30 m、偶然偏心 e = 5%×60 = 3 m、角落距離 y = 30 m：12×3×30/(3,600+900) = 0.24，D_M = 0.40 m 時 D_TM ≈ 0.40×1.24 ≈ 0.50 m，隔震縫淨寬取 0.55 m 以上。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Using the ASCE 7-10 form of torsional amplification, D_TM = D_M·[1 + y·12e/(b² + d²)]. For a 60 m × 30 m plan, accidental eccentricity e = 5%×60 = 3 m and corner distance y = 30 m: 12×3×30/(3,600+900) = 0.24, so D_M = 0.40 m gives D_TM ≈ 0.40×1.24 ≈ 0.50 m and the moat clear width should be at least 0.55 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三維模型做雙向地震的非線性時間歷程分析，檢查每個隔震器的最大位移、最大與最小軸力（含上浮），並確認隔震縫、樓梯、電梯坑與管線在最大總位移下不碰撞；設計圖上逐一標示各穿越點的允許位移量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run three-dimensional nonlinear time-history analysis with bidirectional records to check each isolator's maximum displacement and maximum and minimum axial force, including uplift, and confirm that the moat, stairs, lift pits and utilities do not collide at the total maximum displacement; mark the allowable movement at every crossing on the drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 隔震面位置、扭轉放大與隔震縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Isolation-plane location, torsional amplification and the moat: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隔震縫與隔震面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Moat and isolation plane” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以三維模型做雙向地震的非線性時間歷程分析，檢查每個隔震器的最大位移、最大與最小軸力（含上浮），並確認隔震縫、樓梯、電梯坑與管線在最大總位移下不碰撞；設計圖上逐一標示各穿越點的允許位移量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run three-dimensional nonlinear time-history analysis with bidirectional records to check each isolator's maximum displacement and maximum and minimum axial force, including uplift, and confirm that the moat, stairs, lift pits and utilities do not collide at the total maximum displacement; mark the allowable movement at every crossing on the drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：隔震縫的蓋板、伸縮踏板與管線可動接頭應列入圖說與驗收項目，並在現場以油漆或標牌標示「隔震縫內不得堆放或施作」；任何穿越隔震面的新設施都須經結構技師核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Moat covers, sliding treads and flexible utility joints should be shown on drawings and included in acceptance, and the moat should be marked on site as a no-storage, no-construction zone; any new item crossing the isolation plane needs the structural engineer's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：隔震縫寬度只按中心位移設計時，角落在強震中撞擊擋土牆，撞擊產生的高頻加速度與剪力傳回上部結構，抵銷隔震效益；隔震面上方缺乏剛性樓板，各隔震器不同步變形，部分柱承受額外彎矩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A moat sized for the central displacement lets corners strike the retaining wall in a strong earthquake, sending high-frequency acceleration and shear back into the superstructure and cancelling the isolation benefit; without a stiff diaphragm above, isolators deform unevenly and some columns pick up extra moment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 隔震縫寬度只按中心位移設計時，角落在強震中撞擊擋土牆，撞擊產生的高頻加速度與剪力傳回上部結構，抵銷隔震效益；隔震面上方缺乏剛性樓板，各隔震器不同步變形，部分柱承受額外彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: A moat sized for the central displacement lets corners strike the retaining wall in a strong earthquake, sending high-frequency acceleration and shear back into the superstructure and cancelling the isolation benefit; without a stiff diaphragm above, isolators deform unevenly and some columns pick up extra moment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「隔震面位置、扭轉放大與隔震縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Isolation-plane location, torsional amplification and the moat" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鉛心橡膠支承的雙線性性質」與「托換梁與既有基礎的荷載轉移」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bilinear properties of lead-rubber bearings" and "Transfer girders and load transfer from existing foundations": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鉛心橡膠支承的雙線性性質：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bilinear properties of lead-rubber bearings: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鉛心橡膠支承」如何影響既有建築基礎隔震改造的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lead-rubber bearing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鉛心橡膠支承由多層薄橡膠與鋼板交錯硫化而成，中心插入鉛棒：鋼板限制橡膠的側向膨脹，使支承在垂直方向很硬、水平方向很軟；鉛心在小位移時提供初始勁度與抗風強度，降伏後以塑性變形耗能，力—位移關係近似雙線性。設計參數包括鉛心特性強度 Q_d、降伏後勁度 K_d（由橡膠剪力模數、面積與總厚度決定）、有效勁度與等效阻尼比，這些值都隨位移改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鉛心橡膠支承」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A lead-rubber bearing is built from thin rubber layers vulcanised between steel shims with a lead plug at its centre: the shims restrain lateral bulging so the bearing is very stiff vertically and soft horizontally, while the lead core provides initial stiffness and wind resistance at small displacement and, after yielding, dissipates energy by plastic deformation, giving a roughly bilinear force–displacement curve. Design parameters are the characteristic strength Q_d of the lead, the post-yield stiffness K_d set by rubber shear modulus, area and total thickness, the effective stiffness and the equivalent damping ratio, all of which vary with displacement. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lead-rubber bearing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鉛心直徑 150 mm、鉛降伏應力 10 MPa：Q_d = 10×π/4×150² ≈ 177 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 150 mm lead core with 10 MPa yield stress gives Q_d = 10×π/4×150² ≈ 177 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔震支承的勁度與阻尼是固定值，不隨位移改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An isolator's stiffness and damping are fixed values that do not change with displacement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鉛心橡膠支承」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lead-rubber bearing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 鉛心橡膠支承由多層薄橡膠與鋼板交錯硫化而成，中心插入鉛棒：鋼板限制橡膠的側向膨脹，使支承在垂直方向很硬、水平方向很軟；鉛心在小位移時提供初始勁度與抗風強度，降伏後以塑性變形耗能，力—位移關係近似雙線性。設計參數包括鉛心特性強度 Q_d、降伏後勁度 K_d（由橡膠剪力模數、面積與總厚度決定）、有效勁度與等效阻尼比，這些值都隨位移改變。

An isolator's stiffness and damping are fixed values that do not change with displacement.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鉛心橡膠支承的雙線性性質：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bilinear properties of lead-rubber bearings: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鉛心橡膠支承」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lead-rubber bearing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鉛心直徑 150 mm、鉛降伏應力 10 MPa：Q_d = 10×π/4×150² ≈ 177 kN。支承直徑 900 mm、橡膠總厚 200 mm、G = 0.4 MPa：A_r ≈ 0.619 m²，K_d = G·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,237 kN/m。D = 0.40 m 時 F = 177 + 1,237×0.40 ≈ 672 kN，K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m；EDC ≈ 4×177×(0.40−0.02) ≈ 269 kJ，β_eff = EDC/(2π·K_eff·D²) ≈ 16%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 150 mm lead core with 10 MPa yield stress gives Q_d = 10×π/4×150² ≈ 177 kN. A 900 mm bearing with 200 mm total rubber and G = 0.4 MPa has A_r ≈ 0.619 m² and K_d = G·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,237 kN/m. At D = 0.40 m, F = 177 + 1,237×0.40 ≈ 672 kN and K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m; EDC ≈ 4×177×(0.40−0.02) ≈ 269 kJ and β_eff = EDC/(2π·K_eff·D²) ≈ 16%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依 ISO 22762 或 ASCE 7 隔震章節的精神，以原型試驗量測不同位移下的 Q_d、K_d、K_eff 與 EDC，並檢查垂直勁度、在最大位移下的穩定性與上浮行為；橡膠材料另做剪力模數、硬度與老化試驗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the spirit of ISO 22762 and the isolation chapter of ASCE 7, prototype tests measure Q_d, K_d, K_eff and EDC at several displacements and check vertical stiffness, stability at maximum displacement and uplift behaviour; rubber compounds are also tested for shear modulus, hardness and ageing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鉛心直徑 150 mm、鉛降伏應力 10 MPa：Q_d = 10×π/4×150² ≈ 177 kN。支承直徑 900 mm、橡膠總厚 200 mm、G = 0.4 MPa：A_r ≈ 0.619 m²，K_d = G·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,237 kN/m。D = 0.40 m 時 F = 177 + 1,237×0.40 ≈ 672 kN，K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m；EDC ≈ 4×177×(0.40−0.02) ≈ 269 kJ，β_eff = EDC/(2π·K_eff·D²) ≈ 16%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 150 mm lead core with 10 MPa yield stress gives Q_d = 10×π/4×150² ≈ 177 kN. A 900 mm bearing with 200 mm total rubber and G = 0.4 MPa has A_r ≈ 0.619 m² and K_d = G·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,237 kN/m. At D = 0.40 m, F = 177 + 1,237×0.40 ≈ 672 kN and K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m; EDC ≈ 4×177×(0.40−0.02) ≈ 269 kJ and β_eff = EDC/(2π·K_eff·D²) ≈ 16%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鉛心橡膠支承的雙線性性質」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bilinear properties of lead-rubber bearings", which statement holds?
options: 施工期間只有幾年，不需要考慮地震。
鉛心直徑 150 mm、鉛降伏應力 10 MPa：Q_d = 10×π/4×150² ≈ 177 kN。
小地震時隔震建築的加速度折減應該和設計地震一樣大。
optionsEn: Construction lasts only a few years, so earthquakes need not be considered.
A 150 mm lead core with 10 MPa yield stress gives Q_d = 10×π/4×150² ≈ 177 kN.
In a small earthquake an isolated building should show the same acceleration reduction as in the design earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 鉛心直徑 150 mm、鉛降伏應力 10 MPa：Q_d = 10×π/4×150² ≈ 177 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 150 mm lead core with 10 MPa yield stress gives Q_d = 10×π/4×150² ≈ 177 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鉛心橡膠支承的雙線性性質：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bilinear properties of lead-rubber bearings: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鉛心橡膠支承」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lead-rubber bearing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 ISO 22762 或 ASCE 7 隔震章節的精神，以原型試驗量測不同位移下的 Q_d、K_d、K_eff 與 EDC，並檢查垂直勁度、在最大位移下的穩定性與上浮行為；橡膠材料另做剪力模數、硬度與老化試驗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the spirit of ISO 22762 and the isolation chapter of ASCE 7, prototype tests measure Q_d, K_d, K_eff and EDC at several displacements and check vertical stiffness, stability at maximum displacement and uplift behaviour; rubber compounds are also tested for shear modulus, hardness and ageing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要列出每種支承在設計與最大位移下的 K_eff、EDC 與允收偏差，並要求每個支承有序號與試驗紀錄；同一隔震層盡量減少支承種類，避免安裝時錯置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should list K_eff, EDC and tolerances at design and maximum displacement for each bearing type, with a serial number and test record for every bearing; keep the number of bearing types in one isolation layer small to avoid mix-ups during installation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若支承在最大位移下的重疊面積太小，加上大軸力，橡膠層會失穩或撕裂；鋼板與橡膠的黏結不良，則在反覆剪力下逐層剝離，支承勁度與承載力下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the overlap area at maximum displacement is too small under high axial load, the rubber layers can become unstable or tear; poor bonding between shims and rubber leads to layer-by-layer delamination under cyclic shear, reducing stiffness and capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 ISO 22762 或 ASCE 7 隔震章節的精神，以原型試驗量測不同位移下的 Q_d、K_d、K_eff 與 EDC，並檢查垂直勁度、在最大位移下的穩定性與上浮行為；橡膠材料另做剪力模數、硬度與老化試驗。
knowledge.textEn: In the spirit of ISO 22762 and the isolation chapter of ASCE 7, prototype tests measure Q_d, K_d, K_eff and EDC at several displacements and check vertical stiffness, stability at maximum displacement and uplift behaviour; rubber compounds are also tested for shear modulus, hardness and ageing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格書要列出每種支承在設計與最大位移下的 K_eff、EDC 與允收偏差，並要求每個支承有序號與試驗紀錄；同一隔震層盡量減少支承種類，避免安裝時錯置。
knowledge.textEn: The specification should list K_eff, EDC and tolerances at design and maximum displacement for each bearing type, with a serial number and test record for every bearing; keep the number of bearing types in one isolation layer small to avoid mix-ups during installation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鉛心橡膠支承的雙線性性質」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bilinear properties of lead-rubber bearings"?

隔震改造完成後，隔震縫只是一條空隙，不需要維護。
依 ISO 22762 或 ASCE 7 隔震章節的精神，以原型試驗量測不同位移下的 Q_d、K_d、K_eff 與 EDC，並檢查垂直勁度、在最大位移下的穩定性與上浮行為。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once the retrofit is complete, the moat is just a gap that needs no maintenance.

In the spirit of ISO 22762 and the isolation chapter of ASCE 7, prototype tests measure Q_d, K_d, K_eff and EDC at several displacements and check vertical stiffness, stability at maximum displacement and uplift behaviour.
quiz.explanation: 依 ISO 22762 或 ASCE 7 隔震章節的精神，以原型試驗量測不同位移下的 Q_d、K_d、K_eff 與 EDC，並檢查垂直勁度、在最大位移下的穩定性與上浮行為；橡膠材料另做剪力模數、硬度與老化試驗。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In the spirit of ISO 22762 and the isolation chapter of ASCE 7, prototype tests measure Q_d, K_d, K_eff and EDC at several displacements and check vertical stiffness, stability at maximum displacement and uplift behaviour; rubber compounds are also tested for shear modulus, hardness and ageing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鉛心橡膠支承的雙線性性質：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bilinear properties of lead-rubber bearings: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鉛心橡膠支承」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lead-rubber bearing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若支承在最大位移下的重疊面積太小，加上大軸力，橡膠層會失穩或撕裂；鋼板與橡膠的黏結不良，則在反覆剪力下逐層剝離，支承勁度與承載力下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the overlap area at maximum displacement is too small under high axial load, the rubber layers can become unstable or tear; poor bonding between shims and rubber leads to layer-by-layer delamination under cyclic shear, reducing stiffness and capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計參數包括鉛心特性強度 Q_d、降伏後勁度 K_d（由橡膠剪力模數、面積與總厚度決定）、有效勁度與等效阻尼比，這些值都隨位移改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design parameters are the characteristic strength Q_d of the lead, the post-yield stiffness K_d set by rubber shear modulus, area and total thickness, the effective stiffness and the equivalent damping ratio, all of which vary with displacement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隔震支承的勁度與阻尼是固定值，不隨位移改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
