steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An isolator's stiffness and damping are fixed values that do not change with displacement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若支承在最大位移下的重疊面積太小，加上大軸力，橡膠層會失穩或撕裂；鋼板與橡膠的黏結不良，則在反覆剪力下逐層剝離，支承勁度與承載力下降。
knowledge.textEn: If the overlap area at maximum displacement is too small under high axial load, the rubber layers can become unstable or tear; poor bonding between shims and rubber leads to layer-by-layer delamination under cyclic shear, reducing stiffness and capacity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鉛心橡膠支承的雙線性性質」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bilinear properties of lead-rubber bearings" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若支承在最大位移下的重疊面積太小，加上大軸力，橡膠層會失穩或撕裂；鋼板與橡膠的黏結不良，則在反覆剪力下逐層剝離，支承勁度與承載力下降。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
新澆托換梁只要與舊柱接觸，就能自動把柱荷載傳過去。
optionsEn: If the overlap area at maximum displacement is too small under high axial load, the rubber layers can become unstable or tear.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A newly cast transfer beam that touches the old column will automatically pick up its load.
quiz.explanation: 若支承在最大位移下的重疊面積太小，加上大軸力，橡膠層會失穩或撕裂；鋼板與橡膠的黏結不良，則在反覆剪力下逐層剝離，支承勁度與承載力下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the overlap area at maximum displacement is too small under high axial load, the rubber layers can become unstable or tear; poor bonding between shims and rubber leads to layer-by-layer delamination under cyclic shear, reducing stiffness and capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 托換梁與既有基礎的荷載轉移：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Transfer girders and load transfer from existing foundations: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「後拉預力托換梁」如何影響既有建築基礎隔震改造的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-tensioned transfer girder” governs force, deformation or durability in “Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 改造的關鍵是如何在不移除建築的前提下，把每根柱或每道牆的重量從原基礎轉到新隔震器上。常見做法是在柱或牆兩側澆置新的混凝土托換梁或夾套，以後拉預力把新舊混凝土夾緊，靠摩擦與剪力榫把荷載傳入新構件，再由新構件坐在隔震器上。Forell/Elsesser 的猶他州議會大廈改造即以環繞既有墩基礎的後拉預力混凝土大梁形成複合斷面，跨距約 51 ft，把約 28,000,000 lb 的荷載轉到新隔震器，避免在既有基礎下方開挖。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「後拉預力托換梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The key to a retrofit is moving the weight of every column or wall from the old foundation onto new isolators without removing the building. A common method casts new concrete transfer beams or jackets on both sides of a column or wall and clamps new to old concrete with post-tensioning, so that friction and shear keys carry the load into the new members, which then sit on the isolators. In the Utah State Capitol retrofit, Forell/Elsesser wrapped the existing pier footings with post-tensioned concrete girders forming composite sections, spanning about 51 ft, to transfer about 28,000,000 lb onto new isolators without excavating beneath the old footings. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-tensioned transfer girder” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以摩擦轉移柱荷載 P = 2·μ·N（兩側夾板）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Transferring a column load by friction, P = 2·μ·N for two clamping faces.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「新澆托換梁只要與舊柱接觸，就能自動把柱荷載傳過去。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A newly cast transfer beam that touches the old column will automatically pick up its load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「後拉預力托換梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Post-tensioned transfer girder”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 托換梁與既有基礎的荷載轉移
knowledge.titleEn: Transfer girders and load transfer from existing foundations
knowledge.text: 改造的關鍵是如何在不移除建築的前提下，把每根柱或每道牆的重量從原基礎轉到新隔震器上。常見做法是在柱或牆兩側澆置新的混凝土托換梁或夾套，以後拉預力把新舊混凝土夾緊，靠摩擦與剪力榫把荷載傳入新構件，再由新構件坐在隔震器上。
knowledge.textEn: The key to a retrofit is moving the weight of every column or wall from the old foundation onto new isolators without removing the building. A common method casts new concrete transfer beams or jackets on both sides of a column or wall and clamps new to old concrete with post-tensioning, so that friction and shear keys carry the load into the new members, which then sit on the isolators.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：新澆托換梁只要與舊柱接觸，就能自動把柱荷載傳過去。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A newly cast transfer beam that touches the old column will automatically pick up its load. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「托換梁與既有基礎的荷載轉移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transfer girders and load transfer from existing foundations" is correct?
options: 新澆托換梁只要與舊柱接觸，就能自動把柱荷載傳過去。
改造的關鍵是如何在不移除建築的前提下，把每根柱或每道牆的重量從原基礎轉到新隔震器上。
切柱只是施工手續，只要千斤頂撐住就不會影響上部結構。
optionsEn: A newly cast transfer beam that touches the old column will automatically pick up its load.
The key to a retrofit is moving the weight of every column or wall from the old foundation onto new isolators without removing the building.
Cutting columns is a routine step; as long as jacks hold them, the superstructure is unaffected.
quiz.explanation: 改造的關鍵是如何在不移除建築的前提下，把每根柱或每道牆的重量從原基礎轉到新隔震器上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The key to a retrofit is moving the weight of every column or wall from the old foundation onto new isolators without removing the building. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 托換梁與既有基礎的荷載轉移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transfer girders and load transfer from existing foundations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「後拉預力托換梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-tensioned transfer girder” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以摩擦轉移柱荷載 P = 2·μ·N（兩側夾板）。P = 4,000 kN、粗糙面摩擦係數 μ = 0.7 時，所需夾緊力 N = 4,000/(2×0.7) ≈ 2,857 kN；15.2 mm 鋼絞線（140 mm²、f_pu = 1,860 MPa）以 0.6 f_pu 計每股約 156 kN，需 2,857/156 ≈ 18.3，取 19 股。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Transferring a column load by friction, P = 2·μ·N for two clamping faces. With P = 4,000 kN and a roughened-surface friction coefficient μ = 0.7, the clamping force is N = 4,000/(2×0.7) ≈ 2,857 kN; a 15.2 mm strand (140 mm², f_pu = 1,860 MPa) at 0.6 f_pu gives about 156 kN, so 2,857/156 ≈ 18.3, rounded up to 19 strands. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工前鑽心確認既有混凝土強度與粗糙化處理後的介面，必要時做介面剪力試驗；預力施加時記錄每束伸長量與千斤頂壓力並比對計算值，偏差超過允許值（例如 ±7%）須停工檢討。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before construction, core the existing concrete to confirm strength and the roughened interface, with interface shear tests where needed; during stressing, record elongation and jack pressure for every tendon against calculated values and stop to investigate if deviations exceed tolerance, for example ±7%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以摩擦轉移柱荷載 P = 2·μ·N（兩側夾板）。P = 4,000 kN、粗糙面摩擦係數 μ = 0.7 時，所需夾緊力 N = 4,000/(2×0.7) ≈ 2,857 kN；15.2 mm 鋼絞線（140 mm²、f_pu = 1,860 MPa）以 0.6 f_pu 計每股約 156 kN，需 2,857/156 ≈ 18.3，取 19 股。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Transferring a column load by friction, P = 2·μ·N for two clamping faces. With P = 4,000 kN and a roughened-surface friction coefficient μ = 0.7, the clamping force is N = 4,000/(2×0.7) ≈ 2,857 kN; a 15.2 mm strand (140 mm², f_pu = 1,860 MPa) at 0.6 f_pu gives about 156 kN, so 2,857/156 ≈ 18.3, rounded up to 19 strands. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「托換梁與既有基礎的荷載轉移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Transfer girders and load transfer from existing foundations", which statement holds?
options: 隔震器只要在慢速試驗中合格，地震時的性質就一定相同。
只要用試驗量到的名目性質分析，隔震設計就涵蓋了全部情況。
以摩擦轉移柱荷載 P = 2·μ·N（兩側夾板）。
optionsEn: If an isolator passes slow-speed tests, its properties in an earthquake will be the same.
Analysing with the nominal tested properties covers every case in isolation design.
Transferring a column load by friction, P = 2·μ·N for two clamping faces.
quiz.explanation: 以摩擦轉移柱荷載 P = 2·μ·N（兩側夾板）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Transferring a column load by friction, P = 2·μ·N for two clamping faces. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 托換梁與既有基礎的荷載轉移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transfer girders and load transfer from existing foundations: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「後拉預力托換梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-tensioned transfer girder” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 施工前鑽心確認既有混凝土強度與粗糙化處理後的介面，必要時做介面剪力試驗；預力施加時記錄每束伸長量與千斤頂壓力並比對計算值，偏差超過允許值（例如 ±7%）須停工檢討。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before construction, core the existing concrete to confirm strength and the roughened interface, with interface shear tests where needed; during stressing, record elongation and jack pressure for every tendon against calculated values and stop to investigate if deviations exceed tolerance, for example ±7%. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：荷載轉移構件的界面處理、剪力榫、預力束配置與量測紀錄表都應列為停止點，並由結構技師現場確認後才可進行下一步切柱或頂升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Interface preparation, shear keys, tendon layout and measurement sheets for transfer members should be hold points, confirmed on site by the structural engineer before any column cutting or jacking proceeds.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若既有混凝土強度低於假設或介面清理不足，摩擦轉移不足，荷載轉移時新舊混凝土間發生滑動，柱突然下沉並拉裂上部磚牆；預力損失估計過低，則長期夾緊力下降，轉移構件逐漸滑移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the existing concrete is weaker than assumed or the interface poorly prepared, friction is insufficient and new and old concrete slip during transfer, dropping the column suddenly and cracking masonry above; underestimated prestress losses let clamping fall over time so that the transfer member gradually slips. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 施工前鑽心確認既有混凝土強度與粗糙化處理後的介面，必要時做介面剪力試驗；預力施加時記錄每束伸長量與千斤頂壓力並比對計算值，偏差超過允許值（例如 ±7%）須停工檢討。
knowledge.textEn: Before construction, core the existing concrete to confirm strength and the roughened interface, with interface shear tests where needed; during stressing, record elongation and jack pressure for every tendon against calculated values and stop to investigate if deviations exceed tolerance, for example ±7%.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 荷載轉移構件的界面處理、剪力榫、預力束配置與量測紀錄表都應列為停止點，並由結構技師現場確認後才可進行下一步切柱或頂升。
knowledge.textEn: Interface preparation, shear keys, tendon layout and measurement sheets for transfer members should be hold points, confirmed on site by the structural engineer before any column cutting or jacking proceeds.

quiz.question: 要驗證「托換梁與既有基礎的荷載轉移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transfer girders and load transfer from existing foundations"?
options: 施工前鑽心確認既有混凝土強度與粗糙化處理後的介面，必要時做介面剪力試驗。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
隔震改造會讓建築在地震中完全不動。
optionsEn: Before construction, core the existing concrete to confirm strength and the roughened interface, with interface shear tests where needed.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Base isolation makes a building stay completely still in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 施工前鑽心確認既有混凝土強度與粗糙化處理後的介面，必要時做介面剪力試驗；預力施加時記錄每束伸長量與千斤頂壓力並比對計算值，偏差超過允許值（例如 ±7%）須停工檢討。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before construction, core the existing concrete to confirm strength and the roughened interface, with interface shear tests where needed; during stressing, record elongation and jack pressure for every tendon against calculated values and stop to investigate if deviations exceed tolerance, for example ±7%. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 托換梁與既有基礎的荷載轉移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transfer girders and load transfer from existing foundations: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「後拉預力托換梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-tensioned transfer girder” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若既有混凝土強度低於假設或介面清理不足，摩擦轉移不足，荷載轉移時新舊混凝土間發生滑動，柱突然下沉並拉裂上部磚牆；預力損失估計過低，則長期夾緊力下降，轉移構件逐漸滑移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the existing concrete is weaker than assumed or the interface poorly prepared, friction is insufficient and new and old concrete slip during transfer, dropping the column suddenly and cracking masonry above; underestimated prestress losses let clamping fall over time so that the transfer member gradually slips. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Forell/Elsesser 的猶他州議會大廈改造即以環繞既有墩基礎的後拉預力混凝土大梁形成複合斷面，跨距約 51 ft，把約 28,000,000 lb 的荷載轉到新隔震器，避免在既有基礎下方開挖。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In the Utah State Capitol retrofit, Forell/Elsesser wrapped the existing pier footings with post-tensioned concrete girders forming composite sections, spanning about 51 ft, to transfer about 28,000,000 lb onto new isolators without excavating beneath the old footings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「新澆托換梁只要與舊柱接觸，就能自動把柱荷載傳過去。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A newly cast transfer beam that touches the old column will automatically pick up its load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若既有混凝土強度低於假設或介面清理不足，摩擦轉移不足，荷載轉移時新舊混凝土間發生滑動，柱突然下沉並拉裂上部磚牆；預力損失估計過低，則長期夾緊力下降，轉移構件逐漸滑移。
knowledge.textEn: If the existing concrete is weaker than assumed or the interface poorly prepared, friction is insufficient and new and old concrete slip during transfer, dropping the column suddenly and cracking masonry above; underestimated prestress losses let clamping fall over time so that the transfer member gradually slips.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「托換梁與既有基礎的荷載轉移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transfer girders and load transfer from existing foundations" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若既有混凝土強度低於假設或介面清理不足，摩擦轉移不足，荷載轉移時新舊混凝土間發生滑動，柱突然下沉並拉裂上部磚牆。
切柱只是施工手續，只要千斤頂撐住就不會影響上部結構。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

If the existing concrete is weaker than assumed or the interface poorly prepared, friction is insufficient and new and old concrete slip during transfer, dropping the column suddenly and cracking masonry above.
Cutting columns is a routine step; as long as jacks hold them, the superstructure is unaffected.
quiz.explanation: 若既有混凝土強度低於假設或介面清理不足，摩擦轉移不足，荷載轉移時新舊混凝土間發生滑動，柱突然下沉並拉裂上部磚牆；預力損失估計過低，則長期夾緊力下降，轉移構件逐漸滑移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the existing concrete is weaker than assumed or the interface poorly prepared, friction is insufficient and new and old concrete slip during transfer, dropping the column suddenly and cracking masonry above; underestimated prestress losses let clamping fall over time so that the transfer member gradually slips. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「切柱、頂升與沉陷控制」與「施工期間的暫態結構與地震風險」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cutting, jacking and settlement control" and "Temporary structural states and earthquake risk during construction": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 切柱、頂升與沉陷控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cutting, jacking and settlement control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「切柱頂升與臨時支撐」如何影響既有建築基礎隔震改造的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Column cutting, jacking and shoring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 隔震器就位前，柱或牆必須被切斷，荷載暫時由千斤頂與臨時支撐承擔，再把千斤頂壓力轉到隔震器上。舊金山市政府的改造中，約 530 根柱與約 1,500 ft 的厚重磚牆被切斷並暫時頂撐，才能安裝隔震器。歷史建築對差異沉陷極為敏感，數毫米的差異就可能使灰泥裝飾開裂，因此要以千斤頂預壓抵銷隔震器受壓後的垂直變形，並按事先排定的順序逐柱施作。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「切柱頂升與臨時支撐」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before an isolator goes in, a column or wall must be cut, its load carried temporarily by jacks and shoring, and the jack pressure then transferred onto the isolator. In the San Francisco City Hall retrofit about 530 columns and about 1,500 ft of massive brick walls were cut and temporarily jacked so that isolators could be installed. Historic buildings are very sensitive to differential settlement, where a few millimetres can crack plaster ornament, so jacks preload to offset the isolator's vertical compression, and columns are done one by one in a planned sequence. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Column cutting, jacking and shoring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單層橡膠厚 10 mm 時形狀係數 S = 900/(4×10) = 22.5，壓縮模數近似 E_c ≈ 6·G·S² = 6×0.4×22.5² ≈ 1,215 MPa，垂直勁度 K_v = E_c·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,215,000×0.619/0.2 ≈ 3.76×10⁶ kN/m；柱荷載 4,000 kN 時壓縮約 1.1 mm，須以千斤頂預壓抵銷。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 10 mm rubber layers the shape factor is S = 900/(4×10) = 22.5, the compression modulus is roughly E_c ≈ 6·G·S² = 6×0.4×22.5² ≈ 1,215 MPa and the vertical stiffness K_v = E_c·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,215,000×0.619/0.2 ≈ 3.76×10⁶ kN/m; a 4,000 kN column load compresses the bearing about 1.1 mm, which jack preload must offset.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「切柱只是施工手續，只要千斤頂撐住就不會影響上部結構。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cutting columns is a routine step; as long as jacks hold them, the superstructure is unaffected." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「切柱頂升與臨時支撐」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Column cutting, jacking and shoring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 切柱、頂升與沉陷控制
knowledge.text: 隔震器就位前，柱或牆必須被切斷，荷載暫時由千斤頂與臨時支撐承擔，再把千斤頂壓力轉到隔震器上。舊金山市政府的改造中，約 530 根柱與約 1,500 ft 的厚重磚牆被切斷並暫時頂撐，才能安裝隔震器。
knowledge.textEn: Before an isolator goes in, a column or wall must be cut, its load carried temporarily by jacks and shoring, and the jack pressure then transferred onto the isolator. In the San Francisco City Hall retrofit about 530 columns and about 1,500 ft of massive brick walls were cut and temporarily jacked so that isolators could be installed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：切柱只是施工手續，只要千斤頂撐住就不會影響上部結構。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Cutting columns is a routine step; as long as jacks hold them, the superstructure is unaffected. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「切柱、頂升與沉陷控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cutting, jacking and settlement control" is correct?
options: 切柱只是施工手續，只要千斤頂撐住就不會影響上部結構。
施工期間只有幾年，不需要考慮地震。
隔震器就位前，柱或牆必須被切斷，荷載暫時由千斤頂與臨時支撐承擔，再把千斤頂壓力轉到隔震器上。
optionsEn: Cutting columns is a routine step; as long as jacks hold them, the superstructure is unaffected.
Construction lasts only a few years, so earthquakes need not be considered.
Before an isolator goes in, a column or wall must be cut, its load carried temporarily by jacks and shoring, and the jack pressure then transferred onto the isolator.
quiz.explanation: 隔震器就位前，柱或牆必須被切斷，荷載暫時由千斤頂與臨時支撐承擔，再把千斤頂壓力轉到隔震器上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before an isolator goes in, a column or wall must be cut, its load carried temporarily by jacks and shoring, and the jack pressure then transferred onto the isolator. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 切柱、頂升與沉陷控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cutting, jacking and settlement control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「切柱頂升與臨時支撐」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Column cutting, jacking and shoring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單層橡膠厚 10 mm 時形狀係數 S = 900/(4×10) = 22.5，壓縮模數近似 E_c ≈ 6·G·S² = 6×0.4×22.5² ≈ 1,215 MPa，垂直勁度 K_v = E_c·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,215,000×0.619/0.2 ≈ 3.76×10⁶ kN/m；柱荷載 4,000 kN 時壓縮約 1.1 mm，須以千斤頂預壓抵銷。數值為教學假設，未計體積壓縮修正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 10 mm rubber layers the shape factor is S = 900/(4×10) = 22.5, the compression modulus is roughly E_c ≈ 6·G·S² = 6×0.4×22.5² ≈ 1,215 MPa and the vertical stiffness K_v = E_c·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,215,000×0.619/0.2 ≈ 3.76×10⁶ kN/m; a 4,000 kN column load compresses the bearing about 1.1 mm, which jack preload must offset. Values are teaching assumptions without bulk-compressibility correction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每根柱在切斷前、頂升中與轉移後以精密水準儀量測高程，並在千斤頂上記錄壓力；相鄰柱的差異沉陷超過允許值（例如 3 mm）即停止並調整，裂縫監測計與傾斜計同步記錄磚牆反應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Level every column with a precise level before cutting, during jacking and after transfer, recording jack pressures; stop and adjust if differential settlement between neighbouring columns exceeds the limit, for example 3 mm, while crack gauges and tiltmeters record the masonry's response.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單層橡膠厚 10 mm 時形狀係數 S = 900/(4×10) = 22.5，壓縮模數近似 E_c ≈ 6·G·S² = 6×0.4×22.5² ≈ 1,215 MPa，垂直勁度 K_v = E_c·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,215,000×0.619/0.2 ≈ 3.76×10⁶ kN/m；柱荷載 4,000 kN 時壓縮約 1.1 mm，須以千斤頂預壓抵銷。數值為教學假設，未計體積壓縮修正。
knowledge.textEn: With 10 mm rubber layers the shape factor is S = 900/(4×10) = 22.5, the compression modulus is roughly E_c ≈ 6·G·S² = 6×0.4×22.5² ≈ 1,215 MPa and the vertical stiffness K_v = E_c·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,215,000×0.619/0.2 ≈ 3.76×10⁶ kN/m; a 4,000 kN column load compresses the bearing about 1.1 mm, which jack preload must offset. Values are teaching assumptions without bulk-compressibility correction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「切柱、頂升與沉陷控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cutting, jacking and settlement control", which statement holds?
options: 小地震時隔震建築的加速度折減應該和設計地震一樣大。
隔震改造完成後，隔震縫只是一條空隙，不需要維護。
optionsEn: With 10 mm rubber layers the shape factor is S = 900/(4×10) = 22.5, the compression modulus is roughly E_c ≈ 6·G·S² = 6×0.4×22.5² ≈ 1,215 MPa and the vertical stiffness K_v = E_c·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,215,000×0.619/0.2 ≈ 3.76×10⁶ kN/m.
In a small earthquake an isolated building should show the same acceleration reduction as in the design earthquake.
Once the retrofit is complete, the moat is just a gap that needs no maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 單層橡膠厚 10 mm 時形狀係數 S = 900/(4×10) = 22.5，壓縮模數近似 E_c ≈ 6·G·S² = 6×0.4×22.5² ≈ 1,215 MPa，垂直勁度 K_v = E_c·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,215,000×0.619/0.2 ≈ 3.76×10⁶ kN/m；柱荷載 4,000 kN 時壓縮約 1.1 mm，須以千斤頂預壓抵銷。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 10 mm rubber layers the shape factor is S = 900/(4×10) = 22.5, the compression modulus is roughly E_c ≈ 6·G·S² = 6×0.4×22.5² ≈ 1,215 MPa and the vertical stiffness K_v = E_c·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,215,000×0.619/0.2 ≈ 3.76×10⁶ kN/m; a 4,000 kN column load compresses the bearing about 1.1 mm, which jack preload must offset. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 切柱、頂升與沉陷控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cutting, jacking and settlement control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「切柱頂升與臨時支撐」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Column cutting, jacking and shoring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每根柱在切斷前、頂升中與轉移後以精密水準儀量測高程，並在千斤頂上記錄壓力；相鄰柱的差異沉陷超過允許值（例如 3 mm）即停止並調整，裂縫監測計與傾斜計同步記錄磚牆反應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Level every column with a precise level before cutting, during jacking and after transfer, recording jack pressures; stop and adjust if differential settlement between neighbouring columns exceeds the limit, for example 3 mm, while crack gauges and tiltmeters record the masonry's response. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫要列出切柱順序、同時切斷柱數上限、千斤頂預壓值、沉陷與裂縫的停止條件，以及臨時支撐的側向設計，由結構技師簽認並設為每一柱的停止點；這些步驟是工程推理與檢核，不是現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction plan should list the cutting sequence, the maximum number of columns cut at once, jack preloads, stop criteria for settlement and cracking, and the lateral design of shoring, signed by the structural engineer as a hold point for every column; these steps are engineering reasoning and checks, not a field operating permit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若一次切斷太多相鄰柱或千斤頂壓力不一致，荷載在臨時系統中重分配，部分柱瞬間下沉，造成磚牆與拱頂開裂；臨時支撐若只承受垂直力，施工中的地震或施工機具撞擊可能使其側向失穩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cutting too many adjacent columns at once or uneven jack pressures redistribute load within the temporary system, so some columns drop suddenly and crack masonry walls and vaults; shoring designed only for vertical load can become laterally unstable under a construction-period earthquake or equipment impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每根柱在切斷前、頂升中與轉移後以精密水準儀量測高程，並在千斤頂上記錄壓力；相鄰柱的差異沉陷超過允許值（例如 3 mm）即停止並調整，裂縫監測計與傾斜計同步記錄磚牆反應。
knowledge.textEn: Level every column with a precise level before cutting, during jacking and after transfer, recording jack pressures; stop and adjust if differential settlement between neighbouring columns exceeds the limit, for example 3 mm, while crack gauges and tiltmeters record the masonry's response.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫要列出切柱順序、同時切斷柱數上限、千斤頂預壓值、沉陷與裂縫的停止條件，以及臨時支撐的側向設計，由結構技師簽認並設為每一柱的停止點；這些步驟是工程推理與檢核，不是現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: The construction plan should list the cutting sequence, the maximum number of columns cut at once, jack preloads, stop criteria for settlement and cracking, and the lateral design of shoring, signed by the structural engineer as a hold point for every column; these steps are engineering reasoning and checks, not a field operating permit.

quiz.question: 要驗證「切柱、頂升與沉陷控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cutting, jacking and settlement control"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
每根柱在切斷前、頂升中與轉移後以精密水準儀量測高程，並在千斤頂上記錄壓力。
隔震縫寬度只要等於設計位移即可，不必考慮扭轉。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Level every column with a precise level before cutting, during jacking and after transfer, recording jack pressures.
The moat width only needs to equal the design displacement, without considering torsion.
quiz.explanation: 每根柱在切斷前、頂升中與轉移後以精密水準儀量測高程，並在千斤頂上記錄壓力；相鄰柱的差異沉陷超過允許值（例如 3 mm）即停止並調整，裂縫監測計與傾斜計同步記錄磚牆反應。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Level every column with a precise level before cutting, during jacking and after transfer, recording jack pressures; stop and adjust if differential settlement between neighbouring columns exceeds the limit, for example 3 mm, while crack gauges and tiltmeters record the masonry's response. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 切柱、頂升與沉陷控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cutting, jacking and settlement control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「切柱頂升與臨時支撐」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Column cutting, jacking and shoring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若一次切斷太多相鄰柱或千斤頂壓力不一致，荷載在臨時系統中重分配，部分柱瞬間下沉，造成磚牆與拱頂開裂；臨時支撐若只承受垂直力，施工中的地震或施工機具撞擊可能使其側向失穩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting too many adjacent columns at once or uneven jack pressures redistribute load within the temporary system, so some columns drop suddenly and crack masonry walls and vaults; shoring designed only for vertical load can become laterally unstable under a construction-period earthquake or equipment impact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：歷史建築對差異沉陷極為敏感，數毫米的差異就可能使灰泥裝飾開裂，因此要以千斤頂預壓抵銷隔震器受壓後的垂直變形，並按事先排定的順序逐柱施作。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Historic buildings are very sensitive to differential settlement, where a few millimetres can crack plaster ornament, so jacks preload to offset the isolator's vertical compression, and columns are done one by one in a planned sequence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「切柱只是施工手續，只要千斤頂撐住就不會影響上部結構。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cutting columns is a routine step; as long as jacks hold them, the superstructure is unaffected." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若一次切斷太多相鄰柱或千斤頂壓力不一致，荷載在臨時系統中重分配，部分柱瞬間下沉，造成磚牆與拱頂開裂；臨時支撐若只承受垂直力，施工中的地震或施工機具撞擊可能使其側向失穩。
knowledge.textEn: Cutting too many adjacent columns at once or uneven jack pressures redistribute load within the temporary system, so some columns drop suddenly and crack masonry walls and vaults; shoring designed only for vertical load can become laterally unstable under a construction-period earthquake or equipment impact.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「切柱、頂升與沉陷控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cutting, jacking and settlement control" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
施工期間只有幾年，不需要考慮地震。
若一次切斷太多相鄰柱或千斤頂壓力不一致，荷載在臨時系統中重分配，部分柱瞬間下沉，造成磚牆與拱頂開裂。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Construction lasts only a few years, so earthquakes need not be considered.
Cutting too many adjacent columns at once or uneven jack pressures redistribute load within the temporary system, so some columns drop suddenly and crack masonry walls and vaults.
quiz.explanation: 若一次切斷太多相鄰柱或千斤頂壓力不一致，荷載在臨時系統中重分配，部分柱瞬間下沉，造成磚牆與拱頂開裂；臨時支撐若只承受垂直力，施工中的地震或施工機具撞擊可能使其側向失穩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cutting too many adjacent columns at once or uneven jack pressures redistribute load within the temporary system, so some columns drop suddenly and crack masonry walls and vaults; shoring designed only for vertical load can become laterally unstable under a construction-period earthquake or equipment impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工期間的暫態結構與地震風險：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Temporary structural states and earthquake risk during construction: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「施工期間地震風險」如何影響既有建築基礎隔震改造的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Construction-period earthquake risk” governs force, deformation or durability in “Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 改造期間建築處在最脆弱的狀態：部分柱已切斷、隔震器尚未全部就位、隔震縫還沒完成，原本的基礎與新系統都只是半套。Forell/Elsesser 說明舊金山市政府的施工排序，目的之一就是在施工期間萬一發生地震時仍維持結構穩定。設計者必須把每個施工階段當成一個暫態結構，決定其要承受的地震水準，並以臨時側向束制、限制同時施工範圍或分區施作來控制風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「施工期間地震風險」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During a retrofit the building is at its most vulnerable: some columns are cut, not all isolators are in place and the moat is unfinished, so neither the old foundation nor the new system is complete. Forell/Elsesser explains that construction sequencing at San Francisco City Hall aimed, among other things, to keep the structure stable should an earthquake strike during the work. Designers must treat each construction stage as a temporary structure, choose the earthquake level it must resist, and control risk with temporary lateral restraints, limits on simultaneous work areas or zoned construction. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Construction-period earthquake risk” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：施工期間發生某回歸期地震的機率 P = 1 − exp(−t/T_R)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The probability of an earthquake of a given return period during construction is P = 1 − exp(−t/T_R).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工期間只有幾年，不需要考慮地震。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Construction lasts only a few years, so earthquakes need not be considered." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「施工期間地震風險」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Construction-period earthquake risk”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工期間的暫態結構與地震風險
knowledge.titleEn: Temporary structural states and earthquake risk during construction
knowledge.text: 改造期間建築處在最脆弱的狀態：部分柱已切斷、隔震器尚未全部就位、隔震縫還沒完成，原本的基礎與新系統都只是半套。Forell/Elsesser 說明舊金山市政府的施工排序，目的之一就是在施工期間萬一發生地震時仍維持結構穩定。
knowledge.textEn: During a retrofit the building is at its most vulnerable: some columns are cut, not all isolators are in place and the moat is unfinished, so neither the old foundation nor the new system is complete. Forell/Elsesser explains that construction sequencing at San Francisco City Hall aimed, among other things, to keep the structure stable should an earthquake strike during the work.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工期間只有幾年，不需要考慮地震。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Construction lasts only a few years, so earthquakes need not be considered. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工期間的暫態結構與地震風險」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Temporary structural states and earthquake risk during construction" is correct?
options: 改造期間建築處在最脆弱的狀態：部分柱已切斷、隔震器尚未全部就位、隔震縫還沒完成，原本的基礎與新系統都只是半套。
施工期間只有幾年，不需要考慮地震。
隔震器只要在慢速試驗中合格，地震時的性質就一定相同。
optionsEn: During a retrofit the building is at its most vulnerable: some columns are cut, not all isolators are in place and the moat is unfinished, so neither the old foundation nor the new system is complete.
Construction lasts only a few years, so earthquakes need not be considered.
If an isolator passes slow-speed tests, its properties in an earthquake will be the same.
quiz.explanation: 改造期間建築處在最脆弱的狀態：部分柱已切斷、隔震器尚未全部就位、隔震縫還沒完成，原本的基礎與新系統都只是半套。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: During a retrofit the building is at its most vulnerable: some columns are cut, not all isolators are in place and the moat is unfinished, so neither the old foundation nor the new system is complete. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工期間的暫態結構與地震風險：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temporary structural states and earthquake risk during construction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工期間地震風險」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Construction-period earthquake risk” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：施工期間發生某回歸期地震的機率 P = 1 − exp(−t/T_R)。工期 t = 3 年：對 475 年回歸期 P = 1 − exp(−3/475) ≈ 0.63%；對 72 年回歸期 P ≈ 1 − exp(−3/72) ≈ 4.1%，所以暫態結構至少要能安全承受較常發生的中小地震。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The probability of an earthquake of a given return period during construction is P = 1 − exp(−t/T_R). For t = 3 years: a 475-year event gives P = 1 − exp(−3/475) ≈ 0.63%, and a 72-year event P ≈ 1 − exp(−3/72) ≈ 4.1%, so temporary states must at least safely resist the more frequent moderate earthquakes. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：為每個施工階段建立模型，檢查在選定的施工期地震下，臨時支撐、已切柱位與未完成區的側向強度與變形；施工中每週更新已完成與未完成的柱位圖，確認實際進度沒有超出分析過的暫態組合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Model each construction stage and check the lateral strength and deformation of shoring, cut-column locations and unfinished zones under the selected construction-period earthquake; update a weekly plan of completed and pending column positions to confirm that actual progress stays within the analysed temporary states.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 施工期間發生某回歸期地震的機率 P = 1 − exp(−t/T_R)。工期 t = 3 年：對 475 年回歸期 P = 1 − exp(−3/475) ≈ 0.63%；對 72 年回歸期 P ≈ 1 − exp(−3/72) ≈ 4.1%，所以暫態結構至少要能安全承受較常發生的中小地震。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The probability of an earthquake of a given return period during construction is P = 1 − exp(−t/T_R). For t = 3 years: a 475-year event gives P = 1 − exp(−3/475) ≈ 0.63%, and a 72-year event P ≈ 1 − exp(−3/72) ≈ 4.1%, so temporary states must at least safely resist the more frequent moderate earthquakes. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工期間的暫態結構與地震風險」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temporary structural states and earthquake risk during construction", which statement holds?
options: 只要用試驗量到的名目性質分析，隔震設計就涵蓋了全部情況。
施工期間發生某回歸期地震的機率 P = 1 − exp(−t/T_R)。
隔震改造會讓建築在地震中完全不動。
optionsEn: Analysing with the nominal tested properties covers every case in isolation design.
The probability of an earthquake of a given return period during construction is P = 1 − exp(−t/T_R).
Base isolation makes a building stay completely still in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 施工期間發生某回歸期地震的機率 P = 1 − exp(−t/T_R)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The probability of an earthquake of a given return period during construction is P = 1 − exp(−t/T_R). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工期間的暫態結構與地震風險：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temporary structural states and earthquake risk during construction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工期間地震風險」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Construction-period earthquake risk” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 為每個施工階段建立模型，檢查在選定的施工期地震下，臨時支撐、已切柱位與未完成區的側向強度與變形；施工中每週更新已完成與未完成的柱位圖，確認實際進度沒有超出分析過的暫態組合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Model each construction stage and check the lateral strength and deformation of shoring, cut-column locations and unfinished zones under the selected construction-period earthquake; update a weekly plan of completed and pending column positions to confirm that actual progress stays within the analysed temporary states. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約應規定施工期地震的設計水準、同時施作範圍上限與緊急應變程序，地震後先由結構技師檢查臨時系統才可復工；進度變更須先送設計者評估暫態安全。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The contract should set the construction-period design earthquake, the maximum simultaneous work area and an emergency procedure, with work resuming after an earthquake only once the structural engineer has inspected the temporary system; any change in sequence must first go to the designer for temporary-state assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若施工單位為趕工而同時切斷超出計畫的柱數，結構進入沒有分析過的暫態，中度地震就可能使臨時支撐傾倒；隔震器已安裝但尚未完成隔震縫時，建築撞上開挖面的臨時擋土，也可能造成損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the contractor cuts more columns than planned to save time, the structure enters an unanalysed temporary state in which a moderate earthquake may topple shoring; with isolators installed but the moat unfinished, the building can strike temporary earth retention and suffer damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 為每個施工階段建立模型，檢查在選定的施工期地震下，臨時支撐、已切柱位與未完成區的側向強度與變形；施工中每週更新已完成與未完成的柱位圖，確認實際進度沒有超出分析過的暫態組合。
knowledge.textEn: Model each construction stage and check the lateral strength and deformation of shoring, cut-column locations and unfinished zones under the selected construction-period earthquake; update a weekly plan of completed and pending column positions to confirm that actual progress stays within the analysed temporary states.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合約應規定施工期地震的設計水準、同時施作範圍上限與緊急應變程序，地震後先由結構技師檢查臨時系統才可復工；進度變更須先送設計者評估暫態安全。
knowledge.textEn: The contract should set the construction-period design earthquake, the maximum simultaneous work area and an emergency procedure, with work resuming after an earthquake only once the structural engineer has inspected the temporary system; any change in sequence must first go to the designer for temporary-state assessment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工期間的暫態結構與地震風險」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temporary structural states and earthquake risk during construction"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
隔震支承的勁度與阻尼是固定值，不隨位移改變。
為每個施工階段建立模型，檢查在選定的施工期地震下，臨時支撐、已切柱位與未完成區的側向強度與變形。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
An isolator's stiffness and damping are fixed values that do not change with displacement.
Model each construction stage and check the lateral strength and deformation of shoring, cut-column locations and unfinished zones under the selected construction-period earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 為每個施工階段建立模型，檢查在選定的施工期地震下，臨時支撐、已切柱位與未完成區的側向強度與變形；施工中每週更新已完成與未完成的柱位圖，確認實際進度沒有超出分析過的暫態組合。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Model each construction stage and check the lateral strength and deformation of shoring, cut-column locations and unfinished zones under the selected construction-period earthquake; update a weekly plan of completed and pending column positions to confirm that actual progress stays within the analysed temporary states. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工期間的暫態結構與地震風險：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temporary structural states and earthquake risk during construction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工期間地震風險」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction-period earthquake risk” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若施工單位為趕工而同時切斷超出計畫的柱數，結構進入沒有分析過的暫態，中度地震就可能使臨時支撐傾倒；隔震器已安裝但尚未完成隔震縫時，建築撞上開挖面的臨時擋土，也可能造成損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the contractor cuts more columns than planned to save time, the structure enters an unanalysed temporary state in which a moderate earthquake may topple shoring; with isolators installed but the moat unfinished, the building can strike temporary earth retention and suffer damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計者必須把每個施工階段當成一個暫態結構，決定其要承受的地震水準，並以臨時側向束制、限制同時施工範圍或分區施作來控制風險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Designers must treat each construction stage as a temporary structure, choose the earthquake level it must resist, and control risk with temporary lateral restraints, limits on simultaneous work areas or zoned construction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工期間只有幾年，不需要考慮地震。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Construction lasts only a few years, so earthquakes need not be considered." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若施工單位為趕工而同時切斷超出計畫的柱數，結構進入沒有分析過的暫態，中度地震就可能使臨時支撐傾倒；隔震器已安裝但尚未完成隔震縫時，建築撞上開挖面的臨時擋土，也可能造成損傷。
knowledge.textEn: If the contractor cuts more columns than planned to save time, the structure enters an unanalysed temporary state in which a moderate earthquake may topple shoring; with isolators installed but the moat unfinished, the building can strike temporary earth retention and suffer damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工期間的暫態結構與地震風險」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temporary structural states and earthquake risk during construction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若施工單位為趕工而同時切斷超出計畫的柱數，結構進入沒有分析過的暫態，中度地震就可能使臨時支撐傾倒。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
隔震器只要在慢速試驗中合格，地震時的性質就一定相同。
optionsEn: If the contractor cuts more columns than planned to save time, the structure enters an unanalysed temporary state in which a moderate earthquake may topple shoring.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If an isolator passes slow-speed tests, its properties in an earthquake will be the same.
quiz.explanation: 若施工單位為趕工而同時切斷超出計畫的柱數，結構進入沒有分析過的暫態，中度地震就可能使臨時支撐傾倒；隔震器已安裝但尚未完成隔震縫時，建築撞上開挖面的臨時擋土，也可能造成損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the contractor cuts more columns than planned to save time, the structure enters an unanalysed temporary state in which a moderate earthquake may topple shoring; with isolators installed but the moat unfinished, the building can strike temporary earth retention and suffer damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施」與「強震監測與實際性能判讀」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities" and "Strong-motion monitoring and interpreting real performance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「隔震器試驗機」如何影響既有建築基礎隔震改造的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Isolator test machine” governs force, deformation or durability in “Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 隔震器的性質必須在接近實際的軸壓、速度與位移下試驗，因為鉛心在快速大位移下會發熱、特性強度下降，橡膠性質也受速度與溫度影響。原型試驗在多個位移與軸壓組合下做反覆加載，確認穩定性與耗能；出廠試驗則對每個支承做壓縮與壓剪試驗，確認與原型一致。台灣國家地震工程研究中心的雙軸向動態測試系統（BATS）是少數能同時施加高軸壓與快速水平運動的設備，常用於隔震元件試驗。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「隔震器試驗機」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Isolator properties must be tested under realistic axial load, velocity and displacement, because the lead core heats and loses characteristic strength in fast large cycles, and rubber properties depend on rate and temperature. Prototype tests apply repeated cycles at several displacement and axial-load combinations to confirm stability and dissipation; production tests apply compression and combined compression–shear to every bearing to confirm consistency with the prototype. The Bi-Axial Testing System (BATS) at Taiwan's National Center for Research on Earthquake Engineering is one of the few facilities able to apply high axial load with fast horizontal motion and is commonly used for isolator testing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Isolator test machine” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A bearing cycled to ±0.40 m reads +690 kN and −660 kN, so K_eff = (690+660)/(2×0.40) ≈ 1,688 kN/m, about 0.5% above the design 1,679 kN/m; a loop area of 250 kJ gives β_eff = 250/(2π×1,688×0.40²) ≈ 14.7%, below the design 16%, which must be checked against the acceptance range.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔震器只要在慢速試驗中合格，地震時的性質就一定相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If an isolator passes slow-speed tests, its properties in an earthquake will be the same." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「隔震器試驗機」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Isolator test machine”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施
knowledge.titleEn: Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities
knowledge.text: 隔震器的性質必須在接近實際的軸壓、速度與位移下試驗，因為鉛心在快速大位移下會發熱、特性強度下降，橡膠性質也受速度與溫度影響。原型試驗在多個位移與軸壓組合下做反覆加載，確認穩定性與耗能；出廠試驗則對每個支承做壓縮與壓剪試驗，確認與原型一致。
knowledge.textEn: Isolator properties must be tested under realistic axial load, velocity and displacement, because the lead core heats and loses characteristic strength in fast large cycles, and rubber properties depend on rate and temperature. Prototype tests apply repeated cycles at several displacement and axial-load combinations to confirm stability and dissipation; production tests apply compression and combined compression–shear to every bearing to confirm consistency with the prototype.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隔震器只要在慢速試驗中合格，地震時的性質就一定相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If an isolator passes slow-speed tests, its properties in an earthquake will be the same. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities" is correct?
options: 隔震器只要在慢速試驗中合格，地震時的性質就一定相同。
隔震器的性質必須在接近實際的軸壓、速度與位移下試驗，因為鉛心在快速大位移下會發熱、特性強度下降，橡膠性質也受速度與溫度影響。
小地震時隔震建築的加速度折減應該和設計地震一樣大。
optionsEn: If an isolator passes slow-speed tests, its properties in an earthquake will be the same.

Isolator properties must be tested under realistic axial load, velocity and displacement, because the lead core heats and loses characteristic strength in fast large cycles, and rubber properties depend on rate and temperature.
In a small earthquake an isolated building should show the same acceleration reduction as in the design earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 隔震器的性質必須在接近實際的軸壓、速度與位移下試驗，因為鉛心在快速大位移下會發熱、特性強度下降，橡膠性質也受速度與溫度影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Isolator properties must be tested under realistic axial load, velocity and displacement, because the lead core heats and loses characteristic strength in fast large cycles, and rubber properties depend on rate and temperature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隔震器試驗機」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Isolator test machine” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某支承在 ±0.40 m 循環量得 +690 kN 與 −660 kN，K_eff = (690+660)/(2×0.40) ≈ 1,688 kN/m，比設計 1,679 kN/m 高約 0.5%；迴圈面積 250 kJ，β_eff = 250/(2π×1,688×0.40²) ≈ 14.7%，比設計 16% 低，須確認是否在允收範圍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A bearing cycled to ±0.40 m reads +690 kN and −660 kN, so K_eff = (690+660)/(2×0.40) ≈ 1,688 kN/m, about 0.5% above the design 1,679 kN/m; a loop area of 250 kJ gives β_eff = 250/(2π×1,688×0.40²) ≈ 14.7%, below the design 16%, which must be checked against the acceptance range. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫列出軸壓、位移振幅、循環數、速度與溫度，以及 K_eff、EDC 個別與平均的允收偏差；試驗機的力量測方式要經校正，高速試驗時須考慮致動器慣性與摩擦對量測力的影響，並由第三方見證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The test plan lists axial loads, displacement amplitudes, cycle counts, velocities and temperatures, and acceptance tolerances for individual and average K_eff and EDC; force measurement on the test machine must be calibrated, high-speed tests must account for actuator inertia and friction in the measured force, and a third party should witness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 某支承在 ±0.40 m 循環量得 +690 kN 與 −660 kN，K_eff = (690+660)/(2×0.40) ≈ 1,688 kN/m，比設計 1,679 kN/m 高約 0.5%；迴圈面積 250 kJ，β_eff = 250/(2π×1,688×0.40²) ≈ 14.7%，比設計 16% 低，須確認是否在允收範圍。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A bearing cycled to ±0.40 m reads +690 kN and −660 kN, so K_eff = (690+660)/(2×0.40) ≈ 1,688 kN/m, about 0.5% above the design 1,679 kN/m; a loop area of 250 kJ gives β_eff = 250/(2π×1,688×0.40²) ≈ 14.7%, below the design 16%, which must be checked against the acceptance range. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities", which statement holds?
options: 隔震改造完成後，隔震縫只是一條空隙，不需要維護。
隔震縫寬度只要等於設計位移即可，不必考慮扭轉。
optionsEn: Once the retrofit is complete, the moat is just a gap that needs no maintenance.
The moat width only needs to equal the design displacement, without considering torsion.
A bearing cycled to ±0.40 m reads +690 kN and −660 kN, so K_eff = (690+660)/(2×0.40) ≈ 1,688 kN/m, about 0.5% above the design 1,679 kN/m.
quiz.explanation: 某支承在 ±0.40 m 循環量得 +690 kN 與 −660 kN，K_eff = (690+660)/(2×0.40) ≈ 1,688 kN/m，比設計 1,679 kN/m 高約 0.5%；迴圈面積 250 kJ，β_eff = 250/(2π×1,688×0.40²) ≈ 14.7%，比設計 16% 低，須確認是否在允收範圍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A bearing cycled to ±0.40 m reads +690 kN and −660 kN, so K_eff = (690+660)/(2×0.40) ≈ 1,688 kN/m, about 0.5% above the design 1,679 kN/m; a loop area of 250 kJ gives β_eff = 250/(2π×1,688×0.40²) ≈ 14.7%, below the design 16%, which must be checked against the acceptance range. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隔震器試驗機」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Isolator test machine” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗計畫列出軸壓、位移振幅、循環數、速度與溫度，以及 K_eff、EDC 個別與平均的允收偏差；試驗機的力量測方式要經校正，高速試驗時須考慮致動器慣性與摩擦對量測力的影響，並由第三方見證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The test plan lists axial loads, displacement amplitudes, cycle counts, velocities and temperatures, and acceptance tolerances for individual and average K_eff and EDC; force measurement on the test machine must be calibrated, high-speed tests must account for actuator inertia and friction in the measured force, and a third party should witness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採購文件要求原型試驗速度接近設計速度，或以經核可的方法換算速度效應；每個支承的試驗報告與序號要與安裝位置對照，不合格品不得以修正係數放行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Procurement documents should require prototype test velocities close to design velocity, or an approved method to account for rate effects; every bearing's test report and serial number must match its installed location, and failed units may not be released with correction factors.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若原型試驗只做慢速試驗，鉛心發熱造成的強度下降未被量到，分析高估了阻尼，實際位移超過隔震縫；出廠試驗若只抽樣，個別支承的黏結缺陷可能在地震中才暴露。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Slow-only prototype tests miss the strength loss from lead heating, so analysis overstates damping and real displacement exceeds the moat; sampling instead of testing every production bearing can leave individual bonding defects to reveal themselves in an earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫列出軸壓、位移振幅、循環數、速度與溫度，以及 K_eff、EDC 個別與平均的允收偏差；試驗機的力量測方式要經校正，高速試驗時須考慮致動器慣性與摩擦對量測力的影響，並由第三方見證。
knowledge.textEn: The test plan lists axial loads, displacement amplitudes, cycle counts, velocities and temperatures, and acceptance tolerances for individual and average K_eff and EDC; force measurement on the test machine must be calibrated, high-speed tests must account for actuator inertia and friction in the measured force, and a third party should witness.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 採購文件要求原型試驗速度接近設計速度，或以經核可的方法換算速度效應；每個支承的試驗報告與序號要與安裝位置對照，不合格品不得以修正係數放行。
knowledge.textEn: Procurement documents should require prototype test velocities close to design velocity, or an approved method to account for rate effects; every bearing's test report and serial number must match its installed location, and failed units may not be released with correction factors.

quiz.question: 要驗證「原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities"?
options: 試驗計畫列出軸壓、位移振幅、循環數、速度與溫度，以及 K_eff、EDC 個別與平均的允收偏差。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
新澆托換梁只要與舊柱接觸，就能自動把柱荷載傳過去。
optionsEn: The test plan lists axial loads, displacement amplitudes, cycle counts, velocities and temperatures, and acceptance tolerances for individual and average K_eff and EDC.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A newly cast transfer beam that touches the old column will automatically pick up its load.
quiz.explanation: 試驗計畫列出軸壓、位移振幅、循環數、速度與溫度，以及 K_eff、EDC 個別與平均的允收偏差；試驗機的力量測方式要經校正，高速試驗時須考慮致動器慣性與摩擦對量測力的影響，並由第三方見證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The test plan lists axial loads, displacement amplitudes, cycle counts, velocities and temperatures, and acceptance tolerances for individual and average K_eff and EDC; force measurement on the test machine must be calibrated, high-speed tests must account for actuator inertia and friction in the measured force, and a third party should witness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隔震器試驗機」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Isolator test machine” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若原型試驗只做慢速試驗，鉛心發熱造成的強度下降未被量到，分析高估了阻尼，實際位移超過隔震縫；出廠試驗若只抽樣，個別支承的黏結缺陷可能在地震中才暴露。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slow-only prototype tests miss the strength loss from lead heating, so analysis overstates damping and real displacement exceeds the moat; sampling instead of testing every production bearing can leave individual bonding defects to reveal themselves in an earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：台灣國家地震工程研究中心的雙軸向動態測試系統（BATS）是少數能同時施加高軸壓與快速水平運動的設備，常用於隔震元件試驗。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Bi-Axial Testing System (BATS) at Taiwan's National Center for Research on Earthquake Engineering is one of the few facilities able to apply high axial load with fast horizontal motion and is commonly used for isolator testing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隔震器只要在慢速試驗中合格，地震時的性質就一定相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If an isolator passes slow-speed tests, its properties in an earthquake will be the same." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若原型試驗只做慢速試驗，鉛心發熱造成的強度下降未被量到，分析高估了阻尼，實際位移超過隔震縫；出廠試驗若只抽樣，個別支承的黏結缺陷可能在地震中才暴露。
knowledge.textEn: Slow-only prototype tests miss the strength loss from lead heating, so analysis overstates damping and real displacement exceeds the moat; sampling instead of testing every production bearing can leave individual bonding defects to reveal themselves in an earthquake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若原型試驗只做慢速試驗，鉛心發熱造成的強度下降未被量到，分析高估了阻尼，實際位移超過隔震縫；出廠試驗若只抽樣，個別支承的黏結缺陷可能在地震中才暴露。
小地震時隔震建築的加速度折減應該和設計地震一樣大。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Slow-only prototype tests miss the strength loss from lead heating, so analysis overstates damping and real displacement exceeds the moat.
In a small earthquake an isolated building should show the same acceleration reduction as in the design earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 若原型試驗只做慢速試驗，鉛心發熱造成的強度下降未被量到，分析高估了阻尼，實際位移超過隔震縫；出廠試驗若只抽樣，個別支承的黏結缺陷可能在地震中才暴露。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Slow-only prototype tests miss the strength loss from lead heating, so analysis overstates damping and real displacement exceeds the moat; sampling instead of testing every production bearing can leave individual bonding defects to reveal themselves in an earthquake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 強震監測與實際性能判讀：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Strong-motion monitoring and interpreting real performance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「隔震層上下強震儀」如何影響既有建築基礎隔震改造的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strong-motion sensors above and below isolation” governs force, deformation or durability in “Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 隔震建築應在隔震層下方、上方與屋頂設置強震儀，並在隔震層設位移計，才能在地震後判斷隔震是否如預期作用。中小地震時鉛心可能未完全降伏，系統較硬、週期較短，加速度折減不如設計地震明顯，判讀時不能用設計週期直接比較。鹽湖城市郡大樓在 2020 年規模 5.7 地震後只需輕微修復，這類實際事件與紀錄是隔震改造最有說服力的驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「隔震層上下強震儀」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An isolated building should carry strong-motion instruments below and above the isolation layer and at the roof, with displacement transducers in the isolation layer, so that engineers can judge after an earthquake whether isolation worked as intended. In small and moderate events the lead cores may not fully yield, so the system is stiffer with a shorter period and acceleration reduction is less marked than in the design earthquake; records must not be compared directly with the design period. After a magnitude 5.7 earthquake in 2020 the Salt Lake City and County Building needed only minor repairs, and such real events and records are the most convincing verification of an isolation retrofit. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Strong-motion sensors above and below isolation” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At only 0.03 m isolator displacement, one bearing carries F = 177 + 1,237×0.03 ≈ 214 kN, so K_eff ≈ 7,130 kN/m and 54 bearings total about 384,900 kN/m, giving T = 2π√(216,000/(9.81×384,900)) ≈ 1.5 s, half the 3.1 s at the 0.40 m design displacement.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「小地震時隔震建築的加速度折減應該和設計地震一樣大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "In a small earthquake an isolated building should show the same acceleration reduction as in the design earthquake." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「隔震層上下強震儀」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Strong-motion sensors above and below isolation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 強震監測與實際性能判讀
knowledge.titleEn: Strong-motion monitoring and interpreting real performance
knowledge.text: 隔震建築應在隔震層下方、上方與屋頂設置強震儀，並在隔震層設位移計，才能在地震後判斷隔震是否如預期作用。中小地震時鉛心可能未完全降伏，系統較硬、週期較短，加速度折減不如設計地震明顯，判讀時不能用設計週期直接比較。
knowledge.textEn: An isolated building should carry strong-motion instruments below and above the isolation layer and at the roof, with displacement transducers in the isolation layer, so that engineers can judge after an earthquake whether isolation worked as intended. In small and moderate events the lead cores may not fully yield, so the system is stiffer with a shorter period and acceleration reduction is less marked than in the design earthquake; records must not be compared directly with the design period.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：小地震時隔震建築的加速度折減應該和設計地震一樣大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: In a small earthquake an isolated building should show the same acceleration reduction as in the design earthquake. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「強震監測與實際性能判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strong-motion monitoring and interpreting real performance" is correct?
options: 小地震時隔震建築的加速度折減應該和設計地震一樣大。
只要用試驗量到的名目性質分析，隔震設計就涵蓋了全部情況。
隔震建築應在隔震層下方、上方與屋頂設置強震儀，並在隔震層設位移計，才能在地震後判斷隔震是否如預期作用。
optionsEn: In a small earthquake an isolated building should show the same acceleration reduction as in the design earthquake.
Analysing with the nominal tested properties covers every case in isolation design.

An isolated building should carry strong-motion instruments below and above the isolation layer and at the roof, with displacement transducers in the isolation layer, so that engineers can judge after an earthquake whether isolation worked as intended.
quiz.explanation: 隔震建築應在隔震層下方、上方與屋頂設置強震儀，並在隔震層設位移計，才能在地震後判斷隔震是否如預期作用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An isolated building should carry strong-motion instruments below and above the isolation layer and at the roof, with displacement transducers in the isolation layer, so that engineers can judge after an earthquake whether isolation worked as intended. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 強震監測與實際性能判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strong-motion monitoring and interpreting real performance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隔震層上下強震儀」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strong-motion sensors above and below isolation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：隔震位移僅 0.03 m 時，單一支承 F = 177 + 1,237×0.03 ≈ 214 kN，K_eff ≈ 7,130 kN/m，54 個合計約 384,900 kN/m，T = 2π√(216,000/(9.81×384,900)) ≈ 1.5 s，只有設計位移 0.40 m 時 3.1 s 的一半。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At only 0.03 m isolator displacement, one bearing carries F = 177 + 1,237×0.03 ≈ 214 kN, so K_eff ≈ 7,130 kN/m and 54 bearings total about 384,900 kN/m, giving T = 2π√(216,000/(9.81×384,900)) ≈ 1.5 s, half the 3.1 s at the 0.40 m design displacement. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：地震後比較隔震層上下的尖峰加速度與傅立葉譜，計算傳遞比，並以位移計或刮痕板讀取最大位移；以紀錄反算的有效週期與阻尼，和相同位移下的雙線性模型預測比較，差異過大時檢查是否有障礙物阻擋或支承損傷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After an earthquake, compare peak accelerations and Fourier spectra above and below the isolation layer to compute transfer ratios, and read maximum displacement from transducers or scratch plates; compare effective period and damping back-calculated from records with the bilinear model at the same displacement, and check for obstructions or bearing damage where they differ greatly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: At only 0.03 m isolator displacement, one bearing carries F = 177 + 1,237×0.03 ≈ 214 kN, so K_eff ≈ 7,130 kN/m and 54 bearings total about 384,900 kN/m, giving T = 2π√(216,000/(9.81×384,900)) ≈ 1.5 s, half the 3.1 s at the 0.40 m design displacement. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「強震監測與實際性能判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strong-motion monitoring and interpreting real performance", which statement holds?
options: 隔震改造會讓建築在地震中完全不動。
隔震支承的勁度與阻尼是固定值，不隨位移改變。
optionsEn: At only 0.03 m isolator displacement, one bearing carries F = 177 + 1,237×0.03 ≈ 214 kN, so K_eff ≈ 7,130 kN/m and 54 bearings total about 384,900 kN/m, giving T = 2π√(216,000/(9.81×384,900)) ≈ 1.5 s, half the 3.1 s at the 0.40 m design displacement.
Base isolation makes a building stay completely still in an earthquake.
An isolator's stiffness and damping are fixed values that do not change with displacement.
quiz.explanationEn: At only 0.03 m isolator displacement, one bearing carries F = 177 + 1,237×0.03 ≈ 214 kN, so K_eff ≈ 7,130 kN/m and 54 bearings total about 384,900 kN/m, giving T = 2π√(216,000/(9.81×384,900)) ≈ 1.5 s, half the 3.1 s at the 0.40 m design displacement. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 強震監測與實際性能判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strong-motion monitoring and interpreting real performance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隔震層上下強震儀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
