steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strong-motion sensors above and below isolation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 地震後比較隔震層上下的尖峰加速度與傅立葉譜，計算傳遞比，並以位移計或刮痕板讀取最大位移；以紀錄反算的有效週期與阻尼，和相同位移下的雙線性模型預測比較，差異過大時檢查是否有障礙物阻擋或支承損傷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After an earthquake, compare peak accelerations and Fourier spectra above and below the isolation layer to compute transfer ratios, and read maximum displacement from transducers or scratch plates; compare effective period and damping back-calculated from records with the bilinear model at the same displacement, and check for obstructions or bearing damage where they differ greatly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主應編列強震儀維護與資料判讀預算，地震後在約定時間內由結構技師提出簡報，說明最大位移、傳遞比與是否需要檢查支承；紀錄長期保存供後續研究與再評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Owners should budget for instrument maintenance and data interpretation, with the structural engineer reporting within an agreed time after each earthquake on maximum displacement, transfer ratios and whether bearings need inspection; keep records permanently for research and reassessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若沒有隔震層下方的強震儀，就無法區分加速度降低是因為隔震還是地動本身較弱；若隔震縫被雜物或後來增建的構造卡住，紀錄會顯示上部加速度突然尖峰，代表發生撞擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without an instrument below the isolation layer, nobody can tell whether lower acceleration came from isolation or simply weaker ground motion; if debris or later construction blocks the moat, records show sudden acceleration spikes above the layer, the signature of impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 地震後比較隔震層上下的尖峰加速度與傅立葉譜，計算傳遞比，並以位移計或刮痕板讀取最大位移；以紀錄反算的有效週期與阻尼，和相同位移下的雙線性模型預測比較，差異過大時檢查是否有障礙物阻擋或支承損傷。
knowledge.textEn: After an earthquake, compare peak accelerations and Fourier spectra above and below the isolation layer to compute transfer ratios, and read maximum displacement from transducers or scratch plates; compare effective period and damping back-calculated from records with the bilinear model at the same displacement, and check for obstructions or bearing damage where they differ greatly.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 業主應編列強震儀維護與資料判讀預算，地震後在約定時間內由結構技師提出簡報，說明最大位移、傳遞比與是否需要檢查支承；紀錄長期保存供後續研究與再評估。
knowledge.textEn: Owners should budget for instrument maintenance and data interpretation, with the structural engineer reporting within an agreed time after each earthquake on maximum displacement, transfer ratios and whether bearings need inspection; keep records permanently for research and reassessment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「強震監測與實際性能判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Strong-motion monitoring and interpreting real performance"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
地震後比較隔震層上下的尖峰加速度與傅立葉譜，計算傳遞比，並以位移計或刮痕板讀取最大位移。
切柱只是施工手續，只要千斤頂撐住就不會影響上部結構。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
After an earthquake, compare peak accelerations and Fourier spectra above and below the isolation layer to compute transfer ratios, and read maximum displacement from transducers or scratch plates.
Cutting columns is a routine step; as long as jacks hold them, the superstructure is unaffected.
quiz.explanation: 地震後比較隔震層上下的尖峰加速度與傅立葉譜，計算傳遞比，並以位移計或刮痕板讀取最大位移；以紀錄反算的有效週期與阻尼，和相同位移下的雙線性模型預測比較，差異過大時檢查是否有障礙物阻擋或支承損傷。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After an earthquake, compare peak accelerations and Fourier spectra above and below the isolation layer to compute transfer ratios, and read maximum displacement from transducers or scratch plates; compare effective period and damping back-calculated from records with the bilinear model at the same displacement, and check for obstructions or bearing damage where they differ greatly. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 強震監測與實際性能判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strong-motion monitoring and interpreting real performance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隔震層上下強震儀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Strong-motion sensors above and below isolation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若沒有隔震層下方的強震儀，就無法區分加速度降低是因為隔震還是地動本身較弱；若隔震縫被雜物或後來增建的構造卡住，紀錄會顯示上部加速度突然尖峰，代表發生撞擊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without an instrument below the isolation layer, nobody can tell whether lower acceleration came from isolation or simply weaker ground motion; if debris or later construction blocks the moat, records show sudden acceleration spikes above the layer, the signature of impact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鹽湖城市郡大樓在 2020 年規模 5.7 地震後只需輕微修復，這類實際事件與紀錄是隔震改造最有說服力的驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: After a magnitude 5.7 earthquake in 2020 the Salt Lake City and County Building needed only minor repairs, and such real events and records are the most convincing verification of an isolation retrofit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「小地震時隔震建築的加速度折減應該和設計地震一樣大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "In a small earthquake an isolated building should show the same acceleration reduction as in the design earthquake." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若沒有隔震層下方的強震儀，就無法區分加速度降低是因為隔震還是地動本身較弱；若隔震縫被雜物或後來增建的構造卡住，紀錄會顯示上部加速度突然尖峰，代表發生撞擊。
knowledge.textEn: Without an instrument below the isolation layer, nobody can tell whether lower acceleration came from isolation or simply weaker ground motion; if debris or later construction blocks the moat, records show sudden acceleration spikes above the layer, the signature of impact.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「強震監測與實際性能判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strong-motion monitoring and interpreting real performance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要用試驗量到的名目性質分析，隔震設計就涵蓋了全部情況。
若沒有隔震層下方的強震儀，就無法區分加速度降低是因為隔震還是地動本身較弱；若隔震縫被雜物或後來增建的構造卡住，紀錄會顯示上部加速度突然尖峰，代表發生撞擊。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Analysing with the nominal tested properties covers every case in isolation design.
Without an instrument below the isolation layer, nobody can tell whether lower acceleration came from isolation or simply weaker ground motion.
quiz.explanation: 若沒有隔震層下方的強震儀，就無法區分加速度降低是因為隔震還是地動本身較弱；若隔震縫被雜物或後來增建的構造卡住，紀錄會顯示上部加速度突然尖峰，代表發生撞擊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without an instrument below the isolation layer, nobody can tell whether lower acceleration came from isolation or simply weaker ground motion; if debris or later construction blocks the moat, records show sudden acceleration spikes above the layer, the signature of impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「老化、溫度與性質上下限分析」與「隔震縫維護、事件後檢查與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ageing, temperature and upper- and lower-bound analysis" and "Moat maintenance, post-event inspection and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限分析：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Ageing, temperature and upper- and lower-bound analysis: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「性質修正係數」如何影響既有建築基礎隔震改造的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Property modification factors” governs force, deformation or durability in “Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 隔震器的性質不是固定值：橡膠會隨時間硬化、低溫時變硬，鉛心在連續大位移中發熱而強度下降，製造批次也有變異。因此設計不採用單一性質，而以性質修正係數產生上限與下限兩組性質分別分析：下限性質（較軟、阻尼較低）決定最大位移與隔震縫寬度，上限性質（較硬、強度較高）決定上部結構與托換構件的設計力。改造案的上部結構往往只有有限的強度，對上限力特別敏感。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「性質修正係數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Isolator properties are not fixed: rubber stiffens with age and at low temperature, lead cores heat and lose strength in repeated large cycles, and production batches vary. Design therefore uses property modification factors to create upper- and lower-bound property sets analysed separately: the lower bound, softer with less damping, governs maximum displacement and moat width, while the upper bound, stiffer and stronger, governs forces on the superstructure and transfer members. In a retrofit the superstructure often has limited strength and is especially sensitive to upper-bound forces. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Property modification factors” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Upper bound with Q_d×1.3 and K_d×1.1: F_up = 1.3×177 + 1.1×1,237×0.40 ≈ 774 kN, 1.15 times the nominal 672 kN; lower bound with Q_d×0.85 and K_d×0.9: F_lo = 0.85×177 + 0.9×1,237×0.40 ≈ 596 kN, lengthening the system period from 3.1 s to about 3.3 s and raising displacement demand.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要用試驗量到的名目性質分析，隔震設計就涵蓋了全部情況。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Analysing with the nominal tested properties covers every case in isolation design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「性質修正係數」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Property modification factors”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限分析
knowledge.titleEn: Ageing, temperature and upper- and lower-bound analysis
knowledge.text: 隔震器的性質不是固定值：橡膠會隨時間硬化、低溫時變硬，鉛心在連續大位移中發熱而強度下降，製造批次也有變異。因此設計不採用單一性質，而以性質修正係數產生上限與下限兩組性質分別分析：下限性質（較軟、阻尼較低）決定最大位移與隔震縫寬度，上限性質（較硬、強度較高）決定上部結構與托換構件的設計力。
knowledge.textEn: Isolator properties are not fixed: rubber stiffens with age and at low temperature, lead cores heat and lose strength in repeated large cycles, and production batches vary. Design therefore uses property modification factors to create upper- and lower-bound property sets analysed separately: the lower bound, softer with less damping, governs maximum displacement and moat width, while the upper bound, stiffer and stronger, governs forces on the superstructure and transfer members.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要用試驗量到的名目性質分析，隔震設計就涵蓋了全部情況。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Analysing with the nominal tested properties covers every case in isolation design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「老化、溫度與性質上下限分析」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ageing, temperature and upper- and lower-bound analysis" is correct?
options: 隔震器的性質不是固定值：橡膠會隨時間硬化、低溫時變硬，鉛心在連續大位移中發熱而強度下降，製造批次也有變異。
只要用試驗量到的名目性質分析，隔震設計就涵蓋了全部情況。
隔震改造完成後，隔震縫只是一條空隙，不需要維護。
optionsEn: Isolator properties are not fixed: rubber stiffens with age and at low temperature, lead cores heat and lose strength in repeated large cycles, and production batches vary.
Analysing with the nominal tested properties covers every case in isolation design.
Once the retrofit is complete, the moat is just a gap that needs no maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 隔震器的性質不是固定值：橡膠會隨時間硬化、低溫時變硬，鉛心在連續大位移中發熱而強度下降，製造批次也有變異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Isolator properties are not fixed: rubber stiffens with age and at low temperature, lead cores heat and lose strength in repeated large cycles, and production batches vary. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限分析：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ageing, temperature and upper- and lower-bound analysis: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「性質修正係數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Property modification factors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：上限取 Q_d×1.3、K_d×1.1：F_up = 1.3×177 + 1.1×1,237×0.40 ≈ 774 kN，為名目 672 kN 的 1.15 倍；下限取 Q_d×0.85、K_d×0.9：F_lo = 0.85×177 + 0.9×1,237×0.40 ≈ 596 kN，系統週期由 3.1 s 增為約 3.3 s，位移需求隨之增加。修正係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Upper bound with Q_d×1.3 and K_d×1.1: F_up = 1.3×177 + 1.1×1,237×0.40 ≈ 774 kN, 1.15 times the nominal 672 kN; lower bound with Q_d×0.85 and K_d×0.9: F_lo = 0.85×177 + 0.9×1,237×0.40 ≈ 596 kN, lengthening the system period from 3.1 s to about 3.3 s and raising displacement demand. The factors are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：性質修正係數須以製造商的老化、溫度、速度與循環試驗資料為依據；設計報告同時列出上下限分析的最大位移、基底剪力與上部結構需求比，並在維護計畫中規定定期抽檢或量測支承變形與外觀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Property modification factors must rest on the manufacturer's ageing, temperature, rate and cycling test data; the design report lists maximum displacement, base shear and superstructure demand ratios for both bounds, and the maintenance plan requires periodic inspection of bearing deformation and condition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Upper bound with Q_d×1.3 and K_d×1.1: F_up = 1.3×177 + 1.1×1,237×0.40 ≈ 774 kN, 1.15 times the nominal 672 kN; lower bound with Q_d×0.85 and K_d×0.9: F_lo = 0.85×177 + 0.9×1,237×0.40 ≈ 596 kN, lengthening the system period from 3.1 s to about 3.3 s and raising displacement demand. The factors are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「老化、溫度與性質上下限分析」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ageing, temperature and upper- and lower-bound analysis", which statement holds?
options: 隔震縫寬度只要等於設計位移即可，不必考慮扭轉。
新澆托換梁只要與舊柱接觸，就能自動把柱荷載傳過去。
optionsEn: The moat width only needs to equal the design displacement, without considering torsion.
Upper bound with Q_d×1.3 and K_d×1.1: F_up = 1.3×177 + 1.1×1,237×0.40 ≈ 774 kN, 1.15 times the nominal 672 kN.
A newly cast transfer beam that touches the old column will automatically pick up its load.
quiz.explanationEn: Upper bound with Q_d×1.3 and K_d×1.1: F_up = 1.3×177 + 1.1×1,237×0.40 ≈ 774 kN, 1.15 times the nominal 672 kN; lower bound with Q_d×0.85 and K_d×0.9: F_lo = 0.85×177 + 0.9×1,237×0.40 ≈ 596 kN, lengthening the system period from 3.1 s to about 3.3 s and raising displacement demand. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限分析：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ageing, temperature and upper- and lower-bound analysis: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「性質修正係數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Property modification factors” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 性質修正係數須以製造商的老化、溫度、速度與循環試驗資料為依據；設計報告同時列出上下限分析的最大位移、基底剪力與上部結構需求比，並在維護計畫中規定定期抽檢或量測支承變形與外觀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Property modification factors must rest on the manufacturer's ageing, temperature, rate and cycling test data; the design report lists maximum displacement, base shear and superstructure demand ratios for both bounds, and the maintenance plan requires periodic inspection of bearing deformation and condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件中列出每種支承的名目、上限與下限性質及其依據，任何更換支承都必須落在同一上下限範圍內；外觀檢查項目包括橡膠龜裂、鋼板外露鏽蝕、殘留側向變形與錨栓。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents list nominal, upper- and lower-bound properties and their basis for each bearing type, and any replacement bearing must fall within the same bounds; visual inspection covers rubber cracking, exposed or corroded shims, residual lateral offset and anchor bolts.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以名目性質分析，橡膠多年硬化後實際傳入上部結構的力比設計高一至兩成，脆弱的磚牆或石材裝飾可能在設計地震中受損；低溫地區若忽略橡膠硬化，冬季地震的隔震效果也會打折。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Analysing only nominal properties means that after years of rubber stiffening the forces reaching the superstructure are 10% to 20% above design, so brittle masonry or stone ornament can be damaged in the design earthquake; ignoring low-temperature stiffening in cold climates also reduces isolation in a winter earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 性質修正係數須以製造商的老化、溫度、速度與循環試驗資料為依據；設計報告同時列出上下限分析的最大位移、基底剪力與上部結構需求比，並在維護計畫中規定定期抽檢或量測支承變形與外觀。
knowledge.textEn: Property modification factors must rest on the manufacturer's ageing, temperature, rate and cycling test data; the design report lists maximum displacement, base shear and superstructure demand ratios for both bounds, and the maintenance plan requires periodic inspection of bearing deformation and condition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件中列出每種支承的名目、上限與下限性質及其依據，任何更換支承都必須落在同一上下限範圍內；外觀檢查項目包括橡膠龜裂、鋼板外露鏽蝕、殘留側向變形與錨栓。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents list nominal, upper- and lower-bound properties and their basis for each bearing type, and any replacement bearing must fall within the same bounds; visual inspection covers rubber cracking, exposed or corroded shims, residual lateral offset and anchor bolts.

quiz.question: 要驗證「老化、溫度與性質上下限分析」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ageing, temperature and upper- and lower-bound analysis"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
施工期間只有幾年，不需要考慮地震。
性質修正係數須以製造商的老化、溫度、速度與循環試驗資料為依據。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Construction lasts only a few years, so earthquakes need not be considered.
Property modification factors must rest on the manufacturer's ageing, temperature, rate and cycling test data.
quiz.explanation: 性質修正係數須以製造商的老化、溫度、速度與循環試驗資料為依據；設計報告同時列出上下限分析的最大位移、基底剪力與上部結構需求比，並在維護計畫中規定定期抽檢或量測支承變形與外觀。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Property modification factors must rest on the manufacturer's ageing, temperature, rate and cycling test data; the design report lists maximum displacement, base shear and superstructure demand ratios for both bounds, and the maintenance plan requires periodic inspection of bearing deformation and condition. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限分析：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ageing, temperature and upper- and lower-bound analysis: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「性質修正係數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Property modification factors” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以名目性質分析，橡膠多年硬化後實際傳入上部結構的力比設計高一至兩成，脆弱的磚牆或石材裝飾可能在設計地震中受損；低溫地區若忽略橡膠硬化，冬季地震的隔震效果也會打折。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Analysing only nominal properties means that after years of rubber stiffening the forces reaching the superstructure are 10% to 20% above design, so brittle masonry or stone ornament can be damaged in the design earthquake; ignoring low-temperature stiffening in cold climates also reduces isolation in a winter earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：改造案的上部結構往往只有有限的強度，對上限力特別敏感。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In a retrofit the superstructure often has limited strength and is especially sensitive to upper-bound forces.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要用試驗量到的名目性質分析，隔震設計就涵蓋了全部情況。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Analysing with the nominal tested properties covers every case in isolation design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以名目性質分析，橡膠多年硬化後實際傳入上部結構的力比設計高一至兩成，脆弱的磚牆或石材裝飾可能在設計地震中受損；低溫地區若忽略橡膠硬化，冬季地震的隔震效果也會打折。
knowledge.textEn: Analysing only nominal properties means that after years of rubber stiffening the forces reaching the superstructure are 10% to 20% above design, so brittle masonry or stone ornament can be damaged in the design earthquake; ignoring low-temperature stiffening in cold climates also reduces isolation in a winter earthquake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「老化、溫度與性質上下限分析」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ageing, temperature and upper- and lower-bound analysis" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只以名目性質分析，橡膠多年硬化後實際傳入上部結構的力比設計高一至兩成，脆弱的磚牆或石材裝飾可能在設計地震中受損。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
隔震改造完成後，隔震縫只是一條空隙，不需要維護。
optionsEn: Analysing only nominal properties means that after years of rubber stiffening the forces reaching the superstructure are 10% to 20% above design, so brittle masonry or stone ornament can be damaged in the design earthquake.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once the retrofit is complete, the moat is just a gap that needs no maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 若只以名目性質分析，橡膠多年硬化後實際傳入上部結構的力比設計高一至兩成，脆弱的磚牆或石材裝飾可能在設計地震中受損；低溫地區若忽略橡膠硬化，冬季地震的隔震效果也會打折。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Analysing only nominal properties means that after years of rubber stiffening the forces reaching the superstructure are 10% to 20% above design, so brittle masonry or stone ornament can be damaged in the design earthquake; ignoring low-temperature stiffening in cold climates also reduces isolation in a winter earthquake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 隔震縫維護、事件後檢查與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Moat maintenance, post-event inspection and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「隔震縫淨空與管線接頭」如何影響既有建築基礎隔震改造的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Moat clearance and utility joints” governs force, deformation or durability in “Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 隔震改造完成後，最常見的失效不是支承本身，而是隔震縫被逐漸填滿：新增的花台、儲藏物、管線支架、甚至修繕時加砌的牆，都可能在多年後把建築與地盤重新卡在一起。穿越隔震面的水管、瓦斯管、電纜與排水管也必須保留足夠的可動長度。因此交接文件與日常維護必須把隔震縫當成結構構件管理，並在每次地震後檢查支承、可動接頭與隔震縫是否完整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「隔震縫淨空與管線接頭」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After an isolation retrofit, the most common failure is not the bearings but the moat gradually filling up: new planters, storage, pipe supports or even walls added during repairs can lock the building to the ground again years later. Water, gas, power and drainage lines crossing the isolation plane must also keep enough movable length. Handover documents and routine maintenance must therefore manage the moat as a structural element, and after every earthquake inspect bearings, flexible joints and moat clearance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Moat clearance and utility joints” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若隔震縫被後來的構造縮減到 0.30 m，而設計位移為 0.40 m：系統質量約 216,000/9.81 ≈ 22,000 t，ω = 2π/3.1 ≈ 2.03 rad/s，在 0.30 m 處速度 v = ω·√(0.40² − 0.30²) ≈ 0.54 m/s，撞擊動能 ½mv² ≈ 0.5×22.0×10⁶×0.54² ≈ 3.2 MJ，全部傳入局部牆體與上部結構。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If later construction reduces the moat to 0.30 m while the design displacement is 0.40 m: the system mass is about 216,000/9.81 ≈ 22,000 t, ω = 2π/3.1 ≈ 2.03 rad/s, the velocity at 0.30 m is v = ω·√(0.40² − 0.30²) ≈ 0.54 m/s and the impact energy ½mv² ≈ 0.5×22.0×10⁶×0.54² ≈ 3.2 MJ, all delivered into local walls and the superstructure.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔震改造完成後，隔震縫只是一條空隙，不需要維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the retrofit is complete, the moat is just a gap that needs no maintenance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「隔震縫淨空與管線接頭」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Moat clearance and utility joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隔震縫維護、事件後檢查與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Moat maintenance, post-event inspection and handover
knowledge.text: 隔震改造完成後，最常見的失效不是支承本身，而是隔震縫被逐漸填滿：新增的花台、儲藏物、管線支架、甚至修繕時加砌的牆，都可能在多年後把建築與地盤重新卡在一起。穿越隔震面的水管、瓦斯管、電纜與排水管也必須保留足夠的可動長度。
knowledge.textEn: After an isolation retrofit, the most common failure is not the bearings but the moat gradually filling up: new planters, storage, pipe supports or even walls added during repairs can lock the building to the ground again years later. Water, gas, power and drainage lines crossing the isolation plane must also keep enough movable length.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隔震改造完成後，隔震縫只是一條空隙，不需要維護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the retrofit is complete, the moat is just a gap that needs no maintenance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「隔震縫維護、事件後檢查與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Moat maintenance, post-event inspection and handover" is correct?
options: 隔震改造完成後，隔震縫只是一條空隙，不需要維護。
隔震改造完成後，最常見的失效不是支承本身，而是隔震縫被逐漸填滿：新增的花台、儲藏物、管線支架、甚至修繕時加砌的牆，都可能在多年後把建築與地盤重新卡在一起。
隔震改造會讓建築在地震中完全不動。
optionsEn: Once the retrofit is complete, the moat is just a gap that needs no maintenance.

After an isolation retrofit, the most common failure is not the bearings but the moat gradually filling up: new planters, storage, pipe supports or even walls added during repairs can lock the building to the ground again years later.
Base isolation makes a building stay completely still in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 隔震改造完成後，最常見的失效不是支承本身，而是隔震縫被逐漸填滿：新增的花台、儲藏物、管線支架、甚至修繕時加砌的牆，都可能在多年後把建築與地盤重新卡在一起。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After an isolation retrofit, the most common failure is not the bearings but the moat gradually filling up: new planters, storage, pipe supports or even walls added during repairs can lock the building to the ground again years later. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 隔震縫維護、事件後檢查與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Moat maintenance, post-event inspection and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隔震縫淨空與管線接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Moat clearance and utility joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若隔震縫被後來的構造縮減到 0.30 m，而設計位移為 0.40 m：系統質量約 216,000/9.81 ≈ 22,000 t，ω = 2π/3.1 ≈ 2.03 rad/s，在 0.30 m 處速度 v = ω·√(0.40² − 0.30²) ≈ 0.54 m/s，撞擊動能 ½mv² ≈ 0.5×22.0×10⁶×0.54² ≈ 3.2 MJ，全部傳入局部牆體與上部結構。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If later construction reduces the moat to 0.30 m while the design displacement is 0.40 m: the system mass is about 216,000/9.81 ≈ 22,000 t, ω = 2π/3.1 ≈ 2.03 rad/s, the velocity at 0.30 m is v = ω·√(0.40² − 0.30²) ≈ 0.54 m/s and the impact energy ½mv² ≈ 0.5×22.0×10⁶×0.54² ≈ 3.2 MJ, all delivered into local walls and the superstructure. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每年沿隔震縫全周量測淨寬並拍照，檢查蓋板、伸縮踏板與管線可動接頭；地震後依檢查表記錄支承殘留變形、橡膠龜裂、鉛心外露、錨栓與刮痕板讀數，必要時抽樣更換支承並重新試驗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Each year measure and photograph the clear width all round the moat and inspect covers, sliding treads and flexible utility joints; after an earthquake record residual bearing offset, rubber cracking, lead exposure, anchor bolts and scratch-plate readings against a checklist, replacing and re-testing sample bearings where needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若隔震縫被後來的構造縮減到 0.30 m，而設計位移為 0.40 m：系統質量約 216,000/9.81 ≈ 22,000 t，ω = 2π/3.1 ≈ 2.03 rad/s，在 0.30 m 處速度 v = ω·√(0.40² − 0.30²) ≈ 0.54 m/s，撞擊動能 ½mv² ≈ 0.5×22.0×10⁶×0.54² ≈ 3.2 MJ，全部傳入局部牆體與上部結構。數值為教學假設。

Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 隔震縫維護、事件後檢查與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Moat maintenance, post-event inspection and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隔震縫淨空與管線接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Moat clearance and utility joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每年沿隔震縫全周量測淨寬並拍照，檢查蓋板、伸縮踏板與管線可動接頭；地震後依檢查表記錄支承殘留變形、橡膠龜裂、鉛心外露、錨栓與刮痕板讀數，必要時抽樣更換支承並重新試驗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：管理單位不了解隔震縫的功能，把它當成可利用空間，或在外牆修繕時加設與地面相連的構造，強震時建築撞擊並失去隔震效益；管線可動長度不足，則在地震中拉斷，造成漏水、漏氣或火災。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 隔震縫維護、事件後檢查與交接：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隔震縫淨空與管線接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Moat clearance and utility joints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 管理單位不了解隔震縫的功能，把它當成可利用空間，或在外牆修繕時加設與地面相連的構造，強震時建築撞擊並失去隔震效益；管線可動長度不足，則在地震中拉斷，造成漏水、漏氣或火災。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Managers who do not understand the moat treat it as usable space or add structures tied to the ground during façade repairs, so the building collides and loses its isolation in a strong earthquake; utilities without enough movable length snap, causing water or gas leaks or fire. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隔震改造完成後，隔震縫只是一條空隙，不需要維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the retrofit is complete, the moat is just a gap that needs no maintenance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「隔震縫維護、事件後檢查與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

title: 挫屈束制支撐安裝
summary: 從挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑與層間變位換算核心應變出發，檢查核心、套管與脫層材及節點板的設計，再把重點放在安裝：重力荷載與安裝時機造成的預壓、現場配合誤差與螺栓鎖固，接著談 AISC 341 資格試驗與震後評估、防火與熱膨脹，最後是更換與交接，並以 One Rincon Hill、鹽湖城國際機場與日本製鐵工程的無黏結支撐公開資料對照。
summaryEn: Starting from the load path of buckling-restrained braced frames and the conversion of storey drift into core strain, check the core, casing, unbonding layer and gusset design, then focus on installation: preload from gravity loads and installation timing, fit-up misfit and bolt tightening, followed by AISC 341 qualification tests and post-earthquake assessment, fire and thermal expansion, and finally replacement and handover, compared with public information on One Rincon Hill, Salt Lake City International Airport and Nippon Steel Engineering's unbonded brace.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計與安裝練習：核心 A_sc = 4,000 mm²、F_y = 345 MPa，P_ysc ≈ 1,380 kN；以 ω = 1.4、β = 1.1，T_max ≈ 1,932 kN、C_max ≈ 2,125 kN。柱距 6 m、樓高 4 m，θ ≈ 33.7°、工作點長度約 7.21 m，降伏段 L_ysc ≈ 4,327 mm。設計層間變位 2%（80 mm）時支撐伸縮 ≈ 66.6 mm，核心應變 ≈ 1.54%，資格試驗須涵蓋約 3.1%。套管 250×250×6 mm、長 6.0 m，P_e ≈ 3,188 kN，為 C_max 的 1.5 倍。支撐勁度約 259 kN/mm：若鎖固後上方荷載使每層柱縮短 3.0 mm，支撐預壓約 431 kN（P_ysc 的 31%）；若安裝時強迫消除 2 mm 錯位，再增加約 518 kN。兩者相加約 949 kN，已達 P_ysc 的約 69%，地震時受壓側會提早降伏。若改為主要靜載完成後才鎖固並以墊片處理錯位，預壓可降到 P_ysc 的 10% 以下。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際產品或建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design and installation exercise: a core with A_sc = 4,000 mm² and F_y = 345 MPa gives P_ysc ≈ 1,380 kN; with ω = 1.4 and β = 1.1, T_max ≈ 1,932 kN and C_max ≈ 2,125 kN. For a 6 m bay and 4 m storey, θ ≈ 33.7°, the work-point length is about 7.21 m and the yielding zone L_ysc ≈ 4,327 mm. At a design drift of 2% (80 mm) the brace deforms about 66.6 mm, a core strain of about 1.54%, so qualification must cover about 3.1%. A 250×250×6 mm casing 6.0 m long has P_e ≈ 3,188 kN, 1.5 times C_max. With brace stiffness about 259 kN/mm, loads added after connection that shorten each storey's columns by 3.0 mm preload the brace by about 431 kN (31% of P_ysc), and forcing out a 2 mm misfit adds about 518 kN. Together about 949 kN, roughly 69% of P_ysc, so the brace yields early on the compression side in an earthquake. Connecting after the main dead loads and shimming the misfit can keep preload below 10% of P_ysc. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real product or building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑」與「層間變位與核心應變需求」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame" and "Storey drift and core strain demand": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「支撐核心降伏力」如何影響挫屈束制支撐安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Brace core yield force” governs force, deformation or durability in “Buckling-restrained brace installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 挫屈束制支撐（BRB）由一根可降伏的鋼核心與包覆它的鋼套管及砂漿組成，套管防止核心在受壓時整體挫屈，使核心在拉與壓兩個方向都能降伏並形成飽滿的遲滯迴圈。這讓支撐像一個以鋼材塑性耗能的阻尼器：地震力經樓板傳到梁，再由節點板進入支撐，核心降伏限制了傳入構架的最大力，梁、柱與節點板則依支撐可能的最大力做容量設計，保持彈性。日本製鐵工程公開說明，其無黏結支撐自上市 30 餘年來已交付超過 10 萬支。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「支撐核心降伏力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A buckling-restrained brace (BRB) consists of a yielding steel core enclosed by a steel casing and mortar; the casing prevents overall buckling of the core in compression, so the core yields in both tension and compression with full hysteresis loops. The brace thus acts as a damper dissipating energy through steel plasticity: earthquake force passes from the slab into the beam, through the gusset into the brace, and core yielding caps the force entering the frame, while beams, columns and gussets are capacity-designed for the maximum brace force and remain elastic. Nippon Steel Engineering states that more than 100,000 of its unbonded braces have been delivered in over 30 years on the market. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Brace core yield force” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：核心面積 A_sc = 4,000 mm²、標稱 F_y = 345 MPa：P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With core area A_sc = 4,000 mm² and nominal F_y = 345 MPa, P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支撐的鋼材強度越高越安全，所以核心用高強度鋼最好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stronger brace steel is always safer, so the core should use the highest-strength steel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「支撐核心降伏力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Brace core yield force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑
knowledge.titleEn: Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame
knowledge.text: 挫屈束制支撐（BRB）由一根可降伏的鋼核心與包覆它的鋼套管及砂漿組成，套管防止核心在受壓時整體挫屈，使核心在拉與壓兩個方向都能降伏並形成飽滿的遲滯迴圈。這讓支撐像一個以鋼材塑性耗能的阻尼器：地震力經樓板傳到梁，再由節點板進入支撐，核心降伏限制了傳入構架的最大力，梁、柱與節點板則依支撐可能的最大力做容量設計，保持彈性。
knowledge.textEn: A buckling-restrained brace (BRB) consists of a yielding steel core enclosed by a steel casing and mortar; the casing prevents overall buckling of the core in compression, so the core yields in both tension and compression with full hysteresis loops. The brace thus acts as a damper dissipating energy through steel plasticity: earthquake force passes from the slab into the beam, through the gusset into the brace, and core yielding caps the force entering the frame, while beams, columns and gussets are capacity-designed for the maximum brace force and remain elastic.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支撐的鋼材強度越高越安全，所以核心用高強度鋼最好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stronger brace steel is always safer, so the core should use the highest-strength steel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame" is correct?
options: 支撐的鋼材強度越高越安全，所以核心用高強度鋼最好。
挫屈束制支撐（BRB）由一根可降伏的鋼核心與包覆它的鋼套管及砂漿組成，套管防止核心在受壓時整體挫屈，使核心在拉與壓兩個方向都能降伏並形成飽滿的遲滯迴圈。
支撐越短越硬越好，核心降伏段長度不影響耐久性。
optionsEn: Stronger brace steel is always safer, so the core should use the highest-strength steel.
A buckling-restrained brace (BRB) consists of a yielding steel core enclosed by a steel casing and mortar.
Shorter, stiffer braces are always better, and the yielding-zone length has no effect on durability.
quiz.explanation: 挫屈束制支撐（BRB）由一根可降伏的鋼核心與包覆它的鋼套管及砂漿組成，套管防止核心在受壓時整體挫屈，使核心在拉與壓兩個方向都能降伏並形成飽滿的遲滯迴圈。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A buckling-restrained brace (BRB) consists of a yielding steel core enclosed by a steel casing and mortar; the casing prevents overall buckling of the core in compression, so the core yields in both tension and compression with full hysteresis loops. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支撐核心降伏力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Brace core yield force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：核心面積 A_sc = 4,000 mm²、標稱 F_y = 345 MPa：P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN。以應變硬化係數 ω = 1.4 與受壓強度調整係數 β = 1.1，最大拉力 T_max = ω·P_ysc ≈ 1,932 kN，最大壓力 C_max = β·ω·P_ysc ≈ 2,125 kN，梁柱與節點板依此做容量設計。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With core area A_sc = 4,000 mm² and nominal F_y = 345 MPa, P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN. With strain-hardening factor ω = 1.4 and compression adjustment factor β = 1.1, the maximum tension is T_max = ω·P_ysc ≈ 1,932 kN and the maximum compression C_max = β·ω·P_ysc ≈ 2,125 kN, which govern capacity design of beams, columns and gussets. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計時列出每支支撐的 P_ysc、T_max、C_max 與所連接的梁、柱、節點板需求比；核心鋼材以鋼板試片的實測降伏強度確認落在規格範圍內，避免實際強度過高使構架超載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In design, tabulate P_ysc, T_max and C_max for every brace with the demand ratios of the beams, columns and gussets it connects; confirm from coupon tests on the core plate that the measured yield strength falls within the specified range, so that an overly strong core does not overload the frame.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 核心面積 A_sc = 4,000 mm²、標稱 F_y = 345 MPa：P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN。以應變硬化係數 ω = 1.4 與受壓強度調整係數 β = 1.1，最大拉力 T_max = ω·P_ysc ≈ 1,932 kN，最大壓力 C_max = β·ω·P_ysc ≈ 2,125 kN，梁柱與節點板依此做容量設計。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With core area A_sc = 4,000 mm² and nominal F_y = 345 MPa, P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN. With strain-hardening factor ω = 1.4 and compression adjustment factor β = 1.1, the maximum tension is T_max = ω·P_ysc ≈ 1,932 kN and the maximum compression C_max = β·ω·P_ysc ≈ 2,125 kN, which govern capacity design of beams, columns and gussets. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame", which statement holds?
options: 只要支撐本身合格，節點板照一般斜撐設計就可以。
支撐兩端孔位差幾公釐沒關係，用吊具拉一下就能裝上。

optionsEn: If the brace itself is qualified, the gusset can be designed as for an ordinary brace.
A few millimetres of misfit do not matter, since a hoist can pull the brace into place.
With core area A_sc = 4,000 mm² and nominal F_y = 345 MPa, P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN.
quiz.explanation: 核心面積 A_sc = 4,000 mm²、標稱 F_y = 345 MPa：P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With core area A_sc = 4,000 mm² and nominal F_y = 345 MPa, P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支撐核心降伏力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Brace core yield force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計時列出每支支撐的 P_ysc、T_max、C_max 與所連接的梁、柱、節點板需求比；核心鋼材以鋼板試片的實測降伏強度確認落在規格範圍內，避免實際強度過高使構架超載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In design, tabulate P_ysc, T_max and C_max for every brace with the demand ratios of the beams, columns and gussets it connects; confirm from coupon tests on the core plate that the measured yield strength falls within the specified range, so that an overly strong core does not overload the frame. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書應規定核心鋼材的降伏強度範圍（上下限），並要求每批鋼板試片報告；容量設計所用的 ω 與 β 必須取自該產品的資格試驗，不可直接沿用其他廠牌數值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should set an upper and lower bound on core yield strength and require coupon reports for every plate heat; the ω and β used in capacity design must come from that product's qualification tests, not from another manufacturer's values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若核心鋼材實際降伏強度遠高於設計值，支撐在設計地震中不降伏，力量直接傳入柱與基礎，可能使柱或節點板先破壞；反之核心太弱，則在中小地震就降伏並累積損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the actual core yield strength is far above design, the brace does not yield in the design earthquake and force flows straight into columns and foundations, which may fail first; a core that is too weak yields in minor earthquakes and accumulates damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計時列出每支支撐的 P_ysc、T_max、C_max 與所連接的梁、柱、節點板需求比；核心鋼材以鋼板試片的實測降伏強度確認落在規格範圍內，避免實際強度過高使構架超載。
knowledge.textEn: In design, tabulate P_ysc, T_max and C_max for every brace with the demand ratios of the beams, columns and gussets it connects; confirm from coupon tests on the core plate that the measured yield strength falls within the specified range, so that an overly strong core does not overload the frame.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格書應規定核心鋼材的降伏強度範圍（上下限），並要求每批鋼板試片報告；容量設計所用的 ω 與 β 必須取自該產品的資格試驗，不可直接沿用其他廠牌數值。
knowledge.textEn: The specification should set an upper and lower bound on core yield strength and require coupon reports for every plate heat; the ω and β used in capacity design must come from that product's qualification tests, not from another manufacturer's values.

quiz.question: 要驗證「挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame"?
options: 設計時列出每支支撐的 P_ysc、T_max、C_max 與所連接的梁、柱、節點板需求比。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
挫屈束制支撐外觀沒有變形，就表示裡面的核心沒有損傷。
optionsEn: In design, tabulate P_ysc, T_max and C_max for every brace with the demand ratios of the beams, columns and gussets it connects.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If a BRB looks undeformed, its core is undamaged.
quiz.explanation: 設計時列出每支支撐的 P_ysc、T_max、C_max 與所連接的梁、柱、節點板需求比；核心鋼材以鋼板試片的實測降伏強度確認落在規格範圍內，避免實際強度過高使構架超載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In design, tabulate P_ysc, T_max and C_max for every brace with the demand ratios of the beams, columns and gussets it connects; confirm from coupon tests on the core plate that the measured yield strength falls within the specified range, so that an overly strong core does not overload the frame. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支撐核心降伏力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Brace core yield force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若核心鋼材實際降伏強度遠高於設計值，支撐在設計地震中不降伏，力量直接傳入柱與基礎，可能使柱或節點板先破壞；反之核心太弱，則在中小地震就降伏並累積損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the actual core yield strength is far above design, the brace does not yield in the design earthquake and force flows straight into columns and foundations, which may fail first; a core that is too weak yields in minor earthquakes and accumulates damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：日本製鐵工程公開說明，其無黏結支撐自上市 30 餘年來已交付超過 10 萬支。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Nippon Steel Engineering states that more than 100,000 of its unbonded braces have been delivered in over 30 years on the market.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支撐的鋼材強度越高越安全，所以核心用高強度鋼最好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stronger brace steel is always safer, so the core should use the highest-strength steel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若核心鋼材實際降伏強度遠高於設計值，支撐在設計地震中不降伏，力量直接傳入柱與基礎，可能使柱或節點板先破壞；反之核心太弱，則在中小地震就降伏並累積損傷。
knowledge.textEn: If the actual core yield strength is far above design, the brace does not yield in the design earthquake and force flows straight into columns and foundations, which may fail first; a core that is too weak yields in minor earthquakes and accumulates damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若核心鋼材實際降伏強度遠高於設計值，支撐在設計地震中不降伏，力量直接傳入柱與基礎，可能使柱或節點板先破壞；反之核心太弱，則在中小地震就降伏並累積損傷。
支撐越短越硬越好，核心降伏段長度不影響耐久性。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If the actual core yield strength is far above design, the brace does not yield in the design earthquake and force flows straight into columns and foundations, which may fail first.
Shorter, stiffer braces are always better, and the yielding-zone length has no effect on durability.
quiz.explanation: 若核心鋼材實際降伏強度遠高於設計值，支撐在設計地震中不降伏，力量直接傳入柱與基礎，可能使柱或節點板先破壞；反之核心太弱，則在中小地震就降伏並累積損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the actual core yield strength is far above design, the brace does not yield in the design earthquake and force flows straight into columns and foundations, which may fail first; a core that is too weak yields in minor earthquakes and accumulates damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 層間變位與核心應變需求：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Storey drift and core strain demand: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「核心降伏段應變」如何影響挫屈束制支撐安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core yielding-zone strain” governs force, deformation or durability in “Buckling-restrained brace installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 支撐的變形需求來自層間變位：樓層水平位移在斜撐方向的分量就是支撐伸縮量，而這個伸縮量主要集中在核心的降伏段，兩端的加勁連接段幾乎不變形。降伏段越短，同樣的層間變位就造成越大的核心應變，低週疲勞壽命也越短；降伏段越長，支撐越柔、層間變位越大。因此核心降伏段長度是在構架勁度與核心應變之間取捨，必須與製造商的試驗應變範圍對照。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「核心降伏段應變」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A brace's deformation demand comes from storey drift: the component of horizontal storey displacement along the brace axis is the brace elongation or shortening, concentrated in the yielding zone of the core while the stiffened end zones barely deform. A shorter yielding zone gives larger core strain for the same drift and shorter low-cycle fatigue life; a longer one makes the brace more flexible and increases drift. The yielding-zone length is therefore a trade-off between frame stiffness and core strain and must be checked against the manufacturer's tested strain range. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Core yielding-zone strain” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：柱距 6 m、樓高 4 m：支撐角 θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7°，工作點長度約 7.21 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 6 m bay and 4 m storey, the brace angle is θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7° and the work-point length about 7.21 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支撐越短越硬越好，核心降伏段長度不影響耐久性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shorter, stiffer braces are always better, and the yielding-zone length has no effect on durability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「核心降伏段應變」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Core yielding-zone strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 層間變位與核心應變需求
knowledge.titleEn: Storey drift and core strain demand
knowledge.text: 支撐的變形需求來自層間變位：樓層水平位移在斜撐方向的分量就是支撐伸縮量，而這個伸縮量主要集中在核心的降伏段，兩端的加勁連接段幾乎不變形。降伏段越短，同樣的層間變位就造成越大的核心應變，低週疲勞壽命也越短；降伏段越長，支撐越柔、層間變位越大。
knowledge.textEn: A brace's deformation demand comes from storey drift: the component of horizontal storey displacement along the brace axis is the brace elongation or shortening, concentrated in the yielding zone of the core while the stiffened end zones barely deform. A shorter yielding zone gives larger core strain for the same drift and shorter low-cycle fatigue life; a longer one makes the brace more flexible and increases drift.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支撐越短越硬越好，核心降伏段長度不影響耐久性。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Shorter, stiffer braces are always better, and the yielding-zone length has no effect on durability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「層間變位與核心應變需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Storey drift and core strain demand" is correct?
options: 支撐越短越硬越好，核心降伏段長度不影響耐久性。
套管只是外殼，壁厚可以任意減薄。
支撐的變形需求來自層間變位：樓層水平位移在斜撐方向的分量就是支撐伸縮量，而這個伸縮量主要集中在核心的降伏段，兩端的加勁連接段幾乎不變形。
optionsEn: Shorter, stiffer braces are always better, and the yielding-zone length has no effect on durability.
The casing is just a shell, so its wall can be thinned at will.

A brace's deformation demand comes from storey drift: the component of horizontal storey displacement along the brace axis is the brace elongation or shortening, concentrated in the yielding zone of the core while the stiffened end zones barely deform.
quiz.explanation: 支撐的變形需求來自層間變位：樓層水平位移在斜撐方向的分量就是支撐伸縮量，而這個伸縮量主要集中在核心的降伏段，兩端的加勁連接段幾乎不變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A brace's deformation demand comes from storey drift: the component of horizontal storey displacement along the brace axis is the brace elongation or shortening, concentrated in the yielding zone of the core while the stiffened end zones barely deform. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 層間變位與核心應變需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Storey drift and core strain demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「核心降伏段應變」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Core yielding-zone strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：柱距 6 m、樓高 4 m：支撐角 θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7°，工作點長度約 7.21 m。層間變位 2%×4,000 = 80 mm，支撐伸縮 80×cos33.7° ≈ 66.6 mm；降伏段取工作點長度的 60%，L_ysc ≈ 4,327 mm，核心應變 ≈ 66.6/4,327 ≈ 1.54%，試驗須涵蓋其兩倍約 3.1%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 6 m bay and 4 m storey, the brace angle is θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7° and the work-point length about 7.21 m. A 2% drift of 80 mm gives a brace deformation of 80×cos33.7° ≈ 66.6 mm; with a yielding zone of 60% of the work-point length, L_ysc ≈ 4,327 mm and core strain ≈ 66.6/4,327 ≈ 1.54%, so tests must cover twice that, about 3.1%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從非線性分析取得每支支撐在設計與最大考量地震下的最大變形，換算核心應變並與資格試驗達到的應變比較；日本製鐵工程公開說明其無黏結支撐在約 3% 至 4% 軸應變下仍有穩定遲滯與疲勞性能，可作為比較的量級參考。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take each brace's maximum deformation under the design and maximum considered earthquakes from nonlinear analysis, convert it to core strain and compare with the strain reached in qualification tests; Nippon Steel Engineering reports stable hysteresis and fatigue performance for its unbonded brace at about 3% to 4% axial strain, a useful order of magnitude for comparison.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 柱距 6 m、樓高 4 m：支撐角 θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7°，工作點長度約 7.21 m。層間變位 2%×4,000 = 80 mm，支撐伸縮 80×cos33.7° ≈ 66.6 mm；降伏段取工作點長度的 60%，L_ysc ≈ 4,327 mm，核心應變 ≈ 66.6/4,327 ≈ 1.54%，試驗須涵蓋其兩倍約 3.1%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a 6 m bay and 4 m storey, the brace angle is θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7° and the work-point length about 7.21 m. A 2% drift of 80 mm gives a brace deformation of 80×cos33.7° ≈ 66.6 mm; with a yielding zone of 60% of the work-point length, L_ysc ≈ 4,327 mm and core strain ≈ 66.6/4,327 ≈ 1.54%, so tests must cover twice that, about 3.1%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「層間變位與核心應變需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Storey drift and core strain demand", which statement holds?
options: 柱距 6 m、樓高 4 m：支撐角 θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7°，工作點長度約 7.21 m。
支撐越早鎖固越好，可以順便當施工期間的穩定斜撐。
只要支撐廠牌有任何一份試驗報告，所有尺寸的支撐都算合格。
optionsEn: With a 6 m bay and 4 m storey, the brace angle is θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7° and the work-point length about 7.21 m.
The earlier braces are connected the better, since they can double as construction bracing.
Any test report from a brace manufacturer qualifies braces of every size.
quiz.explanation: 柱距 6 m、樓高 4 m：支撐角 θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7°，工作點長度約 7.21 m。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 層間變位與核心應變需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Storey drift and core strain demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「核心降伏段應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Core yielding-zone strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從非線性分析取得每支支撐在設計與最大考量地震下的最大變形，換算核心應變並與資格試驗達到的應變比較；日本製鐵工程公開說明其無黏結支撐在約 3% 至 4% 軸應變下仍有穩定遲滯與疲勞性能，可作為比較的量級參考。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take each brace's maximum deformation under the design and maximum considered earthquakes from nonlinear analysis, convert it to core strain and compare with the strain reached in qualification tests; Nippon Steel Engineering reports stable hysteresis and fatigue performance for its unbonded brace at about 3% to 4% axial strain, a useful order of magnitude for comparison. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：支撐訂購表要列出每支支撐的工作點長度、降伏段長度、設計變形與最大變形，由製造商確認落在其資格試驗範圍內；設計變更影響樓高或柱距時，須重新計算核心應變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The brace schedule should list work-point length, yielding-zone length, design and maximum deformation for every brace, confirmed by the manufacturer to lie within its qualification range; any change to storey height or bay width requires recalculating core strain.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若為了提高勁度而把降伏段縮得很短，核心應變超過試驗範圍，強震時核心在數個大循環後斷裂，支撐失去強度，層間變位突然增大；若核心應變分析只用平均樓層位移而忽略扭轉，角落支撐的需求會被低估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shortening the yielding zone to raise stiffness can push core strain beyond the tested range, so the core fractures after a few large cycles in a strong earthquake, the brace loses strength and drift jumps; using average storey displacement while ignoring torsion underestimates demand on corner braces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 從非線性分析取得每支支撐在設計與最大考量地震下的最大變形，換算核心應變並與資格試驗達到的應變比較；日本製鐵工程公開說明其無黏結支撐在約 3% 至 4% 軸應變下仍有穩定遲滯與疲勞性能，可作為比較的量級參考。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 支撐訂購表要列出每支支撐的工作點長度、降伏段長度、設計變形與最大變形，由製造商確認落在其資格試驗範圍內；設計變更影響樓高或柱距時，須重新計算核心應變。
knowledge.textEn: The brace schedule should list work-point length, yielding-zone length, design and maximum deformation for every brace, confirmed by the manufacturer to lie within its qualification range; any change to storey height or bay width requires recalculating core strain.

quiz.question: 要驗證「層間變位與核心應變需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Storey drift and core strain demand"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
從非線性分析取得每支支撐在設計與最大考量地震下的最大變形，換算核心應變並與資格試驗達到的應變比較。
支撐裡面已經灌滿砂漿，所以不需要再做防火被覆。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Take each brace's maximum deformation under the design and maximum considered earthquakes from nonlinear analysis, convert it to core strain and compare with the strain reached in qualification tests.
A brace is already filled with mortar, so it needs no fireproofing.
quiz.explanation: 從非線性分析取得每支支撐在設計與最大考量地震下的最大變形，換算核心應變並與資格試驗達到的應變比較；日本製鐵工程公開說明其無黏結支撐在約 3% 至 4% 軸應變下仍有穩定遲滯與疲勞性能，可作為比較的量級參考。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take each brace's maximum deformation under the design and maximum considered earthquakes from nonlinear analysis, convert it to core strain and compare with the strain reached in qualification tests; Nippon Steel Engineering reports stable hysteresis and fatigue performance for its unbonded brace at about 3% to 4% axial strain, a useful order of magnitude for comparison. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 層間變位與核心應變需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Storey drift and core strain demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「核心降伏段應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Core yielding-zone strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若為了提高勁度而把降伏段縮得很短，核心應變超過試驗範圍，強震時核心在數個大循環後斷裂，支撐失去強度，層間變位突然增大；若核心應變分析只用平均樓層位移而忽略扭轉，角落支撐的需求會被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shortening the yielding zone to raise stiffness can push core strain beyond the tested range, so the core fractures after a few large cycles in a strong earthquake, the brace loses strength and drift jumps; using average storey displacement while ignoring torsion underestimates demand on corner braces. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此核心降伏段長度是在構架勁度與核心應變之間取捨，必須與製造商的試驗應變範圍對照。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The yielding-zone length is therefore a trade-off between frame stiffness and core strain and must be checked against the manufacturer's tested strain range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支撐越短越硬越好，核心降伏段長度不影響耐久性。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Shorter, stiffer braces are always better, and the yielding-zone length has no effect on durability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 若為了提高勁度而把降伏段縮得很短，核心應變超過試驗範圍，強震時核心在數個大循環後斷裂，支撐失去強度，層間變位突然增大；若核心應變分析只用平均樓層位移而忽略扭轉，角落支撐的需求會被低估。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「層間變位與核心應變需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Storey drift and core strain demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
套管只是外殼，壁厚可以任意減薄。
若為了提高勁度而把降伏段縮得很短，核心應變超過試驗範圍，強震時核心在數個大循環後斷裂，支撐失去強度，層間變位突然增大。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The casing is just a shell, so its wall can be thinned at will.

Shortening the yielding zone to raise stiffness can push core strain beyond the tested range, so the core fractures after a few large cycles in a strong earthquake, the brace loses strength and drift jumps.
