stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「核心、套管、砂漿與脫層材」與「節點板、耳板與構架作用」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Core, casing, mortar and unbonding layer" and "Gussets, lugs and frame action": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 核心、套管、砂漿與脫層材：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Core, casing, mortar and unbonding layer: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼套管與脫層材」如何影響挫屈束制支撐安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel casing and unbonding layer” governs force, deformation or durability in “Buckling-restrained brace installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 核心受壓時會產生高階挫屈波形並推擠周圍砂漿，套管與砂漿必須有足夠勁度把核心限制在直線上；同時核心與砂漿之間要有脫層材或微小間隙，一方面讓核心受壓時因泊松效應的橫向膨脹有空間，另一方面避免軸力經摩擦傳入套管。間隙太小，套管分擔軸力而使受壓強度遠高於受拉；間隙太大，核心高階挫屈振幅過大而局部受損。日本製鐵工程的無黏結支撐即以鋼管與砂漿約束中心鋼材，並以特殊緩衝材使鋼管與砂漿不承受軸力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼套管與脫層材」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In compression the core develops higher-mode buckling waves that push against the surrounding mortar, so the casing and mortar must be stiff enough to keep the core straight; at the same time an unbonding layer or small gap between core and mortar gives room for the core's Poisson expansion in compression and stops axial force passing into the casing by friction. Too small a gap lets the casing share axial load so compression strength far exceeds tension; too large a gap allows large higher-mode buckling amplitudes and local damage. Nippon Steel Engineering's unbonded brace restrains its central steel with a steel tube and mortar, using a special cushioning material so that the tube and mortar carry no axial force. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Steel casing and unbonding layer” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 250×250×6 mm square casing, I = (250⁴ − 238⁴)/12 ≈ 5.81×10⁷ mm⁴; over 6.0 m, P_e = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×5.81×10⁷/6,000² ≈ 3,188 kN, 1.5 times C_max = 2,125 kN, ignoring the mortar.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「套管只是外殼，壁厚可以任意減薄。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The casing is just a shell, so its wall can be thinned at will." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼套管與脫層材」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Steel casing and unbonding layer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 核心、套管、砂漿與脫層材
knowledge.titleEn: Core, casing, mortar and unbonding layer
knowledge.text: 核心受壓時會產生高階挫屈波形並推擠周圍砂漿，套管與砂漿必須有足夠勁度把核心限制在直線上；同時核心與砂漿之間要有脫層材或微小間隙，一方面讓核心受壓時因泊松效應的橫向膨脹有空間，另一方面避免軸力經摩擦傳入套管。間隙太小，套管分擔軸力而使受壓強度遠高於受拉；間隙太大，核心高階挫屈振幅過大而局部受損。
knowledge.textEn: In compression the core develops higher-mode buckling waves that push against the surrounding mortar, so the casing and mortar must be stiff enough to keep the core straight; at the same time an unbonding layer or small gap between core and mortar gives room for the core's Poisson expansion in compression and stops axial force passing into the casing by friction. Too small a gap lets the casing share axial load so compression strength far exceeds tension; too large a gap allows large higher-mode buckling amplitudes and local damage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：套管只是外殼，壁厚可以任意減薄。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The casing is just a shell, so its wall can be thinned at will. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「核心、套管、砂漿與脫層材」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Core, casing, mortar and unbonding layer" is correct?
options: 核心受壓時會產生高階挫屈波形並推擠周圍砂漿，套管與砂漿必須有足夠勁度把核心限制在直線上。
套管只是外殼，壁厚可以任意減薄。
只要支撐本身合格，節點板照一般斜撐設計就可以。
optionsEn: In compression the core develops higher-mode buckling waves that push against the surrounding mortar, so the casing and mortar must be stiff enough to keep the core straight.
The casing is just a shell, so its wall can be thinned at will.
If the brace itself is qualified, the gusset can be designed as for an ordinary brace.
quiz.explanation: 核心受壓時會產生高階挫屈波形並推擠周圍砂漿，套管與砂漿必須有足夠勁度把核心限制在直線上；同時核心與砂漿之間要有脫層材或微小間隙，一方面讓核心受壓時因泊松效應的橫向膨脹有空間，另一方面避免軸力經摩擦傳入套管。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In compression the core develops higher-mode buckling waves that push against the surrounding mortar, so the casing and mortar must be stiff enough to keep the core straight; at the same time an unbonding layer or small gap between core and mortar gives room for the core's Poisson expansion in compression and stops axial force passing into the casing by friction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 核心、套管、砂漿與脫層材：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Core, casing, mortar and unbonding layer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼套管與脫層材」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel casing and unbonding layer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：套管 250×250×6 mm 方管：I = (250⁴ − 238⁴)/12 ≈ 5.81×10⁷ mm⁴，長 6.0 m 時 P_e = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×5.81×10⁷/6,000² ≈ 3,188 kN，為 C_max = 2,125 kN 的 1.5 倍（不計砂漿貢獻）。若改用 6 mm 壁厚的 200 mm 方管，I 約減半，比值低於 1，套管會先挫屈。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 250×250×6 mm square casing, I = (250⁴ − 238⁴)/12 ≈ 5.81×10⁷ mm⁴; over 6.0 m, P_e = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×5.81×10⁷/6,000² ≈ 3,188 kN, 1.5 times C_max = 2,125 kN, ignoring the mortar. A 200 mm tube with the same 6 mm wall has roughly half the I, a ratio below 1, and the casing would buckle first. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製造時檢查核心板寬厚、脫層材厚度與包覆完整性、砂漿配比與灌注密實度，並記錄套管直線度；出廠時隨機抽樣切開或以非破壞檢測確認砂漿無大孔隙，製造檢驗紀錄與支撐序號對應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During fabrication check core plate dimensions, unbonding-layer thickness and coverage, mortar mix and compaction, and casing straightness; at dispatch, cut open a random sample or use non-destructive testing to confirm the mortar has no large voids, and link inspection records to brace serial numbers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 套管 250×250×6 mm 方管：I = (250⁴ − 238⁴)/12 ≈ 5.81×10⁷ mm⁴，長 6.0 m 時 P_e = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×5.81×10⁷/6,000² ≈ 3,188 kN，為 C_max = 2,125 kN 的 1.5 倍（不計砂漿貢獻）。若改用 6 mm 壁厚的 200 mm 方管，I 約減半，比值低於 1，套管會先挫屈。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 250×250×6 mm square casing, I = (250⁴ − 238⁴)/12 ≈ 5.81×10⁷ mm⁴; over 6.0 m, P_e = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×5.81×10⁷/6,000² ≈ 3,188 kN, 1.5 times C_max = 2,125 kN, ignoring the mortar. A 200 mm tube with the same 6 mm wall has roughly half the I, a ratio below 1, and the casing would buckle first. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「核心、套管、砂漿與脫層材」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Core, casing, mortar and unbonding layer", which statement holds?
options: 支撐兩端孔位差幾公釐沒關係，用吊具拉一下就能裝上。
挫屈束制支撐外觀沒有變形，就表示裡面的核心沒有損傷。
optionsEn: A few millimetres of misfit do not matter, since a hoist can pull the brace into place.
For a 250×250×6 mm square casing, I = (250⁴ − 238⁴)/12 ≈ 5.81×10⁷ mm⁴.
If a BRB looks undeformed, its core is undamaged.
quiz.explanationEn: For a 250×250×6 mm square casing, I = (250⁴ − 238⁴)/12 ≈ 5.81×10⁷ mm⁴; over 6.0 m, P_e = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×5.81×10⁷/6,000² ≈ 3,188 kN, 1.5 times C_max = 2,125 kN, ignoring the mortar. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 核心、套管、砂漿與脫層材：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Core, casing, mortar and unbonding layer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼套管與脫層材」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel casing and unbonding layer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 製造時檢查核心板寬厚、脫層材厚度與包覆完整性、砂漿配比與灌注密實度，並記錄套管直線度；出廠時隨機抽樣切開或以非破壞檢測確認砂漿無大孔隙，製造檢驗紀錄與支撐序號對應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During fabrication check core plate dimensions, unbonding-layer thickness and coverage, mortar mix and compaction, and casing straightness; at dispatch, cut open a random sample or use non-destructive testing to confirm the mortar has no large voids, and link inspection records to brace serial numbers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：核心降伏段不得在現場焊接或鑽孔，套管上也不得焊接附掛物；運輸與吊裝時以吊帶支撐套管兩點，避免彎曲損傷砂漿，運抵現場須檢查套管凹損並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Never weld or drill the core yielding zone on site, and do not weld attachments to the casing; during transport and lifting, support the casing at two points with slings to avoid bending damage to the mortar, and inspect and record casing dents on arrival.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：砂漿灌注不實留下空洞時，核心在該處的高階挫屈振幅增大，局部彎曲使核心提早斷裂；脫層材破損或遺漏時，核心與砂漿黏結，套管分擔軸力，受壓強度大幅提高，使連接與構架超載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Voids left by poorly placed mortar let higher-mode buckling grow at that spot, and local bending fractures the core early; damaged or missing unbonding material bonds core to mortar, the casing shares axial force and compression strength rises sharply, overloading connections and frame. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 製造時檢查核心板寬厚、脫層材厚度與包覆完整性、砂漿配比與灌注密實度，並記錄套管直線度；出廠時隨機抽樣切開或以非破壞檢測確認砂漿無大孔隙，製造檢驗紀錄與支撐序號對應。
knowledge.textEn: During fabrication check core plate dimensions, unbonding-layer thickness and coverage, mortar mix and compaction, and casing straightness; at dispatch, cut open a random sample or use non-destructive testing to confirm the mortar has no large voids, and link inspection records to brace serial numbers.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 核心降伏段不得在現場焊接或鑽孔，套管上也不得焊接附掛物；運輸與吊裝時以吊帶支撐套管兩點，避免彎曲損傷砂漿，運抵現場須檢查套管凹損並記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Never weld or drill the core yielding zone on site, and do not weld attachments to the casing; during transport and lifting, support the casing at two points with slings to avoid bending damage to the mortar, and inspect and record casing dents on arrival.

quiz.question: 要驗證「核心、套管、砂漿與脫層材」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Core, casing, mortar and unbonding layer"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
挫屈束制支撐裝好之後就是永久構件，不需要考慮更換。
製造時檢查核心板寬厚、脫層材厚度與包覆完整性、砂漿配比與灌注密實度，並記錄套管直線度。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once installed, a BRB is a permanent member with no need to plan for replacement.
During fabrication check core plate dimensions, unbonding-layer thickness and coverage, mortar mix and compaction, and casing straightness.
quiz.explanation: 製造時檢查核心板寬厚、脫層材厚度與包覆完整性、砂漿配比與灌注密實度，並記錄套管直線度；出廠時隨機抽樣切開或以非破壞檢測確認砂漿無大孔隙，製造檢驗紀錄與支撐序號對應。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During fabrication check core plate dimensions, unbonding-layer thickness and coverage, mortar mix and compaction, and casing straightness; at dispatch, cut open a random sample or use non-destructive testing to confirm the mortar has no large voids, and link inspection records to brace serial numbers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 核心、套管、砂漿與脫層材：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Core, casing, mortar and unbonding layer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼套管與脫層材」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Steel casing and unbonding layer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 砂漿灌注不實留下空洞時，核心在該處的高階挫屈振幅增大，局部彎曲使核心提早斷裂；脫層材破損或遺漏時，核心與砂漿黏結，套管分擔軸力，受壓強度大幅提高，使連接與構架超載。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Voids left by poorly placed mortar let higher-mode buckling grow at that spot, and local bending fractures the core early; damaged or missing unbonding material bonds core to mortar, the casing shares axial force and compression strength rises sharply, overloading connections and frame. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：日本製鐵工程的無黏結支撐即以鋼管與砂漿約束中心鋼材，並以特殊緩衝材使鋼管與砂漿不承受軸力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Nippon Steel Engineering's unbonded brace restrains its central steel with a steel tube and mortar, using a special cushioning material so that the tube and mortar carry no axial force.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「套管只是外殼，壁厚可以任意減薄。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The casing is just a shell, so its wall can be thinned at will." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 砂漿灌注不實留下空洞時，核心在該處的高階挫屈振幅增大，局部彎曲使核心提早斷裂；脫層材破損或遺漏時，核心與砂漿黏結，套管分擔軸力，受壓強度大幅提高，使連接與構架超載。
knowledge.textEn: Voids left by poorly placed mortar let higher-mode buckling grow at that spot, and local bending fractures the core early; damaged or missing unbonding material bonds core to mortar, the casing shares axial force and compression strength rises sharply, overloading connections and frame.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「核心、套管、砂漿與脫層材」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Core, casing, mortar and unbonding layer" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 砂漿灌注不實留下空洞時，核心在該處的高階挫屈振幅增大，局部彎曲使核心提早斷裂。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要支撐本身合格，節點板照一般斜撐設計就可以。
optionsEn: Voids left by poorly placed mortar let higher-mode buckling grow at that spot, and local bending fractures the core early.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If the brace itself is qualified, the gusset can be designed as for an ordinary brace.
quiz.explanation: 砂漿灌注不實留下空洞時，核心在該處的高階挫屈振幅增大，局部彎曲使核心提早斷裂；脫層材破損或遺漏時，核心與砂漿黏結，套管分擔軸力，受壓強度大幅提高，使連接與構架超載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Voids left by poorly placed mortar let higher-mode buckling grow at that spot, and local bending fractures the core early; damaged or missing unbonding material bonds core to mortar, the casing shares axial force and compression strength rises sharply, overloading connections and frame. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 節點板、耳板與構架作用：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Gussets, lugs and frame action: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「節點板與螺栓耳板」如何影響挫屈束制支撐安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gusset and bolted lug” governs force, deformation or durability in “Buckling-restrained brace installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 支撐兩端的連接段必須在支撐最大拉壓力下保持彈性，包括耳板、螺栓、節點板與梁柱接合。節點板受壓時可能面外挫屈，帶動支撐端部轉動，使支撐整體失穩；另外構架在層間變位時，梁柱夾角會開合，節點板被反覆擠壓與拉開，即所謂構架作用，可能在節點板邊緣產生裂縫。CoreBrace 提供螺栓耳板、銷接與焊接三種接頭，螺栓耳板的現場容許誤差較大，銷接的安裝容許誤差較小，選擇時要同時考慮力量傳遞與現場施工性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「節點板與螺栓耳板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The end connections must stay elastic under the maximum brace tension and compression, including lugs, bolts, gussets and the beam–column joint. A gusset in compression can buckle out of plane and rotate the brace end, destabilising the whole brace; moreover, as the frame drifts the beam–column angle opens and closes, repeatedly squeezing and pulling the gusset, the so-called frame action, which can crack gusset edges. CoreBrace offers bolted-lug, pinned and welded connections: the bolted lug tolerates more field misfit while the pinned connection has tighter erection tolerances, so the choice weighs force transfer against constructability. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Gusset and bolted lug” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Whitmore 有效寬度 w = b + 2·L·tan30°。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The Whitmore effective width is w = b + 2·L·tan30°.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要支撐本身合格，節點板照一般斜撐設計就可以。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the brace itself is qualified, the gusset can be designed as for an ordinary brace." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「節點板與螺栓耳板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Gusset and bolted lug”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節點板、耳板與構架作用
knowledge.text: 支撐兩端的連接段必須在支撐最大拉壓力下保持彈性，包括耳板、螺栓、節點板與梁柱接合。節點板受壓時可能面外挫屈，帶動支撐端部轉動，使支撐整體失穩；另外構架在層間變位時，梁柱夾角會開合，節點板被反覆擠壓與拉開，即所謂構架作用，可能在節點板邊緣產生裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: The end connections must stay elastic under the maximum brace tension and compression, including lugs, bolts, gussets and the beam–column joint. A gusset in compression can buckle out of plane and rotate the brace end, destabilising the whole brace; moreover, as the frame drifts the beam–column angle opens and closes, repeatedly squeezing and pulling the gusset, the so-called frame action, which can crack gusset edges.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要支撐本身合格，節點板照一般斜撐設計就可以。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the brace itself is qualified, the gusset can be designed as for an ordinary brace. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節點板、耳板與構架作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gussets, lugs and frame action" is correct?
options: 只要支撐本身合格，節點板照一般斜撐設計就可以。
支撐兩端的連接段必須在支撐最大拉壓力下保持彈性，包括耳板、螺栓、節點板與梁柱接合。
支撐越早鎖固越好，可以順便當施工期間的穩定斜撐。
optionsEn: If the brace itself is qualified, the gusset can be designed as for an ordinary brace.
The end connections must stay elastic under the maximum brace tension and compression, including lugs, bolts, gussets and the beam–column joint.
The earlier braces are connected the better, since they can double as construction bracing.
quiz.explanation: 支撐兩端的連接段必須在支撐最大拉壓力下保持彈性，包括耳板、螺栓、節點板與梁柱接合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The end connections must stay elastic under the maximum brace tension and compression, including lugs, bolts, gussets and the beam–column joint. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節點板、耳板與構架作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gussets, lugs and frame action: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節點板與螺栓耳板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gusset and bolted lug” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Whitmore 有效寬度 w = b + 2·L·tan30°。螺栓群寬 b = 150 mm、連接長度 L = 300 mm：w = 150 + 2×300×0.577 ≈ 496 mm；節點板厚 25 mm、F_y = 345 MPa，φR = 0.9×345×496×25 ≈ 3,850 kN，大於 T_max = 1,932 kN。受壓時另須以等效柱檢查挫屈。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The Whitmore effective width is w = b + 2·L·tan30°. With a bolt-group width b = 150 mm and connection length L = 300 mm, w = 150 + 2×300×0.577 ≈ 496 mm; a 25 mm gusset with F_y = 345 MPa gives φR = 0.9×345×496×25 ≈ 3,850 kN, above T_max = 1,932 kN. Compression buckling must be checked separately as an equivalent column. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素分析或經試驗驗證的方法檢查節點板在 C_max 下的面外挫屈、在最大層間變位下的構架作用應力，以及耳板與節點板在支撐端轉角下的穩定；資格試驗的子結構試體應包含實際節點板型式。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check gusset out-of-plane buckling under C_max, frame-action stresses at maximum drift and the stability of lug and gusset under brace-end rotation by finite-element analysis or a test-validated method; subassemblage specimens in qualification tests should include the actual gusset configuration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Whitmore 有效寬度 w = b + 2·L·tan30°。螺栓群寬 b = 150 mm、連接長度 L = 300 mm：w = 150 + 2×300×0.577 ≈ 496 mm；節點板厚 25 mm、F_y = 345 MPa，φR = 0.9×345×496×25 ≈ 3,850 kN，大於 T_max = 1,932 kN。受壓時另須以等效柱檢查挫屈。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The Whitmore effective width is w = b + 2·L·tan30°. With a bolt-group width b = 150 mm and connection length L = 300 mm, w = 150 + 2×300×0.577 ≈ 496 mm; a 25 mm gusset with F_y = 345 MPa gives φR = 0.9×345×496×25 ≈ 3,850 kN, above T_max = 1,932 kN. Compression buckling must be checked separately as an equivalent column. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節點板、耳板與構架作用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gussets, lugs and frame action", which statement holds?
options: 只要支撐廠牌有任何一份試驗報告，所有尺寸的支撐都算合格。
支撐裡面已經灌滿砂漿，所以不需要再做防火被覆。
Whitmore 有效寬度 w = b + 2·L·tan30°。
optionsEn: Any test report from a brace manufacturer qualifies braces of every size.
A brace is already filled with mortar, so it needs no fireproofing.
The Whitmore effective width is w = b + 2·L·tan30°.
quiz.explanation: Whitmore 有效寬度 w = b + 2·L·tan30°。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The Whitmore effective width is w = b + 2·L·tan30°. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 節點板、耳板與構架作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gussets, lugs and frame action: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節點板與螺栓耳板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gusset and bolted lug” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素分析或經試驗驗證的方法檢查節點板在 C_max 下的面外挫屈、在最大層間變位下的構架作用應力，以及耳板與節點板在支撐端轉角下的穩定；資格試驗的子結構試體應包含實際節點板型式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check gusset out-of-plane buckling under C_max, frame-action stresses at maximum drift and the stability of lug and gusset under brace-end rotation by finite-element analysis or a test-validated method; subassemblage specimens in qualification tests should include the actual gusset configuration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：節點板的自由邊應設加勁板或限制長度，並在圖說中標示支撐中心線、工作點與允許偏差；接頭型式若由螺栓改為銷接或焊接，須重新檢查安裝誤差與連接設計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Stiffen or limit the free edges of gussets, and show brace centrelines, work points and tolerances on drawings; switching from bolted to pinned or welded connections requires a fresh check of erection tolerance and connection design.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：節點板面外挫屈常發生在自由邊過長、未設加勁板的情況，支撐端部隨之轉動，整支支撐像普通斜撐一樣挫屈；構架作用在梁翼與節點板焊道處反覆作用，地震後可見焊道裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Out-of-plane gusset buckling typically occurs where free edges are long and unstiffened, the brace end rotates with it, and the whole brace buckles like an ordinary brace; frame action cycling at the beam flange and gusset welds leaves visible weld cracks after an earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以有限元素分析或經試驗驗證的方法檢查節點板在 C_max 下的面外挫屈、在最大層間變位下的構架作用應力，以及耳板與節點板在支撐端轉角下的穩定；資格試驗的子結構試體應包含實際節點板型式。
knowledge.textEn: Check gusset out-of-plane buckling under C_max, frame-action stresses at maximum drift and the stability of lug and gusset under brace-end rotation by finite-element analysis or a test-validated method; subassemblage specimens in qualification tests should include the actual gusset configuration.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 節點板的自由邊應設加勁板或限制長度，並在圖說中標示支撐中心線、工作點與允許偏差；接頭型式若由螺栓改為銷接或焊接，須重新檢查安裝誤差與連接設計。
knowledge.textEn: Stiffen or limit the free edges of gussets, and show brace centrelines, work points and tolerances on drawings; switching from bolted to pinned or welded connections requires a fresh check of erection tolerance and connection design.

quiz.question: 要驗證「節點板、耳板與構架作用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gussets, lugs and frame action"?
options: 以有限元素分析或經試驗驗證的方法檢查節點板在 C_max 下的面外挫屈、在最大層間變位下的構架作用應力，以及耳板與節點板在支撐端轉角下的穩定。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

optionsEn: Check gusset out-of-plane buckling under C_max, frame-action stresses at maximum drift and the stability of lug and gusset under brace-end rotation by finite-element analysis or a test-validated method.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Stronger brace steel is always safer, so the core should use the highest-strength steel.
quiz.explanation: 以有限元素分析或經試驗驗證的方法檢查節點板在 C_max 下的面外挫屈、在最大層間變位下的構架作用應力，以及耳板與節點板在支撐端轉角下的穩定；資格試驗的子結構試體應包含實際節點板型式。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check gusset out-of-plane buckling under C_max, frame-action stresses at maximum drift and the stability of lug and gusset under brace-end rotation by finite-element analysis or a test-validated method; subassemblage specimens in qualification tests should include the actual gusset configuration. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 節點板、耳板與構架作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gussets, lugs and frame action: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節點板與螺栓耳板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gusset and bolted lug” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 節點板面外挫屈常發生在自由邊過長、未設加勁板的情況，支撐端部隨之轉動，整支支撐像普通斜撐一樣挫屈；構架作用在梁翼與節點板焊道處反覆作用，地震後可見焊道裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Out-of-plane gusset buckling typically occurs where free edges are long and unstiffened, the brace end rotates with it, and the whole brace buckles like an ordinary brace; frame action cycling at the beam flange and gusset welds leaves visible weld cracks after an earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：CoreBrace 提供螺栓耳板、銷接與焊接三種接頭，螺栓耳板的現場容許誤差較大，銷接的安裝容許誤差較小，選擇時要同時考慮力量傳遞與現場施工性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: CoreBrace offers bolted-lug, pinned and welded connections: the bolted lug tolerates more field misfit while the pinned connection has tighter erection tolerances, so the choice weighs force transfer against constructability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要支撐本身合格，節點板照一般斜撐設計就可以。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the brace itself is qualified, the gusset can be designed as for an ordinary brace." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 節點板面外挫屈常發生在自由邊過長、未設加勁板的情況，支撐端部隨之轉動，整支支撐像普通斜撐一樣挫屈；構架作用在梁翼與節點板焊道處反覆作用，地震後可見焊道裂縫。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「節點板、耳板與構架作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gussets, lugs and frame action" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
節點板面外挫屈常發生在自由邊過長、未設加勁板的情況，支撐端部隨之轉動，整支支撐像普通斜撐一樣挫屈；構架作用在梁翼與節點板焊道處反覆作用，地震後可見焊道裂縫。
支撐越早鎖固越好，可以順便當施工期間的穩定斜撐。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Out-of-plane gusset buckling typically occurs where free edges are long and unstiffened, the brace end rotates with it, and the whole brace buckles like an ordinary brace.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「安裝順序與重力荷載造成的預壓」與「現場尺寸控制、配合誤差與鎖固檢查」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Installation sequence and preload from gravity loads" and "Site dimensional control, misfit and tightening checks": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 安裝順序與重力荷載造成的預壓：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Installation sequence and preload from gravity loads: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「安裝時機與重力預壓」如何影響挫屈束制支撐安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Installation timing and gravity preload” governs force, deformation or durability in “Buckling-restrained brace installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 挫屈束制支撐是為地震而設，不應在平時承受明顯的重力荷載。若支撐在上方樓層、樓板或外牆尚未施作前就鎖固，之後增加的自重會使柱縮短、梁下垂，支撐跟著受壓，預先用掉一部分降伏容量；倒 V 形配置的支撐尤其會分擔梁的重力。因此許多設計要求支撐在主要靜載施加後才最終鎖固，或先以長圓孔暫時固定。支撐也不應被當作施工期間的臨時穩定斜撐，除非經過設計者核算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「安裝時機與重力預壓」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Buckling-restrained braces are meant for earthquakes and should not carry significant gravity load in service. If a brace is fully connected before the floors, slabs or façade above are built, the added self-weight shortens columns and deflects beams and the brace is compressed, using up part of its yield capacity in advance; chevron braces in particular pick up beam gravity load. Many designs therefore require final connection only after the main dead loads are applied, or temporary fixing through slotted holes first. Braces should not serve as temporary construction bracing unless the designer has checked it. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Installation timing and gravity preload” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鎖固後上方再增加荷載使柱應力增加 150 MPa：每層柱縮短 Δv = 150/200,000×4,000 = 3.0 mm，支撐方向分量 3.0×sin33.7° ≈ 1.66 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If loads added after connection raise column stress by 150 MPa, each storey's column shortens by Δv = 150/200,000×4,000 = 3.0 mm, and the component along the brace is 3.0×sin33.7° ≈ 1.66 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支撐越早鎖固越好，可以順便當施工期間的穩定斜撐。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The earlier braces are connected the better, since they can double as construction bracing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「安裝時機與重力預壓」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Installation timing and gravity preload”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安裝順序與重力荷載造成的預壓
knowledge.titleEn: Installation sequence and preload from gravity loads
knowledge.text: 挫屈束制支撐是為地震而設，不應在平時承受明顯的重力荷載。若支撐在上方樓層、樓板或外牆尚未施作前就鎖固，之後增加的自重會使柱縮短、梁下垂，支撐跟著受壓，預先用掉一部分降伏容量；倒 V 形配置的支撐尤其會分擔梁的重力。
knowledge.textEn: Buckling-restrained braces are meant for earthquakes and should not carry significant gravity load in service. If a brace is fully connected before the floors, slabs or façade above are built, the added self-weight shortens columns and deflects beams and the brace is compressed, using up part of its yield capacity in advance; chevron braces in particular pick up beam gravity load.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支撐越早鎖固越好，可以順便當施工期間的穩定斜撐。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The earlier braces are connected the better, since they can double as construction bracing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝順序與重力荷載造成的預壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Installation sequence and preload from gravity loads" is correct?
options: 支撐越早鎖固越好，可以順便當施工期間的穩定斜撐。
支撐兩端孔位差幾公釐沒關係，用吊具拉一下就能裝上。
挫屈束制支撐是為地震而設，不應在平時承受明顯的重力荷載。
optionsEn: The earlier braces are connected the better, since they can double as construction bracing.
A few millimetres of misfit do not matter, since a hoist can pull the brace into place.
Buckling-restrained braces are meant for earthquakes and should not carry significant gravity load in service.
quiz.explanation: 挫屈束制支撐是為地震而設，不應在平時承受明顯的重力荷載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Buckling-restrained braces are meant for earthquakes and should not carry significant gravity load in service. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安裝順序與重力荷載造成的預壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Installation sequence and preload from gravity loads: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「安裝時機與重力預壓」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Installation timing and gravity preload” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鎖固後上方再增加荷載使柱應力增加 150 MPa：每層柱縮短 Δv = 150/200,000×4,000 = 3.0 mm，支撐方向分量 3.0×sin33.7° ≈ 1.66 mm。支撐軸向勁度約 1.4×EA/L_ysc ≈ 1.4×200,000×4,000/4,327 ≈ 259 kN/mm，預壓約 259×1.66 ≈ 431 kN，相當 P_ysc 的 31%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If loads added after connection raise column stress by 150 MPa, each storey's column shortens by Δv = 150/200,000×4,000 = 3.0 mm, and the component along the brace is 3.0×sin33.7° ≈ 1.66 mm. With brace axial stiffness about 1.4×EA/L_ysc ≈ 1.4×200,000×4,000/4,327 ≈ 259 kN/mm, the preload is about 259×1.66 ≈ 431 kN, 31% of P_ysc. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工計畫中以施工階段分析計算各支撐在不同鎖固時點的預壓，選擇可接受的鎖固時點；現場以施工日誌記錄每支支撐暫時固定與最終鎖固的日期，以及當時上方已完成的樓層與外牆範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use construction-stage analysis in the construction plan to compute preload in each brace for different connection times and choose an acceptable one; record on site the dates of temporary fixing and final connection for every brace, together with the floors and façade already completed above.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鎖固後上方再增加荷載使柱應力增加 150 MPa：每層柱縮短 Δv = 150/200,000×4,000 = 3.0 mm，支撐方向分量 3.0×sin33.7° ≈ 1.66 mm。支撐軸向勁度約 1.4×EA/L_ysc ≈ 1.4×200,000×4,000/4,327 ≈ 259 kN/mm，預壓約 259×1.66 ≈ 431 kN，相當 P_ysc 的 31%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If loads added after connection raise column stress by 150 MPa, each storey's column shortens by Δv = 150/200,000×4,000 = 3.0 mm, and the component along the brace is 3.0×sin33.7° ≈ 1.66 mm. With brace axial stiffness about 1.4×EA/L_ysc ≈ 1.4×200,000×4,000/4,327 ≈ 259 kN/mm, the preload is about 259×1.66 ≈ 431 kN, 31% of P_ysc. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安裝順序與重力荷載造成的預壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Installation sequence and preload from gravity loads", which statement holds?
options: 鎖固後上方再增加荷載使柱應力增加 150 MPa：每層柱縮短 Δv = 150/200,000×4,000 = 3.0 mm，支撐方向分量 3.0×sin33.7° ≈ 1.66 mm。
挫屈束制支撐外觀沒有變形，就表示裡面的核心沒有損傷。
挫屈束制支撐裝好之後就是永久構件，不需要考慮更換。
optionsEn: If loads added after connection raise column stress by 150 MPa, each storey's column shortens by Δv = 150/200,000×4,000 = 3.0 mm, and the component along the brace is 3.0×sin33.7° ≈ 1.66 mm.
If a BRB looks undeformed, its core is undamaged.
Once installed, a BRB is a permanent member with no need to plan for replacement.
quiz.explanation: 鎖固後上方再增加荷載使柱應力增加 150 MPa：每層柱縮短 Δv = 150/200,000×4,000 = 3.0 mm，支撐方向分量 3.0×sin33.7° ≈ 1.66 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If loads added after connection raise column stress by 150 MPa, each storey's column shortens by Δv = 150/200,000×4,000 = 3.0 mm, and the component along the brace is 3.0×sin33.7° ≈ 1.66 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安裝順序與重力荷載造成的預壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Installation sequence and preload from gravity loads: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「安裝時機與重力預壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Installation timing and gravity preload” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 施工計畫中以施工階段分析計算各支撐在不同鎖固時點的預壓，選擇可接受的鎖固時點；現場以施工日誌記錄每支支撐暫時固定與最終鎖固的日期，以及當時上方已完成的樓層與外牆範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use construction-stage analysis in the construction plan to compute preload in each brace for different connection times and choose an acceptable one; record on site the dates of temporary fixing and final connection for every brace, together with the floors and façade already completed above. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：安裝說明書要寫明暫時固定方式、最終鎖固的前置條件（例如上方若干樓層樓板與外牆完成）、鎖固順序與停止點，並由結構設計者確認；任何提前鎖固的要求都須提出施工階段分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Installation instructions should state the temporary fixing method, the preconditions for final connection (for example slabs and façade completed for a number of floors above), the connection sequence and hold points, confirmed by the structural designer; any request to connect earlier must be backed by construction-stage analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若支撐在結構體剛立起時就最終鎖固，完工後部分支撐已承受約三成的降伏力，地震時在受壓方向提早降伏，構架反應不對稱，殘留變位增加；把支撐當臨時斜撐承受施工荷載，也可能使核心在使用前就產生塑性變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If braces are finally connected as soon as the frame is erected, some already carry about 30% of their yield force at completion, yield early in compression during an earthquake, and produce asymmetric response with larger residual drift; using braces as temporary bracing under construction loads can even yield the core before service. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 施工計畫中以施工階段分析計算各支撐在不同鎖固時點的預壓，選擇可接受的鎖固時點；現場以施工日誌記錄每支支撐暫時固定與最終鎖固的日期，以及當時上方已完成的樓層與外牆範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Use construction-stage analysis in the construction plan to compute preload in each brace for different connection times and choose an acceptable one; record on site the dates of temporary fixing and final connection for every brace, together with the floors and façade already completed above.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 安裝說明書要寫明暫時固定方式、最終鎖固的前置條件（例如上方若干樓層樓板與外牆完成）、鎖固順序與停止點，並由結構設計者確認；任何提前鎖固的要求都須提出施工階段分析。
knowledge.textEn: Installation instructions should state the temporary fixing method, the preconditions for final connection (for example slabs and façade completed for a number of floors above), the connection sequence and hold points, confirmed by the structural designer; any request to connect earlier must be backed by construction-stage analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「安裝順序與重力荷載造成的預壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Installation sequence and preload from gravity loads"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
施工計畫中以施工階段分析計算各支撐在不同鎖固時點的預壓，選擇可接受的鎖固時點。
支撐越短越硬越好，核心降伏段長度不影響耐久性。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Use construction-stage analysis in the construction plan to compute preload in each brace for different connection times and choose an acceptable one.
Shorter, stiffer braces are always better, and the yielding-zone length has no effect on durability.
quiz.explanation: 施工計畫中以施工階段分析計算各支撐在不同鎖固時點的預壓，選擇可接受的鎖固時點；現場以施工日誌記錄每支支撐暫時固定與最終鎖固的日期，以及當時上方已完成的樓層與外牆範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use construction-stage analysis in the construction plan to compute preload in each brace for different connection times and choose an acceptable one; record on site the dates of temporary fixing and final connection for every brace, together with the floors and façade already completed above. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 安裝順序與重力荷載造成的預壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Installation sequence and preload from gravity loads: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「安裝時機與重力預壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Installation timing and gravity preload” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若支撐在結構體剛立起時就最終鎖固，完工後部分支撐已承受約三成的降伏力，地震時在受壓方向提早降伏，構架反應不對稱，殘留變位增加；把支撐當臨時斜撐承受施工荷載，也可能使核心在使用前就產生塑性變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If braces are finally connected as soon as the frame is erected, some already carry about 30% of their yield force at completion, yield early in compression during an earthquake, and produce asymmetric response with larger residual drift; using braces as temporary bracing under construction loads can even yield the core before service. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支撐也不應被當作施工期間的臨時穩定斜撐，除非經過設計者核算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Braces should not serve as temporary construction bracing unless the designer has checked it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支撐越早鎖固越好，可以順便當施工期間的穩定斜撐。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The earlier braces are connected the better, since they can double as construction bracing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若支撐在結構體剛立起時就最終鎖固，完工後部分支撐已承受約三成的降伏力，地震時在受壓方向提早降伏，構架反應不對稱，殘留變位增加；把支撐當臨時斜撐承受施工荷載，也可能使核心在使用前就產生塑性變形。
knowledge.textEn: If braces are finally connected as soon as the frame is erected, some already carry about 30% of their yield force at completion, yield early in compression during an earthquake, and produce asymmetric response with larger residual drift; using braces as temporary bracing under construction loads can even yield the core before service.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安裝順序與重力荷載造成的預壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Installation sequence and preload from gravity loads" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
支撐兩端孔位差幾公釐沒關係，用吊具拉一下就能裝上。
若支撐在結構體剛立起時就最終鎖固，完工後部分支撐已承受約三成的降伏力，地震時在受壓方向提早降伏，構架反應不對稱，殘留變位增加。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A few millimetres of misfit do not matter, since a hoist can pull the brace into place.

If braces are finally connected as soon as the frame is erected, some already carry about 30% of their yield force at completion, yield early in compression during an earthquake, and produce asymmetric response with larger residual drift.
quiz.explanation: 若支撐在結構體剛立起時就最終鎖固，完工後部分支撐已承受約三成的降伏力，地震時在受壓方向提早降伏，構架反應不對稱，殘留變位增加；把支撐當臨時斜撐承受施工荷載，也可能使核心在使用前就產生塑性變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If braces are finally connected as soon as the frame is erected, some already carry about 30% of their yield force at completion, yield early in compression during an earthquake, and produce asymmetric response with larger residual drift; using braces as temporary bracing under construction loads can even yield the core before service. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 現場尺寸控制、配合誤差與鎖固檢查：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Site dimensional control, misfit and tightening checks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「配合誤差與螺栓鎖固」如何影響挫屈束制支撐安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fit-up misfit and bolt tightening” governs force, deformation or durability in “Buckling-restrained brace installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 支撐在工廠依工作點長度製造，但現場的柱垂直度、梁高程與節點板位置都有誤差，兩端螺栓孔對不上時，常見的錯誤做法是用千斤頂或吊車把支撐硬拉或硬壓進去，這會在支撐中留下預力。正確做法是先量測兩端節點板實際距離，在允許範圍內以長圓孔、墊片或現場擴孔處理，超出範圍則由製造商與設計者決定更換或修改。螺栓鎖固則依規定的預拉方法（例如轉角法）並逐一做記號檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「配合誤差與螺栓鎖固」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Braces are made to work-point length in the factory, but column plumbness, beam elevation and gusset positions all deviate on site; when bolt holes at the two ends do not line up, a common mistake is to jack or crane the brace into place, locking in prestress. The correct approach is to measure the actual distance between gussets first, accommodate deviations within tolerance with slotted holes, shims or field reaming, and refer larger deviations to the manufacturer and designer for replacement or modification. Bolts are tightened by the specified pretensioning method, such as turn-of-nut, with every bolt marked and checked. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fit-up misfit and bolt tightening” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：支撐軸向勁度約 259 kN/mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With brace axial stiffness about 259 kN/mm, forcing a brace into place across a cumulative hole misalignment of 2 mm locks in about 259×2 ≈ 518 kN, roughly 38% of P_ysc = 1,380 kN; even 0.5 mm leaves about 130 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支撐兩端孔位差幾公釐沒關係，用吊具拉一下就能裝上。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A few millimetres of misfit do not matter, since a hoist can pull the brace into place." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「配合誤差與螺栓鎖固」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fit-up misfit and bolt tightening”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Site dimensional control, misfit and tightening checks
knowledge.text: 支撐在工廠依工作點長度製造，但現場的柱垂直度、梁高程與節點板位置都有誤差，兩端螺栓孔對不上時，常見的錯誤做法是用千斤頂或吊車把支撐硬拉或硬壓進去，這會在支撐中留下預力。正確做法是先量測兩端節點板實際距離，在允許範圍內以長圓孔、墊片或現場擴孔處理，超出範圍則由製造商與設計者決定更換或修改。

The correct approach is to measure the actual distance between gussets first, accommodate deviations within tolerance with slotted holes, shims or field reaming, and refer larger deviations to the manufacturer and designer for replacement or modification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支撐兩端孔位差幾公釐沒關係，用吊具拉一下就能裝上。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A few millimetres of misfit do not matter, since a hoist can pull the brace into place. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「現場尺寸控制、配合誤差與鎖固檢查」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Site dimensional control, misfit and tightening checks" is correct?
options: 支撐在工廠依工作點長度製造，但現場的柱垂直度、梁高程與節點板位置都有誤差，兩端螺栓孔對不上時，常見的錯誤做法是用千斤頂或吊車把支撐硬拉或硬壓進去，這會在支撐中留下預力。
支撐兩端孔位差幾公釐沒關係，用吊具拉一下就能裝上。
只要支撐廠牌有任何一份試驗報告，所有尺寸的支撐都算合格。
optionsEn: Braces are made to work-point length in the factory, but column plumbness, beam elevation and gusset positions all deviate on site.
A few millimetres of misfit do not matter, since a hoist can pull the brace into place.
Any test report from a brace manufacturer qualifies braces of every size.
quiz.explanation: 支撐在工廠依工作點長度製造，但現場的柱垂直度、梁高程與節點板位置都有誤差，兩端螺栓孔對不上時，常見的錯誤做法是用千斤頂或吊車把支撐硬拉或硬壓進去，這會在支撐中留下預力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Braces are made to work-point length in the factory, but column plumbness, beam elevation and gusset positions all deviate on site; when bolt holes at the two ends do not line up, a common mistake is to jack or crane the brace into place, locking in prestress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現場尺寸控制、配合誤差與鎖固檢查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Site dimensional control, misfit and tightening checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「配合誤差與螺栓鎖固」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fit-up misfit and bolt tightening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：支撐軸向勁度約 259 kN/mm。若兩端孔位累積錯位 2 mm 而以外力強迫就位，鎖入的預力約 259×2 ≈ 518 kN，約為 P_ysc = 1,380 kN 的 38%；即使只有 0.5 mm，也有約 130 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With brace axial stiffness about 259 kN/mm, forcing a brace into place across a cumulative hole misalignment of 2 mm locks in about 259×2 ≈ 518 kN, roughly 38% of P_ysc = 1,380 kN; even 0.5 mm leaves about 130 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝前以全測站或捲尺量測兩端節點板孔中心距並與支撐實際長度比較，記錄差值與處置方式；鎖固後以轉角法記號或扭力扳手抽驗螺栓預拉，檢查耳板與節點板密貼，並拍照存證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before installation, measure the hole-centre distance between gussets with a total station or tape, compare it with the actual brace length and record the difference and its treatment; after tightening, verify bolt pretension by turn-of-nut marks or torque-wrench sampling, check that lugs and gussets are in firm contact and photograph the result.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 支撐軸向勁度約 259 kN/mm。若兩端孔位累積錯位 2 mm 而以外力強迫就位，鎖入的預力約 259×2 ≈ 518 kN，約為 P_ysc = 1,380 kN 的 38%；即使只有 0.5 mm，也有約 130 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With brace axial stiffness about 259 kN/mm, forcing a brace into place across a cumulative hole misalignment of 2 mm locks in about 259×2 ≈ 518 kN, roughly 38% of P_ysc = 1,380 kN; even 0.5 mm leaves about 130 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場尺寸控制、配合誤差與鎖固檢查」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Site dimensional control, misfit and tightening checks", which statement holds?
options: 支撐裡面已經灌滿砂漿，所以不需要再做防火被覆。
支撐軸向勁度約 259 kN/mm。
支撐的鋼材強度越高越安全，所以核心用高強度鋼最好。
optionsEn: A brace is already filled with mortar, so it needs no fireproofing.
With brace axial stiffness about 259 kN/mm, forcing a brace into place across a cumulative hole misalignment of 2 mm locks in about 259×2 ≈ 518 kN, roughly 38% of P_ysc = 1,380 kN.
Stronger brace steel is always safer, so the core should use the highest-strength steel.
quiz.explanation: 支撐軸向勁度約 259 kN/mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With brace axial stiffness about 259 kN/mm, forcing a brace into place across a cumulative hole misalignment of 2 mm locks in about 259×2 ≈ 518 kN, roughly 38% of P_ysc = 1,380 kN; even 0.5 mm leaves about 130 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 現場尺寸控制、配合誤差與鎖固檢查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Site dimensional control, misfit and tightening checks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「配合誤差與螺栓鎖固」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fit-up misfit and bolt tightening” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝前以全測站或捲尺量測兩端節點板孔中心距並與支撐實際長度比較，記錄差值與處置方式；鎖固後以轉角法記號或扭力扳手抽驗螺栓預拉，檢查耳板與節點板密貼，並拍照存證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before installation, measure the hole-centre distance between gussets with a total station or tape, compare it with the actual brace length and record the difference and its treatment; after tightening, verify bolt pretension by turn-of-nut marks or torque-wrench sampling, check that lugs and gussets are in firm contact and photograph the result. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：安裝檢查表應包含孔距實測值、處置方式、螺栓批號與預拉檢查結果，並設為停止點由監造簽認；禁止以外力強迫支撐就位，修改孔位或長度須經製造商與結構技師書面核可。這些是檢核要求，不是吊裝作業許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The installation checklist should record measured hole spacing, treatment, bolt lot and pretension results as a hold point signed by the site supervisor; forcing braces into position is prohibited, and altering holes or length requires written approval from the manufacturer and structural engineer. These are inspection requirements, not a rigging permit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以吊車或手拉吊具硬拉支撐就位，支撐帶著數百 kN 的預力進入使用，地震時在一個方向提早降伏；螺栓若未達預拉，接頭在反覆荷載下滑動並產生敲擊，耳板孔壁磨損擴大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Pulling a brace into position with a crane or chain hoist puts it into service with a locked-in force of several hundred kN, so it yields early in one direction during an earthquake; bolts below pretension let the joint slip and knock under cyclic load, wearing and enlarging the lug holes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝前以全測站或捲尺量測兩端節點板孔中心距並與支撐實際長度比較，記錄差值與處置方式；鎖固後以轉角法記號或扭力扳手抽驗螺栓預拉，檢查耳板與節點板密貼，並拍照存證。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 安裝檢查表應包含孔距實測值、處置方式、螺栓批號與預拉檢查結果，並設為停止點由監造簽認；禁止以外力強迫支撐就位，修改孔位或長度須經製造商與結構技師書面核可。這些是檢核要求，不是吊裝作業許可。
knowledge.textEn: The installation checklist should record measured hole spacing, treatment, bolt lot and pretension results as a hold point signed by the site supervisor; forcing braces into position is prohibited, and altering holes or length requires written approval from the manufacturer and structural engineer. These are inspection requirements, not a rigging permit.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場尺寸控制、配合誤差與鎖固檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Site dimensional control, misfit and tightening checks"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
套管只是外殼，壁厚可以任意減薄。
安裝前以全測站或捲尺量測兩端節點板孔中心距並與支撐實際長度比較，記錄差值與處置方式；鎖固後以轉角法記號或扭力扳手抽驗螺栓預拉，檢查耳板與節點板密貼，並拍照存證。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The casing is just a shell, so its wall can be thinned at will.
Before installation, measure the hole-centre distance between gussets with a total station or tape, compare it with the actual brace length and record the difference and its treatment.
quiz.explanation: 安裝前以全測站或捲尺量測兩端節點板孔中心距並與支撐實際長度比較，記錄差值與處置方式；鎖固後以轉角法記號或扭力扳手抽驗螺栓預拉，檢查耳板與節點板密貼，並拍照存證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before installation, measure the hole-centre distance between gussets with a total station or tape, compare it with the actual brace length and record the difference and its treatment; after tightening, verify bolt pretension by turn-of-nut marks or torque-wrench sampling, check that lugs and gussets are in firm contact and photograph the result. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現場尺寸控制、配合誤差與鎖固檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Site dimensional control, misfit and tightening checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「配合誤差與螺栓鎖固」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fit-up misfit and bolt tightening” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以吊車或手拉吊具硬拉支撐就位，支撐帶著數百 kN 的預力進入使用，地震時在一個方向提早降伏；螺栓若未達預拉，接頭在反覆荷載下滑動並產生敲擊，耳板孔壁磨損擴大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Pulling a brace into position with a crane or chain hoist puts it into service with a locked-in force of several hundred kN, so it yields early in one direction during an earthquake; bolts below pretension let the joint slip and knock under cyclic load, wearing and enlarging the lug holes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：螺栓鎖固則依規定的預拉方法（例如轉角法）並逐一做記號檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bolts are tightened by the specified pretensioning method, such as turn-of-nut, with every bolt marked and checked.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支撐兩端孔位差幾公釐沒關係，用吊具拉一下就能裝上。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A few millimetres of misfit do not matter, since a hoist can pull the brace into place." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以吊車或手拉吊具硬拉支撐就位，支撐帶著數百 kN 的預力進入使用，地震時在一個方向提早降伏；螺栓若未達預拉，接頭在反覆荷載下滑動並產生敲擊，耳板孔壁磨損擴大。
knowledge.textEn: Pulling a brace into position with a crane or chain hoist puts it into service with a locked-in force of several hundred kN, so it yields early in one direction during an earthquake; bolts below pretension let the joint slip and knock under cyclic load, wearing and enlarging the lug holes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場尺寸控制、配合誤差與鎖固檢查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Site dimensional control, misfit and tightening checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 以吊車或手拉吊具硬拉支撐就位，支撐帶著數百 kN 的預力進入使用，地震時在一個方向提早降伏；螺栓若未達預拉，接頭在反覆荷載下滑動並產生敲擊，耳板孔壁磨損擴大。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要支撐廠牌有任何一份試驗報告，所有尺寸的支撐都算合格。
optionsEn: Pulling a brace into position with a crane or chain hoist puts it into service with a locked-in force of several hundred kN, so it yields early in one direction during an earthquake.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Any test report from a brace manufacturer qualifies braces of every size.
quiz.explanation: 以吊車或手拉吊具硬拉支撐就位，支撐帶著數百 kN 的預力進入使用，地震時在一個方向提早降伏；螺栓若未達預拉，接頭在反覆荷載下滑動並產生敲擊，耳板孔壁磨損擴大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pulling a brace into position with a crane or chain hoist puts it into service with a locked-in force of several hundred kN, so it yields early in one direction during an earthquake; bolts below pretension let the joint slip and knock under cyclic load, wearing and enlarging the lug holes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「AISC 341 資格試驗與 ω、β 係數」與「完工檢查、震後評估與剩餘能力」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "AISC 341 qualification tests and the ω and β factors" and "Completion inspection, post-earthquake assessment and remaining capacity": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: AISC 341 資格試驗與 ω、β 係數：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: AISC 341 qualification tests and the ω and β factors: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「資格試驗加載程序」如何影響挫屈束制支撐安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Qualification loading protocol” governs force, deformation or durability in “Buckling-restrained brace installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 挫屈束制支撐沒有通用的計算公式能保證性能，因此規範要求以試驗證明：AISC 341 規定以子結構試驗與單軸試驗驗證支撐在逐級增加的變形下（至設計變形的兩倍）穩定，並達到足夠的累積非彈性變形，同時由試驗求出應變硬化係數 ω 與受壓強度調整係數 β，供容量設計使用。One Rincon Hill 的報導提到其支撐曾在柏克萊加州大學做實尺度試驗。試驗是產品與連接型式的資格，實際工程的支撐必須落在試驗涵蓋的尺寸與變形範圍內。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「資格試驗加載程序」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: No general formula guarantees BRB performance, so codes require proof by testing: AISC 341 requires subassemblage and uniaxial tests showing stable behaviour as deformation increases in steps up to twice the design deformation, with sufficient cumulative inelastic deformation, and uses the tests to derive the strain-hardening factor ω and compression adjustment factor β for capacity design. Reports on One Rincon Hill mention full-scale testing of its braces at the University of California, Berkeley. Tests qualify a product and connection type, and project braces must fall within the sizes and deformations the tests cover. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Qualification loading protocol” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Δ_by = (380/200,000)×4,327 ≈ 8.2 mm and Δ_bm = 66.6 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要支撐廠牌有任何一份試驗報告，所有尺寸的支撐都算合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any test report from a brace manufacturer qualifies braces of every size." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「資格試驗加載程序」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Qualification loading protocol”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: AISC 341 資格試驗與 ω、β 係數
knowledge.titleEn: AISC 341 qualification tests and the ω and β factors
knowledge.text: 挫屈束制支撐沒有通用的計算公式能保證性能，因此規範要求以試驗證明：AISC 341 規定以子結構試驗與單軸試驗驗證支撐在逐級增加的變形下（至設計變形的兩倍）穩定，並達到足夠的累積非彈性變形，同時由試驗求出應變硬化係數 ω 與受壓強度調整係數 β，供容量設計使用。One Rincon Hill 的報導提到其支撐曾在柏克萊加州大學做實尺度試驗。
