steps.title: 預鑄構架的地震傳力路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seismic load path in precast structures: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓板隔板接合器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diaphragm connectors” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 隔板接合器或集力構件不足時，地震中樓板與牆分離，樓板失去側向支撐，柱承受未設計的大變形而破壞；若只依重力荷載設計擱置支承，板件在大變位下從支承滑落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: With inadequate diaphragm connectors or collectors, floors separate from walls in an earthquake, columns lose lateral support and fail under undesigned deformation; bearings designed for gravity alone let units slide off at large displacement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：1994 年 Northridge 地震中預鑄停車結構的倒塌，正是傳力路徑在接頭處中斷的典型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Collapses of precast parking structures in the 1994 Northridge earthquake typify a load path broken at the connections.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預鑄構件本身強度足夠，接頭只要能承受重力就好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If precast members are strong enough, connections only need to carry gravity loads." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 隔板接合器或集力構件不足時，地震中樓板與牆分離，樓板失去側向支撐，柱承受未設計的大變形而破壞；若只依重力荷載設計擱置支承，板件在大變位下從支承滑落。
knowledge.textEn: With inadequate diaphragm connectors or collectors, floors separate from walls in an earthquake, columns lose lateral support and fail under undesigned deformation; bearings designed for gravity alone let units slide off at large displacement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預鑄構架的地震傳力路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Seismic load path in precast structures" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
隔板接合器或集力構件不足時，地震中樓板與牆分離，樓板失去側向支撐，柱承受未設計的大變形而破壞；若只依重力荷載設計擱置支承，板件在大變位下從支承滑落。
接頭的耗能鋼筋越多越好，因為吸收的能量越多。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
With inadequate diaphragm connectors or collectors, floors separate from walls in an earthquake, columns lose lateral support and fail under undesigned deformation.
More dissipating steel in the joint is always better because it absorbs more energy.
quiz.explanation: 隔板接合器或集力構件不足時，地震中樓板與牆分離，樓板失去側向支撐，柱承受未設計的大變形而破壞；若只依重力荷載設計擱置支承，板件在大變位下從支承滑落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With inadequate diaphragm connectors or collectors, floors separate from walls in an earthquake, columns lose lateral support and fail under undesigned deformation; bearings designed for gravity alone let units slide off at large displacement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「旗形遲滯迴圈」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flag-shaped hysteresis” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 接合式預鑄構架把梁與柱以無黏結預力鋼腱夾在一起，地震時梁端與柱面之間張開一個縫，構件本身幾乎不受損；預力在震後把縫重新壓合，使結構回到原位，這就是自復位。只有預力時遲滯迴圈幾乎沒有面積，耗能不足，因此再加入會降伏的軟鋼筋或耗能元件，得到形如旗子的遲滯迴圈：既能耗能，又能在卸載後歸零。關鍵在於預力提供的回復彎矩必須大於軟鋼的降伏彎矩，否則殘留變位無法消除。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「旗形遲滯迴圈」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A jointed precast frame clamps beams to columns with unbonded post-tensioning tendons; in an earthquake a gap opens between beam end and column face while the members themselves stay nearly undamaged, and after shaking the prestress closes the gap and returns the structure to its original position, which is self-centring. Prestress alone gives hysteresis loops with almost no area and too little dissipation, so yielding mild-steel bars or dissipating devices are added to produce a flag-shaped loop that both dissipates energy and returns to zero on unloading. The key is that the restoring moment from prestress must exceed the yield moment of the mild steel, otherwise residual drift cannot be removed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Flag-shaped hysteresis” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：預力 P = 1,200 kN、對壓力中心力臂 0.35 m，M_pt = 420 kN·m；軟鋼 A_s = 1,000 mm²、以 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa 計，T_s = 525 kN、力臂 0.55 m，M_s ≈ 289 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With prestress P = 1,200 kN at a 0.35 m lever arm to the compression centroid, M_pt = 420 kN·m; mild steel A_s = 1,000 mm² at 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa gives T_s = 525 kN at a 0.55 m lever arm, M_s ≈ 289 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接頭的耗能鋼筋越多越好，因為吸收的能量越多。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More dissipating steel in the joint is always better because it absorbs more energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「旗形遲滯迴圈」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Flag-shaped hysteresis”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯
knowledge.titleEn: Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems
knowledge.text: 接合式預鑄構架把梁與柱以無黏結預力鋼腱夾在一起，地震時梁端與柱面之間張開一個縫，構件本身幾乎不受損；預力在震後把縫重新壓合，使結構回到原位，這就是自復位。只有預力時遲滯迴圈幾乎沒有面積，耗能不足，因此再加入會降伏的軟鋼筋或耗能元件，得到形如旗子的遲滯迴圈：既能耗能，又能在卸載後歸零。
knowledge.textEn: A jointed precast frame clamps beams to columns with unbonded post-tensioning tendons; in an earthquake a gap opens between beam end and column face while the members themselves stay nearly undamaged, and after shaking the prestress closes the gap and returns the structure to its original position, which is self-centring. Prestress alone gives hysteresis loops with almost no area and too little dissipation, so yielding mild-steel bars or dissipating devices are added to produce a flag-shaped loop that both dissipates energy and returns to zero on unloading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接頭的耗能鋼筋越多越好，因為吸收的能量越多。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More dissipating steel in the joint is always better because it absorbs more energy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems" is correct?
options: 接頭的耗能鋼筋越多越好，因為吸收的能量越多。
混合接頭的鋼腱也應該灌漿黏結，這樣才更安全。
接合式預鑄構架把梁與柱以無黏結預力鋼腱夾在一起，地震時梁端與柱面之間張開一個縫，構件本身幾乎不受損；預力在震後把縫重新壓合，使結構回到原位，這就是自復位。
optionsEn: More dissipating steel in the joint is always better because it absorbs more energy.
Tendons in a hybrid joint should also be grouted and bonded, because that is safer.
A jointed precast frame clamps beams to columns with unbonded post-tensioning tendons.
quiz.explanation: 接合式預鑄構架把梁與柱以無黏結預力鋼腱夾在一起，地震時梁端與柱面之間張開一個縫，構件本身幾乎不受損；預力在震後把縫重新壓合，使結構回到原位，這就是自復位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A jointed precast frame clamps beams to columns with unbonded post-tensioning tendons; in an earthquake a gap opens between beam end and column face while the members themselves stay nearly undamaged, and after shaking the prestress closes the gap and returns the structure to its original position, which is self-centring. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「旗形遲滯迴圈」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flag-shaped hysteresis” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預力 P = 1,200 kN、對壓力中心力臂 0.35 m，M_pt = 420 kN·m；軟鋼 A_s = 1,000 mm²、以 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa 計，T_s = 525 kN、力臂 0.55 m，M_s ≈ 289 kN·m。比值 λ = M_pt/M_s ≈ 1.45 > 1，卸載後預力足以把軟鋼拉回，殘留變位小。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With prestress P = 1,200 kN at a 0.35 m lever arm to the compression centroid, M_pt = 420 kN·m; mild steel A_s = 1,000 mm² at 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa gives T_s = 525 kN at a 0.55 m lever arm, M_s ≈ 289 kN·m. The ratio λ = M_pt/M_s ≈ 1.45 > 1, so on unloading the prestress can pull the mild steel back and residual drift stays small. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以接頭的彎矩—轉角分析或試驗確認旗形迴圈的形狀、卸載後殘留轉角與每循環耗能；設計報告中列出每個接頭的 M_pt、M_s 與 λ，確認在材料強度上下限下都大於 1。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm the flag shape, residual rotation after unloading and energy per cycle by moment–rotation analysis or testing of the joint; list M_pt, M_s and λ for every joint in the design report and confirm λ exceeds 1 for both upper- and lower-bound material strengths.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 預力 P = 1,200 kN、對壓力中心力臂 0.35 m，M_pt = 420 kN·m；軟鋼 A_s = 1,000 mm²、以 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa 計，T_s = 525 kN、力臂 0.55 m，M_s ≈ 289 kN·m。比值 λ = M_pt/M_s ≈ 1.45 > 1，卸載後預力足以把軟鋼拉回，殘留變位小。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With prestress P = 1,200 kN at a 0.35 m lever arm to the compression centroid, M_pt = 420 kN·m; mild steel A_s = 1,000 mm² at 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa gives T_s = 525 kN at a 0.55 m lever arm, M_s ≈ 289 kN·m. The ratio λ = M_pt/M_s ≈ 1.45 > 1, so on unloading the prestress can pull the mild steel back and residual drift stays small. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems", which statement holds?
options: 預力 P = 1,200 kN、對壓力中心力臂 0.35 m，M_pt = 420 kN·m。
預鑄構件很重，放上去之後自己就很穩，不需要臨時斜撐。
只要試體的最大承載力達到設計值，接頭就算通過試驗。
optionsEn: With prestress P = 1,200 kN at a 0.35 m lever arm to the compression centroid, M_pt = 420 kN·m.
Precast members are heavy, so once set they are stable without temporary bracing.
A joint passes testing as soon as the specimen reaches its design peak strength.
quiz.explanation: 預力 P = 1,200 kN、對壓力中心力臂 0.35 m，M_pt = 420 kN·m；軟鋼 A_s = 1,000 mm²、以 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa 計，T_s = 525 kN、力臂 0.55 m，M_s ≈ 289 kN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With prestress P = 1,200 kN at a 0.35 m lever arm to the compression centroid, M_pt = 420 kN·m; mild steel A_s = 1,000 mm² at 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa gives T_s = 525 kN at a 0.55 m lever arm, M_s ≈ 289 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「旗形遲滯迴圈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Flag-shaped hysteresis” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以接頭的彎矩—轉角分析或試驗確認旗形迴圈的形狀、卸載後殘留轉角與每循環耗能；設計報告中列出每個接頭的 M_pt、M_s 與 λ，確認在材料強度上下限下都大於 1。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm the flag shape, residual rotation after unloading and energy per cycle by moment–rotation analysis or testing of the joint; list M_pt, M_s and λ for every joint in the design report and confirm λ exceeds 1 for both upper- and lower-bound material strengths. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計者應同時設定耗能與復位兩個目標，並在圖說中標明預力值、軟鋼面積與允許偏差；任何現場變更預力束數或鋼筋量，都須重新計算 λ 並經核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Designers should set both dissipation and recentring targets and show prestress, mild-steel area and tolerances on drawings; any site change in strand count or bar area requires recalculating λ and approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若為增加耗能而放入過多軟鋼，λ 小於 1，震後縫無法閉合，結構留下明顯殘留傾斜，修復困難；預力損失過大也會降低 λ，使原本自復位的系統逐年失去復位能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding too much mild steel for dissipation drops λ below 1, so gaps cannot close after the earthquake and the structure is left with visible residual lean that is hard to repair; excessive prestress loss also lowers λ, so a self-centring system gradually loses its recentring ability over the years. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the flag shape, residual rotation after unloading and energy per cycle by moment–rotation analysis or testing of the joint; list M_pt, M_s and λ for every joint in the design report and confirm λ exceeds 1 for both upper- and lower-bound material strengths.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計者應同時設定耗能與復位兩個目標，並在圖說中標明預力值、軟鋼面積與允許偏差；任何現場變更預力束數或鋼筋量，都須重新計算 λ 並經核可。

quiz.question: 要驗證「接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以接頭的彎矩—轉角分析或試驗確認旗形迴圈的形狀、卸載後殘留轉角與每循環耗能。
接頭被混凝土包住後就安全了，不需要再檢測。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Confirm the flag shape, residual rotation after unloading and energy per cycle by moment–rotation analysis or testing of the joint.
Once a connection is encased in concrete it is safe and needs no further testing.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「旗形遲滯迴圈」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Flag-shaped hysteresis” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若為增加耗能而放入過多軟鋼，λ 小於 1，震後縫無法閉合，結構留下明顯殘留傾斜，修復困難；預力損失過大也會降低 λ，使原本自復位的系統逐年失去復位能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding too much mild steel for dissipation drops λ below 1, so gaps cannot close after the earthquake and the structure is left with visible residual lean that is hard to repair; excessive prestress loss also lowers λ, so a self-centring system gradually loses its recentring ability over the years. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：關鍵在於預力提供的回復彎矩必須大於軟鋼的降伏彎矩，否則殘留變位無法消除。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The key is that the restoring moment from prestress must exceed the yield moment of the mild steel, otherwise residual drift cannot be removed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接頭的耗能鋼筋越多越好，因為吸收的能量越多。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More dissipating steel in the joint is always better because it absorbs more energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若為增加耗能而放入過多軟鋼，λ 小於 1，震後縫無法閉合，結構留下明顯殘留傾斜，修復困難；預力損失過大也會降低 λ，使原本自復位的系統逐年失去復位能力。
knowledge.textEn: Adding too much mild steel for dissipation drops λ below 1, so gaps cannot close after the earthquake and the structure is left with visible residual lean that is hard to repair; excessive prestress loss also lowers λ, so a self-centring system gradually loses its recentring ability over the years.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
混合接頭的鋼腱也應該灌漿黏結，這樣才更安全。
若為增加耗能而放入過多軟鋼，λ 小於 1，震後縫無法閉合，結構留下明顯殘留傾斜，修復困難；預力損失過大也會降低 λ，使原本自復位的系統逐年失去復位能力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Tendons in a hybrid joint should also be grouted and bonded, because that is safer.
Adding too much mild steel for dissipation drops λ below 1, so gaps cannot close after the earthquake and the structure is left with visible residual lean that is hard to repair.
quiz.explanation: 若為增加耗能而放入過多軟鋼，λ 小於 1，震後縫無法閉合，結構留下明顯殘留傾斜，修復困難；預力損失過大也會降低 λ，使原本自復位的系統逐年失去復位能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding too much mild steel for dissipation drops λ below 1, so gaps cannot close after the earthquake and the structure is left with visible residual lean that is hard to repair; excessive prestress loss also lowers λ, so a self-centring system gradually loses its recentring ability over the years. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「混合預力梁柱接頭的開口與脫黏長度」與「柱底灌漿套筒續接與等同現澆接頭」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gap opening and debonded length in hybrid post-tensioned joints" and "Grouted sleeve splices at column bases and emulative joints": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 混合預力梁柱接頭的開口與脫黏長度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Gap opening and debonded length in hybrid post-tensioned joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「混合接頭脫黏軟鋼」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Debonded mild steel in hybrid joint” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混合接頭（hybrid connection）由穿過柱的無黏結預力鋼腱與梁上下緣灌漿套管內的軟鋼筋組成。層間變位幾乎全部轉為梁端開口轉角，開口在鋼腱處造成伸長，因鋼腱無黏結，伸長分攤到整段長度，應力增加有限、保持彈性；軟鋼筋則在接頭附近刻意脫黏一段長度，讓伸長分散在這段長度內，控制應變以避免低週疲勞斷裂。The Paramount 等預鑄混合構架建築即採用此類接頭概念。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「混合接頭脫黏軟鋼」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hybrid connection combines unbonded post-tensioning tendons through the column with mild-steel bars grouted in ducts at the top and bottom of the beam. Almost all storey drift becomes gap-opening rotation at the beam end, which elongates the tendon; being unbonded, the tendon spreads the elongation over its full length, so stress rises modestly and stays elastic, while the mild bars are deliberately debonded over a short length near the joint so their elongation is spread over that length, limiting strain and avoiding low-cycle fatigue fracture. Precast hybrid-frame buildings such as The Paramount use this connection concept. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Debonded mild steel in hybrid joint” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：梁深 700 mm、層間變位 2%：梁端最外緣開口 0.02×700 = 14 mm，位於梁中央的鋼腱伸長 0.02×350 = 7 mm；跨越兩個接頭、長 16 m 的鋼腱應變增加 14/16,000 = 0.0875%，應力增 195,000×0.000875 ≈ 171 MPa，由 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa 增為約 1,194 MPa，仍低於降伏。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 700 mm beam at 2% drift, the extreme gap is 0.02×700 = 14 mm and a mid-depth tendon elongates 0.02×350 = 7 mm per joint; over a 16 m tendon crossing two joints the strain rises by 14/16,000 = 0.0875%, adding 195,000×0.000875 ≈ 171 MPa, from 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa to about 1,194 MPa, still below yield.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混合接頭的鋼腱也應該灌漿黏結，這樣才更安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tendons in a hybrid joint should also be grouted and bonded, because that is safer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「混合接頭脫黏軟鋼」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Debonded mild steel in hybrid joint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 混合預力梁柱接頭的開口與脫黏長度
knowledge.titleEn: Gap opening and debonded length in hybrid post-tensioned joints
knowledge.text: 混合接頭（hybrid connection）由穿過柱的無黏結預力鋼腱與梁上下緣灌漿套管內的軟鋼筋組成。層間變位幾乎全部轉為梁端開口轉角，開口在鋼腱處造成伸長，因鋼腱無黏結，伸長分攤到整段長度，應力增加有限、保持彈性；軟鋼筋則在接頭附近刻意脫黏一段長度，讓伸長分散在這段長度內，控制應變以避免低週疲勞斷裂。
knowledge.textEn: A hybrid connection combines unbonded post-tensioning tendons through the column with mild-steel bars grouted in ducts at the top and bottom of the beam. Almost all storey drift becomes gap-opening rotation at the beam end, which elongates the tendon; being unbonded, the tendon spreads the elongation over its full length, so stress rises modestly and stays elastic, while the mild bars are deliberately debonded over a short length near the joint so their elongation is spread over that length, limiting strain and avoiding low-cycle fatigue fracture.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混合接頭的鋼腱也應該灌漿黏結，這樣才更安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tendons in a hybrid joint should also be grouted and bonded, because that is safer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「混合預力梁柱接頭的開口與脫黏長度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gap opening and debonded length in hybrid post-tensioned joints" is correct?
options: 混合接頭（hybrid connection）由穿過柱的無黏結預力鋼腱與梁上下緣灌漿套管內的軟鋼筋組成。
混合接頭的鋼腱也應該灌漿黏結，這樣才更安全。
灌漿套筒只要灌了漿就一定合格，不需要逐支檢查。
optionsEn: A hybrid connection combines unbonded post-tensioning tendons through the column with mild-steel bars grouted in ducts at the top and bottom of the beam.
Tendons in a hybrid joint should also be grouted and bonded, because that is safer.
A grouted sleeve is acceptable as soon as grout goes in, with no need to check each one.
quiz.explanation: 混合接頭（hybrid connection）由穿過柱的無黏結預力鋼腱與梁上下緣灌漿套管內的軟鋼筋組成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A hybrid connection combines unbonded post-tensioning tendons through the column with mild-steel bars grouted in ducts at the top and bottom of the beam. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 混合預力梁柱接頭的開口與脫黏長度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gap opening and debonded length in hybrid post-tensioned joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混合接頭脫黏軟鋼」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Debonded mild steel in hybrid joint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：梁深 700 mm、層間變位 2%：梁端最外緣開口 0.02×700 = 14 mm，位於梁中央的鋼腱伸長 0.02×350 = 7 mm；跨越兩個接頭、長 16 m 的鋼腱應變增加 14/16,000 = 0.0875%，應力增 195,000×0.000875 ≈ 171 MPa，由 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa 增為約 1,194 MPa，仍低於降伏。軟鋼距轉動點 600 mm，伸長 12 mm，若限制應變 3%，脫黏長度需 12/0.03 = 400 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 700 mm beam at 2% drift, the extreme gap is 0.02×700 = 14 mm and a mid-depth tendon elongates 0.02×350 = 7 mm per joint; over a 16 m tendon crossing two joints the strain rises by 14/16,000 = 0.0875%, adding 195,000×0.000875 ≈ 171 MPa, from 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa to about 1,194 MPa, still below yield. Mild steel 600 mm from the rotation point elongates 12 mm, so a 3% strain limit needs a debonded length of 12/0.03 = 400 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查設計最大變位（例如 3.5%）下鋼腱應力是否仍在彈性範圍、軟鋼應變是否在試驗驗證的範圍；施工時確認脫黏套管長度與位置、灌漿套管密實、預力千斤頂壓力與伸長量紀錄，並與計算值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check that tendon stress stays elastic and mild-steel strain stays within the tested range at the maximum design drift, for example 3.5%; during construction confirm debonding sleeve length and position, duct grouting and jack pressure and elongation records against calculations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.title: 柱底灌漿套筒續接與等同現澆接頭：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Grouted sleeve splices at column bases and emulative joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「灌漿套筒續接器」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grouted sleeve splice” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 等同現澆的預鑄柱常以灌漿套筒把柱主筋與基礎或下層柱的鋼筋續接：下方鋼筋插入預埋在柱底的鋼套筒，再以高強無收縮灌漿填滿，鋼筋力經灌漿黏結與套筒內的凸肋傳遞。柱底正是塑性鉸區，續接器必須能發展鋼筋的抗拉強度而不先破壞，才能讓塑性變形留在鋼筋上。接頭的弱點在施工：插筋錯位、套筒灌漿不滿或灌漿強度不足，外觀完全看不出來。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「灌漿套筒續接器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Emulative precast columns often splice their main bars to foundation or lower-column bars with grouted sleeves: the lower bars enter steel sleeves cast into the column base, which are then filled with high-strength non-shrink grout, and bar force transfers through grout bond and ribs inside the sleeve. The column base is exactly the plastic-hinge zone, so the splice must develop the bar's tensile strength without failing first, keeping plastic deformation in the bars. The weakness lies in construction: misaligned dowels, partly filled sleeves or weak grout are completely invisible from outside. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Grouted sleeve splice” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鋼筋 D32（A_b = 804 mm²）、抗拉強度 f_u = 620 MPa，灌漿黏結應力 τ = 12 MPa：所需埋入長度 L = A_b·f_u/(π·d_b·τ) = 804×620/(π×32×12) ≈ 413 mm；若套筒每側提供 16 d_b = 512 mm，餘裕約 24%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a D32 bar (A_b = 804 mm²) with tensile strength f_u = 620 MPa and grout bond stress τ = 12 MPa, the required embedment is L = A_b·f_u/(π·d_b·τ) = 804×620/(π×32×12) ≈ 413 mm; a sleeve giving 16 d_b = 512 mm per side leaves a margin of about 24%.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A grouted sleeve is acceptable as soon as grout goes in, with no need to check each one." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鋼筋 D32（A_b = 804 mm²）、抗拉強度 f_u = 620 MPa，灌漿黏結應力 τ = 12 MPa：所需埋入長度 L = A_b·f_u/(π·d_b·τ) = 804×620/(π×32×12) ≈ 413 mm；若套筒每側提供 16 d_b = 512 mm，餘裕約 24%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a D32 bar (A_b = 804 mm²) with tensile strength f_u = 620 MPa and grout bond stress τ = 12 MPa, the required embedment is L = A_b·f_u/(π·d_b·τ) = 804×620/(π×32×12) ≈ 413 mm; a sleeve giving 16 d_b = 512 mm per side leaves a margin of about 24%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：續接器型式須有試驗報告證明能發展鋼筋規定抗拉強度，並在工地以同批材料做灌漿立方試體與續接器拉力抽驗；安裝前量測插筋位置與突出長度，灌漿時確認出漿口溢流，並記錄每支套筒。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The splice system needs test reports showing it develops the bar's specified tensile strength, with site cube tests of the same grout batch and sample tension tests of splices; measure dowel positions and projection before setting, confirm grout flows from every outlet during grouting and log each sleeve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 柱底灌漿套筒續接與等同現澆接頭：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grouted sleeve splices at column bases and emulative joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「灌漿套筒續接器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grouted sleeve splice” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 續接器型式須有試驗報告證明能發展鋼筋規定抗拉強度，並在工地以同批材料做灌漿立方試體與續接器拉力抽驗；安裝前量測插筋位置與突出長度，灌漿時確認出漿口溢流，並記錄每支套筒。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The splice system needs test reports showing it develops the bar's specified tensile strength, with site cube tests of the same grout batch and sample tension tests of splices; measure dowel positions and projection before setting, confirm grout flows from every outlet during grouting and log each sleeve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：柱吊裝就位前以樣板確認插筋位置，偏差超過允許值須由設計者決定處置，嚴禁現場熱彎；灌漿作業由受訓人員執行，逐支記錄出漿確認與灌漿批號，並設為柱上方構件安裝前的停止點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check dowel positions with a template before setting each column; deviations beyond tolerance go to the designer, and hot bending on site is forbidden; grouting is done by trained operatives, with outlet flow and grout batch logged for every sleeve as a hold point before members above are erected.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：插筋偏位時工人可能彎折鋼筋強行插入，或把套筒周邊鑿開，使鋼筋在套筒內偏心；灌漿未從出漿口溢出就停止，套筒上半段空洞，地震時鋼筋在套筒內拔出，柱底在達到設計彎矩前破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Misaligned dowels tempt crews to bend bars into place or break out concrete around the sleeve, leaving bars eccentric inside it; stopping grout before it flows from the outlet leaves voids in the upper sleeve, so in an earthquake bars pull out and the column base fails before reaching its design moment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「柱底灌漿套筒續接與等同現澆接頭」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Grouted sleeve splices at column bases and emulative joints"?

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If precast members are strong enough, connections only need to carry gravity loads.

quiz.explanationEn: The splice system needs test reports showing it develops the bar's specified tensile strength, with site cube tests of the same grout batch and sample tension tests of splices; measure dowel positions and projection before setting, confirm grout flows from every outlet during grouting and log each sleeve. steps.title: 柱底灌漿套筒續接與等同現澆接頭：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Grouted sleeve splices at column bases and emulative joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「灌漿套筒續接器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grouted sleeve splice” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 插筋偏位時工人可能彎折鋼筋強行插入，或把套筒周邊鑿開，使鋼筋在套筒內偏心；灌漿未從出漿口溢出就停止，套筒上半段空洞，地震時鋼筋在套筒內拔出，柱底在達到設計彎矩前破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Misaligned dowels tempt crews to bend bars into place or break out concrete around the sleeve, leaving bars eccentric inside it; stopping grout before it flows from the outlet leaves voids in the upper sleeve, so in an earthquake bars pull out and the column base fails before reaching its design moment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接頭的弱點在施工：插筋錯位、套筒灌漿不滿或灌漿強度不足，外觀完全看不出來。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The weakness lies in construction: misaligned dowels, partly filled sleeves or weak grout are completely invisible from outside.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「灌漿套筒只要灌了漿就一定合格，不需要逐支檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A grouted sleeve is acceptable as soon as grout goes in, with no need to check each one." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 插筋偏位時工人可能彎折鋼筋強行插入，或把套筒周邊鑿開，使鋼筋在套筒內偏心；灌漿未從出漿口溢出就停止，套筒上半段空洞，地震時鋼筋在套筒內拔出，柱底在達到設計彎矩前破壞。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「柱底灌漿套筒續接與等同現澆接頭」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Grouted sleeve splices at column bases and emulative joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
插筋偏位時工人可能彎折鋼筋強行插入，或把套筒周邊鑿開，使鋼筋在套筒內偏心。
預鑄構件很重，放上去之後自己就很穩，不需要臨時斜撐。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Misaligned dowels tempt crews to bend bars into place or break out concrete around the sleeve, leaving bars eccentric inside it.
Precast members are heavy, so once set they are stable without temporary bracing.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「吊裝順序與接頭完成前的臨時穩定」與「支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete" and "Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 吊裝順序與接頭完成前的臨時穩定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「吊裝臨時斜撐」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Erection temporary bracing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預鑄構件在接頭灌漿、焊接或預力完成之前，只是彼此擱置的獨立構件，抗側力與穩定都依賴臨時斜撐、墊塊與臨時螺栓。施工階段的風、吊車碰撞或小地震，都可能在此時造成連續傾倒。因此吊裝計畫必須定義每一階段的穩定系統：哪些構件先完成永久接頭、臨時斜撐何時可以拆除、上方可以吊裝多少層而不超過下方未灌漿接頭的能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「吊裝臨時斜撐」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before connections are grouted, welded or post-tensioned, precast members are independent pieces resting on each other, relying on temporary braces, shims and erection bolts for lateral resistance and stability. Wind, crane impact or a small earthquake during this phase can trigger progressive toppling. The erection plan must therefore define the stability system at every stage: which members receive permanent connections first, when temporary braces may be removed, and how many levels may be erected above ungrouted joints without exceeding their capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Erection temporary bracing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：預鑄牆板寬 3.0 m、高 4.0 m，施工期風壓 0.8 kPa：風力 F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN，作用於 2.0 m 高，傾覆彎矩 19.2 kN·m；斜撐接於 3.0 m 高處，水平分力 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN，斜撐與地面 60°，軸力 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN，兩支各 6.4 kN，乘 1.6 後各約 10.2 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A precast wall panel 3.0 m wide and 4.0 m high under a construction-stage wind pressure of 0.8 kPa receives F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN at 2.0 m height, an overturning moment of 19.2 kN·m; braces attached at 3.0 m height need a horizontal component of 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN, and at 60° to the ground the axial force is 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN, 6.4 kN in each of two braces, or about 10.2 kN each with a 1.6 factor.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預鑄構件很重，放上去之後自己就很穩，不需要臨時斜撐。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Precast members are heavy, so once set they are stable without temporary bracing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「吊裝臨時斜撐」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Erection temporary bracing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊裝順序與接頭完成前的臨時穩定
knowledge.titleEn: Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete
knowledge.text: 預鑄構件在接頭灌漿、焊接或預力完成之前，只是彼此擱置的獨立構件，抗側力與穩定都依賴臨時斜撐、墊塊與臨時螺栓。施工階段的風、吊車碰撞或小地震，都可能在此時造成連續傾倒。
knowledge.textEn: Before connections are grouted, welded or post-tensioned, precast members are independent pieces resting on each other, relying on temporary braces, shims and erection bolts for lateral resistance and stability. Wind, crane impact or a small earthquake during this phase can trigger progressive toppling.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預鑄構件很重，放上去之後自己就很穩，不需要臨時斜撐。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Precast members are heavy, so once set they are stable without temporary bracing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊裝順序與接頭完成前的臨時穩定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete" is correct?
options: 預鑄構件很重，放上去之後自己就很穩，不需要臨時斜撐。
預鑄樓梯兩端都固定比較牢靠，地震時比較安全。
預鑄構件在接頭灌漿、焊接或預力完成之前，只是彼此擱置的獨立構件，抗側力與穩定都依賴臨時斜撐、墊塊與臨時螺栓。
optionsEn: Precast members are heavy, so once set they are stable without temporary bracing.
Fixing both ends of a precast stair is sturdier and safer in an earthquake.

Before connections are grouted, welded or post-tensioned, precast members are independent pieces resting on each other, relying on temporary braces, shims and erection bolts for lateral resistance and stability.
quiz.explanation: 預鑄構件在接頭灌漿、焊接或預力完成之前，只是彼此擱置的獨立構件，抗側力與穩定都依賴臨時斜撐、墊塊與臨時螺栓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before connections are grouted, welded or post-tensioned, precast members are independent pieces resting on each other, relying on temporary braces, shims and erection bolts for lateral resistance and stability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊裝順序與接頭完成前的臨時穩定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊裝臨時斜撐」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Erection temporary bracing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預鑄牆板寬 3.0 m、高 4.0 m，施工期風壓 0.8 kPa：風力 F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN，作用於 2.0 m 高，傾覆彎矩 19.2 kN·m；斜撐接於 3.0 m 高處，水平分力 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN，斜撐與地面 60°，軸力 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN，兩支各 6.4 kN，乘 1.6 後各約 10.2 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A precast wall panel 3.0 m wide and 4.0 m high under a construction-stage wind pressure of 0.8 kPa receives F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN at 2.0 m height, an overturning moment of 19.2 kN·m; braces attached at 3.0 m height need a horizontal component of 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN, and at 60° to the ground the axial force is 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN, 6.4 kN in each of two braces, or about 10.2 kN each with a 1.6 factor. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：吊裝計畫附臨時穩定計算、斜撐與地錨的容量、拆除條件與停止風速；每日開工前檢查斜撐、墊塊與臨時螺栓，接頭灌漿強度達到規定值（以試體證明）後才拆除臨時斜撐，並記錄日期與拆除人員。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The erection plan includes temporary stability calculations, capacities of braces and ground anchors, removal conditions and stop-work wind speeds; braces, shims and erection bolts are inspected before work each day, and braces are removed only after joint grout reaches the specified strength, proven by cubes, with dates and personnel recorded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 預鑄牆板寬 3.0 m、高 4.0 m，施工期風壓 0.8 kPa：風力 F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN，作用於 2.0 m 高，傾覆彎矩 19.2 kN·m；斜撐接於 3.0 m 高處，水平分力 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN，斜撐與地面 60°，軸力 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN，兩支各 6.4 kN，乘 1.6 後各約 10.2 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A precast wall panel 3.0 m wide and 4.0 m high under a construction-stage wind pressure of 0.8 kPa receives F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN at 2.0 m height, an overturning moment of 19.2 kN·m; braces attached at 3.0 m height need a horizontal component of 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN, and at 60° to the ground the axial force is 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN, 6.4 kN in each of two braces, or about 10.2 kN each with a 1.6 factor. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊裝順序與接頭完成前的臨時穩定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete", which statement holds?
options: 預鑄牆板寬 3.0 m、高 4.0 m，施工期風壓 0.8 kPa：風力 F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN，作用於 2.0 m 高，傾覆彎矩 19.2 kN·m。
縮尺試驗的力量直接乘上縮尺比就能換回實尺度。
預力是永久的，震後不需要再確認。
optionsEn: A precast wall panel 3.0 m wide and 4.0 m high under a construction-stage wind pressure of 0.8 kPa receives F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN at 2.0 m height, an overturning moment of 19.2 kN·m.
Scaled-test forces convert to full scale by multiplying by the scale factor alone.
Prestress is permanent and needs no checking after an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 預鑄牆板寬 3.0 m、高 4.0 m，施工期風壓 0.8 kPa：風力 F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN，作用於 2.0 m 高，傾覆彎矩 19.2 kN·m；斜撐接於 3.0 m 高處，水平分力 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN，斜撐與地面 60°，軸力 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN，兩支各 6.4 kN，乘 1.6 後各約 10.2 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A precast wall panel 3.0 m wide and 4.0 m high under a construction-stage wind pressure of 0.8 kPa receives F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN at 2.0 m height, an overturning moment of 19.2 kN·m; braces attached at 3.0 m height need a horizontal component of 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN, and at 60° to the ground the axial force is 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN, 6.4 kN in each of two braces, or about 10.2 kN each with a 1.6 factor. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吊裝順序與接頭完成前的臨時穩定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊裝臨時斜撐」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Erection temporary bracing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 吊裝計畫附臨時穩定計算、斜撐與地錨的容量、拆除條件與停止風速；每日開工前檢查斜撐、墊塊與臨時螺栓，接頭灌漿強度達到規定值（以試體證明）後才拆除臨時斜撐，並記錄日期與拆除人員。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The erection plan includes temporary stability calculations, capacities of braces and ground anchors, removal conditions and stop-work wind speeds; braces, shims and erection bolts are inspected before work each day, and braces are removed only after joint grout reaches the specified strength, proven by cubes, with dates and personnel recorded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊裝計畫須由具資格的工程師簽認，列明每一階段的穩定系統、斜撐拆除條件與停工風速；這是工程檢核的停止點，不是吊掛作業的操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The erection plan must be signed by a qualified engineer, stating the stability system at every stage, brace-removal conditions and stop-work wind speeds; it is an engineering hold point, not an operating permit for rigging.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了加快進度而在接頭灌漿強度未達前拆除斜撐，強風時牆板或柱傾倒並撞倒相鄰構件；墊塊材料或位置錯誤使構件偏心擱置，灌漿後殘留應力，日後在接頭處開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing braces before joint grout gains strength to save time lets panels or columns topple in strong wind and knock down neighbours; wrong shim material or position leaves members eccentrically seated, locking in stresses that later crack the joint. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 吊裝計畫附臨時穩定計算、斜撐與地錨的容量、拆除條件與停止風速；每日開工前檢查斜撐、墊塊與臨時螺栓，接頭灌漿強度達到規定值（以試體證明）後才拆除臨時斜撐，並記錄日期與拆除人員。
knowledge.textEn: The erection plan includes temporary stability calculations, capacities of braces and ground anchors, removal conditions and stop-work wind speeds; braces, shims and erection bolts are inspected before work each day, and braces are removed only after joint grout reaches the specified strength, proven by cubes, with dates and personnel recorded.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吊裝計畫須由具資格的工程師簽認，列明每一階段的穩定系統、斜撐拆除條件與停工風速；這是工程檢核的停止點，不是吊掛作業的操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: The erection plan must be signed by a qualified engineer, stating the stability system at every stage, brace-removal conditions and stop-work wind speeds; it is an engineering hold point, not an operating permit for rigging.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊裝順序與接頭完成前的臨時穩定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
吊裝計畫附臨時穩定計算、斜撐與地錨的容量、拆除條件與停止風速。
接頭的耗能鋼筋越多越好，因為吸收的能量越多。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
The erection plan includes temporary stability calculations, capacities of braces and ground anchors, removal conditions and stop-work wind speeds.
More dissipating steel in the joint is always better because it absorbs more energy.
quiz.explanation: 吊裝計畫附臨時穩定計算、斜撐與地錨的容量、拆除條件與停止風速；每日開工前檢查斜撐、墊塊與臨時螺栓，接頭灌漿強度達到規定值（以試體證明）後才拆除臨時斜撐，並記錄日期與拆除人員。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The erection plan includes temporary stability calculations, capacities of braces and ground anchors, removal conditions and stop-work wind speeds; braces, shims and erection bolts are inspected before work each day, and braces are removed only after joint grout reaches the specified strength, proven by cubes, with dates and personnel recorded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊裝順序與接頭完成前的臨時穩定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊裝臨時斜撐」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Erection temporary bracing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了加快進度而在接頭灌漿強度未達前拆除斜撐，強風時牆板或柱傾倒並撞倒相鄰構件；墊塊材料或位置錯誤使構件偏心擱置，灌漿後殘留應力，日後在接頭處開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing braces before joint grout gains strength to save time lets panels or columns topple in strong wind and knock down neighbours; wrong shim material or position leaves members eccentrically seated, locking in stresses that later crack the joint. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此吊裝計畫必須定義每一階段的穩定系統：哪些構件先完成永久接頭、臨時斜撐何時可以拆除、上方可以吊裝多少層而不超過下方未灌漿接頭的能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The erection plan must therefore define the stability system at every stage: which members receive permanent connections first, when temporary braces may be removed, and how many levels may be erected above ungrouted joints without exceeding their capacity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預鑄構件很重，放上去之後自己就很穩，不需要臨時斜撐。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Precast members are heavy, so once set they are stable without temporary bracing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了加快進度而在接頭灌漿強度未達前拆除斜撐，強風時牆板或柱傾倒並撞倒相鄰構件；墊塊材料或位置錯誤使構件偏心擱置，灌漿後殘留應力，日後在接頭處開裂。
knowledge.textEn: Removing braces before joint grout gains strength to save time lets panels or columns topple in strong wind and knock down neighbours; wrong shim material or position leaves members eccentrically seated, locking in stresses that later crack the joint.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊裝順序與接頭完成前的臨時穩定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
預鑄樓梯兩端都固定比較牢靠，地震時比較安全。
為了加快進度而在接頭灌漿強度未達前拆除斜撐，強風時牆板或柱傾倒並撞倒相鄰構件；墊塊材料或位置錯誤使構件偏心擱置，灌漿後殘留應力，日後在接頭處開裂。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Fixing both ends of a precast stair is sturdier and safer in an earthquake.
Removing braces before joint grout gains strength to save time lets panels or columns topple in strong wind and knock down neighbours.
quiz.explanation: 為了加快進度而在接頭灌漿強度未達前拆除斜撐，強風時牆板或柱傾倒並撞倒相鄰構件；墊塊材料或位置錯誤使構件偏心擱置，灌漿後殘留應力，日後在接頭處開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing braces before joint grout gains strength to save time lets panels or columns topple in strong wind and knock down neighbours; wrong shim material or position leaves members eccentrically seated, locking in stresses that later crack the joint. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樓梯滑動支承長度」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stair sliding-seat length” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預鑄樓梯與樓板擱置在梁或牛腿上，地震時上下樓層產生相對位移，若樓梯兩端都被固定，它會像斜撐一樣受壓而破壞；若一端設計為滑動，滑動量與支承長度必須足以容納最大層間變位，並保留施工誤差與邊緣剝落的餘裕。2011 年基督城地震中，Forsyth Barr 大樓與 Grand Chancellor 飯店的預鑄樓梯崩落，就是滑動縫與支承長度不足以容納層間變位的教訓，紐西蘭皇家調查委員會報告對建築非主結構構件的變位相容提出檢討。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樓梯滑動支承長度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Precast stairs and floor units sit on beams or corbels; in an earthquake the floors above and below move relative to each other, and a stair fixed at both ends acts like a brace and fails in compression. If one end is designed to slide, the sliding allowance and seating length must accommodate the maximum storey drift plus margins for construction tolerance and edge spalling. In the 2011 Christchurch earthquake, precast stairs collapsed in the Forsyth Barr building and the Hotel Grand Chancellor, a lesson in sliding joints and seats too small for storey drift, and the Canterbury Earthquakes Royal Commission reviewed the deformation compatibility of elements outside the primary structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stair sliding-seat length” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：樓高 3.5 m、最大層間變位 2.5%，相對位移 0.025×3,500 = 87.5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 3.5 m storey and 2.5% maximum drift, the relative displacement is 0.025×3,500 = 87.5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預鑄樓梯兩端都固定比較牢靠，地震時比較安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fixing both ends of a precast stair is sturdier and safer in an earthquake." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樓梯滑動支承長度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stair sliding-seat length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容
knowledge.titleEn: Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility
knowledge.text: 預鑄樓梯與樓板擱置在梁或牛腿上，地震時上下樓層產生相對位移，若樓梯兩端都被固定，它會像斜撐一樣受壓而破壞；若一端設計為滑動，滑動量與支承長度必須足以容納最大層間變位，並保留施工誤差與邊緣剝落的餘裕。2011 年基督城地震中，Forsyth Barr 大樓與 Grand Chancellor 飯店的預鑄樓梯崩落，就是滑動縫與支承長度不足以容納層間變位的教訓，紐西蘭皇家調查委員會報告對建築非主結構構件的變位相容提出檢討。
knowledge.textEn: Precast stairs and floor units sit on beams or corbels; in an earthquake the floors above and below move relative to each other, and a stair fixed at both ends acts like a brace and fails in compression. If one end is designed to slide, the sliding allowance and seating length must accommodate the maximum storey drift plus margins for construction tolerance and edge spalling.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預鑄樓梯兩端都固定比較牢靠，地震時比較安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fixing both ends of a precast stair is sturdier and safer in an earthquake. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility" is correct?
options: 預鑄樓梯與樓板擱置在梁或牛腿上，地震時上下樓層產生相對位移，若樓梯兩端都被固定，它會像斜撐一樣受壓而破壞。
預鑄樓梯兩端都固定比較牢靠，地震時比較安全。
只要試體的最大承載力達到設計值，接頭就算通過試驗。
optionsEn: Precast stairs and floor units sit on beams or corbels.
Fixing both ends of a precast stair is sturdier and safer in an earthquake.
A joint passes testing as soon as the specimen reaches its design peak strength.
quiz.explanation: 預鑄樓梯與樓板擱置在梁或牛腿上，地震時上下樓層產生相對位移，若樓梯兩端都被固定，它會像斜撐一樣受壓而破壞；若一端設計為滑動，滑動量與支承長度必須足以容納最大層間變位，並保留施工誤差與邊緣剝落的餘裕。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Precast stairs and floor units sit on beams or corbels; in an earthquake the floors above and below move relative to each other, and a stair fixed at both ends acts like a brace and fails in compression. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓梯滑動支承長度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stair sliding-seat length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：樓高 3.5 m、最大層間變位 2.5%，相對位移 0.025×3,500 = 87.5 mm。滑動端支承長度 ≥ 87.5 + 施工誤差 20 + 邊緣剝落 20 + 最小承壓 50 ≈ 178 mm，另一側間隙也須 ≥ 87.5 mm，否則樓梯受壓頂住。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 3.5 m storey and 2.5% maximum drift, the relative displacement is 0.025×3,500 = 87.5 mm. The sliding-end seat must be at least 87.5 + 20 construction tolerance + 20 edge spalling + 50 minimum bearing ≈ 178 mm, and the gap on the other side at least 87.5 mm, or the stair jams in compression. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以結構分析取得每層最大層間變位（含扭轉），換算各樓梯與樓板的滑動需求；安裝後實測每支樓梯的支承長度與兩側間隙並拍照，確認間隙未被砂漿、裝修材或防火填縫硬性材料填滿。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain each storey's maximum drift, including torsion, from analysis and convert it into sliding demand for every stair and floor unit; after installation measure and photograph each stair's seating length and gaps on both sides, confirming they are not filled with mortar, finishes or rigid firestopping.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 樓高 3.5 m、最大層間變位 2.5%，相對位移 0.025×3,500 = 87.5 mm。滑動端支承長度 ≥ 87.5 + 施工誤差 20 + 邊緣剝落 20 + 最小承壓 50 ≈ 178 mm，另一側間隙也須 ≥ 87.5 mm，否則樓梯受壓頂住。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a 3.5 m storey and 2.5% maximum drift, the relative displacement is 0.025×3,500 = 87.5 mm. The sliding-end seat must be at least 87.5 + 20 construction tolerance + 20 edge spalling + 50 minimum bearing ≈ 178 mm, and the gap on the other side at least 87.5 mm, or the stair jams in compression. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility", which statement holds?
options: 接頭被混凝土包住後就安全了，不需要再檢測。
預鑄構件本身強度足夠，接頭只要能承受重力就好。
optionsEn: Once a connection is encased in concrete it is safe and needs no further testing.
With a 3.5 m storey and 2.5% maximum drift, the relative displacement is 0.025×3,500 = 87.5 mm.
If precast members are strong enough, connections only need to carry gravity loads.
quiz.explanation: 樓高 3.5 m、最大層間變位 2.5%，相對位移 0.025×3,500 = 87.5 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a 3.5 m storey and 2.5% maximum drift, the relative displacement is 0.025×3,500 = 87.5 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓梯滑動支承長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stair sliding-seat length” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以結構分析取得每層最大層間變位（含扭轉），換算各樓梯與樓板的滑動需求；安裝後實測每支樓梯的支承長度與兩側間隙並拍照，確認間隙未被砂漿、裝修材或防火填縫硬性材料填滿。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain each storey's maximum drift, including torsion, from analysis and convert it into sliding demand for every stair and floor unit; after installation measure and photograph each stair's seating length and gaps on both sides, confirming they are not filled with mortar, finishes or rigid firestopping. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：圖說應標示每支樓梯的固定端與滑動端、最小支承長度與間隙，並規定間隙只能以可壓縮材料填充；裝修與防火填縫施工前須確認不影響滑動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Drawings should show the fixed and sliding end of every stair, minimum seating length and gap, and require gaps to be filled only with compressible material; fit-out and firestopping must be checked not to impede sliding.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：間隙被水泥砂漿或裝修材料填死時，樓梯變成斜撐，地震中受壓破壞或把支承推落；支承長度只按重力設計，大變位時樓梯從牛腿滑落，阻斷逃生通道。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Gaps packed with mortar or finishes turn the stair into a brace that fails in compression or pushes off its seat; seats sized only for gravity let stairs slide off corbels at large drift, cutting off the escape route. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以結構分析取得每層最大層間變位（含扭轉），換算各樓梯與樓板的滑動需求；安裝後實測每支樓梯的支承長度與兩側間隙並拍照，確認間隙未被砂漿、裝修材或防火填縫硬性材料填滿。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain each storey's maximum drift, including torsion, from analysis and convert it into sliding demand for every stair and floor unit; after installation measure and photograph each stair's seating length and gaps on both sides, confirming they are not filled with mortar, finishes or rigid firestopping.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 圖說應標示每支樓梯的固定端與滑動端、最小支承長度與間隙，並規定間隙只能以可壓縮材料填充；裝修與防火填縫施工前須確認不影響滑動。
knowledge.textEn: Drawings should show the fixed and sliding end of every stair, minimum seating length and gap, and require gaps to be filled only with compressible material; fit-out and firestopping must be checked not to impede sliding.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
混合接頭的鋼腱也應該灌漿黏結，這樣才更安全。
以結構分析取得每層最大層間變位（含扭轉），換算各樓梯與樓板的滑動需求。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Tendons in a hybrid joint should also be grouted and bonded, because that is safer.
Obtain each storey's maximum drift, including torsion, from analysis and convert it into sliding demand for every stair and floor unit.
quiz.explanation: 以結構分析取得每層最大層間變位（含扭轉），換算各樓梯與樓板的滑動需求；安裝後實測每支樓梯的支承長度與兩側間隙並拍照，確認間隙未被砂漿、裝修材或防火填縫硬性材料填滿。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain each storey's maximum drift, including torsion, from analysis and convert it into sliding demand for every stair and floor unit; after installation measure and photograph each stair's seating length and gaps on both sides, confirming they are not filled with mortar, finishes or rigid firestopping. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓梯滑動支承長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stair sliding-seat length” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 間隙被水泥砂漿或裝修材料填死時，樓梯變成斜撐，地震中受壓破壞或把支承推落；支承長度只按重力設計，大變位時樓梯從牛腿滑落，阻斷逃生通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Gaps packed with mortar or finishes turn the stair into a brace that fails in compression or pushes off its seat; seats sized only for gravity let stairs slide off corbels at large drift, cutting off the escape route. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：2011 年基督城地震中，Forsyth Barr 大樓與 Grand Chancellor 飯店的預鑄樓梯崩落，就是滑動縫與支承長度不足以容納層間變位的教訓，紐西蘭皇家調查委員會報告對建築非主結構構件的變位相容提出檢討。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In the 2011 Christchurch earthquake, precast stairs collapsed in the Forsyth Barr building and the Hotel Grand Chancellor, a lesson in sliding joints and seats too small for storey drift, and the Canterbury Earthquakes Royal Commission reviewed the deformation compatibility of elements outside the primary structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預鑄樓梯兩端都固定比較牢靠，地震時比較安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fixing both ends of a precast stair is sturdier and safer in an earthquake." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 間隙被水泥砂漿或裝修材料填死時，樓梯變成斜撐，地震中受壓破壞或把支承推落；支承長度只按重力設計，大變位時樓梯從牛腿滑落，阻斷逃生通道。
knowledge.textEn: Gaps packed with mortar or finishes turn the stair into a brace that fails in compression or pushes off its seat; seats sized only for gravity let stairs slide off corbels at large drift, cutting off the escape route.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 間隙被水泥砂漿或裝修材料填死時，樓梯變成斜撐，地震中受壓破壞或把支承推落；支承長度只按重力設計，大變位時樓梯從牛腿滑落，阻斷逃生通道。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要試體的最大承載力達到設計值，接頭就算通過試驗。
optionsEn: Gaps packed with mortar or finishes turn the stair into a brace that fails in compression or pushes off its seat.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A joint passes testing as soon as the specimen reaches its design peak strength.
quiz.explanation: 間隙被水泥砂漿或裝修材料填死時，樓梯變成斜撐，地震中受壓破壞或把支承推落；支承長度只按重力設計，大變位時樓梯從牛腿滑落，阻斷逃生通道。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Gaps packed with mortar or finishes turn the stair into a brace that fails in compression or pushes off its seat; seats sized only for gravity let stairs slide off corbels at large drift, cutting off the escape route. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比」與「大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio" and "Large system tests and scaling similitude": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「反覆載重試驗允收」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cyclic test acceptance” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 接合式預鑄構架的行為不能完全以現澆規範推論，因此 ACI 374.1 以結構試驗作為允收依據：以實尺度或大尺度梁柱子結構承受逐級增大的反覆位移，至少到 3.5% 層間變位，並檢查強度保持、相對能量消散比與卸載後的勁度。ACI 550.3 則針對以無黏結預力形成的預鑄特殊抗彎構架，規定在符合這些試驗允收的前提下的設計方法。試驗的價值是同時證明強度、韌性與耗能，而不是只看最大承載力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「反覆載重試驗允收」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The behaviour of jointed precast frames cannot be inferred entirely from cast-in-place rules, so ACI 374.1 makes structural testing the basis for acceptance: full- or large-scale beam–column subassemblies are cycled at increasing displacements up to at least 3.5% drift, and strength retention, relative energy-dissipation ratio and stiffness around zero are checked. ACI 550.3 then gives design methods for precast special moment frames with unbonded post-tensioning that satisfy these acceptance criteria. The value of testing is that it proves strength, ductility and dissipation together rather than peak capacity alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cyclic test acceptance” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：相對能量消散比 β = A_loop/A_par。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Relative energy-dissipation ratio β = A_loop/A_par.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要試體的最大承載力達到設計值，接頭就算通過試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A joint passes testing as soon as the specimen reaches its design peak strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「反覆載重試驗允收」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cyclic test acceptance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比
knowledge.titleEn: ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio
knowledge.text: 接合式預鑄構架的行為不能完全以現澆規範推論，因此 ACI 374.1 以結構試驗作為允收依據：以實尺度或大尺度梁柱子結構承受逐級增大的反覆位移，至少到 3.5% 層間變位，並檢查強度保持、相對能量消散比與卸載後的勁度。ACI 550.3 則針對以無黏結預力形成的預鑄特殊抗彎構架，規定在符合這些試驗允收的前提下的設計方法。
knowledge.textEn: The behaviour of jointed precast frames cannot be inferred entirely from cast-in-place rules, so ACI 374.1 makes structural testing the basis for acceptance: full- or large-scale beam–column subassemblies are cycled at increasing displacements up to at least 3.5% drift, and strength retention, relative energy-dissipation ratio and stiffness around zero are checked. ACI 550.3 then gives design methods for precast special moment frames with unbonded post-tensioning that satisfy these acceptance criteria.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要試體的最大承載力達到設計值，接頭就算通過試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A joint passes testing as soon as the specimen reaches its design peak strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio" is correct?
options: 只要試體的最大承載力達到設計值，接頭就算通過試驗。
接合式預鑄構架的行為不能完全以現澆規範推論，因此 ACI 374.1 以結構試驗作為允收依據：以實尺度或大尺度梁柱子結構承受逐級增大的反覆位移，至少到 3.5% 層間變位，並檢查強度保持、相對能量消散比與卸載後的勁度。
縮尺試驗的力量直接乘上縮尺比就能換回實尺度。
optionsEn: A joint passes testing as soon as the specimen reaches its design peak strength.

The behaviour of jointed precast frames cannot be inferred entirely from cast-in-place rules, so ACI 374.1 makes structural testing the basis for acceptance: full- or large-scale beam–column subassemblies are cycled at increasing displacements up to at least 3.5% drift, and strength retention, relative energy-dissipation ratio and stiffness around zero are checked.
Scaled-test forces convert to full scale by multiplying by the scale factor alone.
quiz.explanation: 接合式預鑄構架的行為不能完全以現澆規範推論，因此 ACI 374.1 以結構試驗作為允收依據：以實尺度或大尺度梁柱子結構承受逐級增大的反覆位移，至少到 3.5% 層間變位，並檢查強度保持、相對能量消散比與卸載後的勁度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The behaviour of jointed precast frames cannot be inferred entirely from cast-in-place rules, so ACI 374.1 makes structural testing the basis for acceptance: full- or large-scale beam–column subassemblies are cycled at increasing displacements up to at least 3.5% drift, and strength retention, relative energy-dissipation ratio and stiffness around zero are checked. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比：定量估算
steps.titleEn: ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反覆載重試驗允收」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cyclic test acceptance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：相對能量消散比 β = A_loop/A_par。在 3.5% 變位的第三循環，迴圈面積 26 kJ；以 ±400 kN 尖峰力與扣除彈性段後各 0.09 m 的位移形成的平行四邊形面積 (400+400)×(0.09+0.09) = 144 kJ，β = 26/144 ≈ 0.18，高於 1/8 = 0.125 的允收下限。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Relative energy-dissipation ratio β = A_loop/A_par. In the third cycle at 3.5% drift the loop area is 26 kJ; the parallelogram formed by ±400 kN peaks and 0.09 m of post-elastic displacement each way has area (400+400)×(0.09+0.09) = 144 kJ, so β = 26/144 ≈ 0.18, above the acceptance minimum of 1/8 = 0.125. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：審查試驗報告時確認試體尺寸與細部代表實際接頭、加載程序達到 3.5% 且每級有足夠循環，第三循環尖峰力不低於最大力的規定比例、β 不低於 1/8，並檢查卸載後殘留變位與損傷照片。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: When reviewing a test report, confirm that specimen size and detailing represent the real joint, that the protocol reaches 3.5% with enough cycles at each level, that third-cycle peak force stays above the required fraction of the maximum and β is at least 1/8, and examine residual drift after unloading and damage photographs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 相對能量消散比 β = A_loop/A_par。在 3.5% 變位的第三循環，迴圈面積 26 kJ；以 ±400 kN 尖峰力與扣除彈性段後各 0.09 m 的位移形成的平行四邊形面積 (400+400)×(0.09+0.09) = 144 kJ，β = 26/144 ≈ 0.18，高於 1/8 = 0.125 的允收下限。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Relative energy-dissipation ratio β = A_loop/A_par. In the third cycle at 3.5% drift the loop area is 26 kJ; the parallelogram formed by ±400 kN peaks and 0.09 m of post-elastic displacement each way has area (400+400)×(0.09+0.09) = 144 kJ, so β = 26/144 ≈ 0.18, above the acceptance minimum of 1/8 = 0.125. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
