knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio", which statement holds?
options: 預力是永久的，震後不需要再確認。
接頭的耗能鋼筋越多越好，因為吸收的能量越多。
相對能量消散比 β = A_loop/A_par。
optionsEn: Prestress is permanent and needs no checking after an earthquake.
More dissipating steel in the joint is always better because it absorbs more energy.
Relative energy-dissipation ratio β = A_loop/A_par.
quiz.explanation: 相對能量消散比 β = A_loop/A_par。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Relative energy-dissipation ratio β = A_loop/A_par. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反覆載重試驗允收」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cyclic test acceptance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 審查試驗報告時確認試體尺寸與細部代表實際接頭、加載程序達到 3.5% 且每級有足夠循環，第三循環尖峰力不低於最大力的規定比例、β 不低於 1/8，並檢查卸載後殘留變位與損傷照片。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: When reviewing a test report, confirm that specimen size and detailing represent the real joint, that the protocol reaches 3.5% with enough cycles at each level, that third-cycle peak force stays above the required fraction of the maximum and β is at least 1/8, and examine residual drift after unloading and damage photographs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採用新型預鑄接頭前，須確認已有符合 ACI 374.1 的試驗或安排專案試驗，試驗計畫與報告由設計者與審查者核可；試驗涵蓋範圍外的尺寸變更不得逕行套用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before adopting a new precast joint, confirm that ACI 374.1-compliant tests exist or arrange project tests, with test plan and report approved by designer and reviewer; size changes beyond the tested range must not be applied without justification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以試體縮尺過小或細部簡化的試驗結果套用到實際接頭，混凝土保護層剝落、灌漿與錨碇行為都不相同，實際接頭可能在較小變位就失去強度；只看最大力而忽略第三循環的強度衰減，會高估韌性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying results from a specimen that is too small or simplified to real joints ignores differences in cover spalling, grouting and anchorage, so real joints may lose strength at smaller drifts; looking only at peak force and ignoring third-cycle strength decay overstates ductility. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 審查試驗報告時確認試體尺寸與細部代表實際接頭、加載程序達到 3.5% 且每級有足夠循環，第三循環尖峰力不低於最大力的規定比例、β 不低於 1/8，並檢查卸載後殘留變位與損傷照片。
knowledge.textEn: When reviewing a test report, confirm that specimen size and detailing represent the real joint, that the protocol reaches 3.5% with enough cycles at each level, that third-cycle peak force stays above the required fraction of the maximum and β is at least 1/8, and examine residual drift after unloading and damage photographs.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 採用新型預鑄接頭前，須確認已有符合 ACI 374.1 的試驗或安排專案試驗，試驗計畫與報告由設計者與審查者核可；試驗涵蓋範圍外的尺寸變更不得逕行套用。
knowledge.textEn: Before adopting a new precast joint, confirm that ACI 374.1-compliant tests exist or arrange project tests, with test plan and report approved by designer and reviewer; size changes beyond the tested range must not be applied without justification.

quiz.question: 要驗證「ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio"?
options: 審查試驗報告時確認試體尺寸與細部代表實際接頭、加載程序達到 3.5% 且每級有足夠循環，第三循環尖峰力不低於最大力的規定比例、β 不低於 1/8，並檢查卸載後殘留變位與損傷照片。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
灌漿套筒只要灌了漿就一定合格，不需要逐支檢查。
optionsEn: When reviewing a test report, confirm that specimen size and detailing represent the real joint, that the protocol reaches 3.5% with enough cycles at each level, that third-cycle peak force stays above the required fraction of the maximum and β is at least 1/8, and examine residual drift after unloading and damage photographs.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A grouted sleeve is acceptable as soon as grout goes in, with no need to check each one.
quiz.explanation: 審查試驗報告時確認試體尺寸與細部代表實際接頭、加載程序達到 3.5% 且每級有足夠循環，第三循環尖峰力不低於最大力的規定比例、β 不低於 1/8，並檢查卸載後殘留變位與損傷照片。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: When reviewing a test report, confirm that specimen size and detailing represent the real joint, that the protocol reaches 3.5% with enough cycles at each level, that third-cycle peak force stays above the required fraction of the maximum and β is at least 1/8, and examine residual drift after unloading and damage photographs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反覆載重試驗允收」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cyclic test acceptance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以試體縮尺過小或細部簡化的試驗結果套用到實際接頭，混凝土保護層剝落、灌漿與錨碇行為都不相同，實際接頭可能在較小變位就失去強度；只看最大力而忽略第三循環的強度衰減，會高估韌性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying results from a specimen that is too small or simplified to real joints ignores differences in cover spalling, grouting and anchorage, so real joints may lose strength at smaller drifts; looking only at peak force and ignoring third-cycle strength decay overstates ductility. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試驗的價值是同時證明強度、韌性與耗能，而不是只看最大承載力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The value of testing is that it proves strength, ductility and dissipation together rather than peak capacity alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要試體的最大承載力達到設計值，接頭就算通過試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A joint passes testing as soon as the specimen reaches its design peak strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以試體縮尺過小或細部簡化的試驗結果套用到實際接頭，混凝土保護層剝落、灌漿與錨碇行為都不相同，實際接頭可能在較小變位就失去強度；只看最大力而忽略第三循環的強度衰減，會高估韌性。
knowledge.textEn: Applying results from a specimen that is too small or simplified to real joints ignores differences in cover spalling, grouting and anchorage, so real joints may lose strength at smaller drifts; looking only at peak force and ignoring third-cycle strength decay overstates ductility.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若以試體縮尺過小或細部簡化的試驗結果套用到實際接頭，混凝土保護層剝落、灌漿與錨碇行為都不相同，實際接頭可能在較小變位就失去強度。
縮尺試驗的力量直接乘上縮尺比就能換回實尺度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Applying results from a specimen that is too small or simplified to real joints ignores differences in cover spalling, grouting and anchorage, so real joints may lose strength at smaller drifts.
Scaled-test forces convert to full scale by multiplying by the scale factor alone.
quiz.explanation: 若以試體縮尺過小或細部簡化的試驗結果套用到實際接頭，混凝土保護層剝落、灌漿與錨碇行為都不相同，實際接頭可能在較小變位就失去強度；只看最大力而忽略第三循環的強度衰減，會高估韌性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying results from a specimen that is too small or simplified to real joints ignores differences in cover spalling, grouting and anchorage, so real joints may lose strength at smaller drifts; looking only at peak force and ignoring third-cycle strength decay overstates ductility. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Large system tests and scaling similitude: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「PRESSS 五層試驗建築」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “PRESSS five-storey test building” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 接頭試驗證明單一接頭，系統試驗則檢查整棟建築中樓板、接頭、牆與構架是否協同運作。1999 年在加州大學聖地牙哥分校完成的 PRESSS 五層預鑄試驗建築，以約 60% 縮尺在同一棟試驗建築的兩個方向分別放入多種預鑄構架與接合式剪力牆系統，以擬動態方式施加逐級增大的地震，驗證了混合構架與接合式牆的自復位與低損傷表現，後續影響了 ACI 規範與 The Paramount 等建築。縮尺試驗必須了解相似律，才能把試驗力量換回實尺度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「PRESSS 五層試驗建築」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint tests prove single connections; system tests check that floors, joints, walls and frames work together in a whole building. The PRESSS five-storey precast test building, completed at the University of California, San Diego in 1999 at about 60% scale, placed several precast frame types in one direction and a jointed shear-wall system in the other, applied earthquakes of increasing intensity pseudodynamically, and demonstrated the self-centring, low-damage behaviour of hybrid frames and jointed walls, later influencing ACI provisions and buildings such as The Paramount. Scaled tests require an understanding of similitude to convert test forces back to full scale. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “PRESSS five-storey test building” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以相同材料做縮尺 λ = 0.6 的試驗：應力相同，力量比 λ² = 0.36、彎矩比 λ³ ≈ 0.216。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a test at scale λ = 0.6 with the same materials, stresses are equal, forces scale by λ² = 0.36 and moments by λ³ ≈ 0.216.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「縮尺試驗的力量直接乘上縮尺比就能換回實尺度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Scaled-test forces convert to full scale by multiplying by the scale factor alone." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「PRESSS 五層試驗建築」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “PRESSS five-storey test building”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律
knowledge.titleEn: Large system tests and scaling similitude
knowledge.text: 接頭試驗證明單一接頭，系統試驗則檢查整棟建築中樓板、接頭、牆與構架是否協同運作。1999 年在加州大學聖地牙哥分校完成的 PRESSS 五層預鑄試驗建築，以約 60% 縮尺在同一棟試驗建築的兩個方向分別放入多種預鑄構架與接合式剪力牆系統，以擬動態方式施加逐級增大的地震，驗證了混合構架與接合式牆的自復位與低損傷表現，後續影響了 ACI 規範與 The Paramount 等建築。
knowledge.textEn: Joint tests prove single connections; system tests check that floors, joints, walls and frames work together in a whole building. The PRESSS five-storey precast test building, completed at the University of California, San Diego in 1999 at about 60% scale, placed several precast frame types in one direction and a jointed shear-wall system in the other, applied earthquakes of increasing intensity pseudodynamically, and demonstrated the self-centring, low-damage behaviour of hybrid frames and jointed walls, later influencing ACI provisions and buildings such as The Paramount.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：縮尺試驗的力量直接乘上縮尺比就能換回實尺度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Scaled-test forces convert to full scale by multiplying by the scale factor alone. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Large system tests and scaling similitude" is correct?
options: 縮尺試驗的力量直接乘上縮尺比就能換回實尺度。
接頭被混凝土包住後就安全了，不需要再檢測。
接頭試驗證明單一接頭，系統試驗則檢查整棟建築中樓板、接頭、牆與構架是否協同運作。
optionsEn: Scaled-test forces convert to full scale by multiplying by the scale factor alone.
Once a connection is encased in concrete it is safe and needs no further testing.
Joint tests prove single connections; system tests check that floors, joints, walls and frames work together in a whole building.
quiz.explanation: 接頭試驗證明單一接頭，系統試驗則檢查整棟建築中樓板、接頭、牆與構架是否協同運作。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint tests prove single connections; system tests check that floors, joints, walls and frames work together in a whole building. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Large system tests and scaling similitude: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「PRESSS 五層試驗建築」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “PRESSS five-storey test building” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以相同材料做縮尺 λ = 0.6 的試驗：應力相同，力量比 λ² = 0.36、彎矩比 λ³ ≈ 0.216。實尺度梁端彎矩 420 kN·m 在試體中只有約 0.216×420 ≈ 91 kN·m，實尺度預力 1,200 kN 對應約 0.36×1,200 ≈ 432 kN；層間變位比則與實尺度相同。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a test at scale λ = 0.6 with the same materials, stresses are equal, forces scale by λ² = 0.36 and moments by λ³ ≈ 0.216. A full-scale beam-end moment of 420 kN·m becomes about 0.216×420 ≈ 91 kN·m in the specimen and a full-scale prestress of 1,200 kN about 0.36×1,200 ≈ 432 kN, while drift ratios are the same as at full scale. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查系統試驗的縮尺比、材料與鋼筋尺寸是否一致縮放，擬動態試驗的質量與地震紀錄時間軸如何處理，並把試驗的變位、殘留變位與損傷照片換算回實尺度，與設計假設比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the scale of a system test, whether materials and bar sizes were scaled consistently, how mass and the earthquake time axis were handled in pseudodynamic testing, and convert drifts, residual drifts and damage photographs back to full scale for comparison with design assumptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以相同材料做縮尺 λ = 0.6 的試驗：應力相同，力量比 λ² = 0.36、彎矩比 λ³ ≈ 0.216。實尺度梁端彎矩 420 kN·m 在試體中只有約 0.216×420 ≈ 91 kN·m，實尺度預力 1,200 kN 對應約 0.36×1,200 ≈ 432 kN；層間變位比則與實尺度相同。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a test at scale λ = 0.6 with the same materials, stresses are equal, forces scale by λ² = 0.36 and moments by λ³ ≈ 0.216. A full-scale beam-end moment of 420 kN·m becomes about 0.216×420 ≈ 91 kN·m in the specimen and a full-scale prestress of 1,200 kN about 0.36×1,200 ≈ 432 kN, while drift ratios are the same as at full scale. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Large system tests and scaling similitude", which statement holds?
options: 以相同材料做縮尺 λ = 0.6 的試驗：應力相同，力量比 λ² = 0.36、彎矩比 λ³ ≈ 0.216。
預鑄構件本身強度足夠，接頭只要能承受重力就好。
混合接頭的鋼腱也應該灌漿黏結，這樣才更安全。
optionsEn: For a test at scale λ = 0.6 with the same materials, stresses are equal, forces scale by λ² = 0.36 and moments by λ³ ≈ 0.216.
If precast members are strong enough, connections only need to carry gravity loads.
Tendons in a hybrid joint should also be grouted and bonded, because that is safer.
quiz.explanation: 以相同材料做縮尺 λ = 0.6 的試驗：應力相同，力量比 λ² = 0.36、彎矩比 λ³ ≈ 0.216。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a test at scale λ = 0.6 with the same materials, stresses are equal, forces scale by λ² = 0.36 and moments by λ³ ≈ 0.216. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Large system tests and scaling similitude: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「PRESSS 五層試驗建築」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “PRESSS five-storey test building” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查系統試驗的縮尺比、材料與鋼筋尺寸是否一致縮放，擬動態試驗的質量與地震紀錄時間軸如何處理，並把試驗的變位、殘留變位與損傷照片換算回實尺度，與設計假設比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the scale of a system test, whether materials and bar sizes were scaled consistently, how mass and the earthquake time axis were handled in pseudodynamic testing, and convert drifts, residual drifts and damage photographs back to full scale for comparison with design assumptions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：引用系統試驗作為設計依據時，在計算書中說明縮尺、相似律換算與適用範圍；實際工程的樓板與梁接合方式應與試驗一致，否則須評估開口行為對樓板的影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When citing a system test as design basis, explain the scale, similitude conversion and range of applicability in the calculations; the project's floor-to-beam connection should match the test, or the effect of gap opening on the floor must be assessed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若縮尺試驗的鋼筋直徑、粗骨材或灌漿厚度沒有按比例縮小，黏結與錨碇行為與實尺度不同，試驗可能高估或低估接頭韌性；忽略樓板對梁的束制，則系統試驗中觀察到的開口行為不會出現在設計分析中。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If bar diameters, coarse aggregate or grout thickness are not scaled in proportion, bond and anchorage differ from full scale and the test may over- or underestimate joint ductility; ignoring floor restraint on beams means the gap behaviour seen in system tests is missing from design analysis. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查系統試驗的縮尺比、材料與鋼筋尺寸是否一致縮放，擬動態試驗的質量與地震紀錄時間軸如何處理，並把試驗的變位、殘留變位與損傷照片換算回實尺度，與設計假設比較。
knowledge.textEn: Check the scale of a system test, whether materials and bar sizes were scaled consistently, how mass and the earthquake time axis were handled in pseudodynamic testing, and convert drifts, residual drifts and damage photographs back to full scale for comparison with design assumptions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 引用系統試驗作為設計依據時，在計算書中說明縮尺、相似律換算與適用範圍；實際工程的樓板與梁接合方式應與試驗一致，否則須評估開口行為對樓板的影響。
knowledge.textEn: When citing a system test as design basis, explain the scale, similitude conversion and range of applicability in the calculations; the project's floor-to-beam connection should match the test, or the effect of gap opening on the floor must be assessed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Large system tests and scaling similitude"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
檢查系統試驗的縮尺比、材料與鋼筋尺寸是否一致縮放，擬動態試驗的質量與地震紀錄時間軸如何處理，並把試驗的變位、殘留變位與損傷照片換算回實尺度，與設計假設比較。
預鑄構件很重，放上去之後自己就很穩，不需要臨時斜撐。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Check the scale of a system test, whether materials and bar sizes were scaled consistently, how mass and the earthquake time axis were handled in pseudodynamic testing, and convert drifts, residual drifts and damage photographs back to full scale for comparison with design assumptions.
Precast members are heavy, so once set they are stable without temporary bracing.
quiz.explanation: 檢查系統試驗的縮尺比、材料與鋼筋尺寸是否一致縮放，擬動態試驗的質量與地震紀錄時間軸如何處理，並把試驗的變位、殘留變位與損傷照片換算回實尺度，與設計假設比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the scale of a system test, whether materials and bar sizes were scaled consistently, how mass and the earthquake time axis were handled in pseudodynamic testing, and convert drifts, residual drifts and damage photographs back to full scale for comparison with design assumptions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Large system tests and scaling similitude: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「PRESSS 五層試驗建築」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “PRESSS five-storey test building” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若縮尺試驗的鋼筋直徑、粗骨材或灌漿厚度沒有按比例縮小，黏結與錨碇行為與實尺度不同，試驗可能高估或低估接頭韌性；忽略樓板對梁的束制，則系統試驗中觀察到的開口行為不會出現在設計分析中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If bar diameters, coarse aggregate or grout thickness are not scaled in proportion, bond and anchorage differ from full scale and the test may over- or underestimate joint ductility; ignoring floor restraint on beams means the gap behaviour seen in system tests is missing from design analysis. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：縮尺試驗必須了解相似律，才能把試驗力量換回實尺度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Scaled tests require an understanding of similitude to convert test forces back to full scale.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「縮尺試驗的力量直接乘上縮尺比就能換回實尺度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Scaled-test forces convert to full scale by multiplying by the scale factor alone." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若縮尺試驗的鋼筋直徑、粗骨材或灌漿厚度沒有按比例縮小，黏結與錨碇行為與實尺度不同，試驗可能高估或低估接頭韌性；忽略樓板對梁的束制，則系統試驗中觀察到的開口行為不會出現在設計分析中。
knowledge.textEn: If bar diameters, coarse aggregate or grout thickness are not scaled in proportion, bond and anchorage differ from full scale and the test may over- or underestimate joint ductility; ignoring floor restraint on beams means the gap behaviour seen in system tests is missing from design analysis.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Large system tests and scaling similitude" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
接頭被混凝土包住後就安全了，不需要再檢測。
若縮尺試驗的鋼筋直徑、粗骨材或灌漿厚度沒有按比例縮小，黏結與錨碇行為與實尺度不同，試驗可能高估或低估接頭韌性。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once a connection is encased in concrete it is safe and needs no further testing.
If bar diameters, coarse aggregate or grout thickness are not scaled in proportion, bond and anchorage differ from full scale and the test may over- or underestimate joint ductility.
quiz.explanation: 若縮尺試驗的鋼筋直徑、粗骨材或灌漿厚度沒有按比例縮小，黏結與錨碇行為與實尺度不同，試驗可能高估或低估接頭韌性；忽略樓板對梁的束制，則系統試驗中觀察到的開口行為不會出現在設計分析中。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If bar diameters, coarse aggregate or grout thickness are not scaled in proportion, bond and anchorage differ from full scale and the test may over- or underestimate joint ductility; ignoring floor restraint on beams means the gap behaviour seen in system tests is missing from design analysis. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「隱蔽接頭的檢測與灌漿缺陷」與「震後評估、預力復驗與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Inspection of hidden connections and grouting defects" and "Post-earthquake assessment, prestress checks and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 隱蔽接頭的檢測與灌漿缺陷：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Inspection of hidden connections and grouting defects: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「套筒灌漿非破壞檢測」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Non-destructive testing of sleeve grout” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預鑄接頭最難管理的是隱蔽在混凝土內的部分：灌漿套筒、預力套管、預埋鋼板與焊接接合器，一旦封閉就無法目視。檢測必須在施工中留下紀錄，並在完工後以非破壞方法抽查，例如超音波、X 光或衝擊回音法檢測套筒灌漿飽滿度，內視鏡檢查預力套管，鋼筋掃描確認預埋件位置。使用期間則以防水、防蝕與定期檢查維持外露接合器與預埋鋼板的狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「套筒灌漿非破壞檢測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The hardest part of precast connections to manage is what lies hidden inside concrete: grouted sleeves, post-tensioning ducts, embedded plates and welded connectors cannot be seen once closed. Inspection must leave records during construction and be followed by non-destructive sampling after completion, for example ultrasonic, X-ray or impact-echo checks of sleeve grout fill, borescopes in post-tensioning ducts and cover scanning to locate embeds. In service, waterproofing, corrosion protection and periodic inspection maintain exposed connectors and embedded plates. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Non-destructive testing of sleeve grout” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：套筒每側埋入 512 mm，若灌漿只填滿 70%，有效埋入 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm，低於發展鋼筋抗拉強度所需的 413 mm，續接器只能發展約 358/413 ≈ 87% 的鋼筋強度，柱底在塑性鉸形成前就可能拔出。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 512 mm of embedment per side, a sleeve only 70% filled offers 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm, below the 413 mm needed to develop the bar's tensile strength, so the splice develops only about 358/413 ≈ 87% of bar strength and the column base may pull out before a plastic hinge forms.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接頭被混凝土包住後就安全了，不需要再檢測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a connection is encased in concrete it is safe and needs no further testing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「套筒灌漿非破壞檢測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Non-destructive testing of sleeve grout”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隱蔽接頭的檢測與灌漿缺陷
knowledge.titleEn: Inspection of hidden connections and grouting defects
knowledge.text: 預鑄接頭最難管理的是隱蔽在混凝土內的部分：灌漿套筒、預力套管、預埋鋼板與焊接接合器，一旦封閉就無法目視。檢測必須在施工中留下紀錄，並在完工後以非破壞方法抽查，例如超音波、X 光或衝擊回音法檢測套筒灌漿飽滿度，內視鏡檢查預力套管，鋼筋掃描確認預埋件位置。
knowledge.textEn: The hardest part of precast connections to manage is what lies hidden inside concrete: grouted sleeves, post-tensioning ducts, embedded plates and welded connectors cannot be seen once closed. Inspection must leave records during construction and be followed by non-destructive sampling after completion, for example ultrasonic, X-ray or impact-echo checks of sleeve grout fill, borescopes in post-tensioning ducts and cover scanning to locate embeds.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接頭被混凝土包住後就安全了，不需要再檢測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a connection is encased in concrete it is safe and needs no further testing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「隱蔽接頭的檢測與灌漿缺陷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Inspection of hidden connections and grouting defects" is correct?
options: 預鑄接頭最難管理的是隱蔽在混凝土內的部分：灌漿套筒、預力套管、預埋鋼板與焊接接合器，一旦封閉就無法目視。
接頭被混凝土包住後就安全了，不需要再檢測。
預力是永久的，震後不需要再確認。
optionsEn: The hardest part of precast connections to manage is what lies hidden inside concrete: grouted sleeves, post-tensioning ducts, embedded plates and welded connectors cannot be seen once closed.
Once a connection is encased in concrete it is safe and needs no further testing.
Prestress is permanent and needs no checking after an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 預鑄接頭最難管理的是隱蔽在混凝土內的部分：灌漿套筒、預力套管、預埋鋼板與焊接接合器，一旦封閉就無法目視。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The hardest part of precast connections to manage is what lies hidden inside concrete: grouted sleeves, post-tensioning ducts, embedded plates and welded connectors cannot be seen once closed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 隱蔽接頭的檢測與灌漿缺陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inspection of hidden connections and grouting defects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「套筒灌漿非破壞檢測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Non-destructive testing of sleeve grout” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：套筒每側埋入 512 mm，若灌漿只填滿 70%，有效埋入 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm，低於發展鋼筋抗拉強度所需的 413 mm，續接器只能發展約 358/413 ≈ 87% 的鋼筋強度，柱底在塑性鉸形成前就可能拔出。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 512 mm of embedment per side, a sleeve only 70% filled offers 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm, below the 413 mm needed to develop the bar's tensile strength, so the splice develops only about 358/413 ≈ 87% of bar strength and the column base may pull out before a plastic hinge forms. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依抽樣計畫對灌漿套筒做非破壞檢測（例如每層一定比例，發現缺陷即擴大抽樣），可疑者以鑽孔內視或補灌確認；檢測結果與施工灌漿紀錄對照，並把缺陷位置與處置寫入竣工資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Apply non-destructive testing to grouted sleeves according to a sampling plan, for example a set proportion per floor with expanded sampling when defects appear, confirming suspect sleeves by drilled borescope inspection or regrouting; compare results with grouting logs and record defect locations and treatment in the as-built records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 套筒每側埋入 512 mm，若灌漿只填滿 70%，有效埋入 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm，低於發展鋼筋抗拉強度所需的 413 mm，續接器只能發展約 358/413 ≈ 87% 的鋼筋強度，柱底在塑性鉸形成前就可能拔出。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 512 mm of embedment per side, a sleeve only 70% filled offers 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm, below the 413 mm needed to develop the bar's tensile strength, so the splice develops only about 358/413 ≈ 87% of bar strength and the column base may pull out before a plastic hinge forms. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「隱蔽接頭的檢測與灌漿缺陷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Inspection of hidden connections and grouting defects", which statement holds?
options: 接頭的耗能鋼筋越多越好，因為吸收的能量越多。
套筒每側埋入 512 mm，若灌漿只填滿 70%，有效埋入 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm，低於發展鋼筋抗拉強度所需的 413 mm，續接器只能發展約 358/413 ≈ 87% 的鋼筋強度，柱底在塑性鉸形成前就可能拔出。
灌漿套筒只要灌了漿就一定合格，不需要逐支檢查。
optionsEn: More dissipating steel in the joint is always better because it absorbs more energy.

With 512 mm of embedment per side, a sleeve only 70% filled offers 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm, below the 413 mm needed to develop the bar's tensile strength, so the splice develops only about 358/413 ≈ 87% of bar strength and the column base may pull out before a plastic hinge forms.
A grouted sleeve is acceptable as soon as grout goes in, with no need to check each one.
quiz.explanation: 套筒每側埋入 512 mm，若灌漿只填滿 70%，有效埋入 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm，低於發展鋼筋抗拉強度所需的 413 mm，續接器只能發展約 358/413 ≈ 87% 的鋼筋強度，柱底在塑性鉸形成前就可能拔出。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 512 mm of embedment per side, a sleeve only 70% filled offers 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm, below the 413 mm needed to develop the bar's tensile strength, so the splice develops only about 358/413 ≈ 87% of bar strength and the column base may pull out before a plastic hinge forms. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 隱蔽接頭的檢測與灌漿缺陷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inspection of hidden connections and grouting defects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「套筒灌漿非破壞檢測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Non-destructive testing of sleeve grout” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依抽樣計畫對灌漿套筒做非破壞檢測（例如每層一定比例，發現缺陷即擴大抽樣），可疑者以鑽孔內視或補灌確認；檢測結果與施工灌漿紀錄對照，並把缺陷位置與處置寫入竣工資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Apply non-destructive testing to grouted sleeves according to a sampling plan, for example a set proportion per floor with expanded sampling when defects appear, confirming suspect sleeves by drilled borescope inspection or regrouting; compare results with grouting logs and record defect locations and treatment in the as-built records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工規範應規定隱蔽接頭的紀錄格式、非破壞檢測的抽樣比例與擴大抽樣條件，並由獨立檢驗單位執行；外露接合器須有防蝕塗裝與定期檢查週期。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should set record formats for hidden connections, NDT sampling rates and triggers for expanded sampling, carried out by an independent inspection body; exposed connectors need protective coatings and periodic inspection intervals.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只依賴施工人員的口頭確認而沒有紀錄與抽查，灌漿缺陷可能大量存在而無人知曉，直到地震時多根柱同時在柱底拔出；外露的焊接接合器在停車場等潮濕環境中鏽蝕，斷面減少使隔板傳力能力下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Relying on verbal assurances without records or sampling can leave widespread grouting defects unknown until an earthquake pulls out many column bases at once; exposed welded connectors in damp environments such as car parks corrode, losing section and diaphragm capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依抽樣計畫對灌漿套筒做非破壞檢測（例如每層一定比例，發現缺陷即擴大抽樣），可疑者以鑽孔內視或補灌確認；檢測結果與施工灌漿紀錄對照，並把缺陷位置與處置寫入竣工資料。
knowledge.textEn: Apply non-destructive testing to grouted sleeves according to a sampling plan, for example a set proportion per floor with expanded sampling when defects appear, confirming suspect sleeves by drilled borescope inspection or regrouting; compare results with grouting logs and record defect locations and treatment in the as-built records.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工規範應規定隱蔽接頭的紀錄格式、非破壞檢測的抽樣比例與擴大抽樣條件，並由獨立檢驗單位執行；外露接合器須有防蝕塗裝與定期檢查週期。
knowledge.textEn: The specification should set record formats for hidden connections, NDT sampling rates and triggers for expanded sampling, carried out by an independent inspection body; exposed connectors need protective coatings and periodic inspection intervals.

quiz.question: 要驗證「隱蔽接頭的檢測與灌漿缺陷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inspection of hidden connections and grouting defects"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
預鑄樓梯兩端都固定比較牢靠，地震時比較安全。
依抽樣計畫對灌漿套筒做非破壞檢測（例如每層一定比例，發現缺陷即擴大抽樣），可疑者以鑽孔內視或補灌確認。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Fixing both ends of a precast stair is sturdier and safer in an earthquake.

Apply non-destructive testing to grouted sleeves according to a sampling plan, for example a set proportion per floor with expanded sampling when defects appear, confirming suspect sleeves by drilled borescope inspection or regrouting.
quiz.explanation: 依抽樣計畫對灌漿套筒做非破壞檢測（例如每層一定比例，發現缺陷即擴大抽樣），可疑者以鑽孔內視或補灌確認；檢測結果與施工灌漿紀錄對照，並把缺陷位置與處置寫入竣工資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Apply non-destructive testing to grouted sleeves according to a sampling plan, for example a set proportion per floor with expanded sampling when defects appear, confirming suspect sleeves by drilled borescope inspection or regrouting; compare results with grouting logs and record defect locations and treatment in the as-built records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 隱蔽接頭的檢測與灌漿缺陷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inspection of hidden connections and grouting defects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「套筒灌漿非破壞檢測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Non-destructive testing of sleeve grout” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只依賴施工人員的口頭確認而沒有紀錄與抽查，灌漿缺陷可能大量存在而無人知曉，直到地震時多根柱同時在柱底拔出；外露的焊接接合器在停車場等潮濕環境中鏽蝕，斷面減少使隔板傳力能力下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Relying on verbal assurances without records or sampling can leave widespread grouting defects unknown until an earthquake pulls out many column bases at once; exposed welded connectors in damp environments such as car parks corrode, losing section and diaphragm capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用期間則以防水、防蝕與定期檢查維持外露接合器與預埋鋼板的狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In service, waterproofing, corrosion protection and periodic inspection maintain exposed connectors and embedded plates.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接頭被混凝土包住後就安全了，不需要再檢測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a connection is encased in concrete it is safe and needs no further testing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只依賴施工人員的口頭確認而沒有紀錄與抽查，灌漿缺陷可能大量存在而無人知曉，直到地震時多根柱同時在柱底拔出；外露的焊接接合器在停車場等潮濕環境中鏽蝕，斷面減少使隔板傳力能力下降。
knowledge.textEn: Relying on verbal assurances without records or sampling can leave widespread grouting defects unknown until an earthquake pulls out many column bases at once; exposed welded connectors in damp environments such as car parks corrode, losing section and diaphragm capacity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「隱蔽接頭的檢測與灌漿缺陷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inspection of hidden connections and grouting defects" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只依賴施工人員的口頭確認而沒有紀錄與抽查，灌漿缺陷可能大量存在而無人知曉，直到地震時多根柱同時在柱底拔出。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
預力是永久的，震後不需要再確認。
optionsEn: Relying on verbal assurances without records or sampling can leave widespread grouting defects unknown until an earthquake pulls out many column bases at once.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Prestress is permanent and needs no checking after an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 若只依賴施工人員的口頭確認而沒有紀錄與抽查，灌漿缺陷可能大量存在而無人知曉，直到地震時多根柱同時在柱底拔出；外露的焊接接合器在停車場等潮濕環境中鏽蝕，斷面減少使隔板傳力能力下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Relying on verbal assurances without records or sampling can leave widespread grouting defects unknown until an earthquake pulls out many column bases at once; exposed welded connectors in damp environments such as car parks corrode, losing section and diaphragm capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 震後評估、預力復驗與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake assessment, prestress checks and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預力浮升檢驗」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Prestress lift-off check” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 接合式預鑄建築的優點是震後損傷少、可快速復原，但必須證明預力仍在、縫已閉合、樓梯與樓板支承未移位。震後檢查要量測殘留層間變位、梁端殘留開口、軟鋼脫黏段附近的混凝土狀態，並以千斤頂浮升試驗確認鋼腱預力；等同現澆的接頭則檢查柱底與梁端塑性鉸區裂縫與剝落。交接文件需記錄每種接頭的位置、型式、預力值與檢測紀錄，讓未來的評估有依據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預力浮升檢驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The advantage of jointed precast buildings is little damage and quick recovery after an earthquake, but engineers must prove that prestress remains, gaps have closed and stair and floor seats have not shifted. Post-earthquake inspection measures residual drift and residual gap at beam ends, examines concrete near the debonded mild-steel zones and confirms tendon force by jack lift-off tests; emulative joints are checked for cracking and spalling in column-base and beam-end hinge zones. Handover records must document every connection's location, type, prestress and inspection results to support future assessments. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Prestress lift-off check” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：浮升試驗以千斤頂活塞面積 0.030 m² 量測：設計預力 1,200 kN 對應 40 MPa 油壓；若錨碇在 34 MPa 時浮升，實際預力約 0.030×34,000 ≈ 1,020 kN，損失約 15%，λ 由 1.45 降到約 1.45×0.85 ≈ 1.23，仍大於 1，但應評估是否重新施拉。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A lift-off test uses a jack with 0.030 m² piston area: the design prestress of 1,200 kN corresponds to 40 MPa; if the anchorage lifts off at 34 MPa, the actual force is about 0.030×34,000 ≈ 1,020 kN, a loss of about 15%, so λ falls from 1.45 to about 1.45×0.85 ≈ 1.23, still above 1 but warranting assessment for restressing.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預力是永久的，震後不需要再確認。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Prestress is permanent and needs no checking after an earthquake." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預力浮升檢驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Prestress lift-off check”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 震後評估、預力復驗與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Post-earthquake assessment, prestress checks and handover
knowledge.text: 接合式預鑄建築的優點是震後損傷少、可快速復原，但必須證明預力仍在、縫已閉合、樓梯與樓板支承未移位。震後檢查要量測殘留層間變位、梁端殘留開口、軟鋼脫黏段附近的混凝土狀態，並以千斤頂浮升試驗確認鋼腱預力；等同現澆的接頭則檢查柱底與梁端塑性鉸區裂縫與剝落。
knowledge.textEn: The advantage of jointed precast buildings is little damage and quick recovery after an earthquake, but engineers must prove that prestress remains, gaps have closed and stair and floor seats have not shifted. Post-earthquake inspection measures residual drift and residual gap at beam ends, examines concrete near the debonded mild-steel zones and confirms tendon force by jack lift-off tests; emulative joints are checked for cracking and spalling in column-base and beam-end hinge zones.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預力是永久的，震後不需要再確認。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Prestress is permanent and needs no checking after an earthquake. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「震後評估、預力復驗與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-earthquake assessment, prestress checks and handover" is correct?
options: 預力是永久的，震後不需要再確認。
接合式預鑄建築的優點是震後損傷少、可快速復原，但必須證明預力仍在、縫已閉合、樓梯與樓板支承未移位。
預鑄構件本身強度足夠，接頭只要能承受重力就好。
optionsEn: Prestress is permanent and needs no checking after an earthquake.

The advantage of jointed precast buildings is little damage and quick recovery after an earthquake, but engineers must prove that prestress remains, gaps have closed and stair and floor seats have not shifted.
If precast members are strong enough, connections only need to carry gravity loads.
quiz.explanation: 接合式預鑄建築的優點是震後損傷少、可快速復原，但必須證明預力仍在、縫已閉合、樓梯與樓板支承未移位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The advantage of jointed precast buildings is little damage and quick recovery after an earthquake, but engineers must prove that prestress remains, gaps have closed and stair and floor seats have not shifted. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 震後評估、預力復驗與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake assessment, prestress checks and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預力浮升檢驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Prestress lift-off check” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：浮升試驗以千斤頂活塞面積 0.030 m² 量測：設計預力 1,200 kN 對應 40 MPa 油壓；若錨碇在 34 MPa 時浮升，實際預力約 0.030×34,000 ≈ 1,020 kN，損失約 15%，λ 由 1.45 降到約 1.45×0.85 ≈ 1.23，仍大於 1，但應評估是否重新施拉。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A lift-off test uses a jack with 0.030 m² piston area: the design prestress of 1,200 kN corresponds to 40 MPa; if the anchorage lifts off at 34 MPa, the actual force is about 0.030×34,000 ≈ 1,020 kN, a loss of about 15%, so λ falls from 1.45 to about 1.45×0.85 ≈ 1.23, still above 1 but warranting assessment for restressing. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：地震後依檢查表量測各層殘留變位、梁端開口、樓梯支承位移與間隙，抽樣做預力浮升試驗並與完工基準比較；預力損失或殘留變位超過允許值時，由結構技師評估重新施拉、更換軟鋼或其他修復。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After an earthquake, follow a checklist to measure residual drift, beam-end gaps, stair seat movement and gaps on each floor, and lift-off-test sample tendons against completion baselines; where prestress loss or residual drift exceeds limits, the structural engineer assesses restressing, mild-steel replacement or other repairs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 浮升試驗以千斤頂活塞面積 0.030 m² 量測：設計預力 1,200 kN 對應 40 MPa 油壓；若錨碇在 34 MPa 時浮升，實際預力約 0.030×34,000 ≈ 1,020 kN，損失約 15%，λ 由 1.45 降到約 1.45×0.85 ≈ 1.23，仍大於 1，但應評估是否重新施拉。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A lift-off test uses a jack with 0.030 m² piston area: the design prestress of 1,200 kN corresponds to 40 MPa; if the anchorage lifts off at 34 MPa, the actual force is about 0.030×34,000 ≈ 1,020 kN, a loss of about 15%, so λ falls from 1.45 to about 1.45×0.85 ≈ 1.23, still above 1 but warranting assessment for restressing. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「震後評估、預力復驗與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-earthquake assessment, prestress checks and handover", which statement holds?
options: 混合接頭的鋼腱也應該灌漿黏結，這樣才更安全。
預鑄構件很重，放上去之後自己就很穩，不需要臨時斜撐。
浮升試驗以千斤頂活塞面積 0.030 m² 量測：設計預力 1,200 kN 對應 40 MPa 油壓。
optionsEn: Tendons in a hybrid joint should also be grouted and bonded, because that is safer.
Precast members are heavy, so once set they are stable without temporary bracing.
A lift-off test uses a jack with 0.030 m² piston area: the design prestress of 1,200 kN corresponds to 40 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 浮升試驗以千斤頂活塞面積 0.030 m² 量測：設計預力 1,200 kN 對應 40 MPa 油壓；若錨碇在 34 MPa 時浮升，實際預力約 0.030×34,000 ≈ 1,020 kN，損失約 15%，λ 由 1.45 降到約 1.45×0.85 ≈ 1.23，仍大於 1，但應評估是否重新施拉。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A lift-off test uses a jack with 0.030 m² piston area: the design prestress of 1,200 kN corresponds to 40 MPa; if the anchorage lifts off at 34 MPa, the actual force is about 0.030×34,000 ≈ 1,020 kN, a loss of about 15%, so λ falls from 1.45 to about 1.45×0.85 ≈ 1.23, still above 1 but warranting assessment for restressing. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 震後評估、預力復驗與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake assessment, prestress checks and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預力浮升檢驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Prestress lift-off check” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 地震後依檢查表量測各層殘留變位、梁端開口、樓梯支承位移與間隙，抽樣做預力浮升試驗並與完工基準比較；預力損失或殘留變位超過允許值時，由結構技師評估重新施拉、更換軟鋼或其他修復。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After an earthquake, follow a checklist to measure residual drift, beam-end gaps, stair seat movement and gaps on each floor, and lift-off-test sample tendons against completion baselines; where prestress loss or residual drift exceeds limits, the structural engineer assesses restressing, mild-steel replacement or other repairs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含接頭型式與位置圖、預力施拉與浮升基準、灌漿與非破壞檢測紀錄、樓梯滑動端與間隙紀錄、震後檢查表，並規定錨碇保護蓋可拆除檢查；任何改裝影響接頭或樓梯間隙前須經結構技師核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include connection type and location plans, stressing and lift-off baselines, grouting and NDT records, stair sliding-end and gap records and the post-earthquake checklist, and require removable anchorage caps for inspection; any alteration affecting connections or stair gaps needs prior structural engineer approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若完工時沒有記錄預力基準與錨碇可檢查的設計，震後無法確認預力是否損失，只能保守地長期停用；樓梯支承在地震中移位卻未被檢查，下一次地震或日常使用中才突然崩落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without completion baselines for prestress and inspectable anchorages, nobody can confirm after an earthquake whether prestress was lost, forcing long conservative closures; stair seats displaced in an earthquake but never checked may collapse suddenly in the next event or in daily use. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 地震後依檢查表量測各層殘留變位、梁端開口、樓梯支承位移與間隙，抽樣做預力浮升試驗並與完工基準比較；預力損失或殘留變位超過允許值時，由結構技師評估重新施拉、更換軟鋼或其他修復。
knowledge.textEn: After an earthquake, follow a checklist to measure residual drift, beam-end gaps, stair seat movement and gaps on each floor, and lift-off-test sample tendons against completion baselines; where prestress loss or residual drift exceeds limits, the structural engineer assesses restressing, mild-steel replacement or other repairs.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含接頭型式與位置圖、預力施拉與浮升基準、灌漿與非破壞檢測紀錄、樓梯滑動端與間隙紀錄、震後檢查表，並規定錨碇保護蓋可拆除檢查；任何改裝影響接頭或樓梯間隙前須經結構技師核可。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include connection type and location plans, stressing and lift-off baselines, grouting and NDT records, stair sliding-end and gap records and the post-earthquake checklist, and require removable anchorage caps for inspection; any alteration affecting connections or stair gaps needs prior structural engineer approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「震後評估、預力復驗與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-earthquake assessment, prestress checks and handover"?
options: 地震後依檢查表量測各層殘留變位、梁端開口、樓梯支承位移與間隙，抽樣做預力浮升試驗並與完工基準比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要試體的最大承載力達到設計值，接頭就算通過試驗。
optionsEn: After an earthquake, follow a checklist to measure residual drift, beam-end gaps, stair seat movement and gaps on each floor, and lift-off-test sample tendons against completion baselines.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A joint passes testing as soon as the specimen reaches its design peak strength.
quiz.explanation: 地震後依檢查表量測各層殘留變位、梁端開口、樓梯支承位移與間隙，抽樣做預力浮升試驗並與完工基準比較；預力損失或殘留變位超過允許值時，由結構技師評估重新施拉、更換軟鋼或其他修復。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After an earthquake, follow a checklist to measure residual drift, beam-end gaps, stair seat movement and gaps on each floor, and lift-off-test sample tendons against completion baselines; where prestress loss or residual drift exceeds limits, the structural engineer assesses restressing, mild-steel replacement or other repairs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 震後評估、預力復驗與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake assessment, prestress checks and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預力浮升檢驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Prestress lift-off check” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若完工時沒有記錄預力基準與錨碇可檢查的設計，震後無法確認預力是否損失，只能保守地長期停用；樓梯支承在地震中移位卻未被檢查，下一次地震或日常使用中才突然崩落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without completion baselines for prestress and inspectable anchorages, nobody can confirm after an earthquake whether prestress was lost, forcing long conservative closures; stair seats displaced in an earthquake but never checked may collapse suddenly in the next event or in daily use. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件需記錄每種接頭的位置、型式、預力值與檢測紀錄，讓未來的評估有依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover records must document every connection's location, type, prestress and inspection results to support future assessments.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預力是永久的，震後不需要再確認。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Prestress is permanent and needs no checking after an earthquake." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「震後評估、預力復驗與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

預鑄構件本身強度足夠，接頭只要能承受重力就好。

title: 預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋
summary: 從雙 T 梁斷面與屋頂荷載路徑出發，計算預力反拱與長期撓度、缺口梁端吊筋與水平束制力、翼板連接器的隔板剪力，再處理吊裝期間的臨時穩定與連接完成、反拱差與屋面排水、放鬆時端部應力與出廠品質、現場載重試驗，最後談屋面防水與連接器腐蝕、改裝開孔與交接，並以美國職業安全衛生署對邁阿密戴德學院停車場與 Montgomery Mall 雙 T 梁事故的調查報告對照。
summaryEn: Starting from the double-tee section and the roof load path, compute prestress camber and long-term deflection, dapped-end hangers and horizontal restraint forces, and diaphragm shear on flange connectors, then handle temporary stability and completed connections during erection, camber differential and roof drainage, end stresses at transfer and plant quality, and in-situ load testing, and finally roof waterproofing and connector corrosion, alterations and handover, compared with OSHA investigation reports on the Miami Dade College garage and Montgomery Mall double-tee incidents.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：教學雙 T 梁寬 3.0 m、高 800 mm、跨度 24 m，A = 450,000 mm²、I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴、y_b ≈ 508 mm。自重 10.8 kN/m（3.6 kPa），加附加靜載 0.5 kPa 與屋頂活載 1.0 kPa，w_u ≈ 19.56 kN/m，M_u ≈ 1,408 kN·m。配置 12 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、偏心 e ≈ 408 mm，以 f_ps ≈ 1,700 MPa、f'c = 35 MPa 估計 φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m，需求比約 0.80。放鬆時 P_i ≈ 2,016 kN：反拱約 65.7 mm、自重撓度約 51.7 mm，淨反拱約 14 mm；梁端頂部拉應力約 3.5 MPa，超過 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa，需脫黏或折線配置。長期淨反拱只剩約 2 mm，排水坡度須由支承高程提供，並以雨水荷載約 0.74 kPa 檢核。每根腹肋端部反力約 117 kN，缺口吊筋約需 373 mm²。若日後切斷 2 股鋼絞線，φM_n 降為約 1,471 kN·m，需求比升為約 0.96，使用狀態底緣拉應力約 5.2 MPa 會開裂。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際產品或建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a teaching double tee 3.0 m wide and 800 mm deep spans 24 m, with A = 450,000 mm², I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴ and y_b ≈ 508 mm. Self-weight is 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa); with 0.5 kPa superimposed dead load and 1.0 kPa roof live load, w_u ≈ 19.56 kN/m and M_u ≈ 1,408 kN·m. Twelve 15.2 mm strands at e ≈ 408 mm, with f_ps ≈ 1,700 MPa and f'c = 35 MPa, give φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m and a demand ratio of about 0.80. At release P_i ≈ 2,016 kN: camber about 65.7 mm against self-weight deflection about 51.7 mm, a net of about 14 mm; top tension at the ends is about 3.5 MPa, above 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa, so strands must be debonded or harped. Long-term net camber is only about 2 mm, so drainage slope must come from bearing elevations, checked for a rain load of about 0.74 kPa. Each stem end reacts about 117 kN, needing about 373 mm² of dap hanger steel. If 2 strands are later cut, φM_n falls to about 1,471 kN·m, the demand ratio rises to about 0.96 and service bottom tension of about 5.2 MPa cracks the member. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real product or building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑」與「預力反拱與長期撓度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof" and "Prestress camber and long-term deflection": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙 T 梁斷面」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Double-tee section” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙 T 梁由一片薄翼板與兩根腹肋組成：翼板同時是屋面板與受壓區，兩根腹肋內配置預力鋼絞線，像兩根並排的 T 形梁一樣跨越 15 至 30 m 左右的跨度。屋頂荷載包括自重、防水與設備的附加靜載、活載或雪載與積水雨載，經翼板傳到腹肋，再經腹肋端部擱置在倒 T 梁、牆或牛腿上的承壓墊。翼板之間以焊接連接器相連，使整片屋頂成為傳遞風與地震力的隔板。這個系統輕、快、跨度大，但每一個端部與連接器都是關鍵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙 T 梁斷面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A double tee consists of a thin flange and two stems: the flange is both roof deck and compression zone, while prestressing strands in the stems let the unit span roughly 15 to 30 m like two T-beams side by side. Roof loads, namely self-weight, superimposed dead load from roofing and equipment, live or snow load and ponding rain, pass from the flange into the stems and then through bearing pads at the stem ends onto inverted-tee beams, walls or corbels. Flanges are joined by welded connectors so that the whole roof acts as a diaphragm carrying wind and earthquake forces. The system is light, fast and long-spanning, but every end bearing and connector is critical. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Double-tee section” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching section: flange 3,000×50 mm and two stems averaging 200 mm wide and 750 mm deep, 800 mm overall, so A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm² and self-weight 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙 T 梁是工廠標準品，只要選型號就好，不需要針對屋頂荷載重新檢核。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙 T 梁斷面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Double-tee section”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雙 T 梁是工廠標準品，只要選型號就好，不需要針對屋頂荷載重新檢核。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof" is correct?
options: 雙 T 梁是工廠標準品，只要選型號就好，不需要針對屋頂荷載重新檢核。
雙 T 梁由一片薄翼板與兩根腹肋組成：翼板同時是屋面板與受壓區，兩根腹肋內配置預力鋼絞線，像兩根並排的 T 形梁一樣跨越 15 至 30 m 左右的跨度。
預力梁的反拱在出廠後就固定不變。
optionsEn: Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads.

A double tee consists of a thin flange and two stems: the flange is both roof deck and compression zone, while prestressing strands in the stems let the unit span roughly 15 to 30 m like two T-beams side by side.

quiz.explanation: 雙 T 梁由一片薄翼板與兩根腹肋組成：翼板同時是屋面板與受壓區，兩根腹肋內配置預力鋼絞線，像兩根並排的 T 形梁一樣跨越 15 至 30 m 左右的跨度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙 T 梁斷面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Double-tee section” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學斷面：翼板 3,000×50 mm、兩腹肋平均寬 200 mm 高 750 mm，總高 800 mm，A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm²，自重 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m（3.6 kPa）。附加靜載 0.5 kPa、屋頂活載 1.0 kPa、跨度 24 m：w_u = [1.2×(3.6+0.5) + 1.6×1.0]×3.0 ≈ 19.56 kN/m，M_u = 19.56×24²/8 ≈ 1,408 kN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching section: flange 3,000×50 mm and two stems averaging 200 mm wide and 750 mm deep, 800 mm overall, so A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm² and self-weight 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa). With 0.5 kPa superimposed dead load, 1.0 kPa roof live load and a 24 m span: w_u = [1.2×(3.6+0.5) + 1.6×1.0]×3.0 ≈ 19.56 kN/m and M_u = 19.56×24²/8 ≈ 1,408 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：結構計算書要列出每種雙 T 梁型號的跨度、斷面、預力配置、設計荷載與屋頂設備位置，並確認雪載、積水雨載與設備集中荷載都有檢核；屋頂平面圖上標示每片雙 T 梁的編號、方向與支承型式。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The structural calculations should list span, section, strand layout and design loads for every double-tee type, confirming that snow, ponding rain and concentrated equipment loads are checked; the roof plan should show every tee's mark, direction and bearing type.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Teaching section: flange 3,000×50 mm and two stems averaging 200 mm wide and 750 mm deep, 800 mm overall, so A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm² and self-weight 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa). With 0.5 kPa superimposed dead load, 1.0 kPa roof live load and a 24 m span: w_u = [1.2×(3.6+0.5) + 1.6×1.0]×3.0 ≈ 19.56 kN/m and M_u = 19.56×24²/8 ≈ 1,408 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof", which statement holds?
options: 雙 T 梁靠自重壓在支承上就很穩定，翼板連接器只是防止高低差的配件。
屋頂只要有排水孔，就不必考慮積水對結構的影響。
optionsEn: Double tees are stable under their own weight, so flange connectors merely prevent level differences.
As long as a roof has drains, ponding need not be considered structurally.
Teaching section: flange 3,000×50 mm and two stems averaging 200 mm wide and 750 mm deep, 800 mm overall, so A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm² and self-weight 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa).
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching section: flange 3,000×50 mm and two stems averaging 200 mm wide and 750 mm deep, 800 mm overall, so A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm² and self-weight 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙 T 梁斷面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Double-tee section” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 結構計算書要列出每種雙 T 梁型號的跨度、斷面、預力配置、設計荷載與屋頂設備位置，並確認雪載、積水雨載與設備集中荷載都有檢核；屋頂平面圖上標示每片雙 T 梁的編號、方向與支承型式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The structural calculations should list span, section, strand layout and design loads for every double-tee type, confirming that snow, ponding rain and concentrated equipment loads are checked; the roof plan should show every tee's mark, direction and bearing type. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計與機電要在初期就確定屋頂設備的位置與重量，並在雙 T 梁配置圖上標示允許集中荷載區；後續新增設備必須由結構技師檢核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Structural and services teams should fix rooftop equipment locations and weights early and mark allowable concentrated-load zones on the double-tee layout; any later equipment must be checked by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若屋頂設備或增設太陽能板的荷載未納入設計，或排水不良導致積水，腹肋可能出現撓曲裂縫，嚴重時預力鋼絞線屈服；任何一個端部支承失效，整片雙 T 梁就會掉落，因為它沒有其他替代路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If loads from rooftop equipment or added solar panels are left out, or poor drainage lets water pond, the stems can crack in flexure and, in severe cases, strands yield; failure of any single end bearing drops the whole tee, since it has no alternate path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
