steps.instructionEn: Forcing flanges level with heavy clamps or a crane and welding at once leads to connector fatigue fractures under thermal cycling; overflows set higher than designed or blocked by debris let ponding exceed the assumed depth in a downpour, so the tees deflect, collect more water and in severe cases part of the roof collapses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：另一方面，雙 T 梁屋頂的長期淨反拱往往很小，屋面排水坡度若不足，暴雨時積水增加荷載，形成積水—撓度—更多積水的循環，因此屋頂的雨水荷載與排水設計和結構設計密不可分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Moreover, long-term net camber of a double-tee roof is often small, so with too little drainage slope a downpour ponds water, adding load in a ponding–deflection–more-ponding cycle; rain load and drainage design are therefore inseparable from the structural design of the roof.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「屋頂只要有排水孔，就不必考慮積水對結構的影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as a roof has drains, ponding need not be considered structurally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以強力夾具或吊車壓平高差後立即焊接，連接器在溫度循環中疲勞斷裂；屋頂溢流口高於設計或被雜物堵住，暴雨時積水深度超過假設，雙 T 梁撓度增加又積更多水，嚴重時導致局部屋頂崩塌。
knowledge.textEn: Forcing flanges level with heavy clamps or a crane and welding at once leads to connector fatigue fractures under thermal cycling; overflows set higher than designed or blocked by debris let ponding exceed the assumed depth in a downpour, so the tees deflect, collect more water and in severe cases part of the roof collapses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「反拱差調整與屋面排水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Camber differential and roof drainage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 以強力夾具或吊車壓平高差後立即焊接，連接器在溫度循環中疲勞斷裂。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
預力梁最危險的狀態是滿載使用時，放鬆時不需要特別檢查。
optionsEn: Forcing flanges level with heavy clamps or a crane and welding at once leads to connector fatigue fractures under thermal cycling.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A prestressed member is most at risk under full service load, so release needs no special checks.
quiz.explanation: 以強力夾具或吊車壓平高差後立即焊接，連接器在溫度循環中疲勞斷裂；屋頂溢流口高於設計或被雜物堵住，暴雨時積水深度超過假設，雙 T 梁撓度增加又積更多水，嚴重時導致局部屋頂崩塌。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Forcing flanges level with heavy clamps or a crane and welding at once leads to connector fatigue fractures under thermal cycling; overflows set higher than designed or blocked by debris let ponding exceed the assumed depth in a downpour, so the tees deflect, collect more water and in severe cases part of the roof collapses. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質」與「現場撓度量測與載重試驗」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Transfer checks and plant quality control" and "Field deflection survey and load testing": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Transfer checks and plant quality control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「放鬆時端部應力」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transfer stress at ends” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預力放鬆是雙 T 梁最危險的時刻之一：混凝土強度還低，跨中有自重彎矩抵銷預力偏心，但梁端附近沒有自重彎矩，底部壓應力與頂部拉應力都最大。若頂部拉應力超過容許值，翼板會開裂，因此常把部分鋼絞線在端部脫黏、把鋼絞線折線配置，或在頂部配置黏結鋼筋。工廠品質管理還包括放鬆強度試體、尺寸與預埋件位置、反拱量測與端部裂縫檢查，PCI 設有工廠認證制度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「放鬆時端部應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strand release is one of the most critical moments for a double tee: concrete strength is still low, and while self-weight moment at midspan offsets prestress eccentricity, near the ends there is no self-weight moment, so bottom compression and top tension are both greatest. If top tension exceeds its limit the flange cracks, so some strands are debonded at the ends, strands are harped, or bonded top reinforcement is added. Plant quality control also covers release-strength cylinders, dimensions and embed positions, camber measurement and end-crack inspection, and PCI runs a plant certification programme. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Transfer stress at ends” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At the ends, with no self-weight moment: σ_bot = −P/A − P·e/S_b = −2,016,000/450,000 − 2,016,000×408/5.92×10⁷ ≈ −4.48 − 13.90 ≈ −18.4 MPa, within 0.70 f'ci = 21.0 MPa for f'ci = 30 MPa; σ_top = −4.48 + 2,016,000×408/1.03×10⁸ ≈ +3.5 MPa tension, above 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa, so debonding, harping or top reinforcement is required.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預力梁最危險的狀態是滿載使用時，放鬆時不需要特別檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A prestressed member is most at risk under full service load, so release needs no special checks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「放鬆時端部應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Transfer stress at ends”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質
knowledge.titleEn: Transfer checks and plant quality control
knowledge.text: 預力放鬆是雙 T 梁最危險的時刻之一：混凝土強度還低，跨中有自重彎矩抵銷預力偏心，但梁端附近沒有自重彎矩，底部壓應力與頂部拉應力都最大。若頂部拉應力超過容許值，翼板會開裂，因此常把部分鋼絞線在端部脫黏、把鋼絞線折線配置，或在頂部配置黏結鋼筋。
knowledge.textEn: Strand release is one of the most critical moments for a double tee: concrete strength is still low, and while self-weight moment at midspan offsets prestress eccentricity, near the ends there is no self-weight moment, so bottom compression and top tension are both greatest. If top tension exceeds its limit the flange cracks, so some strands are debonded at the ends, strands are harped, or bonded top reinforcement is added.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預力梁最危險的狀態是滿載使用時，放鬆時不需要特別檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A prestressed member is most at risk under full service load, so release needs no special checks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transfer checks and plant quality control" is correct?
options: 預力梁最危險的狀態是滿載使用時，放鬆時不需要特別檢查。
預力放鬆是雙 T 梁最危險的時刻之一：混凝土強度還低，跨中有自重彎矩抵銷預力偏心，但梁端附近沒有自重彎矩，底部壓應力與頂部拉應力都最大。
預力構件只要加載時沒有斷，就代表通過載重試驗。
optionsEn: A prestressed member is most at risk under full service load, so release needs no special checks.

Strand release is one of the most critical moments for a double tee: concrete strength is still low, and while self-weight moment at midspan offsets prestress eccentricity, near the ends there is no self-weight moment, so bottom compression and top tension are both greatest.
A prestressed member passes a load test as long as it does not break during loading.
quiz.explanation: 預力放鬆是雙 T 梁最危險的時刻之一：混凝土強度還低，跨中有自重彎矩抵銷預力偏心，但梁端附近沒有自重彎矩，底部壓應力與頂部拉應力都最大。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Strand release is one of the most critical moments for a double tee: concrete strength is still low, and while self-weight moment at midspan offsets prestress eccentricity, near the ends there is no self-weight moment, so bottom compression and top tension are both greatest. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transfer checks and plant quality control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「放鬆時端部應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transfer stress at ends” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：梁端（無自重彎矩）：σ_bot = −P/A − P·e/S_b = −2,016,000/450,000 − 2,016,000×408/5.92×10⁷ ≈ −4.48 − 13.90 ≈ −18.4 MPa，小於 0.70 f'ci = 21.0 MPa（f'ci = 30 MPa）；σ_top = −4.48 + 2,016,000×408/1.03×10⁸ ≈ +3.5 MPa 拉應力，大於 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa，須脫黏、折線或配頂部鋼筋。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At the ends, with no self-weight moment: σ_bot = −P/A − P·e/S_b = −2,016,000/450,000 − 2,016,000×408/5.92×10⁷ ≈ −4.48 − 13.90 ≈ −18.4 MPa, within 0.70 f'ci = 21.0 MPa for f'ci = 30 MPa; σ_top = −4.48 + 2,016,000×408/1.03×10⁸ ≈ +3.5 MPa tension, above 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa, so debonding, harping or top reinforcement is required. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一床位放鬆前以同條件養護的圓柱試體確認 f'ci 達到規定值，記錄放鬆順序與時間；放鬆後檢查端部與翼板裂縫、量測反拱，並抽查尺寸、預埋件與吊點位置是否在容許誤差內，結果與構件編號一併歸檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before release on each bed, confirm f'ci from cylinders cured with the product, and record the release sequence and time; afterwards inspect ends and flanges for cracks, measure camber and spot-check dimensions, embeds and lifting points against tolerances, filing results with the member mark.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: At the ends, with no self-weight moment: σ_bot = −P/A − P·e/S_b = −2,016,000/450,000 − 2,016,000×408/5.92×10⁷ ≈ −4.48 − 13.90 ≈ −18.4 MPa, within 0.70 f'ci = 21.0 MPa for f'ci = 30 MPa; σ_top = −4.48 + 2,016,000×408/1.03×10⁸ ≈ +3.5 MPa tension, above 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa, so debonding, harping or top reinforcement is required. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Transfer checks and plant quality control", which statement holds?
options: 雙 T 梁腹肋鑽個小孔穿管線不會影響結構。
預力梁的反拱在出廠後就固定不變。
optionsEn: Drilling a small hole through a double-tee stem for services does not affect the structure.
A prestressed member's camber is fixed once it leaves the plant.
At the ends, with no self-weight moment: σ_bot = −P/A − P·e/S_b = −2,016,000/450,000 − 2,016,000×408/5.92×10⁷ ≈ −4.48 − 13.90 ≈ −18.4 MPa, within 0.70 f'ci = 21.0 MPa for f'ci = 30 MPa.
quiz.explanationEn: At the ends, with no self-weight moment: σ_bot = −P/A − P·e/S_b = −2,016,000/450,000 − 2,016,000×408/5.92×10⁷ ≈ −4.48 − 13.90 ≈ −18.4 MPa, within 0.70 f'ci = 21.0 MPa for f'ci = 30 MPa; σ_top = −4.48 + 2,016,000×408/1.03×10⁸ ≈ +3.5 MPa tension, above 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa, so debonding, harping or top reinforcement is required. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transfer checks and plant quality control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「放鬆時端部應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transfer stress at ends” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每一床位放鬆前以同條件養護的圓柱試體確認 f'ci 達到規定值，記錄放鬆順序與時間；放鬆後檢查端部與翼板裂縫、量測反拱，並抽查尺寸、預埋件與吊點位置是否在容許誤差內，結果與構件編號一併歸檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before release on each bed, confirm f'ci from cylinders cured with the product, and record the release sequence and time; afterwards inspect ends and flanges for cracks, measure camber and spot-check dimensions, embeds and lifting points against tolerances, filing results with the member mark. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：優先採用通過 PCI 工廠認證或同等品質制度的預鑄廠，出廠文件要附放鬆強度、反拱、尺寸與裂縫檢查紀錄；設計者應在圖說中明訂放鬆強度與允許的端部裂縫寬度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prefer plants certified by PCI or an equivalent quality scheme, with shipping documents that include release strength, camber, dimension and crack-inspection records; designers should specify release strength and allowable end-crack width on drawings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在混凝土強度不足時提前放鬆，端部底緣壓碎或頂部翼板橫向開裂，裂縫在之後的使用中讓水滲入鋼絞線；脫黏長度錯誤或鋼絞線放鬆順序不對稱，則雙 T 梁側彎或扭曲，安裝時兩腹肋無法同時落在承壓墊上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Releasing before concrete reaches strength crushes the bottom at the ends or cracks the top flange transversely, and those cracks later admit water to the strands; wrong debonded lengths or an asymmetric release sequence bow or twist the tee so both stems cannot seat on their pads at erection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每一床位放鬆前以同條件養護的圓柱試體確認 f'ci 達到規定值，記錄放鬆順序與時間；放鬆後檢查端部與翼板裂縫、量測反拱，並抽查尺寸、預埋件與吊點位置是否在容許誤差內，結果與構件編號一併歸檔。
knowledge.textEn: Before release on each bed, confirm f'ci from cylinders cured with the product, and record the release sequence and time; afterwards inspect ends and flanges for cracks, measure camber and spot-check dimensions, embeds and lifting points against tolerances, filing results with the member mark.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 優先採用通過 PCI 工廠認證或同等品質制度的預鑄廠，出廠文件要附放鬆強度、反拱、尺寸與裂縫檢查紀錄；設計者應在圖說中明訂放鬆強度與允許的端部裂縫寬度。
knowledge.textEn: Prefer plants certified by PCI or an equivalent quality scheme, with shipping documents that include release strength, camber, dimension and crack-inspection records; designers should specify release strength and allowable end-crack width on drawings.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transfer checks and plant quality control"?
options: 每一床位放鬆前以同條件養護的圓柱試體確認 f'ci 達到規定值，記錄放鬆順序與時間。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
雙 T 梁靠自重壓在支承上就很穩定，翼板連接器只是防止高低差的配件。
optionsEn: Before release on each bed, confirm f'ci from cylinders cured with the product, and record the release sequence and time.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Double tees are stable under their own weight, so flange connectors merely prevent level differences.
quiz.explanation: 每一床位放鬆前以同條件養護的圓柱試體確認 f'ci 達到規定值，記錄放鬆順序與時間；放鬆後檢查端部與翼板裂縫、量測反拱，並抽查尺寸、預埋件與吊點位置是否在容許誤差內，結果與構件編號一併歸檔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before release on each bed, confirm f'ci from cylinders cured with the product, and record the release sequence and time; afterwards inspect ends and flanges for cracks, measure camber and spot-check dimensions, embeds and lifting points against tolerances, filing results with the member mark. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transfer checks and plant quality control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「放鬆時端部應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transfer stress at ends” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在混凝土強度不足時提前放鬆，端部底緣壓碎或頂部翼板橫向開裂，裂縫在之後的使用中讓水滲入鋼絞線；脫黏長度錯誤或鋼絞線放鬆順序不對稱，則雙 T 梁側彎或扭曲，安裝時兩腹肋無法同時落在承壓墊上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Releasing before concrete reaches strength crushes the bottom at the ends or cracks the top flange transversely, and those cracks later admit water to the strands; wrong debonded lengths or an asymmetric release sequence bow or twist the tee so both stems cannot seat on their pads at erection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：工廠品質管理還包括放鬆強度試體、尺寸與預埋件位置、反拱量測與端部裂縫檢查，PCI 設有工廠認證制度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Plant quality control also covers release-strength cylinders, dimensions and embed positions, camber measurement and end-crack inspection, and PCI runs a plant certification programme.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預力梁最危險的狀態是滿載使用時，放鬆時不需要特別檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A prestressed member is most at risk under full service load, so release needs no special checks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若在混凝土強度不足時提前放鬆，端部底緣壓碎或頂部翼板橫向開裂，裂縫在之後的使用中讓水滲入鋼絞線；脫黏長度錯誤或鋼絞線放鬆順序不對稱，則雙 T 梁側彎或扭曲，安裝時兩腹肋無法同時落在承壓墊上。
knowledge.textEn: Releasing before concrete reaches strength crushes the bottom at the ends or cracks the top flange transversely, and those cracks later admit water to the strands; wrong debonded lengths or an asymmetric release sequence bow or twist the tee so both stems cannot seat on their pads at erection.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transfer checks and plant quality control" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若在混凝土強度不足時提前放鬆，端部底緣壓碎或頂部翼板橫向開裂，裂縫在之後的使用中讓水滲入鋼絞線。
預力構件只要加載時沒有斷，就代表通過載重試驗。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Releasing before concrete reaches strength crushes the bottom at the ends or cracks the top flange transversely, and those cracks later admit water to the strands.
A prestressed member passes a load test as long as it does not break during loading.
quiz.explanation: 若在混凝土強度不足時提前放鬆，端部底緣壓碎或頂部翼板橫向開裂，裂縫在之後的使用中讓水滲入鋼絞線；脫黏長度錯誤或鋼絞線放鬆順序不對稱，則雙 T 梁側彎或扭曲，安裝時兩腹肋無法同時落在承壓墊上。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Releasing before concrete reaches strength crushes the bottom at the ends or cracks the top flange transversely, and those cracks later admit water to the strands; wrong debonded lengths or an asymmetric release sequence bow or twist the tee so both stems cannot seat on their pads at erection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 現場撓度量測與載重試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Field deflection survey and load testing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「現場載重試驗」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “In-situ load test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 當雙 T 梁在運輸、吊裝或使用中受損，或屋頂要增加超出原設計的荷載，而計算無法確認安全時，可做現場載重試驗：以水袋或砂包分級加載，量測跨中撓度、裂縫與卸載後的回復。預力構件在未開裂時撓度接近線性且回復良好，若加載過程撓度突然增加或回復不足，代表已開裂或預力鋼絞線受損。試驗本身有風險，必須事先設計荷載級距、停止條件與安全支撐。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「現場載重試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When a double tee has been damaged in transport, erection or service, or a roof must carry more load than designed and calculation cannot confirm safety, an in-situ load test may be used: water bags or sandbags are added in stages while midspan deflection, cracking and recovery after unloading are measured. Uncracked prestressed members deflect almost linearly and recover well; a sudden jump in deflection or poor recovery signals cracking or strand damage. Testing itself carries risk, so load increments, stop criteria and safety shoring must be designed beforehand. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “In-situ load test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 ACI 318 載重試驗的撓度門檻 l_t²/(20,000·h) 檢核：跨度 l_t = 24,000 mm、梁深 h = 800 mm，門檻 = 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Check against the ACI 318 load-test deflection threshold l_t²/(20,000·h): with span l_t = 24,000 mm and depth h = 800 mm, the threshold is 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預力構件只要加載時沒有斷，就代表通過載重試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A prestressed member passes a load test as long as it does not break during loading." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「現場載重試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “In-situ load test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 現場撓度量測與載重試驗
knowledge.titleEn: Field deflection survey and load testing
knowledge.text: 當雙 T 梁在運輸、吊裝或使用中受損，或屋頂要增加超出原設計的荷載，而計算無法確認安全時，可做現場載重試驗：以水袋或砂包分級加載，量測跨中撓度、裂縫與卸載後的回復。預力構件在未開裂時撓度接近線性且回復良好，若加載過程撓度突然增加或回復不足，代表已開裂或預力鋼絞線受損。
knowledge.textEn: When a double tee has been damaged in transport, erection or service, or a roof must carry more load than designed and calculation cannot confirm safety, an in-situ load test may be used: water bags or sandbags are added in stages while midspan deflection, cracking and recovery after unloading are measured. Uncracked prestressed members deflect almost linearly and recover well; a sudden jump in deflection or poor recovery signals cracking or strand damage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預力構件只要加載時沒有斷，就代表通過載重試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A prestressed member passes a load test as long as it does not break during loading. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「現場撓度量測與載重試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Field deflection survey and load testing" is correct?
options: 預力構件只要加載時沒有斷，就代表通過載重試驗。
屋頂漏水只是防水問題，不會影響雙 T 梁的結構安全。
當雙 T 梁在運輸、吊裝或使用中受損，或屋頂要增加超出原設計的荷載，而計算無法確認安全時，可做現場載重試驗：以水袋或砂包分級加載，量測跨中撓度、裂縫與卸載後的回復。
optionsEn: A prestressed member passes a load test as long as it does not break during loading.
Roof leaks are only a waterproofing issue and do not affect the structural safety of double tees.

When a double tee has been damaged in transport, erection or service, or a roof must carry more load than designed and calculation cannot confirm safety, an in-situ load test may be used: water bags or sandbags are added in stages while midspan deflection, cracking and recovery after unloading are measured.
quiz.explanation: 當雙 T 梁在運輸、吊裝或使用中受損，或屋頂要增加超出原設計的荷載，而計算無法確認安全時，可做現場載重試驗：以水袋或砂包分級加載，量測跨中撓度、裂縫與卸載後的回復。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When a double tee has been damaged in transport, erection or service, or a roof must carry more load than designed and calculation cannot confirm safety, an in-situ load test may be used: water bags or sandbags are added in stages while midspan deflection, cracking and recovery after unloading are measured. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現場撓度量測與載重試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field deflection survey and load testing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「現場載重試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “In-situ load test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 ACI 318 載重試驗的撓度門檻 l_t²/(20,000·h) 檢核：跨度 l_t = 24,000 mm、梁深 h = 800 mm，門檻 = 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm。若試驗荷載下最大撓度 30 mm，小於 36 mm，可直接判定撓度合格；若超過，則需檢查卸載後的回復比例。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Check against the ACI 318 load-test deflection threshold l_t²/(20,000·h): with span l_t = 24,000 mm and depth h = 800 mm, the threshold is 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm. A maximum deflection of 30 mm under test load is below 36 mm and passes directly; if exceeded, recovery after unloading must be checked. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫列出試驗荷載、分級、每級持載時間、量測點（跨中與支承沉陷）、停止條件與安全支撐，由結構技師核可並在場監督；結果與預測撓度比較，並記錄裂縫圖與卸載回復，作為是否限制使用或補強的依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The test plan sets test load, increments, hold time per stage, measurement points at midspan and supports, stop criteria and safety shoring, approved and supervised on site by the structural engineer; compare results with predicted deflection and record crack maps and recovery as the basis for use restrictions or strengthening.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 ACI 318 載重試驗的撓度門檻 l_t²/(20,000·h) 檢核：跨度 l_t = 24,000 mm、梁深 h = 800 mm，門檻 = 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm。若試驗荷載下最大撓度 30 mm，小於 36 mm，可直接判定撓度合格；若超過，則需檢查卸載後的回復比例。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Check against the ACI 318 load-test deflection threshold l_t²/(20,000·h): with span l_t = 24,000 mm and depth h = 800 mm, the threshold is 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm. A maximum deflection of 30 mm under test load is below 36 mm and passes directly; if exceeded, recovery after unloading must be checked. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場撓度量測與載重試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Field deflection survey and load testing", which statement holds?
options: 雙 T 梁是工廠標準品，只要選型號就好，不需要針對屋頂荷載重新檢核。
雙 T 梁端部焊死越牢越好，可以防止滑落。
optionsEn: Check against the ACI 318 load-test deflection threshold l_t²/(20,000·h): with span l_t = 24,000 mm and depth h = 800 mm, the threshold is 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm.
Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads.
Welding double-tee ends as rigidly as possible is best because it prevents them sliding off.
quiz.explanation: 以 ACI 318 載重試驗的撓度門檻 l_t²/(20,000·h) 檢核：跨度 l_t = 24,000 mm、梁深 h = 800 mm，門檻 = 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Check against the ACI 318 load-test deflection threshold l_t²/(20,000·h): with span l_t = 24,000 mm and depth h = 800 mm, the threshold is 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 現場撓度量測與載重試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field deflection survey and load testing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「現場載重試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “In-situ load test” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗計畫列出試驗荷載、分級、每級持載時間、量測點（跨中與支承沉陷）、停止條件與安全支撐，由結構技師核可並在場監督；結果與預測撓度比較，並記錄裂縫圖與卸載回復，作為是否限制使用或補強的依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The test plan sets test load, increments, hold time per stage, measurement points at midspan and supports, stop criteria and safety shoring, approved and supervised on site by the structural engineer; compare results with predicted deflection and record crack maps and recovery as the basis for use restrictions or strengthening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：載重試驗須在結構技師監督下進行，試驗區域設禁入範圍並於構件下方架設不接觸的安全支撐；試驗是工程驗證的停止點，結果未經核可前不得恢復使用或增加荷載。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Load tests must run under the structural engineer's supervision, with an exclusion zone and non-contact safety shoring beneath the member; the test is an engineering hold point, and the roof may not return to use or take added load until results are approved.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若試驗時未設安全支撐或停止條件，受損的雙 T 梁可能在加載中突然破壞；只量跨中撓度而忽略支承沉陷，會把支承變形誤當成構件撓度，得到錯誤結論。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without safety shoring or stop criteria, a damaged tee can fail suddenly during loading; measuring midspan deflection while ignoring support settlement mistakes bearing deformation for member deflection and leads to the wrong conclusion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫列出試驗荷載、分級、每級持載時間、量測點（跨中與支承沉陷）、停止條件與安全支撐，由結構技師核可並在場監督；結果與預測撓度比較，並記錄裂縫圖與卸載回復，作為是否限制使用或補強的依據。
knowledge.textEn: The test plan sets test load, increments, hold time per stage, measurement points at midspan and supports, stop criteria and safety shoring, approved and supervised on site by the structural engineer; compare results with predicted deflection and record crack maps and recovery as the basis for use restrictions or strengthening.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 載重試驗須在結構技師監督下進行，試驗區域設禁入範圍並於構件下方架設不接觸的安全支撐；試驗是工程驗證的停止點，結果未經核可前不得恢復使用或增加荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Load tests must run under the structural engineer's supervision, with an exclusion zone and non-contact safety shoring beneath the member; the test is an engineering hold point, and the roof may not return to use or take added load until results are approved.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場撓度量測與載重試驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Field deflection survey and load testing"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
試驗計畫列出試驗荷載、分級、每級持載時間、量測點（跨中與支承沉陷）、停止條件與安全支撐，由結構技師核可並在場監督。
雙 T 梁放上承壓墊後就已經穩定，焊接可以等整層吊完再一起做。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

The test plan sets test load, increments, hold time per stage, measurement points at midspan and supports, stop criteria and safety shoring, approved and supervised on site by the structural engineer.
Once a double tee sits on its pads it is stable, and welding can wait until the whole level is erected.
quiz.explanation: 試驗計畫列出試驗荷載、分級、每級持載時間、量測點（跨中與支承沉陷）、停止條件與安全支撐，由結構技師核可並在場監督；結果與預測撓度比較，並記錄裂縫圖與卸載回復，作為是否限制使用或補強的依據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The test plan sets test load, increments, hold time per stage, measurement points at midspan and supports, stop criteria and safety shoring, approved and supervised on site by the structural engineer; compare results with predicted deflection and record crack maps and recovery as the basis for use restrictions or strengthening. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現場撓度量測與載重試驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Field deflection survey and load testing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「現場載重試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “In-situ load test” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若試驗時未設安全支撐或停止條件，受損的雙 T 梁可能在加載中突然破壞；只量跨中撓度而忽略支承沉陷，會把支承變形誤當成構件撓度，得到錯誤結論。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without safety shoring or stop criteria, a damaged tee can fail suddenly during loading; measuring midspan deflection while ignoring support settlement mistakes bearing deformation for member deflection and leads to the wrong conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試驗本身有風險，必須事先設計荷載級距、停止條件與安全支撐。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Testing itself carries risk, so load increments, stop criteria and safety shoring must be designed beforehand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預力構件只要加載時沒有斷，就代表通過載重試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A prestressed member passes a load test as long as it does not break during loading." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若試驗時未設安全支撐或停止條件，受損的雙 T 梁可能在加載中突然破壞；只量跨中撓度而忽略支承沉陷，會把支承變形誤當成構件撓度，得到錯誤結論。
knowledge.textEn: Without safety shoring or stop criteria, a damaged tee can fail suddenly during loading; measuring midspan deflection while ignoring support settlement mistakes bearing deformation for member deflection and leads to the wrong conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場撓度量測與載重試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Field deflection survey and load testing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
屋頂漏水只是防水問題，不會影響雙 T 梁的結構安全。
若試驗時未設安全支撐或停止條件，受損的雙 T 梁可能在加載中突然破壞；只量跨中撓度而忽略支承沉陷，會把支承變形誤當成構件撓度，得到錯誤結論。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Roof leaks are only a waterproofing issue and do not affect the structural safety of double tees.
Without safety shoring or stop criteria, a damaged tee can fail suddenly during loading.
quiz.explanation: 若試驗時未設安全支撐或停止條件，受損的雙 T 梁可能在加載中突然破壞；只量跨中撓度而忽略支承沉陷，會把支承變形誤當成構件撓度，得到錯誤結論。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without safety shoring or stop criteria, a damaged tee can fail suddenly during loading; measuring midspan deflection while ignoring support settlement mistakes bearing deformation for member deflection and leads to the wrong conclusion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「屋面防水、接縫與連接器腐蝕」與「改裝、開孔、移除與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Roof waterproofing, joints and connector corrosion" and "Alterations, openings, removal and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 屋面防水、接縫與連接器腐蝕：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Roof waterproofing, joints and connector corrosion: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「屋面接縫防水」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Roof joint waterproofing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 無面層的雙 T 梁屋頂有大量翼板接縫，接縫密封與防水層一旦失效，雨水會沿接縫滲入，直接接觸焊接連接器、預埋鋼件與承壓區。連接器多為外露鋼板，在潮濕與乾濕循環下腐蝕，斷面減少使隔板傳力能力下降；承壓區長期潮濕則使缺口端部鋼筋鏽蝕、混凝土剝落。屋面維護因此不只是防漏，而是保護結構連接。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「屋面接縫防水」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An untopped double-tee roof has many flange joints, and once joint sealants and membrane fail, rain runs into the joints and onto welded connectors, embedded steel and bearing areas. Connectors are usually exposed steel plates that corrode under wetting and drying, losing section and diaphragm capacity; persistently damp bearing areas rust dap reinforcement and spall concrete. Roof maintenance is therefore not only about leaks but about protecting structural connections. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Roof joint waterproofing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：10 mm 厚連接器鋼板若在潮濕接縫中每側年腐蝕 0.1 mm，20 年後減少 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm，約 40% 斷面；原容量 60 kN 降為約 36 kN，對 29.5 kN 的需求只剩約 22% 餘裕，再過幾年便不足。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 10 mm connector plate corroding 0.1 mm per side per year in a wet joint loses 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm, about 40% of its section, after 20 years; capacity falls from 60 kN to about 36 kN, leaving only about 22% margin over the 29.5 kN demand, and a few more years make it inadequate.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「屋頂漏水只是防水問題，不會影響雙 T 梁的結構安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Roof leaks are only a waterproofing issue and do not affect the structural safety of double tees." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「屋面接縫防水」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Roof joint waterproofing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 屋面防水、接縫與連接器腐蝕
knowledge.titleEn: Roof waterproofing, joints and connector corrosion
knowledge.text: 無面層的雙 T 梁屋頂有大量翼板接縫，接縫密封與防水層一旦失效，雨水會沿接縫滲入，直接接觸焊接連接器、預埋鋼件與承壓區。連接器多為外露鋼板，在潮濕與乾濕循環下腐蝕，斷面減少使隔板傳力能力下降；承壓區長期潮濕則使缺口端部鋼筋鏽蝕、混凝土剝落。
knowledge.textEn: An untopped double-tee roof has many flange joints, and once joint sealants and membrane fail, rain runs into the joints and onto welded connectors, embedded steel and bearing areas. Connectors are usually exposed steel plates that corrode under wetting and drying, losing section and diaphragm capacity; persistently damp bearing areas rust dap reinforcement and spall concrete.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：屋頂漏水只是防水問題，不會影響雙 T 梁的結構安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Roof leaks are only a waterproofing issue and do not affect the structural safety of double tees. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「屋面防水、接縫與連接器腐蝕」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Roof waterproofing, joints and connector corrosion" is correct?
options: 無面層的雙 T 梁屋頂有大量翼板接縫，接縫密封與防水層一旦失效，雨水會沿接縫滲入，直接接觸焊接連接器、預埋鋼件與承壓區。
屋頂漏水只是防水問題，不會影響雙 T 梁的結構安全。
雙 T 梁腹肋鑽個小孔穿管線不會影響結構。
optionsEn: An untopped double-tee roof has many flange joints, and once joint sealants and membrane fail, rain runs into the joints and onto welded connectors, embedded steel and bearing areas.
Roof leaks are only a waterproofing issue and do not affect the structural safety of double tees.
Drilling a small hole through a double-tee stem for services does not affect the structure.
quiz.explanation: 無面層的雙 T 梁屋頂有大量翼板接縫，接縫密封與防水層一旦失效，雨水會沿接縫滲入，直接接觸焊接連接器、預埋鋼件與承壓區。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An untopped double-tee roof has many flange joints, and once joint sealants and membrane fail, rain runs into the joints and onto welded connectors, embedded steel and bearing areas. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 屋面防水、接縫與連接器腐蝕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Roof waterproofing, joints and connector corrosion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「屋面接縫防水」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Roof joint waterproofing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：10 mm 厚連接器鋼板若在潮濕接縫中每側年腐蝕 0.1 mm，20 年後減少 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm，約 40% 斷面；原容量 60 kN 降為約 36 kN，對 29.5 kN 的需求只剩約 22% 餘裕，再過幾年便不足。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 10 mm connector plate corroding 0.1 mm per side per year in a wet joint loses 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm, about 40% of its section, after 20 years; capacity falls from 60 kN to about 36 kN, leaving only about 22% margin over the 29.5 kN demand, and a few more years make it inadequate. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期檢查屋面防水層、接縫密封與排水口，雨後從下方檢查翼板接縫滲水痕跡與連接器鏽蝕；抽樣清除連接器表面量測剩餘厚度，承壓區以目視與敲擊檢查剝落，結果與前次紀錄比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Periodically inspect the membrane, joint sealants and drains, and after rain check flange joints from below for leakage stains and connector rust; clean sample connectors to measure remaining thickness, and check bearing areas by eye and sounding for spalls, comparing with previous records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 10 mm 厚連接器鋼板若在潮濕接縫中每側年腐蝕 0.1 mm，20 年後減少 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm，約 40% 斷面；原容量 60 kN 降為約 36 kN，對 29.5 kN 的需求只剩約 22% 餘裕，再過幾年便不足。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 10 mm connector plate corroding 0.1 mm per side per year in a wet joint loses 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm, about 40% of its section, after 20 years; capacity falls from 60 kN to about 36 kN, leaving only about 22% margin over the 29.5 kN demand, and a few more years make it inadequate. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「屋面防水、接縫與連接器腐蝕」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Roof waterproofing, joints and connector corrosion", which statement holds?
options: 預力梁的反拱在出廠後就固定不變。
10 mm 厚連接器鋼板若在潮濕接縫中每側年腐蝕 0.1 mm，20 年後減少 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm，約 40% 斷面。
雙 T 梁靠自重壓在支承上就很穩定，翼板連接器只是防止高低差的配件。
optionsEn: A prestressed member's camber is fixed once it leaves the plant.
A 10 mm connector plate corroding 0.1 mm per side per year in a wet joint loses 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm, about 40% of its section, after 20 years.
Double tees are stable under their own weight, so flange connectors merely prevent level differences.
quiz.explanation: 10 mm 厚連接器鋼板若在潮濕接縫中每側年腐蝕 0.1 mm，20 年後減少 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm，約 40% 斷面；原容量 60 kN 降為約 36 kN，對 29.5 kN 的需求只剩約 22% 餘裕，再過幾年便不足。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 10 mm connector plate corroding 0.1 mm per side per year in a wet joint loses 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm, about 40% of its section, after 20 years; capacity falls from 60 kN to about 36 kN, leaving only about 22% margin over the 29.5 kN demand, and a few more years make it inadequate. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 屋面防水、接縫與連接器腐蝕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Roof waterproofing, joints and connector corrosion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「屋面接縫防水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Roof joint waterproofing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期檢查屋面防水層、接縫密封與排水口，雨後從下方檢查翼板接縫滲水痕跡與連接器鏽蝕；抽樣清除連接器表面量測剩餘厚度，承壓區以目視與敲擊檢查剝落，結果與前次紀錄比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Periodically inspect the membrane, joint sealants and drains, and after rain check flange joints from below for leakage stains and connector rust; clean sample connectors to measure remaining thickness, and check bearing areas by eye and sounding for spalls, comparing with previous records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊要把屋面防水、接縫密封與連接器腐蝕列為同一檢查項目，訂定檢查週期與修復時限；更換防水層時須同步檢查並修補下方連接器，修補方式由結構技師核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual should treat membrane, joint sealants and connector corrosion as one inspection item with set intervals and repair deadlines; reroofing must include inspection and repair of connectors below, with repair methods approved by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：長期滲漏讓連接器逐漸鏽斷，平時看不出問題，直到強風或地震時屋頂隔板沿接縫分裂；承壓區剝落使擱置長度不足，極端情況下雙 T 梁一端滑落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Long-term leaks gradually corrode connectors through, showing nothing in normal use until the diaphragm splits along joints in strong wind or an earthquake; spalling at bearings reduces seating length until, in extreme cases, one end of a tee slips off. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期檢查屋面防水層、接縫密封與排水口，雨後從下方檢查翼板接縫滲水痕跡與連接器鏽蝕；抽樣清除連接器表面量測剩餘厚度，承壓區以目視與敲擊檢查剝落，結果與前次紀錄比較。
knowledge.textEn: Periodically inspect the membrane, joint sealants and drains, and after rain check flange joints from below for leakage stains and connector rust; clean sample connectors to measure remaining thickness, and check bearing areas by eye and sounding for spalls, comparing with previous records.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護手冊要把屋面防水、接縫密封與連接器腐蝕列為同一檢查項目，訂定檢查週期與修復時限；更換防水層時須同步檢查並修補下方連接器，修補方式由結構技師核可。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance manual should treat membrane, joint sealants and connector corrosion as one inspection item with set intervals and repair deadlines; reroofing must include inspection and repair of connectors below, with repair methods approved by the structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「屋面防水、接縫與連接器腐蝕」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Roof waterproofing, joints and connector corrosion"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
屋頂只要有排水孔，就不必考慮積水對結構的影響。
定期檢查屋面防水層、接縫密封與排水口，雨後從下方檢查翼板接縫滲水痕跡與連接器鏽蝕。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
As long as a roof has drains, ponding need not be considered structurally.
Periodically inspect the membrane, joint sealants and drains, and after rain check flange joints from below for leakage stains and connector rust.
quiz.explanation: 定期檢查屋面防水層、接縫密封與排水口，雨後從下方檢查翼板接縫滲水痕跡與連接器鏽蝕；抽樣清除連接器表面量測剩餘厚度，承壓區以目視與敲擊檢查剝落，結果與前次紀錄比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Periodically inspect the membrane, joint sealants and drains, and after rain check flange joints from below for leakage stains and connector rust; clean sample connectors to measure remaining thickness, and check bearing areas by eye and sounding for spalls, comparing with previous records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 屋面防水、接縫與連接器腐蝕：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Roof waterproofing, joints and connector corrosion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「屋面接縫防水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Roof joint waterproofing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 長期滲漏讓連接器逐漸鏽斷，平時看不出問題，直到強風或地震時屋頂隔板沿接縫分裂；承壓區剝落使擱置長度不足，極端情況下雙 T 梁一端滑落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Long-term leaks gradually corrode connectors through, showing nothing in normal use until the diaphragm splits along joints in strong wind or an earthquake; spalling at bearings reduces seating length until, in extreme cases, one end of a tee slips off. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：屋面維護因此不只是防漏，而是保護結構連接。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Roof maintenance is therefore not only about leaks but about protecting structural connections.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「屋頂漏水只是防水問題，不會影響雙 T 梁的結構安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Roof leaks are only a waterproofing issue and do not affect the structural safety of double tees." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 長期滲漏讓連接器逐漸鏽斷，平時看不出問題，直到強風或地震時屋頂隔板沿接縫分裂；承壓區剝落使擱置長度不足，極端情況下雙 T 梁一端滑落。
knowledge.textEn: Long-term leaks gradually corrode connectors through, showing nothing in normal use until the diaphragm splits along joints in strong wind or an earthquake; spalling at bearings reduces seating length until, in extreme cases, one end of a tee slips off.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「屋面防水、接縫與連接器腐蝕」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Roof waterproofing, joints and connector corrosion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 長期滲漏讓連接器逐漸鏽斷，平時看不出問題，直到強風或地震時屋頂隔板沿接縫分裂；承壓區剝落使擱置長度不足，極端情況下雙 T 梁一端滑落。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
雙 T 梁腹肋鑽個小孔穿管線不會影響結構。
optionsEn: Long-term leaks gradually corrode connectors through, showing nothing in normal use until the diaphragm splits along joints in strong wind or an earthquake.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Drilling a small hole through a double-tee stem for services does not affect the structure.
quiz.explanation: 長期滲漏讓連接器逐漸鏽斷，平時看不出問題，直到強風或地震時屋頂隔板沿接縫分裂；承壓區剝落使擱置長度不足，極端情況下雙 T 梁一端滑落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-term leaks gradually corrode connectors through, showing nothing in normal use until the diaphragm splits along joints in strong wind or an earthquake; spalling at bearings reduces seating length until, in extreme cases, one end of a tee slips off. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 改裝、開孔、移除與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Alterations, openings, removal and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「屋頂開孔與增設設備」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Roof openings and added equipment” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙 T 梁屋頂在使用期間常因增設空調、太陽能板或天窗而開孔或加載。翼板可在腹肋之間有限度開孔，但腹肋內的預力鋼絞線絕對不可切斷，切斷一股就直接減少強度並可能使端部錨定失效。移除或搬移既有雙 T 梁同樣危險：職業安全衛生署調查的 2013 年 Montgomery Mall 事故，是以千斤頂與滑移方式移除一片長約 60 ft、重約 42,800 lb 的雙 T 梁時，臨時支撐塔頂部鋼梁受壓挫屈，造成一死一傷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「屋頂開孔與增設設備」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Double-tee roofs are often cut or loaded in service for new air-conditioning, solar panels or skylights. The flange may take limited openings between stems, but strands inside the stems must never be cut, since cutting even one strand directly reduces strength and may undermine end anchorage. Removing or relocating existing tees is equally hazardous: in the 2013 Montgomery Mall incident investigated by OSHA, a tee about 60 ft long weighing about 42,800 lb was being removed by jacking and skating when the top beam of a temporary safety tower buckled, killing one worker and injuring another. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Roof openings and added equipment” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：12 股鋼絞線時 φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m，需求比 M_u/φM_n = 1,408/1,758 ≈ 0.80；若開孔切斷 2 股剩 10 股，φM_n 降為約 1,471 kN·m，需求比升為約 0.96，使用狀態底緣拉應力由約 2.5 MPa 增為約 5.2 MPa，超過 0.62√f'c ≈ 3.7 MPa，構件會開裂。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 12 strands φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m and the demand ratio M_u/φM_n = 1,408/1,758 ≈ 0.80; cutting 2 strands for an opening leaves 10 and φM_n of about 1,471 kN·m, raising the ratio to about 0.96, while service bottom tension rises from about 2.5 MPa to about 5.2 MPa, beyond 0.62√f'c ≈ 3.7 MPa, so the member cracks.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙 T 梁腹肋鑽個小孔穿管線不會影響結構。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Drilling a small hole through a double-tee stem for services does not affect the structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「屋頂開孔與增設設備」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Roof openings and added equipment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 改裝、開孔、移除與交接
knowledge.text: 雙 T 梁屋頂在使用期間常因增設空調、太陽能板或天窗而開孔或加載。翼板可在腹肋之間有限度開孔，但腹肋內的預力鋼絞線絕對不可切斷，切斷一股就直接減少強度並可能使端部錨定失效。
knowledge.textEn: Double-tee roofs are often cut or loaded in service for new air-conditioning, solar panels or skylights. The flange may take limited openings between stems, but strands inside the stems must never be cut, since cutting even one strand directly reduces strength and may undermine end anchorage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雙 T 梁腹肋鑽個小孔穿管線不會影響結構。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Drilling a small hole through a double-tee stem for services does not affect the structure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「改裝、開孔、移除與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Alterations, openings, removal and handover" is correct?
options: 雙 T 梁腹肋鑽個小孔穿管線不會影響結構。
雙 T 梁屋頂在使用期間常因增設空調、太陽能板或天窗而開孔或加載。
雙 T 梁是工廠標準品，只要選型號就好，不需要針對屋頂荷載重新檢核。
optionsEn: Drilling a small hole through a double-tee stem for services does not affect the structure.
Double-tee roofs are often cut or loaded in service for new air-conditioning, solar panels or skylights.
Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads.
quiz.explanation: 雙 T 梁屋頂在使用期間常因增設空調、太陽能板或天窗而開孔或加載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Double-tee roofs are often cut or loaded in service for new air-conditioning, solar panels or skylights. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 改裝、開孔、移除與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Alterations, openings, removal and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「屋頂開孔與增設設備」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Roof openings and added equipment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：12 股鋼絞線時 φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m，需求比 M_u/φM_n = 1,408/1,758 ≈ 0.80；若開孔切斷 2 股剩 10 股，φM_n 降為約 1,471 kN·m，需求比升為約 0.96，使用狀態底緣拉應力由約 2.5 MPa 增為約 5.2 MPa，超過 0.62√f'c ≈ 3.7 MPa，構件會開裂。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 12 strands φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m and the demand ratio M_u/φM_n = 1,408/1,758 ≈ 0.80; cutting 2 strands for an opening leaves 10 and φM_n of about 1,471 kN·m, raising the ratio to about 0.96, while service bottom tension rises from about 2.5 MPa to about 5.2 MPa, beyond 0.62√f'c ≈ 3.7 MPa, so the member cracks. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：任何開孔或增設荷載前，以竣工圖確認鋼絞線位置，必要時以鋼筋掃描在現場標示腹肋與鋼絞線，結構技師檢核強度與使用性後才可施工；移除構件須有經設計的臨時支撐與千斤頂計畫，並設停止點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before any opening or added load, locate strands from as-built drawings and mark stems and strands on site by scanning where needed, and proceed only after the structural engineer checks strength and serviceability; removing members needs an engineered temporary support and jacking plan with hold points.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 12 股鋼絞線時 φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m，需求比 M_u/φM_n = 1,408/1,758 ≈ 0.80；若開孔切斷 2 股剩 10 股，φM_n 降為約 1,471 kN·m，需求比升為約 0.96，使用狀態底緣拉應力由約 2.5 MPa 增為約 5.2 MPa，超過 0.62√f'c ≈ 3.7 MPa，構件會開裂。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 12 strands φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m and the demand ratio M_u/φM_n = 1,408/1,758 ≈ 0.80; cutting 2 strands for an opening leaves 10 and φM_n of about 1,471 kN·m, raising the ratio to about 0.96, while service bottom tension rises from about 2.5 MPa to about 5.2 MPa, beyond 0.62√f'c ≈ 3.7 MPa, so the member cracks. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「改裝、開孔、移除與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Alterations, openings, removal and handover", which statement holds?
options: 雙 T 梁端部焊死越牢越好，可以防止滑落。
雙 T 梁放上承壓墊後就已經穩定，焊接可以等整層吊完再一起做。
optionsEn: Welding double-tee ends as rigidly as possible is best because it prevents them sliding off.
Once a double tee sits on its pads it is stable, and welding can wait until the whole level is erected.
With 12 strands φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m and the demand ratio M_u/φM_n = 1,408/1,758 ≈ 0.80.
quiz.explanation: 12 股鋼絞線時 φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m，需求比 M_u/φM_n = 1,408/1,758 ≈ 0.80；若開孔切斷 2 股剩 10 股，φM_n 降為約 1,471 kN·m，需求比升為約 0.96，使用狀態底緣拉應力由約 2.5 MPa 增為約 5.2 MPa，超過 0.62√f'c ≈ 3.7 MPa，構件會開裂。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 12 strands φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m and the demand ratio M_u/φM_n = 1,408/1,758 ≈ 0.80; cutting 2 strands for an opening leaves 10 and φM_n of about 1,471 kN·m, raising the ratio to about 0.96, while service bottom tension rises from about 2.5 MPa to about 5.2 MPa, beyond 0.62√f'c ≈ 3.7 MPa, so the member cracks. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 改裝、開孔、移除與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Alterations, openings, removal and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「屋頂開孔與增設設備」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Roof openings and added equipment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 任何開孔或增設荷載前，以竣工圖確認鋼絞線位置，必要時以鋼筋掃描在現場標示腹肋與鋼絞線，結構技師檢核強度與使用性後才可施工；移除構件須有經設計的臨時支撐與千斤頂計畫，並設停止點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before any opening or added load, locate strands from as-built drawings and mark stems and strands on site by scanning where needed, and proceed only after the structural engineer checks strength and serviceability; removing members needs an engineered temporary support and jacking plan with hold points. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含雙 T 梁配置與編號圖、鋼絞線位置、允許開孔區、允許附加荷載、連接器與承壓檢查紀錄，並在屋頂入口與腹肋上標示「預力構件，禁止切割鑽孔」；移除或搬移構件須經結構技師設計臨時支撐並核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include the tee layout and marks, strand locations, permitted opening zones, allowable added loads and connector and bearing inspection records, with ‘prestressed member: do not cut or drill’ labels at roof access and on stems; removing or relocating members requires temporary supports designed and approved by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：承包商不知道腹肋內有預力鋼絞線，為穿管在腹肋鑽孔或切割，切斷鋼絞線後構件突然開裂下垂；移除構件時臨時支撐的頂部鋼梁或斜撐不足，像 Montgomery Mall 事故一樣在重新頂升時失穩倒塌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A contractor unaware of strands in the stems drills or cuts a stem for pipework, severing strands so the member suddenly cracks and sags; temporary towers with inadequate top beams or bracing during removal become unstable and collapse on re-jacking, as at Montgomery Mall. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 任何開孔或增設荷載前，以竣工圖確認鋼絞線位置，必要時以鋼筋掃描在現場標示腹肋與鋼絞線，結構技師檢核強度與使用性後才可施工；移除構件須有經設計的臨時支撐與千斤頂計畫，並設停止點。
knowledge.textEn: Before any opening or added load, locate strands from as-built drawings and mark stems and strands on site by scanning where needed, and proceed only after the structural engineer checks strength and serviceability; removing members needs an engineered temporary support and jacking plan with hold points.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含雙 T 梁配置與編號圖、鋼絞線位置、允許開孔區、允許附加荷載、連接器與承壓檢查紀錄，並在屋頂入口與腹肋上標示「預力構件，禁止切割鑽孔」；移除或搬移構件須經結構技師設計臨時支撐並核可。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include the tee layout and marks, strand locations, permitted opening zones, allowable added loads and connector and bearing inspection records, with ‘prestressed member: do not cut or drill’ labels at roof access and on stems; removing or relocating members requires temporary supports designed and approved by the structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「改裝、開孔、移除與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Alterations, openings, removal and handover"?
options: 任何開孔或增設荷載前，以竣工圖確認鋼絞線位置，必要時以鋼筋掃描在現場標示腹肋與鋼絞線，結構技師檢核強度與使用性後才可施工。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
預力梁最危險的狀態是滿載使用時，放鬆時不需要特別檢查。
optionsEn: Before any opening or added load, locate strands from as-built drawings and mark stems and strands on site by scanning where needed, and proceed only after the structural engineer checks strength and serviceability.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A prestressed member is most at risk under full service load, so release needs no special checks.
quiz.explanation: 任何開孔或增設荷載前，以竣工圖確認鋼絞線位置，必要時以鋼筋掃描在現場標示腹肋與鋼絞線，結構技師檢核強度與使用性後才可施工；移除構件須有經設計的臨時支撐與千斤頂計畫，並設停止點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before any opening or added load, locate strands from as-built drawings and mark stems and strands on site by scanning where needed, and proceed only after the structural engineer checks strength and serviceability; removing members needs an engineered temporary support and jacking plan with hold points. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 改裝、開孔、移除與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Alterations, openings, removal and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「屋頂開孔與增設設備」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Roof openings and added equipment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 承包商不知道腹肋內有預力鋼絞線，為穿管在腹肋鑽孔或切割，切斷鋼絞線後構件突然開裂下垂；移除構件時臨時支撐的頂部鋼梁或斜撐不足，像 Montgomery Mall 事故一樣在重新頂升時失穩倒塌。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A contractor unaware of strands in the stems drills or cuts a stem for pipework, severing strands so the member suddenly cracks and sags; temporary towers with inadequate top beams or bracing during removal become unstable and collapse on re-jacking, as at Montgomery Mall. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：移除或搬移既有雙 T 梁同樣危險：職業安全衛生署調查的 2013 年 Montgomery Mall 事故，是以千斤頂與滑移方式移除一片長約 60 ft、重約 42,800 lb 的雙 T 梁時，臨時支撐塔頂部鋼梁受壓挫屈，造成一死一傷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Removing or relocating existing tees is equally hazardous: in the 2013 Montgomery Mall incident investigated by OSHA, a tee about 60 ft long weighing about 42,800 lb was being removed by jacking and skating when the top beam of a temporary safety tower buckled, killing one worker and injuring another.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雙 T 梁腹肋鑽個小孔穿管線不會影響結構。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Drilling a small hole through a double-tee stem for services does not affect the structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 承包商不知道腹肋內有預力鋼絞線，為穿管在腹肋鑽孔或切割，切斷鋼絞線後構件突然開裂下垂；移除構件時臨時支撐的頂部鋼梁或斜撐不足，像 Montgomery Mall 事故一樣在重新頂升時失穩倒塌。
knowledge.textEn: A contractor unaware of strands in the stems drills or cuts a stem for pipework, severing strands so the member suddenly cracks and sags; temporary towers with inadequate top beams or bracing during removal become unstable and collapse on re-jacking, as at Montgomery Mall.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「改裝、開孔、移除與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Alterations, openings, removal and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
承包商不知道腹肋內有預力鋼絞線，為穿管在腹肋鑽孔或切割，切斷鋼絞線後構件突然開裂下垂。
雙 T 梁是工廠標準品，只要選型號就好，不需要針對屋頂荷載重新檢核。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A contractor unaware of strands in the stems drills or cuts a stem for pipework, severing strands so the member suddenly cracks and sags.
Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads.
quiz.explanation: 承包商不知道腹肋內有預力鋼絞線，為穿管在腹肋鑽孔或切割，切斷鋼絞線後構件突然開裂下垂；移除構件時臨時支撐的頂部鋼梁或斜撐不足，像 Montgomery Mall 事故一樣在重新頂升時失穩倒塌。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A contractor unaware of strands in the stems drills or cuts a stem for pipework, severing strands so the member suddenly cracks and sags; temporary towers with inadequate top beams or bracing during removal become unstable and collapse on re-jacking, as at Montgomery Mall. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 高層建築消防分區設計
summary: 從防火區劃的目的與火載量出發，比較灑水系統與區劃的分工，計算標準火災溫度與時間等效、防火門縫隙的漏煙、樓板邊緣縫隙的等效開口，再處理施工與裝修期間的區劃完整性、耐火試驗、樓梯加壓驗收、區劃失效時的結構臨界溫度，最後談使用管理與交接，並以高雄城中城大樓、倫敦 Grenfell Tower 與費城 One Meridian Plaza 的教訓對照。
summaryEn: Starting from the purpose of compartmentation and fire load, compare the roles of sprinklers and compartments, compute standard-fire temperatures and time equivalence, smoke leakage through fire-door gaps and the equivalent opening of slab-edge gaps, then cover compartment integrity during construction and fit-out, fire-resistance testing, stair-pressurisation acceptance and structural critical temperatures when compartments fail, and finally management in use and handover, compared with lessons from Kaohsiung's Cheng Chung Cheng Building, London's Grenfell Tower and Philadelphia's One Meridian Plaza.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
