workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 40 層辦公大樓標準層 1,500 m²、火載量 600 MJ/m²，每層一個區劃，火載量 Q = 1,500×600 = 900 GJ。以 Eurocode 簡化時間等效 t_e = 600×0.07×1.0 ≈ 42 min，樓板與區劃牆採 60 min 防火時效；ISO 834 在 60 min 時約 945°C。主要鋼梁使用率 μ₀ = 0.5，臨界溫度約 585°C，被覆厚度依此選定。防火門 3 mm 周邊縫在 25 Pa 壓差下漏煙約 272 m³/h，多 20 mm 門下縫則加倍。帷幕牆與樓板 100 mm 縫、周長 160 m，若未封填等於每層 16 m² 開口。樓梯加壓 50 Pa 時開門力約 91.5 N，80 Pa 時約 122.5 N。若灑水系統失效使火勢跨越兩層，同時燃燒的火載量變為 1,800 GJ，鋼梁若因後續加載使用率升到 0.7，臨界溫度降為約 526°C，原被覆厚度不再足夠。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 40-storey office tower has 1,500 m² typical floors and a fire load of 600 MJ/m², one compartment per floor, so Q = 1,500×600 = 900 GJ. Simplified Eurocode time equivalence gives t_e = 600×0.07×1.0 ≈ 42 min, so floors and compartment walls are rated 60 min; ISO 834 reaches about 945°C at 60 min. Principal steel beams at utilisation μ₀ = 0.5 have a critical temperature of about 585°C, which sets the coating thickness. A fire door with a 3 mm perimeter gap leaks about 272 m³/h at 25 Pa, doubled by an extra 20 mm undercut. A 100 mm curtain-wall gap around a 160 m perimeter, unsealed, equals a 16 m² opening per floor. Stair pressurisation at 50 Pa gives a door-opening force of about 91.5 N, and at 80 Pa about 122.5 N. If sprinkler failure lets the fire span two floors, the fire load burning at once becomes 1,800 GJ, and if later loads raise beam utilisation to 0.7, the critical temperature falls to about 526°C and the original coating is no longer sufficient. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量」與「火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Purpose, area and fire load of compartments" and "Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Purpose, area and fire load of compartments: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「防火區劃面積」如何影響高層建築消防分區設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compartment floor area” governs force, deformation or durability in “Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 防火區劃把建築切成許多以耐火牆、樓板與防火門窗圍成的小盒子，讓火災與煙在一定時間內被限制在起火的盒子裡，爭取避難與消防搶救時間，並限制同時燃燒的面積，保護結構。水平區劃限制每層的燃燒面積，垂直區劃則以樓板、樓梯間與管道間阻止火煙向上蔓延。台灣建築技術規則以每 1,500 m² 為防火構造建築物的區劃原則，設有自動滅火設備時可減計面積；十一層以上樓層則依內裝材料以更小的面積區劃，反映高層救援困難。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「防火區劃面積」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compartmentation divides a building into boxes enclosed by fire-resisting walls, floors and fire doors and windows, so that fire and smoke stay in the box of origin for a defined time, buying time for evacuation and firefighting and limiting the area burning at once to protect the structure. Horizontal compartments limit the burning area on each floor, while vertical compartmentation uses floors, stair enclosures and shafts to stop upward spread. Taiwan's Building Technical Regulations take 1,500 m² as the basic compartment for fire-resistive buildings, allowing reduced counting where automatic suppression is installed, and require smaller compartments above the 10th floor depending on interior finishes, reflecting the difficulty of high-rise rescue. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Compartment floor area” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：火載量 Q = A·q。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Fire load Q = A·q.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要設了灑水系統，防火區劃就可有可無。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With sprinklers installed, compartmentation is optional." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「防火區劃面積」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Compartment floor area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量
knowledge.titleEn: Purpose, area and fire load of compartments
knowledge.text: 防火區劃把建築切成許多以耐火牆、樓板與防火門窗圍成的小盒子，讓火災與煙在一定時間內被限制在起火的盒子裡，爭取避難與消防搶救時間，並限制同時燃燒的面積，保護結構。水平區劃限制每層的燃燒面積，垂直區劃則以樓板、樓梯間與管道間阻止火煙向上蔓延。
knowledge.textEn: Compartmentation divides a building into boxes enclosed by fire-resisting walls, floors and fire doors and windows, so that fire and smoke stay in the box of origin for a defined time, buying time for evacuation and firefighting and limiting the area burning at once to protect the structure. Horizontal compartments limit the burning area on each floor, while vertical compartmentation uses floors, stair enclosures and shafts to stop upward spread.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要設了灑水系統，防火區劃就可有可無。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With sprinklers installed, compartmentation is optional. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Purpose, area and fire load of compartments" is correct?
options: 只要設了灑水系統，防火區劃就可有可無。
防火區劃把建築切成許多以耐火牆、樓板與防火門窗圍成的小盒子，讓火災與煙在一定時間內被限制在起火的盒子裡，爭取避難與消防搶救時間，並限制同時燃燒的面積，保護結構。
防火區劃只是延緩火勢，真正滅火只能靠消防隊，所以區劃不必太嚴格。
optionsEn: With sprinklers installed, compartmentation is optional.

Compartmentation divides a building into boxes enclosed by fire-resisting walls, floors and fire doors and windows, so that fire and smoke stay in the box of origin for a defined time, buying time for evacuation and firefighting and limiting the area burning at once to protect the structure.
Compartments only delay a fire and only firefighters extinguish it, so compartmentation need not be rigorous.
quiz.explanation: 防火區劃把建築切成許多以耐火牆、樓板與防火門窗圍成的小盒子，讓火災與煙在一定時間內被限制在起火的盒子裡，爭取避難與消防搶救時間，並限制同時燃燒的面積，保護結構。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compartmentation divides a building into boxes enclosed by fire-resisting walls, floors and fire doors and windows, so that fire and smoke stay in the box of origin for a defined time, buying time for evacuation and firefighting and limiting the area burning at once to protect the structure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Purpose, area and fire load of compartments: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「防火區劃面積」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compartment floor area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：火載量 Q = A·q。區劃面積 1,500 m²、辦公室火載量密度 q = 600 MJ/m²：Q = 1,500×600 = 900,000 MJ = 900 GJ；若因設灑水系統使區劃面積加倍到 3,000 m²，可能同時燃燒的火載量也加倍到 1,800 GJ，前提是灑水系統確實有效。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fire load Q = A·q. A 1,500 m² compartment with an office fire-load density q = 600 MJ/m² holds Q = 1,500×600 = 900,000 MJ = 900 GJ; if sprinklers allow the compartment to double to 3,000 m², the fire load that could burn at once also doubles to 1,800 GJ, on the assumption that the sprinklers actually work. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計階段以防火區劃圖標示每個區劃的範圍、面積、防火時效、防火門窗與貫穿部，並與建築、機電、帷幕牆圖套繪，確認區劃線在每一層都連續閉合；審查時核對灑水系統減計面積的條件是否成立。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage, a compartmentation plan shows each compartment's extent, area, rating, fire doors and windows and penetrations, overlaid with architectural, services and curtain-wall drawings to confirm that compartment lines close continuously on every floor; at review, check that the conditions for any sprinkler-based area allowance are met.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 火載量 Q = A·q。區劃面積 1,500 m²、辦公室火載量密度 q = 600 MJ/m²：Q = 1,500×600 = 900,000 MJ = 900 GJ；若因設灑水系統使區劃面積加倍到 3,000 m²，可能同時燃燒的火載量也加倍到 1,800 GJ，前提是灑水系統確實有效。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Fire load Q = A·q. A 1,500 m² compartment with an office fire-load density q = 600 MJ/m² holds Q = 1,500×600 = 900,000 MJ = 900 GJ; if sprinklers allow the compartment to double to 3,000 m², the fire load that could burn at once also doubles to 1,800 GJ, on the assumption that the sprinklers actually work. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Purpose, area and fire load of compartments", which statement holds?
options: 防火門只要是防火材料做的，開著也能擋火。
管線穿過防火牆後，用任何填縫材料補起來就可以。
火載量 Q = A·q。
optionsEn: A fire door made of fire-resisting material still stops fire when left open.
After pipes pass through a fire wall, any filler material can seal the gap.
Fire load Q = A·q.
quiz.explanation: 火載量 Q = A·q。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Fire load Q = A·q. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Purpose, area and fire load of compartments: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「防火區劃面積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compartment floor area” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計階段以防火區劃圖標示每個區劃的範圍、面積、防火時效、防火門窗與貫穿部，並與建築、機電、帷幕牆圖套繪，確認區劃線在每一層都連續閉合；審查時核對灑水系統減計面積的條件是否成立。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage, a compartmentation plan shows each compartment's extent, area, rating, fire doors and windows and penetrations, overlaid with architectural, services and curtain-wall drawings to confirm that compartment lines close continuously on every floor; at review, check that the conditions for any sprinkler-based area allowance are met. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：防火區劃圖應由建築師與消防、結構、機電專業共同簽認，並作為竣工交接文件的一部分；任何隔間變更都必須回到這張圖上檢討。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The compartmentation plan should be signed jointly by the architect and the fire, structural and services disciplines and form part of the handover documents; any partition change must be reviewed against it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若區劃線在平面上看似完整，但在天花板上方、架高地板下方或帷幕牆邊緣斷開，火煙會繞過區劃牆擴散，使整層甚至多層同時受害；以灑水系統放大區劃面積後，若灑水系統失效，燃燒面積就超過結構與救援的假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Compartment lines that look complete on plan but break above ceilings, below raised floors or at the curtain-wall edge let fire and smoke bypass the walls and involve whole floors or several floors at once; once sprinklers justify larger compartments, sprinkler failure leaves a burning area beyond what structure and rescue assumed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計階段以防火區劃圖標示每個區劃的範圍、面積、防火時效、防火門窗與貫穿部，並與建築、機電、帷幕牆圖套繪，確認區劃線在每一層都連續閉合；審查時核對灑水系統減計面積的條件是否成立。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage, a compartmentation plan shows each compartment's extent, area, rating, fire doors and windows and penetrations, overlaid with architectural, services and curtain-wall drawings to confirm that compartment lines close continuously on every floor; at review, check that the conditions for any sprinkler-based area allowance are met.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 防火區劃圖應由建築師與消防、結構、機電專業共同簽認，並作為竣工交接文件的一部分；任何隔間變更都必須回到這張圖上檢討。
knowledge.textEn: The compartmentation plan should be signed jointly by the architect and the fire, structural and services disciplines and form part of the handover documents; any partition change must be reviewed against it.

quiz.question: 要驗證「防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Purpose, area and fire load of compartments"?
options: 設計階段以防火區劃圖標示每個區劃的範圍、面積、防火時效、防火門窗與貫穿部，並與建築、機電、帷幕牆圖套繪，確認區劃線在每一層都連續閉合。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
樓梯加壓的壓力越大越安全。
optionsEn: At design stage, a compartmentation plan shows each compartment's extent, area, rating, fire doors and windows and penetrations, overlaid with architectural, services and curtain-wall drawings to confirm that compartment lines close continuously on every floor.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The higher the stair pressurisation, the safer.
quiz.explanation: 設計階段以防火區劃圖標示每個區劃的範圍、面積、防火時效、防火門窗與貫穿部，並與建築、機電、帷幕牆圖套繪，確認區劃線在每一層都連續閉合；審查時核對灑水系統減計面積的條件是否成立。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At design stage, a compartmentation plan shows each compartment's extent, area, rating, fire doors and windows and penetrations, overlaid with architectural, services and curtain-wall drawings to confirm that compartment lines close continuously on every floor; at review, check that the conditions for any sprinkler-based area allowance are met. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Purpose, area and fire load of compartments: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「防火區劃面積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compartment floor area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若區劃線在平面上看似完整，但在天花板上方、架高地板下方或帷幕牆邊緣斷開，火煙會繞過區劃牆擴散，使整層甚至多層同時受害；以灑水系統放大區劃面積後，若灑水系統失效，燃燒面積就超過結構與救援的假設。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Compartment lines that look complete on plan but break above ceilings, below raised floors or at the curtain-wall edge let fire and smoke bypass the walls and involve whole floors or several floors at once; once sprinklers justify larger compartments, sprinkler failure leaves a burning area beyond what structure and rescue assumed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：台灣建築技術規則以每 1,500 m² 為防火構造建築物的區劃原則，設有自動滅火設備時可減計面積；十一層以上樓層則依內裝材料以更小的面積區劃，反映高層救援困難。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Taiwan's Building Technical Regulations take 1,500 m² as the basic compartment for fire-resistive buildings, allowing reduced counting where automatic suppression is installed, and require smaller compartments above the 10th floor depending on interior finishes, reflecting the difficulty of high-rise rescue.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要設了灑水系統，防火區劃就可有可無。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With sprinklers installed, compartmentation is optional." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「灑水頭與火災成長」如何影響高層建築消防分區設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sprinkler heads and fire growth” governs force, deformation or durability in “Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 室內火災初期以近似時間平方成長，若在閃燃前被灑水系統控制，火勢就不會擴大到整個區劃；區劃則是灑水失效或火勢超出設計時的第二道防線。兩者缺一，風險就大增。1991 年費城 38 層的 One Meridian Plaza 從 22 樓起火，未設灑水的樓層接連燃燒，共燒毀 8 層、歷時超過 19 小時並造成 3 名消防員殉職；火勢直到第一個設有自動灑水的 30 樓才被 10 個灑水頭擋住。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「灑水頭與火災成長」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Early compartment fires grow roughly with the square of time; if sprinklers control the fire before flashover, it never spreads across the compartment, and compartmentation is the second line of defence if sprinklers fail or the fire exceeds their design. Lose either and risk rises sharply. In 1991 the 38-storey One Meridian Plaza in Philadelphia caught fire on the 22nd floor; unsprinklered floors burned one after another, eight floors were destroyed over more than 19 hours and three firefighters died, and the fire was stopped only on the 30th floor, the first with automatic sprinklers, where ten heads held it back. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sprinkler heads and fire growth” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A t² fire Q = α·t² with fast growth α = 0.0469 kW/s² reaches 1 MW at t = √(1,000/0.0469) ≈ 146 s and 5 MW at √(5,000/0.0469) ≈ 327 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防火區劃只是延緩火勢，真正滅火只能靠消防隊，所以區劃不必太嚴格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compartments only delay a fire and only firefighters extinguish it, so compartmentation need not be rigorous." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「灑水頭與火災成長」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sprinkler heads and fire growth”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工
knowledge.titleEn: Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments
knowledge.text: 室內火災初期以近似時間平方成長，若在閃燃前被灑水系統控制，火勢就不會擴大到整個區劃；區劃則是灑水失效或火勢超出設計時的第二道防線。兩者缺一，風險就大增。
knowledge.textEn: Early compartment fires grow roughly with the square of time; if sprinklers control the fire before flashover, it never spreads across the compartment, and compartmentation is the second line of defence if sprinklers fail or the fire exceeds their design. Lose either and risk rises sharply.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：防火區劃只是延緩火勢，真正滅火只能靠消防隊，所以區劃不必太嚴格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Compartments only delay a fire and only firefighters extinguish it, so compartmentation need not be rigorous. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments" is correct?

標示一小時防火時效的牆，在任何火災中都一定能撐一小時。
室內火災初期以近似時間平方成長，若在閃燃前被灑水系統控制，火勢就不會擴大到整個區劃；區劃則是灑水失效或火勢超出設計時的第二道防線。
optionsEn: Compartments only delay a fire and only firefighters extinguish it, so compartmentation need not be rigorous.
A wall rated for one hour will always last one hour in any fire.
Early compartment fires grow roughly with the square of time.

quiz.explanationEn: Early compartment fires grow roughly with the square of time; if sprinklers control the fire before flashover, it never spreads across the compartment, and compartmentation is the second line of defence if sprinklers fail or the fire exceeds their design. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「灑水頭與火災成長」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sprinkler heads and fire growth” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t² 火災 Q = α·t²，快速成長 α = 0.0469 kW/s²：熱釋放率達 1 MW 需 t = √(1,000/0.0469) ≈ 146 s，達 5 MW 需 √(5,000/0.0469) ≈ 327 s。灑水頭若在約 1 MW 前動作，火勢可被控制；延遲到 5 MW 以上，房間可能已接近閃燃。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A t² fire Q = α·t² with fast growth α = 0.0469 kW/s² reaches 1 MW at t = √(1,000/0.0469) ≈ 146 s and 5 MW at √(5,000/0.0469) ≈ 327 s. Sprinklers operating before about 1 MW can control the fire; delayed beyond 5 MW, the room may be near flashover. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以火災模擬或手算檢查灑水頭在設計火災下的動作時間，確認水源、消防泵、管徑與壓力能供應設計區域；竣工時做灑水系統的流量與壓力試驗，並核對每一層都設有灑水頭，沒有因裝修而被遮蔽或漏設的區域。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check sprinkler operating time under the design fire by fire modelling or hand calculation, and confirm that water supply, fire pumps, pipe sizes and pressure serve the design area; at completion run flow and pressure tests and verify sprinkler coverage on every floor, with no areas obstructed by fit-out or left unprotected.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t² 火災 Q = α·t²，快速成長 α = 0.0469 kW/s²：熱釋放率達 1 MW 需 t = √(1,000/0.0469) ≈ 146 s，達 5 MW 需 √(5,000/0.0469) ≈ 327 s。灑水頭若在約 1 MW 前動作，火勢可被控制；延遲到 5 MW 以上，房間可能已接近閃燃。數值為教學假設。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「灑水頭與火災成長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sprinkler heads and fire growth” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以火災模擬或手算檢查灑水頭在設計火災下的動作時間，確認水源、消防泵、管徑與壓力能供應設計區域；竣工時做灑水系統的流量與壓力試驗，並核對每一層都設有灑水頭，沒有因裝修而被遮蔽或漏設的區域。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check sprinkler operating time under the design fire by fire modelling or hand calculation, and confirm that water supply, fire pumps, pipe sizes and pressure serve the design area; at completion run flow and pressure tests and verify sprinkler coverage on every floor, with no areas obstructed by fit-out or left unprotected. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主與管理單位應把灑水系統、消防泵、立管減壓閥與緊急電源列為同一套維護與測試計畫，任何停水或停用都要事前通報並採取補償措施，例如加強巡查與臨時滅火設備。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Owners and managers should treat sprinklers, fire pumps, standpipe pressure-reducing valves and emergency power as one maintenance and testing programme, notifying any shutdown in advance and adopting compensating measures such as extra patrols and temporary extinguishing equipment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：One Meridian Plaza 中消防立管的減壓閥設定不當，出水壓力不足，加上電力中斷，消防員無法有效滅火，火勢依靠窗戶與樓板逐層向上；灑水系統水源中斷時，世界貿易中心 7 號大樓的下層火災也同樣失控，顯示區劃必須獨立承受長時間火災。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: At One Meridian Plaza, misadjusted pressure-reducing valves on the standpipes delivered too little pressure and power was lost, so firefighters could not fight the fire effectively while it climbed floor by floor; when the sprinkler water supply was lost at World Trade Center 7, lower-floor fires likewise burned uncontrolled, showing that compartments must withstand long fires on their own. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以火災模擬或手算檢查灑水頭在設計火災下的動作時間，確認水源、消防泵、管徑與壓力能供應設計區域；竣工時做灑水系統的流量與壓力試驗，並核對每一層都設有灑水頭，沒有因裝修而被遮蔽或漏設的區域。
knowledge.textEn: Check sprinkler operating time under the design fire by fire modelling or hand calculation, and confirm that water supply, fire pumps, pipe sizes and pressure serve the design area; at completion run flow and pressure tests and verify sprinkler coverage on every floor, with no areas obstructed by fit-out or left unprotected.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 業主與管理單位應把灑水系統、消防泵、立管減壓閥與緊急電源列為同一套維護與測試計畫，任何停水或停用都要事前通報並採取補償措施，例如加強巡查與臨時滅火設備。
knowledge.textEn: Owners and managers should treat sprinklers, fire pumps, standpipe pressure-reducing valves and emergency power as one maintenance and testing programme, notifying any shutdown in advance and adopting compensating measures such as extra patrols and temporary extinguishing equipment.

quiz.explanationEn: Check sprinkler operating time under the design fire by fire modelling or hand calculation, and confirm that water supply, fire pumps, pipe sizes and pressure serve the design area; at completion run flow and pressure tests and verify sprinkler coverage on every floor, with no areas obstructed by fit-out or left unprotected. steps.title: 火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「灑水頭與火災成長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sprinkler heads and fire growth” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: One Meridian Plaza 中消防立管的減壓閥設定不當，出水壓力不足，加上電力中斷，消防員無法有效滅火，火勢依靠窗戶與樓板逐層向上；灑水系統水源中斷時，世界貿易中心 7 號大樓的下層火災也同樣失控，顯示區劃必須獨立承受長時間火災。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: At One Meridian Plaza, misadjusted pressure-reducing valves on the standpipes delivered too little pressure and power was lost, so firefighters could not fight the fire effectively while it climbed floor by floor; when the sprinkler water supply was lost at World Trade Center 7, lower-floor fires likewise burned uncontrolled, showing that compartments must withstand long fires on their own. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：1991 年費城 38 層的 One Meridian Plaza 從 22 樓起火，未設灑水的樓層接連燃燒，共燒毀 8 層、歷時超過 19 小時並造成 3 名消防員殉職；火勢直到第一個設有自動灑水的 30 樓才被 10 個灑水頭擋住。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In 1991 the 38-storey One Meridian Plaza in Philadelphia caught fire on the 22nd floor; unsprinklered floors burned one after another, eight floors were destroyed over more than 19 hours and three firefighters died, and the fire was stopped only on the 30th floor, the first with automatic sprinklers, where ten heads held it back.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「防火區劃只是延緩火勢，真正滅火只能靠消防隊，所以區劃不必太嚴格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Compartments only delay a fire and only firefighters extinguish it, so compartmentation need not be rigorous." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「防火時效、標準火災與時間等效」與「防火門、自動關閉與漏煙」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fire resistance, the standard fire and time equivalence" and "Fire doors, self-closing and smoke leakage": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 防火時效、標準火災與時間等效：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire resistance, the standard fire and time equivalence: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「區劃牆與樓板防火時效」如何影響高層建築消防分區設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fire rating of compartment walls and floors” governs force, deformation or durability in “Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 區劃構件的防火時效，是在標準升溫曲線下維持承載、完整性（不讓火焰與熱氣穿過）與隔熱性（背火面溫升不超過限值）的時間。真實火災的強度取決於火載量與開口通風，與標準火災不同，因此工程上常用時間等效的觀念，把真實火災的嚴重度換算成標準火災的等效時間，與構件的防火時效比較。對高層建築而言，樓板同時是結構構件與垂直區劃，防火時效常比一般隔間牆高。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「區劃牆與樓板防火時效」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The fire resistance of a compartment element is the time it maintains load-bearing capacity, integrity against flames and hot gases and insulation, keeping the unexposed face temperature rise within limits, under the standard temperature–time curve. Real fire severity depends on fire load and ventilation and differs from the standard fire, so engineers use time equivalence to convert real severity into an equivalent standard-fire duration for comparison with the element's rating. In high-rise buildings the floor slab is both a structural member and the vertical compartment, so its rating is often higher than that of ordinary partitions. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fire rating of compartment walls and floors” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ISO 834 標準火災 T = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20：t = 60 min 時 T = 345×log₁₀(481) + 20 ≈ 945°C，t = 120 min 時約 1,049°C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The ISO 834 standard fire is T = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20: at t = 60 min, T = 345×log₁₀(481) + 20 ≈ 945°C, and at 120 min about 1,049°C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「標示一小時防火時效的牆，在任何火災中都一定能撐一小時。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A wall rated for one hour will always last one hour in any fire." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「區劃牆與樓板防火時效」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fire rating of compartment walls and floors”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 防火時效、標準火災與時間等效
knowledge.titleEn: Fire resistance, the standard fire and time equivalence
knowledge.text: 區劃構件的防火時效，是在標準升溫曲線下維持承載、完整性（不讓火焰與熱氣穿過）與隔熱性（背火面溫升不超過限值）的時間。真實火災的強度取決於火載量與開口通風，與標準火災不同，因此工程上常用時間等效的觀念，把真實火災的嚴重度換算成標準火災的等效時間，與構件的防火時效比較。
knowledge.textEn: The fire resistance of a compartment element is the time it maintains load-bearing capacity, integrity against flames and hot gases and insulation, keeping the unexposed face temperature rise within limits, under the standard temperature–time curve. Real fire severity depends on fire load and ventilation and differs from the standard fire, so engineers use time equivalence to convert real severity into an equivalent standard-fire duration for comparison with the element's rating.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：標示一小時防火時效的牆，在任何火災中都一定能撐一小時。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A wall rated for one hour will always last one hour in any fire. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「防火時效、標準火災與時間等效」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire resistance, the standard fire and time equivalence" is correct?
options: 區劃構件的防火時效，是在標準升溫曲線下維持承載、完整性（不讓火焰與熱氣穿過）與隔熱性（背火面溫升不超過限值）的時間。
標示一小時防火時效的牆，在任何火災中都一定能撐一小時。
防火門只要是防火材料做的，開著也能擋火。
optionsEn: The fire resistance of a compartment element is the time it maintains load-bearing capacity, integrity against flames and hot gases and insulation, keeping the unexposed face temperature rise within limits, under the standard temperature–time curve.
A wall rated for one hour will always last one hour in any fire.
A fire door made of fire-resisting material still stops fire when left open.
quiz.explanation: 區劃構件的防火時效，是在標準升溫曲線下維持承載、完整性（不讓火焰與熱氣穿過）與隔熱性（背火面溫升不超過限值）的時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 防火時效、標準火災與時間等效：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire resistance, the standard fire and time equivalence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「區劃牆與樓板防火時效」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fire rating of compartment walls and floors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ISO 834 標準火災 T = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20：t = 60 min 時 T = 345×log₁₀(481) + 20 ≈ 945°C，t = 120 min 時約 1,049°C。以 Eurocode 簡化時間等效 t_e = q·k_b·w_f，q = 600 MJ/m²、k_b = 0.07 min·m²/MJ、w_f = 1.0：t_e = 600×0.07×1.0 ≈ 42 min，小於 60 min 防火時效。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The ISO 834 standard fire is T = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20: at t = 60 min, T = 345×log₁₀(481) + 20 ≈ 945°C, and at 120 min about 1,049°C. With the simplified Eurocode time equivalence t_e = q·k_b·w_f, q = 600 MJ/m², k_b = 0.07 min·m²/MJ and w_f = 1.0, t_e = 600×0.07×1.0 ≈ 42 min, below a 60-minute rating. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對每種區劃牆、樓板、防火門窗與貫穿系統都有經認可的耐火試驗或認證，試驗構造與現場構造（材料、厚度、固定方式、尺寸）一致；採性能設計時，火載量與通風假設須有調查依據並經審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm that every compartment wall, floor, fire door and window and penetration system has an approved fire test or listing, and that the tested construction matches the site construction in materials, thickness, fixing and size; where performance-based design is used, fire-load and ventilation assumptions must be based on survey data and reviewed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ISO 834 標準火災 T = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20：t = 60 min 時 T = 345×log₁₀(481) + 20 ≈ 945°C，t = 120 min 時約 1,049°C。以 Eurocode 簡化時間等效 t_e = q·k_b·w_f，q = 600 MJ/m²、k_b = 0.07 min·m²/MJ、w_f = 1.0：t_e = 600×0.07×1.0 ≈ 42 min，小於 60 min 防火時效。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The ISO 834 standard fire is T = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20: at t = 60 min, T = 345×log₁₀(481) + 20 ≈ 945°C, and at 120 min about 1,049°C. With the simplified Eurocode time equivalence t_e = q·k_b·w_f, q = 600 MJ/m², k_b = 0.07 min·m²/MJ and w_f = 1.0, t_e = 600×0.07×1.0 ≈ 42 min, below a 60-minute rating. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「防火時效、標準火災與時間等效」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire resistance, the standard fire and time equivalence", which statement holds?
options: 管線穿過防火牆後，用任何填縫材料補起來就可以。
樓梯加壓的壓力越大越安全。
optionsEn: After pipes pass through a fire wall, any filler material can seal the gap.
The ISO 834 standard fire is T = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20: at t = 60 min, T = 345×log₁₀(481) + 20 ≈ 945°C, and at 120 min about 1,049°C.
The higher the stair pressurisation, the safer.
quiz.explanation: ISO 834 標準火災 T = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20：t = 60 min 時 T = 345×log₁₀(481) + 20 ≈ 945°C，t = 120 min 時約 1,049°C。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The ISO 834 standard fire is T = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20: at t = 60 min, T = 345×log₁₀(481) + 20 ≈ 945°C, and at 120 min about 1,049°C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 防火時效、標準火災與時間等效：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire resistance, the standard fire and time equivalence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「區劃牆與樓板防火時效」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fire rating of compartment walls and floors” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對每種區劃牆、樓板、防火門窗與貫穿系統都有經認可的耐火試驗或認證，試驗構造與現場構造（材料、厚度、固定方式、尺寸）一致；採性能設計時，火載量與通風假設須有調查依據並經審查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm that every compartment wall, floor, fire door and window and penetration system has an approved fire test or listing, and that the tested construction matches the site construction in materials, thickness, fixing and size; where performance-based design is used, fire-load and ventilation assumptions must be based on survey data and reviewed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：防火構造的材料送審要附耐火試驗報告與構造詳圖，現場依詳圖施作並由監造逐區查驗；使用用途改變為高火載量時，須重新檢討防火時效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Submittals for fire-resisting construction must include fire test reports and construction details, with site work following the details and inspected area by area; any change to a high-fire-load use requires the ratings to be reassessed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若現場以未經試驗的輕隔間或板材替代，或固定間距、板材層數與試驗不同，區劃牆在火災中提早失去完整性；倉儲或資料中心等高火載量用途若沿用辦公室的時間等效，真實火災會超過構件的防火時效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting untested partitions or boards on site, or changing fixing spacing or board layers from the tested build-up, makes compartment walls lose integrity early in a fire; applying office time equivalence to high-fire-load uses such as storage or data centres lets real fires exceed element ratings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對每種區劃牆、樓板、防火門窗與貫穿系統都有經認可的耐火試驗或認證，試驗構造與現場構造（材料、厚度、固定方式、尺寸）一致；採性能設計時，火載量與通風假設須有調查依據並經審查。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm that every compartment wall, floor, fire door and window and penetration system has an approved fire test or listing, and that the tested construction matches the site construction in materials, thickness, fixing and size; where performance-based design is used, fire-load and ventilation assumptions must be based on survey data and reviewed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 防火構造的材料送審要附耐火試驗報告與構造詳圖，現場依詳圖施作並由監造逐區查驗；使用用途改變為高火載量時，須重新檢討防火時效。
knowledge.textEn: Submittals for fire-resisting construction must include fire test reports and construction details, with site work following the details and inspected area by area; any change to a high-fire-load use requires the ratings to be reassessed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「防火時效、標準火災與時間等效」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fire resistance, the standard fire and time equivalence"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
老舊建築只要當年合法取得使用執照，就不需要再檢討防火區劃。
核對每種區劃牆、樓板、防火門窗與貫穿系統都有經認可的耐火試驗或認證，試驗構造與現場構造（材料、厚度、固定方式、尺寸）一致。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
An old building that was lawfully approved when built needs no further review of its compartmentation.

Confirm that every compartment wall, floor, fire door and window and penetration system has an approved fire test or listing, and that the tested construction matches the site construction in materials, thickness, fixing and size.
quiz.explanation: 核對每種區劃牆、樓板、防火門窗與貫穿系統都有經認可的耐火試驗或認證，試驗構造與現場構造（材料、厚度、固定方式、尺寸）一致；採性能設計時，火載量與通風假設須有調查依據並經審查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm that every compartment wall, floor, fire door and window and penetration system has an approved fire test or listing, and that the tested construction matches the site construction in materials, thickness, fixing and size; where performance-based design is used, fire-load and ventilation assumptions must be based on survey data and reviewed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 防火時效、標準火災與時間等效：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire resistance, the standard fire and time equivalence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「區劃牆與樓板防火時效」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fire rating of compartment walls and floors” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若現場以未經試驗的輕隔間或板材替代，或固定間距、板材層數與試驗不同，區劃牆在火災中提早失去完整性；倉儲或資料中心等高火載量用途若沿用辦公室的時間等效，真實火災會超過構件的防火時效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting untested partitions or boards on site, or changing fixing spacing or board layers from the tested build-up, makes compartment walls lose integrity early in a fire; applying office time equivalence to high-fire-load uses such as storage or data centres lets real fires exceed element ratings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對高層建築而言，樓板同時是結構構件與垂直區劃，防火時效常比一般隔間牆高。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In high-rise buildings the floor slab is both a structural member and the vertical compartment, so its rating is often higher than that of ordinary partitions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「標示一小時防火時效的牆，在任何火災中都一定能撐一小時。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A wall rated for one hour will always last one hour in any fire." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若現場以未經試驗的輕隔間或板材替代，或固定間距、板材層數與試驗不同，區劃牆在火災中提早失去完整性；倉儲或資料中心等高火載量用途若沿用辦公室的時間等效，真實火災會超過構件的防火時效。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting untested partitions or boards on site, or changing fixing spacing or board layers from the tested build-up, makes compartment walls lose integrity early in a fire; applying office time equivalence to high-fire-load uses such as storage or data centres lets real fires exceed element ratings.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「防火時效、標準火災與時間等效」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire resistance, the standard fire and time equivalence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若現場以未經試驗的輕隔間或板材替代，或固定間距、板材層數與試驗不同，區劃牆在火災中提早失去完整性。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
防火門只要是防火材料做的，開著也能擋火。
optionsEn: Substituting untested partitions or boards on site, or changing fixing spacing or board layers from the tested build-up, makes compartment walls lose integrity early in a fire.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A fire door made of fire-resisting material still stops fire when left open.
quiz.explanation: 若現場以未經試驗的輕隔間或板材替代，或固定間距、板材層數與試驗不同，區劃牆在火災中提早失去完整性；倉儲或資料中心等高火載量用途若沿用辦公室的時間等效，真實火災會超過構件的防火時效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting untested partitions or boards on site, or changing fixing spacing or board layers from the tested build-up, makes compartment walls lose integrity early in a fire; applying office time equivalence to high-fire-load uses such as storage or data centres lets real fires exceed element ratings. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 防火門、自動關閉與漏煙：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire doors, self-closing and smoke leakage: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「防火門與門縫」如何影響高層建築消防分區設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fire doors and door gaps” governs force, deformation or durability in “Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 防火門是區劃上最常被打開的缺口：門必須自動關閉並緊密閉合，門框與牆的接縫、門下縫與門扇周邊縫都會漏煙。高層建築的煙囪效應與加壓系統使門兩側存在壓力差，即使只有數公釐的縫隙，也能讓大量煙進入走廊或樓梯。Grenfell Tower 火災中，住戶單元的防火門未能自動關閉與密封，使煙從住戶進入梯廳；事前的防火缺失通知也已列出防火門問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「防火門與門縫」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fire doors are the most frequently opened gaps in a compartment: they must self-close and latch tightly, and frame-to-wall joints, undercuts and leaf perimeters all leak smoke. Stack effect and pressurisation in tall buildings create pressure differences across doors, so even gaps of a few millimetres admit large amounts of smoke into corridors or stairs. In the Grenfell Tower fire, flat entrance fire doors failed to close and seal, letting smoke pass from flats into lobbies, and an earlier fire deficiency notice had already listed fire-door problems. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fire doors and door gaps” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：孔口流量 Q = C·A·√(2ΔP/ρ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Orifice flow Q = C·A·√(2ΔP/ρ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防火門只要是防火材料做的，開著也能擋火。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fire door made of fire-resisting material still stops fire when left open." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「防火門與門縫」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fire doors and door gaps”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 防火門、自動關閉與漏煙
knowledge.titleEn: Fire doors, self-closing and smoke leakage
knowledge.text: 防火門是區劃上最常被打開的缺口：門必須自動關閉並緊密閉合，門框與牆的接縫、門下縫與門扇周邊縫都會漏煙。高層建築的煙囪效應與加壓系統使門兩側存在壓力差，即使只有數公釐的縫隙，也能讓大量煙進入走廊或樓梯。
knowledge.textEn: Fire doors are the most frequently opened gaps in a compartment: they must self-close and latch tightly, and frame-to-wall joints, undercuts and leaf perimeters all leak smoke. Stack effect and pressurisation in tall buildings create pressure differences across doors, so even gaps of a few millimetres admit large amounts of smoke into corridors or stairs.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：防火門只要是防火材料做的，開著也能擋火。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fire door made of fire-resisting material still stops fire when left open. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「防火門、自動關閉與漏煙」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire doors, self-closing and smoke leakage" is correct?
options: 防火門只要是防火材料做的，開著也能擋火。
防火門是區劃上最常被打開的缺口：門必須自動關閉並緊密閉合，門框與牆的接縫、門下縫與門扇周邊縫都會漏煙。
樓板本身有防火時效，就代表上下樓層已經完全區劃。
optionsEn: A fire door made of fire-resisting material still stops fire when left open.
Fire doors are the most frequently opened gaps in a compartment: they must self-close and latch tightly, and frame-to-wall joints, undercuts and leaf perimeters all leak smoke.
If the floor slab is fire-rated, the floors above and below are fully compartmented.
quiz.explanation: 防火門是區劃上最常被打開的缺口：門必須自動關閉並緊密閉合，門框與牆的接縫、門下縫與門扇周邊縫都會漏煙。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fire doors are the most frequently opened gaps in a compartment: they must self-close and latch tightly, and frame-to-wall joints, undercuts and leaf perimeters all leak smoke. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 防火門、自動關閉與漏煙：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire doors, self-closing and smoke leakage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「防火門與門縫」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fire doors and door gaps” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：孔口流量 Q = C·A·√(2ΔP/ρ)。2.1 m × 0.9 m 門扇周邊縫 3 mm，A = 0.003×(2×2.1 + 2×0.9) = 0.018 m²；ΔP = 25 Pa、ρ = 1.2 kg/m³、C = 0.65：v = √(2×25/1.2) ≈ 6.45 m/s，Q ≈ 0.65×0.018×6.45 ≈ 0.076 m³/s（約 272 m³/h）。門下縫再多 20 mm，面積加倍，漏煙量增為約 544 m³/h。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Orifice flow Q = C·A·√(2ΔP/ρ). A 2.1 m × 0.9 m door leaf with a 3 mm perimeter gap has A = 0.003×(2×2.1 + 2×0.9) = 0.018 m²; with ΔP = 25 Pa, ρ = 1.2 kg/m³ and C = 0.65, v = √(2×25/1.2) ≈ 6.45 m/s and Q ≈ 0.65×0.018×6.45 ≈ 0.076 m³/s, about 272 m³/h. A further 20 mm undercut doubles the area and leakage to about 544 m³/h. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：竣工時逐樘檢查防火門的認證標籤、門弓器自動關閉與閂鎖、門縫尺寸與防煙條，並抽樣做關閉時間測試；與消防受信總機連動的常開防火門，要實際觸發偵測器確認會關閉。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At completion check every fire door's certification label, closer self-closing and latching, gap sizes and smoke seals, and test closing time on a sample; for hold-open doors linked to the fire alarm panel, trigger the detectors to confirm they close.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Orifice flow Q = C·A·√(2ΔP/ρ). A 2.1 m × 0.9 m door leaf with a 3 mm perimeter gap has A = 0.003×(2×2.1 + 2×0.9) = 0.018 m²; with ΔP = 25 Pa, ρ = 1.2 kg/m³ and C = 0.65, v = √(2×25/1.2) ≈ 6.45 m/s and Q ≈ 0.65×0.018×6.45 ≈ 0.076 m³/s, about 272 m³/h. A further 20 mm undercut doubles the area and leakage to about 544 m³/h. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「防火門、自動關閉與漏煙」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire doors, self-closing and smoke leakage", which statement holds?
options: 只要材料本身不燃，組成的牆或門就自動具有防火時效。
鋼構只要有防火被覆，區劃失效也不會影響結構安全。
孔口流量 Q = C·A·√(2ΔP/ρ)。
optionsEn: If the materials are non-combustible, the wall or door they form automatically has a fire rating.
Steelwork with fireproofing is safe even if compartmentation fails.
Orifice flow Q = C·A·√(2ΔP/ρ).
quiz.explanation: 孔口流量 Q = C·A·√(2ΔP/ρ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Orifice flow Q = C·A·√(2ΔP/ρ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 防火門、自動關閉與漏煙：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire doors, self-closing and smoke leakage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「防火門與門縫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fire doors and door gaps” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 竣工時逐樘檢查防火門的認證標籤、門弓器自動關閉與閂鎖、門縫尺寸與防煙條，並抽樣做關閉時間測試；與消防受信總機連動的常開防火門，要實際觸發偵測器確認會關閉。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At completion check every fire door's certification label, closer self-closing and latching, gap sizes and smoke seals, and test closing time on a sample; for hold-open doors linked to the fire alarm panel, trigger the detectors to confirm they close. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：管理規約應禁止撐開防火門，需要常開者必須改為與偵測器連動的自動關閉裝置；防火門的五金更換須使用經認證的配件，並列入定期檢查表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: House rules should forbid propping fire doors open, with doors that must stay open fitted with detector-linked automatic release; door hardware replacements must use certified components and be included in periodic inspections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：防火門被楔子撐開、門弓器拆除或門扇變形無法閂鎖時，起火區的煙直接灌入走廊與樓梯，使逃生路徑在數分鐘內失去可用性；更換門鎖或加裝貓眼若破壞門扇構造，也會讓防火門失去認證性能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fire doors wedged open, closers removed or leaves warped so they cannot latch let smoke pour straight into corridors and stairs, making escape routes unusable within minutes; replacing locks or adding viewers in a way that breaks the leaf construction also voids the door's certified performance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 竣工時逐樘檢查防火門的認證標籤、門弓器自動關閉與閂鎖、門縫尺寸與防煙條，並抽樣做關閉時間測試；與消防受信總機連動的常開防火門，要實際觸發偵測器確認會關閉。
knowledge.textEn: At completion check every fire door's certification label, closer self-closing and latching, gap sizes and smoke seals, and test closing time on a sample; for hold-open doors linked to the fire alarm panel, trigger the detectors to confirm they close.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 管理規約應禁止撐開防火門，需要常開者必須改為與偵測器連動的自動關閉裝置；防火門的五金更換須使用經認證的配件，並列入定期檢查表。
knowledge.textEn: House rules should forbid propping fire doors open, with doors that must stay open fitted with detector-linked automatic release; door hardware replacements must use certified components and be included in periodic inspections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「防火門、自動關閉與漏煙」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fire doors, self-closing and smoke leakage"?
options: 竣工時逐樘檢查防火門的認證標籤、門弓器自動關閉與閂鎖、門縫尺寸與防煙條，並抽樣做關閉時間測試；與消防受信總機連動的常開防火門，要實際觸發偵測器確認會關閉。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要設了灑水系統，防火區劃就可有可無。
optionsEn: At completion check every fire door's certification label, closer self-closing and latching, gap sizes and smoke seals, and test closing time on a sample.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
With sprinklers installed, compartmentation is optional.
quiz.explanation: 竣工時逐樘檢查防火門的認證標籤、門弓器自動關閉與閂鎖、門縫尺寸與防煙條，並抽樣做關閉時間測試；與消防受信總機連動的常開防火門，要實際觸發偵測器確認會關閉。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At completion check every fire door's certification label, closer self-closing and latching, gap sizes and smoke seals, and test closing time on a sample; for hold-open doors linked to the fire alarm panel, trigger the detectors to confirm they close. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 防火門、自動關閉與漏煙：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire doors, self-closing and smoke leakage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「防火門與門縫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fire doors and door gaps” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 防火門被楔子撐開、門弓器拆除或門扇變形無法閂鎖時，起火區的煙直接灌入走廊與樓梯，使逃生路徑在數分鐘內失去可用性；更換門鎖或加裝貓眼若破壞門扇構造，也會讓防火門失去認證性能。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fire doors wedged open, closers removed or leaves warped so they cannot latch let smoke pour straight into corridors and stairs, making escape routes unusable within minutes; replacing locks or adding viewers in a way that breaks the leaf construction also voids the door's certified performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Grenfell Tower 火災中，住戶單元的防火門未能自動關閉與密封，使煙從住戶進入梯廳；事前的防火缺失通知也已列出防火門問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In the Grenfell Tower fire, flat entrance fire doors failed to close and seal, letting smoke pass from flats into lobbies, and an earlier fire deficiency notice had already listed fire-door problems.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「防火門只要是防火材料做的，開著也能擋火。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fire door made of fire-resisting material still stops fire when left open." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 防火門被楔子撐開、門弓器拆除或門扇變形無法閂鎖時，起火區的煙直接灌入走廊與樓梯，使逃生路徑在數分鐘內失去可用性；更換門鎖或加裝貓眼若破壞門扇構造，也會讓防火門失去認證性能。
knowledge.textEn: Fire doors wedged open, closers removed or leaves warped so they cannot latch let smoke pour straight into corridors and stairs, making escape routes unusable within minutes; replacing locks or adding viewers in a way that breaks the leaf construction also voids the door's certified performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「防火門、自動關閉與漏煙」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire doors, self-closing and smoke leakage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
防火門被楔子撐開、門弓器拆除或門扇變形無法閂鎖時，起火區的煙直接灌入走廊與樓梯，使逃生路徑在數分鐘內失去可用性。
樓板本身有防火時效，就代表上下樓層已經完全區劃。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Fire doors wedged open, closers removed or leaves warped so they cannot latch let smoke pour straight into corridors and stairs, making escape routes unusable within minutes.
If the floor slab is fire-rated, the floors above and below are fully compartmented.
quiz.explanation: 防火門被楔子撐開、門弓器拆除或門扇變形無法閂鎖時，起火區的煙直接灌入走廊與樓梯，使逃生路徑在數分鐘內失去可用性；更換門鎖或加裝貓眼若破壞門扇構造，也會讓防火門失去認證性能。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fire doors wedged open, closers removed or leaves warped so they cannot latch let smoke pour straight into corridors and stairs, making escape routes unusable within minutes; replacing locks or adding viewers in a way that breaks the leaf construction also voids the door's certified performance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「樓板邊緣、帷幕牆與外牆的垂直蔓延」與「施工與裝修期間的區劃完整性」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Slab edges, curtain walls and vertical spread on the façade" and "Compartment integrity during construction and fit-out": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 樓板邊緣、帷幕牆與外牆的垂直蔓延：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Slab edges, curtain walls and vertical spread on the façade: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「帷幕牆層間防火」如何影響高層建築消防分區設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Curtain-wall perimeter fire barrier” governs force, deformation or durability in “Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 高層建築的垂直區劃常在樓板邊緣斷開：帷幕牆與樓板之間留有施工縫，若沒有以經試驗的層間防火填塞封閉，火煙會沿縫隙直接竄上樓。外牆本身也可能成為火的通道，Grenfell Tower 在 2015 至 2016 年改裝時加上鋁複合板與可燃保溫材，火災時火焰沿外牆空腔向上，繞過內部的區劃，約 30 分鐘內抵達屋頂，公開調查第一階段報告指出外牆是火勢快速蔓延的主因。設計上要同時處理樓板邊緣填塞、窗間牆高度與外牆材料的燃燒性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「帷幕牆層間防火」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Vertical compartmentation in tall buildings often breaks at the slab edge: a construction gap between curtain wall and floor, if not closed with a tested perimeter fire barrier, lets fire and smoke rise straight up. The façade itself can also become a fire path; Grenfell Tower was overclad in 2015 to 2016 with aluminium composite panels and combustible insulation, and in the fire flames travelled up the external cavity, bypassing internal compartments and reaching the roof within about 30 minutes, with the inquiry's Phase 1 report identifying the exterior as the principal reason for the rapid spread. Design must address slab-edge firestopping, spandrel height and façade combustibility together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Curtain-wall perimeter fire barrier” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：樓板外周長 160 m、帷幕牆與樓板之間的縫寬 100 mm，若完全未封填，每層等效開口 A = 0.10×160 = 16 m²，相當於樓板上一個 4 m × 4 m 的洞；即使只有 10% 長度漏封，也有約 1.6 m² 的垂直通道。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 160 m slab perimeter and a 100 mm gap between curtain wall and slab, an unsealed gap is an equivalent opening of A = 0.10×160 = 16 m² per floor, like a 4 m × 4 m hole in the slab; even 10% of the length left unsealed is a vertical path of about 1.6 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樓板本身有防火時效，就代表上下樓層已經完全區劃。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the floor slab is fire-rated, the floors above and below are fully compartmented." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「帷幕牆層間防火」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Curtain-wall perimeter fire barrier”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 樓板邊緣、帷幕牆與外牆的垂直蔓延
knowledge.titleEn: Slab edges, curtain walls and vertical spread on the façade
knowledge.text: 高層建築的垂直區劃常在樓板邊緣斷開：帷幕牆與樓板之間留有施工縫，若沒有以經試驗的層間防火填塞封閉，火煙會沿縫隙直接竄上樓。外牆本身也可能成為火的通道，Grenfell Tower 在 2015 至 2016 年改裝時加上鋁複合板與可燃保溫材，火災時火焰沿外牆空腔向上，繞過內部的區劃，約 30 分鐘內抵達屋頂，公開調查第一階段報告指出外牆是火勢快速蔓延的主因。
knowledge.textEn: Vertical compartmentation in tall buildings often breaks at the slab edge: a construction gap between curtain wall and floor, if not closed with a tested perimeter fire barrier, lets fire and smoke rise straight up. The façade itself can also become a fire path; Grenfell Tower was overclad in 2015 to 2016 with aluminium composite panels and combustible insulation, and in the fire flames travelled up the external cavity, bypassing internal compartments and reaching the roof within about 30 minutes, with the inquiry's Phase 1 report identifying the exterior as the principal reason for the rapid spread.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：樓板本身有防火時效，就代表上下樓層已經完全區劃。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the floor slab is fire-rated, the floors above and below are fully compartmented. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「樓板邊緣、帷幕牆與外牆的垂直蔓延」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Slab edges, curtain walls and vertical spread on the façade" is correct?
options: 樓板本身有防火時效，就代表上下樓層已經完全區劃。
管線穿過防火牆後，用任何填縫材料補起來就可以。
高層建築的垂直區劃常在樓板邊緣斷開：帷幕牆與樓板之間留有施工縫，若沒有以經試驗的層間防火填塞封閉，火煙會沿縫隙直接竄上樓。
optionsEn: If the floor slab is fire-rated, the floors above and below are fully compartmented.
After pipes pass through a fire wall, any filler material can seal the gap.

Vertical compartmentation in tall buildings often breaks at the slab edge: a construction gap between curtain wall and floor, if not closed with a tested perimeter fire barrier, lets fire and smoke rise straight up.
quiz.explanation: 高層建築的垂直區劃常在樓板邊緣斷開：帷幕牆與樓板之間留有施工縫，若沒有以經試驗的層間防火填塞封閉，火煙會沿縫隙直接竄上樓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Vertical compartmentation in tall buildings often breaks at the slab edge: a construction gap between curtain wall and floor, if not closed with a tested perimeter fire barrier, lets fire and smoke rise straight up. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 樓板邊緣、帷幕牆與外牆的垂直蔓延：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Slab edges, curtain walls and vertical spread on the façade: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「帷幕牆層間防火」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Curtain-wall perimeter fire barrier” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：樓板外周長 160 m、帷幕牆與樓板之間的縫寬 100 mm，若完全未封填，每層等效開口 A = 0.10×160 = 16 m²，相當於樓板上一個 4 m × 4 m 的洞；即使只有 10% 長度漏封，也有約 1.6 m² 的垂直通道。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 160 m slab perimeter and a 100 mm gap between curtain wall and slab, an unsealed gap is an equivalent opening of A = 0.10×160 = 16 m² per floor, like a 4 m × 4 m hole in the slab; even 10% of the length left unsealed is a vertical path of about 1.6 m². Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：層間防火填塞必須採用與帷幕牆型式一致的試驗系統，現場檢查礦棉密度、壓縮率、支撐角鐵與表面防煙密封，並逐層拍照；外牆材料須有燃燒性能證明，帷幕牆設計審查時把窗間牆與層間填塞一併檢核。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Perimeter fire barriers must be a tested system matching the curtain-wall type, with mineral-wool density, compression, support angles and surface smoke seal inspected and photographed floor by floor; façade materials need combustibility evidence, and curtain-wall design review checks spandrels and perimeter barriers together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 樓板外周長 160 m、帷幕牆與樓板之間的縫寬 100 mm，若完全未封填，每層等效開口 A = 0.10×160 = 16 m²，相當於樓板上一個 4 m × 4 m 的洞；即使只有 10% 長度漏封，也有約 1.6 m² 的垂直通道。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a 160 m slab perimeter and a 100 mm gap between curtain wall and slab, an unsealed gap is an equivalent opening of A = 0.10×160 = 16 m² per floor, like a 4 m × 4 m hole in the slab; even 10% of the length left unsealed is a vertical path of about 1.6 m². Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「樓板邊緣、帷幕牆與外牆的垂直蔓延」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Slab edges, curtain walls and vertical spread on the façade", which statement holds?
options: 樓板外周長 160 m、帷幕牆與樓板之間的縫寬 100 mm，若完全未封填，每層等效開口 A = 0.10×160 = 16 m²，相當於樓板上一個 4 m × 4 m 的洞。
樓梯加壓的壓力越大越安全。
老舊建築只要當年合法取得使用執照，就不需要再檢討防火區劃。
optionsEn: With a 160 m slab perimeter and a 100 mm gap between curtain wall and slab, an unsealed gap is an equivalent opening of A = 0.10×160 = 16 m² per floor, like a 4 m × 4 m hole in the slab.
The higher the stair pressurisation, the safer.
An old building that was lawfully approved when built needs no further review of its compartmentation.
quiz.explanation: 樓板外周長 160 m、帷幕牆與樓板之間的縫寬 100 mm，若完全未封填，每層等效開口 A = 0.10×160 = 16 m²，相當於樓板上一個 4 m × 4 m 的洞；即使只有 10% 長度漏封，也有約 1.6 m² 的垂直通道。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a 160 m slab perimeter and a 100 mm gap between curtain wall and slab, an unsealed gap is an equivalent opening of A = 0.10×160 = 16 m² per floor, like a 4 m × 4 m hole in the slab; even 10% of the length left unsealed is a vertical path of about 1.6 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 樓板邊緣、帷幕牆與外牆的垂直蔓延：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Slab edges, curtain walls and vertical spread on the façade: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「帷幕牆層間防火」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Curtain-wall perimeter fire barrier” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 層間防火填塞必須採用與帷幕牆型式一致的試驗系統，現場檢查礦棉密度、壓縮率、支撐角鐵與表面防煙密封，並逐層拍照；外牆材料須有燃燒性能證明，帷幕牆設計審查時把窗間牆與層間填塞一併檢核。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Perimeter fire barriers must be a tested system matching the curtain-wall type, with mineral-wool density, compression, support angles and surface smoke seal inspected and photographed floor by floor; façade materials need combustibility evidence, and curtain-wall design review checks spandrels and perimeter barriers together. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：帷幕牆、防火填塞與結構三方要在施工圖階段協調樓板邊緣細部，層間填塞列為帷幕牆安裝每層的停止點；外牆材料變更必須提出燃燒性證明並經審查，地震後檢查表應包含層間填塞。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Curtain-wall, firestopping and structural teams must coordinate slab-edge details at shop-drawing stage, with perimeter barriers a hold point on every floor of curtain-wall installation; any façade material change requires combustibility evidence and review, and post-earthquake checklists should include perimeter barriers.

steps.title: 樓板邊緣、帷幕牆與外牆的垂直蔓延：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slab edges, curtain walls and vertical spread on the façade: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「帷幕牆層間防火」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Curtain-wall perimeter fire barrier” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 層間填塞因帷幕牆變位或施工擠壓脫落，或保溫材被替換為可燃材料，火災時火煙沿樓板邊緣與外牆空腔逐層向上，區劃形同虛設；地震後帷幕牆層間變位也可能把填塞拉開而無人發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Perimeter barriers dislodged by curtain-wall movement or construction, or insulation swapped for combustible products, let fire and smoke climb floor by floor along slab edges and façade cavities, nullifying compartmentation; storey drift in an earthquake can also pull barriers open unnoticed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計上要同時處理樓板邊緣填塞、窗間牆高度與外牆材料的燃燒性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design must address slab-edge firestopping, spandrel height and façade combustibility together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樓板本身有防火時效，就代表上下樓層已經完全區劃。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the floor slab is fire-rated, the floors above and below are fully compartmented." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 層間填塞因帷幕牆變位或施工擠壓脫落，或保溫材被替換為可燃材料，火災時火煙沿樓板邊緣與外牆空腔逐層向上，區劃形同虛設；地震後帷幕牆層間變位也可能把填塞拉開而無人發現。
knowledge.textEn: Perimeter barriers dislodged by curtain-wall movement or construction, or insulation swapped for combustible products, let fire and smoke climb floor by floor along slab edges and façade cavities, nullifying compartmentation; storey drift in an earthquake can also pull barriers open unnoticed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「樓板邊緣、帷幕牆與外牆的垂直蔓延」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Slab edges, curtain walls and vertical spread on the façade" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
管線穿過防火牆後，用任何填縫材料補起來就可以。
層間填塞因帷幕牆變位或施工擠壓脫落，或保溫材被替換為可燃材料，火災時火煙沿樓板邊緣與外牆空腔逐層向上，區劃形同虛設。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
After pipes pass through a fire wall, any filler material can seal the gap.

Perimeter barriers dislodged by curtain-wall movement or construction, or insulation swapped for combustible products, let fire and smoke climb floor by floor along slab edges and façade cavities, nullifying compartmentation.
