quiz.explanationEn: Perimeter barriers dislodged by curtain-wall movement or construction, or insulation swapped for combustible products, let fire and smoke climb floor by floor along slab edges and façade cavities, nullifying compartmentation; storey drift in an earthquake can also pull barriers open unnoticed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工與裝修期間的區劃完整性：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Compartment integrity during construction and fit-out: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「管線貫穿防火填塞」如何影響高層建築消防分區設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Service penetration firestops” governs force, deformation or durability in “Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 區劃最大的敵人是施工後期與使用期間的穿孔：機電、弱電、空調與消防管線大量穿越區劃牆與樓板，每一個貫穿部都要以與管材、管徑、牆體型式相符的試驗系統封填。許多填塞在區劃牆完成驗收後才被後續工班打開，或以一般發泡材隨意填補。高層建築的貫穿部以萬計，只要少數失效就足以讓煙在樓層間流通。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「管線貫穿防火填塞」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The greatest enemy of compartmentation is late-stage and in-service penetrations: services, data, ductwork and fire-protection pipes cross compartment walls and floors in large numbers, and each penetration must be sealed with a tested system matching pipe material, size and wall type. Many seals are opened by later trades after the wall has been accepted, or patched with ordinary foam. A high-rise building has tens of thousands of penetrations, and a small fraction failing is enough to let smoke circulate between floors. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Service penetration firestops” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：40 層建築每層約 300 個貫穿部，總數 40×300 = 12,000 個；若 2% 未正確封填，即 240 個缺口，每個平均 0.01 m²，等效開口合計約 2.4 m²，分散在各層成為煙的通道。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 40-storey building with about 300 penetrations per floor has 40×300 = 12,000 in total; if 2% are not properly sealed, 240 gaps averaging 0.01 m² add up to an equivalent opening of about 2.4 m², spread over the floors as smoke paths.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管線穿過防火牆後，用任何填縫材料補起來就可以。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "After pipes pass through a fire wall, any filler material can seal the gap." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「管線貫穿防火填塞」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Service penetration firestops”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工與裝修期間的區劃完整性
knowledge.titleEn: Compartment integrity during construction and fit-out
knowledge.text: 區劃最大的敵人是施工後期與使用期間的穿孔：機電、弱電、空調與消防管線大量穿越區劃牆與樓板，每一個貫穿部都要以與管材、管徑、牆體型式相符的試驗系統封填。許多填塞在區劃牆完成驗收後才被後續工班打開，或以一般發泡材隨意填補。
knowledge.textEn: The greatest enemy of compartmentation is late-stage and in-service penetrations: services, data, ductwork and fire-protection pipes cross compartment walls and floors in large numbers, and each penetration must be sealed with a tested system matching pipe material, size and wall type. Many seals are opened by later trades after the wall has been accepted, or patched with ordinary foam.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管線穿過防火牆後，用任何填縫材料補起來就可以。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: After pipes pass through a fire wall, any filler material can seal the gap. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工與裝修期間的區劃完整性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compartment integrity during construction and fit-out" is correct?

管線穿過防火牆後，用任何填縫材料補起來就可以。
只要材料本身不燃，組成的牆或門就自動具有防火時效。
optionsEn: The greatest enemy of compartmentation is late-stage and in-service penetrations: services, data, ductwork and fire-protection pipes cross compartment walls and floors in large numbers, and each penetration must be sealed with a tested system matching pipe material, size and wall type.
After pipes pass through a fire wall, any filler material can seal the gap.
If the materials are non-combustible, the wall or door they form automatically has a fire rating.

quiz.explanationEn: The greatest enemy of compartmentation is late-stage and in-service penetrations: services, data, ductwork and fire-protection pipes cross compartment walls and floors in large numbers, and each penetration must be sealed with a tested system matching pipe material, size and wall type. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工與裝修期間的區劃完整性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compartment integrity during construction and fit-out: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「管線貫穿防火填塞」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Service penetration firestops” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：40 層建築每層約 300 個貫穿部，總數 40×300 = 12,000 個；若 2% 未正確封填，即 240 個缺口，每個平均 0.01 m²，等效開口合計約 2.4 m²，分散在各層成為煙的通道。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 40-storey building with about 300 penetrations per floor has 40×300 = 12,000 in total; if 2% are not properly sealed, 240 gaps averaging 0.01 m² add up to an equivalent opening of about 2.4 m², spread over the floors as smoke paths. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立貫穿部登錄系統，每個填塞貼上編號標籤並記錄系統型號、施工人員、日期與照片；由獨立檢查人員抽樣破壞性或目視檢查，發現缺失即擴大抽查；區劃牆在天花板封板前設停止點，未完成填塞不得封板。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Set up a penetration register in which each seal carries a numbered label recording system, installer, date and photograph; an independent inspector samples seals visually or destructively and extends sampling when defects appear; compartment walls have a hold point before ceilings close, and no ceiling may close over incomplete seals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 40 層建築每層約 300 個貫穿部，總數 40×300 = 12,000 個；若 2% 未正確封填，即 240 個缺口，每個平均 0.01 m²，等效開口合計約 2.4 m²，分散在各層成為煙的通道。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 40-storey building with about 300 penetrations per floor has 40×300 = 12,000 in total; if 2% are not properly sealed, 240 gaps averaging 0.01 m² add up to an equivalent opening of about 2.4 m², spread over the floors as smoke paths. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工與裝修期間的區劃完整性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Compartment integrity during construction and fit-out", which statement holds?
options: 鋼構只要有防火被覆，區劃失效也不會影響結構安全。
只要設了灑水系統，防火區劃就可有可無。
optionsEn: Steelwork with fireproofing is safe even if compartmentation fails.
A 40-storey building with about 300 penetrations per floor has 40×300 = 12,000 in total.
With sprinklers installed, compartmentation is optional.
quiz.explanation: 40 層建築每層約 300 個貫穿部，總數 40×300 = 12,000 個；若 2% 未正確封填，即 240 個缺口，每個平均 0.01 m²，等效開口合計約 2.4 m²，分散在各層成為煙的通道。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 40-storey building with about 300 penetrations per floor has 40×300 = 12,000 in total; if 2% are not properly sealed, 240 gaps averaging 0.01 m² add up to an equivalent opening of about 2.4 m², spread over the floors as smoke paths. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工與裝修期間的區劃完整性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compartment integrity during construction and fit-out: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「管線貫穿防火填塞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Service penetration firestops” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立貫穿部登錄系統，每個填塞貼上編號標籤並記錄系統型號、施工人員、日期與照片；由獨立檢查人員抽樣破壞性或目視檢查，發現缺失即擴大抽查；區劃牆在天花板封板前設停止點，未完成填塞不得封板。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Set up a penetration register in which each seal carries a numbered label recording system, installer, date and photograph; an independent inspector samples seals visually or destructively and extends sampling when defects appear; compartment walls have a hold point before ceilings close, and no ceiling may close over incomplete seals. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工規範規定區劃上的任何新開孔須先申請許可並指定合格施工者，完工後更新登錄系統；物業管理階段沿用同一套許可制度，裝修承包商退場前由管理單位檢查區劃。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification requires a permit and a qualified installer for any new opening in a compartment, with the register updated afterwards; the same permit system continues in facility management, and managers inspect compartments before fit-out contractors leave.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：後續工班為了新增線路在已填塞的貫穿部旁鑿孔，事後只用一般矽利康或發泡劑封住，外觀看似完整，火災時這些材料迅速燒失，煙與火穿過區劃；天花板封閉後無人再檢查，缺陷一直潛伏到火災發生。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Later trades break through beside sealed penetrations to add cables and close them with ordinary sealant or foam; it looks complete, but in a fire these materials burn away quickly and smoke and flame pass through, and once ceilings close nobody checks again until a fire reveals the defect. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 施工與裝修期間的區劃完整性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compartment integrity during construction and fit-out: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「管線貫穿防火填塞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Service penetration firestops” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 後續工班為了新增線路在已填塞的貫穿部旁鑿孔，事後只用一般矽利康或發泡劑封住，外觀看似完整，火災時這些材料迅速燒失，煙與火穿過區劃；天花板封閉後無人再檢查，缺陷一直潛伏到火災發生。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Later trades break through beside sealed penetrations to add cables and close them with ordinary sealant or foam; it looks complete, but in a fire these materials burn away quickly and smoke and flame pass through, and once ceilings close nobody checks again until a fire reveals the defect. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高層建築的貫穿部以萬計，只要少數失效就足以讓煙在樓層間流通。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A high-rise building has tens of thousands of penetrations, and a small fraction failing is enough to let smoke circulate between floors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管線穿過防火牆後，用任何填縫材料補起來就可以。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "After pipes pass through a fire wall, any filler material can seal the gap." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工與裝修期間的區劃完整性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compartment integrity during construction and fit-out" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 後續工班為了新增線路在已填塞的貫穿部旁鑿孔，事後只用一般矽利康或發泡劑封住，外觀看似完整，火災時這些材料迅速燒失，煙與火穿過區劃。

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If the materials are non-combustible, the wall or door they form automatically has a fire rating.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍」與「樓梯加壓、排煙與驗收試驗」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval" and "Stair pressurisation, smoke control and acceptance tests": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「標準耐火試驗爐」如何影響高層建築消防分區設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Standard fire-resistance furnace” governs force, deformation or durability in “Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 區劃構件的防火時效來自標準耐火試驗：把牆、樓板、門或貫穿系統安裝在試驗爐上，依 ISO 834、ASTM E119 或國家標準的升溫曲線加熱，觀察承載力、完整性（有無火焰穿透或棉墊點燃）與隔熱性（背火面平均溫升與最高點溫升）何時失效。試驗結果只適用於試驗構造及其認可的延伸範圍，尺寸、材料、固定方式與試驗不同時，不能直接沿用。台灣內政部建築研究所等機構設有性能試驗設施，支持防火材料與構造的驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「標準耐火試驗爐」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An element's fire rating comes from standard fire-resistance tests: a wall, floor, door or penetration system is mounted on a furnace and heated to the ISO 834, ASTM E119 or national curve while load-bearing capacity, integrity (flame penetration or cotton-pad ignition) and insulation (average and maximum temperature rise on the unexposed face) are watched for failure. Results apply only to the tested construction and its approved field of extension; different sizes, materials or fixings cannot simply borrow the rating. Institutions such as Taiwan's Architecture and Building Research Institute operate performance test facilities that support verification of fire-resisting materials and constructions. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Standard fire-resistance furnace” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ISO 834 曲線 30 min 時約 842°C、60 min 約 945°C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The ISO 834 curve reaches about 842°C at 30 min and 945°C at 60 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要材料本身不燃，組成的牆或門就自動具有防火時效。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the materials are non-combustible, the wall or door they form automatically has a fire rating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「標準耐火試驗爐」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Standard fire-resistance furnace”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍
knowledge.titleEn: Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval
knowledge.text: 區劃構件的防火時效來自標準耐火試驗：把牆、樓板、門或貫穿系統安裝在試驗爐上，依 ISO 834、ASTM E119 或國家標準的升溫曲線加熱，觀察承載力、完整性（有無火焰穿透或棉墊點燃）與隔熱性（背火面平均溫升與最高點溫升）何時失效。試驗結果只適用於試驗構造及其認可的延伸範圍，尺寸、材料、固定方式與試驗不同時，不能直接沿用。

Results apply only to the tested construction and its approved field of extension; different sizes, materials or fixings cannot simply borrow the rating.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要材料本身不燃，組成的牆或門就自動具有防火時效。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the materials are non-combustible, the wall or door they form automatically has a fire rating. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval" is correct?
options: 只要材料本身不燃，組成的牆或門就自動具有防火時效。
區劃構件的防火時效來自標準耐火試驗：把牆、樓板、門或貫穿系統安裝在試驗爐上，依 ISO 834、ASTM E119 或國家標準的升溫曲線加熱，觀察承載力、完整性（有無火焰穿透或棉墊點燃）與隔熱性（背火面平均溫升與最高點溫升）何時失效。
樓梯加壓的壓力越大越安全。
optionsEn: If the materials are non-combustible, the wall or door they form automatically has a fire rating.

An element's fire rating comes from standard fire-resistance tests: a wall, floor, door or penetration system is mounted on a furnace and heated to the ISO 834, ASTM E119 or national curve while load-bearing capacity, integrity (flame penetration or cotton-pad ignition) and insulation (average and maximum temperature rise on the unexposed face) are watched for failure.
The higher the stair pressurisation, the safer.
quiz.explanation: 區劃構件的防火時效來自標準耐火試驗：把牆、樓板、門或貫穿系統安裝在試驗爐上，依 ISO 834、ASTM E119 或國家標準的升溫曲線加熱，觀察承載力、完整性（有無火焰穿透或棉墊點燃）與隔熱性（背火面平均溫升與最高點溫升）何時失效。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An element's fire rating comes from standard fire-resistance tests: a wall, floor, door or penetration system is mounted on a furnace and heated to the ISO 834, ASTM E119 or national curve while load-bearing capacity, integrity (flame penetration or cotton-pad ignition) and insulation (average and maximum temperature rise on the unexposed face) are watched for failure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「標準耐火試驗爐」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Standard fire-resistance furnace” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ISO 834 曲線 30 min 時約 842°C、60 min 約 945°C。隔熱性常以背火面平均溫升不超過 140 K、任一點不超過 180 K 判定：室溫 20°C 時，背火面平均溫度達 160°C 或任一點達 200°C 即判定隔熱失效；若 52 分鐘時平均溫度先達 160°C，該構造只能認定為 30 分鐘等級而非 60 分鐘。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The ISO 834 curve reaches about 842°C at 30 min and 945°C at 60 min. Insulation is commonly judged by an average unexposed-face rise of no more than 140 K and no more than 180 K at any point: from 20°C ambient, failure occurs when the average reaches 160°C or any point reaches 200°C; if the average hits 160°C at 52 minutes, the construction rates only 30 minutes, not 60. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：審查試驗報告時核對試驗標準、試體尺寸、構造層次、固定方式、承載狀態與失效時間，並確認認可範圍涵蓋現場尺寸與配置；必要時要求第三方認證機構的產品認證與工廠品質管制紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: When reviewing test reports, check the standard, specimen size, build-up, fixing, loading condition and failure times, and confirm that the approved scope covers site sizes and configurations; where needed require third-party product certification and factory quality-control records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ISO 834 曲線 30 min 時約 842°C、60 min 約 945°C。隔熱性常以背火面平均溫升不超過 140 K、任一點不超過 180 K 判定：室溫 20°C 時，背火面平均溫度達 160°C 或任一點達 200°C 即判定隔熱失效；若 52 分鐘時平均溫度先達 160°C，該構造只能認定為 30 分鐘等級而非 60 分鐘。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The ISO 834 curve reaches about 842°C at 30 min and 945°C at 60 min. Insulation is commonly judged by an average unexposed-face rise of no more than 140 K and no more than 180 K at any point: from 20°C ambient, failure occurs when the average reaches 160°C or any point reaches 200°C; if the average hits 160°C at 52 minutes, the construction rates only 30 minutes, not 60. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval", which statement holds?
options: 老舊建築只要當年合法取得使用執照，就不需要再檢討防火區劃。
防火區劃只是延緩火勢，真正滅火只能靠消防隊，所以區劃不必太嚴格。
ISO 834 曲線 30 min 時約 842°C、60 min 約 945°C。
optionsEn: An old building that was lawfully approved when built needs no further review of its compartmentation.
Compartments only delay a fire and only firefighters extinguish it, so compartmentation need not be rigorous.
The ISO 834 curve reaches about 842°C at 30 min and 945°C at 60 min.
quiz.explanation: ISO 834 曲線 30 min 時約 842°C、60 min 約 945°C。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The ISO 834 curve reaches about 842°C at 30 min and 945°C at 60 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「標準耐火試驗爐」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Standard fire-resistance furnace” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 審查試驗報告時核對試驗標準、試體尺寸、構造層次、固定方式、承載狀態與失效時間，並確認認可範圍涵蓋現場尺寸與配置；必要時要求第三方認證機構的產品認證與工廠品質管制紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: When reviewing test reports, check the standard, specimen size, build-up, fixing, loading condition and failure times, and confirm that the approved scope covers site sizes and configurations; where needed require third-party product certification and factory quality-control records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計說明應明列每種防火構造引用的試驗報告編號與認可範圍，承包商變更產品須提出同等或更佳的試驗證明並經建築師與消防審查核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should list the test report number and approved scope for each fire-resisting construction, and any product substitution by the contractor must be supported by equal or better test evidence and approved by the architect and fire reviewer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若引用的試驗報告是較小尺寸的門或較薄的牆，現場大尺寸構造在火災中翹曲變形、提早出現縫隙；把非承重試驗的牆當作承重區劃牆使用，火災中可能因承載而提早倒塌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Citing a test on a smaller door or thinner wall means larger site constructions bow and open gaps early in a fire; using a wall tested as non-load-bearing as a load-bearing compartment wall can lead to early collapse under load in a fire. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 審查試驗報告時核對試驗標準、試體尺寸、構造層次、固定方式、承載狀態與失效時間，並確認認可範圍涵蓋現場尺寸與配置；必要時要求第三方認證機構的產品認證與工廠品質管制紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: When reviewing test reports, check the standard, specimen size, build-up, fixing, loading condition and failure times, and confirm that the approved scope covers site sizes and configurations; where needed require third-party product certification and factory quality-control records.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計說明應明列每種防火構造引用的試驗報告編號與認可範圍，承包商變更產品須提出同等或更佳的試驗證明並經建築師與消防審查核可。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis should list the test report number and approved scope for each fire-resisting construction, and any product substitution by the contractor must be supported by equal or better test evidence and approved by the architect and fire reviewer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval"?
options: 審查試驗報告時核對試驗標準、試體尺寸、構造層次、固定方式、承載狀態與失效時間，並確認認可範圍涵蓋現場尺寸與配置。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
防火門只要是防火材料做的，開著也能擋火。
optionsEn: When reviewing test reports, check the standard, specimen size, build-up, fixing, loading condition and failure times, and confirm that the approved scope covers site sizes and configurations.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A fire door made of fire-resisting material still stops fire when left open.
quiz.explanation: 審查試驗報告時核對試驗標準、試體尺寸、構造層次、固定方式、承載狀態與失效時間，並確認認可範圍涵蓋現場尺寸與配置；必要時要求第三方認證機構的產品認證與工廠品質管制紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: When reviewing test reports, check the standard, specimen size, build-up, fixing, loading condition and failure times, and confirm that the approved scope covers site sizes and configurations; where needed require third-party product certification and factory quality-control records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「標準耐火試驗爐」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Standard fire-resistance furnace” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若引用的試驗報告是較小尺寸的門或較薄的牆，現場大尺寸構造在火災中翹曲變形、提早出現縫隙；把非承重試驗的牆當作承重區劃牆使用，火災中可能因承載而提早倒塌。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Citing a test on a smaller door or thinner wall means larger site constructions bow and open gaps early in a fire; using a wall tested as non-load-bearing as a load-bearing compartment wall can lead to early collapse under load in a fire. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：台灣內政部建築研究所等機構設有性能試驗設施，支持防火材料與構造的驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Institutions such as Taiwan's Architecture and Building Research Institute operate performance test facilities that support verification of fire-resisting materials and constructions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要材料本身不燃，組成的牆或門就自動具有防火時效。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the materials are non-combustible, the wall or door they form automatically has a fire rating." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若引用的試驗報告是較小尺寸的門或較薄的牆，現場大尺寸構造在火災中翹曲變形、提早出現縫隙；把非承重試驗的牆當作承重區劃牆使用，火災中可能因承載而提早倒塌。
knowledge.textEn: Citing a test on a smaller door or thinner wall means larger site constructions bow and open gaps early in a fire; using a wall tested as non-load-bearing as a load-bearing compartment wall can lead to early collapse under load in a fire.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若引用的試驗報告是較小尺寸的門或較薄的牆，現場大尺寸構造在火災中翹曲變形、提早出現縫隙；把非承重試驗的牆當作承重區劃牆使用，火災中可能因承載而提早倒塌。
樓梯加壓的壓力越大越安全。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Citing a test on a smaller door or thinner wall means larger site constructions bow and open gaps early in a fire.
The higher the stair pressurisation, the safer.
quiz.explanation: 若引用的試驗報告是較小尺寸的門或較薄的牆，現場大尺寸構造在火災中翹曲變形、提早出現縫隙；把非承重試驗的牆當作承重區劃牆使用，火災中可能因承載而提早倒塌。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Citing a test on a smaller door or thinner wall means larger site constructions bow and open gaps early in a fire; using a wall tested as non-load-bearing as a load-bearing compartment wall can lead to early collapse under load in a fire. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 樓梯加壓、排煙與驗收試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stair pressurisation, smoke control and acceptance tests: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「特別安全梯加壓」如何影響高層建築消防分區設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stair pressurisation” governs force, deformation or durability in “Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 高層建築的樓梯與緊急昇降機間是垂直逃生與消防搶救的生命線，常以加壓送風維持比走廊高的壓力，讓門縫只往外漏氣而不讓煙進入。但壓力太高時，門會推不開，避難者無法進入樓梯；壓力太低則擋不住煙。煙囪效應使高層建築上下壓力分布不同，冬夏也不一樣，因此加壓系統要在實際建築中做驗收試驗，確認多扇門同時開啟時仍能維持壓差，且開門力在限值內。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「特別安全梯加壓」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stairs and fire-fighting lift lobbies in tall buildings are the lifelines for vertical escape and firefighting, often pressurised above corridor pressure so that air leaks outward through door gaps and smoke stays out. Too much pressure makes doors impossible to open and occupants cannot enter the stair; too little fails to hold back smoke. Stack effect distributes pressure differently over the height and between winter and summer, so pressurisation must be acceptance-tested in the real building to confirm that the pressure difference holds with several doors open and that door-opening forces stay within limits. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stair pressurisation” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：開門力 F = F_dc + W·A·ΔP/[2(W − d)]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Door-opening force F = F_dc + W·A·ΔP/[2(W − d)].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樓梯加壓的壓力越大越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher the stair pressurisation, the safer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「特別安全梯加壓」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stair pressurisation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 樓梯加壓、排煙與驗收試驗
knowledge.titleEn: Stair pressurisation, smoke control and acceptance tests
knowledge.text: 高層建築的樓梯與緊急昇降機間是垂直逃生與消防搶救的生命線，常以加壓送風維持比走廊高的壓力，讓門縫只往外漏氣而不讓煙進入。但壓力太高時，門會推不開，避難者無法進入樓梯；壓力太低則擋不住煙。
knowledge.textEn: Stairs and fire-fighting lift lobbies in tall buildings are the lifelines for vertical escape and firefighting, often pressurised above corridor pressure so that air leaks outward through door gaps and smoke stays out. Too much pressure makes doors impossible to open and occupants cannot enter the stair; too little fails to hold back smoke.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：樓梯加壓的壓力越大越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The higher the stair pressurisation, the safer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「樓梯加壓、排煙與驗收試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stair pressurisation, smoke control and acceptance tests" is correct?
options: 樓梯加壓的壓力越大越安全。
鋼構只要有防火被覆，區劃失效也不會影響結構安全。
高層建築的樓梯與緊急昇降機間是垂直逃生與消防搶救的生命線，常以加壓送風維持比走廊高的壓力，讓門縫只往外漏氣而不讓煙進入。
optionsEn: The higher the stair pressurisation, the safer.
Steelwork with fireproofing is safe even if compartmentation fails.

Stairs and fire-fighting lift lobbies in tall buildings are the lifelines for vertical escape and firefighting, often pressurised above corridor pressure so that air leaks outward through door gaps and smoke stays out.
quiz.explanation: 高層建築的樓梯與緊急昇降機間是垂直逃生與消防搶救的生命線，常以加壓送風維持比走廊高的壓力，讓門縫只往外漏氣而不讓煙進入。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stairs and fire-fighting lift lobbies in tall buildings are the lifelines for vertical escape and firefighting, often pressurised above corridor pressure so that air leaks outward through door gaps and smoke stays out. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 樓梯加壓、排煙與驗收試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stair pressurisation, smoke control and acceptance tests: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「特別安全梯加壓」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stair pressurisation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：開門力 F = F_dc + W·A·ΔP/[2(W − d)]。門寬 W = 0.9 m、門面積 A = 1.89 m²、把手距門邊 d = 0.075 m、門弓器力 F_dc = 40 N：ΔP = 50 Pa 時 F = 40 + 0.9×1.89×50/(2×0.825) ≈ 91.5 N；ΔP = 80 Pa 時約 122.5 N，接近常見的 133 N 上限。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Door-opening force F = F_dc + W·A·ΔP/[2(W − d)]. With door width W = 0.9 m, area A = 1.89 m², knob distance d = 0.075 m and closer force F_dc = 40 N: at ΔP = 50 Pa, F = 40 + 0.9×1.89×50/(2×0.825) ≈ 91.5 N; at 80 Pa about 122.5 N, close to the common 133 N limit. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收時在多個樓層量測樓梯與走廊間的壓差，分別在全部門關閉與指定數量門開啟時測試，並以拉力計量測開門力；夏季與冬季各測一次以涵蓋煙囪效應，結果與設計值比較並記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At acceptance, measure pressure difference between stair and corridor on several floors with all doors closed and with the specified number of doors open, and measure door-opening force with a force gauge; test in both summer and winter to capture stack effect, recording results against design values.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 開門力 F = F_dc + W·A·ΔP/[2(W − d)]。門寬 W = 0.9 m、門面積 A = 1.89 m²、把手距門邊 d = 0.075 m、門弓器力 F_dc = 40 N：ΔP = 50 Pa 時 F = 40 + 0.9×1.89×50/(2×0.825) ≈ 91.5 N；ΔP = 80 Pa 時約 122.5 N，接近常見的 133 N 上限。數值為教學假設。

With door width W = 0.9 m, area A = 1.89 m², knob distance d = 0.075 m and closer force F_dc = 40 N: at ΔP = 50 Pa, F = 40 + 0.9×1.89×50/(2×0.825) ≈ 91.5 N; at 80 Pa about 122.5 N, close to the common 133 N limit. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「樓梯加壓、排煙與驗收試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stair pressurisation, smoke control and acceptance tests", which statement holds?
options: 開門力 F = F_dc + W·A·ΔP/[2(W − d)]。
只要設了灑水系統，防火區劃就可有可無。
標示一小時防火時效的牆，在任何火災中都一定能撐一小時。
optionsEn: Door-opening force F = F_dc + W·A·ΔP/[2(W − d)].
With sprinklers installed, compartmentation is optional.
A wall rated for one hour will always last one hour in any fire.
quiz.explanation: 開門力 F = F_dc + W·A·ΔP/[2(W − d)]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Door-opening force F = F_dc + W·A·ΔP/[2(W − d)]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 樓梯加壓、排煙與驗收試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stair pressurisation, smoke control and acceptance tests: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「特別安全梯加壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stair pressurisation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 驗收時在多個樓層量測樓梯與走廊間的壓差，分別在全部門關閉與指定數量門開啟時測試，並以拉力計量測開門力；夏季與冬季各測一次以涵蓋煙囪效應，結果與設計值比較並記錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At acceptance, measure pressure difference between stair and corridor on several floors with all doors closed and with the specified number of doors open, and measure door-opening force with a force gauge; test in both summer and winter to capture stack effect, recording results against design values. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：加壓與排煙系統的驗收應包含跨季節試驗與聯動測試，並納入年度消防安全設備檢修；任何樓梯門、走廊隔間或機電改裝後，須重新量測壓差與開門力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Acceptance of pressurisation and smoke control should include seasonal and interlock tests and be part of annual fire-protection maintenance; after any change to stair doors, corridor partitions or services, re-measure pressure difference and door-opening force.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只在單一樓層、單一季節測試，冬季強烈煙囪效應下低樓層門可能推不開，高樓層壓差卻不足而進煙；加壓風機的電源與偵測連動若未與區劃同步維護，火災時加壓失效，樓梯成為煙囪。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing on one floor in one season can miss that, under strong winter stack effect, lower-floor doors cannot be opened while upper floors lack pressure and admit smoke; if fan power and detector interlocks are not maintained along with compartments, pressurisation fails in a fire and the stair becomes a chimney. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 驗收時在多個樓層量測樓梯與走廊間的壓差，分別在全部門關閉與指定數量門開啟時測試，並以拉力計量測開門力；夏季與冬季各測一次以涵蓋煙囪效應，結果與設計值比較並記錄。
knowledge.textEn: At acceptance, measure pressure difference between stair and corridor on several floors with all doors closed and with the specified number of doors open, and measure door-opening force with a force gauge; test in both summer and winter to capture stack effect, recording results against design values.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 加壓與排煙系統的驗收應包含跨季節試驗與聯動測試，並納入年度消防安全設備檢修；任何樓梯門、走廊隔間或機電改裝後，須重新量測壓差與開門力。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance of pressurisation and smoke control should include seasonal and interlock tests and be part of annual fire-protection maintenance; after any change to stair doors, corridor partitions or services, re-measure pressure difference and door-opening force.

quiz.question: 要驗證「樓梯加壓、排煙與驗收試驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stair pressurisation, smoke control and acceptance tests"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
驗收時在多個樓層量測樓梯與走廊間的壓差，分別在全部門關閉與指定數量門開啟時測試，並以拉力計量測開門力；夏季與冬季各測一次以涵蓋煙囪效應，結果與設計值比較並記錄。
樓板本身有防火時效，就代表上下樓層已經完全區劃。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

At acceptance, measure pressure difference between stair and corridor on several floors with all doors closed and with the specified number of doors open, and measure door-opening force with a force gauge.
If the floor slab is fire-rated, the floors above and below are fully compartmented.
quiz.explanation: 驗收時在多個樓層量測樓梯與走廊間的壓差，分別在全部門關閉與指定數量門開啟時測試，並以拉力計量測開門力；夏季與冬季各測一次以涵蓋煙囪效應，結果與設計值比較並記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At acceptance, measure pressure difference between stair and corridor on several floors with all doors closed and with the specified number of doors open, and measure door-opening force with a force gauge; test in both summer and winter to capture stack effect, recording results against design values. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 樓梯加壓、排煙與驗收試驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stair pressurisation, smoke control and acceptance tests: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「特別安全梯加壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stair pressurisation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只在單一樓層、單一季節測試，冬季強烈煙囪效應下低樓層門可能推不開，高樓層壓差卻不足而進煙；加壓風機的電源與偵測連動若未與區劃同步維護，火災時加壓失效，樓梯成為煙囪。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing on one floor in one season can miss that, under strong winter stack effect, lower-floor doors cannot be opened while upper floors lack pressure and admit smoke; if fan power and detector interlocks are not maintained along with compartments, pressurisation fails in a fire and the stair becomes a chimney. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：煙囪效應使高層建築上下壓力分布不同，冬夏也不一樣，因此加壓系統要在實際建築中做驗收試驗，確認多扇門同時開啟時仍能維持壓差，且開門力在限值內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Stack effect distributes pressure differently over the height and between winter and summer, so pressurisation must be acceptance-tested in the real building to confirm that the pressure difference holds with several doors open and that door-opening forces stay within limits.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樓梯加壓的壓力越大越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher the stair pressurisation, the safer." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只在單一樓層、單一季節測試，冬季強烈煙囪效應下低樓層門可能推不開，高樓層壓差卻不足而進煙；加壓風機的電源與偵測連動若未與區劃同步維護，火災時加壓失效，樓梯成為煙囪。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「樓梯加壓、排煙與驗收試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stair pressurisation, smoke control and acceptance tests" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼構只要有防火被覆，區劃失效也不會影響結構安全。
若只在單一樓層、單一季節測試，冬季強烈煙囪效應下低樓層門可能推不開，高樓層壓差卻不足而進煙。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Steelwork with fireproofing is safe even if compartmentation fails.
Testing on one floor in one season can miss that, under strong winter stack effect, lower-floor doors cannot be opened while upper floors lack pressure and admit smoke.
quiz.explanation: 若只在單一樓層、單一季節測試，冬季強烈煙囪效應下低樓層門可能推不開，高樓層壓差卻不足而進煙；加壓風機的電源與偵測連動若未與區劃同步維護，火災時加壓失效，樓梯成為煙囪。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing on one floor in one season can miss that, under strong winter stack effect, lower-floor doors cannot be opened while upper floors lack pressure and admit smoke; if fan power and detector interlocks are not maintained along with compartments, pressurisation fails in a fire and the stair becomes a chimney. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「區劃失效時的結構防火」與「使用管理、避難時間與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Structural fire safety when compartments fail" and "Management in use, escape time and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 區劃失效時的結構防火：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Structural fire safety when compartments fail: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼構臨界溫度」如何影響高層建築消防分區設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel critical temperature” governs force, deformation or durability in “Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 區劃假設火災被限制在一個區劃內燒完，結構防火被覆也依此設計；若灑水與區劃同時失效，多個區劃或多層同時燃燒，熱膨脹與強度折減會同時作用在大範圍的梁、柱與接頭上。One Meridian Plaza 火災後鋼梁與大梁下垂扭曲、樓板開裂，世界貿易中心 7 號大樓則在下層火災失控後倒塌。結構工程師要知道構件在多高的溫度會失去承載力，並與防火被覆的設計溫度一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼構臨界溫度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compartmentation assumes a fire burns out within one compartment, and structural fire protection is designed accordingly; if sprinklers and compartments both fail, several compartments or floors burn at once, and thermal expansion and strength loss act together on beams, columns and connections over a wide area. After the One Meridian Plaza fire, steel beams and girders sagged and twisted and floors cracked, while World Trade Center 7 collapsed after lower-floor fires burned uncontrolled. Structural engineers must know the temperature at which members lose capacity and align it with the fireproofing design temperature. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Steel critical temperature” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The EN 1993-1-2 critical temperature is θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼構只要有防火被覆，區劃失效也不會影響結構安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steelwork with fireproofing is safe even if compartmentation fails." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼構臨界溫度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Steel critical temperature”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 區劃失效時的結構防火
knowledge.titleEn: Structural fire safety when compartments fail
knowledge.text: 區劃假設火災被限制在一個區劃內燒完，結構防火被覆也依此設計；若灑水與區劃同時失效，多個區劃或多層同時燃燒，熱膨脹與強度折減會同時作用在大範圍的梁、柱與接頭上。One Meridian Plaza 火災後鋼梁與大梁下垂扭曲、樓板開裂，世界貿易中心 7 號大樓則在下層火災失控後倒塌。
knowledge.textEn: Compartmentation assumes a fire burns out within one compartment, and structural fire protection is designed accordingly; if sprinklers and compartments both fail, several compartments or floors burn at once, and thermal expansion and strength loss act together on beams, columns and connections over a wide area. After the One Meridian Plaza fire, steel beams and girders sagged and twisted and floors cracked, while World Trade Center 7 collapsed after lower-floor fires burned uncontrolled.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼構只要有防火被覆，區劃失效也不會影響結構安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Steelwork with fireproofing is safe even if compartmentation fails. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「區劃失效時的結構防火」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Structural fire safety when compartments fail" is correct?
options: 區劃假設火災被限制在一個區劃內燒完，結構防火被覆也依此設計；若灑水與區劃同時失效，多個區劃或多層同時燃燒，熱膨脹與強度折減會同時作用在大範圍的梁、柱與接頭上。
鋼構只要有防火被覆，區劃失效也不會影響結構安全。
老舊建築只要當年合法取得使用執照，就不需要再檢討防火區劃。
optionsEn: Compartmentation assumes a fire burns out within one compartment, and structural fire protection is designed accordingly.
Steelwork with fireproofing is safe even if compartmentation fails.
An old building that was lawfully approved when built needs no further review of its compartmentation.
quiz.explanation: 區劃假設火災被限制在一個區劃內燒完，結構防火被覆也依此設計；若灑水與區劃同時失效，多個區劃或多層同時燃燒，熱膨脹與強度折減會同時作用在大範圍的梁、柱與接頭上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compartmentation assumes a fire burns out within one compartment, and structural fire protection is designed accordingly; if sprinklers and compartments both fail, several compartments or floors burn at once, and thermal expansion and strength loss act together on beams, columns and connections over a wide area. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 區劃失效時的結構防火：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Structural fire safety when compartments fail: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼構臨界溫度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel critical temperature” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EN 1993-1-2 臨界溫度 θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482。使用率 μ₀ = 0.5 時 θ_cr ≈ 585°C；μ₀ = 0.7 時降為約 526°C；μ₀ = 0.3 時升為約 664°C。使用率越高，允許的鋼材溫度越低，防火被覆要越厚。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The EN 1993-1-2 critical temperature is θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482. At utilisation μ₀ = 0.5, θ_cr ≈ 585°C; at μ₀ = 0.7 it drops to about 526°C, and at μ₀ = 0.3 it rises to about 664°C. Higher utilisation means a lower allowable steel temperature and thicker fire protection. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：結構計算書列出主要梁柱在火災荷載組合下的使用率與臨界溫度，與防火被覆廠商的厚度表一致；長跨樓板與關鍵柱另做結構火災分析，並在施工時以測厚儀抽查被覆厚度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The structural calculations list utilisation and critical temperature for principal beams and columns under the fire load combination, consistent with the fireproofing manufacturer's thickness tables; long-span floors and key columns receive structural fire analysis, and coating thickness is sampled with a gauge during construction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: EN 1993-1-2 臨界溫度 θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482。使用率 μ₀ = 0.5 時 θ_cr ≈ 585°C；μ₀ = 0.7 時降為約 526°C；μ₀ = 0.3 時升為約 664°C。使用率越高，允許的鋼材溫度越低，防火被覆要越厚。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The EN 1993-1-2 critical temperature is θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482. At utilisation μ₀ = 0.5, θ_cr ≈ 585°C; at μ₀ = 0.7 it drops to about 526°C, and at μ₀ = 0.3 it rises to about 664°C. Higher utilisation means a lower allowable steel temperature and thicker fire protection. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「區劃失效時的結構防火」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Structural fire safety when compartments fail", which statement holds?
options: 防火區劃只是延緩火勢，真正滅火只能靠消防隊，所以區劃不必太嚴格。
防火門只要是防火材料做的，開著也能擋火。
optionsEn: Compartments only delay a fire and only firefighters extinguish it, so compartmentation need not be rigorous.
The EN 1993-1-2 critical temperature is θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482.
A fire door made of fire-resisting material still stops fire when left open.
quiz.explanationEn: The EN 1993-1-2 critical temperature is θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 區劃失效時的結構防火：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Structural fire safety when compartments fail: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼構臨界溫度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel critical temperature” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 結構計算書列出主要梁柱在火災荷載組合下的使用率與臨界溫度，與防火被覆廠商的厚度表一致；長跨樓板與關鍵柱另做結構火災分析，並在施工時以測厚儀抽查被覆厚度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The structural calculations list utilisation and critical temperature for principal beams and columns under the fire load combination, consistent with the fireproofing manufacturer's thickness tables; long-span floors and key columns receive structural fire analysis, and coating thickness is sampled with a gauge during construction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構與消防設計應共同決定設計火災情境（單一區劃或多層火災）並寫入設計基準；被覆修補列入機電施工的退場檢查，使用期間的荷載增加須回饋到臨界溫度檢核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Structural and fire engineers should jointly set the design fire scenarios, single-compartment or multi-floor, in the design basis; fireproofing repair is part of services contractors' exit inspection, and added loads in service must feed back into critical-temperature checks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若防火被覆依一般使用率設計，而某些構件因設計變更或增加荷載使用率提高，臨界溫度下降，同樣厚度的被覆在火災中提早失效；機電施工刮除或撞落被覆而未修補，也會形成局部弱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If fireproofing is sized for typical utilisation while design changes or added loads raise utilisation in some members, their critical temperature falls and the same coating fails early in a fire; fireproofing scraped or knocked off by services work and not repaired creates local weak points. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
