steps.title: 區劃失效時的結構防火：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Structural fire safety when compartments fail: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼構臨界溫度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Steel critical temperature” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若防火被覆依一般使用率設計，而某些構件因設計變更或增加荷載使用率提高，臨界溫度下降，同樣厚度的被覆在火災中提早失效；機電施工刮除或撞落被覆而未修補，也會形成局部弱點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If fireproofing is sized for typical utilisation while design changes or added loads raise utilisation in some members, their critical temperature falls and the same coating fails early in a fire; fireproofing scraped or knocked off by services work and not repaired creates local weak points. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：結構工程師要知道構件在多高的溫度會失去承載力，並與防火被覆的設計溫度一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Structural engineers must know the temperature at which members lose capacity and align it with the fireproofing design temperature.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼構只要有防火被覆，區劃失效也不會影響結構安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steelwork with fireproofing is safe even if compartmentation fails." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若防火被覆依一般使用率設計，而某些構件因設計變更或增加荷載使用率提高，臨界溫度下降，同樣厚度的被覆在火災中提早失效；機電施工刮除或撞落被覆而未修補，也會形成局部弱點。
knowledge.textEn: If fireproofing is sized for typical utilisation while design changes or added loads raise utilisation in some members, their critical temperature falls and the same coating fails early in a fire; fireproofing scraped or knocked off by services work and not repaired creates local weak points.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「區劃失效時的結構防火」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Structural fire safety when compartments fail" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若防火被覆依一般使用率設計，而某些構件因設計變更或增加荷載使用率提高，臨界溫度下降，同樣厚度的被覆在火災中提早失效。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
老舊建築只要當年合法取得使用執照，就不需要再檢討防火區劃。
optionsEn: If fireproofing is sized for typical utilisation while design changes or added loads raise utilisation in some members, their critical temperature falls and the same coating fails early in a fire.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
An old building that was lawfully approved when built needs no further review of its compartmentation.
quiz.explanation: 若防火被覆依一般使用率設計，而某些構件因設計變更或增加荷載使用率提高，臨界溫度下降，同樣厚度的被覆在火災中提早失效；機電施工刮除或撞落被覆而未修補，也會形成局部弱點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If fireproofing is sized for typical utilisation while design changes or added loads raise utilisation in some members, their critical temperature falls and the same coating fails early in a fire; fireproofing scraped or knocked off by services work and not repaired creates local weak points. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 使用管理、避難時間與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Management in use, escape time and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「區劃管理與公共安全申報」如何影響高層建築消防分區設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compartment management and safety reporting” governs force, deformation or durability in “Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 區劃在使用期間最容易被破壞：防火門被撐開、走廊堆放雜物、隔間任意變更、管道間被打開。2021 年 10 月高雄 13 層的城中城大樓火災造成 46 人死亡、41 人受傷，火從一樓起火，因低樓層挑高與玻璃立面迅速竄升，濃煙充滿上方樓層，雜物又助長火勢並阻礙救援，多數死者因吸入濃煙而亡。這類老舊大樓顯示，區劃不只是設計問題，而是管理、檢查與住戶教育的長期責任。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「區劃管理與公共安全申報」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compartments are most easily defeated in use: fire doors propped open, corridors cluttered, partitions altered at will and shafts opened. The October 2021 fire at Kaohsiung's 13-storey Cheng Chung Cheng Building killed 46 people and injured 41; starting on the ground floor, it rose quickly through high-ceilinged lower floors with a glass frontage and filled the floors above with smoke, while clutter fed the fire and blocked rescue, and most victims died of smoke inhalation. Such ageing buildings show that compartmentation is not only a design issue but a long-term responsibility of management, inspection and occupant education. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Compartment management and safety reporting” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以可用避難時間與所需避難時間比較：RSET = 偵測 60 s + 反應準備 300 s（夜間睡眠）+ 移動 180 s = 540 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Compare available and required safe egress time: RSET = detection 60 s + pre-movement 300 s (asleep at night) + travel 180 s = 540 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「老舊建築只要當年合法取得使用執照，就不需要再檢討防火區劃。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An old building that was lawfully approved when built needs no further review of its compartmentation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「區劃管理與公共安全申報」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Compartment management and safety reporting”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 使用管理、避難時間與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Management in use, escape time and handover
knowledge.text: 區劃在使用期間最容易被破壞：防火門被撐開、走廊堆放雜物、隔間任意變更、管道間被打開。2021 年 10 月高雄 13 層的城中城大樓火災造成 46 人死亡、41 人受傷，火從一樓起火，因低樓層挑高與玻璃立面迅速竄升，濃煙充滿上方樓層，雜物又助長火勢並阻礙救援，多數死者因吸入濃煙而亡。
knowledge.textEn: Compartments are most easily defeated in use: fire doors propped open, corridors cluttered, partitions altered at will and shafts opened. The October 2021 fire at Kaohsiung's 13-storey Cheng Chung Cheng Building killed 46 people and injured 41; starting on the ground floor, it rose quickly through high-ceilinged lower floors with a glass frontage and filled the floors above with smoke, while clutter fed the fire and blocked rescue, and most victims died of smoke inhalation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：老舊建築只要當年合法取得使用執照，就不需要再檢討防火區劃。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An old building that was lawfully approved when built needs no further review of its compartmentation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「使用管理、避難時間與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Management in use, escape time and handover" is correct?
options: 老舊建築只要當年合法取得使用執照，就不需要再檢討防火區劃。
區劃在使用期間最容易被破壞：防火門被撐開、走廊堆放雜物、隔間任意變更、管道間被打開。
只要設了灑水系統，防火區劃就可有可無。
optionsEn: An old building that was lawfully approved when built needs no further review of its compartmentation.
Compartments are most easily defeated in use: fire doors propped open, corridors cluttered, partitions altered at will and shafts opened.
With sprinklers installed, compartmentation is optional.
quiz.explanation: 區劃在使用期間最容易被破壞：防火門被撐開、走廊堆放雜物、隔間任意變更、管道間被打開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compartments are most easily defeated in use: fire doors propped open, corridors cluttered, partitions altered at will and shafts opened. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 使用管理、避難時間與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Management in use, escape time and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「區劃管理與公共安全申報」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compartment management and safety reporting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以可用避難時間與所需避難時間比較：RSET = 偵測 60 s + 反應準備 300 s（夜間睡眠）+ 移動 180 s = 540 s。若區劃失效、快速成長火災使走廊約 300 s 就不可維生，ASET − RSET = 300 − 540 = −240 s；區劃與防火門完整而把走廊維生時間延長到 900 s 以上，才有 360 s 的餘裕。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Compare available and required safe egress time: RSET = detection 60 s + pre-movement 300 s (asleep at night) + travel 180 s = 540 s. If compartments fail and a fast fire makes the corridor untenable at about 300 s, ASET − RSET = 300 − 540 = −240 s; only intact compartments and doors that extend corridor tenability beyond 900 s leave a margin of 360 s. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：管理單位依建築物公共安全檢查與消防安全設備檢修申報制度定期檢查防火門、區劃牆、貫穿填塞、樓梯淨空與灑水系統，檢查結果與防火區劃圖比對；改裝前由建築師或專業技師確認不破壞區劃。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Managers inspect fire doors, compartment walls, penetration seals, stair clearance and sprinklers periodically under building public-safety inspection and fire-protection equipment reporting schemes, comparing results with the compartmentation plan; before alterations an architect or professional engineer confirms that compartments are not breached.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以可用避難時間與所需避難時間比較：RSET = 偵測 60 s + 反應準備 300 s（夜間睡眠）+ 移動 180 s = 540 s。若區劃失效、快速成長火災使走廊約 300 s 就不可維生，ASET − RSET = 300 − 540 = −240 s；區劃與防火門完整而把走廊維生時間延長到 900 s 以上，才有 360 s 的餘裕。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Compare available and required safe egress time: RSET = detection 60 s + pre-movement 300 s (asleep at night) + travel 180 s = 540 s. If compartments fail and a fast fire makes the corridor untenable at about 300 s, ASET − RSET = 300 − 540 = −240 s; only intact compartments and doors that extend corridor tenability beyond 900 s leave a margin of 360 s. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「使用管理、避難時間與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Management in use, escape time and handover", which statement holds?
options: 標示一小時防火時效的牆，在任何火災中都一定能撐一小時。
樓板本身有防火時效，就代表上下樓層已經完全區劃。
以可用避難時間與所需避難時間比較：RSET = 偵測 60 s + 反應準備 300 s（夜間睡眠）+ 移動 180 s = 540 s。
optionsEn: A wall rated for one hour will always last one hour in any fire.
If the floor slab is fire-rated, the floors above and below are fully compartmented.
Compare available and required safe egress time: RSET = detection 60 s + pre-movement 300 s (asleep at night) + travel 180 s = 540 s.
quiz.explanation: 以可用避難時間與所需避難時間比較：RSET = 偵測 60 s + 反應準備 300 s（夜間睡眠）+ 移動 180 s = 540 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare available and required safe egress time: RSET = detection 60 s + pre-movement 300 s (asleep at night) + travel 180 s = 540 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 使用管理、避難時間與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Management in use, escape time and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「區劃管理與公共安全申報」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compartment management and safety reporting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 管理單位依建築物公共安全檢查與消防安全設備檢修申報制度定期檢查防火門、區劃牆、貫穿填塞、樓梯淨空與灑水系統，檢查結果與防火區劃圖比對；改裝前由建築師或專業技師確認不破壞區劃。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Managers inspect fire doors, compartment walls, penetration seals, stair clearance and sprinklers periodically under building public-safety inspection and fire-protection equipment reporting schemes, comparing results with the compartmentation plan; before alterations an architect or professional engineer confirms that compartments are not breached. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含防火區劃圖、防火構造試驗報告清單、防火門與貫穿部登錄、加壓與灑水系統驗收紀錄、檢查週期與改裝許可流程；管理單位應定期辦理住戶防火教育，並把防火門常閉列入規約。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include the compartmentation plan, a list of fire-test reports, registers of fire doors and penetrations, acceptance records for pressurisation and sprinklers, inspection intervals and the alteration permit procedure; managers should run regular occupant fire education and write ‘fire doors kept closed’ into house rules.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交接文件沒有防火區劃圖與貫穿部登錄，後續管理者不知道哪些牆是區劃牆，裝修時任意打通或開孔；長期堆放雜物與撐開防火門，讓設計上可行的避難時間在真實火災中變成負值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a compartmentation plan and penetration register at handover, later managers cannot tell which walls are compartment walls and break through or cut them during renovation; years of clutter and propped-open fire doors turn an escape margin that worked in design into a negative one in a real fire. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 管理單位依建築物公共安全檢查與消防安全設備檢修申報制度定期檢查防火門、區劃牆、貫穿填塞、樓梯淨空與灑水系統，檢查結果與防火區劃圖比對；改裝前由建築師或專業技師確認不破壞區劃。
knowledge.textEn: Managers inspect fire doors, compartment walls, penetration seals, stair clearance and sprinklers periodically under building public-safety inspection and fire-protection equipment reporting schemes, comparing results with the compartmentation plan; before alterations an architect or professional engineer confirms that compartments are not breached.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含防火區劃圖、防火構造試驗報告清單、防火門與貫穿部登錄、加壓與灑水系統驗收紀錄、檢查週期與改裝許可流程；管理單位應定期辦理住戶防火教育，並把防火門常閉列入規約。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include the compartmentation plan, a list of fire-test reports, registers of fire doors and penetrations, acceptance records for pressurisation and sprinklers, inspection intervals and the alteration permit procedure; managers should run regular occupant fire education and write ‘fire doors kept closed’ into house rules.

quiz.question: 要驗證「使用管理、避難時間與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Management in use, escape time and handover"?
options: 管理單位依建築物公共安全檢查與消防安全設備檢修申報制度定期檢查防火門、區劃牆、貫穿填塞、樓梯淨空與灑水系統，檢查結果與防火區劃圖比對。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要材料本身不燃，組成的牆或門就自動具有防火時效。
optionsEn: Managers inspect fire doors, compartment walls, penetration seals, stair clearance and sprinklers periodically under building public-safety inspection and fire-protection equipment reporting schemes, comparing results with the compartmentation plan.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If the materials are non-combustible, the wall or door they form automatically has a fire rating.
quiz.explanation: 管理單位依建築物公共安全檢查與消防安全設備檢修申報制度定期檢查防火門、區劃牆、貫穿填塞、樓梯淨空與灑水系統，檢查結果與防火區劃圖比對；改裝前由建築師或專業技師確認不破壞區劃。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Managers inspect fire doors, compartment walls, penetration seals, stair clearance and sprinklers periodically under building public-safety inspection and fire-protection equipment reporting schemes, comparing results with the compartmentation plan; before alterations an architect or professional engineer confirms that compartments are not breached. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 使用管理、避難時間與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Management in use, escape time and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「區劃管理與公共安全申報」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compartment management and safety reporting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交接文件沒有防火區劃圖與貫穿部登錄，後續管理者不知道哪些牆是區劃牆，裝修時任意打通或開孔；長期堆放雜物與撐開防火門，讓設計上可行的避難時間在真實火災中變成負值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a compartmentation plan and penetration register at handover, later managers cannot tell which walls are compartment walls and break through or cut them during renovation; years of clutter and propped-open fire doors turn an escape margin that worked in design into a negative one in a real fire. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這類老舊大樓顯示，區劃不只是設計問題，而是管理、檢查與住戶教育的長期責任。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Such ageing buildings show that compartmentation is not only a design issue but a long-term responsibility of management, inspection and occupant education.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「老舊建築只要當年合法取得使用執照，就不需要再檢討防火區劃。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An old building that was lawfully approved when built needs no further review of its compartmentation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若交接文件沒有防火區劃圖與貫穿部登錄，後續管理者不知道哪些牆是區劃牆，裝修時任意打通或開孔；長期堆放雜物與撐開防火門，讓設計上可行的避難時間在真實火災中變成負值。
knowledge.textEn: Without a compartmentation plan and penetration register at handover, later managers cannot tell which walls are compartment walls and break through or cut them during renovation; years of clutter and propped-open fire doors turn an escape margin that worked in design into a negative one in a real fire.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「使用管理、避難時間與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Management in use, escape time and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若交接文件沒有防火區劃圖與貫穿部登錄，後續管理者不知道哪些牆是區劃牆，裝修時任意打通或開孔。
只要設了灑水系統，防火區劃就可有可無。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without a compartmentation plan and penetration register at handover, later managers cannot tell which walls are compartment walls and break through or cut them during renovation.
With sprinklers installed, compartmentation is optional.
quiz.explanation: 若交接文件沒有防火區劃圖與貫穿部登錄，後續管理者不知道哪些牆是區劃牆，裝修時任意打通或開孔；長期堆放雜物與撐開防火門，讓設計上可行的避難時間在真實火災中變成負值。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without a compartmentation plan and penetration register at handover, later managers cannot tell which walls are compartment walls and break through or cut them during renovation; years of clutter and propped-open fire doors turn an escape margin that worked in design into a negative one in a real fire. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鋼構耐火被覆施工
summary: 從鋼材在火害中的強度折減與臨界溫度出發，建立斷面係數與被覆厚度的熱傳關係，比較噴覆型防火材料（SFRM）與膨脹型防火塗料的材料機制、施工環境與交叉作業損傷，再以 ASTM E605／E736 現場抽驗、耐火試驗登錄與約束條件判讀完成驗收，並以世界貿易中心、紐約時報大樓與馬德里溫莎大樓說明厚度、黏結與改修過渡期的風險。
summaryEn: Starting from steel strength loss and critical temperature in fire, build the heat-transfer link between section factor and protection thickness, compare the mechanisms, site conditions and trade damage of sprayed fire-resistive materials (SFRM) and intumescent coatings, then close acceptance with ASTM E605/E736 field sampling, fire-test listings and restraint classification, using the World Trade Center, the New York Times Building and the Windsor Building in Madrid to show the risks of thin spots, weak bond and half-finished retrofits.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 建築耐震、預鑄與防火
subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 150 m（約 492 ft）辦公塔的樓板梁要求 2 小時非約束等級，選用的登錄設計以 W/D = 0.82 的試驗梁、SFRM 厚度 1.00 in 取得該等級。專案梁 W16×26：D = 3bf + 2d − 2tw = 3×5.50 + 2×15.7 − 2×0.25 = 47.4 in，W/D = 26/47.4 ≈ 0.55，換算斷面係數 Ap/V ≈ 134/(W/D) ≈ 244 m⁻¹；厚度 T₁ = 1.00×(0.82 + 0.6)/(0.55 + 0.6) = 1.42/1.15 ≈ 1.24 in，取 1.25 in（約 32 mm）。現場允收：設計 ≥ 1 in，單點不得低於 1.25 − 0.25 = 1.00 in。樓高超過 420 ft，黏結門檻 1,000 psf ≈ 47.9 kPa，以 0.0045 m² 拉拔蓋需承受約 215 N 不破壞。若改用 W16×40（D = 3×7.00 + 2×16.0 − 2×0.305 ≈ 52.4 in，W/D ≈ 0.76），T₁ = 1.42/1.36 ≈ 1.04 in，較重斷面可減薄約 0.2 in，但仍不得低於登錄最小厚度。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: floor beams in a 150 m (about 492 ft) office tower need a 2-hour unrestrained rating, and the chosen listed design achieved it with a test beam of W/D = 0.82 and 1.00 in of SFRM. Project beam W16×26: D = 3bf + 2d − 2tw = 3×5.50 + 2×15.7 − 2×0.25 = 47.4 in, W/D = 26/47.4 ≈ 0.55, equivalent to a section factor Ap/V ≈ 134/(W/D) ≈ 244 m⁻¹; thickness T₁ = 1.00×(0.82 + 0.6)/(0.55 + 0.6) = 1.42/1.15 ≈ 1.24 in, specified as 1.25 in (about 32 mm). Field acceptance: with a design of 1 in or more, no reading may be below 1.25 − 0.25 = 1.00 in. The tower exceeds 420 ft, so the bond threshold is 1,000 psf ≈ 47.9 kPa, meaning a 0.0045 m² pull-off cap must hold about 215 N. If a W16×40 is used instead (D = 3×7.00 + 2×16.0 − 2×0.305 ≈ 52.4 in, W/D ≈ 0.76), T₁ = 1.42/1.36 ≈ 1.04 in, so the heavier section saves about 0.2 in but must still respect the listed minimum. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「火害曝露與鋼材強度折減」與「斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fire exposure and steel strength loss" and "Section factor and heating of protected steel": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 火害曝露與鋼材強度折減：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire exposure and steel strength loss: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼構件臨界溫度」如何影響鋼構耐火被覆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Critical steel temperature” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural-steel fireproofing application”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 結構鋼在約 400°C 以上開始明顯損失降伏強度與彈性模數，600°C 左右只剩常溫強度的一半左右，而一般建築火災的煙層溫度在數十分鐘內即可超過 800°C。耐火被覆本身不承載，它的任務是延緩熱量進入鋼材，使構件在要求的耐火時效內仍低於「臨界溫度」，也就是剩餘強度恰好等於火災時載重效應的溫度。臨界溫度不是固定值：火災載重組合採用較低的活載重，構件利用率越低，可容許的溫度越高；梁柱的支承與約束條件也會改變破壞模式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼構件臨界溫度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Structural steel begins to lose yield strength and stiffness noticeably above about 400°C and keeps only about half its ambient strength near 600°C, while gas temperatures in an ordinary building fire can exceed 800°C within tens of minutes. Fireproofing carries no load; its task is to slow heat flow into the steel so that, for the required fire-resistance period, the member stays below its critical temperature, the temperature at which the remaining strength just equals the load effect in fire. That temperature is not fixed: fire load combinations use reduced live load, a lower utilisation allows a higher temperature, and support and restraint conditions change the failure mode. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Critical steel temperature” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼材要到熔點（約 1,500°C）才會失去承載力，所以一般火災不足以讓鋼構倒塌。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel only loses capacity near its melting point of about 1,500°C, so an ordinary fire cannot bring down a steel frame." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼構件臨界溫度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Critical steel temperature”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 火害曝露與鋼材強度折減
knowledge.titleEn: Fire exposure and steel strength loss
knowledge.text: 結構鋼在約 400°C 以上開始明顯損失降伏強度與彈性模數，600°C 左右只剩常溫強度的一半左右，而一般建築火災的煙層溫度在數十分鐘內即可超過 800°C。耐火被覆本身不承載，它的任務是延緩熱量進入鋼材，使構件在要求的耐火時效內仍低於「臨界溫度」，也就是剩餘強度恰好等於火災時載重效應的溫度。
knowledge.textEn: Structural steel begins to lose yield strength and stiffness noticeably above about 400°C and keeps only about half its ambient strength near 600°C, while gas temperatures in an ordinary building fire can exceed 800°C within tens of minutes. Fireproofing carries no load; its task is to slow heat flow into the steel so that, for the required fire-resistance period, the member stays below its critical temperature, the temperature at which the remaining strength just equals the load effect in fire.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼材要到熔點（約 1,500°C）才會失去承載力，所以一般火災不足以讓鋼構倒塌。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Steel only loses capacity near its melting point of about 1,500°C, so an ordinary fire cannot bring down a steel frame. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「火害曝露與鋼材強度折減」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire exposure and steel strength loss" is correct?
options: 鋼材要到熔點（約 1,500°C）才會失去承載力，所以一般火災不足以讓鋼構倒塌。
結構鋼在約 400°C 以上開始明顯損失降伏強度與彈性模數，600°C 左右只剩常溫強度的一半左右，而一般建築火災的煙層溫度在數十分鐘內即可超過 800°C。
被覆厚度只依耐火時效決定，與鋼構件斷面大小無關。
optionsEn: Steel only loses capacity near its melting point of about 1,500°C, so an ordinary fire cannot bring down a steel frame.

Structural steel begins to lose yield strength and stiffness noticeably above about 400°C and keeps only about half its ambient strength near 600°C, while gas temperatures in an ordinary building fire can exceed 800°C within tens of minutes.
Protection thickness depends only on the required rating, not on the size of the steel section.
quiz.explanation: 結構鋼在約 400°C 以上開始明顯損失降伏強度與彈性模數，600°C 左右只剩常溫強度的一半左右，而一般建築火災的煙層溫度在數十分鐘內即可超過 800°C。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Structural steel begins to lose yield strength and stiffness noticeably above about 400°C and keeps only about half its ambient strength near 600°C, while gas temperatures in an ordinary building fire can exceed 800°C within tens of minutes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 火害曝露與鋼材強度折減：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire exposure and steel strength loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼構件臨界溫度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Critical steel temperature” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EN 1993-1-2 臨界溫度 θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482。利用率 μ₀ = 0.6 時 θ_cr ≈ 554°C；μ₀ = 0.4 時 θ_cr ≈ 620°C。ISO 834 標準升溫 θ_g = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20 在 t = 60 min 時約 945°C，遠高於兩者，因此必須靠被覆延緩升溫。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482. A utilisation μ₀ = 0.6 gives θ_cr ≈ 554°C; μ₀ = 0.4 gives θ_cr ≈ 620°C. The ISO 834 standard curve θ_g = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20 reaches about 945°C at t = 60 min, far above both, so protection must delay the heating. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在結構計算書列出每一類構件在火災載重組合下的利用率並換算臨界溫度，再對照所選耐火試驗登錄的允收溫度（ASTM E119 梁為四點平均 593°C、任一點 704°C）是否一致或較保守；若採性能化設計，需由防火工程師提出升溫分析，並經審查單位與主管建築機關認可。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List each member type's utilisation under the fire load combination in the structural calculations, convert it to a critical temperature, and check that the acceptance temperature of the chosen fire-test listing (ASTM E119 beams: 593°C average over four points, 704°C at any point) is consistent or more conservative; a performance-based design needs a heat-transfer analysis by a fire engineer, accepted by the peer reviewer and the building authority.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: EN 1993-1-2 臨界溫度 θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482。利用率 μ₀ = 0.6 時 θ_cr ≈ 554°C；μ₀ = 0.4 時 θ_cr ≈ 620°C。ISO 834 標準升溫 θ_g = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20 在 t = 60 min 時約 945°C，遠高於兩者，因此必須靠被覆延緩升溫。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482. A utilisation μ₀ = 0.6 gives θ_cr ≈ 554°C; μ₀ = 0.4 gives θ_cr ≈ 620°C. The ISO 834 standard curve θ_g = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20 reaches about 945°C at t = 60 min, far above both, so protection must delay the heating. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「火害曝露與鋼材強度折減」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire exposure and steel strength loss", which statement holds?
options: 膨脹型塗料只要總乾膜厚度足夠，底漆與面漆可以任意搭配。
被覆驗收合格之後，後續工班的作業不會影響耐火性能。
optionsEn: As long as the total dry film is thick enough, any primer and topcoat can be paired with an intumescent coating.
Once fireproofing passes acceptance, later trades cannot affect its fire performance.
EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482.
quiz.explanationEn: EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 火害曝露與鋼材強度折減：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire exposure and steel strength loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼構件臨界溫度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Critical steel temperature” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在結構計算書列出每一類構件在火災載重組合下的利用率並換算臨界溫度，再對照所選耐火試驗登錄的允收溫度（ASTM E119 梁為四點平均 593°C、任一點 704°C）是否一致或較保守；若採性能化設計，需由防火工程師提出升溫分析，並經審查單位與主管建築機關認可。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List each member type's utilisation under the fire load combination in the structural calculations, convert it to a critical temperature, and check that the acceptance temperature of the chosen fire-test listing (ASTM E119 beams: 593°C average over four points, 704°C at any point) is consistent or more conservative; a performance-based design needs a heat-transfer analysis by a fire engineer, accepted by the peer reviewer and the building authority. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計圖應以表格列出每種構件的耐火時效、所依據的試驗登錄編號、利用率假設與所需厚度，並註明「變更斷面或載重須重新核算被覆」；這張表是監造、被覆廠商與檢驗員共同的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Drawings should tabulate for each member type the fire-resistance rating, the listing number relied on, the assumed utilisation and the required thickness, with a note that any change of section or load requires the fireproofing to be re-checked; this table is the common reference for the supervising engineer, applicator and inspector.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把所有構件一律套用相同被覆厚度而不看利用率與斷面，常造成重載的細長柱保護不足、輕載大梁卻過度保護；火災中保護不足的柱先達臨界溫度並縮短，迫使上方樓層荷重重分配，嚴重時引發連鎖破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying one thickness to every member regardless of utilisation and section often leaves heavily loaded slender columns under-protected and lightly loaded girders over-protected; in a fire the under-protected column reaches its critical temperature first and shortens, forcing load redistribution in the floors above and, at worst, progressive failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在結構計算書列出每一類構件在火災載重組合下的利用率並換算臨界溫度，再對照所選耐火試驗登錄的允收溫度（ASTM E119 梁為四點平均 593°C、任一點 704°C）是否一致或較保守；若採性能化設計，需由防火工程師提出升溫分析，並經審查單位與主管建築機關認可。
knowledge.textEn: List each member type's utilisation under the fire load combination in the structural calculations, convert it to a critical temperature, and check that the acceptance temperature of the chosen fire-test listing (ASTM E119 beams: 593°C average over four points, 704°C at any point) is consistent or more conservative; a performance-based design needs a heat-transfer analysis by a fire engineer, accepted by the peer reviewer and the building authority.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計圖應以表格列出每種構件的耐火時效、所依據的試驗登錄編號、利用率假設與所需厚度，並註明「變更斷面或載重須重新核算被覆」；這張表是監造、被覆廠商與檢驗員共同的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Drawings should tabulate for each member type the fire-resistance rating, the listing number relied on, the assumed utilisation and the required thickness, with a note that any change of section or load requires the fireproofing to be re-checked; this table is the common reference for the supervising engineer, applicator and inspector.

quiz.question: 要驗證「火害曝露與鋼材強度折減」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fire exposure and steel strength loss"?
options: 在結構計算書列出每一類構件在火災載重組合下的利用率並換算臨界溫度，再對照所選耐火試驗登錄的允收溫度（ASTM E119 梁為四點平均 593°C、任一點 704°C）是否一致或較保守。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
約束等級的耐火時效一定比非約束等級長，所以都應採用約束等級。
optionsEn: List each member type's utilisation under the fire load combination in the structural calculations, convert it to a critical temperature, and check that the acceptance temperature of the chosen fire-test listing (ASTM E119 beams: 593°C average over four points, 704°C at any point) is consistent or more conservative.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A restrained rating always lasts longer than an unrestrained one, so it should always be used.
quiz.explanation: 在結構計算書列出每一類構件在火災載重組合下的利用率並換算臨界溫度，再對照所選耐火試驗登錄的允收溫度（ASTM E119 梁為四點平均 593°C、任一點 704°C）是否一致或較保守；若採性能化設計，需由防火工程師提出升溫分析，並經審查單位與主管建築機關認可。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List each member type's utilisation under the fire load combination in the structural calculations, convert it to a critical temperature, and check that the acceptance temperature of the chosen fire-test listing (ASTM E119 beams: 593°C average over four points, 704°C at any point) is consistent or more conservative; a performance-based design needs a heat-transfer analysis by a fire engineer, accepted by the peer reviewer and the building authority. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 火害曝露與鋼材強度折減：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire exposure and steel strength loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼構件臨界溫度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Critical steel temperature” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把所有構件一律套用相同被覆厚度而不看利用率與斷面，常造成重載的細長柱保護不足、輕載大梁卻過度保護；火災中保護不足的柱先達臨界溫度並縮短，迫使上方樓層荷重重分配，嚴重時引發連鎖破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying one thickness to every member regardless of utilisation and section often leaves heavily loaded slender columns under-protected and lightly loaded girders over-protected; in a fire the under-protected column reaches its critical temperature first and shortens, forcing load redistribution in the floors above and, at worst, progressive failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：臨界溫度不是固定值：火災載重組合採用較低的活載重，構件利用率越低，可容許的溫度越高；梁柱的支承與約束條件也會改變破壞模式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That temperature is not fixed: fire load combinations use reduced live load, a lower utilisation allows a higher temperature, and support and restraint conditions change the failure mode.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼材要到熔點（約 1,500°C）才會失去承載力，所以一般火災不足以讓鋼構倒塌。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steel only loses capacity near its melting point of about 1,500°C, so an ordinary fire cannot bring down a steel frame." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把所有構件一律套用相同被覆厚度而不看利用率與斷面，常造成重載的細長柱保護不足、輕載大梁卻過度保護；火災中保護不足的柱先達臨界溫度並縮短，迫使上方樓層荷重重分配，嚴重時引發連鎖破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Applying one thickness to every member regardless of utilisation and section often leaves heavily loaded slender columns under-protected and lightly loaded girders over-protected; in a fire the under-protected column reaches its critical temperature first and shortens, forcing load redistribution in the floors above and, at worst, progressive failure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「火害曝露與鋼材強度折減」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire exposure and steel strength loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把所有構件一律套用相同被覆厚度而不看利用率與斷面，常造成重載的細長柱保護不足、輕載大梁卻過度保護。
被覆厚度只依耐火時效決定，與鋼構件斷面大小無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Applying one thickness to every member regardless of utilisation and section often leaves heavily loaded slender columns under-protected and lightly loaded girders over-protected.
Protection thickness depends only on the required rating, not on the size of the steel section.
quiz.explanation: 把所有構件一律套用相同被覆厚度而不看利用率與斷面，常造成重載的細長柱保護不足、輕載大梁卻過度保護；火災中保護不足的柱先達臨界溫度並縮短，迫使上方樓層荷重重分配，嚴重時引發連鎖破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying one thickness to every member regardless of utilisation and section often leaves heavily loaded slender columns under-protected and lightly loaded girders over-protected; in a fire the under-protected column reaches its critical temperature first and shortens, forcing load redistribution in the floors above and, at worst, progressive failure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Section factor and heating of protected steel: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斷面係數 Ap/V」如何影響鋼構耐火被覆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section factor Ap/V” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural-steel fireproofing application”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 受火鋼材的升溫速度取決於吸熱表面積與可儲熱鋼材體積之比，也就是斷面係數 Ap/V（美制以每呎重量與受熱周長之比 W/D 表示，意義相反）。同樣的被覆厚度包在薄腹細長斷面上升溫較快，包在厚重斷面上升溫較慢。被覆以低熱傳導係數形成熱阻，熱流大約與厚度成反比；含水的水泥系材料在約 100°C 時還會因水分蒸發出現升溫平台。三面受火（上方為樓板）與四面受火的周長不同，必須依實際構造計算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斷面係數 Ap/V」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The heating rate of protected steel depends on the ratio of heated surface to the steel volume that stores heat, the section factor Ap/V (US practice uses weight per foot over heated perimeter, W/D, the inverse sense). The same protection thickness lets a thin-walled slender section heat faster than a heavy one. The protection forms a thermal resistance with low conductivity, so heat flow is roughly inversely proportional to thickness; moisture in cementitious products also produces a temperature plateau near 100°C as water evaporates. Three-sided exposure under a slab and four-sided exposure give different perimeters and must follow the actual construction. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Section factor Ap/V” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：輕質被覆的集總升溫率 Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For light protection the lumped heating rate is Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「被覆厚度只依耐火時效決定，與鋼構件斷面大小無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Protection thickness depends only on the required rating, not on the size of the steel section." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「斷面係數 Ap/V」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Section factor Ap/V”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Section factor and heating of protected steel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斷面係數 Ap/V」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Section factor Ap/V” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：輕質被覆的集總升溫率 Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa)。取 λp = 0.12 W/m·K、dp = 25 mm、Ap/V = 150 m⁻¹、θg − θa = 800 K、ca = 600 J/kg·K、ρa = 7,850 kg/m³：(0.12/0.025)×150×800×60 s/(600×7,850) ≈ 7.3 K/min；厚度加倍為 50 mm 時約 3.7 K/min。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For light protection the lumped heating rate is Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa). With λp = 0.12 W/m·K, dp = 25 mm, Ap/V = 150 m⁻¹, θg − θa = 800 K, ca = 600 J/kg·K and ρa = 7,850 kg/m³: (0.12/0.025)×150×800×60 s/(600×7,850) ≈ 7.3 K/min; doubling the thickness to 50 mm gives about 3.7 K/min. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從鋼構深化圖取出每一斷面尺寸，依三面或四面受火計算受熱周長與斷面係數，與廠商厚度表或試驗登錄的適用範圍比對；超出範圍（斷面係數過大或過小）時不可外插，須取得廠商或試驗機構出具的工程判定書。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take each section's dimensions from the steel shop drawings, compute heated perimeter and section factor for three- or four-sided exposure, and compare with the range of the manufacturer's thickness tables or the test listing; outside that range, with a section factor too high or too low, do not extrapolate but obtain an engineering judgement from the manufacturer or test body.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 輕質被覆的集總升溫率 Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa)。取 λp = 0.12 W/m·K、dp = 25 mm、Ap/V = 150 m⁻¹、θg − θa = 800 K、ca = 600 J/kg·K、ρa = 7,850 kg/m³：(0.12/0.025)×150×800×60 s/(600×7,850) ≈ 7.3 K/min；厚度加倍為 50 mm 時約 3.7 K/min。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For light protection the lumped heating rate is Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa). With λp = 0.12 W/m·K, dp = 25 mm, Ap/V = 150 m⁻¹, θg − θa = 800 K, ca = 600 J/kg·K and ρa = 7,850 kg/m³: (0.12/0.025)×150×800×60 s/(600×7,850) ≈ 7.3 K/min; doubling the thickness to 50 mm gives about 3.7 K/min. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Section factor and heating of protected steel", which statement holds?
options: 輕質被覆的集總升溫率 Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa)。
只要噴得夠厚，鋼材表面的油汙或浮鏽不會影響被覆效果。

If it is sprayed thick enough, oil or loose rust on the steel does not affect the protection.

steps.title: 斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Section factor and heating of protected steel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斷面係數 Ap/V」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Section factor Ap/V” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從鋼構深化圖取出每一斷面尺寸，依三面或四面受火計算受熱周長與斷面係數，與廠商厚度表或試驗登錄的適用範圍比對；超出範圍（斷面係數過大或過小）時不可外插，須取得廠商或試驗機構出具的工程判定書。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take each section's dimensions from the steel shop drawings, compute heated perimeter and section factor for three- or four-sided exposure, and compare with the range of the manufacturer's thickness tables or the test listing; outside that range, with a section factor too high or too low, do not extrapolate but obtain an engineering judgement from the manufacturer or test body. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：深化圖階段由鋼構廠輸出每支構件的斷面係數清單，被覆廠商據此提出逐件厚度表並簽章；現場每支構件以噴漆或標籤標示所需厚度，讓施作人員與檢驗員不必在現場自行換算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At shop-drawing stage the steel fabricator issues a section-factor list for every member, the fireproofing contractor returns a signed member-by-member thickness schedule, and each member on site is marked with its required thickness so that applicators and inspectors never recalculate in the field.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把四面受火周長套用到頂部有樓板的梁，或把箱形柱當成 H 型鋼計算，斷面係數算錯會直接造成厚度不足或浪費；另一常見錯誤是忽略蜂巢梁與腹板開孔梁的薄腹板，局部升溫遠快於翼板。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using a four-sided perimeter for a beam under a slab, or treating a box column as an H-section, gives a wrong section factor and directly produces too little or wasted thickness; another common error ignores the thin webs of cellular or castellated beams, which heat much faster locally than the flanges. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從鋼構深化圖取出每一斷面尺寸，依三面或四面受火計算受熱周長與斷面係數，與廠商厚度表或試驗登錄的適用範圍比對；超出範圍（斷面係數過大或過小）時不可外插，須取得廠商或試驗機構出具的工程判定書。
knowledge.textEn: Take each section's dimensions from the steel shop drawings, compute heated perimeter and section factor for three- or four-sided exposure, and compare with the range of the manufacturer's thickness tables or the test listing; outside that range, with a section factor too high or too low, do not extrapolate but obtain an engineering judgement from the manufacturer or test body.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 深化圖階段由鋼構廠輸出每支構件的斷面係數清單，被覆廠商據此提出逐件厚度表並簽章；現場每支構件以噴漆或標籤標示所需厚度，讓施作人員與檢驗員不必在現場自行換算。

quiz.question: 要驗證「斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Section factor and heating of protected steel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斷面係數 Ap/V」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Section factor Ap/V” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把四面受火周長套用到頂部有樓板的梁，或把箱形柱當成 H 型鋼計算，斷面係數算錯會直接造成厚度不足或浪費；另一常見錯誤是忽略蜂巢梁與腹板開孔梁的薄腹板，局部升溫遠快於翼板。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a four-sided perimeter for a beam under a slab, or treating a box column as an H-section, gives a wrong section factor and directly produces too little or wasted thickness; another common error ignores the thin webs of cellular or castellated beams, which heat much faster locally than the flanges. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：三面受火（上方為樓板）與四面受火的周長不同，必須依實際構造計算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Three-sided exposure under a slab and four-sided exposure give different perimeters and must follow the actual construction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「被覆厚度只依耐火時效決定，與鋼構件斷面大小無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Protection thickness depends only on the required rating, not on the size of the steel section." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把四面受火周長套用到頂部有樓板的梁，或把箱形柱當成 H 型鋼計算，斷面係數算錯會直接造成厚度不足或浪費；另一常見錯誤是忽略蜂巢梁與腹板開孔梁的薄腹板，局部升溫遠快於翼板。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Section factor and heating of protected steel" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
噴覆材料越輕越隔熱，因此任何場所都應選用最低密度的產品。
把四面受火周長套用到頂部有樓板的梁，或把箱形柱當成 H 型鋼計算，斷面係數算錯會直接造成厚度不足或浪費。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Lighter fireproofing always insulates better, so the lowest-density product suits every location.
Using a four-sided perimeter for a beam under a slab, or treating a box column as an H-section, gives a wrong section factor and directly produces too little or wasted thickness.
quiz.explanation: 把四面受火周長套用到頂部有樓板的梁，或把箱形柱當成 H 型鋼計算，斷面係數算錯會直接造成厚度不足或浪費；另一常見錯誤是忽略蜂巢梁與腹板開孔梁的薄腹板，局部升溫遠快於翼板。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a four-sided perimeter for a beam under a slab, or treating a box column as an H-section, gives a wrong section factor and directly produces too little or wasted thickness; another common error ignores the thin webs of cellular or castellated beams, which heat much faster locally than the flanges. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「噴覆材料密度與厚度換算」與「膨脹型塗料與塗裝系統相容」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "SFRM density and thickness substitution" and "Intumescent coatings and coating-system compatibility": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 噴覆材料密度與厚度換算：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: SFRM density and thickness substitution: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「噴覆型防火材料 SFRM」如何影響鋼構耐火被覆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sprayed fire-resistive material” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural-steel fireproofing application”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: SFRM 以石膏或水泥為膠結材，加入礦物纖維、蛭石或輕質骨材，濕噴或乾噴於鋼材表面，固化後形成多孔隔熱層。標準密度產品（約 15–21 pcf，240–336 kg/m³）適用於隱蔽空間；中、高密度產品抗衝擊與黏結較佳，用於停車場、機房或外露區。耐火試驗只對特定試體斷面取得厚度，其他斷面須以經認可的換算式調整：較重的斷面（W/D 較大）吸熱能力較高，可用較薄的被覆，但不得低於登錄的最小厚度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「噴覆型防火材料 SFRM」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SFRM uses a gypsum or cement binder with mineral fibre, vermiculite or lightweight aggregate, sprayed wet or dry onto the steel and cured into a porous insulating layer. Standard-density products (about 15–21 pcf, 240–336 kg/m³) suit concealed spaces; medium- and high-density products resist impact and bond better and are used in car parks, plant rooms or exposed areas. A fire test establishes thickness only for the tested section, so other sections are adjusted with an accepted substitution equation: heavier sections with higher W/D absorb more heat and may take a thinner coat, but never below the listed minimum thickness. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sprayed fire-resistive material” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：梁斷面替代式 T₁ = T₂·(W₂/D₂ + 0.6)/(W₁/D₁ + 0.6)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Beam substitution T₁ = T₂·(W₂/D₂ + 0.6)/(W₁/D₁ + 0.6).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「噴覆材料越輕越隔熱，因此任何場所都應選用最低密度的產品。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lighter fireproofing always insulates better, so the lowest-density product suits every location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「噴覆型防火材料 SFRM」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sprayed fire-resistive material”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「噴覆材料密度與厚度換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "SFRM density and thickness substitution" is correct?
options: SFRM 以石膏或水泥為膠結材，加入礦物纖維、蛭石或輕質骨材，濕噴或乾噴於鋼材表面，固化後形成多孔隔熱層。

As long as the total dry film is thick enough, any primer and topcoat can be paired with an intumescent coating.

steps.title: 噴覆材料密度與厚度換算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: SFRM density and thickness substitution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「噴覆型防火材料 SFRM」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sprayed fire-resistive material” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：梁斷面替代式 T₁ = T₂·(W₂/D₂ + 0.6)/(W₁/D₁ + 0.6)。W16×26 三面受火周長 D = 3bf + 2d − 2tw = 3×5.50 + 2×15.7 − 2×0.25 = 47.4 in，W/D = 26/47.4 ≈ 0.55。若試驗梁 W/D = 0.82、厚度 1.00 in，則 T₁ = 1.00×1.42/1.15 ≈ 1.24 in，取 1.25 in（約 32 mm）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Beam substitution T₁ = T₂·(W₂/D₂ + 0.6)/(W₁/D₁ + 0.6). A W16×26 with three-sided exposure has D = 3bf + 2d − 2tw = 3×5.50 + 2×15.7 − 2×0.25 = 47.4 in, so W/D = 26/47.4 ≈ 0.55. If the tested beam has W/D = 0.82 and 1.00 in of protection, T₁ = 1.00×1.42/1.15 ≈ 1.24 in, specified as 1.25 in (about 32 mm). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：確認所選登錄設計允許使用替代式、替代式只用於以溫度判定的非約束梁等級、計算結果不低於 3/8 in 等最小厚度，並把每一斷面的換算過程附在送審文件；同時核對產品密度等級與使用環境（隱蔽、外露、潮濕）相符。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm that the chosen listed design permits substitution, that the equation is applied only to the temperature-based unrestrained beam rating, and that results respect minimum thicknesses such as 3/8 in; attach the calculation for each section to the submittal, and check that the product density class matches the exposure: concealed, exposed or damp.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Beam substitution T₁ = T₂·(W₂/D₂ + 0.6)/(W₁/D₁ + 0.6). A W16×26 with three-sided exposure has D = 3bf + 2d − 2tw = 3×5.50 + 2×15.7 − 2×0.25 = 47.4 in, so W/D = 26/47.4 ≈ 0.55. If the tested beam has W/D = 0.82 and 1.00 in of protection, T₁ = 1.00×1.42/1.15 ≈ 1.24 in, specified as 1.25 in (about 32 mm). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「噴覆材料密度與厚度換算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "SFRM density and thickness substitution", which statement holds?
options: 被覆驗收合格之後，後續工班的作業不會影響耐火性能。
梁斷面替代式 T₁ = T₂·(W₂/D₂ + 0.6)/(W₁/D₁ + 0.6)。
約束等級的耐火時效一定比非約束等級長，所以都應採用約束等級。
optionsEn: Once fireproofing passes acceptance, later trades cannot affect its fire performance.
Beam substitution T₁ = T₂·(W₂/D₂ + 0.6)/(W₁/D₁ + 0.6).
A restrained rating always lasts longer than an unrestrained one, so it should always be used.
quiz.explanation: 梁斷面替代式 T₁ = T₂·(W₂/D₂ + 0.6)/(W₁/D₁ + 0.6)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Beam substitution T₁ = T₂·(W₂/D₂ + 0.6)/(W₁/D₁ + 0.6). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 噴覆材料密度與厚度換算：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: SFRM density and thickness substitution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「噴覆型防火材料 SFRM」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sprayed fire-resistive material” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 確認所選登錄設計允許使用替代式、替代式只用於以溫度判定的非約束梁等級、計算結果不低於 3/8 in 等最小厚度，並把每一斷面的換算過程附在送審文件；同時核對產品密度等級與使用環境（隱蔽、外露、潮濕）相符。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm that the chosen listed design permits substitution, that the equation is applied only to the temperature-based unrestrained beam rating, and that results respect minimum thicknesses such as 3/8 in; attach the calculation for each section to the submittal, and check that the product density class matches the exposure: concealed, exposed or damp. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規範應依區域指定密度等級（外露區與停車場用中、高密度），並要求廠商提交產品登錄、替代計算與現場密度試驗計畫；任何以較薄厚度取代設計值的提案，都須經結構與防火設計者書面同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should assign density classes by zone, with medium or high density for exposed areas and car parks, and require listings, substitution calculations and a field density-testing plan; any proposal to use a thinner coat than designed needs written approval from the structural and fire designers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把梁的替代式用在柱，或為較輕斷面減少厚度，等於拿試驗沒有涵蓋的條件冒險；把標準密度產品噴在經常受碰撞的停車場或機房，短期內就被撞落、刮除，留下大片裸露鋼材。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using the beam equation for columns, or reducing thickness for a lighter section, gambles on conditions the test never covered; spraying standard-density product in a car park or plant room that sees frequent impact soon leaves it knocked off and scraped away, exposing large areas of bare steel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 確認所選登錄設計允許使用替代式、替代式只用於以溫度判定的非約束梁等級、計算結果不低於 3/8 in 等最小厚度，並把每一斷面的換算過程附在送審文件；同時核對產品密度等級與使用環境（隱蔽、外露、潮濕）相符。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm that the chosen listed design permits substitution, that the equation is applied only to the temperature-based unrestrained beam rating, and that results respect minimum thicknesses such as 3/8 in; attach the calculation for each section to the submittal, and check that the product density class matches the exposure: concealed, exposed or damp.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規範應依區域指定密度等級（外露區與停車場用中、高密度），並要求廠商提交產品登錄、替代計算與現場密度試驗計畫；任何以較薄厚度取代設計值的提案，都須經結構與防火設計者書面同意。
knowledge.textEn: The specification should assign density classes by zone, with medium or high density for exposed areas and car parks, and require listings, substitution calculations and a field density-testing plan; any proposal to use a thinner coat than designed needs written approval from the structural and fire designers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「噴覆材料密度與厚度換算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "SFRM density and thickness substitution"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

If existing fireproofing looks intact, new material can simply be sprayed over it to reach a higher rating.

Confirm that the chosen listed design permits substitution, that the equation is applied only to the temperature-based unrestrained beam rating, and that results respect minimum thicknesses such as 3/8 in.

quiz.explanationEn: Confirm that the chosen listed design permits substitution, that the equation is applied only to the temperature-based unrestrained beam rating, and that results respect minimum thicknesses such as 3/8 in; attach the calculation for each section to the submittal, and check that the product density class matches the exposure: concealed, exposed or damp. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 噴覆材料密度與厚度換算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: SFRM density and thickness substitution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「噴覆型防火材料 SFRM」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sprayed fire-resistive material” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把梁的替代式用在柱，或為較輕斷面減少厚度，等於拿試驗沒有涵蓋的條件冒險；把標準密度產品噴在經常受碰撞的停車場或機房，短期內就被撞落、刮除，留下大片裸露鋼材。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：耐火試驗只對特定試體斷面取得厚度，其他斷面須以經認可的換算式調整：較重的斷面（W/D 較大）吸熱能力較高，可用較薄的被覆，但不得低於登錄的最小厚度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A fire test establishes thickness only for the tested section, so other sections are adjusted with an accepted substitution equation: heavier sections with higher W/D absorb more heat and may take a thinner coat, but never below the listed minimum thickness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「噴覆材料越輕越隔熱，因此任何場所都應選用最低密度的產品。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lighter fireproofing always insulates better, so the lowest-density product suits every location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把梁的替代式用在柱，或為較輕斷面減少厚度，等於拿試驗沒有涵蓋的條件冒險；把標準密度產品噴在經常受碰撞的停車場或機房，短期內就被撞落、刮除，留下大片裸露鋼材。
knowledge.textEn: Using the beam equation for columns, or reducing thickness for a lighter section, gambles on conditions the test never covered; spraying standard-density product in a car park or plant room that sees frequent impact soon leaves it knocked off and scraped away, exposing large areas of bare steel.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「噴覆材料密度與厚度換算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "SFRM density and thickness substitution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把梁的替代式用在柱，或為較輕斷面減少厚度，等於拿試驗沒有涵蓋的條件冒險；把標準密度產品噴在經常受碰撞的停車場或機房，短期內就被撞落、刮除，留下大片裸露鋼材。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
膨脹型塗料只要總乾膜厚度足夠，底漆與面漆可以任意搭配。
optionsEn: Using the beam equation for columns, or reducing thickness for a lighter section, gambles on conditions the test never covered.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
As long as the total dry film is thick enough, any primer and topcoat can be paired with an intumescent coating.
quiz.explanation: 把梁的替代式用在柱，或為較輕斷面減少厚度，等於拿試驗沒有涵蓋的條件冒險；把標準密度產品噴在經常受碰撞的停車場或機房，短期內就被撞落、刮除，留下大片裸露鋼材。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the beam equation for columns, or reducing thickness for a lighter section, gambles on conditions the test never covered; spraying standard-density product in a car park or plant room that sees frequent impact soon leaves it knocked off and scraped away, exposing large areas of bare steel. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 膨脹型塗料與塗裝系統相容：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Intumescent coatings and coating-system compatibility: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「膨脹型防火塗料」如何影響鋼構耐火被覆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Intumescent coating” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural-steel fireproofing application”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 膨脹型防火塗料在常溫下只是一層數百微米到數毫米的塗膜，受熱到約 200–250°C 時，酸源、碳源與發泡劑反應，膨脹成多孔炭化層；薄塗型膨脹比可達約 50 倍，厚塗環氧型膨脹較小但耐候與抗衝擊較佳，常用於建築師希望保留鋼構外形的外露梁柱。塗膜是一個系統：底漆提供防蝕與附著，膨脹層提供耐火，面漆提供耐候與顏色；三者必須在試驗中一起驗證，任意更換底漆或面漆都可能讓炭化層剝落或膨脹不足。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「膨脹型防火塗料」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An intumescent coating is only a film of a few hundred microns to a few millimetres at ambient temperature; at about 200–250°C its acid source, carbon source and blowing agent react and swell into a porous char. Thin-film products can expand about 50 times, while thick-film epoxy types expand less but resist weather and impact better; they are used where architects want exposed beams and columns to keep their steel profile. The film is a system: the primer gives corrosion protection and adhesion, the intumescent layer gives fire resistance and the topcoat gives weathering and colour. All three must be proven together in testing, and swapping a primer or topcoat can make the char detach or under-expand. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Intumescent coating” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：乾膜厚 DFT = 濕膜厚 WFT × 體積固含量 VS。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Dry film thickness DFT = wet film thickness WFT × volume solids VS.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「膨脹型塗料只要總乾膜厚度足夠，底漆與面漆可以任意搭配。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the total dry film is thick enough, any primer and topcoat can be paired with an intumescent coating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「膨脹型防火塗料」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Intumescent coating”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 膨脹型塗料與塗裝系統相容
knowledge.text: 膨脹型防火塗料在常溫下只是一層數百微米到數毫米的塗膜，受熱到約 200–250°C 時，酸源、碳源與發泡劑反應，膨脹成多孔炭化層；薄塗型膨脹比可達約 50 倍，厚塗環氧型膨脹較小但耐候與抗衝擊較佳，常用於建築師希望保留鋼構外形的外露梁柱。塗膜是一個系統：底漆提供防蝕與附著，膨脹層提供耐火，面漆提供耐候與顏色；三者必須在試驗中一起驗證，任意更換底漆或面漆都可能讓炭化層剝落或膨脹不足。
knowledge.textEn: An intumescent coating is only a film of a few hundred microns to a few millimetres at ambient temperature; at about 200–250°C its acid source, carbon source and blowing agent react and swell into a porous char. Thin-film products can expand about 50 times, while thick-film epoxy types expand less but resist weather and impact better; they are used where architects want exposed beams and columns to keep their steel profile.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：膨脹型塗料只要總乾膜厚度足夠，底漆與面漆可以任意搭配。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the total dry film is thick enough, any primer and topcoat can be paired with an intumescent coating. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「膨脹型塗料與塗裝系統相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Intumescent coatings and coating-system compatibility" is correct?
options: 膨脹型塗料只要總乾膜厚度足夠，底漆與面漆可以任意搭配。
膨脹型防火塗料在常溫下只是一層數百微米到數毫米的塗膜，受熱到約 200–250°C 時，酸源、碳源與發泡劑反應，膨脹成多孔炭化層。
只要噴得夠厚，鋼材表面的油汙或浮鏽不會影響被覆效果。
optionsEn: As long as the total dry film is thick enough, any primer and topcoat can be paired with an intumescent coating.
An intumescent coating is only a film of a few hundred microns to a few millimetres at ambient temperature.
If it is sprayed thick enough, oil or loose rust on the steel does not affect the protection.
quiz.explanation: 膨脹型防火塗料在常溫下只是一層數百微米到數毫米的塗膜，受熱到約 200–250°C 時，酸源、碳源與發泡劑反應，膨脹成多孔炭化層；薄塗型膨脹比可達約 50 倍，厚塗環氧型膨脹較小但耐候與抗衝擊較佳，常用於建築師希望保留鋼構外形的外露梁柱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An intumescent coating is only a film of a few hundred microns to a few millimetres at ambient temperature; at about 200–250°C its acid source, carbon source and blowing agent react and swell into a porous char. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 膨脹型塗料與塗裝系統相容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Intumescent coatings and coating-system compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「膨脹型防火塗料」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Intumescent coating” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：乾膜厚 DFT = 濕膜厚 WFT × 體積固含量 VS。目標 DFT 2.10 mm、VS = 70%、每道最大 WFT 1.0 mm，則每道 DFT = 0.70 mm，需 3 道；理論用量 2.10/0.70 = 3.0 L/m²，計入 30% 損耗為 3.0/0.7 ≈ 4.3 L/m²。若膨脹 50 倍，1.0 mm 薄塗膜約形成 50 mm 炭化層。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Dry film thickness DFT = wet film thickness WFT × volume solids VS. For a target DFT of 2.10 mm, VS = 70% and a maximum WFT of 1.0 mm per coat, each coat gives 0.70 mm DFT, so 3 coats are needed; theoretical consumption is 2.10/0.70 = 3.0 L/m², or 3.0/0.7 ≈ 4.3 L/m² with 30% loss. At 50-fold expansion a 1.0 mm thin film forms about 50 mm of char. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對塗裝系統（底漆、膨脹層、面漆）與評估報告或試驗登錄（如 EN 13381-8 或 UL 設計）所列產品完全一致；施工中以濕膜梳量測每道濕膜，乾燥後以磁感式膜厚計依斷面分區量測乾膜，平均值須達要求、最低讀值在允許範圍內，並扣除底漆與面漆厚度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check that the system of primer, intumescent and topcoat matches exactly the products in the assessment report or listing, for example EN 13381-8 or a UL design; during work measure each wet coat with a comb gauge, and after drying measure DFT with a magnetic gauge zone by zone on each section, requiring the mean to reach the target and the lowest readings to stay within tolerance, after deducting primer and topcoat thickness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 乾膜厚 DFT = 濕膜厚 WFT × 體積固含量 VS。目標 DFT 2.10 mm、VS = 70%、每道最大 WFT 1.0 mm，則每道 DFT = 0.70 mm，需 3 道；理論用量 2.10/0.70 = 3.0 L/m²，計入 30% 損耗為 3.0/0.7 ≈ 4.3 L/m²。若膨脹 50 倍，1.0 mm 薄塗膜約形成 50 mm 炭化層。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Dry film thickness DFT = wet film thickness WFT × volume solids VS. For a target DFT of 2.10 mm, VS = 70% and a maximum WFT of 1.0 mm per coat, each coat gives 0.70 mm DFT, so 3 coats are needed; theoretical consumption is 2.10/0.70 = 3.0 L/m², or 3.0/0.7 ≈ 4.3 L/m² with 30% loss. At 50-fold expansion a 1.0 mm thin film forms about 50 mm of char. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「膨脹型塗料與塗裝系統相容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Intumescent coatings and coating-system compatibility", which statement holds?
options: 平均厚度達到設計值，就代表每一處都有足夠的保護。
防火塗料只在火災時發揮作用，平時不需要檢查與維護。
乾膜厚 DFT = 濕膜厚 WFT × 體積固含量 VS。
optionsEn: If the average thickness meets the design value, every location is adequately protected.
Fire-protective coatings only matter during a fire, so they need no routine inspection or maintenance.
Dry film thickness DFT = wet film thickness WFT × volume solids VS.
quiz.explanation: 乾膜厚 DFT = 濕膜厚 WFT × 體積固含量 VS。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Dry film thickness DFT = wet film thickness WFT × volume solids VS. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 膨脹型塗料與塗裝系統相容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Intumescent coatings and coating-system compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「膨脹型防火塗料」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Intumescent coating” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
