steps.instruction: 核對塗裝系統（底漆、膨脹層、面漆）與評估報告或試驗登錄（如 EN 13381-8 或 UL 設計）所列產品完全一致；施工中以濕膜梳量測每道濕膜，乾燥後以磁感式膜厚計依斷面分區量測乾膜，平均值須達要求、最低讀值在允許範圍內，並扣除底漆與面漆厚度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check that the system of primer, intumescent and topcoat matches exactly the products in the assessment report or listing, for example EN 13381-8 or a UL design; during work measure each wet coat with a comb gauge, and after drying measure DFT with a magnetic gauge zone by zone on each section, requiring the mean to reach the target and the lowest readings to stay within tolerance, after deducting primer and topcoat thickness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：工廠塗裝與現場塗裝要劃清界面：哪些構件在廠內完成、運輸吊裝損傷由誰修補、接合部位留白多少與如何補塗，都要寫入塗裝計畫；底漆或面漆變更須取得塗料廠商的相容性書面確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw a clear line between shop and site application: which members are finished in the shop, who repairs transport and erection damage, how much is left bare at connections and how it is made good must all be in the coating plan; any primer or topcoat change needs the coating manufacturer's written compatibility confirmation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：面漆過厚或使用未經驗證的面漆會壓住膨脹，火災時炭化層只有設計的一部分；底漆不相容則可能讓整片塗膜受熱脫落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An over-thick or unproven topcoat can restrain expansion so the char reaches only part of its design thickness; an incompatible primer may let the whole film fall away when heated. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對塗裝系統（底漆、膨脹層、面漆）與評估報告或試驗登錄（如 EN 13381-8 或 UL 設計）所列產品完全一致；施工中以濕膜梳量測每道濕膜，乾燥後以磁感式膜厚計依斷面分區量測乾膜，平均值須達要求、最低讀值在允許範圍內，並扣除底漆與面漆厚度。
knowledge.textEn: Check that the system of primer, intumescent and topcoat matches exactly the products in the assessment report or listing, for example EN 13381-8 or a UL design; during work measure each wet coat with a comb gauge, and after drying measure DFT with a magnetic gauge zone by zone on each section, requiring the mean to reach the target and the lowest readings to stay within tolerance, after deducting primer and topcoat thickness.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 工廠塗裝與現場塗裝要劃清界面：哪些構件在廠內完成、運輸吊裝損傷由誰修補、接合部位留白多少與如何補塗，都要寫入塗裝計畫；底漆或面漆變更須取得塗料廠商的相容性書面確認。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a clear line between shop and site application: which members are finished in the shop, who repairs transport and erection damage, how much is left bare at connections and how it is made good must all be in the coating plan; any primer or topcoat change needs the coating manufacturer's written compatibility confirmation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「膨脹型塗料與塗裝系統相容」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Intumescent coatings and coating-system compatibility"?
options: 核對塗裝系統（底漆、膨脹層、面漆）與評估報告或試驗登錄（如 EN 13381-8 或 UL 設計）所列產品完全一致。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
鋼材要到熔點（約 1,500°C）才會失去承載力，所以一般火災不足以讓鋼構倒塌。
optionsEn: Check that the system of primer, intumescent and topcoat matches exactly the products in the assessment report or listing, for example EN 13381-8 or a UL design.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Steel only loses capacity near its melting point of about 1,500°C, so an ordinary fire cannot bring down a steel frame.
quiz.explanation: 核對塗裝系統（底漆、膨脹層、面漆）與評估報告或試驗登錄（如 EN 13381-8 或 UL 設計）所列產品完全一致；施工中以濕膜梳量測每道濕膜，乾燥後以磁感式膜厚計依斷面分區量測乾膜，平均值須達要求、最低讀值在允許範圍內，並扣除底漆與面漆厚度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check that the system of primer, intumescent and topcoat matches exactly the products in the assessment report or listing, for example EN 13381-8 or a UL design; during work measure each wet coat with a comb gauge, and after drying measure DFT with a magnetic gauge zone by zone on each section, requiring the mean to reach the target and the lowest readings to stay within tolerance, after deducting primer and topcoat thickness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 膨脹型塗料與塗裝系統相容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Intumescent coatings and coating-system compatibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「膨脹型防火塗料」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Intumescent coating” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 面漆過厚或使用未經驗證的面漆會壓住膨脹，火災時炭化層只有設計的一部分；底漆不相容則可能讓整片塗膜受熱脫落。單道塗得過厚還會流垂、溶劑封在膜內而起泡，乾膜讀值看似足夠，內部卻有空洞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An over-thick or unproven topcoat can restrain expansion so the char reaches only part of its design thickness; an incompatible primer may let the whole film fall away when heated. A single coat applied too thick sags or traps solvent and blisters, so the DFT reading looks adequate while the film contains voids. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：塗膜是一個系統：底漆提供防蝕與附著，膨脹層提供耐火，面漆提供耐候與顏色；三者必須在試驗中一起驗證，任意更換底漆或面漆都可能讓炭化層剝落或膨脹不足。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: All three must be proven together in testing, and swapping a primer or topcoat can make the char detach or under-expand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「膨脹型塗料只要總乾膜厚度足夠，底漆與面漆可以任意搭配。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the total dry film is thick enough, any primer and topcoat can be paired with an intumescent coating." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 面漆過厚或使用未經驗證的面漆會壓住膨脹，火災時炭化層只有設計的一部分；底漆不相容則可能讓整片塗膜受熱脫落。單道塗得過厚還會流垂、溶劑封在膜內而起泡，乾膜讀值看似足夠，內部卻有空洞。
knowledge.textEn: An over-thick or unproven topcoat can restrain expansion so the char reaches only part of its design thickness; an incompatible primer may let the whole film fall away when heated. A single coat applied too thick sags or traps solvent and blisters, so the DFT reading looks adequate while the film contains voids.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「膨脹型塗料與塗裝系統相容」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Intumescent coatings and coating-system compatibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
面漆過厚或使用未經驗證的面漆會壓住膨脹，火災時炭化層只有設計的一部分；底漆不相容則可能讓整片塗膜受熱脫落。
只要噴得夠厚，鋼材表面的油汙或浮鏽不會影響被覆效果。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An over-thick or unproven topcoat can restrain expansion so the char reaches only part of its design thickness.
If it is sprayed thick enough, oil or loose rust on the steel does not affect the protection.
quiz.explanation: 面漆過厚或使用未經驗證的面漆會壓住膨脹，火災時炭化層只有設計的一部分；底漆不相容則可能讓整片塗膜受熱脫落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An over-thick or unproven topcoat can restrain expansion so the char reaches only part of its design thickness; an incompatible primer may let the whole film fall away when heated. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「表面準備、環境條件與施工順序」與「交叉作業損傷與等效厚度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Surface preparation, ambient conditions and sequencing" and "Trade damage and equivalent thickness": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 表面準備、環境條件與施工順序：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Surface preparation, ambient conditions and sequencing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼材表面與環境條件」如何影響鋼構耐火被覆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Substrate and ambient conditions” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural-steel fireproofing application”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 被覆能否在火災時留在鋼材上，首先取決於施工當天的表面與環境：油汙、軋鋼鱗片、浮鏽或不相容的底漆會降低黏結，結露的鋼面會讓塗膜附著不良，低溫則使水泥系材料無法正常水化。SFRM 通常在樓板混凝土澆置、鋼承板與吊架夾具完成後施作，以免後續焊接或鑽孔破壞被覆；但若太晚，管線與風管已擋住鋼梁，噴槍無法到達。施工順序因此是品質的一部分，而不只是進度問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼材表面與環境條件」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Whether protection stays on the steel in a fire depends first on the surface and ambient conditions on the day of application: oil, mill scale, loose rust or an incompatible primer reduce bond, condensation on the steel prevents coating adhesion, and low temperature stops cementitious products from hydrating properly. SFRM is normally applied after the slab is cast and deck attachments and hanger clips are installed, so that later welding or drilling does not damage it; but if it comes too late, pipes and ducts already shield the beams and the spray gun cannot reach. Sequencing is therefore part of quality, not just of programme. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Substrate and ambient conditions” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Magnus dew point Td = 243.12·γ/(17.62 − γ), with γ = ln(RH) + 17.62·T/(243.12 + T).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要噴得夠厚，鋼材表面的油汙或浮鏽不會影響被覆效果。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If it is sprayed thick enough, oil or loose rust on the steel does not affect the protection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼材表面與環境條件」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Substrate and ambient conditions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 表面準備、環境條件與施工順序
knowledge.titleEn: Surface preparation, ambient conditions and sequencing
knowledge.text: 被覆能否在火災時留在鋼材上，首先取決於施工當天的表面與環境：油汙、軋鋼鱗片、浮鏽或不相容的底漆會降低黏結，結露的鋼面會讓塗膜附著不良，低溫則使水泥系材料無法正常水化。SFRM 通常在樓板混凝土澆置、鋼承板與吊架夾具完成後施作，以免後續焊接或鑽孔破壞被覆；但若太晚，管線與風管已擋住鋼梁，噴槍無法到達。
knowledge.textEn: Whether protection stays on the steel in a fire depends first on the surface and ambient conditions on the day of application: oil, mill scale, loose rust or an incompatible primer reduce bond, condensation on the steel prevents coating adhesion, and low temperature stops cementitious products from hydrating properly. SFRM is normally applied after the slab is cast and deck attachments and hanger clips are installed, so that later welding or drilling does not damage it; but if it comes too late, pipes and ducts already shield the beams and the spray gun cannot reach.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要噴得夠厚，鋼材表面的油汙或浮鏽不會影響被覆效果。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If it is sprayed thick enough, oil or loose rust on the steel does not affect the protection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「表面準備、環境條件與施工順序」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Surface preparation, ambient conditions and sequencing" is correct?
options: 只要噴得夠厚，鋼材表面的油汙或浮鏽不會影響被覆效果。
被覆驗收合格之後，後續工班的作業不會影響耐火性能。
被覆能否在火災時留在鋼材上，首先取決於施工當天的表面與環境：油汙、軋鋼鱗片、浮鏽或不相容的底漆會降低黏結，結露的鋼面會讓塗膜附著不良，低溫則使水泥系材料無法正常水化。
optionsEn: If it is sprayed thick enough, oil or loose rust on the steel does not affect the protection.
Once fireproofing passes acceptance, later trades cannot affect its fire performance.

Whether protection stays on the steel in a fire depends first on the surface and ambient conditions on the day of application: oil, mill scale, loose rust or an incompatible primer reduce bond, condensation on the steel prevents coating adhesion, and low temperature stops cementitious products from hydrating properly.
quiz.explanation: 被覆能否在火災時留在鋼材上，首先取決於施工當天的表面與環境：油汙、軋鋼鱗片、浮鏽或不相容的底漆會降低黏結，結露的鋼面會讓塗膜附著不良，低溫則使水泥系材料無法正常水化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Whether protection stays on the steel in a fire depends first on the surface and ambient conditions on the day of application: oil, mill scale, loose rust or an incompatible primer reduce bond, condensation on the steel prevents coating adhesion, and low temperature stops cementitious products from hydrating properly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 表面準備、環境條件與施工順序：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Surface preparation, ambient conditions and sequencing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼材表面與環境條件」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Substrate and ambient conditions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Magnus 露點 Td = 243.12·γ/(17.62 − γ)，γ = ln(RH) + 17.62·T/(243.12 + T)。氣溫 28°C、相對濕度 85%：γ = ln(0.85) + 17.62×28/271.12 ≈ 1.657，Td ≈ 243.12×1.657/15.96 ≈ 25.2°C；若要求鋼面高於露點 3°C，鋼面須 ≥ 28.2°C，量得 26°C 即不得塗裝。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Magnus dew point Td = 243.12·γ/(17.62 − γ), with γ = ln(RH) + 17.62·T/(243.12 + T). At 28°C and 85% relative humidity, γ = ln(0.85) + 17.62×28/271.12 ≈ 1.657 and Td ≈ 243.12×1.657/15.96 ≈ 25.2°C; requiring steel at least 3°C above dew point means 28.2°C or more, so a measured 26°C stops coating. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每班開工前記錄氣溫、相對濕度、鋼面溫度與露點，檢查表面清潔度與底漆狀態，必要時先做小面積黏結試噴；SFRM 須確認基材溫度與通風符合廠商要求，並在施作前完成吊架、夾具與焊接的先行件檢查，簽核後才放行噴覆。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before each shift record air temperature, relative humidity, steel surface temperature and dew point, and inspect cleanliness and primer condition, with a small bond trial patch where needed; for SFRM confirm substrate temperature and ventilation meet the manufacturer's limits, and complete a pre-application check of hangers, clips and welding, released by signature before spraying begins.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Magnus dew point Td = 243.12·γ/(17.62 − γ), with γ = ln(RH) + 17.62·T/(243.12 + T). At 28°C and 85% relative humidity, γ = ln(0.85) + 17.62×28/271.12 ≈ 1.657 and Td ≈ 243.12×1.657/15.96 ≈ 25.2°C; requiring steel at least 3°C above dew point means 28.2°C or more, so a measured 26°C stops coating. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「表面準備、環境條件與施工順序」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Surface preparation, ambient conditions and sequencing", which statement holds?
options: 約束等級的耐火時效一定比非約束等級長，所以都應採用約束等級。
既有被覆只要外觀完整，就能直接加噴新材料達到更高的耐火時效。
optionsEn: Magnus dew point Td = 243.12·γ/(17.62 − γ), with γ = ln(RH) + 17.62·T/(243.12 + T).
A restrained rating always lasts longer than an unrestrained one, so it should always be used.
If existing fireproofing looks intact, new material can simply be sprayed over it to reach a higher rating.
quiz.explanation: Magnus 露點 Td = 243.12·γ/(17.62 − γ)，γ = ln(RH) + 17.62·T/(243.12 + T)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Magnus dew point Td = 243.12·γ/(17.62 − γ), with γ = ln(RH) + 17.62·T/(243.12 + T). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 表面準備、環境條件與施工順序：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surface preparation, ambient conditions and sequencing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼材表面與環境條件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Substrate and ambient conditions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每班開工前記錄氣溫、相對濕度、鋼面溫度與露點，檢查表面清潔度與底漆狀態，必要時先做小面積黏結試噴；SFRM 須確認基材溫度與通風符合廠商要求，並在施作前完成吊架、夾具與焊接的先行件檢查，簽核後才放行噴覆。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before each shift record air temperature, relative humidity, steel surface temperature and dew point, and inspect cleanliness and primer condition, with a small bond trial patch where needed; for SFRM confirm substrate temperature and ventilation meet the manufacturer's limits, and complete a pre-application check of hangers, clips and welding, released by signature before spraying begins. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把被覆前檢查設為停止點：鋼承板焊接、吊架夾具、剪力釘與穿孔全部完成，表面與環境紀錄合格後，由監造簽發被覆許可；之後任何焊接或鑽孔都要事先申請，並排定補修與複驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make the pre-fireproofing inspection a hold point: deck welding, hanger clips, shear studs and penetrations all complete and surface and ambient records accepted, then the supervising engineer issues a permit to fireproof; any later welding or drilling requires a prior request and scheduled repair and re-inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在潮濕清晨噴塗膨脹漆，膜下結露造成大面積起泡剝離；SFRM 噴在帶油的鋼梁上，乾燥後看似完整，卻在後續振動或碰撞時整塊脫落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Intumescent sprayed on a damp morning with condensation under the film blisters and peels over large areas; SFRM sprayed on oily beams looks intact once dry but falls off in sheets under later vibration or impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每班開工前記錄氣溫、相對濕度、鋼面溫度與露點，檢查表面清潔度與底漆狀態，必要時先做小面積黏結試噴；SFRM 須確認基材溫度與通風符合廠商要求，並在施作前完成吊架、夾具與焊接的先行件檢查，簽核後才放行噴覆。
knowledge.textEn: Before each shift record air temperature, relative humidity, steel surface temperature and dew point, and inspect cleanliness and primer condition, with a small bond trial patch where needed; for SFRM confirm substrate temperature and ventilation meet the manufacturer's limits, and complete a pre-application check of hangers, clips and welding, released by signature before spraying begins.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把被覆前檢查設為停止點：鋼承板焊接、吊架夾具、剪力釘與穿孔全部完成，表面與環境紀錄合格後，由監造簽發被覆許可；之後任何焊接或鑽孔都要事先申請，並排定補修與複驗。
knowledge.textEn: Make the pre-fireproofing inspection a hold point: deck welding, hanger clips, shear studs and penetrations all complete and surface and ambient records accepted, then the supervising engineer issues a permit to fireproof; any later welding or drilling requires a prior request and scheduled repair and re-inspection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「表面準備、環境條件與施工順序」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Surface preparation, ambient conditions and sequencing"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
每班開工前記錄氣溫、相對濕度、鋼面溫度與露點，檢查表面清潔度與底漆狀態，必要時先做小面積黏結試噴。
被覆厚度只依耐火時效決定，與鋼構件斷面大小無關。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before each shift record air temperature, relative humidity, steel surface temperature and dew point, and inspect cleanliness and primer condition, with a small bond trial patch where needed.
Protection thickness depends only on the required rating, not on the size of the steel section.
quiz.explanation: 每班開工前記錄氣溫、相對濕度、鋼面溫度與露點，檢查表面清潔度與底漆狀態，必要時先做小面積黏結試噴；SFRM 須確認基材溫度與通風符合廠商要求，並在施作前完成吊架、夾具與焊接的先行件檢查，簽核後才放行噴覆。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before each shift record air temperature, relative humidity, steel surface temperature and dew point, and inspect cleanliness and primer condition, with a small bond trial patch where needed; for SFRM confirm substrate temperature and ventilation meet the manufacturer's limits, and complete a pre-application check of hangers, clips and welding, released by signature before spraying begins. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 表面準備、環境條件與施工順序：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surface preparation, ambient conditions and sequencing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼材表面與環境條件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Substrate and ambient conditions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在潮濕清晨噴塗膨脹漆，膜下結露造成大面積起泡剝離；SFRM 噴在帶油的鋼梁上，乾燥後看似完整，卻在後續振動或碰撞時整塊脫落。若被覆完成後才在梁上焊接吊架，熱影響區的被覆燒損又常被天花板遮住而未被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Intumescent sprayed on a damp morning with condensation under the film blisters and peels over large areas; SFRM sprayed on oily beams looks intact once dry but falls off in sheets under later vibration or impact. Hangers welded to beams after fireproofing burn the protection in the heat-affected zone, and the damage is often hidden by the ceiling and never found. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工順序因此是品質的一部分，而不只是進度問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sequencing is therefore part of quality, not just of programme.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要噴得夠厚，鋼材表面的油汙或浮鏽不會影響被覆效果。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If it is sprayed thick enough, oil or loose rust on the steel does not affect the protection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在潮濕清晨噴塗膨脹漆，膜下結露造成大面積起泡剝離；SFRM 噴在帶油的鋼梁上，乾燥後看似完整，卻在後續振動或碰撞時整塊脫落。若被覆完成後才在梁上焊接吊架，熱影響區的被覆燒損又常被天花板遮住而未被發現。
knowledge.textEn: Intumescent sprayed on a damp morning with condensation under the film blisters and peels over large areas; SFRM sprayed on oily beams looks intact once dry but falls off in sheets under later vibration or impact. Hangers welded to beams after fireproofing burn the protection in the heat-affected zone, and the damage is often hidden by the ceiling and never found.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「表面準備、環境條件與施工順序」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surface preparation, ambient conditions and sequencing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
被覆驗收合格之後，後續工班的作業不會影響耐火性能。
在潮濕清晨噴塗膨脹漆，膜下結露造成大面積起泡剝離；SFRM 噴在帶油的鋼梁上，乾燥後看似完整，卻在後續振動或碰撞時整塊脫落。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Once fireproofing passes acceptance, later trades cannot affect its fire performance.
Intumescent sprayed on a damp morning with condensation under the film blisters and peels over large areas.
quiz.explanation: 在潮濕清晨噴塗膨脹漆，膜下結露造成大面積起泡剝離；SFRM 噴在帶油的鋼梁上，乾燥後看似完整，卻在後續振動或碰撞時整塊脫落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Intumescent sprayed on a damp morning with condensation under the film blisters and peels over large areas; SFRM sprayed on oily beams looks intact once dry but falls off in sheets under later vibration or impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 交叉作業損傷與等效厚度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Trade damage and equivalent thickness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「機電吊架與補修區」如何影響鋼構耐火被覆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hanger penetrations and patch areas” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural-steel fireproofing application”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 被覆完成後，機電、消防灑水、天花板與帷幕牆工班仍需在鋼梁上固定吊架、切割或搬運材料，常刮除或撞落局部被覆。由於熱流近似與厚度成反比，局部變薄或裸露的區域就是熱的捷徑，使該處鋼材升溫遠快於平均厚度所預測。NIST 在世界貿易中心調查中以「熱等效均勻厚度」描述不均勻被覆的實際效果：原設計的平均厚度並不能代表最薄處的風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「機電吊架與補修區」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After fireproofing, MEP, sprinkler, ceiling and façade trades still fix hangers to beams and cut or move materials, often scraping or knocking off local patches. Because heat flow is roughly inversely proportional to thickness, thin or bare spots become thermal short cuts where the steel heats much faster than the average thickness predicts. In its World Trade Center investigation NIST described the real effect of uneven protection with a thermally equivalent uniform thickness: the average thickness does not represent the risk at the thinnest areas. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Hanger penetrations and patch areas” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：並聯熱流路徑的等效厚度 d_eq = 1/Σ(fᵢ/dᵢ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For parallel heat paths the equivalent thickness is d_eq = 1/Σ(fᵢ/dᵢ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「被覆驗收合格之後，後續工班的作業不會影響耐火性能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once fireproofing passes acceptance, later trades cannot affect its fire performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「機電吊架與補修區」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Hanger penetrations and patch areas”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 交叉作業損傷與等效厚度
knowledge.text: 被覆完成後，機電、消防灑水、天花板與帷幕牆工班仍需在鋼梁上固定吊架、切割或搬運材料，常刮除或撞落局部被覆。由於熱流近似與厚度成反比，局部變薄或裸露的區域就是熱的捷徑，使該處鋼材升溫遠快於平均厚度所預測。
knowledge.textEn: After fireproofing, MEP, sprinkler, ceiling and façade trades still fix hangers to beams and cut or move materials, often scraping or knocking off local patches. Because heat flow is roughly inversely proportional to thickness, thin or bare spots become thermal short cuts where the steel heats much faster than the average thickness predicts.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：被覆驗收合格之後，後續工班的作業不會影響耐火性能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once fireproofing passes acceptance, later trades cannot affect its fire performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「交叉作業損傷與等效厚度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Trade damage and equivalent thickness" is correct?
options: 被覆完成後，機電、消防灑水、天花板與帷幕牆工班仍需在鋼梁上固定吊架、切割或搬運材料，常刮除或撞落局部被覆。
被覆驗收合格之後，後續工班的作業不會影響耐火性能。
平均厚度達到設計值，就代表每一處都有足夠的保護。
optionsEn: After fireproofing, MEP, sprinkler, ceiling and façade trades still fix hangers to beams and cut or move materials, often scraping or knocking off local patches.
Once fireproofing passes acceptance, later trades cannot affect its fire performance.
If the average thickness meets the design value, every location is adequately protected.
quiz.explanation: 被覆完成後，機電、消防灑水、天花板與帷幕牆工班仍需在鋼梁上固定吊架、切割或搬運材料，常刮除或撞落局部被覆。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After fireproofing, MEP, sprinkler, ceiling and façade trades still fix hangers to beams and cut or move materials, often scraping or knocking off local patches. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 交叉作業損傷與等效厚度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trade damage and equivalent thickness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「機電吊架與補修區」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hanger penetrations and patch areas” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：並聯熱流路徑的等效厚度 d_eq = 1/Σ(fᵢ/dᵢ)。90% 面積 25 mm、10% 面積因刮損只剩 5 mm：d_eq = 1/(0.9/25 + 0.1/5) = 1/0.056 ≈ 17.9 mm，算術平均卻是 23 mm；升溫率約為原設計的 25/17.9 ≈ 1.4 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For parallel heat paths the equivalent thickness is d_eq = 1/Σ(fᵢ/dᵢ). With 90% of the area at 25 mm and 10% scraped to 5 mm: d_eq = 1/(0.9/25 + 0.1/5) = 1/0.056 ≈ 17.9 mm, although the arithmetic mean is 23 mm; the heating rate rises to about 25/17.9 ≈ 1.4 times the design value. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：天花板封板前安排第二次全面目視與抽量，特別檢查吊架、穿孔與梁柱接頭周邊；補修使用原產品或廠商核可的補修材料，補修區重新量測厚度並拍照，記入樓層補修清單後才准許封板。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Schedule a second full visual inspection with spot measurements before ceilings close, focusing on hangers, penetrations and beam–column joints; repairs use the original product or a manufacturer-approved patching material, each repaired area is re-measured and photographed, and the floor's repair log must be complete before ceilings may be closed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 並聯熱流路徑的等效厚度 d_eq = 1/Σ(fᵢ/dᵢ)。90% 面積 25 mm、10% 面積因刮損只剩 5 mm：d_eq = 1/(0.9/25 + 0.1/5) = 1/0.056 ≈ 17.9 mm，算術平均卻是 23 mm；升溫率約為原設計的 25/17.9 ≈ 1.4 倍。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For parallel heat paths the equivalent thickness is d_eq = 1/Σ(fᵢ/dᵢ). With 90% of the area at 25 mm and 10% scraped to 5 mm: d_eq = 1/(0.9/25 + 0.1/5) = 1/0.056 ≈ 17.9 mm, although the arithmetic mean is 23 mm; the heating rate rises to about 25/17.9 ≈ 1.4 times the design value. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「交叉作業損傷與等效厚度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Trade damage and equivalent thickness", which statement holds?
options: 防火塗料只在火災時發揮作用，平時不需要檢查與維護。
並聯熱流路徑的等效厚度 d_eq = 1/Σ(fᵢ/dᵢ)。
鋼材要到熔點（約 1,500°C）才會失去承載力，所以一般火災不足以讓鋼構倒塌。
optionsEn: Fire-protective coatings only matter during a fire, so they need no routine inspection or maintenance.
For parallel heat paths the equivalent thickness is d_eq = 1/Σ(fᵢ/dᵢ).
Steel only loses capacity near its melting point of about 1,500°C, so an ordinary fire cannot bring down a steel frame.
quiz.explanation: 並聯熱流路徑的等效厚度 d_eq = 1/Σ(fᵢ/dᵢ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For parallel heat paths the equivalent thickness is d_eq = 1/Σ(fᵢ/dᵢ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 交叉作業損傷與等效厚度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trade damage and equivalent thickness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「機電吊架與補修區」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hanger penetrations and patch areas” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 天花板封板前安排第二次全面目視與抽量，特別檢查吊架、穿孔與梁柱接頭周邊；補修使用原產品或廠商核可的補修材料，補修區重新量測厚度並拍照，記入樓層補修清單後才准許封板。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Schedule a second full visual inspection with spot measurements before ceilings close, focusing on hangers, penetrations and beam–column joints; repairs use the original product or a manufacturer-approved patching material, each repaired area is re-measured and photographed, and the floor's repair log must be complete before ceilings may be closed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約應規定誰破壞誰負擔、由原被覆廠商修補，並要求機電吊架優先採用夾具而非焊接；每層樓在天花板封閉前設最終被覆檢查停止點，由監造與第三方檢驗員共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The contract should make the trade that causes damage pay for repair by the original fireproofing contractor and require clamp-on rather than welded MEP hangers; each floor gets a final fireproofing hold point before ceilings close, signed jointly by the supervising engineer and the third-party inspector.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：天花板封閉後才發現被覆缺損，修補成本極高而常被忽略；火災時這些裸露點附近的梁下翼板先達臨界溫度，造成局部撓曲與接頭破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Damage found only after ceilings close is so expensive to reach that it is often ignored; in a fire the bottom flange near these bare spots reaches its critical temperature first, causing local deflection and connection failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 天花板封板前安排第二次全面目視與抽量，特別檢查吊架、穿孔與梁柱接頭周邊；補修使用原產品或廠商核可的補修材料，補修區重新量測厚度並拍照，記入樓層補修清單後才准許封板。
knowledge.textEn: Schedule a second full visual inspection with spot measurements before ceilings close, focusing on hangers, penetrations and beam–column joints; repairs use the original product or a manufacturer-approved patching material, each repaired area is re-measured and photographed, and the floor's repair log must be complete before ceilings may be closed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合約應規定誰破壞誰負擔、由原被覆廠商修補，並要求機電吊架優先採用夾具而非焊接；每層樓在天花板封閉前設最終被覆檢查停止點，由監造與第三方檢驗員共同簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The contract should make the trade that causes damage pay for repair by the original fireproofing contractor and require clamp-on rather than welded MEP hangers; each floor gets a final fireproofing hold point before ceilings close, signed jointly by the supervising engineer and the third-party inspector.

quiz.question: 要驗證「交叉作業損傷與等效厚度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Trade damage and equivalent thickness"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
噴覆材料越輕越隔熱，因此任何場所都應選用最低密度的產品。
天花板封板前安排第二次全面目視與抽量，特別檢查吊架、穿孔與梁柱接頭周邊。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Lighter fireproofing always insulates better, so the lowest-density product suits every location.
Schedule a second full visual inspection with spot measurements before ceilings close, focusing on hangers, penetrations and beam–column joints.
quiz.explanation: 天花板封板前安排第二次全面目視與抽量，特別檢查吊架、穿孔與梁柱接頭周邊；補修使用原產品或廠商核可的補修材料，補修區重新量測厚度並拍照，記入樓層補修清單後才准許封板。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Schedule a second full visual inspection with spot measurements before ceilings close, focusing on hangers, penetrations and beam–column joints; repairs use the original product or a manufacturer-approved patching material, each repaired area is re-measured and photographed, and the floor's repair log must be complete before ceilings may be closed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 交叉作業損傷與等效厚度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Trade damage and equivalent thickness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「機電吊架與補修區」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hanger penetrations and patch areas” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 天花板封閉後才發現被覆缺損，修補成本極高而常被忽略；火災時這些裸露點附近的梁下翼板先達臨界溫度，造成局部撓曲與接頭破壞。NIST 的世界貿易中心調查也指出，飛機撞擊使樓板桁架與柱上的被覆大量脫落，是鋼構件快速升溫的重要原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Damage found only after ceilings close is so expensive to reach that it is often ignored; in a fire the bottom flange near these bare spots reaches its critical temperature first, causing local deflection and connection failure. NIST's World Trade Center investigation also found that the aircraft impacts dislodged much of the fireproofing on floor trusses and columns, a key reason for rapid heating of the steel. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：NIST 在世界貿易中心調查中以「熱等效均勻厚度」描述不均勻被覆的實際效果：原設計的平均厚度並不能代表最薄處的風險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In its World Trade Center investigation NIST described the real effect of uneven protection with a thermally equivalent uniform thickness: the average thickness does not represent the risk at the thinnest areas.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「被覆驗收合格之後，後續工班的作業不會影響耐火性能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once fireproofing passes acceptance, later trades cannot affect its fire performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 天花板封閉後才發現被覆缺損，修補成本極高而常被忽略；火災時這些裸露點附近的梁下翼板先達臨界溫度，造成局部撓曲與接頭破壞。NIST 的世界貿易中心調查也指出，飛機撞擊使樓板桁架與柱上的被覆大量脫落，是鋼構件快速升溫的重要原因。
knowledge.textEn: Damage found only after ceilings close is so expensive to reach that it is often ignored; in a fire the bottom flange near these bare spots reaches its critical temperature first, causing local deflection and connection failure. NIST's World Trade Center investigation also found that the aircraft impacts dislodged much of the fireproofing on floor trusses and columns, a key reason for rapid heating of the steel.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「交叉作業損傷與等效厚度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Trade damage and equivalent thickness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 天花板封閉後才發現被覆缺損，修補成本極高而常被忽略；火災時這些裸露點附近的梁下翼板先達臨界溫度，造成局部撓曲與接頭破壞。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
平均厚度達到設計值，就代表每一處都有足夠的保護。
optionsEn: Damage found only after ceilings close is so expensive to reach that it is often ignored.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If the average thickness meets the design value, every location is adequately protected.
quiz.explanation: 天花板封閉後才發現被覆缺損，修補成本極高而常被忽略；火災時這些裸露點附近的梁下翼板先達臨界溫度，造成局部撓曲與接頭破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Damage found only after ceilings close is so expensive to reach that it is often ignored; in a fire the bottom flange near these bare spots reaches its critical temperature first, causing local deflection and connection failure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「現場厚度、密度與黏結強度抽驗」與「標準耐火試驗、登錄設計與約束分類」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Field sampling of thickness, density and bond strength" and "Standard fire tests, listed designs and restraint classification": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 現場厚度、密度與黏結強度抽驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Field sampling of thickness, density and bond strength: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「厚度、密度與黏結抽驗」如何影響鋼構耐火被覆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thickness, density and bond sampling” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural-steel fireproofing application”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 現場驗收把試驗室的耐火設計轉成三個可量測的量：厚度、密度與黏結強度。厚度依 ASTM E605 以探針式量規在指定位置量測，梁與柱都有規定的點數與抽樣比例；密度由切取試塊的體積與乾重求得；黏結強度則依 ASTM E736 以拉拔試驗確認被覆不會從鋼材或自身內部分離。美國 IBC 要求這些項目由特別檢驗員執行，並依樓高提高高層建築的黏結強度門檻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「厚度、密度與黏結抽驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Field acceptance turns the laboratory fire design into three measurable quantities: thickness, density and bond strength. Thickness is measured to ASTM E605 with a probe gauge at prescribed locations, with set numbers of readings and sampling rates for beams and columns; density comes from the volume and dry mass of cut samples; and bond strength is checked to ASTM E736 with a pull-off test showing that the material does not separate from the steel or within itself. The US IBC assigns these items to a special inspector and raises the bond threshold for high-rise buildings by height. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Thickness, density and bond sampling” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：IBC 黏結門檻換算：150 psf × 47.88 Pa/psf ≈ 7.2 kPa；430 psf ≈ 20.6 kPa；1,000 psf ≈ 47.9 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: IBC bond thresholds: 150 psf × 47.88 Pa/psf ≈ 7.2 kPa; 430 psf ≈ 20.6 kPa; 1,000 psf ≈ 47.9 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均厚度達到設計值，就代表每一處都有足夠的保護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the average thickness meets the design value, every location is adequately protected." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「厚度、密度與黏結抽驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Thickness, density and bond sampling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 現場厚度、密度與黏結強度抽驗
knowledge.titleEn: Field sampling of thickness, density and bond strength
knowledge.text: 現場驗收把試驗室的耐火設計轉成三個可量測的量：厚度、密度與黏結強度。厚度依 ASTM E605 以探針式量規在指定位置量測，梁與柱都有規定的點數與抽樣比例；密度由切取試塊的體積與乾重求得；黏結強度則依 ASTM E736 以拉拔試驗確認被覆不會從鋼材或自身內部分離。
knowledge.textEn: Field acceptance turns the laboratory fire design into three measurable quantities: thickness, density and bond strength. Thickness is measured to ASTM E605 with a probe gauge at prescribed locations, with set numbers of readings and sampling rates for beams and columns; density comes from the volume and dry mass of cut samples; and bond strength is checked to ASTM E736 with a pull-off test showing that the material does not separate from the steel or within itself.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均厚度達到設計值，就代表每一處都有足夠的保護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the average thickness meets the design value, every location is adequately protected. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「現場厚度、密度與黏結強度抽驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Field sampling of thickness, density and bond strength" is correct?
options: 平均厚度達到設計值，就代表每一處都有足夠的保護。
現場驗收把試驗室的耐火設計轉成三個可量測的量：厚度、密度與黏結強度。
約束等級的耐火時效一定比非約束等級長，所以都應採用約束等級。
optionsEn: If the average thickness meets the design value, every location is adequately protected.
Field acceptance turns the laboratory fire design into three measurable quantities: thickness, density and bond strength.
A restrained rating always lasts longer than an unrestrained one, so it should always be used.
quiz.explanation: 現場驗收把試驗室的耐火設計轉成三個可量測的量：厚度、密度與黏結強度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Field acceptance turns the laboratory fire design into three measurable quantities: thickness, density and bond strength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現場厚度、密度與黏結強度抽驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field sampling of thickness, density and bond strength: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「厚度、密度與黏結抽驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thickness, density and bond sampling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：IBC 黏結門檻換算：150 psf × 47.88 Pa/psf ≈ 7.2 kPa；430 psf ≈ 20.6 kPa；1,000 psf ≈ 47.9 kPa。若拉拔蓋接觸面積 A = 0.0045 m²，所需破壞荷重 F = σ·A 分別約 32 N、93 N 與 215 N。密度試塊 0.30×0.30×0.025 m = 0.00225 m³、乾重 0.63 kg，密度 = 280 kg/m³。門檻為 IBC 規定，其餘為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: IBC bond thresholds: 150 psf × 47.88 Pa/psf ≈ 7.2 kPa; 430 psf ≈ 20.6 kPa; 1,000 psf ≈ 47.9 kPa. With a pull-off cap area A = 0.0045 m², the required failure loads F = σ·A are about 32 N, 93 N and 215 N. A density sample of 0.30×0.30×0.025 m = 0.00225 m³ with 0.63 kg dry mass gives 280 kg/m³. The thresholds are IBC values; the rest are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依 IBC 第 1705 節抽樣：樓板每 1,000 ft² 至少 4 點厚度；每層至少 25% 構件，梁在 12 in 長度兩端各量 9 點、寬翼柱各量 12 點；密度與黏結每 2,500 ft² 至少一組。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample per IBC Section 1705: at least 4 thickness readings per 1,000 ft² of floor; at least 25% of members per storey, with 9 readings at each end of a 12 in length on beams and 12 on wide-flange columns; at least one density and one bond sample per 2,500 ft².
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: IBC 黏結門檻換算：150 psf × 47.88 Pa/psf ≈ 7.2 kPa；430 psf ≈ 20.6 kPa；1,000 psf ≈ 47.9 kPa。若拉拔蓋接觸面積 A = 0.0045 m²，所需破壞荷重 F = σ·A 分別約 32 N、93 N 與 215 N。密度試塊 0.30×0.30×0.025 m = 0.00225 m³、乾重 0.63 kg，密度 = 280 kg/m³。門檻為 IBC 規定，其餘為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: IBC bond thresholds: 150 psf × 47.88 Pa/psf ≈ 7.2 kPa; 430 psf ≈ 20.6 kPa; 1,000 psf ≈ 47.9 kPa. With a pull-off cap area A = 0.0045 m², the required failure loads F = σ·A are about 32 N, 93 N and 215 N. A density sample of 0.30×0.30×0.025 m = 0.00225 m³ with 0.63 kg dry mass gives 280 kg/m³. The thresholds are IBC values; the rest are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場厚度、密度與黏結強度抽驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Field sampling of thickness, density and bond strength", which statement holds?
options: 既有被覆只要外觀完整，就能直接加噴新材料達到更高的耐火時效。
被覆厚度只依耐火時效決定，與鋼構件斷面大小無關。
IBC 黏結門檻換算：150 psf × 47.88 Pa/psf ≈ 7.2 kPa。
optionsEn: If existing fireproofing looks intact, new material can simply be sprayed over it to reach a higher rating.
Protection thickness depends only on the required rating, not on the size of the steel section.
IBC bond thresholds: 150 psf × 47.88 Pa/psf ≈ 7.2 kPa; 430 psf ≈ 20.6 kPa; 1,000 psf ≈ 47.9 kPa.
quiz.explanation: IBC 黏結門檻換算：150 psf × 47.88 Pa/psf ≈ 7.2 kPa；430 psf ≈ 20.6 kPa；1,000 psf ≈ 47.9 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: IBC bond thresholds: 150 psf × 47.88 Pa/psf ≈ 7.2 kPa; 430 psf ≈ 20.6 kPa; 1,000 psf ≈ 47.9 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 現場厚度、密度與黏結強度抽驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field sampling of thickness, density and bond strength: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「厚度、密度與黏結抽驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thickness, density and bond sampling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 IBC 第 1705 節抽樣：樓板每 1,000 ft² 至少 4 點厚度；每層至少 25% 構件，梁在 12 in 長度兩端各量 9 點、寬翼柱各量 12 點；密度與黏結每 2,500 ft² 至少一組。平均厚度須達設計值；設計 ≥ 1 in 時單點不得低於設計值減 1/4 in，小於 1 in 時不得低於設計值減 25%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample per IBC Section 1705: at least 4 thickness readings per 1,000 ft² of floor; at least 25% of members per storey, with 9 readings at each end of a 12 in length on beams and 12 on wide-flange columns; at least one density and one bond sample per 2,500 ft². Mean thickness must reach the design value; for a design of 1 in or more no reading may fall below design minus 1/4 in, and below 1 in no reading may fall below design minus 25%. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢驗計畫須在施工前送審，列明抽樣位置的隨機選取方式（不由施工者指定）、量規校正、取樣孔的補修方法，以及不合格時擴大抽樣的規則；高層建築要先確認適用的黏結強度門檻。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Submit the inspection plan before work starts, stating how sample locations are chosen at random rather than by the applicator, gauge calibration, how sample holes are patched and the rule for expanding sampling after a failure; for high-rise buildings confirm the applicable bond threshold first.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量容易到達的腹板而不量下翼板邊緣，或讓遠超設計的讀值拉高平均，都會掩蓋薄點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Measuring only the easily reached web and not the bottom-flange edges, or letting very thick readings inflate the average, hides thin spots. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 IBC 第 1705 節抽樣：樓板每 1,000 ft² 至少 4 點厚度；每層至少 25% 構件，梁在 12 in 長度兩端各量 9 點、寬翼柱各量 12 點；密度與黏結每 2,500 ft² 至少一組。平均厚度須達設計值；設計 ≥ 1 in 時單點不得低於設計值減 1/4 in，小於 1 in 時不得低於設計值減 25%。
knowledge.textEn: Sample per IBC Section 1705: at least 4 thickness readings per 1,000 ft² of floor; at least 25% of members per storey, with 9 readings at each end of a 12 in length on beams and 12 on wide-flange columns; at least one density and one bond sample per 2,500 ft². Mean thickness must reach the design value; for a design of 1 in or more no reading may fall below design minus 1/4 in, and below 1 in no reading may fall below design minus 25%.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 檢驗計畫須在施工前送審，列明抽樣位置的隨機選取方式（不由施工者指定）、量規校正、取樣孔的補修方法，以及不合格時擴大抽樣的規則；高層建築要先確認適用的黏結強度門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Submit the inspection plan before work starts, stating how sample locations are chosen at random rather than by the applicator, gauge calibration, how sample holes are patched and the rule for expanding sampling after a failure; for high-rise buildings confirm the applicable bond threshold first.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場厚度、密度與黏結強度抽驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Field sampling of thickness, density and bond strength"?
options: 依 IBC 第 1705 節抽樣：樓板每 1,000 ft² 至少 4 點厚度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
膨脹型塗料只要總乾膜厚度足夠，底漆與面漆可以任意搭配。
optionsEn: Sample per IBC Section 1705: at least 4 thickness readings per 1,000 ft² of floor.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
As long as the total dry film is thick enough, any primer and topcoat can be paired with an intumescent coating.
quiz.explanation: 依 IBC 第 1705 節抽樣：樓板每 1,000 ft² 至少 4 點厚度；每層至少 25% 構件，梁在 12 in 長度兩端各量 9 點、寬翼柱各量 12 點；密度與黏結每 2,500 ft² 至少一組。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample per IBC Section 1705: at least 4 thickness readings per 1,000 ft² of floor; at least 25% of members per storey, with 9 readings at each end of a 12 in length on beams and 12 on wide-flange columns; at least one density and one bond sample per 2,500 ft². Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現場厚度、密度與黏結強度抽驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Field sampling of thickness, density and bond strength: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「厚度、密度與黏結抽驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thickness, density and bond sampling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量容易到達的腹板而不量下翼板邊緣，或讓遠超設計的讀值拉高平均，都會掩蓋薄點。世界貿易中心樓板桁架原規定 1/2 in，NIST 引用的實測平均約 0.75 in、變異係數約 0.4；若以常態分布估算，約兩成讀值可能低於 0.5 in。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring only the easily reached web and not the bottom-flange edges, or letting very thick readings inflate the average, hides thin spots. The World Trade Center floor trusses originally specified 1/2 in, and NIST cited a measured average of about 0.75 in with a coefficient of variation of about 0.4; a normal-distribution estimate puts about one reading in five below 0.5 in. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：美國 IBC 要求這些項目由特別檢驗員執行，並依樓高提高高層建築的黏結強度門檻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The US IBC assigns these items to a special inspector and raises the bond threshold for high-rise buildings by height.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均厚度達到設計值，就代表每一處都有足夠的保護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the average thickness meets the design value, every location is adequately protected." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量容易到達的腹板而不量下翼板邊緣，或讓遠超設計的讀值拉高平均，都會掩蓋薄點。世界貿易中心樓板桁架原規定 1/2 in，NIST 引用的實測平均約 0.75 in、變異係數約 0.4；若以常態分布估算，約兩成讀值可能低於 0.5 in。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring only the easily reached web and not the bottom-flange edges, or letting very thick readings inflate the average, hides thin spots. The World Trade Center floor trusses originally specified 1/2 in, and NIST cited a measured average of about 0.75 in with a coefficient of variation of about 0.4; a normal-distribution estimate puts about one reading in five below 0.5 in.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場厚度、密度與黏結強度抽驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Field sampling of thickness, density and bond strength" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只量容易到達的腹板而不量下翼板邊緣，或讓遠超設計的讀值拉高平均，都會掩蓋薄點。
約束等級的耐火時效一定比非約束等級長，所以都應採用約束等級。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Measuring only the easily reached web and not the bottom-flange edges, or letting very thick readings inflate the average, hides thin spots.
A restrained rating always lasts longer than an unrestrained one, so it should always be used.
quiz.explanation: 只量容易到達的腹板而不量下翼板邊緣，或讓遠超設計的讀值拉高平均，都會掩蓋薄點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring only the easily reached web and not the bottom-flange edges, or letting very thick readings inflate the average, hides thin spots. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 標準耐火試驗、登錄設計與約束分類：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Standard fire tests, listed designs and restraint classification: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「耐火試驗登錄與約束條件」如何影響鋼構耐火被覆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fire-test listing and restraint” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural-steel fireproofing application”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: ASTM E119（與 UL 263 同等）以標準升溫曲線加熱載重試體，梁的溫度判準為四點平均 593°C 或任一點 704°C；試驗結果以登錄設計公告，規定鋼材斷面、被覆產品、厚度與構造細部。試驗分為約束與非約束兩種等級：約束假設周邊結構阻止梁受熱伸長，會在梁內產生軸壓並改變破壞模式。實際建築的約束程度介於兩者之間，熱膨脹推擠柱與接頭本身也是火災倒塌的重要機制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「耐火試驗登錄與約束條件」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: ASTM E119, equivalent to UL 263, heats loaded specimens along a standard time–temperature curve; for beams the temperature criteria are 593°C averaged over four thermocouples or 704°C at any point. Results are published as listed designs that fix the steel section, protection product, thickness and construction details. Tests yield restrained and unrestrained ratings: restraint assumes the surrounding structure prevents thermal elongation of the beam, inducing axial compression and changing the failure mode. Real buildings fall between the two, and thermal expansion pushing on columns and connections is itself an important collapse mechanism. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fire-test listing and restraint” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：受熱伸長 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal elongation ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「約束等級的耐火時效一定比非約束等級長，所以都應採用約束等級。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A restrained rating always lasts longer than an unrestrained one, so it should always be used." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「耐火試驗登錄與約束條件」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fire-test listing and restraint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 標準耐火試驗、登錄設計與約束分類
knowledge.titleEn: Standard fire tests, listed designs and restraint classification
knowledge.text: ASTM E119（與 UL 263 同等）以標準升溫曲線加熱載重試體，梁的溫度判準為四點平均 593°C 或任一點 704°C；試驗結果以登錄設計公告，規定鋼材斷面、被覆產品、厚度與構造細部。試驗分為約束與非約束兩種等級：約束假設周邊結構阻止梁受熱伸長，會在梁內產生軸壓並改變破壞模式。
knowledge.textEn: ASTM E119, equivalent to UL 263, heats loaded specimens along a standard time–temperature curve; for beams the temperature criteria are 593°C averaged over four thermocouples or 704°C at any point. Results are published as listed designs that fix the steel section, protection product, thickness and construction details.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：約束等級的耐火時效一定比非約束等級長，所以都應採用約束等級。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A restrained rating always lasts longer than an unrestrained one, so it should always be used. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「標準耐火試驗、登錄設計與約束分類」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Standard fire tests, listed designs and restraint classification" is correct?
options: 約束等級的耐火時效一定比非約束等級長，所以都應採用約束等級。
防火塗料只在火災時發揮作用，平時不需要檢查與維護。
ASTM E119（與 UL 263 同等）以標準升溫曲線加熱載重試體，梁的溫度判準為四點平均 593°C 或任一點 704°C。
optionsEn: A restrained rating always lasts longer than an unrestrained one, so it should always be used.
Fire-protective coatings only matter during a fire, so they need no routine inspection or maintenance.
ASTM E119, equivalent to UL 263, heats loaded specimens along a standard time–temperature curve.
quiz.explanation: ASTM E119（與 UL 263 同等）以標準升溫曲線加熱載重試體，梁的溫度判準為四點平均 593°C 或任一點 704°C；試驗結果以登錄設計公告，規定鋼材斷面、被覆產品、厚度與構造細部。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: ASTM E119, equivalent to UL 263, heats loaded specimens along a standard time–temperature curve; for beams the temperature criteria are 593°C averaged over four thermocouples or 704°C at any point. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 標準耐火試驗、登錄設計與約束分類：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Standard fire tests, listed designs and restraint classification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「耐火試驗登錄與約束條件」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fire-test listing and restraint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：受熱伸長 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /K、跨度 L = 10.67 m（35 ft）、升溫 ΔT = 500 K：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×10.67×500 ≈ 64 mm。若完全約束，σ = E·α·ΔT = 200,000×1.2×10⁻⁵×500 = 1,200 MPa，遠超過降伏強度，代表實際上必有接頭滑移、梁挫屈或柱被推出。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal elongation ΔL = α·L·ΔT. With α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /K, span L = 10.67 m (35 ft) and ΔT = 500 K: ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×10.67×500 ≈ 64 mm. If fully restrained, σ = E·α·ΔT = 200,000×1.2×10⁻⁵×500 = 1,200 MPa, far beyond yield, so in reality connections slip, the beam buckles or the column is pushed out. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：審查送審資料時逐項比對登錄設計：鋼材斷面範圍、樓板種類、被覆產品與厚度、是否需金屬網或黏結劑，以及採用約束或非約束等級；建築的約束分類須由結構設計者依周邊構架判定並寫入圖說，而非由被覆廠商自行選擇。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: When reviewing submittals compare item by item with the listed design: steel section range, slab type, protection product and thickness, need for mesh or bonding agent, and whether the restrained or unrestrained rating is used; the restraint classification must be decided by the structural engineer from the surrounding framing and written on the drawings, not chosen by the applicator.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 受熱伸長 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /K、跨度 L = 10.67 m（35 ft）、升溫 ΔT = 500 K：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×10.67×500 ≈ 64 mm。若完全約束，σ = E·α·ΔT = 200,000×1.2×10⁻⁵×500 = 1,200 MPa，遠超過降伏強度，代表實際上必有接頭滑移、梁挫屈或柱被推出。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal elongation ΔL = α·L·ΔT. With α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /K, span L = 10.67 m (35 ft) and ΔT = 500 K: ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×10.67×500 ≈ 64 mm. If fully restrained, σ = E·α·ΔT = 200,000×1.2×10⁻⁵×500 = 1,200 MPa, far beyond yield, so in reality connections slip, the beam buckles or the column is pushed out. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「標準耐火試驗、登錄設計與約束分類」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Standard fire tests, listed designs and restraint classification", which statement holds?
options: 受熱伸長 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
鋼材要到熔點（約 1,500°C）才會失去承載力，所以一般火災不足以讓鋼構倒塌。
噴覆材料越輕越隔熱，因此任何場所都應選用最低密度的產品。
optionsEn: Thermal elongation ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
Steel only loses capacity near its melting point of about 1,500°C, so an ordinary fire cannot bring down a steel frame.
Lighter fireproofing always insulates better, so the lowest-density product suits every location.
quiz.explanation: 受熱伸長 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal elongation ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 標準耐火試驗、登錄設計與約束分類：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Standard fire tests, listed designs and restraint classification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「耐火試驗登錄與約束條件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fire-test listing and restraint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 審查送審資料時逐項比對登錄設計：鋼材斷面範圍、樓板種類、被覆產品與厚度、是否需金屬網或黏結劑，以及採用約束或非約束等級；建築的約束分類須由結構設計者依周邊構架判定並寫入圖說，而非由被覆廠商自行選擇。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: When reviewing submittals compare item by item with the listed design: steel section range, slab type, protection product and thickness, need for mesh or bonding agent, and whether the restrained or unrestrained rating is used; the restraint classification must be decided by the structural engineer from the surrounding framing and written on the drawings, not chosen by the applicator. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：圖說應明確標示採用的試驗登錄編號與約束條件；任何偏離登錄的構造（不同樓板、不同斷面、開孔梁）都要取得試驗機構或廠商的工程判定，並經防火設計者與主管建築機關認可後才可施工。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Drawings must state the listing number and restraint condition used; any construction that departs from the listing, such as a different slab, section or a cellular beam, needs an engineering judgement from the test body or manufacturer, accepted by the fire designer and the building authority before work proceeds.

steps.title: 標準耐火試驗、登錄設計與約束分類：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Standard fire tests, listed designs and restraint classification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「耐火試驗登錄與約束條件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fire-test listing and restraint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: NIST 委託 UL 對世界貿易中心樓板桁架做的 ASTM E119 試驗中，35 ft 跨度非約束試體得到 2 小時，約束試體只有 1.5 小時，與一般預期相反，提醒工程師小型試驗爐的結果不能直接外推到長跨度與真實約束。忽略熱膨脹，柱與接頭可能在梁尚未失去強度前就被推壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: In the ASTM E119 tests of World Trade Center floor trusses that NIST commissioned from UL, the 35 ft unrestrained specimen achieved 2 hours while the restrained one achieved only 1.5 hours, contrary to expectation, a reminder that small-furnace results cannot simply be extrapolated to long spans and real restraint. Ignoring thermal expansion lets columns and connections be pushed to failure before the beam itself loses strength. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實際建築的約束程度介於兩者之間，熱膨脹推擠柱與接頭本身也是火災倒塌的重要機制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Real buildings fall between the two, and thermal expansion pushing on columns and connections is itself an important collapse mechanism.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「約束等級的耐火時效一定比非約束等級長，所以都應採用約束等級。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A restrained rating always lasts longer than an unrestrained one, so it should always be used." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「標準耐火試驗、登錄設計與約束分類」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Standard fire tests, listed designs and restraint classification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
