stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「外露環境、耐久與維護」與「改修升級、用途變更與竣工交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Exposure, durability and maintenance" and "Retrofit upgrades, change of use and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 外露環境、耐久與維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Exposure, durability and maintenance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「外露鋼構厚塗環氧膨脹漆」如何影響鋼構耐火被覆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exterior thick-film epoxy intumescent” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural-steel fireproofing application”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 室內乾燥環境中的 SFRM 數十年幾乎不變，但外露或半外露構件要承受雨水、紫外線、溫濕循環與鹽分。薄塗型膨脹漆吸濕後可能失去膨脹能力，因此外露鋼構多採厚塗環氧型膨脹漆加耐候面漆；紐約時報大樓外露的角柱與橫梁即以約 80 或 120 mils（約 2 或 3 mm）的環氧膨脹漆一次噴塗，再滾平外觀。防火塗層同時擔任防蝕層，一旦面漆破損或膜下鏽蝕擴展，耐火與防蝕會一起失效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外露鋼構厚塗環氧膨脹漆」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SFRM in dry interiors hardly changes for decades, but exposed or semi-exposed members face rain, ultraviolet light, thermal and humidity cycling and salt. Thin-film intumescents can lose their ability to expand after absorbing moisture, so exterior steel usually takes a thick-film epoxy intumescent with a weathering topcoat; the exposed corner columns and cross beams of the New York Times Building received epoxy intumescent sprayed in one coat at about 80 or 120 mils, about 2 or 3 mm, and back-rolled for appearance. The fire coating also acts as corrosion protection, so once the topcoat fails or rust creeps beneath the film, fire and corrosion protection fail together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Exterior thick-film epoxy intumescent” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：面漆壽命 t = (初始厚度 − 最小厚度)/年損耗率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Topcoat life t = (initial − minimum thickness)/annual loss.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防火塗料只在火災時發揮作用，平時不需要檢查與維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fire-protective coatings only matter during a fire, so they need no routine inspection or maintenance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「外露鋼構厚塗環氧膨脹漆」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Exterior thick-film epoxy intumescent”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外露環境、耐久與維護
knowledge.text: 室內乾燥環境中的 SFRM 數十年幾乎不變，但外露或半外露構件要承受雨水、紫外線、溫濕循環與鹽分。薄塗型膨脹漆吸濕後可能失去膨脹能力，因此外露鋼構多採厚塗環氧型膨脹漆加耐候面漆；紐約時報大樓外露的角柱與橫梁即以約 80 或 120 mils（約 2 或 3 mm）的環氧膨脹漆一次噴塗，再滾平外觀。
knowledge.textEn: SFRM in dry interiors hardly changes for decades, but exposed or semi-exposed members face rain, ultraviolet light, thermal and humidity cycling and salt. Thin-film intumescents can lose their ability to expand after absorbing moisture, so exterior steel usually takes a thick-film epoxy intumescent with a weathering topcoat; the exposed corner columns and cross beams of the New York Times Building received epoxy intumescent sprayed in one coat at about 80 or 120 mils, about 2 or 3 mm, and back-rolled for appearance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：防火塗料只在火災時發揮作用，平時不需要檢查與維護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fire-protective coatings only matter during a fire, so they need no routine inspection or maintenance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外露環境、耐久與維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Exposure, durability and maintenance" is correct?
options: 室內乾燥環境中的 SFRM 數十年幾乎不變，但外露或半外露構件要承受雨水、紫外線、溫濕循環與鹽分。
防火塗料只在火災時發揮作用，平時不需要檢查與維護。
既有被覆只要外觀完整，就能直接加噴新材料達到更高的耐火時效。
optionsEn: SFRM in dry interiors hardly changes for decades, but exposed or semi-exposed members face rain, ultraviolet light, thermal and humidity cycling and salt.
Fire-protective coatings only matter during a fire, so they need no routine inspection or maintenance.
If existing fireproofing looks intact, new material can simply be sprayed over it to reach a higher rating.
quiz.explanation: 室內乾燥環境中的 SFRM 數十年幾乎不變，但外露或半外露構件要承受雨水、紫外線、溫濕循環與鹽分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: SFRM in dry interiors hardly changes for decades, but exposed or semi-exposed members face rain, ultraviolet light, thermal and humidity cycling and salt. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外露環境、耐久與維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Exposure, durability and maintenance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外露鋼構厚塗環氧膨脹漆」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exterior thick-film epoxy intumescent” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：面漆壽命 t = (初始厚度 − 最小厚度)/年損耗率。面漆 60 μm、最低需保留 30 μm、外露面年損耗 5 μm：t = (60 − 30)/5 = 6 年；改用 80 μm 面漆則 t = 10 年。單位換算：80 mils × 25.4 μm/mil ≈ 2,030 μm，120 mils ≈ 3,050 μm。除單位換算外，數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Topcoat life t = (initial − minimum thickness)/annual loss. With a 60 μm topcoat, a 30 μm minimum and 5 μm/year loss on exposed faces: t = (60 − 30)/5 = 6 years; an 80 μm topcoat gives t = 10 years. Unit check: 80 mils × 25.4 μm/mil ≈ 2,030 μm and 120 mils ≈ 3,050 μm. Apart from the unit conversion, values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：正式施工前以實尺寸鋼構樣品做外觀與施工性試驗（紐約時報大樓曾在業主場址做過兩次鋼構樣品現場試驗），完工後建立分區基準照片與乾膜厚度圖；之後定期目視檢查粉化、龜裂、起泡與鏽水，抽量乾膜厚度與附著力，與基準比較決定局部修補或全面重塗面漆。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before production, apply the system to full-size steel mock-ups for appearance and workability (the New York Times Building ran two off-site field tests on steel mock-ups at the owner's facility), and after completion record zone-by-zone baseline photographs and DFT maps; then inspect periodically for chalking, cracking, blistering and rust staining, spot-check DFT and adhesion, and compare with the baseline to choose between local repair and full topcoat renewal.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 面漆壽命 t = (初始厚度 − 最小厚度)/年損耗率。面漆 60 μm、最低需保留 30 μm、外露面年損耗 5 μm：t = (60 − 30)/5 = 6 年；改用 80 μm 面漆則 t = 10 年。單位換算：80 mils × 25.4 μm/mil ≈ 2,030 μm，120 mils ≈ 3,050 μm。除單位換算外，數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Topcoat life t = (initial − minimum thickness)/annual loss. With a 60 μm topcoat, a 30 μm minimum and 5 μm/year loss on exposed faces: t = (60 − 30)/5 = 6 years; an 80 μm topcoat gives t = 10 years. Unit check: 80 mils × 25.4 μm/mil ≈ 2,030 μm and 120 mils ≈ 3,050 μm. Apart from the unit conversion, values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外露環境、耐久與維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Exposure, durability and maintenance", which statement holds?
options: 被覆厚度只依耐火時效決定，與鋼構件斷面大小無關。
面漆壽命 t = (初始厚度 − 最小厚度)/年損耗率。
膨脹型塗料只要總乾膜厚度足夠，底漆與面漆可以任意搭配。
optionsEn: Protection thickness depends only on the required rating, not on the size of the steel section.
Topcoat life t = (initial − minimum thickness)/annual loss.
As long as the total dry film is thick enough, any primer and topcoat can be paired with an intumescent coating.
quiz.explanation: 面漆壽命 t = (初始厚度 − 最小厚度)/年損耗率。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Topcoat life t = (initial − minimum thickness)/annual loss. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外露環境、耐久與維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Exposure, durability and maintenance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「外露鋼構厚塗環氧膨脹漆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Exterior thick-film epoxy intumescent” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 正式施工前以實尺寸鋼構樣品做外觀與施工性試驗（紐約時報大樓曾在業主場址做過兩次鋼構樣品現場試驗），完工後建立分區基準照片與乾膜厚度圖；之後定期目視檢查粉化、龜裂、起泡與鏽水，抽量乾膜厚度與附著力，與基準比較決定局部修補或全面重塗面漆。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before production, apply the system to full-size steel mock-ups for appearance and workability (the New York Times Building ran two off-site field tests on steel mock-ups at the owner's facility), and after completion record zone-by-zone baseline photographs and DFT maps; then inspect periodically for chalking, cracking, blistering and rust staining, spot-check DFT and adhesion, and compare with the baseline to choose between local repair and full topcoat renewal. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：依環境分類選用經耐久評估的產品（如 ETAG 018-2 依室內、半外露與外露區分的類別），並在維護手冊列出檢查週期、允許的修補材料與修補後須量測的乾膜厚度；外露構件的任何塗層修補都要由原系統廠商確認相容性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Select products with a durability assessment matching the exposure, for example the internal, semi-exposed and exposed categories of ETAG 018-2, and list in the maintenance manual the inspection interval, permitted repair materials and the DFT to be measured after repair; every coating repair on exposed members needs compatibility confirmation from the original system manufacturer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把室內型薄塗膨脹漆用於半外露的雨遮梁或停車場邊梁，數年後塗膜吸濕軟化、起泡，火災時膨脹不足；邊緣與螺栓頭等銳角處膜厚最薄，往往最先鏽蝕並從底部把塗層撐開。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using an interior thin-film intumescent on semi-exposed canopy or car-park edge beams lets the film absorb moisture, soften and blister within a few years, so it under-expands in a fire; sharp edges and bolt heads carry the thinnest film and are often the first to corrode and lift the coating from beneath. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外露環境、耐久與維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Exposure, durability and maintenance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
被覆驗收合格之後，後續工班的作業不會影響耐火性能。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once fireproofing passes acceptance, later trades cannot affect its fire performance.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外露環境、耐久與維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Exposure, durability and maintenance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「外露鋼構厚塗環氧膨脹漆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Exterior thick-film epoxy intumescent” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把室內型薄塗膨脹漆用於半外露的雨遮梁或停車場邊梁，數年後塗膜吸濕軟化、起泡，火災時膨脹不足；邊緣與螺栓頭等銳角處膜厚最薄，往往最先鏽蝕並從底部把塗層撐開。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using an interior thin-film intumescent on semi-exposed canopy or car-park edge beams lets the film absorb moisture, soften and blister within a few years, so it under-expands in a fire; sharp edges and bolt heads carry the thinnest film and are often the first to corrode and lift the coating from beneath. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：防火塗層同時擔任防蝕層，一旦面漆破損或膜下鏽蝕擴展，耐火與防蝕會一起失效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The fire coating also acts as corrosion protection, so once the topcoat fails or rust creeps beneath the film, fire and corrosion protection fail together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「防火塗料只在火災時發揮作用，平時不需要檢查與維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fire-protective coatings only matter during a fire, so they need no routine inspection or maintenance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把室內型薄塗膨脹漆用於半外露的雨遮梁或停車場邊梁，數年後塗膜吸濕軟化、起泡，火災時膨脹不足；邊緣與螺栓頭等銳角處膜厚最薄，往往最先鏽蝕並從底部把塗層撐開。
knowledge.textEn: Using an interior thin-film intumescent on semi-exposed canopy or car-park edge beams lets the film absorb moisture, soften and blister within a few years, so it under-expands in a fire; sharp edges and bolt heads carry the thinnest film and are often the first to corrode and lift the coating from beneath.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外露環境、耐久與維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Exposure, durability and maintenance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把室內型薄塗膨脹漆用於半外露的雨遮梁或停車場邊梁，數年後塗膜吸濕軟化、起泡，火災時膨脹不足；邊緣與螺栓頭等銳角處膜厚最薄，往往最先鏽蝕並從底部把塗層撐開。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
既有被覆只要外觀完整，就能直接加噴新材料達到更高的耐火時效。
optionsEn: Using an interior thin-film intumescent on semi-exposed canopy or car-park edge beams lets the film absorb moisture, soften and blister within a few years, so it under-expands in a fire.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If existing fireproofing looks intact, new material can simply be sprayed over it to reach a higher rating.
quiz.explanation: 把室內型薄塗膨脹漆用於半外露的雨遮梁或停車場邊梁，數年後塗膜吸濕軟化、起泡，火災時膨脹不足；邊緣與螺栓頭等銳角處膜厚最薄，往往最先鏽蝕並從底部把塗層撐開。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using an interior thin-film intumescent on semi-exposed canopy or car-park edge beams lets the film absorb moisture, soften and blister within a few years, so it under-expands in a fire; sharp edges and bolt heads carry the thinnest film and are often the first to corrode and lift the coating from beneath. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 改修升級、用途變更與竣工交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Retrofit upgrades, change of use and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「既有建築被覆升級」如何影響鋼構耐火被覆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Retrofit upgrade of fireproofing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural-steel fireproofing application”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 既有鋼構建築常因法規更新、樓高分類或用途變更而需提高耐火時效，改修期間建築多半仍在使用，部分樓層已完成、部分尚未施作，防火區劃與被覆同時處於不完整狀態。馬德里溫莎大樓 2005 年火災時，外圍鋼柱的補強被覆只完成到第 17 層以下，未保護的上部外圍鋼柱在火中失效，上方樓層局部崩塌；世界貿易中心在 1990 年代把樓板桁架被覆由 1/2 in 提高到 1.5 in，也只完成部分樓層。改修計畫必須同時管控過渡期風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「既有建築被覆升級」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Existing steel buildings often need higher fire ratings after code updates, a change of height class or a change of use, and they usually stay occupied during the work, so some floors are finished and others not, with compartmentation and protection both incomplete. When the Windsor Building in Madrid burned in 2005, retrofit protection to the perimeter steel columns had been completed only below the 17th floor; the unprotected upper perimeter columns failed and upper storeys partly collapsed. The World Trade Center raised floor-truss protection from 1/2 in to 1.5 in in the 1990s, but only on some floors. A retrofit plan must manage the risk of the transition period. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Retrofit upgrade of fireproofing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：柱的厚度關係常寫成 R = (C₁·W/D + C₂)·h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Column thickness relations are often written R = (C₁·W/D + C₂)·h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「既有被覆只要外觀完整，就能直接加噴新材料達到更高的耐火時效。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If existing fireproofing looks intact, new material can simply be sprayed over it to reach a higher rating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「既有建築被覆升級」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Retrofit upgrade of fireproofing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 改修升級、用途變更與竣工交接
knowledge.titleEn: Retrofit upgrades, change of use and handover
knowledge.text: 既有鋼構建築常因法規更新、樓高分類或用途變更而需提高耐火時效，改修期間建築多半仍在使用，部分樓層已完成、部分尚未施作，防火區劃與被覆同時處於不完整狀態。馬德里溫莎大樓 2005 年火災時，外圍鋼柱的補強被覆只完成到第 17 層以下，未保護的上部外圍鋼柱在火中失效，上方樓層局部崩塌；世界貿易中心在 1990 年代把樓板桁架被覆由 1/2 in 提高到 1.5 in，也只完成部分樓層。
knowledge.textEn: Existing steel buildings often need higher fire ratings after code updates, a change of height class or a change of use, and they usually stay occupied during the work, so some floors are finished and others not, with compartmentation and protection both incomplete. When the Windsor Building in Madrid burned in 2005, retrofit protection to the perimeter steel columns had been completed only below the 17th floor; the unprotected upper perimeter columns failed and upper storeys partly collapsed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：既有被覆只要外觀完整，就能直接加噴新材料達到更高的耐火時效。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If existing fireproofing looks intact, new material can simply be sprayed over it to reach a higher rating. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「改修升級、用途變更與竣工交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Retrofit upgrades, change of use and handover" is correct?
options: 既有被覆只要外觀完整，就能直接加噴新材料達到更高的耐火時效。
既有鋼構建築常因法規更新、樓高分類或用途變更而需提高耐火時效，改修期間建築多半仍在使用，部分樓層已完成、部分尚未施作，防火區劃與被覆同時處於不完整狀態。
鋼材要到熔點（約 1,500°C）才會失去承載力，所以一般火災不足以讓鋼構倒塌。
optionsEn: If existing fireproofing looks intact, new material can simply be sprayed over it to reach a higher rating.

Existing steel buildings often need higher fire ratings after code updates, a change of height class or a change of use, and they usually stay occupied during the work, so some floors are finished and others not, with compartmentation and protection both incomplete.
Steel only loses capacity near its melting point of about 1,500°C, so an ordinary fire cannot bring down a steel frame.
quiz.explanation: 既有鋼構建築常因法規更新、樓高分類或用途變更而需提高耐火時效，改修期間建築多半仍在使用，部分樓層已完成、部分尚未施作，防火區劃與被覆同時處於不完整狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Existing steel buildings often need higher fire ratings after code updates, a change of height class or a change of use, and they usually stay occupied during the work, so some floors are finished and others not, with compartmentation and protection both incomplete. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 改修升級、用途變更與竣工交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Retrofit upgrades, change of use and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「既有建築被覆升級」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Retrofit upgrade of fireproofing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：柱的厚度關係常寫成 R = (C₁·W/D + C₂)·h。取教學常數 C₁ = 1.05、C₂ = 0.61，W/D = 0.80：R/h = 1.05×0.80 + 0.61 = 1.45 h/in；2 小時需 h = 2/1.45 ≈ 1.38 in，升級為 3 小時需 3/1.45 ≈ 2.07 in，增加約 0.69 in（約 17.5 mm）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Column thickness relations are often written R = (C₁·W/D + C₂)·h. With teaching constants C₁ = 1.05 and C₂ = 0.61 and W/D = 0.80: R/h = 1.05×0.80 + 0.61 = 1.45 h/in; 2 hours needs h = 2/1.45 ≈ 1.38 in, and an upgrade to 3 hours needs 3/1.45 ≈ 2.07 in, an increase of about 0.69 in (about 17.5 mm). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：改修前以破壞性取樣確認既有被覆的產品、厚度、密度與黏結，判定可否直接加噴或必須全部清除；改修後依新建標準抽驗，並更新每層的被覆狀態圖，標示已完成、施工中與未施作區域，供消防單位與管理者掌握。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before retrofit, take destructive samples to establish the existing product, thickness, density and bond, and decide whether to overspray or strip completely; after retrofit sample to new-construction standards and update each floor's fireproofing status plan, marking completed, in-progress and untouched zones for the fire service and building management.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 柱的厚度關係常寫成 R = (C₁·W/D + C₂)·h。取教學常數 C₁ = 1.05、C₂ = 0.61，W/D = 0.80：R/h = 1.05×0.80 + 0.61 = 1.45 h/in；2 小時需 h = 2/1.45 ≈ 1.38 in，升級為 3 小時需 3/1.45 ≈ 2.07 in，增加約 0.69 in（約 17.5 mm）。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Column thickness relations are often written R = (C₁·W/D + C₂)·h. With teaching constants C₁ = 1.05 and C₂ = 0.61 and W/D = 0.80: R/h = 1.05×0.80 + 0.61 = 1.45 h/in; 2 hours needs h = 2/1.45 ≈ 1.38 in, and an upgrade to 3 hours needs 3/1.45 ≈ 2.07 in, an increase of about 0.69 in (about 17.5 mm). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「改修升級、用途變更與竣工交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Retrofit upgrades, change of use and handover", which statement holds?
options: 噴覆材料越輕越隔熱，因此任何場所都應選用最低密度的產品。
只要噴得夠厚，鋼材表面的油汙或浮鏽不會影響被覆效果。
柱的厚度關係常寫成 R = (C₁·W/D + C₂)·h。
optionsEn: Lighter fireproofing always insulates better, so the lowest-density product suits every location.
If it is sprayed thick enough, oil or loose rust on the steel does not affect the protection.
Column thickness relations are often written R = (C₁·W/D + C₂)·h.
quiz.explanation: 柱的厚度關係常寫成 R = (C₁·W/D + C₂)·h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Column thickness relations are often written R = (C₁·W/D + C₂)·h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 改修升級、用途變更與竣工交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Retrofit upgrades, change of use and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「既有建築被覆升級」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Retrofit upgrade of fireproofing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 改修前以破壞性取樣確認既有被覆的產品、厚度、密度與黏結，判定可否直接加噴或必須全部清除；改修後依新建標準抽驗，並更新每層的被覆狀態圖，標示已完成、施工中與未施作區域，供消防單位與管理者掌握。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before retrofit, take destructive samples to establish the existing product, thickness, density and bond, and decide whether to overspray or strip completely; after retrofit sample to new-construction standards and update each floor's fireproofing status plan, marking completed, in-progress and untouched zones for the fire service and building management. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：竣工交接應包含逐構件厚度表、登錄設計編號、檢驗報告、補修紀錄與產品資料，並在 BIM 或樓層圖標示被覆類型；任何改裝、用途變更或新增吊掛荷重前，須由結構與防火設計者評估，改修計畫的分區與臨時措施須經主管建築機關核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include the member-by-member thickness schedule, listing numbers, inspection reports, repair logs and product data, with protection types marked in BIM or floor plans; before any alteration, change of use or added suspended load, the structural and fire designers must assess the impact, and the building authority must approve the retrofit plan's phasing and temporary measures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：改修期間拆除層間防火阻隔與天花板卻未設臨時防火措施，火災會跨樓層蔓延並同時加熱多層未保護鋼材，溫莎大樓的報導即指出施工中層間防火阻隔曾被移除；新材料直接噴在老化或含石綿的舊被覆上，黏結失效時兩層會一起剝落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing floor-edge fire stops and ceilings during retrofit without temporary protection lets fire spread across storeys and heat several levels of unprotected steel at once, and reports on the Windsor Building note that fire stops between floors had been removed during the works; spraying new material straight over aged or asbestos-containing old protection can fail in bond and peel both layers off together. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 改修前以破壞性取樣確認既有被覆的產品、厚度、密度與黏結，判定可否直接加噴或必須全部清除；改修後依新建標準抽驗，並更新每層的被覆狀態圖，標示已完成、施工中與未施作區域，供消防單位與管理者掌握。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 竣工交接應包含逐構件厚度表、登錄設計編號、檢驗報告、補修紀錄與產品資料，並在 BIM 或樓層圖標示被覆類型；任何改裝、用途變更或新增吊掛荷重前，須由結構與防火設計者評估，改修計畫的分區與臨時措施須經主管建築機關核准。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include the member-by-member thickness schedule, listing numbers, inspection reports, repair logs and product data, with protection types marked in BIM or floor plans; before any alteration, change of use or added suspended load, the structural and fire designers must assess the impact, and the building authority must approve the retrofit plan's phasing and temporary measures.

quiz.question: 要驗證「改修升級、用途變更與竣工交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Retrofit upgrades, change of use and handover"?
options: 改修前以破壞性取樣確認既有被覆的產品、厚度、密度與黏結，判定可否直接加噴或必須全部清除。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
平均厚度達到設計值，就代表每一處都有足夠的保護。
optionsEn: Before retrofit, take destructive samples to establish the existing product, thickness, density and bond, and decide whether to overspray or strip completely.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If the average thickness meets the design value, every location is adequately protected.
quiz.explanation: 改修前以破壞性取樣確認既有被覆的產品、厚度、密度與黏結，判定可否直接加噴或必須全部清除；改修後依新建標準抽驗，並更新每層的被覆狀態圖，標示已完成、施工中與未施作區域，供消防單位與管理者掌握。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before retrofit, take destructive samples to establish the existing product, thickness, density and bond, and decide whether to overspray or strip completely; after retrofit sample to new-construction standards and update each floor's fireproofing status plan, marking completed, in-progress and untouched zones for the fire service and building management. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 改修升級、用途變更與竣工交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Retrofit upgrades, change of use and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「既有建築被覆升級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Retrofit upgrade of fireproofing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 改修期間拆除層間防火阻隔與天花板卻未設臨時防火措施，火災會跨樓層蔓延並同時加熱多層未保護鋼材，溫莎大樓的報導即指出施工中層間防火阻隔曾被移除；新材料直接噴在老化或含石綿的舊被覆上，黏結失效時兩層會一起剝落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing floor-edge fire stops and ceilings during retrofit without temporary protection lets fire spread across storeys and heat several levels of unprotected steel at once, and reports on the Windsor Building note that fire stops between floors had been removed during the works; spraying new material straight over aged or asbestos-containing old protection can fail in bond and peel both layers off together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：改修計畫必須同時管控過渡期風險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A retrofit plan must manage the risk of the transition period.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「既有被覆只要外觀完整，就能直接加噴新材料達到更高的耐火時效。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If existing fireproofing looks intact, new material can simply be sprayed over it to reach a higher rating." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 改修期間拆除層間防火阻隔與天花板卻未設臨時防火措施，火災會跨樓層蔓延並同時加熱多層未保護鋼材，溫莎大樓的報導即指出施工中層間防火阻隔曾被移除；新材料直接噴在老化或含石綿的舊被覆上，黏結失效時兩層會一起剝落。
knowledge.textEn: Removing floor-edge fire stops and ceilings during retrofit without temporary protection lets fire spread across storeys and heat several levels of unprotected steel at once, and reports on the Windsor Building note that fire stops between floors had been removed during the works; spraying new material straight over aged or asbestos-containing old protection can fail in bond and peel both layers off together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「改修升級、用途變更與竣工交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Retrofit upgrades, change of use and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
改修期間拆除層間防火阻隔與天花板卻未設臨時防火措施，火災會跨樓層蔓延並同時加熱多層未保護鋼材，溫莎大樓的報導即指出施工中層間防火阻隔曾被移除。
鋼材要到熔點（約 1,500°C）才會失去承載力，所以一般火災不足以讓鋼構倒塌。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

Removing floor-edge fire stops and ceilings during retrofit without temporary protection lets fire spread across storeys and heat several levels of unprotected steel at once, and reports on the Windsor Building note that fire stops between floors had been removed during the works.
Steel only loses capacity near its melting point of about 1,500°C, so an ordinary fire cannot bring down a steel frame.
quiz.explanation: 改修期間拆除層間防火阻隔與天花板卻未設臨時防火措施，火災會跨樓層蔓延並同時加熱多層未保護鋼材，溫莎大樓的報導即指出施工中層間防火阻隔曾被移除；新材料直接噴在老化或含石綿的舊被覆上，黏結失效時兩層會一起剝落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing floor-edge fire stops and ceilings during retrofit without temporary protection lets fire spread across storeys and heat several levels of unprotected steel at once, and reports on the Windsor Building note that fire stops between floors had been removed during the works; spraying new material straight over aged or asbestos-containing old protection can fail in bond and peel both layers off together. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 大型玻璃肋結構安裝
summary: 從全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑出發，把面玻璃視為支承於玻璃肋之間的板，再把玻璃肋當作細長深梁檢核面內應力、撓度與側向扭轉挫屈，說明膠合中間膜、強化與熱浸處理、結構矽利康與埋入式金屬件的設計要點，最後處理長玻璃的運輸翻轉、頂部滑動接頭、實體試驗、熱應力與自爆風險，並以上海陸家嘴、曼谷 Iconsiam 與紐約第五大道蘋果直營店的公開工程資料比較不同做法。
summaryEn: Starting from the wind load path through an all-glass façade, treat the face glass as plates spanning between fins and each fin as a slender deep beam checked for in-plane stress, deflection and lateral–torsional buckling, then cover laminated interlayers, toughening and heat soaking, structural silicone and laminated-in metal fittings, and finally long-glass transport and tilting, sliding head joints, physical testing, thermal stress and spontaneous-breakage risk, comparing approaches through public engineering information on Apple Pudong in Shanghai, Apple Iconsiam in Bangkok and Apple Fifth Avenue in New York.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某展示廳全玻璃立面高 10 m，玻璃肋間距 2.0 m，設計風壓 1.5 kPa，肋為 3×15 mm 膠合強化玻璃、深 550 mm，上下簡支。線荷重 w = 1.5×2.0 = 3.0 kN/m，M = wL²/8 = 3.0×10²/8 = 37.5 kN·m；S = 45×550²/6 ≈ 2.27×10⁶ mm³，σ ≈ 16.5 MPa；一片破裂後 σ ≈ 24.8 MPa。撓度 δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 8.9 mm（約 L/1,120）。挫屈：完全耦合 M_cr ≈ 129 kN·m，安全比 129/37.5 ≈ 3.4；完全不耦合 M_cr ≈ 14.6 kN·m，比值只有 0.39，不足，因此必須以面玻璃與矽利康拘束受壓邊、改用高剪力勁度中間膜，或加深斷面。若把肋深加到 650 mm，I_z 與 I_t 約按深度比增加，不耦合 M_cr 約為 14.6×650/550 ≈ 17.3 kN·m，仍不足，說明挫屈主要靠厚度與耦合而非深度解決。矽利康咬合寬 = 1.5 kN/m ÷ 138 kPa ≈ 10.9 mm，取 12 mm。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a showroom has a 10 m high all-glass façade with fins at 2.0 m centres, design wind 1.5 kPa, and fins of 3×15 mm laminated toughened glass, 550 mm deep and simply supported top and bottom. Line load w = 1.5×2.0 = 3.0 kN/m and M = wL²/8 = 3.0×10²/8 = 37.5 kN·m; S = 45×550²/6 ≈ 2.27×10⁶ mm³, so σ ≈ 16.5 MPa, rising to about 24.8 MPa with one ply broken. Deflection δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 8.9 mm (about L/1,120). Buckling: fully coupled M_cr ≈ 129 kN·m, a ratio of 129/37.5 ≈ 3.4; uncoupled M_cr ≈ 14.6 kN·m, a ratio of only 0.39, which fails, so the compressed edge must be restrained by face glass and silicone, a stiffer interlayer used, or the section changed. Deepening the fin to 650 mm raises I_z and I_t roughly in proportion to depth, so uncoupled M_cr becomes about 14.6×650/550 ≈ 17.3 kN·m, still inadequate, showing that buckling is solved mainly by thickness and coupling rather than depth. Silicone bite = 1.5 kN/m ÷ 138 kPa ≈ 10.9 mm, specified as 12 mm. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑」與「細長玻璃肋的側向扭轉挫屈」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wind load path through an all-glass façade" and "Lateral–torsional buckling of slender fins": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind load path through an all-glass façade: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「玻璃肋風壓分擔寬度」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fin tributary wind load” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 全玻璃立面沒有鋁或鋼豎框，面玻璃把風壓以板彎曲傳到兩側的玻璃肋，玻璃肋再以面內彎曲把荷重送到頂部與底部的主結構。玻璃肋垂直於立面放置，就像一支立起來的深梁：深度方向抵抗風壓彎矩，厚度方向卻很薄。面玻璃與玻璃肋通常以結構矽利康黏結，或以金屬夾具、埋入式金屬件連接；面玻璃的自重則多由底部墊塊或頂部吊掛承受，不經過矽利康。設計時要分清楚每一種荷重走哪一條路徑，否則某個看似次要的接合會意外承擔主要力量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「玻璃肋風壓分擔寬度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An all-glass façade has no aluminium or steel mullions: face glass carries wind pressure by plate bending to the fins on either side, and each fin carries the load by in-plane bending to the main structure at its top and bottom. A fin stands perpendicular to the façade like an upended deep beam, resisting the wind moment through its depth while being very thin through its thickness. Face glass and fins are usually joined with structural silicone, or with metal clamps and laminated-in fittings, while the self-weight of the face glass sits on setting blocks at the base or hangs from the head, not on the silicone. The designer must know which path each load takes, or a seemingly minor joint ends up carrying a major force. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fin tributary wind load” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：風壓 q = 1.5 kPa、肋間距（分擔寬度）b = 2.0 m，線荷重 w = q·b = 3.0 kN/m；簡支跨度 L = 10 m，彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 3.0×10²/8 = 37.5 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With wind pressure q = 1.5 kPa and fin spacing (tributary width) b = 2.0 m, the line load is w = q·b = 3.0 kN/m; for a simply supported span L = 10 m the moment is M = wL²/8 = 3.0×10²/8 = 37.5 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全玻璃立面的玻璃肋只是裝飾，風壓主要由面玻璃自己承受。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Glass fins in an all-glass façade are decorative; the face glass carries the wind by itself." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「玻璃肋風壓分擔寬度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fin tributary wind load”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind load path through an all-glass façade" is correct?

全玻璃立面沒有鋁或鋼豎框，面玻璃把風壓以板彎曲傳到兩側的玻璃肋，玻璃肋再以面內彎曲把荷重送到頂部與底部的主結構。

optionsEn: Glass fins in an all-glass façade are decorative; the face glass carries the wind by itself.

An all-glass façade has no aluminium or steel mullions: face glass carries wind pressure by plate bending to the fins on either side, and each fin carries the load by in-plane bending to the main structure at its top and bottom.

quiz.explanationEn: An all-glass façade has no aluminium or steel mullions: face glass carries wind pressure by plate bending to the fins on either side, and each fin carries the load by in-plane bending to the main structure at its top and bottom. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind load path through an all-glass façade: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「玻璃肋風壓分擔寬度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fin tributary wind load” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：風壓 q = 1.5 kPa、肋間距（分擔寬度）b = 2.0 m，線荷重 w = q·b = 3.0 kN/m；簡支跨度 L = 10 m，彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 3.0×10²/8 = 37.5 kN·m。肋深 d = 550 mm、總厚 t = 3×15 = 45 mm，S = t·d²/6 = 45×550²/6 ≈ 2.27×10⁶ mm³，σ = M/S ≈ 16.5 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With wind pressure q = 1.5 kPa and fin spacing (tributary width) b = 2.0 m, the line load is w = q·b = 3.0 kN/m; for a simply supported span L = 10 m the moment is M = wL²/8 = 3.0×10²/8 = 37.5 kN·m. With fin depth d = 550 mm and total thickness t = 3×15 = 45 mm, S = t·d²/6 = 45×550²/6 ≈ 2.27×10⁶ mm³ and σ = M/S ≈ 16.5 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素模型同時建立面玻璃、矽利康與玻璃肋，確認風壓分配到肋的比例與手算分擔寬度一致；檢查頂部與底部支承反力的方向與大小，並與主結構設計者確認這些反力已納入屋頂梁、樓板邊梁與錨栓的設計。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Model face glass, silicone and fins together in a finite-element analysis and confirm that the share of wind reaching each fin matches the hand tributary-width estimate; check the direction and magnitude of top and bottom support reactions, and confirm with the main-structure designer that these reactions are included in the design of roof beams, slab-edge beams and anchors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 風壓 q = 1.5 kPa、肋間距（分擔寬度）b = 2.0 m，線荷重 w = q·b = 3.0 kN/m；簡支跨度 L = 10 m，彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 3.0×10²/8 = 37.5 kN·m。肋深 d = 550 mm、總厚 t = 3×15 = 45 mm，S = t·d²/6 = 45×550²/6 ≈ 2.27×10⁶ mm³，σ = M/S ≈ 16.5 MPa。數值為教學假設。

With fin depth d = 550 mm and total thickness t = 3×15 = 45 mm, S = t·d²/6 = 45×550²/6 ≈ 2.27×10⁶ mm³ and σ = M/S ≈ 16.5 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wind load path through an all-glass façade", which statement holds?

The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade.

steps.title: 全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind load path through an all-glass façade: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「玻璃肋風壓分擔寬度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fin tributary wind load” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素模型同時建立面玻璃、矽利康與玻璃肋，確認風壓分配到肋的比例與手算分擔寬度一致；檢查頂部與底部支承反力的方向與大小，並與主結構設計者確認這些反力已納入屋頂梁、樓板邊梁與錨栓的設計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Model face glass, silicone and fins together in a finite-element analysis and confirm that the share of wind reaching each fin matches the hand tributary-width estimate; check the direction and magnitude of top and bottom support reactions, and confirm with the main-structure designer that these reactions are included in the design of roof beams, slab-edge beams and anchors. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計初期就要繪出荷重路徑圖，分別標示風壓、自重、地震與溫度變形由哪些構件與接合承擔，並列出需要主結構配合的反力與位移限制，作為帷幕牆與結構兩方介面協調的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw a load-path diagram early, marking which members and joints carry wind, self-weight, seismic and thermal movement, and list the reactions and movement limits the main structure must accommodate, as the basis for coordinating the façade–structure interface.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若忽略角隅或開口處的分擔寬度變化，邊肋可能承受比中間肋高出許多的風壓；支承反力未傳達給主結構設計者時，屋頂梁可能因玻璃肋反力而過度變形，反過來把壓力推回玻璃。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring changes in tributary width at corners or openings can leave edge fins carrying much more wind than the middle fins; if support reactions never reach the main-structure designer, the roof beam may deflect excessively under fin reactions and push load back into the glass. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以有限元素模型同時建立面玻璃、矽利康與玻璃肋，確認風壓分配到肋的比例與手算分擔寬度一致；檢查頂部與底部支承反力的方向與大小，並與主結構設計者確認這些反力已納入屋頂梁、樓板邊梁與錨栓的設計。
knowledge.textEn: Model face glass, silicone and fins together in a finite-element analysis and confirm that the share of wind reaching each fin matches the hand tributary-width estimate; check the direction and magnitude of top and bottom support reactions, and confirm with the main-structure designer that these reactions are included in the design of roof beams, slab-edge beams and anchors.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計初期就要繪出荷重路徑圖，分別標示風壓、自重、地震與溫度變形由哪些構件與接合承擔，並列出需要主結構配合的反力與位移限制，作為帷幕牆與結構兩方介面協調的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a load-path diagram early, marking which members and joints carry wind, self-weight, seismic and thermal movement, and list the reactions and movement limits the main structure must accommodate, as the basis for coordinating the façade–structure interface.

quiz.question: 要驗證「全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wind load path through an all-glass façade"?
options: 以有限元素模型同時建立面玻璃、矽利康與玻璃肋，確認風壓分配到肋的比例與手算分擔寬度一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。
optionsEn: Model face glass, silicone and fins together in a finite-element analysis and confirm that the share of wind reaching each fin matches the hand tributary-width estimate.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact.
quiz.explanation: 以有限元素模型同時建立面玻璃、矽利康與玻璃肋，確認風壓分配到肋的比例與手算分擔寬度一致；檢查頂部與底部支承反力的方向與大小，並與主結構設計者確認這些反力已納入屋頂梁、樓板邊梁與錨栓的設計。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Model face glass, silicone and fins together in a finite-element analysis and confirm that the share of wind reaching each fin matches the hand tributary-width estimate; check the direction and magnitude of top and bottom support reactions, and confirm with the main-structure designer that these reactions are included in the design of roof beams, slab-edge beams and anchors. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind load path through an all-glass façade: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「玻璃肋風壓分擔寬度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fin tributary wind load” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若忽略角隅或開口處的分擔寬度變化，邊肋可能承受比中間肋高出許多的風壓；支承反力未傳達給主結構設計者時，屋頂梁可能因玻璃肋反力而過度變形，反過來把壓力推回玻璃。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring changes in tributary width at corners or openings can leave edge fins carrying much more wind than the middle fins; if support reactions never reach the main-structure designer, the roof beam may deflect excessively under fin reactions and push load back into the glass. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計時要分清楚每一種荷重走哪一條路徑，否則某個看似次要的接合會意外承擔主要力量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The designer must know which path each load takes, or a seemingly minor joint ends up carrying a major force.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全玻璃立面的玻璃肋只是裝飾，風壓主要由面玻璃自己承受。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Glass fins in an all-glass façade are decorative; the face glass carries the wind by itself." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若忽略角隅或開口處的分擔寬度變化，邊肋可能承受比中間肋高出許多的風壓；支承反力未傳達給主結構設計者時，屋頂梁可能因玻璃肋反力而過度變形，反過來把壓力推回玻璃。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring changes in tributary width at corners or openings can leave edge fins carrying much more wind than the middle fins; if support reactions never reach the main-structure designer, the roof beam may deflect excessively under fin reactions and push load back into the glass.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wind load path through an all-glass façade" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若忽略角隅或開口處的分擔寬度變化，邊肋可能承受比中間肋高出許多的風壓；支承反力未傳達給主結構設計者時，屋頂梁可能因玻璃肋反力而過度變形，反過來把壓力推回玻璃。
玻璃肋只要彎曲應力低於玻璃強度，就不會失效。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Ignoring changes in tributary width at corners or openings can leave edge fins carrying much more wind than the middle fins.
A glass fin cannot fail as long as its bending stress is below the strength of glass.
quiz.explanation: 若忽略角隅或開口處的分擔寬度變化，邊肋可能承受比中間肋高出許多的風壓；支承反力未傳達給主結構設計者時，屋頂梁可能因玻璃肋反力而過度變形，反過來把壓力推回玻璃。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring changes in tributary width at corners or openings can leave edge fins carrying much more wind than the middle fins; if support reactions never reach the main-structure designer, the roof beam may deflect excessively under fin reactions and push load back into the glass. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 細長玻璃肋的側向扭轉挫屈：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral–torsional buckling of slender fins: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「玻璃肋受壓自由邊」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fin compression free edge” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 玻璃肋的深厚比常超過 10，面內彎曲時受壓的那一條邊像一根細長壓桿，可能側向彎出並帶動整支肋扭轉，這就是側向扭轉挫屈。風壓與風吸使受壓邊在內側與外側之間交替：若受壓邊緊貼面玻璃並由矽利康連續拘束，挫屈長度大幅縮短；若受壓邊是室內側的自由邊，就只能靠肋本身的弱軸與扭轉勁度抵抗。玻璃是脆性材料，挫屈造成的附加應力會直接疊加在邊緣，常在達到彎曲強度前就破壞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「玻璃肋受壓自由邊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A glass fin often has a depth-to-thickness ratio above 10, so under in-plane bending its compressed edge behaves like a slender strut that can bow sideways and twist the whole fin, which is lateral–torsional buckling. Wind pressure and suction alternate the compressed edge between the inside and outside: if the compressed edge bears against face glass with continuous silicone restraint, the buckling length shrinks sharply; if it is the free inner edge, only the fin's own weak-axis and torsional stiffness resist. Glass is brittle, so the extra stress from buckling adds directly at the edge and often breaks the fin before its bending strength is reached. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fin compression free edge” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：M_cr = C₁·(π/L)·√(E·I_z·G·I_t)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: M_cr = C₁·(π/L)·√(E·I_z·G·I_t).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻璃肋只要彎曲應力低於玻璃強度，就不會失效。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A glass fin cannot fail as long as its bending stress is below the strength of glass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「玻璃肋受壓自由邊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fin compression free edge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：玻璃肋只要彎曲應力低於玻璃強度，就不會失效。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A glass fin cannot fail as long as its bending stress is below the strength of glass. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「細長玻璃肋的側向扭轉挫屈」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lateral–torsional buckling of slender fins" is correct?
options: 玻璃肋只要彎曲應力低於玻璃強度，就不會失效。
膠合玻璃的強度永遠等於同總厚度的單片玻璃。
玻璃肋的深厚比常超過 10，面內彎曲時受壓的那一條邊像一根細長壓桿，可能側向彎出並帶動整支肋扭轉，這就是側向扭轉挫屈。
optionsEn: A glass fin cannot fail as long as its bending stress is below the strength of glass.
A laminated pane is always as strong and stiff as a monolithic pane of the same total thickness.

A glass fin often has a depth-to-thickness ratio above 10, so under in-plane bending its compressed edge behaves like a slender strut that can bow sideways and twist the whole fin, which is lateral–torsional buckling.
quiz.explanation: 玻璃肋的深厚比常超過 10，面內彎曲時受壓的那一條邊像一根細長壓桿，可能側向彎出並帶動整支肋扭轉，這就是側向扭轉挫屈。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A glass fin often has a depth-to-thickness ratio above 10, so under in-plane bending its compressed edge behaves like a slender strut that can bow sideways and twist the whole fin, which is lateral–torsional buckling. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 細長玻璃肋的側向扭轉挫屈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral–torsional buckling of slender fins: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「玻璃肋受壓自由邊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fin compression free edge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：M_cr = C₁·(π/L)·√(E·I_z·G·I_t)。E = 70,000 MPa、G = 28,700 MPa、L = 10 m、C₁ = 1.13。整體作用（45 mm 單體）：I_z = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴、I_t ≈ 1.58×10⁷ mm⁴，M_cr ≈ 129 kN·m；完全不耦合（3 片 15 mm 各自作用）時 I_z 與 I_t 都約降為 1/9，M_cr ≈ 14.6 kN·m，低於 37.5 kN·m 的需求。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: M_cr = C₁·(π/L)·√(E·I_z·G·I_t). With E = 70,000 MPa, G = 28,700 MPa, L = 10 m and C₁ = 1.13: fully composite (45 mm monolithic) gives I_z = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴, I_t ≈ 1.58×10⁷ mm⁴ and M_cr ≈ 129 kN·m; with no coupling (three 15 mm plies acting alone) both I_z and I_t fall to about 1/9 and M_cr ≈ 14.6 kN·m, below the 37.5 kN·m demand. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以考慮初始彎曲（例如 L/300）與荷重作用高度的幾何非線性分析檢核挫屈，並分別計算受壓邊在室內側與室外側兩種情況；若依賴面玻璃的側向拘束，須證明矽利康的剪力勁度與耐久足以長期提供該拘束。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check buckling with a geometrically nonlinear analysis that includes an initial bow (for example L/300) and the load-application height, for both the inner and outer edge in compression; if relying on lateral restraint from face glass, demonstrate that the silicone's shear stiffness and durability can provide that restraint for the life of the façade.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: M_cr = C₁·(π/L)·√(E·I_z·G·I_t)。E = 70,000 MPa、G = 28,700 MPa、L = 10 m、C₁ = 1.13。整體作用（45 mm 單體）：I_z = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴、I_t ≈ 1.58×10⁷ mm⁴，M_cr ≈ 129 kN·m；完全不耦合（3 片 15 mm 各自作用）時 I_z 與 I_t 都約降為 1/9，M_cr ≈ 14.6 kN·m，低於 37.5 kN·m 的需求。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: M_cr = C₁·(π/L)·√(E·I_z·G·I_t). With E = 70,000 MPa, G = 28,700 MPa, L = 10 m and C₁ = 1.13: fully composite (45 mm monolithic) gives I_z = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴, I_t ≈ 1.58×10⁷ mm⁴ and M_cr ≈ 129 kN·m; with no coupling (three 15 mm plies acting alone) both I_z and I_t fall to about 1/9 and M_cr ≈ 14.6 kN·m, below the 37.5 kN·m demand. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「細長玻璃肋的側向扭轉挫屈」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lateral–torsional buckling of slender fins", which statement holds?
options: M_cr = C₁·(π/L)·√(E·I_z·G·I_t)。
玻璃肋在使用期的受力最大，吊裝過程的應力可以忽略。
玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。
optionsEn: M_cr = C₁·(π/L)·√(E·I_z·G·I_t).
A glass fin sees its highest stresses in service, so handling stresses can be ignored.
Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing.
quiz.explanation: M_cr = C₁·(π/L)·√(E·I_z·G·I_t)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: M_cr = C₁·(π/L)·√(E·I_z·G·I_t). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 細長玻璃肋的側向扭轉挫屈：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lateral–torsional buckling of slender fins: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「玻璃肋受壓自由邊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fin compression free edge” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以考慮初始彎曲（例如 L/300）與荷重作用高度的幾何非線性分析檢核挫屈，並分別計算受壓邊在室內側與室外側兩種情況；若依賴面玻璃的側向拘束，須證明矽利康的剪力勁度與耐久足以長期提供該拘束。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check buckling with a geometrically nonlinear analysis that includes an initial bow (for example L/300) and the load-application height, for both the inner and outer edge in compression; if relying on lateral restraint from face glass, demonstrate that the silicone's shear stiffness and durability can provide that restraint for the life of the façade. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：長玻璃肋應在設計說明中寫明挫屈驗算假設（初始彎曲、耦合程度、側向拘束來源），並要求在受壓自由邊設置可檢查的側向支撐或加深斷面；任何取消拘束的變更都須重新驗算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For long fins the design statement must record the buckling assumptions, namely initial bow, degree of coupling and source of lateral restraint, and require an inspectable lateral restraint or a deeper section on the compressed free edge; any change that removes restraint requires a new check.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只檢核面內彎曲應力而忽略挫屈，風吸作用下室內自由邊受壓、側向彎出，玻璃肋在遠低於設計應力時突然破裂；若面玻璃隨後失去支承，整片立面可能連鎖掉落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only in-plane bending stress and ignoring buckling lets the free inner edge, compressed under suction, bow sideways so the fin breaks suddenly far below its design stress; if the face glass then loses its support, a whole bay can fall in sequence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以考慮初始彎曲（例如 L/300）與荷重作用高度的幾何非線性分析檢核挫屈，並分別計算受壓邊在室內側與室外側兩種情況；若依賴面玻璃的側向拘束，須證明矽利康的剪力勁度與耐久足以長期提供該拘束。
knowledge.textEn: Check buckling with a geometrically nonlinear analysis that includes an initial bow (for example L/300) and the load-application height, for both the inner and outer edge in compression; if relying on lateral restraint from face glass, demonstrate that the silicone's shear stiffness and durability can provide that restraint for the life of the façade.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 長玻璃肋應在設計說明中寫明挫屈驗算假設（初始彎曲、耦合程度、側向拘束來源），並要求在受壓自由邊設置可檢查的側向支撐或加深斷面；任何取消拘束的變更都須重新驗算。
knowledge.textEn: For long fins the design statement must record the buckling assumptions, namely initial bow, degree of coupling and source of lateral restraint, and require an inspectable lateral restraint or a deeper section on the compressed free edge; any change that removes restraint requires a new check.

quiz.question: 要驗證「細長玻璃肋的側向扭轉挫屈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lateral–torsional buckling of slender fins"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以考慮初始彎曲（例如 L/300）與荷重作用高度的幾何非線性分析檢核挫屈，並分別計算受壓邊在室內側與室外側兩種情況。
熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Check buckling with a geometrically nonlinear analysis that includes an initial bow (for example L/300) and the load-application height, for both the inner and outer edge in compression.
Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously.
quiz.explanation: 以考慮初始彎曲（例如 L/300）與荷重作用高度的幾何非線性分析檢核挫屈，並分別計算受壓邊在室內側與室外側兩種情況；若依賴面玻璃的側向拘束，須證明矽利康的剪力勁度與耐久足以長期提供該拘束。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check buckling with a geometrically nonlinear analysis that includes an initial bow (for example L/300) and the load-application height, for both the inner and outer edge in compression; if relying on lateral restraint from face glass, demonstrate that the silicone's shear stiffness and durability can provide that restraint for the life of the façade. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 細長玻璃肋的側向扭轉挫屈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lateral–torsional buckling of slender fins: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「玻璃肋受壓自由邊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fin compression free edge” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只檢核面內彎曲應力而忽略挫屈，風吸作用下室內自由邊受壓、側向彎出，玻璃肋在遠低於設計應力時突然破裂；若面玻璃隨後失去支承，整片立面可能連鎖掉落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only in-plane bending stress and ignoring buckling lets the free inner edge, compressed under suction, bow sideways so the fin breaks suddenly far below its design stress; if the face glass then loses its support, a whole bay can fall in sequence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：玻璃是脆性材料，挫屈造成的附加應力會直接疊加在邊緣，常在達到彎曲強度前就破壞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Glass is brittle, so the extra stress from buckling adds directly at the edge and often breaks the fin before its bending strength is reached.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻璃肋只要彎曲應力低於玻璃強度，就不會失效。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A glass fin cannot fail as long as its bending stress is below the strength of glass." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只檢核面內彎曲應力而忽略挫屈，風吸作用下室內自由邊受壓、側向彎出，玻璃肋在遠低於設計應力時突然破裂；若面玻璃隨後失去支承，整片立面可能連鎖掉落。
knowledge.textEn: Checking only in-plane bending stress and ignoring buckling lets the free inner edge, compressed under suction, bow sideways so the fin breaks suddenly far below its design stress; if the face glass then loses its support, a whole bay can fall in sequence.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「細長玻璃肋的側向扭轉挫屈」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lateral–torsional buckling of slender fins" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
膠合玻璃的強度永遠等於同總厚度的單片玻璃。
只檢核面內彎曲應力而忽略挫屈，風吸作用下室內自由邊受壓、側向彎出，玻璃肋在遠低於設計應力時突然破裂；若面玻璃隨後失去支承，整片立面可能連鎖掉落。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A laminated pane is always as strong and stiff as a monolithic pane of the same total thickness.
Checking only in-plane bending stress and ignoring buckling lets the free inner edge, compressed under suction, bow sideways so the fin breaks suddenly far below its design stress.
quiz.explanation: 只檢核面內彎曲應力而忽略挫屈，風吸作用下室內自由邊受壓、側向彎出，玻璃肋在遠低於設計應力時突然破裂；若面玻璃隨後失去支承，整片立面可能連鎖掉落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Checking only in-plane bending stress and ignoring buckling lets the free inner edge, compressed under suction, bow sideways so the fin breaks suddenly far below its design stress; if the face glass then loses its support, a whole bay can fall in sequence. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「膠合玻璃、中間膜與等效厚度」與「面玻璃接合、矽利康咬合寬與金屬件」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Laminated glass, interlayers and effective thickness" and "Face-glass joints, silicone bite and metal fittings": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 膠合玻璃、中間膜與等效厚度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Laminated glass, interlayers and effective thickness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「膠合中間膜耦合」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Laminate interlayer coupling” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 結構玻璃肋幾乎都是兩片以上的膠合玻璃，中間夾 PVB 或離子型（ionoplast）中間膜。面內彎曲時各片玻璃深度相同、共同變形，中間膜幾乎不影響強度；但弱軸彎曲、扭轉與挫屈時，各片能否像一塊厚板一起作用，取決於中間膜的剪力勁度，而這個勁度會隨溫度升高與荷重持續時間變長而急劇下降。因此陣風、長期風或日照高溫下的同一支肋，可能有完全不同的有效厚度。離子型中間膜在較高溫度下保有較高剪力勁度，也讓玻璃破裂後的殘餘承載較好。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「膠合中間膜耦合」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Structural fins are almost always laminates of two or more plies with a PVB or ionoplast interlayer. Under in-plane bending all plies have the same depth and deform together, so the interlayer barely affects strength; but in weak-axis bending, torsion and buckling, whether the plies act as one thick plate depends on the interlayer's shear stiffness, which drops sharply with higher temperature and longer load duration. The same fin can therefore have very different effective thickness under a gust, a sustained wind or hot sunshine. Ionoplast interlayers keep more shear stiffness at higher temperatures and also give better residual capacity after the glass breaks. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Laminate interlayer coupling” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：三片 15 mm 弱軸慣性矩：完全耦合 I = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴；完全不耦合 I = 3×550×15³/12 ≈ 0.46×10⁶ mm⁴，比值 n² = 3² = 9。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Weak-axis inertia of three 15 mm plies: fully coupled I = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴; uncoupled I = 3×550×15³/12 ≈ 0.46×10⁶ mm⁴, a ratio n² = 3² = 9.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「膠合玻璃的強度永遠等於同總厚度的單片玻璃。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A laminated pane is always as strong and stiff as a monolithic pane of the same total thickness." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「膠合中間膜耦合」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Laminate interlayer coupling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
