Under in-plane bending all plies have the same depth and deform together, so the interlayer barely affects strength; but in weak-axis bending, torsion and buckling, whether the plies act as one thick plate depends on the interlayer's shear stiffness, which drops sharply with higher temperature and longer load duration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：膠合玻璃的強度永遠等於同總厚度的單片玻璃。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A laminated pane is always as strong and stiff as a monolithic pane of the same total thickness. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「膠合玻璃、中間膜與等效厚度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Laminated glass, interlayers and effective thickness" is correct?
options: 結構玻璃肋幾乎都是兩片以上的膠合玻璃，中間夾 PVB 或離子型（ionoplast）中間膜。
膠合玻璃的強度永遠等於同總厚度的單片玻璃。
結構矽利康越厚、塗得越多，接合就越安全。
optionsEn: Structural fins are almost always laminates of two or more plies with a PVB or ionoplast interlayer.
A laminated pane is always as strong and stiff as a monolithic pane of the same total thickness.
The thicker and more generous the structural silicone, the safer the joint.
quiz.explanation: 結構玻璃肋幾乎都是兩片以上的膠合玻璃，中間夾 PVB 或離子型（ionoplast）中間膜。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Structural fins are almost always laminates of two or more plies with a PVB or ionoplast interlayer. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 膠合玻璃、中間膜與等效厚度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Laminated glass, interlayers and effective thickness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「膠合中間膜耦合」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Laminate interlayer coupling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：三片 15 mm 弱軸慣性矩：完全耦合 I = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴；完全不耦合 I = 3×550×15³/12 ≈ 0.46×10⁶ mm⁴，比值 n² = 3² = 9。一片破裂後面內斷面模數降為 2/3：σ = 37.5×10⁶/(30×550²/6) ≈ 24.8 MPa，比完整時的 16.5 MPa 高 50%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Weak-axis inertia of three 15 mm plies: fully coupled I = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴; uncoupled I = 3×550×15³/12 ≈ 0.46×10⁶ mm⁴, a ratio n² = 3² = 9. With one ply broken the in-plane section modulus drops to 2/3: σ = 37.5×10⁶/(30×550²/6) ≈ 24.8 MPa, 50% above the intact 16.5 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依 ASTM E1300、EN 16612 或 CEN/TS 19100 的等效厚度方法，分別以陣風、長期與高溫情境的中間膜剪力模數計算；要求中間膜廠商提供不同溫度與載重時間下的剪力模數資料，並以一片破裂的情境檢核殘餘承載與變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute effective thickness by the methods of ASTM E1300, EN 16612 or CEN/TS 19100 using interlayer shear moduli for gust, long-duration and high-temperature cases; require the interlayer manufacturer's shear-modulus data across temperature and load duration, and check residual capacity and deformation with one ply broken.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 三片 15 mm 弱軸慣性矩：完全耦合 I = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴；完全不耦合 I = 3×550×15³/12 ≈ 0.46×10⁶ mm⁴，比值 n² = 3² = 9。一片破裂後面內斷面模數降為 2/3：σ = 37.5×10⁶/(30×550²/6) ≈ 24.8 MPa，比完整時的 16.5 MPa 高 50%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Weak-axis inertia of three 15 mm plies: fully coupled I = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴; uncoupled I = 3×550×15³/12 ≈ 0.46×10⁶ mm⁴, a ratio n² = 3² = 9. With one ply broken the in-plane section modulus drops to 2/3: σ = 37.5×10⁶/(30×550²/6) ≈ 24.8 MPa, 50% above the intact 16.5 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「膠合玻璃、中間膜與等效厚度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Laminated glass, interlayers and effective thickness", which statement holds?
options: 玻璃肋上下兩端都固定得越牢，立面就越穩定。
三片 15 mm 弱軸慣性矩：完全耦合 I = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴。
玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。
optionsEn: The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade.
Weak-axis inertia of three 15 mm plies: fully coupled I = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴; uncoupled I = 3×550×15³/12 ≈ 0.46×10⁶ mm⁴, a ratio n² = 3² = 9.
Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact.
quiz.explanation: 三片 15 mm 弱軸慣性矩：完全耦合 I = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴；完全不耦合 I = 3×550×15³/12 ≈ 0.46×10⁶ mm⁴，比值 n² = 3² = 9。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Weak-axis inertia of three 15 mm plies: fully coupled I = 550×45³/12 ≈ 4.18×10⁶ mm⁴; uncoupled I = 3×550×15³/12 ≈ 0.46×10⁶ mm⁴, a ratio n² = 3² = 9. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 膠合玻璃、中間膜與等效厚度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Laminated glass, interlayers and effective thickness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「膠合中間膜耦合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Laminate interlayer coupling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 ASTM E1300、EN 16612 或 CEN/TS 19100 的等效厚度方法，分別以陣風、長期與高溫情境的中間膜剪力模數計算；要求中間膜廠商提供不同溫度與載重時間下的剪力模數資料，並以一片破裂的情境檢核殘餘承載與變形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute effective thickness by the methods of ASTM E1300, EN 16612 or CEN/TS 19100 using interlayer shear moduli for gust, long-duration and high-temperature cases; require the interlayer manufacturer's shear-modulus data across temperature and load duration, and check residual capacity and deformation with one ply broken. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規範要寫明中間膜種類、厚度、溫度與載重時間對應的設計剪力模數，以及一片破裂時的殘餘承載要求；玻璃廠須提交膠合製程紀錄與抽樣檢驗，替換中間膜品牌須經結構設計者重新驗算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification must state interlayer type, thickness and design shear moduli for each temperature and load duration, plus the residual-capacity requirement with one ply broken; the glass processor must submit laminating records and sample tests, and any change of interlayer brand needs re-checking by the structural designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以室溫短時的中間膜勁度設計，夏季正午受日照的玻璃肋實際接近不耦合狀態，挫屈承載只剩設計值的一小部分；膠合品質不良的氣泡或邊緣脫層也會讓局部變成各片獨立作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing with room-temperature short-term interlayer stiffness means that a fin in summer midday sun is actually close to uncoupled, leaving only a fraction of the design buckling capacity; bubbles or edge delamination from poor laminating make plies act separately in those zones. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 ASTM E1300、EN 16612 或 CEN/TS 19100 的等效厚度方法，分別以陣風、長期與高溫情境的中間膜剪力模數計算；要求中間膜廠商提供不同溫度與載重時間下的剪力模數資料，並以一片破裂的情境檢核殘餘承載與變形。
knowledge.textEn: Compute effective thickness by the methods of ASTM E1300, EN 16612 or CEN/TS 19100 using interlayer shear moduli for gust, long-duration and high-temperature cases; require the interlayer manufacturer's shear-modulus data across temperature and load duration, and check residual capacity and deformation with one ply broken.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規範要寫明中間膜種類、厚度、溫度與載重時間對應的設計剪力模數，以及一片破裂時的殘餘承載要求；玻璃廠須提交膠合製程紀錄與抽樣檢驗，替換中間膜品牌須經結構設計者重新驗算。
knowledge.textEn: The specification must state interlayer type, thickness and design shear moduli for each temperature and load duration, plus the residual-capacity requirement with one ply broken; the glass processor must submit laminating records and sample tests, and any change of interlayer brand needs re-checking by the structural designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「膠合玻璃、中間膜與等效厚度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Laminated glass, interlayers and effective thickness"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
玻璃結構完工後不會再更換，因此不必保留吊點與運輸路徑。
依 ASTM E1300、EN 16612 或 CEN/TS 19100 的等效厚度方法，分別以陣風、長期與高溫情境的中間膜剪力模數計算。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A glass structure will never be replaced, so pick points and access routes need not be kept.
Compute effective thickness by the methods of ASTM E1300, EN 16612 or CEN/TS 19100 using interlayer shear moduli for gust, long-duration and high-temperature cases.
quiz.explanation: 依 ASTM E1300、EN 16612 或 CEN/TS 19100 的等效厚度方法，分別以陣風、長期與高溫情境的中間膜剪力模數計算；要求中間膜廠商提供不同溫度與載重時間下的剪力模數資料，並以一片破裂的情境檢核殘餘承載與變形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute effective thickness by the methods of ASTM E1300, EN 16612 or CEN/TS 19100 using interlayer shear moduli for gust, long-duration and high-temperature cases; require the interlayer manufacturer's shear-modulus data across temperature and load duration, and check residual capacity and deformation with one ply broken. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 膠合玻璃、中間膜與等效厚度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Laminated glass, interlayers and effective thickness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「膠合中間膜耦合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Laminate interlayer coupling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以室溫短時的中間膜勁度設計，夏季正午受日照的玻璃肋實際接近不耦合狀態，挫屈承載只剩設計值的一小部分；膠合品質不良的氣泡或邊緣脫層也會讓局部變成各片獨立作用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 面玻璃接合、矽利康咬合寬與金屬件：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Face-glass joints, silicone bite and metal fittings: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「結構矽利康與埋入金屬件」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Structural silicone and embedded fittings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 面玻璃與玻璃肋的接合有兩大做法：以結構矽利康連續黏結，讓風壓沿整條邊均勻傳遞；或以螺栓、夾具與膠合入玻璃的金屬件集中傳力。矽利康柔軟、可吸收溫差與微小變位，但設計應力很低，咬合寬度與厚度都要計算；螺栓孔則會在孔緣造成應力集中，必須以襯套、墊片與強化玻璃處理。膠合入玻璃的金屬件讓力量分散到中間膜與多片玻璃，減少外露夾具與鑽孔數量，是近年大型玻璃結構的重要發展。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「結構矽利康與埋入金屬件」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Face glass joins fins in two main ways: continuous structural silicone bonding, which transfers wind evenly along the whole edge, or bolts, clamps and laminated-in metal fittings that transfer it at points. Silicone is soft and absorbs thermal and small movements, but its design stress is very low, so bite and thickness must be calculated; bolt holes concentrate stress at the hole edge and need bushings, liners and toughened glass. Metal fittings laminated into the glass spread force through the interlayer and several plies, reducing exposed clamps and drilled holes, an important recent development in large glass structures. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Structural silicone and embedded fittings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩邊支承面玻璃每邊承受 q·b/2 = 1.5×2.0/2 = 1.5 kN/m；矽利康風載設計應力取 138 kPa（20 psi），咬合寬 = 1.5 kN/m ÷ 138 kPa ≈ 10.9 mm，取 12 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Face glass supported on two edges carries q·b/2 = 1.5×2.0/2 = 1.5 kN/m per edge; with a silicone wind design stress of 138 kPa (20 psi), the bite = 1.5 kN/m ÷ 138 kPa ≈ 10.9 mm, specified as 12 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「結構矽利康越厚、塗得越多，接合就越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The thicker and more generous the structural silicone, the safer the joint." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「結構矽利康與埋入金屬件」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 面玻璃接合、矽利康咬合寬與金屬件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Face-glass joints, silicone bite and metal fittings: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「結構矽利康與埋入金屬件」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Structural silicone and embedded fittings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩邊支承面玻璃每邊承受 q·b/2 = 1.5×2.0/2 = 1.5 kN/m；矽利康風載設計應力取 138 kPa（20 psi），咬合寬 = 1.5 kN/m ÷ 138 kPa ≈ 10.9 mm，取 12 mm。若肋間距改為 2.5 m，所需咬合寬約 13.6 mm。風壓值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Face glass supported on two edges carries q·b/2 = 1.5×2.0/2 = 1.5 kN/m per edge; with a silicone wind design stress of 138 kPa (20 psi), the bite = 1.5 kN/m ÷ 138 kPa ≈ 10.9 mm, specified as 12 mm. If fin spacing becomes 2.5 m, the bite needed is about 13.6 mm. The wind values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依 ASTM C1401 原則提交矽利康相容性與附著試驗報告（以實際玻璃鍍膜、間隔條與清潔劑做試驗），確認咬合寬與膠縫厚度；金屬件與螺栓接合則要求原型件載重試驗，記錄破壞模式與承載，並與計算的孔緣應力比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Following ASTM C1401 principles, submit silicone compatibility and adhesion test reports made with the actual glass coatings, spacers and cleaners, and confirm bite and joint thickness; for metal fittings and bolted joints require prototype load tests recording failure mode and capacity, compared with the calculated hole-edge stresses.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 面玻璃接合、矽利康咬合寬與金屬件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Face-glass joints, silicone bite and metal fittings: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「結構矽利康與埋入金屬件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Structural silicone and embedded fittings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 ASTM C1401 原則提交矽利康相容性與附著試驗報告（以實際玻璃鍍膜、間隔條與清潔劑做試驗），確認咬合寬與膠縫厚度；金屬件與螺栓接合則要求原型件載重試驗，記錄破壞模式與承載，並與計算的孔緣應力比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Following ASTM C1401 principles, submit silicone compatibility and adhesion test reports made with the actual glass coatings, spacers and cleaners, and confirm bite and joint thickness; for metal fittings and bolted joints require prototype load tests recording failure mode and capacity, compared with the calculated hole-edge stresses. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：矽利康施作須在可控的工廠或現場淨化條件下進行，每批記錄清潔、底漆、混合比與蝴蝶試驗或斷膠試驗結果；所有金屬件與螺栓接合都要有可讀的扭力或預壓紀錄，並避免金屬直接接觸玻璃。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Silicone work must be done under controlled shop or clean site conditions, with each batch recording cleaning, priming, mix ratio and butterfly or snap test results; every fitting and bolted joint needs a readable torque or preload record, and metal must never touch glass directly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：矽利康咬合寬不足或與鍍膜不相容時，膠縫在數年後逐漸脫黏，面玻璃在強風吸力下外移甚至脫落；螺栓孔未設襯套，金屬與玻璃直接接觸，孔緣在溫度循環與振動下產生裂紋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the silicone bite is too small or incompatible with the coating, the joint gradually debonds over a few years and face glass moves outward or even detaches under strong suction; bolt holes without bushings put metal in direct contact with glass, and the hole edge cracks under thermal cycling and vibration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.text: 矽利康施作須在可控的工廠或現場淨化條件下進行，每批記錄清潔、底漆、混合比與蝴蝶試驗或斷膠試驗結果；所有金屬件與螺栓接合都要有可讀的扭力或預壓紀錄，並避免金屬直接接觸玻璃。

全玻璃立面的玻璃肋只是裝飾，風壓主要由面玻璃自己承受。
optionsEn: Following ASTM C1401 principles, submit silicone compatibility and adhesion test reports made with the actual glass coatings, spacers and cleaners, and confirm bite and joint thickness.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Glass fins in an all-glass façade are decorative; the face glass carries the wind by itself.
quiz.explanation: 依 ASTM C1401 原則提交矽利康相容性與附著試驗報告（以實際玻璃鍍膜、間隔條與清潔劑做試驗），確認咬合寬與膠縫厚度；金屬件與螺栓接合則要求原型件載重試驗，記錄破壞模式與承載，並與計算的孔緣應力比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Following ASTM C1401 principles, submit silicone compatibility and adhesion test reports made with the actual glass coatings, spacers and cleaners, and confirm bite and joint thickness; for metal fittings and bolted joints require prototype load tests recording failure mode and capacity, compared with the calculated hole-edge stresses. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 面玻璃接合、矽利康咬合寬與金屬件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Face-glass joints, silicone bite and metal fittings: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「結構矽利康與埋入金屬件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Structural silicone and embedded fittings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 矽利康咬合寬不足或與鍍膜不相容時，膠縫在數年後逐漸脫黏，面玻璃在強風吸力下外移甚至脫落；螺栓孔未設襯套，金屬與玻璃直接接觸，孔緣在溫度循環與振動下產生裂紋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the silicone bite is too small or incompatible with the coating, the joint gradually debonds over a few years and face glass moves outward or even detaches under strong suction; bolt holes without bushings put metal in direct contact with glass, and the hole edge cracks under thermal cycling and vibration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：膠合入玻璃的金屬件讓力量分散到中間膜與多片玻璃，減少外露夾具與鑽孔數量，是近年大型玻璃結構的重要發展。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Metal fittings laminated into the glass spread force through the interlayer and several plies, reducing exposed clamps and drilled holes, an important recent development in large glass structures.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「結構矽利康越厚、塗得越多，接合就越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The thicker and more generous the structural silicone, the safer the joint." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 矽利康咬合寬不足或與鍍膜不相容時，膠縫在數年後逐漸脫黏，面玻璃在強風吸力下外移甚至脫落；螺栓孔未設襯套，金屬與玻璃直接接觸，孔緣在溫度循環與振動下產生裂紋。
knowledge.textEn: If the silicone bite is too small or incompatible with the coating, the joint gradually debonds over a few years and face glass moves outward or even detaches under strong suction; bolt holes without bushings put metal in direct contact with glass, and the hole edge cracks under thermal cycling and vibration.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「面玻璃接合、矽利康咬合寬與金屬件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Face-glass joints, silicone bite and metal fittings" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
矽利康咬合寬不足或與鍍膜不相容時，膠縫在數年後逐漸脫黏，面玻璃在強風吸力下外移甚至脫落；螺栓孔未設襯套，金屬與玻璃直接接觸，孔緣在溫度循環與振動下產生裂紋。
玻璃肋在使用期的受力最大，吊裝過程的應力可以忽略。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If the silicone bite is too small or incompatible with the coating, the joint gradually debonds over a few years and face glass moves outward or even detaches under strong suction.
A glass fin sees its highest stresses in service, so handling stresses can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 矽利康咬合寬不足或與鍍膜不相容時，膠縫在數年後逐漸脫黏，面玻璃在強風吸力下外移甚至脫落；螺栓孔未設襯套，金屬與玻璃直接接觸，孔緣在溫度循環與振動下產生裂紋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the silicone bite is too small or incompatible with the coating, the joint gradually debonds over a few years and face glass moves outward or even detaches under strong suction; bolt holes without bushings put metal in direct contact with glass, and the hole edge cracks under thermal cycling and vibration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝」與「安裝順序、公差與主結構變位」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass" and "Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「長玻璃翻轉與吊裝」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-glass tilting and lifting” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 十公尺以上的玻璃肋與面玻璃需要特殊運輸架、吊具與現場動線；玻璃最脆弱的時刻往往不是使用期，而是平放、翻轉與吊起的過程。玻璃肋平放時以弱軸受自重彎曲，與設計時的強軸受力完全不同，若支點位置不當，搬運應力可能接近風壓設計應力；邊緣碰撞造成的小缺口更是日後破裂的起點。因此吊裝計畫要指定支點位置、翻轉方式（立式運輸架或翻轉架）、吸盤或夾具配置、風速限制與每一步的停止條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「長玻璃翻轉與吊裝」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fins and face panels longer than ten metres need special transport frames, lifting gear and site routes; glass is often most vulnerable not in service but while lying flat, being tilted and being lifted. A fin lying flat bends under its own weight about the weak axis, completely unlike its strong-axis design loading, and with poorly placed supports the handling stress can approach the wind design stress; small chips from edge impact become the origin of later breakage. The lifting plan must therefore specify support positions, the tilting method (upright transport frame or tilting frame), vacuum-pad or clamp layout, wind-speed limits and stop conditions for every step. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Long-glass tilting and lifting” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：肋自重 w = 0.55×0.045×25 kN/m³ ≈ 0.62 kN/m，10 m 重約 6.2 kN（約 630 kg）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Fin self-weight w = 0.55×0.045×25 kN/m³ ≈ 0.62 kN/m, so a 10 m fin weighs about 6.2 kN (about 630 kg).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻璃肋在使用期的受力最大，吊裝過程的應力可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A glass fin sees its highest stresses in service, so handling stresses can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「長玻璃翻轉與吊裝」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Long-glass tilting and lifting”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝
knowledge.titleEn: Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass
knowledge.text: 十公尺以上的玻璃肋與面玻璃需要特殊運輸架、吊具與現場動線；玻璃最脆弱的時刻往往不是使用期，而是平放、翻轉與吊起的過程。玻璃肋平放時以弱軸受自重彎曲，與設計時的強軸受力完全不同，若支點位置不當，搬運應力可能接近風壓設計應力；邊緣碰撞造成的小缺口更是日後破裂的起點。
knowledge.textEn: Fins and face panels longer than ten metres need special transport frames, lifting gear and site routes; glass is often most vulnerable not in service but while lying flat, being tilted and being lifted. A fin lying flat bends under its own weight about the weak axis, completely unlike its strong-axis design loading, and with poorly placed supports the handling stress can approach the wind design stress; small chips from edge impact become the origin of later breakage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：玻璃肋在使用期的受力最大，吊裝過程的應力可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A glass fin sees its highest stresses in service, so handling stresses can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass" is correct?
options: 玻璃肋在使用期的受力最大，吊裝過程的應力可以忽略。
玻璃肋上下兩端都固定得越牢，立面就越穩定。
十公尺以上的玻璃肋與面玻璃需要特殊運輸架、吊具與現場動線；玻璃最脆弱的時刻往往不是使用期，而是平放、翻轉與吊起的過程。
optionsEn: A glass fin sees its highest stresses in service, so handling stresses can be ignored.
The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade.
Fins and face panels longer than ten metres need special transport frames, lifting gear and site routes.
quiz.explanation: 十公尺以上的玻璃肋與面玻璃需要特殊運輸架、吊具與現場動線；玻璃最脆弱的時刻往往不是使用期，而是平放、翻轉與吊起的過程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fins and face panels longer than ten metres need special transport frames, lifting gear and site routes; glass is often most vulnerable not in service but while lying flat, being tilted and being lifted. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長玻璃翻轉與吊裝」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-glass tilting and lifting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：肋自重 w = 0.55×0.045×25 kN/m³ ≈ 0.62 kN/m，10 m 重約 6.2 kN（約 630 kg）。平放兩點支承於距端 0.207L 時 M ≈ 0.0214wL² = 0.0214×0.62×10² ≈ 1.32 kN·m。弱軸 S：整體 550×45²/6 ≈ 186,000 mm³，σ ≈ 7.1 MPa；不耦合 3×550×15²/6 ≈ 61,900 mm³，σ ≈ 21.4 MPa，乘動力係數 1.3 約 27.8 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fin self-weight w = 0.55×0.045×25 kN/m³ ≈ 0.62 kN/m, so a 10 m fin weighs about 6.2 kN (about 630 kg). Lying flat on two supports 0.207L from the ends, M ≈ 0.0214wL² = 0.0214×0.62×10² ≈ 1.32 kN·m. Weak-axis S: composite 550×45²/6 ≈ 186,000 mm³ gives σ ≈ 7.1 MPa; uncoupled 3×550×15²/6 ≈ 61,900 mm³ gives σ ≈ 21.4 MPa, about 27.8 MPa with a 1.3 dynamic factor. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：吊裝計畫須附每一搬運狀態（平放、翻轉、吊升、就位）的應力計算、吊具與吸盤額定荷重與安全係數、風速上限與停止條件，由帷幕牆工程師與起重負責人共同簽認；每支玻璃進場時目視檢查邊緣與膠合品質並拍照建檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The lifting plan must include stress calculations for each handling state (flat, tilting, hoisting, placing), lifting-gear and vacuum-pad ratings and safety factors, wind-speed limits and stop conditions, signed jointly by the façade engineer and the lifting supervisor; inspect and photograph every pane's edges and laminate on arrival.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Fin self-weight w = 0.55×0.045×25 kN/m³ ≈ 0.62 kN/m, so a 10 m fin weighs about 6.2 kN (about 630 kg). Lying flat on two supports 0.207L from the ends, M ≈ 0.0214wL² = 0.0214×0.62×10² ≈ 1.32 kN·m. Weak-axis S: composite 550×45²/6 ≈ 186,000 mm³ gives σ ≈ 7.1 MPa; uncoupled 3×550×15²/6 ≈ 61,900 mm³ gives σ ≈ 21.4 MPa, about 27.8 MPa with a 1.3 dynamic factor. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass", which statement holds?
options: 玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。
玻璃結構完工後不會再更換，因此不必保留吊點與運輸路徑。
optionsEn: Fin self-weight w = 0.55×0.045×25 kN/m³ ≈ 0.62 kN/m, so a 10 m fin weighs about 6.2 kN (about 630 kg).
Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact.
A glass structure will never be replaced, so pick points and access routes need not be kept.
quiz.explanation: 肋自重 w = 0.55×0.045×25 kN/m³ ≈ 0.62 kN/m，10 m 重約 6.2 kN（約 630 kg）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Fin self-weight w = 0.55×0.045×25 kN/m³ ≈ 0.62 kN/m, so a 10 m fin weighs about 6.2 kN (about 630 kg). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長玻璃翻轉與吊裝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-glass tilting and lifting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 吊裝計畫須附每一搬運狀態（平放、翻轉、吊升、就位）的應力計算、吊具與吸盤額定荷重與安全係數、風速上限與停止條件，由帷幕牆工程師與起重負責人共同簽認；每支玻璃進場時目視檢查邊緣與膠合品質並拍照建檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The lifting plan must include stress calculations for each handling state (flat, tilting, hoisting, placing), lifting-gear and vacuum-pad ratings and safety factors, wind-speed limits and stop conditions, signed jointly by the façade engineer and the lifting supervisor; inspect and photograph every pane's edges and laminate on arrival. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊裝屬高風險作業，每一次大型玻璃吊裝都要有經核准的吊裝計畫、試吊與停止點，由起重負責人與帷幕牆工程師在現場確認後才能進行；玻璃以立式運輸架運送並全程保護邊緣。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lifting is high-risk work: every major glass lift needs an approved lifting plan, a trial lift and hold points, and proceeds only after the lifting supervisor and façade engineer confirm on site; glass travels in upright transport frames with its edges protected throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把長玻璃肋平放在中央單點或兩端支點上搬運，弱軸彎曲加上車輛振動足以讓玻璃開裂；翻轉時邊緣碰到地面或鋼構造成貝殼狀崩邊，安裝時看不出，數月後在風壓或溫差下自邊緣破裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Carrying a long fin flat on a single central support or on supports at its ends lets weak-axis bending plus vehicle vibration crack it; during tilting an edge that strikes the ground or steelwork suffers a shell chip invisible at installation that later starts a crack under wind or thermal stress months afterwards. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 吊裝計畫須附每一搬運狀態（平放、翻轉、吊升、就位）的應力計算、吊具與吸盤額定荷重與安全係數、風速上限與停止條件，由帷幕牆工程師與起重負責人共同簽認；每支玻璃進場時目視檢查邊緣與膠合品質並拍照建檔。
knowledge.textEn: The lifting plan must include stress calculations for each handling state (flat, tilting, hoisting, placing), lifting-gear and vacuum-pad ratings and safety factors, wind-speed limits and stop conditions, signed jointly by the façade engineer and the lifting supervisor; inspect and photograph every pane's edges and laminate on arrival.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吊裝屬高風險作業，每一次大型玻璃吊裝都要有經核准的吊裝計畫、試吊與停止點，由起重負責人與帷幕牆工程師在現場確認後才能進行；玻璃以立式運輸架運送並全程保護邊緣。
knowledge.textEn: Lifting is high-risk work: every major glass lift needs an approved lifting plan, a trial lift and hold points, and proceeds only after the lifting supervisor and façade engineer confirm on site; glass travels in upright transport frames with its edges protected throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
吊裝計畫須附每一搬運狀態（平放、翻轉、吊升、就位）的應力計算、吊具與吸盤額定荷重與安全係數、風速上限與停止條件，由帷幕牆工程師與起重負責人共同簽認。
玻璃肋只要彎曲應力低於玻璃強度，就不會失效。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

The lifting plan must include stress calculations for each handling state (flat, tilting, hoisting, placing), lifting-gear and vacuum-pad ratings and safety factors, wind-speed limits and stop conditions, signed jointly by the façade engineer and the lifting supervisor.
A glass fin cannot fail as long as its bending stress is below the strength of glass.
quiz.explanation: 吊裝計畫須附每一搬運狀態（平放、翻轉、吊升、就位）的應力計算、吊具與吸盤額定荷重與安全係數、風速上限與停止條件，由帷幕牆工程師與起重負責人共同簽認；每支玻璃進場時目視檢查邊緣與膠合品質並拍照建檔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The lifting plan must include stress calculations for each handling state (flat, tilting, hoisting, placing), lifting-gear and vacuum-pad ratings and safety factors, wind-speed limits and stop conditions, signed jointly by the façade engineer and the lifting supervisor; inspect and photograph every pane's edges and laminate on arrival. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長玻璃翻轉與吊裝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-glass tilting and lifting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把長玻璃肋平放在中央單點或兩端支點上搬運，弱軸彎曲加上車輛振動足以讓玻璃開裂；翻轉時邊緣碰到地面或鋼構造成貝殼狀崩邊，安裝時看不出，數月後在風壓或溫差下自邊緣破裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Carrying a long fin flat on a single central support or on supports at its ends lets weak-axis bending plus vehicle vibration crack it; during tilting an edge that strikes the ground or steelwork suffers a shell chip invisible at installation that later starts a crack under wind or thermal stress months afterwards. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此吊裝計畫要指定支點位置、翻轉方式（立式運輸架或翻轉架）、吸盤或夾具配置、風速限制與每一步的停止條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The lifting plan must therefore specify support positions, the tilting method (upright transport frame or tilting frame), vacuum-pad or clamp layout, wind-speed limits and stop conditions for every step.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻璃肋在使用期的受力最大，吊裝過程的應力可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A glass fin sees its highest stresses in service, so handling stresses can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把長玻璃肋平放在中央單點或兩端支點上搬運，弱軸彎曲加上車輛振動足以讓玻璃開裂；翻轉時邊緣碰到地面或鋼構造成貝殼狀崩邊，安裝時看不出，數月後在風壓或溫差下自邊緣破裂。
knowledge.textEn: Carrying a long fin flat on a single central support or on supports at its ends lets weak-axis bending plus vehicle vibration crack it; during tilting an edge that strikes the ground or steelwork suffers a shell chip invisible at installation that later starts a crack under wind or thermal stress months afterwards.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
玻璃肋上下兩端都固定得越牢，立面就越穩定。
把長玻璃肋平放在中央單點或兩端支點上搬運，弱軸彎曲加上車輛振動足以讓玻璃開裂。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade.
Carrying a long fin flat on a single central support or on supports at its ends lets weak-axis bending plus vehicle vibration crack it.
quiz.explanation: 把長玻璃肋平放在中央單點或兩端支點上搬運，弱軸彎曲加上車輛振動足以讓玻璃開裂；翻轉時邊緣碰到地面或鋼構造成貝殼狀崩邊，安裝時看不出，數月後在風壓或溫差下自邊緣破裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Carrying a long fin flat on a single central support or on supports at its ends lets weak-axis bending plus vehicle vibration crack it; during tilting an edge that strikes the ground or steelwork suffers a shell chip invisible at installation that later starts a crack under wind or thermal stress months afterwards. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 安裝順序、公差與主結構變位：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「頂部滑動接頭」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sliding head joint” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 玻璃肋安裝的關鍵是讓它只承擔設計中的荷重，而不被主結構的變形「擠壓」。屋頂梁在活載重、雪或溫度下會上下變位，若玻璃肋頂部固定死，就會被當成柱子受壓；因此常見做法是底部固定、頂部只傳遞水平力並允許垂直滑動，或改為頂部吊掛、底部滑動，讓玻璃處於受拉。安裝順序通常是先定位支座、立起並調整玻璃肋垂直度，再裝面玻璃、最後施打矽利康，每一步都要量測累積公差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「頂部滑動接頭」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The key to fin installation is that the fin carries only its design loads and is never squeezed by deformation of the main structure. A roof beam moves vertically under live load, snow or temperature; a fin fixed rigidly at its head would be loaded as a column, so the usual approach fixes the base and lets the head transfer horizontal force while sliding vertically, or hangs the fin from the head with a sliding base so the glass is in tension. The normal sequence is to set the shoes, stand and plumb the fins, install face glass and finally apply silicone, measuring the accumulated tolerance at every step. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sliding head joint” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：屋頂梁跨度 18 m、活載重撓度限制 L/360：δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm；加上安裝公差 ±10 mm，頂部滑動接頭的垂直行程至少 50 + 10 = 60 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For an 18 m roof beam with a live-load deflection limit of L/360, δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm; adding ±10 mm installation tolerance, the sliding head joint needs at least 50 + 10 = 60 mm of vertical travel.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻璃肋上下兩端都固定得越牢，立面就越穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「頂部滑動接頭」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sliding head joint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安裝順序、公差與主結構變位
knowledge.titleEn: Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement
knowledge.text: 玻璃肋安裝的關鍵是讓它只承擔設計中的荷重，而不被主結構的變形「擠壓」。屋頂梁在活載重、雪或溫度下會上下變位，若玻璃肋頂部固定死，就會被當成柱子受壓；因此常見做法是底部固定、頂部只傳遞水平力並允許垂直滑動，或改為頂部吊掛、底部滑動，讓玻璃處於受拉。
knowledge.textEn: The key to fin installation is that the fin carries only its design loads and is never squeezed by deformation of the main structure. A roof beam moves vertically under live load, snow or temperature; a fin fixed rigidly at its head would be loaded as a column, so the usual approach fixes the base and lets the head transfer horizontal force while sliding vertically, or hangs the fin from the head with a sliding base so the glass is in tension.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：玻璃肋上下兩端都固定得越牢，立面就越穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝順序、公差與主結構變位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement" is correct?
options: 玻璃肋安裝的關鍵是讓它只承擔設計中的荷重，而不被主結構的變形「擠壓」。
玻璃肋上下兩端都固定得越牢，立面就越穩定。
玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。
optionsEn: The key to fin installation is that the fin carries only its design loads and is never squeezed by deformation of the main structure.
The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade.
Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing.
quiz.explanation: 玻璃肋安裝的關鍵是讓它只承擔設計中的荷重，而不被主結構的變形「擠壓」。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The key to fin installation is that the fin carries only its design loads and is never squeezed by deformation of the main structure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安裝順序、公差與主結構變位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂部滑動接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sliding head joint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：屋頂梁跨度 18 m、活載重撓度限制 L/360：δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm；加上安裝公差 ±10 mm，頂部滑動接頭的垂直行程至少 50 + 10 = 60 mm。若接頭被卡死，10 m 玻璃肋需承受迫使梁減少撓度的軸壓，遠超過設計。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For an 18 m roof beam with a live-load deflection limit of L/360, δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm; adding ±10 mm installation tolerance, the sliding head joint needs at least 50 + 10 = 60 mm of vertical travel. If the joint jams, the 10 m fin must take the axial compression needed to stop the beam deflecting, far beyond its design. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝時以全站儀或雷射量測每支玻璃肋的垂直度、間距與面外偏差，記錄於逐支檢查表；頂部滑動接頭在打矽利康前檢查行程、潤滑與止動，並確認臨時固定件已全部拆除，由監造簽認後才進行下一階段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During installation survey each fin's plumb, spacing and out-of-plane deviation with a total station or laser and record them on a fin-by-fin checklist; before siliconing, check the sliding head joint's travel, lubrication and stops, and confirm all temporary fixings are removed, signed off by the supervising engineer before the next stage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 屋頂梁跨度 18 m、活載重撓度限制 L/360：δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm；加上安裝公差 ±10 mm，頂部滑動接頭的垂直行程至少 50 + 10 = 60 mm。若接頭被卡死，10 m 玻璃肋需承受迫使梁減少撓度的軸壓，遠超過設計。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For an 18 m roof beam with a live-load deflection limit of L/360, δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm; adding ±10 mm installation tolerance, the sliding head joint needs at least 50 + 10 = 60 mm of vertical travel. If the joint jams, the 10 m fin must take the axial compression needed to stop the beam deflecting, far beyond its design. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安裝順序、公差與主結構變位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement", which statement holds?
options: 熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。
屋頂梁跨度 18 m、活載重撓度限制 L/360：δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm。
全玻璃立面的玻璃肋只是裝飾，風壓主要由面玻璃自己承受。
optionsEn: Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously.
For an 18 m roof beam with a live-load deflection limit of L/360, δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm.
Glass fins in an all-glass façade are decorative; the face glass carries the wind by itself.
quiz.explanation: 屋頂梁跨度 18 m、活載重撓度限制 L/360：δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm；加上安裝公差 ±10 mm，頂部滑動接頭的垂直行程至少 50 + 10 = 60 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For an 18 m roof beam with a live-load deflection limit of L/360, δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm; adding ±10 mm installation tolerance, the sliding head joint needs at least 50 + 10 = 60 mm of vertical travel. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安裝順序、公差與主結構變位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂部滑動接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sliding head joint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝時以全站儀或雷射量測每支玻璃肋的垂直度、間距與面外偏差，記錄於逐支檢查表；頂部滑動接頭在打矽利康前檢查行程、潤滑與止動，並確認臨時固定件已全部拆除，由監造簽認後才進行下一階段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During installation survey each fin's plumb, spacing and out-of-plane deviation with a total station or laser and record them on a fin-by-fin checklist; before siliconing, check the sliding head joint's travel, lubrication and stops, and confirm all temporary fixings are removed, signed off by the supervising engineer before the next stage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：介面圖應標示主結構在各荷重下的預估變位與滑動接頭的設計行程，並在安裝程序中設「臨時固定件拆除確認」停止點；屋頂後續增設設備或改變用途，須由結構設計者確認不超過玻璃肋的容許變位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Interface drawings must show predicted main-structure movements under each load and the design travel of sliding joints, with a hold point in the installation procedure confirming removal of temporary fixings; any later rooftop equipment or change of use needs the structural designer to confirm that fin movement limits are not exceeded.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工時為了方便而以點焊或螺栓暫時固定頂部滑動接頭，完工後忘記拆除；第一次大雪或屋頂設備加載時，屋頂梁下垂把玻璃肋壓裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A sliding head joint temporarily tack-welded or bolted for convenience and never released lets the roof beam, sagging under the first heavy snow or rooftop equipment, crush the fin; setting blocks in the wrong position put the face glass's weight off-centre and concentrate stress at the corners. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝時以全站儀或雷射量測每支玻璃肋的垂直度、間距與面外偏差，記錄於逐支檢查表；頂部滑動接頭在打矽利康前檢查行程、潤滑與止動，並確認臨時固定件已全部拆除，由監造簽認後才進行下一階段。
knowledge.textEn: During installation survey each fin's plumb, spacing and out-of-plane deviation with a total station or laser and record them on a fin-by-fin checklist; before siliconing, check the sliding head joint's travel, lubrication and stops, and confirm all temporary fixings are removed, signed off by the supervising engineer before the next stage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 介面圖應標示主結構在各荷重下的預估變位與滑動接頭的設計行程，並在安裝程序中設「臨時固定件拆除確認」停止點；屋頂後續增設設備或改變用途，須由結構設計者確認不超過玻璃肋的容許變位。
knowledge.textEn: Interface drawings must show predicted main-structure movements under each load and the design travel of sliding joints, with a hold point in the installation procedure confirming removal of temporary fixings; any later rooftop equipment or change of use needs the structural designer to confirm that fin movement limits are not exceeded.

quiz.question: 要驗證「安裝順序、公差與主結構變位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
膠合玻璃的強度永遠等於同總厚度的單片玻璃。
安裝時以全站儀或雷射量測每支玻璃肋的垂直度、間距與面外偏差，記錄於逐支檢查表。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A laminated pane is always as strong and stiff as a monolithic pane of the same total thickness.
During installation survey each fin's plumb, spacing and out-of-plane deviation with a total station or laser and record them on a fin-by-fin checklist.
quiz.explanation: 安裝時以全站儀或雷射量測每支玻璃肋的垂直度、間距與面外偏差，記錄於逐支檢查表；頂部滑動接頭在打矽利康前檢查行程、潤滑與止動，並確認臨時固定件已全部拆除，由監造簽認後才進行下一階段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During installation survey each fin's plumb, spacing and out-of-plane deviation with a total station or laser and record them on a fin-by-fin checklist; before siliconing, check the sliding head joint's travel, lubrication and stops, and confirm all temporary fixings are removed, signed off by the supervising engineer before the next stage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 安裝順序、公差與主結構變位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂部滑動接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sliding head joint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 施工時為了方便而以點焊或螺栓暫時固定頂部滑動接頭，完工後忘記拆除；第一次大雪或屋頂設備加載時，屋頂梁下垂把玻璃肋壓裂。底部墊塊位置錯誤也會讓面玻璃自重偏心，造成角隅應力集中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A sliding head joint temporarily tack-welded or bolted for convenience and never released lets the roof beam, sagging under the first heavy snow or rooftop equipment, crush the fin; setting blocks in the wrong position put the face glass's weight off-centre and concentrate stress at the corners. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：安裝順序通常是先定位支座、立起並調整玻璃肋垂直度，再裝面玻璃、最後施打矽利康，每一步都要量測累積公差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The normal sequence is to set the shoes, stand and plumb the fins, install face glass and finally apply silicone, measuring the accumulated tolerance at every step.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻璃肋上下兩端都固定得越牢，立面就越穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 施工時為了方便而以點焊或螺栓暫時固定頂部滑動接頭，完工後忘記拆除；第一次大雪或屋頂設備加載時，屋頂梁下垂把玻璃肋壓裂。底部墊塊位置錯誤也會讓面玻璃自重偏心，造成角隅應力集中。
knowledge.textEn: A sliding head joint temporarily tack-welded or bolted for convenience and never released lets the roof beam, sagging under the first heavy snow or rooftop equipment, crush the fin; setting blocks in the wrong position put the face glass's weight off-centre and concentrate stress at the corners.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安裝順序、公差與主結構變位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 施工時為了方便而以點焊或螺栓暫時固定頂部滑動接頭，完工後忘記拆除；第一次大雪或屋頂設備加載時，屋頂梁下垂把玻璃肋壓裂。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。
optionsEn: A sliding head joint temporarily tack-welded or bolted for convenience and never released lets the roof beam, sagging under the first heavy snow or rooftop equipment, crush the fin.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing.
quiz.explanation: 施工時為了方便而以點焊或螺栓暫時固定頂部滑動接頭，完工後忘記拆除；第一次大雪或屋頂設備加載時，屋頂梁下垂把玻璃肋壓裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A sliding head joint temporarily tack-welded or bolted for convenience and never released lets the roof beam, sagging under the first heavy snow or rooftop equipment, crush the fin; setting blocks in the wrong position put the face glass's weight off-centre and concentrate stress at the corners. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」與「現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison" and "Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 實尺寸試驗與撓度比對：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Full-scale testing and deflection comparison: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「實尺寸玻璃肋載重試驗」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full-scale fin load test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 玻璃結構的計算對邊界條件、中間膜耦合與接合剛度非常敏感，因此大型玻璃肋常以實尺寸樣品做載重試驗：在試驗架上以分級靜載重或氣壓箱施加設計風壓與超載，量測撓度、側向位移與殘餘變形，並在破壞試驗中觀察裂紋起點與破裂後行為。實測撓度若明顯大於計算，表示支承鬆動、耦合不足或接合滑移，必須在量產前找出原因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「實尺寸玻璃肋載重試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Glass calculations are very sensitive to boundary conditions, interlayer coupling and joint stiffness, so large fins are often load-tested at full scale: on a test rig, staged static loads or a pressure chamber apply design wind and overload while deflection, lateral displacement and residual set are measured, and destructive tests reveal where cracks start and how the fin behaves after breakage. A measured deflection clearly above the calculation points to loose supports, insufficient coupling or joint slip, which must be explained before production. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Full-scale fin load test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Strong-axis deflection δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) with I = 45×550³/12 ≈ 6.24×10⁸ mm⁴, w = 3.0 N/mm and L = 10,000 mm: δ = 5×3.0×10¹⁶/(384×70,000×6.24×10⁸) ≈ 8.9 mm (about L/1,120); at a 150% test load the prediction is 13.4 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「實尺寸玻璃肋載重試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Full-scale fin load test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 實尺寸試驗與撓度比對
knowledge.text: 玻璃結構的計算對邊界條件、中間膜耦合與接合剛度非常敏感，因此大型玻璃肋常以實尺寸樣品做載重試驗：在試驗架上以分級靜載重或氣壓箱施加設計風壓與超載，量測撓度、側向位移與殘餘變形，並在破壞試驗中觀察裂紋起點與破裂後行為。實測撓度若明顯大於計算，表示支承鬆動、耦合不足或接合滑移，必須在量產前找出原因。
knowledge.textEn: Glass calculations are very sensitive to boundary conditions, interlayer coupling and joint stiffness, so large fins are often load-tested at full scale: on a test rig, staged static loads or a pressure chamber apply design wind and overload while deflection, lateral displacement and residual set are measured, and destructive tests reveal where cracks start and how the fin behaves after breakage. A measured deflection clearly above the calculation points to loose supports, insufficient coupling or joint slip, which must be explained before production.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison" is correct?
options: 玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。
玻璃結構的計算對邊界條件、中間膜耦合與接合剛度非常敏感，因此大型玻璃肋常以實尺寸樣品做載重試驗：在試驗架上以分級靜載重或氣壓箱施加設計風壓與超載，量測撓度、側向位移與殘餘變形，並在破壞試驗中觀察裂紋起點與破裂後行為。
玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。
optionsEn: Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing.

Glass calculations are very sensitive to boundary conditions, interlayer coupling and joint stiffness, so large fins are often load-tested at full scale: on a test rig, staged static loads or a pressure chamber apply design wind and overload while deflection, lateral displacement and residual set are measured, and destructive tests reveal where cracks start and how the fin behaves after breakage.
Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact.
quiz.explanation: 玻璃結構的計算對邊界條件、中間膜耦合與接合剛度非常敏感，因此大型玻璃肋常以實尺寸樣品做載重試驗：在試驗架上以分級靜載重或氣壓箱施加設計風壓與超載，量測撓度、側向位移與殘餘變形，並在破壞試驗中觀察裂紋起點與破裂後行為。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Glass calculations are very sensitive to boundary conditions, interlayer coupling and joint stiffness, so large fins are often load-tested at full scale: on a test rig, staged static loads or a pressure chamber apply design wind and overload while deflection, lateral displacement and residual set are measured, and destructive tests reveal where cracks start and how the fin behaves after breakage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 實尺寸試驗與撓度比對：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Full-scale testing and deflection comparison: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「實尺寸玻璃肋載重試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full-scale fin load test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：強軸撓度 δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI)，I = 45×550³/12 ≈ 6.24×10⁸ mm⁴，w = 3.0 N/mm、L = 10,000 mm：δ = 5×3.0×10¹⁶/(384×70,000×6.24×10⁸) ≈ 8.9 mm（約 L/1,120）；150% 試驗載重時預估 13.4 mm。若實測 16.0 mm，表觀勁度只有 13.4/16.0 ≈ 84%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Strong-axis deflection δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) with I = 45×550³/12 ≈ 6.24×10⁸ mm⁴, w = 3.0 N/mm and L = 10,000 mm: δ = 5×3.0×10¹⁶/(384×70,000×6.24×10⁸) ≈ 8.9 mm (about L/1,120); at a 150% test load the prediction is 13.4 mm. A measured 16.0 mm means the apparent stiffness is only 13.4/16.0 ≈ 84%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫事先定義載重分級、保持時間、量測點（中央撓度、受壓邊側向位移、支承滑移）與允收準則，例如設計載重下撓度不超過計算值一定比例、卸載後殘餘變形小於規定值、無裂紋；破壞試驗後檢查破裂片是否仍由中間膜保持在原位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define in advance the load steps, hold times, measurement points (mid-span deflection, lateral movement of the compressed edge, support slip) and acceptance criteria, such as deflection at design load within a set margin of the calculation, residual set below a stated limit after unloading and no cracks; after a destructive test check that broken fragments are still held in place by the interlayer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Strong-axis deflection δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) with I = 45×550³/12 ≈ 6.24×10⁸ mm⁴, w = 3.0 N/mm and L = 10,000 mm: δ = 5×3.0×10¹⁶/(384×70,000×6.24×10⁸) ≈ 8.9 mm (about L/1,120); at a 150% test load the prediction is 13.4 mm. A measured 16.0 mm means the apparent stiffness is only 13.4/16.0 ≈ 84%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison", which statement holds?
options: 玻璃結構完工後不會再更換，因此不必保留吊點與運輸路徑。
玻璃肋只要彎曲應力低於玻璃強度，就不會失效。
optionsEn: A glass structure will never be replaced, so pick points and access routes need not be kept.
A glass fin cannot fail as long as its bending stress is below the strength of glass.
Strong-axis deflection δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) with I = 45×550³/12 ≈ 6.24×10⁸ mm⁴, w = 3.0 N/mm and L = 10,000 mm: δ = 5×3.0×10¹⁶/(384×70,000×6.24×10⁸) ≈ 8.9 mm (about L/1,120).
quiz.explanationEn: Strong-axis deflection δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) with I = 45×550³/12 ≈ 6.24×10⁸ mm⁴, w = 3.0 N/mm and L = 10,000 mm: δ = 5×3.0×10¹⁶/(384×70,000×6.24×10⁸) ≈ 8.9 mm (about L/1,120); at a 150% test load the prediction is 13.4 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 實尺寸試驗與撓度比對：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Full-scale testing and deflection comparison: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「實尺寸玻璃肋載重試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full-scale fin load test” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗計畫事先定義載重分級、保持時間、量測點（中央撓度、受壓邊側向位移、支承滑移）與允收準則，例如設計載重下撓度不超過計算值一定比例、卸載後殘餘變形小於規定值、無裂紋；破壞試驗後檢查破裂片是否仍由中間膜保持在原位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define in advance the load steps, hold times, measurement points (mid-span deflection, lateral movement of the compressed edge, support slip) and acceptance criteria, such as deflection at design load within a set margin of the calculation, residual set below a stated limit after unloading and no cracks; after a destructive test check that broken fragments are still held in place by the interlayer. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗樣品的玻璃、中間膜、金屬件與支承要與量產相同，並由獨立試驗室執行、設計者到場見證；試驗結果與計算差異超過預定範圍時，須修正模型或細部後重新試驗，不能以「安全係數夠大」帶過。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Test samples must use the production glass, interlayer, fittings and supports, tested by an independent laboratory with the designer witnessing; if results differ from calculation beyond the agreed range, correct the model or details and retest rather than relying on a large safety factor.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試驗只量中央撓度而沒有量受壓邊的側向位移，挫屈前兆被忽略；或試驗樣品的支承比現場更剛硬，試驗合格但現場勁度不足，實際立面在強風時明顯晃動並有破裂風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Measuring only mid-span deflection and not the lateral movement of the compressed edge misses the warning signs of buckling; a test rig with stiffer supports than the site lets the sample pass while the real façade lacks stiffness, swaying visibly in strong wind with a risk of breakage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Define in advance the load steps, hold times, measurement points (mid-span deflection, lateral movement of the compressed edge, support slip) and acceptance criteria, such as deflection at design load within a set margin of the calculation, residual set below a stated limit after unloading and no cracks; after a destructive test check that broken fragments are still held in place by the interlayer.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 試驗樣品的玻璃、中間膜、金屬件與支承要與量產相同，並由獨立試驗室執行、設計者到場見證；試驗結果與計算差異超過預定範圍時，須修正模型或細部後重新試驗，不能以「安全係數夠大」帶過。
