quiz.question: 要驗證「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison"?
options: 試驗計畫事先定義載重分級、保持時間、量測點（中央撓度、受壓邊側向位移、支承滑移）與允收準則，例如設計載重下撓度不超過計算值一定比例、卸載後殘餘變形小於規定值、無裂紋。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
結構矽利康越厚、塗得越多，接合就越安全。
optionsEn: Define in advance the load steps, hold times, measurement points (mid-span deflection, lateral movement of the compressed edge, support slip) and acceptance criteria, such as deflection at design load within a set margin of the calculation, residual set below a stated limit after unloading and no cracks.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The thicker and more generous the structural silicone, the safer the joint.
quiz.explanation: 試驗計畫事先定義載重分級、保持時間、量測點（中央撓度、受壓邊側向位移、支承滑移）與允收準則，例如設計載重下撓度不超過計算值一定比例、卸載後殘餘變形小於規定值、無裂紋；破壞試驗後檢查破裂片是否仍由中間膜保持在原位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Define in advance the load steps, hold times, measurement points (mid-span deflection, lateral movement of the compressed edge, support slip) and acceptance criteria, such as deflection at design load within a set margin of the calculation, residual set below a stated limit after unloading and no cracks; after a destructive test check that broken fragments are still held in place by the interlayer. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 實尺寸試驗與撓度比對：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Full-scale testing and deflection comparison: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「實尺寸玻璃肋載重試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Full-scale fin load test” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試驗只量中央撓度而沒有量受壓邊的側向位移，挫屈前兆被忽略；或試驗樣品的支承比現場更剛硬，試驗合格但現場勁度不足，實際立面在強風時明顯晃動並有破裂風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring only mid-span deflection and not the lateral movement of the compressed edge misses the warning signs of buckling; a test rig with stiffer supports than the site lets the sample pass while the real façade lacks stiffness, swaying visibly in strong wind with a risk of breakage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實測撓度若明顯大於計算，表示支承鬆動、耦合不足或接合滑移，必須在量產前找出原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A measured deflection clearly above the calculation points to loose supports, insufficient coupling or joint slip, which must be explained before production.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試驗只量中央撓度而沒有量受壓邊的側向位移，挫屈前兆被忽略；或試驗樣品的支承比現場更剛硬，試驗合格但現場勁度不足，實際立面在強風時明顯晃動並有破裂風險。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring only mid-span deflection and not the lateral movement of the compressed edge misses the warning signs of buckling; a test rig with stiffer supports than the site lets the sample pass while the real façade lacks stiffness, swaying visibly in strong wind with a risk of breakage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
試驗只量中央撓度而沒有量受壓邊的側向位移，挫屈前兆被忽略；或試驗樣品的支承比現場更剛硬，試驗合格但現場勁度不足，實際立面在強風時明顯晃動並有破裂風險。
玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Measuring only mid-span deflection and not the lateral movement of the compressed edge misses the warning signs of buckling.
Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact.
quiz.explanation: 試驗只量中央撓度而沒有量受壓邊的側向位移，挫屈前兆被忽略；或試驗樣品的支承比現場更剛硬，試驗合格但現場勁度不足，實際立面在強風時明顯晃動並有破裂風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring only mid-span deflection and not the lateral movement of the compressed edge misses the warning signs of buckling; a test rig with stiffer supports than the site lets the sample pass while the real façade lacks stiffness, swaying visibly in strong wind with a risk of breakage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「玻璃邊緣品質與熱應力」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Glass edge quality and thermal stress” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 玻璃破裂幾乎都從邊緣或孔緣開始，因此現場檢查的重點是邊緣：研磨等級、崩邊、刮傷與接觸金屬。局部遮陽、室內暖氣出風口或深色貼紙會讓同一片玻璃中央與邊緣溫差擴大，在邊緣產生拉應力；未強化或邊緣受損的玻璃最容易因熱應力破裂。強化玻璃還要檢查應力分布是否均勻（以偏光觀察）與輥筒波紋等光學缺陷，後者雖不影響安全，卻常是業主驗收爭議的來源。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「玻璃邊緣品質與熱應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Glass breakage almost always starts at an edge or hole, so site inspection concentrates on edges: grinding grade, chips, scratches and metal contact. Partial shading, heating outlets or dark films widen the temperature difference between the centre and edge of a pane and create edge tension; untoughened glass or damaged edges are most prone to thermal breakage. Toughened glass is also checked for uniform stress distribution by polarised viewing and for optical defects such as roller wave, which do not affect safety but often cause acceptance disputes with the owner. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Glass edge quality and thermal stress” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱應力 σ ≈ E·α·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal stress σ ≈ E·α·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「玻璃邊緣品質與熱應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Glass edge quality and thermal stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質
knowledge.titleEn: Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality
knowledge.text: 玻璃破裂幾乎都從邊緣或孔緣開始，因此現場檢查的重點是邊緣：研磨等級、崩邊、刮傷與接觸金屬。局部遮陽、室內暖氣出風口或深色貼紙會讓同一片玻璃中央與邊緣溫差擴大，在邊緣產生拉應力；未強化或邊緣受損的玻璃最容易因熱應力破裂。
knowledge.textEn: Glass breakage almost always starts at an edge or hole, so site inspection concentrates on edges: grinding grade, chips, scratches and metal contact. Partial shading, heating outlets or dark films widen the temperature difference between the centre and edge of a pane and create edge tension; untoughened glass or damaged edges are most prone to thermal breakage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality" is correct?
options: 玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。
熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。
玻璃破裂幾乎都從邊緣或孔緣開始，因此現場檢查的重點是邊緣：研磨等級、崩邊、刮傷與接觸金屬。
optionsEn: Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact.
Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously.
Glass breakage almost always starts at an edge or hole, so site inspection concentrates on edges: grinding grade, chips, scratches and metal contact.
quiz.explanation: 玻璃破裂幾乎都從邊緣或孔緣開始，因此現場檢查的重點是邊緣：研磨等級、崩邊、刮傷與接觸金屬。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Glass breakage almost always starts at an edge or hole, so site inspection concentrates on edges: grinding grade, chips, scratches and metal contact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「玻璃邊緣品質與熱應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Glass edge quality and thermal stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱應力 σ ≈ E·α·ΔT。E = 70,000 MPa、α = 9×10⁻⁶ /K、中央與遮陰邊緣溫差 ΔT = 30 K：σ ≈ 70,000×9×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 18.9 MPa，已接近未強化玻璃受損邊緣的允許應力；若 ΔT 增為 40 K，σ ≈ 25.2 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal stress σ ≈ E·α·ΔT. With E = 70,000 MPa, α = 9×10⁻⁶ /K and a 30 K difference between the sunlit centre and shaded edge: σ ≈ 70,000×9×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 18.9 MPa, close to the allowable stress of a damaged annealed edge; with ΔT = 40 K, σ ≈ 25.2 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每片玻璃進場與安裝後以目視與放大鏡檢查邊緣，記錄崩邊大小與位置並對照允收標準；以熱應力分析檢查遮陽、暖氣與貼膜配置；強化玻璃以偏光片抽查應力分布，光學品質依合約約定的觀看距離與角度判定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect every pane's edges visually and with a magnifier on arrival and after installation, recording chip size and position against the acceptance standard; check shading, heating and film layouts with a thermal-stress analysis; spot-check toughened glass with polarising filters, and judge optical quality at the viewing distance and angle stated in the contract.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱應力 σ ≈ E·α·ΔT。E = 70,000 MPa、α = 9×10⁻⁶ /K、中央與遮陰邊緣溫差 ΔT = 30 K：σ ≈ 70,000×9×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 18.9 MPa，已接近未強化玻璃受損邊緣的允許應力；若 ΔT 增為 40 K，σ ≈ 25.2 MPa。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal stress σ ≈ E·α·ΔT. With E = 70,000 MPa, α = 9×10⁻⁶ /K and a 30 K difference between the sunlit centre and shaded edge: σ ≈ 70,000×9×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 18.9 MPa, close to the allowable stress of a damaged annealed edge; with ΔT = 40 K, σ ≈ 25.2 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality", which statement holds?
options: 熱應力 σ ≈ E·α·ΔT。
全玻璃立面的玻璃肋只是裝飾，風壓主要由面玻璃自己承受。
膠合玻璃的強度永遠等於同總厚度的單片玻璃。
optionsEn: Thermal stress σ ≈ E·α·ΔT.
Glass fins in an all-glass façade are decorative; the face glass carries the wind by itself.
A laminated pane is always as strong and stiff as a monolithic pane of the same total thickness.
quiz.explanation: 熱應力 σ ≈ E·α·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal stress σ ≈ E·α·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「玻璃邊緣品質與熱應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Glass edge quality and thermal stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每片玻璃進場與安裝後以目視與放大鏡檢查邊緣，記錄崩邊大小與位置並對照允收標準；以熱應力分析檢查遮陽、暖氣與貼膜配置；強化玻璃以偏光片抽查應力分布，光學品質依合約約定的觀看距離與角度判定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect every pane's edges visually and with a magnifier on arrival and after installation, recording chip size and position against the acceptance standard; check shading, heating and film layouts with a thermal-stress analysis; spot-check toughened glass with polarising filters, and judge optical quality at the viewing distance and angle stated in the contract. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：竣工文件要列出禁止事項（例如未經評估不得貼膜、不得在玻璃附近加裝出風口），並規定玻璃清潔與維修時使用不傷邊緣的工具；所有崩邊紀錄與更換紀錄都要納入維護資料庫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Completion documents must list prohibitions, such as no films and no new air outlets near the glass without assessment, and require cleaning and maintenance tools that cannot damage edges; all chip and replacement records go into the maintenance database.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：安裝時被金屬工具碰出的小崩邊未被記錄，冬季清晨室內暖氣直吹玻璃下緣、上半部仍冰冷，溫差使邊緣拉應力超過受損邊緣強度而破裂；業主事後貼深色隔熱膜也可能讓原本安全的玻璃熱裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small chip from a metal tool during installation goes unrecorded, then on a winter morning heating blows on the lower edge while the upper part is still cold and the edge tension exceeds the damaged edge's strength; a dark solar film added later by the owner can also crack glass that was originally safe. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「玻璃邊緣品質與熱應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Glass edge quality and thermal stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 安裝時被金屬工具碰出的小崩邊未被記錄，冬季清晨室內暖氣直吹玻璃下緣、上半部仍冰冷，溫差使邊緣拉應力超過受損邊緣強度而破裂；業主事後貼深色隔熱膜也可能讓原本安全的玻璃熱裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A small chip from a metal tool during installation goes unrecorded, then on a winter morning heating blows on the lower edge while the upper part is still cold and the edge tension exceeds the damaged edge's strength; a dark solar film added later by the owner can also crack glass that was originally safe. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：強化玻璃還要檢查應力分布是否均勻（以偏光觀察）與輥筒波紋等光學缺陷，後者雖不影響安全，卻常是業主驗收爭議的來源。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Toughened glass is also checked for uniform stress distribution by polarised viewing and for optical defects such as roller wave, which do not affect safety but often cause acceptance disputes with the owner.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久」與「更換計畫、簡化接合與竣工交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability" and "Replacement planning, simplified joints and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「硫化鎳自爆風險」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nickel-sulphide breakage risk” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 強化玻璃內若含硫化鎳雜質，雜質在常溫下會緩慢相變並體積膨脹，數年後可能讓玻璃在沒有外力的情況下突然破裂，這就是自爆。熱浸處理（如 EN 14179）把強化後的玻璃加熱並保持一段時間，讓含雜質的玻璃在工廠先破，以降低現場自爆機率，但無法完全消除。玻璃肋若為強化玻璃，自爆一片就要靠其餘玻璃與中間膜承擔；長期而言，中間膜邊緣受潮脫層、矽利康老化與金屬件腐蝕也會削弱接合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「硫化鎳自爆風險」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: If toughened glass contains a nickel-sulphide inclusion, the inclusion slowly changes phase and expands at ambient temperature, and years later the glass may shatter with no external load, which is spontaneous breakage. Heat soaking, for example to EN 14179, reheats toughened glass and holds it at temperature so that affected panes break in the factory, reducing but not eliminating the site risk. In a toughened-glass fin one broken ply must be carried by the remaining plies and interlayer; in the long term, moisture delamination at interlayer edges, silicone ageing and corrosion of fittings also weaken the joints. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Nickel-sulphide breakage risk” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若每片未熱浸強化玻璃的使用期自爆機率取 p = 0.1%，120 片中至少一片自爆的機率 = 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%；熱浸處理使 p 降為 0.01% 時，機率約 1.2%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If each non-heat-soaked toughened pane has a lifetime spontaneous-breakage probability p = 0.1%, the chance that at least one of 120 panes breaks is 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%; if heat soaking lowers p to 0.01%, the chance is about 1.2%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「硫化鎳自爆風險」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Nickel-sulphide breakage risk”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久
knowledge.titleEn: Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability
knowledge.text: 強化玻璃內若含硫化鎳雜質，雜質在常溫下會緩慢相變並體積膨脹，數年後可能讓玻璃在沒有外力的情況下突然破裂，這就是自爆。熱浸處理（如 EN 14179）把強化後的玻璃加熱並保持一段時間，讓含雜質的玻璃在工廠先破，以降低現場自爆機率，但無法完全消除。
knowledge.textEn: If toughened glass contains a nickel-sulphide inclusion, the inclusion slowly changes phase and expands at ambient temperature, and years later the glass may shatter with no external load, which is spontaneous breakage. Heat soaking, for example to EN 14179, reheats toughened glass and holds it at temperature so that affected panes break in the factory, reducing but not eliminating the site risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability" is correct?
options: 強化玻璃內若含硫化鎳雜質，雜質在常溫下會緩慢相變並體積膨脹，數年後可能讓玻璃在沒有外力的情況下突然破裂，這就是自爆。
熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。
玻璃結構完工後不會再更換，因此不必保留吊點與運輸路徑。
optionsEn: If toughened glass contains a nickel-sulphide inclusion, the inclusion slowly changes phase and expands at ambient temperature, and years later the glass may shatter with no external load, which is spontaneous breakage.
Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously.
A glass structure will never be replaced, so pick points and access routes need not be kept.
quiz.explanation: 強化玻璃內若含硫化鎳雜質，雜質在常溫下會緩慢相變並體積膨脹，數年後可能讓玻璃在沒有外力的情況下突然破裂，這就是自爆。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: If toughened glass contains a nickel-sulphide inclusion, the inclusion slowly changes phase and expands at ambient temperature, and years later the glass may shatter with no external load, which is spontaneous breakage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「硫化鎳自爆風險」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nickel-sulphide breakage risk” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若每片未熱浸強化玻璃的使用期自爆機率取 p = 0.1%，120 片中至少一片自爆的機率 = 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%；熱浸處理使 p 降為 0.01% 時，機率約 1.2%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何產品或標準的統計值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If each non-heat-soaked toughened pane has a lifetime spontaneous-breakage probability p = 0.1%, the chance that at least one of 120 panes breaks is 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%; if heat soaking lowers p to 0.01%, the chance is about 1.2%. Values are teaching assumptions, not statistics for any product or standard. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：要求玻璃廠提交每批熱浸處理的爐溫紀錄與保溫時間，並在玻璃上留可追溯的標記；使用期定期檢查玻璃肋的破裂、中間膜邊緣脫層與白化、矽利康硬化或龜裂、金屬件鏽蝕與螺栓鬆動，以照片與量測結果和竣工基準比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Require furnace temperature records and dwell times for every heat-soak batch and traceable marks on each pane; in service inspect fins periodically for breakage, interlayer edge delamination and clouding, silicone hardening or cracking, corrosion of fittings and loose bolts, comparing photographs and measurements with the completion baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若每片未熱浸強化玻璃的使用期自爆機率取 p = 0.1%，120 片中至少一片自爆的機率 = 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%；熱浸處理使 p 降為 0.01% 時，機率約 1.2%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何產品或標準的統計值。
knowledge.textEn: If each non-heat-soaked toughened pane has a lifetime spontaneous-breakage probability p = 0.1%, the chance that at least one of 120 panes breaks is 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%; if heat soaking lowers p to 0.01%, the chance is about 1.2%. Values are teaching assumptions, not statistics for any product or standard.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability", which statement holds?
options: 玻璃肋只要彎曲應力低於玻璃強度，就不會失效。
若每片未熱浸強化玻璃的使用期自爆機率取 p = 0.1%，120 片中至少一片自爆的機率 = 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%。
結構矽利康越厚、塗得越多，接合就越安全。
optionsEn: A glass fin cannot fail as long as its bending stress is below the strength of glass.
If each non-heat-soaked toughened pane has a lifetime spontaneous-breakage probability p = 0.1%, the chance that at least one of 120 panes breaks is 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%.
The thicker and more generous the structural silicone, the safer the joint.
quiz.explanation: 若每片未熱浸強化玻璃的使用期自爆機率取 p = 0.1%，120 片中至少一片自爆的機率 = 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%；熱浸處理使 p 降為 0.01% 時，機率約 1.2%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If each non-heat-soaked toughened pane has a lifetime spontaneous-breakage probability p = 0.1%, the chance that at least one of 120 panes breaks is 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%; if heat soaking lowers p to 0.01%, the chance is about 1.2%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「硫化鎳自爆風險」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Nickel-sulphide breakage risk” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 要求玻璃廠提交每批熱浸處理的爐溫紀錄與保溫時間，並在玻璃上留可追溯的標記；使用期定期檢查玻璃肋的破裂、中間膜邊緣脫層與白化、矽利康硬化或龜裂、金屬件鏽蝕與螺栓鬆動，以照片與量測結果和竣工基準比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Require furnace temperature records and dwell times for every heat-soak batch and traceable marks on each pane; in service inspect fins periodically for breakage, interlayer edge delamination and clouding, silicone hardening or cracking, corrosion of fittings and loose bolts, comparing photographs and measurements with the completion baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構玻璃肋至少應採多片膠合並以一片破裂作為設計情境，外層用半強化或熱浸強化玻璃；維護手冊要寫明破裂後的緊急隔離範圍、臨時支撐方式與更換程序，並由帷幕牆工程師判定是否可繼續開放使用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Structural fins should be multi-ply laminates designed for the one-ply-broken case, with heat-strengthened or heat-soaked toughened outer plies; the maintenance manual must state the emergency exclusion zone, temporary support and replacement procedure after breakage, with the façade engineer deciding whether the area can stay open.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：結構玻璃肋全部採用未熱浸的強化玻璃且未考慮一片破裂的殘餘承載，一次自爆就可能讓整支肋失去承載，面玻璃隨之鬆脫；中間膜邊緣長期浸水造成脫層，耦合降低而增加挫屈風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using non-heat-soaked toughened glass throughout the fins without checking residual capacity after one ply breaks means a single spontaneous breakage can disable a whole fin and release the face glass; long-term water at interlayer edges causes delamination, reducing coupling and increasing buckling risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 要求玻璃廠提交每批熱浸處理的爐溫紀錄與保溫時間，並在玻璃上留可追溯的標記；使用期定期檢查玻璃肋的破裂、中間膜邊緣脫層與白化、矽利康硬化或龜裂、金屬件鏽蝕與螺栓鬆動，以照片與量測結果和竣工基準比較。
knowledge.textEn: Require furnace temperature records and dwell times for every heat-soak batch and traceable marks on each pane; in service inspect fins periodically for breakage, interlayer edge delamination and clouding, silicone hardening or cracking, corrosion of fittings and loose bolts, comparing photographs and measurements with the completion baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構玻璃肋至少應採多片膠合並以一片破裂作為設計情境，外層用半強化或熱浸強化玻璃；維護手冊要寫明破裂後的緊急隔離範圍、臨時支撐方式與更換程序，並由帷幕牆工程師判定是否可繼續開放使用。
knowledge.textEn: Structural fins should be multi-ply laminates designed for the one-ply-broken case, with heat-strengthened or heat-soaked toughened outer plies; the maintenance manual must state the emergency exclusion zone, temporary support and replacement procedure after breakage, with the façade engineer deciding whether the area can stay open.

quiz.question: 要驗證「自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
玻璃肋上下兩端都固定得越牢，立面就越穩定。
要求玻璃廠提交每批熱浸處理的爐溫紀錄與保溫時間，並在玻璃上留可追溯的標記。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade.
Require furnace temperature records and dwell times for every heat-soak batch and traceable marks on each pane.
quiz.explanation: 要求玻璃廠提交每批熱浸處理的爐溫紀錄與保溫時間，並在玻璃上留可追溯的標記；使用期定期檢查玻璃肋的破裂、中間膜邊緣脫層與白化、矽利康硬化或龜裂、金屬件鏽蝕與螺栓鬆動，以照片與量測結果和竣工基準比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Require furnace temperature records and dwell times for every heat-soak batch and traceable marks on each pane; in service inspect fins periodically for breakage, interlayer edge delamination and clouding, silicone hardening or cracking, corrosion of fittings and loose bolts, comparing photographs and measurements with the completion baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「硫化鎳自爆風險」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Nickel-sulphide breakage risk” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 結構玻璃肋全部採用未熱浸的強化玻璃且未考慮一片破裂的殘餘承載，一次自爆就可能讓整支肋失去承載，面玻璃隨之鬆脫；中間膜邊緣長期浸水造成脫層，耦合降低而增加挫屈風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using non-heat-soaked toughened glass throughout the fins without checking residual capacity after one ply breaks means a single spontaneous breakage can disable a whole fin and release the face glass; long-term water at interlayer edges causes delamination, reducing coupling and increasing buckling risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：玻璃肋若為強化玻璃，自爆一片就要靠其餘玻璃與中間膜承擔；長期而言，中間膜邊緣受潮脫層、矽利康老化與金屬件腐蝕也會削弱接合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In a toughened-glass fin one broken ply must be carried by the remaining plies and interlayer; in the long term, moisture delamination at interlayer edges, silicone ageing and corrosion of fittings also weaken the joints.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 結構玻璃肋全部採用未熱浸的強化玻璃且未考慮一片破裂的殘餘承載，一次自爆就可能讓整支肋失去承載，面玻璃隨之鬆脫；中間膜邊緣長期浸水造成脫層，耦合降低而增加挫屈風險。
knowledge.textEn: Using non-heat-soaked toughened glass throughout the fins without checking residual capacity after one ply breaks means a single spontaneous breakage can disable a whole fin and release the face glass; long-term water at interlayer edges causes delamination, reducing coupling and increasing buckling risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 結構玻璃肋全部採用未熱浸的強化玻璃且未考慮一片破裂的殘餘承載，一次自爆就可能讓整支肋失去承載，面玻璃隨之鬆脫。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
玻璃結構完工後不會再更換，因此不必保留吊點與運輸路徑。
optionsEn: Using non-heat-soaked toughened glass throughout the fins without checking residual capacity after one ply breaks means a single spontaneous breakage can disable a whole fin and release the face glass.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A glass structure will never be replaced, so pick points and access routes need not be kept.
quiz.explanation: 結構玻璃肋全部採用未熱浸的強化玻璃且未考慮一片破裂的殘餘承載，一次自爆就可能讓整支肋失去承載，面玻璃隨之鬆脫；中間膜邊緣長期浸水造成脫層，耦合降低而增加挫屈風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using non-heat-soaked toughened glass throughout the fins without checking residual capacity after one ply breaks means a single spontaneous breakage can disable a whole fin and release the face glass; long-term water at interlayer edges causes delamination, reducing coupling and increasing buckling risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 更換計畫、簡化接合與竣工交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Replacement planning, simplified joints and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「更換路徑與竣工紀錄」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Replacement route and records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大型玻璃肋的設計壽命可達數十年，但必須預期至少一次更換：自爆、撞擊或改裝都可能需要拆下單支肋或單片面玻璃。更換時玻璃肋是結構構件，拆除前需臨時支撐面玻璃並傳遞風壓，因此設計時就要預留吊點、運輸路徑與替換玻璃的尺寸限制。紐約第五大道蘋果直營店的玻璃立方體在 2011 年改建時，以更少、更大的玻璃單元與更少的接合件取代原版，正說明減少接合數量能同時降低維護與更換的工作量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「更換路徑與竣工紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large fins can have a design life of decades, but at least one replacement must be expected: spontaneous breakage, impact or alteration may require a single fin or face pane to come out. Because the fin is structural, the face glass must be temporarily supported and its wind load carried before removal, so pick points, access routes and replacement-size limits must be planned in the design. When the glass cube at Apple Fifth Avenue in New York was rebuilt in 2011, fewer and larger glass units with fewer fixings replaced the original, showing how reducing the number of joints also cuts maintenance and replacement work. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Replacement route and records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：第五大道蘋果直營店玻璃立方體：2006 年版 164 片玻璃單元、250 個主要接合件；2011 年版 15 片玻璃單元、40 個接合件。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Apple Fifth Avenue glass cube: the 2006 version had 164 glass units and 250 primary fixings; the 2011 version had 15 units and 40 fixings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻璃結構完工後不會再更換，因此不必保留吊點與運輸路徑。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A glass structure will never be replaced, so pick points and access routes need not be kept." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「更換路徑與竣工紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Replacement route and records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 更換計畫、簡化接合與竣工交接
knowledge.titleEn: Replacement planning, simplified joints and handover
knowledge.text: 大型玻璃肋的設計壽命可達數十年，但必須預期至少一次更換：自爆、撞擊或改裝都可能需要拆下單支肋或單片面玻璃。更換時玻璃肋是結構構件，拆除前需臨時支撐面玻璃並傳遞風壓，因此設計時就要預留吊點、運輸路徑與替換玻璃的尺寸限制。
knowledge.textEn: Large fins can have a design life of decades, but at least one replacement must be expected: spontaneous breakage, impact or alteration may require a single fin or face pane to come out. Because the fin is structural, the face glass must be temporarily supported and its wind load carried before removal, so pick points, access routes and replacement-size limits must be planned in the design.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：玻璃結構完工後不會再更換，因此不必保留吊點與運輸路徑。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A glass structure will never be replaced, so pick points and access routes need not be kept. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「更換計畫、簡化接合與竣工交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Replacement planning, simplified joints and handover" is correct?
options: 玻璃結構完工後不會再更換，因此不必保留吊點與運輸路徑。
大型玻璃肋的設計壽命可達數十年，但必須預期至少一次更換：自爆、撞擊或改裝都可能需要拆下單支肋或單片面玻璃。
全玻璃立面的玻璃肋只是裝飾，風壓主要由面玻璃自己承受。
optionsEn: A glass structure will never be replaced, so pick points and access routes need not be kept.
Large fins can have a design life of decades, but at least one replacement must be expected: spontaneous breakage, impact or alteration may require a single fin or face pane to come out.
Glass fins in an all-glass façade are decorative; the face glass carries the wind by itself.
quiz.explanation: 大型玻璃肋的設計壽命可達數十年，但必須預期至少一次更換：自爆、撞擊或改裝都可能需要拆下單支肋或單片面玻璃。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Large fins can have a design life of decades, but at least one replacement must be expected: spontaneous breakage, impact or alteration may require a single fin or face pane to come out. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 更換計畫、簡化接合與竣工交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Replacement planning, simplified joints and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「更換路徑與竣工紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Replacement route and records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：第五大道蘋果直營店玻璃立方體：2006 年版 164 片玻璃單元、250 個主要接合件；2011 年版 15 片玻璃單元、40 個接合件。接合件減少 (250 − 40)/250 = 84%，玻璃單元減少 (164 − 15)/164 ≈ 91%。若每個接合件年檢 0.5 小時，年檢工時由 125 小時降為 20 小時。檢查工時為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Apple Fifth Avenue glass cube: the 2006 version had 164 glass units and 250 primary fixings; the 2011 version had 15 units and 40 fixings. Fixings fell by (250 − 40)/250 = 84% and glass units by (164 − 15)/164 ≈ 91%. At 0.5 hours of annual inspection per fixing, annual inspection drops from 125 to 20 hours. The inspection hours are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前以實際演練或詳細程序書確認單支玻璃肋可被更換：臨時支撐方式、吊點、吊具與運輸路徑尺寸、替換玻璃的交期；竣工資料要包含逐片玻璃的規格、熱浸紀錄、中間膜批號、試驗報告與安裝量測紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover confirm by trial or detailed method statement that a single fin can be replaced: temporary support, pick points, lifting gear, access-route dimensions and replacement-glass lead time; completion records must include each pane's specification, heat-soak record, interlayer batch, test reports and installation survey.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 第五大道蘋果直營店玻璃立方體：2006 年版 164 片玻璃單元、250 個主要接合件；2011 年版 15 片玻璃單元、40 個接合件。接合件減少 (250 − 40)/250 = 84%，玻璃單元減少 (164 − 15)/164 ≈ 91%。若每個接合件年檢 0.5 小時，年檢工時由 125 小時降為 20 小時。檢查工時為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Apple Fifth Avenue glass cube: the 2006 version had 164 glass units and 250 primary fixings; the 2011 version had 15 units and 40 fixings. Fixings fell by (250 − 40)/250 = 84% and glass units by (164 − 15)/164 ≈ 91%. At 0.5 hours of annual inspection per fixing, annual inspection drops from 125 to 20 hours. The inspection hours are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「更換計畫、簡化接合與竣工交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Replacement planning, simplified joints and handover", which statement holds?
options: 膠合玻璃的強度永遠等於同總厚度的單片玻璃。
玻璃肋在使用期的受力最大，吊裝過程的應力可以忽略。
第五大道蘋果直營店玻璃立方體：2006 年版 164 片玻璃單元、250 個主要接合件；2011 年版 15 片玻璃單元、40 個接合件。
optionsEn: A laminated pane is always as strong and stiff as a monolithic pane of the same total thickness.
A glass fin sees its highest stresses in service, so handling stresses can be ignored.
Apple Fifth Avenue glass cube: the 2006 version had 164 glass units and 250 primary fixings; the 2011 version had 15 units and 40 fixings.
quiz.explanation: 第五大道蘋果直營店玻璃立方體：2006 年版 164 片玻璃單元、250 個主要接合件；2011 年版 15 片玻璃單元、40 個接合件。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Apple Fifth Avenue glass cube: the 2006 version had 164 glass units and 250 primary fixings; the 2011 version had 15 units and 40 fixings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 更換計畫、簡化接合與竣工交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Replacement planning, simplified joints and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「更換路徑與竣工紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Replacement route and records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前以實際演練或詳細程序書確認單支玻璃肋可被更換：臨時支撐方式、吊點、吊具與運輸路徑尺寸、替換玻璃的交期；竣工資料要包含逐片玻璃的規格、熱浸紀錄、中間膜批號、試驗報告與安裝量測紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover confirm by trial or detailed method statement that a single fin can be replaced: temporary support, pick points, lifting gear, access-route dimensions and replacement-glass lead time; completion records must include each pane's specification, heat-soak record, interlayer batch, test reports and installation survey. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含更換程序、臨時支撐設計、緊急隔離範圍、備品清單與玻璃供應商資訊；任何周邊改建或內裝變更若影響吊裝路徑，須經帷幕牆顧問評估並由業主核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover must include the replacement procedure, temporary-support design, emergency exclusion zone, spares list and glass supplier details; any surrounding alteration or fit-out that affects the lifting route needs assessment by the façade consultant and the owner's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：設計時沒有考慮更換路徑，完工後周邊加建或室內裝修封住運輸動線，一片十公尺以上的玻璃破裂後無法運入，只能長期以臨時板封閉；缺少逐片紀錄也使業主無法向供應商追查同批玻璃的風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a planned replacement route, later surrounding construction or fit-out blocks the access, so a broken pane over ten metres long cannot be brought in and the opening stays boarded for a long time; without pane-by-pane records the owner cannot trace the risk of other panes from the same batch. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前以實際演練或詳細程序書確認單支玻璃肋可被更換：臨時支撐方式、吊點、吊具與運輸路徑尺寸、替換玻璃的交期；竣工資料要包含逐片玻璃的規格、熱浸紀錄、中間膜批號、試驗報告與安裝量測紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover confirm by trial or detailed method statement that a single fin can be replaced: temporary support, pick points, lifting gear, access-route dimensions and replacement-glass lead time; completion records must include each pane's specification, heat-soak record, interlayer batch, test reports and installation survey.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含更換程序、臨時支撐設計、緊急隔離範圍、備品清單與玻璃供應商資訊；任何周邊改建或內裝變更若影響吊裝路徑，須經帷幕牆顧問評估並由業主核准。
knowledge.textEn: Handover must include the replacement procedure, temporary-support design, emergency exclusion zone, spares list and glass supplier details; any surrounding alteration or fit-out that affects the lifting route needs assessment by the façade consultant and the owner's approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「更換計畫、簡化接合與竣工交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Replacement planning, simplified joints and handover"?
options: 交接前以實際演練或詳細程序書確認單支玻璃肋可被更換：臨時支撐方式、吊點、吊具與運輸路徑尺寸、替換玻璃的交期。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。
optionsEn: Before handover confirm by trial or detailed method statement that a single fin can be replaced: temporary support, pick points, lifting gear, access-route dimensions and replacement-glass lead time.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing.
quiz.explanation: 交接前以實際演練或詳細程序書確認單支玻璃肋可被更換：臨時支撐方式、吊點、吊具與運輸路徑尺寸、替換玻璃的交期；竣工資料要包含逐片玻璃的規格、熱浸紀錄、中間膜批號、試驗報告與安裝量測紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover confirm by trial or detailed method statement that a single fin can be replaced: temporary support, pick points, lifting gear, access-route dimensions and replacement-glass lead time; completion records must include each pane's specification, heat-soak record, interlayer batch, test reports and installation survey. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 更換計畫、簡化接合與竣工交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Replacement planning, simplified joints and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「更換路徑與竣工紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Replacement route and records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 設計時沒有考慮更換路徑，完工後周邊加建或室內裝修封住運輸動線，一片十公尺以上的玻璃破裂後無法運入，只能長期以臨時板封閉；缺少逐片紀錄也使業主無法向供應商追查同批玻璃的風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a planned replacement route, later surrounding construction or fit-out blocks the access, so a broken pane over ten metres long cannot be brought in and the opening stays boarded for a long time; without pane-by-pane records the owner cannot trace the risk of other panes from the same batch. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：紐約第五大道蘋果直營店的玻璃立方體在 2011 年改建時，以更少、更大的玻璃單元與更少的接合件取代原版，正說明減少接合數量能同時降低維護與更換的工作量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When the glass cube at Apple Fifth Avenue in New York was rebuilt in 2011, fewer and larger glass units with fewer fixings replaced the original, showing how reducing the number of joints also cuts maintenance and replacement work.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻璃結構完工後不會再更換，因此不必保留吊點與運輸路徑。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A glass structure will never be replaced, so pick points and access routes need not be kept." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 設計時沒有考慮更換路徑，完工後周邊加建或室內裝修封住運輸動線，一片十公尺以上的玻璃破裂後無法運入，只能長期以臨時板封閉；缺少逐片紀錄也使業主無法向供應商追查同批玻璃的風險。
knowledge.textEn: Without a planned replacement route, later surrounding construction or fit-out blocks the access, so a broken pane over ten metres long cannot be brought in and the opening stays boarded for a long time; without pane-by-pane records the owner cannot trace the risk of other panes from the same batch.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「更換計畫、簡化接合與竣工交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Replacement planning, simplified joints and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
設計時沒有考慮更換路徑，完工後周邊加建或室內裝修封住運輸動線，一片十公尺以上的玻璃破裂後無法運入，只能長期以臨時板封閉。
全玻璃立面的玻璃肋只是裝飾，風壓主要由面玻璃自己承受。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

Without a planned replacement route, later surrounding construction or fit-out blocks the access, so a broken pane over ten metres long cannot be brought in and the opening stays boarded for a long time.
Glass fins in an all-glass façade are decorative; the face glass carries the wind by itself.
quiz.explanation: 設計時沒有考慮更換路徑，完工後周邊加建或室內裝修封住運輸動線，一片十公尺以上的玻璃破裂後無法運入，只能長期以臨時板封閉；缺少逐片紀錄也使業主無法向供應商追查同批玻璃的風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without a planned replacement route, later surrounding construction or fit-out blocks the access, so a broken pane over ten metres long cannot be brought in and the opening stays boarded for a long time; without pane-by-pane records the owner cannot trace the risk of other panes from the same batch. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 單元式帷幕牆安裝
summary: 從單元板塊的風壓與自重傳遞路徑出發，計算錨件反力、樓板撓度與層間變位對上下單元接縫的需求，說明公母豎框、預埋槽與三向調整錨件的設計，再處理樓層吊運、安裝順序、公差吸收與性能樣品牆的層間位移試驗，最後以斷熱、排水、結露與維護更換完成交接，並以哈里發塔、世界貿易中心一號大樓與碎片大廈的公開資料說明超高層立面的尺度。
summaryEn: Starting from how wind and self-weight travel through a unit, calculate anchor reactions and the demands that slab deflection and interstorey drift place on the stack joint, explain split mullions, cast-in channels and three-way adjustable brackets, then cover floor-by-floor logistics, installation sequence, tolerance absorption and racking tests on the performance mock-up, and close with thermal breaks, drainage, condensation and maintenance, using public information on Burj Khalifa, One World Trade Center and The Shard to show the scale of supertall façades.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 60 層辦公塔標準層周長 120 m、層高 4.2 m，採 1.5 m 寬單元，標準區設計風壓 3.0 kPa、角隅區 4.5 kPa。每層 120/1.5 = 80 片，共 4,800 片。標準區每單元風力 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN，每錨件 9.45 kN；角隅區為 4.5×1.5×4.2 = 28.35 kN，每錨件約 14.2 kN，乘 1.5 為 21.3 kN。豎框：標準區 w = 4.5 kN/m，L/175 = 24 mm 需 I ≥ 1.09×10⁷ mm⁴；角隅區 w = 6.75 kN/m，需 I 按比例增為約 1.63×10⁷ mm⁴，即增加 50%。接縫變位預算 18.8 mm，設計 ±20 mm；層間位移試驗 1.5×21 = 31.5 mm。公差組合 √(25² + 10² + 5²) ≈ 27.4 mm，在 ±30 mm 調整量內。若安裝速率每日 40 片，約 120 個工作天。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 60-storey office tower has a 120 m typical-floor perimeter and 4.2 m storeys, using 1.5 m units with design pressures of 3.0 kPa in typical zones and 4.5 kPa at corners. Each floor needs 120/1.5 = 80 units, 4,800 in total. A typical unit takes 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN of wind, 9.45 kN per anchor; a corner unit takes 4.5×1.5×4.2 = 28.35 kN, about 14.2 kN per anchor or 21.3 kN with a 1.5 factor. Mullions: in typical zones w = 4.5 kN/m and L/175 = 24 mm requires I ≥ 1.09×10⁷ mm⁴; at corners w = 6.75 kN/m, so I rises proportionally to about 1.63×10⁷ mm⁴, 50% more. The stack-joint movement budget is 18.8 mm, designed as ±20 mm, and the racking test uses 1.5×21 = 31.5 mm. Combined tolerance √(25² + 10² + 5²) ≈ 27.4 mm lies within the ±30 mm adjustment. At 40 units per day installation takes about 120 working days. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力」與「層間變位、樓板撓度與上下單元接縫」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Unit load path and anchor reactions" and "Interstorey drift, slab deflection and the stack joint": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Unit load path and anchor reactions: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樓板邊緣錨件反力」如何影響單元式帷幕牆安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slab-edge anchor reaction” governs force, deformation or durability in “Unitized curtain-wall installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 單元式帷幕牆把玻璃、鋁框、層間板與密封在工廠組成一層樓高、一個模數寬的板塊，現場只需掛上錨件並與相鄰單元插接。風壓由玻璃傳到豎框，豎框像跨越一層樓的簡支梁，上端反力經錨件進入樓板邊緣，下端反力經上下單元接縫傳給下一個單元的頂部，再由同一組錨件承受。自重則由每層錨件直接吊掛，並因板塊外移於樓板邊緣而產生偏心彎矩。設計時必須把每一層錨件的水平與垂直反力交給主結構設計者，納入樓板邊緣與邊梁的設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樓板邊緣錨件反力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A unitized curtain wall assembles glass, aluminium framing, spandrel panels and seals in the factory into panels one storey high and one module wide, so on site each unit only needs to be hooked onto its anchors and interlocked with its neighbours. Wind passes from the glass to the mullions, which act as simple beams spanning one storey: the top reaction goes through the anchor into the slab edge, while the bottom reaction passes through the stack joint into the head of the unit below and on to the same anchors. Self-weight hangs directly from each floor's anchors and, because the unit sits outboard of the slab edge, creates an eccentric moment. Each floor's horizontal and vertical anchor reactions must be handed to the structural engineer for the design of the slab edge and edge beams. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Slab-edge anchor reaction” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單元 1.5 m × 4.2 m、設計風壓 q = 3.0 kPa：每單元風力 = 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN，每層兩個錨件各約 9.45 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 1.5 m × 4.2 m unit at design pressure q = 3.0 kPa, the wind on each unit is 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN, about 9.45 kN at each of the two anchors per floor.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「帷幕牆只是外裝飾，它的荷重對主結構可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A curtain wall is just cladding, so its loads on the main structure can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樓板邊緣錨件反力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Slab-edge anchor reaction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力
knowledge.titleEn: Unit load path and anchor reactions
knowledge.text: 單元式帷幕牆把玻璃、鋁框、層間板與密封在工廠組成一層樓高、一個模數寬的板塊，現場只需掛上錨件並與相鄰單元插接。風壓由玻璃傳到豎框，豎框像跨越一層樓的簡支梁，上端反力經錨件進入樓板邊緣，下端反力經上下單元接縫傳給下一個單元的頂部，再由同一組錨件承受。
knowledge.textEn: A unitized curtain wall assembles glass, aluminium framing, spandrel panels and seals in the factory into panels one storey high and one module wide, so on site each unit only needs to be hooked onto its anchors and interlocked with its neighbours. Wind passes from the glass to the mullions, which act as simple beams spanning one storey: the top reaction goes through the anchor into the slab edge, while the bottom reaction passes through the stack joint into the head of the unit below and on to the same anchors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：帷幕牆只是外裝飾，它的荷重對主結構可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A curtain wall is just cladding, so its loads on the main structure can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Unit load path and anchor reactions" is correct?
options: 帷幕牆只是外裝飾，它的荷重對主結構可以忽略。
單元式帷幕牆把玻璃、鋁框、層間板與密封在工廠組成一層樓高、一個模數寬的板塊，現場只需掛上錨件並與相鄰單元插接。
只要密封膠夠好，上下單元接縫不需要預留變位行程。
optionsEn: A curtain wall is just cladding, so its loads on the main structure can be ignored.

A unitized curtain wall assembles glass, aluminium framing, spandrel panels and seals in the factory into panels one storey high and one module wide, so on site each unit only needs to be hooked onto its anchors and interlocked with its neighbours.
With good enough sealant, the stack joint needs no allowance for movement.
quiz.explanation: 單元式帷幕牆把玻璃、鋁框、層間板與密封在工廠組成一層樓高、一個模數寬的板塊，現場只需掛上錨件並與相鄰單元插接。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A unitized curtain wall assembles glass, aluminium framing, spandrel panels and seals in the factory into panels one storey high and one module wide, so on site each unit only needs to be hooked onto its anchors and interlocked with its neighbours. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit load path and anchor reactions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板邊緣錨件反力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slab-edge anchor reaction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單元 1.5 m × 4.2 m、設計風壓 q = 3.0 kPa：每單元風力 = 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN，每層兩個錨件各約 9.45 kN。單元面重 50 kg/m²，重 1.5×4.2×50 = 315 kg ≈ 3.09 kN；偏心 150 mm 時彎矩 ≈ 3.09×0.15 ≈ 0.46 kN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 1.5 m × 4.2 m unit at design pressure q = 3.0 kPa, the wind on each unit is 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN, about 9.45 kN at each of the two anchors per floor. At 50 kg/m² the unit weighs 1.5×4.2×50 = 315 kg ≈ 3.09 kN; with 150 mm eccentricity the moment is about 3.09×0.15 ≈ 0.46 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以帷幕牆結構計算書列出各區（一般區、角隅區、頂部）的設計風壓、單元尺寸與錨件反力表，並由主結構設計者書面確認樓板邊緣、邊梁與預埋件能承受；風壓應以風洞試驗或規範的局部外壓係數為依據，角隅區通常明顯較高。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List in the façade structural calculations the design pressure, unit size and anchor reactions for each zone (typical, corner, top), and have the structural engineer confirm in writing that slab edges, edge beams and embeds can take them; pressures should come from wind-tunnel testing or code local cladding coefficients, and corner zones are usually much higher.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單元 1.5 m × 4.2 m、設計風壓 q = 3.0 kPa：每單元風力 = 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN，每層兩個錨件各約 9.45 kN。單元面重 50 kg/m²，重 1.5×4.2×50 = 315 kg ≈ 3.09 kN；偏心 150 mm 時彎矩 ≈ 3.09×0.15 ≈ 0.46 kN·m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 1.5 m × 4.2 m unit at design pressure q = 3.0 kPa, the wind on each unit is 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN, about 9.45 kN at each of the two anchors per floor. At 50 kg/m² the unit weighs 1.5×4.2×50 = 315 kg ≈ 3.09 kN; with 150 mm eccentricity the moment is about 3.09×0.15 ≈ 0.46 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Unit load path and anchor reactions", which statement holds?
options: 錨件的調整範圍越大越好，可以吸收任何樓板誤差。
只要每一片單元都對齊下面那一片，整面帷幕牆就一定垂直。
單元 1.5 m × 4.2 m、設計風壓 q = 3.0 kPa：每單元風力 = 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN，每層兩個錨件各約 9.45 kN。
optionsEn: The bigger the bracket adjustment range, the better, since it can absorb any slab error.
If each unit lines up with the one below it, the whole wall is bound to be plumb.
For a 1.5 m × 4.2 m unit at design pressure q = 3.0 kPa, the wind on each unit is 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN, about 9.45 kN at each of the two anchors per floor.
quiz.explanation: 單元 1.5 m × 4.2 m、設計風壓 q = 3.0 kPa：每單元風力 = 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN，每層兩個錨件各約 9.45 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 1.5 m × 4.2 m unit at design pressure q = 3.0 kPa, the wind on each unit is 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN, about 9.45 kN at each of the two anchors per floor. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit load path and anchor reactions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓板邊緣錨件反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slab-edge anchor reaction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以帷幕牆結構計算書列出各區（一般區、角隅區、頂部）的設計風壓、單元尺寸與錨件反力表，並由主結構設計者書面確認樓板邊緣、邊梁與預埋件能承受；風壓應以風洞試驗或規範的局部外壓係數為依據，角隅區通常明顯較高。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List in the façade structural calculations the design pressure, unit size and anchor reactions for each zone (typical, corner, top), and have the structural engineer confirm in writing that slab edges, edge beams and embeds can take them; pressures should come from wind-tunnel testing or code local cladding coefficients, and corner zones are usually much higher. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：介面協調時以「錨件反力表」作為正式交付文件，標明荷重組合、作用點與偏心，並約定任何單元尺寸或風壓分區變更都要重新發出反力表，由結構設計者確認後才可施作預埋件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make the anchor-reaction table a formal deliverable at interface coordination, stating load combinations, points of application and eccentricities, and agree that any change of unit size or wind zone triggers a reissued table, confirmed by the structural engineer before embeds are cast.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只用一般區風壓設計全部錨件，角隅區單元在颱風中可能拉脫錨件或使豎框過度變形；未把偏心自重交給結構設計者，懸臂樓板邊緣長期下垂，上下單元接縫被擠壓而漏水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing all anchors for the typical-zone pressure lets corner units pull out their anchors or over-deflect their mullions in a typhoon; if the eccentric dead load is never passed to the structural engineer, cantilevered slab edges sag over time and squeeze the stack joints until they leak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以帷幕牆結構計算書列出各區（一般區、角隅區、頂部）的設計風壓、單元尺寸與錨件反力表，並由主結構設計者書面確認樓板邊緣、邊梁與預埋件能承受；風壓應以風洞試驗或規範的局部外壓係數為依據，角隅區通常明顯較高。
knowledge.textEn: List in the façade structural calculations the design pressure, unit size and anchor reactions for each zone (typical, corner, top), and have the structural engineer confirm in writing that slab edges, edge beams and embeds can take them; pressures should come from wind-tunnel testing or code local cladding coefficients, and corner zones are usually much higher.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 介面協調時以「錨件反力表」作為正式交付文件，標明荷重組合、作用點與偏心，並約定任何單元尺寸或風壓分區變更都要重新發出反力表，由結構設計者確認後才可施作預埋件。
knowledge.textEn: Make the anchor-reaction table a formal deliverable at interface coordination, stating load combinations, points of application and eccentricities, and agree that any change of unit size or wind zone triggers a reissued table, confirmed by the structural engineer before embeds are cast.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Unit load path and anchor reactions"?
options: 以帷幕牆結構計算書列出各區（一般區、角隅區、頂部）的設計風壓、單元尺寸與錨件反力表，並由主結構設計者書面確認樓板邊緣、邊梁與預埋件能承受。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
錨件螺栓只要鎖緊，扭力值高低並不重要。
optionsEn: List in the façade structural calculations the design pressure, unit size and anchor reactions for each zone (typical, corner, top), and have the structural engineer confirm in writing that slab edges, edge beams and embeds can take them.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
As long as bracket bolts are tight, the torque value does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 以帷幕牆結構計算書列出各區（一般區、角隅區、頂部）的設計風壓、單元尺寸與錨件反力表，並由主結構設計者書面確認樓板邊緣、邊梁與預埋件能承受；風壓應以風洞試驗或規範的局部外壓係數為依據，角隅區通常明顯較高。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List in the façade structural calculations the design pressure, unit size and anchor reactions for each zone (typical, corner, top), and have the structural engineer confirm in writing that slab edges, edge beams and embeds can take them; pressures should come from wind-tunnel testing or code local cladding coefficients, and corner zones are usually much higher. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Unit load path and anchor reactions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓板邊緣錨件反力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slab-edge anchor reaction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只用一般區風壓設計全部錨件，角隅區單元在颱風中可能拉脫錨件或使豎框過度變形；未把偏心自重交給結構設計者，懸臂樓板邊緣長期下垂，上下單元接縫被擠壓而漏水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing all anchors for the typical-zone pressure lets corner units pull out their anchors or over-deflect their mullions in a typhoon; if the eccentric dead load is never passed to the structural engineer, cantilevered slab edges sag over time and squeeze the stack joints until they leak. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計時必須把每一層錨件的水平與垂直反力交給主結構設計者，納入樓板邊緣與邊梁的設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each floor's horizontal and vertical anchor reactions must be handed to the structural engineer for the design of the slab edge and edge beams.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「帷幕牆只是外裝飾，它的荷重對主結構可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A curtain wall is just cladding, so its loads on the main structure can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只用一般區風壓設計全部錨件，角隅區單元在颱風中可能拉脫錨件或使豎框過度變形；未把偏心自重交給結構設計者，懸臂樓板邊緣長期下垂，上下單元接縫被擠壓而漏水。
knowledge.textEn: Designing all anchors for the typical-zone pressure lets corner units pull out their anchors or over-deflect their mullions in a typhoon; if the eccentric dead load is never passed to the structural engineer, cantilevered slab edges sag over time and squeeze the stack joints until they leak.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Unit load path and anchor reactions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只用一般區風壓設計全部錨件，角隅區單元在颱風中可能拉脫錨件或使豎框過度變形；未把偏心自重交給結構設計者，懸臂樓板邊緣長期下垂，上下單元接縫被擠壓而漏水。
只要密封膠夠好，上下單元接縫不需要預留變位行程。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Designing all anchors for the typical-zone pressure lets corner units pull out their anchors or over-deflect their mullions in a typhoon.
With good enough sealant, the stack joint needs no allowance for movement.
quiz.explanation: 若只用一般區風壓設計全部錨件，角隅區單元在颱風中可能拉脫錨件或使豎框過度變形；未把偏心自重交給結構設計者，懸臂樓板邊緣長期下垂，上下單元接縫被擠壓而漏水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing all anchors for the typical-zone pressure lets corner units pull out their anchors or over-deflect their mullions in a typhoon; if the eccentric dead load is never passed to the structural engineer, cantilevered slab edges sag over time and squeeze the stack joints until they leak. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 層間變位、樓板撓度與上下單元接縫：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Interstorey drift, slab deflection and the stack joint: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「上下單元接縫」如何影響單元式帷幕牆安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stack joint” governs force, deformation or durability in “Unitized curtain-wall installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每一層的單元在水平接縫處以公母型材互相插接，形成「上下單元接縫」。它必須同時做到防水、氣密與允許變位：樓板在活載重下撓曲、柱與核心筒長期縮短、鋁框隨溫度伸縮，都使上下單元的間距改變；地震或強風造成的層間變位則讓上下樓層水平錯動。單元式系統的優勢在於每個單元可在接縫處滑動或轉動，而不是讓玻璃本身受剪；但接縫的伸縮量若估計不足，密封條會被擠出或拉開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「上下單元接縫」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Units at each floor interlock at the horizontal joint through male and female profiles, forming the stack joint. It must be watertight and airtight while allowing movement: slab deflection under live load, long-term shortening of columns and core, and thermal movement of the aluminium all change the gap between units, and interstorey drift from earthquakes or strong wind shifts one floor sideways relative to the next. The advantage of a unitized system is that each unit can slide or rotate at the joints instead of shearing the glass; but if the joint's movement range is underestimated, the seals are squeezed out or pulled apart. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stack joint” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：垂直變位預算：樓板邊緣差異撓度 10 mm＋鋁豎框溫度伸縮 ΔL = 23×10⁻⁶×4,200×60 ≈ 5.8 mm＋柱與核心差異縮短 3 mm ≈ 18.8 mm，接縫設計行程取 ±20 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vertical movement budget: differential slab-edge deflection 10 mm + aluminium mullion thermal movement ΔL = 23×10⁻⁶×4,200×60 ≈ 5.8 mm + differential shortening of columns and core 3 mm ≈ 18.8 mm, so the joint is designed for ±20 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要密封膠夠好，上下單元接縫不需要預留變位行程。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With good enough sealant, the stack joint needs no allowance for movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「上下單元接縫」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stack joint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
