If the inner frame surface falls below the dew point of room air, winter condensation drips and keeps frames and seals wet; if sealant blocks the drainage and equalisation paths, otherwise harmless rain is trapped inside the unit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：帷幕牆漏水時，多打一層密封膠把所有縫封死就能解決。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: When a curtain wall leaks, sealing every gap with more sealant solves the problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斷熱、等壓排水與結露控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal breaks, pressure-equalised drainage and condensation" is correct?
options: 單元式帷幕牆的耐久與舒適，取決於三個看不見的系統：鋁框中的斷熱條阻斷熱橋，避免室內側框料過冷結露。
帷幕牆漏水時，多打一層密封膠把所有縫封死就能解決。
單元式帷幕牆的玻璃壞了，只要從室內拆下重裝即可，不需要外牆維護設備。
optionsEn: The durability and comfort of a unitized wall depend on three hidden systems: polyamide thermal breaks in the aluminium cut thermal bridges so inner frames do not get cold enough to condense.
When a curtain wall leaks, sealing every gap with more sealant solves the problem.
If a unitized pane breaks, it can simply be replaced from inside without any external access equipment.
quiz.explanation: 單元式帷幕牆的耐久與舒適，取決於三個看不見的系統：鋁框中的斷熱條阻斷熱橋，避免室內側框料過冷結露；外層密封與內層氣密之間的等壓腔體，讓滲入的少量雨水在壓差很小的情況下由排水孔排出；層間板背後的防火與防潮層則避免水汽在牆內凝結。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The durability and comfort of a unitized wall depend on three hidden systems: polyamide thermal breaks in the aluminium cut thermal bridges so inner frames do not get cold enough to condense; a pressure-equalised cavity between the outer seal and the inner air seal lets the small amount of water that enters drain through weep holes under a very small pressure difference; and fire and vapour layers behind spandrels stop moisture condensing inside the wall. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斷熱、等壓排水與結露控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal breaks, pressure-equalised drainage and condensation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斷熱條與內表面溫度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal break and inner surface temperature” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：內表面溫度 T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total。T_i = 21°C、T_o = −5°C、R_si = 0.13 m²K/W、框料 U = 3.0 W/m²K（R_total ≈ 0.333）：T_si = 21 − 26×0.13/0.333 ≈ 10.9°C；室內 21°C、相對濕度 50% 的露點約 10.2°C，餘裕僅約 0.7 K。U 改善為 2.0 時 T_si ≈ 14.2°C。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Inner surface temperature T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total. With T_i = 21°C, T_o = −5°C, R_si = 0.13 m²K/W and a frame U = 3.0 W/m²K (R_total ≈ 0.333): T_si = 21 − 26×0.13/0.333 ≈ 10.9°C; the dew point of room air at 21°C and 50% relative humidity is about 10.2°C, a margin of only about 0.7 K. Improving U to 2.0 gives T_si ≈ 14.2°C. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以二維熱傳模擬（如 ISO 10211 方法）計算框料內表面最低溫度與溫度係數，與室內設計溫濕度的露點比較；在樣品牆與現場檢查排水孔是否暢通、等壓腔體是否被多餘密封膠堵塞，必要時以紅外線熱像儀在冬季找出熱橋。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate the minimum inner-frame surface temperature and temperature factor with two-dimensional heat-transfer modelling, for example by ISO 10211 methods, and compare with the dew point of the indoor design condition; on the mock-up and on site check that weep holes are clear and that pressure-equalised cavities are not blocked by excess sealant, and use infrared thermography in winter to find thermal bridges where needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 內表面溫度 T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total。T_i = 21°C、T_o = −5°C、R_si = 0.13 m²K/W、框料 U = 3.0 W/m²K（R_total ≈ 0.333）：T_si = 21 − 26×0.13/0.333 ≈ 10.9°C；室內 21°C、相對濕度 50% 的露點約 10.2°C，餘裕僅約 0.7 K。U 改善為 2.0 時 T_si ≈ 14.2°C。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Inner surface temperature T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total. With T_i = 21°C, T_o = −5°C, R_si = 0.13 m²K/W and a frame U = 3.0 W/m²K (R_total ≈ 0.333): T_si = 21 − 26×0.13/0.333 ≈ 10.9°C; the dew point of room air at 21°C and 50% relative humidity is about 10.2°C, a margin of only about 0.7 K. Improving U to 2.0 gives T_si ≈ 14.2°C. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斷熱、等壓排水與結露控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal breaks, pressure-equalised drainage and condensation", which statement holds?
options: 只要密封膠夠好，上下單元接縫不需要預留變位行程。
內表面溫度 T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total。
錨件的調整範圍越大越好，可以吸收任何樓板誤差。
optionsEn: With good enough sealant, the stack joint needs no allowance for movement.
Inner surface temperature T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total.
The bigger the bracket adjustment range, the better, since it can absorb any slab error.
quiz.explanation: 內表面溫度 T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Inner surface temperature T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斷熱、等壓排水與結露控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal breaks, pressure-equalised drainage and condensation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斷熱條與內表面溫度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal break and inner surface temperature” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以二維熱傳模擬（如 ISO 10211 方法）計算框料內表面最低溫度與溫度係數，與室內設計溫濕度的露點比較；在樣品牆與現場檢查排水孔是否暢通、等壓腔體是否被多餘密封膠堵塞，必要時以紅外線熱像儀在冬季找出熱橋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate the minimum inner-frame surface temperature and temperature factor with two-dimensional heat-transfer modelling, for example by ISO 10211 methods, and compare with the dew point of the indoor design condition; on the mock-up and on site check that weep holes are clear and that pressure-equalised cavities are not blocked by excess sealant, and use infrared thermography in winter to find thermal bridges where needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工說明中標示所有不得填塞的排水孔與等壓通道，並禁止現場未經核准的補打密封；維修單位在處理漏水前，須先由帷幕牆顧問判斷水的路徑，而非直接封閉。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark on the installation drawings every weep hole and equalisation path that must stay open and prohibit unapproved site sealing; before treating a leak, maintenance staff must have the façade consultant trace the water path instead of simply sealing over it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了省成本取消斷熱條或以金屬螺絲穿過斷熱層，寒流時室內框料結露滴水，長期造成內裝發霉與密封膠脫黏；現場補打密封膠堵住排水孔，雨水在單元底部累積，最後從室內側溢出。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting thermal breaks to save cost, or driving metal screws through them, lets inner frames condense and drip in cold spells, causing mould in finishes and debonded seals over time; sealant added on site that blocks weep holes lets rainwater collect in the bottom of units until it spills indoors. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以二維熱傳模擬（如 ISO 10211 方法）計算框料內表面最低溫度與溫度係數，與室內設計溫濕度的露點比較；在樣品牆與現場檢查排水孔是否暢通、等壓腔體是否被多餘密封膠堵塞，必要時以紅外線熱像儀在冬季找出熱橋。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate the minimum inner-frame surface temperature and temperature factor with two-dimensional heat-transfer modelling, for example by ISO 10211 methods, and compare with the dew point of the indoor design condition; on the mock-up and on site check that weep holes are clear and that pressure-equalised cavities are not blocked by excess sealant, and use infrared thermography in winter to find thermal bridges where needed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工說明中標示所有不得填塞的排水孔與等壓通道，並禁止現場未經核准的補打密封；維修單位在處理漏水前，須先由帷幕牆顧問判斷水的路徑，而非直接封閉。
knowledge.textEn: Mark on the installation drawings every weep hole and equalisation path that must stay open and prohibit unapproved site sealing; before treating a leak, maintenance staff must have the façade consultant trace the water path instead of simply sealing over it.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斷熱、等壓排水與結露控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal breaks, pressure-equalised drainage and condensation"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要每一片單元都對齊下面那一片，整面帷幕牆就一定垂直。
以二維熱傳模擬（如 ISO 10211 方法）計算框料內表面最低溫度與溫度係數，與室內設計溫濕度的露點比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If each unit lines up with the one below it, the whole wall is bound to be plumb.

Calculate the minimum inner-frame surface temperature and temperature factor with two-dimensional heat-transfer modelling, for example by ISO 10211 methods, and compare with the dew point of the indoor design condition.
quiz.explanation: 以二維熱傳模擬（如 ISO 10211 方法）計算框料內表面最低溫度與溫度係數，與室內設計溫濕度的露點比較；在樣品牆與現場檢查排水孔是否暢通、等壓腔體是否被多餘密封膠堵塞，必要時以紅外線熱像儀在冬季找出熱橋。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calculate the minimum inner-frame surface temperature and temperature factor with two-dimensional heat-transfer modelling, for example by ISO 10211 methods, and compare with the dew point of the indoor design condition; on the mock-up and on site check that weep holes are clear and that pressure-equalised cavities are not blocked by excess sealant, and use infrared thermography in winter to find thermal bridges where needed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斷熱、等壓排水與結露控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal breaks, pressure-equalised drainage and condensation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斷熱條與內表面溫度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal break and inner surface temperature” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了省成本取消斷熱條或以金屬螺絲穿過斷熱層，寒流時室內框料結露滴水，長期造成內裝發霉與密封膠脫黏；現場補打密封膠堵住排水孔，雨水在單元底部累積，最後從室內側溢出。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting thermal breaks to save cost, or driving metal screws through them, lets inner frames condense and drip in cold spells, causing mould in finishes and debonded seals over time; sealant added on site that blocks weep holes lets rainwater collect in the bottom of units until it spills indoors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：等壓與排水路徑若被密封膠堵住，原本安全的雨水就會被困在單元內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If the inner frame surface falls below the dew point of room air, winter condensation drips and keeps frames and seals wet; if sealant blocks the drainage and equalisation paths, otherwise harmless rain is trapped inside the unit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「帷幕牆漏水時，多打一層密封膠把所有縫封死就能解決。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "When a curtain wall leaks, sealing every gap with more sealant solves the problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了省成本取消斷熱條或以金屬螺絲穿過斷熱層，寒流時室內框料結露滴水，長期造成內裝發霉與密封膠脫黏；現場補打密封膠堵住排水孔，雨水在單元底部累積，最後從室內側溢出。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting thermal breaks to save cost, or driving metal screws through them, lets inner frames condense and drip in cold spells, causing mould in finishes and debonded seals over time; sealant added on site that blocks weep holes lets rainwater collect in the bottom of units until it spills indoors.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斷熱、等壓排水與結露控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal breaks, pressure-equalised drainage and condensation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 為了省成本取消斷熱條或以金屬螺絲穿過斷熱層，寒流時室內框料結露滴水，長期造成內裝發霉與密封膠脫黏。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
單元式帷幕牆的玻璃壞了，只要從室內拆下重裝即可，不需要外牆維護設備。
optionsEn: Omitting thermal breaks to save cost, or driving metal screws through them, lets inner frames condense and drip in cold spells, causing mould in finishes and debonded seals over time.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If a unitized pane breaks, it can simply be replaced from inside without any external access equipment.
quiz.explanation: 為了省成本取消斷熱條或以金屬螺絲穿過斷熱層，寒流時室內框料結露滴水，長期造成內裝發霉與密封膠脫黏；現場補打密封膠堵住排水孔，雨水在單元底部累積，最後從室內側溢出。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting thermal breaks to save cost, or driving metal screws through them, lets inner frames condense and drip in cold spells, causing mould in finishes and debonded seals over time; sealant added on site that blocks weep holes lets rainwater collect in the bottom of units until it spills indoors. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 維護吊車、單元更換與竣工交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Maintenance access, unit replacement and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「外牆維護吊車與更換紀錄」如何影響單元式帷幕牆安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “BMU access and replacement records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Unitized curtain-wall installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超高層帷幕牆完工後仍需數十年的清洗、檢查、密封更新與玻璃更換，這些都依賴外牆維護吊車（BMU）的軌道、吊臂伸距與固定點。單元式系統的玻璃多以結構矽利康固定在框上，更換時常需從外側以 BMU 吊運新玻璃，或在室內拆下整片單元，因此設計時就要確認 BMU 能到達每一片單元、吊運能力足以處理最大玻璃。CTBUH 資料中哈里發塔另列有外牆維護顧問，顯示超高層維護規劃是獨立的專業。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外牆維護吊車與更換紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After completion a supertall curtain wall still needs decades of cleaning, inspection, seal renewal and glass replacement, all depending on the building maintenance unit (BMU) tracks, jib reach and restraint points. In unitized systems glass is often structurally siliconed to the frame, so replacement usually means lifting new glass from outside with the BMU or removing a whole unit from inside, and the design must confirm that the BMU can reach every unit and lift the largest pane. The CTBUH record for Burj Khalifa separately lists a façade-maintenance consultant, showing that supertall maintenance planning is a specialism of its own. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “BMU access and replacement records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：立面面積 = 周長 120 m × 60 層 × 4.2 m = 30,240 m²；兩台 BMU 每台每日清洗 600 m²，一輪約 30,240/(2×600) ≈ 25.2 天。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Façade area = 120 m perimeter × 60 floors × 4.2 m = 30,240 m²; with two BMUs cleaning 600 m² per day each, one cycle takes about 30,240/(2×600) ≈ 25.2 days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單元式帷幕牆的玻璃壞了，只要從室內拆下重裝即可，不需要外牆維護設備。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a unitized pane breaks, it can simply be replaced from inside without any external access equipment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「外牆維護吊車與更換紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “BMU access and replacement records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 維護吊車、單元更換與竣工交接
knowledge.titleEn: Maintenance access, unit replacement and handover
knowledge.text: 超高層帷幕牆完工後仍需數十年的清洗、檢查、密封更新與玻璃更換，這些都依賴外牆維護吊車（BMU）的軌道、吊臂伸距與固定點。單元式系統的玻璃多以結構矽利康固定在框上，更換時常需從外側以 BMU 吊運新玻璃，或在室內拆下整片單元，因此設計時就要確認 BMU 能到達每一片單元、吊運能力足以處理最大玻璃。
knowledge.textEn: After completion a supertall curtain wall still needs decades of cleaning, inspection, seal renewal and glass replacement, all depending on the building maintenance unit (BMU) tracks, jib reach and restraint points. In unitized systems glass is often structurally siliconed to the frame, so replacement usually means lifting new glass from outside with the BMU or removing a whole unit from inside, and the design must confirm that the BMU can reach every unit and lift the largest pane.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單元式帷幕牆的玻璃壞了，只要從室內拆下重裝即可，不需要外牆維護設備。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a unitized pane breaks, it can simply be replaced from inside without any external access equipment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「維護吊車、單元更換與竣工交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Maintenance access, unit replacement and handover" is correct?
options: 單元式帷幕牆的玻璃壞了，只要從室內拆下重裝即可，不需要外牆維護設備。
超高層帷幕牆完工後仍需數十年的清洗、檢查、密封更新與玻璃更換，這些都依賴外牆維護吊車（BMU）的軌道、吊臂伸距與固定點。
帷幕牆只是外裝飾，它的荷重對主結構可以忽略。
optionsEn: If a unitized pane breaks, it can simply be replaced from inside without any external access equipment.

After completion a supertall curtain wall still needs decades of cleaning, inspection, seal renewal and glass replacement, all depending on the building maintenance unit (BMU) tracks, jib reach and restraint points.
A curtain wall is just cladding, so its loads on the main structure can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 超高層帷幕牆完工後仍需數十年的清洗、檢查、密封更新與玻璃更換，這些都依賴外牆維護吊車（BMU）的軌道、吊臂伸距與固定點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After completion a supertall curtain wall still needs decades of cleaning, inspection, seal renewal and glass replacement, all depending on the building maintenance unit (BMU) tracks, jib reach and restraint points. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 維護吊車、單元更換與竣工交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Maintenance access, unit replacement and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外牆維護吊車與更換紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “BMU access and replacement records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：立面面積 = 周長 120 m × 60 層 × 4.2 m = 30,240 m²；兩台 BMU 每台每日清洗 600 m²，一輪約 30,240/(2×600) ≈ 25.2 天。若單元年更換率 0.2%，4,800 片每年約 9.6 片，建議常備約 10 片典型尺寸玻璃與密封材。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Façade area = 120 m perimeter × 60 floors × 4.2 m = 30,240 m²; with two BMUs cleaning 600 m² per day each, one cycle takes about 30,240/(2×600) ≈ 25.2 days. With an annual replacement rate of 0.2%, 4,800 units need about 9.6 replacements per year, so about 10 typical-size panes and seal kits should be kept in stock. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前以實際操作確認 BMU 能到達最難接近的角隅與退縮處，並以最大玻璃尺寸做吊運演練；定期檢查計畫包含密封膠硬度與附著抽驗、排水孔清理、錨件抽樣檢查與漏水紀錄分析，結果與竣工基準比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover demonstrate that the BMU reaches the most difficult corners and setbacks, and rehearse lifting the largest glass size; the periodic inspection plan includes sealant hardness and adhesion sampling, weep-hole cleaning, sample bracket checks and analysis of leak records, compared with the completion baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 立面面積 = 周長 120 m × 60 層 × 4.2 m = 30,240 m²；兩台 BMU 每台每日清洗 600 m²，一輪約 30,240/(2×600) ≈ 25.2 天。若單元年更換率 0.2%，4,800 片每年約 9.6 片，建議常備約 10 片典型尺寸玻璃與密封材。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Façade area = 120 m perimeter × 60 floors × 4.2 m = 30,240 m²; with two BMUs cleaning 600 m² per day each, one cycle takes about 30,240/(2×600) ≈ 25.2 days. With an annual replacement rate of 0.2%, 4,800 units need about 9.6 replacements per year, so about 10 typical-size panes and seal kits should be kept in stock. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

單元式帷幕牆在工廠完成，現場安裝不需要品質管制。

Because units are made in the factory, site installation needs no quality control.
Façade area = 120 m perimeter × 60 floors × 4.2 m = 30,240 m²; with two BMUs cleaning 600 m² per day each, one cycle takes about 30,240/(2×600) ≈ 25.2 days.

steps.title: 維護吊車、單元更換與竣工交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Maintenance access, unit replacement and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「外牆維護吊車與更換紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “BMU access and replacement records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前以實際操作確認 BMU 能到達最難接近的角隅與退縮處，並以最大玻璃尺寸做吊運演練；定期檢查計畫包含密封膠硬度與附著抽驗、排水孔清理、錨件抽樣檢查與漏水紀錄分析，結果與竣工基準比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover demonstrate that the BMU reaches the most difficult corners and setbacks, and rehearse lifting the largest glass size; the periodic inspection plan includes sealant hardness and adhesion sampling, weep-hole cleaning, sample bracket checks and analysis of leak records, compared with the completion baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：竣工文件應包含單元編號圖、各單元玻璃與型材規格、錨件與接縫細部、試驗報告、BMU 操作與吊運程序、備品清單與保固條款；任何外牆改裝或加掛招牌前，須由帷幕牆顧問評估對錨件與防水的影響並經業主核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Completion documents should include the unit ID map, glass and profile specifications for each unit, bracket and joint details, test reports, BMU operating and lifting procedures, spares list and warranties; before any façade alteration or added signage, the façade consultant must assess the effect on brackets and waterproofing and the owner must approve.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：BMU 吊臂伸距不足以到達退縮樓層的立面，某片玻璃破裂後只能搭設昂貴的臨時吊架；交接時沒有留下單元編號與玻璃規格對照，更換時訂錯鍍膜或尺寸，色差與漏水問題接踵而來。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A BMU jib too short to reach façades at setback floors means a single broken pane needs costly temporary rigging; without a record linking unit IDs to glass specifications at handover, replacements arrive with the wrong coating or size, bringing colour mismatch and leaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「維護吊車、單元更換與竣工交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Maintenance access, unit replacement and handover"?
options: 交接前以實際操作確認 BMU 能到達最難接近的角隅與退縮處，並以最大玻璃尺寸做吊運演練。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

optionsEn: Before handover demonstrate that the BMU reaches the most difficult corners and setbacks, and rehearse lifting the largest glass size.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Because unitized joints can slide, no racking test is needed.

quiz.explanationEn: Before handover demonstrate that the BMU reaches the most difficult corners and setbacks, and rehearse lifting the largest glass size; the periodic inspection plan includes sealant hardness and adhesion sampling, weep-hole cleaning, sample bracket checks and analysis of leak records, compared with the completion baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 維護吊車、單元更換與竣工交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Maintenance access, unit replacement and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「外牆維護吊車與更換紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “BMU access and replacement records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: BMU 吊臂伸距不足以到達退縮樓層的立面，某片玻璃破裂後只能搭設昂貴的臨時吊架；交接時沒有留下單元編號與玻璃規格對照，更換時訂錯鍍膜或尺寸，色差與漏水問題接踵而來。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A BMU jib too short to reach façades at setback floors means a single broken pane needs costly temporary rigging; without a record linking unit IDs to glass specifications at handover, replacements arrive with the wrong coating or size, bringing colour mismatch and leaks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：CTBUH 資料中哈里發塔另列有外牆維護顧問，顯示超高層維護規劃是獨立的專業。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The CTBUH record for Burj Khalifa separately lists a façade-maintenance consultant, showing that supertall maintenance planning is a specialism of its own.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單元式帷幕牆的玻璃壞了，只要從室內拆下重裝即可，不需要外牆維護設備。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a unitized pane breaks, it can simply be replaced from inside without any external access equipment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「維護吊車、單元更換與竣工交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Maintenance access, unit replacement and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
BMU 吊臂伸距不足以到達退縮樓層的立面，某片玻璃破裂後只能搭設昂貴的臨時吊架。
帷幕牆只是外裝飾，它的荷重對主結構可以忽略。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A BMU jib too short to reach façades at setback floors means a single broken pane needs costly temporary rigging.
A curtain wall is just cladding, so its loads on the main structure can be ignored.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 雙層通風幕牆整合
summary: 從雙層通風幕牆的腔體類型與氣候條件出發，建立日射吸熱與通風量決定腔體溫升、煙囪效應決定浮力風量的模型，說明外層玻璃與懸挑托架、檢修走道的結構設計、開口與遮陽的細部，再處理施工整合、控制系統試運轉、樣品牆熱流量測與腔體煙控，最後以清潔、結露與實測能耗完成交接，並以柏林 GSW 總部、溫尼伯曼尼托巴水電大樓與倫敦聖瑪莉斧街 30 號說明不同的腔體策略。
summaryEn: Starting from cavity types and climate, build models in which absorbed solar gain and airflow set cavity temperature rise and the stack effect sets buoyant airflow, explain the structural design of outer glass, cantilever brackets and maintenance walkways and the detailing of openings and shading, then cover construction integration, control commissioning, mock-up heat-flow measurement and smoke control in the cavity, and close with cleaning, condensation and measured energy at handover, comparing cavity strategies at the GSW headquarters in Berlin, Manitoba Hydro Place in Winnipeg and 30 St Mary Axe in London.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

subcategoryTitleEn: Facades, vertical transport and digital construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 20 m 高的多樓層式雙層幕牆開間寬 3.0 m、層高 3.6 m、腔深 0.9 m。夏季晴天百葉吸收 0.5×600×10.8 = 3,240 W/開間，70% 即 2,268 W 進入腔體空氣。若以腔體出風溫升 ΔT ≤ 8 K 為目標，需風量 V = 2,268/(1,206×8) ≈ 0.235 m³/s。浮力壓差 ΔP = 1.2×9.81×20×8/300 ≈ 6.3 Pa；有效開口 Cd·A = V/√(2ΔP/ρ) = 0.235/3.24 ≈ 0.073 m²，以 50% 自由面積、Cd = 0.6 的百葉需毛面積約 0.073/0.3 ≈ 0.24 m²，加防蟲網（再乘 0.6）約 0.40 m²。外層托架根部彎矩約 2.65 kN·m。若腔體高度降為 10 m，ΔP 減半為約 3.1 Pa，同樣風量需開口增為約 √2 ≈ 1.41 倍，即約 0.57 m²。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 20 m high multi-storey double-skin façade has 3.0 m bays, 3.6 m storeys and a 0.9 m cavity. On a clear summer day the blinds absorb 0.5×600×10.8 = 3,240 W per bay, 70% of which, 2,268 W, enters the cavity air. To keep the outlet temperature rise to ΔT ≤ 8 K requires V = 2,268/(1,206×8) ≈ 0.235 m³/s. The stack pressure is ΔP = 1.2×9.81×20×8/300 ≈ 6.3 Pa, so the effective opening is Cd·A = V/√(2ΔP/ρ) = 0.235/3.24 ≈ 0.073 m²; a louvre with 50% free area and Cd = 0.6 needs a gross area of about 0.073/0.3 ≈ 0.24 m², or about 0.40 m² with an insect screen (a further factor of 0.6). The outer-skin bracket root moment is about 2.65 kN·m. If the cavity height drops to 10 m, ΔP halves to about 3.1 Pa and the same airflow needs openings about √2 ≈ 1.41 times larger, about 0.57 m². Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「腔體類型與日射熱平衡」與「煙囪效應、風壓與腔體通風量」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cavity types and the solar heat balance" and "Stack effect, wind pressure and cavity airflow": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 腔體類型與日射熱平衡：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cavity types and the solar heat balance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「通風腔體熱平衡」如何影響雙層通風幕牆整合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cavity heat balance” governs force, deformation or durability in “Double-skin ventilated facade integration”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙層幕牆在內層隔熱玻璃外再加一層單層玻璃，兩層之間形成數十公分到一公尺以上的通風腔體，常依分隔方式分為箱窗式、井箱式、走廊式與多樓層式。遮陽百葉放在腔體內可免受風雨，但百葉吸收的日射會加熱腔體空氣，若通風不足，腔體可能比室外熱得多，反而把熱推進室內。因此腔體的核心是熱平衡：吸收的日射熱必須由流經腔體的空氣帶走，風量與開口決定了腔體是「緩衝區」還是「烤箱」。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「通風腔體熱平衡」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A double-skin façade adds a single-glazed outer layer outside the insulated inner glazing, forming a ventilated cavity from a few tenths of a metre to over a metre deep, usually classified by its subdivision as box-window, shaft-box, corridor or multi-storey. Blinds in the cavity are protected from wind and rain, but the solar energy they absorb heats the cavity air, and with too little ventilation the cavity can become much hotter than outdoors and push heat indoors. The core of the cavity is therefore its heat balance: absorbed solar gain must be carried away by air flowing through the cavity, and airflow and openings decide whether the cavity is a buffer or an oven. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cavity heat balance” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：百葉吸收率 0.5、垂直日射 600 W/m²，每格 3.0×3.6 = 10.8 m² 吸熱 0.5×600×10.8 = 3,240 W，其中 70% 對流入腔體空氣為 2,268 W。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With blind absorptance 0.5 and 600 W/m² vertical irradiance, each 3.0×3.6 = 10.8 m² bay absorbs 0.5×600×10.8 = 3,240 W, of which 70%, 2,268 W, is convected to cavity air.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多加一層玻璃一定能減少建築的空調耗能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding a second layer of glass always reduces air-conditioning energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「通風腔體熱平衡」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cavity heat balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 腔體類型與日射熱平衡
knowledge.titleEn: Cavity types and the solar heat balance
knowledge.text: 雙層幕牆在內層隔熱玻璃外再加一層單層玻璃，兩層之間形成數十公分到一公尺以上的通風腔體，常依分隔方式分為箱窗式、井箱式、走廊式與多樓層式。遮陽百葉放在腔體內可免受風雨，但百葉吸收的日射會加熱腔體空氣，若通風不足，腔體可能比室外熱得多，反而把熱推進室內。
knowledge.textEn: A double-skin façade adds a single-glazed outer layer outside the insulated inner glazing, forming a ventilated cavity from a few tenths of a metre to over a metre deep, usually classified by its subdivision as box-window, shaft-box, corridor or multi-storey. Blinds in the cavity are protected from wind and rain, but the solar energy they absorb heats the cavity air, and with too little ventilation the cavity can become much hotter than outdoors and push heat indoors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：多加一層玻璃一定能減少建築的空調耗能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding a second layer of glass always reduces air-conditioning energy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「腔體類型與日射熱平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cavity types and the solar heat balance" is correct?
options: 多加一層玻璃一定能減少建築的空調耗能。
雙層幕牆在內層隔熱玻璃外再加一層單層玻璃，兩層之間形成數十公分到一公尺以上的通風腔體，常依分隔方式分為箱窗式、井箱式、走廊式與多樓層式。
雙層幕牆的腔體只要夠高，空氣就一定會由下往上流動。
optionsEn: Adding a second layer of glass always reduces air-conditioning energy.

A double-skin façade adds a single-glazed outer layer outside the insulated inner glazing, forming a ventilated cavity from a few tenths of a metre to over a metre deep, usually classified by its subdivision as box-window, shaft-box, corridor or multi-storey.
If the cavity is tall enough, air will always flow upward through it.
quiz.explanation: 雙層幕牆在內層隔熱玻璃外再加一層單層玻璃，兩層之間形成數十公分到一公尺以上的通風腔體，常依分隔方式分為箱窗式、井箱式、走廊式與多樓層式。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A double-skin façade adds a single-glazed outer layer outside the insulated inner glazing, forming a ventilated cavity from a few tenths of a metre to over a metre deep, usually classified by its subdivision as box-window, shaft-box, corridor or multi-storey. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 腔體類型與日射熱平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cavity types and the solar heat balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通風腔體熱平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cavity heat balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：百葉吸收率 0.5、垂直日射 600 W/m²，每格 3.0×3.6 = 10.8 m² 吸熱 0.5×600×10.8 = 3,240 W，其中 70% 對流入腔體空氣為 2,268 W。腔體溫升 ΔT = Q/(ρ·cp·V)，ρ·cp = 1.2×1,005 ≈ 1,206 J/m³K：風量 0.3 m³/s 時 ΔT ≈ 6.3 K；風量降為 0.1 m³/s 時 ΔT ≈ 18.8 K。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With blind absorptance 0.5 and 600 W/m² vertical irradiance, each 3.0×3.6 = 10.8 m² bay absorbs 0.5×600×10.8 = 3,240 W, of which 70%, 2,268 W, is convected to cavity air. Temperature rise ΔT = Q/(ρ·cp·V) with ρ·cp = 1.2×1,005 ≈ 1,206 J/m³K: at 0.3 m³/s ΔT ≈ 6.3 K; if airflow drops to 0.1 m³/s, ΔT ≈ 18.8 K. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分區熱網路模型或計算流體力學模擬各方位、季節與遮陽位置下的腔體溫度與內層玻璃熱流，檢查夏季最熱時段的腔體溫度上限與冬季的預熱效益；模擬假設須在樣品牆量測中驗證，並由機電與帷幕牆顧問共同確認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Simulate cavity temperatures and heat flow through the inner glazing for each orientation, season and blind position with a zonal thermal-network model or computational fluid dynamics, checking the cavity temperature ceiling in the hottest summer hours and the preheating benefit in winter; the assumptions must be validated by mock-up measurement and agreed by the MEP and façade consultants.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 百葉吸收率 0.5、垂直日射 600 W/m²，每格 3.0×3.6 = 10.8 m² 吸熱 0.5×600×10.8 = 3,240 W，其中 70% 對流入腔體空氣為 2,268 W。腔體溫升 ΔT = Q/(ρ·cp·V)，ρ·cp = 1.2×1,005 ≈ 1,206 J/m³K：風量 0.3 m³/s 時 ΔT ≈ 6.3 K；風量降為 0.1 m³/s 時 ΔT ≈ 18.8 K。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With blind absorptance 0.5 and 600 W/m² vertical irradiance, each 3.0×3.6 = 10.8 m² bay absorbs 0.5×600×10.8 = 3,240 W, of which 70%, 2,268 W, is convected to cavity air. Temperature rise ΔT = Q/(ρ·cp·V) with ρ·cp = 1.2×1,005 ≈ 1,206 J/m³K: at 0.3 m³/s ΔT ≈ 6.3 K; if airflow drops to 0.1 m³/s, ΔT ≈ 18.8 K. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「腔體類型與日射熱平衡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cavity types and the solar heat balance", which statement holds?
options: 腔體開口只要外觀上夠大，通風量就足夠。
雙層幕牆是被動式設計，完工後不需要控制系統試運轉。
optionsEn: If cavity openings look large enough, the airflow will be sufficient.
A double-skin façade is passive, so it needs no control commissioning after completion.
With blind absorptance 0.5 and 600 W/m² vertical irradiance, each 3.0×3.6 = 10.8 m² bay absorbs 0.5×600×10.8 = 3,240 W, of which 70%, 2,268 W, is convected to cavity air.
quiz.explanation: 百葉吸收率 0.5、垂直日射 600 W/m²，每格 3.0×3.6 = 10.8 m² 吸熱 0.5×600×10.8 = 3,240 W，其中 70% 對流入腔體空氣為 2,268 W。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With blind absorptance 0.5 and 600 W/m² vertical irradiance, each 3.0×3.6 = 10.8 m² bay absorbs 0.5×600×10.8 = 3,240 W, of which 70%, 2,268 W, is convected to cavity air. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 腔體類型與日射熱平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cavity types and the solar heat balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通風腔體熱平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cavity heat balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分區熱網路模型或計算流體力學模擬各方位、季節與遮陽位置下的腔體溫度與內層玻璃熱流，檢查夏季最熱時段的腔體溫度上限與冬季的預熱效益；模擬假設須在樣品牆量測中驗證，並由機電與帷幕牆顧問共同確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Simulate cavity temperatures and heat flow through the inner glazing for each orientation, season and blind position with a zonal thermal-network model or computational fluid dynamics, checking the cavity temperature ceiling in the hottest summer hours and the preheating benefit in winter; the assumptions must be validated by mock-up measurement and agreed by the MEP and façade consultants. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：方案階段就以當地氣候資料比較單層高性能帷幕牆與各類雙層幕牆的全年耗能、舒適度與造價，並把腔體最高溫度、最小風量與遮陽控制邏輯寫成設計準則，作為後續各專業共同遵守的目標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At concept stage compare annual energy, comfort and cost of a high-performance single skin against each double-skin type using local climate data, and write the maximum cavity temperature, minimum airflow and shading control logic into design criteria that all disciplines then follow.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在高日射地區採用封閉或通風不足的腔體，夏季腔體溫度遠高於室外，內層玻璃與窗框成為大型輻射熱源，空調負荷不降反升；百葉卡在放下位置又無法通風時，腔體高溫甚至使密封材料老化與玻璃熱破裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using a closed or under-ventilated cavity in a high-irradiance climate makes summer cavity temperatures far exceed outdoor air, so the inner glazing and frames become large radiant heat sources and cooling loads rise instead of falling; with blinds stuck down and ventilation blocked, cavity heat can even age seals and cause thermal breakage of glass. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以分區熱網路模型或計算流體力學模擬各方位、季節與遮陽位置下的腔體溫度與內層玻璃熱流，檢查夏季最熱時段的腔體溫度上限與冬季的預熱效益；模擬假設須在樣品牆量測中驗證，並由機電與帷幕牆顧問共同確認。
knowledge.textEn: Simulate cavity temperatures and heat flow through the inner glazing for each orientation, season and blind position with a zonal thermal-network model or computational fluid dynamics, checking the cavity temperature ceiling in the hottest summer hours and the preheating benefit in winter; the assumptions must be validated by mock-up measurement and agreed by the MEP and façade consultants.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 方案階段就以當地氣候資料比較單層高性能帷幕牆與各類雙層幕牆的全年耗能、舒適度與造價，並把腔體最高溫度、最小風量與遮陽控制邏輯寫成設計準則，作為後續各專業共同遵守的目標。
knowledge.textEn: At concept stage compare annual energy, comfort and cost of a high-performance single skin against each double-skin type using local climate data, and write the maximum cavity temperature, minimum airflow and shading control logic into design criteria that all disciplines then follow.

quiz.question: 要驗證「腔體類型與日射熱平衡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cavity types and the solar heat balance"?
options: 以分區熱網路模型或計算流體力學模擬各方位、季節與遮陽位置下的腔體溫度與內層玻璃熱流，檢查夏季最熱時段的腔體溫度上限與冬季的預熱效益。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
雙層幕牆的外層玻璃可以擋住火焰，所以腔體不需要防火設計。
optionsEn: Simulate cavity temperatures and heat flow through the inner glazing for each orientation, season and blind position with a zonal thermal-network model or computational fluid dynamics, checking the cavity temperature ceiling in the hottest summer hours and the preheating benefit in winter.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The outer glass of a double skin stops flames, so the cavity needs no fire design.
quiz.explanation: 以分區熱網路模型或計算流體力學模擬各方位、季節與遮陽位置下的腔體溫度與內層玻璃熱流，檢查夏季最熱時段的腔體溫度上限與冬季的預熱效益；模擬假設須在樣品牆量測中驗證，並由機電與帷幕牆顧問共同確認。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Simulate cavity temperatures and heat flow through the inner glazing for each orientation, season and blind position with a zonal thermal-network model or computational fluid dynamics, checking the cavity temperature ceiling in the hottest summer hours and the preheating benefit in winter; the assumptions must be validated by mock-up measurement and agreed by the MEP and façade consultants. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 腔體類型與日射熱平衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cavity types and the solar heat balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通風腔體熱平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cavity heat balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在高日射地區採用封閉或通風不足的腔體，夏季腔體溫度遠高於室外，內層玻璃與窗框成為大型輻射熱源，空調負荷不降反升；百葉卡在放下位置又無法通風時，腔體高溫甚至使密封材料老化與玻璃熱破裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a closed or under-ventilated cavity in a high-irradiance climate makes summer cavity temperatures far exceed outdoor air, so the inner glazing and frames become large radiant heat sources and cooling loads rise instead of falling; with blinds stuck down and ventilation blocked, cavity heat can even age seals and cause thermal breakage of glass. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此腔體的核心是熱平衡：吸收的日射熱必須由流經腔體的空氣帶走，風量與開口決定了腔體是「緩衝區」還是「烤箱」。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The core of the cavity is therefore its heat balance: absorbed solar gain must be carried away by air flowing through the cavity, and airflow and openings decide whether the cavity is a buffer or an oven.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「多加一層玻璃一定能減少建築的空調耗能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding a second layer of glass always reduces air-conditioning energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在高日射地區採用封閉或通風不足的腔體，夏季腔體溫度遠高於室外，內層玻璃與窗框成為大型輻射熱源，空調負荷不降反升；百葉卡在放下位置又無法通風時，腔體高溫甚至使密封材料老化與玻璃熱破裂。
knowledge.textEn: Using a closed or under-ventilated cavity in a high-irradiance climate makes summer cavity temperatures far exceed outdoor air, so the inner glazing and frames become large radiant heat sources and cooling loads rise instead of falling; with blinds stuck down and ventilation blocked, cavity heat can even age seals and cause thermal breakage of glass.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「腔體類型與日射熱平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cavity types and the solar heat balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
在高日射地區採用封閉或通風不足的腔體，夏季腔體溫度遠高於室外，內層玻璃與窗框成為大型輻射熱源，空調負荷不降反升。
雙層幕牆的腔體只要夠高，空氣就一定會由下往上流動。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Using a closed or under-ventilated cavity in a high-irradiance climate makes summer cavity temperatures far exceed outdoor air, so the inner glazing and frames become large radiant heat sources and cooling loads rise instead of falling.
If the cavity is tall enough, air will always flow upward through it.
