quiz.explanationEn: Using a closed or under-ventilated cavity in a high-irradiance climate makes summer cavity temperatures far exceed outdoor air, so the inner glazing and frames become large radiant heat sources and cooling loads rise instead of falling; with blinds stuck down and ventilation blocked, cavity heat can even age seals and cause thermal breakage of glass. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 煙囪效應、風壓與腔體通風量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stack effect, wind pressure and cavity airflow: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「煙囪效應浮力風量」如何影響雙層通風幕牆整合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stack-driven airflow” governs force, deformation or durability in “Double-skin ventilated facade integration”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 腔體空氣受熱後密度降低而上升，形成煙囪效應：腔體越高、溫差越大，浮力驅動的壓差就越大。多樓層式腔體可利用數十公尺的高度產生可觀的自然通風，柏林 GSW 總部的西向雙層立面即把腔體當成對流井，輔助高層辦公室的自然通風。然而外部風壓同樣作用在進出風口上，迎風面可能加強、背風面可能抵銷甚至逆轉浮力流；高樓層的風壓遠大於浮力壓差，因此腔體開口常需可調風門。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「煙囪效應浮力風量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Heated cavity air becomes less dense and rises, creating a stack effect: the taller the cavity and the larger the temperature difference, the greater the buoyancy-driven pressure difference. A multi-storey cavity can use tens of metres of height to generate substantial natural ventilation; the west double façade of the GSW headquarters in Berlin uses its cavity as a convection shaft that supports natural ventilation of the high-rise offices. Wind pressure acts on the inlets and outlets too, reinforcing buoyancy on the windward side and cancelling or even reversing it on the leeward side; at height wind pressures far exceed stack pressures, so cavity openings usually need adjustable dampers. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stack-driven airflow” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：浮力壓差 ΔP = ρ·g·h·ΔT/T。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stack pressure ΔP = ρ·g·h·ΔT/T.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙層幕牆的腔體只要夠高，空氣就一定會由下往上流動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the cavity is tall enough, air will always flow upward through it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「煙囪效應浮力風量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stack-driven airflow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 煙囪效應、風壓與腔體通風量
knowledge.titleEn: Stack effect, wind pressure and cavity airflow
knowledge.text: 腔體空氣受熱後密度降低而上升，形成煙囪效應：腔體越高、溫差越大，浮力驅動的壓差就越大。多樓層式腔體可利用數十公尺的高度產生可觀的自然通風，柏林 GSW 總部的西向雙層立面即把腔體當成對流井，輔助高層辦公室的自然通風。
knowledge.textEn: Heated cavity air becomes less dense and rises, creating a stack effect: the taller the cavity and the larger the temperature difference, the greater the buoyancy-driven pressure difference. A multi-storey cavity can use tens of metres of height to generate substantial natural ventilation; the west double façade of the GSW headquarters in Berlin uses its cavity as a convection shaft that supports natural ventilation of the high-rise offices.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雙層幕牆的腔體只要夠高，空氣就一定會由下往上流動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the cavity is tall enough, air will always flow upward through it. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「煙囪效應、風壓與腔體通風量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stack effect, wind pressure and cavity airflow" is correct?
options: 雙層幕牆的腔體只要夠高，空氣就一定會由下往上流動。
外層玻璃有開口，所以幾乎不受風壓，可以用很薄的玻璃。
腔體空氣受熱後密度降低而上升，形成煙囪效應：腔體越高、溫差越大，浮力驅動的壓差就越大。
optionsEn: If the cavity is tall enough, air will always flow upward through it.
Because the outer skin has openings, it sees almost no wind and can use very thin glass.
Heated cavity air becomes less dense and rises, creating a stack effect: the taller the cavity and the larger the temperature difference, the greater the buoyancy-driven pressure difference.
quiz.explanation: 腔體空氣受熱後密度降低而上升，形成煙囪效應：腔體越高、溫差越大，浮力驅動的壓差就越大。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Heated cavity air becomes less dense and rises, creating a stack effect: the taller the cavity and the larger the temperature difference, the greater the buoyancy-driven pressure difference. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 煙囪效應、風壓與腔體通風量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stack effect, wind pressure and cavity airflow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「煙囪效應浮力風量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stack-driven airflow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：浮力壓差 ΔP = ρ·g·h·ΔT/T。h = 20 m、ΔT = 8 K、T = 300 K：ΔP = 1.2×9.81×20×8/300 ≈ 6.3 Pa。開口 Cd = 0.6、A = 0.5 m²：V = Cd·A·√(2ΔP/ρ) = 0.6×0.5×√(2×6.3/1.2) ≈ 0.97 m³/s。若迎風面 5 m/s 的風壓係數差 0.2，風壓約 0.5×1.2×5²×0.2 = 3 Pa，足以明顯改變流量。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stack pressure ΔP = ρ·g·h·ΔT/T. With h = 20 m, ΔT = 8 K and T = 300 K: ΔP = 1.2×9.81×20×8/300 ≈ 6.3 Pa. Through an opening with Cd = 0.6 and A = 0.5 m²: V = Cd·A·√(2ΔP/ρ) = 0.6×0.5×√(2×6.3/1.2) ≈ 0.97 m³/s. A 5 m/s wind with a pressure-coefficient difference of 0.2 gives about 0.5×1.2×5²×0.2 = 3 Pa, enough to change the flow noticeably. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以風洞試驗或計算流體力學取得各風向下進出風口的風壓係數，與浮力模型合併計算全年風量分布，檢查逆流與停滯的時數；完工後以腔體內多點溫度與風速量測確認實際流向，並與控制系統紀錄的風門開度比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain pressure coefficients at inlets and outlets for each wind direction from wind-tunnel tests or CFD, combine them with the buoyancy model to compute the annual airflow distribution and count hours of reversal and stagnation; after completion confirm actual flow direction with multi-point temperature and air-speed measurement in the cavity, compared with damper positions logged by the control system.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Stack pressure ΔP = ρ·g·h·ΔT/T. With h = 20 m, ΔT = 8 K and T = 300 K: ΔP = 1.2×9.81×20×8/300 ≈ 6.3 Pa. Through an opening with Cd = 0.6 and A = 0.5 m²: V = Cd·A·√(2ΔP/ρ) = 0.6×0.5×√(2×6.3/1.2) ≈ 0.97 m³/s. A 5 m/s wind with a pressure-coefficient difference of 0.2 gives about 0.5×1.2×5²×0.2 = 3 Pa, enough to change the flow noticeably. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「煙囪效應、風壓與腔體通風量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stack effect, wind pressure and cavity airflow", which statement holds?
options: 浮力壓差 ΔP = ρ·g·h·ΔT/T。
雙層幕牆只是把一般帷幕牆多做一層，施工程序不需要改變。
腔體溫度只要量一個點就能代表整個腔體。
optionsEn: Stack pressure ΔP = ρ·g·h·ΔT/T.
A double-skin façade is just an ordinary curtain wall with one more layer, so the construction process need not change.
One temperature reading represents the whole cavity.
quiz.explanation: 浮力壓差 ΔP = ρ·g·h·ΔT/T。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Stack pressure ΔP = ρ·g·h·ΔT/T. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 煙囪效應、風壓與腔體通風量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stack effect, wind pressure and cavity airflow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「煙囪效應浮力風量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stack-driven airflow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以風洞試驗或計算流體力學取得各風向下進出風口的風壓係數，與浮力模型合併計算全年風量分布，檢查逆流與停滯的時數；完工後以腔體內多點溫度與風速量測確認實際流向，並與控制系統紀錄的風門開度比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain pressure coefficients at inlets and outlets for each wind direction from wind-tunnel tests or CFD, combine them with the buoyancy model to compute the annual airflow distribution and count hours of reversal and stagnation; after completion confirm actual flow direction with multi-point temperature and air-speed measurement in the cavity, compared with damper positions logged by the control system. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：開口與風門的設計要同時考慮浮力、風壓與防雨，並在控制邏輯中設定強風關閉、逆流偵測與過熱開啟的條件；這些條件須由機電顧問、帷幕牆顧問與自動控制承包商共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design openings and dampers for buoyancy, wind pressure and rain together, and set control conditions for closing in high wind, detecting reversal and opening on overheating; these conditions must be signed off jointly by the MEP consultant, façade consultant and controls contractor.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以無風浮力計算開口大小，高樓層在強風時腔體出現逆流，熱空氣與汙染空氣被壓回上方樓層的開窗；或在無風炎熱的午後浮力不足，腔體停滯過熱。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing openings for windless buoyancy alone lets strong wind reverse the cavity flow at upper floors, pushing hot or polluted air back into windows above; on a still, hot afternoon buoyancy may be too weak and the cavity stagnates and overheats. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以風洞試驗或計算流體力學取得各風向下進出風口的風壓係數，與浮力模型合併計算全年風量分布，檢查逆流與停滯的時數；完工後以腔體內多點溫度與風速量測確認實際流向，並與控制系統紀錄的風門開度比對。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain pressure coefficients at inlets and outlets for each wind direction from wind-tunnel tests or CFD, combine them with the buoyancy model to compute the annual airflow distribution and count hours of reversal and stagnation; after completion confirm actual flow direction with multi-point temperature and air-speed measurement in the cavity, compared with damper positions logged by the control system.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 開口與風門的設計要同時考慮浮力、風壓與防雨，並在控制邏輯中設定強風關閉、逆流偵測與過熱開啟的條件；這些條件須由機電顧問、帷幕牆顧問與自動控制承包商共同簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Design openings and dampers for buoyancy, wind pressure and rain together, and set control conditions for closing in high wind, detecting reversal and opening on overheating; these conditions must be signed off jointly by the MEP consultant, façade consultant and controls contractor.

quiz.question: 要驗證「煙囪效應、風壓與腔體通風量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stack effect, wind pressure and cavity airflow"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以風洞試驗或計算流體力學取得各風向下進出風口的風壓係數，與浮力模型合併計算全年風量分布，檢查逆流與停滯的時數。
腔體位於室內外之間受到保護，不需要定期清潔與檢查。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Obtain pressure coefficients at inlets and outlets for each wind direction from wind-tunnel tests or CFD, combine them with the buoyancy model to compute the annual airflow distribution and count hours of reversal and stagnation.
The cavity is sheltered between inside and outside, so it needs no regular cleaning or inspection.
quiz.explanation: 以風洞試驗或計算流體力學取得各風向下進出風口的風壓係數，與浮力模型合併計算全年風量分布，檢查逆流與停滯的時數；完工後以腔體內多點溫度與風速量測確認實際流向，並與控制系統紀錄的風門開度比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain pressure coefficients at inlets and outlets for each wind direction from wind-tunnel tests or CFD, combine them with the buoyancy model to compute the annual airflow distribution and count hours of reversal and stagnation; after completion confirm actual flow direction with multi-point temperature and air-speed measurement in the cavity, compared with damper positions logged by the control system. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 煙囪效應、風壓與腔體通風量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stack effect, wind pressure and cavity airflow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「煙囪效應浮力風量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stack-driven airflow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以無風浮力計算開口大小，高樓層在強風時腔體出現逆流，熱空氣與汙染空氣被壓回上方樓層的開窗；或在無風炎熱的午後浮力不足，腔體停滯過熱。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing openings for windless buoyancy alone lets strong wind reverse the cavity flow at upper floors, pushing hot or polluted air back into windows above; on a still, hot afternoon buoyancy may be too weak and the cavity stagnates and overheats. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：然而外部風壓同樣作用在進出風口上，迎風面可能加強、背風面可能抵銷甚至逆轉浮力流；高樓層的風壓遠大於浮力壓差，因此腔體開口常需可調風門。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Wind pressure acts on the inlets and outlets too, reinforcing buoyancy on the windward side and cancelling or even reversing it on the leeward side; at height wind pressures far exceed stack pressures, so cavity openings usually need adjustable dampers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雙層幕牆的腔體只要夠高，空氣就一定會由下往上流動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the cavity is tall enough, air will always flow upward through it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以無風浮力計算開口大小，高樓層在強風時腔體出現逆流，熱空氣與汙染空氣被壓回上方樓層的開窗；或在無風炎熱的午後浮力不足，腔體停滯過熱。
knowledge.textEn: Sizing openings for windless buoyancy alone lets strong wind reverse the cavity flow at upper floors, pushing hot or polluted air back into windows above; on a still, hot afternoon buoyancy may be too weak and the cavity stagnates and overheats.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「煙囪效應、風壓與腔體通風量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stack effect, wind pressure and cavity airflow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
外層玻璃有開口，所以幾乎不受風壓，可以用很薄的玻璃。
只以無風浮力計算開口大小，高樓層在強風時腔體出現逆流，熱空氣與汙染空氣被壓回上方樓層的開窗；或在無風炎熱的午後浮力不足，腔體停滯過熱。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Because the outer skin has openings, it sees almost no wind and can use very thin glass.
Sizing openings for windless buoyancy alone lets strong wind reverse the cavity flow at upper floors, pushing hot or polluted air back into windows above.
quiz.explanation: 只以無風浮力計算開口大小，高樓層在強風時腔體出現逆流，熱空氣與汙染空氣被壓回上方樓層的開窗；或在無風炎熱的午後浮力不足，腔體停滯過熱。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sizing openings for windless buoyancy alone lets strong wind reverse the cavity flow at upper floors, pushing hot or polluted air back into windows above; on a still, hot afternoon buoyancy may be too weak and the cavity stagnates and overheats. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「外層玻璃、托架與檢修走道結構」與「開口、風門、遮陽與樓層分隔細部」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Outer glass, brackets and maintenance-walkway structure" and "Openings, dampers, shading and floor-separation details": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 外層玻璃、托架與檢修走道結構：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Outer glass, brackets and maintenance-walkway structure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「外層玻璃懸挑托架」如何影響雙層通風幕牆整合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Outer-skin cantilever bracket” governs force, deformation or durability in “Double-skin ventilated facade integration”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外層玻璃通常由樓板邊緣或內層幕牆伸出的懸挑托架支承，托架同時承托腔體內的檢修格柵走道。因此托架要承受外層玻璃自重、走道恆載與維修活載、外層玻璃承受的風壓，以及這些力在懸臂根部造成的彎矩。外層玻璃有開口時，風壓會部分進入腔體，內外兩層各自分擔的壓差隨開口比例與陣風而改變，保守做法是外層以全部外部風壓設計、內層再以腔體與室內的壓差檢核。托架穿越內層的位置也是熱橋與漏水的弱點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外層玻璃懸挑托架」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The outer glass is usually carried on cantilever brackets from the slab edge or the inner curtain wall, and the same brackets support the grating walkway in the cavity. The brackets must therefore carry outer-glass self-weight, walkway dead and maintenance live loads, wind on the outer glass and the resulting moments at the cantilever root. Where the outer skin has openings, wind pressure partly enters the cavity and the share taken by each skin varies with opening ratio and gusts; a conservative approach designs the outer skin for the full external pressure and checks the inner skin for the cavity-to-room difference. Where brackets pass through the inner skin they are weak points for thermal bridging and leaks. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Outer-skin cantilever bracket” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：托架間距 1.5 m、層高 3.6 m、腔深 0.9 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With brackets at 1.5 m, 3.6 m storeys and a 0.9 m cavity: 12 mm outer glass at about 30 kg/m² gives 1.5×3.6×30×9.81 ≈ 1.59 kN, a moment of about 1.43 kN·m at 0.9 m; walkway dead load 0.5 kPa and maintenance live load 1.5 kPa on 1.5×0.9 m² give 0.675 + 2.025 = 2.70 kN, about 1.22 kN·m at 0.45 m; the bracket root sees about 2.65 kN·m in total, plus a 10.8 kN horizontal force from 2.0 kPa wind.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外層玻璃有開口，所以幾乎不受風壓，可以用很薄的玻璃。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because the outer skin has openings, it sees almost no wind and can use very thin glass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「外層玻璃懸挑托架」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Outer-skin cantilever bracket”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外層玻璃、托架與檢修走道結構
knowledge.titleEn: Outer glass, brackets and maintenance-walkway structure
knowledge.text: 外層玻璃通常由樓板邊緣或內層幕牆伸出的懸挑托架支承，托架同時承托腔體內的檢修格柵走道。因此托架要承受外層玻璃自重、走道恆載與維修活載、外層玻璃承受的風壓，以及這些力在懸臂根部造成的彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: The outer glass is usually carried on cantilever brackets from the slab edge or the inner curtain wall, and the same brackets support the grating walkway in the cavity. The brackets must therefore carry outer-glass self-weight, walkway dead and maintenance live loads, wind on the outer glass and the resulting moments at the cantilever root.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外層玻璃有開口，所以幾乎不受風壓，可以用很薄的玻璃。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Because the outer skin has openings, it sees almost no wind and can use very thin glass. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外層玻璃、托架與檢修走道結構」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Outer glass, brackets and maintenance-walkway structure" is correct?
options: 外層玻璃通常由樓板邊緣或內層幕牆伸出的懸挑托架支承，托架同時承托腔體內的檢修格柵走道。
外層玻璃有開口，所以幾乎不受風壓，可以用很薄的玻璃。
腔體開口只要外觀上夠大，通風量就足夠。
optionsEn: The outer glass is usually carried on cantilever brackets from the slab edge or the inner curtain wall, and the same brackets support the grating walkway in the cavity.
Because the outer skin has openings, it sees almost no wind and can use very thin glass.
If cavity openings look large enough, the airflow will be sufficient.
quiz.explanation: 外層玻璃通常由樓板邊緣或內層幕牆伸出的懸挑托架支承，托架同時承托腔體內的檢修格柵走道。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The outer glass is usually carried on cantilever brackets from the slab edge or the inner curtain wall, and the same brackets support the grating walkway in the cavity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外層玻璃、托架與檢修走道結構：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Outer glass, brackets and maintenance-walkway structure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外層玻璃懸挑托架」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Outer-skin cantilever bracket” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：托架間距 1.5 m、層高 3.6 m、腔深 0.9 m。外層 12 mm 玻璃約 30 kg/m²：1.5×3.6×30×9.81 ≈ 1.59 kN，力臂 0.9 m 彎矩 ≈ 1.43 kN·m；走道恆載 0.5 kPa 與維修活載 1.5 kPa 作用於 1.5×0.9 m²，合力 0.675 + 2.025 = 2.70 kN，力臂 0.45 m 彎矩 ≈ 1.22 kN·m；托架根部合計約 2.65 kN·m，另有 2.0 kPa 風壓造成的 10.8 kN 水平力。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With brackets at 1.5 m, 3.6 m storeys and a 0.9 m cavity: 12 mm outer glass at about 30 kg/m² gives 1.5×3.6×30×9.81 ≈ 1.59 kN, a moment of about 1.43 kN·m at 0.9 m; walkway dead load 0.5 kPa and maintenance live load 1.5 kPa on 1.5×0.9 m² give 0.675 + 2.025 = 2.70 kN, about 1.22 kN·m at 0.45 m; the bracket root sees about 2.65 kN·m in total, plus a 10.8 kN horizontal force from 2.0 kPa wind. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：托架與走道的結構計算須涵蓋恆載、維修活載、風壓與可能的人員墜落荷重組合，並確認根部連接、樓板邊緣錨栓與內層幕牆框料的承載；以樣品牆或原型托架做載重試驗，量測撓度與殘餘變形，並檢查走道格柵的防墜與防滑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Bracket and walkway calculations must cover combinations of dead load, maintenance live load, wind and any fall-arrest loads, and confirm the capacity of the root connection, slab-edge anchors and inner curtain-wall frames; load-test a mock-up or prototype bracket for deflection and residual set, and check the grating for fall protection and slip resistance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 托架間距 1.5 m、層高 3.6 m、腔深 0.9 m。外層 12 mm 玻璃約 30 kg/m²：1.5×3.6×30×9.81 ≈ 1.59 kN，力臂 0.9 m 彎矩 ≈ 1.43 kN·m；走道恆載 0.5 kPa 與維修活載 1.5 kPa 作用於 1.5×0.9 m²，合力 0.675 + 2.025 = 2.70 kN，力臂 0.45 m 彎矩 ≈ 1.22 kN·m；托架根部合計約 2.65 kN·m，另有 2.0 kPa 風壓造成的 10.8 kN 水平力。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With brackets at 1.5 m, 3.6 m storeys and a 0.9 m cavity: 12 mm outer glass at about 30 kg/m² gives 1.5×3.6×30×9.81 ≈ 1.59 kN, a moment of about 1.43 kN·m at 0.9 m; walkway dead load 0.5 kPa and maintenance live load 1.5 kPa on 1.5×0.9 m² give 0.675 + 2.025 = 2.70 kN, about 1.22 kN·m at 0.45 m; the bracket root sees about 2.65 kN·m in total, plus a 10.8 kN horizontal force from 2.0 kPa wind. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外層玻璃、托架與檢修走道結構」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Outer glass, brackets and maintenance-walkway structure", which statement holds?
options: 雙層幕牆是被動式設計，完工後不需要控制系統試運轉。
托架間距 1.5 m、層高 3.6 m、腔深 0.9 m。
雙層幕牆的外層玻璃可以擋住火焰，所以腔體不需要防火設計。
optionsEn: A double-skin façade is passive, so it needs no control commissioning after completion.
With brackets at 1.5 m, 3.6 m storeys and a 0.9 m cavity: 12 mm outer glass at about 30 kg/m² gives 1.5×3.6×30×9.81 ≈ 1.59 kN, a moment of about 1.43 kN·m at 0.9 m.
The outer glass of a double skin stops flames, so the cavity needs no fire design.
quiz.explanation: 托架間距 1.5 m、層高 3.6 m、腔深 0.9 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With brackets at 1.5 m, 3.6 m storeys and a 0.9 m cavity: 12 mm outer glass at about 30 kg/m² gives 1.5×3.6×30×9.81 ≈ 1.59 kN, a moment of about 1.43 kN·m at 0.9 m; walkway dead load 0.5 kPa and maintenance live load 1.5 kPa on 1.5×0.9 m² give 0.675 + 2.025 = 2.70 kN, about 1.22 kN·m at 0.45 m; the bracket root sees about 2.65 kN·m in total, plus a 10.8 kN horizontal force from 2.0 kPa wind. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外層玻璃、托架與檢修走道結構：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Outer glass, brackets and maintenance-walkway structure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「外層玻璃懸挑托架」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Outer-skin cantilever bracket” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 托架與走道的結構計算須涵蓋恆載、維修活載、風壓與可能的人員墜落荷重組合，並確認根部連接、樓板邊緣錨栓與內層幕牆框料的承載；以樣品牆或原型托架做載重試驗，量測撓度與殘餘變形，並檢查走道格柵的防墜與防滑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Bracket and walkway calculations must cover combinations of dead load, maintenance live load, wind and any fall-arrest loads, and confirm the capacity of the root connection, slab-edge anchors and inner curtain-wall frames; load-test a mock-up or prototype bracket for deflection and residual set, and check the grating for fall protection and slip resistance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：外層玻璃採膠合玻璃以防破裂墜落，托架與走道的設計荷重、防墜錨點與允許人數須標示在現場與維護手冊；托架穿越內層處的斷熱與防水細部須在樣品牆中驗證，經帷幕牆顧問核可後才可量產。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use laminated outer glass so broken glass does not fall, and post the design loads, fall-arrest anchors and permitted number of people for brackets and walkways on site and in the maintenance manual; thermal-break and waterproofing details where brackets cross the inner skin must be proven on the mock-up and approved by the façade consultant before production.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：托架只以玻璃自重設計而忽略檢修人員與工具荷重，維修時托架下垂、外層玻璃受扭而破裂；托架以鋼件直接穿過內層鋁框且未斷熱，冬季穿越點結露並生鏽漏水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Brackets designed only for glass weight, ignoring maintenance staff and tools, sag during cleaning and twist the outer glass until it breaks; steel brackets passing straight through aluminium inner frames without a thermal break condense at each penetration in winter, then rust and leak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 托架與走道的結構計算須涵蓋恆載、維修活載、風壓與可能的人員墜落荷重組合，並確認根部連接、樓板邊緣錨栓與內層幕牆框料的承載；以樣品牆或原型托架做載重試驗，量測撓度與殘餘變形，並檢查走道格柵的防墜與防滑。
knowledge.textEn: Bracket and walkway calculations must cover combinations of dead load, maintenance live load, wind and any fall-arrest loads, and confirm the capacity of the root connection, slab-edge anchors and inner curtain-wall frames; load-test a mock-up or prototype bracket for deflection and residual set, and check the grating for fall protection and slip resistance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 外層玻璃採膠合玻璃以防破裂墜落，托架與走道的設計荷重、防墜錨點與允許人數須標示在現場與維護手冊；托架穿越內層處的斷熱與防水細部須在樣品牆中驗證，經帷幕牆顧問核可後才可量產。
knowledge.textEn: Use laminated outer glass so broken glass does not fall, and post the design loads, fall-arrest anchors and permitted number of people for brackets and walkways on site and in the maintenance manual; thermal-break and waterproofing details where brackets cross the inner skin must be proven on the mock-up and approved by the façade consultant before production.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外層玻璃、托架與檢修走道結構」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Outer glass, brackets and maintenance-walkway structure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
雙層幕牆的節能效果在設計模擬時就已確定，完工後不需要驗證。
托架與走道的結構計算須涵蓋恆載、維修活載、風壓與可能的人員墜落荷重組合，並確認根部連接、樓板邊緣錨栓與內層幕牆框料的承載。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The energy savings of a double skin are fixed by the design simulation and need no verification after completion.

Bracket and walkway calculations must cover combinations of dead load, maintenance live load, wind and any fall-arrest loads, and confirm the capacity of the root connection, slab-edge anchors and inner curtain-wall frames.
quiz.explanation: 托架與走道的結構計算須涵蓋恆載、維修活載、風壓與可能的人員墜落荷重組合，並確認根部連接、樓板邊緣錨栓與內層幕牆框料的承載；以樣品牆或原型托架做載重試驗，量測撓度與殘餘變形，並檢查走道格柵的防墜與防滑。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Bracket and walkway calculations must cover combinations of dead load, maintenance live load, wind and any fall-arrest loads, and confirm the capacity of the root connection, slab-edge anchors and inner curtain-wall frames; load-test a mock-up or prototype bracket for deflection and residual set, and check the grating for fall protection and slip resistance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外層玻璃、托架與檢修走道結構：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outer glass, brackets and maintenance-walkway structure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「外層玻璃懸挑托架」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Outer-skin cantilever bracket” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 托架只以玻璃自重設計而忽略檢修人員與工具荷重，維修時托架下垂、外層玻璃受扭而破裂；托架以鋼件直接穿過內層鋁框且未斷熱，冬季穿越點結露並生鏽漏水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Brackets designed only for glass weight, ignoring maintenance staff and tools, sag during cleaning and twist the outer glass until it breaks; steel brackets passing straight through aluminium inner frames without a thermal break condense at each penetration in winter, then rust and leak. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：托架穿越內層的位置也是熱橋與漏水的弱點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Where brackets pass through the inner skin they are weak points for thermal bridging and leaks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外層玻璃有開口，所以幾乎不受風壓，可以用很薄的玻璃。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because the outer skin has openings, it sees almost no wind and can use very thin glass." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 托架只以玻璃自重設計而忽略檢修人員與工具荷重，維修時托架下垂、外層玻璃受扭而破裂；托架以鋼件直接穿過內層鋁框且未斷熱，冬季穿越點結露並生鏽漏水。
knowledge.textEn: Brackets designed only for glass weight, ignoring maintenance staff and tools, sag during cleaning and twist the outer glass until it breaks; steel brackets passing straight through aluminium inner frames without a thermal break condense at each penetration in winter, then rust and leak.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外層玻璃、托架與檢修走道結構」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outer glass, brackets and maintenance-walkway structure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 托架只以玻璃自重設計而忽略檢修人員與工具荷重，維修時托架下垂、外層玻璃受扭而破裂；托架以鋼件直接穿過內層鋁框且未斷熱，冬季穿越點結露並生鏽漏水。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
腔體開口只要外觀上夠大，通風量就足夠。
optionsEn: Brackets designed only for glass weight, ignoring maintenance staff and tools, sag during cleaning and twist the outer glass until it breaks.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If cavity openings look large enough, the airflow will be sufficient.
quiz.explanation: 托架只以玻璃自重設計而忽略檢修人員與工具荷重，維修時托架下垂、外層玻璃受扭而破裂；托架以鋼件直接穿過內層鋁框且未斷熱，冬季穿越點結露並生鏽漏水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Brackets designed only for glass weight, ignoring maintenance staff and tools, sag during cleaning and twist the outer glass until it breaks; steel brackets passing straight through aluminium inner frames without a thermal break condense at each penetration in winter, then rust and leak. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 開口、風門、遮陽與樓層分隔細部：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Openings, dampers, shading and floor-separation details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「進出風口與防蟲網」如何影響雙層通風幕牆整合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inlet, outlet and insect screens” governs force, deformation or durability in “Double-skin ventilated facade integration”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 腔體的性能最終由細部決定：進出風口的有效面積、百葉格柵與防蟲網造成的阻力、風門的密合度、遮陽百葉與玻璃之間的距離，以及每層或每數層的水平分隔。走廊式與箱窗式腔體在每層設水平分隔，可阻斷聲音、氣味與煙在樓層間傳遞，但限制了浮力高度；多樓層式腔體通風較強，卻必須以其他方式處理防火與隔音。倫敦聖瑪莉斧街 30 號的螺旋採光井每六層設防火隔斷，就是在通風效益與防火之間折衷的例子。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「進出風口與防蟲網」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cavity performance is ultimately decided by details: the effective area of inlets and outlets, the resistance of louvres and insect screens, the tightness of dampers, the spacing between blinds and glass, and horizontal divisions at every floor or every few floors. Corridor and box-window cavities divided at each floor stop sound, odours and smoke passing between floors but limit the buoyancy height; multi-storey cavities ventilate better but must deal with fire and acoustics in other ways. The spiralling light wells of 30 St Mary Axe in London, interrupted by fire breaks every sixth floor, are an example of compromise between ventilation benefit and fire safety. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Inlet, outlet and insect screens” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：所需有效開口 Cd·A = 0.3 m²，百葉格柵自由面積比 50%、流量係數 0.6：毛面積 = 0.3/(0.6×0.5) = 1.0 m²，在 3.0 m 寬的開間即需高約 0.33 m 的開口帶；加裝使自由面積再降至 60% 的防蟲網，毛面積增為 0.3/(0.6×0.5×0.6) ≈ 1.67 m²，約高 0.56 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a required effective opening Cd·A = 0.3 m² with a louvre free-area ratio of 50% and a discharge coefficient of 0.6, the gross area is 0.3/(0.6×0.5) = 1.0 m², an opening band about 0.33 m high across a 3.0 m bay; adding an insect screen that cuts free area to 60% raises the gross area to 0.3/(0.6×0.5×0.6) ≈ 1.67 m², about 0.56 m high.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「腔體開口只要外觀上夠大，通風量就足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If cavity openings look large enough, the airflow will be sufficient." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「進出風口與防蟲網」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Inlet, outlet and insect screens”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「開口、風門、遮陽與樓層分隔細部」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Openings, dampers, shading and floor-separation details" is correct?
options: 腔體開口只要外觀上夠大，通風量就足夠。
腔體的性能最終由細部決定：進出風口的有效面積、百葉格柵與防蟲網造成的阻力、風門的密合度、遮陽百葉與玻璃之間的距離，以及每層或每數層的水平分隔。

steps.title: 開口、風門、遮陽與樓層分隔細部：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Openings, dampers, shading and floor-separation details: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「進出風口與防蟲網」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inlet, outlet and insect screens” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：所需有效開口 Cd·A = 0.3 m²，百葉格柵自由面積比 50%、流量係數 0.6：毛面積 = 0.3/(0.6×0.5) = 1.0 m²，在 3.0 m 寬的開間即需高約 0.33 m 的開口帶；加裝使自由面積再降至 60% 的防蟲網，毛面積增為 0.3/(0.6×0.5×0.6) ≈ 1.67 m²，約高 0.56 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a required effective opening Cd·A = 0.3 m² with a louvre free-area ratio of 50% and a discharge coefficient of 0.6, the gross area is 0.3/(0.6×0.5) = 1.0 m², an opening band about 0.33 m high across a 3.0 m bay; adding an insect screen that cuts free area to 60% raises the gross area to 0.3/(0.6×0.5×0.6) ≈ 1.67 m², about 0.56 m high. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以廠商試驗的百葉與防蟲網壓損資料計算實際有效面積，並在樣品牆中量測開口處風速；水平分隔須確認材料耐火時效、與內外兩層的接合密封，以及檢修人員通過時的開閉方式；遮陽百葉與玻璃的距離須檢查熱應力與百葉擺動碰撞。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate actual effective area from the manufacturer's tested pressure-loss data for louvres and insect screens, and measure air speed at openings on the mock-up; for horizontal divisions confirm fire rating, seals to both skins and how they open for maintenance staff to pass; check blind-to-glass spacing for thermal stress and blind swing contact.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 所需有效開口 Cd·A = 0.3 m²，百葉格柵自由面積比 50%、流量係數 0.6：毛面積 = 0.3/(0.6×0.5) = 1.0 m²，在 3.0 m 寬的開間即需高約 0.33 m 的開口帶；加裝使自由面積再降至 60% 的防蟲網，毛面積增為 0.3/(0.6×0.5×0.6) ≈ 1.67 m²，約高 0.56 m。數值為教學假設。

Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「開口、風門、遮陽與樓層分隔細部」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Openings, dampers, shading and floor-separation details", which statement holds?

腔體位於室內外之間受到保護，不需要定期清潔與檢查。

optionsEn: One temperature reading represents the whole cavity.
The cavity is sheltered between inside and outside, so it needs no regular cleaning or inspection.

For a required effective opening Cd·A = 0.3 m² with a louvre free-area ratio of 50% and a discharge coefficient of 0.6, the gross area is 0.3/(0.6×0.5) = 1.0 m², an opening band about 0.33 m high across a 3.0 m bay.
