steps.title: 開口、風門、遮陽與樓層分隔細部：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Openings, dampers, shading and floor-separation details: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「進出風口與防蟲網」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inlet, outlet and insect screens” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以廠商試驗的百葉與防蟲網壓損資料計算實際有效面積，並在樣品牆中量測開口處風速；水平分隔須確認材料耐火時效、與內外兩層的接合密封，以及檢修人員通過時的開閉方式；遮陽百葉與玻璃的距離須檢查熱應力與百葉擺動碰撞。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate actual effective area from the manufacturer's tested pressure-loss data for louvres and insect screens, and measure air speed at openings on the mock-up; for horizontal divisions confirm fire rating, seals to both skins and how they open for maintenance staff to pass; check blind-to-glass spacing for thermal stress and blind swing contact. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：開口與防蟲網要設計成可從腔體內安全拆卸清潔，並在維護手冊列出清潔週期與壓損檢查方法；樓層水平分隔的位置與耐火時效須由防火工程師與帷幕牆顧問共同確認，並經主管機關審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design openings and insect screens to be removed and cleaned safely from inside the cavity, and list the cleaning interval and pressure-loss check in the maintenance manual; positions and fire ratings of horizontal divisions must be agreed by the fire engineer and façade consultant and reviewed by the authority.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：設計時以開口毛面積計算風量，加上百葉與防蟲網後實際有效面積只剩三成，腔體長期過熱；防蟲網積塵或被鳥巢堵塞後風量再降，而沒有人知道要清理。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calculating airflow from gross opening area means that louvres and insect screens leave only about a third of the effective area and the cavity overheats chronically; once screens clog with dust or bird nests, airflow falls further and nobody knows they need cleaning. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以廠商試驗的百葉與防蟲網壓損資料計算實際有效面積，並在樣品牆中量測開口處風速；水平分隔須確認材料耐火時效、與內外兩層的接合密封，以及檢修人員通過時的開閉方式；遮陽百葉與玻璃的距離須檢查熱應力與百葉擺動碰撞。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate actual effective area from the manufacturer's tested pressure-loss data for louvres and insect screens, and measure air speed at openings on the mock-up; for horizontal divisions confirm fire rating, seals to both skins and how they open for maintenance staff to pass; check blind-to-glass spacing for thermal stress and blind swing contact.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 開口與防蟲網要設計成可從腔體內安全拆卸清潔，並在維護手冊列出清潔週期與壓損檢查方法；樓層水平分隔的位置與耐火時效須由防火工程師與帷幕牆顧問共同確認，並經主管機關審查。
knowledge.textEn: Design openings and insect screens to be removed and cleaned safely from inside the cavity, and list the cleaning interval and pressure-loss check in the maintenance manual; positions and fire ratings of horizontal divisions must be agreed by the fire engineer and façade consultant and reviewed by the authority.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開口、風門、遮陽與樓層分隔細部」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Openings, dampers, shading and floor-separation details"?
options: 以廠商試驗的百葉與防蟲網壓損資料計算實際有效面積，並在樣品牆中量測開口處風速。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
多加一層玻璃一定能減少建築的空調耗能。
optionsEn: Calculate actual effective area from the manufacturer's tested pressure-loss data for louvres and insect screens, and measure air speed at openings on the mock-up.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adding a second layer of glass always reduces air-conditioning energy.
quiz.explanation: 以廠商試驗的百葉與防蟲網壓損資料計算實際有效面積，並在樣品牆中量測開口處風速；水平分隔須確認材料耐火時效、與內外兩層的接合密封，以及檢修人員通過時的開閉方式；遮陽百葉與玻璃的距離須檢查熱應力與百葉擺動碰撞。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calculate actual effective area from the manufacturer's tested pressure-loss data for louvres and insect screens, and measure air speed at openings on the mock-up; for horizontal divisions confirm fire rating, seals to both skins and how they open for maintenance staff to pass; check blind-to-glass spacing for thermal stress and blind swing contact. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 開口、風門、遮陽與樓層分隔細部：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Openings, dampers, shading and floor-separation details: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「進出風口與防蟲網」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inlet, outlet and insect screens” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 設計時以開口毛面積計算風量，加上百葉與防蟲網後實際有效面積只剩三成，腔體長期過熱；防蟲網積塵或被鳥巢堵塞後風量再降，而沒有人知道要清理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calculating airflow from gross opening area means that louvres and insect screens leave only about a third of the effective area and the cavity overheats chronically; once screens clog with dust or bird nests, airflow falls further and nobody knows they need cleaning. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：倫敦聖瑪莉斧街 30 號的螺旋採光井每六層設防火隔斷，就是在通風效益與防火之間折衷的例子。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The spiralling light wells of 30 St Mary Axe in London, interrupted by fire breaks every sixth floor, are an example of compromise between ventilation benefit and fire safety.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「腔體開口只要外觀上夠大，通風量就足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If cavity openings look large enough, the airflow will be sufficient." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 設計時以開口毛面積計算風量，加上百葉與防蟲網後實際有效面積只剩三成，腔體長期過熱；防蟲網積塵或被鳥巢堵塞後風量再降，而沒有人知道要清理。
knowledge.textEn: Calculating airflow from gross opening area means that louvres and insect screens leave only about a third of the effective area and the cavity overheats chronically; once screens clog with dust or bird nests, airflow falls further and nobody knows they need cleaning.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開口、風門、遮陽與樓層分隔細部」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Openings, dampers, shading and floor-separation details" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
設計時以開口毛面積計算風量，加上百葉與防蟲網後實際有效面積只剩三成，腔體長期過熱；防蟲網積塵或被鳥巢堵塞後風量再降，而沒有人知道要清理。
雙層幕牆只是把一般帷幕牆多做一層，施工程序不需要改變。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Calculating airflow from gross opening area means that louvres and insect screens leave only about a third of the effective area and the cavity overheats chronically.
A double-skin façade is just an ordinary curtain wall with one more layer, so the construction process need not change.
quiz.explanation: 設計時以開口毛面積計算風量，加上百葉與防蟲網後實際有效面積只剩三成，腔體長期過熱；防蟲網積塵或被鳥巢堵塞後風量再降，而沒有人知道要清理。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calculating airflow from gross opening area means that louvres and insect screens leave only about a third of the effective area and the cavity overheats chronically; once screens clog with dust or bird nests, airflow falls further and nobody knows they need cleaning. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙層單元的預組、吊裝與施工整合」與「控制系統整合與試運轉」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Prefabrication, lifting and construction integration of double-skin units" and "Control-system integration and commissioning": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙層單元的預組、吊裝與施工整合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Prefabrication, lifting and construction integration of double-skin units: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預組箱窗單元」如何影響雙層通風幕牆整合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Prefabricated box-window unit” governs force, deformation or durability in “Double-skin ventilated facade integration”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙層幕牆可以分別安裝內層與外層，也可以在工廠把內外兩層、腔體百葉與風門組成一個箱窗單元整體吊裝。整體單元減少現場工序與腔體汙染，但重量與尺寸明顯增加，吊裝設備、樓層運輸與錨件都要重新檢討；分開安裝則需要協調兩組工班與托架的施工順序，並在外層封閉前完成腔體內所有電線、馬達與感測器。無論哪一種，腔體一旦封閉，任何遺漏的接線或碎屑都很難處理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預組箱窗單元」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A double-skin façade can be installed as separate inner and outer layers, or factory-assembled with both skins, cavity blinds and dampers into box-window units lifted as one piece. Complete units reduce site operations and cavity contamination but are much heavier and larger, so lifting equipment, floor logistics and anchors must be reconsidered; separate installation requires coordinating two crews and the bracket sequence, and completing every cable, motor and sensor in the cavity before the outer skin closes. Either way, once the cavity is closed, any missed wiring or debris is hard to deal with. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Prefabricated box-window unit” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：3.0×3.6 m = 10.8 m² 單元：單層幕牆約 60 kg/m²，重約 648 kg；雙層箱窗單元（內層 50、外層玻璃 30、框架與百葉 25 kg/m²）約 105 kg/m²，重約 1,134 kg，為單層的 1.75 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 3.0×3.6 m = 10.8 m² unit: a single skin at about 60 kg/m² weighs about 648 kg; a box-window double-skin unit (inner 50, outer glass 30, frame and blinds 25 kg/m²) at about 105 kg/m² weighs about 1,134 kg, 1.75 times as much.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙層幕牆只是把一般帷幕牆多做一層，施工程序不需要改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A double-skin façade is just an ordinary curtain wall with one more layer, so the construction process need not change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預組箱窗單元」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Prefabricated box-window unit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雙層單元的預組、吊裝與施工整合
knowledge.titleEn: Prefabrication, lifting and construction integration of double-skin units
knowledge.text: 雙層幕牆可以分別安裝內層與外層，也可以在工廠把內外兩層、腔體百葉與風門組成一個箱窗單元整體吊裝。整體單元減少現場工序與腔體汙染，但重量與尺寸明顯增加，吊裝設備、樓層運輸與錨件都要重新檢討；分開安裝則需要協調兩組工班與托架的施工順序，並在外層封閉前完成腔體內所有電線、馬達與感測器。
knowledge.textEn: A double-skin façade can be installed as separate inner and outer layers, or factory-assembled with both skins, cavity blinds and dampers into box-window units lifted as one piece. Complete units reduce site operations and cavity contamination but are much heavier and larger, so lifting equipment, floor logistics and anchors must be reconsidered; separate installation requires coordinating two crews and the bracket sequence, and completing every cable, motor and sensor in the cavity before the outer skin closes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雙層幕牆只是把一般帷幕牆多做一層，施工程序不需要改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A double-skin façade is just an ordinary curtain wall with one more layer, so the construction process need not change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙層單元的預組、吊裝與施工整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Prefabrication, lifting and construction integration of double-skin units" is correct?
options: 雙層幕牆只是把一般帷幕牆多做一層，施工程序不需要改變。
雙層幕牆是被動式設計，完工後不需要控制系統試運轉。
雙層幕牆可以分別安裝內層與外層，也可以在工廠把內外兩層、腔體百葉與風門組成一個箱窗單元整體吊裝。
optionsEn: A double-skin façade is just an ordinary curtain wall with one more layer, so the construction process need not change.
A double-skin façade is passive, so it needs no control commissioning after completion.
A double-skin façade can be installed as separate inner and outer layers, or factory-assembled with both skins, cavity blinds and dampers into box-window units lifted as one piece.
quiz.explanation: 雙層幕牆可以分別安裝內層與外層，也可以在工廠把內外兩層、腔體百葉與風門組成一個箱窗單元整體吊裝。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A double-skin façade can be installed as separate inner and outer layers, or factory-assembled with both skins, cavity blinds and dampers into box-window units lifted as one piece. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雙層單元的預組、吊裝與施工整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Prefabrication, lifting and construction integration of double-skin units: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預組箱窗單元」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Prefabricated box-window unit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：3.0×3.6 m = 10.8 m² 單元：單層幕牆約 60 kg/m²，重約 648 kg；雙層箱窗單元（內層 50、外層玻璃 30、框架與百葉 25 kg/m²）約 105 kg/m²，重約 1,134 kg，為單層的 1.75 倍。若塔吊在該半徑額定 1.5 t、吊具 0.2 t，餘裕約 0.17 t。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 3.0×3.6 m = 10.8 m² unit: a single skin at about 60 kg/m² weighs about 648 kg; a box-window double-skin unit (inner 50, outer glass 30, frame and blinds 25 kg/m²) at about 105 kg/m² weighs about 1,134 kg, 1.75 times as much. With a 1.5 t crane rating at that radius and 0.2 t of rigging, about 0.17 t of margin remains. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較整體單元與分開安裝的吊裝重量、錨件反力、樓層暫存荷重與工期；外層封閉前設腔體檢查停止點，逐格確認百葉、馬達、感測器與線路已安裝並通電測試，腔體清潔無碎屑，並拍照紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare complete-unit and separate installation for lifting weight, anchor reactions, floor storage loads and programme; set a cavity hold point before the outer skin closes, confirming bay by bay that blinds, motors, sensors and wiring are installed and power-tested and that the cavity is clean, with photographs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 3.0×3.6 m = 10.8 m² 單元：單層幕牆約 60 kg/m²，重約 648 kg；雙層箱窗單元（內層 50、外層玻璃 30、框架與百葉 25 kg/m²）約 105 kg/m²，重約 1,134 kg，為單層的 1.75 倍。若塔吊在該半徑額定 1.5 t、吊具 0.2 t，餘裕約 0.17 t。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 3.0×3.6 m = 10.8 m² unit: a single skin at about 60 kg/m² weighs about 648 kg; a box-window double-skin unit (inner 50, outer glass 30, frame and blinds 25 kg/m²) at about 105 kg/m² weighs about 1,134 kg, 1.75 times as much. With a 1.5 t crane rating at that radius and 0.2 t of rigging, about 0.17 t of margin remains. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙層單元的預組、吊裝與施工整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Prefabrication, lifting and construction integration of double-skin units", which statement holds?
options: 3.0×3.6 m = 10.8 m² 單元：單層幕牆約 60 kg/m²，重約 648 kg。
雙層幕牆的外層玻璃可以擋住火焰，所以腔體不需要防火設計。
雙層幕牆的節能效果在設計模擬時就已確定，完工後不需要驗證。
optionsEn: For a 3.0×3.6 m = 10.8 m² unit: a single skin at about 60 kg/m² weighs about 648 kg.
The outer glass of a double skin stops flames, so the cavity needs no fire design.
The energy savings of a double skin are fixed by the design simulation and need no verification after completion.
quiz.explanation: 3.0×3.6 m = 10.8 m² 單元：單層幕牆約 60 kg/m²，重約 648 kg；雙層箱窗單元（內層 50、外層玻璃 30、框架與百葉 25 kg/m²）約 105 kg/m²，重約 1,134 kg，為單層的 1.75 倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 3.0×3.6 m = 10.8 m² unit: a single skin at about 60 kg/m² weighs about 648 kg; a box-window double-skin unit (inner 50, outer glass 30, frame and blinds 25 kg/m²) at about 105 kg/m² weighs about 1,134 kg, 1.75 times as much. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙層單元的預組、吊裝與施工整合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Prefabrication, lifting and construction integration of double-skin units: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預組箱窗單元」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Prefabricated box-window unit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較整體單元與分開安裝的吊裝重量、錨件反力、樓層暫存荷重與工期；外層封閉前設腔體檢查停止點，逐格確認百葉、馬達、感測器與線路已安裝並通電測試，腔體清潔無碎屑，並拍照紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare complete-unit and separate installation for lifting weight, anchor reactions, floor storage loads and programme; set a cavity hold point before the outer skin closes, confirming bay by bay that blinds, motors, sensors and wiring are installed and power-tested and that the cavity is clean, with photographs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫要明確劃分帷幕牆、機電與自動控制承包商在腔體內的工作界面與順序，以「腔體封閉許可」作為停止點，由三方與監造共同簽認；吊裝重量增加時須重新核算塔吊、樓板與錨件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction plan must define the cavity work interfaces and sequence between façade, MEP and controls contractors, with a cavity-closure permit as a hold point signed by all three and the supervising engineer; heavier lifts require cranes, slabs and anchors to be re-checked.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：外層玻璃安裝完畢後才發現某些樓層的百葉馬達線路未接，只能拆除外層玻璃重來；腔體封閉前未清除施工粉塵與碎屑，完工後百葉卡死、感測器失準，玻璃內側也留下難以清潔的汙漬。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Finding after the outer glass is installed that blind motors on some floors were never wired means removing the outer glass and starting again; failing to clear construction dust and debris before closure leaves blinds jamming, sensors drifting and stains on inner glass faces that are hard to clean. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較整體單元與分開安裝的吊裝重量、錨件反力、樓層暫存荷重與工期；外層封閉前設腔體檢查停止點，逐格確認百葉、馬達、感測器與線路已安裝並通電測試，腔體清潔無碎屑，並拍照紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Compare complete-unit and separate installation for lifting weight, anchor reactions, floor storage loads and programme; set a cavity hold point before the outer skin closes, confirming bay by bay that blinds, motors, sensors and wiring are installed and power-tested and that the cavity is clean, with photographs.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫要明確劃分帷幕牆、機電與自動控制承包商在腔體內的工作界面與順序，以「腔體封閉許可」作為停止點，由三方與監造共同簽認；吊裝重量增加時須重新核算塔吊、樓板與錨件。
knowledge.textEn: The construction plan must define the cavity work interfaces and sequence between façade, MEP and controls contractors, with a cavity-closure permit as a hold point signed by all three and the supervising engineer; heavier lifts require cranes, slabs and anchors to be re-checked.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙層單元的預組、吊裝與施工整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Prefabrication, lifting and construction integration of double-skin units"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
比較整體單元與分開安裝的吊裝重量、錨件反力、樓層暫存荷重與工期。
雙層幕牆的腔體只要夠高，空氣就一定會由下往上流動。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare complete-unit and separate installation for lifting weight, anchor reactions, floor storage loads and programme.
If the cavity is tall enough, air will always flow upward through it.
quiz.explanation: 比較整體單元與分開安裝的吊裝重量、錨件反力、樓層暫存荷重與工期；外層封閉前設腔體檢查停止點，逐格確認百葉、馬達、感測器與線路已安裝並通電測試，腔體清潔無碎屑，並拍照紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare complete-unit and separate installation for lifting weight, anchor reactions, floor storage loads and programme; set a cavity hold point before the outer skin closes, confirming bay by bay that blinds, motors, sensors and wiring are installed and power-tested and that the cavity is clean, with photographs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙層單元的預組、吊裝與施工整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Prefabrication, lifting and construction integration of double-skin units: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預組箱窗單元」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Prefabricated box-window unit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 外層玻璃安裝完畢後才發現某些樓層的百葉馬達線路未接，只能拆除外層玻璃重來；腔體封閉前未清除施工粉塵與碎屑，完工後百葉卡死、感測器失準，玻璃內側也留下難以清潔的汙漬。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Finding after the outer glass is installed that blind motors on some floors were never wired means removing the outer glass and starting again; failing to clear construction dust and debris before closure leaves blinds jamming, sensors drifting and stains on inner glass faces that are hard to clean. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：無論哪一種，腔體一旦封閉，任何遺漏的接線或碎屑都很難處理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Either way, once the cavity is closed, any missed wiring or debris is hard to deal with.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雙層幕牆只是把一般帷幕牆多做一層，施工程序不需要改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A double-skin façade is just an ordinary curtain wall with one more layer, so the construction process need not change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 外層玻璃安裝完畢後才發現某些樓層的百葉馬達線路未接，只能拆除外層玻璃重來；腔體封閉前未清除施工粉塵與碎屑，完工後百葉卡死、感測器失準，玻璃內側也留下難以清潔的汙漬。
knowledge.textEn: Finding after the outer glass is installed that blind motors on some floors were never wired means removing the outer glass and starting again; failing to clear construction dust and debris before closure leaves blinds jamming, sensors drifting and stains on inner glass faces that are hard to clean.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙層單元的預組、吊裝與施工整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Prefabrication, lifting and construction integration of double-skin units" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
雙層幕牆是被動式設計，完工後不需要控制系統試運轉。
外層玻璃安裝完畢後才發現某些樓層的百葉馬達線路未接，只能拆除外層玻璃重來。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A double-skin façade is passive, so it needs no control commissioning after completion.
Finding after the outer glass is installed that blind motors on some floors were never wired means removing the outer glass and starting again.
quiz.explanation: 外層玻璃安裝完畢後才發現某些樓層的百葉馬達線路未接，只能拆除外層玻璃重來；腔體封閉前未清除施工粉塵與碎屑，完工後百葉卡死、感測器失準，玻璃內側也留下難以清潔的汙漬。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Finding after the outer glass is installed that blind motors on some floors were never wired means removing the outer glass and starting again; failing to clear construction dust and debris before closure leaves blinds jamming, sensors drifting and stains on inner glass faces that are hard to clean. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 控制系統整合與試運轉：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Control-system integration and commissioning: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「風門百葉控制點」如何影響雙層通風幕牆整合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Damper and blind control points” governs force, deformation or durability in “Double-skin ventilated facade integration”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙層幕牆是一個需要「操作」的立面：風門開度、百葉角度、內層窗戶與空調系統必須依日射、室外溫度、風速、雨量與腔體溫度協同動作。曼尼托巴水電大樓的東西向雙層立面內外兩層都設可開啟窗，配合中庭與太陽能煙囪通風，就仰賴建築自動化系統整合。控制邏輯若只在設計說明中描述而未經實際試運轉，常出現感測器位置不當、指令衝突或手動覆寫後無法回復等問題，使立面長期停在不利的狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「風門百葉控制點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A double-skin façade has to be operated: damper positions, blind angles, inner windows and HVAC must act together according to irradiance, outdoor temperature, wind speed, rain and cavity temperature. Manitoba Hydro Place, with operable windows in both layers of its east and west double façades working with atria and a solar chimney, relies on building-automation integration in exactly this way. Control logic described in a design report but never commissioned often suffers from poorly sited sensors, conflicting commands or manual overrides that never reset, leaving the façade stuck in an unfavourable state for years. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Damper and blind control points” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：60 層、每層 40 個開間，每開間 2 個風門與 1 個百葉馬達：致動器 60×40×3 = 7,200 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 60 floors, 40 bays per floor and 2 dampers plus 1 blind motor per bay, there are 60×40×3 = 7,200 actuators.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙層幕牆是被動式設計，完工後不需要控制系統試運轉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A double-skin façade is passive, so it needs no control commissioning after completion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「風門百葉控制點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Damper and blind control points”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制系統整合與試運轉
knowledge.text: 雙層幕牆是一個需要「操作」的立面：風門開度、百葉角度、內層窗戶與空調系統必須依日射、室外溫度、風速、雨量與腔體溫度協同動作。曼尼托巴水電大樓的東西向雙層立面內外兩層都設可開啟窗，配合中庭與太陽能煙囪通風，就仰賴建築自動化系統整合。
knowledge.textEn: A double-skin façade has to be operated: damper positions, blind angles, inner windows and HVAC must act together according to irradiance, outdoor temperature, wind speed, rain and cavity temperature. Manitoba Hydro Place, with operable windows in both layers of its east and west double façades working with atria and a solar chimney, relies on building-automation integration in exactly this way.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雙層幕牆是被動式設計，完工後不需要控制系統試運轉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A double-skin façade is passive, so it needs no control commissioning after completion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制系統整合與試運轉」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control-system integration and commissioning" is correct?
options: 雙層幕牆是一個需要「操作」的立面：風門開度、百葉角度、內層窗戶與空調系統必須依日射、室外溫度、風速、雨量與腔體溫度協同動作。
雙層幕牆是被動式設計，完工後不需要控制系統試運轉。
腔體溫度只要量一個點就能代表整個腔體。
optionsEn: A double-skin façade has to be operated: damper positions, blind angles, inner windows and HVAC must act together according to irradiance, outdoor temperature, wind speed, rain and cavity temperature.
A double-skin façade is passive, so it needs no control commissioning after completion.
One temperature reading represents the whole cavity.
quiz.explanation: 雙層幕牆是一個需要「操作」的立面：風門開度、百葉角度、內層窗戶與空調系統必須依日射、室外溫度、風速、雨量與腔體溫度協同動作。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A double-skin façade has to be operated: damper positions, blind angles, inner windows and HVAC must act together according to irradiance, outdoor temperature, wind speed, rain and cavity temperature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制系統整合與試運轉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control-system integration and commissioning: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風門百葉控制點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Damper and blind control points” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：60 層、每層 40 個開間，每開間 2 個風門與 1 個百葉馬達：致動器 60×40×3 = 7,200 個。若試運轉每日完成 150 個點的逐點測試，需 7,200/150 = 48 個工作天；若每點須加做一次功能測試，約需 96 天。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 60 floors, 40 bays per floor and 2 dampers plus 1 blind motor per bay, there are 60×40×3 = 7,200 actuators. At 150 point-to-point tests per day, commissioning takes 7,200/150 = 48 working days; adding one functional test per point brings it to about 96 days. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試運轉分三層：逐點測試（每個致動器與感測器的接線、方向與回饋）、功能測試（依控制邏輯模擬日射、強風、降雨與火警情境）與季節性測試（夏冬各一次實際運轉後檢討趨勢資料）；每項由試運轉顧問見證並記錄缺失與改正。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Commission in three levels: point-to-point tests of each actuator and sensor's wiring, direction and feedback; functional tests simulating irradiance, high wind, rain and fire-alarm scenarios against the control logic; and seasonal tests reviewing trend data after real operation in summer and winter.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 60 層、每層 40 個開間，每開間 2 個風門與 1 個百葉馬達：致動器 60×40×3 = 7,200 個。若試運轉每日完成 150 個點的逐點測試，需 7,200/150 = 48 個工作天；若每點須加做一次功能測試，約需 96 天。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 60 floors, 40 bays per floor and 2 dampers plus 1 blind motor per bay, there are 60×40×3 = 7,200 actuators. At 150 point-to-point tests per day, commissioning takes 7,200/150 = 48 working days; adding one functional test per point brings it to about 96 days. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制系統整合與試運轉」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control-system integration and commissioning", which statement holds?
options: 腔體位於室內外之間受到保護，不需要定期清潔與檢查。
60 層、每層 40 個開間，每開間 2 個風門與 1 個百葉馬達：致動器 60×40×3 = 7,200 個。
多加一層玻璃一定能減少建築的空調耗能。
optionsEn: The cavity is sheltered between inside and outside, so it needs no regular cleaning or inspection.
With 60 floors, 40 bays per floor and 2 dampers plus 1 blind motor per bay, there are 60×40×3 = 7,200 actuators.
Adding a second layer of glass always reduces air-conditioning energy.
quiz.explanation: 60 層、每層 40 個開間，每開間 2 個風門與 1 個百葉馬達：致動器 60×40×3 = 7,200 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 60 floors, 40 bays per floor and 2 dampers plus 1 blind motor per bay, there are 60×40×3 = 7,200 actuators. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制系統整合與試運轉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control-system integration and commissioning: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風門百葉控制點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Damper and blind control points” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試運轉分三層：逐點測試（每個致動器與感測器的接線、方向與回饋）、功能測試（依控制邏輯模擬日射、強風、降雨與火警情境）與季節性測試（夏冬各一次實際運轉後檢討趨勢資料）；每項由試運轉顧問見證並記錄缺失與改正。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Commission in three levels: point-to-point tests of each actuator and sensor's wiring, direction and feedback; functional tests simulating irradiance, high wind, rain and fire-alarm scenarios against the control logic; and seasonal tests reviewing trend data after real operation in summer and winter. A commissioning authority witnesses each step and logs defects and corrections. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：控制邏輯應以表格列出每個情境的感測條件、致動器動作、優先順序與手動覆寫的自動回復時間；火警時的腔體狀態必須由防火工程師訂定並納入消防聯動測試，未完成者不得取得使用許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Tabulate the control logic for each scenario with sensing conditions, actuator actions, priorities and automatic reset time after manual override; the cavity state on fire alarm must be set by the fire engineer and included in fire-system interface testing, without which occupancy should not be granted.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：雨量感測器裝在被遮蔽的位置，降雨時風門仍保持開啟而讓雨水進入腔體；火警時控制系統未把腔體風門切換到預定狀態，煙在腔體內擴散到上方樓層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A rain sensor mounted in a sheltered spot keeps dampers open during rain so water enters the cavity; on a fire alarm the control system fails to move cavity dampers to their preset state and smoke spreads up the cavity; frequent manual overrides of blinds by occupants leave the system without overall coordination. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試運轉分三層：逐點測試（每個致動器與感測器的接線、方向與回饋）、功能測試（依控制邏輯模擬日射、強風、降雨與火警情境）與季節性測試（夏冬各一次實際運轉後檢討趨勢資料）；每項由試運轉顧問見證並記錄缺失與改正。
knowledge.textEn: Commission in three levels: point-to-point tests of each actuator and sensor's wiring, direction and feedback; functional tests simulating irradiance, high wind, rain and fire-alarm scenarios against the control logic; and seasonal tests reviewing trend data after real operation in summer and winter. A commissioning authority witnesses each step and logs defects and corrections.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 控制邏輯應以表格列出每個情境的感測條件、致動器動作、優先順序與手動覆寫的自動回復時間；火警時的腔體狀態必須由防火工程師訂定並納入消防聯動測試，未完成者不得取得使用許可。
knowledge.textEn: Tabulate the control logic for each scenario with sensing conditions, actuator actions, priorities and automatic reset time after manual override; the cavity state on fire alarm must be set by the fire engineer and included in fire-system interface testing, without which occupancy should not be granted.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制系統整合與試運轉」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control-system integration and commissioning"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
外層玻璃有開口，所以幾乎不受風壓，可以用很薄的玻璃。
試運轉分三層：逐點測試（每個致動器與感測器的接線、方向與回饋）、功能測試（依控制邏輯模擬日射、強風、降雨與火警情境）與季節性測試（夏冬各一次實際運轉後檢討趨勢資料）。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Because the outer skin has openings, it sees almost no wind and can use very thin glass.
Commission in three levels: point-to-point tests of each actuator and sensor's wiring, direction and feedback.
quiz.explanation: 試運轉分三層：逐點測試（每個致動器與感測器的接線、方向與回饋）、功能測試（依控制邏輯模擬日射、強風、降雨與火警情境）與季節性測試（夏冬各一次實際運轉後檢討趨勢資料）；每項由試運轉顧問見證並記錄缺失與改正。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Commission in three levels: point-to-point tests of each actuator and sensor's wiring, direction and feedback; functional tests simulating irradiance, high wind, rain and fire-alarm scenarios against the control logic; and seasonal tests reviewing trend data after real operation in summer and winter. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制系統整合與試運轉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control-system integration and commissioning: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風門百葉控制點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Damper and blind control points” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 雨量感測器裝在被遮蔽的位置，降雨時風門仍保持開啟而讓雨水進入腔體；火警時控制系統未把腔體風門切換到預定狀態，煙在腔體內擴散到上方樓層。使用者頻繁手動覆寫百葉後，系統失去整體協調。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A rain sensor mounted in a sheltered spot keeps dampers open during rain so water enters the cavity; on a fire alarm the control system fails to move cavity dampers to their preset state and smoke spreads up the cavity; frequent manual overrides of blinds by occupants leave the system without overall coordination. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：控制邏輯若只在設計說明中描述而未經實際試運轉，常出現感測器位置不當、指令衝突或手動覆寫後無法回復等問題，使立面長期停在不利的狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Control logic described in a design report but never commissioned often suffers from poorly sited sensors, conflicting commands or manual overrides that never reset, leaving the façade stuck in an unfavourable state for years.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雙層幕牆是被動式設計，完工後不需要控制系統試運轉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A double-skin façade is passive, so it needs no control commissioning after completion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 雨量感測器裝在被遮蔽的位置，降雨時風門仍保持開啟而讓雨水進入腔體；火警時控制系統未把腔體風門切換到預定狀態，煙在腔體內擴散到上方樓層。使用者頻繁手動覆寫百葉後，系統失去整體協調。
knowledge.textEn: A rain sensor mounted in a sheltered spot keeps dampers open during rain so water enters the cavity; on a fire alarm the control system fails to move cavity dampers to their preset state and smoke spreads up the cavity; frequent manual overrides of blinds by occupants leave the system without overall coordination.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制系統整合與試運轉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control-system integration and commissioning" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 雨量感測器裝在被遮蔽的位置，降雨時風門仍保持開啟而讓雨水進入腔體；火警時控制系統未把腔體風門切換到預定狀態，煙在腔體內擴散到上方樓層。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
腔體溫度只要量一個點就能代表整個腔體。
optionsEn: A rain sensor mounted in a sheltered spot keeps dampers open during rain so water enters the cavity.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
One temperature reading represents the whole cavity.
quiz.explanation: 雨量感測器裝在被遮蔽的位置，降雨時風門仍保持開啟而讓雨水進入腔體；火警時控制系統未把腔體風門切換到預定狀態，煙在腔體內擴散到上方樓層。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A rain sensor mounted in a sheltered spot keeps dampers open during rain so water enters the cavity; on a fire alarm the control system fails to move cavity dampers to their preset state and smoke spreads up the cavity; frequent manual overrides of blinds by occupants leave the system without overall coordination. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「樣品牆與實建築的熱流量測」與「腔體煙流、防火分隔與消防驗證」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building" and "Cavity smoke flow, fire separation and fire-safety verification": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 樣品牆與實建築的熱流量測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「腔體溫度與風速量測」如何影響雙層通風幕牆整合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cavity temperature and air-speed survey” governs force, deformation or durability in “Double-skin ventilated facade integration”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 腔體性能無法只靠計算保證，需要在實尺寸樣品牆或完工建築上量測：在腔體不同高度布設遮光溫度計、風速計與日射計，同時量測內層玻璃表面溫度與通過內層的熱通量。由進出風口的風量與溫差可以算出腔體帶走的熱量，再與吸收的日射熱比較，檢查能量平衡是否閉合；若差異很大，代表量測位置、百葉吸收率或滲漏假設有問題。這些資料也是校正控制邏輯與能耗模型的基礎。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「腔體溫度與風速量測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cavity performance cannot be guaranteed by calculation alone; it must be measured on a full-size mock-up or the completed building. Shielded thermometers, anemometers and pyranometers are placed at several heights in the cavity, while inner-glass surface temperature and heat flux through the inner skin are measured. Airflow and temperature difference across inlets and outlets give the heat removed by the cavity, which is compared with absorbed solar gain to check whether the energy balance closes; a large discrepancy points to problems with sensor positions, blind absorptance or leakage assumptions. These data also form the basis for tuning control logic and energy models. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cavity temperature and air-speed survey” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：量測風量 0.25 m³/s、進出風口溫差 9 K：帶走熱量 Q = ρ·cp·V·ΔT = 1,206×0.25×9 ≈ 2,714 W；與第一步估算的對流熱 2,268 W 相比高約 (2,714 − 2,268)/2,268 ≈ 20%，表示實際日射或百葉吸收率高於假設，或有室內空氣滲入腔體。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a measured airflow of 0.25 m³/s and a 9 K inlet-to-outlet difference, the heat removed is Q = ρ·cp·V·ΔT = 1,206×0.25×9 ≈ 2,714 W; compared with the 2,268 W of convected heat estimated earlier it is about (2,714 − 2,268)/2,268 ≈ 20% higher, suggesting irradiance or blind absorptance above the assumption, or room air leaking into the cavity.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「腔體溫度只要量一個點就能代表整個腔體。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One temperature reading represents the whole cavity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「腔體溫度與風速量測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cavity temperature and air-speed survey”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 樣品牆與實建築的熱流量測
knowledge.titleEn: Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building
knowledge.text: 腔體性能無法只靠計算保證，需要在實尺寸樣品牆或完工建築上量測：在腔體不同高度布設遮光溫度計、風速計與日射計，同時量測內層玻璃表面溫度與通過內層的熱通量。由進出風口的風量與溫差可以算出腔體帶走的熱量，再與吸收的日射熱比較，檢查能量平衡是否閉合；若差異很大，代表量測位置、百葉吸收率或滲漏假設有問題。
knowledge.textEn: Cavity performance cannot be guaranteed by calculation alone; it must be measured on a full-size mock-up or the completed building. Shielded thermometers, anemometers and pyranometers are placed at several heights in the cavity, while inner-glass surface temperature and heat flux through the inner skin are measured.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：腔體溫度只要量一個點就能代表整個腔體。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One temperature reading represents the whole cavity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「樣品牆與實建築的熱流量測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building" is correct?
options: 腔體溫度只要量一個點就能代表整個腔體。
腔體性能無法只靠計算保證，需要在實尺寸樣品牆或完工建築上量測：在腔體不同高度布設遮光溫度計、風速計與日射計，同時量測內層玻璃表面溫度與通過內層的熱通量。
雙層幕牆的外層玻璃可以擋住火焰，所以腔體不需要防火設計。
optionsEn: One temperature reading represents the whole cavity.
Cavity performance cannot be guaranteed by calculation alone; it must be measured on a full-size mock-up or the completed building.
The outer glass of a double skin stops flames, so the cavity needs no fire design.
quiz.explanation: 腔體性能無法只靠計算保證，需要在實尺寸樣品牆或完工建築上量測：在腔體不同高度布設遮光溫度計、風速計與日射計，同時量測內層玻璃表面溫度與通過內層的熱通量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cavity performance cannot be guaranteed by calculation alone; it must be measured on a full-size mock-up or the completed building. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 樣品牆與實建築的熱流量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「腔體溫度與風速量測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cavity temperature and air-speed survey” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：量測風量 0.25 m³/s、進出風口溫差 9 K：帶走熱量 Q = ρ·cp·V·ΔT = 1,206×0.25×9 ≈ 2,714 W；與第一步估算的對流熱 2,268 W 相比高約 (2,714 − 2,268)/2,268 ≈ 20%，表示實際日射或百葉吸收率高於假設，或有室內空氣滲入腔體。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a measured airflow of 0.25 m³/s and a 9 K inlet-to-outlet difference, the heat removed is Q = ρ·cp·V·ΔT = 1,206×0.25×9 ≈ 2,714 W; compared with the 2,268 W of convected heat estimated earlier it is about (2,714 − 2,268)/2,268 ≈ 20% higher, suggesting irradiance or blind absorptance above the assumption, or room air leaking into the cavity. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測計畫事先規定感測器校正、遮光方式、取樣頻率、量測期間（至少涵蓋晴天與陰天）與能量平衡允許誤差；樣品牆量測結果與模擬比較後，若差異超過預定範圍，須修正模型或細部再決定量產，並保留原始資料供日後重算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The measurement plan states sensor calibration, radiation shielding, sampling rate, duration (covering at least clear and overcast days) and the allowable energy-balance error; if mock-up results differ from simulation beyond the agreed range, revise the model or details before production, and keep the raw data for later recalculation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 量測風量 0.25 m³/s、進出風口溫差 9 K：帶走熱量 Q = ρ·cp·V·ΔT = 1,206×0.25×9 ≈ 2,714 W；與第一步估算的對流熱 2,268 W 相比高約 (2,714 − 2,268)/2,268 ≈ 20%，表示實際日射或百葉吸收率高於假設，或有室內空氣滲入腔體。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a measured airflow of 0.25 m³/s and a 9 K inlet-to-outlet difference, the heat removed is Q = ρ·cp·V·ΔT = 1,206×0.25×9 ≈ 2,714 W; compared with the 2,268 W of convected heat estimated earlier it is about (2,714 − 2,268)/2,268 ≈ 20% higher, suggesting irradiance or blind absorptance above the assumption, or room air leaking into the cavity. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「樣品牆與實建築的熱流量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building", which statement holds?
options: 雙層幕牆的節能效果在設計模擬時就已確定，完工後不需要驗證。
雙層幕牆的腔體只要夠高，空氣就一定會由下往上流動。
量測風量 0.25 m³/s、進出風口溫差 9 K：帶走熱量 Q = ρ·cp·V·ΔT = 1,206×0.25×9 ≈ 2,714 W。
optionsEn: The energy savings of a double skin are fixed by the design simulation and need no verification after completion.
If the cavity is tall enough, air will always flow upward through it.
With a measured airflow of 0.25 m³/s and a 9 K inlet-to-outlet difference, the heat removed is Q = ρ·cp·V·ΔT = 1,206×0.25×9 ≈ 2,714 W.
quiz.explanation: 量測風量 0.25 m³/s、進出風口溫差 9 K：帶走熱量 Q = ρ·cp·V·ΔT = 1,206×0.25×9 ≈ 2,714 W；與第一步估算的對流熱 2,268 W 相比高約 (2,714 − 2,268)/2,268 ≈ 20%，表示實際日射或百葉吸收率高於假設，或有室內空氣滲入腔體。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a measured airflow of 0.25 m³/s and a 9 K inlet-to-outlet difference, the heat removed is Q = ρ·cp·V·ΔT = 1,206×0.25×9 ≈ 2,714 W; compared with the 2,268 W of convected heat estimated earlier it is about (2,714 − 2,268)/2,268 ≈ 20% higher, suggesting irradiance or blind absorptance above the assumption, or room air leaking into the cavity. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 樣品牆與實建築的熱流量測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「腔體溫度與風速量測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cavity temperature and air-speed survey” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測計畫事先規定感測器校正、遮光方式、取樣頻率、量測期間（至少涵蓋晴天與陰天）與能量平衡允許誤差；樣品牆量測結果與模擬比較後，若差異超過預定範圍，須修正模型或細部再決定量產，並保留原始資料供日後重算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The measurement plan states sensor calibration, radiation shielding, sampling rate, duration (covering at least clear and overcast days) and the allowable energy-balance error; if mock-up results differ from simulation beyond the agreed range, revise the model or details before production, and keep the raw data for later recalculation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：完工後至少保留一個代表性開間的永久量測點，並把腔體溫度、風門與百葉狀態納入建築自動化系統的趨勢紀錄；第一年夏冬季的資料要由設計團隊檢討並調整控制參數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep permanent sensors in at least one representative bay after completion and log cavity temperature, damper and blind states as trends in the building-automation system; the design team should review the first summer and winter of data and adjust control parameters.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：溫度計未加遮光，陽光直射使讀值偏高數度，誤判腔體過熱而增加不必要的機械通風；量測只在陰天進行，無法發現夏季晴天的停滯問題，完工後才在最熱的月份出現大量抱怨。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unshielded thermometers read several degrees high in direct sun, falsely indicating overheating and prompting unnecessary mechanical ventilation; measuring only on overcast days misses the clear-sky summer stagnation problem, which surfaces as a flood of complaints in the hottest month after completion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 樣品牆與實建築的熱流量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「腔體溫度與風速量測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cavity temperature and air-speed survey” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 溫度計未加遮光，陽光直射使讀值偏高數度，誤判腔體過熱而增加不必要的機械通風；量測只在陰天進行，無法發現夏季晴天的停滯問題，完工後才在最熱的月份出現大量抱怨。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unshielded thermometers read several degrees high in direct sun, falsely indicating overheating and prompting unnecessary mechanical ventilation; measuring only on overcast days misses the clear-sky summer stagnation problem, which surfaces as a flood of complaints in the hottest month after completion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些資料也是校正控制邏輯與能耗模型的基礎。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: These data also form the basis for tuning control logic and energy models.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「腔體溫度只要量一個點就能代表整個腔體。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One temperature reading represents the whole cavity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「樣品牆與實建築的熱流量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

溫度計未加遮光，陽光直射使讀值偏高數度，誤判腔體過熱而增加不必要的機械通風；量測只在陰天進行，無法發現夏季晴天的停滯問題，完工後才在最熱的月份出現大量抱怨。
雙層幕牆的外層玻璃可以擋住火焰，所以腔體不需要防火設計。

Unshielded thermometers read several degrees high in direct sun, falsely indicating overheating and prompting unnecessary mechanical ventilation.
The outer glass of a double skin stops flames, so the cavity needs no fire design.

steps.title: 腔體煙流、防火分隔與消防驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cavity smoke flow, fire separation and fire-safety verification: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「腔體煙控與防火分隔」如何影響雙層通風幕牆整合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cavity smoke control and fire separation” governs force, deformation or durability in “Double-skin ventilated facade integration”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙層幕牆的腔體可能成為火與煙的垂直通道：下層火災破窗後，熱煙進入腔體，被浮力推升並從上層開啟的窗戶或風門回到室內；外層玻璃也可能把火焰反射或約束在腔體內，使上層內層玻璃承受更高的熱暴露。因此防火策略常包括每層或數層的水平分隔、火警時關閉或開啟特定風門、腔體內灑水或耐火玻璃，以及以煙控模擬驗證。這些措施必須與建築的消防分區與避難策略一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「腔體煙控與防火分隔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A double-skin cavity can become a vertical path for fire and smoke: after a fire breaks the windows of a lower floor, hot smoke enters the cavity, is driven upward by buoyancy and re-enters upper floors through open windows or dampers; the outer glass may also reflect or confine flames in the cavity, increasing the heat exposure of inner glazing above. Fire strategies therefore include horizontal divisions at every floor or every few floors, closing or opening particular dampers on alarm, sprinklers or fire-resistant glass in the cavity, and verification by smoke modelling, all consistent with the building's compartmentation and evacuation strategy. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cavity smoke control and fire separation” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱煙在 6 層高（21.6 m）連通腔體中的浮力壓差 ΔP = ρ_a·g·h·(1 − T_a/T_s)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The buoyancy pressure of hot smoke in a six-storey (21.6 m) connected cavity is ΔP = ρ_a·g·h·(1 − T_a/T_s).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙層幕牆的外層玻璃可以擋住火焰，所以腔體不需要防火設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The outer glass of a double skin stops flames, so the cavity needs no fire design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「腔體煙控與防火分隔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cavity smoke control and fire separation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Fire strategies therefore include horizontal divisions at every floor or every few floors, closing or opening particular dampers on alarm, sprinklers or fire-resistant glass in the cavity, and verification by smoke modelling, all consistent with the building's compartmentation and evacuation strategy.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 腔體煙流、防火分隔與消防驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cavity smoke flow, fire separation and fire-safety verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「腔體煙控與防火分隔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cavity smoke control and fire separation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱煙在 6 層高（21.6 m）連通腔體中的浮力壓差 ΔP = ρ_a·g·h·(1 − T_a/T_s)。T_a = 293 K、煙溫 T_s = 493 K（比環境高 200 K）：ΔP = 1.2×9.81×21.6×(1 − 293/493) ≈ 103 Pa，遠大於一般樓梯加壓的數十帕，足以把煙推進上層開口。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The buoyancy pressure of hot smoke in a six-storey (21.6 m) connected cavity is ΔP = ρ_a·g·h·(1 − T_a/T_s). With T_a = 293 K and smoke at T_s = 493 K, 200 K above ambient: ΔP = 1.2×9.81×21.6×(1 − 293/493) ≈ 103 Pa, far above the few tens of pascals of typical stair pressurisation and enough to push smoke into openings above. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由防火工程師以計算流體力學煙控模擬檢查各火災情境下腔體與上層樓層的煙溫、能見度與可用避難時間；現場驗證水平分隔的耐火構造、腔體灑水的覆蓋與排水，並在消防聯動測試中確認火警時每個腔體風門移到預定位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Have the fire engineer run CFD smoke simulations of each fire scenario, checking smoke temperature, visibility and available evacuation time in the cavity and upper floors; on site verify the fire-resisting construction of horizontal divisions and the coverage and drainage of any cavity sprinklers, and confirm in fire-interface testing that every cavity damper moves to its preset position on alarm.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱煙在 6 層高（21.6 m）連通腔體中的浮力壓差 ΔP = ρ_a·g·h·(1 − T_a/T_s)。T_a = 293 K、煙溫 T_s = 493 K（比環境高 200 K）：ΔP = 1.2×9.81×21.6×(1 − 293/493) ≈ 103 Pa，遠大於一般樓梯加壓的數十帕，足以把煙推進上層開口。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The buoyancy pressure of hot smoke in a six-storey (21.6 m) connected cavity is ΔP = ρ_a·g·h·(1 − T_a/T_s). With T_a = 293 K and smoke at T_s = 493 K, 200 K above ambient: ΔP = 1.2×9.81×21.6×(1 − 293/493) ≈ 103 Pa, far above the few tens of pascals of typical stair pressurisation and enough to push smoke into openings above. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「腔體煙流、防火分隔與消防驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cavity smoke flow, fire separation and fire-safety verification", which statement holds?
options: 熱煙在 6 層高（21.6 m）連通腔體中的浮力壓差 ΔP = ρ_a·g·h·(1 − T_a/T_s)。
多加一層玻璃一定能減少建築的空調耗能。
外層玻璃有開口，所以幾乎不受風壓，可以用很薄的玻璃。
optionsEn: The buoyancy pressure of hot smoke in a six-storey (21.6 m) connected cavity is ΔP = ρ_a·g·h·(1 − T_a/T_s).
Adding a second layer of glass always reduces air-conditioning energy.
Because the outer skin has openings, it sees almost no wind and can use very thin glass.
quiz.explanation: 熱煙在 6 層高（21.6 m）連通腔體中的浮力壓差 ΔP = ρ_a·g·h·(1 − T_a/T_s)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The buoyancy pressure of hot smoke in a six-storey (21.6 m) connected cavity is ΔP = ρ_a·g·h·(1 − T_a/T_s). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 腔體煙流、防火分隔與消防驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cavity smoke flow, fire separation and fire-safety verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「腔體煙控與防火分隔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cavity smoke control and fire separation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由防火工程師以計算流體力學煙控模擬檢查各火災情境下腔體與上層樓層的煙溫、能見度與可用避難時間；現場驗證水平分隔的耐火構造、腔體灑水的覆蓋與排水，並在消防聯動測試中確認火警時每個腔體風門移到預定位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Have the fire engineer run CFD smoke simulations of each fire scenario, checking smoke temperature, visibility and available evacuation time in the cavity and upper floors; on site verify the fire-resisting construction of horizontal divisions and the coverage and drainage of any cavity sprinklers, and confirm in fire-interface testing that every cavity damper moves to its preset position on alarm. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：雙層幕牆的防火策略須在設計初期由防火工程師主導，與帷幕牆形式一起決定，並送主管建築與消防機關審查；竣工後任何穿越或改動水平分隔、腔體風門的工程，都須經防火工程師評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The fire strategy for a double-skin façade must be led by the fire engineer from early design, decided together with the façade type and reviewed by the building and fire authorities; after completion any work that penetrates or alters horizontal divisions or cavity dampers needs the fire engineer's assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：多樓層連通腔體未設任何分隔，下層辦公室火災的煙在數分鐘內進入上方多層，避難時間遠低於設計假設；改裝時移除或穿越水平分隔而未修復，原本合格的防火策略悄悄失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A multi-storey cavity without any division lets smoke from an office fire below reach several floors above within minutes, far less than the assumed evacuation time; removing or penetrating horizontal divisions during later alterations without repair silently defeats a previously compliant strategy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Have the fire engineer run CFD smoke simulations of each fire scenario, checking smoke temperature, visibility and available evacuation time in the cavity and upper floors; on site verify the fire-resisting construction of horizontal divisions and the coverage and drainage of any cavity sprinklers, and confirm in fire-interface testing that every cavity damper moves to its preset position on alarm.

quiz.question: 要驗證「腔體煙流、防火分隔與消防驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cavity smoke flow, fire separation and fire-safety verification"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
由防火工程師以計算流體力學煙控模擬檢查各火災情境下腔體與上層樓層的煙溫、能見度與可用避難時間。

Have the fire engineer run CFD smoke simulations of each fire scenario, checking smoke temperature, visibility and available evacuation time in the cavity and upper floors.
A double-skin façade is just an ordinary curtain wall with one more layer, so the construction process need not change.
quiz.explanation: 由防火工程師以計算流體力學煙控模擬檢查各火災情境下腔體與上層樓層的煙溫、能見度與可用避難時間；現場驗證水平分隔的耐火構造、腔體灑水的覆蓋與排水，並在消防聯動測試中確認火警時每個腔體風門移到預定位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
