Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 腔體煙流、防火分隔與消防驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cavity smoke flow, fire separation and fire-safety verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「腔體煙控與防火分隔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cavity smoke control and fire separation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 多樓層連通腔體未設任何分隔，下層辦公室火災的煙在數分鐘內進入上方多層，避難時間遠低於設計假設；改裝時移除或穿越水平分隔而未修復，原本合格的防火策略悄悄失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A multi-storey cavity without any division lets smoke from an office fire below reach several floors above within minutes, far less than the assumed evacuation time; removing or penetrating horizontal divisions during later alterations without repair silently defeats a previously compliant strategy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些措施必須與建築的消防分區與避難策略一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Fire strategies therefore include horizontal divisions at every floor or every few floors, closing or opening particular dampers on alarm, sprinklers or fire-resistant glass in the cavity, and verification by smoke modelling, all consistent with the building's compartmentation and evacuation strategy.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雙層幕牆的外層玻璃可以擋住火焰，所以腔體不需要防火設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The outer glass of a double skin stops flames, so the cavity needs no fire design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 多樓層連通腔體未設任何分隔，下層辦公室火災的煙在數分鐘內進入上方多層，避難時間遠低於設計假設；改裝時移除或穿越水平分隔而未修復，原本合格的防火策略悄悄失效。
knowledge.textEn: A multi-storey cavity without any division lets smoke from an office fire below reach several floors above within minutes, far less than the assumed evacuation time; removing or penetrating horizontal divisions during later alterations without repair silently defeats a previously compliant strategy.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「腔體煙流、防火分隔與消防驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cavity smoke flow, fire separation and fire-safety verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
腔體位於室內外之間受到保護，不需要定期清潔與檢查。
多樓層連通腔體未設任何分隔，下層辦公室火災的煙在數分鐘內進入上方多層，避難時間遠低於設計假設；改裝時移除或穿越水平分隔而未修復，原本合格的防火策略悄悄失效。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The cavity is sheltered between inside and outside, so it needs no regular cleaning or inspection.
A multi-storey cavity without any division lets smoke from an office fire below reach several floors above within minutes, far less than the assumed evacuation time.
quiz.explanation: 多樓層連通腔體未設任何分隔，下層辦公室火災的煙在數分鐘內進入上方多層，避難時間遠低於設計假設；改裝時移除或穿越水平分隔而未修復，原本合格的防火策略悄悄失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A multi-storey cavity without any division lets smoke from an office fire below reach several floors above within minutes, far less than the assumed evacuation time; removing or penetrating horizontal divisions during later alterations without repair silently defeats a previously compliant strategy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「清潔、結露與長期維護」與「實測性能驗證與竣工交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cleaning, condensation and long-term maintenance" and "Measured performance verification and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 清潔、結露與長期維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cleaning, condensation and long-term maintenance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「腔體清潔與結露」如何影響雙層通風幕牆整合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cavity cleaning and condensation” governs force, deformation or durability in “Double-skin ventilated facade integration”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙層幕牆有四個玻璃面需要清潔：外層兩面與內層兩面，其中腔體內的兩面只能由檢修走道或可開啟的外層進入。腔體還會累積灰塵、昆蟲與鳥類，使百葉與風門卡住、玻璃透光率下降。冬季若室內的潮濕空氣經由內層漏入腔體，碰到接近室外溫度的外層玻璃內側就會結露，長期造成框料腐蝕與汙漬；因此內層應比外層更氣密，腔體則以室外空氣通風，讓腔體的水汽含量接近室外。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「腔體清潔與結露」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A double-skin façade has four glass faces to clean, two on each skin, and the two inside the cavity can only be reached from the walkway or by opening the outer skin. The cavity also collects dust, insects and birds, jamming blinds and dampers and reducing light transmission. In winter, if moist room air leaks through the inner skin into the cavity, it condenses on the inside of the outer glass, which is close to outdoor temperature, corroding frames and leaving stains over time; so the inner skin should be tighter than the outer, and the cavity ventilated with outdoor air so its moisture content stays close to outdoor conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cavity cleaning and condensation” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：室內 21°C、相對濕度 50% 的露點約 10.2°C；室外 0°C、相對濕度 80% 的露點約 −3.0°C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Room air at 21°C and 50% relative humidity has a dew point of about 10.2°C; outdoor air at 0°C and 80% has about −3.0°C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「腔體位於室內外之間受到保護，不需要定期清潔與檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The cavity is sheltered between inside and outside, so it needs no regular cleaning or inspection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「腔體清潔與結露」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cavity cleaning and condensation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 清潔、結露與長期維護
knowledge.text: 雙層幕牆有四個玻璃面需要清潔：外層兩面與內層兩面，其中腔體內的兩面只能由檢修走道或可開啟的外層進入。腔體還會累積灰塵、昆蟲與鳥類，使百葉與風門卡住、玻璃透光率下降。
knowledge.textEn: A double-skin façade has four glass faces to clean, two on each skin, and the two inside the cavity can only be reached from the walkway or by opening the outer skin. The cavity also collects dust, insects and birds, jamming blinds and dampers and reducing light transmission.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：腔體位於室內外之間受到保護，不需要定期清潔與檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The cavity is sheltered between inside and outside, so it needs no regular cleaning or inspection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「清潔、結露與長期維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cleaning, condensation and long-term maintenance" is correct?
options: 雙層幕牆有四個玻璃面需要清潔：外層兩面與內層兩面，其中腔體內的兩面只能由檢修走道或可開啟的外層進入。
腔體位於室內外之間受到保護，不需要定期清潔與檢查。
雙層幕牆的節能效果在設計模擬時就已確定，完工後不需要驗證。
optionsEn: A double-skin façade has four glass faces to clean, two on each skin, and the two inside the cavity can only be reached from the walkway or by opening the outer skin.
The cavity is sheltered between inside and outside, so it needs no regular cleaning or inspection.
The energy savings of a double skin are fixed by the design simulation and need no verification after completion.
quiz.explanation: 雙層幕牆有四個玻璃面需要清潔：外層兩面與內層兩面，其中腔體內的兩面只能由檢修走道或可開啟的外層進入。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A double-skin façade has four glass faces to clean, two on each skin, and the two inside the cavity can only be reached from the walkway or by opening the outer skin. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 清潔、結露與長期維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cleaning, condensation and long-term maintenance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「腔體清潔與結露」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cavity cleaning and condensation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：室內 21°C、相對濕度 50% 的露點約 10.2°C；室外 0°C、相對濕度 80% 的露點約 −3.0°C。外層玻璃內側冬夜約 2°C：若腔體空氣接近室外水汽量（露點 −3°C）不會結露；若室內空氣滲入使露點接近 10°C，就會大量結露。立面 10,000 m² 時，需清潔的玻璃面由單層的 20,000 m² 增為 40,000 m²。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Room air at 21°C and 50% relative humidity has a dew point of about 10.2°C; outdoor air at 0°C and 80% has about −3.0°C. With the inside of the outer glass at about 2°C on a winter night, cavity air close to outdoor moisture (dew point −3°C) will not condense, but room air leaking in and lifting the dew point toward 10°C causes heavy condensation. For a 10,000 m² façade, glass faces to clean rise from 20,000 m² for a single skin to 40,000 m². Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期檢查腔體內的結露痕跡、框料腐蝕、百葉與風門動作、防蟲網堵塞與玻璃透光；以氣密試驗確認內層比外層更氣密；冬季以溫濕度紀錄器量測腔體露點與外層玻璃溫度，評估結露時數，並與交接時的基準比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect the cavity periodically for condensation marks, frame corrosion, blind and damper operation, screen clogging and glass transmission; confirm by air-leakage testing that the inner skin is tighter than the outer; in winter log cavity dew point and outer-glass temperature to estimate condensation hours, compared with the handover baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 室內 21°C、相對濕度 50% 的露點約 10.2°C；室外 0°C、相對濕度 80% 的露點約 −3.0°C。外層玻璃內側冬夜約 2°C：若腔體空氣接近室外水汽量（露點 −3°C）不會結露；若室內空氣滲入使露點接近 10°C，就會大量結露。立面 10,000 m² 時，需清潔的玻璃面由單層的 20,000 m² 增為 40,000 m²。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Room air at 21°C and 50% relative humidity has a dew point of about 10.2°C; outdoor air at 0°C and 80% has about −3.0°C. With the inside of the outer glass at about 2°C on a winter night, cavity air close to outdoor moisture (dew point −3°C) will not condense, but room air leaking in and lifting the dew point toward 10°C causes heavy condensation. For a 10,000 m² façade, glass faces to clean rise from 20,000 m² for a single skin to 40,000 m². Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「清潔、結露與長期維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cleaning, condensation and long-term maintenance", which statement holds?
options: 雙層幕牆的腔體只要夠高，空氣就一定會由下往上流動。
室內 21°C、相對濕度 50% 的露點約 10.2°C；室外 0°C、相對濕度 80% 的露點約 −3.0°C。
腔體開口只要外觀上夠大，通風量就足夠。
optionsEn: If the cavity is tall enough, air will always flow upward through it.
Room air at 21°C and 50% relative humidity has a dew point of about 10.2°C; outdoor air at 0°C and 80% has about −3.0°C.
If cavity openings look large enough, the airflow will be sufficient.
quiz.explanation: 室內 21°C、相對濕度 50% 的露點約 10.2°C；室外 0°C、相對濕度 80% 的露點約 −3.0°C。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Room air at 21°C and 50% relative humidity has a dew point of about 10.2°C; outdoor air at 0°C and 80% has about −3.0°C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 清潔、結露與長期維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cleaning, condensation and long-term maintenance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「腔體清潔與結露」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cavity cleaning and condensation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期檢查腔體內的結露痕跡、框料腐蝕、百葉與風門動作、防蟲網堵塞與玻璃透光；以氣密試驗確認內層比外層更氣密；冬季以溫濕度紀錄器量測腔體露點與外層玻璃溫度，評估結露時數，並與交接時的基準比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect the cavity periodically for condensation marks, frame corrosion, blind and damper operation, screen clogging and glass transmission; confirm by air-leakage testing that the inner skin is tighter than the outer; in winter log cavity dew point and outer-glass temperature to estimate condensation hours, compared with the handover baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊要列出腔體進入方式、安全措施（防墜、通風、照明）、清潔週期、百葉與風門保養與更換程序，以及結露異常的處理方式；腔體進入屬局限或高處作業時，須依工作許可制度核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual must state how to enter the cavity, safety measures (fall protection, ventilation, lighting), cleaning intervals, blind and damper servicing and replacement, and what to do about abnormal condensation; where cavity entry is confined-space or work at height, it requires approval under a permit-to-work system.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：內層幕牆氣密不良、腔體又以室內排氣通風，冬季外層玻璃內側每晚結露，水沿框料流入樓板邊緣；清潔預算只以單層幕牆估算，業主減少腔體清潔次數，數年後百葉卡死、透光率下降而增加照明耗能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A leaky inner skin combined with cavity ventilation by room exhaust air causes condensation on the outer glass every winter night, with water running along frames to the slab edge; a cleaning budget estimated for a single skin leads the owner to cut cavity cleaning, and within a few years blinds jam and reduced light transmission increases lighting energy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期檢查腔體內的結露痕跡、框料腐蝕、百葉與風門動作、防蟲網堵塞與玻璃透光；以氣密試驗確認內層比外層更氣密；冬季以溫濕度紀錄器量測腔體露點與外層玻璃溫度，評估結露時數，並與交接時的基準比較。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect the cavity periodically for condensation marks, frame corrosion, blind and damper operation, screen clogging and glass transmission; confirm by air-leakage testing that the inner skin is tighter than the outer; in winter log cavity dew point and outer-glass temperature to estimate condensation hours, compared with the handover baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護手冊要列出腔體進入方式、安全措施（防墜、通風、照明）、清潔週期、百葉與風門保養與更換程序，以及結露異常的處理方式；腔體進入屬局限或高處作業時，須依工作許可制度核准。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance manual must state how to enter the cavity, safety measures (fall protection, ventilation, lighting), cleaning intervals, blind and damper servicing and replacement, and what to do about abnormal condensation; where cavity entry is confined-space or work at height, it requires approval under a permit-to-work system.

quiz.question: 要驗證「清潔、結露與長期維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cleaning, condensation and long-term maintenance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
雙層幕牆是被動式設計，完工後不需要控制系統試運轉。
定期檢查腔體內的結露痕跡、框料腐蝕、百葉與風門動作、防蟲網堵塞與玻璃透光。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A double-skin façade is passive, so it needs no control commissioning after completion.
Inspect the cavity periodically for condensation marks, frame corrosion, blind and damper operation, screen clogging and glass transmission.
quiz.explanation: 定期檢查腔體內的結露痕跡、框料腐蝕、百葉與風門動作、防蟲網堵塞與玻璃透光；以氣密試驗確認內層比外層更氣密；冬季以溫濕度紀錄器量測腔體露點與外層玻璃溫度，評估結露時數，並與交接時的基準比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect the cavity periodically for condensation marks, frame corrosion, blind and damper operation, screen clogging and glass transmission; confirm by air-leakage testing that the inner skin is tighter than the outer; in winter log cavity dew point and outer-glass temperature to estimate condensation hours, compared with the handover baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 清潔、結露與長期維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cleaning, condensation and long-term maintenance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「腔體清潔與結露」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cavity cleaning and condensation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 內層幕牆氣密不良、腔體又以室內排氣通風，冬季外層玻璃內側每晚結露，水沿框料流入樓板邊緣；清潔預算只以單層幕牆估算，業主減少腔體清潔次數，數年後百葉卡死、透光率下降而增加照明耗能。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A leaky inner skin combined with cavity ventilation by room exhaust air causes condensation on the outer glass every winter night, with water running along frames to the slab edge; a cleaning budget estimated for a single skin leads the owner to cut cavity cleaning, and within a few years blinds jam and reduced light transmission increases lighting energy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：冬季若室內的潮濕空氣經由內層漏入腔體，碰到接近室外溫度的外層玻璃內側就會結露，長期造成框料腐蝕與汙漬；因此內層應比外層更氣密，腔體則以室外空氣通風，讓腔體的水汽含量接近室外。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In winter, if moist room air leaks through the inner skin into the cavity, it condenses on the inside of the outer glass, which is close to outdoor temperature, corroding frames and leaving stains over time; so the inner skin should be tighter than the outer, and the cavity ventilated with outdoor air so its moisture content stays close to outdoor conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「腔體位於室內外之間受到保護，不需要定期清潔與檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The cavity is sheltered between inside and outside, so it needs no regular cleaning or inspection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 內層幕牆氣密不良、腔體又以室內排氣通風，冬季外層玻璃內側每晚結露，水沿框料流入樓板邊緣；清潔預算只以單層幕牆估算，業主減少腔體清潔次數，數年後百葉卡死、透光率下降而增加照明耗能。
knowledge.textEn: A leaky inner skin combined with cavity ventilation by room exhaust air causes condensation on the outer glass every winter night, with water running along frames to the slab edge; a cleaning budget estimated for a single skin leads the owner to cut cavity cleaning, and within a few years blinds jam and reduced light transmission increases lighting energy.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「清潔、結露與長期維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cleaning, condensation and long-term maintenance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 內層幕牆氣密不良、腔體又以室內排氣通風，冬季外層玻璃內側每晚結露，水沿框料流入樓板邊緣。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
雙層幕牆的節能效果在設計模擬時就已確定，完工後不需要驗證。
optionsEn: A leaky inner skin combined with cavity ventilation by room exhaust air causes condensation on the outer glass every winter night, with water running along frames to the slab edge.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The energy savings of a double skin are fixed by the design simulation and need no verification after completion.
quiz.explanation: 內層幕牆氣密不良、腔體又以室內排氣通風，冬季外層玻璃內側每晚結露，水沿框料流入樓板邊緣；清潔預算只以單層幕牆估算，業主減少腔體清潔次數，數年後百葉卡死、透光率下降而增加照明耗能。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A leaky inner skin combined with cavity ventilation by room exhaust air causes condensation on the outer glass every winter night, with water running along frames to the slab edge; a cleaning budget estimated for a single skin leads the owner to cut cavity cleaning, and within a few years blinds jam and reduced light transmission increases lighting energy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 實測性能驗證與竣工交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Measured performance verification and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「實測能耗與交接紀錄」如何影響雙層通風幕牆整合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Measured energy and handover records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Double-skin ventilated facade integration”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙層幕牆的投資理由通常是節能、舒適、自然通風與隔音，因此交接時不能只交圖面，而要交付可驗證的性能：設計時的能耗與舒適度預測、控制邏輯、試運轉紀錄、量測基準與維護計畫。完工後一到兩年應以實測能耗與趨勢資料比較設計預測，找出控制參數、使用行為或細部的偏差。曼尼托巴水電大樓於 2009 年完工並取得 LEED 白金級，GSW 總部則以西向腔體與可動穿孔金屬遮陽板展現立面與通風一體的設計，這些案例都依賴長期的操作與調整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「實測能耗與交接紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case for a double skin is usually energy, comfort, natural ventilation and acoustics, so handover must deliver verifiable performance, not just drawings: predicted energy and comfort, control logic, commissioning records, measurement baselines and a maintenance plan. One to two years after completion measured energy and trend data should be compared with predictions to find deviations in control parameters, occupant behaviour or details. Manitoba Hydro Place, completed in 2009 with LEED Platinum, and the GSW headquarters, with its west cavity and movable perforated-metal shading panels integrating façade and ventilation, both depend on long-term operation and tuning. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Measured energy and handover records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設計預測冷房耗能 80 kWh/m²·年，實測 96 kWh/m²·年，性能落差 (96 − 80)/80 = 20%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Predicted cooling energy is 80 kWh/m²·year and measured is 96 kWh/m²·year, a performance gap of (96 − 80)/80 = 20%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙層幕牆的節能效果在設計模擬時就已確定，完工後不需要驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The energy savings of a double skin are fixed by the design simulation and need no verification after completion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「實測能耗與交接紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Measured energy and handover records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 實測性能驗證與竣工交接
knowledge.text: 雙層幕牆的投資理由通常是節能、舒適、自然通風與隔音，因此交接時不能只交圖面，而要交付可驗證的性能：設計時的能耗與舒適度預測、控制邏輯、試運轉紀錄、量測基準與維護計畫。完工後一到兩年應以實測能耗與趨勢資料比較設計預測，找出控制參數、使用行為或細部的偏差。
knowledge.textEn: The case for a double skin is usually energy, comfort, natural ventilation and acoustics, so handover must deliver verifiable performance, not just drawings: predicted energy and comfort, control logic, commissioning records, measurement baselines and a maintenance plan. One to two years after completion measured energy and trend data should be compared with predictions to find deviations in control parameters, occupant behaviour or details.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雙層幕牆的節能效果在設計模擬時就已確定，完工後不需要驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The energy savings of a double skin are fixed by the design simulation and need no verification after completion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「實測性能驗證與竣工交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Measured performance verification and handover" is correct?
options: 雙層幕牆的節能效果在設計模擬時就已確定，完工後不需要驗證。

多加一層玻璃一定能減少建築的空調耗能。

quiz.explanationEn: The case for a double skin is usually energy, comfort, natural ventilation and acoustics, so handover must deliver verifiable performance, not just drawings: predicted energy and comfort, control logic, commissioning records, measurement baselines and a maintenance plan. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 實測性能驗證與竣工交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measured performance verification and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「實測能耗與交接紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Measured energy and handover records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設計預測冷房耗能 80 kWh/m²·年，實測 96 kWh/m²·年，性能落差 (96 − 80)/80 = 20%。若分析顯示其中 12 kWh/m²·年來自百葉控制門檻設得太高，調整後預估回到 84 kWh/m²·年，落差縮小為 5%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Predicted cooling energy is 80 kWh/m²·year and measured is 96 kWh/m²·year, a performance gap of (96 − 80)/80 = 20%. If analysis attributes 12 kWh/m²·year to a blind-control threshold set too high, retuning is predicted to bring consumption back to 84 kWh/m²·year, narrowing the gap to 5%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接後的第一年進行季節性複驗：比較分項電表、腔體溫度與風門百葉趨勢資料與設計預測，訪查使用者舒適度與手動覆寫頻率，提出調整清單並重新試運轉；結果寫入性能報告，作為保固期結束前的驗收依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the first year after handover carry out seasonal re-verification: compare sub-metered energy and cavity-temperature, damper and blind trends with predictions, survey occupant comfort and override frequency, issue a tuning list and recommission; record the outcome in a performance report used for acceptance before the warranty expires.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：交接時沒有控制邏輯說明與量測基準，管理單位為了減少抱怨把百葉與風門全部改為手動，雙層幕牆變成昂貴的單層幕牆；能耗上升也無從判斷原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

title: 建築外牆氣密水密試驗
summary: 從雨水穿透外牆的驅動力與風壓換算出發，說明壓力等化雨幕、空氣屏障與接縫毛細作用的原理，再把設計風壓轉成 ASTM E283、E331 與 AAMA 501 系列試驗的壓力與允收值，處理樣品牆試驗、施工中現場抽驗與 AAMA 501.2 噴水試驗的時程，最後以漏水診斷、事件後複驗與交接紀錄收尾，並以台北 101、麻省理工學院 Stata 中心與英屬哥倫比亞漏水公寓危機說明試驗與設計失誤的代價。
summaryEn: Starting from the forces that drive rain through a façade and the conversion of wind pressure, explain pressure-equalised rainscreens, air barriers and capillarity at joints, then turn design pressure into the test pressures and acceptance values of ASTM E283, E331 and the AAMA 501 series, covering mock-up testing, field sampling during installation and the time budget of AAMA 501.2 hose testing, and close with leak diagnosis, post-event re-testing and handover records, using Taipei 101, MIT's Stata Center and the British Columbia leaky-condo crisis to show what testing and design errors cost.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 40 層辦公塔外牆面積 30,000 m²，風洞試驗得標準區設計風壓 DP = 2.4 kPa、角隅區 3.6 kPa。標準區水密試驗壓力取 15% DP = 360 Pa（高於 300 Pa 下限），角隅區 540 Pa；結構試驗 150% DP 分別為 3.6 kPa 與 5.4 kPa；氣密試驗 300 Pa、限值 0.30 L/s·m²。樣品牆 37.8 m²：總洩漏 15.0 L/s、基準洩漏 4.5 L/s，試體洩漏 10.5 L/s，q = 10.5/37.8 ≈ 0.28 L/s·m²，合格。現場抽驗：水密壓力 2/3×360 = 240 Pa（標準區），氣密允許 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m²。540 Pa 相當於水柱 540/9,810 ≈ 55 mm，角隅區橫框擋水高度至少要大於此值並留餘裕。若角隅區改以 20% DP 試驗，壓力升為 720 Pa，水柱約 73 mm，擋水需相應加高。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 40-storey office tower has 30,000 m² of façade, and wind-tunnel testing gives design pressures DP = 2.4 kPa in typical zones and 3.6 kPa at corners. Water-test pressure is 15% DP = 360 Pa for typical zones (above the 300 Pa minimum) and 540 Pa at corners; structural tests at 150% DP are 3.6 kPa and 5.4 kPa; the air test is at 300 Pa with a 0.30 L/s·m² limit. Mock-up of 37.8 m²: total leakage 15.0 L/s, tare 4.5 L/s, specimen 10.5 L/s, q = 10.5/37.8 ≈ 0.28 L/s·m², a pass. Field sampling: water at 2/3×360 = 240 Pa in typical zones, air allowance 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m². 540 Pa equals a water column of 540/9,810 ≈ 55 mm, so corner transom dams must exceed this with margin. If corners are instead tested at 20% DP, the pressure rises to 720 Pa, a column of about 73 mm, and the dams must rise accordingly. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

steps.objective: 說明「風壓驅動水頭」如何影響建築外牆氣密水密試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wind-driven water head” governs force, deformation or durability in “Facade air- and water-tightness testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雨水要穿過外牆，需要同時具備三個條件：牆面有水、有開口、有把水推過開口的力。驅動力包括重力（水沿向內傾斜的面流入）、雨滴動能、表面張力與毛細作用、氣流帶動，以及最重要的室內外壓差。颱風時迎風面外部壓力高於室內，壓差會把附著在接縫上的水「吸」進牆內，甚至推過排水槽的擋水高度。因此水密設計不能只靠密封膠，而要逐一切斷每一種驅動力，試驗則是在可控壓差下確認這些措施有效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「風壓驅動水頭」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For rain to pass through a façade, three conditions must coexist: water on the wall, an opening, and a force to move the water through it. The forces are gravity (water running along inward-sloping surfaces), raindrop momentum, surface tension and capillarity, air currents and, most important, the pressure difference between outside and inside. In a typhoon the windward exterior pressure exceeds the interior, and the difference draws water clinging to joints into the wall or even pushes it over the dam of a drainage channel. Watertightness therefore cannot rely on sealant alone but must cut off each force in turn, and testing confirms under controlled pressure that these measures work. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wind-driven water head” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：風壓差 ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wind pressure difference ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外牆會漏水，一定是因為密封膠品質不好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A leaking façade must have poor-quality sealant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「風壓驅動水頭」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wind-driven water head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓
knowledge.titleEn: Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure
knowledge.text: 雨水要穿過外牆，需要同時具備三個條件：牆面有水、有開口、有把水推過開口的力。驅動力包括重力（水沿向內傾斜的面流入）、雨滴動能、表面張力與毛細作用、氣流帶動，以及最重要的室內外壓差。
knowledge.textEn: For rain to pass through a façade, three conditions must coexist: water on the wall, an opening, and a force to move the water through it. The forces are gravity (water running along inward-sloping surfaces), raindrop momentum, surface tension and capillarity, air currents and, most important, the pressure difference between outside and inside.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外牆會漏水，一定是因為密封膠品質不好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A leaking façade must have poor-quality sealant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure" is correct?
options: 外牆會漏水，一定是因為密封膠品質不好。
雨水要穿過外牆，需要同時具備三個條件：牆面有水、有開口、有把水推過開口的力。
雨幕的通氣開口會讓雨水進入，所以封得越密越好。
optionsEn: A leaking façade must have poor-quality sealant.
For rain to pass through a façade, three conditions must coexist: water on the wall, an opening, and a force to move the water through it.
Rainscreen vents let rain in, so the tighter the outer layer is sealed the better.
quiz.explanation: 雨水要穿過外牆，需要同時具備三個條件：牆面有水、有開口、有把水推過開口的力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For rain to pass through a façade, three conditions must coexist: water on the wall, an opening, and a force to move the water through it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風壓驅動水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wind-driven water head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：風壓差 ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp。V = 30 m/s、ρ = 1.2 kg/m³、ΔCp = 1.2：ΔP = 0.5×1.2×30²×1.2 = 648 Pa，相當於水柱高 h = ΔP/(ρ_w·g) = 648/9,810 ≈ 66 mm；排水槽擋水高度若只有 40 mm，水就可能被推過。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wind pressure difference ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp. With V = 30 m/s, ρ = 1.2 kg/m³ and ΔCp = 1.2: ΔP = 0.5×1.2×30²×1.2 = 648 Pa, equivalent to a water column of h = ΔP/(ρ_w·g) = 648/9,810 ≈ 66 mm; a drainage-channel dam only 40 mm high can be overtopped. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以風洞試驗或規範的局部外牆壓力係數求得各區設計風壓，換算成水密試驗壓力與擋水高度需求；檢查設計圖中每一處窗台、橫框與上下單元接縫的擋水高度是否大於試驗壓力對應的水柱高，並在樣品牆試驗中觀察水位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain zone design pressures from wind-tunnel tests or code local cladding coefficients, convert them into water-test pressures and required dam heights; check that every sill, transom and stack joint on the drawings has a dam higher than the water column equivalent to the test pressure, and observe water levels during the mock-up test.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 風壓差 ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp。V = 30 m/s、ρ = 1.2 kg/m³、ΔCp = 1.2：ΔP = 0.5×1.2×30²×1.2 = 648 Pa，相當於水柱高 h = ΔP/(ρ_w·g) = 648/9,810 ≈ 66 mm；排水槽擋水高度若只有 40 mm，水就可能被推過。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Wind pressure difference ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp. With V = 30 m/s, ρ = 1.2 kg/m³ and ΔCp = 1.2: ΔP = 0.5×1.2×30²×1.2 = 648 Pa, equivalent to a water column of h = ΔP/(ρ_w·g) = 648/9,810 ≈ 66 mm; a drainage-channel dam only 40 mm high can be overtopped. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure", which statement holds?
options: 接縫縫隙做得越小，雨水就越不會滲入牆內。
現場試驗的壓力比實驗室低，所以現場試驗只是形式。
風壓差 ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp。
optionsEn: The narrower a joint gap is made, the less rain can get into the wall.
Field tests use lower pressure than the laboratory, so they are a mere formality.
Wind pressure difference ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp.
quiz.explanation: 風壓差 ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wind pressure difference ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風壓驅動水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wind-driven water head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以風洞試驗或規範的局部外牆壓力係數求得各區設計風壓，換算成水密試驗壓力與擋水高度需求；檢查設計圖中每一處窗台、橫框與上下單元接縫的擋水高度是否大於試驗壓力對應的水柱高，並在樣品牆試驗中觀察水位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain zone design pressures from wind-tunnel tests or code local cladding coefficients, convert them into water-test pressures and required dam heights; check that every sill, transom and stack joint on the drawings has a dam higher than the water column equivalent to the test pressure, and observe water levels during the mock-up test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：外牆設計說明須列出各風壓區的水密試驗壓力與對應的擋水高度，並要求所有水平構件向外洩水；擋水高度與洩水坡度在深化圖審查時逐一核對，由帷幕牆顧問簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The façade design statement should list the water-test pressure and corresponding dam height for each wind zone and require all horizontal members to shed water outward; dam heights and drainage falls are checked one by one at shop-drawing review and signed by the façade consultant.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以低樓層的風壓設計整棟樓的擋水高度，高樓層在颱風中水被推過橫框擋水，沿樓板邊緣流進室內；把窗台做成向內傾斜，重力就把水直接帶進牆內，再好的密封也擋不住。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing dams for the lower-floor pressure throughout lets typhoon rain at upper floors overtop the transom dams and run along the slab edge indoors; a sill sloping inward lets gravity carry water straight into the wall, which no sealant can stop. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以風洞試驗或規範的局部外牆壓力係數求得各區設計風壓，換算成水密試驗壓力與擋水高度需求；檢查設計圖中每一處窗台、橫框與上下單元接縫的擋水高度是否大於試驗壓力對應的水柱高，並在樣品牆試驗中觀察水位。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain zone design pressures from wind-tunnel tests or code local cladding coefficients, convert them into water-test pressures and required dam heights; check that every sill, transom and stack joint on the drawings has a dam higher than the water column equivalent to the test pressure, and observe water levels during the mock-up test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 外牆設計說明須列出各風壓區的水密試驗壓力與對應的擋水高度，並要求所有水平構件向外洩水；擋水高度與洩水坡度在深化圖審查時逐一核對，由帷幕牆顧問簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The façade design statement should list the water-test pressure and corresponding dam height for each wind zone and require all horizontal members to shed water outward; dam heights and drainage falls are checked one by one at shop-drawing review and signed by the façade consultant.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure"?
options: 以風洞試驗或規範的局部外牆壓力係數求得各區設計風壓，換算成水密試驗壓力與擋水高度需求。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
現場用水管噴水不漏，就證明外牆在颱風中也不會漏。
optionsEn: Obtain zone design pressures from wind-tunnel tests or code local cladding coefficients, convert them into water-test pressures and required dam heights.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If a façade does not leak under a site hose, it will not leak in a typhoon either.
quiz.explanation: 以風洞試驗或規範的局部外牆壓力係數求得各區設計風壓，換算成水密試驗壓力與擋水高度需求；檢查設計圖中每一處窗台、橫框與上下單元接縫的擋水高度是否大於試驗壓力對應的水柱高，並在樣品牆試驗中觀察水位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain zone design pressures from wind-tunnel tests or code local cladding coefficients, convert them into water-test pressures and required dam heights; check that every sill, transom and stack joint on the drawings has a dam higher than the water column equivalent to the test pressure, and observe water levels during the mock-up test. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風壓驅動水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wind-driven water head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以低樓層的風壓設計整棟樓的擋水高度，高樓層在颱風中水被推過橫框擋水，沿樓板邊緣流進室內；把窗台做成向內傾斜，重力就把水直接帶進牆內，再好的密封也擋不住。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing dams for the lower-floor pressure throughout lets typhoon rain at upper floors overtop the transom dams and run along the slab edge indoors; a sill sloping inward lets gravity carry water straight into the wall, which no sealant can stop. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此水密設計不能只靠密封膠，而要逐一切斷每一種驅動力，試驗則是在可控壓差下確認這些措施有效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Watertightness therefore cannot rely on sealant alone but must cut off each force in turn, and testing confirms under controlled pressure that these measures work.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外牆會漏水，一定是因為密封膠品質不好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A leaking façade must have poor-quality sealant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以低樓層的風壓設計整棟樓的擋水高度，高樓層在颱風中水被推過橫框擋水，沿樓板邊緣流進室內；把窗台做成向內傾斜，重力就把水直接帶進牆內，再好的密封也擋不住。
knowledge.textEn: Sizing dams for the lower-floor pressure throughout lets typhoon rain at upper floors overtop the transom dams and run along the slab edge indoors; a sill sloping inward lets gravity carry water straight into the wall, which no sealant can stop.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
以低樓層的風壓設計整棟樓的擋水高度，高樓層在颱風中水被推過橫框擋水，沿樓板邊緣流進室內；把窗台做成向內傾斜，重力就把水直接帶進牆內，再好的密封也擋不住。
雨幕的通氣開口會讓雨水進入，所以封得越密越好。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Sizing dams for the lower-floor pressure throughout lets typhoon rain at upper floors overtop the transom dams and run along the slab edge indoors.
Rainscreen vents let rain in, so the tighter the outer layer is sealed the better.
quiz.explanation: 以低樓層的風壓設計整棟樓的擋水高度，高樓層在颱風中水被推過橫框擋水，沿樓板邊緣流進室內；把窗台做成向內傾斜，重力就把水直接帶進牆內，再好的密封也擋不住。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sizing dams for the lower-floor pressure throughout lets typhoon rain at upper floors overtop the transom dams and run along the slab edge indoors; a sill sloping inward lets gravity carry water straight into the wall, which no sealant can stop. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓力等化雨幕與空氣屏障：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure-equalised rainscreens and the air barrier: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「壓力等化腔體」如何影響建築外牆氣密水密試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure-equalised cavity” governs force, deformation or durability in “Facade air- and water-tightness testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 壓力等化雨幕把外牆分成兩道防線：外側的雨幕擋住大部分雨水，但刻意留有通氣開口；內側的空氣屏障則必須連續且氣密。當外部風壓變化時，空氣經由通氣開口進入兩道防線之間的腔體，使腔體壓力接近外部壓力，雨幕兩側的壓差就很小，水不再被壓差推過外層接縫；真正承受壓差的是乾燥的內側空氣屏障。若空氣屏障漏氣，腔體壓力就無法建立，等化失效。英屬哥倫比亞沿海在 1990 年代大量出現的漏水公寓，調查即指出過度依賴「單層表面密封」的牆體是主因之一。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「壓力等化腔體」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pressure-equalised rainscreen divides the wall into two lines of defence: an outer rainscreen that stops most rain but deliberately has vents, and an inner air barrier that must be continuous and airtight. As exterior pressure changes, air flows through the vents into the cavity between them, bringing cavity pressure close to the exterior so that the pressure difference across the rainscreen is small and water is no longer pushed through its joints; the dry inner air barrier takes the pressure difference. If the air barrier leaks, cavity pressure cannot build and equalisation fails. Investigations into the leaky condominiums of coastal British Columbia in the 1990s identified reliance on face-sealed walls as a main cause. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pressure-equalised cavity” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：通氣口與空氣屏障洩漏可視為串聯孔口：A_v·√ΔP_v = A_l·√ΔP_l，故 ΔP_v/ΔP = 1/[1 + (A_v/A_l)²]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vents and air-barrier leakage act as orifices in series: A_v·√ΔP_v = A_l·√ΔP_l, so ΔP_v/ΔP = 1/[1 + (A_v/A_l)²].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雨幕的通氣開口會讓雨水進入，所以封得越密越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rainscreen vents let rain in, so the tighter the outer layer is sealed the better." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「壓力等化腔體」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pressure-equalised cavity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 壓力等化雨幕與空氣屏障：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure-equalised rainscreens and the air barrier: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力等化腔體」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure-equalised cavity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：通氣口與空氣屏障洩漏可視為串聯孔口：A_v·√ΔP_v = A_l·√ΔP_l，故 ΔP_v/ΔP = 1/[1 + (A_v/A_l)²]。通氣面積為屏障洩漏面積 10 倍時，雨幕只承受 1/101 ≈ 1% 的壓差；只有 5 倍時約 3.8%。若屏障洩漏增加使比值降為 2，雨幕承受 20%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vents and air-barrier leakage act as orifices in series: A_v·√ΔP_v = A_l·√ΔP_l, so ΔP_v/ΔP = 1/[1 + (A_v/A_l)²]. With vent area 10 times the barrier leakage area the rainscreen sees only 1/101 ≈ 1% of the pressure difference; at 5 times about 3.8%. If barrier leakage grows so the ratio falls to 2, the rainscreen sees 20%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在樣品牆腔體內與內外側設壓力計，於靜壓與動壓試驗時同步記錄，確認腔體壓力能跟上外部壓力變化；以氣密試驗確認空氣屏障的洩漏量，並檢查通氣口與腔體分隔是否依設計配置，避免不同壓力區的腔體互相連通。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit pressure taps in the mock-up cavity and on both faces, logging them together during static and dynamic tests to confirm that cavity pressure follows exterior pressure; confirm air-barrier leakage by air testing, and check that vents and cavity compartments follow the design so that cavities in different pressure zones are not connected.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With vent area 10 times the barrier leakage area the rainscreen sees only 1/101 ≈ 1% of the pressure difference; at 5 times about 3.8%. knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

A passed mock-up proves that every panel on site will be watertight.

steps.title: 壓力等化雨幕與空氣屏障：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure-equalised rainscreens and the air barrier: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓力等化腔體」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure-equalised cavity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在樣品牆腔體內與內外側設壓力計，於靜壓與動壓試驗時同步記錄，確認腔體壓力能跟上外部壓力變化；以氣密試驗確認空氣屏障的洩漏量，並檢查通氣口與腔體分隔是否依設計配置，避免不同壓力區的腔體互相連通。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit pressure taps in the mock-up cavity and on both faces, logging them together during static and dynamic tests to confirm that cavity pressure follows exterior pressure; confirm air-barrier leakage by air testing, and check that vents and cavity compartments follow the design so that cavities in different pressure zones are not connected. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：外牆圖說要以顏色或線型標示空氣屏障的連續路徑，包括與樓板、屋頂、地坪及相鄰系統的接續；腔體分隔與通氣口位置在深化圖與樣品牆中確認，空氣屏障的任何中斷須經帷幕牆顧問核可處理方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Façade drawings should trace the continuous air-barrier line in colour or linetype, including its connections to slabs, roof, ground and adjacent systems; cavity compartments and vent positions are confirmed in shop drawings and the mock-up, and any break in the air barrier needs the façade consultant's approved remedy.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：腔體在轉角處沒有分隔，迎風面與側風面的腔體相通，空氣在腔體內橫向流動，迎風面腔體壓力永遠追不上外部，雨水被推過外層接縫；空氣屏障在樓板邊緣不連續，等化系統徒具形式。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without compartment closures at corners, windward and side cavities connect and air flows sideways inside them, so the windward cavity never reaches exterior pressure and rain is pushed through the outer joints; an air barrier discontinuous at slab edges reduces the equalisation system to a formality. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 外牆圖說要以顏色或線型標示空氣屏障的連續路徑，包括與樓板、屋頂、地坪及相鄰系統的接續；腔體分隔與通氣口位置在深化圖與樣品牆中確認，空氣屏障的任何中斷須經帷幕牆顧問核可處理方式。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure-equalised cavity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 腔體在轉角處沒有分隔，迎風面與側風面的腔體相通，空氣在腔體內橫向流動，迎風面腔體壓力永遠追不上外部，雨水被推過外層接縫；空氣屏障在樓板邊緣不連續，等化系統徒具形式。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「壓力等化雨幕與空氣屏障」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure-equalised rainscreens and the air barrier" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
空氣洩漏量與壓差成正比，壓差加倍洩漏量也剛好加倍。
腔體在轉角處沒有分隔，迎風面與側風面的腔體相通，空氣在腔體內橫向流動，迎風面腔體壓力永遠追不上外部，雨水被推過外層接縫。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Air leakage is proportional to pressure difference, so doubling the pressure exactly doubles the leakage.

Without compartment closures at corners, windward and side cavities connect and air flows sideways inside them, so the windward cavity never reaches exterior pressure and rain is pushed through the outer joints.
quiz.explanation: 腔體在轉角處沒有分隔，迎風面與側風面的腔體相通，空氣在腔體內橫向流動，迎風面腔體壓力永遠追不上外部，雨水被推過外層接縫；空氣屏障在樓板邊緣不連續，等化系統徒具形式。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without compartment closures at corners, windward and side cavities connect and air flows sideways inside them, so the windward cavity never reaches exterior pressure and rain is pushed through the outer joints; an air barrier discontinuous at slab edges reduces the equalisation system to a formality. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「空氣洩漏量、壓力指數與允收值」與「接縫、介面與毛細作用細部」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Air-leakage rate, pressure exponent and acceptance values" and "Joints, interfaces and capillary details": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 空氣洩漏量、壓力指數與允收值：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Air-leakage rate, pressure exponent and acceptance values: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「空氣洩漏特性曲線」如何影響建築外牆氣密水密試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Air-leakage characteristic” governs force, deformation or durability in “Facade air- and water-tightness testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外牆的空氣洩漏量隨壓差增加而增加，但不是線性：通過細小縫隙的氣流介於層流與紊流之間，可用 Q = C·ΔP^n 描述，n 常介於 0.5（完全紊流的孔口）與 1.0（層流）之間。洩漏量影響的不只是空調能耗，室內潮濕空氣冬季外洩會在牆內結露，夏季濕熱空氣內滲也會造成凝結與發霉。實驗室試驗依 ASTM E283 在指定壓差下量測單位面積洩漏量，美國帷幕牆規範常要求在 300 Pa（6.24 psf）下不超過約 0.3 L/s·m²（0.06 cfm/ft²），但不同規範的試驗壓力不同，比較時必須換算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「空氣洩漏特性曲線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Façade air leakage rises with pressure difference but not linearly: flow through small cracks lies between laminar and turbulent and is described by Q = C·ΔP^n, with n usually between 0.5 for a fully turbulent orifice and 1.0 for laminar flow. Leakage affects more than HVAC energy: moist room air escaping in winter condenses inside the wall, and hot humid air infiltrating in summer also causes condensation and mould. Laboratory tests to ASTM E283 measure leakage per unit area at a specified pressure difference, and US curtain-wall specifications commonly require no more than about 0.3 L/s·m² (0.06 cfm/ft²) at 300 Pa (6.24 psf), but test pressures differ between codes, so comparisons need conversion. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Air-leakage characteristic” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Q = C·ΔP^n，取 n = 0.65。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Q = C·ΔP^n with n = 0.65.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「空氣洩漏量與壓差成正比，壓差加倍洩漏量也剛好加倍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Air leakage is proportional to pressure difference, so doubling the pressure exactly doubles the leakage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「空氣洩漏特性曲線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Air-leakage characteristic”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 空氣洩漏量、壓力指數與允收值
knowledge.titleEn: Air-leakage rate, pressure exponent and acceptance values
knowledge.text: 外牆的空氣洩漏量隨壓差增加而增加，但不是線性：通過細小縫隙的氣流介於層流與紊流之間，可用 Q = C·ΔP^n 描述，n 常介於 0.5（完全紊流的孔口）與 1.0（層流）之間。洩漏量影響的不只是空調能耗，室內潮濕空氣冬季外洩會在牆內結露，夏季濕熱空氣內滲也會造成凝結與發霉。
knowledge.textEn: Façade air leakage rises with pressure difference but not linearly: flow through small cracks lies between laminar and turbulent and is described by Q = C·ΔP^n, with n usually between 0.5 for a fully turbulent orifice and 1.0 for laminar flow. Leakage affects more than HVAC energy: moist room air escaping in winter condenses inside the wall, and hot humid air infiltrating in summer also causes condensation and mould.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：空氣洩漏量與壓差成正比，壓差加倍洩漏量也剛好加倍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Air leakage is proportional to pressure difference, so doubling the pressure exactly doubles the leakage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「空氣洩漏量、壓力指數與允收值」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Air-leakage rate, pressure exponent and acceptance values" is correct?
options: 外牆的空氣洩漏量隨壓差增加而增加，但不是線性：通過細小縫隙的氣流介於層流與紊流之間，可用 Q = C·ΔP^n 描述，n 常介於 0.5（完全紊流的孔口）與 1.0（層流）之間。
空氣洩漏量與壓差成正比，壓差加倍洩漏量也剛好加倍。
接縫縫隙做得越小，雨水就越不會滲入牆內。
optionsEn: Façade air leakage rises with pressure difference but not linearly: flow through small cracks lies between laminar and turbulent and is described by Q = C·ΔP^n, with n usually between 0.5 for a fully turbulent orifice and 1.0 for laminar flow.
Air leakage is proportional to pressure difference, so doubling the pressure exactly doubles the leakage.
The narrower a joint gap is made, the less rain can get into the wall.
quiz.explanation: 外牆的空氣洩漏量隨壓差增加而增加，但不是線性：通過細小縫隙的氣流介於層流與紊流之間，可用 Q = C·ΔP^n 描述，n 常介於 0.5（完全紊流的孔口）與 1.0（層流）之間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Façade air leakage rises with pressure difference but not linearly: flow through small cracks lies between laminar and turbulent and is described by Q = C·ΔP^n, with n usually between 0.5 for a fully turbulent orifice and 1.0 for laminar flow. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 空氣洩漏量、壓力指數與允收值：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Air-leakage rate, pressure exponent and acceptance values: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空氣洩漏特性曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Air-leakage characteristic” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = C·ΔP^n，取 n = 0.65。若在 75 Pa 量得 0.30 L/s·m²，換算到 300 Pa：Q = 0.30×(300/75)^0.65 = 0.30×4^0.65 ≈ 0.30×2.46 ≈ 0.74 L/s·m²，已超過 300 Pa 下 0.3 L/s·m² 的常見限值約 2.5 倍。單位換算：0.06 cfm/ft² ≈ 0.305 L/s·m²。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = C·ΔP^n with n = 0.65. If 0.30 L/s·m² is measured at 75 Pa, at 300 Pa Q = 0.30×(300/75)^0.65 = 0.30×4^0.65 ≈ 0.30×2.46 ≈ 0.74 L/s·m², about 2.5 times the common limit of 0.3 L/s·m² at 300 Pa. Unit check: 0.06 cfm/ft² ≈ 0.305 L/s·m². Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗時在數個壓差（例如 50、75、150、300 Pa）量測洩漏量，以對數迴歸求得 C 與 n，確認在規定壓差的值低於允收值；同時區分正壓與負壓下的洩漏，因為密封條在負壓下可能被拉開；報告中須註明試體面積、量測溫濕度與大氣壓修正。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure leakage at several pressures (for example 50, 75, 150 and 300 Pa), fit C and n by log regression, and confirm the value at the specified pressure is below the limit; distinguish leakage under positive and negative pressure, since gaskets may pull open under suction; the report must state specimen area and the temperature, humidity and barometric corrections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Q = C·ΔP^n with n = 0.65. If 0.30 L/s·m² is measured at 75 Pa, at 300 Pa Q = 0.30×(300/75)^0.65 = 0.30×4^0.65 ≈ 0.30×2.46 ≈ 0.74 L/s·m², about 2.5 times the common limit of 0.3 L/s·m² at 300 Pa. Unit check: 0.06 cfm/ft² ≈ 0.305 L/s·m². Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「空氣洩漏量、壓力指數與允收值」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Air-leakage rate, pressure exponent and acceptance values", which statement holds?
options: 現場試驗的壓力比實驗室低，所以現場試驗只是形式。
Q = C·ΔP^n，取 n = 0.65。
現場用水管噴水不漏，就證明外牆在颱風中也不會漏。
optionsEn: Field tests use lower pressure than the laboratory, so they are a mere formality.
Q = C·ΔP^n with n = 0.65.
If a façade does not leak under a site hose, it will not leak in a typhoon either.
quiz.explanation: Q = C·ΔP^n，取 n = 0.65。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Q = C·ΔP^n with n = 0.65. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 空氣洩漏量、壓力指數與允收值：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Air-leakage rate, pressure exponent and acceptance values: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「空氣洩漏特性曲線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Air-leakage characteristic” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗時在數個壓差（例如 50、75、150、300 Pa）量測洩漏量，以對數迴歸求得 C 與 n，確認在規定壓差的值低於允收值；同時區分正壓與負壓下的洩漏，因為密封條在負壓下可能被拉開；報告中須註明試體面積、量測溫濕度與大氣壓修正。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure leakage at several pressures (for example 50, 75, 150 and 300 Pa), fit C and n by log regression, and confirm the value at the specified pressure is below the limit; distinguish leakage under positive and negative pressure, since gaskets may pull open under suction; the report must state specimen area and the temperature, humidity and barometric corrections. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規範要同時寫明允收洩漏量、試驗壓力、正負壓方向與面積計算方式，並要求提交多點壓力的洩漏曲線而非單一數字；比較不同標準（ASTM 與 EN 分級）時，由帷幕牆顧問統一換算後再判定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification must state the allowable leakage, test pressure, positive and negative directions and area basis together, and require a multi-point leakage curve rather than one number; when comparing standards such as ASTM limits and EN classes, the façade consultant converts them on a common basis before judging.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把在 75 Pa 下合格的窗戶數據直接拿來比較 300 Pa 的帷幕牆規範，誤以為符合要求，完工後冬季樓板邊緣與窗框周邊出現大量結露；只測正壓而未測負壓，背風面的實際洩漏遠大於報告值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing window data that passed at 75 Pa directly with a curtain-wall specification at 300 Pa wrongly suggests compliance, and after completion heavy winter condensation appears at slab edges and around frames; testing only under positive pressure misses much larger real leakage on leeward faces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗時在數個壓差（例如 50、75、150、300 Pa）量測洩漏量，以對數迴歸求得 C 與 n，確認在規定壓差的值低於允收值；同時區分正壓與負壓下的洩漏，因為密封條在負壓下可能被拉開；報告中須註明試體面積、量測溫濕度與大氣壓修正。
knowledge.textEn: Measure leakage at several pressures (for example 50, 75, 150 and 300 Pa), fit C and n by log regression, and confirm the value at the specified pressure is below the limit; distinguish leakage under positive and negative pressure, since gaskets may pull open under suction; the report must state specimen area and the temperature, humidity and barometric corrections.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規範要同時寫明允收洩漏量、試驗壓力、正負壓方向與面積計算方式，並要求提交多點壓力的洩漏曲線而非單一數字；比較不同標準（ASTM 與 EN 分級）時，由帷幕牆顧問統一換算後再判定。
knowledge.textEn: The specification must state the allowable leakage, test pressure, positive and negative directions and area basis together, and require a multi-point leakage curve rather than one number; when comparing standards such as ASTM limits and EN classes, the façade consultant converts them on a common basis before judging.

quiz.question: 要驗證「空氣洩漏量、壓力指數與允收值」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Air-leakage rate, pressure exponent and acceptance values"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
外牆在竣工時通過試驗，之後數十年都會保持同樣的氣密水密性能。
試驗時在數個壓差（例如 50、75、150、300 Pa）量測洩漏量，以對數迴歸求得 C 與 n，確認在規定壓差的值低於允收值。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A façade that passes its tests at completion keeps the same tightness for decades.
Measure leakage at several pressures (for example 50, 75, 150 and 300 Pa), fit C and n by log regression, and confirm the value at the specified pressure is below the limit.
quiz.explanation: 試驗時在數個壓差（例如 50、75、150、300 Pa）量測洩漏量，以對數迴歸求得 C 與 n，確認在規定壓差的值低於允收值；同時區分正壓與負壓下的洩漏，因為密封條在負壓下可能被拉開；報告中須註明試體面積、量測溫濕度與大氣壓修正。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure leakage at several pressures (for example 50, 75, 150 and 300 Pa), fit C and n by log regression, and confirm the value at the specified pressure is below the limit; distinguish leakage under positive and negative pressure, since gaskets may pull open under suction; the report must state specimen area and the temperature, humidity and barometric corrections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 空氣洩漏量、壓力指數與允收值：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Air-leakage rate, pressure exponent and acceptance values: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「空氣洩漏特性曲線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Air-leakage characteristic” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把在 75 Pa 下合格的窗戶數據直接拿來比較 300 Pa 的帷幕牆規範，誤以為符合要求，完工後冬季樓板邊緣與窗框周邊出現大量結露；只測正壓而未測負壓，背風面的實際洩漏遠大於報告值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing window data that passed at 75 Pa directly with a curtain-wall specification at 300 Pa wrongly suggests compliance, and after completion heavy winter condensation appears at slab edges and around frames; testing only under positive pressure misses much larger real leakage on leeward faces. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實驗室試驗依 ASTM E283 在指定壓差下量測單位面積洩漏量，美國帷幕牆規範常要求在 300 Pa（6.24 psf）下不超過約 0.3 L/s·m²（0.06 cfm/ft²），但不同規範的試驗壓力不同，比較時必須換算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Laboratory tests to ASTM E283 measure leakage per unit area at a specified pressure difference, and US curtain-wall specifications commonly require no more than about 0.3 L/s·m² (0.06 cfm/ft²) at 300 Pa (6.24 psf), but test pressures differ between codes, so comparisons need conversion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「空氣洩漏量與壓差成正比，壓差加倍洩漏量也剛好加倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Air leakage is proportional to pressure difference, so doubling the pressure exactly doubles the leakage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把在 75 Pa 下合格的窗戶數據直接拿來比較 300 Pa 的帷幕牆規範，誤以為符合要求，完工後冬季樓板邊緣與窗框周邊出現大量結露；只測正壓而未測負壓，背風面的實際洩漏遠大於報告值。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing window data that passed at 75 Pa directly with a curtain-wall specification at 300 Pa wrongly suggests compliance, and after completion heavy winter condensation appears at slab edges and around frames; testing only under positive pressure misses much larger real leakage on leeward faces.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 接縫、介面與毛細作用細部：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Joints, interfaces and capillary details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「接縫寬度與毛細作用」如何影響建築外牆氣密水密試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint width and capillarity” governs force, deformation or durability in “Facade air- and water-tightness testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外牆漏水最常發生在介面而不是材料本身：上下單元接縫、轉角、帷幕牆與石材或金屬板的交界、穿越外牆的管線與招牌錨栓，以及帷幕牆與屋頂、地坪的收邊。細小縫隙會產生毛細作用，即使沒有壓差也能把水吸進牆內；把縫隙放寬到數毫米以上、設置滴水線與毛細斷開槽，可以切斷這種驅動力。介面因為分屬不同承包商，常在圖面上只畫一條線，現場卻沒有人負責防水的連續性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「接縫寬度與毛細作用」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Façade leaks occur most often at interfaces rather than in the materials themselves: stack joints, corners, junctions between curtain wall and stone or metal panels, pipes and sign anchors through the wall, and the terminations of the curtain wall at roofs and grade. Fine gaps create capillary action that can draw water inward even without a pressure difference; widening gaps to several millimetres and providing drips and capillary breaks cuts off this force. Because interfaces belong to different contractors, they are often drawn as a single line while on site nobody owns the continuity of the weatherproofing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Joint width and capillarity” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：平行縫毛細上升高度 h = 2γ·cosθ/(ρ·g·w)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Capillary rise in a parallel slot h = 2γ·cosθ/(ρ·g·w).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫縫隙做得越小，雨水就越不會滲入牆內。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The narrower a joint gap is made, the less rain can get into the wall." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「接縫寬度與毛細作用」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Joint width and capillarity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Façade leaks occur most often at interfaces rather than in the materials themselves: stack joints, corners, junctions between curtain wall and stone or metal panels, pipes and sign anchors through the wall, and the terminations of the curtain wall at roofs and grade. knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫縫隙做得越小，雨水就越不會滲入牆內。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The narrower a joint gap is made, the less rain can get into the wall. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接縫、介面與毛細作用細部」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

quiz.explanationEn: Façade leaks occur most often at interfaces rather than in the materials themselves: stack joints, corners, junctions between curtain wall and stone or metal panels, pipes and sign anchors through the wall, and the terminations of the curtain wall at roofs and grade. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接縫、介面與毛細作用細部：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joints, interfaces and capillary details: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接縫寬度與毛細作用」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint width and capillarity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平行縫毛細上升高度 h = 2γ·cosθ/(ρ·g·w)。γ = 0.072 N/m、θ = 0°：縫寬 w = 0.2 mm 時 h = 2×0.072/(1,000×9.81×0.0002) ≈ 73 mm；w = 1 mm 時約 15 mm；w = 5 mm 時約 2.9 mm。因此毛細斷開槽通常做到數毫米寬。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Capillary rise in a parallel slot h = 2γ·cosθ/(ρ·g·w). With γ = 0.072 N/m and θ = 0°: a 0.2 mm slot gives h = 2×0.072/(1,000×9.81×0.0002) ≈ 73 mm; 1 mm gives about 15 mm; 5 mm gives about 2.9 mm. Capillary breaks are therefore made several millimetres wide. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：深化圖審查時逐一列出所有介面（介面清單），指定每個介面的防水與氣密負責承包商、材料與施工順序，並繪製三維節點；樣品牆必須包含最複雜的介面，現場則在介面完成時以噴水試驗抽驗，合格後才允許覆蓋。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At shop-drawing review list every interface in an interface register, assigning for each the contractor responsible for weather and air tightness, the materials and the sequence, with three-dimensional details; the mock-up must include the most complex interfaces, and on site each interface is hose-tested on completion before it may be covered.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 平行縫毛細上升高度 h = 2γ·cosθ/(ρ·g·w)。γ = 0.072 N/m、θ = 0°：縫寬 w = 0.2 mm 時 h = 2×0.072/(1,000×9.81×0.0002) ≈ 73 mm；w = 1 mm 時約 15 mm；w = 5 mm 時約 2.9 mm。因此毛細斷開槽通常做到數毫米寬。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Capillary rise in a parallel slot h = 2γ·cosθ/(ρ·g·w). With γ = 0.072 N/m and θ = 0°: a 0.2 mm slot gives h = 2×0.072/(1,000×9.81×0.0002) ≈ 73 mm; 1 mm gives about 15 mm; 5 mm gives about 2.9 mm. Capillary breaks are therefore made several millimetres wide. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接縫、介面與毛細作用細部」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joints, interfaces and capillary details", which statement holds?
options: 流量計讀到的空氣量就是外牆的洩漏量。
在室內出水的位置補上密封膠，就能解決外牆漏水。
平行縫毛細上升高度 h = 2γ·cosθ/(ρ·g·w)。
optionsEn: The airflow read on the meter is the façade's leakage.
