steps.title: 接縫、介面與毛細作用細部：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joints, interfaces and capillary details: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接縫寬度與毛細作用」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint width and capillarity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 深化圖審查時逐一列出所有介面（介面清單），指定每個介面的防水與氣密負責承包商、材料與施工順序，並繪製三維節點；樣品牆必須包含最複雜的介面，現場則在介面完成時以噴水試驗抽驗，合格後才允許覆蓋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At shop-drawing review list every interface in an interface register, assigning for each the contractor responsible for weather and air tightness, the materials and the sequence, with three-dimensional details; the mock-up must include the most complex interfaces, and on site each interface is hose-tested on completion before it may be covered. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以介面清單作為合約附件，每一個介面都有唯一負責單位與試驗要求；介面處的覆蓋前檢查設為停止點，由帷幕牆顧問或監造確認噴水試驗合格後才能封閉。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Attach the interface register to the contracts so every interface has one responsible party and a test requirement; make pre-cover inspection at interfaces a hold point, released only after the façade consultant or supervising engineer confirms a passed hose test.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：帷幕牆與石材外牆交界處各自施作、彼此以為對方會處理收邊，結果只留一道表面密封膠；數年後密封膠老化龜裂，雨水經毛細作用沿石材背面流入樓板，造成大面積室內水損。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Curtain wall and stone cladding installed separately, each assuming the other will close the junction, leave only a single face sealant line; after a few years the sealant ages and cracks, and capillary action draws rain along the back of the stone onto the slab, causing extensive interior water damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 帷幕牆與石材外牆交界處各自施作、彼此以為對方會處理收邊，結果只留一道表面密封膠；數年後密封膠老化龜裂，雨水經毛細作用沿石材背面流入樓板，造成大面積室內水損。
knowledge.textEn: Curtain wall and stone cladding installed separately, each assuming the other will close the junction, leave only a single face sealant line; after a few years the sealant ages and cracks, and capillary action draws rain along the back of the stone onto the slab, causing extensive interior water damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接縫、介面與毛細作用細部」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joints, interfaces and capillary details" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
帷幕牆與石材外牆交界處各自施作、彼此以為對方會處理收邊，結果只留一道表面密封膠；數年後密封膠老化龜裂，雨水經毛細作用沿石材背面流入樓板，造成大面積室內水損。
樣品牆試驗合格，就代表現場每一片外牆都不會漏水。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Curtain wall and stone cladding installed separately, each assuming the other will close the junction, leave only a single face sealant line.
A passed mock-up proves that every panel on site will be watertight.
quiz.explanation: 帷幕牆與石材外牆交界處各自施作、彼此以為對方會處理收邊，結果只留一道表面密封膠；數年後密封膠老化龜裂，雨水經毛細作用沿石材背面流入樓板，造成大面積室內水損。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Curtain wall and stone cladding installed separately, each assuming the other will close the junction, leave only a single face sealant line; after a few years the sealant ages and cracks, and capillary action draws rain along the back of the stone onto the slab, causing extensive interior water damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「樣品牆試驗計畫與試驗壓力」與「施工中的現場氣密水密抽驗」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mock-up test planning and test pressures" and "Field air and water testing during construction": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 樣品牆試驗計畫與試驗壓力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Mock-up test planning and test pressures: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樣品牆試驗壓力表」如何影響建築外牆氣密水密試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mock-up test pressure schedule” governs force, deformation or durability in “Facade air- and water-tightness testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 實驗室性能樣品牆是量產前最重要的關卡：在密閉試驗艙上安裝實尺寸外牆，依規定順序進行氣密、靜態水密、動態水密、結構與層間位移等試驗，再重複氣密與水密，以確認結構變形後仍保有性能。試驗壓力由設計風壓換算：結構試驗常以設計風壓與其 1.5 倍驗證；水密試驗則取設計風壓的一定比例並設下限。試驗順序很重要，先做結構再做水密，才能反映颱風後的真實狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樣品牆試驗壓力表」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The laboratory performance mock-up is the most important gate before production: a full-size façade is mounted on a sealed test chamber and tested in a prescribed sequence for air, static water, dynamic water, structural and racking performance, then air and water again to confirm performance survives structural deformation. Test pressures derive from design pressure: structural tests commonly verify the design pressure and 1.5 times it, while water tests take a fraction of design pressure with a minimum. The sequence matters, since water tests after structural loading reflect the real condition after a typhoon. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mock-up test pressure schedule” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設計風壓 DP = 3.0 kPa：水密試驗取 15% DP = 450 Pa（不低於 300 Pa）；結構試驗 100% DP = 3.0 kPa 量測撓度、150% DP = 4.5 kPa 驗證無破壞與殘餘變形；氣密試驗 300 Pa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For design pressure DP = 3.0 kPa: water test at 15% DP = 450 Pa (not below 300 Pa); structural test at 100% DP = 3.0 kPa for deflection and 150% DP = 4.5 kPa for no failure and limited residual set; air test at 300 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樣品牆試驗合格，就代表現場每一片外牆都不會漏水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A passed mock-up proves that every panel on site will be watertight." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樣品牆試驗壓力表」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Mock-up test pressure schedule”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 樣品牆試驗計畫與試驗壓力
knowledge.titleEn: Mock-up test planning and test pressures
knowledge.text: 實驗室性能樣品牆是量產前最重要的關卡：在密閉試驗艙上安裝實尺寸外牆，依規定順序進行氣密、靜態水密、動態水密、結構與層間位移等試驗，再重複氣密與水密，以確認結構變形後仍保有性能。試驗壓力由設計風壓換算：結構試驗常以設計風壓與其 1.5 倍驗證；水密試驗則取設計風壓的一定比例並設下限。
knowledge.textEn: The laboratory performance mock-up is the most important gate before production: a full-size façade is mounted on a sealed test chamber and tested in a prescribed sequence for air, static water, dynamic water, structural and racking performance, then air and water again to confirm performance survives structural deformation. Test pressures derive from design pressure: structural tests commonly verify the design pressure and 1.5 times it, while water tests take a fraction of design pressure with a minimum.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：樣品牆試驗合格，就代表現場每一片外牆都不會漏水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A passed mock-up proves that every panel on site will be watertight. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「樣品牆試驗計畫與試驗壓力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mock-up test planning and test pressures" is correct?
options: 樣品牆試驗合格，就代表現場每一片外牆都不會漏水。
現場試驗的壓力比實驗室低，所以現場試驗只是形式。
實驗室性能樣品牆是量產前最重要的關卡：在密閉試驗艙上安裝實尺寸外牆，依規定順序進行氣密、靜態水密、動態水密、結構與層間位移等試驗，再重複氣密與水密，以確認結構變形後仍保有性能。
optionsEn: A passed mock-up proves that every panel on site will be watertight.
Field tests use lower pressure than the laboratory, so they are a mere formality.

The laboratory performance mock-up is the most important gate before production: a full-size façade is mounted on a sealed test chamber and tested in a prescribed sequence for air, static water, dynamic water, structural and racking performance, then air and water again to confirm performance survives structural deformation.
quiz.explanation: 實驗室性能樣品牆是量產前最重要的關卡：在密閉試驗艙上安裝實尺寸外牆，依規定順序進行氣密、靜態水密、動態水密、結構與層間位移等試驗，再重複氣密與水密，以確認結構變形後仍保有性能。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The laboratory performance mock-up is the most important gate before production: a full-size façade is mounted on a sealed test chamber and tested in a prescribed sequence for air, static water, dynamic water, structural and racking performance, then air and water again to confirm performance survives structural deformation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 樣品牆試驗計畫與試驗壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mock-up test planning and test pressures: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樣品牆試驗壓力表」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mock-up test pressure schedule” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設計風壓 DP = 3.0 kPa：水密試驗取 15% DP = 450 Pa（不低於 300 Pa）；結構試驗 100% DP = 3.0 kPa 量測撓度、150% DP = 4.5 kPa 驗證無破壞與殘餘變形；氣密試驗 300 Pa。若 DP 降為 1.5 kPa，15% 只有 225 Pa，須改用 300 Pa 下限。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For design pressure DP = 3.0 kPa: water test at 15% DP = 450 Pa (not below 300 Pa); structural test at 100% DP = 3.0 kPa for deflection and 150% DP = 4.5 kPa for no failure and limited residual set; air test at 300 Pa. If DP is 1.5 kPa, 15% is only 225 Pa, so the 300 Pa minimum governs. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫在試驗前送審，列明試體範圍（至少含典型單元、上下單元接縫、轉角與最複雜介面）、試驗順序、壓力與持續時間、量測點與允收準則；由獨立實驗室執行，業主顧問全程見證，任何修改都要記錄並納入量產圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Submit the test plan before testing, stating specimen extent (at least typical units, stack joints, a corner and the most complex interface), sequence, pressures and durations, measurement points and acceptance criteria; an independent laboratory performs the tests with the owner's consultant witnessing throughout, and every modification is recorded and carried into production drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 設計風壓 DP = 3.0 kPa：水密試驗取 15% DP = 450 Pa（不低於 300 Pa）；結構試驗 100% DP = 3.0 kPa 量測撓度、150% DP = 4.5 kPa 驗證無破壞與殘餘變形；氣密試驗 300 Pa。若 DP 降為 1.5 kPa，15% 只有 225 Pa，須改用 300 Pa 下限。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For design pressure DP = 3.0 kPa: water test at 15% DP = 450 Pa (not below 300 Pa); structural test at 100% DP = 3.0 kPa for deflection and 150% DP = 4.5 kPa for no failure and limited residual set; air test at 300 Pa. If DP is 1.5 kPa, 15% is only 225 Pa, so the 300 Pa minimum governs. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「樣品牆試驗計畫與試驗壓力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mock-up test planning and test pressures", which statement holds?
options: 設計風壓 DP = 3.0 kPa：水密試驗取 15% DP = 450 Pa（不低於 300 Pa）。
現場用水管噴水不漏，就證明外牆在颱風中也不會漏。
外牆在竣工時通過試驗，之後數十年都會保持同樣的氣密水密性能。
optionsEn: For design pressure DP = 3.0 kPa: water test at 15% DP = 450 Pa (not below 300 Pa).
If a façade does not leak under a site hose, it will not leak in a typhoon either.
A façade that passes its tests at completion keeps the same tightness for decades.
quiz.explanation: 設計風壓 DP = 3.0 kPa：水密試驗取 15% DP = 450 Pa（不低於 300 Pa）；結構試驗 100% DP = 3.0 kPa 量測撓度、150% DP = 4.5 kPa 驗證無破壞與殘餘變形；氣密試驗 300 Pa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For design pressure DP = 3.0 kPa: water test at 15% DP = 450 Pa (not below 300 Pa); structural test at 100% DP = 3.0 kPa for deflection and 150% DP = 4.5 kPa for no failure and limited residual set; air test at 300 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 樣品牆試驗計畫與試驗壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mock-up test planning and test pressures: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樣品牆試驗壓力表」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mock-up test pressure schedule” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗計畫在試驗前送審，列明試體範圍（至少含典型單元、上下單元接縫、轉角與最複雜介面）、試驗順序、壓力與持續時間、量測點與允收準則；由獨立實驗室執行，業主顧問全程見證，任何修改都要記錄並納入量產圖。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Submit the test plan before testing, stating specimen extent (at least typical units, stack joints, a corner and the most complex interface), sequence, pressures and durations, measurement points and acceptance criteria; an independent laboratory performs the tests with the owner's consultant witnessing throughout, and every modification is recorded and carried into production drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：樣品牆試驗合格是量產的停止點；試驗報告要附上所有修改的照片與圖說，並由帷幕牆顧問確認修改已納入量產與安裝程序。量產第一批產品須與試驗品逐項比對。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A passed mock-up is the hold point for production; the test report must include photographs and drawings of every modification, with the façade consultant confirming they are incorporated in production and installation procedures, and the first production batch is compared item by item with the tested specimen.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：樣品牆只做了典型單元而省略轉角與介面，試驗順利過關，量產後漏水卻集中在轉角與屋頂收邊；或試驗中為了通過而大量補打密封膠，卻沒有回寫到量產圖，現場產品與試驗品並不相同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A mock-up limited to typical units, omitting corners and interfaces, passes easily while production leaks concentrate at corners and roof terminations; or sealant is added liberally during testing to pass but never written back into production drawings, so site products differ from the tested specimen. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫在試驗前送審，列明試體範圍（至少含典型單元、上下單元接縫、轉角與最複雜介面）、試驗順序、壓力與持續時間、量測點與允收準則；由獨立實驗室執行，業主顧問全程見證，任何修改都要記錄並納入量產圖。
knowledge.textEn: Submit the test plan before testing, stating specimen extent (at least typical units, stack joints, a corner and the most complex interface), sequence, pressures and durations, measurement points and acceptance criteria; an independent laboratory performs the tests with the owner's consultant witnessing throughout, and every modification is recorded and carried into production drawings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 樣品牆試驗合格是量產的停止點；試驗報告要附上所有修改的照片與圖說，並由帷幕牆顧問確認修改已納入量產與安裝程序。量產第一批產品須與試驗品逐項比對。
knowledge.textEn: A passed mock-up is the hold point for production; the test report must include photographs and drawings of every modification, with the façade consultant confirming they are incorporated in production and installation procedures, and the first production batch is compared item by item with the tested specimen.

quiz.question: 要驗證「樣品牆試驗計畫與試驗壓力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mock-up test planning and test pressures"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
試驗計畫在試驗前送審，列明試體範圍（至少含典型單元、上下單元接縫、轉角與最複雜介面）、試驗順序、壓力與持續時間、量測點與允收準則。
雨幕的通氣開口會讓雨水進入，所以封得越密越好。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Submit the test plan before testing, stating specimen extent (at least typical units, stack joints, a corner and the most complex interface), sequence, pressures and durations, measurement points and acceptance criteria.
Rainscreen vents let rain in, so the tighter the outer layer is sealed the better.
quiz.explanation: 試驗計畫在試驗前送審，列明試體範圍（至少含典型單元、上下單元接縫、轉角與最複雜介面）、試驗順序、壓力與持續時間、量測點與允收準則；由獨立實驗室執行，業主顧問全程見證，任何修改都要記錄並納入量產圖。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Submit the test plan before testing, stating specimen extent (at least typical units, stack joints, a corner and the most complex interface), sequence, pressures and durations, measurement points and acceptance criteria; an independent laboratory performs the tests with the owner's consultant witnessing throughout, and every modification is recorded and carried into production drawings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 樣品牆試驗計畫與試驗壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mock-up test planning and test pressures: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樣品牆試驗壓力表」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mock-up test pressure schedule” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樣品牆只做了典型單元而省略轉角與介面，試驗順利過關，量產後漏水卻集中在轉角與屋頂收邊；或試驗中為了通過而大量補打密封膠，卻沒有回寫到量產圖，現場產品與試驗品並不相同。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A mock-up limited to typical units, omitting corners and interfaces, passes easily while production leaks concentrate at corners and roof terminations; or sealant is added liberally during testing to pass but never written back into production drawings, so site products differ from the tested specimen. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試驗順序很重要，先做結構再做水密，才能反映颱風後的真實狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The sequence matters, since water tests after structural loading reflect the real condition after a typhoon.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樣品牆試驗合格，就代表現場每一片外牆都不會漏水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A passed mock-up proves that every panel on site will be watertight." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 樣品牆只做了典型單元而省略轉角與介面，試驗順利過關，量產後漏水卻集中在轉角與屋頂收邊；或試驗中為了通過而大量補打密封膠，卻沒有回寫到量產圖，現場產品與試驗品並不相同。
knowledge.textEn: A mock-up limited to typical units, omitting corners and interfaces, passes easily while production leaks concentrate at corners and roof terminations; or sealant is added liberally during testing to pass but never written back into production drawings, so site products differ from the tested specimen.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「樣品牆試驗計畫與試驗壓力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mock-up test planning and test pressures" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
現場試驗的壓力比實驗室低，所以現場試驗只是形式。
樣品牆只做了典型單元而省略轉角與介面，試驗順利過關，量產後漏水卻集中在轉角與屋頂收邊。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Field tests use lower pressure than the laboratory, so they are a mere formality.
A mock-up limited to typical units, omitting corners and interfaces, passes easily while production leaks concentrate at corners and roof terminations.
quiz.explanation: 樣品牆只做了典型單元而省略轉角與介面，試驗順利過關，量產後漏水卻集中在轉角與屋頂收邊；或試驗中為了通過而大量補打密封膠，卻沒有回寫到量產圖，現場產品與試驗品並不相同。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A mock-up limited to typical units, omitting corners and interfaces, passes easily while production leaks concentrate at corners and roof terminations; or sealant is added liberally during testing to pass but never written back into production drawings, so site products differ from the tested specimen. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工中的現場氣密水密抽驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Field air and water testing during construction: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「現場抽驗時程」如何影響建築外牆氣密水密試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Field-test schedule” governs force, deformation or durability in “Facade air- and water-tightness testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 實驗室證明的是設計與製造，現場試驗證明的是安裝。因為現場的試體邊界、密封條件與量測精度都不如實驗室，AAMA 503 等現場試驗規範通常把水密試驗壓力降為實驗室的三分之二，並把允許的空氣洩漏量放寬為實驗室值的 1.5 倍。現場試驗最有價值的時機是安裝初期：在第一批樓層完成時就測，可在問題擴散到整棟樓之前修正工法；之後再於中期與完工前抽驗，確認品質穩定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「現場抽驗時程」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The laboratory proves design and manufacture; field tests prove installation. Because specimen boundaries, sealing and measurement precision on site are poorer than in the laboratory, field-test standards such as AAMA 503 usually reduce the water-test pressure to two thirds of the laboratory value and relax the allowable air leakage to 1.5 times the laboratory value. The most valuable time for field testing is early: testing as soon as the first floors are complete lets workmanship be corrected before a problem spreads through the building, followed by sampling at mid-point and before completion to confirm consistent quality. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Field-test schedule” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：實驗室水密 450 Pa，現場 = 2/3×450 = 300 Pa；實驗室氣密限值 0.30 L/s·m²，現場允許 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Laboratory water pressure 450 Pa gives a field pressure of 2/3×450 = 300 Pa; a laboratory air limit of 0.30 L/s·m² gives a field allowance of 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「現場試驗的壓力比實驗室低，所以現場試驗只是形式。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Field tests use lower pressure than the laboratory, so they are a mere formality." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「現場抽驗時程」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Field-test schedule”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工中的現場氣密水密抽驗
knowledge.titleEn: Field air and water testing during construction
knowledge.text: 實驗室證明的是設計與製造，現場試驗證明的是安裝。因為現場的試體邊界、密封條件與量測精度都不如實驗室，AAMA 503 等現場試驗規範通常把水密試驗壓力降為實驗室的三分之二，並把允許的空氣洩漏量放寬為實驗室值的 1.5 倍。
knowledge.textEn: The laboratory proves design and manufacture; field tests prove installation. Because specimen boundaries, sealing and measurement precision on site are poorer than in the laboratory, field-test standards such as AAMA 503 usually reduce the water-test pressure to two thirds of the laboratory value and relax the allowable air leakage to 1.5 times the laboratory value.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：現場試驗的壓力比實驗室低，所以現場試驗只是形式。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Field tests use lower pressure than the laboratory, so they are a mere formality. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工中的現場氣密水密抽驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Field air and water testing during construction" is correct?
options: 實驗室證明的是設計與製造，現場試驗證明的是安裝。
現場試驗的壓力比實驗室低，所以現場試驗只是形式。
流量計讀到的空氣量就是外牆的洩漏量。
optionsEn: The laboratory proves design and manufacture; field tests prove installation.
Field tests use lower pressure than the laboratory, so they are a mere formality.
The airflow read on the meter is the façade's leakage.
quiz.explanation: 實驗室證明的是設計與製造，現場試驗證明的是安裝。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The laboratory proves design and manufacture; field tests prove installation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工中的現場氣密水密抽驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field air and water testing during construction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「現場抽驗時程」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Field-test schedule” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：實驗室水密 450 Pa，現場 = 2/3×450 = 300 Pa；實驗室氣密限值 0.30 L/s·m²，現場允許 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m²。若立面 30,000 m²、規定在 10%、50% 與 90% 完成時各抽驗 2 處，共 6 次；每處試驗面積約 2 個單元 12.6 m²，合計約 75.6 m²，約佔立面 0.25%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Laboratory water pressure 450 Pa gives a field pressure of 2/3×450 = 300 Pa; a laboratory air limit of 0.30 L/s·m² gives a field allowance of 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m². For a 30,000 m² façade with 2 tests each at 10%, 50% and 90% completion, there are 6 tests; at about 2 units or 12.6 m² each, about 75.6 m² is tested, roughly 0.25% of the façade. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：現場試驗依 ASTM E1105（水）與 ASTM E783（氣）在室內側建立密閉試驗箱，扣除試驗箱自身洩漏後計算試體洩漏；抽驗位置由業主顧問隨機或依風險選定（含轉角與介面），不合格時找出原因、修正並擴大抽驗，所有結果納入品質紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Field tests to ASTM E1105 for water and ASTM E783 for air build a sealed chamber on the interior side, deduct chamber leakage and compute specimen leakage; locations are chosen by the owner's consultant at random or by risk, including corners and interfaces, and failures trigger root-cause correction and expanded sampling, with all results kept in the quality records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 實驗室水密 450 Pa，現場 = 2/3×450 = 300 Pa；實驗室氣密限值 0.30 L/s·m²，現場允許 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m²。若立面 30,000 m²、規定在 10%、50% 與 90% 完成時各抽驗 2 處，共 6 次；每處試驗面積約 2 個單元 12.6 m²，合計約 75.6 m²，約佔立面 0.25%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Laboratory water pressure 450 Pa gives a field pressure of 2/3×450 = 300 Pa; a laboratory air limit of 0.30 L/s·m² gives a field allowance of 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m². For a 30,000 m² façade with 2 tests each at 10%, 50% and 90% completion, there are 6 tests; at about 2 units or 12.6 m² each, about 75.6 m² is tested, roughly 0.25% of the façade. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工中的現場氣密水密抽驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Field air and water testing during construction", which statement holds?
options: 在室內出水的位置補上密封膠，就能解決外牆漏水。
外牆會漏水，一定是因為密封膠品質不好。
optionsEn: Sealing the spot where water appears indoors fixes the façade leak.
Laboratory water pressure 450 Pa gives a field pressure of 2/3×450 = 300 Pa.
A leaking façade must have poor-quality sealant.
quiz.explanation: 實驗室水密 450 Pa，現場 = 2/3×450 = 300 Pa；實驗室氣密限值 0.30 L/s·m²，現場允許 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Laboratory water pressure 450 Pa gives a field pressure of 2/3×450 = 300 Pa; a laboratory air limit of 0.30 L/s·m² gives a field allowance of 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工中的現場氣密水密抽驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field air and water testing during construction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「現場抽驗時程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Field-test schedule” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 現場試驗依 ASTM E1105（水）與 ASTM E783（氣）在室內側建立密閉試驗箱，扣除試驗箱自身洩漏後計算試體洩漏；抽驗位置由業主顧問隨機或依風險選定（含轉角與介面），不合格時找出原因、修正並擴大抽驗，所有結果納入品質紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Field tests to ASTM E1105 for water and ASTM E783 for air build a sealed chamber on the interior side, deduct chamber leakage and compute specimen leakage; locations are chosen by the owner's consultant at random or by risk, including corners and interfaces, and failures trigger root-cause correction and expanded sampling, with all results kept in the quality records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約中規定第一次現場試驗必須在安裝首批樓層後立即進行，合格前不得大量安裝；抽驗位置選定權屬業主顧問，試驗失敗的修正與擴大抽驗費用由責任方負擔。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The contract should require the first field test immediately after the first floors are installed, with no large-scale installation until it passes; the owner's consultant chooses test locations, and the responsible party bears the cost of correction and expanded sampling after a failure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：現場試驗拖到完工前才做，發現系統性的上下接縫安裝錯誤時，整棟樓已安裝完畢，只能從室外逐條補修；試驗位置由施工者挑選最容易通過的單元，報告全部合格，實際使用卻持續漏水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Leaving field tests until just before completion means a systematic stack-joint installation error is found only after the whole building is clad, forcing joint-by-joint repair from outside; letting the installer choose the easiest units yields all-pass reports while the building keeps leaking in use. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 現場試驗依 ASTM E1105（水）與 ASTM E783（氣）在室內側建立密閉試驗箱，扣除試驗箱自身洩漏後計算試體洩漏；抽驗位置由業主顧問隨機或依風險選定（含轉角與介面），不合格時找出原因、修正並擴大抽驗，所有結果納入品質紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Field tests to ASTM E1105 for water and ASTM E783 for air build a sealed chamber on the interior side, deduct chamber leakage and compute specimen leakage; locations are chosen by the owner's consultant at random or by risk, including corners and interfaces, and failures trigger root-cause correction and expanded sampling, with all results kept in the quality records.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合約中規定第一次現場試驗必須在安裝首批樓層後立即進行，合格前不得大量安裝；抽驗位置選定權屬業主顧問，試驗失敗的修正與擴大抽驗費用由責任方負擔。
knowledge.textEn: The contract should require the first field test immediately after the first floors are installed, with no large-scale installation until it passes; the owner's consultant chooses test locations, and the responsible party bears the cost of correction and expanded sampling after a failure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工中的現場氣密水密抽驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Field air and water testing during construction"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
空氣洩漏量與壓差成正比，壓差加倍洩漏量也剛好加倍。
現場試驗依 ASTM E1105（水）與 ASTM E783（氣）在室內側建立密閉試驗箱，扣除試驗箱自身洩漏後計算試體洩漏。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Air leakage is proportional to pressure difference, so doubling the pressure exactly doubles the leakage.
Field tests to ASTM E1105 for water and ASTM E783 for air build a sealed chamber on the interior side, deduct chamber leakage and compute specimen leakage.
quiz.explanation: 現場試驗依 ASTM E1105（水）與 ASTM E783（氣）在室內側建立密閉試驗箱，扣除試驗箱自身洩漏後計算試體洩漏；抽驗位置由業主顧問隨機或依風險選定（含轉角與介面），不合格時找出原因、修正並擴大抽驗，所有結果納入品質紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Field tests to ASTM E1105 for water and ASTM E783 for air build a sealed chamber on the interior side, deduct chamber leakage and compute specimen leakage; locations are chosen by the owner's consultant at random or by risk, including corners and interfaces, and failures trigger root-cause correction and expanded sampling, with all results kept in the quality records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工中的現場氣密水密抽驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Field air and water testing during construction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「現場抽驗時程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Field-test schedule” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 現場試驗拖到完工前才做，發現系統性的上下接縫安裝錯誤時，整棟樓已安裝完畢，只能從室外逐條補修；試驗位置由施工者挑選最容易通過的單元，報告全部合格，實際使用卻持續漏水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Leaving field tests until just before completion means a systematic stack-joint installation error is found only after the whole building is clad, forcing joint-by-joint repair from outside; letting the installer choose the easiest units yields all-pass reports while the building keeps leaking in use. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：現場試驗最有價值的時機是安裝初期：在第一批樓層完成時就測，可在問題擴散到整棟樓之前修正工法；之後再於中期與完工前抽驗，確認品質穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The most valuable time for field testing is early: testing as soon as the first floors are complete lets workmanship be corrected before a problem spreads through the building, followed by sampling at mid-point and before completion to confirm consistent quality.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「現場試驗的壓力比實驗室低，所以現場試驗只是形式。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Field tests use lower pressure than the laboratory, so they are a mere formality." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 現場試驗拖到完工前才做，發現系統性的上下接縫安裝錯誤時，整棟樓已安裝完畢，只能從室外逐條補修；試驗位置由施工者挑選最容易通過的單元，報告全部合格，實際使用卻持續漏水。
knowledge.textEn: Leaving field tests until just before completion means a systematic stack-joint installation error is found only after the whole building is clad, forcing joint-by-joint repair from outside; letting the installer choose the easiest units yields all-pass reports while the building keeps leaking in use.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工中的現場氣密水密抽驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Field air and water testing during construction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 現場試驗拖到完工前才做，發現系統性的上下接縫安裝錯誤時，整棟樓已安裝完畢，只能從室外逐條補修。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
流量計讀到的空氣量就是外牆的洩漏量。
optionsEn: Leaving field tests until just before completion means a systematic stack-joint installation error is found only after the whole building is clad, forcing joint-by-joint repair from outside.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The airflow read on the meter is the façade's leakage.
quiz.explanation: 現場試驗拖到完工前才做，發現系統性的上下接縫安裝錯誤時，整棟樓已安裝完畢，只能從室外逐條補修；試驗位置由施工者挑選最容易通過的單元，報告全部合格，實際使用卻持續漏水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Leaving field tests until just before completion means a systematic stack-joint installation error is found only after the whole building is clad, forcing joint-by-joint repair from outside; letting the installer choose the easiest units yields all-pass reports while the building keeps leaking in use. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀」與「靜態、動態與現場噴水水密試驗」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation" and "Static, dynamic and field hose water tests": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「試驗艙與基準洩漏」如何影響建築外牆氣密水密試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Test chamber and tare leakage” governs force, deformation or durability in “Facade air- and water-tightness testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 氣密試驗量到的是流過整個試驗艙的空氣，其中包括試體本身的洩漏，也包括試驗艙與試體邊框之間、艙體接縫的「基準洩漏」。正確的程序是先以塑膠膜完全封住試體，在相同壓差下量測基準洩漏，再撕開膜量測總洩漏，兩者相減才是試體洩漏，再除以試體面積得到單位面積洩漏量。溫度、濕度與大氣壓也會影響流量計讀值，須依標準修正到標準狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「試驗艙與基準洩漏」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An air test measures the air flowing through the whole chamber, which includes the specimen's own leakage plus tare leakage between chamber and specimen frame and at chamber joints. The correct procedure first seals the specimen completely with plastic film and measures tare leakage at the same pressure, then removes the film and measures total leakage; the difference is the specimen leakage, which is divided by specimen area to give leakage per unit area. Temperature, humidity and barometric pressure also affect flow-meter readings and must be corrected to standard conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Test chamber and tare leakage” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：試體 3 個單元 × 1.5 m 寬 × 8.4 m 高（兩層），面積 A = 37.8 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Specimen of 3 units × 1.5 m wide × 8.4 m high (two storeys), area A = 37.8 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「流量計讀到的空氣量就是外牆的洩漏量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The airflow read on the meter is the façade's leakage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「試驗艙與基準洩漏」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Test chamber and tare leakage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀
knowledge.titleEn: Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation
knowledge.text: 氣密試驗量到的是流過整個試驗艙的空氣，其中包括試體本身的洩漏，也包括試驗艙與試體邊框之間、艙體接縫的「基準洩漏」。正確的程序是先以塑膠膜完全封住試體，在相同壓差下量測基準洩漏，再撕開膜量測總洩漏，兩者相減才是試體洩漏，再除以試體面積得到單位面積洩漏量。
knowledge.textEn: An air test measures the air flowing through the whole chamber, which includes the specimen's own leakage plus tare leakage between chamber and specimen frame and at chamber joints. The correct procedure first seals the specimen completely with plastic film and measures tare leakage at the same pressure, then removes the film and measures total leakage; the difference is the specimen leakage, which is divided by specimen area to give leakage per unit area.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：流量計讀到的空氣量就是外牆的洩漏量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The airflow read on the meter is the façade's leakage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation" is correct?
options: 流量計讀到的空氣量就是外牆的洩漏量。
氣密試驗量到的是流過整個試驗艙的空氣，其中包括試體本身的洩漏，也包括試驗艙與試體邊框之間、艙體接縫的「基準洩漏」。
現場用水管噴水不漏，就證明外牆在颱風中也不會漏。
optionsEn: The airflow read on the meter is the façade's leakage.
An air test measures the air flowing through the whole chamber, which includes the specimen's own leakage plus tare leakage between chamber and specimen frame and at chamber joints.
If a façade does not leak under a site hose, it will not leak in a typhoon either.
quiz.explanation: 氣密試驗量到的是流過整個試驗艙的空氣，其中包括試體本身的洩漏，也包括試驗艙與試體邊框之間、艙體接縫的「基準洩漏」。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An air test measures the air flowing through the whole chamber, which includes the specimen's own leakage plus tare leakage between chamber and specimen frame and at chamber joints. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試驗艙與基準洩漏」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Test chamber and tare leakage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：試體 3 個單元 × 1.5 m 寬 × 8.4 m 高（兩層），面積 A = 37.8 m²。300 Pa 下總洩漏 18.0 L/s、封膜基準洩漏 4.5 L/s：試體洩漏 = 18.0 − 4.5 = 13.5 L/s，q = 13.5/37.8 ≈ 0.36 L/s·m²，超過 0.30 限值而不合格；若忘了扣除基準洩漏，誤算為 0.48 L/s·m²。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Specimen of 3 units × 1.5 m wide × 8.4 m high (two storeys), area A = 37.8 m². At 300 Pa total leakage is 18.0 L/s and tare leakage with the film on is 4.5 L/s: specimen leakage = 18.0 − 4.5 = 13.5 L/s and q = 13.5/37.8 ≈ 0.36 L/s·m², above the 0.30 limit, so it fails; forgetting the tare correction would give 0.48 L/s·m². Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：確認流量計校正有效、試驗艙基準洩漏小於試體預期洩漏的一定比例、各壓差停留時間足以穩定；不合格時以煙筆或紅外線熱像在試體內側找出洩漏點，修正後重做，並記錄修正內容與重測結果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm that the flow meter is in calibration, that chamber tare leakage is a small fraction of expected specimen leakage and that each pressure step is held long enough to stabilise; after a failure locate leaks on the inner face with a smoke pencil or infrared thermography, correct them and retest, recording the corrections and new results.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 試體 3 個單元 × 1.5 m 寬 × 8.4 m 高（兩層），面積 A = 37.8 m²。300 Pa 下總洩漏 18.0 L/s、封膜基準洩漏 4.5 L/s：試體洩漏 = 18.0 − 4.5 = 13.5 L/s，q = 13.5/37.8 ≈ 0.36 L/s·m²，超過 0.30 限值而不合格；若忘了扣除基準洩漏，誤算為 0.48 L/s·m²。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Specimen of 3 units × 1.5 m wide × 8.4 m high (two storeys), area A = 37.8 m². At 300 Pa total leakage is 18.0 L/s and tare leakage with the film on is 4.5 L/s: specimen leakage = 18.0 − 4.5 = 13.5 L/s and q = 13.5/37.8 ≈ 0.36 L/s·m², above the 0.30 limit, so it fails; forgetting the tare correction would give 0.48 L/s·m². Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation", which statement holds?
options: 外牆在竣工時通過試驗，之後數十年都會保持同樣的氣密水密性能。
雨幕的通氣開口會讓雨水進入，所以封得越密越好。
試體 3 個單元 × 1.5 m 寬 × 8.4 m 高（兩層），面積 A = 37.8 m²。
optionsEn: A façade that passes its tests at completion keeps the same tightness for decades.
Rainscreen vents let rain in, so the tighter the outer layer is sealed the better.
Specimen of 3 units × 1.5 m wide × 8.4 m high (two storeys), area A = 37.8 m².
quiz.explanation: 試體 3 個單元 × 1.5 m 寬 × 8.4 m 高（兩層），面積 A = 37.8 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Specimen of 3 units × 1.5 m wide × 8.4 m high (two storeys), area A = 37.8 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試驗艙與基準洩漏」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Test chamber and tare leakage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 確認流量計校正有效、試驗艙基準洩漏小於試體預期洩漏的一定比例、各壓差停留時間足以穩定；不合格時以煙筆或紅外線熱像在試體內側找出洩漏點，修正後重做，並記錄修正內容與重測結果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm that the flow meter is in calibration, that chamber tare leakage is a small fraction of expected specimen leakage and that each pressure step is held long enough to stabilise; after a failure locate leaks on the inner face with a smoke pencil or infrared thermography, correct them and retest, recording the corrections and new results. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗報告必須同時列出總洩漏、基準洩漏、修正後試體洩漏、試體面積、環境條件與流量計校正證明；業主顧問應親自見證封膜與撕膜兩個步驟，避免只拿到最終數字。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The test report must list total leakage, tare leakage, corrected specimen leakage, specimen area, ambient conditions and flow-meter calibration together; the owner's consultant should witness both the sealed and unsealed steps rather than receive only the final number.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試驗艙邊框密封不良，基準洩漏比試體洩漏還大，量測誤差掩蓋了試體的真實表現；或基準洩漏只在單一壓差量測，其他壓差直接套用，造成洩漏曲線失真而誤判合格。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A poorly sealed chamber frame gives tare leakage larger than the specimen's, so measurement error hides the specimen's real performance; or tare leakage measured at only one pressure is applied to all others, distorting the leakage curve and producing a false pass. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 確認流量計校正有效、試驗艙基準洩漏小於試體預期洩漏的一定比例、各壓差停留時間足以穩定；不合格時以煙筆或紅外線熱像在試體內側找出洩漏點，修正後重做，並記錄修正內容與重測結果。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm that the flow meter is in calibration, that chamber tare leakage is a small fraction of expected specimen leakage and that each pressure step is held long enough to stabilise; after a failure locate leaks on the inner face with a smoke pencil or infrared thermography, correct them and retest, recording the corrections and new results.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 試驗報告必須同時列出總洩漏、基準洩漏、修正後試體洩漏、試體面積、環境條件與流量計校正證明；業主顧問應親自見證封膜與撕膜兩個步驟，避免只拿到最終數字。
knowledge.textEn: The test report must list total leakage, tare leakage, corrected specimen leakage, specimen area, ambient conditions and flow-meter calibration together; the owner's consultant should witness both the sealed and unsealed steps rather than receive only the final number.

quiz.question: 要驗證「氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation"?
options: 確認流量計校正有效、試驗艙基準洩漏小於試體預期洩漏的一定比例、各壓差停留時間足以穩定。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
接縫縫隙做得越小，雨水就越不會滲入牆內。
optionsEn: Confirm that the flow meter is in calibration, that chamber tare leakage is a small fraction of expected specimen leakage and that each pressure step is held long enough to stabilise.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The narrower a joint gap is made, the less rain can get into the wall.
quiz.explanation: 確認流量計校正有效、試驗艙基準洩漏小於試體預期洩漏的一定比例、各壓差停留時間足以穩定；不合格時以煙筆或紅外線熱像在試體內側找出洩漏點，修正後重做，並記錄修正內容與重測結果。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm that the flow meter is in calibration, that chamber tare leakage is a small fraction of expected specimen leakage and that each pressure step is held long enough to stabilise; after a failure locate leaks on the inner face with a smoke pencil or infrared thermography, correct them and retest, recording the corrections and new results. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試驗艙與基準洩漏」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Test chamber and tare leakage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試驗艙邊框密封不良，基準洩漏比試體洩漏還大，量測誤差掩蓋了試體的真實表現；或基準洩漏只在單一壓差量測，其他壓差直接套用，造成洩漏曲線失真而誤判合格。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A poorly sealed chamber frame gives tare leakage larger than the specimen's, so measurement error hides the specimen's real performance; or tare leakage measured at only one pressure is applied to all others, distorting the leakage curve and producing a false pass. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：溫度、濕度與大氣壓也會影響流量計讀值，須依標準修正到標準狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Temperature, humidity and barometric pressure also affect flow-meter readings and must be corrected to standard conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「流量計讀到的空氣量就是外牆的洩漏量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The airflow read on the meter is the façade's leakage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試驗艙邊框密封不良，基準洩漏比試體洩漏還大，量測誤差掩蓋了試體的真實表現；或基準洩漏只在單一壓差量測，其他壓差直接套用，造成洩漏曲線失真而誤判合格。
knowledge.textEn: A poorly sealed chamber frame gives tare leakage larger than the specimen's, so measurement error hides the specimen's real performance; or tare leakage measured at only one pressure is applied to all others, distorting the leakage curve and producing a false pass.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
試驗艙邊框密封不良，基準洩漏比試體洩漏還大，量測誤差掩蓋了試體的真實表現；或基準洩漏只在單一壓差量測，其他壓差直接套用，造成洩漏曲線失真而誤判合格。
現場用水管噴水不漏，就證明外牆在颱風中也不會漏。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A poorly sealed chamber frame gives tare leakage larger than the specimen's, so measurement error hides the specimen's real performance.
If a façade does not leak under a site hose, it will not leak in a typhoon either.
quiz.explanation: 試驗艙邊框密封不良，基準洩漏比試體洩漏還大，量測誤差掩蓋了試體的真實表現；或基準洩漏只在單一壓差量測，其他壓差直接套用，造成洩漏曲線失真而誤判合格。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A poorly sealed chamber frame gives tare leakage larger than the specimen's, so measurement error hides the specimen's real performance; or tare leakage measured at only one pressure is applied to all others, distorting the leakage curve and producing a false pass. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 靜態、動態與現場噴水水密試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Static, dynamic and field hose water tests: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「噴水架與 B25 噴嘴」如何影響建築外牆氣密水密試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spray rack and B25 nozzle” governs force, deformation or durability in “Facade air- and water-tightness testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 水密試驗有三種主要形式：ASTM E331 在外側以噴水架均勻噴水，同時在試體兩側維持靜態壓差 15 分鐘；AAMA 501.1 以大型螺旋槳風機產生紊動風與噴水，模擬颱風的動態壓力與風雨，檢查壓力等化系統在脈動下是否有效；AAMA 501.2 則是在現場以手持噴嘴對已安裝的接縫直接噴水，沒有壓差，只檢查接縫與介面的施工品質。三者各有角色，不能互相取代：現場噴水合格不代表系統在壓差下不漏。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「噴水架與 B25 噴嘴」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water tests take three main forms: ASTM E331 sprays the exterior uniformly from a spray rack while holding a static pressure difference across the specimen for 15 minutes; AAMA 501.1 uses a large propeller wind generator with spray to create turbulent wind and rain, simulating the dynamic pressures of a typhoon and checking whether pressure equalisation works under pulsation; AAMA 501.2 sprays installed joints on site with a hand-held nozzle and no pressure difference, checking only the workmanship of joints and interfaces. Each has its role and none replaces another: passing a field hose test does not mean the system stays dry under pressure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Spray rack and B25 nozzle” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：噴水量換算：5 gal/ft²·h = 5×3.785 L/(0.0929 m²×60 min) ≈ 3.4 L/m²·min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Spray-rate conversion: 5 gal/ft²·h = 5×3.785 L/(0.0929 m²×60 min) ≈ 3.4 L/m²·min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「現場用水管噴水不漏，就證明外牆在颱風中也不會漏。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a façade does not leak under a site hose, it will not leak in a typhoon either." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「噴水架與 B25 噴嘴」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Spray rack and B25 nozzle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 靜態、動態與現場噴水水密試驗
knowledge.titleEn: Static, dynamic and field hose water tests
knowledge.text: 水密試驗有三種主要形式：ASTM E331 在外側以噴水架均勻噴水，同時在試體兩側維持靜態壓差 15 分鐘；AAMA 501.1 以大型螺旋槳風機產生紊動風與噴水，模擬颱風的動態壓力與風雨，檢查壓力等化系統在脈動下是否有效；AAMA 501.2 則是在現場以手持噴嘴對已安裝的接縫直接噴水，沒有壓差，只檢查接縫與介面的施工品質。三者各有角色，不能互相取代：現場噴水合格不代表系統在壓差下不漏。
knowledge.textEn: Water tests take three main forms: ASTM E331 sprays the exterior uniformly from a spray rack while holding a static pressure difference across the specimen for 15 minutes; AAMA 501.1 uses a large propeller wind generator with spray to create turbulent wind and rain, simulating the dynamic pressures of a typhoon and checking whether pressure equalisation works under pulsation; AAMA 501.2 sprays installed joints on site with a hand-held nozzle and no pressure difference, checking only the workmanship of joints and interfaces. Each has its role and none replaces another: passing a field hose test does not mean the system stays dry under pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：現場用水管噴水不漏，就證明外牆在颱風中也不會漏。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a façade does not leak under a site hose, it will not leak in a typhoon either. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「靜態、動態與現場噴水水密試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Static, dynamic and field hose water tests" is correct?
options: 現場用水管噴水不漏，就證明外牆在颱風中也不會漏。
在室內出水的位置補上密封膠，就能解決外牆漏水。

optionsEn: If a façade does not leak under a site hose, it will not leak in a typhoon either.
Sealing the spot where water appears indoors fixes the façade leak.

quiz.explanationEn: Water tests take three main forms: ASTM E331 sprays the exterior uniformly from a spray rack while holding a static pressure difference across the specimen for 15 minutes; AAMA 501.1 uses a large propeller wind generator with spray to create turbulent wind and rain, simulating the dynamic pressures of a typhoon and checking whether pressure equalisation works under pulsation; AAMA 501.2 sprays installed joints on site with a hand-held nozzle and no pressure difference, checking only the workmanship of joints and interfaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 靜態、動態與現場噴水水密試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Static, dynamic and field hose water tests: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「噴水架與 B25 噴嘴」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spray rack and B25 nozzle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：噴水量換算：5 gal/ft²·h = 5×3.785 L/(0.0929 m²×60 min) ≈ 3.4 L/m²·min。AAMA 501.2 以 B25 #6.030 噴嘴、噴嘴處 30 psi（約 207 kPa），每 5 ft（約 1.52 m）接縫噴 5 分鐘：抽驗 200 m 接縫需 200/1.524×5 ≈ 656 min，約 10.9 小時。抽驗長度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Spray-rate conversion: 5 gal/ft²·h = 5×3.785 L/(0.0929 m²×60 min) ≈ 3.4 L/m²·min. AAMA 501.2 uses a B25 #6.030 nozzle at 30 psi (about 207 kPa) at the nozzle, spraying 5 minutes per 5 ft (about 1.52 m) of joint: checking 200 m of joints takes 200/1.524×5 ≈ 656 min, about 10.9 hours. The sampled length is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：實驗室試驗前校正噴水架流量的均勻性與壓力；現場噴水試驗須由外到內安排觀察員，從最低的接縫開始向上逐段噴水，記錄每段的時間、位置與是否滲水，並以照片標示；允收準則（例如內側不得出現未受控制的水）須事先定義。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before laboratory tests calibrate the spray rack for uniform flow and pressure; for field hose tests station an observer inside, spray joint segments from the lowest upward, record time, position and any leakage for each segment, and mark them on photographs; the acceptance criterion, such as no uncontrolled water on the interior, must be defined beforehand.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 噴水量換算：5 gal/ft²·h = 5×3.785 L/(0.0929 m²×60 min) ≈ 3.4 L/m²·min。AAMA 501.2 以 B25 #6.030 噴嘴、噴嘴處 30 psi（約 207 kPa），每 5 ft（約 1.52 m）接縫噴 5 分鐘：抽驗 200 m 接縫需 200/1.524×5 ≈ 656 min，約 10.9 小時。抽驗長度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Spray-rate conversion: 5 gal/ft²·h = 5×3.785 L/(0.0929 m²×60 min) ≈ 3.4 L/m²·min. AAMA 501.2 uses a B25 #6.030 nozzle at 30 psi (about 207 kPa) at the nozzle, spraying 5 minutes per 5 ft (about 1.52 m) of joint: checking 200 m of joints takes 200/1.524×5 ≈ 656 min, about 10.9 hours. The sampled length is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「靜態、動態與現場噴水水密試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Static, dynamic and field hose water tests", which statement holds?
options: 噴水量換算：5 gal/ft²·h = 5×3.785 L/(0.0929 m²×60 min) ≈ 3.4 L/m²·min。
外牆會漏水，一定是因為密封膠品質不好。
空氣洩漏量與壓差成正比，壓差加倍洩漏量也剛好加倍。

A leaking façade must have poor-quality sealant.
