quiz.explanation: 噴水量換算：5 gal/ft²·h = 5×3.785 L/(0.0929 m²×60 min) ≈ 3.4 L/m²·min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Spray-rate conversion: 5 gal/ft²·h = 5×3.785 L/(0.0929 m²×60 min) ≈ 3.4 L/m²·min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 靜態、動態與現場噴水水密試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Static, dynamic and field hose water tests: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「噴水架與 B25 噴嘴」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spray rack and B25 nozzle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 實驗室試驗前校正噴水架流量的均勻性與壓力；現場噴水試驗須由外到內安排觀察員，從最低的接縫開始向上逐段噴水，記錄每段的時間、位置與是否滲水，並以照片標示；允收準則（例如內側不得出現未受控制的水）須事先定義。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before laboratory tests calibrate the spray rack for uniform flow and pressure; for field hose tests station an observer inside, spray joint segments from the lowest upward, record time, position and any leakage for each segment, and mark them on photographs; the acceptance criterion, such as no uncontrolled water on the interior, must be defined beforehand. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規範要分別指定實驗室靜態、動態與現場噴水試驗的適用範圍與允收準則，並規定現場噴水使用標準噴嘴與壓力錶；每次試驗由業主顧問見證並簽認紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should state separately the scope and acceptance criteria for laboratory static, dynamic and field hose tests, and require a standard nozzle and pressure gauge on site; the owner's consultant witnesses and signs each test record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：現場噴水從高處開始，水往下流使下方接縫同時被測試，漏水點無法定位；或以一般水管與不定壓力噴水，結果無法重現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Starting a hose test at the top lets water run down and wet lower joints simultaneously, so leaks cannot be located; using an ordinary hose at uncontrolled pressure makes results unrepeatable; a system tested only statically may lose equalisation under typhoon gust pulsation and leak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 實驗室試驗前校正噴水架流量的均勻性與壓力；現場噴水試驗須由外到內安排觀察員，從最低的接縫開始向上逐段噴水，記錄每段的時間、位置與是否滲水，並以照片標示；允收準則（例如內側不得出現未受控制的水）須事先定義。
knowledge.textEn: Before laboratory tests calibrate the spray rack for uniform flow and pressure; for field hose tests station an observer inside, spray joint segments from the lowest upward, record time, position and any leakage for each segment, and mark them on photographs; the acceptance criterion, such as no uncontrolled water on the interior, must be defined beforehand.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規範要分別指定實驗室靜態、動態與現場噴水試驗的適用範圍與允收準則，並規定現場噴水使用標準噴嘴與壓力錶；每次試驗由業主顧問見證並簽認紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: The specification should state separately the scope and acceptance criteria for laboratory static, dynamic and field hose tests, and require a standard nozzle and pressure gauge on site; the owner's consultant witnesses and signs each test record.

quiz.question: 要驗證「靜態、動態與現場噴水水密試驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Static, dynamic and field hose water tests"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
實驗室試驗前校正噴水架流量的均勻性與壓力。
樣品牆試驗合格，就代表現場每一片外牆都不會漏水。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Before laboratory tests calibrate the spray rack for uniform flow and pressure.
A passed mock-up proves that every panel on site will be watertight.
quiz.explanation: 實驗室試驗前校正噴水架流量的均勻性與壓力；現場噴水試驗須由外到內安排觀察員，從最低的接縫開始向上逐段噴水，記錄每段的時間、位置與是否滲水，並以照片標示；允收準則（例如內側不得出現未受控制的水）須事先定義。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before laboratory tests calibrate the spray rack for uniform flow and pressure; for field hose tests station an observer inside, spray joint segments from the lowest upward, record time, position and any leakage for each segment, and mark them on photographs; the acceptance criterion, such as no uncontrolled water on the interior, must be defined beforehand. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 靜態、動態與現場噴水水密試驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Static, dynamic and field hose water tests: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「噴水架與 B25 噴嘴」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spray rack and B25 nozzle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 現場噴水從高處開始，水往下流使下方接縫同時被測試，漏水點無法定位；或以一般水管與不定壓力噴水，結果無法重現。只做靜態試驗的系統，在颱風的陣風脈動下等化失效而漏水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Starting a hose test at the top lets water run down and wet lower joints simultaneously, so leaks cannot be located; using an ordinary hose at uncontrolled pressure makes results unrepeatable; a system tested only statically may lose equalisation under typhoon gust pulsation and leak. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：三者各有角色，不能互相取代：現場噴水合格不代表系統在壓差下不漏。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each has its role and none replaces another: passing a field hose test does not mean the system stays dry under pressure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「現場用水管噴水不漏，就證明外牆在颱風中也不會漏。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a façade does not leak under a site hose, it will not leak in a typhoon either." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 現場噴水從高處開始，水往下流使下方接縫同時被測試，漏水點無法定位；或以一般水管與不定壓力噴水，結果無法重現。只做靜態試驗的系統，在颱風的陣風脈動下等化失效而漏水。
knowledge.textEn: Starting a hose test at the top lets water run down and wet lower joints simultaneously, so leaks cannot be located; using an ordinary hose at uncontrolled pressure makes results unrepeatable; a system tested only statically may lose equalisation under typhoon gust pulsation and leak.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「靜態、動態與現場噴水水密試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Static, dynamic and field hose water tests" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
在室內出水的位置補上密封膠，就能解決外牆漏水。
現場噴水從高處開始，水往下流使下方接縫同時被測試，漏水點無法定位；或以一般水管與不定壓力噴水，結果無法重現。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Sealing the spot where water appears indoors fixes the façade leak.
Starting a hose test at the top lets water run down and wet lower joints simultaneously, so leaks cannot be located.
quiz.explanation: 現場噴水從高處開始，水往下流使下方接縫同時被測試，漏水點無法定位；或以一般水管與不定壓力噴水，結果無法重現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Starting a hose test at the top lets water run down and wet lower joints simultaneously, so leaks cannot be located; using an ordinary hose at uncontrolled pressure makes results unrepeatable; a system tested only statically may lose equalisation under typhoon gust pulsation and leak. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漏水診斷、溼害與法律責任」與「地震颱風後複驗、保固與竣工交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Leak diagnosis, moisture damage and liability" and "Post-event re-testing, warranty and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漏水診斷、溼害與法律責任：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Leak diagnosis, moisture damage and liability: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「漏水路徑診斷」如何影響建築外牆氣密水密試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Leak-path diagnosis” governs force, deformation or durability in “Facade air- and water-tightness testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 使用中的外牆漏水，難處在於水在牆內移動的路徑常與內側出水點相距甚遠。診斷要從資料開始：漏水時的風向、雨量與持續時間，再以分段噴水由下往上隔離可疑接縫，搭配紅外線熱像、含水率計與局部拆檢找出入口。小量長期滲漏比偶發的大量漏水更危險，因為它在牆內持續累積，造成金屬腐蝕、隔熱層失效與發霉。英屬哥倫比亞沿海的漏水公寓危機與麻省理工學院 Stata 中心的漏水訴訟，都顯示外牆水密失敗最後會變成昂貴的修復與法律責任。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「漏水路徑診斷」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The difficulty with leaks in service is that water often travels far inside the wall from where it enters to where it appears. Diagnosis starts with data on wind direction, rainfall and duration during leaks, then isolates suspect joints by segment-by-segment spraying from the bottom up, with infrared thermography, moisture meters and local opening-up to find the entry point. Small long-term leaks are more dangerous than occasional large ones because they accumulate inside the wall, corroding metal, degrading insulation and causing mould. The leaky-condominium crisis in coastal British Columbia and the leak litigation over MIT's Stata Center both show that façade watertightness failures end in costly repairs and legal liability. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Leak-path diagnosis” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一個接縫在降雨時滲漏 0.05 L/h，若年降雨時數 800 h，每年進入牆內 0.05×800 = 40 L；若牆內只能以蒸發排出每年 15 L，淨累積 25 L/年，5 年後約 125 L 留在牆內。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A joint leaking 0.05 L/h during rain, with 800 rain hours a year, admits 0.05×800 = 40 L per year; if the wall can dry only 15 L a year by evaporation, 25 L accumulates each year, about 125 L after 5 years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「在室內出水的位置補上密封膠，就能解決外牆漏水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Sealing the spot where water appears indoors fixes the façade leak." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「漏水路徑診斷」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Leak-path diagnosis”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 漏水診斷、溼害與法律責任
knowledge.titleEn: Leak diagnosis, moisture damage and liability
knowledge.text: 使用中的外牆漏水，難處在於水在牆內移動的路徑常與內側出水點相距甚遠。診斷要從資料開始：漏水時的風向、雨量與持續時間，再以分段噴水由下往上隔離可疑接縫，搭配紅外線熱像、含水率計與局部拆檢找出入口。
knowledge.textEn: The difficulty with leaks in service is that water often travels far inside the wall from where it enters to where it appears. Diagnosis starts with data on wind direction, rainfall and duration during leaks, then isolates suspect joints by segment-by-segment spraying from the bottom up, with infrared thermography, moisture meters and local opening-up to find the entry point.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：在室內出水的位置補上密封膠，就能解決外牆漏水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Sealing the spot where water appears indoors fixes the façade leak. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漏水診斷、溼害與法律責任」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Leak diagnosis, moisture damage and liability" is correct?
options: 使用中的外牆漏水，難處在於水在牆內移動的路徑常與內側出水點相距甚遠。
在室內出水的位置補上密封膠，就能解決外牆漏水。
外牆在竣工時通過試驗，之後數十年都會保持同樣的氣密水密性能。
optionsEn: The difficulty with leaks in service is that water often travels far inside the wall from where it enters to where it appears.
Sealing the spot where water appears indoors fixes the façade leak.
A façade that passes its tests at completion keeps the same tightness for decades.
quiz.explanation: 使用中的外牆漏水，難處在於水在牆內移動的路徑常與內側出水點相距甚遠。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The difficulty with leaks in service is that water often travels far inside the wall from where it enters to where it appears. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 漏水診斷、溼害與法律責任：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Leak diagnosis, moisture damage and liability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漏水路徑診斷」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Leak-path diagnosis” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一個接縫在降雨時滲漏 0.05 L/h，若年降雨時數 800 h，每年進入牆內 0.05×800 = 40 L；若牆內只能以蒸發排出每年 15 L，淨累積 25 L/年，5 年後約 125 L 留在牆內。分段隔離 6 條可疑接縫，每段噴水 5 分鐘並觀察 10 分鐘，需 6×(5 + 10) = 90 分鐘。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A joint leaking 0.05 L/h during rain, with 800 rain hours a year, admits 0.05×800 = 40 L per year; if the wall can dry only 15 L a year by evaporation, 25 L accumulates each year, about 125 L after 5 years. Isolating 6 suspect joints with 5 minutes of spray and 10 minutes of observation each takes 6×(5 + 10) = 90 minutes. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立漏水紀錄表（日期、位置、風向、雨量、出水量），以分段噴水重現漏水並定位入口；修補後在相同條件下複驗，並以含水率計或感測器追蹤牆內乾燥；重大漏水案件須由獨立外牆顧問出具調查報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Keep a leak log (date, position, wind direction, rainfall, quantity), reproduce the leak by segment-by-segment spraying to locate the entry point, retest under the same conditions after repair and track drying inside the wall with moisture meters or sensors; serious cases need an investigation report by an independent façade consultant.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一個接縫在降雨時滲漏 0.05 L/h，若年降雨時數 800 h，每年進入牆內 0.05×800 = 40 L；若牆內只能以蒸發排出每年 15 L，淨累積 25 L/年，5 年後約 125 L 留在牆內。分段隔離 6 條可疑接縫，每段噴水 5 分鐘並觀察 10 分鐘，需 6×(5 + 10) = 90 分鐘。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A joint leaking 0.05 L/h during rain, with 800 rain hours a year, admits 0.05×800 = 40 L per year; if the wall can dry only 15 L a year by evaporation, 25 L accumulates each year, about 125 L after 5 years. Isolating 6 suspect joints with 5 minutes of spray and 10 minutes of observation each takes 6×(5 + 10) = 90 minutes. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「漏水診斷、溼害與法律責任」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Leak diagnosis, moisture damage and liability", which statement holds?
options: 雨幕的通氣開口會讓雨水進入，所以封得越密越好。
一個接縫在降雨時滲漏 0.05 L/h，若年降雨時數 800 h，每年進入牆內 0.05×800 = 40 L。
接縫縫隙做得越小，雨水就越不會滲入牆內。
optionsEn: Rainscreen vents let rain in, so the tighter the outer layer is sealed the better.
A joint leaking 0.05 L/h during rain, with 800 rain hours a year, admits 0.05×800 = 40 L per year.
The narrower a joint gap is made, the less rain can get into the wall.
quiz.explanation: 一個接縫在降雨時滲漏 0.05 L/h，若年降雨時數 800 h，每年進入牆內 0.05×800 = 40 L；若牆內只能以蒸發排出每年 15 L，淨累積 25 L/年，5 年後約 125 L 留在牆內。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A joint leaking 0.05 L/h during rain, with 800 rain hours a year, admits 0.05×800 = 40 L per year; if the wall can dry only 15 L a year by evaporation, 25 L accumulates each year, about 125 L after 5 years. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漏水診斷、溼害與法律責任：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Leak diagnosis, moisture damage and liability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漏水路徑診斷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Leak-path diagnosis” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立漏水紀錄表（日期、位置、風向、雨量、出水量），以分段噴水重現漏水並定位入口；修補後在相同條件下複驗，並以含水率計或感測器追蹤牆內乾燥；重大漏水案件須由獨立外牆顧問出具調查報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Keep a leak log (date, position, wind direction, rainfall, quantity), reproduce the leak by segment-by-segment spraying to locate the entry point, retest under the same conditions after repair and track drying inside the wall with moisture meters or sensors; serious cases need an investigation report by an independent façade consultant. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保固期內的每一次漏水都要依程序調查並記錄根因，不得只做表面補修；涉及設計或系統性施工缺陷時，業主、設計者與承包商須依合約啟動責任判定程序，並保留所有試驗與調查證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Every leak during the warranty period must be investigated by procedure with the root cause recorded, not merely patched; where design or systematic workmanship defects are involved, owner, designer and contractor must start the contractual liability process and preserve all test and investigation evidence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：管理單位只在室內出水點補打密封膠，真正的入口在數米外的上方介面，水改道從其他位置流出；牆內長期累積的水使鋼件鏽蝕、隔熱棉失效，等到發現時已需拆除整片外牆修復。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Management seals only where water appears indoors while the real entry is an interface several metres above, so the water reroutes and emerges elsewhere; water accumulating inside the wall for years rusts steel and ruins insulation, and by discovery the remedy requires removing whole areas of cladding. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立漏水紀錄表（日期、位置、風向、雨量、出水量），以分段噴水重現漏水並定位入口；修補後在相同條件下複驗，並以含水率計或感測器追蹤牆內乾燥；重大漏水案件須由獨立外牆顧問出具調查報告。
knowledge.textEn: Keep a leak log (date, position, wind direction, rainfall, quantity), reproduce the leak by segment-by-segment spraying to locate the entry point, retest under the same conditions after repair and track drying inside the wall with moisture meters or sensors; serious cases need an investigation report by an independent façade consultant.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保固期內的每一次漏水都要依程序調查並記錄根因，不得只做表面補修；涉及設計或系統性施工缺陷時，業主、設計者與承包商須依合約啟動責任判定程序，並保留所有試驗與調查證據。
knowledge.textEn: Every leak during the warranty period must be investigated by procedure with the root cause recorded, not merely patched; where design or systematic workmanship defects are involved, owner, designer and contractor must start the contractual liability process and preserve all test and investigation evidence.

quiz.question: 要驗證「漏水診斷、溼害與法律責任」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Leak diagnosis, moisture damage and liability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
現場試驗的壓力比實驗室低，所以現場試驗只是形式。
建立漏水紀錄表（日期、位置、風向、雨量、出水量），以分段噴水重現漏水並定位入口。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Field tests use lower pressure than the laboratory, so they are a mere formality.

Keep a leak log (date, position, wind direction, rainfall, quantity), reproduce the leak by segment-by-segment spraying to locate the entry point, retest under the same conditions after repair and track drying inside the wall with moisture meters or sensors.
quiz.explanation: 建立漏水紀錄表（日期、位置、風向、雨量、出水量），以分段噴水重現漏水並定位入口；修補後在相同條件下複驗，並以含水率計或感測器追蹤牆內乾燥；重大漏水案件須由獨立外牆顧問出具調查報告。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Keep a leak log (date, position, wind direction, rainfall, quantity), reproduce the leak by segment-by-segment spraying to locate the entry point, retest under the same conditions after repair and track drying inside the wall with moisture meters or sensors; serious cases need an investigation report by an independent façade consultant. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 漏水診斷、溼害與法律責任：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Leak diagnosis, moisture damage and liability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漏水路徑診斷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Leak-path diagnosis” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 管理單位只在室內出水點補打密封膠，真正的入口在數米外的上方介面，水改道從其他位置流出；牆內長期累積的水使鋼件鏽蝕、隔熱棉失效，等到發現時已需拆除整片外牆修復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Management seals only where water appears indoors while the real entry is an interface several metres above, so the water reroutes and emerges elsewhere; water accumulating inside the wall for years rusts steel and ruins insulation, and by discovery the remedy requires removing whole areas of cladding. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：英屬哥倫比亞沿海的漏水公寓危機與麻省理工學院 Stata 中心的漏水訴訟，都顯示外牆水密失敗最後會變成昂貴的修復與法律責任。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The leaky-condominium crisis in coastal British Columbia and the leak litigation over MIT's Stata Center both show that façade watertightness failures end in costly repairs and legal liability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「在室內出水的位置補上密封膠，就能解決外牆漏水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Sealing the spot where water appears indoors fixes the façade leak." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 管理單位只在室內出水點補打密封膠，真正的入口在數米外的上方介面，水改道從其他位置流出；牆內長期累積的水使鋼件鏽蝕、隔熱棉失效，等到發現時已需拆除整片外牆修復。
knowledge.textEn: Management seals only where water appears indoors while the real entry is an interface several metres above, so the water reroutes and emerges elsewhere; water accumulating inside the wall for years rusts steel and ruins insulation, and by discovery the remedy requires removing whole areas of cladding.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「漏水診斷、溼害與法律責任」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Leak diagnosis, moisture damage and liability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 管理單位只在室內出水點補打密封膠，真正的入口在數米外的上方介面，水改道從其他位置流出；牆內長期累積的水使鋼件鏽蝕、隔熱棉失效，等到發現時已需拆除整片外牆修復。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
外牆在竣工時通過試驗，之後數十年都會保持同樣的氣密水密性能。
optionsEn: Management seals only where water appears indoors while the real entry is an interface several metres above, so the water reroutes and emerges elsewhere.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A façade that passes its tests at completion keeps the same tightness for decades.
quiz.explanation: 管理單位只在室內出水點補打密封膠，真正的入口在數米外的上方介面，水改道從其他位置流出；牆內長期累積的水使鋼件鏽蝕、隔熱棉失效，等到發現時已需拆除整片外牆修復。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Management seals only where water appears indoors while the real entry is an interface several metres above, so the water reroutes and emerges elsewhere; water accumulating inside the wall for years rusts steel and ruins insulation, and by discovery the remedy requires removing whole areas of cladding. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 地震颱風後複驗、保固與竣工交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-event re-testing, warranty and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「事件後複驗與竣工基準」如何影響建築外牆氣密水密試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-event retest and baseline” governs force, deformation or durability in “Facade air- and water-tightness testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外牆的氣密水密性能會因地震層間變位、颱風反覆壓力、密封材老化與後續改裝而改變。台北 101 的外牆系統公開資料指出可承受約 95 mm 的側向地震位移而不損壞，這類設計能力需要以層間位移後再做水密試驗的程序驗證，也提醒管理者在大事件後應檢查接縫與密封是否位移。交接時應建立性能基準：試驗報告、現場抽驗結果、介面清單與漏水紀錄格式，讓日後的複驗能與原始狀態比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「事件後複驗與竣工基準」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Façade air and water tightness can change with seismic drift, repeated typhoon pressure, sealant ageing and later alterations. Public information on Taipei 101 states that its façade system can take about 95 mm of lateral seismic displacement without damage; such capacity must be proven by a procedure that repeats the water test after racking, and it reminds managers to check joints and seals for displacement after major events. Handover should establish a performance baseline of test reports, field results, the interface register and the leak-log format so that later re-tests can be compared with the original state. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-event retest and baseline” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若層高取 4.2 m，95 mm 相當於層間變位角 95/4,200 ≈ 2.3%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taking a 4.2 m storey height, 95 mm corresponds to an interstorey drift ratio of 95/4,200 ≈ 2.3%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外牆在竣工時通過試驗，之後數十年都會保持同樣的氣密水密性能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A façade that passes its tests at completion keeps the same tightness for decades." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「事件後複驗與竣工基準」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Post-event retest and baseline”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地震颱風後複驗、保固與竣工交接
knowledge.text: 外牆的氣密水密性能會因地震層間變位、颱風反覆壓力、密封材老化與後續改裝而改變。台北 101 的外牆系統公開資料指出可承受約 95 mm 的側向地震位移而不損壞，這類設計能力需要以層間位移後再做水密試驗的程序驗證，也提醒管理者在大事件後應檢查接縫與密封是否位移。
knowledge.textEn: Façade air and water tightness can change with seismic drift, repeated typhoon pressure, sealant ageing and later alterations. Public information on Taipei 101 states that its façade system can take about 95 mm of lateral seismic displacement without damage; such capacity must be proven by a procedure that repeats the water test after racking, and it reminds managers to check joints and seals for displacement after major events.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外牆在竣工時通過試驗，之後數十年都會保持同樣的氣密水密性能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A façade that passes its tests at completion keeps the same tightness for decades. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地震颱風後複驗、保固與竣工交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-event re-testing, warranty and handover" is correct?
options: 外牆在竣工時通過試驗，之後數十年都會保持同樣的氣密水密性能。
外牆的氣密水密性能會因地震層間變位、颱風反覆壓力、密封材老化與後續改裝而改變。
外牆會漏水，一定是因為密封膠品質不好。
optionsEn: A façade that passes its tests at completion keeps the same tightness for decades.
Façade air and water tightness can change with seismic drift, repeated typhoon pressure, sealant ageing and later alterations.
A leaking façade must have poor-quality sealant.
quiz.explanation: 外牆的氣密水密性能會因地震層間變位、颱風反覆壓力、密封材老化與後續改裝而改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Façade air and water tightness can change with seismic drift, repeated typhoon pressure, sealant ageing and later alterations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地震颱風後複驗、保固與竣工交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-event re-testing, warranty and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「事件後複驗與竣工基準」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-event retest and baseline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若層高取 4.2 m，95 mm 相當於層間變位角 95/4,200 ≈ 2.3%。事件後若監測到某些樓層變位角超過 0.5%，在這些樓層的 2% 接縫長度做現場噴水複驗：每層接縫 2,000 m 時抽驗 40 m，以每 1.52 m 噴 5 分鐘計約 40/1.52×5 ≈ 132 分鐘。層高與接縫長度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taking a 4.2 m storey height, 95 mm corresponds to an interstorey drift ratio of 95/4,200 ≈ 2.3%. If monitoring after an event shows some floors exceeded 0.5% drift, hose-test 2% of joint length on those floors: with 2,000 m of joints per floor, test 40 m, about 40/1.52×5 ≈ 132 minutes at 5 minutes per 1.52 m. The storey height and joint lengths are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接文件中規定定期檢查（例如每年目視、每五年抽驗）與事件後檢查的觸發條件（震度、層間變位、颱風風速），檢查內容包括密封膠附著與硬度、密封條位移、排水孔暢通與現場噴水抽驗，結果與竣工基準比較並記錄於維護資料庫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Handover documents should set routine inspections, for example annual visual checks and five-yearly sampling, and post-event triggers such as intensity, drift or typhoon wind speed, covering sealant adhesion and hardness, gasket displacement, weep-hole clearance and field hose sampling, compared with the completion baseline and logged in the maintenance database.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若層高取 4.2 m，95 mm 相當於層間變位角 95/4,200 ≈ 2.3%。事件後若監測到某些樓層變位角超過 0.5%，在這些樓層的 2% 接縫長度做現場噴水複驗：每層接縫 2,000 m 時抽驗 40 m，以每 1.52 m 噴 5 分鐘計約 40/1.52×5 ≈ 132 分鐘。層高與接縫長度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Taking a 4.2 m storey height, 95 mm corresponds to an interstorey drift ratio of 95/4,200 ≈ 2.3%. If monitoring after an event shows some floors exceeded 0.5% drift, hose-test 2% of joint length on those floors: with 2,000 m of joints per floor, test 40 m, about 40/1.52×5 ≈ 132 minutes at 5 minutes per 1.52 m. The storey height and joint lengths are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地震颱風後複驗、保固與竣工交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-event re-testing, warranty and handover", which statement holds?
options: 空氣洩漏量與壓差成正比，壓差加倍洩漏量也剛好加倍。
樣品牆試驗合格，就代表現場每一片外牆都不會漏水。
若層高取 4.2 m，95 mm 相當於層間變位角 95/4,200 ≈ 2.3%。
optionsEn: Air leakage is proportional to pressure difference, so doubling the pressure exactly doubles the leakage.
A passed mock-up proves that every panel on site will be watertight.
Taking a 4.2 m storey height, 95 mm corresponds to an interstorey drift ratio of 95/4,200 ≈ 2.3%.
quiz.explanation: 若層高取 4.2 m，95 mm 相當於層間變位角 95/4,200 ≈ 2.3%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Taking a 4.2 m storey height, 95 mm corresponds to an interstorey drift ratio of 95/4,200 ≈ 2.3%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地震颱風後複驗、保固與竣工交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-event re-testing, warranty and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「事件後複驗與竣工基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-event retest and baseline” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接文件中規定定期檢查（例如每年目視、每五年抽驗）與事件後檢查的觸發條件（震度、層間變位、颱風風速），檢查內容包括密封膠附著與硬度、密封條位移、排水孔暢通與現場噴水抽驗，結果與竣工基準比較並記錄於維護資料庫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Handover documents should set routine inspections, for example annual visual checks and five-yearly sampling, and post-event triggers such as intensity, drift or typhoon wind speed, covering sealant adhesion and hardness, gasket displacement, weep-hole clearance and field hose sampling, compared with the completion baseline and logged in the maintenance database. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：竣工交接應包含樣品牆與現場試驗報告、介面清單、排水路徑圖、密封材資料與更換週期、漏水紀錄格式與事件後檢查程序；任何外牆穿孔、加掛設備或改裝前，須經帷幕牆顧問評估水密影響並由業主核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include mock-up and field test reports, the interface register, drainage-path drawings, sealant data and renewal intervals, the leak-log format and the post-event inspection procedure; before any penetration, added equipment or alteration of the façade, the façade consultant must assess the watertightness impact and the owner must approve.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：大地震後只檢查結構而未檢查外牆，上下單元接縫的密封條已位移，下一個颱風季多個樓層同時漏水；交接時沒有留下試驗報告與介面清單，後續維修單位無法判斷原設計的排水路徑而誤封排水孔。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: After a major earthquake only the structure is inspected, not the façade, so displaced stack-joint gaskets cause leaks on several floors in the next typhoon season; without test reports and the interface register at handover, later maintenance contractors cannot tell the intended drainage paths and seal the weep holes by mistake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接文件中規定定期檢查（例如每年目視、每五年抽驗）與事件後檢查的觸發條件（震度、層間變位、颱風風速），檢查內容包括密封膠附著與硬度、密封條位移、排水孔暢通與現場噴水抽驗，結果與竣工基準比較並記錄於維護資料庫。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents should set routine inspections, for example annual visual checks and five-yearly sampling, and post-event triggers such as intensity, drift or typhoon wind speed, covering sealant adhesion and hardness, gasket displacement, weep-hole clearance and field hose sampling, compared with the completion baseline and logged in the maintenance database.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 竣工交接應包含樣品牆與現場試驗報告、介面清單、排水路徑圖、密封材資料與更換週期、漏水紀錄格式與事件後檢查程序；任何外牆穿孔、加掛設備或改裝前，須經帷幕牆顧問評估水密影響並由業主核准。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include mock-up and field test reports, the interface register, drainage-path drawings, sealant data and renewal intervals, the leak-log format and the post-event inspection procedure; before any penetration, added equipment or alteration of the façade, the façade consultant must assess the watertightness impact and the owner must approve.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地震颱風後複驗、保固與竣工交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-event re-testing, warranty and handover"?
options: 交接文件中規定定期檢查（例如每年目視、每五年抽驗）與事件後檢查的觸發條件（震度、層間變位、颱風風速），檢查內容包括密封膠附著與硬度、密封條位移、排水孔暢通與現場噴水抽驗，結果與竣工基準比較並記錄於維護資料庫。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
流量計讀到的空氣量就是外牆的洩漏量。
optionsEn: Handover documents should set routine inspections, for example annual visual checks and five-yearly sampling, and post-event triggers such as intensity, drift or typhoon wind speed, covering sealant adhesion and hardness, gasket displacement, weep-hole clearance and field hose sampling, compared with the completion baseline and logged in the maintenance database.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The airflow read on the meter is the façade's leakage.
quiz.explanation: 交接文件中規定定期檢查（例如每年目視、每五年抽驗）與事件後檢查的觸發條件（震度、層間變位、颱風風速），檢查內容包括密封膠附著與硬度、密封條位移、排水孔暢通與現場噴水抽驗，結果與竣工基準比較並記錄於維護資料庫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Handover documents should set routine inspections, for example annual visual checks and five-yearly sampling, and post-event triggers such as intensity, drift or typhoon wind speed, covering sealant adhesion and hardness, gasket displacement, weep-hole clearance and field hose sampling, compared with the completion baseline and logged in the maintenance database. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地震颱風後複驗、保固與竣工交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-event re-testing, warranty and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「事件後複驗與竣工基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-event retest and baseline” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 大地震後只檢查結構而未檢查外牆，上下單元接縫的密封條已位移，下一個颱風季多個樓層同時漏水；交接時沒有留下試驗報告與介面清單，後續維修單位無法判斷原設計的排水路徑而誤封排水孔。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: After a major earthquake only the structure is inspected, not the façade, so displaced stack-joint gaskets cause leaks on several floors in the next typhoon season; without test reports and the interface register at handover, later maintenance contractors cannot tell the intended drainage paths and seal the weep holes by mistake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時應建立性能基準：試驗報告、現場抽驗結果、介面清單與漏水紀錄格式，讓日後的複驗能與原始狀態比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover should establish a performance baseline of test reports, field results, the interface register and the leak-log format so that later re-tests can be compared with the original state.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外牆在竣工時通過試驗，之後數十年都會保持同樣的氣密水密性能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A façade that passes its tests at completion keeps the same tightness for decades." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 大地震後只檢查結構而未檢查外牆，上下單元接縫的密封條已位移，下一個颱風季多個樓層同時漏水；交接時沒有留下試驗報告與介面清單，後續維修單位無法判斷原設計的排水路徑而誤封排水孔。
knowledge.textEn: After a major earthquake only the structure is inspected, not the façade, so displaced stack-joint gaskets cause leaks on several floors in the next typhoon season; without test reports and the interface register at handover, later maintenance contractors cannot tell the intended drainage paths and seal the weep holes by mistake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地震颱風後複驗、保固與竣工交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-event re-testing, warranty and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
大地震後只檢查結構而未檢查外牆，上下單元接縫的密封條已位移，下一個颱風季多個樓層同時漏水。
外牆會漏水，一定是因為密封膠品質不好。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
After a major earthquake only the structure is inspected, not the façade, so displaced stack-joint gaskets cause leaks on several floors in the next typhoon season.
A leaking façade must have poor-quality sealant.
quiz.explanation: 大地震後只檢查結構而未檢查外牆，上下單元接縫的密封條已位移，下一個颱風季多個樓層同時漏水；交接時沒有留下試驗報告與介面清單，後續維修單位無法判斷原設計的排水路徑而誤封排水孔。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: After a major earthquake only the structure is inspected, not the façade, so displaced stack-joint gaskets cause leaks on several floors in the next typhoon season; without test reports and the interface register at handover, later maintenance contractors cannot tell the intended drainage paths and seal the weep holes by mistake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 超高層電梯分區與調度
titleEn: Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings
summary: 從上行尖峰人口與五分鐘運輸能力出發，說明超高層為何以穿梭電梯、空中大廳與疊用井道分段服務，再處理數百公尺行程的鋼索自重與曳引、超高速車廂的耳壓與振動、核心筒縮短下的導軌安裝、目的樓層派梯與往返時間計算，最後談鋼索擺動、維護更新與緊急運轉，並以哈里發塔、上海中心大廈與台北 101 的公開資料對照。
summaryEn: Starting from up-peak population and five-minute handling capacity, explain why supertall towers serve their floors in tiers with shuttles, sky lobbies and stacked shafts, then handle rope self-weight and traction over hundreds of metres, ear pressure and vibration in ultra-high-speed cars, rail installation on a shortening core, destination dispatch and round-trip-time calculation, and finally rope sway, maintenance, modernisation and emergency operation, compared with public data from Burj Khalifa, Shanghai Tower and Taipei 101.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 帷幕牆、垂直運輸與數位營建
subcategoryTitleEn: Facades, vertical transport and digital construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：上段 30 層、每層淨面積 1,600 m²、每人 10 m²、出勤率 85%，人口 30×1,600/10×0.85 = 4,080 人；穿梭電梯須在五分鐘運送 13%，即 0.13×4,080 ≈ 530 人。採雙層車廂，每層車廂載 21 人，每趟 42 人；直達行程 250 m、速度 8 m/s、加速度 1.0 m/s²、加加速度 1.0 m/s³，單程時間 t = D/v + v/a + a/j = 31.25+8+1 = 40.25 s。往返時間 = 2×40.25 + 12 s 開關門 + 42 s 上下客 ≈ 134.5 s；每部五分鐘運量 300×42/134.5 ≈ 93.7 人，需 530/93.7 ≈ 5.7，取 6 部，間隔 134.5/6 ≈ 22.4 s。若速度提高到 10 m/s，單程 25+10+1 = 36 s、往返 126 s、每部 100 人，仍需 5.3 部，即 6 部：提速每趟只省約 8.5 s，台數不變，雙層化與縮短上下客時間反而更有效。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: an upper tier of 30 floors with 1,600 m² net per floor, 10 m² per person and 85% attendance holds 30×1,600/10×0.85 = 4,080 people; the shuttles must move 13% in five minutes, 0.13×4,080 ≈ 530 people. Using double-deck cars with 21 passengers per deck, each trip carries 42. Express travel of 250 m at 8 m/s with acceleration 1.0 m/s² and jerk 1.0 m/s³ gives a one-way time t = D/v + v/a + a/j = 31.25+8+1 = 40.25 s. Round trip = 2×40.25 + 12 s of door operation + 42 s of passenger transfer ≈ 134.5 s; each car moves 300×42/134.5 ≈ 93.7 people per five minutes, so 530/93.7 ≈ 5.7 and six shuttles are needed, with an interval of 134.5/6 ≈ 22.4 s. Raising speed to 10 m/s gives 25+10+1 = 36 s one way, a 126 s round trip and 100 people per car, still 5.3 and therefore six cars: the extra speed saves only about 8.5 s per trip and does not change the car count, while double-decking and faster passenger transfer do more. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「尖峰交通需求與服務指標」與「分區、空中大廳與井道疊用」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Peak traffic demand and service metrics" and "Zoning, sky lobbies and stacked shafts": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 尖峰交通需求與服務指標：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Peak traffic demand and service metrics: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「上行尖峰人口」如何影響超高層電梯分區與調度的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Up-peak population” governs force, deformation or durability in “Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超高層辦公塔的電梯不是依平均使用量設計，而是依早上上班的上行尖峰：數千人在約一小時內從大廳湧入，各自前往不同樓層。設計者先由樓層淨面積、每人使用面積與出勤率估算各分區人口，再以「五分鐘運輸能力佔人口百分比」與「平均間隔」描述系統能否吸收尖峰；現代評估也加入午餐雙向交通、平均候梯時間與到達目的地時間。超高層的特殊之處在於人流必須經由轉乘，任何一段運輸不足都會在空中大廳形成排隊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「上行尖峰人口」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Elevators in a supertall office tower are sized not for average use but for the morning up-peak, when thousands of people arrive at the lobby within about an hour and head to different floors. The designer first estimates each zone's population from net floor area, area per person and attendance, then describes whether the system can absorb the peak through the five-minute handling capacity as a percentage of population and the average interval; modern assessments add two-way lunchtime traffic, average waiting time and time to destination. What makes supertall towers different is that people must transfer, so a shortfall in any one leg forms a queue in the sky lobby. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Up-peak population” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：分區人口 = 樓層數 × 淨面積 / 每人面積 × 出勤率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Zone population = floors × net area / area per person × attendance.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電梯數量只要依全天平均搭乘人次決定就足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The number of elevators can be set from the average number of rides over the whole day." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「上行尖峰人口」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Up-peak population”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 尖峰交通需求與服務指標
knowledge.titleEn: Peak traffic demand and service metrics
knowledge.text: 超高層辦公塔的電梯不是依平均使用量設計，而是依早上上班的上行尖峰：數千人在約一小時內從大廳湧入，各自前往不同樓層。設計者先由樓層淨面積、每人使用面積與出勤率估算各分區人口，再以「五分鐘運輸能力佔人口百分比」與「平均間隔」描述系統能否吸收尖峰；現代評估也加入午餐雙向交通、平均候梯時間與到達目的地時間。
knowledge.textEn: Elevators in a supertall office tower are sized not for average use but for the morning up-peak, when thousands of people arrive at the lobby within about an hour and head to different floors. The designer first estimates each zone's population from net floor area, area per person and attendance, then describes whether the system can absorb the peak through the five-minute handling capacity as a percentage of population and the average interval; modern assessments add two-way lunchtime traffic, average waiting time and time to destination.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：電梯數量只要依全天平均搭乘人次決定就足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The number of elevators can be set from the average number of rides over the whole day. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「尖峰交通需求與服務指標」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Peak traffic demand and service metrics" is correct?
options: 電梯數量只要依全天平均搭乘人次決定就足夠。
超高層辦公塔的電梯不是依平均使用量設計，而是依早上上班的上行尖峰：數千人在約一小時內從大廳湧入，各自前往不同樓層。
分區越多、每區電梯越少，核心筒面積就一定越省。
optionsEn: The number of elevators can be set from the average number of rides over the whole day.
Elevators in a supertall office tower are sized not for average use but for the morning up-peak, when thousands of people arrive at the lobby within about an hour and head to different floors.
More zones with fewer elevators each always means a smaller core.
quiz.explanation: 超高層辦公塔的電梯不是依平均使用量設計，而是依早上上班的上行尖峰：數千人在約一小時內從大廳湧入，各自前往不同樓層。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Elevators in a supertall office tower are sized not for average use but for the morning up-peak, when thousands of people arrive at the lobby within about an hour and head to different floors. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 尖峰交通需求與服務指標：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Peak traffic demand and service metrics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「上行尖峰人口」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Up-peak population” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：分區人口 = 樓層數 × 淨面積 / 每人面積 × 出勤率。取 15 層、每層淨面積 1,500 m²、每人 10 m²、出勤率 80%：每層 1,500/10×0.8 = 120 人，分區人口 15×120 = 1,800 人。若目標為五分鐘運輸 12%，需 HC5 = 0.12×1,800 = 216 人/5 min，相當於 216/300 = 0.72 人/s。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Zone population = floors × net area / area per person × attendance. With 15 floors, 1,500 m² net per floor, 10 m² per person and 80% attendance, each floor holds 1,500/10×0.8 = 120 people and the zone holds 15×120 = 1,800. A 12% five-minute target needs HC5 = 0.12×1,800 = 216 persons per 5 min, or 216/300 = 0.72 persons/s. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計階段依 ISO 8100-32 或 CIBSE Guide D 的方法同時做計算與模擬並互相比對；入住後以大廳閘門刷卡紀錄、派梯系統登錄資料或人工計數，取尖峰最忙五分鐘的實際到達率，與設計假設的人口與百分比比較，若差異超過約兩成就重新檢討分區或派梯設定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage, run both the calculation and the simulation methods of ISO 8100-32 or CIBSE Guide D and compare them; after occupation, take the busiest five-minute arrival rate from lobby turnstile logs, dispatch-system call records or manual counts, compare it with the assumed population and percentage, and revisit zoning or dispatch settings if they differ by more than about a fifth.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 分區人口 = 樓層數 × 淨面積 / 每人面積 × 出勤率。取 15 層、每層淨面積 1,500 m²、每人 10 m²、出勤率 80%：每層 1,500/10×0.8 = 120 人，分區人口 15×120 = 1,800 人。若目標為五分鐘運輸 12%，需 HC5 = 0.12×1,800 = 216 人/5 min，相當於 216/300 = 0.72 人/s。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Zone population = floors × net area / area per person × attendance. With 15 floors, 1,500 m² net per floor, 10 m² per person and 80% attendance, each floor holds 1,500/10×0.8 = 120 people and the zone holds 15×120 = 1,800. A 12% five-minute target needs HC5 = 0.12×1,800 = 216 persons per 5 min, or 216/300 = 0.72 persons/s. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「尖峰交通需求與服務指標」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Peak traffic demand and service metrics", which statement holds?
options: 超高速電梯上行與下行一定以相同的最高速度運轉。
目的樓層派梯一定會讓每位乘客的候梯時間變短。
分區人口 = 樓層數 × 淨面積 / 每人面積 × 出勤率。
optionsEn: An ultra-high-speed elevator always runs at the same top speed up and down.
Destination dispatch always shortens every passenger's waiting time.
Zone population = floors × net area / area per person × attendance.
quiz.explanation: 分區人口 = 樓層數 × 淨面積 / 每人面積 × 出勤率。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Zone population = floors × net area / area per person × attendance. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 尖峰交通需求與服務指標：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Peak traffic demand and service metrics: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「上行尖峰人口」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Up-peak population” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計階段依 ISO 8100-32 或 CIBSE Guide D 的方法同時做計算與模擬並互相比對；入住後以大廳閘門刷卡紀錄、派梯系統登錄資料或人工計數，取尖峰最忙五分鐘的實際到達率，與設計假設的人口與百分比比較，若差異超過約兩成就重新檢討分區或派梯設定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage, run both the calculation and the simulation methods of ISO 8100-32 or CIBSE Guide D and compare them; after occupation, take the busiest five-minute arrival rate from lobby turnstile logs, dispatch-system call records or manual counts, compare it with the assumed population and percentage, and revisit zoning or dispatch settings if they differ by more than about a fifth. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在設計基準文件中寫明人口密度、出勤率、尖峰百分比與間隔目標，並請業主確認未來租戶型態；分區人口要逐區列表，作為日後改租或改用途時的比對基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write population density, attendance, peak percentage and interval targets into the design basis, ask the owner to confirm expected tenant types, and tabulate population zone by zone so it becomes the reference whenever leasing or use changes later.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：租戶改為高密度開放辦公或共享辦公後，每人面積由 10 m² 降到約 7 m²，人口增加約四成，原本合格的分區在尖峰時大廳排隊延伸到門外、候梯時間倍增，只能錯開上班時間或改裝派梯系統補救。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: When tenants switch to dense open-plan or co-working layouts, area per person drops from 10 m² to about 7 m², population rises by roughly 40%, and a zone that once passed sees lobby queues spill outside at peak and waiting times double, leaving staggered hours or a dispatch retrofit as the only remedies. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計階段依 ISO 8100-32 或 CIBSE Guide D 的方法同時做計算與模擬並互相比對；入住後以大廳閘門刷卡紀錄、派梯系統登錄資料或人工計數，取尖峰最忙五分鐘的實際到達率，與設計假設的人口與百分比比較，若差異超過約兩成就重新檢討分區或派梯設定。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage, run both the calculation and the simulation methods of ISO 8100-32 or CIBSE Guide D and compare them; after occupation, take the busiest five-minute arrival rate from lobby turnstile logs, dispatch-system call records or manual counts, compare it with the assumed population and percentage, and revisit zoning or dispatch settings if they differ by more than about a fifth.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在設計基準文件中寫明人口密度、出勤率、尖峰百分比與間隔目標，並請業主確認未來租戶型態；分區人口要逐區列表，作為日後改租或改用途時的比對基準。
knowledge.textEn: Write population density, attendance, peak percentage and interval targets into the design basis, ask the owner to confirm expected tenant types, and tabulate population zone by zone so it becomes the reference whenever leasing or use changes later.

quiz.question: 要驗證「尖峰交通需求與服務指標」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Peak traffic demand and service metrics"?
options: 設計階段依 ISO 8100-32 或 CIBSE Guide D 的方法同時做計算與模擬並互相比對。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
鋼索擺動只與電梯速度有關，與建築擺動無關。
optionsEn: At design stage, run both the calculation and the simulation methods of ISO 8100-32 or CIBSE Guide D and compare them.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Rope sway depends only on elevator speed, not on building sway.
quiz.explanation: 設計階段依 ISO 8100-32 或 CIBSE Guide D 的方法同時做計算與模擬並互相比對；入住後以大廳閘門刷卡紀錄、派梯系統登錄資料或人工計數，取尖峰最忙五分鐘的實際到達率，與設計假設的人口與百分比比較，若差異超過約兩成就重新檢討分區或派梯設定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At design stage, run both the calculation and the simulation methods of ISO 8100-32 or CIBSE Guide D and compare them; after occupation, take the busiest five-minute arrival rate from lobby turnstile logs, dispatch-system call records or manual counts, compare it with the assumed population and percentage, and revisit zoning or dispatch settings if they differ by more than about a fifth. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 尖峰交通需求與服務指標：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Peak traffic demand and service metrics: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「上行尖峰人口」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Up-peak population” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 租戶改為高密度開放辦公或共享辦公後，每人面積由 10 m² 降到約 7 m²，人口增加約四成，原本合格的分區在尖峰時大廳排隊延伸到門外、候梯時間倍增，只能錯開上班時間或改裝派梯系統補救。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: When tenants switch to dense open-plan or co-working layouts, area per person drops from 10 m² to about 7 m², population rises by roughly 40%, and a zone that once passed sees lobby queues spill outside at peak and waiting times double, leaving staggered hours or a dispatch retrofit as the only remedies. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：超高層的特殊之處在於人流必須經由轉乘，任何一段運輸不足都會在空中大廳形成排隊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: What makes supertall towers different is that people must transfer, so a shortfall in any one leg forms a queue in the sky lobby.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電梯數量只要依全天平均搭乘人次決定就足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The number of elevators can be set from the average number of rides over the whole day." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 租戶改為高密度開放辦公或共享辦公後，每人面積由 10 m² 降到約 7 m²，人口增加約四成，原本合格的分區在尖峰時大廳排隊延伸到門外、候梯時間倍增，只能錯開上班時間或改裝派梯系統補救。
knowledge.textEn: When tenants switch to dense open-plan or co-working layouts, area per person drops from 10 m² to about 7 m², population rises by roughly 40%, and a zone that once passed sees lobby queues spill outside at peak and waiting times double, leaving staggered hours or a dispatch retrofit as the only remedies.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「尖峰交通需求與服務指標」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Peak traffic demand and service metrics" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
租戶改為高密度開放辦公或共享辦公後，每人面積由 10 m² 降到約 7 m²，人口增加約四成，原本合格的分區在尖峰時大廳排隊延伸到門外、候梯時間倍增，只能錯開上班時間或改裝派梯系統補救。
分區越多、每區電梯越少，核心筒面積就一定越省。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

When tenants switch to dense open-plan or co-working layouts, area per person drops from 10 m² to about 7 m², population rises by roughly 40%, and a zone that once passed sees lobby queues spill outside at peak and waiting times double, leaving staggered hours or a dispatch retrofit as the only remedies.
More zones with fewer elevators each always means a smaller core.
quiz.explanation: 租戶改為高密度開放辦公或共享辦公後，每人面積由 10 m² 降到約 7 m²，人口增加約四成，原本合格的分區在尖峰時大廳排隊延伸到門外、候梯時間倍增，只能錯開上班時間或改裝派梯系統補救。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When tenants switch to dense open-plan or co-working layouts, area per person drops from 10 m² to about 7 m², population rises by roughly 40%, and a zone that once passed sees lobby queues spill outside at peak and waiting times double, leaving staggered hours or a dispatch retrofit as the only remedies. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分區、空中大廳與井道疊用：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Zoning, sky lobbies and stacked shafts: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「空中大廳轉乘層」如何影響超高層電梯分區與調度的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sky-lobby transfer floor” governs force, deformation or durability in “Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 若每部電梯都從地面直達服務樓層，越高的分區就有越多井道穿過下方樓層，核心筒會吃掉大量可出租面積。超高層因此把建築分成數個高區段，以大容量直達穿梭電梯（常為雙層車廂）把人送到空中大廳，再轉乘區間電梯；上段的區間電梯可以疊在下段區間電梯的同一井道位置上，讓同一片核心面積被重複使用。原世界貿易中心雙塔即以 44 與 78 樓空中大廳把每棟分成三段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「空中大廳轉乘層」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: If every elevator ran from the ground to its served floors, higher zones would send more shafts through the floors below and the core would consume a large share of lettable area. Supertall towers therefore split the building into tiers: high-capacity express shuttles, often double-deck, carry people to a sky lobby where they transfer to local elevators, and the upper tier's local cars stack in the same shaft positions as the lower tier's, so the same core area is reused. The original World Trade Center towers used sky lobbies on floors 44 and 78 to divide each tower into three tiers. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sky-lobby transfer floor” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：上半部 45 層若由 3 組各 6 部電梯從地面直達，下半部 45 層每層都要讓 18 個井道通過：18×45 = 810 井道·層；改為 6 部穿梭電梯到空中大廳、區間電梯疊用井道後只剩 6×45 = 270 井道·層。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the upper 45 floors were served by three groups of six cars running from the ground, 18 shafts would pass through each of the lower 45 floors: 18×45 = 810 shaft-floors.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分區越多、每區電梯越少，核心筒面積就一定越省。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More zones with fewer elevators each always means a smaller core." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「空中大廳轉乘層」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sky-lobby transfer floor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分區、空中大廳與井道疊用
knowledge.titleEn: Zoning, sky lobbies and stacked shafts
knowledge.text: 若每部電梯都從地面直達服務樓層，越高的分區就有越多井道穿過下方樓層，核心筒會吃掉大量可出租面積。超高層因此把建築分成數個高區段，以大容量直達穿梭電梯（常為雙層車廂）把人送到空中大廳，再轉乘區間電梯；上段的區間電梯可以疊在下段區間電梯的同一井道位置上，讓同一片核心面積被重複使用。
knowledge.textEn: If every elevator ran from the ground to its served floors, higher zones would send more shafts through the floors below and the core would consume a large share of lettable area. Supertall towers therefore split the building into tiers: high-capacity express shuttles, often double-deck, carry people to a sky lobby where they transfer to local elevators, and the upper tier's local cars stack in the same shaft positions as the lower tier's, so the same core area is reused.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：分區越多、每區電梯越少，核心筒面積就一定越省。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More zones with fewer elevators each always means a smaller core. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分區、空中大廳與井道疊用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Zoning, sky lobbies and stacked shafts" is correct?
options: 分區越多、每區電梯越少，核心筒面積就一定越省。
只要換更大的馬達，單段行程就能無限提高。
若每部電梯都從地面直達服務樓層，越高的分區就有越多井道穿過下方樓層，核心筒會吃掉大量可出租面積。
optionsEn: More zones with fewer elevators each always means a smaller core.
A bigger motor alone lets single-run travel grow without limit.
If every elevator ran from the ground to its served floors, higher zones would send more shafts through the floors below and the core would consume a large share of lettable area.
quiz.explanation: 若每部電梯都從地面直達服務樓層，越高的分區就有越多井道穿過下方樓層，核心筒會吃掉大量可出租面積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: If every elevator ran from the ground to its served floors, higher zones would send more shafts through the floors below and the core would consume a large share of lettable area. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分區、空中大廳與井道疊用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Zoning, sky lobbies and stacked shafts: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空中大廳轉乘層」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sky-lobby transfer floor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：上半部 45 層若由 3 組各 6 部電梯從地面直達，下半部 45 層每層都要讓 18 個井道通過：18×45 = 810 井道·層；改為 6 部穿梭電梯到空中大廳、區間電梯疊用井道後只剩 6×45 = 270 井道·層。每井道取 8.4 m²，節省 (810−270)×8.4 ≈ 4,536 m²，約三層 1,500 m² 標準層。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the upper 45 floors were served by three groups of six cars running from the ground, 18 shafts would pass through each of the lower 45 floors: 18×45 = 810 shaft-floors. With six shuttles to a sky lobby and stacked local shafts only 6×45 = 270 shaft-floors remain. At 8.4 m² per shaft the saving is (810−270)×8.4 ≈ 4,536 m², about three 1,500 m² typical floors. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以核心筒樓層平面逐層統計井道、機房、緩衝坑與轉乘大廳面積，計算核心效率（淨出租面積除以總樓地板面積），並與交通模擬得到的轉乘排隊長度一起比較不同分區方案，確認空中大廳的候梯面積能容納尖峰時的轉乘人數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count shafts, machine rooms, pits and transfer lobbies floor by floor on the core plans, compute core efficiency (net lettable over gross floor area), and compare zoning options together with the transfer queue lengths from traffic simulation, confirming that each sky lobby has enough waiting area for peak transfers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With six shuttles to a sky lobby and stacked local shafts only 6×45 = 270 shaft-floors remain. At 8.4 m² per shaft the saving is (810−270)×8.4 ≈ 4,536 m², about three 1,500 m² typical floors. 往返時間公式可以直接套用在雙層車廂與數百公尺的直達穿梭電梯。

steps.title: 分區、空中大廳與井道疊用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Zoning, sky lobbies and stacked shafts: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「空中大廳轉乘層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sky-lobby transfer floor” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以核心筒樓層平面逐層統計井道、機房、緩衝坑與轉乘大廳面積，計算核心效率（淨出租面積除以總樓地板面積），並與交通模擬得到的轉乘排隊長度一起比較不同分區方案，確認空中大廳的候梯面積能容納尖峰時的轉乘人數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count shafts, machine rooms, pits and transfer lobbies floor by floor on the core plans, compute core efficiency (net lettable over gross floor area), and compare zoning options together with the transfer queue lengths from traffic simulation, confirming that each sky lobby has enough waiting area for peak transfers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：空中大廳應設計成與雙層車廂對應的上下兩層並以手扶梯連接，保留足夠候梯面積與無障礙轉乘路線；分區界線樓層要避開避難層與機電層，或把它們整合在同一轉換段。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design the sky lobby as two stacked levels matching double-deck cars and linked by escalators, keep enough waiting area and an accessible transfer route, and place zone boundaries clear of refuge and plant floors or integrate them within the same transfer tier.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：空中大廳的轉乘動線若太窄，或穿梭電梯與區間電梯的停靠位置相距太遠，尖峰時往上轉乘的人流與往下的人流交錯，大廳變成瓶頸；穿梭電梯能力不足時，上段區間電梯再空也送不上人。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A sky lobby with narrow transfer routes, or with shuttle and local landings far apart, makes rising transfer traffic cross downward traffic at peak and becomes a bottleneck; if shuttle capacity is short, empty local cars in the upper tier cannot be filled no matter how many there are. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 分區、空中大廳與井道疊用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Zoning, sky lobbies and stacked shafts: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「空中大廳轉乘層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sky-lobby transfer floor” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 空中大廳的轉乘動線若太窄，或穿梭電梯與區間電梯的停靠位置相距太遠，尖峰時往上轉乘的人流與往下的人流交錯，大廳變成瓶頸；穿梭電梯能力不足時，上段區間電梯再空也送不上人。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A sky lobby with narrow transfer routes, or with shuttle and local landings far apart, makes rising transfer traffic cross downward traffic at peak and becomes a bottleneck; if shuttle capacity is short, empty local cars in the upper tier cannot be filled no matter how many there are. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：原世界貿易中心雙塔即以 44 與 78 樓空中大廳把每棟分成三段。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The original World Trade Center towers used sky lobbies on floors 44 and 78 to divide each tower into three tiers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「分區越多、每區電梯越少，核心筒面積就一定越省。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More zones with fewer elevators each always means a smaller core." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.questionEn: When "Zoning, sky lobbies and stacked shafts" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
