stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼索自重、曳引與行程極限」與「超高速車廂：耳壓、振動與導軌」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rope self-weight, traction and travel limits" and "Ultra-high-speed cars: ear pressure, vibration and rails": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼索自重、曳引與行程極限：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rope self-weight, traction and travel limits: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「曳引鋼索與補償索」如何影響超高層電梯分區與調度的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hoist and compensation ropes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 曳引式電梯靠鋼索與曳引輪槽間的摩擦傳力，車廂側與配重側的張力比不得超過 Euler–Eytelwein 關係 e^(fα)，否則鋼索打滑。行程很高時，鋼索本身的重量變成移動質量的主角：車廂停在底層時，車廂側懸掛整段鋼索，張力比迅速放大，所以要在車廂與配重底部掛補償索平衡；但鋼索加補償索的總重又推高馬達、煞車與建築載重。這是超高層多以轉乘分段而非單段直達的主要原因之一，輕量的碳纖維帶狀曳引索則把這個限制往外推。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「曳引鋼索與補償索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A traction elevator transfers force by friction between ropes and sheave grooves, and the ratio of car-side to counterweight-side tension must not exceed the Euler–Eytelwein limit e^(fα) or the ropes slip. At large rises the ropes' own weight dominates the moving mass: with the car at the bottom landing the full rope length hangs on the car side and the tension ratio grows quickly, so compensation ropes hang below car and counterweight to balance it; yet ropes plus compensation then load the motor, brake and building. This is one of the main reasons supertall towers use transfers rather than single-run travel, while lightweight carbon-fibre belt ropes push that limit outward. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Hoist and compensation ropes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：車廂 6,000 kg、額定載重 2,000 kg、8 條鋼索每條 0.9 kg/m、行程 500 m，鋼索重 8×0.9×500 = 3,600 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 6,000 kg car, 2,000 kg rated load and eight ropes of 0.9 kg/m over 500 m, rope mass is 8×0.9×500 = 3,600 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要換更大的馬達，單段行程就能無限提高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A bigger motor alone lets single-run travel grow without limit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「曳引鋼索與補償索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Hoist and compensation ropes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼索自重、曳引與行程極限
knowledge.titleEn: Rope self-weight, traction and travel limits
knowledge.text: 曳引式電梯靠鋼索與曳引輪槽間的摩擦傳力，車廂側與配重側的張力比不得超過 Euler–Eytelwein 關係 e^(fα)，否則鋼索打滑。行程很高時，鋼索本身的重量變成移動質量的主角：車廂停在底層時，車廂側懸掛整段鋼索，張力比迅速放大，所以要在車廂與配重底部掛補償索平衡；但鋼索加補償索的總重又推高馬達、煞車與建築載重。
knowledge.textEn: A traction elevator transfers force by friction between ropes and sheave grooves, and the ratio of car-side to counterweight-side tension must not exceed the Euler–Eytelwein limit e^(fα) or the ropes slip. At large rises the ropes' own weight dominates the moving mass: with the car at the bottom landing the full rope length hangs on the car side and the tension ratio grows quickly, so compensation ropes hang below car and counterweight to balance it; yet ropes plus compensation then load the motor, brake and building.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要換更大的馬達，單段行程就能無限提高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A bigger motor alone lets single-run travel grow without limit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼索自重、曳引與行程極限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rope self-weight, traction and travel limits" is correct?
options: 曳引式電梯靠鋼索與曳引輪槽間的摩擦傳力，車廂側與配重側的張力比不得超過 Euler–Eytelwein 關係 e^(fα)，否則鋼索打滑。
只要換更大的馬達，單段行程就能無限提高。
超高速電梯上行與下行一定以相同的最高速度運轉。
optionsEn: A traction elevator transfers force by friction between ropes and sheave grooves, and the ratio of car-side to counterweight-side tension must not exceed the Euler–Eytelwein limit e^(fα) or the ropes slip.
A bigger motor alone lets single-run travel grow without limit.
An ultra-high-speed elevator always runs at the same top speed up and down.
quiz.explanation: 曳引式電梯靠鋼索與曳引輪槽間的摩擦傳力，車廂側與配重側的張力比不得超過 Euler–Eytelwein 關係 e^(fα)，否則鋼索打滑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A traction elevator transfers force by friction between ropes and sheave grooves, and the ratio of car-side to counterweight-side tension must not exceed the Euler–Eytelwein limit e^(fα) or the ropes slip. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼索自重、曳引與行程極限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rope self-weight, traction and travel limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曳引鋼索與補償索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hoist and compensation ropes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：車廂 6,000 kg、額定載重 2,000 kg、8 條鋼索每條 0.9 kg/m、行程 500 m，鋼索重 8×0.9×500 = 3,600 kg。車廂在底層時車廂側 6,000+2,000+3,600 = 11,600 kg；配重 6,000+0.45×2,000 = 6,900 kg。無補償索時張力比 11,600/6,900 ≈ 1.68，大於 f = 0.1、α = π 的 e^(0.1π) ≈ 1.37，會打滑；加 3,600 kg 補償索後為 11,600/10,500 ≈ 1.10。靜態估算，數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 6,000 kg car, 2,000 kg rated load and eight ropes of 0.9 kg/m over 500 m, rope mass is 8×0.9×500 = 3,600 kg. With the car at the bottom the car side carries 6,000+2,000+3,600 = 11,600 kg and the counterweight is 6,000+0.45×2,000 = 6,900 kg. Without compensation the ratio 11,600/6,900 ≈ 1.68 exceeds e^(0.1π) ≈ 1.37 for f = 0.1 and α = π, so the ropes slip; adding 3,600 kg of compensation gives 11,600/10,500 ≈ 1.10. Static estimate; values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依 EN 81-20 與 EN 81-50 的計算方法檢核裝載、緊急煞車與車廂受阻三種曳引條件，並核對鋼索安全係數；現場以超載試驗與緊急煞車試驗確認不打滑，再用鋼索張力計逐條量測張力，偏差過大須調整。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the three traction conditions of loading, emergency braking and stalled car with the calculation methods of EN 81-20 and EN 81-50 and confirm the rope safety factor; on site, confirm no slip in overload and emergency-braking tests, then measure each rope's tension with a rope-tension gauge and adjust when the spread is excessive.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: With a 6,000 kg car, 2,000 kg rated load and eight ropes of 0.9 kg/m over 500 m, rope mass is 8×0.9×500 = 3,600 kg. With the car at the bottom the car side carries 6,000+2,000+3,600 = 11,600 kg and the counterweight is 6,000+0.45×2,000 = 6,900 kg. Without compensation the ratio 11,600/6,900 ≈ 1.68 exceeds e^(0.1π) ≈ 1.37 for f = 0.1 and α = π, so the ropes slip; adding 3,600 kg of compensation gives 11,600/10,500 ≈ 1.10. Static estimate; values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼索自重、曳引與行程極限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rope self-weight, traction and travel limits", which statement holds?
options: 目的樓層派梯一定會讓每位乘客的候梯時間變短。
車廂 6,000 kg、額定載重 2,000 kg、8 條鋼索每條 0.9 kg/m、行程 500 m，鋼索重 8×0.9×500 = 3,600 kg。
鋼索擺動只與電梯速度有關，與建築擺動無關。
optionsEn: Destination dispatch always shortens every passenger's waiting time.
With a 6,000 kg car, 2,000 kg rated load and eight ropes of 0.9 kg/m over 500 m, rope mass is 8×0.9×500 = 3,600 kg.
Rope sway depends only on elevator speed, not on building sway.
quiz.explanation: 車廂 6,000 kg、額定載重 2,000 kg、8 條鋼索每條 0.9 kg/m、行程 500 m，鋼索重 8×0.9×500 = 3,600 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a 6,000 kg car, 2,000 kg rated load and eight ropes of 0.9 kg/m over 500 m, rope mass is 8×0.9×500 = 3,600 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼索自重、曳引與行程極限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rope self-weight, traction and travel limits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「曳引鋼索與補償索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hoist and compensation ropes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 EN 81-20 與 EN 81-50 的計算方法檢核裝載、緊急煞車與車廂受阻三種曳引條件，並核對鋼索安全係數；現場以超載試驗與緊急煞車試驗確認不打滑，再用鋼索張力計逐條量測張力，偏差過大須調整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the three traction conditions of loading, emergency braking and stalled car with the calculation methods of EN 81-20 and EN 81-50 and confirm the rope safety factor; on site, confirm no slip in overload and emergency-braking tests, then measure each rope's tension with a rope-tension gauge and adjust when the spread is excessive. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鋼索規格書應列出直徑、構造、最小破斷荷重、安全係數與張力均勻允差；補償索要配置拉緊導輪與防跳裝置，並把鋼索伸長後重新截短的程序寫入保養計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The rope specification should list diameter, construction, minimum breaking load, safety factor and tension-equalisation tolerance; compensation ropes need a tensioning sheave with an anti-rebound device, and the procedure for re-shortening stretched ropes belongs in the maintenance plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：各條鋼索張力不均時，受力最大的鋼索與其輪槽磨耗最快，輪槽變形後曳引能力下降，可能在緊急煞車時打滑；補償索導輪或拉緊裝置卡滯，車廂高速停止時會產生跳動與異常衝擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven rope tensions wear the most heavily loaded rope and its groove first; a deformed groove loses traction and may slip during emergency braking, while a jammed compensation sheave or tensioning device makes the car bounce and jolt when it stops from high speed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 EN 81-20 與 EN 81-50 的計算方法檢核裝載、緊急煞車與車廂受阻三種曳引條件，並核對鋼索安全係數；現場以超載試驗與緊急煞車試驗確認不打滑，再用鋼索張力計逐條量測張力，偏差過大須調整。
knowledge.textEn: Check the three traction conditions of loading, emergency braking and stalled car with the calculation methods of EN 81-20 and EN 81-50 and confirm the rope safety factor; on site, confirm no slip in overload and emergency-braking tests, then measure each rope's tension with a rope-tension gauge and adjust when the spread is excessive.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 鋼索規格書應列出直徑、構造、最小破斷荷重、安全係數與張力均勻允差；補償索要配置拉緊導輪與防跳裝置，並把鋼索伸長後重新截短的程序寫入保養計畫。
knowledge.textEn: The rope specification should list diameter, construction, minimum breaking load, safety factor and tension-equalisation tolerance; compensation ropes need a tensioning sheave with an anti-rebound device, and the procedure for re-shortening stretched ropes belongs in the maintenance plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼索自重、曳引與行程極限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rope self-weight, traction and travel limits"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
火災時建築內所有電梯一律不能使用，連消防人員也不例外。
依 EN 81-20 與 EN 81-50 的計算方法檢核裝載、緊急煞車與車廂受阻三種曳引條件，並核對鋼索安全係數。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
In a fire no lift in the building may be used, not even by firefighters.
Check the three traction conditions of loading, emergency braking and stalled car with the calculation methods of EN 81-20 and EN 81-50 and confirm the rope safety factor.
quiz.explanation: 依 EN 81-20 與 EN 81-50 的計算方法檢核裝載、緊急煞車與車廂受阻三種曳引條件，並核對鋼索安全係數；現場以超載試驗與緊急煞車試驗確認不打滑，再用鋼索張力計逐條量測張力，偏差過大須調整。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the three traction conditions of loading, emergency braking and stalled car with the calculation methods of EN 81-20 and EN 81-50 and confirm the rope safety factor; on site, confirm no slip in overload and emergency-braking tests, then measure each rope's tension with a rope-tension gauge and adjust when the spread is excessive. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼索自重、曳引與行程極限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rope self-weight, traction and travel limits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曳引鋼索與補償索」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hoist and compensation ropes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 各條鋼索張力不均時，受力最大的鋼索與其輪槽磨耗最快，輪槽變形後曳引能力下降，可能在緊急煞車時打滑；補償索導輪或拉緊裝置卡滯，車廂高速停止時會產生跳動與異常衝擊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven rope tensions wear the most heavily loaded rope and its groove first; a deformed groove loses traction and may slip during emergency braking, while a jammed compensation sheave or tensioning device makes the car bounce and jolt when it stops from high speed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這是超高層多以轉乘分段而非單段直達的主要原因之一，輕量的碳纖維帶狀曳引索則把這個限制往外推。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is one of the main reasons supertall towers use transfers rather than single-run travel, while lightweight carbon-fibre belt ropes push that limit outward.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要換更大的馬達，單段行程就能無限提高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A bigger motor alone lets single-run travel grow without limit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 各條鋼索張力不均時，受力最大的鋼索與其輪槽磨耗最快，輪槽變形後曳引能力下降，可能在緊急煞車時打滑；補償索導輪或拉緊裝置卡滯，車廂高速停止時會產生跳動與異常衝擊。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven rope tensions wear the most heavily loaded rope and its groove first; a deformed groove loses traction and may slip during emergency braking, while a jammed compensation sheave or tensioning device makes the car bounce and jolt when it stops from high speed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼索自重、曳引與行程極限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rope self-weight, traction and travel limits" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 各條鋼索張力不均時，受力最大的鋼索與其輪槽磨耗最快，輪槽變形後曳引能力下降，可能在緊急煞車時打滑；補償索導輪或拉緊裝置卡滯，車廂高速停止時會產生跳動與異常衝擊。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
超高速電梯上行與下行一定以相同的最高速度運轉。
optionsEn: Uneven rope tensions wear the most heavily loaded rope and its groove first.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
An ultra-high-speed elevator always runs at the same top speed up and down.
quiz.explanation: 各條鋼索張力不均時，受力最大的鋼索與其輪槽磨耗最快，輪槽變形後曳引能力下降，可能在緊急煞車時打滑；補償索導輪或拉緊裝置卡滯，車廂高速停止時會產生跳動與異常衝擊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uneven rope tensions wear the most heavily loaded rope and its groove first; a deformed groove loses traction and may slip during emergency braking, while a jammed compensation sheave or tensioning device makes the car bounce and jolt when it stops from high speed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 超高速車廂：耳壓、振動與導軌：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high-speed cars: ear pressure, vibration and rails: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「車廂氣壓與主動導靴」如何影響超高層電梯分區與調度的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cabin pressure and active guides” governs force, deformation or durability in “Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 速度超過約 10 m/s 後，限制乘坐品質的不再是馬達，而是人耳與車廂動態。大氣壓隨高度降低，快速升降時中耳來不及平衡而產生耳塞感，超高速電梯因此以送風機控制車廂內氣壓變化率，並把車廂做成流線型膠囊以降低風切噪音。導軌接頭錯位與彎曲在高速下會轉成橫向振動，需以感測器與致動器構成的主動導靴抵銷。下降時耳壓較難平衡，所以廣州周大福金融中心的電梯上行 1,260 m/min，下行只有 600 m/min。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「車廂氣壓與主動導靴」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Above roughly 10 m/s, ride quality is limited not by the motor but by the human ear and car dynamics. Air pressure falls with height, so in a fast ascent or descent the middle ear cannot equalise and feels blocked; ultra-high-speed elevators therefore use blowers to control the rate of cabin pressure change and streamlined capsule cars to reduce wind noise. Rail joint offsets and bends turn into lateral vibration at high speed, which active roller guides cancel with sensors and actuators. Descent is harder on the ears, so the Guangzhou CTF Finance Centre elevators rise at 1,260 m/min but descend at only 600 m/min. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cabin pressure and active guides” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：壓力變化率 dp/dt = ρ·g·v。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Pressure change rate dp/dt = ρ·g·v.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超高速電梯上行與下行一定以相同的最高速度運轉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An ultra-high-speed elevator always runs at the same top speed up and down." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「車廂氣壓與主動導靴」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cabin pressure and active guides”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 超高速車廂：耳壓、振動與導軌
knowledge.titleEn: Ultra-high-speed cars: ear pressure, vibration and rails
knowledge.text: 速度超過約 10 m/s 後，限制乘坐品質的不再是馬達，而是人耳與車廂動態。大氣壓隨高度降低，快速升降時中耳來不及平衡而產生耳塞感，超高速電梯因此以送風機控制車廂內氣壓變化率，並把車廂做成流線型膠囊以降低風切噪音。
knowledge.textEn: Above roughly 10 m/s, ride quality is limited not by the motor but by the human ear and car dynamics. Air pressure falls with height, so in a fast ascent or descent the middle ear cannot equalise and feels blocked; ultra-high-speed elevators therefore use blowers to control the rate of cabin pressure change and streamlined capsule cars to reduce wind noise.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：超高速電梯上行與下行一定以相同的最高速度運轉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An ultra-high-speed elevator always runs at the same top speed up and down. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「超高速車廂：耳壓、振動與導軌」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ultra-high-speed cars: ear pressure, vibration and rails" is correct?
options: 超高速電梯上行與下行一定以相同的最高速度運轉。
速度超過約 10 m/s 後，限制乘坐品質的不再是馬達，而是人耳與車廂動態。
鋼導軌只要安裝時完全垂直，日後就不需要考慮結構變形。
optionsEn: An ultra-high-speed elevator always runs at the same top speed up and down.
Above roughly 10 m/s, ride quality is limited not by the motor but by the human ear and car dynamics.
Steel rails installed perfectly plumb need no allowance for later structural movement.
quiz.explanation: 速度超過約 10 m/s 後，限制乘坐品質的不再是馬達，而是人耳與車廂動態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Above roughly 10 m/s, ride quality is limited not by the motor but by the human ear and car dynamics. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 超高速車廂：耳壓、振動與導軌：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high-speed cars: ear pressure, vibration and rails: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車廂氣壓與主動導靴」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cabin pressure and active guides” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：壓力變化率 dp/dt = ρ·g·v。取 ρ = 1.2 kg/m³、v = 16.8 m/s：dp/dt = 1.2×9.81×16.8 ≈ 198 Pa/s ≈ 2.0 hPa/s；上升 382 m 的總壓差 ρgh = 1.2×9.81×382 ≈ 4,500 Pa ≈ 45 hPa。若把變化率控制在約 1.26 hPa/s，45 hPa 要分散在約 36 s 內完成。數值為教學估算，台北 101 公開資料約為 48 hPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Pressure change rate dp/dt = ρ·g·v. With ρ = 1.2 kg/m³ and v = 16.8 m/s, dp/dt = 1.2×9.81×16.8 ≈ 198 Pa/s ≈ 2.0 hPa/s; rising 382 m gives ρgh = 1.2×9.81×382 ≈ 4,500 Pa ≈ 45 hPa. Holding the rate near 1.26 hPa/s spreads 45 hPa over about 36 s. Teaching estimate; public Taipei 101 data give about 48 hPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依 ISO 18738-1 以三軸加速度計與麥克風量測車廂乘坐品質，記錄最大加減速度、加加速度、水平與垂直振動及噪音，並以氣壓計記錄車廂內壓力變化率；導軌安裝後以雷射或鋼線檢查直線度與接頭段差，結果與規格比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure ride quality to ISO 18738-1 with a triaxial accelerometer and microphone, recording peak acceleration, jerk, horizontal and vertical vibration and noise, and log the cabin pressure change rate with a barometer; after rail installation, check straightness and joint steps with a laser or plumb wire and compare with the specification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 壓力變化率 dp/dt = ρ·g·v。取 ρ = 1.2 kg/m³、v = 16.8 m/s：dp/dt = 1.2×9.81×16.8 ≈ 198 Pa/s ≈ 2.0 hPa/s；上升 382 m 的總壓差 ρgh = 1.2×9.81×382 ≈ 4,500 Pa ≈ 45 hPa。若把變化率控制在約 1.26 hPa/s，45 hPa 要分散在約 36 s 內完成。數值為教學估算，台北 101 公開資料約為 48 hPa。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure change rate dp/dt = ρ·g·v. With ρ = 1.2 kg/m³ and v = 16.8 m/s, dp/dt = 1.2×9.81×16.8 ≈ 198 Pa/s ≈ 2.0 hPa/s; rising 382 m gives ρgh = 1.2×9.81×382 ≈ 4,500 Pa ≈ 45 hPa. Holding the rate near 1.26 hPa/s spreads 45 hPa over about 36 s. Teaching estimate; public Taipei 101 data give about 48 hPa.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「超高速車廂：耳壓、振動與導軌」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ultra-high-speed cars: ear pressure, vibration and rails", which statement holds?
options: 往返時間公式可以直接套用在雙層車廂與數百公尺的直達穿梭電梯。
鋼索外觀沒有斷絲，就代表內部狀況良好。
壓力變化率 dp/dt = ρ·g·v。
optionsEn: The round-trip-time formula applies directly to double-deck cars and shuttles travelling hundreds of metres.
A rope with no visible broken wires is sound inside.
Pressure change rate dp/dt = ρ·g·v.
quiz.explanation: 壓力變化率 dp/dt = ρ·g·v。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure change rate dp/dt = ρ·g·v. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超高速車廂：耳壓、振動與導軌：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high-speed cars: ear pressure, vibration and rails: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車廂氣壓與主動導靴」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cabin pressure and active guides” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 ISO 18738-1 以三軸加速度計與麥克風量測車廂乘坐品質，記錄最大加減速度、加加速度、水平與垂直振動及噪音，並以氣壓計記錄車廂內壓力變化率；導軌安裝後以雷射或鋼線檢查直線度與接頭段差，結果與規格比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure ride quality to ISO 18738-1 with a triaxial accelerometer and microphone, recording peak acceleration, jerk, horizontal and vertical vibration and noise, and log the cabin pressure change rate with a barometer; after rail installation, check straightness and joint steps with a laser or plumb wire and compare with the specification. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在規範中把乘坐品質寫成可量測的驗收值（振動、噪音、壓力變化率），並為導軌安裝設保留點：導軌直線度檢查完成並經監造簽認前，不得安裝車廂與門系統。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write ride quality into the specification as measurable acceptance values (vibration, noise, pressure-change rate) and set a hold point for rail installation: no car or door equipment may be installed until rail straightness has been checked and signed off by the supervising engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：導軌接頭段差或支架鬆動會在固定高度產生週期性橫向衝擊，乘客感到「卡一下」，主動導靴長期飽和後滾輪與軸承加速磨耗；壓力控制失效時耳痛投訴增加，營運者常被迫降速運轉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A rail joint step or loose bracket causes a periodic lateral knock at the same height that passengers feel as a jolt; active guides that run saturated for long periods wear their rollers and bearings faster, and when pressure control fails ear-pain complaints rise and operators are often forced to run at reduced speed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 ISO 18738-1 以三軸加速度計與麥克風量測車廂乘坐品質，記錄最大加減速度、加加速度、水平與垂直振動及噪音，並以氣壓計記錄車廂內壓力變化率；導軌安裝後以雷射或鋼線檢查直線度與接頭段差，結果與規格比較。
knowledge.textEn: Measure ride quality to ISO 18738-1 with a triaxial accelerometer and microphone, recording peak acceleration, jerk, horizontal and vertical vibration and noise, and log the cabin pressure change rate with a barometer; after rail installation, check straightness and joint steps with a laser or plumb wire and compare with the specification.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在規範中把乘坐品質寫成可量測的驗收值（振動、噪音、壓力變化率），並為導軌安裝設保留點：導軌直線度檢查完成並經監造簽認前，不得安裝車廂與門系統。
knowledge.textEn: Write ride quality into the specification as measurable acceptance values (vibration, noise, pressure-change rate) and set a hold point for rail installation: no car or door equipment may be installed until rail straightness has been checked and signed off by the supervising engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超高速車廂：耳壓、振動與導軌」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ultra-high-speed cars: ear pressure, vibration and rails"?
options: 依 ISO 18738-1 以三軸加速度計與麥克風量測車廂乘坐品質，記錄最大加減速度、加加速度、水平與垂直振動及噪音，並以氣壓計記錄車廂內壓力變化率。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
電梯數量只要依全天平均搭乘人次決定就足夠。
optionsEn: Measure ride quality to ISO 18738-1 with a triaxial accelerometer and microphone, recording peak acceleration, jerk, horizontal and vertical vibration and noise, and log the cabin pressure change rate with a barometer.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The number of elevators can be set from the average number of rides over the whole day.
quiz.explanation: 依 ISO 18738-1 以三軸加速度計與麥克風量測車廂乘坐品質，記錄最大加減速度、加加速度、水平與垂直振動及噪音，並以氣壓計記錄車廂內壓力變化率；導軌安裝後以雷射或鋼線檢查直線度與接頭段差，結果與規格比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure ride quality to ISO 18738-1 with a triaxial accelerometer and microphone, recording peak acceleration, jerk, horizontal and vertical vibration and noise, and log the cabin pressure change rate with a barometer; after rail installation, check straightness and joint steps with a laser or plumb wire and compare with the specification. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 超高速車廂：耳壓、振動與導軌：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high-speed cars: ear pressure, vibration and rails: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車廂氣壓與主動導靴」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cabin pressure and active guides” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 導軌接頭段差或支架鬆動會在固定高度產生週期性橫向衝擊，乘客感到「卡一下」，主動導靴長期飽和後滾輪與軸承加速磨耗；壓力控制失效時耳痛投訴增加，營運者常被迫降速運轉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A rail joint step or loose bracket causes a periodic lateral knock at the same height that passengers feel as a jolt; active guides that run saturated for long periods wear their rollers and bearings faster, and when pressure control fails ear-pain complaints rise and operators are often forced to run at reduced speed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：下降時耳壓較難平衡，所以廣州周大福金融中心的電梯上行 1,260 m/min，下行只有 600 m/min。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Descent is harder on the ears, so the Guangzhou CTF Finance Centre elevators rise at 1,260 m/min but descend at only 600 m/min.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超高速電梯上行與下行一定以相同的最高速度運轉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An ultra-high-speed elevator always runs at the same top speed up and down." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 導軌接頭段差或支架鬆動會在固定高度產生週期性橫向衝擊，乘客感到「卡一下」，主動導靴長期飽和後滾輪與軸承加速磨耗；壓力控制失效時耳痛投訴增加，營運者常被迫降速運轉。
knowledge.textEn: A rail joint step or loose bracket causes a periodic lateral knock at the same height that passengers feel as a jolt; active guides that run saturated for long periods wear their rollers and bearings faster, and when pressure control fails ear-pain complaints rise and operators are often forced to run at reduced speed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超高速車廂：耳壓、振動與導軌」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ultra-high-speed cars: ear pressure, vibration and rails" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
導軌接頭段差或支架鬆動會在固定高度產生週期性橫向衝擊，乘客感到「卡一下」，主動導靴長期飽和後滾輪與軸承加速磨耗。
鋼導軌只要安裝時完全垂直，日後就不需要考慮結構變形。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A rail joint step or loose bracket causes a periodic lateral knock at the same height that passengers feel as a jolt.
Steel rails installed perfectly plumb need no allowance for later structural movement.
quiz.explanation: 導軌接頭段差或支架鬆動會在固定高度產生週期性橫向衝擊，乘客感到「卡一下」，主動導靴長期飽和後滾輪與軸承加速磨耗；壓力控制失效時耳痛投訴增加，營運者常被迫降速運轉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A rail joint step or loose bracket causes a periodic lateral knock at the same height that passengers feel as a jolt; active guides that run saturated for long periods wear their rollers and bearings faster, and when pressure control fails ear-pain complaints rise and operators are often forced to run at reduced speed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「核心筒縮短與施工期電梯」與「目的樓層派梯與群控演算法」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Core shortening and construction-phase lifts" and "Destination dispatch and group-control algorithms": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 核心筒縮短與施工期電梯：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Core shortening and construction-phase lifts: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「導軌滑動支架」如何影響超高層電梯分區與調度的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sliding rail brackets” governs force, deformation or durability in “Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超高層核心筒以爬模逐層上升，電梯井道在結構仍在施工時就得開始安裝，許多專案還用可隨結構爬升的施工期電梯（例如 KONE JumpLift）提早載運工人。混凝土核心筒在自重、潛變與乾縮下會持續縮短，鋼導軌卻不會，所以導軌必須以允許垂直滑動的支架固定，並在導軌接頭與頂部預留伸縮量；施工期的風致擺動與日照溫差也讓井道垂直度量測必須選在穩定時段進行。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「導軌滑動支架」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A supertall core rises floor by floor on climbing forms, and hoistway installation must start while the structure is still being built; many projects also run construction lifts that climb with the structure, such as KONE JumpLift, to move workers early. The concrete core keeps shortening under self-weight, creep and shrinkage while the steel rails do not, so rails are fixed with brackets that allow vertical sliding, and movement allowances are left at rail joints and at the top; wind sway and solar temperature differences during construction also mean hoistway plumb surveys must be taken in stable periods. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sliding rail brackets” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：核心筒長期縮短 ΔL = ε·H。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Long-term core shortening ΔL = ε·H.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼導軌只要安裝時完全垂直，日後就不需要考慮結構變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel rails installed perfectly plumb need no allowance for later structural movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「導軌滑動支架」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sliding rail brackets”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 核心筒縮短與施工期電梯
knowledge.text: 超高層核心筒以爬模逐層上升，電梯井道在結構仍在施工時就得開始安裝，許多專案還用可隨結構爬升的施工期電梯（例如 KONE JumpLift）提早載運工人。混凝土核心筒在自重、潛變與乾縮下會持續縮短，鋼導軌卻不會，所以導軌必須以允許垂直滑動的支架固定，並在導軌接頭與頂部預留伸縮量；施工期的風致擺動與日照溫差也讓井道垂直度量測必須選在穩定時段進行。
knowledge.textEn: A supertall core rises floor by floor on climbing forms, and hoistway installation must start while the structure is still being built; many projects also run construction lifts that climb with the structure, such as KONE JumpLift, to move workers early. The concrete core keeps shortening under self-weight, creep and shrinkage while the steel rails do not, so rails are fixed with brackets that allow vertical sliding, and movement allowances are left at rail joints and at the top; wind sway and solar temperature differences during construction also mean hoistway plumb surveys must be taken in stable periods.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼導軌只要安裝時完全垂直，日後就不需要考慮結構變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Steel rails installed perfectly plumb need no allowance for later structural movement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「核心筒縮短與施工期電梯」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Core shortening and construction-phase lifts" is correct?
options: 鋼導軌只要安裝時完全垂直，日後就不需要考慮結構變形。
目的樓層派梯一定會讓每位乘客的候梯時間變短。
超高層核心筒以爬模逐層上升，電梯井道在結構仍在施工時就得開始安裝，許多專案還用可隨結構爬升的施工期電梯（例如 KONE JumpLift）提早載運工人。
optionsEn: Steel rails installed perfectly plumb need no allowance for later structural movement.
Destination dispatch always shortens every passenger's waiting time.
A supertall core rises floor by floor on climbing forms, and hoistway installation must start while the structure is still being built.
quiz.explanation: 超高層核心筒以爬模逐層上升，電梯井道在結構仍在施工時就得開始安裝，許多專案還用可隨結構爬升的施工期電梯（例如 KONE JumpLift）提早載運工人。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A supertall core rises floor by floor on climbing forms, and hoistway installation must start while the structure is still being built; many projects also run construction lifts that climb with the structure, such as KONE JumpLift, to move workers early. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 核心筒縮短與施工期電梯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Core shortening and construction-phase lifts: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導軌滑動支架」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sliding rail brackets” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：核心筒長期縮短 ΔL = ε·H。取潛變加乾縮應變 ε = 300×10⁻⁶、井道高度 H = 400 m：ΔL = 300×10⁻⁶×400,000 mm = 120 mm。導軌支架間距 4 m 時，相鄰支架間的相對滑動增量為 300×10⁻⁶×4,000 mm = 1.2 mm；若導軌固定於底部，頂部支架累積滑動 120 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Long-term core shortening ΔL = ε·H. With creep plus shrinkage strain ε = 300×10⁻⁶ and hoistway height H = 400 m, ΔL = 300×10⁻⁶×400,000 mm = 120 mm. With rail brackets every 4 m the slip increment between neighbouring brackets is 300×10⁻⁶×4,000 mm = 1.2 mm; if the rail is fixed at the bottom, the top bracket accumulates 120 mm of slip. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以鉛垂雷射或垂線在井道內設基準線，每隔數層量測井道牆面與基準線距離，確認淨尺寸與垂直度；並與結構設計者提供的預測縮短量比較，在導軌安裝後第一年內複測支架滑動量與導軌接頭間隙。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Set reference lines in the hoistway with plumb lasers or wires, measure wall offsets every few floors to confirm clear dimensions and plumbness, compare with the structural designer's predicted shortening, and re-measure bracket slip and rail joint gaps during the first year after rail installation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 核心筒長期縮短 ΔL = ε·H。取潛變加乾縮應變 ε = 300×10⁻⁶、井道高度 H = 400 m：ΔL = 300×10⁻⁶×400,000 mm = 120 mm。導軌支架間距 4 m 時，相鄰支架間的相對滑動增量為 300×10⁻⁶×4,000 mm = 1.2 mm；若導軌固定於底部，頂部支架累積滑動 120 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Long-term core shortening ΔL = ε·H. With creep plus shrinkage strain ε = 300×10⁻⁶ and hoistway height H = 400 m, ΔL = 300×10⁻⁶×400,000 mm = 120 mm. With rail brackets every 4 m the slip increment between neighbouring brackets is 300×10⁻⁶×4,000 mm = 1.2 mm; if the rail is fixed at the bottom, the top bracket accumulates 120 mm of slip. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「核心筒縮短與施工期電梯」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Core shortening and construction-phase lifts", which statement holds?
options: 核心筒長期縮短 ΔL = ε·H。
鋼索擺動只與電梯速度有關，與建築擺動無關。
火災時建築內所有電梯一律不能使用，連消防人員也不例外。
optionsEn: Long-term core shortening ΔL = ε·H.
Rope sway depends only on elevator speed, not on building sway.
In a fire no lift in the building may be used, not even by firefighters.
quiz.explanation: 核心筒長期縮短 ΔL = ε·H。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-term core shortening ΔL = ε·H. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 核心筒縮短與施工期電梯：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Core shortening and construction-phase lifts: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導軌滑動支架」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sliding rail brackets” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以鉛垂雷射或垂線在井道內設基準線，每隔數層量測井道牆面與基準線距離，確認淨尺寸與垂直度；並與結構設計者提供的預測縮短量比較，在導軌安裝後第一年內複測支架滑動量與導軌接頭間隙。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Set reference lines in the hoistway with plumb lasers or wires, measure wall offsets every few floors to confirm clear dimensions and plumbness, compare with the structural designer's predicted shortening, and re-measure bracket slip and rail joint gaps during the first year after rail installation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：機電與結構顧問應共同出具井道變形預算，列出縮短、擺動與溫度變形量，作為導軌支架形式與調整範圍的依據；施工期電梯的使用、爬升與移交程序須經業主、電梯公司與檢查機構三方確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lift and structural consultants should jointly issue a hoistway movement budget listing shortening, sway and thermal deformation as the basis for bracket type and adjustment range; use, climbing and handover of construction-phase lifts must be agreed among the owner, the lift company and the inspection body.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：導軌若以固定支架鎖死在核心筒上，核心縮短會把導軌壓彎或在接頭處擠出段差，造成車廂振動甚至導靴卡滯；井道垂直度量測若選在日照不均的下午，可能把結構暫時的熱彎曲當成施工偏差而錯誤修正。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rails clamped rigidly to the core are bowed or pushed into joint steps as the core shortens, causing car vibration or even jammed guides; plumb surveys taken on unevenly sunlit afternoons can mistake temporary thermal bending of the structure for construction error and lead to wrong corrections. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以鉛垂雷射或垂線在井道內設基準線，每隔數層量測井道牆面與基準線距離，確認淨尺寸與垂直度；並與結構設計者提供的預測縮短量比較，在導軌安裝後第一年內複測支架滑動量與導軌接頭間隙。
knowledge.textEn: Set reference lines in the hoistway with plumb lasers or wires, measure wall offsets every few floors to confirm clear dimensions and plumbness, compare with the structural designer's predicted shortening, and re-measure bracket slip and rail joint gaps during the first year after rail installation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 機電與結構顧問應共同出具井道變形預算，列出縮短、擺動與溫度變形量，作為導軌支架形式與調整範圍的依據；施工期電梯的使用、爬升與移交程序須經業主、電梯公司與檢查機構三方確認。
knowledge.textEn: The lift and structural consultants should jointly issue a hoistway movement budget listing shortening, sway and thermal deformation as the basis for bracket type and adjustment range; use, climbing and handover of construction-phase lifts must be agreed among the owner, the lift company and the inspection body.

quiz.question: 要驗證「核心筒縮短與施工期電梯」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Core shortening and construction-phase lifts"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以鉛垂雷射或垂線在井道內設基準線，每隔數層量測井道牆面與基準線距離，確認淨尺寸與垂直度。
分區越多、每區電梯越少，核心筒面積就一定越省。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Set reference lines in the hoistway with plumb lasers or wires, measure wall offsets every few floors to confirm clear dimensions and plumbness, compare with the structural designer's predicted shortening, and re-measure bracket slip and rail joint gaps during the first year after rail installation.
More zones with fewer elevators each always means a smaller core.
quiz.explanation: 以鉛垂雷射或垂線在井道內設基準線，每隔數層量測井道牆面與基準線距離，確認淨尺寸與垂直度；並與結構設計者提供的預測縮短量比較，在導軌安裝後第一年內複測支架滑動量與導軌接頭間隙。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Set reference lines in the hoistway with plumb lasers or wires, measure wall offsets every few floors to confirm clear dimensions and plumbness, compare with the structural designer's predicted shortening, and re-measure bracket slip and rail joint gaps during the first year after rail installation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 核心筒縮短與施工期電梯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Core shortening and construction-phase lifts: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導軌滑動支架」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sliding rail brackets” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 導軌若以固定支架鎖死在核心筒上，核心縮短會把導軌壓彎或在接頭處擠出段差，造成車廂振動甚至導靴卡滯；井道垂直度量測若選在日照不均的下午，可能把結構暫時的熱彎曲當成施工偏差而錯誤修正。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rails clamped rigidly to the core are bowed or pushed into joint steps as the core shortens, causing car vibration or even jammed guides; plumb surveys taken on unevenly sunlit afternoons can mistake temporary thermal bending of the structure for construction error and lead to wrong corrections. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：混凝土核心筒在自重、潛變與乾縮下會持續縮短，鋼導軌卻不會，所以導軌必須以允許垂直滑動的支架固定，並在導軌接頭與頂部預留伸縮量；施工期的風致擺動與日照溫差也讓井道垂直度量測必須選在穩定時段進行。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The concrete core keeps shortening under self-weight, creep and shrinkage while the steel rails do not, so rails are fixed with brackets that allow vertical sliding, and movement allowances are left at rail joints and at the top; wind sway and solar temperature differences during construction also mean hoistway plumb surveys must be taken in stable periods.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼導軌只要安裝時完全垂直，日後就不需要考慮結構變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steel rails installed perfectly plumb need no allowance for later structural movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 導軌若以固定支架鎖死在核心筒上，核心縮短會把導軌壓彎或在接頭處擠出段差，造成車廂振動甚至導靴卡滯；井道垂直度量測若選在日照不均的下午，可能把結構暫時的熱彎曲當成施工偏差而錯誤修正。
knowledge.textEn: Rails clamped rigidly to the core are bowed or pushed into joint steps as the core shortens, causing car vibration or even jammed guides; plumb surveys taken on unevenly sunlit afternoons can mistake temporary thermal bending of the structure for construction error and lead to wrong corrections.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「核心筒縮短與施工期電梯」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Core shortening and construction-phase lifts" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
目的樓層派梯一定會讓每位乘客的候梯時間變短。
導軌若以固定支架鎖死在核心筒上，核心縮短會把導軌壓彎或在接頭處擠出段差，造成車廂振動甚至導靴卡滯。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Destination dispatch always shortens every passenger's waiting time.
Rails clamped rigidly to the core are bowed or pushed into joint steps as the core shortens, causing car vibration or even jammed guides.
quiz.explanation: 導軌若以固定支架鎖死在核心筒上，核心縮短會把導軌壓彎或在接頭處擠出段差，造成車廂振動甚至導靴卡滯；井道垂直度量測若選在日照不均的下午，可能把結構暫時的熱彎曲當成施工偏差而錯誤修正。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rails clamped rigidly to the core are bowed or pushed into joint steps as the core shortens, causing car vibration or even jammed guides; plumb surveys taken on unevenly sunlit afternoons can mistake temporary thermal bending of the structure for construction error and lead to wrong corrections. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 目的樓層派梯與群控演算法：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Destination dispatch and group-control algorithms: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「目的樓層登錄面板」如何影響超高層電梯分區與調度的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Destination entry panels” governs force, deformation or durability in “Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 傳統群控在乘客進入車廂後才知道目的地，同一部車往往在許多樓層停靠。目的樓層派梯讓乘客在大廳先輸入樓層，系統把前往相近樓層的人分到同一部車，因此每趟停靠次數減少、往返時間縮短、尖峰運輸能力提高；代價是乘客要依指示走到指定電梯，候梯時間可能略增，但到達目的地時間通常縮短。演算法還能依時段切換上行尖峰、午餐雙向與下行模式，並保留無障礙或特殊用途的分派規則。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「目的樓層登錄面板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Conventional group control learns a passenger's destination only after boarding, so one car often stops at many floors. Destination dispatch has passengers enter their floor in the lobby and groups people bound for nearby floors into the same car, so each trip makes fewer stops, the round trip shortens and peak handling capacity rises; the price is that passengers must walk to the assigned car and waiting time may rise slightly, while time to destination usually falls. The algorithm can also switch between up-peak, two-way lunch and down-peak modes and keep special assignment rules for accessibility or other uses. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Destination entry panels” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：可能停靠數 S = N[1 − (1 − 1/N)^P]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Probable stops S = N[1 − (1 − 1/N)^P].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目的樓層派梯一定會讓每位乘客的候梯時間變短。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Destination dispatch always shortens every passenger's waiting time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「目的樓層登錄面板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Destination entry panels”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 目的樓層派梯與群控演算法
knowledge.text: 傳統群控在乘客進入車廂後才知道目的地，同一部車往往在許多樓層停靠。目的樓層派梯讓乘客在大廳先輸入樓層，系統把前往相近樓層的人分到同一部車，因此每趟停靠次數減少、往返時間縮短、尖峰運輸能力提高；代價是乘客要依指示走到指定電梯，候梯時間可能略增，但到達目的地時間通常縮短。
knowledge.textEn: Conventional group control learns a passenger's destination only after boarding, so one car often stops at many floors. Destination dispatch has passengers enter their floor in the lobby and groups people bound for nearby floors into the same car, so each trip makes fewer stops, the round trip shortens and peak handling capacity rises; the price is that passengers must walk to the assigned car and waiting time may rise slightly, while time to destination usually falls.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目的樓層派梯一定會讓每位乘客的候梯時間變短。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Destination dispatch always shortens every passenger's waiting time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「目的樓層派梯與群控演算法」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Destination dispatch and group-control algorithms" is correct?
options: 傳統群控在乘客進入車廂後才知道目的地，同一部車往往在許多樓層停靠。
目的樓層派梯一定會讓每位乘客的候梯時間變短。
往返時間公式可以直接套用在雙層車廂與數百公尺的直達穿梭電梯。
optionsEn: Conventional group control learns a passenger's destination only after boarding, so one car often stops at many floors.
Destination dispatch always shortens every passenger's waiting time.
The round-trip-time formula applies directly to double-deck cars and shuttles travelling hundreds of metres.
quiz.explanation: 傳統群控在乘客進入車廂後才知道目的地，同一部車往往在許多樓層停靠。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Conventional group control learns a passenger's destination only after boarding, so one car often stops at many floors. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 目的樓層派梯與群控演算法：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Destination dispatch and group-control algorithms: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「目的樓層登錄面板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Destination entry panels” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：可能停靠數 S = N[1 − (1 − 1/N)^P]。一般群控 N = 15 層、每趟 P = 16 人：(14/15)^16 ≈ 0.332，S ≈ 15×0.668 ≈ 10.0 站。若派梯把每部車限制在約 5 層：(4/5)^16 ≈ 0.028，S ≈ 5×0.972 ≈ 4.9 站。每站損失時間取 10 s，每趟約節省 (10.0−4.9)×10 ≈ 51 s。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Probable stops S = N[1 − (1 − 1/N)^P]. With conventional control, N = 15 floors and P = 16 passengers per trip: (14/15)^16 ≈ 0.332 and S ≈ 15×0.668 ≈ 10.0 stops. If dispatch limits each car to about 5 floors: (4/5)^16 ≈ 0.028 and S ≈ 5×0.972 ≈ 4.9 stops. At 10 s lost per stop each trip saves about (10.0−4.9)×10 ≈ 51 s. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試運轉時以派梯系統的事件紀錄（登錄時間、分派車號、上車與到達時間）計算候梯時間與到達目的地時間分布，與模擬預測的平均值及 95 百分位比較；並實地觀察乘客是否看得懂指示、是否有人搭錯車而造成多餘停靠。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During commissioning, compute distributions of waiting time and time to destination from the dispatch system's event log (registration time, assigned car, boarding and arrival times) and compare averages and 95th percentiles with the simulation; also observe on site whether passengers understand the signs and whether wrong boardings cause extra stops.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Probable stops S = N[1 − (1 − 1/N)^P]. With conventional control, N = 15 floors and P = 16 passengers per trip: (14/15)^16 ≈ 0.332 and S ≈ 15×0.668 ≈ 10.0 stops. If dispatch limits each car to about 5 floors: (4/5)^16 ≈ 0.028 and S ≈ 5×0.972 ≈ 4.9 stops. At 10 s lost per stop each trip saves about (10.0−4.9)×10 ≈ 51 s. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「目的樓層派梯與群控演算法」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Destination dispatch and group-control algorithms", which statement holds?
options: 鋼索外觀沒有斷絲，就代表內部狀況良好。
可能停靠數 S = N[1 − (1 − 1/N)^P]。
電梯數量只要依全天平均搭乘人次決定就足夠。
optionsEn: A rope with no visible broken wires is sound inside.
Probable stops S = N[1 − (1 − 1/N)^P].
The number of elevators can be set from the average number of rides over the whole day.
quiz.explanation: 可能停靠數 S = N[1 − (1 − 1/N)^P]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Probable stops S = N[1 − (1 − 1/N)^P]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 目的樓層派梯與群控演算法：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Destination dispatch and group-control algorithms: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「目的樓層登錄面板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Destination entry panels” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試運轉時以派梯系統的事件紀錄（登錄時間、分派車號、上車與到達時間）計算候梯時間與到達目的地時間分布，與模擬預測的平均值及 95 百分位比較；並實地觀察乘客是否看得懂指示、是否有人搭錯車而造成多餘停靠。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During commissioning, compute distributions of waiting time and time to destination from the dispatch system's event log (registration time, assigned car, boarding and arrival times) and compare averages and 95th percentiles with the simulation; also observe on site whether passengers understand the signs and whether wrong boardings cause extra stops. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：派梯參數（尖峰模式時段、分組上限、無障礙登錄、緊急模式）應以書面設定表交接，並在入住率約一半與接近滿租時各調校一次；任何參數修改都要記錄日期與理由。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hand over dispatch parameters (peak-mode periods, grouping limits, accessible registration, emergency modes) as a written settings table, retune once at about half occupancy and again near full occupancy, and log the date and reason for every parameter change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：登錄面板位置不當或指示不清時，乘客會在車廂內再按樓層或搭上非指派車輛，系統的分組假設被打亂，停靠數回升；若只有大廳採目的樓層登錄而上層仍用傳統按鈕，混合模式設定錯誤也會讓午餐尖峰表現比舊系統更差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Badly placed panels or unclear signs lead passengers to press buttons inside the car or board unassigned cars, upsetting the grouping and pushing stop counts back up; when only the lobby uses destination entry while upper floors keep conventional buttons, a wrongly configured hybrid mode can make lunch-peak performance worse than the old system. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試運轉時以派梯系統的事件紀錄（登錄時間、分派車號、上車與到達時間）計算候梯時間與到達目的地時間分布，與模擬預測的平均值及 95 百分位比較；並實地觀察乘客是否看得懂指示、是否有人搭錯車而造成多餘停靠。
knowledge.textEn: During commissioning, compute distributions of waiting time and time to destination from the dispatch system's event log (registration time, assigned car, boarding and arrival times) and compare averages and 95th percentiles with the simulation; also observe on site whether passengers understand the signs and whether wrong boardings cause extra stops.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 派梯參數（尖峰模式時段、分組上限、無障礙登錄、緊急模式）應以書面設定表交接，並在入住率約一半與接近滿租時各調校一次；任何參數修改都要記錄日期與理由。
knowledge.textEn: Hand over dispatch parameters (peak-mode periods, grouping limits, accessible registration, emergency modes) as a written settings table, retune once at about half occupancy and again near full occupancy, and log the date and reason for every parameter change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「目的樓層派梯與群控演算法」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Destination dispatch and group-control algorithms"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要換更大的馬達，單段行程就能無限提高。

optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A bigger motor alone lets single-run travel grow without limit.

During commissioning, compute distributions of waiting time and time to destination from the dispatch system's event log (registration time, assigned car, boarding and arrival times) and compare averages and 95th percentiles with the simulation.

quiz.explanationEn: During commissioning, compute distributions of waiting time and time to destination from the dispatch system's event log (registration time, assigned car, boarding and arrival times) and compare averages and 95th percentiles with the simulation; also observe on site whether passengers understand the signs and whether wrong boardings cause extra stops. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 目的樓層派梯與群控演算法：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Destination dispatch and group-control algorithms: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「目的樓層登錄面板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Destination entry panels” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 登錄面板位置不當或指示不清時，乘客會在車廂內再按樓層或搭上非指派車輛，系統的分組假設被打亂，停靠數回升；若只有大廳採目的樓層登錄而上層仍用傳統按鈕，混合模式設定錯誤也會讓午餐尖峰表現比舊系統更差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Badly placed panels or unclear signs lead passengers to press buttons inside the car or board unassigned cars, upsetting the grouping and pushing stop counts back up; when only the lobby uses destination entry while upper floors keep conventional buttons, a wrongly configured hybrid mode can make lunch-peak performance worse than the old system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：演算法還能依時段切換上行尖峰、午餐雙向與下行模式，並保留無障礙或特殊用途的分派規則。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The algorithm can also switch between up-peak, two-way lunch and down-peak modes and keep special assignment rules for accessibility or other uses.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目的樓層派梯一定會讓每位乘客的候梯時間變短。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Destination dispatch always shortens every passenger's waiting time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 登錄面板位置不當或指示不清時，乘客會在車廂內再按樓層或搭上非指派車輛，系統的分組假設被打亂，停靠數回升；若只有大廳採目的樓層登錄而上層仍用傳統按鈕，混合模式設定錯誤也會讓午餐尖峰表現比舊系統更差。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「目的樓層派梯與群控演算法」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Destination dispatch and group-control algorithms" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「往返時間計算與交通模擬」與「建築風擺下的鋼索擺動與管制運轉」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Round-trip-time calculation and traffic simulation" and "Rope sway under building sway and controlled operation": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 往返時間計算與交通模擬：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Round-trip-time calculation and traffic simulation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「往返時間」如何影響超高層電梯分區與調度的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Round-trip time” governs force, deformation or durability in “Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 傳統上行尖峰計算把一部電梯的一個循環拆成：在大廳載客、往上行駛到最高反轉樓層、途中各站開關門與乘客進出、再空車回到大廳。往返時間除以電梯台數得到平均間隔，車廂人數乘以 300 s 再除以往返時間得到每部車的五分鐘運輸量。公式假設乘客均勻到達、樓層需求平均，並不適用於雙層車廂、超過約 200 m 的行程或轉乘系統，ISO 8100-32 也明列這些排除項，因此超高層須以蒙地卡羅交通模擬補足。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「往返時間」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The classic up-peak calculation breaks one car cycle into loading at the lobby, travelling up to the highest reversal floor, opening and closing doors and transferring passengers at each stop, then returning empty to the lobby. Round-trip time divided by the number of cars gives the average interval, and car load times 300 s divided by round-trip time gives the five-minute capacity of each car. The formula assumes uniform arrivals and evenly spread demand, so it does not fit double-deck cars, travel beyond about 200 m or transfer systems; ISO 8100-32 lists these exclusions explicitly, so supertall towers supplement it with Monte Carlo traffic simulation. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Round-trip time” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：RTT = 2H·t_v + (S+1)·t_s + 2P·t_p。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: RTT = 2H·t_v + (S+1)·t_s + 2P·t_p.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「往返時間公式可以直接套用在雙層車廂與數百公尺的直達穿梭電梯。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

quiz.question: 關於「往返時間計算與交通模擬」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 往返時間計算與交通模擬：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Round-trip-time calculation and traffic simulation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「往返時間」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Round-trip time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：RTT = 2H·t_v + (S+1)·t_s + 2P·t_p。取 N = 15、P = 16、最高反轉層 H ≈ 14.5、S ≈ 10.0、每層行駛 t_v = 1.0 s、每站損失 t_s = 10 s、每人進出 t_p = 1.2 s：RTT = 29.1+110.3+38.4 ≈ 178 s。6 部車 HC5 = 300×16×6/178 ≈ 162 人（1,800 人的 9.0%）；8 部車約 216 人（12.0%），間隔 178/8 ≈ 22 s。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: RTT = 2H·t_v + (S+1)·t_s + 2P·t_p. With N = 15, P = 16, highest reversal floor H ≈ 14.5, S ≈ 10.0, t_v = 1.0 s per floor, t_s = 10 s per stop and t_p = 1.2 s per passenger: RTT = 29.1+110.3+38.4 ≈ 178 s. Six cars give HC5 = 300×16×6/178 ≈ 162 persons (9.0% of 1,800); eight cars give about 216 (12.0%) with an interval of 178/8 ≈ 22 s. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同一方案以計算法與至少一種模擬工具各算一次，若兩者差異超過約一成就追查假設（車門時間、加減速度、乘客到達分布）；完工後實測車門開關時間、樓層間行駛時間與乘客進出時間，回填模型重算，確認結果仍符合設計目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run each option once by calculation and once in at least one simulation tool; if they differ by more than about a tenth, trace the assumptions (door times, acceleration, arrival distribution).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: RTT = 2H·t_v + (S+1)·t_s + 2P·t_p. With N = 15, P = 16, highest reversal floor H ≈ 14.5, S ≈ 10.0, t_v = 1.0 s per floor, t_s = 10 s per stop and t_p = 1.2 s per passenger: RTT = 29.1+110.3+38.4 ≈ 178 s. Six cars give HC5 = 300×16×6/178 ≈ 162 persons (9.0% of 1,800); eight cars give about 216 (12.0%) with an interval of 178/8 ≈ 22 s. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「往返時間計算與交通模擬」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 往返時間計算與交通模擬：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Round-trip-time calculation and traffic simulation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「往返時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Round-trip time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同一方案以計算法與至少一種模擬工具各算一次，若兩者差異超過約一成就追查假設（車門時間、加減速度、乘客到達分布）；完工後實測車門開關時間、樓層間行駛時間與乘客進出時間，回填模型重算，確認結果仍符合設計目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run each option once by calculation and once in at least one simulation tool; if they differ by more than about a tenth, trace the assumptions (door times, acceleration, arrival distribution). After completion, measure actual door open and close times, floor-to-floor flight times and passenger transfer times, feed them back into the model and confirm the result still meets the design targets. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交通分析報告須列出所有輸入參數與來源、計算與模擬兩種結果、候梯時間與到達目的地時間的分布圖，並由獨立的垂直運輸顧問複核；電梯合約應把車門時間與樓層行駛時間列為可量測的驗收項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The traffic report must list every input and its source, both calculated and simulated results and distributions of waiting time and time to destination, and be reviewed by an independent vertical-transport consultant; the lift contract should make door times and floor-to-floor flight times measurable acceptance items.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若假設車門開關 4 s，實際因安全光幕與門速設定變成 6 s，每趟 11 次停靠就多出約 22 s，往返時間增加超過一成，原本剛好達標的分區在入住後立即不足；只看平均值也會忽略最差 5% 乘客的長時間候梯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If door operation was assumed at 4 s but light-curtain and door-speed settings make it 6 s, a trip with 11 stops gains about 22 s and the round trip grows by more than a tenth, so a zone that just met its target falls short as soon as it is occupied; looking only at averages also hides the long waits of the worst 5% of passengers. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 往返時間計算與交通模擬：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Round-trip-time calculation and traffic simulation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「往返時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Round-trip time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若假設車門開關 4 s，實際因安全光幕與門速設定變成 6 s，每趟 11 次停靠就多出約 22 s，往返時間增加超過一成，原本剛好達標的分區在入住後立即不足；只看平均值也會忽略最差 5% 乘客的長時間候梯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 建築風擺下的鋼索擺動與管制運轉：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rope sway under building sway and controlled operation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼索擺動感測器」如何影響超高層電梯分區與調度的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rope-sway sensors” governs force, deformation or durability in “Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超高層在強風下以約 0.1 至 0.2 Hz 的低頻擺動，而數百公尺長的懸吊鋼索與補償索就像長弦，橫向自然頻率也落在相近範圍。兩者頻率接近時，井道頂部的微小擺動會把鋼索激成大幅擺動，鋼索可能碰撞井道設備、纏住感測器或在輪槽中跳槽。電梯系統因此接收建築擺動感測器訊號，超過門檻時自動降速，或把車廂停在使鋼索自由長度避開共振的位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼索擺動感測器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A supertall tower sways at low frequency, around 0.1 to 0.2 Hz, in strong wind, while suspension and compensation ropes hundreds of metres long behave like long strings whose transverse natural frequencies fall in a similar range. When the two frequencies approach each other, small motion at the top of the hoistway can drive the ropes into large swings that strike hoistway equipment, snag sensors or jump sheave grooves. The lift system therefore takes signals from building-sway sensors and, above a threshold, slows down automatically or parks cars where the free rope length avoids resonance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rope-sway sensors” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：弦振動 f = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: String vibration f = (1/2L)·√(T/m).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼索擺動只與電梯速度有關，與建築擺動無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rope sway depends only on elevator speed, not on building sway." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼索擺動感測器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rope-sway sensors”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
