steps.title: 建築風擺下的鋼索擺動與管制運轉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rope sway under building sway and controlled operation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼索擺動感測器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rope-sway sensors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：弦振動 f = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。取單條鋼索張力 T = 14,000 N、線密度 m = 0.9 kg/m：√(T/m) = √15,556 ≈ 124.7 m/s。自由長度 L = 400 m 時 f ≈ 124.7/800 ≈ 0.156 Hz；若建築頻率為 0.14 Hz，共振長度 L = 124.7/(2×0.14) ≈ 445 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: String vibration f = (1/2L)·√(T/m). With rope tension T = 14,000 N and linear density m = 0.9 kg/m, √(T/m) = √15,556 ≈ 124.7 m/s. A free length L = 400 m gives f ≈ 124.7/800 ≈ 0.156 Hz; if the building frequency is 0.14 Hz the resonant length is L = 124.7/(2×0.14) ≈ 445 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在建築頂部設加速度計或位移計，與井道內鋼索擺動感測器同步記錄並對照風速；試運轉時以模擬訊號測試管制運轉邏輯（降速、停靠樓層、復駛條件），強風事件後檢查鋼索、補償索與井道設備是否有碰撞痕跡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record accelerometers or displacement sensors at the top of the building together with rope-sway sensors in the hoistway and wind speed; during commissioning test the controlled-operation logic (speed reduction, parking floors, restart conditions) with simulated signals, and after strong-wind events inspect ropes, compensation ropes and hoistway equipment for contact marks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: String vibration f = (1/2L)·√(T/m). With rope tension T = 14,000 N and linear density m = 0.9 kg/m, √(T/m) = √15,556 ≈ 124.7 m/s. A free length L = 400 m gives f ≈ 124.7/800 ≈ 0.156 Hz; if the building frequency is 0.14 Hz the resonant length is L = 124.7/(2×0.14) ≈ 445 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「建築風擺下的鋼索擺動與管制運轉」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rope sway under building sway and controlled operation", which statement holds?
options: 電梯數量只要依全天平均搭乘人次決定就足夠。
只要換更大的馬達，單段行程就能無限提高。
optionsEn: String vibration f = (1/2L)·√(T/m).
The number of elevators can be set from the average number of rides over the whole day.
A bigger motor alone lets single-run travel grow without limit.

steps.title: 建築風擺下的鋼索擺動與管制運轉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rope sway under building sway and controlled operation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼索擺動感測器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rope-sway sensors” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在建築頂部設加速度計或位移計，與井道內鋼索擺動感測器同步記錄並對照風速；試運轉時以模擬訊號測試管制運轉邏輯（降速、停靠樓層、復駛條件），強風事件後檢查鋼索、補償索與井道設備是否有碰撞痕跡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record accelerometers or displacement sensors at the top of the building together with rope-sway sensors in the hoistway and wind speed; during commissioning test the controlled-operation logic (speed reduction, parking floors, restart conditions) with simulated signals, and after strong-wind events inspect ropes, compensation ropes and hoistway equipment for contact marks. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把建築第一、二模態頻率與阻尼器資料交給電梯公司做鋼索共振分析，並在營運手冊寫明擺動門檻、管制模式與復駛前巡檢項目；須由維修主管確認巡檢完成後才能解除管制復駛。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Give the building's first and second modal frequencies and damper data to the lift company for rope-resonance analysis, and write sway thresholds, controlled modes and pre-restart inspection items into the operating manual; normal service is released only after the maintenance supervisor confirms that the inspection is complete.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若未設擺動管制，颱風後鋼索可能纏繞井道內的限位開關或電纜，電梯停駛數日；反之門檻設得太低，一般強風就讓全部高區電梯降速，風季的尖峰運輸能力大幅下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without sway control, ropes may wrap around limit switches or cables in the hoistway after a typhoon and keep the lifts out of service for days; conversely, a threshold set too low makes every high-zone lift slow down in ordinary strong wind and cuts peak handling capacity throughout the windy season. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 建築風擺下的鋼索擺動與管制運轉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rope sway under building sway and controlled operation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼索擺動感測器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rope-sway sensors” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若未設擺動管制，颱風後鋼索可能纏繞井道內的限位開關或電纜，電梯停駛數日；反之門檻設得太低，一般強風就讓全部高區電梯降速，風季的尖峰運輸能力大幅下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rope sway depends only on elevator speed, not on building sway." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「建築風擺下的鋼索擺動與管制運轉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rope sway under building sway and controlled operation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A rope with no visible broken wires is sound inside.
Without sway control, ropes may wrap around limit switches or cables in the hoistway after a typhoon and keep the lifts out of service for days.
quiz.explanation: 若未設擺動管制，颱風後鋼索可能纏繞井道內的限位開關或電纜，電梯停駛數日；反之門檻設得太低，一般強風就讓全部高區電梯降速，風季的尖峰運輸能力大幅下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without sway control, ropes may wrap around limit switches or cables in the hoistway after a typhoon and keep the lifts out of service for days; conversely, a threshold set too low makes every high-zone lift slow down in ordinary strong wind and cuts peak handling capacity throughout the windy season. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼索磨耗、保養與現代化更新」與「緊急運轉、避難電梯與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rope wear, maintenance and modernisation" and "Emergency operation, evacuation lifts and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼索磨耗、保養與現代化更新：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rope wear, maintenance and modernisation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「曳引輪槽與彎曲次數」如何影響超高層電梯分區與調度的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sheave grooves and bending cycles” governs force, deformation or durability in “Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼索每次繞過曳引輪與導向輪都會反覆彎曲，鋼絲在輪槽接觸處逐漸磨耗並出現斷絲；繞輪次數最多的那段鋼索決定整組更換時機。輪槽磨耗會使各條鋼索的有效直徑不同、張力不均，又加速磨耗，所以鋼索與輪槽要一起評估。超高層電梯使用強度高、停機代價大，業主通常在十多年後依控制系統、曳引機與鋼索狀態分階段現代化，例如 Otis 於 2024 年取得更新哈里發塔 57 部電梯中 34 部的合約。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「曳引輪槽與彎曲次數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each pass over the traction and deflector sheaves bends the rope again, wearing the wires where they touch the groove until wires break; the rope section that passes over sheaves most often sets the replacement time for the whole set. Groove wear makes the effective diameters of ropes differ and their tensions uneven, which accelerates wear further, so ropes and grooves must be assessed together. Supertall lifts work hard and downtime is costly, so owners usually modernise in phases after a decade or more according to the condition of controllers, machines and ropes; in 2024, for example, Otis won a contract to modernise 34 of the 57 elevators in Burj Khalifa. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sheave grooves and bending cycles” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：彎曲次數 = 每日運轉趟數 × 每趟繞輪次數 × 365。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Bending cycles = daily trips × bends per trip × 365.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼索外觀沒有斷絲，就代表內部狀況良好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A rope with no visible broken wires is sound inside." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「曳引輪槽與彎曲次數」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sheave grooves and bending cycles”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼索磨耗、保養與現代化更新
knowledge.text: 鋼索每次繞過曳引輪與導向輪都會反覆彎曲，鋼絲在輪槽接觸處逐漸磨耗並出現斷絲；繞輪次數最多的那段鋼索決定整組更換時機。輪槽磨耗會使各條鋼索的有效直徑不同、張力不均，又加速磨耗，所以鋼索與輪槽要一起評估。
knowledge.textEn: Each pass over the traction and deflector sheaves bends the rope again, wearing the wires where they touch the groove until wires break; the rope section that passes over sheaves most often sets the replacement time for the whole set. Groove wear makes the effective diameters of ropes differ and their tensions uneven, which accelerates wear further, so ropes and grooves must be assessed together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼索外觀沒有斷絲，就代表內部狀況良好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A rope with no visible broken wires is sound inside. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼索磨耗、保養與現代化更新」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rope wear, maintenance and modernisation" is correct?
options: 鋼索每次繞過曳引輪與導向輪都會反覆彎曲，鋼絲在輪槽接觸處逐漸磨耗並出現斷絲；繞輪次數最多的那段鋼索決定整組更換時機。
鋼索外觀沒有斷絲，就代表內部狀況良好。
火災時建築內所有電梯一律不能使用，連消防人員也不例外。
optionsEn: Each pass over the traction and deflector sheaves bends the rope again, wearing the wires where they touch the groove until wires break.
A rope with no visible broken wires is sound inside.
In a fire no lift in the building may be used, not even by firefighters.
quiz.explanation: 鋼索每次繞過曳引輪與導向輪都會反覆彎曲，鋼絲在輪槽接觸處逐漸磨耗並出現斷絲；繞輪次數最多的那段鋼索決定整組更換時機。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each pass over the traction and deflector sheaves bends the rope again, wearing the wires where they touch the groove until wires break; the rope section that passes over sheaves most often sets the replacement time for the whole set. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼索磨耗、保養與現代化更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rope wear, maintenance and modernisation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曳引輪槽與彎曲次數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sheave grooves and bending cycles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：彎曲次數 = 每日運轉趟數 × 每趟繞輪次數 × 365。每日 400 趟、每趟繞過曳引輪與導向輪共 2 次：400×2×365 = 292,000 次/年。若教學假設鋼索壽命為 3,000,000 次彎曲，約 3,000,000/292,000 ≈ 10.3 年；改為雙繞式（每趟 4 次彎曲）時壽命約減半為 5.1 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Bending cycles = daily trips × bends per trip × 365. With 400 trips a day and two bends per trip over the traction and deflector sheaves, 400×2×365 = 292,000 cycles per year. With a teaching rope life of 3,000,000 bends this gives about 3,000,000/292,000 ≈ 10.3 years; a double-wrap layout with four bends per trip roughly halves that to 5.1 years. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期以目視、量規與電磁探傷檢查鋼索的斷絲數、直徑減少與腐蝕，並以輪槽量規檢查槽形磨耗；依鋼索位置把結果記錄成趨勢圖，與製造商的汰換判準比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Periodically inspect ropes visually, with gauges and by magnetic flaw detection for broken wires, diameter loss and corrosion, and check groove wear with groove gauges; plot the results as trends by rope position and compare with the manufacturer's discard criteria.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 彎曲次數 = 每日運轉趟數 × 每趟繞輪次數 × 365。每日 400 趟、每趟繞過曳引輪與導向輪共 2 次：400×2×365 = 292,000 次/年。若教學假設鋼索壽命為 3,000,000 次彎曲，約 3,000,000/292,000 ≈ 10.3 年；改為雙繞式（每趟 4 次彎曲）時壽命約減半為 5.1 年。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Bending cycles = daily trips × bends per trip × 365. With 400 trips a day and two bends per trip over the traction and deflector sheaves, 400×2×365 = 292,000 cycles per year. With a teaching rope life of 3,000,000 bends this gives about 3,000,000/292,000 ≈ 10.3 years; a double-wrap layout with four bends per trip roughly halves that to 5.1 years. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼索磨耗、保養與現代化更新」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rope wear, maintenance and modernisation", which statement holds?
options: 分區越多、每區電梯越少，核心筒面積就一定越省。
彎曲次數 = 每日運轉趟數 × 每趟繞輪次數 × 365。
超高速電梯上行與下行一定以相同的最高速度運轉。
optionsEn: More zones with fewer elevators each always means a smaller core.
Bending cycles = daily trips × bends per trip × 365.
An ultra-high-speed elevator always runs at the same top speed up and down.
quiz.explanation: 彎曲次數 = 每日運轉趟數 × 每趟繞輪次數 × 365。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Bending cycles = daily trips × bends per trip × 365. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼索磨耗、保養與現代化更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rope wear, maintenance and modernisation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「曳引輪槽與彎曲次數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sheave grooves and bending cycles” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期以目視、量規與電磁探傷檢查鋼索的斷絲數、直徑減少與腐蝕，並以輪槽量規檢查槽形磨耗；依鋼索位置把結果記錄成趨勢圖，與製造商的汰換判準比較。遠端監控資料（啟動次數、煞車次數、異常停車）可用來預判下一次檢查重點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Periodically inspect ropes visually, with gauges and by magnetic flaw detection for broken wires, diameter loss and corrosion, and check groove wear with groove gauges; plot the results as trends by rope position and compare with the manufacturer's discard criteria. Remote-monitoring data (starts, brake applications, unplanned stops) helps predict where the next inspection should focus. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護合約應要求逐台建立鋼索與輪槽檔案並規定電磁探傷頻率；現代化計畫要分批停機，確保每個分區在任何時候都保留足夠台數維持尖峰服務。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance contract should require a rope-and-groove record for every lift and set the frequency of magnetic testing, and the modernisation plan should take lifts out in batches so every zone always keeps enough cars to sustain peak service.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只換鋼索而不修整或更換磨耗輪槽，新鋼索在舊槽中受力不均，短時間內又出現斷絲；鋼索潤滑不足或處於沿海鹽霧環境時，內部腐蝕從外表看不出來，可能在檢查間隔內突然劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Replacing ropes without re-machining or renewing worn grooves loads the new ropes unevenly in the old grooves so broken wires reappear quickly; with poor lubrication or coastal salt air, internal corrosion invisible from outside can degrade a rope suddenly between inspections. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期以目視、量規與電磁探傷檢查鋼索的斷絲數、直徑減少與腐蝕，並以輪槽量規檢查槽形磨耗；依鋼索位置把結果記錄成趨勢圖，與製造商的汰換判準比較。遠端監控資料（啟動次數、煞車次數、異常停車）可用來預判下一次檢查重點。
knowledge.textEn: Periodically inspect ropes visually, with gauges and by magnetic flaw detection for broken wires, diameter loss and corrosion, and check groove wear with groove gauges; plot the results as trends by rope position and compare with the manufacturer's discard criteria. Remote-monitoring data (starts, brake applications, unplanned stops) helps predict where the next inspection should focus.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護合約應要求逐台建立鋼索與輪槽檔案並規定電磁探傷頻率；現代化計畫要分批停機，確保每個分區在任何時候都保留足夠台數維持尖峰服務。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance contract should require a rope-and-groove record for every lift and set the frequency of magnetic testing, and the modernisation plan should take lifts out in batches so every zone always keeps enough cars to sustain peak service.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼索磨耗、保養與現代化更新」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rope wear, maintenance and modernisation"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
目的樓層派梯一定會讓每位乘客的候梯時間變短。
定期以目視、量規與電磁探傷檢查鋼索的斷絲數、直徑減少與腐蝕，並以輪槽量規檢查槽形磨耗；依鋼索位置把結果記錄成趨勢圖，與製造商的汰換判準比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Destination dispatch always shortens every passenger's waiting time.
Periodically inspect ropes visually, with gauges and by magnetic flaw detection for broken wires, diameter loss and corrosion, and check groove wear with groove gauges.
quiz.explanation: 定期以目視、量規與電磁探傷檢查鋼索的斷絲數、直徑減少與腐蝕，並以輪槽量規檢查槽形磨耗；依鋼索位置把結果記錄成趨勢圖，與製造商的汰換判準比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Periodically inspect ropes visually, with gauges and by magnetic flaw detection for broken wires, diameter loss and corrosion, and check groove wear with groove gauges; plot the results as trends by rope position and compare with the manufacturer's discard criteria. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼索磨耗、保養與現代化更新：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rope wear, maintenance and modernisation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曳引輪槽與彎曲次數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sheave grooves and bending cycles” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只換鋼索而不修整或更換磨耗輪槽，新鋼索在舊槽中受力不均，短時間內又出現斷絲；鋼索潤滑不足或處於沿海鹽霧環境時，內部腐蝕從外表看不出來，可能在檢查間隔內突然劣化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Replacing ropes without re-machining or renewing worn grooves loads the new ropes unevenly in the old grooves so broken wires reappear quickly; with poor lubrication or coastal salt air, internal corrosion invisible from outside can degrade a rope suddenly between inspections. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：超高層電梯使用強度高、停機代價大，業主通常在十多年後依控制系統、曳引機與鋼索狀態分階段現代化，例如 Otis 於 2024 年取得更新哈里發塔 57 部電梯中 34 部的合約。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Supertall lifts work hard and downtime is costly, so owners usually modernise in phases after a decade or more according to the condition of controllers, machines and ropes; in 2024, for example, Otis won a contract to modernise 34 of the 57 elevators in Burj Khalifa.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼索外觀沒有斷絲，就代表內部狀況良好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A rope with no visible broken wires is sound inside." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只換鋼索而不修整或更換磨耗輪槽，新鋼索在舊槽中受力不均，短時間內又出現斷絲；鋼索潤滑不足或處於沿海鹽霧環境時，內部腐蝕從外表看不出來，可能在檢查間隔內突然劣化。
knowledge.textEn: Replacing ropes without re-machining or renewing worn grooves loads the new ropes unevenly in the old grooves so broken wires reappear quickly; with poor lubrication or coastal salt air, internal corrosion invisible from outside can degrade a rope suddenly between inspections.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼索磨耗、保養與現代化更新」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rope wear, maintenance and modernisation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只換鋼索而不修整或更換磨耗輪槽，新鋼索在舊槽中受力不均，短時間內又出現斷絲；鋼索潤滑不足或處於沿海鹽霧環境時，內部腐蝕從外表看不出來，可能在檢查間隔內突然劣化。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
火災時建築內所有電梯一律不能使用，連消防人員也不例外。
optionsEn: Replacing ropes without re-machining or renewing worn grooves loads the new ropes unevenly in the old grooves so broken wires reappear quickly.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
In a fire no lift in the building may be used, not even by firefighters.
quiz.explanation: 只換鋼索而不修整或更換磨耗輪槽，新鋼索在舊槽中受力不均，短時間內又出現斷絲；鋼索潤滑不足或處於沿海鹽霧環境時，內部腐蝕從外表看不出來，可能在檢查間隔內突然劣化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Replacing ropes without re-machining or renewing worn grooves loads the new ropes unevenly in the old grooves so broken wires reappear quickly; with poor lubrication or coastal salt air, internal corrosion invisible from outside can degrade a rope suddenly between inspections. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 緊急運轉、避難電梯與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Emergency operation, evacuation lifts and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「消防與避難電梯」如何影響超高層電梯分區與調度的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Firefighter and evacuation lifts” governs force, deformation or durability in “Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超高層的樓梯疏散距離可達數百公尺，行動不便者與高樓層人員單靠樓梯需要很長時間。消防電梯依 EN 81-72 一類規範提供具防火、防水與專用電源的電梯供消防人員使用；部分超高層更把穿梭電梯設計成火災時可由避難層或空中大廳分批接運的避難電梯。這要求井道加壓、電源與控制備援、機電設備防水，並在交接時把各種緊急模式的操作權責寫清楚。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「消防與避難電梯」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stair evacuation in a supertall tower can span hundreds of metres, so people with limited mobility and occupants on high floors need a long time to escape by stairs alone. Firefighter lifts to standards such as EN 81-72 provide fire- and water-protected lifts with dedicated power for fire services, and some supertall towers design their shuttles as evacuation lifts that move people in batches from refuge floors or sky lobbies during a fire. This requires pressurised shafts, redundant power and controls and water-protected equipment, and at handover the responsibilities for operating each emergency mode must be written down clearly. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Firefighter and evacuation lifts” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：樓梯：垂直距離 400 m、垂直下降速度約 0.25 m/s，無壅塞時 400/0.25 = 1,600 s ≈ 27 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stairs: 400 m of vertical descent at about 0.25 m/s vertical speed takes 400/0.25 = 1,600 s ≈ 27 min without congestion.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「火災時建築內所有電梯一律不能使用，連消防人員也不例外。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "In a fire no lift in the building may be used, not even by firefighters." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「消防與避難電梯」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Firefighter and evacuation lifts”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 緊急運轉、避難電梯與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Emergency operation, evacuation lifts and handover
knowledge.text: 超高層的樓梯疏散距離可達數百公尺，行動不便者與高樓層人員單靠樓梯需要很長時間。消防電梯依 EN 81-72 一類規範提供具防火、防水與專用電源的電梯供消防人員使用；部分超高層更把穿梭電梯設計成火災時可由避難層或空中大廳分批接運的避難電梯。
knowledge.textEn: Stair evacuation in a supertall tower can span hundreds of metres, so people with limited mobility and occupants on high floors need a long time to escape by stairs alone. Firefighter lifts to standards such as EN 81-72 provide fire- and water-protected lifts with dedicated power for fire services, and some supertall towers design their shuttles as evacuation lifts that move people in batches from refuge floors or sky lobbies during a fire.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：火災時建築內所有電梯一律不能使用，連消防人員也不例外。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: In a fire no lift in the building may be used, not even by firefighters. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「緊急運轉、避難電梯與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Emergency operation, evacuation lifts and handover" is correct?
options: 火災時建築內所有電梯一律不能使用，連消防人員也不例外。
超高層的樓梯疏散距離可達數百公尺，行動不便者與高樓層人員單靠樓梯需要很長時間。
電梯數量只要依全天平均搭乘人次決定就足夠。
optionsEn: In a fire no lift in the building may be used, not even by firefighters.
Stair evacuation in a supertall tower can span hundreds of metres, so people with limited mobility and occupants on high floors need a long time to escape by stairs alone.
The number of elevators can be set from the average number of rides over the whole day.
quiz.explanation: 超高層的樓梯疏散距離可達數百公尺，行動不便者與高樓層人員單靠樓梯需要很長時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stair evacuation in a supertall tower can span hundreds of metres, so people with limited mobility and occupants on high floors need a long time to escape by stairs alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 緊急運轉、避難電梯與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Emergency operation, evacuation lifts and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「消防與避難電梯」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Firefighter and evacuation lifts” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：樓梯：垂直距離 400 m、垂直下降速度約 0.25 m/s，無壅塞時 400/0.25 = 1,600 s ≈ 27 min。穿梭電梯：8 部雙層車各載 48 人，每循環 384 人；從 300 m 避難層往返 2×(300/10+10)+60 = 140 s；2,000 人需 2,000/384 ≈ 5.2，取 6 循環，約 6×140 = 840 s = 14 min。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stairs: 400 m of vertical descent at about 0.25 m/s vertical speed takes 400/0.25 = 1,600 s ≈ 27 min without congestion. Shuttles: eight double-deck cars carrying 48 people each move 384 per cycle; a round trip from a refuge floor at 300 m takes 2×(300/10+10)+60 = 140 s; 2,000 people need 2,000/384 ≈ 5.2, so six cycles, about 6×140 = 840 s = 14 min. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：完工前做整合消防測試：觸發火警後確認電梯依程序返回指定樓層、消防員開關與通話有效、備用電源切換時間符合規範、井道加壓維持設計壓差；並在演練中記錄避難電梯的實際循環時間，與疏散策略的計算比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before completion run an integrated fire test: after a fire alarm, confirm lifts recall to the designated floors, firefighter switches and intercoms work, standby power transfers within the specified time and shaft pressurisation holds the design pressure difference; record actual evacuation-lift cycle times in drills and compare them with the evacuation-strategy calculation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Stairs: 400 m of vertical descent at about 0.25 m/s vertical speed takes 400/0.25 = 1,600 s ≈ 27 min without congestion. Shuttles: eight double-deck cars carrying 48 people each move 384 per cycle; a round trip from a refuge floor at 300 m takes 2×(300/10+10)+60 = 140 s; 2,000 people need 2,000/384 ≈ 5.2, so six cycles, about 6×140 = 840 s = 14 min. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「緊急運轉、避難電梯與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Emergency operation, evacuation lifts and handover", which statement holds?
options: 只要換更大的馬達，單段行程就能無限提高。
鋼導軌只要安裝時完全垂直，日後就不需要考慮結構變形。
樓梯：垂直距離 400 m、垂直下降速度約 0.25 m/s，無壅塞時 400/0.25 = 1,600 s ≈ 27 min。
optionsEn: A bigger motor alone lets single-run travel grow without limit.
Steel rails installed perfectly plumb need no allowance for later structural movement.
Stairs: 400 m of vertical descent at about 0.25 m/s vertical speed takes 400/0.25 = 1,600 s ≈ 27 min without congestion.
quiz.explanation: 樓梯：垂直距離 400 m、垂直下降速度約 0.25 m/s，無壅塞時 400/0.25 = 1,600 s ≈ 27 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Stairs: 400 m of vertical descent at about 0.25 m/s vertical speed takes 400/0.25 = 1,600 s ≈ 27 min without congestion. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 緊急運轉、避難電梯與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Emergency operation, evacuation lifts and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「消防與避難電梯」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Firefighter and evacuation lifts” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 完工前做整合消防測試：觸發火警後確認電梯依程序返回指定樓層、消防員開關與通話有效、備用電源切換時間符合規範、井道加壓維持設計壓差；並在演練中記錄避難電梯的實際循環時間，與疏散策略的計算比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before completion run an integrated fire test: after a fire alarm, confirm lifts recall to the designated floors, firefighter switches and intercoms work, standby power transfers within the specified time and shaft pressurisation holds the design pressure difference; record actual evacuation-lift cycle times in drills and compare them with the evacuation-strategy calculation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時提供緊急運轉矩陣：每種事件（火警、停電、地震、強風）下各組電梯的動作、操作人與復歸條件，並安排與消防機關的聯合演練；任何避難電梯策略都須取得主管消防機關核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover provide an emergency-operation matrix stating, for each event (fire alarm, power failure, earthquake, strong wind), what each lift group does, who operates it and the conditions for return to service, and hold joint drills with the fire service; any evacuation-lift strategy must be approved by the authority having jurisdiction for fire safety.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：消防電梯前室若防水或排水不足，消防射水流入井道會使電氣設備短路，電梯在最需要時停擺；交接文件缺少緊急模式說明時，管理人員可能在事件中誤操作，把電梯送往起火樓層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the firefighter-lift lobby lacks water protection or drainage, firefighting water entering the shaft can short the electrical equipment and stop the lift when it is most needed; when handover documents omit emergency-mode instructions, building staff may mis-operate lifts during an incident and send them toward the fire floor. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 完工前做整合消防測試：觸發火警後確認電梯依程序返回指定樓層、消防員開關與通話有效、備用電源切換時間符合規範、井道加壓維持設計壓差；並在演練中記錄避難電梯的實際循環時間，與疏散策略的計算比較。
knowledge.textEn: Before completion run an integrated fire test: after a fire alarm, confirm lifts recall to the designated floors, firefighter switches and intercoms work, standby power transfers within the specified time and shaft pressurisation holds the design pressure difference; record actual evacuation-lift cycle times in drills and compare them with the evacuation-strategy calculation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時提供緊急運轉矩陣：每種事件（火警、停電、地震、強風）下各組電梯的動作、操作人與復歸條件，並安排與消防機關的聯合演練；任何避難電梯策略都須取得主管消防機關核准。
knowledge.textEn: At handover provide an emergency-operation matrix stating, for each event (fire alarm, power failure, earthquake, strong wind), what each lift group does, who operates it and the conditions for return to service, and hold joint drills with the fire service; any evacuation-lift strategy must be approved by the authority having jurisdiction for fire safety.

quiz.question: 要驗證「緊急運轉、避難電梯與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Emergency operation, evacuation lifts and handover"?
options: 完工前做整合消防測試：觸發火警後確認電梯依程序返回指定樓層、消防員開關與通話有效、備用電源切換時間符合規範、井道加壓維持設計壓差。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
往返時間公式可以直接套用在雙層車廂與數百公尺的直達穿梭電梯。
optionsEn: Before completion run an integrated fire test: after a fire alarm, confirm lifts recall to the designated floors, firefighter switches and intercoms work, standby power transfers within the specified time and shaft pressurisation holds the design pressure difference.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The round-trip-time formula applies directly to double-deck cars and shuttles travelling hundreds of metres.
quiz.explanation: 完工前做整合消防測試：觸發火警後確認電梯依程序返回指定樓層、消防員開關與通話有效、備用電源切換時間符合規範、井道加壓維持設計壓差；並在演練中記錄避難電梯的實際循環時間，與疏散策略的計算比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before completion run an integrated fire test: after a fire alarm, confirm lifts recall to the designated floors, firefighter switches and intercoms work, standby power transfers within the specified time and shaft pressurisation holds the design pressure difference; record actual evacuation-lift cycle times in drills and compare them with the evacuation-strategy calculation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 緊急運轉、避難電梯與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Emergency operation, evacuation lifts and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「消防與避難電梯」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Firefighter and evacuation lifts” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 消防電梯前室若防水或排水不足，消防射水流入井道會使電氣設備短路，電梯在最需要時停擺；交接文件缺少緊急模式說明時，管理人員可能在事件中誤操作，把電梯送往起火樓層。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the firefighter-lift lobby lacks water protection or drainage, firefighting water entering the shaft can short the electrical equipment and stop the lift when it is most needed; when handover documents omit emergency-mode instructions, building staff may mis-operate lifts during an incident and send them toward the fire floor. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這要求井道加壓、電源與控制備援、機電設備防水，並在交接時把各種緊急模式的操作權責寫清楚。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This requires pressurised shafts, redundant power and controls and water-protected equipment, and at handover the responsibilities for operating each emergency mode must be written down clearly.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「火災時建築內所有電梯一律不能使用，連消防人員也不例外。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "In a fire no lift in the building may be used, not even by firefighters." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 消防電梯前室若防水或排水不足，消防射水流入井道會使電氣設備短路，電梯在最需要時停擺；交接文件缺少緊急模式說明時，管理人員可能在事件中誤操作，把電梯送往起火樓層。
knowledge.textEn: If the firefighter-lift lobby lacks water protection or drainage, firefighting water entering the shaft can short the electrical equipment and stop the lift when it is most needed; when handover documents omit emergency-mode instructions, building staff may mis-operate lifts during an incident and send them toward the fire floor.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「緊急運轉、避難電梯與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Emergency operation, evacuation lifts and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
消防電梯前室若防水或排水不足，消防射水流入井道會使電氣設備短路，電梯在最需要時停擺；交接文件缺少緊急模式說明時，管理人員可能在事件中誤操作，把電梯送往起火樓層。
電梯數量只要依全天平均搭乘人次決定就足夠。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If the firefighter-lift lobby lacks water protection or drainage, firefighting water entering the shaft can short the electrical equipment and stop the lift when it is most needed.
The number of elevators can be set from the average number of rides over the whole day.
quiz.explanation: 消防電梯前室若防水或排水不足，消防射水流入井道會使電氣設備短路，電梯在最需要時停擺；交接文件缺少緊急模式說明時，管理人員可能在事件中誤操作，把電梯送往起火樓層。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the firefighter-lift lobby lacks water protection or drainage, firefighting water entering the shaft can short the electrical equipment and stop the lift when it is most needed; when handover documents omit emergency-mode instructions, building staff may mis-operate lifts during an incident and send them toward the fire floor. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 工程數位模型碰撞檢查
summary: 從樓層高度預算與管線空間出發，說明聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器如何讓各專業模型可比對，再處理硬碰撞與軟碰撞規則、模型發展程度、BCF 議題追蹤與區域簽認、4D 時空碰撞、誤報分組與模型品質、現場放樣公差，以及版本控制與資產資訊交接，並以 Crossrail 與巴黎路易威登基金會的公開資料對照。
summaryEn: Starting from storey-height budgets and service space, explain how federated models, shared coordinates and information containers make discipline models comparable, then cover hard and clearance clash rules, level of development, BCF issue tracking and area sign-off, 4D space–time clashes, grouping of false positives and model quality, site set-out tolerances, version control and asset-information handover, compared with public material from Crossrail and the Fondation Louis Vuitton in Paris.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 帷幕牆、垂直運輸與數位營建
subcategoryTitleEn: Facades, vertical transport and digital construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一棟 20 層建築第一次聯合碰撞檢查得到 18,000 筆原始結果，分組後成為 900 組，其中 30% 即 270 組為真實議題。若這些議題留到現場，每件需 3 人工班 2 天（3×8×2 = 48 工時），以每工時 60 美元計為 2,880 美元，再加材料 1,200 美元，每件 4,080 美元，總計 270×4,080 = 1,101,600 美元。施工前協調由 2 名協調員做 26 週、每週 40 小時、每小時 75 美元，即 2×26×40×75 = 156,000 美元，加軟硬體 30,000 美元共 186,000 美元，效益比約 1,101,600/186,000 ≈ 5.9。若其中一半議題本來就會在製造圖階段被發現，效益減半為 550,800 美元，比值約 3.0，仍值得投入。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: the first federated clash run on a 20-storey building returns 18,000 raw results, grouped into 900 groups, of which 30%, or 270, are real issues. Left to site, each would need a three-person crew for two days (3×8×2 = 48 labour-hours) at US$60 per hour, US$2,880, plus US$1,200 of material, US$4,080 each and 270×4,080 = US$1,101,600 in total. Pre-construction coordination by two coordinators for 26 weeks at 40 hours a week and US$75 per hour costs 2×26×40×75 = US$156,000, plus US$30,000 for software and hardware, US$186,000 in all, a benefit ratio of about 1,101,600/186,000 ≈ 5.9. If half the issues would have been caught at shop-drawing stage anyway, the benefit halves to US$550,800 and the ratio is about 3.0, still worth the effort. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突」與「聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts" and "Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「天花板內管線空間」如何影響工程數位模型碰撞檢查的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ceiling service void” governs force, deformation or durability in “BIM-based construction clash detection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 碰撞多半不是軟體問題，而是空間預算問題：樓層高度一旦定案，結構梁深、天花板高度、架高地板與各類管線就要在固定的垂直空間中分配。風管斷面大且需要保溫，排水管必須依坡度下降，消防灑水支管與電纜架又各有間距要求，它們往往同時想佔用梁下方那一層最方便的空間。碰撞檢查真正的作用，是在施工前把這些搶空間的情況找出來，讓設計團隊重新分配管線層次、在梁腹開孔或調整風管斷面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「天花板內管線空間」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Most clashes are not a software problem but a space-budget problem: once the storey height is fixed, beam depth, ceiling height, raised floor and every service must share a fixed vertical allowance. Ducts are large and need insulation, drainage pipes must fall at a gradient, and sprinkler branches and cable trays each have spacing rules, so they all compete for the same convenient layer just below the beams. The real purpose of clash detection is to expose these space conflicts before construction so the design team can re-layer the services, open beam webs or change duct sections. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ceiling service void” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：樓高 4.20 m − 淨高 2.80 m − 天花板 0.05 m − 架高地板 0.15 m − 樓板 0.20 m = 樓板底至天花板 1.00 m；樓板下梁深 0.60 m，梁下只剩 0.40 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Storey 4.20 m − clear height 2.80 m − ceiling 0.05 m − raised floor 0.15 m − slab 0.20 m = 1.00 m from slab soffit to ceiling; with beams 0.60 m deep below the slab only 0.40 m remains under the beams.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「碰撞檢查的主要目的是找建模錯誤，與樓高設計無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「天花板內管線空間」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Ceiling service void”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突
knowledge.text: 碰撞多半不是軟體問題，而是空間預算問題：樓層高度一旦定案，結構梁深、天花板高度、架高地板與各類管線就要在固定的垂直空間中分配。風管斷面大且需要保溫，排水管必須依坡度下降，消防灑水支管與電纜架又各有間距要求，它們往往同時想佔用梁下方那一層最方便的空間。
knowledge.textEn: Most clashes are not a software problem but a space-budget problem: once the storey height is fixed, beam depth, ceiling height, raised floor and every service must share a fixed vertical allowance. Ducts are large and need insulation, drainage pipes must fall at a gradient, and sprinkler branches and cable trays each have spacing rules, so they all compete for the same convenient layer just below the beams.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：碰撞檢查的主要目的是找建模錯誤，與樓高設計無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts" is correct?
options: 碰撞檢查的主要目的是找建模錯誤，與樓高設計無關。
碰撞多半不是軟體問題，而是空間預算問題：樓層高度一旦定案，結構梁深、天花板高度、架高地板與各類管線就要在固定的垂直空間中分配。
只要把所有檔案匯入同一個軟體，模型就會自動對齊。
optionsEn: Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design.
Most clashes are not a software problem but a space-budget problem: once the storey height is fixed, beam depth, ceiling height, raised floor and every service must share a fixed vertical allowance.
Importing every file into the same software aligns the models automatically.
quiz.explanation: 碰撞多半不是軟體問題，而是空間預算問題：樓層高度一旦定案，結構梁深、天花板高度、架高地板與各類管線就要在固定的垂直空間中分配。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Most clashes are not a software problem but a space-budget problem: once the storey height is fixed, beam depth, ceiling height, raised floor and every service must share a fixed vertical allowance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「天花板內管線空間」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ceiling service void” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：樓高 4.20 m − 淨高 2.80 m − 天花板 0.05 m − 架高地板 0.15 m − 樓板 0.20 m = 樓板底至天花板 1.00 m；樓板下梁深 0.60 m，梁下只剩 0.40 m。0.45 m 高風管加保溫 2×0.025 m 與吊架 0.05 m 需 0.55 m，不足 0.15 m。若維持斷面積 0.45×1.00 = 0.45 m² 而把風管高度壓到 0.30 m，寬度需 0.45/0.30 = 1.5 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Storey 4.20 m − clear height 2.80 m − ceiling 0.05 m − raised floor 0.15 m − slab 0.20 m = 1.00 m from slab soffit to ceiling; with beams 0.60 m deep below the slab only 0.40 m remains under the beams. A 0.45 m duct plus 2×0.025 m insulation and a 0.05 m hanger needs 0.55 m, 0.15 m short. Keeping the area 0.45×1.00 = 0.45 m² but limiting the duct to 0.30 m high needs a width of 0.45/0.30 = 1.5 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在聯合模型中以剖面與平面標示每一樓層的管線分層區帶（例如梁下第一層給風管、第二層給水管），以碰撞檢查確認各專業物件都落在自己的區帶內；梁腹開孔要由結構工程師核算，並在模型中建立開孔物件，而不是讓管線直接穿梁。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the federated model, mark service layer zones on sections and plans for every floor (for example the first layer below the beams for ducts, the next for pipes) and use clash runs to confirm that each discipline's objects stay inside their zone; beam web openings must be checked by the structural engineer and modelled as opening objects rather than letting services pass through beams.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 樓高 4.20 m − 淨高 2.80 m − 天花板 0.05 m − 架高地板 0.15 m − 樓板 0.20 m = 樓板底至天花板 1.00 m；樓板下梁深 0.60 m，梁下只剩 0.40 m。0.45 m 高風管加保溫 2×0.025 m 與吊架 0.05 m 需 0.55 m，不足 0.15 m。若維持斷面積 0.45×1.00 = 0.45 m² 而把風管高度壓到 0.30 m，寬度需 0.45/0.30 = 1.5 m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Storey 4.20 m − clear height 2.80 m − ceiling 0.05 m − raised floor 0.15 m − slab 0.20 m = 1.00 m from slab soffit to ceiling; with beams 0.60 m deep below the slab only 0.40 m remains under the beams. A 0.45 m duct plus 2×0.025 m insulation and a 0.05 m hanger needs 0.55 m, 0.15 m short. Keeping the area 0.45×1.00 = 0.45 m² but limiting the duct to 0.30 m high needs a width of 0.45/0.30 = 1.5 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts", which statement holds?
options: 所有元素都要做到最高的模型發展程度，碰撞檢查才有意義。
只要三維模型沒有碰撞，施工順序就不會發生衝突。
樓高 4.20 m − 淨高 2.80 m − 天花板 0.05 m − 架高地板 0.15 m − 樓板 0.20 m = 樓板底至天花板 1.00 m。
optionsEn: Every element must reach the highest level of development for clash detection to be meaningful.
If the 3D model has no clashes, the construction sequence cannot conflict.
Storey 4.20 m − clear height 2.80 m − ceiling 0.05 m − raised floor 0.15 m − slab 0.20 m = 1.00 m from slab soffit to ceiling.
quiz.explanation: 樓高 4.20 m − 淨高 2.80 m − 天花板 0.05 m − 架高地板 0.15 m − 樓板 0.20 m = 樓板底至天花板 1.00 m；樓板下梁深 0.60 m，梁下只剩 0.40 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Storey 4.20 m − clear height 2.80 m − ceiling 0.05 m − raised floor 0.15 m − slab 0.20 m = 1.00 m from slab soffit to ceiling; with beams 0.60 m deep below the slab only 0.40 m remains under the beams. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「天花板內管線空間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ceiling service void” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在聯合模型中以剖面與平面標示每一樓層的管線分層區帶（例如梁下第一層給風管、第二層給水管），以碰撞檢查確認各專業物件都落在自己的區帶內；梁腹開孔要由結構工程師核算，並在模型中建立開孔物件，而不是讓管線直接穿梁。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the federated model, mark service layer zones on sections and plans for every floor (for example the first layer below the beams for ducts, the next for pipes) and use clash runs to confirm that each discipline's objects stay inside their zone; beam web openings must be checked by the structural engineer and modelled as opening objects rather than letting services pass through beams. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在概念設計階段就由建築、結構與機電共同訂定典型樓層的垂直空間預算圖，列為設計凍結項目；之後任何梁深或淨高變更都必須重新簽認空間預算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At concept stage have architecture, structure and building services jointly agree a vertical space budget for typical floors and treat it as a design-freeze item; any later change to beam depth or clear height must re-sign the space budget.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：樓高在初期為了增加樓層數被壓縮，管線空間卻沒有同步檢討，到施工圖階段才發現主風管無法通過梁下，只好降低天花板或在已澆置的梁上鑽孔；前者違反租約淨高，後者可能切斷鋼筋而需要結構補強。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「天花板內管線空間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ceiling service void” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樓高在初期為了增加樓層數被壓縮，管線空間卻沒有同步檢討，到施工圖階段才發現主風管無法通過梁下，只好降低天花板或在已澆置的梁上鑽孔；前者違反租約淨高，後者可能切斷鋼筋而需要結構補強。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Storey height squeezed early to gain floors, without a matching review of service space, reveals at shop-drawing stage that main ducts cannot pass under the beams, forcing either a lower ceiling that breaches lease clear heights or coring through cast beams that may cut reinforcement and require strengthening. steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

steps.title: 聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「共用座標原點」如何影響工程數位模型碰撞檢查的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shared coordinate origin” governs force, deformation or durability in “BIM-based construction clash detection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 各專業通常在不同軟體、不同檔案中建模，碰撞檢查前要把它們組成聯合模型；聯合時各模型互不改動，只是疊在一起比對，Crossrail 的 BIM 經驗也強調個別模型不互相影響，必須由模型管理者確認它們彼此吻合。要能正確疊合，所有模型必須使用同一個專案原點、同一個方位角與同一個高程基準，並依 ISO 19650 的資訊容器規則命名與分割，讓每個檔案的責任人、狀態與版本都清楚。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「共用座標原點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each discipline usually models in its own software and files, so before clash runs they are assembled into a federated model; the models are overlaid and compared without altering one another, and Crossrail's BIM lessons likewise stress that individual models do not interact and that the model steward must confirm they fit together. To overlay correctly, every model must use the same project origin, the same rotation to grid north and the same height datum, and be named and split as information containers under ISO 19650 so that each file's owner, status and revision are clear. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shared coordinate origin” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：旋轉誤差造成的位移 d = L·sin θ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Offset from a rotation error d = L·sin θ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把所有檔案匯入同一個軟體，模型就會自動對齊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Importing every file into the same software aligns the models automatically." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共用座標原點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shared coordinate origin” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：旋轉誤差造成的位移 d = L·sin θ。建築長 120 m、兩模型方位差 0.5°：d = 120×sin 0.5° = 120×0.00873 ≈ 1.05 m；即使只差 0.05°，遠端仍偏約 0.10 m，足以產生大量假碰撞。單位若誤設為公尺與公釐之差，尺度相差 1,000 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Offset from a rotation error d = L·sin θ. For a 120 m building with a 0.5° rotation mismatch, d = 120×sin 0.5° = 120×0.00873 ≈ 1.05 m; even 0.05° leaves about 0.10 m at the far end, enough to create many false clashes. A unit mix-up between metres and millimetres scales the model by 1,000. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在每個模型中放置相同的座標檢核物件（例如三個角落的格線交點與測量控制點），聯合後量測它們的偏差，要求小於約 1 mm；並檢查單位、樓層高程表與檔名規則，未通過者退回原作者，不得進入碰撞檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place identical coordinate check objects in every model (for example grid intersections at three corners and survey control points), measure their deviation after federation and require it to be below about 1 mm; also check units, level tables and naming rules, and return any failing model to its author before it enters clash runs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「共用座標原點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shared coordinate origin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在每個模型中放置相同的座標檢核物件（例如三個角落的格線交點與測量控制點），聯合後量測它們的偏差，要求小於約 1 mm；並檢查單位、樓層高程表與檔名規則，未通過者退回原作者，不得進入碰撞檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place identical coordinate check objects in every model (for example grid intersections at three corners and survey control points), measure their deviation after federation and require it to be below about 1 mm; also check units, level tables and naming rules, and return any failing model to its author before it enters clash runs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：BIM 執行計畫應明列專案座標系統、原點、方位角、高程基準、單位與檔案分割原則，由資訊管理者在每次聯合前執行座標檢核；未通過檢核的模型不得改為「共享」狀態。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The BIM execution plan should state the project coordinate system, origin, rotation, height datum, units and file-splitting rules, and the information manager should run the coordinate check before every federation; a model that fails cannot be moved to Shared status.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：機電模型以本地原點建立而未對齊結構模型時，第一次碰撞報告可能出現數萬筆假碰撞，團隊為了消化報告而放寬容許值或關閉部分測試，真正的碰撞反而被淹沒。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An MEP model built on a local origin and not aligned to the structural model can produce tens of thousands of false clashes in the first report, and teams trying to digest it widen tolerances or switch off tests, burying the real clashes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在每個模型中放置相同的座標檢核物件（例如三個角落的格線交點與測量控制點），聯合後量測它們的偏差，要求小於約 1 mm；並檢查單位、樓層高程表與檔名規則，未通過者退回原作者，不得進入碰撞檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Place identical coordinate check objects in every model (for example grid intersections at three corners and survey control points), measure their deviation after federation and require it to be below about 1 mm; also check units, level tables and naming rules, and return any failing model to its author before it enters clash runs.

quiz.question: 要驗證「聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

在每個模型中放置相同的座標檢核物件（例如三個角落的格線交點與測量控制點），聯合後量測它們的偏差，要求小於約 1 mm。

A common data environment is just a cloud folder for storing files.

steps.title: 聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「共用座標原點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shared coordinate origin” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 機電模型以本地原點建立而未對齊結構模型時，第一次碰撞報告可能出現數萬筆假碰撞，團隊為了消化報告而放寬容許值或關閉部分測試，真正的碰撞反而被淹沒。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An MEP model built on a local origin and not aligned to the structural model can produce tens of thousands of false clashes in the first report, and teams trying to digest it widen tolerances or switch off tests, burying the real clashes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：要能正確疊合，所有模型必須使用同一個專案原點、同一個方位角與同一個高程基準，並依 ISO 19650 的資訊容器規則命名與分割，讓每個檔案的責任人、狀態與版本都清楚。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: To overlay correctly, every model must use the same project origin, the same rotation to grid north and the same height datum, and be named and split as information containers under ISO 19650 so that each file's owner, status and revision are clear.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把所有檔案匯入同一個軟體，模型就會自動對齊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Importing every file into the same software aligns the models automatically." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
碰撞報告為零，就代表現場一定可以順利安裝。
機電模型以本地原點建立而未對齊結構模型時，第一次碰撞報告可能出現數萬筆假碰撞，團隊為了消化報告而放寬容許值或關閉部分測試，真正的碰撞反而被淹沒。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A clash report of zero guarantees smooth installation on site.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「硬碰撞、軟碰撞與容許值設定」與「模型發展程度與細部碰撞」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hard clashes, clearance clashes and tolerance settings" and "Level of development and detail clashes": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 硬碰撞、軟碰撞與容許值設定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Hard clashes, clearance clashes and tolerance settings: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「碰撞規則與容許值」如何影響工程數位模型碰撞檢查的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Clash rules and tolerances” governs force, deformation or durability in “BIM-based construction clash detection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 硬碰撞是兩個實體幾何直接重疊，例如風管穿過梁；軟碰撞（淨距碰撞）則是物件之間的距離小於規定淨距，例如保溫層、維修空間、灑水頭下方淨空或電纜與熱水管的間隔。碰撞軟體只比對幾何與規則，所以容許值設定決定報告的意義：容許值太小會把接觸與建模誤差都報出來，太大則漏掉真正問題；保溫層、防火被覆是否建模，也會讓同一配置出現或不出現碰撞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「碰撞規則與容許值」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hard clash is a direct overlap of two solids, such as a duct passing through a beam; a soft or clearance clash is a distance below a required clearance, such as insulation, maintenance access, sprinkler deflector clearance or separation between cables and hot-water pipes. Clash software only compares geometry against rules, so tolerance settings decide what a report means: too small a tolerance reports touching objects and modelling noise, too large misses real problems, and whether insulation or fireproofing is modelled decides whether the same layout clashes at all. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Clash rules and tolerances” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩支外徑 150 mm 的管線中心距 160 mm：裸管間隙 160 − 150 = 10 mm，無硬碰撞。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Two 150 mm OD pipes at 160 mm centres: bare gap 160 − 150 = 10 mm, no hard clash.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「碰撞報告為零，就代表現場一定可以順利安裝。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A clash report of zero guarantees smooth installation on site." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「碰撞規則與容許值」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Clash rules and tolerances”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 硬碰撞、軟碰撞與容許值設定
knowledge.titleEn: Hard clashes, clearance clashes and tolerance settings
knowledge.text: 硬碰撞是兩個實體幾何直接重疊，例如風管穿過梁；軟碰撞（淨距碰撞）則是物件之間的距離小於規定淨距，例如保溫層、維修空間、灑水頭下方淨空或電纜與熱水管的間隔。碰撞軟體只比對幾何與規則，所以容許值設定決定報告的意義：容許值太小會把接觸與建模誤差都報出來，太大則漏掉真正問題；保溫層、防火被覆是否建模，也會讓同一配置出現或不出現碰撞。
knowledge.textEn: A hard clash is a direct overlap of two solids, such as a duct passing through a beam; a soft or clearance clash is a distance below a required clearance, such as insulation, maintenance access, sprinkler deflector clearance or separation between cables and hot-water pipes. Clash software only compares geometry against rules, so tolerance settings decide what a report means: too small a tolerance reports touching objects and modelling noise, too large misses real problems, and whether insulation or fireproofing is modelled decides whether the same layout clashes at all.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：碰撞報告為零，就代表現場一定可以順利安裝。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A clash report of zero guarantees smooth installation on site. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「硬碰撞、軟碰撞與容許值設定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hard clashes, clearance clashes and tolerance settings" is correct?
options: 硬碰撞是兩個實體幾何直接重疊，例如風管穿過梁；軟碰撞（淨距碰撞）則是物件之間的距離小於規定淨距，例如保溫層、維修空間、灑水頭下方淨空或電纜與熱水管的間隔。
碰撞報告為零，就代表現場一定可以順利安裝。
所有元素都要做到最高的模型發展程度，碰撞檢查才有意義。
optionsEn: A hard clash is a direct overlap of two solids, such as a duct passing through a beam.
A clash report of zero guarantees smooth installation on site.
Every element must reach the highest level of development for clash detection to be meaningful.
quiz.explanation: 硬碰撞是兩個實體幾何直接重疊，例如風管穿過梁；軟碰撞（淨距碰撞）則是物件之間的距離小於規定淨距，例如保溫層、維修空間、灑水頭下方淨空或電纜與熱水管的間隔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A hard clash is a direct overlap of two solids, such as a duct passing through a beam; a soft or clearance clash is a distance below a required clearance, such as insulation, maintenance access, sprinkler deflector clearance or separation between cables and hot-water pipes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 硬碰撞、軟碰撞與容許值設定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hard clashes, clearance clashes and tolerance settings: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「碰撞規則與容許值」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Clash rules and tolerances” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩支外徑 150 mm 的管線中心距 160 mm：裸管間隙 160 − 150 = 10 mm，無硬碰撞。各加 25 mm 保溫後外徑 200 mm，重疊 200 − 160 = 40 mm。若規定保溫面之間淨距 50 mm，所需中心距 200 + 50 = 250 mm，須再移開 90 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Two 150 mm OD pipes at 160 mm centres: bare gap 160 − 150 = 10 mm, no hard clash. With 25 mm insulation each the outer diameter is 200 mm and the overlap is 200 − 160 = 40 mm. A 50 mm clearance rule between insulation faces needs 200 + 50 = 250 mm centres, another 90 mm apart. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：為每一組專業配對建立碰撞矩陣，寫明硬碰撞容許值、軟碰撞淨距與排除條件（例如同系統的接頭、穿越套管），先以刻意放入的已知碰撞樣本測試規則是否抓得到；規則每次修改都要記錄版本，以免前後報告數量無法比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build a clash matrix for every discipline pair stating hard-clash tolerance, clearance distances and exclusions (for example joints within one system or penetrations through sleeves), test the rules first on seeded known clashes to confirm they are caught, and version every rule change so that report counts remain comparable over time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩支外徑 150 mm 的管線中心距 160 mm：裸管間隙 160 − 150 = 10 mm，無硬碰撞。各加 25 mm 保溫後外徑 200 mm，重疊 200 − 160 = 40 mm。若規定保溫面之間淨距 50 mm，所需中心距 200 + 50 = 250 mm，須再移開 90 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Two 150 mm OD pipes at 160 mm centres: bare gap 160 − 150 = 10 mm, no hard clash. With 25 mm insulation each the outer diameter is 200 mm and the overlap is 200 − 160 = 40 mm. A 50 mm clearance rule between insulation faces needs 200 + 50 = 250 mm centres, another 90 mm apart. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「硬碰撞、軟碰撞與容許值設定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hard clashes, clearance clashes and tolerance settings", which statement holds?
options: 只要三維模型沒有碰撞，施工順序就不會發生衝突。
兩支外徑 150 mm 的管線中心距 160 mm：裸管間隙 160 − 150 = 10 mm，無硬碰撞。
模型協調完成後，現場只要照圖施工就不會有空間衝突。
optionsEn: If the 3D model has no clashes, the construction sequence cannot conflict.
Two 150 mm OD pipes at 160 mm centres: bare gap 160 − 150 = 10 mm, no hard clash.
Once the model is coordinated, building to the drawings cannot produce space conflicts.
quiz.explanation: 兩支外徑 150 mm 的管線中心距 160 mm：裸管間隙 160 − 150 = 10 mm，無硬碰撞。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Two 150 mm OD pipes at 160 mm centres: bare gap 160 − 150 = 10 mm, no hard clash. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 硬碰撞、軟碰撞與容許值設定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hard clashes, clearance clashes and tolerance settings: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「碰撞規則與容許值」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Clash rules and tolerances” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 為每一組專業配對建立碰撞矩陣，寫明硬碰撞容許值、軟碰撞淨距與排除條件（例如同系統的接頭、穿越套管），先以刻意放入的已知碰撞樣本測試規則是否抓得到；規則每次修改都要記錄版本，以免前後報告數量無法比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a clash matrix for every discipline pair stating hard-clash tolerance, clearance distances and exclusions (for example joints within one system or penetrations through sleeves), test the rules first on seeded known clashes to confirm they are caught, and version every rule change so that report counts remain comparable over time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 硬碰撞、軟碰撞與容許值設定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hard clashes, clearance clashes and tolerance settings: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「碰撞規則與容許值」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Clash rules and tolerances” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 規則若未包含保溫層或維修淨空，報告顯示零碰撞，現場卻發現保溫後的管線互相擠壓、閥門無法操作，只能拆除重排；反之把同系統接頭也列為碰撞，報告數量膨脹到無法審查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rules that omit insulation or maintenance clearance show zero clashes, yet on site insulated pipes are squeezed together and valves cannot be operated, forcing removal and re-routing; conversely, counting joints within one system as clashes inflates reports beyond any chance of review. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：碰撞軟體只比對幾何與規則，所以容許值設定決定報告的意義：容許值太小會把接觸與建模誤差都報出來，太大則漏掉真正問題；保溫層、防火被覆是否建模，也會讓同一配置出現或不出現碰撞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Clash software only compares geometry against rules, so tolerance settings decide what a report means: too small a tolerance reports touching objects and modelling noise, too large misses real problems, and whether insulation or fireproofing is modelled decides whether the same layout clashes at all.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「碰撞報告為零，就代表現場一定可以順利安裝。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A clash report of zero guarantees smooth installation on site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
