steps.title: 模型發展程度與細部碰撞：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Level of development and detail clashes: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼筋與預埋件密度」如何影響工程數位模型碰撞檢查的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rebar and embed congestion” governs force, deformation or durability in “BIM-based construction clash detection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 模型能找出什麼碰撞，取決於模型發展程度（LOD）或資訊需求程度：LOD 300 的梁柱只有外形，看不到鋼筋、預埋件與鋼構接頭板，因此梁柱接頭的鋼筋擁擠、錨栓與套管衝突要到 LOD 350 或 400 的製造模型才會出現。BIMForum 的 LOD 規範依元素分類說明每個等級應包含的內容，專案應依協調目的指定每個階段需要的程度，而不是一律要求最高等級。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼筋與預埋件密度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: What clashes a model can reveal depends on its level of development or level of information need: LOD 300 beams and columns show only outer shape, without reinforcement, embeds or steel connection plates, so rebar congestion at beam–column joints and conflicts between anchors and sleeves only appear in LOD 350 or 400 fabrication models. The BIMForum LOD Specification describes what each level contains element by element, and a project should specify the level needed at each stage for its coordination purpose rather than demanding the highest level everywhere. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rebar and embed congestion” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：梁寬 600 mm、保護層 40 mm、箍筋 13 mm、一層 8 支 32 mm 主筋：淨間距 = (600 − 2×40 − 2×13 − 8×32)/7 = 238/7 = 34.0 mm，大於 ACI 318 的下限 max(32 mm, 25 mm, 4/3×20 mm) = 32 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Beam width 600 mm, cover 40 mm, 13 mm stirrups and one layer of eight 32 mm bars: clear spacing = (600 − 2×40 − 2×13 − 8×32)/7 = 238/7 = 34.0 mm, above the ACI 318 minimum of max(32 mm, 25 mm, 4/3×20 mm) = 32 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有元素都要做到最高的模型發展程度，碰撞檢查才有意義。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every element must reach the highest level of development for clash detection to be meaningful." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼筋與預埋件密度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rebar and embed congestion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 模型發展程度與細部碰撞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Level of development and detail clashes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼筋與預埋件密度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rebar and embed congestion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：梁寬 600 mm、保護層 40 mm、箍筋 13 mm、一層 8 支 32 mm 主筋：淨間距 = (600 − 2×40 − 2×13 − 8×32)/7 = 238/7 = 34.0 mm，大於 ACI 318 的下限 max(32 mm, 25 mm, 4/3×20 mm) = 32 mm。若再加 1 支成 9 支：(494 − 288)/8 ≈ 25.8 mm，不合格。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Beam width 600 mm, cover 40 mm, 13 mm stirrups and one layer of eight 32 mm bars: clear spacing = (600 − 2×40 − 2×13 − 8×32)/7 = 238/7 = 34.0 mm, above the ACI 318 minimum of max(32 mm, 25 mm, 4/3×20 mm) = 32 mm. Adding a ninth bar gives (494 − 288)/8 ≈ 25.8 mm, which fails. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在梁柱接頭、轉換梁與機電套管密集區建立鋼筋與預埋件模型，以碰撞檢查找出鋼筋與套管、錨栓、預力管的衝突，再以淨間距規則檢查擁擠度；結果交由結構設計者確認，必要時以 1:1 樣品或局部模型試排。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Model reinforcement and embeds at beam–column joints, transfer beams and dense sleeve zones, run clash checks between bars and sleeves, anchors and post-tensioning ducts, then check congestion with clear-spacing rules; have the structural designer confirm the results and trial-place difficult joints with a full-size mock-up or local model when needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Adding a ninth bar gives (494 − 288)/8 ≈ 25.8 mm, which fails. Values are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 模型發展程度與細部碰撞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Level of development and detail clashes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼筋與預埋件密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rebar and embed congestion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在梁柱接頭、轉換梁與機電套管密集區建立鋼筋與預埋件模型，以碰撞檢查找出鋼筋與套管、錨栓、預力管的衝突，再以淨間距規則檢查擁擠度；結果交由結構設計者確認，必要時以 1:1 樣品或局部模型試排。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Model reinforcement and embeds at beam–column joints, transfer beams and dense sleeve zones, run clash checks between bars and sleeves, anchors and post-tensioning ducts, then check congestion with clear-spacing rules; have the structural designer confirm the results and trial-place difficult joints with a full-size mock-up or local model when needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在資訊需求文件中依區域指定 LOD：一般樓板與牆面維持 LOD 300，鋼筋擁擠接頭、機電密集走廊與機房要求 LOD 350 至 400，並把這些高細度區域列為協調會議的固定議程。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: In the information requirements, assign LOD by area: keep typical slabs and walls at LOD 300, require LOD 350 to 400 for congested joints, dense service corridors and plant rooms, and make these high-detail areas a standing item on the coordination agenda.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用外形模型做協調，報告看似乾淨，施工時卻發現接頭鋼筋與鋼骨柱的螺栓、灌漿管互相阻擋，混凝土無法填實而形成蜂窩；事後補強或改設計往往拖累整個樓層的工期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Coordinating with shape-only models gives a clean-looking report, yet during construction joint bars block steel-column bolts and grout tubes so concrete cannot consolidate and honeycombs form; the subsequent repair or redesign often delays the whole floor cycle. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在梁柱接頭、轉換梁與機電套管密集區建立鋼筋與預埋件模型，以碰撞檢查找出鋼筋與套管、錨栓、預力管的衝突，再以淨間距規則檢查擁擠度；結果交由結構設計者確認，必要時以 1:1 樣品或局部模型試排。
knowledge.textEn: Model reinforcement and embeds at beam–column joints, transfer beams and dense sleeve zones, run clash checks between bars and sleeves, anchors and post-tensioning ducts, then check congestion with clear-spacing rules; have the structural designer confirm the results and trial-place difficult joints with a full-size mock-up or local model when needed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在資訊需求文件中依區域指定 LOD：一般樓板與牆面維持 LOD 300，鋼筋擁擠接頭、機電密集走廊與機房要求 LOD 350 至 400，並把這些高細度區域列為協調會議的固定議程。
knowledge.textEn: In the information requirements, assign LOD by area: keep typical slabs and walls at LOD 300, require LOD 350 to 400 for congested joints, dense service corridors and plant rooms, and make these high-detail areas a standing item on the coordination agenda.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模型發展程度與細部碰撞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Level of development and detail clashes"?
options: 在梁柱接頭、轉換梁與機電套管密集區建立鋼筋與預埋件模型，以碰撞檢查找出鋼筋與套管、錨栓、預力管的衝突，再以淨間距規則檢查擁擠度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
碰撞檢查的主要目的是找建模錯誤，與樓高設計無關。
optionsEn: Model reinforcement and embeds at beam–column joints, transfer beams and dense sleeve zones, run clash checks between bars and sleeves, anchors and post-tensioning ducts, then check congestion with clear-spacing rules.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design.
quiz.explanation: 在梁柱接頭、轉換梁與機電套管密集區建立鋼筋與預埋件模型，以碰撞檢查找出鋼筋與套管、錨栓、預力管的衝突，再以淨間距規則檢查擁擠度；結果交由結構設計者確認，必要時以 1:1 樣品或局部模型試排。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Model reinforcement and embeds at beam–column joints, transfer beams and dense sleeve zones, run clash checks between bars and sleeves, anchors and post-tensioning ducts, then check congestion with clear-spacing rules; have the structural designer confirm the results and trial-place difficult joints with a full-size mock-up or local model when needed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模型發展程度與細部碰撞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Level of development and detail clashes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼筋與預埋件密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rebar and embed congestion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用外形模型做協調，報告看似乾淨，施工時卻發現接頭鋼筋與鋼骨柱的螺栓、灌漿管互相阻擋，混凝土無法填實而形成蜂窩；事後補強或改設計往往拖累整個樓層的工期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Coordinating with shape-only models gives a clean-looking report, yet during construction joint bars block steel-column bolts and grout tubes so concrete cannot consolidate and honeycombs form; the subsequent repair or redesign often delays the whole floor cycle. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：BIMForum 的 LOD 規範依元素分類說明每個等級應包含的內容，專案應依協調目的指定每個階段需要的程度，而不是一律要求最高等級。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The BIMForum LOD Specification describes what each level contains element by element, and a project should specify the level needed at each stage for its coordination purpose rather than demanding the highest level everywhere.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有元素都要做到最高的模型發展程度，碰撞檢查才有意義。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every element must reach the highest level of development for clash detection to be meaningful." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用外形模型做協調，報告看似乾淨，施工時卻發現接頭鋼筋與鋼骨柱的螺栓、灌漿管互相阻擋，混凝土無法填實而形成蜂窩；事後補強或改設計往往拖累整個樓層的工期。
knowledge.textEn: Coordinating with shape-only models gives a clean-looking report, yet during construction joint bars block steel-column bolts and grout tubes so concrete cannot consolidate and honeycombs form; the subsequent repair or redesign often delays the whole floor cycle.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模型發展程度與細部碰撞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Level of development and detail clashes" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只用外形模型做協調，報告看似乾淨，施工時卻發現接頭鋼筋與鋼骨柱的螺栓、灌漿管互相阻擋，混凝土無法填實而形成蜂窩；事後補強或改設計往往拖累整個樓層的工期。
碰撞報告產出後，軟體會自動決定哪個專業必須修改。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Coordinating with shape-only models gives a clean-looking report, yet during construction joint bars block steel-column bolts and grout tubes so concrete cannot consolidate and honeycombs form.
Once the clash report is produced, the software decides which discipline must change.
quiz.explanation: 只用外形模型做協調，報告看似乾淨，施工時卻發現接頭鋼筋與鋼骨柱的螺栓、灌漿管互相阻擋，混凝土無法填實而形成蜂窩；事後補強或改設計往往拖累整個樓層的工期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Coordinating with shape-only models gives a clean-looking report, yet during construction joint bars block steel-column bolts and grout tubes so concrete cannot consolidate and honeycombs form; the subsequent repair or redesign often delays the whole floor cycle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「協調週期、議題追蹤與區域簽認」與「時空碰撞與施工順序模擬」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Coordination cycles, issue tracking and area sign-off" and "Space–time clashes and sequence simulation": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 協調週期、議題追蹤與區域簽認：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Coordination cycles, issue tracking and area sign-off: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「BCF 議題清單」如何影響工程數位模型碰撞檢查的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “BCF issue list” governs force, deformation or durability in “BIM-based construction clash detection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 碰撞檢查不是一次性的動作，而是每週或每兩週重複的協調循環：各專業上傳最新模型到共用資料環境，資訊管理者聯合模型並執行碰撞測試，把結果分組成議題，以 BCF 格式記錄視點、相關元素 GUID 與責任人，在協調會議中決定誰改、怎麼改，下一輪再確認是否關閉。某區域的議題清空並經各專業簽認後，才放行製造圖與預製。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「BCF 議題清單」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Clash detection is not a one-off act but a coordination cycle repeated weekly or fortnightly: each discipline uploads its latest model to the common data environment, the information manager federates and runs the tests, groups results into issues and records them in BCF with viewpoints, element GUIDs and owners, the coordination meeting decides who changes what, and the next round confirms closure. Only when an area's issues are cleared and signed off by every discipline are its fabrication drawings and prefabrication released. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “BCF issue list” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：議題數 N_k = N* + (N₀ − N*)(1−r)^k，穩態 N* = 每週新增/解決率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Open issues N_k = N* + (N₀ − N*)(1−r)^k with steady state N* = new per week / resolution rate.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「碰撞報告產出後，軟體會自動決定哪個專業必須修改。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the clash report is produced, the software decides which discipline must change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「BCF 議題清單」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “BCF issue list”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 協調週期、議題追蹤與區域簽認
knowledge.titleEn: Coordination cycles, issue tracking and area sign-off
knowledge.text: 碰撞檢查不是一次性的動作，而是每週或每兩週重複的協調循環：各專業上傳最新模型到共用資料環境，資訊管理者聯合模型並執行碰撞測試，把結果分組成議題，以 BCF 格式記錄視點、相關元素 GUID 與責任人，在協調會議中決定誰改、怎麼改，下一輪再確認是否關閉。某區域的議題清空並經各專業簽認後，才放行製造圖與預製。
knowledge.textEn: Clash detection is not a one-off act but a coordination cycle repeated weekly or fortnightly: each discipline uploads its latest model to the common data environment, the information manager federates and runs the tests, groups results into issues and records them in BCF with viewpoints, element GUIDs and owners, the coordination meeting decides who changes what, and the next round confirms closure. Only when an area's issues are cleared and signed off by every discipline are its fabrication drawings and prefabrication released.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：碰撞報告產出後，軟體會自動決定哪個專業必須修改。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the clash report is produced, the software decides which discipline must change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「協調週期、議題追蹤與區域簽認」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Coordination cycles, issue tracking and area sign-off" is correct?
options: 碰撞報告產出後，軟體會自動決定哪個專業必須修改。
只要三維模型沒有碰撞，施工順序就不會發生衝突。
碰撞檢查不是一次性的動作，而是每週或每兩週重複的協調循環：各專業上傳最新模型到共用資料環境，資訊管理者聯合模型並執行碰撞測試，把結果分組成議題，以 BCF 格式記錄視點、相關元素 GUID 與責任人，在協調會議中決定誰改、怎麼改，下一輪再確認是否關閉。
optionsEn: Once the clash report is produced, the software decides which discipline must change.
If the 3D model has no clashes, the construction sequence cannot conflict.

Clash detection is not a one-off act but a coordination cycle repeated weekly or fortnightly: each discipline uploads its latest model to the common data environment, the information manager federates and runs the tests, groups results into issues and records them in BCF with viewpoints, element GUIDs and owners, the coordination meeting decides who changes what, and the next round confirms closure.
quiz.explanation: 碰撞檢查不是一次性的動作，而是每週或每兩週重複的協調循環：各專業上傳最新模型到共用資料環境，資訊管理者聯合模型並執行碰撞測試，把結果分組成議題，以 BCF 格式記錄視點、相關元素 GUID 與責任人，在協調會議中決定誰改、怎麼改，下一輪再確認是否關閉。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Clash detection is not a one-off act but a coordination cycle repeated weekly or fortnightly: each discipline uploads its latest model to the common data environment, the information manager federates and runs the tests, groups results into issues and records them in BCF with viewpoints, element GUIDs and owners, the coordination meeting decides who changes what, and the next round confirms closure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 協調週期、議題追蹤與區域簽認：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Coordination cycles, issue tracking and area sign-off: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「BCF 議題清單」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “BCF issue list” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：議題數 N_k = N* + (N₀ − N*)(1−r)^k，穩態 N* = 每週新增/解決率。取 N₀ = 600、每週解決 r = 35%、每週新增 40：N* = 40/0.35 ≈ 114。要降到 150 以下需 (600−114)×0.65^k ≤ 36，即 0.65^k ≤ 0.074，k ≥ ln 0.074/ln 0.65 ≈ 6.04，取 7 週。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Open issues N_k = N* + (N₀ − N*)(1−r)^k with steady state N* = new per week / resolution rate. With N₀ = 600, r = 35% per week and 40 new issues per week: N* = 40/0.35 ≈ 114. Falling below 150 needs (600−114)×0.65^k ≤ 36, so 0.65^k ≤ 0.074 and k ≥ ln 0.074/ln 0.65 ≈ 6.04, giving 7 weeks. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 BCF 或議題追蹤平台統計每週新增、關閉與逾期議題，畫出每個區域的燃盡曲線並與製造圖送審時程對照；區域簽認表需有各專業負責人簽名與模型版本號，監造抽查已簽認區域是否確實沒有未關閉議題。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count new, closed and overdue issues each week in BCF or the issue platform, plot a burn-down for every area against the fabrication-drawing schedule, and require each area sign-off sheet to carry the signatures of all discipline leads and the model revision numbers; the supervising engineer spot-checks that signed-off areas really have no open issues.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Open issues N_k = N* + (N₀ − N*)(1−r)^k with steady state N* = new per week / resolution rate. With N₀ = 600, r = 35% per week and 40 new issues per week: N* = 40/0.35 ≈ 114. Falling below 150 needs (600−114)×0.65^k ≤ 36, so 0.65^k ≤ 0.074 and k ≥ ln 0.074/ln 0.65 ≈ 6.04, giving 7 weeks. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「協調週期、議題追蹤與區域簽認」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Coordination cycles, issue tracking and area sign-off", which statement holds?
options: 議題數 N_k = N* + (N₀ − N*)(1−r)^k，穩態 N* = 每週新增/解決率。
模型協調完成後，現場只要照圖施工就不會有空間衝突。
施工期間協調用的模型就等於竣工模型。
optionsEn: Open issues N_k = N* + (N₀ − N*)(1−r)^k with steady state N* = new per week / resolution rate.
Once the model is coordinated, building to the drawings cannot produce space conflicts.
The model used for coordination during construction is the as-built model.
quiz.explanation: 議題數 N_k = N* + (N₀ − N*)(1−r)^k，穩態 N* = 每週新增/解決率。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Open issues N_k = N* + (N₀ − N*)(1−r)^k with steady state N* = new per week / resolution rate. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 協調週期、議題追蹤與區域簽認：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Coordination cycles, issue tracking and area sign-off: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「BCF 議題清單」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “BCF issue list” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以 BCF 或議題追蹤平台統計每週新增、關閉與逾期議題，畫出每個區域的燃盡曲線並與製造圖送審時程對照；區域簽認表需有各專業負責人簽名與模型版本號，監造抽查已簽認區域是否確實沒有未關閉議題。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count new, closed and overdue issues each week in BCF or the issue platform, plot a burn-down for every area against the fabrication-drawing schedule, and require each area sign-off sheet to carry the signatures of all discipline leads and the model revision numbers; the supervising engineer spot-checks that signed-off areas really have no open issues. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以區域簽認作為預製放行的保留點：未經建築、結構、機電與消防負責人簽認的區域，不得發出製造圖或材料訂單；每個議題都要有單一責任人與到期日。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make area sign-off the hold point for releasing prefabrication: no fabrication drawings or material orders may be issued for an area until the architecture, structure, MEP and fire leads have signed it off, and every issue has a single owner and a due date.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：協調會議只播放碰撞畫面而沒有指定責任人與期限，議題數長期停在高檔；製造廠在區域未簽認前就依舊模型預製風管與管架，到現場才發現已改線，整批材料報廢。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Meetings that only replay clash views without naming owners and deadlines leave issue counts high for months; a fabricator that prefabricates ducts and racks from an old model before area sign-off finds on site that routes have changed and scraps the whole batch. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以 BCF 或議題追蹤平台統計每週新增、關閉與逾期議題，畫出每個區域的燃盡曲線並與製造圖送審時程對照；區域簽認表需有各專業負責人簽名與模型版本號，監造抽查已簽認區域是否確實沒有未關閉議題。
knowledge.textEn: Count new, closed and overdue issues each week in BCF or the issue platform, plot a burn-down for every area against the fabrication-drawing schedule, and require each area sign-off sheet to carry the signatures of all discipline leads and the model revision numbers; the supervising engineer spot-checks that signed-off areas really have no open issues.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以區域簽認作為預製放行的保留點：未經建築、結構、機電與消防負責人簽認的區域，不得發出製造圖或材料訂單；每個議題都要有單一責任人與到期日。
knowledge.textEn: Make area sign-off the hold point for releasing prefabrication: no fabrication drawings or material orders may be issued for an area until the architecture, structure, MEP and fire leads have signed it off, and every issue has a single owner and a due date.

quiz.question: 要驗證「協調週期、議題追蹤與區域簽認」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Coordination cycles, issue tracking and area sign-off"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以 BCF 或議題追蹤平台統計每週新增、關閉與逾期議題，畫出每個區域的燃盡曲線並與製造圖送審時程對照。
只要把所有檔案匯入同一個軟體，模型就會自動對齊。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Count new, closed and overdue issues each week in BCF or the issue platform, plot a burn-down for every area against the fabrication-drawing schedule, and require each area sign-off sheet to carry the signatures of all discipline leads and the model revision numbers.
Importing every file into the same software aligns the models automatically.
quiz.explanation: 以 BCF 或議題追蹤平台統計每週新增、關閉與逾期議題，畫出每個區域的燃盡曲線並與製造圖送審時程對照；區域簽認表需有各專業負責人簽名與模型版本號，監造抽查已簽認區域是否確實沒有未關閉議題。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Count new, closed and overdue issues each week in BCF or the issue platform, plot a burn-down for every area against the fabrication-drawing schedule, and require each area sign-off sheet to carry the signatures of all discipline leads and the model revision numbers; the supervising engineer spot-checks that signed-off areas really have no open issues. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 協調週期、議題追蹤與區域簽認：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Coordination cycles, issue tracking and area sign-off: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「BCF 議題清單」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “BCF issue list” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 協調會議只播放碰撞畫面而沒有指定責任人與期限，議題數長期停在高檔；製造廠在區域未簽認前就依舊模型預製風管與管架，到現場才發現已改線，整批材料報廢。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Meetings that only replay clash views without naming owners and deadlines leave issue counts high for months; a fabricator that prefabricates ducts and racks from an old model before area sign-off finds on site that routes have changed and scraps the whole batch. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：某區域的議題清空並經各專業簽認後，才放行製造圖與預製。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Only when an area's issues are cleared and signed off by every discipline are its fabrication drawings and prefabrication released.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「碰撞報告產出後，軟體會自動決定哪個專業必須修改。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the clash report is produced, the software decides which discipline must change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 協調會議只播放碰撞畫面而沒有指定責任人與期限，議題數長期停在高檔；製造廠在區域未簽認前就依舊模型預製風管與管架，到現場才發現已改線，整批材料報廢。
knowledge.textEn: Meetings that only replay clash views without naming owners and deadlines leave issue counts high for months; a fabricator that prefabricates ducts and racks from an old model before area sign-off finds on site that routes have changed and scraps the whole batch.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「協調週期、議題追蹤與區域簽認」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Coordination cycles, issue tracking and area sign-off" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要三維模型沒有碰撞，施工順序就不會發生衝突。
協調會議只播放碰撞畫面而沒有指定責任人與期限，議題數長期停在高檔；製造廠在區域未簽認前就依舊模型預製風管與管架，到現場才發現已改線，整批材料報廢。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If the 3D model has no clashes, the construction sequence cannot conflict.
Meetings that only replay clash views without naming owners and deadlines leave issue counts high for months.
quiz.explanation: 協調會議只播放碰撞畫面而沒有指定責任人與期限，議題數長期停在高檔；製造廠在區域未簽認前就依舊模型預製風管與管架，到現場才發現已改線，整批材料報廢。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Meetings that only replay clash views without naming owners and deadlines leave issue counts high for months; a fabricator that prefabricates ducts and racks from an old model before area sign-off finds on site that routes have changed and scraps the whole batch. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 時空碰撞與施工順序模擬：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Space–time clashes and sequence simulation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「4D 施工順序」如何影響工程數位模型碰撞檢查的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “4D construction sequence” governs force, deformation or durability in “BIM-based construction clash detection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 空間沒有碰撞，不代表施工可行：兩組工班若在同一時間需要同一區域，或塔吊吊運路徑穿過正在組立的支撐架，都是時空碰撞。4D 模型把模型元素與排程活動連結，依時間播放施工順序，並可加入工作空間、吊裝範圍與臨時結構，檢查同一時段是否有空間重疊。Crossrail 在法靈頓站以約 12 萬英鎊做 3D 排程分析，促成約 800 萬英鎊風險預備金的釋出，顯示排程協調的價值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「4D 施工順序」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A model without spatial clashes is not necessarily buildable: two crews needing the same area at once, or a tower-crane lift path crossing temporary shoring under erection, are space–time clashes. A 4D model links model elements to schedule activities, plays the construction sequence over time and can include workspaces, lifting zones and temporary works to detect overlaps in the same period. At Farringdon station Crossrail spent about £120k on 3D schedule analysis, which enabled about £8 million of risk contingency to be released, showing the value of schedule coordination. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “4D construction sequence” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：第 3 區的風管安裝排在第 10 至 18 天，天花板骨架排在第 16 至 22 天，兩者在第 16、17、18 天重疊，共 3 天。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In zone 3, duct installation runs on days 10 to 18 and ceiling framing on days 16 to 22, overlapping on days 16, 17 and 18, three days in all.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要三維模型沒有碰撞，施工順序就不會發生衝突。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the 3D model has no clashes, the construction sequence cannot conflict." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「4D 施工順序」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “4D construction sequence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 時空碰撞與施工順序模擬
knowledge.text: 空間沒有碰撞，不代表施工可行：兩組工班若在同一時間需要同一區域，或塔吊吊運路徑穿過正在組立的支撐架，都是時空碰撞。4D 模型把模型元素與排程活動連結，依時間播放施工順序，並可加入工作空間、吊裝範圍與臨時結構，檢查同一時段是否有空間重疊。
knowledge.textEn: A model without spatial clashes is not necessarily buildable: two crews needing the same area at once, or a tower-crane lift path crossing temporary shoring under erection, are space–time clashes. A 4D model links model elements to schedule activities, plays the construction sequence over time and can include workspaces, lifting zones and temporary works to detect overlaps in the same period.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要三維模型沒有碰撞，施工順序就不會發生衝突。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the 3D model has no clashes, the construction sequence cannot conflict. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「時空碰撞與施工順序模擬」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Space–time clashes and sequence simulation" is correct?
options: 空間沒有碰撞，不代表施工可行：兩組工班若在同一時間需要同一區域，或塔吊吊運路徑穿過正在組立的支撐架，都是時空碰撞。
只要三維模型沒有碰撞，施工順序就不會發生衝突。
碰撞數量越少，代表協調品質越好。
optionsEn: A model without spatial clashes is not necessarily buildable: two crews needing the same area at once, or a tower-crane lift path crossing temporary shoring under erection, are space–time clashes.
If the 3D model has no clashes, the construction sequence cannot conflict.
The fewer the clashes in the report, the better the coordination.
quiz.explanation: 空間沒有碰撞，不代表施工可行：兩組工班若在同一時間需要同一區域，或塔吊吊運路徑穿過正在組立的支撐架，都是時空碰撞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A model without spatial clashes is not necessarily buildable: two crews needing the same area at once, or a tower-crane lift path crossing temporary shoring under erection, are space–time clashes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 時空碰撞與施工順序模擬：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Space–time clashes and sequence simulation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「4D 施工順序」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “4D construction sequence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：第 3 區的風管安裝排在第 10 至 18 天，天花板骨架排在第 16 至 22 天，兩者在第 16、17、18 天重疊，共 3 天。若天花板活動的總浮時只有 2 天，延後 3 天會使完工日延後 3 − 2 = 1 天；改把第 3 區分成 3a、3b 兩段交錯施工即可消除重疊。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In zone 3, duct installation runs on days 10 to 18 and ceiling framing on days 16 to 22, overlapping on days 16, 17 and 18, three days in all. If the ceiling activity has only 2 days of total float, delaying it by 3 days pushes completion by 3 − 2 = 1 day; splitting zone 3 into 3a and 3b and staggering the work removes the overlap. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 4D 模擬逐週檢查工作空間、吊裝範圍、臨時支撐與材料堆置是否重疊，並與總承包商的三週滾動計畫比對；每月以現場照片或掃描檢查實際進度與 4D 模型是否一致，偏離時更新排程後重新模擬。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use 4D simulation to check weekly for overlaps between workspaces, lifting zones, temporary supports and laydown areas, compare it with the main contractor's three-week look-ahead, and each month compare site photographs or scans with the 4D model, updating the schedule and re-simulating when they diverge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 第 3 區的風管安裝排在第 10 至 18 天，天花板骨架排在第 16 至 22 天，兩者在第 16、17、18 天重疊，共 3 天。若天花板活動的總浮時只有 2 天，延後 3 天會使完工日延後 3 − 2 = 1 天；改把第 3 區分成 3a、3b 兩段交錯施工即可消除重疊。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: In zone 3, duct installation runs on days 10 to 18 and ceiling framing on days 16 to 22, overlapping on days 16, 17 and 18, three days in all. If the ceiling activity has only 2 days of total float, delaying it by 3 days pushes completion by 3 − 2 = 1 day; splitting zone 3 into 3a and 3b and staggering the work removes the overlap. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「時空碰撞與施工順序模擬」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Space–time clashes and sequence simulation", which statement holds?
options: 共用資料環境只是存放檔案的雲端資料夾。
第 3 區的風管安裝排在第 10 至 18 天，天花板骨架排在第 16 至 22 天，兩者在第 16、17、18 天重疊，共 3 天。
碰撞檢查的主要目的是找建模錯誤，與樓高設計無關。
optionsEn: A common data environment is just a cloud folder for storing files.
In zone 3, duct installation runs on days 10 to 18 and ceiling framing on days 16 to 22, overlapping on days 16, 17 and 18, three days in all.
Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design.
quiz.explanation: 第 3 區的風管安裝排在第 10 至 18 天，天花板骨架排在第 16 至 22 天，兩者在第 16、17、18 天重疊，共 3 天。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: In zone 3, duct installation runs on days 10 to 18 and ceiling framing on days 16 to 22, overlapping on days 16, 17 and 18, three days in all. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 時空碰撞與施工順序模擬：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Space–time clashes and sequence simulation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「4D 施工順序」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “4D construction sequence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以 4D 模擬逐週檢查工作空間、吊裝範圍、臨時支撐與材料堆置是否重疊，並與總承包商的三週滾動計畫比對；每月以現場照片或掃描檢查實際進度與 4D 模型是否一致，偏離時更新排程後重新模擬。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use 4D simulation to check weekly for overlaps between workspaces, lifting zones, temporary supports and laydown areas, compare it with the main contractor's three-week look-ahead, and each month compare site photographs or scans with the 4D model, updating the schedule and re-simulating when they diverge. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大型設備吊入路徑、臨時開口與吊裝區應建成模型物件並納入碰撞矩陣，其封閉時點列入排程；吊裝計畫本身仍須由合格吊掛工程師與工地主任依規定核准，4D 模擬只是協調工具。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Model large-equipment lift routes, temporary openings and lifting zones as objects in the clash matrix and put their closing dates in the schedule; the lifting plan itself must still be approved by a qualified lifting engineer and the site manager as the rules require, with 4D simulation serving only as a coordination tool.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只檢查永久構件的空間碰撞而忽略臨時支撐與吊運路徑，結果大型機電模組無法從預留開口吊入，因為開口已被先施工的管線佔用，只好拆除部分已完成工作再吊裝。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only permanent elements and ignoring temporary supports and lifting routes can mean a large MEP module cannot be lifted in through its reserved opening because services installed earlier now occupy it, so finished work must be partly removed to make the lift. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「時空碰撞與施工順序模擬」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Space–time clashes and sequence simulation"?

steps.title: 時空碰撞與施工順序模擬：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Space–time clashes and sequence simulation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「4D 施工順序」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “4D construction sequence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只檢查永久構件的空間碰撞而忽略臨時支撐與吊運路徑，結果大型機電模組無法從預留開口吊入，因為開口已被先施工的管線佔用，只好拆除部分已完成工作再吊裝。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only permanent elements and ignoring temporary supports and lifting routes can mean a large MEP module cannot be lifted in through its reserved opening because services installed earlier now occupy it, so finished work must be partly removed to make the lift. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Crossrail 在法靈頓站以約 12 萬英鎊做 3D 排程分析，促成約 800 萬英鎊風險預備金的釋出，顯示排程協調的價值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At Farringdon station Crossrail spent about £120k on 3D schedule analysis, which enabled about £8 million of risk contingency to be released, showing the value of schedule coordination.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要三維模型沒有碰撞，施工順序就不會發生衝突。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the 3D model has no clashes, the construction sequence cannot conflict." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只檢查永久構件的空間碰撞而忽略臨時支撐與吊運路徑，結果大型機電模組無法從預留開口吊入，因為開口已被先施工的管線佔用，只好拆除部分已完成工作再吊裝。
knowledge.textEn: Checking only permanent elements and ignoring temporary supports and lifting routes can mean a large MEP module cannot be lifted in through its reserved opening because services installed earlier now occupy it, so finished work must be partly removed to make the lift.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「時空碰撞與施工順序模擬」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Space–time clashes and sequence simulation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只檢查永久構件的空間碰撞而忽略臨時支撐與吊運路徑，結果大型機電模組無法從預留開口吊入，因為開口已被先施工的管線佔用，只好拆除部分已完成工作再吊裝。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
碰撞數量越少，代表協調品質越好。
optionsEn: Checking only permanent elements and ignoring temporary supports and lifting routes can mean a large MEP module cannot be lifted in through its reserved opening because services installed earlier now occupy it, so finished work must be partly removed to make the lift.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The fewer the clashes in the report, the better the coordination.
quiz.explanation: 只檢查永久構件的空間碰撞而忽略臨時支撐與吊運路徑，結果大型機電模組無法從預留開口吊入，因為開口已被先施工的管線佔用，只好拆除部分已完成工作再吊裝。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Checking only permanent elements and ignoring temporary supports and lifting routes can mean a large MEP module cannot be lifted in through its reserved opening because services installed earlier now occupy it, so finished work must be partly removed to make the lift. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質」與「現場安裝公差與模型驗證」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Clash grouping, false positives and model quality" and "Installation tolerances and field verification of the model": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Clash grouping, false positives and model quality: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「規則式模型檢查」如何影響工程數位模型碰撞檢查的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rule-based model checking” governs force, deformation or durability in “BIM-based construction clash detection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 原始碰撞報告常有數千至上萬筆結果，其中大部分是同一原因重複出現，例如一根風管穿過二十根吊桿就產生二十筆。有效的審查先依元素、系統、樓層或格線分組，排除建模雜訊，再由人判斷哪些是需要設計決策的真實議題。碰撞檢查只看幾何，因此還要以規則式模型檢查補足：重複元素、未連接的管線、缺少系統分類或防火等級屬性，都會讓碰撞結果失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「規則式模型檢查」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Raw clash reports often contain thousands to tens of thousands of results, most of them repeats of one cause; one duct passing twenty hanger rods produces twenty results. Effective review first groups results by element, system, level or grid, removes modelling noise, and then lets people judge which are real issues needing design decisions. Clash detection sees only geometry, so rule-based model checking must complement it: duplicate elements, unconnected pipework and missing system or fire-rating properties all distort clash results. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rule-based model checking” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原始結果 12,000 筆，依元素與區域分組成 480 組，審查確認其中 120 組為真實設計議題：以組計的精確率 120/480 = 25%，以原始筆數計僅 120/12,000 = 1%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 12,000 raw results grouped by element and zone become 480 groups, of which review confirms 120 as real design issues: precision is 120/480 = 25% by group but only 120/12,000 = 1% by raw result.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「碰撞數量越少，代表協調品質越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The fewer the clashes in the report, the better the coordination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「規則式模型檢查」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rule-based model checking”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質
knowledge.titleEn: Clash grouping, false positives and model quality
knowledge.text: 原始碰撞報告常有數千至上萬筆結果，其中大部分是同一原因重複出現，例如一根風管穿過二十根吊桿就產生二十筆。有效的審查先依元素、系統、樓層或格線分組，排除建模雜訊，再由人判斷哪些是需要設計決策的真實議題。
knowledge.textEn: Raw clash reports often contain thousands to tens of thousands of results, most of them repeats of one cause; one duct passing twenty hanger rods produces twenty results. Effective review first groups results by element, system, level or grid, removes modelling noise, and then lets people judge which are real issues needing design decisions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：碰撞數量越少，代表協調品質越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The fewer the clashes in the report, the better the coordination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Clash grouping, false positives and model quality" is correct?
options: 碰撞數量越少，代表協調品質越好。
原始碰撞報告常有數千至上萬筆結果，其中大部分是同一原因重複出現，例如一根風管穿過二十根吊桿就產生二十筆。
模型協調完成後，現場只要照圖施工就不會有空間衝突。
optionsEn: The fewer the clashes in the report, the better the coordination.
Raw clash reports often contain thousands to tens of thousands of results, most of them repeats of one cause.
Once the model is coordinated, building to the drawings cannot produce space conflicts.
quiz.explanation: 原始碰撞報告常有數千至上萬筆結果，其中大部分是同一原因重複出現，例如一根風管穿過二十根吊桿就產生二十筆。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Raw clash reports often contain thousands to tens of thousands of results, most of them repeats of one cause; one duct passing twenty hanger rods produces twenty results. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Clash grouping, false positives and model quality: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「規則式模型檢查」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rule-based model checking” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原始結果 12,000 筆，依元素與區域分組成 480 組，審查確認其中 120 組為真實設計議題：以組計的精確率 120/480 = 25%，以原始筆數計僅 120/12,000 = 1%。每組審查 6 分鐘約需 480×6/60 = 48 小時；逐筆每筆 0.5 分鐘則需 12,000×0.5/60 = 100 小時。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 12,000 raw results grouped by element and zone become 480 groups, of which review confirms 120 as real design issues: precision is 120/480 = 25% by group but only 120/12,000 = 1% by raw result. At 6 minutes per group, review takes 480×6/60 = 48 hours; reviewing raw results at 0.5 minutes each would take 12,000×0.5/60 = 100 hours. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次聯合前先執行規則式模型檢查（重複物件、空間未封閉、缺屬性、不合理尺寸），通過門檻（例如失敗元素少於 1%）才進入碰撞測試；分組規則與排除清單要版本化，並抽查被排除的結果，確認沒有誤刪真實問題。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before each federation run rule-based model checks (duplicates, unclosed spaces, missing properties, implausible sizes) and allow clash testing only above a threshold such as fewer than 1% failing elements; version the grouping rules and exclusion lists and spot-check excluded results to confirm that no real problem was discarded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原始結果 12,000 筆，依元素與區域分組成 480 組，審查確認其中 120 組為真實設計議題：以組計的精確率 120/480 = 25%，以原始筆數計僅 120/12,000 = 1%。每組審查 6 分鐘約需 480×6/60 = 48 小時；逐筆每筆 0.5 分鐘則需 12,000×0.5/60 = 100 小時。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 12,000 raw results grouped by element and zone become 480 groups, of which review confirms 120 as real design issues: precision is 120/480 = 25% by group but only 120/12,000 = 1% by raw result. At 6 minutes per group, review takes 480×6/60 = 48 hours; reviewing raw results at 0.5 minutes each would take 12,000×0.5/60 = 100 hours. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Clash grouping, false positives and model quality", which statement holds?
options: 施工期間協調用的模型就等於竣工模型。
只要把所有檔案匯入同一個軟體，模型就會自動對齊。
原始結果 12,000 筆，依元素與區域分組成 480 組，審查確認其中 120 組為真實設計議題：以組計的精確率 120/480 = 25%，以原始筆數計僅 120/12,000 = 1%。
optionsEn: The model used for coordination during construction is the as-built model.
Importing every file into the same software aligns the models automatically.
12,000 raw results grouped by element and zone become 480 groups, of which review confirms 120 as real design issues: precision is 120/480 = 25% by group but only 120/12,000 = 1% by raw result.
quiz.explanation: 原始結果 12,000 筆，依元素與區域分組成 480 組，審查確認其中 120 組為真實設計議題：以組計的精確率 120/480 = 25%，以原始筆數計僅 120/12,000 = 1%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: 12,000 raw results grouped by element and zone become 480 groups, of which review confirms 120 as real design issues: precision is 120/480 = 25% by group but only 120/12,000 = 1% by raw result. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Clash grouping, false positives and model quality: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「規則式模型檢查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rule-based model checking” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每次聯合前先執行規則式模型檢查（重複物件、空間未封閉、缺屬性、不合理尺寸），通過門檻（例如失敗元素少於 1%）才進入碰撞測試；分組規則與排除清單要版本化，並抽查被排除的結果，確認沒有誤刪真實問題。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before each federation run rule-based model checks (duplicates, unclosed spaces, missing properties, implausible sizes) and allow clash testing only above a threshold such as fewer than 1% failing elements; version the grouping rules and exclusion lists and spot-check excluded results to confirm that no real problem was discarded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：協調報表應同時呈現原始數、分組數、真實議題數與逾期數，由不參與建模的協調經理抽查排除與核可紀錄；任何「核可碰撞」都要寫明理由與核可人。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Coordination reports should show raw counts, groups, real issues and overdue issues together, with a coordination manager who does not model spot-checking exclusions and approvals; every ‘approved clash’ must record its reason and approver.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：團隊為了讓數字好看而大量標記「已核可」或擴大排除條件，管理報表顯示碰撞快速下降，真正的衝突卻被埋進排除清單，直到現場安裝才暴露。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Teams that mark results ‘approved’ en masse or widen exclusions to make numbers look good see management reports show clashes falling fast, while real conflicts are buried in exclusion lists until site installation exposes them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
