knowledge.text: 每次聯合前先執行規則式模型檢查（重複物件、空間未封閉、缺屬性、不合理尺寸），通過門檻（例如失敗元素少於 1%）才進入碰撞測試；分組規則與排除清單要版本化，並抽查被排除的結果，確認沒有誤刪真實問題。
knowledge.textEn: Before each federation run rule-based model checks (duplicates, unclosed spaces, missing properties, implausible sizes) and allow clash testing only above a threshold such as fewer than 1% failing elements; version the grouping rules and exclusion lists and spot-check excluded results to confirm that no real problem was discarded.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 協調報表應同時呈現原始數、分組數、真實議題數與逾期數，由不參與建模的協調經理抽查排除與核可紀錄；任何「核可碰撞」都要寫明理由與核可人。
knowledge.textEn: Coordination reports should show raw counts, groups, real issues and overdue issues together, with a coordination manager who does not model spot-checking exclusions and approvals; every ‘approved clash’ must record its reason and approver.

quiz.question: 要驗證「碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Clash grouping, false positives and model quality"?
options: 每次聯合前先執行規則式模型檢查（重複物件、空間未封閉、缺屬性、不合理尺寸），通過門檻（例如失敗元素少於 1%）才進入碰撞測試。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
所有元素都要做到最高的模型發展程度，碰撞檢查才有意義。
optionsEn: Before each federation run rule-based model checks (duplicates, unclosed spaces, missing properties, implausible sizes) and allow clash testing only above a threshold such as fewer than 1% failing elements.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Every element must reach the highest level of development for clash detection to be meaningful.
quiz.explanation: 每次聯合前先執行規則式模型檢查（重複物件、空間未封閉、缺屬性、不合理尺寸），通過門檻（例如失敗元素少於 1%）才進入碰撞測試；分組規則與排除清單要版本化，並抽查被排除的結果，確認沒有誤刪真實問題。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before each federation run rule-based model checks (duplicates, unclosed spaces, missing properties, implausible sizes) and allow clash testing only above a threshold such as fewer than 1% failing elements; version the grouping rules and exclusion lists and spot-check excluded results to confirm that no real problem was discarded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Clash grouping, false positives and model quality: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「規則式模型檢查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rule-based model checking” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 團隊為了讓數字好看而大量標記「已核可」或擴大排除條件，管理報表顯示碰撞快速下降，真正的衝突卻被埋進排除清單，直到現場安裝才暴露。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Teams that mark results ‘approved’ en masse or widen exclusions to make numbers look good see management reports show clashes falling fast, while real conflicts are buried in exclusion lists until site installation exposes them. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：碰撞檢查只看幾何，因此還要以規則式模型檢查補足：重複元素、未連接的管線、缺少系統分類或防火等級屬性，都會讓碰撞結果失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Clash detection sees only geometry, so rule-based model checking must complement it: duplicate elements, unconnected pipework and missing system or fire-rating properties all distort clash results.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「碰撞數量越少，代表協調品質越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The fewer the clashes in the report, the better the coordination." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 團隊為了讓數字好看而大量標記「已核可」或擴大排除條件，管理報表顯示碰撞快速下降，真正的衝突卻被埋進排除清單，直到現場安裝才暴露。
knowledge.textEn: Teams that mark results ‘approved’ en masse or widen exclusions to make numbers look good see management reports show clashes falling fast, while real conflicts are buried in exclusion lists until site installation exposes them.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Clash grouping, false positives and model quality" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
團隊為了讓數字好看而大量標記「已核可」或擴大排除條件，管理報表顯示碰撞快速下降，真正的衝突卻被埋進排除清單，直到現場安裝才暴露。
模型協調完成後，現場只要照圖施工就不會有空間衝突。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Teams that mark results ‘approved’ en masse or widen exclusions to make numbers look good see management reports show clashes falling fast, while real conflicts are buried in exclusion lists until site installation exposes them.
Once the model is coordinated, building to the drawings cannot produce space conflicts.
quiz.explanation: 團隊為了讓數字好看而大量標記「已核可」或擴大排除條件，管理報表顯示碰撞快速下降，真正的衝突卻被埋進排除清單，直到現場安裝才暴露。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Teams that mark results ‘approved’ en masse or widen exclusions to make numbers look good see management reports show clashes falling fast, while real conflicts are buried in exclusion lists until site installation exposes them. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 現場安裝公差與模型驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Installation tolerances and field verification of the model: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「現場放樣與公差累積」如何影響工程數位模型碰撞檢查的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Site set-out and tolerance stack” governs force, deformation or durability in “BIM-based construction clash detection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 模型中相距幾公釐的兩個物件，在現場可能因放樣、預製尺寸與安裝誤差而相撞。因此協調後的模型要經由全測站或雷射掃描回到現場：先以模型座標放樣吊架與套管位置，安裝後再量測實際位置與模型比對。這一步把虛擬協調與實體施工連成閉環，也讓軟碰撞淨距有了依據：淨距應涵蓋各項誤差的合成，而不是任意的數字。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「現場放樣與公差累積」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two objects a few millimetres apart in the model can collide on site because of set-out, fabrication and installation errors. The coordinated model must therefore return to site through total stations or laser scanning: hangers and sleeves are set out from model coordinates, and after installation actual positions are measured and compared with the model. This closes the loop between virtual coordination and physical construction and gives the clearance rules a basis, since the clearance should cover the combined errors rather than an arbitrary number. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Site set-out and tolerance stack” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單一物件位置誤差以平方和開根號合成：放樣 ±5 mm、預製 ±3 mm、安裝 ±10 mm，√(5² + 3² + 10²) = √134 ≈ ±11.6 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Combine position errors for one object by root-sum-square: set-out ±5 mm, fabrication ±3 mm and installation ±10 mm give √(5² + 3² + 10²) = √134 ≈ ±11.6 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模型協調完成後，現場只要照圖施工就不會有空間衝突。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the model is coordinated, building to the drawings cannot produce space conflicts." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「現場放樣與公差累積」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Site set-out and tolerance stack”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 現場安裝公差與模型驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Installation tolerances and field verification of the model
knowledge.text: 模型中相距幾公釐的兩個物件，在現場可能因放樣、預製尺寸與安裝誤差而相撞。因此協調後的模型要經由全測站或雷射掃描回到現場：先以模型座標放樣吊架與套管位置，安裝後再量測實際位置與模型比對。
knowledge.textEn: Two objects a few millimetres apart in the model can collide on site because of set-out, fabrication and installation errors. The coordinated model must therefore return to site through total stations or laser scanning: hangers and sleeves are set out from model coordinates, and after installation actual positions are measured and compared with the model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模型協調完成後，現場只要照圖施工就不會有空間衝突。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the model is coordinated, building to the drawings cannot produce space conflicts. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「現場安裝公差與模型驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Installation tolerances and field verification of the model" is correct?
options: 模型協調完成後，現場只要照圖施工就不會有空間衝突。
共用資料環境只是存放檔案的雲端資料夾。
模型中相距幾公釐的兩個物件，在現場可能因放樣、預製尺寸與安裝誤差而相撞。
optionsEn: Once the model is coordinated, building to the drawings cannot produce space conflicts.
A common data environment is just a cloud folder for storing files.
Two objects a few millimetres apart in the model can collide on site because of set-out, fabrication and installation errors.
quiz.explanation: 模型中相距幾公釐的兩個物件，在現場可能因放樣、預製尺寸與安裝誤差而相撞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Two objects a few millimetres apart in the model can collide on site because of set-out, fabrication and installation errors. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現場安裝公差與模型驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Installation tolerances and field verification of the model: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「現場放樣與公差累積」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Site set-out and tolerance stack” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單一物件位置誤差以平方和開根號合成：放樣 ±5 mm、預製 ±3 mm、安裝 ±10 mm，√(5² + 3² + 10²) = √134 ≈ ±11.6 mm。兩個獨立安裝物件之間的相對誤差約 √2×11.6 ≈ ±16.4 mm，所以模型淨距小於約 16 mm 處現場就有明顯碰撞機率，軟碰撞規則宜取 20 至 25 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Combine position errors for one object by root-sum-square: set-out ±5 mm, fabrication ±3 mm and installation ±10 mm give √(5² + 3² + 10²) = √134 ≈ ±11.6 mm. Between two independently installed objects the relative error is about √2×11.6 ≈ ±16.4 mm, so where the model gap is below about 16 mm a site clash is quite likely, and a clearance rule of 20 to 25 mm is sensible. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以機器人全測站從模型匯出點位放樣吊架、套管與預埋件，放樣後抽查實際位置；安裝完成後以雷射掃描或全測站量測關鍵管線，與模型比對並列出超過容許值的位置，作為封板前的檢查點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Set out hangers, sleeves and embeds from model points with a robotic total station and spot-check the marks; after installation measure key services by laser scanning or total station, compare with the model and list locations beyond tolerance as a check before the ceiling closes up.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單一物件位置誤差以平方和開根號合成：放樣 ±5 mm、預製 ±3 mm、安裝 ±10 mm，√(5² + 3² + 10²) = √134 ≈ ±11.6 mm。兩個獨立安裝物件之間的相對誤差約 √2×11.6 ≈ ±16.4 mm，所以模型淨距小於約 16 mm 處現場就有明顯碰撞機率，軟碰撞規則宜取 20 至 25 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Combine position errors for one object by root-sum-square: set-out ±5 mm, fabrication ±3 mm and installation ±10 mm give √(5² + 3² + 10²) = √134 ≈ ±11.6 mm. Between two independently installed objects the relative error is about √2×11.6 ≈ ±16.4 mm, so where the model gap is below about 16 mm a site clash is quite likely, and a clearance rule of 20 to 25 mm is sensible. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場安裝公差與模型驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Installation tolerances and field verification of the model", which statement holds?
options: 單一物件位置誤差以平方和開根號合成：放樣 ±5 mm、預製 ±3 mm、安裝 ±10 mm，√(5² + 3² + 10²) = √134 ≈ ±11.6 mm。
碰撞檢查的主要目的是找建模錯誤，與樓高設計無關。
碰撞報告為零，就代表現場一定可以順利安裝。
optionsEn: Combine position errors for one object by root-sum-square: set-out ±5 mm, fabrication ±3 mm and installation ±10 mm give √(5² + 3² + 10²) = √134 ≈ ±11.6 mm.
Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design.
A clash report of zero guarantees smooth installation on site.
quiz.explanation: 單一物件位置誤差以平方和開根號合成：放樣 ±5 mm、預製 ±3 mm、安裝 ±10 mm，√(5² + 3² + 10²) = √134 ≈ ±11.6 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Combine position errors for one object by root-sum-square: set-out ±5 mm, fabrication ±3 mm and installation ±10 mm give √(5² + 3² + 10²) = √134 ≈ ±11.6 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 現場安裝公差與模型驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Installation tolerances and field verification of the model: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「現場放樣與公差累積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Site set-out and tolerance stack” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以機器人全測站從模型匯出點位放樣吊架、套管與預埋件，放樣後抽查實際位置；安裝完成後以雷射掃描或全測站量測關鍵管線，與模型比對並列出超過容許值的位置，作為封板前的檢查點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Set out hangers, sleeves and embeds from model points with a robotic total station and spot-check the marks; after installation measure key services by laser scanning or total station, compare with the model and list locations beyond tolerance as a check before the ceiling closes up. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規定封板前量測為保留點：天花板、管道間與牆面封板前，必須完成關鍵管線位置量測並與模型比對，偏差超過容許值者由設計與施工雙方確認處置後才能封閉。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make pre-close-up survey a hold point: before ceilings, shafts or walls are closed, key services must be measured and compared with the model, and any deviation beyond tolerance must be resolved jointly by design and construction before closing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：模型協調完美，現場卻仍用捲尺從柱面量測放樣，累積誤差讓多支管線偏移數公分，與後續施工的電纜架相撞；因為沒有安裝後量測，問題到天花板封板時才被發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The model is perfectly coordinated but site crews still set out with tapes from column faces, accumulated errors shift several pipes by centimetres into later cable trays, and with no post-installation survey the problem surfaces only when the ceiling is boarded. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以機器人全測站從模型匯出點位放樣吊架、套管與預埋件，放樣後抽查實際位置；安裝完成後以雷射掃描或全測站量測關鍵管線，與模型比對並列出超過容許值的位置，作為封板前的檢查點。
knowledge.textEn: Set out hangers, sleeves and embeds from model points with a robotic total station and spot-check the marks; after installation measure key services by laser scanning or total station, compare with the model and list locations beyond tolerance as a check before the ceiling closes up.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規定封板前量測為保留點：天花板、管道間與牆面封板前，必須完成關鍵管線位置量測並與模型比對，偏差超過容許值者由設計與施工雙方確認處置後才能封閉。
knowledge.textEn: Make pre-close-up survey a hold point: before ceilings, shafts or walls are closed, key services must be measured and compared with the model, and any deviation beyond tolerance must be resolved jointly by design and construction before closing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場安裝公差與模型驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Installation tolerances and field verification of the model"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以機器人全測站從模型匯出點位放樣吊架、套管與預埋件，放樣後抽查實際位置。
碰撞報告產出後，軟體會自動決定哪個專業必須修改。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Set out hangers, sleeves and embeds from model points with a robotic total station and spot-check the marks.
Once the clash report is produced, the software decides which discipline must change.
quiz.explanation: 以機器人全測站從模型匯出點位放樣吊架、套管與預埋件，放樣後抽查實際位置；安裝完成後以雷射掃描或全測站量測關鍵管線，與模型比對並列出超過容許值的位置，作為封板前的檢查點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Set out hangers, sleeves and embeds from model points with a robotic total station and spot-check the marks; after installation measure key services by laser scanning or total station, compare with the model and list locations beyond tolerance as a check before the ceiling closes up. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現場安裝公差與模型驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Installation tolerances and field verification of the model: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「現場放樣與公差累積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Site set-out and tolerance stack” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模型協調完美，現場卻仍用捲尺從柱面量測放樣，累積誤差讓多支管線偏移數公分，與後續施工的電纜架相撞；因為沒有安裝後量測，問題到天花板封板時才被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The model is perfectly coordinated but site crews still set out with tapes from column faces, accumulated errors shift several pipes by centimetres into later cable trays, and with no post-installation survey the problem surfaces only when the ceiling is boarded. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這一步把虛擬協調與實體施工連成閉環，也讓軟碰撞淨距有了依據：淨距應涵蓋各項誤差的合成，而不是任意的數字。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This closes the loop between virtual coordination and physical construction and gives the clearance rules a basis, since the clearance should cover the combined errors rather than an arbitrary number.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模型協調完成後，現場只要照圖施工就不會有空間衝突。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the model is coordinated, building to the drawings cannot produce space conflicts." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 模型協調完美，現場卻仍用捲尺從柱面量測放樣，累積誤差讓多支管線偏移數公分，與後續施工的電纜架相撞；因為沒有安裝後量測，問題到天花板封板時才被發現。
knowledge.textEn: The model is perfectly coordinated but site crews still set out with tapes from column faces, accumulated errors shift several pipes by centimetres into later cable trays, and with no post-installation survey the problem surfaces only when the ceiling is boarded.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場安裝公差與模型驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Installation tolerances and field verification of the model" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
共用資料環境只是存放檔案的雲端資料夾。
模型協調完美，現場卻仍用捲尺從柱面量測放樣，累積誤差讓多支管線偏移數公分，與後續施工的電纜架相撞；因為沒有安裝後量測，問題到天花板封板時才被發現。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A common data environment is just a cloud folder for storing files.

The model is perfectly coordinated but site crews still set out with tapes from column faces, accumulated errors shift several pipes by centimetres into later cable trays, and with no post-installation survey the problem surfaces only when the ceiling is boarded.
quiz.explanation: 模型協調完美，現場卻仍用捲尺從柱面量測放樣，累積誤差讓多支管線偏移數公分，與後續施工的電纜架相撞；因為沒有安裝後量測，問題到天花板封板時才被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The model is perfectly coordinated but site crews still set out with tapes from column faces, accumulated errors shift several pipes by centimetres into later cable trays, and with no post-installation survey the problem surfaces only when the ceiling is boarded. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設計變更下的模型維護」與「竣工模型與資產資訊交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Model maintenance under design change" and "As-built models and asset-information handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設計變更下的模型維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Model maintenance under design change: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「共用資料環境狀態」如何影響工程數位模型碰撞檢查的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “CDE states and change control” governs force, deformation or durability in “BIM-based construction clash detection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計變更、送審意見與現場問題會讓模型持續修改，若沒有版本控制，碰撞檢查可能拿新版結構對舊版機電比較而得出錯誤結論。ISO 19650 把資訊容器分成作業中、共享、發布與封存等狀態：只有經過檢核並轉為共享的模型才能進入聯合，只有發布版本才能作為施工依據；每次狀態轉換都要記錄版本與核准人，讓任何一份碰撞報告都能追溯到確切的模型版本。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「共用資料環境狀態」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Design changes, review comments and site issues keep the models changing, and without version control a clash run may compare a new structure against an old MEP model and reach wrong conclusions. ISO 19650 divides information containers into work-in-progress, shared, published and archived states: only checked models moved to shared may enter federation, and only published revisions may be built from, with every state change recording the revision and approver so that any clash report can be traced to exact model versions. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “CDE states and change control” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：聯合模型含 12 個專業模型，若每個模型準時以當週版本上傳的機率為 90%，全部都是當週版本的機率只有 0.9^12 ≈ 0.28；訂定固定凍結時間、把準時率提高到 98% 後，機率升為 0.98^12 ≈ 0.78。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A federated model contains 12 discipline models; if each is uploaded on time with that week's revision with probability 90%, the chance that all are current is only 0.9^12 ≈ 0.28; a fixed freeze time that lifts on-time delivery to 98% raises it to 0.98^12 ≈ 0.78.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「共用資料環境只是存放檔案的雲端資料夾。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A common data environment is just a cloud folder for storing files." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「共用資料環境狀態」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “CDE states and change control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設計變更下的模型維護
knowledge.text: 設計變更、送審意見與現場問題會讓模型持續修改，若沒有版本控制，碰撞檢查可能拿新版結構對舊版機電比較而得出錯誤結論。ISO 19650 把資訊容器分成作業中、共享、發布與封存等狀態：只有經過檢核並轉為共享的模型才能進入聯合，只有發布版本才能作為施工依據；每次狀態轉換都要記錄版本與核准人，讓任何一份碰撞報告都能追溯到確切的模型版本。
knowledge.textEn: Design changes, review comments and site issues keep the models changing, and without version control a clash run may compare a new structure against an old MEP model and reach wrong conclusions. ISO 19650 divides information containers into work-in-progress, shared, published and archived states: only checked models moved to shared may enter federation, and only published revisions may be built from, with every state change recording the revision and approver so that any clash report can be traced to exact model versions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：共用資料環境只是存放檔案的雲端資料夾。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A common data environment is just a cloud folder for storing files. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設計變更下的模型維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Model maintenance under design change" is correct?
options: 設計變更、送審意見與現場問題會讓模型持續修改，若沒有版本控制，碰撞檢查可能拿新版結構對舊版機電比較而得出錯誤結論。
共用資料環境只是存放檔案的雲端資料夾。
施工期間協調用的模型就等於竣工模型。
optionsEn: Design changes, review comments and site issues keep the models changing, and without version control a clash run may compare a new structure against an old MEP model and reach wrong conclusions.
A common data environment is just a cloud folder for storing files.
The model used for coordination during construction is the as-built model.
quiz.explanation: 設計變更、送審意見與現場問題會讓模型持續修改，若沒有版本控制，碰撞檢查可能拿新版結構對舊版機電比較而得出錯誤結論。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Design changes, review comments and site issues keep the models changing, and without version control a clash run may compare a new structure against an old MEP model and reach wrong conclusions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設計變更下的模型維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Model maintenance under design change: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共用資料環境狀態」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “CDE states and change control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：聯合模型含 12 個專業模型，若每個模型準時以當週版本上傳的機率為 90%，全部都是當週版本的機率只有 0.9^12 ≈ 0.28；訂定固定凍結時間、把準時率提高到 98% 後，機率升為 0.98^12 ≈ 0.78。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A federated model contains 12 discipline models; if each is uploaded on time with that week's revision with probability 90%, the chance that all are current is only 0.9^12 ≈ 0.28; a fixed freeze time that lifts on-time delivery to 98% raises it to 0.98^12 ≈ 0.78. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每份碰撞報告封面列出所有參與模型的檔名、版本號與狀態，資訊管理者在聯合前與共用資料環境的發布紀錄比對；設計變更單要列出受影響區域，並觸發該區域重新協調與重新簽認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Every clash report cover lists the file name, revision and status of every model used, and the information manager checks them against the common data environment's publication record before federation; each design change notice must list affected areas and trigger re-coordination and re-sign-off of those areas.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 聯合模型含 12 個專業模型，若每個模型準時以當週版本上傳的機率為 90%，全部都是當週版本的機率只有 0.9^12 ≈ 0.28；訂定固定凍結時間、把準時率提高到 98% 後，機率升為 0.98^12 ≈ 0.78。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A federated model contains 12 discipline models; if each is uploaded on time with that week's revision with probability 90%, the chance that all are current is only 0.9^12 ≈ 0.28; a fixed freeze time that lifts on-time delivery to 98% raises it to 0.98^12 ≈ 0.78. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設計變更下的模型維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Model maintenance under design change", which statement holds?
options: 只要把所有檔案匯入同一個軟體，模型就會自動對齊。
聯合模型含 12 個專業模型，若每個模型準時以當週版本上傳的機率為 90%，全部都是當週版本的機率只有 0.9^12 ≈ 0.28。
所有元素都要做到最高的模型發展程度，碰撞檢查才有意義。
optionsEn: Importing every file into the same software aligns the models automatically.
A federated model contains 12 discipline models.
Every element must reach the highest level of development for clash detection to be meaningful.
quiz.explanation: 聯合模型含 12 個專業模型，若每個模型準時以當週版本上傳的機率為 90%，全部都是當週版本的機率只有 0.9^12 ≈ 0.28；訂定固定凍結時間、把準時率提高到 98% 後，機率升為 0.98^12 ≈ 0.78。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A federated model contains 12 discipline models; if each is uploaded on time with that week's revision with probability 90%, the chance that all are current is only 0.9^12 ≈ 0.28; a fixed freeze time that lifts on-time delivery to 98% raises it to 0.98^12 ≈ 0.78. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 設計變更下的模型維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Model maintenance under design change: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「共用資料環境狀態」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “CDE states and change control” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每份碰撞報告封面列出所有參與模型的檔名、版本號與狀態，資訊管理者在聯合前與共用資料環境的發布紀錄比對；設計變更單要列出受影響區域，並觸發該區域重新協調與重新簽認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Every clash report cover lists the file name, revision and status of every model used, and the information manager checks them against the common data environment's publication record before federation; each design change notice must list affected areas and trigger re-coordination and re-sign-off of those areas. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在合約中明定模型與圖說的優先順序與同步規則，訂定每週固定的模型凍結時間；設計變更通知必須同時附上更新後的模型版本，否則不得發布。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State in the contract the precedence and synchronisation rules between models and drawings and set a fixed weekly model-freeze time; a design change notice may not be issued without the updated model revision attached.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：變更只更新了圖說而未更新模型，或反之，使模型與圖說不一致；施工依圖說做、協調依模型做，雙方都以為自己正確，衝突到現場才出現，責任歸屬也難以釐清。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A change that updates the drawings but not the model, or the reverse, leaves the two inconsistent; construction follows the drawings while coordination follows the model, each side believes it is right, the conflict surfaces on site and responsibility is hard to establish. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每份碰撞報告封面列出所有參與模型的檔名、版本號與狀態，資訊管理者在聯合前與共用資料環境的發布紀錄比對；設計變更單要列出受影響區域，並觸發該區域重新協調與重新簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Every clash report cover lists the file name, revision and status of every model used, and the information manager checks them against the common data environment's publication record before federation; each design change notice must list affected areas and trigger re-coordination and re-sign-off of those areas.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在合約中明定模型與圖說的優先順序與同步規則，訂定每週固定的模型凍結時間；設計變更通知必須同時附上更新後的模型版本，否則不得發布。
knowledge.textEn: State in the contract the precedence and synchronisation rules between models and drawings and set a fixed weekly model-freeze time; a design change notice may not be issued without the updated model revision attached.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設計變更下的模型維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Model maintenance under design change"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要三維模型沒有碰撞，施工順序就不會發生衝突。
每份碰撞報告封面列出所有參與模型的檔名、版本號與狀態，資訊管理者在聯合前與共用資料環境的發布紀錄比對。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If the 3D model has no clashes, the construction sequence cannot conflict.

Every clash report cover lists the file name, revision and status of every model used, and the information manager checks them against the common data environment's publication record before federation.
quiz.explanation: 每份碰撞報告封面列出所有參與模型的檔名、版本號與狀態，資訊管理者在聯合前與共用資料環境的發布紀錄比對；設計變更單要列出受影響區域，並觸發該區域重新協調與重新簽認。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Every clash report cover lists the file name, revision and status of every model used, and the information manager checks them against the common data environment's publication record before federation; each design change notice must list affected areas and trigger re-coordination and re-sign-off of those areas. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 設計變更下的模型維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Model maintenance under design change: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「共用資料環境狀態」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “CDE states and change control” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 變更只更新了圖說而未更新模型，或反之，使模型與圖說不一致；施工依圖說做、協調依模型做，雙方都以為自己正確，衝突到現場才出現，責任歸屬也難以釐清。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A change that updates the drawings but not the model, or the reverse, leaves the two inconsistent; construction follows the drawings while coordination follows the model, each side believes it is right, the conflict surfaces on site and responsibility is hard to establish. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：ISO 19650 把資訊容器分成作業中、共享、發布與封存等狀態：只有經過檢核並轉為共享的模型才能進入聯合，只有發布版本才能作為施工依據；每次狀態轉換都要記錄版本與核准人，讓任何一份碰撞報告都能追溯到確切的模型版本。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: ISO 19650 divides information containers into work-in-progress, shared, published and archived states: only checked models moved to shared may enter federation, and only published revisions may be built from, with every state change recording the revision and approver so that any clash report can be traced to exact model versions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「共用資料環境只是存放檔案的雲端資料夾。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A common data environment is just a cloud folder for storing files." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 變更只更新了圖說而未更新模型，或反之，使模型與圖說不一致；施工依圖說做、協調依模型做，雙方都以為自己正確，衝突到現場才出現，責任歸屬也難以釐清。
knowledge.textEn: A change that updates the drawings but not the model, or the reverse, leaves the two inconsistent; construction follows the drawings while coordination follows the model, each side believes it is right, the conflict surfaces on site and responsibility is hard to establish.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「設計變更下的模型維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Model maintenance under design change" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 變更只更新了圖說而未更新模型，或反之，使模型與圖說不一致；施工依圖說做、協調依模型做，雙方都以為自己正確，衝突到現場才出現，責任歸屬也難以釐清。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
施工期間協調用的模型就等於竣工模型。
optionsEn: A change that updates the drawings but not the model, or the reverse, leaves the two inconsistent.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The model used for coordination during construction is the as-built model.
quiz.explanation: 變更只更新了圖說而未更新模型，或反之，使模型與圖說不一致；施工依圖說做、協調依模型做，雙方都以為自己正確，衝突到現場才出現，責任歸屬也難以釐清。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A change that updates the drawings but not the model, or the reverse, leaves the two inconsistent; construction follows the drawings while coordination follows the model, each side believes it is right, the conflict surfaces on site and responsibility is hard to establish. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 竣工模型與資產資訊交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: As-built models and asset-information handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「資產資訊模型」如何影響工程數位模型碰撞檢查的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset information model” governs force, deformation or durability in “BIM-based construction clash detection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 協調後的模型若在交接時只留下幾何，營運者仍找不到閥門、維修淨空與設備資料。交接應把模型轉成資產資訊模型：依資產分類賦予編碼、廠牌、型號、保固與維護週期，並保留碰撞協調中確認的維修通道與淨空。Crossrail 中央段九座主要車站每站約有 15,000 至 25,000 個資產，說明交接資料量之大，必須以資料規則自動檢查，不能只靠人工逐一核對。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「資產資訊模型」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: If the coordinated model leaves handover with geometry only, operators still cannot find valves, maintenance clearances or equipment data. Handover should turn the model into an asset information model: assign classification codes, makes, models, warranties and maintenance intervals by asset, and keep the access routes and clearances confirmed during clash coordination. The nine main Crossrail central-section stations each had about 15,000 to 25,000 assets, showing how large handover data becomes and why it must be checked by automated data rules rather than by hand alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Asset information model” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：9 站 × 每站 15,000 至 25,000 個資產 = 135,000 至 225,000 個資產；每個資產 20 項屬性時共 2.7 至 4.5 百萬筆資料。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 9 stations × 15,000 to 25,000 assets each = 135,000 to 225,000 assets; with 20 attributes per asset that is 2.7 to 4.5 million values.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工期間協調用的模型就等於竣工模型。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The model used for coordination during construction is the as-built model." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「資產資訊模型」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Asset information model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 竣工模型與資產資訊交接
knowledge.text: 協調後的模型若在交接時只留下幾何，營運者仍找不到閥門、維修淨空與設備資料。交接應把模型轉成資產資訊模型：依資產分類賦予編碼、廠牌、型號、保固與維護週期，並保留碰撞協調中確認的維修通道與淨空。
knowledge.textEn: If the coordinated model leaves handover with geometry only, operators still cannot find valves, maintenance clearances or equipment data. Handover should turn the model into an asset information model: assign classification codes, makes, models, warranties and maintenance intervals by asset, and keep the access routes and clearances confirmed during clash coordination.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工期間協調用的模型就等於竣工模型。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The model used for coordination during construction is the as-built model. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「竣工模型與資產資訊交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "As-built models and asset-information handover" is correct?
options: 施工期間協調用的模型就等於竣工模型。
協調後的模型若在交接時只留下幾何，營運者仍找不到閥門、維修淨空與設備資料。
碰撞檢查的主要目的是找建模錯誤，與樓高設計無關。
optionsEn: The model used for coordination during construction is the as-built model.
If the coordinated model leaves handover with geometry only, operators still cannot find valves, maintenance clearances or equipment data.
Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design.
quiz.explanation: 協調後的模型若在交接時只留下幾何，營運者仍找不到閥門、維修淨空與設備資料。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: If the coordinated model leaves handover with geometry only, operators still cannot find valves, maintenance clearances or equipment data. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 竣工模型與資產資訊交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: As-built models and asset-information handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資訊模型」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset information model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：9 站 × 每站 15,000 至 25,000 個資產 = 135,000 至 225,000 個資產；每個資產 20 項屬性時共 2.7 至 4.5 百萬筆資料。即使正確率 99.5%，仍有 0.005×2,700,000 = 13,500 至 0.005×4,500,000 = 22,500 筆錯誤。屬性數與正確率為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 9 stations × 15,000 to 25,000 assets each = 135,000 to 225,000 assets; with 20 attributes per asset that is 2.7 to 4.5 million values. Even at 99.5% accuracy there remain 0.005×2,700,000 = 13,500 to 0.005×4,500,000 = 22,500 wrong values. Attribute count and accuracy are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依交接資訊需求建立自動檢查規則（必填屬性、編碼格式、空間歸屬、與設備清單的一致性），每批交付都產出通過率報告；並抽樣到現場核對模型中的資產編號、位置與銘牌，確認竣工模型反映實際安裝，而非協調時的設計意圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build automated checks from the handover information requirements (mandatory attributes, code formats, space assignment, consistency with equipment schedules), produce a pass-rate report for every delivery, and sample assets on site to compare model tags, positions and nameplates, confirming that the as-built model reflects what was installed rather than the design intent at coordination.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: 9 stations × 15,000 to 25,000 assets each = 135,000 to 225,000 assets; with 20 attributes per asset that is 2.7 to 4.5 million values. Even at 99.5% accuracy there remain 0.005×2,700,000 = 13,500 to 0.005×4,500,000 = 22,500 wrong values. Attribute count and accuracy are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「竣工模型與資產資訊交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "As-built models and asset-information handover", which statement holds?
options: 碰撞報告為零，就代表現場一定可以順利安裝。
碰撞報告產出後，軟體會自動決定哪個專業必須修改。
optionsEn: A clash report of zero guarantees smooth installation on site.
Once the clash report is produced, the software decides which discipline must change.
9 stations × 15,000 to 25,000 assets each = 135,000 to 225,000 assets; with 20 attributes per asset that is 2.7 to 4.5 million values.
quiz.explanation: 9 站 × 每站 15,000 至 25,000 個資產 = 135,000 至 225,000 個資產；每個資產 20 項屬性時共 2.7 至 4.5 百萬筆資料。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: 9 stations × 15,000 to 25,000 assets each = 135,000 to 225,000 assets; with 20 attributes per asset that is 2.7 to 4.5 million values. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 竣工模型與資產資訊交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: As-built models and asset-information handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資訊模型」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset information model” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依交接資訊需求建立自動檢查規則（必填屬性、編碼格式、空間歸屬、與設備清單的一致性），每批交付都產出通過率報告；並抽樣到現場核對模型中的資產編號、位置與銘牌，確認竣工模型反映實際安裝，而非協調時的設計意圖。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build automated checks from the handover information requirements (mandatory attributes, code formats, space assignment, consistency with equipment schedules), produce a pass-rate report for every delivery, and sample assets on site to compare model tags, positions and nameplates, confirming that the as-built model reflects what was installed rather than the design intent at coordination. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接資訊需求要在招標時寫入合約，指定格式（例如 IFC 與 COBie）、屬性清單與驗收門檻；竣工模型須經現場抽驗與業主營運代表簽認，才能作為最後付款條件之一。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write handover information requirements into the contract at tender, specifying formats (for example IFC and COBie), attribute lists and acceptance thresholds; the as-built model must pass site sampling and sign-off by the owner's operations representative before it counts toward final payment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：所謂竣工模型其實是最後一版協調模型，未反映現場改線，營運單位依模型打開天花板找閥門卻撲空；資產屬性缺漏使維護系統無法匯入，業主只好另外花錢重新盤點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An ‘as-built’ model that is really the last coordination model, missing site re-routes, sends operators opening ceilings to find valves that are not there; missing asset attributes stop the maintenance system from importing data, and the owner pays again for a fresh survey. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 竣工模型與資產資訊交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: As-built models and asset-information handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資訊模型」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset information model” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 所謂竣工模型其實是最後一版協調模型，未反映現場改線，營運單位依模型打開天花板找閥門卻撲空；資產屬性缺漏使維護系統無法匯入，業主只好另外花錢重新盤點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An ‘as-built’ model that is really the last coordination model, missing site re-routes, sends operators opening ceilings to find valves that are not there; missing asset attributes stop the maintenance system from importing data, and the owner pays again for a fresh survey. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Crossrail 中央段九座主要車站每站約有 15,000 至 25,000 個資產，說明交接資料量之大，必須以資料規則自動檢查，不能只靠人工逐一核對。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The nine main Crossrail central-section stations each had about 15,000 to 25,000 assets, showing how large handover data becomes and why it must be checked by automated data rules rather than by hand alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工期間協調用的模型就等於竣工模型。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The model used for coordination during construction is the as-built model." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「竣工模型與資產資訊交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "As-built models and asset-information handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
所謂竣工模型其實是最後一版協調模型，未反映現場改線，營運單位依模型打開天花板找閥門卻撲空；資產屬性缺漏使維護系統無法匯入，業主只好另外花錢重新盤點。
碰撞檢查的主要目的是找建模錯誤，與樓高設計無關。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An ‘as-built’ model that is really the last coordination model, missing site re-routes, sends operators opening ceilings to find valves that are not there.
Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design.
