steps.title: 導線加密、網形平差與閉合差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Traverse densification, network adjustment and misclosure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「閉合導線與平差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closed traverse and adjustment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 平差報告需列出每個觀測的殘差、標準化殘差與多餘觀測分量，標準化殘差超過約 3 的觀測要追查；成果點誤差橢圓的長半軸須小於精度目標，並由另一組人員以不同路徑檢測少數關鍵點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The adjustment report must list residuals, standardised residuals and redundancy numbers for every observation, and any standardised residual above about 3 is investigated; error-ellipse semi-major axes of the resulting points must be below the accuracy target, and a different crew re-checks a few key points by a different route. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：控制加密一律採閉合導線或網形觀測，以最小二乘法平差並保存原始觀測檔；成果表需附平差報告並經測量主管簽核，未簽核的坐標不得用於放樣。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Densify control only with closed traverses or network observations, adjust by least squares and keep the raw observation files; the coordinate list must come with the adjustment report signed by the survey lead, and unsigned coordinates may not be used for set-out.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了趕工以多段支導線一路延伸到基地另一端，既無閉合也無檢核，某一站的後視點認錯導致後續所有點旋轉數十秒，偏差到最後一站已達數公分卻無人察覺。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rushing, a crew extends a chain of open spur traverses to the far end of the site with no closure or check; a wrong backsight at one station rotates every later point by tens of seconds, and the error reaches several centimetres at the last station without anyone noticing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 控制加密一律採閉合導線或網形觀測，以最小二乘法平差並保存原始觀測檔；成果表需附平差報告並經測量主管簽核，未簽核的坐標不得用於放樣。

quiz.question: 要驗證「導線加密、網形平差與閉合差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Traverse densification, network adjustment and misclosure"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
平差報告需列出每個觀測的殘差、標準化殘差與多餘觀測分量，標準化殘差超過約 3 的觀測要追查。
坐標反算的距離就是現場量到的實際距離。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
The adjustment report must list residuals, standardised residuals and redundancy numbers for every observation, and any standardised residual above about 3 is investigated.
The distance computed from coordinates equals the actual distance measured on the ground.

quiz.explanationEn: The adjustment report must list residuals, standardised residuals and redundancy numbers for every observation, and any standardised residual above about 3 is investigated; error-ellipse semi-major axes of the resulting points must be below the accuracy target, and a different crew re-checks a few key points by a different route. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 導線加密、網形平差與閉合差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Traverse densification, network adjustment and misclosure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「閉合導線與平差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closed traverse and adjustment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了趕工以多段支導線一路延伸到基地另一端，既無閉合也無檢核，某一站的後視點認錯導致後續所有點旋轉數十秒，偏差到最後一站已達數公分卻無人察覺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rushing, a crew extends a chain of open spur traverses to the far end of the site with no closure or check; a wrong backsight at one station rotates every later point by tens of seconds, and the error reaches several centimetres at the last station without anyone noticing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：網形必須有足夠的多餘觀測，單一路徑的支導線無法檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The network needs enough redundant observations, since a single open spur traverse cannot be checked.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「閉合差很小，就證明導線中沒有任何錯誤。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small misclosure proves the traverse contains no errors." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了趕工以多段支導線一路延伸到基地另一端，既無閉合也無檢核，某一站的後視點認錯導致後續所有點旋轉數十秒，偏差到最後一站已達數公分卻無人察覺。
knowledge.textEn: Rushing, a crew extends a chain of open spur traverses to the far end of the site with no closure or check; a wrong backsight at one station rotates every later point by tens of seconds, and the error reaches several centimetres at the last station without anyone noticing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「導線加密、網形平差與閉合差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Traverse densification, network adjustment and misclosure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
超高層核心筒在任何時刻都應該量測到完全垂直。
為了趕工以多段支導線一路延伸到基地另一端，既無閉合也無檢核，某一站的後視點認錯導致後續所有點旋轉數十秒，偏差到最後一站已達數公分卻無人察覺。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A supertall core should measure perfectly vertical at any moment.
Rushing, a crew extends a chain of open spur traverses to the far end of the site with no closure or check.
quiz.explanation: 為了趕工以多段支導線一路延伸到基地另一端，既無閉合也無檢核，某一站的後視點認錯導致後續所有點旋轉數十秒，偏差到最後一站已達數公分卻無人察覺。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rushing, a crew extends a chain of open spur traverses to the far end of the site with no closure or check; a wrong backsight at one station rotates every later point by tens of seconds, and the error reaches several centimetres at the last station without anyone noticing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 高層建築的軸線垂直傳遞：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Vertical transfer of grid lines in tall buildings: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樓板垂直傳遞孔」如何影響施工測量控制網的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slab transfer openings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Construction surveying control networks”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 高層建築的軸線要從地面控制逐層往上傳：常用方式是在樓板預留垂直傳遞孔，以天頂垂準儀或雷射垂準儀把地面參考點投到上層，再在上層重建軸線。樓層越高，核心筒會因日照受熱不均而彎曲、因風擺動、因自重與潛變縮短，所以量測要選在清晨溫度均勻、風小的時段；超高層更在核心筒頂部以 GNSS 搭配傾斜儀修正瞬間擺動，並依設計提供的預調量施作，而不是追求當下的絕對垂直。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樓板垂直傳遞孔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grid lines in a tall building are carried up floor by floor from ground control: transfer holes are left in the slabs and zenith or laser plummets project ground reference points to the upper floor, where the grid is re-established. The higher the building, the more the core bends from uneven solar heating, sways in wind and shortens under self-weight and creep, so observations are taken early in the morning when temperatures are even and wind is light; supertall towers also combine GNSS at the top of the core with inclinometers to correct instantaneous sway, and build to the pre-set offsets supplied by the designer rather than chasing momentary absolute verticality. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Slab transfer openings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：核心筒兩側溫差造成的頂部側移 δ ≈ α·ΔT·H²/(2B)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Top drift from a temperature difference across the core δ ≈ α·ΔT·H²/(2B).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超高層核心筒在任何時刻都應該量測到完全垂直。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A supertall core should measure perfectly vertical at any moment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樓板垂直傳遞孔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Slab transfer openings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高層建築的軸線垂直傳遞
knowledge.titleEn: Vertical transfer of grid lines in tall buildings
knowledge.text: 高層建築的軸線要從地面控制逐層往上傳：常用方式是在樓板預留垂直傳遞孔，以天頂垂準儀或雷射垂準儀把地面參考點投到上層，再在上層重建軸線。樓層越高，核心筒會因日照受熱不均而彎曲、因風擺動、因自重與潛變縮短，所以量測要選在清晨溫度均勻、風小的時段；超高層更在核心筒頂部以 GNSS 搭配傾斜儀修正瞬間擺動，並依設計提供的預調量施作，而不是追求當下的絕對垂直。

The higher the building, the more the core bends from uneven solar heating, sways in wind and shortens under self-weight and creep, so observations are taken early in the morning when temperatures are even and wind is light; supertall towers also combine GNSS at the top of the core with inclinometers to correct instantaneous sway, and build to the pre-set offsets supplied by the designer rather than chasing momentary absolute verticality.

knowledge.text: 誤解：超高層核心筒在任何時刻都應該量測到完全垂直。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A supertall core should measure perfectly vertical at any moment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高層建築的軸線垂直傳遞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 高層建築的軸線垂直傳遞：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板垂直傳遞孔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slab transfer openings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：核心筒兩側溫差造成的頂部側移 δ ≈ α·ΔT·H²/(2B)。取 α = 1.0×10⁻⁵/°C、ΔT = 5°C、高度 H = 300 m、寬度 B = 30 m：δ = 1.0×10⁻⁵×5×300²/(2×30) = 4.5/60 = 0.075 m = 75 mm。相較之下，每 30 m 接力一次、每次 ±1.5 mm 的垂準傳遞，10 次合成 √10×1.5 ≈ 4.7 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Top drift from a temperature difference across the core δ ≈ α·ΔT·H²/(2B). With α = 1.0×10⁻⁵/°C, ΔT = 5°C, height H = 300 m and width B = 30 m: δ = 1.0×10⁻⁵×5×300²/(2×30) = 4.5/60 = 0.075 m = 75 mm. By comparison, plumb transfers relayed every 30 m with ±1.5 mm each combine over 10 relays to √10×1.5 ≈ 4.7 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次傳遞後在上層以至少三個傳遞點檢查彼此的距離與角度，與地面值比較；高樓層同時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀記錄核心筒當時的偏移，換算回設計的理論位置，並定期由底層重新傳遞一次，避免接力誤差累積。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each transfer, check distances and angles between at least three transferred points on the upper floor against their ground values; at high levels record the core's instantaneous offset with GNSS and inclinometers, convert back to the designer's theoretical position, and periodically re-transfer from the base to stop relay errors accumulating.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 核心筒兩側溫差造成的頂部側移 δ ≈ α·ΔT·H²/(2B)。取 α = 1.0×10⁻⁵/°C、ΔT = 5°C、高度 H = 300 m、寬度 B = 30 m：δ = 1.0×10⁻⁵×5×300²/(2×30) = 4.5/60 = 0.075 m = 75 mm。相較之下，每 30 m 接力一次、每次 ±1.5 mm 的垂準傳遞，10 次合成 √10×1.5 ≈ 4.7 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Top drift from a temperature difference across the core δ ≈ α·ΔT·H²/(2B). With α = 1.0×10⁻⁵/°C, ΔT = 5°C, height H = 300 m and width B = 30 m: δ = 1.0×10⁻⁵×5×300²/(2×30) = 4.5/60 = 0.075 m = 75 mm. By comparison, plumb transfers relayed every 30 m with ±1.5 mm each combine over 10 relays to √10×1.5 ≈ 4.7 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高層建築的軸線垂直傳遞」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Vertical transfer of grid lines in tall buildings", which statement holds?
options: 監測點的變位一定代表結構移動，與參考點無關。
核心筒兩側溫差造成的頂部側移 δ ≈ α·ΔT·H²/(2B)。
只要用最精密的儀器，就不需要規劃控制網層級與誤差分配。
optionsEn: Any movement of a monitored point means the structure moved, regardless of the reference points.
Top drift from a temperature difference across the core δ ≈ α·ΔT·H²/(2B).
With the most precise instrument there is no need to plan network hierarchy or error allocation.
quiz.explanation: 核心筒兩側溫差造成的頂部側移 δ ≈ α·ΔT·H²/(2B)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Top drift from a temperature difference across the core δ ≈ α·ΔT·H²/(2B). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高層建築的軸線垂直傳遞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vertical transfer of grid lines in tall buildings: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓板垂直傳遞孔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slab transfer openings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每次傳遞後在上層以至少三個傳遞點檢查彼此的距離與角度，與地面值比較；高樓層同時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀記錄核心筒當時的偏移，換算回設計的理論位置，並定期由底層重新傳遞一次，避免接力誤差累積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each transfer, check distances and angles between at least three transferred points on the upper floor against their ground values; at high levels record the core's instantaneous offset with GNSS and inclinometers, convert back to the designer's theoretical position, and periodically re-transfer from the base to stop relay errors accumulating. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：垂直傳遞作業程序要規定觀測時段、風速與溫差門檻、傳遞點數量與回到底層重新傳遞的間隔；預調量由結構設計者以書面提供，測量單位不得自行決定修正量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The vertical-transfer procedure should set observation windows, wind and temperature-difference limits, the number of transfer points and the interval for re-transferring from the base; pre-set offsets come in writing from the structural designer, and surveyors must not decide corrections on their own.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在午後日照強烈時做垂直傳遞，把核心筒暫時的熱彎曲當成施工偏差並在上層修正，第二天清晨結構回彎，軸線反而被修歪；長期只依賴下一層接力而不回到底層檢核，誤差逐層累積。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A transfer made in strong afternoon sun treats temporary thermal bending of the core as construction error and corrects it on the upper floor; the next morning the structure straightens and the grid is now wrong. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每次傳遞後在上層以至少三個傳遞點檢查彼此的距離與角度，與地面值比較；高樓層同時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀記錄核心筒當時的偏移，換算回設計的理論位置，並定期由底層重新傳遞一次，避免接力誤差累積。
knowledge.textEn: After each transfer, check distances and angles between at least three transferred points on the upper floor against their ground values; at high levels record the core's instantaneous offset with GNSS and inclinometers, convert back to the designer's theoretical position, and periodically re-transfer from the base to stop relay errors accumulating.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 垂直傳遞作業程序要規定觀測時段、風速與溫差門檻、傳遞點數量與回到底層重新傳遞的間隔；預調量由結構設計者以書面提供，測量單位不得自行決定修正量。
knowledge.textEn: The vertical-transfer procedure should set observation windows, wind and temperature-difference limits, the number of transfer points and the interval for re-transferring from the base; pre-set offsets come in writing from the structural designer, and surveyors must not decide corrections on their own.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高層建築的軸線垂直傳遞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Vertical transfer of grid lines in tall buildings"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
控制點一旦埋設完成，坐標就永遠不會改變。
每次傳遞後在上層以至少三個傳遞點檢查彼此的距離與角度，與地面值比較。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Once a control point is installed, its coordinates never change.
After each transfer, check distances and angles between at least three transferred points on the upper floor against their ground values.
quiz.explanation: 每次傳遞後在上層以至少三個傳遞點檢查彼此的距離與角度，與地面值比較；高樓層同時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀記錄核心筒當時的偏移，換算回設計的理論位置，並定期由底層重新傳遞一次，避免接力誤差累積。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After each transfer, check distances and angles between at least three transferred points on the upper floor against their ground values; at high levels record the core's instantaneous offset with GNSS and inclinometers, convert back to the designer's theoretical position, and periodically re-transfer from the base to stop relay errors accumulating. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高層建築的軸線垂直傳遞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vertical transfer of grid lines in tall buildings: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓板垂直傳遞孔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slab transfer openings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在午後日照強烈時做垂直傳遞，把核心筒暫時的熱彎曲當成施工偏差並在上層修正，第二天清晨結構回彎，軸線反而被修歪；長期只依賴下一層接力而不回到底層檢核，誤差逐層累積。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A transfer made in strong afternoon sun treats temporary thermal bending of the core as construction error and corrects it on the upper floor; the next morning the structure straightens and the grid is now wrong. Relying for months on relays from the floor below without re-checking from the base lets errors accumulate floor by floor. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：樓層越高，核心筒會因日照受熱不均而彎曲、因風擺動、因自重與潛變縮短，所以量測要選在清晨溫度均勻、風小的時段；超高層更在核心筒頂部以 GNSS 搭配傾斜儀修正瞬間擺動，並依設計提供的預調量施作，而不是追求當下的絕對垂直。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The higher the building, the more the core bends from uneven solar heating, sways in wind and shortens under self-weight and creep, so observations are taken early in the morning when temperatures are even and wind is light; supertall towers also combine GNSS at the top of the core with inclinometers to correct instantaneous sway, and build to the pre-set offsets supplied by the designer rather than chasing momentary absolute verticality.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超高層核心筒在任何時刻都應該量測到完全垂直。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A supertall core should measure perfectly vertical at any moment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在午後日照強烈時做垂直傳遞，把核心筒暫時的熱彎曲當成施工偏差並在上層修正，第二天清晨結構回彎，軸線反而被修歪；長期只依賴下一層接力而不回到底層檢核，誤差逐層累積。
knowledge.textEn: A transfer made in strong afternoon sun treats temporary thermal bending of the core as construction error and corrects it on the upper floor; the next morning the structure straightens and the grid is now wrong. Relying for months on relays from the floor below without re-checking from the base lets errors accumulate floor by floor.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高層建築的軸線垂直傳遞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Vertical transfer of grid lines in tall buildings" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在午後日照強烈時做垂直傳遞，把核心筒暫時的熱彎曲當成施工偏差並在上層修正，第二天清晨結構回彎，軸線反而被修歪。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
GNSS 量到的高程就是海拔高度。
optionsEn: A transfer made in strong afternoon sun treats temporary thermal bending of the core as construction error and corrects it on the upper floor.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The height measured by GNSS is the height above sea level.
quiz.explanation: 在午後日照強烈時做垂直傳遞，把核心筒暫時的熱彎曲當成施工偏差並在上層修正，第二天清晨結構回彎，軸線反而被修歪；長期只依賴下一層接力而不回到底層檢核，誤差逐層累積。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A transfer made in strong afternoon sun treats temporary thermal bending of the core as construction error and corrects it on the upper floor; the next morning the structure straightens and the grid is now wrong. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算」與「長隧道貫通與誤差傳播」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Static GNSS surveys and height conversion" and "Long-tunnel breakthrough and error propagation": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Static GNSS surveys and height conversion: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「GNSS 靜態基線」如何影響施工測量控制網的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “GNSS static baselines” governs force, deformation or durability in “Construction surveying control networks”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: GNSS 靜態測量在多個控制點同時長時間接收衛星訊號，以載波相位解算點與點之間的基線向量，精度可達公釐級，適合建立大範圍主控制網。為了避免同一組衛星幾何與大氣狀況造成的系統誤差，重要基線要在不同日期、不同時段重複觀測。GNSS 直接得到的是橢球高 h，工程需要的是以平均海水面為基準的正高 H，兩者相差大地起伏 N，必須以大地水準面模型換算，並以精密水準檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「GNSS 靜態基線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A static GNSS survey records satellite signals at several control points simultaneously for long periods and solves baseline vectors between them from carrier phase, reaching millimetre-level precision suited to large primary networks. To avoid systematic errors from one satellite geometry and atmosphere, important baselines are re-observed on different days at different times. GNSS gives ellipsoidal height h directly, whereas works need orthometric height H referred to mean sea level; the two differ by the geoid undulation N, so a geoid model is used for conversion and precise levelling for checking. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “GNSS static baselines” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：H = h − N。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: H = h − N.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「GNSS 量到的高程就是海拔高度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The height measured by GNSS is the height above sea level." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「GNSS 靜態基線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “GNSS static baselines”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算
knowledge.titleEn: Static GNSS surveys and height conversion
knowledge.text: GNSS 靜態測量在多個控制點同時長時間接收衛星訊號，以載波相位解算點與點之間的基線向量，精度可達公釐級，適合建立大範圍主控制網。為了避免同一組衛星幾何與大氣狀況造成的系統誤差，重要基線要在不同日期、不同時段重複觀測。
knowledge.textEn: A static GNSS survey records satellite signals at several control points simultaneously for long periods and solves baseline vectors between them from carrier phase, reaching millimetre-level precision suited to large primary networks. To avoid systematic errors from one satellite geometry and atmosphere, important baselines are re-observed on different days at different times.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：GNSS 量到的高程就是海拔高度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The height measured by GNSS is the height above sea level. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Static GNSS surveys and height conversion" is correct?
options: GNSS 量到的高程就是海拔高度。
GNSS 靜態測量在多個控制點同時長時間接收衛星訊號，以載波相位解算點與點之間的基線向量，精度可達公釐級，適合建立大範圍主控制網。
隧道內導線只要每站量得夠準，就不需要獨立定向檢核。
optionsEn: The height measured by GNSS is the height above sea level.

A static GNSS survey records satellite signals at several control points simultaneously for long periods and solves baseline vectors between them from carrier phase, reaching millimetre-level precision suited to large primary networks.
If each underground traverse station is measured precisely enough, no independent orientation check is needed.
quiz.explanation: GNSS 靜態測量在多個控制點同時長時間接收衛星訊號，以載波相位解算點與點之間的基線向量，精度可達公釐級，適合建立大範圍主控制網。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A static GNSS survey records satellite signals at several control points simultaneously for long periods and solves baseline vectors between them from carrier phase, reaching millimetre-level precision suited to large primary networks. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Static GNSS surveys and height conversion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「GNSS 靜態基線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “GNSS static baselines” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：H = h − N。某點 GNSS 橢球高 h = 52.318 m、模型大地起伏 N = 21.740 m，H = 52.318 − 21.740 = 30.578 m。精密水準 2 km 閉合路線若容許 3 mm√K = 3×√2 ≈ 4.2 mm，而 GNSS 推得高程與水準相差 18 mm：雖在約 2 cm 的大地水準面模型不確定度內，仍超出水準容許值，施工高程應以水準為準。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: H = h − N. With GNSS ellipsoidal height h = 52.318 m and model undulation N = 21.740 m, H = 52.318 − 21.740 = 30.578 m. If a 2 km precise-levelling loop allows 3 mm√K = 3×√2 ≈ 4.2 mm and the GNSS-derived height differs from levelling by 18 mm, it lies within a geoid-model uncertainty of about 2 cm yet beyond the levelling tolerance, so construction heights should follow levelling. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：參考 NOAA NGS-58 一類指引：每條相鄰基線至少在兩個不同日期、不同時段觀測，重複高差超過門檻就重測；網形平差時檢查基線閉合環，最後以精密水準聯測數個 GNSS 點，比較換算正高與水準高程，確認大地水準面模型在本地適用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Following guidance such as NOAA NGS-58, observe every adjacent baseline on at least two different days at different times and re-observe when repeat height differences exceed the threshold; check baseline loop closures in the network adjustment, and finally tie several GNSS points by precise levelling to compare converted orthometric heights with levelled heights, confirming that the geoid model fits locally.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: H = h − N。某點 GNSS 橢球高 h = 52.318 m、模型大地起伏 N = 21.740 m，H = 52.318 − 21.740 = 30.578 m。精密水準 2 km 閉合路線若容許 3 mm√K = 3×√2 ≈ 4.2 mm，而 GNSS 推得高程與水準相差 18 mm：雖在約 2 cm 的大地水準面模型不確定度內，仍超出水準容許值，施工高程應以水準為準。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: H = h − N. With GNSS ellipsoidal height h = 52.318 m and model undulation N = 21.740 m, H = 52.318 − 21.740 = 30.578 m. If a 2 km precise-levelling loop allows 3 mm√K = 3×√2 ≈ 4.2 mm and the GNSS-derived height differs from levelling by 18 mm, it lies within a geoid-model uncertainty of about 2 cm yet beyond the levelling tolerance, so construction heights should follow levelling. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Static GNSS surveys and height conversion", which statement holds?
options: 坐標是永久不變的數字，只要記錄數值本身就足夠。
坐標反算的距離就是現場量到的實際距離。
H = h − N。
optionsEn: Coordinates are permanent numbers, so recording the values alone is enough.
The distance computed from coordinates equals the actual distance measured on the ground.
H = h − N.
quiz.explanation: H = h − N。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: H = h − N. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Static GNSS surveys and height conversion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「GNSS 靜態基線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “GNSS static baselines” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 參考 NOAA NGS-58 一類指引：每條相鄰基線至少在兩個不同日期、不同時段觀測，重複高差超過門檻就重測；網形平差時檢查基線閉合環，最後以精密水準聯測數個 GNSS 點，比較換算正高與水準高程，確認大地水準面模型在本地適用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Following guidance such as NOAA NGS-58, observe every adjacent baseline on at least two different days at different times and re-observe when repeat height differences exceed the threshold; check baseline loop closures in the network adjustment, and finally tie several GNSS points by precise levelling to compare converted orthometric heights with levelled heights, confirming that the geoid model fits locally. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：主控制網一律採靜態 GNSS 加重複觀測並與國家控制點聯測，高程以精密水準傳遞；RTK 只用於次級控制與碎部，且每天開工前先在已知點上檢核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Establish primary control only by static GNSS with repeat sessions tied to national control points, carry heights by precise levelling, and use RTK only for secondary control and detail, checking it on a known point before each day's work.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以單次短時間 RTK 量測建立主控制，未做重複觀測，又把橢球高直接當作正高使用，結果基地兩端的高程基準相差數十公分，排水坡度與結構標高全部出錯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Establishing primary control from single short RTK occupations without repeats, and using ellipsoidal height directly as orthometric height, leaves the height datum at the two ends of the site tens of centimetres apart, so drainage falls and structural levels are all wrong. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 參考 NOAA NGS-58 一類指引：每條相鄰基線至少在兩個不同日期、不同時段觀測，重複高差超過門檻就重測；網形平差時檢查基線閉合環，最後以精密水準聯測數個 GNSS 點，比較換算正高與水準高程，確認大地水準面模型在本地適用。
knowledge.textEn: Following guidance such as NOAA NGS-58, observe every adjacent baseline on at least two different days at different times and re-observe when repeat height differences exceed the threshold; check baseline loop closures in the network adjustment, and finally tie several GNSS points by precise levelling to compare converted orthometric heights with levelled heights, confirming that the geoid model fits locally.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 主控制網一律採靜態 GNSS 加重複觀測並與國家控制點聯測，高程以精密水準傳遞；RTK 只用於次級控制與碎部，且每天開工前先在已知點上檢核。
knowledge.textEn: Establish primary control only by static GNSS with repeat sessions tied to national control points, carry heights by precise levelling, and use RTK only for secondary control and detail, checking it on a known point before each day's work.

quiz.question: 要驗證「GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Static GNSS surveys and height conversion"?
options: 參考 NOAA NGS-58 一類指引：每條相鄰基線至少在兩個不同日期、不同時段觀測，重複高差超過門檻就重測。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
儀器規格表上的精度，就是現場實際能達到的精度。
optionsEn: Following guidance such as NOAA NGS-58, observe every adjacent baseline on at least two different days at different times and re-observe when repeat height differences exceed the threshold.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The accuracy on the instrument data sheet is what will be achieved on site.
quiz.explanation: 參考 NOAA NGS-58 一類指引：每條相鄰基線至少在兩個不同日期、不同時段觀測，重複高差超過門檻就重測；網形平差時檢查基線閉合環，最後以精密水準聯測數個 GNSS 點，比較換算正高與水準高程，確認大地水準面模型在本地適用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Following guidance such as NOAA NGS-58, observe every adjacent baseline on at least two different days at different times and re-observe when repeat height differences exceed the threshold; check baseline loop closures in the network adjustment, and finally tie several GNSS points by precise levelling to compare converted orthometric heights with levelled heights, confirming that the geoid model fits locally. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Static GNSS surveys and height conversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「GNSS 靜態基線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “GNSS static baselines” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以單次短時間 RTK 量測建立主控制，未做重複觀測，又把橢球高直接當作正高使用，結果基地兩端的高程基準相差數十公分，排水坡度與結構標高全部出錯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Establishing primary control from single short RTK occupations without repeats, and using ellipsoidal height directly as orthometric height, leaves the height datum at the two ends of the site tens of centimetres apart, so drainage falls and structural levels are all wrong. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：GNSS 直接得到的是橢球高 h，工程需要的是以平均海水面為基準的正高 H，兩者相差大地起伏 N，必須以大地水準面模型換算，並以精密水準檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: GNSS gives ellipsoidal height h directly, whereas works need orthometric height H referred to mean sea level; the two differ by the geoid undulation N, so a geoid model is used for conversion and precise levelling for checking.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「GNSS 量到的高程就是海拔高度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The height measured by GNSS is the height above sea level." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以單次短時間 RTK 量測建立主控制，未做重複觀測，又把橢球高直接當作正高使用，結果基地兩端的高程基準相差數十公分，排水坡度與結構標高全部出錯。
knowledge.textEn: Establishing primary control from single short RTK occupations without repeats, and using ellipsoidal height directly as orthometric height, leaves the height datum at the two ends of the site tens of centimetres apart, so drainage falls and structural levels are all wrong.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Static GNSS surveys and height conversion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
以單次短時間 RTK 量測建立主控制，未做重複觀測，又把橢球高直接當作正高使用，結果基地兩端的高程基準相差數十公分，排水坡度與結構標高全部出錯。
隧道內導線只要每站量得夠準，就不需要獨立定向檢核。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Establishing primary control from single short RTK occupations without repeats, and using ellipsoidal height directly as orthometric height, leaves the height datum at the two ends of the site tens of centimetres apart, so drainage falls and structural levels are all wrong.
If each underground traverse station is measured precisely enough, no independent orientation check is needed.
quiz.explanation: 以單次短時間 RTK 量測建立主控制，未做重複觀測，又把橢球高直接當作正高使用，結果基地兩端的高程基準相差數十公分，排水坡度與結構標高全部出錯。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Establishing primary control from single short RTK occupations without repeats, and using ellipsoidal height directly as orthometric height, leaves the height datum at the two ends of the site tens of centimetres apart, so drainage falls and structural levels are all wrong. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 長隧道貫通與誤差傳播：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-tunnel breakthrough and error propagation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「隧道貫通誤差」如何影響施工測量控制網的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tunnel breakthrough error” governs force, deformation or durability in “Construction surveying control networks”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 長隧道從兩端或多個工作面對向開挖，洞內只能以導線向前延伸，沒有外部檢核，誤差隨長度累積，其中方位角誤差造成的橫向偏差隨距離線性放大。因此隧道測量要先在洞口建立高精度地面網，洞內採雙重導線、以陀螺經緯儀獨立定向並定期回測，才能把貫通偏差控制在公分級。戈達基線隧道東管 2010 年貫通時橫向偏差約 8 cm、垂直約 1 cm；1990 年英法海底隧道服務隧道貫通時約偏 30 cm 與 8 cm。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「隧道貫通誤差」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A long tunnel is driven from both ends or several faces toward each other, and underground the control can only be extended by traverse with no outside check, so errors accumulate with length; lateral deviation from azimuth error grows linearly with distance. Tunnel surveys therefore begin with a high-accuracy surface network at the portals, then use double traverses underground, independent orientation by gyro-theodolite and regular re-measurement to hold the breakthrough deviation to centimetres. The east tube of the Gotthard Base Tunnel broke through in 2010 with about 8 cm lateral and 1 cm vertical deviation; the Channel Tunnel service tunnel met in 1990 about 30 cm and 8 cm apart. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tunnel breakthrough error” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：方位角誤差 σ_α 造成的橫向偏差 e = L·σ_α。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Lateral deviation from azimuth error σ_α is e = L·σ_α.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道內導線只要每站量得夠準，就不需要獨立定向檢核。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If each underground traverse station is measured precisely enough, no independent orientation check is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「隧道貫通誤差」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tunnel breakthrough error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長隧道貫通與誤差傳播
knowledge.text: 長隧道從兩端或多個工作面對向開挖，洞內只能以導線向前延伸，沒有外部檢核，誤差隨長度累積，其中方位角誤差造成的橫向偏差隨距離線性放大。因此隧道測量要先在洞口建立高精度地面網，洞內採雙重導線、以陀螺經緯儀獨立定向並定期回測，才能把貫通偏差控制在公分級。
knowledge.textEn: A long tunnel is driven from both ends or several faces toward each other, and underground the control can only be extended by traverse with no outside check, so errors accumulate with length; lateral deviation from azimuth error grows linearly with distance. Tunnel surveys therefore begin with a high-accuracy surface network at the portals, then use double traverses underground, independent orientation by gyro-theodolite and regular re-measurement to hold the breakthrough deviation to centimetres.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隧道內導線只要每站量得夠準，就不需要獨立定向檢核。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If each underground traverse station is measured precisely enough, no independent orientation check is needed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長隧道貫通與誤差傳播」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-tunnel breakthrough and error propagation" is correct?
options: 隧道內導線只要每站量得夠準，就不需要獨立定向檢核。
監測點的變位一定代表結構移動，與參考點無關。
長隧道從兩端或多個工作面對向開挖，洞內只能以導線向前延伸，沒有外部檢核，誤差隨長度累積，其中方位角誤差造成的橫向偏差隨距離線性放大。
optionsEn: If each underground traverse station is measured precisely enough, no independent orientation check is needed.
Any movement of a monitored point means the structure moved, regardless of the reference points.
A long tunnel is driven from both ends or several faces toward each other, and underground the control can only be extended by traverse with no outside check, so errors accumulate with length.
quiz.explanation: 長隧道從兩端或多個工作面對向開挖，洞內只能以導線向前延伸，沒有外部檢核，誤差隨長度累積，其中方位角誤差造成的橫向偏差隨距離線性放大。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A long tunnel is driven from both ends or several faces toward each other, and underground the control can only be extended by traverse with no outside check, so errors accumulate with length; lateral deviation from azimuth error grows linearly with distance. The other options are common misconceptions.
