steps.instruction: 報告只給整棟樓「95% 點位在公差內」的單一數字，實際上 5% 的超差點全集中在帷幕牆托架所在的樓板邊緣，直到帷幕牆單元到場無法安裝才被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A report giving a single building-wide figure of ‘95% of points within tolerance’ hides that the 5% outside are all at slab edges where façade brackets sit, so the problem appears only when curtain-wall units arrive and cannot be installed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此偏差分析要同時檢視平均偏移與離散程度，並逐一元素呈現，而非整棟建築一個數字。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Deviation analysis must therefore examine mean offset and scatter together, element by element rather than as one number for the building.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「偏差圖大部分是綠色，就代表竣工品質合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the deviation map is mostly green, the as-built quality is acceptable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 報告只給整棟樓「95% 點位在公差內」的單一數字，實際上 5% 的超差點全集中在帷幕牆托架所在的樓板邊緣，直到帷幕牆單元到場無法安裝才被發現。
knowledge.textEn: A report giving a single building-wide figure of ‘95% of points within tolerance’ hides that the 5% outside are all at slab edges where façade brackets sit, so the problem appears only when curtain-wall units arrive and cannot be installed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「點雲與設計模型的偏差分析」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Deviation analysis between cloud and design model" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
報告只給整棟樓「95% 點位在公差內」的單一數字，實際上 5% 的超差點全集中在帷幕牆托架所在的樓板邊緣，直到帷幕牆單元到場無法安裝才被發現。
配準軟體報告的誤差就是點雲的絕對精度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

A report giving a single building-wide figure of ‘95% of points within tolerance’ hides that the 5% outside are all at slab edges where façade brackets sit, so the problem appears only when curtain-wall units arrive and cannot be installed.
The error reported by registration software is the absolute accuracy of the cloud.
quiz.explanation: 報告只給整棟樓「95% 點位在公差內」的單一數字，實際上 5% 的超差點全集中在帷幕牆托架所在的樓板邊緣，直到帷幕牆單元到場無法安裝才被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A report giving a single building-wide figure of ‘95% of points within tolerance’ hides that the 5% outside are all at slab edges where façade brackets sit, so the problem appears only when curtain-wall units arrive and cannot be installed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 掃描精度驗證與儀器檢定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Verifying scan accuracy and testing scanners: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「獨立檢核點」如何影響建築雷射掃描竣工比對的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Independent check points” governs force, deformation or durability in “Laser-scan verification of as-built construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 掃描成果的精度不能只引用儀器規格或配準軟體的數字，而要以獨立檢核點證明：在掃描範圍內設置一批由全測站量測、未參與配準的檢核點，比較它們在點雲中的坐標與全測站坐標，計算均方根誤差。ISO 17123-9 規定以現場程序檢查地面雷射掃描儀的重複精度，可在專案開始前與定期檢查時使用；檢核結果再與 LOA 規格比較，決定成果能否用於判定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「獨立檢核點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The accuracy of a scan cannot simply be quoted from the instrument specification or the registration software; it must be shown with independent check points. A set of points surveyed by total station, not used in registration, is placed within the scanned area, and their cloud coordinates are compared with total-station coordinates to compute the root-mean-square error. ISO 17123-9 gives field procedures for checking the repeatability of terrestrial laser scanners, usable before a project and at periodic checks, and the check-point result is compared with the LOA specification to decide whether the data can support conformance decisions. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Independent check points” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Ten check-point residuals (mm) of 2.1, −1.5, 3.0, −2.4, 1.2, 0.8, −2.9, 1.9, −0.6 and 2.6 give a sum of squares of 42.64 and RMSE = √(42.64/10) = √4.264 ≈ 2.06 mm, a 2σ of about 4.1 mm, inside a 1 to 5 mm class but near its upper bound.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「配準軟體報告的誤差就是點雲的絕對精度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The error reported by registration software is the absolute accuracy of the cloud." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「獨立檢核點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Independent check points”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 掃描精度驗證與儀器檢定
knowledge.titleEn: Verifying scan accuracy and testing scanners
knowledge.text: 掃描成果的精度不能只引用儀器規格或配準軟體的數字，而要以獨立檢核點證明：在掃描範圍內設置一批由全測站量測、未參與配準的檢核點，比較它們在點雲中的坐標與全測站坐標，計算均方根誤差。ISO 17123-9 規定以現場程序檢查地面雷射掃描儀的重複精度，可在專案開始前與定期檢查時使用；檢核結果再與 LOA 規格比較，決定成果能否用於判定。
knowledge.textEn: The accuracy of a scan cannot simply be quoted from the instrument specification or the registration software; it must be shown with independent check points. A set of points surveyed by total station, not used in registration, is placed within the scanned area, and their cloud coordinates are compared with total-station coordinates to compute the root-mean-square error.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：配準軟體報告的誤差就是點雲的絕對精度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The error reported by registration software is the absolute accuracy of the cloud. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「掃描精度驗證與儀器檢定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Verifying scan accuracy and testing scanners" is correct?
options: 配準軟體報告的誤差就是點雲的絕對精度。
兩期點雲直接相減，就能偵測到小於單點雜訊的變形。
掃描成果的精度不能只引用儀器規格或配準軟體的數字，而要以獨立檢核點證明：在掃描範圍內設置一批由全測站量測、未參與配準的檢核點，比較它們在點雲中的坐標與全測站坐標，計算均方根誤差。
optionsEn: The error reported by registration software is the absolute accuracy of the cloud.
Subtracting two point clouds directly detects deformation smaller than single-point noise.
The accuracy of a scan cannot simply be quoted from the instrument specification or the registration software; it must be shown with independent check points.
quiz.explanation: 掃描成果的精度不能只引用儀器規格或配準軟體的數字，而要以獨立檢核點證明：在掃描範圍內設置一批由全測站量測、未參與配準的檢核點，比較它們在點雲中的坐標與全測站坐標，計算均方根誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The accuracy of a scan cannot simply be quoted from the instrument specification or the registration software; it must be shown with independent check points. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 掃描精度驗證與儀器檢定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Verifying scan accuracy and testing scanners: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「獨立檢核點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Independent check points” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：10 個檢核點的殘差（mm）為 2.1、−1.5、3.0、−2.4、1.2、0.8、−2.9、1.9、−0.6、2.6，平方和 = 42.64，RMSE = √(42.64/10) = √4.264 ≈ 2.06 mm，2σ 約 4.1 mm，落在 1 至 5 mm 的等級範圍內但接近上限。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Ten check-point residuals (mm) of 2.1, −1.5, 3.0, −2.4, 1.2, 0.8, −2.9, 1.9, −0.6 and 2.6 give a sum of squares of 42.64 and RMSE = √(42.64/10) = √4.264 ≈ 2.06 mm, a 2σ of about 4.1 mm, inside a 1 to 5 mm class but near its upper bound. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢核點應分布在掃描範圍四周與中央、不同高度與距離，數量依面積訂定；每台掃描儀在專案開始前依 ISO 17123-9 做現場檢定並保存紀錄，檢核點結果與 LOA 規格一起列入交付報告，未達規格者重掃或補控制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Distribute check points around the edges and centre of the scanned area at different heights and ranges, with numbers set by area; test each scanner in the field to ISO 17123-9 before the project and keep the records, include check-point results with the LOA specification in the delivery report, and re-scan or add control where the specification is not met.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Ten check-point residuals (mm) of 2.1, −1.5, 3.0, −2.4, 1.2, 0.8, −2.9, 1.9, −0.6 and 2.6 give a sum of squares of 42.64 and RMSE = √(42.64/10) = √4.264 ≈ 2.06 mm, a 2σ of about 4.1 mm, inside a 1 to 5 mm class but near its upper bound. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「掃描精度驗證與儀器檢定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Verifying scan accuracy and testing scanners", which statement holds?
options: 點雲有數百萬個點，所以每一點都比全測站量測更準確。
掃描儀的標稱精度在任何距離與角度都一樣。
optionsEn: Ten check-point residuals (mm) of 2.1, −1.5, 3.0, −2.4, 1.2, 0.8, −2.9, 1.9, −0.6 and 2.6 give a sum of squares of 42.64 and RMSE = √(42.64/10) = √4.264 ≈ 2.06 mm, a 2σ of about 4.1 mm, inside a 1 to 5 mm class but near its upper bound.
A point cloud has millions of points, so every point is more accurate than a total-station measurement.
A scanner's nominal accuracy holds at every range and angle.
quiz.explanationEn: Ten check-point residuals (mm) of 2.1, −1.5, 3.0, −2.4, 1.2, 0.8, −2.9, 1.9, −0.6 and 2.6 give a sum of squares of 42.64 and RMSE = √(42.64/10) = √4.264 ≈ 2.06 mm, a 2σ of about 4.1 mm, inside a 1 to 5 mm class but near its upper bound. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 掃描精度驗證與儀器檢定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Verifying scan accuracy and testing scanners: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「獨立檢核點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Independent check points” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢核點應分布在掃描範圍四周與中央、不同高度與距離，數量依面積訂定；每台掃描儀在專案開始前依 ISO 17123-9 做現場檢定並保存紀錄，檢核點結果與 LOA 規格一起列入交付報告，未達規格者重掃或補控制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Distribute check points around the edges and centre of the scanned area at different heights and ranges, with numbers set by area; test each scanner in the field to ISO 17123-9 before the project and keep the records, include check-point results with the LOA specification in the delivery report, and re-scan or add control where the specification is not met. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交付規格要求每個掃描區附獨立檢核點報告與儀器檢定紀錄，檢核點不得用於配準；監造驗收以檢核點結果為準，不接受只有軟體統計的成果。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Delivery specifications require an independent check-point report and instrument test record for every scan area, with check points excluded from registration; the supervising engineer accepts on check-point results and rejects deliveries supported only by software statistics.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以配準軟體顯示的「平均誤差 1 mm」作為精度證明，沒有任何獨立檢核；後來以全測站抽驗發現點雲整體旋轉，遠端偏差達 15 mm，已據以下料的帷幕牆托架必須重做。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using the registration software's ‘mean error 1 mm’ as the only proof of accuracy, with no independent checks, a later total-station spot check finds the cloud rotated so that far points are 15 mm out, and façade brackets already cut from it must be remade. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢核點應分布在掃描範圍四周與中央、不同高度與距離，數量依面積訂定；每台掃描儀在專案開始前依 ISO 17123-9 做現場檢定並保存紀錄，檢核點結果與 LOA 規格一起列入交付報告，未達規格者重掃或補控制。
knowledge.textEn: Distribute check points around the edges and centre of the scanned area at different heights and ranges, with numbers set by area; test each scanner in the field to ISO 17123-9 before the project and keep the records, include check-point results with the LOA specification in the delivery report, and re-scan or add control where the specification is not met.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交付規格要求每個掃描區附獨立檢核點報告與儀器檢定紀錄，檢核點不得用於配準；監造驗收以檢核點結果為準，不接受只有軟體統計的成果。
knowledge.textEn: Delivery specifications require an independent check-point report and instrument test record for every scan area, with check points excluded from registration; the supervising engineer accepts on check-point results and rejects deliveries supported only by software statistics.

quiz.question: 要驗證「掃描精度驗證與儀器檢定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Verifying scan accuracy and testing scanners"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
檢核點應分布在掃描範圍四周與中央、不同高度與距離，數量依面積訂定。
竣工掃描可以等全部完工後一次做完就好。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Distribute check points around the edges and centre of the scanned area at different heights and ranges, with numbers set by area.
As-built scanning can wait until everything is finished and be done once.
quiz.explanation: 檢核點應分布在掃描範圍四周與中央、不同高度與距離，數量依面積訂定；每台掃描儀在專案開始前依 ISO 17123-9 做現場檢定並保存紀錄，檢核點結果與 LOA 規格一起列入交付報告，未達規格者重掃或補控制。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Distribute check points around the edges and centre of the scanned area at different heights and ranges, with numbers set by area; test each scanner in the field to ISO 17123-9 before the project and keep the records, include check-point results with the LOA specification in the delivery report, and re-scan or add control where the specification is not met. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 掃描精度驗證與儀器檢定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Verifying scan accuracy and testing scanners: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「獨立檢核點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Independent check points” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以配準軟體顯示的「平均誤差 1 mm」作為精度證明，沒有任何獨立檢核；後來以全測站抽驗發現點雲整體旋轉，遠端偏差達 15 mm，已據以下料的帷幕牆托架必須重做。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using the registration software's ‘mean error 1 mm’ as the only proof of accuracy, with no independent checks, a later total-station spot check finds the cloud rotated so that far points are 15 mm out, and façade brackets already cut from it must be remade. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：ISO 17123-9 規定以現場程序檢查地面雷射掃描儀的重複精度，可在專案開始前與定期檢查時使用；檢核結果再與 LOA 規格比較，決定成果能否用於判定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: ISO 17123-9 gives field procedures for checking the repeatability of terrestrial laser scanners, usable before a project and at periodic checks, and the check-point result is compared with the LOA specification to decide whether the data can support conformance decisions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「配準軟體報告的誤差就是點雲的絕對精度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The error reported by registration software is the absolute accuracy of the cloud." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以配準軟體顯示的「平均誤差 1 mm」作為精度證明，沒有任何獨立檢核；後來以全測站抽驗發現點雲整體旋轉，遠端偏差達 15 mm，已據以下料的帷幕牆托架必須重做。
knowledge.textEn: Using the registration software's ‘mean error 1 mm’ as the only proof of accuracy, with no independent checks, a later total-station spot check finds the cloud rotated so that far points are 15 mm out, and façade brackets already cut from it must be remade.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「掃描精度驗證與儀器檢定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Verifying scan accuracy and testing scanners" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩期點雲直接相減，就能偵測到小於單點雜訊的變形。
只以配準軟體顯示的「平均誤差 1 mm」作為精度證明，沒有任何獨立檢核。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Subtracting two point clouds directly detects deformation smaller than single-point noise.

Using the registration software's ‘mean error 1 mm’ as the only proof of accuracy, with no independent checks, a later total-station spot check finds the cloud rotated so that far points are 15 mm out, and façade brackets already cut from it must be remade.
quiz.explanation: 只以配準軟體顯示的「平均誤差 1 mm」作為精度證明，沒有任何獨立檢核；後來以全測站抽驗發現點雲整體旋轉，遠端偏差達 15 mm，已據以下料的帷幕牆托架必須重做。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the registration software's ‘mean error 1 mm’ as the only proof of accuracy, with no independent checks, a later total-station spot check finds the cloud rotated so that far points are 15 mm out, and façade brackets already cut from it must be remade. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基準掃描、變形比對與重建驗證」與「點雲資料管理、格式與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Baseline scans, change detection and reconstruction checks" and "Point-cloud data management, formats and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基準掃描、變形比對與重建驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Baseline scans, change detection and reconstruction checks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「災前基準掃描」如何影響建築雷射掃描竣工比對的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pre-event baseline scan” governs force, deformation or durability in “Laser-scan verification of as-built construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 掃描成果在完工後仍有價值：它是日後變形監測的基準，也是災後重建的依據。藝術史學者 Andrew Tallon 自 2010 年起以雷射掃描記錄巴黎聖母院，2019 年大火後這批資料成為修復的參考；烏干達卡蘇比王陵在 2009 年被掃描，2010 年主陵毀於火災，這批紀錄被規劃作為重建依據。兩期掃描比對時，可偵測的最小變化不只取決於點的雜訊，更取決於兩期配準是否一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「災前基準掃描」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Scan data keeps its value after completion: it is the baseline for later deformation monitoring and the reference for rebuilding after disaster. The art historian Andrew Tallon laser-scanned Notre-Dame de Paris from 2010, and after the 2019 fire his data became a reference for restoration; the Kasubi Tombs in Uganda were scanned in 2009, their main tomb was destroyed by fire in 2010, and those records were intended to support reconstruction. When two epochs are compared, the smallest detectable change depends less on point noise than on whether the two registrations are consistent. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pre-event baseline scan” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每點雜訊 σ = 2 mm，取 100 點平均的區塊 σ = 2/√100 = 0.2 mm，兩期差值 σ = √2×0.2 ≈ 0.28 mm，95% 偵測門檻約 1.96×0.28 ≈ 0.55 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With point noise σ = 2 mm, a patch averaging 100 points has σ = 2/√100 = 0.2 mm, the difference of two epochs σ = √2×0.2 ≈ 0.28 mm, and a 95% detection threshold of about 1.96×0.28 ≈ 0.55 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩期點雲直接相減，就能偵測到小於單點雜訊的變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Subtracting two point clouds directly detects deformation smaller than single-point noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「災前基準掃描」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pre-event baseline scan”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基準掃描、變形比對與重建驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Baseline scans, change detection and reconstruction checks
knowledge.text: 掃描成果在完工後仍有價值：它是日後變形監測的基準，也是災後重建的依據。藝術史學者 Andrew Tallon 自 2010 年起以雷射掃描記錄巴黎聖母院，2019 年大火後這批資料成為修復的參考；烏干達卡蘇比王陵在 2009 年被掃描，2010 年主陵毀於火災，這批紀錄被規劃作為重建依據。
knowledge.textEn: Scan data keeps its value after completion: it is the baseline for later deformation monitoring and the reference for rebuilding after disaster. The art historian Andrew Tallon laser-scanned Notre-Dame de Paris from 2010, and after the 2019 fire his data became a reference for restoration; the Kasubi Tombs in Uganda were scanned in 2009, their main tomb was destroyed by fire in 2010, and those records were intended to support reconstruction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩期點雲直接相減，就能偵測到小於單點雜訊的變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Subtracting two point clouds directly detects deformation smaller than single-point noise. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基準掃描、變形比對與重建驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Baseline scans, change detection and reconstruction checks" is correct?
options: 掃描成果在完工後仍有價值：它是日後變形監測的基準，也是災後重建的依據。
兩期點雲直接相減，就能偵測到小於單點雜訊的變形。
點雲交出檔案就完成交接，不需要後設資料。
optionsEn: Scan data keeps its value after completion: it is the baseline for later deformation monitoring and the reference for rebuilding after disaster.
Subtracting two point clouds directly detects deformation smaller than single-point noise.
Handing over the point-cloud files completes the handover; metadata is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 掃描成果在完工後仍有價值：它是日後變形監測的基準，也是災後重建的依據。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Scan data keeps its value after completion: it is the baseline for later deformation monitoring and the reference for rebuilding after disaster. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基準掃描、變形比對與重建驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Baseline scans, change detection and reconstruction checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「災前基準掃描」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pre-event baseline scan” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每點雜訊 σ = 2 mm，取 100 點平均的區塊 σ = 2/√100 = 0.2 mm，兩期差值 σ = √2×0.2 ≈ 0.28 mm，95% 偵測門檻約 1.96×0.28 ≈ 0.55 mm。若每期配準另有 1.5 mm 系統誤差，差值 σ = √(2×(0.2² + 1.5²)) ≈ 2.14 mm，門檻升到約 4.2 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With point noise σ = 2 mm, a patch averaging 100 points has σ = 2/√100 = 0.2 mm, the difference of two epochs σ = √2×0.2 ≈ 0.28 mm, and a 95% detection threshold of about 1.96×0.28 ≈ 0.55 mm. If each epoch's registration also carries a 1.5 mm systematic error, the difference σ = √(2×(0.2² + 1.5²)) ≈ 2.14 mm and the threshold rises to about 4.2 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：基準掃描要使用長期保留的控制點，並把控制點坐標、儀器、日期與配準報告一起保存；後續各期以同一組控制點定位，先比較穩定區域（例如基礎或未受影響的牆面）確認兩期一致，再解讀變化區域。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Baseline scans must use long-term control points, archiving their coordinates, the instrument, date and registration report together; later epochs are positioned on the same control, stable areas such as foundations or unaffected walls are compared first to confirm consistency, and only then are changed areas interpreted.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每點雜訊 σ = 2 mm，取 100 點平均的區塊 σ = 2/√100 = 0.2 mm，兩期差值 σ = √2×0.2 ≈ 0.28 mm，95% 偵測門檻約 1.96×0.28 ≈ 0.55 mm。若每期配準另有 1.5 mm 系統誤差，差值 σ = √(2×(0.2² + 1.5²)) ≈ 2.14 mm，門檻升到約 4.2 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With point noise σ = 2 mm, a patch averaging 100 points has σ = 2/√100 = 0.2 mm, the difference of two epochs σ = √2×0.2 ≈ 0.28 mm, and a 95% detection threshold of about 1.96×0.28 ≈ 0.55 mm. If each epoch's registration also carries a 1.5 mm systematic error, the difference σ = √(2×(0.2² + 1.5²)) ≈ 2.14 mm and the threshold rises to about 4.2 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基準掃描、變形比對與重建驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Baseline scans, change detection and reconstruction checks", which statement holds?
options: 點雲精度很高，由它建立的模型自然也同樣精確。
自動配準軟體顯示誤差很小，點雲位置就一定正確。
optionsEn: If the point cloud is accurate, the model built from it is automatically just as accurate.
With point noise σ = 2 mm, a patch averaging 100 points has σ = 2/√100 = 0.2 mm, the difference of two epochs σ = √2×0.2 ≈ 0.28 mm, and a 95% detection threshold of about 1.96×0.28 ≈ 0.55 mm.
If automatic registration reports small errors, the cloud must be correctly positioned.
quiz.explanation: 每點雜訊 σ = 2 mm，取 100 點平均的區塊 σ = 2/√100 = 0.2 mm，兩期差值 σ = √2×0.2 ≈ 0.28 mm，95% 偵測門檻約 1.96×0.28 ≈ 0.55 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With point noise σ = 2 mm, a patch averaging 100 points has σ = 2/√100 = 0.2 mm, the difference of two epochs σ = √2×0.2 ≈ 0.28 mm, and a 95% detection threshold of about 1.96×0.28 ≈ 0.55 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基準掃描、變形比對與重建驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Baseline scans, change detection and reconstruction checks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「災前基準掃描」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pre-event baseline scan” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 基準掃描要使用長期保留的控制點，並把控制點坐標、儀器、日期與配準報告一起保存；後續各期以同一組控制點定位，先比較穩定區域（例如基礎或未受影響的牆面）確認兩期一致，再解讀變化區域。重建時從基準掃描抽取關鍵尺寸，與新建構件的掃描比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Baseline scans must use long-term control points, archiving their coordinates, the instrument, date and registration report together; later epochs are positioned on the same control, stable areas such as foundations or unaffected walls are compared first to confirm consistency, and only then are changed areas interpreted. In reconstruction, key dimensions are extracted from the baseline and compared with scans of the new work. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重要建築與文化資產應在完工或重大修復後建立基準掃描並納入資產紀錄，長期控制點與基準資料一起保存；變形判定結果須經結構工程師確認後才可發布。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Important buildings and heritage assets should receive a baseline scan after completion or major restoration, kept in the asset record with the long-term control points; any deformation finding must be confirmed by a structural engineer before release.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩期掃描各自以點雲匹配配準、沒有共同控制，比對結果顯示整座結構「傾斜」數毫米，引發不必要的緊急評估，查證後才發現只是兩期坐標系統不一致。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two epochs each registered by cloud matching without common control show the whole structure ‘tilting’ by several millimetres, triggering an unnecessary emergency assessment, until checking reveals that the two coordinate systems simply did not agree. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 基準掃描要使用長期保留的控制點，並把控制點坐標、儀器、日期與配準報告一起保存；後續各期以同一組控制點定位，先比較穩定區域（例如基礎或未受影響的牆面）確認兩期一致，再解讀變化區域。重建時從基準掃描抽取關鍵尺寸，與新建構件的掃描比較。
knowledge.textEn: Baseline scans must use long-term control points, archiving their coordinates, the instrument, date and registration report together; later epochs are positioned on the same control, stable areas such as foundations or unaffected walls are compared first to confirm consistency, and only then are changed areas interpreted. In reconstruction, key dimensions are extracted from the baseline and compared with scans of the new work.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重要建築與文化資產應在完工或重大修復後建立基準掃描並納入資產紀錄，長期控制點與基準資料一起保存；變形判定結果須經結構工程師確認後才可發布。
knowledge.textEn: Important buildings and heritage assets should receive a baseline scan after completion or major restoration, kept in the asset record with the long-term control points; any deformation finding must be confirmed by a structural engineer before release.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基準掃描、變形比對與重建驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Baseline scans, change detection and reconstruction checks"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
樓板澆置完成後形狀就固定不變，何時量測都一樣。
基準掃描要使用長期保留的控制點，並把控制點坐標、儀器、日期與配準報告一起保存。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once a slab is poured its shape is fixed, so it does not matter when it is measured.
Baseline scans must use long-term control points, archiving their coordinates, the instrument, date and registration report together.
quiz.explanation: 基準掃描要使用長期保留的控制點，並把控制點坐標、儀器、日期與配準報告一起保存；後續各期以同一組控制點定位，先比較穩定區域（例如基礎或未受影響的牆面）確認兩期一致，再解讀變化區域。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Baseline scans must use long-term control points, archiving their coordinates, the instrument, date and registration report together; later epochs are positioned on the same control, stable areas such as foundations or unaffected walls are compared first to confirm consistency, and only then are changed areas interpreted. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基準掃描、變形比對與重建驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Baseline scans, change detection and reconstruction checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「災前基準掃描」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pre-event baseline scan” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩期掃描各自以點雲匹配配準、沒有共同控制，比對結果顯示整座結構「傾斜」數毫米，引發不必要的緊急評估，查證後才發現只是兩期坐標系統不一致。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two epochs each registered by cloud matching without common control show the whole structure ‘tilting’ by several millimetres, triggering an unnecessary emergency assessment, until checking reveals that the two coordinate systems simply did not agree. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩期掃描比對時，可偵測的最小變化不只取決於點的雜訊，更取決於兩期配準是否一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When two epochs are compared, the smallest detectable change depends less on point noise than on whether the two registrations are consistent.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩期點雲直接相減，就能偵測到小於單點雜訊的變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Subtracting two point clouds directly detects deformation smaller than single-point noise." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩期掃描各自以點雲匹配配準、沒有共同控制，比對結果顯示整座結構「傾斜」數毫米，引發不必要的緊急評估，查證後才發現只是兩期坐標系統不一致。
knowledge.textEn: Two epochs each registered by cloud matching without common control show the whole structure ‘tilting’ by several millimetres, triggering an unnecessary emergency assessment, until checking reveals that the two coordinate systems simply did not agree.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基準掃描、變形比對與重建驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Baseline scans, change detection and reconstruction checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 兩期掃描各自以點雲匹配配準、沒有共同控制，比對結果顯示整座結構「傾斜」數毫米，引發不必要的緊急評估，查證後才發現只是兩期坐標系統不一致。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
點雲交出檔案就完成交接，不需要後設資料。
optionsEn: Two epochs each registered by cloud matching without common control show the whole structure ‘tilting’ by several millimetres, triggering an unnecessary emergency assessment, until checking reveals that the two coordinate systems simply did not agree.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Handing over the point-cloud files completes the handover; metadata is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 兩期掃描各自以點雲匹配配準、沒有共同控制，比對結果顯示整座結構「傾斜」數毫米，引發不必要的緊急評估，查證後才發現只是兩期坐標系統不一致。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Two epochs each registered by cloud matching without common control show the whole structure ‘tilting’ by several millimetres, triggering an unnecessary emergency assessment, until checking reveals that the two coordinate systems simply did not agree. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 點雲資料管理、格式與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Point-cloud data management, formats and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「E57 點雲檔與後設資料」如何影響建築雷射掃描竣工比對的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “E57 files and metadata” governs force, deformation or durability in “Laser-scan verification of as-built construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 點雲檔案很大且格式多樣，若只以掃描軟體的專有格式交付，業主日後可能無法讀取。ASTM E57 格式可在一個檔案中保存三維點、強度或顏色與影像，是常用的中立交換格式。交接時除了點雲本身，還要附上後設資料：坐標系統、控制點、儀器與日期、配準與檢核報告、LOA 等級；同時要管理資料量、版本與存取權限，以及掃描到的人員與敏感區域。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「E57 點雲檔與後設資料」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Point clouds are large and come in many formats, and delivery only in a scanning package's proprietary format may leave the owner unable to read them later. The ASTM E57 format stores three-dimensional points, intensity or colour and images in one file and is a common neutral exchange format. Handover needs metadata as well as the cloud: coordinate system, control points, instrument and date, registration and check reports, and LOA level, while data volume, versions, access rights and any captured people or sensitive areas must also be managed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “E57 files and metadata” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：10 億點、每點以 3 個 4 位元組坐標加 2 位元組強度與 3 位元組顏色計 17 位元組，約 1×10⁹×17 = 17 GB；若坐標以 8 位元組儲存，每點 29 位元組約 29 GB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One billion points at 17 bytes each (three 4-byte coordinates plus 2 bytes of intensity and 3 of colour) is about 1×10⁹×17 = 17 GB; with 8-byte coordinates, 29 bytes per point gives about 29 GB.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「點雲交出檔案就完成交接，不需要後設資料。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Handing over the point-cloud files completes the handover; metadata is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「E57 點雲檔與後設資料」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “E57 files and metadata”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 點雲資料管理、格式與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Point-cloud data management, formats and handover
knowledge.text: 點雲檔案很大且格式多樣，若只以掃描軟體的專有格式交付，業主日後可能無法讀取。ASTM E57 格式可在一個檔案中保存三維點、強度或顏色與影像，是常用的中立交換格式。
knowledge.textEn: Point clouds are large and come in many formats, and delivery only in a scanning package's proprietary format may leave the owner unable to read them later. The ASTM E57 format stores three-dimensional points, intensity or colour and images in one file and is a common neutral exchange format.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：點雲交出檔案就完成交接，不需要後設資料。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Handing over the point-cloud files completes the handover; metadata is unnecessary. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「點雲資料管理、格式與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Point-cloud data management, formats and handover" is correct?
options: 點雲交出檔案就完成交接，不需要後設資料。
點雲檔案很大且格式多樣，若只以掃描軟體的專有格式交付，業主日後可能無法讀取。
點雲有數百萬個點，所以每一點都比全測站量測更準確。
optionsEn: Handing over the point-cloud files completes the handover; metadata is unnecessary.
Point clouds are large and come in many formats, and delivery only in a scanning package's proprietary format may leave the owner unable to read them later.
A point cloud has millions of points, so every point is more accurate than a total-station measurement.
quiz.explanation: 點雲檔案很大且格式多樣，若只以掃描軟體的專有格式交付，業主日後可能無法讀取。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Point clouds are large and come in many formats, and delivery only in a scanning package's proprietary format may leave the owner unable to read them later. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 點雲資料管理、格式與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Point-cloud data management, formats and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「E57 點雲檔與後設資料」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “E57 files and metadata” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：10 億點、每點以 3 個 4 位元組坐標加 2 位元組強度與 3 位元組顏色計 17 位元組，約 1×10⁹×17 = 17 GB；若坐標以 8 位元組儲存，每點 29 位元組約 29 GB。三期掃描即 51 至 87 GB；抽稀保留 10% 作日常瀏覽約 1.7 至 2.9 GB。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One billion points at 17 bytes each (three 4-byte coordinates plus 2 bytes of intensity and 3 of colour) is about 1×10⁹×17 = 17 GB; with 8-byte coordinates, 29 bytes per point gives about 29 GB. Three epochs make 51 to 87 GB, and a 10% decimated copy for everyday viewing is about 1.7 to 2.9 GB. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前以第二套軟體開啟 E57 檔，確認坐標、強度與影像完整，並抽查控制點坐標與後設資料一致；檢查檔名與版本規則、備份與存取權限，並確認敏感區域已遮蔽或依規定處理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover open the E57 files in a second software package to confirm coordinates, intensity and images are intact, and spot-check that control-point coordinates agree with the metadata; check naming and version rules, backups and access rights, and confirm that sensitive areas are masked or handled as required.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 10 億點、每點以 3 個 4 位元組坐標加 2 位元組強度與 3 位元組顏色計 17 位元組，約 1×10⁹×17 = 17 GB；若坐標以 8 位元組儲存，每點 29 位元組約 29 GB。三期掃描即 51 至 87 GB；抽稀保留 10% 作日常瀏覽約 1.7 至 2.9 GB。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: One billion points at 17 bytes each (three 4-byte coordinates plus 2 bytes of intensity and 3 of colour) is about 1×10⁹×17 = 17 GB; with 8-byte coordinates, 29 bytes per point gives about 29 GB. Three epochs make 51 to 87 GB, and a 10% decimated copy for everyday viewing is about 1.7 to 2.9 GB. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「點雲資料管理、格式與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Point-cloud data management, formats and handover", which statement holds?
options: 掃描儀的標稱精度在任何距離與角度都一樣。
竣工掃描可以等全部完工後一次做完就好。
10 億點、每點以 3 個 4 位元組坐標加 2 位元組強度與 3 位元組顏色計 17 位元組，約 1×10⁹×17 = 17 GB。
optionsEn: A scanner's nominal accuracy holds at every range and angle.
As-built scanning can wait until everything is finished and be done once.
One billion points at 17 bytes each (three 4-byte coordinates plus 2 bytes of intensity and 3 of colour) is about 1×10⁹×17 = 17 GB.
quiz.explanation: 10 億點、每點以 3 個 4 位元組坐標加 2 位元組強度與 3 位元組顏色計 17 位元組，約 1×10⁹×17 = 17 GB；若坐標以 8 位元組儲存，每點 29 位元組約 29 GB。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: One billion points at 17 bytes each (three 4-byte coordinates plus 2 bytes of intensity and 3 of colour) is about 1×10⁹×17 = 17 GB; with 8-byte coordinates, 29 bytes per point gives about 29 GB. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 點雲資料管理、格式與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Point-cloud data management, formats and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「E57 點雲檔與後設資料」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “E57 files and metadata” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前以第二套軟體開啟 E57 檔，確認坐標、強度與影像完整，並抽查控制點坐標與後設資料一致；檢查檔名與版本規則、備份與存取權限，並確認敏感區域已遮蔽或依規定處理。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover open the E57 files in a second software package to confirm coordinates, intensity and images are intact, and spot-check that control-point coordinates agree with the metadata; check naming and version rules, backups and access rights, and confirm that sensitive areas are masked or handled as required. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約要求以 E57 等中立格式加原生格式雙軌交付，附後設資料表與配準、檢核報告；業主資訊管理人員確認可讀後才簽收，並把點雲連結到資產資訊模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The contract should require delivery in a neutral format such as E57 alongside the native format, with a metadata sheet and registration and check reports; the owner's information manager signs for it only after confirming readability, and links the cloud to the asset information model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：交付的點雲只有專有格式且沒有坐標系統說明，幾年後軟體授權失效、廠商不再支援，業主手上的資料等於無法使用，翻修時只能全部重新掃描。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clouds delivered only in a proprietary format with no coordinate-system note become unusable years later when the licence lapses and the vendor no longer supports the format, so a renovation must scan everything again. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前以第二套軟體開啟 E57 檔，確認坐標、強度與影像完整，並抽查控制點坐標與後設資料一致；檢查檔名與版本規則、備份與存取權限，並確認敏感區域已遮蔽或依規定處理。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover open the E57 files in a second software package to confirm coordinates, intensity and images are intact, and spot-check that control-point coordinates agree with the metadata; check naming and version rules, backups and access rights, and confirm that sensitive areas are masked or handled as required.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合約要求以 E57 等中立格式加原生格式雙軌交付，附後設資料表與配準、檢核報告；業主資訊管理人員確認可讀後才簽收，並把點雲連結到資產資訊模型。
knowledge.textEn: The contract should require delivery in a neutral format such as E57 alongside the native format, with a metadata sheet and registration and check reports; the owner's information manager signs for it only after confirming readability, and links the cloud to the asset information model.

quiz.question: 要驗證「點雲資料管理、格式與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Point-cloud data management, formats and handover"?
options: 交接前以第二套軟體開啟 E57 檔，確認坐標、強度與影像完整，並抽查控制點坐標與後設資料一致。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
偏差圖大部分是綠色，就代表竣工品質合格。
optionsEn: Before handover open the E57 files in a second software package to confirm coordinates, intensity and images are intact, and spot-check that control-point coordinates agree with the metadata.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If the deviation map is mostly green, the as-built quality is acceptable.
quiz.explanation: 交接前以第二套軟體開啟 E57 檔，確認坐標、強度與影像完整，並抽查控制點坐標與後設資料一致；檢查檔名與版本規則、備份與存取權限，並確認敏感區域已遮蔽或依規定處理。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover open the E57 files in a second software package to confirm coordinates, intensity and images are intact, and spot-check that control-point coordinates agree with the metadata; check naming and version rules, backups and access rights, and confirm that sensitive areas are masked or handled as required. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 點雲資料管理、格式與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Point-cloud data management, formats and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「E57 點雲檔與後設資料」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “E57 files and metadata” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 交付的點雲只有專有格式且沒有坐標系統說明，幾年後軟體授權失效、廠商不再支援，業主手上的資料等於無法使用，翻修時只能全部重新掃描。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clouds delivered only in a proprietary format with no coordinate-system note become unusable years later when the licence lapses and the vendor no longer supports the format, so a renovation must scan everything again. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時除了點雲本身，還要附上後設資料：坐標系統、控制點、儀器與日期、配準與檢核報告、LOA 等級；同時要管理資料量、版本與存取權限，以及掃描到的人員與敏感區域。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover needs metadata as well as the cloud: coordinate system, control points, instrument and date, registration and check reports, and LOA level, while data volume, versions, access rights and any captured people or sensitive areas must also be managed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「點雲交出檔案就完成交接，不需要後設資料。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Handing over the point-cloud files completes the handover; metadata is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 交付的點雲只有專有格式且沒有坐標系統說明，幾年後軟體授權失效、廠商不再支援，業主手上的資料等於無法使用，翻修時只能全部重新掃描。
knowledge.textEn: Clouds delivered only in a proprietary format with no coordinate-system note become unusable years later when the licence lapses and the vendor no longer supports the format, so a renovation must scan everything again.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「點雲資料管理、格式與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Point-cloud data management, formats and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

點雲有數百萬個點，所以每一點都比全測站量測更準確。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

Clouds delivered only in a proprietary format with no coordinate-system note become unusable years later when the licence lapses and the vendor no longer supports the format, so a renovation must scan everything again.
A point cloud has millions of points, so every point is more accurate than a total-station measurement.

quiz.explanationEn: Clouds delivered only in a proprietary format with no coordinate-system note become unusable years later when the licence lapses and the vendor no longer supports the format, so a renovation must scan everything again. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 建築模組化吊裝與接合
summary: 從體積模組的角柱荷載路徑與雙層樓板出發，說明模組間繫結與防連續倒塌、角部接頭與螺栓接合、吊點與吊裝框，再處理起重機選型與風速限制、堆疊公差與墊片、工廠出廠檢驗、現場接頭與防火防水檢查，最後談模組間空腔的耐久與模組履歷交接，並以新加坡 The Clement Canopy、紐約 461 Dean Street 與蒙特婁 Habitat 67 對照。
summaryEn: Starting from corner-post load paths and double floors in volumetric modules, explain inter-module ties and progressive-collapse resistance, corner joints and bolting, lift points and lifting frames, then crane selection and wind limits, stacking tolerances and shims, factory release inspection, site joint, fire-stopping and waterproofing checks, and finally durability of inter-module cavities and module-record handover, compared with The Clement Canopy in Singapore, 461 Dean Street in New York and Habitat 67 in Montreal.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一棟 20 層鋼構模組建築，每層 8 個模組，共 8×20 = 160 個。每個模組吊裝循環（掛鉤、吊升、定位、鎖固、回程）40 分鐘，總吊裝時間 160×40/60 ≈ 106.7 小時；每天可吊裝 6 小時，需 106.7/6 ≈ 17.8 天，若預留 25% 風雨停工，約 17.8/0.75 ≈ 23.7 天，取 24 個工作天。起重機在 40 m 半徑的額定荷重 28 t，模組 22 t 加吊裝框 2.5 t 與索具 0.5 t，吊重 25 t，使用率 25/28 ≈ 89%。若裝修與設備使模組增重 8% 成 22×1.08 = 23.76 t，吊重 26.76 t，使用率 26.76/28 ≈ 96%，超過 90% 的規劃上限，須縮短半徑、移位起重機或改用較大機型。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案；實際吊裝計畫須由合格的吊掛負責人核准。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 20-storey steel modular building has 8 modules per floor, 8×20 = 160 in all. Each lifting cycle (hook on, hoist, place, bolt, return) takes 40 minutes, so total hook time is 160×40/60 ≈ 106.7 hours; at 6 lifting hours a day this needs 106.7/6 ≈ 17.8 days, and allowing 25% for wind and rain about 17.8/0.75 ≈ 23.7 days, so 24 working days. The crane is rated 28 t at 40 m radius; a 22 t module plus a 2.5 t lifting frame and 0.5 t of rigging gives a 25 t hook load and 25/28 ≈ 89% utilisation. If finishes and equipment add 8% to the module, 22×1.08 = 23.76 t, the hook load is 26.76 t and utilisation 26.76/28 ≈ 96%, above a 90% planning limit, so the radius must be shortened, the crane moved or a larger crane used. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project; an actual lifting plan must be approved by a competent lifting supervisor.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統」與「側向力傳遞、整體性與防連續倒塌」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules" and "Lateral load transfer, robustness and progressive collapse": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「角柱與雙層樓板」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corner posts and double floors” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 體積模組是在工廠完成結構、隔間、機電與裝修的立體箱體，到工地後像積木一樣堆疊。鋼構模組通常以四角的方管柱與上下框梁承受重力，荷載沿角柱一路往下傳；新加坡 PPVC 一類的混凝土模組則以六面混凝土板承重。每個模組都有自己的地板與天花板，形成雙層樓板與雙層牆，自重與樓高都比傳統構造大；較高的模組建築通常另以現澆混凝土核心筒或斜撐承受側力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「角柱與雙層樓板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A volumetric module is a three-dimensional box whose structure, partitions, services and finishes are completed in a factory and then stacked on site like building blocks. Steel modules usually carry gravity through square hollow-section posts at the four corners and top and bottom edge beams, so load runs down the corner posts; concrete modules such as Singapore's PPVC carry it through six-sided concrete panels. Every module has its own floor and ceiling, giving double floors and walls that add weight and storey height compared with conventional construction, and taller modular buildings usually resist lateral load with a cast-in-place concrete core or bracing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Corner posts and double floors” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：模組 3.6 m × 12 m = 43.2 m²，靜載 4.0 kPa（雙層樓板與天花）、活載 2.0 kPa，設計荷重 1.2×4.0 + 1.6×2.0 = 8.0 kPa，每模組每層 43.2×8.0 = 345.6 kN，由 4 根角柱各分擔 86.4 kN；上方 10 層累積 864 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 3.6 m × 12 m module covers 43.2 m²; with 4.0 kPa dead load (double floor and ceiling) and 2.0 kPa live load the design load is 1.2×4.0 + 1.6×2.0 = 8.0 kPa, so each module carries 43.2×8.0 = 345.6 kN per storey, 86.4 kN on each of four corner posts; ten storeys above accumulate 864 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「角柱與雙層樓板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Corner posts and double floors”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統
knowledge.titleEn: Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules
knowledge.text: 體積模組是在工廠完成結構、隔間、機電與裝修的立體箱體，到工地後像積木一樣堆疊。鋼構模組通常以四角的方管柱與上下框梁承受重力，荷載沿角柱一路往下傳；新加坡 PPVC 一類的混凝土模組則以六面混凝土板承重。
knowledge.textEn: A volumetric module is a three-dimensional box whose structure, partitions, services and finishes are completed in a factory and then stacked on site like building blocks. Steel modules usually carry gravity through square hollow-section posts at the four corners and top and bottom edge beams, so load runs down the corner posts; concrete modules such as Singapore's PPVC carry it through six-sided concrete panels.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules" is correct?
options: 模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。
體積模組是在工廠完成結構、隔間、機電與裝修的立體箱體，到工地後像積木一樣堆疊。
模組只要上下疊好，自重就足以讓建築維持整體性。
optionsEn: Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis.
A volumetric module is a three-dimensional box whose structure, partitions, services and finishes are completed in a factory and then stacked on site like building blocks.
As long as modules are stacked properly, self-weight alone keeps the building intact.
quiz.explanation: 體積模組是在工廠完成結構、隔間、機電與裝修的立體箱體，到工地後像積木一樣堆疊。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A volumetric module is a three-dimensional box whose structure, partitions, services and finishes are completed in a factory and then stacked on site like building blocks. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「角柱與雙層樓板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Corner posts and double floors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：模組 3.6 m × 12 m = 43.2 m²，靜載 4.0 kPa（雙層樓板與天花）、活載 2.0 kPa，設計荷重 1.2×4.0 + 1.6×2.0 = 8.0 kPa，每模組每層 43.2×8.0 = 345.6 kN，由 4 根角柱各分擔 86.4 kN；上方 10 層累積 864 kN。角柱採 200×200×10 mm 方管（面積約 7,600 mm²），軸應力約 864,000/7,600 ≈ 114 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 3.6 m × 12 m module covers 43.2 m²; with 4.0 kPa dead load (double floor and ceiling) and 2.0 kPa live load the design load is 1.2×4.0 + 1.6×2.0 = 8.0 kPa, so each module carries 43.2×8.0 = 345.6 kN per storey, 86.4 kN on each of four corner posts; ten storeys above accumulate 864 kN. A 200×200×10 mm SHS post (area about 7,600 mm²) then sees about 864,000/7,600 ≈ 114 MPa axial stress. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：結構分析要以實際的角柱、框梁與接頭勁度建立堆疊模型，檢查角柱軸力、局部壓屈與接頭承壓；並核對模組之間是否真如假設只在角部傳力（例如墊塊或承壓板位置），工廠以抽樣試驗確認方管與焊接品質。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The structural analysis should model the stack with the actual stiffness of corner posts, edge beams and joints, checking post axial force, local buckling and joint bearing, and confirm that modules really bear on each other only at the corners as assumed (for example at packers or bearing plates); the factory confirms hollow-section and weld quality by sample testing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
