A 200×200×10 mm SHS post (area about 7,600 mm²) then sees about 864,000/7,600 ≈ 114 MPa axial stress. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules", which statement holds?
options: 模組既然能承受使用荷載，用任何方式吊起來都不會受損。
只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。
模組 3.6 m × 12 m = 43.2 m²，靜載 4.0 kPa（雙層樓板與天花）、活載 2.0 kPa，設計荷重 1.2×4.0 + 1.6×2.0 = 8.0 kPa，每模組每層 43.2×8.0 = 345.6 kN，由 4 根角柱各分擔 86.4 kN。
optionsEn: Since a module can carry service loads, any way of lifting it will do no harm.
If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too.
A 3.6 m × 12 m module covers 43.2 m².
quiz.explanation: 模組 3.6 m × 12 m = 43.2 m²，靜載 4.0 kPa（雙層樓板與天花）、活載 2.0 kPa，設計荷重 1.2×4.0 + 1.6×2.0 = 8.0 kPa，每模組每層 43.2×8.0 = 345.6 kN，由 4 根角柱各分擔 86.4 kN；上方 10 層累積 864 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 3.6 m × 12 m module covers 43.2 m²; with 4.0 kPa dead load (double floor and ceiling) and 2.0 kPa live load the design load is 1.2×4.0 + 1.6×2.0 = 8.0 kPa, so each module carries 43.2×8.0 = 345.6 kN per storey, 86.4 kN on each of four corner posts; ten storeys above accumulate 864 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「角柱與雙層樓板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Corner posts and double floors” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 結構分析要以實際的角柱、框梁與接頭勁度建立堆疊模型，檢查角柱軸力、局部壓屈與接頭承壓；並核對模組之間是否真如假設只在角部傳力（例如墊塊或承壓板位置），工廠以抽樣試驗確認方管與焊接品質。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The structural analysis should model the stack with the actual stiffness of corner posts, edge beams and joints, checking post axial force, local buckling and joint bearing, and confirm that modules really bear on each other only at the corners as assumed (for example at packers or bearing plates); the factory confirms hollow-section and weld quality by sample testing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構設計者要在圖上標明每一處模組間的承壓點、墊塊材料與厚度，並把「非承壓區保持間隙」列為安裝檢查項目；超過一定層數的模組建築須設計獨立的抗側力系統並經結構審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural designer must mark every inter-module bearing point, packer material and thickness on the drawings and make ‘keep non-bearing zones clear’ an installation check item; modular buildings above a set height need an independent lateral system, designed and passed through structural review.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若模組間在樓板邊緣意外接觸而非只在角部承壓，荷載會流入未設計承壓的框梁，造成局部變形與裝修開裂；角柱接頭偏心產生附加彎矩，可能使高層堆疊下方的角柱提早壓屈。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If modules accidentally bear along floor edges rather than only at the corners, load flows into edge beams not designed for bearing, causing local distortion and cracked finishes; eccentric corner joints add bending that can buckle lower corner posts early in a tall stack. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 結構分析要以實際的角柱、框梁與接頭勁度建立堆疊模型，檢查角柱軸力、局部壓屈與接頭承壓；並核對模組之間是否真如假設只在角部傳力（例如墊塊或承壓板位置），工廠以抽樣試驗確認方管與焊接品質。
knowledge.textEn: The structural analysis should model the stack with the actual stiffness of corner posts, edge beams and joints, checking post axial force, local buckling and joint bearing, and confirm that modules really bear on each other only at the corners as assumed (for example at packers or bearing plates); the factory confirms hollow-section and weld quality by sample testing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構設計者要在圖上標明每一處模組間的承壓點、墊塊材料與厚度，並把「非承壓區保持間隙」列為安裝檢查項目；超過一定層數的模組建築須設計獨立的抗側力系統並經結構審查。
knowledge.textEn: The structural designer must mark every inter-module bearing point, packer material and thickness on the drawings and make ‘keep non-bearing zones clear’ an installation check item; modular buildings above a set height need an independent lateral system, designed and passed through structural review.

quiz.question: 要驗證「體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules"?
options: 結構分析要以實際的角柱、框梁與接頭勁度建立堆疊模型，檢查角柱軸力、局部壓屈與接頭承壓。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
扳手鎖到規定扭矩，就代表螺栓預拉力一定正確。
optionsEn: The structural analysis should model the stack with the actual stiffness of corner posts, edge beams and joints, checking post axial force, local buckling and joint bearing, and confirm that modules really bear on each other only at the corners as assumed (for example at packers or bearing plates).
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload.
quiz.explanation: 結構分析要以實際的角柱、框梁與接頭勁度建立堆疊模型，檢查角柱軸力、局部壓屈與接頭承壓；並核對模組之間是否真如假設只在角部傳力（例如墊塊或承壓板位置），工廠以抽樣試驗確認方管與焊接品質。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The structural analysis should model the stack with the actual stiffness of corner posts, edge beams and joints, checking post axial force, local buckling and joint bearing, and confirm that modules really bear on each other only at the corners as assumed (for example at packers or bearing plates); the factory confirms hollow-section and weld quality by sample testing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「角柱與雙層樓板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Corner posts and double floors” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若模組間在樓板邊緣意外接觸而非只在角部承壓，荷載會流入未設計承壓的框梁，造成局部變形與裝修開裂；角柱接頭偏心產生附加彎矩，可能使高層堆疊下方的角柱提早壓屈。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If modules accidentally bear along floor edges rather than only at the corners, load flows into edge beams not designed for bearing, causing local distortion and cracked finishes; eccentric corner joints add bending that can buckle lower corner posts early in a tall stack. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每個模組都有自己的地板與天花板，形成雙層樓板與雙層牆，自重與樓高都比傳統構造大；較高的模組建築通常另以現澆混凝土核心筒或斜撐承受側力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Every module has its own floor and ceiling, giving double floors and walls that add weight and storey height compared with conventional construction, and taller modular buildings usually resist lateral load with a cast-in-place concrete core or bracing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若模組間在樓板邊緣意外接觸而非只在角部承壓，荷載會流入未設計承壓的框梁，造成局部變形與裝修開裂；角柱接頭偏心產生附加彎矩，可能使高層堆疊下方的角柱提早壓屈。
knowledge.textEn: If modules accidentally bear along floor edges rather than only at the corners, load flows into edge beams not designed for bearing, causing local distortion and cracked finishes; eccentric corner joints add bending that can buckle lower corner posts early in a tall stack.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若模組間在樓板邊緣意外接觸而非只在角部承壓，荷載會流入未設計承壓的框梁，造成局部變形與裝修開裂；角柱接頭偏心產生附加彎矩，可能使高層堆疊下方的角柱提早壓屈。
模組只要上下疊好，自重就足以讓建築維持整體性。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If modules accidentally bear along floor edges rather than only at the corners, load flows into edge beams not designed for bearing, causing local distortion and cracked finishes.
As long as modules are stacked properly, self-weight alone keeps the building intact.
quiz.explanation: 若模組間在樓板邊緣意外接觸而非只在角部承壓，荷載會流入未設計承壓的框梁，造成局部變形與裝修開裂；角柱接頭偏心產生附加彎矩，可能使高層堆疊下方的角柱提早壓屈。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If modules accidentally bear along floor edges rather than only at the corners, load flows into edge beams not designed for bearing, causing local distortion and cracked finishes; eccentric corner joints add bending that can buckle lower corner posts early in a tall stack. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 側向力傳遞、整體性與防連續倒塌：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral load transfer, robustness and progressive collapse: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「模組間水平繫結」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inter-module horizontal ties” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 側向風力與地震力先由每個模組的樓板與天花板收集，再透過模組間的水平連接板傳到核心筒或斜撐模組。模組之間只靠少數點連接，若連接設計不足，建築在偶發事件中缺乏整體性，一個模組受損就可能讓相鄰模組失去支承。因此設計要提供水平與垂直繫結，並檢核移除一個模組或一根角柱後，上方荷載能否由懸臂作用或繫結重新分配，這是模組建築防止連續倒塌的核心。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「模組間水平繫結」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wind and seismic forces are first collected by each module's floor and ceiling, then passed through horizontal inter-module plates to the core or braced modules. Modules are joined at only a few points, so weak connections leave the building without integrity in an accident, and damage to one module can strip support from its neighbours. The design must therefore provide horizontal and vertical ties and check whether, with one module or corner post removed, the load above can be redistributed by cantilever action or ties; this is the core of preventing progressive collapse in modular buildings. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Inter-module horizontal ties” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：參考 EN 1991-1-7 附錄 A 的內部繫結型式 T = 0.8(g_k + ψq_k)·s·L，且不小於 75 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Following the internal-tie form of EN 1991-1-7 Annex A, T = 0.8(g_k + ψq_k)·s·L but not less than 75 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模組只要上下疊好，自重就足以讓建築維持整體性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as modules are stacked properly, self-weight alone keeps the building intact." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「模組間水平繫結」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Inter-module horizontal ties”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 側向力傳遞、整體性與防連續倒塌
knowledge.titleEn: Lateral load transfer, robustness and progressive collapse
knowledge.text: 側向風力與地震力先由每個模組的樓板與天花板收集，再透過模組間的水平連接板傳到核心筒或斜撐模組。模組之間只靠少數點連接，若連接設計不足，建築在偶發事件中缺乏整體性，一個模組受損就可能讓相鄰模組失去支承。
knowledge.textEn: Wind and seismic forces are first collected by each module's floor and ceiling, then passed through horizontal inter-module plates to the core or braced modules. Modules are joined at only a few points, so weak connections leave the building without integrity in an accident, and damage to one module can strip support from its neighbours.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模組只要上下疊好，自重就足以讓建築維持整體性。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as modules are stacked properly, self-weight alone keeps the building intact. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「側向力傳遞、整體性與防連續倒塌」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lateral load transfer, robustness and progressive collapse" is correct?
options: 模組只要上下疊好，自重就足以讓建築維持整體性。
模組接頭只要強度計算通過，安裝方式可以留給現場決定。
側向風力與地震力先由每個模組的樓板與天花板收集，再透過模組間的水平連接板傳到核心筒或斜撐模組。
optionsEn: As long as modules are stacked properly, self-weight alone keeps the building intact.
Once a module joint passes the strength calculation, how it is installed can be left to the site.
Wind and seismic forces are first collected by each module's floor and ceiling, then passed through horizontal inter-module plates to the core or braced modules.
quiz.explanation: 側向風力與地震力先由每個模組的樓板與天花板收集，再透過模組間的水平連接板傳到核心筒或斜撐模組。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wind and seismic forces are first collected by each module's floor and ceiling, then passed through horizontal inter-module plates to the core or braced modules. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 側向力傳遞、整體性與防連續倒塌：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral load transfer, robustness and progressive collapse: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模組間水平繫結」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inter-module horizontal ties” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：參考 EN 1991-1-7 附錄 A 的內部繫結型式 T = 0.8(g_k + ψq_k)·s·L，且不小於 75 kN。取 g_k = 4.0 kPa、ψq_k = 0.5×2.0 = 1.0 kPa、間距 s = 3.6 m、跨度 L = 12 m：T = 0.8×5.0×3.6×12 = 172.8 kN > 75 kN，故每處水平繫結須承受約 173 kN 拉力。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Following the internal-tie form of EN 1991-1-7 Annex A, T = 0.8(g_k + ψq_k)·s·L but not less than 75 kN. With g_k = 4.0 kPa, ψq_k = 0.5×2.0 = 1.0 kPa, spacing s = 3.6 m and span L = 12 m: T = 0.8×5.0×3.6×12 = 172.8 kN > 75 kN, so each horizontal tie must resist about 173 kN of tension. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以模型分析每一處模組間連接在風與地震下的剪力與拉力，並做移除單一模組的替代路徑分析；連接件以原型試驗確認強度與滑移，現場逐一檢查繫結板是否安裝、螺栓是否齊全。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Analyse shear and tension at every inter-module connection under wind and earthquake, and run alternate-path analysis with a single module removed; confirm connector strength and slip by prototype testing, and on site check one by one that tie plates are installed and every bolt is present.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 參考 EN 1991-1-7 附錄 A 的內部繫結型式 T = 0.8(g_k + ψq_k)·s·L，且不小於 75 kN。取 g_k = 4.0 kPa、ψq_k = 0.5×2.0 = 1.0 kPa、間距 s = 3.6 m、跨度 L = 12 m：T = 0.8×5.0×3.6×12 = 172.8 kN > 75 kN，故每處水平繫結須承受約 173 kN 拉力。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Following the internal-tie form of EN 1991-1-7 Annex A, T = 0.8(g_k + ψq_k)·s·L but not less than 75 kN. With g_k = 4.0 kPa, ψq_k = 0.5×2.0 = 1.0 kPa, spacing s = 3.6 m and span L = 12 m: T = 0.8×5.0×3.6×12 = 172.8 kN > 75 kN, so each horizontal tie must resist about 173 kN of tension. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「側向力傳遞、整體性與防連續倒塌」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lateral load transfer, robustness and progressive collapse", which statement holds?
options: 參考 EN 1991-1-7 附錄 A 的內部繫結型式 T = 0.8(g_k + ψq_k)·s·L，且不小於 75 kN。
只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。
模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。
optionsEn: Following the internal-tie form of EN 1991-1-7 Annex A, T = 0.8(g_k + ψq_k)·s·L but not less than 75 kN.
If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed.
Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed.
quiz.explanation: 參考 EN 1991-1-7 附錄 A 的內部繫結型式 T = 0.8(g_k + ψq_k)·s·L，且不小於 75 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Following the internal-tie form of EN 1991-1-7 Annex A, T = 0.8(g_k + ψq_k)·s·L but not less than 75 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 側向力傳遞、整體性與防連續倒塌：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lateral load transfer, robustness and progressive collapse: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模組間水平繫結」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inter-module horizontal ties” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以模型分析每一處模組間連接在風與地震下的剪力與拉力，並做移除單一模組的替代路徑分析；連接件以原型試驗確認強度與滑移，現場逐一檢查繫結板是否安裝、螺栓是否齊全。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse shear and tension at every inter-module connection under wind and earthquake, and run alternate-path analysis with a single module removed; confirm connector strength and slip by prototype testing, and on site check one by one that tie plates are installed and every bolt is present. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構設計須提出繫結配置圖與連續倒塌檢核，每一處繫結都是安裝保留點：未經檢查員確認繫結完成，不得在其上方繼續堆疊下一層模組。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural design must provide a tie layout and progressive-collapse check, and every tie becomes an installation hold point: no further module may be stacked above until the inspector confirms the tie is complete.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了方便安裝而省略部分模組間繫結，或把繫結板只以點焊臨時固定後忘記補強，正常使用時看不出問題，一旦發生瓦斯爆炸或車輛撞擊，局部破壞便可能沿著缺乏繫結的模組擴大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting some inter-module ties for easier installation, or tack-welding tie plates temporarily and never completing them, shows nothing in normal use, but a gas explosion or vehicle impact can then spread local damage through the untied modules. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以模型分析每一處模組間連接在風與地震下的剪力與拉力，並做移除單一模組的替代路徑分析；連接件以原型試驗確認強度與滑移，現場逐一檢查繫結板是否安裝、螺栓是否齊全。
knowledge.textEn: Analyse shear and tension at every inter-module connection under wind and earthquake, and run alternate-path analysis with a single module removed; confirm connector strength and slip by prototype testing, and on site check one by one that tie plates are installed and every bolt is present.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構設計須提出繫結配置圖與連續倒塌檢核，每一處繫結都是安裝保留點：未經檢查員確認繫結完成，不得在其上方繼續堆疊下一層模組。
knowledge.textEn: The structural design must provide a tie layout and progressive-collapse check, and every tie becomes an installation hold point: no further module may be stacked above until the inspector confirms the tie is complete.

quiz.question: 要驗證「側向力傳遞、整體性與防連續倒塌」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lateral load transfer, robustness and progressive collapse"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以模型分析每一處模組間連接在風與地震下的剪力與拉力，並做移除單一模組的替代路徑分析；連接件以原型試驗確認強度與滑移，現場逐一檢查繫結板是否安裝、螺栓是否齊全。
模組在工廠已做好防水，現場吊裝期間不需要另外防雨。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Analyse shear and tension at every inter-module connection under wind and earthquake, and run alternate-path analysis with a single module removed.
Modules are waterproofed in the factory, so no rain protection is needed during site installation.
quiz.explanation: 以模型分析每一處模組間連接在風與地震下的剪力與拉力，並做移除單一模組的替代路徑分析；連接件以原型試驗確認強度與滑移，現場逐一檢查繫結板是否安裝、螺栓是否齊全。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Analyse shear and tension at every inter-module connection under wind and earthquake, and run alternate-path analysis with a single module removed; confirm connector strength and slip by prototype testing, and on site check one by one that tie plates are installed and every bolt is present. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 側向力傳遞、整體性與防連續倒塌：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lateral load transfer, robustness and progressive collapse: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模組間水平繫結」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inter-module horizontal ties” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了方便安裝而省略部分模組間繫結，或把繫結板只以點焊臨時固定後忘記補強，正常使用時看不出問題，一旦發生瓦斯爆炸或車輛撞擊，局部破壞便可能沿著缺乏繫結的模組擴大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting some inter-module ties for easier installation, or tack-welding tie plates temporarily and never completing them, shows nothing in normal use, but a gas explosion or vehicle impact can then spread local damage through the untied modules. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此設計要提供水平與垂直繫結，並檢核移除一個模組或一根角柱後，上方荷載能否由懸臂作用或繫結重新分配，這是模組建築防止連續倒塌的核心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The design must therefore provide horizontal and vertical ties and check whether, with one module or corner post removed, the load above can be redistributed by cantilever action or ties; this is the core of preventing progressive collapse in modular buildings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模組只要上下疊好，自重就足以讓建築維持整體性。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as modules are stacked properly, self-weight alone keeps the building intact." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了方便安裝而省略部分模組間繫結，或把繫結板只以點焊臨時固定後忘記補強，正常使用時看不出問題，一旦發生瓦斯爆炸或車輛撞擊，局部破壞便可能沿著缺乏繫結的模組擴大。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting some inter-module ties for easier installation, or tack-welding tie plates temporarily and never completing them, shows nothing in normal use, but a gas explosion or vehicle impact can then spread local damage through the untied modules.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「側向力傳遞、整體性與防連續倒塌」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lateral load transfer, robustness and progressive collapse" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
模組接頭只要強度計算通過，安裝方式可以留給現場決定。
為了方便安裝而省略部分模組間繫結，或把繫結板只以點焊臨時固定後忘記補強，正常使用時看不出問題，一旦發生瓦斯爆炸或車輛撞擊，局部破壞便可能沿著缺乏繫結的模組擴大。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once a module joint passes the strength calculation, how it is installed can be left to the site.

Omitting some inter-module ties for easier installation, or tack-welding tie plates temporarily and never completing them, shows nothing in normal use, but a gas explosion or vehicle impact can then spread local damage through the untied modules.
quiz.explanation: 為了方便安裝而省略部分模組間繫結，或把繫結板只以點焊臨時固定後忘記補強，正常使用時看不出問題，一旦發生瓦斯爆炸或車輛撞擊，局部破壞便可能沿著缺乏繫結的模組擴大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting some inter-module ties for easier installation, or tack-welding tie plates temporarily and never completing them, shows nothing in normal use, but a gas explosion or vehicle impact can then spread local damage through the untied modules. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「模組角部接頭與螺栓接合」與「吊點設計、吊具與模組變形」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Module corner joints and bolted connections" and "Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 模組角部接頭與螺栓接合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Module corner joints and bolted connections: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「角部定位錐與連接板」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corner locating cones and plates” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼構模組的角部接頭同時負責垂直定位與水平連接：常見做法是在下方模組頂部設定位錐或插銷，上方模組落下時自動對位，再以螺栓連接板把相鄰模組拉在一起。困難在於接頭位於模組內部或狹窄間隙中，螺栓必須能從外側、預留手孔或上一層施工面鎖固，否則既無法施作也無法檢查。混凝土 PPVC 則以預留鋼筋、續接器與灌漿形成濕式接頭，灌漿飽滿度是品質關鍵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「角部定位錐與連接板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Corner joints in steel modules provide both vertical location and horizontal connection: a common approach puts locating cones or pins on top of the lower module so the upper module self-aligns as it is lowered, then bolted plates pull adjacent modules together. The difficulty is that the joints sit inside modules or in narrow gaps, so bolts must be tightenable from outside, through access holes or from the next working level, or they can neither be installed nor inspected. Concrete PPVC uses projecting bars, couplers and grout to form wet joints, where complete grout filling is the key to quality. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Corner locating cones and plates” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：繫結力 172.8 kN 以 8.8 級 M20 螺栓單剪承擔，每支 F_v,Rd = 0.6×800×245/1.25 ≈ 94.1 kN，需 172.8/94.1 ≈ 1.84，取 2 支；若為了吸收公差改用長槽孔，承壓與滑移檢核更嚴，常需增加為 3 支或改用摩阻型接合。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Resisting the 172.8 kN tie force with grade 8.8 M20 bolts in single shear, each gives F_v,Rd = 0.6×800×245/1.25 ≈ 94.1 kN, so 172.8/94.1 ≈ 1.84 and two bolts are needed; long slotted holes used to absorb tolerances make bearing and slip checks stricter, often requiring three bolts or a slip-resistant connection.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模組接頭只要強度計算通過，安裝方式可以留給現場決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a module joint passes the strength calculation, how it is installed can be left to the site." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「角部定位錐與連接板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Corner locating cones and plates”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模組角部接頭與螺栓接合
knowledge.titleEn: Module corner joints and bolted connections
knowledge.text: 鋼構模組的角部接頭同時負責垂直定位與水平連接：常見做法是在下方模組頂部設定位錐或插銷，上方模組落下時自動對位，再以螺栓連接板把相鄰模組拉在一起。困難在於接頭位於模組內部或狹窄間隙中，螺栓必須能從外側、預留手孔或上一層施工面鎖固，否則既無法施作也無法檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Corner joints in steel modules provide both vertical location and horizontal connection: a common approach puts locating cones or pins on top of the lower module so the upper module self-aligns as it is lowered, then bolted plates pull adjacent modules together. The difficulty is that the joints sit inside modules or in narrow gaps, so bolts must be tightenable from outside, through access holes or from the next working level, or they can neither be installed nor inspected.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模組接頭只要強度計算通過，安裝方式可以留給現場決定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a module joint passes the strength calculation, how it is installed can be left to the site. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模組角部接頭與螺栓接合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Module corner joints and bolted connections" is correct?
options: 鋼構模組的角部接頭同時負責垂直定位與水平連接：常見做法是在下方模組頂部設定位錐或插銷，上方模組落下時自動對位，再以螺栓連接板把相鄰模組拉在一起。
模組接頭只要強度計算通過，安裝方式可以留給現場決定。
模組既然能承受使用荷載，用任何方式吊起來都不會受損。
optionsEn: Corner joints in steel modules provide both vertical location and horizontal connection: a common approach puts locating cones or pins on top of the lower module so the upper module self-aligns as it is lowered, then bolted plates pull adjacent modules together.
Once a module joint passes the strength calculation, how it is installed can be left to the site.
Since a module can carry service loads, any way of lifting it will do no harm.
quiz.explanation: 鋼構模組的角部接頭同時負責垂直定位與水平連接：常見做法是在下方模組頂部設定位錐或插銷，上方模組落下時自動對位，再以螺栓連接板把相鄰模組拉在一起。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Corner joints in steel modules provide both vertical location and horizontal connection: a common approach puts locating cones or pins on top of the lower module so the upper module self-aligns as it is lowered, then bolted plates pull adjacent modules together. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模組角部接頭與螺栓接合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Module corner joints and bolted connections: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「角部定位錐與連接板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Corner locating cones and plates” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：繫結力 172.8 kN 以 8.8 級 M20 螺栓單剪承擔，每支 F_v,Rd = 0.6×800×245/1.25 ≈ 94.1 kN，需 172.8/94.1 ≈ 1.84，取 2 支；若為了吸收公差改用長槽孔，承壓與滑移檢核更嚴，常需增加為 3 支或改用摩阻型接合。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Resisting the 172.8 kN tie force with grade 8.8 M20 bolts in single shear, each gives F_v,Rd = 0.6×800×245/1.25 ≈ 94.1 kN, so 172.8/94.1 ≈ 1.84 and two bolts are needed; long slotted holes used to absorb tolerances make bearing and slip checks stricter, often requiring three bolts or a slip-resistant connection. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以足尺接頭原型做拉力與剪力試驗，確認強度與滑移量；安裝後檢查螺栓數量、墊圈、鎖固順序與標記，混凝土接頭則以灌漿量紀錄、試體強度與必要時的非破壞檢測確認飽滿。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test full-scale joint prototypes in tension and shear to confirm strength and slip; after installation check bolt count, washers, tightening sequence and marking, and for concrete joints confirm complete filling from grout-volume records, cube strengths and non-destructive testing where needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 繫結力 172.8 kN 以 8.8 級 M20 螺栓單剪承擔，每支 F_v,Rd = 0.6×800×245/1.25 ≈ 94.1 kN，需 172.8/94.1 ≈ 1.84，取 2 支；若為了吸收公差改用長槽孔，承壓與滑移檢核更嚴，常需增加為 3 支或改用摩阻型接合。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Resisting the 172.8 kN tie force with grade 8.8 M20 bolts in single shear, each gives F_v,Rd = 0.6×800×245/1.25 ≈ 94.1 kN, so 172.8/94.1 ≈ 1.84 and two bolts are needed; long slotted holes used to absorb tolerances make bearing and slip checks stricter, often requiring three bolts or a slip-resistant connection. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模組角部接頭與螺栓接合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Module corner joints and bolted connections", which statement holds?
options: 只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。
扳手鎖到規定扭矩，就代表螺栓預拉力一定正確。
optionsEn: If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too.
Resisting the 172.8 kN tie force with grade 8.8 M20 bolts in single shear, each gives F_v,Rd = 0.6×800×245/1.25 ≈ 94.1 kN, so 172.8/94.1 ≈ 1.84 and two bolts are needed.
Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload.
quiz.explanation: 繫結力 172.8 kN 以 8.8 級 M20 螺栓單剪承擔，每支 F_v,Rd = 0.6×800×245/1.25 ≈ 94.1 kN，需 172.8/94.1 ≈ 1.84，取 2 支；若為了吸收公差改用長槽孔，承壓與滑移檢核更嚴，常需增加為 3 支或改用摩阻型接合。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Resisting the 172.8 kN tie force with grade 8.8 M20 bolts in single shear, each gives F_v,Rd = 0.6×800×245/1.25 ≈ 94.1 kN, so 172.8/94.1 ≈ 1.84 and two bolts are needed; long slotted holes used to absorb tolerances make bearing and slip checks stricter, often requiring three bolts or a slip-resistant connection. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模組角部接頭與螺栓接合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Module corner joints and bolted connections: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「角部定位錐與連接板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Corner locating cones and plates” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以足尺接頭原型做拉力與剪力試驗，確認強度與滑移量；安裝後檢查螺栓數量、墊圈、鎖固順序與標記，混凝土接頭則以灌漿量紀錄、試體強度與必要時的非破壞檢測確認飽滿。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test full-scale joint prototypes in tension and shear to confirm strength and slip; after installation check bolt count, washers, tightening sequence and marking, and for concrete joints confirm complete filling from grout-volume records, cube strengths and non-destructive testing where needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接頭設計要以三維模型檢查扳手與手孔的施工空間，並在工廠以實體樣品演練；任何接頭形式的變更都須由結構設計者重新簽認，並更新安裝程序書。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check wrench and access-hole space for every joint in the 3D model and rehearse it on a physical sample at the factory; any change to a joint type must be re-signed by the structural designer and reflected in the installation method statement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭在圖面上可行，現場卻因相鄰模組的牆板擋住而放不進扳手，工人只好少鎖或改焊，接頭強度與可檢查性都無從保證；灌漿接頭若排氣不良留下空洞，鋼筋無法發揮錨定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A joint that works on paper cannot take a wrench on site because the neighbouring module's wall panel is in the way, so workers fit fewer bolts or weld instead, leaving strength and inspectability unknown; a grouted joint with poor venting leaves voids so bars cannot develop anchorage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以足尺接頭原型做拉力與剪力試驗，確認強度與滑移量；安裝後檢查螺栓數量、墊圈、鎖固順序與標記，混凝土接頭則以灌漿量紀錄、試體強度與必要時的非破壞檢測確認飽滿。
knowledge.textEn: Test full-scale joint prototypes in tension and shear to confirm strength and slip; after installation check bolt count, washers, tightening sequence and marking, and for concrete joints confirm complete filling from grout-volume records, cube strengths and non-destructive testing where needed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 接頭設計要以三維模型檢查扳手與手孔的施工空間，並在工廠以實體樣品演練；任何接頭形式的變更都須由結構設計者重新簽認，並更新安裝程序書。
knowledge.textEn: Check wrench and access-hole space for every joint in the 3D model and rehearse it on a physical sample at the factory; any change to a joint type must be re-signed by the structural designer and reflected in the installation method statement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模組角部接頭與螺栓接合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Module corner joints and bolted connections"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。
以足尺接頭原型做拉力與剪力試驗，確認強度與滑移量；安裝後檢查螺栓數量、墊圈、鎖固順序與標記，混凝土接頭則以灌漿量紀錄、試體強度與必要時的非破壞檢測確認飽滿。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records.
Test full-scale joint prototypes in tension and shear to confirm strength and slip.
quiz.explanation: 以足尺接頭原型做拉力與剪力試驗，確認強度與滑移量；安裝後檢查螺栓數量、墊圈、鎖固順序與標記，混凝土接頭則以灌漿量紀錄、試體強度與必要時的非破壞檢測確認飽滿。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test full-scale joint prototypes in tension and shear to confirm strength and slip; after installation check bolt count, washers, tightening sequence and marking, and for concrete joints confirm complete filling from grout-volume records, cube strengths and non-destructive testing where needed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模組角部接頭與螺栓接合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Module corner joints and bolted connections: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「角部定位錐與連接板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Corner locating cones and plates” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接頭在圖面上可行，現場卻因相鄰模組的牆板擋住而放不進扳手，工人只好少鎖或改焊，接頭強度與可檢查性都無從保證；灌漿接頭若排氣不良留下空洞，鋼筋無法發揮錨定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A joint that works on paper cannot take a wrench on site because the neighbouring module's wall panel is in the way, so workers fit fewer bolts or weld instead, leaving strength and inspectability unknown; a grouted joint with poor venting leaves voids so bars cannot develop anchorage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：混凝土 PPVC 則以預留鋼筋、續接器與灌漿形成濕式接頭，灌漿飽滿度是品質關鍵。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Concrete PPVC uses projecting bars, couplers and grout to form wet joints, where complete grout filling is the key to quality.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模組接頭只要強度計算通過，安裝方式可以留給現場決定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a module joint passes the strength calculation, how it is installed can be left to the site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接頭在圖面上可行，現場卻因相鄰模組的牆板擋住而放不進扳手，工人只好少鎖或改焊，接頭強度與可檢查性都無從保證；灌漿接頭若排氣不良留下空洞，鋼筋無法發揮錨定。
knowledge.textEn: A joint that works on paper cannot take a wrench on site because the neighbouring module's wall panel is in the way, so workers fit fewer bolts or weld instead, leaving strength and inspectability unknown; a grouted joint with poor venting leaves voids so bars cannot develop anchorage.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模組角部接頭與螺栓接合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Module corner joints and bolted connections" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 接頭在圖面上可行，現場卻因相鄰模組的牆板擋住而放不進扳手，工人只好少鎖或改焊，接頭強度與可檢查性都無從保證；灌漿接頭若排氣不良留下空洞，鋼筋無法發揮錨定。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
模組既然能承受使用荷載，用任何方式吊起來都不會受損。
optionsEn: A joint that works on paper cannot take a wrench on site because the neighbouring module's wall panel is in the way, so workers fit fewer bolts or weld instead, leaving strength and inspectability unknown.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Since a module can carry service loads, any way of lifting it will do no harm.
quiz.explanation: 接頭在圖面上可行，現場卻因相鄰模組的牆板擋住而放不進扳手，工人只好少鎖或改焊，接頭強度與可檢查性都無從保證；灌漿接頭若排氣不良留下空洞，鋼筋無法發揮錨定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A joint that works on paper cannot take a wrench on site because the neighbouring module's wall panel is in the way, so workers fit fewer bolts or weld instead, leaving strength and inspectability unknown; a grouted joint with poor venting leaves voids so bars cannot develop anchorage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 吊點設計、吊具與模組變形：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「吊點與吊裝框」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lift points and lifting frame” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 模組是大而薄的箱體，吊裝時的受力與使用時完全不同：若四條吊索直接斜拉到吊鉤，吊索的水平分力會向內壓擠模組頂框，可能使框架變形、牆板與裝修開裂，所以常用吊裝框或吊梁讓吊索保持垂直。浴室、廚房與機電設備使重心偏離幾何中心，吊起時模組會傾斜，需調整吊點或吊索長度。吊點與吊具屬於臨時工程，必須依起重相關標準設計、標示額定荷重並做荷重試驗。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「吊點與吊裝框」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A module is a large, thin box whose forces in lifting differ completely from those in service: four slings pulled straight to the hook push inward on the top frame with their horizontal components, which can distort the frame and crack wall panels and finishes, so a lifting frame or spreader beam keeps the slings vertical. Bathrooms, kitchens and plant shift the centre of gravity away from the geometric centre, so the module tilts when lifted unless lift points or sling lengths are adjusted. Lift points and lifting gear are temporary works that must be designed to lifting-equipment standards, marked with their rated load and load-tested. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lift points and lifting frame” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 25 t module with a dynamic factor of 1.2 gives a hook load of 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模組既然能承受使用荷載，用任何方式吊起來都不會受損。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Since a module can carry service loads, any way of lifting it will do no harm." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「吊點與吊裝框」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lift points and lifting frame”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊點設計、吊具與模組變形
knowledge.titleEn: Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion
knowledge.text: 模組是大而薄的箱體，吊裝時的受力與使用時完全不同：若四條吊索直接斜拉到吊鉤，吊索的水平分力會向內壓擠模組頂框，可能使框架變形、牆板與裝修開裂，所以常用吊裝框或吊梁讓吊索保持垂直。浴室、廚房與機電設備使重心偏離幾何中心，吊起時模組會傾斜，需調整吊點或吊索長度。
knowledge.textEn: A module is a large, thin box whose forces in lifting differ completely from those in service: four slings pulled straight to the hook push inward on the top frame with their horizontal components, which can distort the frame and crack wall panels and finishes, so a lifting frame or spreader beam keeps the slings vertical. Bathrooms, kitchens and plant shift the centre of gravity away from the geometric centre, so the module tilts when lifted unless lift points or sling lengths are adjusted.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模組既然能承受使用荷載，用任何方式吊起來都不會受損。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Since a module can carry service loads, any way of lifting it will do no harm. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊點設計、吊具與模組變形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion" is correct?
options: 模組既然能承受使用荷載，用任何方式吊起來都不會受損。
模組是大而薄的箱體，吊裝時的受力與使用時完全不同：若四條吊索直接斜拉到吊鉤，吊索的水平分力會向內壓擠模組頂框，可能使框架變形、牆板與裝修開裂，所以常用吊裝框或吊梁讓吊索保持垂直。
只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。
optionsEn: Since a module can carry service loads, any way of lifting it will do no harm.

A module is a large, thin box whose forces in lifting differ completely from those in service: four slings pulled straight to the hook push inward on the top frame with their horizontal components, which can distort the frame and crack wall panels and finishes, so a lifting frame or spreader beam keeps the slings vertical.
If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed.
quiz.explanation: 模組是大而薄的箱體，吊裝時的受力與使用時完全不同：若四條吊索直接斜拉到吊鉤，吊索的水平分力會向內壓擠模組頂框，可能使框架變形、牆板與裝修開裂，所以常用吊裝框或吊梁讓吊索保持垂直。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A module is a large, thin box whose forces in lifting differ completely from those in service: four slings pulled straight to the hook push inward on the top frame with their horizontal components, which can distort the frame and crack wall panels and finishes, so a lifting frame or spreader beam keeps the slings vertical. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊點設計、吊具與模組變形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊點與吊裝框」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lift points and lifting frame” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：模組 25 t、動力係數 1.2，吊重 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN。四肢吊索與水平成 60° 時，每肢張力 T = 294/(4 sin 60°) ≈ 85.0 kN，水平分力 T cos 60° ≈ 42.5 kN 向內壓擠頂框；改用吊裝框使吊索垂直後，每肢 294/4 ≈ 73.6 kN，水平分力趨近 0。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 25 t module with a dynamic factor of 1.2 gives a hook load of 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN. With four sling legs at 60° to the horizontal, each leg carries T = 294/(4 sin 60°) ≈ 85.0 kN and its horizontal component T cos 60° ≈ 42.5 kN squeezes the top frame inward; a lifting frame that keeps slings vertical gives 294/4 ≈ 73.6 kN per leg with nearly zero horizontal component. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：吊點以計算與荷重試驗確認，吊裝框依 EN 13155 一類標準設計並標示額定荷重與自重；每種模組型式在工廠先試吊，量測離地後的傾斜角與框架變形並與重心計算比較，調整後才放行運送。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm lift points by calculation and load test, design the lifting frame to standards such as EN 13155 and mark it with rated load and self-weight; trial-lift each module type at the factory, measuring tilt and frame distortion once clear of the ground against the centre-of-gravity calculation, and release it for shipping only after adjustment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 模組 25 t、動力係數 1.2，吊重 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN。四肢吊索與水平成 60° 時，每肢張力 T = 294/(4 sin 60°) ≈ 85.0 kN，水平分力 T cos 60° ≈ 42.5 kN 向內壓擠頂框；改用吊裝框使吊索垂直後，每肢 294/4 ≈ 73.6 kN，水平分力趨近 0。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 25 t module with a dynamic factor of 1.2 gives a hook load of 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN. With four sling legs at 60° to the horizontal, each leg carries T = 294/(4 sin 60°) ≈ 85.0 kN and its horizontal component T cos 60° ≈ 42.5 kN squeezes the top frame inward; a lifting frame that keeps slings vertical gives 294/4 ≈ 73.6 kN per leg with nearly zero horizontal component. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊點設計、吊具與模組變形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion", which statement holds?
options: 模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。
模組在工廠已做好防水，現場吊裝期間不需要另外防雨。
optionsEn: Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed.
Modules are waterproofed in the factory, so no rain protection is needed during site installation.
A 25 t module with a dynamic factor of 1.2 gives a hook load of 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN.
quiz.explanation: 模組 25 t、動力係數 1.2，吊重 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 25 t module with a dynamic factor of 1.2 gives a hook load of 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吊點設計、吊具與模組變形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊點與吊裝框」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lift points and lifting frame” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 吊點以計算與荷重試驗確認，吊裝框依 EN 13155 一類標準設計並標示額定荷重與自重；每種模組型式在工廠先試吊，量測離地後的傾斜角與框架變形並與重心計算比較，調整後才放行運送。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm lift points by calculation and load test, design the lifting frame to standards such as EN 13155 and mark it with rated load and self-weight; trial-lift each module type at the factory, measuring tilt and frame distortion once clear of the ground against the centre-of-gravity calculation, and release it for shipping only after adjustment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每種模組都要有吊裝計算書與吊點圖，標示重量、重心與吊具配置；吊具須有荷重試驗證明與定期檢查紀錄，吊裝計畫由合格的吊掛負責人簽核，現場依核准的計畫作業。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Every module type needs a lifting calculation and lift-point drawing showing weight, centre of gravity and rigging arrangement; lifting gear needs load-test certificates and periodic inspection records, and the lifting plan is signed by a competent lifting supervisor and followed as approved on site.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未用吊裝框而直接斜拉吊索，模組頂框被壓彎，落位後門框變形、石膏板接縫開裂；重心估算錯誤使模組在高空傾斜，接近定位時撞擊已安裝的模組，造成損壞並威脅下方人員。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Slinging directly at an angle without a lifting frame bends the module's top frame, so after setting the door frames are distorted and plasterboard joints crack; a wrong centre-of-gravity estimate tilts the module at height so it strikes already-installed modules on approach, causing damage and endangering people below. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 吊點以計算與荷重試驗確認，吊裝框依 EN 13155 一類標準設計並標示額定荷重與自重；每種模組型式在工廠先試吊，量測離地後的傾斜角與框架變形並與重心計算比較，調整後才放行運送。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm lift points by calculation and load test, design the lifting frame to standards such as EN 13155 and mark it with rated load and self-weight; trial-lift each module type at the factory, measuring tilt and frame distortion once clear of the ground against the centre-of-gravity calculation, and release it for shipping only after adjustment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每種模組都要有吊裝計算書與吊點圖，標示重量、重心與吊具配置；吊具須有荷重試驗證明與定期檢查紀錄，吊裝計畫由合格的吊掛負責人簽核，現場依核准的計畫作業。
knowledge.textEn: Every module type needs a lifting calculation and lift-point drawing showing weight, centre of gravity and rigging arrangement; lifting gear needs load-test certificates and periodic inspection records, and the lifting plan is signed by a competent lifting supervisor and followed as approved on site.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊點設計、吊具與模組變形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion"?
options: 吊點以計算與荷重試驗確認，吊裝框依 EN 13155 一類標準設計並標示額定荷重與自重。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。
optionsEn: Confirm lift points by calculation and load test, design the lifting frame to standards such as EN 13155 and mark it with rated load and self-weight.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis.
quiz.explanation: 吊點以計算與荷重試驗確認，吊裝框依 EN 13155 一類標準設計並標示額定荷重與自重；每種模組型式在工廠先試吊，量測離地後的傾斜角與框架變形並與重心計算比較，調整後才放行運送。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm lift points by calculation and load test, design the lifting frame to standards such as EN 13155 and mark it with rated load and self-weight; trial-lift each module type at the factory, measuring tilt and frame distortion once clear of the ground against the centre-of-gravity calculation, and release it for shipping only after adjustment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊點設計、吊具與模組變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊點與吊裝框」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lift points and lifting frame” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未用吊裝框而直接斜拉吊索，模組頂框被壓彎，落位後門框變形、石膏板接縫開裂；重心估算錯誤使模組在高空傾斜，接近定位時撞擊已安裝的模組，造成損壞並威脅下方人員。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slinging directly at an angle without a lifting frame bends the module's top frame, so after setting the door frames are distorted and plasterboard joints crack; a wrong centre-of-gravity estimate tilts the module at height so it strikes already-installed modules on approach, causing damage and endangering people below. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：吊點與吊具屬於臨時工程，必須依起重相關標準設計、標示額定荷重並做荷重試驗。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Lift points and lifting gear are temporary works that must be designed to lifting-equipment standards, marked with their rated load and load-tested.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模組既然能承受使用荷載，用任何方式吊起來都不會受損。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Since a module can carry service loads, any way of lifting it will do no harm." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未用吊裝框而直接斜拉吊索，模組頂框被壓彎，落位後門框變形、石膏板接縫開裂；重心估算錯誤使模組在高空傾斜，接近定位時撞擊已安裝的模組，造成損壞並威脅下方人員。
knowledge.textEn: Slinging directly at an angle without a lifting frame bends the module's top frame, so after setting the door frames are distorted and plasterboard joints crack; a wrong centre-of-gravity estimate tilts the module at height so it strikes already-installed modules on approach, causing damage and endangering people below.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊點設計、吊具與模組變形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
未用吊裝框而直接斜拉吊索，模組頂框被壓彎，落位後門框變形、石膏板接縫開裂；重心估算錯誤使模組在高空傾斜，接近定位時撞擊已安裝的模組，造成損壞並威脅下方人員。
只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Slinging directly at an angle without a lifting frame bends the module's top frame, so after setting the door frames are distorted and plasterboard joints crack.
If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed.
quiz.explanation: 未用吊裝框而直接斜拉吊索，模組頂框被壓彎，落位後門框變形、石膏板接縫開裂；重心估算錯誤使模組在高空傾斜，接近定位時撞擊已安裝的模組，造成損壞並威脅下方人員。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Slinging directly at an angle without a lifting frame bends the module's top frame, so after setting the door frames are distorted and plasterboard joints crack; a wrong centre-of-gravity estimate tilts the module at height so it strikes already-installed modules on approach, causing damage and endangering people below. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制」與「堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits" and "Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「起重半徑與受風面積」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crane radius and wind area” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 模組重量集中、外形大，起重機選型要同時考慮吊重、半徑與吊高，最遠、最重的模組通常決定起重機規格。模組像一面帆，受風面積遠大於鋼梁，風會讓吊在空中的模組旋轉與擺動，使定位困難並可能撞擊結構，所以模組吊裝的允許風速通常低於一般吊裝。吊裝順序要讓結構在每個階段都穩定，並配合即時進場的運輸排程，減少工地堆置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「起重半徑與受風面積」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Modules are heavy and bulky, so crane selection must consider load, radius and hook height together, and the farthest, heaviest module usually sets the crane size. A module acts like a sail with far more wind area than a steel beam, so wind turns and swings it in the air, making placement difficult and risking impact with the structure; module lifting therefore usually has a lower permissible wind speed than ordinary lifting. The lifting sequence must keep the structure stable at every stage and match just-in-time delivery to minimise storage on site. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Crane radius and wind area” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A module face of 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m² with C_d = 1.2 and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ takes F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N at 10 m/s and 6,480 N at 15 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「起重半徑與受風面積」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Crane radius and wind area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制
knowledge.titleEn: Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits
knowledge.text: 模組重量集中、外形大，起重機選型要同時考慮吊重、半徑與吊高，最遠、最重的模組通常決定起重機規格。模組像一面帆，受風面積遠大於鋼梁，風會讓吊在空中的模組旋轉與擺動，使定位困難並可能撞擊結構，所以模組吊裝的允許風速通常低於一般吊裝。
knowledge.textEn: Modules are heavy and bulky, so crane selection must consider load, radius and hook height together, and the farthest, heaviest module usually sets the crane size. A module acts like a sail with far more wind area than a steel beam, so wind turns and swings it in the air, making placement difficult and risking impact with the structure; module lifting therefore usually has a lower permissible wind speed than ordinary lifting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits" is correct?
options: 只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。
只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。
模組重量集中、外形大，起重機選型要同時考慮吊重、半徑與吊高，最遠、最重的模組通常決定起重機規格。
optionsEn: If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed.
If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too.
Modules are heavy and bulky, so crane selection must consider load, radius and hook height together, and the farthest, heaviest module usually sets the crane size.
quiz.explanation: 模組重量集中、外形大，起重機選型要同時考慮吊重、半徑與吊高，最遠、最重的模組通常決定起重機規格。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Modules are heavy and bulky, so crane selection must consider load, radius and hook height together, and the farthest, heaviest module usually sets the crane size. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「起重半徑與受風面積」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crane radius and wind area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：模組受風面積 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m²，C_d = 1.2、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³：風速 10 m/s 時 F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N，15 m/s 時 6,480 N。相對於 25 t（約 245 kN）的重量，偏擺角約 atan(6.48/245) ≈ 1.5°，吊索長 40 m 時水平偏移約 40×6.48/245 ≈ 1.06 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A module face of 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m² with C_d = 1.2 and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ takes F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N at 10 m/s and 6,480 N at 15 m/s. Against a 25 t weight of about 245 kN the swing angle is about atan(6.48/245) ≈ 1.5°, so with 40 m of hoist rope the horizontal offset is about 40×6.48/245 ≈ 1.06 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：吊裝前核對每一模組的出廠秤重、吊具重量與半徑，對照起重機荷重表；現場以風速計在吊高處量測陣風，超過計畫門檻即暫停；每次吊裝記錄模組編號、重量、風速與定位時間，作為後續吊次規劃依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before lifting, check each module's weighed factory mass, rigging weight and radius against the crane load chart; measure gusts at hook height with an anemometer and stop when the planned limit is exceeded; record module number, weight, wind speed and placement time for every lift to inform later lift planning.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: A module face of 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m² with C_d = 1.2 and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ takes F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N at 10 m/s and 6,480 N at 15 m/s. Against a 25 t weight of about 245 kN the swing angle is about atan(6.48/245) ≈ 1.5°, so with 40 m of hoist rope the horizontal offset is about 40×6.48/245 ≈ 1.06 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits", which statement holds?
options: 扳手鎖到規定扭矩，就代表螺栓預拉力一定正確。
模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。
optionsEn: A module face of 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m² with C_d = 1.2 and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ takes F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N at 10 m/s and 6,480 N at 15 m/s.
Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload.
Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records.
quiz.explanationEn: A module face of 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m² with C_d = 1.2 and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ takes F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N at 10 m/s and 6,480 N at 15 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「起重半徑與受風面積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crane radius and wind area” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 吊裝前核對每一模組的出廠秤重、吊具重量與半徑，對照起重機荷重表；現場以風速計在吊高處量測陣風，超過計畫門檻即暫停；每次吊裝記錄模組編號、重量、風速與定位時間，作為後續吊次規劃依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before lifting, check each module's weighed factory mass, rigging weight and radius against the crane load chart; measure gusts at hook height with an anemometer and stop when the planned limit is exceeded; record module number, weight, wind speed and placement time for every lift to inform later lift planning. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊裝計畫須列出每一吊次的重量、半徑、使用率、允許風速、牽引繩配置與禁區，經吊掛負責人與工地主任核准；風速、能見度或通訊不符條件時，吊掛負責人有權也有義務停止作業。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lifting plan must list weight, radius, utilisation, permissible wind speed, tag-line arrangement and exclusion zone for every lift, approved by the lifting supervisor and site manager; when wind, visibility or communications fall outside the conditions, the lifting supervisor has both the authority and the duty to stop work.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以設計重量而非出廠秤重規劃吊次，裝修與設備增加的重量使部分吊次超過起重機在該半徑的能力；在陣風中勉強吊裝，模組旋轉撞擊鷹架，拉牽引繩的工人被拖行受傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Planning lifts from design weights instead of weighed factory masses lets added finishes and equipment push some lifts beyond the crane's capacity at that radius; forcing a lift in gusts spins the module into scaffolding and drags tag-line workers, injuring them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 吊裝前核對每一模組的出廠秤重、吊具重量與半徑，對照起重機荷重表；現場以風速計在吊高處量測陣風，超過計畫門檻即暫停；每次吊裝記錄模組編號、重量、風速與定位時間，作為後續吊次規劃依據。
knowledge.textEn: Before lifting, check each module's weighed factory mass, rigging weight and radius against the crane load chart; measure gusts at hook height with an anemometer and stop when the planned limit is exceeded; record module number, weight, wind speed and placement time for every lift to inform later lift planning.

knowledge.textEn: The lifting plan must list weight, radius, utilisation, permissible wind speed, tag-line arrangement and exclusion zone for every lift, approved by the lifting supervisor and site manager; when wind, visibility or communications fall outside the conditions, the lifting supervisor has both the authority and the duty to stop work.

quiz.question: 要驗證「起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits"?

吊裝前核對每一模組的出廠秤重、吊具重量與半徑，對照起重機荷重表。
模組只要上下疊好，自重就足以讓建築維持整體性。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before lifting, check each module's weighed factory mass, rigging weight and radius against the crane load chart.
As long as modules are stacked properly, self-weight alone keeps the building intact.
quiz.explanation: 吊裝前核對每一模組的出廠秤重、吊具重量與半徑，對照起重機荷重表；現場以風速計在吊高處量測陣風，超過計畫門檻即暫停；每次吊裝記錄模組編號、重量、風速與定位時間，作為後續吊次規劃依據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
