Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「起重半徑與受風面積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crane radius and wind area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以設計重量而非出廠秤重規劃吊次，裝修與設備增加的重量使部分吊次超過起重機在該半徑的能力；在陣風中勉強吊裝，模組旋轉撞擊鷹架，拉牽引繩的工人被拖行受傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Planning lifts from design weights instead of weighed factory masses lets added finishes and equipment push some lifts beyond the crane's capacity at that radius; forcing a lift in gusts spins the module into scaffolding and drags tag-line workers, injuring them. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：吊裝順序要讓結構在每個階段都穩定，並配合即時進場的運輸排程，減少工地堆置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The lifting sequence must keep the structure stable at every stage and match just-in-time delivery to minimise storage on site.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以設計重量而非出廠秤重規劃吊次，裝修與設備增加的重量使部分吊次超過起重機在該半徑的能力；在陣風中勉強吊裝，模組旋轉撞擊鷹架，拉牽引繩的工人被拖行受傷。
knowledge.textEn: Planning lifts from design weights instead of weighed factory masses lets added finishes and equipment push some lifts beyond the crane's capacity at that radius; forcing a lift in gusts spins the module into scaffolding and drags tag-line workers, injuring them.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。
以設計重量而非出廠秤重規劃吊次，裝修與設備增加的重量使部分吊次超過起重機在該半徑的能力；在陣風中勉強吊裝，模組旋轉撞擊鷹架，拉牽引繩的工人被拖行受傷。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too.
Planning lifts from design weights instead of weighed factory masses lets added finishes and equipment push some lifts beyond the crane's capacity at that radius.
quiz.explanation: 以設計重量而非出廠秤重規劃吊次，裝修與設備增加的重量使部分吊次超過起重機在該半徑的能力；在陣風中勉強吊裝，模組旋轉撞擊鷹架，拉牽引繩的工人被拖行受傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Planning lifts from design weights instead of weighed factory masses lets added finishes and equipment push some lifts beyond the crane's capacity at that radius; forcing a lift in gusts spins the module into scaffolding and drags tag-line workers, injuring them. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「墊片與堆疊標高」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shims and stack levels” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每個模組出廠時都有高度、長度與方正度的製造公差，堆疊時這些偏差會逐層累積，墊塊壓縮、接頭間隙與裙樓轉換層的平整度也會加入。若不控制，高樓層模組的樓板會越來越不水平、外牆線條歪斜，帷幕或外牆板接縫寬度失控。因此安裝時每隔幾層就要量測標高與垂直度並以墊片修正，裙樓或轉換層頂面的精度要求也必須比一般樓板嚴格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「墊片與堆疊標高」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every module leaves the factory with height, length and squareness tolerances, and in stacking these deviations accumulate floor by floor, joined by packer compression, joint gaps and the flatness of the podium or transfer level. Uncontrolled, upper module floors drift out of level, façade lines lean and cladding joint widths run out of control. Installation therefore measures level and verticality every few storeys and corrects with shims, and the top of the podium or transfer level needs tighter accuracy than an ordinary slab. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shims and stack levels” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每個模組高度公差 ±3 mm、堆疊 30 層：最壞情況累積 30×3 = 90 mm，隨機合成約 √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With ±3 mm height tolerance per module over 30 storeys, worst-case accumulation is 30×3 = 90 mm and random combination about √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「墊片與堆疊標高」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shims and stack levels”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制
knowledge.titleEn: Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control
knowledge.text: 每個模組出廠時都有高度、長度與方正度的製造公差，堆疊時這些偏差會逐層累積，墊塊壓縮、接頭間隙與裙樓轉換層的平整度也會加入。若不控制，高樓層模組的樓板會越來越不水平、外牆線條歪斜，帷幕或外牆板接縫寬度失控。
knowledge.textEn: Every module leaves the factory with height, length and squareness tolerances, and in stacking these deviations accumulate floor by floor, joined by packer compression, joint gaps and the flatness of the podium or transfer level. Uncontrolled, upper module floors drift out of level, façade lines lean and cladding joint widths run out of control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control" is correct?
options: 每個模組出廠時都有高度、長度與方正度的製造公差，堆疊時這些偏差會逐層累積，墊塊壓縮、接頭間隙與裙樓轉換層的平整度也會加入。
只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。
模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。
optionsEn: Every module leaves the factory with height, length and squareness tolerances, and in stacking these deviations accumulate floor by floor, joined by packer compression, joint gaps and the flatness of the podium or transfer level.
If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too.
Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed.
quiz.explanation: 每個模組出廠時都有高度、長度與方正度的製造公差，堆疊時這些偏差會逐層累積，墊塊壓縮、接頭間隙與裙樓轉換層的平整度也會加入。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every module leaves the factory with height, length and squareness tolerances, and in stacking these deviations accumulate floor by floor, joined by packer compression, joint gaps and the flatness of the podium or transfer level. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墊片與堆疊標高」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shims and stack levels” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每個模組高度公差 ±3 mm、堆疊 30 層：最壞情況累積 30×3 = 90 mm，隨機合成約 √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm。若墊塊壓縮比預期少而每層系統偏高 +1 mm，30 層再加 30 mm，隨機與系統合計可能超出外牆接縫 ±20 mm 的調整範圍，所以每 5 層以墊片歸零一次。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With ±3 mm height tolerance per module over 30 storeys, worst-case accumulation is 30×3 = 90 mm and random combination about √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm. If packers compress less than expected so each storey sits 1 mm high, 30 storeys add 30 mm systematically, and random plus systematic error may exceed a ±20 mm façade joint adjustment range, so levels are reset with shims every five storeys. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每安裝一層，以全測站量測模組角點的標高與平面位置，計算與設計的偏差並繪成趨勢；每 5 層做一次整體垂直度與標高檢核，結果連動下一批模組的墊片厚度計畫，並在開始堆疊前先驗收裙樓頂面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each level, measure corner levels and plan positions with a total station, compute deviations from design and plot the trend; every five storeys check overall verticality and level, link the results to the shim plan for the next batch, and accept the podium top surface before stacking starts.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每個模組高度公差 ±3 mm、堆疊 30 層：最壞情況累積 30×3 = 90 mm，隨機合成約 √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm。若墊塊壓縮比預期少而每層系統偏高 +1 mm，30 層再加 30 mm，隨機與系統合計可能超出外牆接縫 ±20 mm 的調整範圍，所以每 5 層以墊片歸零一次。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With ±3 mm height tolerance per module over 30 storeys, worst-case accumulation is 30×3 = 90 mm and random combination about √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm. If packers compress less than expected so each storey sits 1 mm high, 30 storeys add 30 mm systematically, and random plus systematic error may exceed a ±20 mm façade joint adjustment range, so levels are reset with shims every five storeys. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control", which statement holds?
options: 模組在工廠已做好防水，現場吊裝期間不需要另外防雨。
每個模組高度公差 ±3 mm、堆疊 30 層：最壞情況累積 30×3 = 90 mm，隨機合成約 √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm。
模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。
optionsEn: Modules are waterproofed in the factory, so no rain protection is needed during site installation.
With ±3 mm height tolerance per module over 30 storeys, worst-case accumulation is 30×3 = 90 mm and random combination about √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm.
Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis.
quiz.explanation: 每個模組高度公差 ±3 mm、堆疊 30 層：最壞情況累積 30×3 = 90 mm，隨機合成約 √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With ±3 mm height tolerance per module over 30 storeys, worst-case accumulation is 30×3 = 90 mm and random combination about √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「墊片與堆疊標高」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shims and stack levels” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每安裝一層，以全測站量測模組角點的標高與平面位置，計算與設計的偏差並繪成趨勢；每 5 層做一次整體垂直度與標高檢核，結果連動下一批模組的墊片厚度計畫，並在開始堆疊前先驗收裙樓頂面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each level, measure corner levels and plan positions with a total station, compute deviations from design and plot the trend; every five storeys check overall verticality and level, link the results to the shim plan for the next batch, and accept the podium top surface before stacking starts. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：安裝程序書應規定量測頻率、墊片材料與最大厚度、歸零樓層與允許偏差；裙樓頂面驗收列為開始堆疊前的保留點，由測量主管與結構設計者共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The installation method statement must set measurement frequency, shim material and maximum thickness, reset levels and permitted deviations, with podium acceptance as a hold point before stacking begins, signed jointly by the survey lead and the structural designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：裙樓轉換層頂面不平而未先修正，第一層模組就帶著傾斜，後續每層依前一層對位使傾斜延續到頂部，帷幕外牆接縫上寬下窄，只能在高樓層以異形板件收邊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An uneven podium transfer slab left uncorrected tilts the first module level, each later level aligns to the one below so the tilt continues to the roof, and façade joints widen toward the top, ending in special-shaped closure panels at high level. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每安裝一層，以全測站量測模組角點的標高與平面位置，計算與設計的偏差並繪成趨勢；每 5 層做一次整體垂直度與標高檢核，結果連動下一批模組的墊片厚度計畫，並在開始堆疊前先驗收裙樓頂面。
knowledge.textEn: After each level, measure corner levels and plan positions with a total station, compute deviations from design and plot the trend; every five storeys check overall verticality and level, link the results to the shim plan for the next batch, and accept the podium top surface before stacking starts.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 安裝程序書應規定量測頻率、墊片材料與最大厚度、歸零樓層與允許偏差；裙樓頂面驗收列為開始堆疊前的保留點，由測量主管與結構設計者共同簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The installation method statement must set measurement frequency, shim material and maximum thickness, reset levels and permitted deviations, with podium acceptance as a hold point before stacking begins, signed jointly by the survey lead and the structural designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
模組接頭只要強度計算通過，安裝方式可以留給現場決定。
每安裝一層，以全測站量測模組角點的標高與平面位置，計算與設計的偏差並繪成趨勢。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Once a module joint passes the strength calculation, how it is installed can be left to the site.
After each level, measure corner levels and plan positions with a total station, compute deviations from design and plot the trend.
quiz.explanation: 每安裝一層，以全測站量測模組角點的標高與平面位置，計算與設計的偏差並繪成趨勢；每 5 層做一次整體垂直度與標高檢核，結果連動下一批模組的墊片厚度計畫，並在開始堆疊前先驗收裙樓頂面。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After each level, measure corner levels and plan positions with a total station, compute deviations from design and plot the trend; every five storeys check overall verticality and level, link the results to the shim plan for the next batch, and accept the podium top surface before stacking starts. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墊片與堆疊標高」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shims and stack levels” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 裙樓轉換層頂面不平而未先修正，第一層模組就帶著傾斜，後續每層依前一層對位使傾斜延續到頂部，帷幕外牆接縫上寬下窄，只能在高樓層以異形板件收邊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An uneven podium transfer slab left uncorrected tilts the first module level, each later level aligns to the one below so the tilt continues to the roof, and façade joints widen toward the top, ending in special-shaped closure panels at high level. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此安裝時每隔幾層就要量測標高與垂直度並以墊片修正，裙樓或轉換層頂面的精度要求也必須比一般樓板嚴格。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Installation therefore measures level and verticality every few storeys and corrects with shims, and the top of the podium or transfer level needs tighter accuracy than an ordinary slab.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 裙樓轉換層頂面不平而未先修正，第一層模組就帶著傾斜，後續每層依前一層對位使傾斜延續到頂部，帷幕外牆接縫上寬下窄，只能在高樓層以異形板件收邊。
knowledge.textEn: An uneven podium transfer slab left uncorrected tilts the first module level, each later level aligns to the one below so the tilt continues to the roof, and façade joints widen toward the top, ending in special-shaped closure panels at high level.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 裙樓轉換層頂面不平而未先修正，第一層模組就帶著傾斜，後續每層依前一層對位使傾斜延續到頂部，帷幕外牆接縫上寬下窄，只能在高樓層以異形板件收邊。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。
optionsEn: An uneven podium transfer slab left uncorrected tilts the first module level, each later level aligns to the one below so the tilt continues to the roof, and façade joints widen toward the top, ending in special-shaped closure panels at high level.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed.
quiz.explanation: 裙樓轉換層頂面不平而未先修正，第一層模組就帶著傾斜，後續每層依前一層對位使傾斜延續到頂部，帷幕外牆接縫上寬下窄，只能在高樓層以異形板件收邊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An uneven podium transfer slab left uncorrected tilts the first module level, each later level aligns to the one below so the tilt continues to the roof, and façade joints widen toward the top, ending in special-shaped closure panels at high level. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收」與「現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance" and "Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「出廠檢查表」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Factory release checklist” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 模組化的品質大部分在工廠決定：結構焊接、尺寸方正、防水層、防火封堵與機電管線都在出廠前完成，到工地後很難再打開檢查。因此工廠要建立與工地同等嚴格的檢驗制度，包含原物料證明、焊接檢查、尺寸量測、給排水試壓與電氣測試，並由第三方或主管機關在廠內查驗。ICC/MBI 1205 規範廠內與現場檢查及法規符合程序，新加坡則對 PPVC 製造廠實施認證制度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「出廠檢查表」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Most of a module's quality is decided in the factory: structural welds, dimensional squareness, waterproofing, fire stopping and services are all complete before shipping and hard to open up again on site. The factory therefore needs an inspection regime as strict as on site, covering material certificates, weld inspection, dimensional measurement, plumbing pressure tests and electrical tests, with in-plant inspection by third parties or the authority. ICC/MBI 1205 sets in-plant and on-site inspection and regulatory-compliance procedures, and Singapore runs an accreditation scheme for PPVC manufacturers. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Factory release checklist” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The theoretical diagonal of a 3.6 m × 12.0 m module is √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「出廠檢查表」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Factory release checklist”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收
knowledge.text: 模組化的品質大部分在工廠決定：結構焊接、尺寸方正、防水層、防火封堵與機電管線都在出廠前完成，到工地後很難再打開檢查。因此工廠要建立與工地同等嚴格的檢驗制度，包含原物料證明、焊接檢查、尺寸量測、給排水試壓與電氣測試，並由第三方或主管機關在廠內查驗。
knowledge.textEn: Most of a module's quality is decided in the factory: structural welds, dimensional squareness, waterproofing, fire stopping and services are all complete before shipping and hard to open up again on site. The factory therefore needs an inspection regime as strict as on site, covering material certificates, weld inspection, dimensional measurement, plumbing pressure tests and electrical tests, with in-plant inspection by third parties or the authority.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance" is correct?
options: 模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。
模組化的品質大部分在工廠決定：結構焊接、尺寸方正、防水層、防火封堵與機電管線都在出廠前完成，到工地後很難再打開檢查。
扳手鎖到規定扭矩，就代表螺栓預拉力一定正確。
optionsEn: Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed.

Most of a module's quality is decided in the factory: structural welds, dimensional squareness, waterproofing, fire stopping and services are all complete before shipping and hard to open up again on site.
Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload.
quiz.explanation: 模組化的品質大部分在工廠決定：結構焊接、尺寸方正、防水層、防火封堵與機電管線都在出廠前完成，到工地後很難再打開檢查。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Most of a module's quality is decided in the factory: structural welds, dimensional squareness, waterproofing, fire stopping and services are all complete before shipping and hard to open up again on site. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出廠檢查表」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Factory release checklist” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：3.6 m × 12.0 m 模組的理論對角線 √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m。實測兩對角線 12.531 m 與 12.522 m，差 9 mm，大於教學假設的允許差 6 mm，表示框架歪斜，須在出廠前調整，否則角部接頭到現場將無法對位。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The theoretical diagonal of a 3.6 m × 12.0 m module is √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m. Measured diagonals of 12.531 m and 12.522 m differ by 9 mm, more than an assumed allowable 6 mm, showing a racked frame that must be corrected before shipping or the corner joints will not align on site. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個模組出廠前完成檢查表：對角線與高度量測、焊接目視與抽樣非破壞檢測、試水與試壓、電氣絕緣測試、防火封堵照片，由廠內品管與第三方簽名；檢查表與模組編號綁定，隨模組送到工地供驗收比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before shipping, complete a checklist for each module: diagonal and height measurements, visual and sampled non-destructive weld testing, water and pressure tests, electrical insulation tests and photographs of fire stopping, signed by factory QA and a third party; the checklist is tied to the module number and travels with it for comparison at site acceptance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 3.6 m × 12.0 m 模組的理論對角線 √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m。實測兩對角線 12.531 m 與 12.522 m，差 9 mm，大於教學假設的允許差 6 mm，表示框架歪斜，須在出廠前調整，否則角部接頭到現場將無法對位。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The theoretical diagonal of a 3.6 m × 12.0 m module is √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m. Measured diagonals of 12.531 m and 12.522 m differ by 9 mm, more than an assumed allowable 6 mm, showing a racked frame that must be corrected before shipping or the corner joints will not align on site. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。
模組只要上下疊好，自重就足以讓建築維持整體性。
optionsEn: Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records.
As long as modules are stacked properly, self-weight alone keeps the building intact.
The theoretical diagonal of a 3.6 m × 12.0 m module is √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m.
quiz.explanationEn: The theoretical diagonal of a 3.6 m × 12.0 m module is √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出廠檢查表」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Factory release checklist” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個模組出廠前完成檢查表：對角線與高度量測、焊接目視與抽樣非破壞檢測、試水與試壓、電氣絕緣測試、防火封堵照片，由廠內品管與第三方簽名；檢查表與模組編號綁定，隨模組送到工地供驗收比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before shipping, complete a checklist for each module: diagonal and height measurements, visual and sampled non-destructive weld testing, water and pressure tests, electrical insulation tests and photographs of fire stopping, signed by factory QA and a third party; the checklist is tied to the module number and travels with it for comparison at site acceptance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出廠檢查表」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Factory release checklist” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 工廠為了趕交期而跳過試水與試壓，模組堆疊後才發現衛浴管線接頭滲漏，只能拆除已完成的裝修甚至吊出模組；尺寸歪斜的模組被勉強安裝，接頭只能在現場切割修改。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A factory that skips water and pressure tests to meet deadlines finds bathroom pipe joints leaking only after the modules are stacked, forcing removal of finished linings or even lifting modules back out; racked modules forced into place can only be connected by cutting joints on site. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：ICC/MBI 1205 規範廠內與現場檢查及法規符合程序，新加坡則對 PPVC 製造廠實施認證制度。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

steps.title: 現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「螺栓預拉力與封堵檢查」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bolt preload and sealing checks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 模組落位後還有一連串現場工作決定成敗：螺栓鎖固與檢查、灌漿或現場焊接、模組間防水接縫、屋頂與外牆的臨時防護，以及模組之間的防火封堵與隔音。這些位置多半在吊裝後很快被下一個模組遮住，所以必須跟著吊裝節奏逐層檢查。螺栓預拉力透過扭矩係數與鎖固扭矩相關，而扭矩係數會隨表面狀況改變，重要接頭宜以校正過的工具配合轉角法等方式確認。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「螺栓預拉力與封堵檢查」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After a module is set, a chain of site work decides success: bolt tightening and checks, grouting or site welding, waterproof joints between modules, temporary protection of roof and façade, and fire stopping and acoustic sealing between modules. Most of these locations are soon hidden by the next module, so they must be inspected level by level at the pace of lifting. Bolt preload depends on tightening torque through a torque coefficient that varies with surface condition, so critical joints should be confirmed with calibrated tools and methods such as turn-of-nut. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bolt preload and sealing checks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Preload F_p = 0.7·f_ub·A_s = 0.7×800×245 ≈ 137.2 kN for an M20 grade 8.8 bolt.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「扳手鎖到規定扭矩，就代表螺栓預拉力一定正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「螺栓預拉力與封堵檢查」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bolt preload and sealing checks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: After a module is set, a chain of site work decides success: bolt tightening and checks, grouting or site welding, waterproof joints between modules, temporary protection of roof and façade, and fire stopping and acoustic sealing between modules. knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螺栓預拉力與封堵檢查」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bolt preload and sealing checks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預拉力 F_p = 0.7·f_ub·A_s = 0.7×800×245 ≈ 137.2 kN（8.8 級 M20）。以 T = K·F·d 估算扭矩，K = 0.20、d = 0.020 m：T = 0.20×137,200×0.020 ≈ 549 N·m；若潤滑使 K 降為 0.14，同樣扭矩會產生約 137.2×0.20/0.14 ≈ 196 kN，可能超出螺栓降伏。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Preload F_p = 0.7·f_ub·A_s = 0.7×800×245 ≈ 137.2 kN for an M20 grade 8.8 bolt. Estimating torque by T = K·F·d with K = 0.20 and d = 0.020 m gives T = 0.20×137,200×0.020 ≈ 549 N·m; if lubrication lowers K to 0.14, the same torque produces about 137.2×0.20/0.14 ≈ 196 kN, possibly beyond bolt yield. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每層吊裝後由檢查員確認螺栓數量、鎖固標記與抽樣扭矩，灌漿接頭檢查灌漿紀錄；在下一個模組覆蓋前拍照記錄防火封堵與防水接縫，並對外牆接縫做試水，紀錄與模組編號連結。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each level is lifted, an inspector confirms bolt count, tightening marks and sampled torque, and checks grout records for grouted joints; before the next module covers them, fire stopping and waterproof joints are photographed, façade joints are water-tested, and records are linked to module numbers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Preload F_p = 0.7·f_ub·A_s = 0.7×800×245 ≈ 137.2 kN for an M20 grade 8.8 bolt. Estimating torque by T = K·F·d with K = 0.20 and d = 0.020 m gives T = 0.20×137,200×0.020 ≈ 549 N·m; if lubrication lowers K to 0.14, the same torque produces about 137.2×0.20/0.14 ≈ 196 kN, possibly beyond bolt yield. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把接頭檢查、防火封堵與防水接縫列為每一層的保留點，未經檢查員簽認不得吊放覆蓋該處的模組；扭矩工具定期校正，並先在工地以預拉力試驗確認扭矩係數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make joint checks, fire stopping and waterproof joints a hold point at every level, with no covering module lifted until the inspector signs off; calibrate torque tools regularly and confirm the torque coefficient on site with preload tests first.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為趕吊裝進度讓下一個模組先覆蓋，未檢查的接頭從此無法進入；防火封堵遺漏使模組間空腔連通多個樓層，日後火災時煙與火沿空腔蔓延。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rushing the lifting sequence so the next module covers joints before inspection leaves them permanently inaccessible; missing fire stopping links inter-module cavities through several floors so that in a later fire smoke and flame travel along the cavities. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: After each level is lifted, an inspector confirms bolt count, tightening marks and sampled torque, and checks grout records for grouted joints; before the next module covers them, fire stopping and waterproof joints are photographed, façade joints are water-tested, and records are linked to module numbers.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把接頭檢查、防火封堵與防水接縫列為每一層的保留點，未經檢查員簽認不得吊放覆蓋該處的模組；扭矩工具定期校正，並先在工地以預拉力試驗確認扭矩係數。

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
After each level is lifted, an inspector confirms bolt count, tightening marks and sampled torque, and checks grout records for grouted joints.

steps.title: 現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「螺栓預拉力與封堵檢查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bolt preload and sealing checks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為趕吊裝進度讓下一個模組先覆蓋，未檢查的接頭從此無法進入；防火封堵遺漏使模組間空腔連通多個樓層，日後火災時煙與火沿空腔蔓延。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rushing the lifting sequence so the next module covers joints before inspection leaves them permanently inaccessible; missing fire stopping links inter-module cavities through several floors so that in a later fire smoke and flame travel along the cavities. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：螺栓預拉力透過扭矩係數與鎖固扭矩相關，而扭矩係數會隨表面狀況改變，重要接頭宜以校正過的工具配合轉角法等方式確認。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bolt preload depends on tightening torque through a torque coefficient that varies with surface condition, so critical joints should be confirmed with calibrated tools and methods such as turn-of-nut.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「扳手鎖到規定扭矩，就代表螺栓預拉力一定正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為趕吊裝進度讓下一個模組先覆蓋，未檢查的接頭從此無法進入；防火封堵遺漏使模組間空腔連通多個樓層，日後火災時煙與火沿空腔蔓延。
knowledge.textEn: Rushing the lifting sequence so the next module covers joints before inspection leaves them permanently inaccessible; missing fire stopping links inter-module cavities through several floors so that in a later fire smoke and flame travel along the cavities.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
模組在工廠已做好防水，現場吊裝期間不需要另外防雨。
為趕吊裝進度讓下一個模組先覆蓋，未檢查的接頭從此無法進入；防火封堵遺漏使模組間空腔連通多個樓層，日後火災時煙與火沿空腔蔓延。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Modules are waterproofed in the factory, so no rain protection is needed during site installation.
Rushing the lifting sequence so the next module covers joints before inspection leaves them permanently inaccessible.
quiz.explanation: 為趕吊裝進度讓下一個模組先覆蓋，未檢查的接頭從此無法進入；防火封堵遺漏使模組間空腔連通多個樓層，日後火災時煙與火沿空腔蔓延。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rushing the lifting sequence so the next module covers joints before inspection leaves them permanently inaccessible; missing fire stopping links inter-module cavities through several floors so that in a later fire smoke and flame travel along the cavities. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久」與「模組履歷、維修更換與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities" and "Module records, repair and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「模組間空腔」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inter-module cavities” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 模組建築的雙層牆與雙層樓板之間形成許多隱藏空腔，它們讓模組能獨立製造，卻也帶來耐久與防火風險：施工期間未覆蓋的模組頂部遇雨，水會流入空腔與隔熱材中久久不乾；空腔若沒有分隔，火煙可沿著它跨越樓層；鋼接頭藏在空腔內，長期潮濕會鏽蝕卻難以檢查。因此設計要提供空腔分隔、排水與通風路徑，並規劃日後的檢查開口。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「模組間空腔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The double walls and floors of modular buildings create many concealed cavities that allow modules to be made independently but bring durability and fire risks: rain on uncovered module tops during construction runs into cavities and insulation and stays wet for a long time, unsubdivided cavities let fire and smoke cross floors, and steel joints hidden inside can corrode in long-term damp while being hard to inspect. The design must therefore provide cavity barriers, drainage and ventilation paths and plan inspection openings for later. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Inter-module cavities” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一個 3.6 m × 12 m 模組頂面 43.2 m²，若未覆蓋時遇到 50 mm 降雨，落在頂面的雨水約 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³，即約 2,160 L；只要其中一成滲入空腔，就有約 216 L 的水進入隔熱材與石膏板。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The 43.2 m² top of a 3.6 m × 12 m module left uncovered in a 50 mm rainfall receives about 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³, roughly 2,160 L; if only a tenth enters the cavities, about 216 L of water reaches the insulation and plasterboard.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模組在工廠已做好防水，現場吊裝期間不需要另外防雨。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Modules are waterproofed in the factory, so no rain protection is needed during site installation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「模組間空腔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Inter-module cavities”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久
knowledge.titleEn: Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities
knowledge.text: 模組建築的雙層牆與雙層樓板之間形成許多隱藏空腔，它們讓模組能獨立製造，卻也帶來耐久與防火風險：施工期間未覆蓋的模組頂部遇雨，水會流入空腔與隔熱材中久久不乾；空腔若沒有分隔，火煙可沿著它跨越樓層；鋼接頭藏在空腔內，長期潮濕會鏽蝕卻難以檢查。因此設計要提供空腔分隔、排水與通風路徑，並規劃日後的檢查開口。

quiz.question: 關於「模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities" is correct?
