steps.title: 模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模組間空腔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inter-module cavities” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一個 3.6 m × 12 m 模組頂面 43.2 m²，若未覆蓋時遇到 50 mm 降雨，落在頂面的雨水約 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³，即約 2,160 L；只要其中一成滲入空腔，就有約 216 L 的水進入隔熱材與石膏板。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The 43.2 m² top of a 3.6 m × 12 m module left uncovered in a 50 mm rainfall receives about 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³, roughly 2,160 L; if only a tenth enters the cavities, about 216 L of water reaches the insulation and plasterboard. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝期間每天收工前檢查模組頂部的臨時防水覆蓋，雨後以含水率計抽查空腔內木料、石膏板與隔熱材；完工前確認空腔分隔完整，並以內視鏡或預留開口抽查鋼接頭的防蝕狀況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During installation inspect temporary waterproof covers on module tops before the end of each shift, spot-check moisture content of timber, plasterboard and insulation in cavities with a moisture meter after rain, and before completion confirm cavity barriers are complete and check corrosion protection of steel joints through borescopes or planned openings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一個 3.6 m × 12 m 模組頂面 43.2 m²，若未覆蓋時遇到 50 mm 降雨，落在頂面的雨水約 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³，即約 2,160 L；只要其中一成滲入空腔，就有約 216 L 的水進入隔熱材與石膏板。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The 43.2 m² top of a 3.6 m × 12 m module left uncovered in a 50 mm rainfall receives about 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³, roughly 2,160 L; if only a tenth enters the cavities, about 216 L of water reaches the insulation and plasterboard. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities", which statement holds?
options: 模組只要上下疊好，自重就足以讓建築維持整體性。
一個 3.6 m × 12 m 模組頂面 43.2 m²，若未覆蓋時遇到 50 mm 降雨，落在頂面的雨水約 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³，即約 2,160 L。
模組既然能承受使用荷載，用任何方式吊起來都不會受損。
optionsEn: As long as modules are stacked properly, self-weight alone keeps the building intact.
The 43.2 m² top of a 3.6 m × 12 m module left uncovered in a 50 mm rainfall receives about 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³, roughly 2,160 L.
Since a module can carry service loads, any way of lifting it will do no harm.
quiz.explanation: 一個 3.6 m × 12 m 模組頂面 43.2 m²，若未覆蓋時遇到 50 mm 降雨，落在頂面的雨水約 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³，即約 2,160 L；只要其中一成滲入空腔，就有約 216 L 的水進入隔熱材與石膏板。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The 43.2 m² top of a 3.6 m × 12 m module left uncovered in a 50 mm rainfall receives about 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³, roughly 2,160 L; if only a tenth enters the cavities, about 216 L of water reaches the insulation and plasterboard. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模組間空腔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inter-module cavities” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝期間每天收工前檢查模組頂部的臨時防水覆蓋，雨後以含水率計抽查空腔內木料、石膏板與隔熱材；完工前確認空腔分隔完整，並以內視鏡或預留開口抽查鋼接頭的防蝕狀況。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During installation inspect temporary waterproof covers on module tops before the end of each shift, spot-check moisture content of timber, plasterboard and insulation in cavities with a moisture meter after rain, and before completion confirm cavity barriers are complete and check corrosion protection of steel joints through borescopes or planned openings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫要規定每一層吊裝完成後的臨時防水程序與責任人，雨後含水率超過門檻的模組須乾燥並經檢查員確認才能封閉；空腔分隔位置要在圖面與現場標示，並列入消防查驗項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction plan must set the temporary waterproofing procedure and responsible person after each level is lifted; modules whose moisture content exceeds the threshold after rain must be dried and cleared by the inspector before closing, and cavity-barrier locations must be marked on drawings and on site and included in fire inspections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工中臨時防水覆蓋不足，雨水滲入多層模組的空腔，完工後出現發霉、地板變形與異味，只能拆開大量內裝乾燥與更換；空腔分隔遺漏時，火災中的煙可在住戶察覺前擴散到其他樓層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inadequate temporary weather protection lets rain into cavities across several module levels, and after completion mould, buckled floors and odours appear, requiring extensive linings to be opened, dried and replaced; missing cavity barriers let smoke from a fire spread to other floors before occupants notice. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝期間每天收工前檢查模組頂部的臨時防水覆蓋，雨後以含水率計抽查空腔內木料、石膏板與隔熱材；完工前確認空腔分隔完整，並以內視鏡或預留開口抽查鋼接頭的防蝕狀況。
knowledge.textEn: During installation inspect temporary waterproof covers on module tops before the end of each shift, spot-check moisture content of timber, plasterboard and insulation in cavities with a moisture meter after rain, and before completion confirm cavity barriers are complete and check corrosion protection of steel joints through borescopes or planned openings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫要規定每一層吊裝完成後的臨時防水程序與責任人，雨後含水率超過門檻的模組須乾燥並經檢查員確認才能封閉；空腔分隔位置要在圖面與現場標示，並列入消防查驗項目。
knowledge.textEn: The construction plan must set the temporary waterproofing procedure and responsible person after each level is lifted; modules whose moisture content exceeds the threshold after rain must be dried and cleared by the inspector before closing, and cavity-barrier locations must be marked on drawings and on site and included in fire inspections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。
安裝期間每天收工前檢查模組頂部的臨時防水覆蓋，雨後以含水率計抽查空腔內木料、石膏板與隔熱材；完工前確認空腔分隔完整，並以內視鏡或預留開口抽查鋼接頭的防蝕狀況。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too.

During installation inspect temporary waterproof covers on module tops before the end of each shift, spot-check moisture content of timber, plasterboard and insulation in cavities with a moisture meter after rain, and before completion confirm cavity barriers are complete and check corrosion protection of steel joints through borescopes or planned openings.
quiz.explanation: 安裝期間每天收工前檢查模組頂部的臨時防水覆蓋，雨後以含水率計抽查空腔內木料、石膏板與隔熱材；完工前確認空腔分隔完整，並以內視鏡或預留開口抽查鋼接頭的防蝕狀況。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During installation inspect temporary waterproof covers on module tops before the end of each shift, spot-check moisture content of timber, plasterboard and insulation in cavities with a moisture meter after rain, and before completion confirm cavity barriers are complete and check corrosion protection of steel joints through borescopes or planned openings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模組間空腔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inter-module cavities” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 施工中臨時防水覆蓋不足，雨水滲入多層模組的空腔，完工後出現發霉、地板變形與異味，只能拆開大量內裝乾燥與更換；空腔分隔遺漏時，火災中的煙可在住戶察覺前擴散到其他樓層。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inadequate temporary weather protection lets rain into cavities across several module levels, and after completion mould, buckled floors and odours appear, requiring extensive linings to be opened, dried and replaced; missing cavity barriers let smoke from a fire spread to other floors before occupants notice. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此設計要提供空腔分隔、排水與通風路徑，並規劃日後的檢查開口。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The design must therefore provide cavity barriers, drainage and ventilation paths and plan inspection openings for later.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模組在工廠已做好防水，現場吊裝期間不需要另外防雨。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Modules are waterproofed in the factory, so no rain protection is needed during site installation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 施工中臨時防水覆蓋不足，雨水滲入多層模組的空腔，完工後出現發霉、地板變形與異味，只能拆開大量內裝乾燥與更換；空腔分隔遺漏時，火災中的煙可在住戶察覺前擴散到其他樓層。
knowledge.textEn: Inadequate temporary weather protection lets rain into cavities across several module levels, and after completion mould, buckled floors and odours appear, requiring extensive linings to be opened, dried and replaced; missing cavity barriers let smoke from a fire spread to other floors before occupants notice.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 施工中臨時防水覆蓋不足，雨水滲入多層模組的空腔，完工後出現發霉、地板變形與異味，只能拆開大量內裝乾燥與更換。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。
optionsEn: Inadequate temporary weather protection lets rain into cavities across several module levels, and after completion mould, buckled floors and odours appear, requiring extensive linings to be opened, dried and replaced.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records.
quiz.explanation: 施工中臨時防水覆蓋不足，雨水滲入多層模組的空腔，完工後出現發霉、地板變形與異味，只能拆開大量內裝乾燥與更換；空腔分隔遺漏時，火災中的煙可在住戶察覺前擴散到其他樓層。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Inadequate temporary weather protection lets rain into cavities across several module levels, and after completion mould, buckled floors and odours appear, requiring extensive linings to be opened, dried and replaced; missing cavity barriers let smoke from a fire spread to other floors before occupants notice. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 模組履歷、維修更換與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Module records, repair and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「模組履歷」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Module records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 模組建築的每個箱體都是可追溯的產品：材料批號、焊接與試驗紀錄、安裝位置、墊片厚度與接頭檢查都應與模組編號連結。日後改裝時，住戶或設計者必須知道哪些牆是承重框架、哪些是可拆隔間、接頭位在哪裡；若需要修理或更換某個模組，也要知道它的連接方式與吊出路徑。把這些紀錄連到資產資訊模型交給業主，才能讓工廠品質延續到營運期。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「模組履歷」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each box in a modular building is a traceable product: material batches, welding and test records, installed location, shim thickness and joint inspections should all be linked to the module number. In later alterations occupants and designers must know which walls are structural frame, which are removable partitions and where the joints are; if a module must be repaired or replaced, its connections and lift-out route must also be known. Linking these records to the asset information model at handover is what carries the factory's quality into operation. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Module records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 1,866 個模組、每個模組約 30 個品質檢查點估算，共 1,866×30 = 55,980 筆紀錄；若不符合率 0.5%，約有 280 筆需追蹤處置與結案。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 1,866 modules and about 30 quality checkpoints per module there are 1,866×30 = 55,980 records; at a 0.5% nonconformance rate about 280 items need tracking and close-out.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「模組履歷」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Module records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模組履歷、維修更換與交接
knowledge.text: 模組建築的每個箱體都是可追溯的產品：材料批號、焊接與試驗紀錄、安裝位置、墊片厚度與接頭檢查都應與模組編號連結。日後改裝時，住戶或設計者必須知道哪些牆是承重框架、哪些是可拆隔間、接頭位在哪裡；若需要修理或更換某個模組，也要知道它的連接方式與吊出路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Each box in a modular building is a traceable product: material batches, welding and test records, installed location, shim thickness and joint inspections should all be linked to the module number. In later alterations occupants and designers must know which walls are structural frame, which are removable partitions and where the joints are; if a module must be repaired or replaced, its connections and lift-out route must also be known.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模組履歷、維修更換與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Module records, repair and handover" is correct?
options: 模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。
模組建築的每個箱體都是可追溯的產品：材料批號、焊接與試驗紀錄、安裝位置、墊片厚度與接頭檢查都應與模組編號連結。
模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。
optionsEn: Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records.
Each box in a modular building is a traceable product: material batches, welding and test records, installed location, shim thickness and joint inspections should all be linked to the module number.
Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis.
quiz.explanation: 模組建築的每個箱體都是可追溯的產品：材料批號、焊接與試驗紀錄、安裝位置、墊片厚度與接頭檢查都應與模組編號連結。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each box in a modular building is a traceable product: material batches, welding and test records, installed location, shim thickness and joint inspections should all be linked to the module number. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模組履歷、維修更換與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Module records, repair and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模組履歷」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Module records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 1,866 個模組、每個模組約 30 個品質檢查點估算，共 1,866×30 = 55,980 筆紀錄；若不符合率 0.5%，約有 280 筆需追蹤處置與結案。模組數取自公開案例，檢查點數與不符合率為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 1,866 modules and about 30 quality checkpoints per module there are 1,866×30 = 55,980 records; at a 0.5% nonconformance rate about 280 items need tracking and close-out. The module count comes from a public case; checkpoints and nonconformance rate are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前抽查模組編號、位置與紀錄是否一致，確認所有不符合事項已結案；交接文件應包含模組配置圖、承重構件標示、接頭詳圖與檢查紀錄、維護與改裝限制，並由業主的設施管理單位確認可查詢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, spot-check that module numbers, positions and records agree and that every nonconformance is closed; the handover set should include the module layout, identification of structural elements, joint details and inspection records, and maintenance and alteration limits, confirmed as searchable by the owner's facilities team.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 1,866 個模組、每個模組約 30 個品質檢查點估算，共 1,866×30 = 55,980 筆紀錄；若不符合率 0.5%，約有 280 筆需追蹤處置與結案。模組數取自公開案例，檢查點數與不符合率為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 1,866 modules and about 30 quality checkpoints per module there are 1,866×30 = 55,980 records; at a 0.5% nonconformance rate about 280 items need tracking and close-out. The module count comes from a public case; checkpoints and nonconformance rate are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模組履歷、維修更換與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Module records, repair and handover", which statement holds?
options: 模組接頭只要強度計算通過，安裝方式可以留給現場決定。
只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。
以 1,866 個模組、每個模組約 30 個品質檢查點估算，共 1,866×30 = 55,980 筆紀錄。
optionsEn: Once a module joint passes the strength calculation, how it is installed can be left to the site.
If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed.
With 1,866 modules and about 30 quality checkpoints per module there are 1,866×30 = 55,980 records.
quiz.explanation: 以 1,866 個模組、每個模組約 30 個品質檢查點估算，共 1,866×30 = 55,980 筆紀錄；若不符合率 0.5%，約有 280 筆需追蹤處置與結案。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 1,866 modules and about 30 quality checkpoints per module there are 1,866×30 = 55,980 records; at a 0.5% nonconformance rate about 280 items need tracking and close-out. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模組履歷、維修更換與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Module records, repair and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模組履歷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Module records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前抽查模組編號、位置與紀錄是否一致，確認所有不符合事項已結案；交接文件應包含模組配置圖、承重構件標示、接頭詳圖與檢查紀錄、維護與改裝限制，並由業主的設施管理單位確認可查詢。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, spot-check that module numbers, positions and records agree and that every nonconformance is closed; the handover set should include the module layout, identification of structural elements, joint details and inspection records, and maintenance and alteration limits, confirmed as searchable by the owner's facilities team. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主管理規約與使用手冊應寫明模組承重構件不得任意切割，任何改裝須經結構技師評估；模組履歷由業主長期保存，並在產權移轉時一併移交。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owners' rules and user manual must state that structural module members may not be cut freely and that any alteration requires assessment by a structural engineer; module records are kept long-term by the owner and passed on with any change of ownership.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：交接資料只有一般竣工圖，沒有標示模組框架與接頭位置，多年後住戶裝修時切開模組角柱旁的牆，削弱承重框架；需要更換受損模組時，也找不到原始接頭設計與吊裝資料。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Handover with only general as-built drawings, without module frames and joint locations, lets a later tenant fit-out cut a wall beside a corner post and weaken the structural frame; when a damaged module needs replacing, nobody can find the original joint design or lifting data. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前抽查模組編號、位置與紀錄是否一致，確認所有不符合事項已結案；交接文件應包含模組配置圖、承重構件標示、接頭詳圖與檢查紀錄、維護與改裝限制，並由業主的設施管理單位確認可查詢。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover, spot-check that module numbers, positions and records agree and that every nonconformance is closed; the handover set should include the module layout, identification of structural elements, joint details and inspection records, and maintenance and alteration limits, confirmed as searchable by the owner's facilities team.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 業主管理規約與使用手冊應寫明模組承重構件不得任意切割，任何改裝須經結構技師評估；模組履歷由業主長期保存，並在產權移轉時一併移交。
knowledge.textEn: The owners' rules and user manual must state that structural module members may not be cut freely and that any alteration requires assessment by a structural engineer; module records are kept long-term by the owner and passed on with any change of ownership.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模組履歷、維修更換與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Module records, repair and handover"?
options: 交接前抽查模組編號、位置與紀錄是否一致，確認所有不符合事項已結案。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。
optionsEn: Before handover, spot-check that module numbers, positions and records agree and that every nonconformance is closed.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed.
quiz.explanation: 交接前抽查模組編號、位置與紀錄是否一致，確認所有不符合事項已結案；交接文件應包含模組配置圖、承重構件標示、接頭詳圖與檢查紀錄、維護與改裝限制，並由業主的設施管理單位確認可查詢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover, spot-check that module numbers, positions and records agree and that every nonconformance is closed; the handover set should include the module layout, identification of structural elements, joint details and inspection records, and maintenance and alteration limits, confirmed as searchable by the owner's facilities team. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模組履歷、維修更換與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Module records, repair and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模組履歷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Module records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 交接資料只有一般竣工圖，沒有標示模組框架與接頭位置，多年後住戶裝修時切開模組角柱旁的牆，削弱承重框架；需要更換受損模組時，也找不到原始接頭設計與吊裝資料。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Handover with only general as-built drawings, without module frames and joint locations, lets a later tenant fit-out cut a wall beside a corner post and weaken the structural frame; when a damaged module needs replacing, nobody can find the original joint design or lifting data. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把這些紀錄連到資產資訊模型交給業主，才能讓工廠品質延續到營運期。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Linking these records to the asset information model at handover is what carries the factory's quality into operation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 交接資料只有一般竣工圖，沒有標示模組框架與接頭位置，多年後住戶裝修時切開模組角柱旁的牆，削弱承重框架；需要更換受損模組時，也找不到原始接頭設計與吊裝資料。
knowledge.textEn: Handover with only general as-built drawings, without module frames and joint locations, lets a later tenant fit-out cut a wall beside a corner post and weaken the structural frame; when a damaged module needs replacing, nobody can find the original joint design or lifting data.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模組履歷、維修更換與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Module records, repair and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
交接資料只有一般竣工圖，沒有標示模組框架與接頭位置，多年後住戶裝修時切開模組角柱旁的牆，削弱承重框架；需要更換受損模組時，也找不到原始接頭設計與吊裝資料。
模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Handover with only general as-built drawings, without module frames and joint locations, lets a later tenant fit-out cut a wall beside a corner post and weaken the structural frame.
Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis.
quiz.explanation: 交接資料只有一般竣工圖，沒有標示模組框架與接頭位置，多年後住戶裝修時切開模組角柱旁的牆，削弱承重框架；需要更換受損模組時，也找不到原始接頭設計與吊裝資料。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Handover with only general as-built drawings, without module frames and joint locations, lets a later tenant fit-out cut a wall beside a corner post and weaken the structural frame; when a damaged module needs replacing, nobody can find the original joint design or lifting data. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 勒奇山基線隧道
summary: 勒奇山案例的核心不是單純延長隧道，而是已營運路線如何面對分期建造留下的容量與介面限制。BLS公開資料將其描述為約35公里的基線隧道；本課把未裝設段、單線衝突、維修窗口、出水與施工隔離分開，逐步建立可供營運和擴建共同審查的證據鏈。
summaryEn: The Lotschberg case concerns the capacity and interfaces left by staged construction rather than length alone. BLS describes an approximately 35 km base tunnel. This course separates unfinished bore sections, single-track conflicts, maintenance windows, water conditions and construction isolation, building an evidence chain that operations and expansion teams can review together.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 世界隧道與地下巨作
subcategoryTitleEn: World tunnels and underground landmarks

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「單線瓶頸與時距容量」，再獨立計算「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」。原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h。僅把區段占用增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.24324 trains/h。邊界：單方向理論容量，未含對向衝突、延誤或維修；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=23 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=157.714 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為143.377 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity, then independently calculate shared access and transport bottlenecks. Original teaching assumptions: occupation=15 min; clearance=2 min. C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h. Increasing only occupation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.24324 trains/h. Boundary: One-direction theoretical capacity without opposing conflicts, delay or maintenance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=23 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=157.714 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 143.377 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「單線瓶頸與時距容量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 比較勒奇山已營運段與擴建段的共同端點，將未裝軌洞體與不存在的洞段分開，避免把土建完成當交通容量。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare common endpoints across operating and expansion sections, distinguishing an unfitted bore from an unexcavated section before assigning transport capacity. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=13.2 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.2 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 比較勒奇山已營運段與擴建段的共同端點，將未裝軌洞體與不存在的洞段分開，避免把土建完成當交通容量。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Compare common endpoints across operating and expansion sections, distinguishing an unfitted bore from an unexcavated section before assigning transport capacity. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
比較勒奇山已營運段與擴建段的共同端點，將未裝軌洞體與不存在的洞段分開，避免把土建完成當交通容量。
單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Compare common endpoints across operating and expansion sections, distinguishing an unfitted bore from an unexcavated section before assigning transport capacity.
One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity.
quiz.explanation: 比較勒奇山已營運段與擴建段的共同端點，將未裝軌洞體與不存在的洞段分開，避免把土建完成當交通容量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare common endpoints across operating and expansion sections, distinguishing an unfitted bore from an unexcavated section before assigning transport capacity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=13.2 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=13.2 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14.52 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.2 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14.52 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment.

steps.instructionEn: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只有洞體未裝軌的段落若算入容量，會虛構列車交會點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting an unfitted bore creates fictitious train-passing opportunities. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只有洞體未裝軌的段落若算入容量，會虛構列車交會點。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting an unfitted bore creates fictitious train-passing opportunities. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity.

steps.title: 單線瓶頸與時距容量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「區段占用時間」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section occupation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以勒奇山單線與雙線相接為情境，將對向列車等待和清空時間分開，辨認貨客混行的容量限制。一段單線或共用道岔會把連續鐵路變成受時間窗限制的系統，清空時間與衝突進路和列車行走時間同樣重要。單方向理論容量只提供上界比較；雙向交會、延誤傳播及維修封鎖會改變可實現班次，必須在共同時距圖中檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「區段占用時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At a single-to-double-track transition, separate opposing-train waiting from clearance time and identify the constraints imposed by mixed passenger and freight traffic. A single-track section or shared turnout creates time-window constraints, making clearance and conflicting routes as important as travel time. One-direction theoretical capacity gives only a comparison bound. Opposing movements, propagated delays and maintenance closures alter achievable service and must be examined together on a common timetable diagram. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Section occupation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「區段占用時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。從列車通過與路線釋放時間戳重建占用，對照進路衝突表，再測試一班延誤如何影響後續交會而非只看平均準點。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added. Reconstruct occupation from passage and release timestamps, compare the route-conflict table and test how one delay affects subsequent meets. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「區段占用時間」的交付需回答：重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。容量報告附衝突進路、列車性能和維修窗，任何新增班次須由營運方用可重播的時距圖驗證，不只比較單一每小時數字。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the section occupation time handover must address the following evidence: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added. Capacity reports include conflicting routes, train performance and maintenance windows; operations validates additions with replayable timetables rather than one hourly figure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只算單向班距會漏掉對向衝突，使時刻表名目容量無法實現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One-direction headways omit opposing conflicts and overstate timetable capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 本案「區段占用時間」的交付需回答：重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。容量報告附衝突進路、列車性能和維修窗，任何新增班次須由營運方用可重播的時距圖驗證，不只比較單一每小時數字。

quiz.question: 要驗證「單線瓶頸與時距容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 單線瓶頸與時距容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「區段占用時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Section occupation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只算單向班距會漏掉對向衝突，使時刻表名目容量無法實現。把清空時間省略或把雙向列車當同方向排列會高估容量，實際服務可能需要長時間等待才能保留安全間隔。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One-direction headways omit opposing conflicts and overstate timetable capacity. Omitting clearance or treating opposing trains as one-direction traffic overstates capacity and requires long real waits to preserve separation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單方向理論容量只提供上界比較；雙向交會、延誤傳播及維修封鎖會改變可實現班次，必須在共同時距圖中檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Opposing movements, propagated delays and maintenance closures alter achievable service and must be examined together on a common timetable diagram.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只算單向班距會漏掉對向衝突，使時刻表名目容量無法實現。把清空時間省略或把雙向列車當同方向排列會高估容量，實際服務可能需要長時間等待才能保留安全間隔。
knowledge.textEn: One-direction headways omit opposing conflicts and overstate timetable capacity. Omitting clearance or treating opposing trains as one-direction traffic overstates capacity and requires long real waits to preserve separation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「單線瓶頸與時距容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
只算單向班距會漏掉對向衝突，使時刻表名目容量無法實現。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
One-direction headways omit opposing conflicts and overstate timetable capacity.
quiz.explanation: 只算單向班距會漏掉對向衝突，使時刻表名目容量無法實現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One-direction headways omit opposing conflicts and overstate timetable capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基線縱坡與牽引需求」與「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" and "Piezometric head and lining pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡度阻力功率」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grade-resistance power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 比較基線路線的低坡度與列車質量，將坡度功率和站外加速需求分開，避免把省能全歸於隧道長度。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare low-gradient alignment and train mass, separating grade power from approach acceleration rather than attributing all energy benefit to tunnel length. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grade-resistance power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.26e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0054 無因次；速度=20 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.26e+06 kg; grade=0.0054 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡度阻力功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grade-resistance power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求
knowledge.text: 比較基線路線的低坡度與列車質量，將坡度功率和站外加速需求分開，避免把省能全歸於隧道長度。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。
knowledge.textEn: Compare low-gradient alignment and train mass, separating grade power from approach acceleration rather than attributing all energy benefit to tunnel length. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基線縱坡與牽引需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" is correct?
options: 比較基線路線的低坡度與列車質量，將坡度功率和站外加速需求分開，避免把省能全歸於隧道長度。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Compare low-gradient alignment and train mass, separating grade power from approach acceleration rather than attributing all energy benefit to tunnel length.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 比較基線路線的低坡度與列車質量，將坡度功率和站外加速需求分開，避免把省能全歸於隧道長度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare low-gradient alignment and train mass, separating grade power from approach acceleration rather than attributing all energy benefit to tunnel length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坡度阻力功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grade-resistance power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.26e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0054 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1334.94 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1468.44 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.26e+06 kg; grade=0.0054 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1334.94 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1468.44 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對縱斷面坡度符號、列車質量和同速區段的功率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check gradient sign, train mass and power over equal-speed sections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.26e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0054 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1334.94 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1468.44 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.26e+06 kg; grade=0.0054 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1334.94 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1468.44 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基線縱坡與牽引需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Base-alignment grade and traction demand", which statement holds?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
原創教學假設：列車質量=1.26e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0054 無因次；速度=20 m/s。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.26e+06 kg; grade=0.0054 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.26e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0054 無因次；速度=20 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.26e+06 kg; grade=0.0054 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡度阻力功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grade-resistance power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對縱斷面坡度符號、列車質量和同速區段的功率。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check gradient sign, train mass and power over equal-speed sections. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：核對縱斷面坡度符號、列車質量和同速區段的功率。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Check gradient sign, train mass and power over equal-speed sections. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：下坡回生未計效率時可能被當作全部可回收能量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring regenerative efficiency can overstate recoverable downhill energy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對縱斷面坡度符號、列車質量和同速區段的功率。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check gradient sign, train mass and power over equal-speed sections. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：核對縱斷面坡度符號、列車質量和同速區段的功率。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。
knowledge.textEn: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Check gradient sign, train mass and power over equal-speed sections. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.

Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Check gradient sign, train mass and power over equal-speed sections.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡度阻力功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grade-resistance power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 下坡回生未計效率時可能被當作全部可回收能量。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring regenerative efficiency can overstate recoverable downhill energy. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Ignoring regenerative efficiency can overstate recoverable downhill energy. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences.

No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 勒奇山擴建的教學模型保留營運孔排水與新開挖孔之間的水力連通，檢查新排水是否改變既有孔外壓。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Retain hydraulic connectivity between the operating bore and a hypothetical new heading, testing whether new drainage changes pressure around the existing bore. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=45 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=45 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓
knowledge.text: 勒奇山擴建的教學模型保留營運孔排水與新開挖孔之間的水力連通，檢查新排水是否改變既有孔外壓。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。
knowledge.textEn: Retain hydraulic connectivity between the operating bore and a hypothetical new heading, testing whether new drainage changes pressure around the existing bore. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometric head and lining pressure" is correct?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
勒奇山擴建的教學模型保留營運孔排水與新開挖孔之間的水力連通，檢查新排水是否改變既有孔外壓。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Retain hydraulic connectivity between the operating bore and a hypothetical new heading, testing whether new drainage changes pressure around the existing bore.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 勒奇山擴建的教學模型保留營運孔排水與新開挖孔之間的水力連通，檢查新排水是否改變既有孔外壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain hydraulic connectivity between the operating bore and a hypothetical new heading, testing whether new drainage changes pressure around the existing bore. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=45 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為485.595 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=45 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 485.595 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：配對兩孔水頭與出流歷線，標示新孔施工事件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair both-bore heads and flows against new-heading construction events.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=45 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為485.595 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=45 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 485.595 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Piezometric head and lining pressure", which statement holds?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=45 m。

Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=45 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=45 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=45 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 配對兩孔水頭與出流歷線，標示新孔施工事件。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair both-bore heads and flows against new-heading construction events. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同水頭下降不應被誤判為兩套排水設備同時改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shared drawdown should not be mistaken for independent improvement of both drainage systems. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：配對兩孔水頭與出流歷線，標示新孔施工事件。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。

Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
