steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同水頭下降不應被誤判為兩套排水設備同時改善。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shared drawdown should not be mistaken for independent improvement of both drainage systems. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共同水頭下降不應被誤判為兩套排水設備同時改善。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Shared drawdown should not be mistaken for independent improvement of both drainage systems. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
共同水頭下降不應被誤判為兩套排水設備同時改善。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shared drawdown should not be mistaken for independent improvement of both drainage systems.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 共同水頭下降不應被誤判為兩套排水設備同時改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shared drawdown should not be mistaken for independent improvement of both drainage systems. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支護啟動與變形容量」與「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Support activation and deformation capacity" and "Shared access and transport bottlenecks": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在未完成洞段重新進場的情境中，分析舊支護齡期、暴露環境與新開挖釋放的疊加，不直接沿用原施工期參數。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For re-entry to an unfinished section, examine aged support, exposure and renewed excavation release rather than reusing original construction parameters unchanged. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=33 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=33 kN/mm; movement=9 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護啟動與變形容量
knowledge.text: 在未完成洞段重新進場的情境中，分析舊支護齡期、暴露環境與新開挖釋放的疊加，不直接沿用原施工期參數。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。
knowledge.textEn: For re-entry to an unfinished section, examine aged support, exposure and renewed excavation release rather than reusing original construction parameters unchanged. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support activation and deformation capacity" is correct?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
在未完成洞段重新進場的情境中，分析舊支護齡期、暴露環境與新開挖釋放的疊加，不直接沿用原施工期參數。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
For re-entry to an unfinished section, examine aged support, exposure and renewed excavation release rather than reusing original construction parameters unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 在未完成洞段重新進場的情境中，分析舊支護齡期、暴露環境與新開挖釋放的疊加，不直接沿用原施工期參數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For re-entry to an unfinished section, examine aged support, exposure and renewed excavation release rather than reusing original construction parameters unchanged. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護安裝時點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support activation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：局部剛度=33 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=297 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為326.7 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=33 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=297 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 326.7 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將舊裂縫圖與新收斂基線配對，區分既有和新增變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=33 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=297 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為326.7 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=33 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=297 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 326.7 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支護啟動與變形容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support activation and deformation capacity", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=33 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=33 kN/mm; movement=9 mm.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=33 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=33 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護安裝時點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support activation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將舊裂縫圖與新收斂基線配對，區分既有和新增變形。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將舊裂縫圖與新收斂基線配對，區分既有和新增變形。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把舊裂縫全部視為新施工所致會誤導支護判讀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Attributing all old cracks to new works misdirects support interpretation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將舊裂縫圖與新收斂基線配對，區分既有和新增變形。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將舊裂縫圖與新收斂基線配對，區分既有和新增變形。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
knowledge.textEn: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support activation and deformation capacity"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
將舊裂縫圖與新收斂基線配對，區分既有和新增變形。
單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement.
One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity.
quiz.explanation: 將舊裂縫圖與新收斂基線配對，區分既有和新增變形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護安裝時點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support activation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把舊裂縫全部視為新施工所致會誤導支護判讀。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Attributing all old cracks to new works misdirects support interpretation. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把舊裂縫全部視為新施工所致會誤導支護判讀。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。
knowledge.textEn: Attributing all old cracks to new works misdirects support interpretation. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護啟動與變形容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support activation and deformation capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
把舊裂縫全部視為新施工所致會誤導支護判讀。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Attributing all old cracks to new works misdirects support interpretation.
quiz.explanation: 把舊裂縫全部視為新施工所致會誤導支護判讀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Attributing all old cracks to new works misdirects support interpretation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 營運旁擴建需要共用入口時，列車、材料與維修人員各自占用時間，不能假設夜間窗口全供出渣。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When expansion shares access with operations, trains, materials and maintainers each occupy time; a night window is not entirely available for spoil transport. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=23 t；往返週期=35 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=23 t; cycle=35 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸
knowledge.text: 營運旁擴建需要共用入口時，列車、材料與維修人員各自占用時間，不能假設夜間窗口全供出渣。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。
knowledge.textEn: When expansion shares access with operations, trains, materials and maintainers each occupy time; a night window is not entirely available for spoil transport. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 營運旁擴建需要共用入口時，列車、材料與維修人員各自占用時間，不能假設夜間窗口全供出渣。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: When expansion shares access with operations, trains, materials and maintainers each occupy time; a night window is not entirely available for spoil transport.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 營運旁擴建需要共用入口時，列車、材料與維修人員各自占用時間，不能假設夜間窗口全供出渣。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When expansion shares access with operations, trains, materials and maintainers each occupy time; a night window is not entirely available for spoil transport. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出渣運輸節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Muck-transport cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=23 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=157.714 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為143.377 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=23 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=157.714 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 143.377 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將保護設置和恢復營運時間從窗口中明確扣除。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Explicitly deduct protection setup and restoration time from each access window.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=23 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=157.714 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為143.377 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=23 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=157.714 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 143.377 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shared access and transport bottlenecks", which statement holds?
options: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=23 t；往返週期=35 min。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=23 t; cycle=35 min.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=23 t；往返週期=35 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=23 t; cycle=35 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出渣運輸節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Muck-transport cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將保護設置和恢復營運時間從窗口中明確扣除。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Explicitly deduct protection setup and restoration time from each access window. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：將保護設置和恢復營運時間從窗口中明確扣除。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Explicitly deduct protection setup and restoration time from each access window. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略恢復檢查會使最後一車出渣與首班營運列車衝突。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted restoration checks create conflict between the final spoil movement and first service. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將保護設置和恢復營運時間從窗口中明確扣除。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Explicitly deduct protection setup and restoration time from each access window. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：將保護設置和恢復營運時間從窗口中明確扣除。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
knowledge.textEn: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Explicitly deduct protection setup and restoration time from each access window. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shared access and transport bottlenecks"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
將保護設置和恢復營運時間從窗口中明確扣除。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
Explicitly deduct protection setup and restoration time from each access window.
quiz.explanation: 將保護設置和恢復營運時間從窗口中明確扣除。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Explicitly deduct protection setup and restoration time from each access window. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出渣運輸節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Muck-transport cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略恢復檢查會使最後一車出渣與首班營運列車衝突。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted restoration checks create conflict between the final spoil movement and first service. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略恢復檢查會使最後一車出渣與首班營運列車衝突。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted restoration checks create conflict between the final spoil movement and first service. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 忽略恢復檢查會使最後一車出渣與首班營運列車衝突。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Omitted restoration checks create conflict between the final spoil movement and first service.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 忽略恢復檢查會使最後一車出渣與首班營運列車衝突。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted restoration checks create conflict between the final spoil movement and first service. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「控制網與貫通誤差」與「通風網路與壓力損失」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Control network and breakthrough error" and "Ventilation network and pressure loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 擴建需接回既有軌道控制網，研究新舊坐標、溫度和軌道維修基準不一致所造成的累積偏差。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Expansion must reconnect with existing track control, so examine bias from differing coordinate revisions, temperatures and maintenance reference systems. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=3360 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3360 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0423533 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與貫通誤差
knowledge.text: 擴建需接回既有軌道控制網，研究新舊坐標、溫度和軌道維修基準不一致所造成的累積偏差。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。
knowledge.textEn: Expansion must reconnect with existing track control, so examine bias from differing coordinate revisions, temperatures and maintenance reference systems. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control network and breakthrough error" is correct?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
擴建需接回既有軌道控制網，研究新舊坐標、溫度和軌道維修基準不一致所造成的累積偏差。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Expansion must reconnect with existing track control, so examine bias from differing coordinate revisions, temperatures and maintenance reference systems.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 擴建需接回既有軌道控制網，研究新舊坐標、溫度和軌道維修基準不一致所造成的累積偏差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Expansion must reconnect with existing track control, so examine bias from differing coordinate revisions, temperatures and maintenance reference systems. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=3360 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0423533 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0465887 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3360 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0423533 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0465887 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立控制線核對新舊網的尺度及高程轉換。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Independently verify scale and height transformations between old and new networks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

原創教學假設：控制長度=3360 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。

One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立控制線核對新舊網的尺度及高程轉換。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Independently verify scale and height transformations between old and new networks. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：以獨立控制線核對新舊網的尺度及高程轉換。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently verify scale and height transformations between old and new networks. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只比坐標數字而未比版本可能把基準移動當結構位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing coordinates without revisions confuses datum change with structural movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control network and breakthrough error"?
options: 以獨立控制線核對新舊網的尺度及高程轉換。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Independently verify scale and height transformations between old and new networks.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 以獨立控制線核對新舊網的尺度及高程轉換。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Independently verify scale and height transformations between old and new networks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方向角誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orientation error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只比坐標數字而未比版本可能把基準移動當結構位移。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing coordinates without revisions confuses datum change with structural movement. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只比坐標數字而未比版本可能把基準移動當結構位移。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing coordinates without revisions confuses datum change with structural movement. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與貫通誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control network and breakthrough error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只比坐標數字而未比版本可能把基準移動當結構位移。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Comparing coordinates without revisions confuses datum change with structural movement.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 只比坐標數字而未比版本可能把基準移動當結構位移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing coordinates without revisions confuses datum change with structural movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風道摩擦壓損」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以施工區與營運區隔離為題，分析門位及施工風管改變時兩區壓差，保留營運事故模式的獨立需求。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風道摩擦壓損」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Study pressure differences across construction-operational isolation as doors and temporary ducts change, retaining the separate requirements of operational incident modes. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Duct friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=620 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=620 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.7 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=31.8292 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風道摩擦壓損」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Duct friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

options: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。

Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=31.8292 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 38.5134 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在核准隔離狀態下比對施工側風量與營運側壓差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare construction airflow and operational pressure under approved isolation states.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=620 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=31.8292 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為38.5134 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=620 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.7 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=31.8292 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 38.5134 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風網路與壓力損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation network and pressure loss", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=620 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=620 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=620 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.7 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=31.8292 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風道摩擦壓損」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在核准隔離狀態下比對施工側風量與營運側壓差。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare construction airflow and operational pressure under approved isolation states. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：在核准隔離狀態下比對施工側風量與營運側壓差。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Compare construction airflow and operational pressure under approved isolation states. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工排風若短路到營運區，兩側感測器可能各自顯示正常局部風速。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A construction-air shortcut may coexist with apparently normal local velocities on both sides. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在核准隔離狀態下比對施工側風量與營運側壓差。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare construction airflow and operational pressure under approved isolation states. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：在核准隔離狀態下比對施工側風量與營運側壓差。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
knowledge.textEn: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Compare construction airflow and operational pressure under approved isolation states. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation network and pressure loss"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在核准隔離狀態下比對施工側風量與營運側壓差。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare construction airflow and operational pressure under approved isolation states.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 在核准隔離狀態下比對施工側風量與營運側壓差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare construction airflow and operational pressure under approved isolation states. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風道摩擦壓損」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 施工排風若短路到營運區，兩側感測器可能各自顯示正常局部風速。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A construction-air shortcut may coexist with apparently normal local velocities on both sides. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 施工排風若短路到營運區，兩側感測器可能各自顯示正常局部風速。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。
knowledge.textEn: A construction-air shortcut may coexist with apparently normal local velocities on both sides. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通風網路與壓力損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation network and pressure loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
施工排風若短路到營運區，兩側感測器可能各自顯示正常局部風速。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
A construction-air shortcut may coexist with apparently normal local velocities on both sides.
quiz.explanation: 施工排風若短路到營運區，兩側感測器可能各自顯示正常局部風速。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A construction-air shortcut may coexist with apparently normal local velocities on both sides. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「疏散時間與分區可用性」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Evacuation time and zone availability" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「所需疏散時間」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分期工程的避難路徑可能穿越暫時封閉區域，建立依施工階段變動的路線圖，不能只保留最終完工配置。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Staged works can temporarily close an escape route; maintain stage-specific access maps rather than relying only on the final completed arrangement. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=86 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=86 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「所需疏散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Required evacuation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性
knowledge.text: 分期工程的避難路徑可能穿越暫時封閉區域，建立依施工階段變動的路線圖，不能只保留最終完工配置。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。
knowledge.textEn: Staged works can temporarily close an escape route; maintain stage-specific access maps rather than relying only on the final completed arrangement. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evacuation time and zone availability" is correct?
options: 分期工程的避難路徑可能穿越暫時封閉區域，建立依施工階段變動的路線圖，不能只保留最終完工配置。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Staged works can temporarily close an escape route; maintain stage-specific access maps rather than relying only on the final completed arrangement.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 分期工程的避難路徑可能穿越暫時封閉區域，建立依施工階段變動的路線圖，不能只保留最終完工配置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Staged works can temporarily close an escape route; maintain stage-specific access maps rather than relying only on the final completed arrangement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「所需疏散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Required evacuation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：前置時間=86 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=536 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為581 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=86 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=536 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 581 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：走查每個施工階段的門位、可通行淨寬和資訊標示。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Walk each stage to check door state, usable width and signs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：前置時間=86 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=536 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為581 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=86 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=536 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 581 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疏散時間與分區可用性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Evacuation time and zone availability", which statement holds?
options: 單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。
原創教學假設：前置時間=86 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity.
Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=86 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：前置時間=86 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=86 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「所需疏散時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Required evacuation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 走查每個施工階段的門位、可通行淨寬和資訊標示。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Walk each stage to check door state, usable width and signs. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：走查每個施工階段的門位、可通行淨寬和資訊標示。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Walk each stage to check door state, usable width and signs. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：舊版逃生圖若仍指向施工封閉段，距離計算再精確也無效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An obsolete map leading into a closed works zone invalidates precise distance calculations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evacuation time and zone availability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
走查每個施工階段的門位、可通行淨寬和資訊標示。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Walk each stage to check door state, usable width and signs.
quiz.explanation: 走查每個施工階段的門位、可通行淨寬和資訊標示。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Walk each stage to check door state, usable width and signs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「所需疏散時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Required evacuation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 舊版逃生圖若仍指向施工封閉段，距離計算再精確也無效。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An obsolete map leading into a closed works zone invalidates precise distance calculations. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 舊版逃生圖若仍指向施工封閉段，距離計算再精確也無效。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。
knowledge.textEn: An obsolete map leading into a closed works zone invalidates precise distance calculations. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「疏散時間與分區可用性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evacuation time and zone availability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 舊版逃生圖若仍指向施工封閉段，距離計算再精確也無效。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: An obsolete map leading into a closed works zone invalidates precise distance calculations.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 舊版逃生圖若仍指向施工封閉段，距離計算再精確也無效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An obsolete map leading into a closed works zone invalidates precise distance calculations. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 擴建介面需把舊設備識別碼、控制位址與新竣工資料連結，檢查維修系統是否能辨認同名不同孔設備。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Link legacy identifiers and control addresses to expansion records, testing whether maintenance systems distinguish similarly named assets in different bores. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=103 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=103 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.466 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 擴建介面需把舊設備識別碼、控制位址與新竣工資料連結，檢查維修系統是否能辨認同名不同孔設備。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。
knowledge.textEn: Link legacy identifiers and control addresses to expansion records, testing whether maintenance systems distinguish similarly named assets in different bores. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
擴建介面需把舊設備識別碼、控制位址與新竣工資料連結，檢查維修系統是否能辨認同名不同孔設備。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Link legacy identifiers and control addresses to expansion records, testing whether maintenance systems distinguish similarly named assets in different bores.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 擴建介面需把舊設備識別碼、控制位址與新竣工資料連結，檢查維修系統是否能辨認同名不同孔設備。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Link legacy identifiers and control addresses to expansion records, testing whether maintenance systems distinguish similarly named assets in different bores. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=103 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.466 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為82.9126 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=103 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.466 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 82.9126 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽樣由現場標籤追到圖紙、控制點及檢修紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample the trace from field label to drawing, control point and maintenance record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 82.9126 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset identity and traceable handover", which statement holds?
options: 基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證
