steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽樣由現場標籤追到圖紙、控制點及檢修紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample the trace from field label to drawing, control point and maintenance record. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽樣由現場標籤追到圖紙、控制點及檢修紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample the trace from field label to drawing, control point and maintenance record. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重複識別碼會把故障回報派到錯誤孔別，完整表格也可能內容錯配。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Duplicate identifiers send fault responses to the wrong bore despite apparently complete records. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Sample the trace from field label to drawing, control point and maintenance record. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽樣由現場標籤追到圖紙、控制點及檢修紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 抽樣由現場標籤追到圖紙、控制點及檢修紀錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Sample the trace from field label to drawing, control point and maintenance record.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 抽樣由現場標籤追到圖紙、控制點及檢修紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample the trace from field label to drawing, control point and maintenance record. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重複識別碼會把故障回報派到錯誤孔別，完整表格也可能內容錯配。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Duplicate identifiers send fault responses to the wrong bore despite apparently complete records. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重複識別碼會把故障回報派到錯誤孔別，完整表格也可能內容錯配。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: Duplicate identifiers send fault responses to the wrong bore despite apparently complete records. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
重複識別碼會把故障回報派到錯誤孔別，完整表格也可能內容錯配。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Duplicate identifiers send fault responses to the wrong bore despite apparently complete records.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 重複識別碼會把故障回報派到錯誤孔別，完整表格也可能內容錯配。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Duplicate identifiers send fault responses to the wrong bore despite apparently complete records. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 切內里基線隧道
summary: 切內里是瑞士新阿爾卑斯鐵路線的南段關鍵，官方資料列長15.4公里並於2020年底全面營運。本課由縱坡與列車需求出發，連接施工物流、軌道基準、隧道氣動和設備交付；學員須解釋土建完成之後仍有哪些測試才能支持完整鐵路服務。
summaryEn: Ceneri is a southern link of the Swiss new transalpine railway, officially described as 15.4 km and fully operational at the end of 2020. Starting with gradient and train demand, this course connects construction logistics, track reference systems, tunnel aerodynamics and equipment handover to the evidence needed beyond civil completion.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 世界隧道與地下巨作
subcategoryTitleEn: World tunnels and underground landmarks

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「基線縱坡與牽引需求」，再獨立計算「控制網與貫通誤差」。原創教學假設：列車質量=1.28e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0052 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1436.5 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：控制長度=3480 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0421788 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0463967 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate base-alignment grade and traction demand, then independently calculate control network and breakthrough error. Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.28e+06 kg; grade=0.0052 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1436.5 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: control length=3480 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0421788 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0463967 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「基線縱坡與牽引需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Base-alignment grade and traction demand": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響切內里基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ceneri Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將切內里基線孔與兩端接線分開，研究站間時間與隧道內行程不是同一計量邊界。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate the base bore from its approaches and distinguish station-to-station time from travel within the tunnel. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=13.6 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.6 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 將切內里基線孔與兩端接線分開，研究站間時間與隧道內行程不是同一計量邊界。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Separate the base bore from its approaches and distinguish station-to-station time from travel within the tunnel. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
將切內里基線孔與兩端接線分開，研究站間時間與隧道內行程不是同一計量邊界。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Separate the base bore from its approaches and distinguish station-to-station time from travel within the tunnel.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
quiz.explanation: 將切內里基線孔與兩端接線分開，研究站間時間與隧道內行程不是同一計量邊界。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate the base bore from its approaches and distinguish station-to-station time from travel within the tunnel. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=13.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=13.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14.96 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14.96 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=13.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=13.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14.96 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14.96 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
原創教學假設：長度=13.6 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Original teaching assumptions: length=13.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.6 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=13.6 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.6 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略站外接線會把隧道理論節時當成全線實際節時。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting approaches equates theoretical tunnel savings with whole-route savings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略站外接線會把隧道理論節時當成全線實際節時。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting approaches equates theoretical tunnel savings with whole-route savings. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略站外接線會把隧道理論節時當成全線實際節時。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting approaches equates theoretical tunnel savings with whole-route savings. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
忽略站外接線會把隧道理論節時當成全線實際節時。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Omitting approaches equates theoretical tunnel savings with whole-route savings.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
quiz.explanation: 忽略站外接線會把隧道理論節時當成全線實際節時。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting approaches equates theoretical tunnel savings with whole-route savings. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡度阻力功率」如何影響切內里基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grade-resistance power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ceneri Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以切內里低坡度路線連接區域與長途列車為題，分析相同坡度對不同質量列車的牽引需求。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use the low-gradient link to compare traction demand for regional and long-distance trains with different masses. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grade-resistance power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.28e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0052 無因次；速度=20 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.28e+06 kg; grade=0.0052 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡度阻力功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grade-resistance power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求
knowledge.text: 以切內里低坡度路線連接區域與長途列車為題，分析相同坡度對不同質量列車的牽引需求。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。
knowledge.textEn: Use the low-gradient link to compare traction demand for regional and long-distance trains with different masses. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基線縱坡與牽引需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" is correct?
options: 基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
以切內里低坡度路線連接區域與長途列車為題，分析相同坡度對不同質量列車的牽引需求。
optionsEn: A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Use the low-gradient link to compare traction demand for regional and long-distance trains with different masses.
quiz.explanation: 以切內里低坡度路線連接區域與長途列車為題，分析相同坡度對不同質量列車的牽引需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use the low-gradient link to compare traction demand for regional and long-distance trains with different masses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坡度阻力功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grade-resistance power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.28e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0052 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1436.5 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.28e+06 kg; grade=0.0052 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1436.5 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.28e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0052 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1436.5 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.28e+06 kg; grade=0.0052 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1436.5 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基線縱坡與牽引需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Base-alignment grade and traction demand", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.28e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0052 無因次；速度=20 m/s。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.28e+06 kg; grade=0.0052 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.28e+06 kg; grade=0.0052 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡度阻力功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grade-resistance power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以空車質量估滿載運轉會低估坡度阻力，尤其混編比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using empty mass understates grade resistance in loaded and mixed formations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。
knowledge.textEn: For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基線縱坡與牽引需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Base-alignment grade and traction demand"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡度阻力功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grade-resistance power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以空車質量估滿載運轉會低估坡度阻力，尤其混編比較。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using empty mass understates grade resistance in loaded and mixed formations. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以空車質量估滿載運轉會低估坡度阻力，尤其混編比較。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。
knowledge.textEn: Using empty mass understates grade resistance in loaded and mixed formations. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基線縱坡與牽引需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
以空車質量估滿載運轉會低估坡度阻力，尤其混編比較。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Using empty mass understates grade resistance in loaded and mixed formations.
quiz.explanation: 以空車質量估滿載運轉會低估坡度阻力，尤其混編比較。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using empty mass understates grade resistance in loaded and mixed formations. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「破碎帶連通與預報更新」與「掘進利用率與設備停時」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" and "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「破碎帶連通性」如何影響切內里基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault-zone connectivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ceneri Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 切內里山區教學剖面保留節理方向改變，分析同岩性不同構造如何影響掌子面穩定與探查布置。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「破碎帶連通性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Retain changing joint orientation in a teaching section, examining how structure changes face behaviour even within the same rock type. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault-zone connectivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.2 無因次；通水面積=240 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.2 dimensionless; flow area=240 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「破碎帶連通性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fault-zone connectivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新
knowledge.text: 切內里山區教學剖面保留節理方向改變，分析同岩性不同構造如何影響掌子面穩定與探查布置。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。
knowledge.textEn: Retain changing joint orientation in a teaching section, examining how structure changes face behaviour even within the same rock type. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" is correct?
options: 切內里山區教學剖面保留節理方向改變，分析同岩性不同構造如何影響掌子面穩定與探查布置。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Retain changing joint orientation in a teaching section, examining how structure changes face behaviour even within the same rock type.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
quiz.explanation: 切內里山區教學剖面保留節理方向改變，分析同岩性不同構造如何影響掌子面穩定與探查布置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain changing joint orientation in a teaching section, examining how structure changes face behaviour even within the same rock type. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「破碎帶連通性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fault-zone connectivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.2 無因次；通水面積=240 m²。Q=k i A=0.00264 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.002904 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.2 dimensionless; flow area=240 m². Q=k i A=0.00264 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.002904 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按方位而非只按岩名整理揭露資料，核對探孔代表性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Organise exposures by orientation as well as lithology and check probe representativeness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.2 無因次；通水面積=240 m²。Q=k i A=0.00264 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.002904 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.2 dimensionless; flow area=240 m². Q=k i A=0.00264 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.002904 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「破碎帶連通與預報更新」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fault connectivity and forecast updating", which statement holds?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.2 無因次；通水面積=240 m²。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.2 dimensionless; flow area=240 m².
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.2 無因次；通水面積=240 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.2 dimensionless; flow area=240 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「破碎帶連通性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fault-zone connectivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按方位而非只按岩名整理揭露資料，核對探孔代表性。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Organise exposures by orientation as well as lithology and check probe representativeness. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：按方位而非只按岩名整理揭露資料，核對探孔代表性。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Organise exposures by orientation as well as lithology and check probe representativeness. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同岩名即採同支護會漏掉新形成的可動節理塊體。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assigning support by rock name alone misses newly removable joint blocks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按方位而非只按岩名整理揭露資料，核對探孔代表性。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Organise exposures by orientation as well as lithology and check probe representativeness. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：按方位而非只按岩名整理揭露資料，核對探孔代表性。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
knowledge.textEn: For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Organise exposures by orientation as well as lithology and check probe representativeness. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fault connectivity and forecast updating"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
按方位而非只按岩名整理揭露資料，核對探孔代表性。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Organise exposures by orientation as well as lithology and check probe representativeness.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「破碎帶連通性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fault-zone connectivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同岩名即採同支護會漏掉新形成的可動節理塊體。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assigning support by rock name alone misses newly removable joint blocks. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「破碎帶連通與預報更新」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：機制與系統路徑

Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand. steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效掘進利用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：切削速率=1.62 m/h；有效利用率=0.295 無因次。D=24vu=11.4696 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.6166 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.62 m/h; utilisation=0.295 dimensionless. D=24vu=11.4696 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 12.6166 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對兩個假想班次使用相同總工時與完整停時分類。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use equal total shift time and complete downtime classes for both hypothetical shifts.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：試驗與驗證

quiz.question: 在「掘進利用率與設備停時」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只以最快切削分鐘比較兩方法會誤判整班生產能力。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Comparing only the fastest cutting minutes misjudges whole-shift production.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 只以最快切削分鐘比較兩方法會誤判整班生產能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing only the fastest cutting minutes misjudges whole-shift production. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」與「控制網與貫通誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" and "Control network and breakthrough error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響切內里基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ceneri Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雙孔設備安裝同時進行時，軌道板、電纜與通風材料共用運輸通道，研究施工隊介面造成的等待。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During simultaneous twin-bore installation, track components, cables and ventilation materials share access and create inter-team queues. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=24 t；往返週期=34 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=24 t; cycle=34 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸
knowledge.text: 雙孔設備安裝同時進行時，軌道板、電纜與通風材料共用運輸通道，研究施工隊介面造成的等待。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。
knowledge.textEn: During simultaneous twin-bore installation, track components, cables and ventilation materials share access and create inter-team queues. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
雙孔設備安裝同時進行時，軌道板、電纜與通風材料共用運輸通道，研究施工隊介面造成的等待。
optionsEn: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
During simultaneous twin-bore installation, track components, cables and ventilation materials share access and create inter-team queues.
quiz.explanation: 雙孔設備安裝同時進行時，軌道板、電纜與通風材料共用運輸通道，研究施工隊介面造成的等待。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: During simultaneous twin-bore installation, track components, cables and ventilation materials share access and create inter-team queues. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出渣運輸節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Muck-transport cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=24 t；往返週期=34 min。C=N payload 60/T=169.412 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為154.011 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=24 t; cycle=34 min. C=N payload 60/T=169.412 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 154.011 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按材料類別比較到場、卸載和實際安裝時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare arrival, unloading and installation times by material class.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=24 t；往返週期=34 min。C=N payload 60/T=169.412 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為154.011 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=24 t; cycle=34 min. C=N payload 60/T=169.412 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 154.011 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shared access and transport bottlenecks", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=24 t；往返週期=34 min。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=24 t; cycle=34 min.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=24 t；往返週期=34 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=24 t; cycle=34 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出渣運輸節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Muck-transport cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按材料類別比較到場、卸載和實際安裝時間。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare arrival, unloading and installation times by material class. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：按材料類別比較到場、卸載和實際安裝時間。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Compare arrival, unloading and installation times by material class. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：材料到場被列為完成安裝會高估可用工作面和剩餘窗口。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating delivery as installation completion overstates available work fronts and remaining time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按材料類別比較到場、卸載和實際安裝時間。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare arrival, unloading and installation times by material class. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：按材料類別比較到場、卸載和實際安裝時間。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
knowledge.textEn: For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Compare arrival, unloading and installation times by material class. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shared access and transport bottlenecks"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
按材料類別比較到場、卸載和實際安裝時間。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare arrival, unloading and installation times by material class.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
quiz.explanation: 按材料類別比較到場、卸載和實際安裝時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare arrival, unloading and installation times by material class. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出渣運輸節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Muck-transport cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 材料到場被列為完成安裝會高估可用工作面和剩餘窗口。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating delivery as installation completion overstates available work fronts and remaining time. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 材料到場被列為完成安裝會高估可用工作面和剩餘窗口。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。
knowledge.textEn: Treating delivery as installation completion overstates available work fronts and remaining time. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
材料到場被列為完成安裝會高估可用工作面和剩餘窗口。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Treating delivery as installation completion overstates available work fronts and remaining time.
quiz.explanation: 材料到場被列為完成安裝會高估可用工作面和剩餘窗口。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating delivery as installation completion overstates available work fronts and remaining time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響切內里基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ceneri Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軌道與接觸網在切內里長孔內需共享幾何基準，分析土建控制點與軌道調整坐標之間的轉換。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track and overhead systems need a shared geometric reference; examine transformations from civil control to adjusted railway coordinates. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=3480 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3480 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0421788 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與貫通誤差
knowledge.text: 軌道與接觸網在切內里長孔內需共享幾何基準，分析土建控制點與軌道調整坐標之間的轉換。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。
knowledge.textEn: Track and overhead systems need a shared geometric reference; examine transformations from civil control to adjusted railway coordinates. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control network and breakthrough error" is correct?
options: 軌道與接觸網在切內里長孔內需共享幾何基準，分析土建控制點與軌道調整坐標之間的轉換。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
optionsEn: Track and overhead systems need a shared geometric reference; examine transformations from civil control to adjusted railway coordinates.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 軌道與接觸網在切內里長孔內需共享幾何基準，分析土建控制點與軌道調整坐標之間的轉換。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Track and overhead systems need a shared geometric reference; examine transformations from civil control to adjusted railway coordinates. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=3480 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0421788 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0463967 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3480 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0421788 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0463967 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：獨立核對軌頂高程、中心線和接觸網定位的版本。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Independently reconcile rail elevation, centreline and overhead positioning revisions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3480 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0421788 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0463967 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control network and breakthrough error", which statement holds?
options: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
原創教學假設：控制長度=3480 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Original teaching assumptions: control length=3480 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0421788 m.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3480 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3480 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0421788 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 獨立核對軌頂高程、中心線和接觸網定位的版本。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Independently reconcile rail elevation, centreline and overhead positioning revisions. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：獨立核對軌頂高程、中心線和接觸網定位的版本。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently reconcile rail elevation, centreline and overhead positioning revisions. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同基準各自閉合仍可能使設備淨空在介面處不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Individually closed networks can still create inadequate interface clearance if their references differ. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Independently reconcile rail elevation, centreline and overhead positioning revisions. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：獨立核對軌頂高程、中心線和接觸網定位的版本。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
